Hold on just a second... okay, so this goes here, and that connects like this...
There! Problem solved! When it comes to this genius scientist,
there's no problem that I can't fix!

Oh? Kept you waiting, did I? I'm Washington!
Genius scientist and the brains of the Red Dragon Organization!
There's nothing I "can't" do!
keys.WashingtonRegularIdle50Key:
Hm? Just now... I think I heard someone say "can't" somewhere in the distance...
Ugh, it makes me feel so agitated... Whenever I hear that word, I just can't stand it!
keys.WashingtonRegularLogin46Key:
Commander Luther's already told me everything. Let's move, and quickly!
Heh. No matter what happens, we'll be fine — I, Washington the genius, is with you!
keys.WashingtonRegularTap47Key:
Ah—there you are! I won't let you get away when we've got a score to settle.
Now then, face me! You're not going anywhere until I win!
keys.WashingtonRegularTap48Key:
Learning the piano's harder than I thought... but I'm going to master it, no matter what!
And someday — I'll even surpass Chopin herself!
keys.WashingtonRegularTap49Key:
All those new theories making waves in the scientific journals right now? Oh, I built the foundational framework for every one of them.
I just got bored once they moved into the application phase. I'm already researching the next frontier.
keys.WaterElfWarriorGacha21Key:
My name is Eves. I am a platoon leader
in the marine squadron Seaspires. As a veteran,
I look forward to serving under your command, sir!
keys.WaterLancerGirlGacha41Key:
Here's pirate girl Adena!
You're lucky, with me around
soon you'll have all the treasure in the world.
OK then, let's get our adventure started!
I'm sure there's more gold and silver out there
than we can carry!
keys.WaterPriestessGacha39Key:
Hello, my name's Esma.
I am the queen of
the small nation of Laomis.
It's a beautiful land.
My people are all kind-hearted and generous,
and the seaside scenery is lovely.
I would be glad to show it to you sometime.
We could gaze on the evening sky, with stars
like pearls in the heavens...
keys.WeaponStatsTextKey:
HP is how much health is added to the character equipping this weapon.

Attack is also added to the Attack stat of the character equipping this weapon.

Awakening increases the HP and Attack of the weapon.

Boosts give stat bonuses and can be gained from Powering Up with Boost Gems

Potential increases HP and Attack by a percentage, and can be increased by Powering Up with Ore of Potential.
keys.WhiteKnightGacha45Key:
The name's Lucius. I'm a knight of Hymelia.
I am grateful to the Soul Stone miracle
that brought us this fateful encounter.

Oh, is there something in your eyes? Could it be
the light reflected off my armor? This armor is full of stories.
It has been handed down in my family for generations.
keys.WhiteKnightIdle50Key:
What's with the dazed look?
If the general can't stay sharp, the soldiers will get nervous.
keys.WhiteKnightLogin46Key:
Hey, I've been waiting.
Let's go, we've got each other's backs.
keys.WhiteKnightTap47Key:
Hey!
Are you interested in my ancestral armor?
Then I'll have to tell you all the legends surrounding it!
keys.WhiteKnightTap48Key:
Hmm-hmm♪ Huh? What am I doing?
I'm just taking care of my armor. It's all covered in decorations, so the dirt really builds up.
keys.WhiteKnightTap49Key:
Do you... Have any friends?
Can you imagine a future with them?
I.... Oh, never mind.
keys.WhiteSnakeGirlDarkGacha45Key: It is I, Akame Mizuchi, the one ranked second among the Four Masters of Onmyo. What irony that an onmyoji should gain the power of an oni....hehe. I feel so fantastic now... I want to let go of everything and just...kill. It seems it would be so much fun!
keys.WhiteSnakeGirlDarkIdle50Key:
My head feels a bit foggy... I feel like there's something I'm forgetting...something trying to call out to me...
He he, but there's no need to dwell on it. Nothing matters anymore...
keys.WhiteSnakeGirlDarkLogin46Key:
Are you not ready to go yet? Well...I'll give you 10 more seconds.
If you're still not ready then, can I just kill you?
keys.WhiteSnakeGirlDarkTap47Key:
It pains me to think of the fate awaiting my former colleagues of the Onmyo Bureau... They're all doomed to be devoured by oni...
Hehe, such a shame, it soooo breaks my heart.
keys.WhiteSnakeGirlDarkTap48Key:
You seem to be such a responsible person... But doesn't all that responsibility feel suffocating?
Why don't you join me and become an oni? You'll be freed from any and all concerns...
keys.WhiteSnakeGirlDarkTap49Key:
Can you hear that voice...? No? So only I can hear it...
But it's just a matter of time. Soon, you'll be able to hear Mama's voice too...
keys.WhiteSnakeGirlGacha45Key:
I am Mizuchi Akame, one of the onmyoji elites.
I am an ally of the forgotten,
and defender of the mortal.

Because one day they will be found.
Until then, I will keep on fighting alone,
no matter if others approve or not.

Oh, but thank you for
subscribing to my channel!
Don't forget to hit that like button!
keys.WhiteSnakeGirlIdle50Key:
This room is so cold...
Zzzz...
Huh, I fell asleep.
Cold is my one weakness!
keys.WhiteSnakeGirlLogin46Key:
Morning! It's Mizuchi, famous Orotuber! Huh?
What is happening? Is the yin and yang imbalance interfering with my connection!?
keys.WhiteSnakeGirlTap47Key:
Yes, I am the strongest member of the onmyoji.
What's that? Some other girls said I wasn't?
I see, I see...
Heehee, it looks like they need a little reminder.
keys.WhiteSnakeGirlTap48Key:
Hey, hasn't that boring guy been talking whatever he wants for a while now?
I don't remember inviting him as a guest!
And who is that goofy sounding person I can hear right now? I don't remember summoning a shikigami like this, either...
keys.WhiteSnakeGirlTap49Key:
Stillness and motion. That is also the harmony between yin and yang.
When you are tired, get some rest.
No, no! You can't go to sleep now!
I'm getting ready to stream!
keys.WouldYouLikeToKeepPlayingKey: Would you like to continue playing or go to the main menu?
keys.XiaoLiRegularGacha45Key:
Heeeey! I'm Xiao Li, the strongest and bestest martial artist ever!

What about you, are you strong...? Hmmmm...
Ooh, I'm getting strong vibes from you!!
So how about it? Can you fight me with all your might?
keys.XiaoLiRegularIdle50Key:
Hmmmm...I sense a strong presence from over there...
I bet it's someone powerful! He he he, Xiao Li will be on her way to meet this person shortly!
keys.XiaoLiRegularLogin46Key:
Well someone sure took their timeー!
I've gotten so bored while waiting for you that I've started fights with some of the locals here♪ And of course, I've won them all!
keys.XiaoLiRegularTap47Key:
Huh? This smell... I smell dumplings!
I'm so hungry... Where are those dumplingsーCome on out, my dear dumplings!
keys.XiaoLiRegularTap48Key:
No...please, no more... I don't wanna do homework...
Mmm...huh? Oh, it was just a dream...
So I guess that's one thing in this world which even the mighty Xiao Li cannot beat...
keys.XiaoLiRegularTap49Key:
There's someone I desperately want to meet, who I really look up to!
Do you know her? She's called Lü Bu! She's like strong as a gorilla!
keys.YamatoRegularGacha45Key:
A pleasure to make your acquaintance!
I'm Yamato, Student Council President of Shinano Academy!

As a Vessel, and above all, as a representative
of all the students, I want to protect everyone!
Please, lend me your strength!
keys.YamatoRegularIdle50Key:
It's so quiet... Alright, let's go do some patrols!
This is all part of the President's job!
keys.YamatoRegularLogin46Key:
Ah, I was just about to head out.
Are you ready? Then let's weigh anchor!
keys.YamatoRegularTap47Key:
I asked Rio to handle my weapon's maintenance, but...
she makes some strange modifications. The other day, she attached a bull horn...
keys.YamatoRegularTap48Key:
You're interested in the military stuff too!? Let's have a chat!!
What do you think of Ship No. 111? ...Is that too niche?
keys.YamatoRegularTap49Key:
I often get asked for relationship advice...As the Student Council President, I'd like to answer, but...
I don't have experience myself, so I can't answer...
keys.YandereMaidDarkGacha45Key:
I'm Clarice, the black maid.
I will destroy anything you wish.
Just give me the command.

Are you ready?
Let the show of darkness and euphoria begin!
keys.YandereMaidDarkIdle50Key:
Phew...I think I can take a little break here...
It's not easy acting all the time...
keys.YandereMaidDarkLogin46Key:
You're 30 seconds late. Are you telling me you can't listen to my orders?
Or is it that you want to be punished? Kuhuhu.
keys.YandereMaidDarkTap47Key:
Would you be quiet for a moment? I was admiring Miss Ludmilla's profile...
How uncultured you are. Do you want me to close that mouth for you?
keys.YandereMaidDarkTap48Key:
A little warning for you: beware of the wicked mage.
You might be brainwashed before you know it. Oh...could it be that you already are?
keys.YandereMaidDarkTap49Key:
The expression of someone in pain is so beautiful...
Especially when a confident man starts trembling in fear—I can't get enough of it!
keys.YandereMaidGacha45Key:
I am Clarice, a humble maid.
Are you my new master?
Cooking, cleaning laundry....

Infiltration, tracking, assassination...
Whatever your orders, I'm happy to obey.
As long as you are a fit master.
One never knows when this blade with change directions.
It's an unpredictable thing.
Kuhuhu, what are your orders?
keys.YandereMaidIdle50Key:
What are you you doing resting?
When my mistress is working so hard?
This is the perfect chance to eliminate an obstacle...
My mistress will be worried, though.
keys.YandereMaidLogin46Key:
Oh, have you been here all along?
You are so much more insignificant than my mistress, I didn't notice you.
keys.YandereMaidRaceQueenGacha45Key:
Kuhuhu, this is the first time you see this costume, correct?
My mistress picked it for me, so that we can have matching looks!

When I put it on, there's no race I cannot win♪
keys.YandereMaidRaceQueenIdle50Key:
Everyone's gone somewhere else...
I can finally enjoy my photos of Miss Ludmilla in her race queen costume in peace... Kuhu, kuhuhu♪
keys.YandereMaidRaceQueenLogin46Key:
Miss Lud—Ah. It's just you.
Well, hurry up and get in the car!
I'll have you know I don't normally let anyone but my mistress ride with me, so be grateful!
keys.YandereMaidRaceQueenTap47Key: Beautiful roses have their thorns, and this beautiful race queen has her irresistible love♪
keys.YandereMaidRaceQueenTap48Key: I will always and forever be Miss Ludmilla's maid. I might be a race queen right now, but that is one role I'm never going to retire from!
keys.YandereMaidRaceQueenTap49Key:
Kuhuhu, matching outfits with my mistress...♪
Ah, I can feel her warmth just by wearing this...
keys.YandereMaidSwimsuitGacha45Key:
I am Clarice, a servant of, for,
and exclusive to my mistress.
I came in summer clothing today.

My mistress chose this outfit for me.
Does it suit me?
Now, what are you doing here?

I was about to show myself to Mistress Ludmilla, and you have interrupted,
calling on me all of a sudden.
Kuhuhu... Are you ready for your penance?
keys.YandereMaidSwimsuitIdle50Key:
You know I am here, and yet still your guard is down.
Not even a thought of being poisoned.
I will admit it. Your attitude has a certain resemblance to my mistress. Resemblance only. Nothing more than that.
keys.YandereMaidSwimsuitLogin46Key:
Mistress? Mistress!
What? I called you by her name?
O-Oh, oooh nooo...
What a terrible mistake...
Vile, terrible, horrible, unforgivable...
keys.YandereMaidSwimsuitTap47Key:
...
Do you not see I am ignoring you?
I would appreciate you never speaking to me again.
keys.YandereMaidSwimsuitTap48Key:
...
I told you not to talk, didn't I?
I accept such open frankness aimed directly at me from one person and one person only...
keys.YandereMaidSwimsuitTap49Key:
Oh, mistress! You look wonderful in a swimsuit, as well!
Me, too?
Kuhuhu, thank you.
This person here said the same...
Ah, no. Never mind.
keys.YandereMaidTap47Key:
Such familiarity with my mistress...!
Die, die, die a thousand deaths!
But first, you will reveal to me everything you have done with her...
Kuhuhu, no sleep for you tonight!
keys.YandereMaidTap48Key:
What I like?
Number one is my mistress, and number two is my mistress...
Numbers three, four, five...
Care to guess who is six and seven? What else?
Well... I don't hate plants, or tea.
Or fairy tales either...
keys.YandereMaidTap49Key:
Were you that little country girl's brother?
Where did you learn to cook like that?
That's—Huh!? I see.
I think you should do this instead.
keys.YourRestoreCodeTextKey:
Your restore code is

%d

Do not share this restore code with anybody.
keys.ZeusRegularGacha45Key:
Who is it that awakens me?
O one who knows no fear…
Very well, I shall answer your call.

I am Zeus, with absolute power and authority!
The one who governs all heaven and earth!
keys.ZeusRegularIdle50Key:
Hmm... what an utterly meaningless stretch of time...
Perhaps I should order the Valkyries to do some combat training... Or maybe I'll have Rizette make some tea instead...
keys.ZeusRegularLogin46Key:
You must have quite the death wish to keep me waiting...
I shall grant you one chance to redeem yourself. Now go!
keys.ZeusRegularTap47Key:
The most repulsive thing in this world is a heart of betrayal...
Even I possess a heart that despises such things...
keys.ZeusRegularTap48Key:
Love is such a fragile thing... Can a creature like you grasp this?
Hmph... That was a pointless question.
keys.ZeusRegularTap49Key:
You wish to see me smile? You ask the strangest of things...
But if that is what you wish, it's simple. Kneel right there and lick my boots!
keys.ZoroRegularGacha45Key:
Mucho gusto—pleased to meet you.
The Marvelous Zoro has arrived!

Oh my, you seem bored as well.
Would you care to join me in a little work?
I'm sure a delightful adventure awaits us!
keys.ZoroRegularIdle50Key:
No one's around.

Let's slip away while we can... and go treasure hunting!
keys.ZoroRegularLogin46Key:
My, you are quite punctual.
Excellent, let us head off to our delightful work!
keys.ZoroRegularTap47Key: I like pretty and beautiful things. The person I love most is my adorable younger sister. What I hate might be bugs crawling on the ground.
keys.ZoroRegularTap48Key:
The crispy and creamy crema catalana is usually a dessert for special days.
But my sister said it was delicious, so in our home we have it every day!
keys.ZoroRegularTap49Key:
I'm not very close with my father... It's not that I dislike him.
It's just that we have nothing to talk about... It's complicated...

- Certain Arenas and Champion's Arenas failing to complete their daily reward handout

We apologize for both issues and are working to address the causes, we will be arranging a compensation package once we have confirmed the issues are resolved.

いつもエバーテイルをご利用いただき、ありがとうございます。

「ジグザゲーム超懸賞祭」のデイリー懸賞につきまして、ギフトコード発行を行う提携先「デジコ」のサービス復旧に伴い、本日2026年10月28日より、デイリー懸賞の結果発表を再開いたします。

■ デイリー懸賞の再開について
2026年10月23日0:00（日本時間）の発表分より一時停止していたデイリー懸賞の結果発表を、本日より再開いたします。

■ 当選コードの有効期限延長について
デイリー懸賞で発行済みの当選コードの有効期限を、通常の1週間から3週間に延長しております。

ゲーム内の当選コードのカウントダウンは、延長前の有効期限をもとに表示されており、延長後の期限は反映されておりません。
表示上の残り時間がなくなった場合も、当選コードは延長後の有効期限まで有効ですので、ご安心ください。

ご参加の皆様には、ご不便をおかけしましたことをお詫び申し上げます。
今後とも『エバーテイル』ならびに「ジグザゲーム超懸賞祭」をよろしくお願いいたします。

keys.UpdateIssuesSorryNews2LongKey:
Thank you for playing Evertale.

We are sorry for the issues experienced since the most recent version update. We are working hard to stabilize the game as soon as possible. Meanwhile, as an apology, we have distributed a compensation package to all accounts that existed prior to this notice. This package contains Soul Stones and Power Up materials that have been determined by taking into account the following:

- Missed and interrupted Raids
- Interruptions to Alliance War Battle Phases
- Network issues at declaration times
- Some players were blocked from participating in War of the Realms
- Arena ranking issues
- Arena reward distribution failures
- Summon history display issues

Players who have missed out on arena rewards due to errors in their individual rankings will receive an additional compensation package.

We are monitoring all modes that are experiencing issues, and summon history is temporarily unavailable while we address display issues. We apologize again for all of these issues experienced since the update. We will continue to work to get the game to a stable state as soon as possible.
keys.UpdateIssuesSorryNews3LongKey:
Thank you for playing Evertale.

- Interruptions to Alliance War Battle Phases

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusShouting&$$@Center@$...this way. Stay close.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$Sure. God-killing power isn't meant to be
flung around by those who can't handle it.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$The sword's likely feeding on her soul. She'll
go after anyone right now, friend or foe.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$You didn't say a thing about this to me!
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Oh, are you scared?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$Of course I am. And I feel responsible, too.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$I'm the one who gave her the Endbringer
in the first place...
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSurprised&$$@Right@$You don't say?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$...should I really wield a sword like this,
Cyrus?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No one else can. And if you want to keep
these people safe, you don't have a choice.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusShouting&$$@Center@$You're the chosen one, the only one who
can master that blade's power.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$How do you know where Ludmilla is,
anyway?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$(The chosen one, the hero...
I don't care about any of that.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$(I just can't turn a blind eye to people in
need. That's all...)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldShouting&$$@Center@$Astrid! Get out here!
Astriiid!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldAngry&$$@Center@$...hm?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Ludmilla! You have to drop that sword,
right now!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldHurt&$$@Left@$Ah... aaah?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$...Ludmilla?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldCrazy&$$@Center@$Ha... haha...
Hahahahaha!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldExcited&$$@Center@$Well, well, well! If it isn't Astrid's handy
little clown! Or should I say, her pawn?
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$It's simple. Look at the walls.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldExcited&$$@Center@$You've finally shown your true colors, then.
I really am amazed how foolish you are.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Ah, but I didn't realize she was an undead
either, no. I'm a fool myself, I suppose!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldAngry&$$@Center@$How did she hide it...? How did she hide
her trickery from me? Unbelievable...

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Ludmilla... she barely seems to notice
we're here. She's just talking to herself.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$That must be the Endbringer's influence.
She's being swallowed up by its power.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldExcited&$$@Left@$...so be it. Draw your blades, traitors.
I need your blood.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$I'm not here to fight you, Ludmilla.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$Orcanix is coming to Last Bastion. We need
the Endbringer to take her down.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$And we need you, too. The Vanguard have
a holdout by the sea cliffs.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$They need a leader. Someone who can pull
them together, like you.

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Left@$Slashes... in the wood, in the masonry...
even in the ground.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldIrritated&$$@Left@$Foolish. This war will not be decided by
strategy and trickery, no.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldShouting&$$@Left@$The only thing that can destroy Orcanix is
power. Pure power. My power.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldCrazy&$$@Left@$I will kill the undead, gather their power,
and then...!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Gather the undead's power...?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldExcited&$$@Left@$When I kill her, the betrayer, the one who
destroyed the walls... then I'll have enough.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$Wait! What do you mean, gather their
power?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I really don't think she's in the mood for
casual conversation. ...hup!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldHurt&$$@Center@$Ngh! What is this... a card?! You think this
will hurt me? How dare you...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Cyrus! What are you doing?!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldCrazy&$$@Center@$Fine, then. I hate wasting time on chatter.
Come on! I'll cut out your hearts!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$The Endbringer's power cuts down more
than just undead, as you can see.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Left@$So if we follow these slashes, we'll find the
sword... and Ludmilla.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$...Ludmilla was cruel, but I thought she was
doing it all for the sake of Last Bastion.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$But all this... that building's split right in
half. There could have been people there.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSad&$$@Right@$She probably can't help it. Absolute power
corrupts absolutely, and all that.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$We... we managed to push her back! Now
we need to take the Endbringer from her...!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(This world's Nagi is brave and honorable,
just like the one from my world.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Left@$I did what I had to to ensure humanity's
survival. Nothing more, and nothing less.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$...you're right, I wasn't there. Maybe it was
the best choice, logically speaking.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$But I'm not asking your head.
I'm asking your heart.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$My heart?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$You regret leaving her to die, don't you?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...I can't say I don't. Not completely.
But I tore out my heart that day.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$I weighed my ideals against reality, and I
did what I had to do to save the city.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Center@$But now... it seems letting Astrid die led
Last Bastion to ruin.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Center@$I made the wrong call... and because of it,
humanity is doomed.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Rizette is similar, too, now that she's been
freed from Orcanix's control.)

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Don't give up hope. The living haven't
lost yet.

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Left@$There are survivors by the cliffs. With you
leading them, they may be able to hold out.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Everything you've done, you've done for
Last Bastion, right?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$I can't agree with all of your decisions, but
you made them for your people.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$The city may have fallen, but its people are
still out there, still fighting. They need you.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$...I see.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$The people of Last Bastion... they are what
I sacrificed my friends to protect.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Then...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaShouting&$$@Left@$If I'm going to die like a dog, I may as well
fight like one.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$...take me to these survivors.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$(So somewhere in there, this Ludmilla must
have the same just heart our Ludmilla does!)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Right@$Okay! The line is this way. Hurry!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$!-1!$$@Center@$A deal with the devil, is it? Let's see how
this plays out...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$I just have to get through to her!
I'm not giving up!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldExcited&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You ought to discuss your strategy before
you get into battle, not after!
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Right@$Agh!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Rizette!
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$@Right@$I'm alright! It's not deep!

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Right@$I need you to trust in me, Finn.
Trust in me like I trust in you!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldAngry&$$@Right@$Do you really think it will be that easy?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(She's right. Rizette's on my side—
And she's a skilled warrior, too.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$(I need to trust her to watch my back.
We'll win this by working together!)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...is that it?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldIrritated&$$@Right@$What?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Is this all you can muster, even leaning on
the power of a magic sword?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Left@$No wonder the Revolution hid under your
nose so long! Even I was able to fool you!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Left@$You didn't even realize we'd stolen the
dragonfire, did you? That's really sad!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Right@$A transparent attempt to provoke me...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$None of this would have happened if Astrid
had led the Vanguard instead of you!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldAngry&$$@Right@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Left@$Guh!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$She would have led with mercy and wisdom.
She wouldn't be a brutal tyrant like you!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldIrritated&$$@Right@$...shut up.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Maybe Last Bastion could have survived.
If only someone other than you had led it!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldShouting&$$@Right@$I said, shut your mouth!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Left@$...!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldShouting&$$@Right@$Get back here!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$...a dead end!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldExcited&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You're cornered, rat. How dare you compare
me to that foolish, sentimental girl.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldCrazy&$$@Left@$I'll carve your head from your shoulders
and show them all what happens to fools!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$...!
Now, Rizette!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldExcited&$$@Right@$Do you really think you can stop me, holding
back like that? How dare you disrespect me.
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Right@$Haaaa!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldHurt&$$@Left@$What—! I can't get the Endbringer free
of these damned chains!

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You fell for Finn's provocations and lost
sight of your surroundings.

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$@Center@$It's over. Without the magic of this sword,
you can't beat us, and you know it!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...I see. I've lost, then.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Center@$Sigh... what an ignominious end.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...you seem different from before. Are you
feeling clearer-headed now?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Left@$Maybe so. Can any "brutal tyrant" really
be called clear-headed?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Right@$Well...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaGoldCrazy&$$@Right@$Neither I, nor this Endbringer, will be
broken by the likes of you!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$Perhaps you're right. Perhaps I did lose
my way.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$...tell me one thing, before you end it.
How do you know so much about Astrid?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$You only came to the city recently, and you
don't seem like a longtime rebel agent.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$Yet you speak as though you knew Astrid
when she was in the Vanguard. How?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$...it just sounded right from what I know
of her, that's all.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaHurt&$$@Left@$Honestly, you haven't said a word of sense
since I met you. Mysteries upon mysteries...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Ludmilla. I plan to stop Astrid, too.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Can you tell me what happened between
you two? So I know better how to reach her.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Left@$...
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeNormal&$$@Right@$...I met Astrid several times in the Pyre.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$She has a point. Is this really the time to
be holding back?

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Right@$She often spoke of getting revenge on the
living.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSad&$$@Left@$Revenge, huh... Her death must have been
pretty hard for her to swallow, then.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$I'd bet my last dime it's got something
to do with the Commander here.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$Not that I'm a betting man, of course.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$So Astrid has some kind of grudge...
Please, Ludmilla. Won't you tell me?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hmph... I hardly think it will help anything.
But...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Center@$...Astrid, and another soldier named Mysha.
They were my close friends.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Center@$But this is a war, and war sometimes
demands sacrifices...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Right@$You plan to destroy the undead and the
Wall all at once?!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$I've been ordered to remove you from the
blast zone. Evacuate immediately.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusShouting&$$@Center@$We have the Primordial with us, remember.
You can kill her and she won't turn undead.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$Mysha, you go too. But you can't bring
your platoon. The undead will notice.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$@Right@$Wait. If we do this, a lot of people are
going to die. Does the Commander...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$He must realize that.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Center@$I ordered the residents of the Outer City
to shelter in their homes.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Center@$If the Wall explodes, every single one of
those people will die!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Center@$Ludmilla, did you really agree to this?!
Even knowing that?!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Center@$This is... it is immoral! I will never support
this madness!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Center@$You take Tori back to headquarters for
treatment. I'll activate the sigil.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Center@$Then... I'll face my fate along with
everyone else.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$@Center@$So, please, Tori...
Don't hate Ludmilla.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$I know that. But that doesn't mean I want
to kill her!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Center@$No... No, Mya! Don't do this!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Center@$Sacrifice the few to save the many, or refuse,
and sacrifice many in defense of the few.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Mysha and I saw what had to be done.
Astrid... did not.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Center@$We crossed blades. I crippled her. Mysha
left to enact the plan, and we were alone.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Center@$You talk of making choices, but all you
have chosen is blind obedience!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Center@$If you claim your bloodstained hands
will save humanity, then so be it.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Center@$But your own humanity is long gone.
You are no more than a monster.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...
...believe whatever you'd like.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Center@$Goodbye, Astrid. May your next life be
a kinder one, in a kinder world.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Center@$Ludmilla? You do not have to do this.
Ludmilla, please!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$(That sword's feeding on her soul. I'm sure
she doesn't mean to be doing all this.)
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridCrying&$$@Center@$Ludmillaaaa!!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Center@$If she had become Commander, her naïveté
would have doomed Last Bastion.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$I left her there... and she, along with Mysha
and the undead, died in the blast.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...you left her there, knowing she couldn't
move? You just let her die?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$I did.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$But... but why?! Weren't you friends?!
Didn't it hurt?!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Left@$...
There was no other choice.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Right@$But you didn't have to kill her...
Couldn't you have worked together?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$You could have helped each other lead, and
maybe things would have—
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaShouting&$$@Left@$Don't you patronize me! You weren't there!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHurt&$$@Center@$Aaah!
$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$But you will not pierce my wall of flame!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteHurt&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Ggh... it's everywhere! I can't see her
at all!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$Sir Finn, we must retreat! We cannot risk
losing you, the last hope of our world!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteGrit&$$@Left@$...no. I won't back down.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$Sir Finn!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteGrit&$$@Left@$There are people suffering right now.
People losing family to the undead.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteShouting&$$@Left@$How can we abandon them when we've
made it this far?!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$But... if we cannot fight her, then...!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteGrit&$$@Left@$Those people are counting on us.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Everyone we met along the way. All the
Sages. Everyone in this world believes in us!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Theo! Are you okay?!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteShouting&$$@Center@$If we retreat, they'll only suffer more.
How can we do that to them?!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Center@$Yes, but... but...!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteShouting&$$@Center@$The legendary blade chose me for this.
I won't betray its faith in me! I—!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Are you finished spouting your nonsense?
Then perish!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Here she comes! Look out, Sir Finn!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteHorror&$$@Left@$(Ah... no, I can't dodge—)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Finn! Noooo!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteAngry&$$@Center@$Aaagh!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Center@$R-Riz!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteSurprised&$$@Center@$Huh...?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$What?! But the magic of the blessed forest
should have protected Sir Theo!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteHorror&$$@Center@$No... no, no, no...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteCry&$$@Center@$Rizette...!!
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Center@$...!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Finn! Are you okay?!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Left@$Huh...? Y-yeah, I'm fine.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$I must've been dreaming... I guess that's
the Golden Crest at work.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmAngry&$$@Right@$Sir Finn! Look at Lady Rizette!
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Right@$Huh...? W-what is this?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$That's... the wound you got from Orcanix.
The one that killed you.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$You died protecting me...

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Forest magic? Such trifles wilt before my
flames.

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Right@$Oh... right. I remember all of it now.
Every moment...
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Right@$Nngh! I-it burns!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Hey! What's happening? Are you okay?!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Right@$She feels pain? Even though she's undead?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Right@$Finn's power has weakened Orcanix's hold
on her. The power to break curses, was it?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Not just curses. It lets me strike at anything
binding someone against their will.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Center@$That's what the Crest does. Which is why
I could break Orcanix's hold on her.

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Center@$Yes... I can feel it. Your power has severed
the chains that bound me.

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Center@$And brought to life a host of memories I'd
buried in my heart.

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$@Center@$That was the first time I've remembered my
death. You... you saw it too, didn't you?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHurt&$$@Center@$No...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$Yeah... so that wasn't a dream at all. It was
a memory.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$You, Nagi, Theo, and this world's version
of me fought against Orcanix...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmSad&$$@Center@$...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$But your soul went to Aria after that,
didn't it?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Right@$Yes. But before I could send her along, she
was yanked back to your world.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Does that mean Orcanix got a hold of her
somehow?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$That's strange. If Orcanix was going to turn
you, why did she let your soul go at all?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$She could have turned you before you got
to Aria's throne, right?
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Right@$...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Normally, no force in existence could pry a
soul from my domain.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$How pathetic Erden has become. All your
legends and powers cannot match me.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Center@$But somehow you did, Finn. The other you
did this to Rizette.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$I...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$...Nagi. I'd like you to tell me more about
this world's Finn, please.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$He's not me, but he is me... and if he did something wrong, I have to make it right.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$If I don't know what he did, I can't help
fix it, right?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmSad&$$@Center@$...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmAngry&$$@Center@$...fine, then.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmAngry&$$@Center@$This world's Finn, racked with rage and
grief, lashed out at Orcanix...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteShouting&$$@Center@$Raaaaaaagh!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Ngh... where is this strength of yours
coming from?!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteAngry&$$@Center@$We finally made it to the Pyre... we're
finally face to face with Orcanix, but...!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteShouting&$$@Center@$This strength isn't the legendary sword, or
the ancient magic. It's my rage!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteGrit&$$@Center@$Every time I lose someone, I swear, never
again. And I keep failing them...!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteShouting&$$@Center@$It ends now! So no one else is lost, ever
again... I'll end it all right now!
$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...fascinating.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteGrit&$$@Left@$What?!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$You hold within you the same fear I do.
Then, perhaps you desire the same future.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteSurprised&$$@Left@$What... are you saying?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$No, Sir Finn! Do not listen to her!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Wha— the flames?!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Back, creature. I am speaking to Finn, not
to you.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteShouting&$$@Center@$Don't give up, everyone! Our attacks are
hurting her!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You fear loss. You fear eternal separation.
I say to you, Finn, I know those fears well.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteShouting&$$@Left@$Then why raise the undead?! Why attack
the living?!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Do you not see? I slay them to grant them
eternal life.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Death plants in mankind the seed of fear.
It is the first and most terrible tragedy.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$And so, I realized: if not for death, would
mankind know sadness at all? I say... no.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteHorror&$$@Left@$What are you talking about?

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Very soon now, this world will no longer
fear death, nor loss, nor partings.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$All shall be born anew, into a beautiful
life unending.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteSurprised&$$@Left@$You're... you're saying you could bring
Rizette back?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteSurprised&$$@Left@$And everyone else who died as well...?

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Indeed. Just as the bites of an insect,
repeated manyfold, may sting and irritate.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Yes, Finn. But I cannot do it alone. I need
the aid of a powerful warrior.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I...I can save her? I can save Rizette?

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Not only Rizette. You can save every being
in this world from the tragedy of death.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Finn... you hold within you the power
to save Erden, now and forever.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$Sir Finn! You mustn't!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnWhiteCry&$$@Center@$I...——

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaShouting&$$@Center@$The barricades need reinforcement! Fetch
more materials from the square!

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaNormal&$$@Left@$We could use your help, too. If you're
offering it.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedBack&$$@Right@$Of course. What's the situation like?

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Several hours ago, there was a huge
explosion inside the city.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSerious&$$@Center@$The Commander said it was a Revolutionary
plot, and demanded we track them down.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSerious&$$@Center@$We raided the Stonemasons' Guild, their
headquarters, and...

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaDetermined&$$@Center@$...well, we failed to take their leader,
Astrid von Draclow, into custody.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaAngry&$$@Center@$We took the surviving Rebels in. All of
them said Astrid betrayed them.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedBack&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Survivors... was Raleigh among them?

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSad&$$@Left@$Oh, your old squadmate... I'm sorry to say
he was not.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Right@$...
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$Averna!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousDown&$$@Right@$...apologies for the interruption. Please,
continue.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You've changed, Shiori. Before, you would
have been—

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSad&$$@Center@$Never mind. Sorry. About our current
situation... honestly, it's really bad.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSad&$$@Center@$The walls are down, most of our ballistas
are destroyed, and our dragonfire is gone.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSerious&$$@Center@$The undead came flooding in right after the
explosion. And worse... look up there.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAngryBack&$$@Right@$Orcanix...

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSerious&$$@Left@$Morale is in the pits. And worse, the rebel
traitors are butting heads with the Vanguard.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$Don't call them traitors. That will only make
the tensions worse.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSerious&$$@Left@$...I suppose so. But it's not as though their
revolution helped much, did it?

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaAngry&$$@Left@$Anyway, we're struggling to keep things
under control here as it is.
$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSurprised&$$@Center@$Shiori?! You're alive...

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSad&$$@Left@$Without Commander Ludmilla, we may not
stand a chance of winning at all.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSmug&$$@Right@$Hmph. Even now, you still consider this a
war? How foolish.
$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSurprised&$$@Left@$What do you mean? Wait, who is this child?
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAnnoyed&$$@Right@$C-child?! How rude!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSmug&$$@Right@$Now that I'm here, you won't even need a
strategy anymore!

$#Vanguard(Vanguard)#$$&VanguardSoldier&$$!-1!$$@Center@$L-Lady Averna! The barricades are starting
to fall!

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaShouting&$$@Center@$Tch, we have less time than I thought. Use
fire arrows! Burn them to buy time!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Center@$Are you not listening?! Fine! I'll show you
doubting saps what I can do!

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaShouting&$$@Center@$H-hey! Don't go beyond the barricades!
It's too dangerous!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Center@$Damn you, Orcanix. Corrupting these souls
like this...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$A friend of yours?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Center@$I will not allow this mockery to continue!
Behold the power of death!
$#Undead(Undead)#$$&Skeleton&$$@Center@$...
$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$The undead are... collapsing?!

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSurprised&$$@Right@$They're not reviving... is she breaking
Orcanix's control somehow?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hah. Are you finally going to listen to me
now?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSmug&$$@Center@$The souls of the dead fall under my domain.
Wherever I go, Orcanix has no power.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSmug&$$@Center@$Now, rebuild the barricades. While giving
thanks and praise to Aria, your savior!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Right@$She's... a Valkyrie. An elite among elites.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$Are you in command here, Averna?
$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaNormal&$$@Left@$...yes.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$We've brought survivors from the city.
Can you take them in?

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaNormal&$$@Left@$Of course. Can any of them fight? We're
running very low on manpower here.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusShouting&$$@Center@$...there!
$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleScared&$$@Left@$Please! Please don't hurt him!

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleCrying&$$@Left@$I won't ask you to forgive me, but please...
he's my little brother!

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeNormal&$$@Right@$...he's beyond help now. Surely you must
recognize that.
$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleCrying&$$@Left@$I know. He's already turned...

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleCrying&$$@Left@$But I don't want him to suffer the pain of
dying over and over and over!

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleHurt&$$@Left@$He's such a gentle boy. He's so kind and
sweet. Please, just...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...I shall bestow upon him forgiveness.
The eternal peace and rest of death.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Robero)#$$!-1!$Ah...?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Robero)#$...th... thank you.
$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSurprised&$$@Left@$...he's passed out? No, that's not it.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$This is... the slums!

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSurprised&$$@Left@$The light of the flame is going out...!
You freed him from Orcanix's control?!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaNormal&$$@Right@$Be at ease. Your brother has passed on to
his eternal rest.

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSurprised&$$@Left@$Really...? Is such a miracle even possible?
Who... who are you?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$We can explain everything later. There's
no time to waste right now.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$We need an update on the city's status.
How far in have the undead advanced?
$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSerious&$$@Left@$Um... I'm not really sure, myself.

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSerious&$$@Left@$But after the walls blew, they came pouring
in, like they'd been expecting it.

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSerious&$$@Left@$The surviving Vanguard and Revolutionaries
are holding the line back by the sea cliffs.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$The Vanguard... led by Ludmilla?
$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSerious&$$@Left@$No, by the Valkyries.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridSad&$$@Center@$You should have been cold. Heartless,

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridCrying&$$@Center@$But your kindness... made me see how
twisted I have become.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridCrying&$$@Center@$...forgive me. I was the one who was weak
this whole time.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridCrying&$$@Center@$I am so... so sorry. Everyone... I am sorry...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$There's no need to beat yourself up. You
were being used by Orcanix.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...Finn. May I ask one favor of you?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridCrying&$$@Left@$I am a monster, and a murderer. But...
Will you... stay with me, until the end?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridAngry&$$@Left@$We have only known each other for days!
I very nearly killed you!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$You're not a monster. Not anymore.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Right@$And I already said I wouldn't leave you
alone.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridSad&$$@Left@$...thank you.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridSmile&$$@Left@$It doesn't hurt anymore. I'm not alone...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Right@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$...you're going to pay for this, Orcanix.
$#ManInBlack(Man In Black)#$$&BlackMageOpenMouth&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...ggh...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCry&$$@Center@$...
I'll send you all to Aria, too.
$#ManInBlack(Man In Black)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Center@$...th...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Let's get back to the holdout, Cyrus.
We still have work to do.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridAngry&$$@Left@$So why are you treating me like this?
What is wrong with you?!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSad&$$@Right@$Right away, sir. Still, you really didn't
listen to a word I said, did you?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I know you warned me. But... is it alright
if I use the Crest one more time?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$You'd just do it anyway, no matter what I
said. Best get it over with.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Twister of souls, author of tragedies.
Orcanix, I hope you're listening.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$For all the people you've hurt... I swear,
I will end this Endless nightmare!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandGold&$$@Center@$This is a declaration of war!
$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$A golden light...?

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$I see. The living have brought forth a new
weapon to oppose Me.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$But the weapons of Man are weak. This
last futile struggle shall not reach Me.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Go, My general. Smash down their wall
and free them from the fear of death!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$I didn't expect to be coming back here...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Don't rely on the Golden Crest too much.
Save it for the exact right moment.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Huh? What do you mean?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$The Golden Crest is a new power, born from
your determination and the two Crests.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$But think about it. Who does that power
originally belong to?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Arcane... the evil god.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$Exactly.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSad&$$@Right@$Not only did you reject Arcane in spectacular
fashion, the god himself is now long dead.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$The last echoes of Arcane's power, plus
power from you two: the Red and Blue.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSad&$$@Right@$That's what the Golden Crest is. And what
do you think'll happen if you use too much?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Is... is that why the Golden Crest has been
weakening? It's lost its power source?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$No time to get all choked up. Best hurry
before Orcanix arrives at the holdout.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Most likely.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$You're special, Finn. You're a good-hearted
kid, with some unique strengths.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSad&$$@Center@$But you can't keep pumping out power on
the level of a god.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSad&$$@Center@$The more you use the Golden Crest, the
weaker it'll get. Eventually, it'll vanish.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$That's why you need that sword. It has
the power to vanquish evil, too.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$...I understand. But I think I'll keep it
sheathed for now.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$I'm here to talk to Astrid, not kill her.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$Even if I can't reach her with the Crest
the way I reached Rizette...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$I want to find a way to save her. I will find a way to save her.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$...honestly. Just like your old man,
you are.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I know. But before I meet with Astrid,
there's something I want to say to you.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Keep your nose out of it, right?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Yeah. You provoked Ludmilla into
fighting back in the market.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I don't want it to happen again.
Understand?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Don't worry, I'll keep my peace this time.
You won't hear a peep out of me.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$But I will give you one bit of advice.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Advice?

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$I am finally here... Last Bastion.
The rotten heart of suffering in this world.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Accept my blessing, mortals! Let salvation
wash across all corners of this world!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritGold&$$@Center@$Salvation? You really think what you're
doing to these people is salvation?!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritGold&$$@Center@$Twisting them, sealing their hearts away...
I don't want any salvation like that!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandGold&$$@Center@$I don't want it... and I won't let you force
it on anyone, ever again!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$That golden light... I see. So it was you,
on the island...

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Such pitiful light. With this meager power,
you will deny My blessing? Laughable!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$No. I will snuff out your light and your life
in the same moment!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$This way, Sir Finn!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritGold&$$@Left@$Thanks, Nagi! That was close.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmHeh&$$@Right@$Her flames can be tracked and dodged.
Listen carefully to me! I will guide you!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$A festering city, overrun with the pain and
despair, born of the fear of death.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSeriousGold&$$@Left@$Got it. Let's go!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$Finn's on the move. He'll be aiming to turn
Orcanix away from the ballista.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedBack&$$@Center@$I'm nearly there. Everything's going
smoothly so far, but...
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$Finn, please don't be reckless...!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$In the end, you are bound as tightly by your
fear of death as any mortal.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Foolish, sad creatures. Fear drives all you
do, yet you still think yourselves free.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandGold&$$@Center@$You're wrong. Death drives us to live our
best lives in the time we have!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Lies. I have seen it all: the scrambling
panic that is human history.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$You fight over limited resources, slaughter
one another. Your lives are built
$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$upon the graves of those you've savaged.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$...a voice. I know this voice. Familiar it is...
And repulsive, too.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$With My blessing, such struggles are no
longer necessary. No blood must be shed!
$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$If this is not salvation, then what is?!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritGold&$$@Center@$You say that, after causing all this war?
A war across two worlds?!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Hm? Wait... your face. And the color of
your soul...

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$I see. You hail from another Erden.
Your power is that of another god...

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Ha... hahaha! Mind your business, outsider!
Do you wish so badly to be called a savior?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandGold&$$@Center@$I don't care about that! I just want to save
the people I see suffering!
$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaAngry&$$@Right@$Tch... we can't hold out much longer here!
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Left@$Averna! I need you to do something for me!

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSerious&$$@Right@$Rizette, I can't! The line's seconds from
breaking over here!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$That pain and despair is all because of you,
Orcanix! You're the one who caused it!

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$@Left@$Please, hold just a little longer! Can you
bring Aria here? I have a plan!
$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSurprised&$$@Right@$...

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaDetermined&$$@Right@$Fine. You'd better make it worth it!
Bring down that hunk of metal!

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Averna... she really does trust me.
Me, an undead...
$#EndlessFinn(Endless Finn)#$$&DarkFinnGlowEye&$$@Center@$Nngh... gaaah!

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Center@$Finn...
Don't worry. It'll all be over soon!
$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$I do not push My will upon those I bless!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$I simply open their eyes to the truth that
will spare them from suffering and pain!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritGold&$$@Center@$What? Are you serious?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritGold&$$@Center@$Rizette's grief over her brother's death,
Astrid's pain and desire for revenge...

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$...foolish. Death is a cruelty of nature,
which I hate above all else.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandGold&$$@Center@$You're responsible for all of it!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandGold&$$@Center@$Their suffering didn't exist until you
twisted them to put it there!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$You claim to know all that is within the
hearts of others? Arrogant creature!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSeriousGold&$$@Center@$You're right, I didn't know. I had no idea
how much suffering you'd caused.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandGold&$$@Center@$But now I do know. And I know how brave
everyone fighting here is!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandGold&$$@Center@$Even with your armies on their doorsteps,
they refuse to bow or break!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandGold&$$@Center@$Orcanix! For what you've done to the noble
souls of this Erden... I will destroy you!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Fool! Worm! Wretch! You cannot grasp the
eternal mercy that is My blessing!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$You, a mere human, seek to challenge the
god of this world? Laughable!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$You struggle in vain to reach me, even with
that stolen power!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Death is the root of all fear and suffering.
I have simply sought to uproot it.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSeriousGold&$$@Center@$(She's afraid of the Crest. And she gets
really mad when I talk about death...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSeriousGold&$$@Center@$(She uses her power to keep death as far
from herself as possible.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritGold&$$@Center@$(There's no doubt. For all her talk,
Orcanix fears death more than anyone!)
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$More fire is coming! This way, Sir Finn!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurpriseGold&$$@Left@$Thanks, Na...gi...
H-huh?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmShouting&$$@Right@$Sir Finn?!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritGold&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(I can't move my legs... Did I use too much
power getting her attention?!)

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Hahaha! Are you tired, worm? This is what
comes of your arrogance and pride!

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Left@$Show me, Finn. Show me your soul...
Everything you are!
$#EndlessFinn(Endless Finn)#$$&DarkFinnGlowEye&$$@Right@$Gh... gaaah?!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Those who follow Me want for nothing;
thus, they fear no loss.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSurprised&$$@Left@$Is she... drawing out the black flame on
her sword?!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSurprised&$$@Right@$The core of that flame is his heart...
The life that Finn offered to Orcanix!
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Left@$Aria! Use your power on his heart!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Right@$O-okay! Here I go...!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$I grant you My blessing, outsider!
Welcome to the embrace of endless life!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Sir Finn! You must move!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritGold&$$@Left@$...No. If this is how it has to be...
If this is what it takes...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackBack&$$@Center@$She's fully focused on Finn.
Only one shot at this...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Shiori & Aria)#$Now...!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$They will not suffer death; thus, they do not
fear it. Endless bliss is theirs to embrace.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Why do you resist? I only wish to free you
from the shackles of your mortality.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Cyrus. So this is where you went off to.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$Really. All split up in the chaos, though.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteThoughtful&$$@Center@$Because I will be home someday...
I promise.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSmile&$$@Center@$......yes. Yes, of course!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSmile&$$@Center@$Take the path you believe in, Finn. We'll...
I'll be waiting for you.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteThoughtful&$$@Center@$As long as you promise me...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteBlush&$$@Center@$That someday I'll get to welcome you home.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$I see... well, that's okay. As long as they're
alive...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Now that Orcanix is gone, you'll send me
back, right?
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Hm? When did I ever say that?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$What?! You send me to another world,
and now you won't let me go home?!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Well, if you really insist, I suppose I could
send you back. I'm not a monster.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$But before that, there's just one thing I
want to ask.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$How would you feel about visiting another
world, hm?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Another world? What are you talking about?
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Do you remember what Arcane said to you?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Hm? What brings the hero of the hour to a
place like this? Tired of celebrating?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Huh? Uh...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$There are countless worlds. Many of them
suffer under gods like Arcane, Magnifo...
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$Or Orcanix.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$With your strength, and the Endbringer...
You could save those worlds.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$You could do that. Ah, let me rephrase. Only you could do that.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$...you're telling me this so I feel like
I can't refuse you.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Oh, you're sharper than you look.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$You said my friends are just scattered, right?
They're not in any danger?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$No more than usual. The undead will
vanish from Hymelia soon enough.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I'm glad everyone's happy, sure. But there's
something I had to ask you.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$And once Hymelia's resettled, the Bergarians
will calm down too.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Eventually, at least. I can pop in to check
on occasion, but I can't see everything.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I see...
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$So? What'll it be?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Orcanix called me arrogant. Maybe...
I've never thought of myself as a savior.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$But when this world's Rizette vanished...
She looked so happy. She looked at peace.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Center@$It wasn't me alone, but I was able to save
her. And when I think of it that way...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$If there are people out there suffering,
people I can help... I want to help them.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Then it's settled. Onto the next—
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Ah! W-wait! Wait a minute!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$How are things back home? Back in our
Erden, I mean.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSurprised&$$@Right@$Hm?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I just... I have one favor to ask.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Can you let them know I'm alright?
That I'm doing okay. Can you tell them?
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$I see. Sure, why not?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$But remember, this magic isn't as easy as
snapping my fingers and making a wish.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$Once I send you off, I'll head back to our
Erden and get to delivering your message.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$I may have to do some digging to find out
where they went, so it'll take some time.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$That's okay.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$So? What'll this message of yours say?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Huh? Um...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Orcanix's power has been cut off. There
might be a few undead leftover, but...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(...I didn't have anything in mind. I just
want them to know I'm doing okay...)
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$!-1!$$@Right@$"Um?" Not very inspiring, I have to say.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$W-wait! Uh...
Okay, tell them...!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriHappyUp&$$@Right@$Finn! You'll be coming to the feast tonight,
right?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriHappyUp&$$@Right@$We found a storehouse that didn't burn.
Everyone's excited for it. It'll be—
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$...Shiori.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedDown&$$@Right@$...oh.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedDown&$$@Right@$Yeah... I figured you'd be on your way.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$I'll miss you. You're my light, my hope, my
teacher... like a brother to me...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$This list keeps getting longer every time...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$The problem should wrap itself up sooner
or later. Don't fret too much about it.
