You dare stand against Me?!
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$@Left@$...handled. How is he?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...nngh...!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$He has pushed himself very hard.
His strength is almost exhausted.

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Left@$I see...
And Orcanix?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmAngry&$$@Right@$...there.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Aah...aaaah! You... you insects! What have
you... what have you done to Me?!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$You seek to... to kill the unkillable, with
these tricks and contrivances?!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$You do not deserve My blessing! Burn...
and die!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Right@$...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmPleasant&$$@Left@$The evil one has been felled...
And the world is saved.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...we'll have to work hard!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Center@$We're going to rebuild the world, and we'll
need to make it worth their sacrifices.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Rebuilding, hm... I would have loved to see
how this place looked before its fall.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Left@$Well, you will live for many thousands of
years, so you will see it in the future instead.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Right@$No! That's not the same! I hate waiting!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmHurt&$$@Left@$Honestly, you are so childish.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSmile&$$@Left@$If you'd be willing to help rebuild, I could
provide you room and board, Aria.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaNormal&$$@Right@$I am a Primordial. I don't need you looking
after me... but maybe I will accept.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Right@$First, though, I must return to the Throne.
The freed dead will need seeing to.
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Left@$...Finn? Finn?! He covered for me?!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Left@$...Lady Aria. What is the afterlife like?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaClosedEyes&$$@Right@$I... I don't actually know. All I do is send
souls there. I've never seen it myself.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Right@$But every time I see a soul off, they look
like they're seeing something beautiful.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Left@$I see...
Thank you. That's enough for me.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Father, Raleigh, Hajime... I'm sure everyone
is in a better place now.

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeCry&$$@Left@$Why?! I'm already dead! You must know
I don't have very long left!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Ha... haha...
No mortal may stand against a God...
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeCry&$$@Left@$This is... this is just...!
$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Just the same as the first time, is it not!
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Left@$!!!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$He died a fool's death, Rizette. All this
struggle, and he accomplished nothing!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$The fool traveled the rift between worlds
just to die like a dog, unfulfilled!

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Left@$(There's no way Finn, as tired as he was,
could have survived those flames.)

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Center@$(A wall of black flames! This must be her
most desperate attack...)

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeCry&$$@Left@$(...his heart's not beating. He really was
snuffed out... just like that...)
$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Rizette. My ruinous angel.
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeCry&$$@Left@$...

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$I am prepared to offer you a boon for your
service... Eternal life.
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Left@$...what are you saying?

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Swear fealty to Me once more, and Finn
shall live again. Forever.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Return to Me, and you and he shall never
again be separated, by death or aught else.

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You think you can get me with the same
trick you pulled on Finn?

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Center@$Don't you think I understand now what a
sham your "eternal life" is?

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$A sham? In comparison to your mortality,
the true blessing should be clear.
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Center@$(...there's no escaping it now.)

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$That which lasts forever, and that which will
fail, fall, and rot. Surely you see this.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$The Finn you know has been stolen by the
hateful Primordial of Death...

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$But this Finn yet remains. Though the souls
differ somewhat, he is still the same man.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Do you truly wish to let him go? To never
hear his voice or see his smile?

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Will you choose eternal separation, knowing
you could have chosen differently?
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Center@$...

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$@Center@$...I'm sorry, other me. I need to borrow
him for just a little while.
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Center@$Finn... grant me strength.
$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$What...?
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Left@$This is my answer, Orcanix!
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSadSmile&$$@Center@$(But maybe it's better this way.)
$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$You... dare to point a sword at Me?!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$...Gaaaaah! My... my body...
W-what is this hateful power?!

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Left@$It's what's left of Finn's strength... and
mine. The sword is giving it form.

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Left@$You probably can't understand what's so
beautiful about a lifetime that will end.

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Left@$To know that your time is all too short,
and to make the most of it anyway!
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Left@$Our lives may be short, but they're ours. And they don't belong to you anymore!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No... no, that cannot...aah! My body...!
My body is... decaying!

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$No... no. Stop. Please...
I... I'm afraid... please......
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Center@$...goodbye, Orcanix. And...

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSadSmile&$$@Center@$Goodbye...
Finn...

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSadSmile&$$@Center@$(Now that I've been cut off from the Pyre,
my body won't last much longer anyway.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$I can't feel my fingertips anymore.
My body feels... so heavy. It's so dark.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Center@$So this... is what dying's like.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$I wasn't exactly trying for this...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCry&$$@Center@$...
I just wish...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCry&$$@Center@$I wish I could have seen everyone...
Seen Rizette... one last time.
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$We shall not die here.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$...huh?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$W-who's there?! A voice... it sounds like
a voice inside my head...
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Rise thee above the Undead God.
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$Rise thee above thine own mortality!

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSadSmile&$$@Center@$(So let's put an end to it now. Just like last
time... I'll die in fire—)
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$F...Finn?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$$!-1!$...
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidBack&$$@Center@$He's... not breathing?
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidBack&$$@Center@$...no. No, no, no!!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriCryingDown&$$@Center@$You promised you wouldn't die! You... liar!
How could you?!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriCryingDown&$$@Center@$...it's happening again. I've sacrificed a
friend again...!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriCryingDown&$$@Center@$Finn, please! Please...! Open your eyes...!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$......
...nnh...
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedBack&$$@Center@$...huh?
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedBack&$$@Center@$F-Finn?! He's breathing!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$Rizette!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriCryingUp&$$@Center@$Finn! Finn! Answer me!

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$S-Shiori! Don't shake him like that!
I'll heal him, just give me a moment!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Left@$Mm... Shiori?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAngryUp&$$@Right@$You idiot! Do you have any idea... any idea
how worried I was?!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Left@$...wait. Rizette... where's Rizette?!
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Right@$...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$!!!
Rizette...!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$(Just like Astrid...
Her body is slowly turning to ash.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$Wait... please. You defeated Orcanix, right?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$I'm sure everyone will be grateful. At least
wait until they've had a chance to thank you!
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Left@$Kya?!
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeCry&$$@Right@$...your hand...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Huh? My hand?

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeCry&$$@Right@$Ah... you're so warm. You really are just
like him...
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSadSmile&$$@Right@$This time... I did it right. I kept you safe.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$...

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeCry&$$@Right@$Live on... for us. Find the happiness we
never could...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Left@$......
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCry&$$@Left@$Rizette...!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...when we traveled together, she always
said...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmSad&$$@Center@$Helping Finn was her goal. She viewed it
as her life's work. Her calling.

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Left@$...
...huh?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmSad&$$@Center@$It has been a long and winding road...
But her journey has finally come to its end.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$...thank you, Lucelle. I think I'm all healed
up now.

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSerious&$$@Left@$Are you sure? You really shouldn't push
yourself. You'll make Shiori worry.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$I know. I'll be careful.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$...this place really got wrecked, huh?
It was pretty nice before.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$What happened to the undead around here?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Left@$A little after Orcanix fell, they all turned
to ash and vanished.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Left@$...I would have liked to bury them properly.
But we can build a monument, at least.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$Yeah...
So many people have died.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Left@$Yes, but look there. That damnable tower
no longer darkens the horizon.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Center@$You, get gone! And you! And you, and you,
and you and you and you!
$#EndlessFinn(Endless Finn)#$$&DarkFinnGlowEye&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I knew it...
Who could it have been, but you?
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaNormal&$$@Right@$What are you going to do?

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSadSmile&$$@Left@$...I'd like to try reaching out to him, like a
certain someone we both know.

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Left@$But I doubt words can even reach him
anymore...

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$@Left@$So I'll distract him long enough for Aria
to end him. That should do it.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Right@$...and you won't regret it?

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$@Left@$I'll do everything I can to reach him.
So, no, I won't regret it.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSmile&$$@Right@$Understood. As you like, then!

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSerious&$$@Right@$We'll run interference for you... as much
as I hate to trust an undead.
$#Undead(Undead)#$$&Skeleton&$$@Center@$...

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaDetermined&$$@Right@$But we're fighting for the future here. And
to build a better future, we need change.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaDetermined&$$@Right@$We have to be clear-eyed and strong...
Like Shiori.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSerious&$$@Right@$We know better than anyone how strong
you are. So... you lead the charge, Rizette.
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSadSmile&$$@Left@$...thanks. I'll be back!
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Left@$Finn! Pull your soldiers back, now!

$#EndlessFinn(Endless Finn)#$$&DarkFinnGlowEye&$$@Right@$...Or. Canix.
For. Or. Can. Ix.
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Left@$(He's too far gone... I'll have to fight!)
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Left@$Here I come!

$#EndlessFinn(Endless Finn)#$$&DarkFinnGlowEye&$$@Right@$...!
Trai...tor!

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Left@$I don't want to hear that from the one who
betrayed all of Erden!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$How many has it been already...? I lost
count around one hundred...
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Aria, now!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSurprised&$$@Center@$W-wait, Rizette! I can't see his soul!
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What?!
$#EndlessFinn(Endless Finn)#$$&DarkFinnGlowEye&$$@Right@$Haaaaa!
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Left@$Gah?!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Rizette!
$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I'm okay! Just a scratch!

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Left@$I'll handle him myself! You all focus on
cutting down the other soldiers!
$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaDetermined&$$@Right@$...alright. Let's go, Aria!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Left@$Urgh, fine! Don't you dare die on us,
Rizette!

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaNormal&$$@Right@$Thank you, Aria. You're allowing the
Valkyries to focus on their mission.
$#EndlessFinn(Endless Finn)#$$&DarkFinnGlowEye&$$!-1!$$@Center@$For, Or, can, ix...!

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Center@$That's all you have to say, huh?
...fine.

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Center@$Even if you're a shell of your former self...
I'll be the one to take you down!

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaNormal&$$@Right@$If they fall, they won't get back up.
Knowing that has lifted their spirits.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Left@$Hmph. It would be better for all of us if
they didn't die in the first place!
$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSmile&$$@Right@$...haha.

$#EndlessRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Left@$He'll be leading from the back, I'm sure.
He should be coming into view soon...
$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSurprised&$$@Right@$Ah... look, Rizette! There, in the armor!

keys.DescriptionKey: With Rizette and the Primordial of Death now on their side, Finn and Shiori return to Last Bastion to end Orcanix's reign. But with an undead army, a ghost of the past, and the might of a Goddess standing in their way, can they overcome impossible odds to free this broken Erden once and for all?

a10.name: Act 10
a10.title: Act 10
a10.subtitle: World Without End
a10.description: With Rizette and the Primordial of Death now on their side, Finn and Shiori return to Last Bastion to end Orcanix's reign. But with an undead army, a ghost of the past, and the might of a Goddess standing in their way, can they overcome impossible odds to free this broken Erden once and for all?

keys.value:
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$(We've been walking for a pretty long
time since leaving Callen's lab...)

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaBlush&$$@Left@$You don't say! So what's the other me
like? Is she all refined and fancy?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Hmm, she's bright and cheery...
About as bright as the sun, I'd say!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHappy&$$@Left@$The sun... wow, that's pretty bright,
parallel me!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$That's not all, though. She's also kind and
considerate, and looks out for others.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Just like you, I'm sure, from what
Callen was saying.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaBlush&$$@Left@$Ah... hmm, I wonder, haha.
I dunno about that.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$You were trying so hard to get Callen to
evacuate to Base, after all.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaBlush&$$@Left@$Yeah, but it's not what she wants.
I should respect her wishes.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$I'm sure she sees it as what's best for
everyone, in her own way.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$I guess so.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Left@$Are you okay, Finn?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(In the last world, and my own world,
everyone worked so hard to save people...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(I'm sure it must be the same here.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...Mysha?
Is there something on my face?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Left@$Oh, sorry. No, I was just thinking.
You really are Finn, after all.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$I'm myself, huh...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Yeah. If I didn't do everything I could, I
wouldn't be myself, after all.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Left@$Yup. You even talk like he used to.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyes&$$@Right@$(The things I can do because of who I am.
That's what I've done, and I'll keep it up.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Hey...how many people are left in this
world?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSerious&$$@Left@$Hard to say. Probably not many. I only
know the Base folks, and the Sky People.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Don't worry, I can handle it.
About how much farther is it?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Sky People?
What do you mean?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Left@$Oh right, you wouldn't know. It'll be
easier just to show you. Come on, up here!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Left@$Come on! We've got a ways to go, so let's
pick up the pace!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$H-hey, Mysha!
Slow down, please...!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$Finally...made it...!
So this is the summit...?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Mysha)#$$!-1!$There, see that?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$Is that...a castle floating in the sky!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Away from Cyrus?
I don't understand.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonAngry&$$@Left@$Finn, I will be blunt.
How much do you trust him?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Huh? I mean, we've fought together...
He was my dad's adventuring companion.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonSurprised&$$@Left@$Your father?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$There are no manastones here, so we
shouldn't have to worry about golems.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$It's a long story, but my world also had a
cyclical disaster just like this one's.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$My dad and Cyrus fought against this
guy called the Eternal to end it.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Right@$Actually, you were part of that party
too, Callen.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonSurprised&$$@Left@$I was?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Well, the Callen from my world. He said
you were fire-forged allies, right?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonGrit&$$@Left@$I suppose he did. That explains his
off-putting overfamiliarity.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$And he gave me Endbringer, too.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonSurprised&$$@Left@$What!? Is that true?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Yeah, last time I traveled worlds. He said
it would come in handy, and it did.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonSerious&$$@Left@$Mm... So that is the way of it...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonNormal&$$@Center@$We cannot say for sure this place is safe
until we have a better look around.

$#Endbringer(Callen)#$$&Endbringer&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I believe this blade is forged from
mithril.
$#Endbringer(Finn)#$$&Endbringer&$$@Center@$Mithril!?
$#Endbringer(Callen)#$$&Endbringer&$$@Center@$Then you know of it already?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Not in detail. But the sword we made to
kill the Eternal was also made of mithril.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$The Sword of Sealing, Exeternia.
You're the one who made it.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonStare&$$@Left@$Oh? Am I, perhaps, supremely rich or
powerful in your world?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$No, you're very smart, but you're just a
regular researcher. Why?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonShouting&$$@Left@$Then what a wild idea it was to design
something that required mithril!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$What do you mean?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonSerious&$$@Left@$This metal is unbelievably rare. Only the
most prosperous of rulers will ever see it.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonNormal&$$@Center@$Finn and I will scout over here. You two,
check around the rest area itself.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonSerious&$$@Left@$In this world, its supply is controlled
entirely by the Divines.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonSerious&$$@Left@$And it is much more dangerous than
these manastones if mishandled.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonSerious&$$@Left@$This metal appears extremely pure. Its
smith must have been a trained scholar.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$A magic scholar?
Not a magician?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyes&$$@Right@$I think Cyrus said he got the sword from
a magician...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonAngry&$$@Left@$Unlikely. No single magic user could have
created this weapon alone.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$So he lied? But why?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonAngry&$$@Left@$...Mithril's most notable quality is its
ability to absorb magic and mana.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$Does it cancel it out or something?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonSerious&$$@Left@$No. It simply absorbs and then stores it.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Center@$Okay! That's a good idea.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$But I definitely killed the undead god
Orcanix with it...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonAngry&$$@Left@$Ah, yes, you mentioned that!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonNormal&$$@Left@$Have you experienced anything strange
since taking up this Endbringer?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Anything strange? I don't think so...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Ah, there was one thing. But I think it
might have been a dream or something.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonAngry&$$@Left@$Let me hear it.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyes&$$@Right@$...When I fought Orcanix, I nearly died.
And I heard a voice speaking to me.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$That's kind of stuck with me ever since.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonAngry&$$@Left@$A strange voice...and you were not able
to discern who it was, then?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$No. But that's all— I haven't noticed or
felt anything else strange since then.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Look after each other, okay?
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$@Left@$Kyaaaaa!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$That was Mysha!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonShouting&$$@Left@$Let us hurry back!
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$But of course.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHeh&$$@Center@$You two be careful too!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenDragonNormal&$$@Center@$Come along, Finn. Keep an eye out for
golems while we scout.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Guided by Cyrus, Finn finds his way into
another parallel world—one full of destruction
and despair, terrorized by invincible dragons.

keys.value:
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Looks like there's some kind of commotion
in the village.
$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$Captain, there's more!

$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$Early this morning, a farmer saw some
people running from the village.
$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$She said they were carrying two sacks!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$!

$#RedKnightA(Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$Sacks... You think the children could have
been inside?!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Which way did they go?
$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$Toward the ocean!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$It's still early. If we hurry, we may catch
them!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$It doesn't sound like they're being attacked,
though.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Let's go in and see if they need help.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Two children are missing?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$The villagers said they vanished from
their beds in the night.
$#RedKnightB(Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$Do you think bandits are responsible...?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$That seems unlikely. They didn't take
anything of monetary value.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$Who would do something like this? And
why?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$I'm not sure. Let's assist the villagers in
searching for the children.
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$I know this darkness.
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$Where are my enemies?
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$I...
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$I need...
$#RolotiaClock(Clock)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$Then you shall have.

$#RolotiaClock(Clock)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$You shall have a new body, new weapons,
and a new enemy.
$#RolotiaClock(Clock)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$Your "time..."
$#RolotiaClock(Clock)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$is renewed!
$#()#$Southwest Rigland, Westland

$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Center@$Phew... The Captain keeps a tough pace,
at least when we're answering aid calls.
$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Center@$You alright there, Theo?

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$The cruel void that follows disgrace,
despair, and pitiful defeat.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHurt&$$@Center@$Y-Yeah, I'm okay...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Center@$I'm more worried about how many of these
kinds of requests we've been getting.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Center@$Bandit activity seems to be growing more
rampant every day.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Center@$I thought with the Pandemonium gone,
people would embrace peacetime...

$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Ha ha... You're a sweet kid, Theo. But
most folk aren't that sweet.

$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$Just be glad we don't have to worry about
demons riling up the wild monsters anymore.

$#RedKnightB(Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$You say that, but these bandits are pretty
tough. On top of trained monsters,

$#RedKnightB(Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$most of them are summoning warriors with
soul stones to help them terrorize folk.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$It's awful... I'm sure not all of those
warriors want to attack innocent people.
$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$I'm sure most of them don't.

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$This darkness has been my greatest
teacher.

$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$But it's the heart of the summoner that
decides their alignment.

$#RedKnightB(Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$So warriors summoned by the Pandemonium
Task Force make excellent allies!

$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$To be honest, I was disappointed when I
heard Finn was stepping down as Captain.

$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$But after working with our current Captain,
I can't imagine following anyone else!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$You don't know...?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$I've exhausted all my connections and
tried everything conceivable.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$But I still have no explanation as to why
Finn won't wake up.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$The Great Sage said it is not an illness...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$So it must have something to do with that
crest.

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$It urges me to embrace defeat, to use it as
the fuel I need to stand once more.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Left@$The power Finn got when he fought
Arcane...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$The Golden Crest...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$That crest was a miracle created by Finn
and all the other Crimson Crestbearers.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$If Finn's condition is a side effect, we have
nowhere to turn for answers!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$@Right@$We've asked everywhere. No one knows
anything but legends about the crests.

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Left@$Have there been any changes in Finn's
condition, Professor Callen?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$No. His body and soul are still in a state of
deep sleep. It is as though he is hibernating.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$I have anchored his soul to the leylines of
Elvenlent, so he is in no danger for now.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$How long will he continue to slumber?
For months? Years?!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$No! There must be something we can do!
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$It pushes me to steel myself, and resist.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$Don't despair just yet, Theo. It has only
been one month.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$And we have only tried existing
approaches.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Right@$Whether it takes us months, or years...
We must search for a new solution!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Center@$...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What are you thinking about, Theo?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$Wah! Don't sneak up on me like that...
$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Captain Rizette! You're back!
$#RedKnightB(Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$Did you find any traces of the bandits?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Yes. I think there are several groups
operating around here.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$Should we follow their tracks?
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$But...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$No. We should check in with the village
that called us first.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$But we could be attacked on the road. We
need to stay vigilant.
$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$Yes ma'am!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$I'm sorry for the quick march. Can you all
keep going a while longer?
$#RedKnightA(Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Of course!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHeh&$$@Left@$We're ready to go, Captain!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Good.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Center@$Red Dragon Strike Force, move out!
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$Where are my legs?
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$Where are my arms?
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$Where is my weapon?

$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$They just keep coming... Where did all
these warriors and monsters come from?!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Center@$?!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGrit&$$@Center@$(It's too close! I can't deflect it!)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGrit&$$@Center@$(Finn!!)
$#Minotaur(Large Monster)#$$&Minotaur&$$@Center@$GROOOARGH?!
$#Oz(Stranger)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$You hit light for such a huge brute.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Center@$Who...?!
$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Who is that?!

$#RedKnightB(Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$He parried a blow from that huge monster
like he was swatting a fly!!
$#Minotaur(Large Monster)#$$&Minotaur&$$@Center@$$%0.5%$GRR...GROOOOAARGH!!
$#Oz(Stranger)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$That wasn't enough to frighten you off?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$@Right@$That man in the black robes! He's gone!
$#Oz(Stranger)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Center@$Fine... I could use a warm-up!

$#RedKnightA(Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$Darn it... He must have escaped in all the
confusion!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Right@$Huff... Huff... Let's finish this!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...?!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Center@$Riz, behind you!!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Center@$What...?
$#Minotaur(Large Monster)#$$&Minotaur&$$@Center@$$%1%$GROOOAAAARGH!!
$#RedKnightB(Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Center@$Captain!!
$#Oz(Stranger)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$Is this all they've got?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Center@$Who are you?
$#Oz(Stranger)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$...
$#Oz(Stranger)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$My name...
$#Oz(Stranger)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$...is Oz.
$#RolotiaClock(Clock)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$I have detected traces of the Void.

$#RolotiaClock(Clock)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$It appears to have begun a large-scale
operation to increase its forces.

$#RolotiaClock(Clock)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$The scanning ability you gave "him" seems
to be functioning correctly. However...

$#RolotiaClock(Clock)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$Yes. I believe this meeting was brought
about by his residual fate.

$#Oz(Stranger)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$I don't suppose I can expect much from
the Apostles either.

$#RolotiaClock(Clock)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$No, there are still no signs of a power that
could shatter the fetters of the Void.

$#RolotiaClock(Clock)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$Understood. He should unlock it in the
course of pursuing the Void's—
$#RolotiaClock(Clock)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$Yes. All of time is as you command...

$#RedKnightB(Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$!-1!$$@Left@$He took out that enormous monster
alone?!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$Woah...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$(That face... That voice... And that fighting
style. Is that...?)

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$Come, little heroes! Let us shed blood
together!!
$#Oz(Stranger)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(No... It's not possible. But...)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Center@$This is Limnavale?

$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Center@$It's completely deserted. Where did
everyone go?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Center@$(Something is watching me...)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Center@$?!
$#GruGrim(???)#$$&GruGrimSerious&$$@Center@$...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Center@$Who are you? Where are the villagers?!
$#GruGrim(???)#$$&GruGrimSmile&$$@Center@$...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Center@$Look out, he has soul stones! Strike
Force, engage!
$#RedKnightB(Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$All the bandits have been arrested!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$We're nearly at the village that requested
our help.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$We may encounter more hostile groups on
the way, so stay on your guard!

$#Thief(Bandit)#$$&Thief&$$@Left@$Ugh, knights... Oh well, this is the perfect
chance to test those soul stones we stole!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$Is that a checkpoint up ahead?

$#RedKnightB(Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$Not an official one. Bandits might be using it
to trick travelers out of their money.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$I see.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Left@$Knights, prepare for a possible engagement!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$This cottage is empty, but it was
ransacked recently.

$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$It looks like a family of two or three lived
here, but there's no one around.

$#RedKnightB(Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$There are signs of a struggle, but no
bodies.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$Do you think the people who lived here
were taken by someone too?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Let's keep looking for the children.
We should head toward the coast.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$If we keep going that way, we should reach
the port town of Limnavale.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHappy&$$@Left@$Nice!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Looks like this campsite has been deserted.
$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$That's the last of them!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$The children weren't there...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$No. But at least we eliminated a dangerous
group.

$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$They've spotted us coming! Captain, the
bandits are headed right for us!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Left@$Prepare to engage! Send a detachment
around back to search for the children!
$#RedKnightB(Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$Yes ma'am!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$What's that up ahead?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$Theo...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$I'm sorry.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$Huh?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$I know you wanted to help with the
recovery efforts in Rossé...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$Don't be sorry—I want to be here.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$Did you know Finn donated all his wages to
the recovery efforts?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$Yeah, Mysha told me. She said it was a lot.
Finn never said anything, though.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSadSmile&$$@Right@$I'm sure he wanted to go and help too, but
he knew he needed to support Astrid.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$When this mission is done, we should both
visit Rossé.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$Agreed! Maybe there's still something we
can do to help.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$It should be an old battleground.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$I read about it in the Rigland Archives.
There was a battle here 200 years ago.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$It was during a Pandemonium. Demons
attacked from the sea.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Left@$Oz...?
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$...Fine.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$Try and hit me.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$Use your full strength or we'll stop right
here. And I won't help you again.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Left@$I have to hit you with my full strength?!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$...What?
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzCommand&$$@Right@$Come on!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$Um...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$Y-You're really strong, Oz.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$So um... I was wondering...
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzClosedEye&$$@Right@$If you have nothing to say, leave me be.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Left@$W-Wait! Um...

keys.value: $#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Left@$Look—there's an oasis over there!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$That oasis is known around here for its
beauty.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$It seems like a good spot for a break.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$Indeed... It seems "convenient."
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$?
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$...
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$(That sziviik is staring at me again.)

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$(I could continue to play dumb, but I'm
becoming curious...)
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$...

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Left@$Isn't it you and your patron's goal to have
this power manifest, Rolotia?

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Left@$You should be pleased. Your pawn is
growing faster than you expected.

$#RolotiaClock(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Right@$You are disrupting my timeline. This is a
violation of your contract.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Left@$I thought my time was in you and your
master's hands, Miss Avatar.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Left@$If it is disrupting something, isn't that
your fault?

$#RolotiaClock(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Right@$I won't overlook that remark. It amounts to
blasphemy against my patron.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Left@$What are you going to do, kill me? Sounds
like fun. Show me the power of an Avatar!

$#RolotiaClock(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Right@$As you wish. Taste the power that can
awaken even the souls of the departed!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzAngry&$$@Left@$?!
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$BRIIIIIIIIINNNNNNGGGGG!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$Where am I? What—
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzHurt&$$@Center@$Urgh?!

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzHurt&$$@Center@$(What's going on?! Something is
screeching in my head... Is this—?!)
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzAngry&$$@Center@$An alarm clock?! Rolotia, you—!
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$BRIIIIIIiiiinngg...
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzAngry&$$@Left@$It stopped... Honestly, are you a child?
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSurprise&$$@Left@$?!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$...

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSurprise&$$@Left@$(Why is there a szi warrior at my
bedside?!)
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$Well, this is a surprise.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$What?
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Oz.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Right@$Oz! You're awake!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$Who was that?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$Don't worry, he's one of our greatest
allies!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$You woke up just in time. Lunch is nearly
ready.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#DONTSHOWME(Oz)#$Apparently, I slept for a whole day after the
battle in Me'Dracona.
$#DONTSHOWME(Oz)#$When I awoke, the city was peaceful again.

$#DONTSHOWME(Oz)#$The sziviik who had been brainwashed into
abducting people were back to normal.

$#DONTSHOWME(Oz)#$The people the Red Dragon Knights were
seeking were found imprisoned in the city.

$#DONTSHOWME(Oz)#$They had all been freed by the time I
awoke.
$#RolotiaClock(Clock)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$What are you doing?

$#DONTSHOWME(Oz)#$Warriors came from Me'Rizanté to
investigate Me'Dracona.

$#DONTSHOWME(Oz)#$They are assisting in taking people back
home.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Left@$The two children from Rigland were safe
and sound too!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$The sziviik from Me'Dracona are very
helpful now. But...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$Their memories from the time they were
brainwashed are mostly gone.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$They weren't able to tell us what "Gru
Grim" means.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$Are the same things happening in
Me'Rizanté?
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$...No.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$I didn't know anything before coming to
see why Me'Dracona went silent.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Left@$Ga'Luga is going to be the next chief of
Me'Rizanté!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh, it's you.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$Is that so...
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$Me'Dracona itself may have been saved...
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$But this incident is not over.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$Apparently it was Me'Dracona's chief who
ordered all the abductions.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$But he is nowhere to be found.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$We have pieced together the fractured
memories of the townsfolk.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$They said their chief, A'Zelmeda, was
leading his own soldiers to snatch people.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$He is likely still at large.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(A'Zelmeda, Chief of Me'Dracona... He
must be one of the Apostles!)
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$(Finally, I've found one!)

$#RolotiaClock(Clock)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Right@$You haven't been permitted to even test that
power yet, let alone use it in combat...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oz, we are going to search for A'Zelmeda.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$The people of Me'Dracona begged us to
return him back to normal...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$But the only one who can dispel the
brainwashing is...
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$I have a mission to fulfil. It's up to you if
you wish to follow me.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Right@$Oz!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Then let's go together. We have an idea of
where to find him.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$I will join you. I must learn the truth of
this incident and see it dealt with.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Left@$Hmph... As the next chief?

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$As an Erdener...and in duty to my
Brother.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$Something feels... I see. So I'm asleep,
am I?
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$(Brother?)

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$If you can tell me the truth right here,
though, that is a different story.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$Where are my things, Theo?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$(He... He called Theo by name!)
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$I-I'll go and get them!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$Let's get moving.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Center@$...
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Center@$(Oz... He looks exactly like "him.")

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Center@$(Rizette is a good judge of character. Theo
is an even better one.)

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Center@$(But I will be making my own assessment.
Who in Erden are you?!)
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$And this is a dream.
$#RolotiaClock(Clock)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Right@$Answer me, Oz!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$Phew... That was a shock!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$I've heard you won't speak about yourself.
But what about them?

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$...The ones pulling the strings are called
"Apostles."

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$They can penetrate your defenses and
force you to do their bidding.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Left@$Apostles...?

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$They are most likely the leaders of the
Gru Grim.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$What are the Gru Grim trying to
accomplish?
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$That is all we get, is it? So your goal is to
find and defeat these Apostles?
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$...That's right.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(It seems like...Oz is just repeating things
that someone else told him.)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$Were those...?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Center@$(Did someone ask him to do this? Or...
Order him to?)

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That's enough questions. We need to go
after this group of sziviik.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$If we waste time, their numbers will grow.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$I'm going.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Ga'Luga?

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$He doesn't appear to have an ulterior
motive. But I sensed hesitation from him.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$At any rate, we have an idea of his goal.
But I still intend to keep my eye on him.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$What's wrong, Theo? Is there something
on my face?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Left@$No, it's nothing like that. It's just... It
seems like you've become more...
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$...Most likely.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteCalm&$$@Left@$Intellectual. And calm.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$How exactly did you two see me before?!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Left@$That was really cool, Ga'Luga!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$Very chief-like.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSleep&$$@Right@$No. I still have a lot to learn.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$I need to work harder. At this rate,
I'll never catch up to Mysha.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$Lieutenant Mysha is amazing, isn't she?
Working so hard to protect Astrid.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Left@$Lately even Marshal Ludmilla is in awe of
her.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$Really? Tell me more.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$The foot soldiers of this ring of abductors
and brainwashers?
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$(They act so casually...)

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$(How can they stand around laughing in this
situation? Is this what camaraderie is?)

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$(Such pointless intimacy. Do they not see
how it dulls their blades?)
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$Truly...
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzClosedEye&$$@Center@$Pathetic.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$The Gru Grim...
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$...
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$Oz.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$Who are the Gru Grim? What are they
after?
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$...

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$These footprints... They belong to a group
of sziviik.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzAngry&$$@Right@$Brace yourselves!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$A large one.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$A heavily armed one.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$It must be the force that A'Zelmeda is
leading.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Right... Ah!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Left@$There, on the slopes of the mountains!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzAngry&$$@Right@$!
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$ROOOAAAARGH!!!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$It's an ambush!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$They did not seem to be in control of
themselves. What is going on here?
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$Enemies hiding in empty villages... So
this is what you meant.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$What?
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$Let's go. The Chief isn't here.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$Y-Yeah...
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$Do you think the chief of Me'Dracona is
controlling them, too?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$What do you think, Oz?

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$I don't know. But they are in the same
state as the sziviik from Me'Dracona.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Left@$Then you could use your power to—

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$It isn't something to be used lightly. If I
had to describe it...
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$It's life-threatening.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$Sorry...
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Right@$Heh... That's what makes it worthwhile.

$#Eves(Eves)#$$&EvesSerious&$$@Center@$Urgh?! Your order is even mightier than
the rumors...
$#Eves(Eves)#$$&EvesSerious&$$@Center@$It appears we are still no match for you.

$#Eves(Eves)#$$&EvesSerious&$$@Center@$Thank you for your time. This loss has
been most educational.

$#Eves(Eves)#$$&EvesCommand&$$@Center@$Alright you layabouts! No rest till you can
show me exactly why we lost!

$#Eves(Eves)#$$&EvesSmile&$$@Center@$Oh, excuse me. Farewell, Knights. I look
forward to our next meeting!

$#Eves(Eves)#$$&EvesSerious&$$@Center@$Excuse me. Might you be the Red Dragon
Knights?

$#Eves(Eves)#$$&EvesSerious&$$@Center@$My name is Eves. I am a member of the
elven anti-crime group, the Seaspires.

$#Eves(Eves)#$$&EvesSerious&$$@Center@$We are conducting an independent patrol of
this region.

$#Eves(Eves)#$$&EvesSerious&$$@Center@$I did not think I would have the luck of
encountering your order here.

$#Eves(Eves)#$$&EvesSerious&$$@Center@$How would you feel about engaging in some
light combat with my troops and I?

$#Eves(Eves)#$$&EvesSerious&$$@Center@$We won't take up much of your time. I'm
sure it will be mutually fruitful.

$#Eves(Eves)#$$&EvesSmile&$$@Center@$I thank you for your graciousness. Now
then...

$#Eves(Eves)#$$&EvesCommand&$$@Center@$Seaspire, Platoon Eves... Show me your
guts, louts!!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$This is a lucky find. What's up ahead?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Left@$The Kawazu Wetlands. We should get back
on course.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$This is a secondary residence used by
Me'Dracona's chief.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$It's so green... Like an oasis in the
desert.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$The folk of Me'Dracona gave us permission
to use the supplies here.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Right@$They've got a decent stockpile.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$Do you intend to carry off everything they
have?

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Right@$They gave their permission, didn't they?
What's the problem?
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$Hmph...

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Right@$Heh. We should make the most of their
kindness.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$Urgh...!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$Shall we continue?

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$...Regretfully, I'll decline. The siblings
will notice.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$For the moment, I'll place trust in the
strength of your arm.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$But do not expect me to take my eye off
you. Both during and outside of battle.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Right@$That's a lot of caution. I suppose it's
befitting of your "Ga."

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Right@$I look forward to our next convenient
opportunity.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$(They really are alike... But there is also a
fundamental difference between them.)
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$(Oz... Just who are you?)

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$(His precision reminds me of Gilgan in his
prime... And his blade is as swift as Nagi's.)
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$(He fights as flexibly as Finn...)
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$(Who is this man...?!)
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$Hmph...

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$(His blows are brutally heavy, and he
utilizes a vast array of techniques.)

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Right@$(It's been a while since I've felt this
excited by a battle!)
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$...This is no good.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Right@$You've got that right... A mere test is
nowhere near enough.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$You were right—this oasis is quite
beautiful.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$I did not realize you were fond of pretty
views.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$...I'm only here to learn what you felt it to
be "convenient" for.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$So you noticed.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$It was difficult to ignore your murderous
glances. Where are the siblings?
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$Resting elsewhere.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Left@$I see... This certainly is convenient.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$Show me your make, "Oz."
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Left@$Sure... If you show me yours!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$They must have been Gru Grim pawns.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$(These attackers are becoming more
powerful. An Apostle must be nearby...)
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$These szi footprints just keep going...
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$(Can I control this new power...?)

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$They look to be in heavy armor, but they
never break stride.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$They must be highly trained.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$They are likely Me'Dracona's main force.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$We're in a desert, and our opponents are
an army of sziviik...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$They have the advantage in this territory.
But we have Ga'Luga. And...
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$(An army consisting of a city's main
forces...)

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$(They will be much tougher than those I
faced in Me'Dracona.)

$#GruGrim(???)#$$&GruGrim&$$@Center@$Ul Ganan, the Holy Sixth...

$#UlGanan(???)#$$&UlGanan&$$@Center@$Who is he?

$#AZelmeda(A'Zelmeda)#$$&AZelmeda&$$@Center@$Soon, all of Habsu will be indoctrinated

$#AZelmeda(A'Zelmeda)#$$&AZelmeda&$$@Center@$By the hand of the 18th Apostle, A'Zelmeda!
$#SziGuardA;SziGuardB;(Szi Guards)#$$&SziGuard;SziGuardB.SziGuard&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;SziGuardB.Right;@$WOAAAAAARRRRGH!!
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$I see...
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$So this is what an "Apostle" is.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$!-1!$$@Center@$A self-important brute obsessed with
their own status. Pitiful.

$#AZelmeda(A'Zelmeda)#$$&AZelmeda&$$@Center@$How did you get past my guards?!

$#SziGuardA(Szi Guard)#$$&SziGuard;SziGuardB.SziGuard&$$@Left;;;SziGuardB.Right;@$We have gathered the number you asked.
Please, begin the initiation.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hmph. There were certainly a lot of
them...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHeh&$$@Right@$But it was nothing compared to the Aeon
Tower!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$I am Rizette, Captain of the Red Dragon
Strike Force.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Left@$A'Zelmeda, you are under arrest on
suspicion of mass abduction!

$#AZelmeda(A'Zelmeda)#$$&AZelmeda&$$@Right@$The Red Dragon Knights?! And
Me'Rizanté's Ga?!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$Give it up, A'Zelmeda. You do not stand a
chance with just those guards of yours.

$#AZelmeda(A'Zelmeda)#$$&AZelmeda&$$@Right@$Lowly Ga, how dare you! You think you
can defeat me, a chief and an Apostle?!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Left@$You hardly seem deserving of either title.
$#AZelmeda(A'Zelmeda)#$$&AZelmeda&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You...!!

$#AZelmeda(A'Zelmeda)#$$&AZelmeda&$$@Center@$Your insolence is deserving of the harshest
punishment!
$#AZelmeda(A'Zelmeda)#$$&AZelmeda&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Very well. Although...

$#AZelmeda(A'Zelmeda)#$$&AZelmeda&$$@Center@$I, A'Zelmeda, hereby sentence you to
death!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzAngry&$$@Center@$He has soul stones!

$#AZelmeda(A'Zelmeda)#$$&AZelmeda&$$@Center@$Come, warriors... Follow your fate, and
embrace the teachings of the Void!!
$#DONTSHOWME(Summoned Heroes)#$$!-1!$Urghh...?! ROOAAAAARGH!!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$Those warriors he summoned... What's
wrong with them?!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Right@$Their eyes... They've been brainwashed!

$#AZelmeda(A'Zelmeda)#$$&AZelmeda&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Allow the Void to guide you, my warriors...
Go, and strike down the non-believers!

$#AZelmeda(A'Zelmeda)#$$&AZelmeda&$$@Center@$They are all unsatisfactory. None of them
will make good soldiers.

$#SziGuardB(Szi Guard)#$$&SziGuard;SziGuardA.SziGuard&$$!-1!$$@Right;;;SziGuardA.Left@$My apologies. The soldiers here became
mercenaries during the Pandemonium.
$#SziGuardB(Szi Guard)#$$&SziGuard;SziGuardA.SziGuard&$$@Right;;;SziGuardA.Left@$Many of them did not return.

$#SziGuardB(Szi Guard)#$$&SziGuard;SziGuardA.SziGuard&$$@Right;;;SziGuardA.Left@$Those remaining are children and
civilians.

$#AZelmeda(A'Zelmeda)#$$&AZelmeda&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I see... No mind. We will simply have to
train them.

$#AZelmeda(A'Zelmeda)#$$&AZelmeda&$$@Center@$The teachings of the Void shall fill their
souls.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$Mhu'Skalé is the largest village in the
area.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$If A'Zelmeda is a chief, he must be quite
powerful.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$Ability wise he is a "Za." A warrior of
average skill.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$Really? I thought only "Ga" head warriors
and "Da" head tacticians could be chief?

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$Heredity plays a role too. A'Zelmeda's
father was the previous chief.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$He died suddenly of an illness, so
A'Zelmeda was promoted early.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$Bloodline was prioritized over the
proficiency of the current Ga and Da?

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$Me'Dracona's Ga and Da were both killed
in the previous Pandemonium.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$So that's why he was chosen...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$A fresh young leader was needed to bring
the city together after such hardship.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$It looks well defended. Almost like a
fortress.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$But now he's hunting down his own kind
as one of the Apostles.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$You don't have to say it like that...
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$Theo, it is a truth that we must now face.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$You must steel yourself against it.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$...I know.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$Theo...
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$Ga'Luga, Oz! We're back!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$What did you find?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$There's a mid-sized company inside. Most
of them are sziviik.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$The villagers are gathered in the town
square. They don't look brainwashed...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$There were soldiers there waiting on a
sziviik with red scales.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$That must be A'Zelmeda.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$He was giving orders, and the soldiers
were obeying like mindless puppets...
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$What's that?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$Wow, an oasis! It's huge!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$Or'Baruha, the largest oasis in Habsu.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGentleSmile&$$@Right@$It's beautiful...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$...?

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$(Did a giant shadow just cross the surface
of the water...?)
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$Curse these surprise attacks...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Ah...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$Theo... That was way too direct.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$Sorry...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$He reacted to the word "Pandemonium"
though.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$Let's give it a little more time.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$When this Me'Dracona business is over,
we can see what Astrid thinks.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$Okay.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Oz looked conflicted about something.)
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Center@$(I wonder if he's okay...)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$This still isn't as bad as it was during the
Pandemonium. We'll manage.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$The Pandemonium...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$...Oz?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$Where were you during the last
Pandemonium?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$(Theo...!)
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$Don't know.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$Lucky!
$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennAngry&$$@Center@$Urgh... I cannot win...
$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSmile&$$@Center@$Thank you. I have learned much.

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSerious&$$@Center@$(I sensed no evil in their blows. I cannot
imagine they would kill for sport...)

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSerious&$$@Center@$(Perhaps I should take a closer look at the
motives of my client.)

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSmile&$$@Center@$I hope we can spar again if we have the
fortune of a second meeting. Farewell.

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSmile&$$@Center@$Greetings. I am Fenn Fal, a traveling
fencer.

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSmile&$$@Center@$Am I correct in assuming you are the Red
Dragon Knights, guardians of Westland?

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSmile&$$@Center@$Would you consider engaging in some
light sparring?

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSmile&$$@Center@$A simple fight is rather tasteless, though.
How about we set some limitations?
$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSmile&$$@Center@$Thank you for humoring me.

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSerious&$$@Center@$(My target is here... But first I must make
certain they are deserving of my wrath.)
$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSerious&$$@Center@$En garde!
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaWah&$$@Right@$Nyaaaaah?!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Left@$Luna! Are you okay? You said you didn't
care if we lost this one!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaWah&$$@Right@$What are you saying, Solas?! That fight
was over before it started, aren't you mad?

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSmile&$$@Left@$I guess. But look on the bright side—now
we know what we have to do to improve!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Right@$Like what? Do we need to work on our
poses again?

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Left@$I've been meaning to say this for a while,
but maybe we should cut back on that...

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaCommand&$$@Right@$What?! You can't call it a battle if it doesn't
have some pomp and whimsy!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSmile&$$@Left@$Luna... Thank you for taking the time
to battle us!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$Just wait, next time you'll get the honor of
seeing our victory poses!!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Right@$It's the Red Dragon Knights! Long time no
see. I challenge you to a battle!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Left@$Luna! You're jumping into things way too
fast! Um... Hello! Nice to see you again!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$After our last battle we thought about how
we can improve, and we have a strategy!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$If we want to be the best, we have to butt
heads with the best!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Left@$Um... She means we want to battle you
guys, so we can learn from you.
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$Yeah, that!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$How about it? You better not go easy on
us if you say yes!
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy;Solas.SolasSmile&$$@Right;;;Solas.Left@$Yay! Alright, let's go!!

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$Hmph... I was wondering why there
weren't any animals around.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$Theo, that was careless!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$I-I'm sorry! I was just excited to see some
water after all this sand...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$Theo... Thank goodness!!

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$Or'Baruha... It sounds like an old name,
even by szi standards.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$In the common tongue, it means...
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$"Dazzling trap."
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Left@$Heh... I see.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Left@$Or'Baruha! It really is beautiful!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$Theo, don't go too close. It may be a
pretty sight, but...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Right@$Theo!! Get away from the water!!
$#DONTSHOWME(Monster)#$$!-1!$GROOOAAAARGH!!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Left@$Wah?!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzAngry&$$@Right@$A monster?!
