prefer it if you asked someone else...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$No way! I want Oz to teach me!
$#RolotiaClock(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$Oz will soon vanquish the Sixth Apostle.

$#RolotiaClock(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$You believe "its" interference in Erden
accelerated their growth?

$#RolotiaClock(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$...Understood. I will begin by investigating
those around him.
$#RolotiaClock(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$Yes. All of time is as you command...
$#RolotiaClock(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$Lady Chronos...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Left@$E-Elmina... Are you saying you're...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$One of the Gru Grim's Apostles?!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...!
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$"Former" Apostle. Don't leave that out!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$You once said you were a captive in
bandit hideouts... Is this what you meant?

$#RolotiaClock(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$With this, the Void's hold over the north
should be at an end.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$Yes. Those bandits...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$were the cult of the Hidden God, the Gru
Grim.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Left@$B-But you're nothing like them... You're
not brainwashed, are you?!
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Right@$Nope. I broke free of it!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$How?!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$Oz, was it? You seem to have earned the
trust of not only Rizette and Theo...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$but even Ga'Luga. He's a tough nut to
crack.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$What do you mean by that?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSmile&$$@Right@$That's why I'll trust you enough to answer
your question.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Elmina, can we speak on the road? We'd
like to ask for your help.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$No need to ask. I have some business with
that masked snake too.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Right@$That's why I'm here. So I'd love to join if
you'll have me, Cap.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHeh&$$@Left@$...Thank you!

$#RolotiaClock(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$Yes... I did not imagine that his fate would
draw them to him.
$#RolotiaClock(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$No... He is likely acting of his own accord.

$#RolotiaClock(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$It is yet unclear whether this is his own
gift...

$#RolotiaClock(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Center@$Or a sign of the evolution Erden has
undergone across two millennia.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Left@$This magic... It's Ul Ganan, no mistake.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$Isn't he one rank above you, if he's
number six?
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$Sure, but the Apostles don't interact much.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$I've heard some things about him, though.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$Tell me.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Right@$Alright, don't get your knickers in a knot.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$He used to be a swindler.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Left@$A swindler?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$He'd sell rocks as precious stones using
his illusions.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$He extorted money from mountain villages
by frightening them with apparitions.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$That's...
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$Do you think he plans to attack?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$So petty.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$It's no laughing matter. Some of the
people he hoodwinked killed themselves.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$That's awful...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$He got caught by the Gru Grim when he
tried tricking one of the Apostles.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$He had promise, though. He survived
the rituals, so now he's an Apostle, too.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$I see.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$So he's a lowlife, not worth saving.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$Ah...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$Oz... We want to capture Ul Ganan alive.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$And you want me to use my power so
you can?
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$He deserves punishment, but if we can get
him alive we may learn a lot from him.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$Just as we did with A'Zelmeda.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Left@$You're talking about the power you said
could break the Apostles' spell?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Left@$If it's for real, it's the best weapon we have
against the Gru Grim.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Right@$I'll support you Oz, like last time! So...!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzClosedEye&$$@Left@$...

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$(Nothing to say, Rolotia? So you want me
to use it too?)
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzAngry&$$@Left@$(I can't get any peace from this circus.)

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$(But I need to keep sharpening this
power.)
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$I'm not making any promises.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$(I feel the Void's influence. But it's not
like it was with A'Zelmeda.)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$Oz...
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$But I need information too.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Right@$Then...!

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$It takes time for me to prepare it. And the
target needs to be weakened.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$Make me the opportunity I need.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$...Deal.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$We've done this twice now. I think we
know how to make it work.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Right@$Heh. I see how it is.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHeh&$$@Left@$We'll do our best so you can do yours,
Oz!

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Get ready. Don't ruin this chance by being
underprepared.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$(It's like Ul Ganan is calling it to
himself...)
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$Elmina.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Right@$Hmm? What's up, Oz?
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$What is Ul Ganan like?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$To tell you the truth, that was my first
time meeting him back there.
$#GruGrim(Robed Man)#$$&GruGrim&$$@Center@$...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Is that...?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$@Right@$A Gru Grim follower. He's no Apostle, but
he can still hoodwink people!

$#GruGrim(Robed Man)#$$&GruGrim&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Come, warriors... Follow your fate, and
embrace the teachings of the Void...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGrit&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Soul stones! This is the same thing that
happened with A'Zelmeda!!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzAngry&$$@Right@$Brace yourselves!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$My magic has always been strong. I was an
orphan, so I used it to steal and stay fed.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$As an Apostle, I acted on the orders of
some mystery commander.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$Following those orders, I took a lot of
people. I hurt a lot of people.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$Elmina...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$One day, I was ordered to abduct children
from an orphanage.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$It was a simple job. I gathered my
subordinates and grabbed all the kids.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$But one of the little girls, dazed after just
waking up, grabbed onto me...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$And called me "Mama."
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$Before I knew what I was doing, I'd taken
out all my subordinates.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$I took all the kids back.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$Before I knew it, I'd become the leader of
all the other street kids.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSmile&$$@Right@$I set out on my own, running away from
everything and toward nothing.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$Elmina...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$Don't look at me with pity, Rizette.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$So that's why you helped the children in
Nushelle...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSmile&$$@Right@$Yeah, more or less.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$So a little girl was the key to you
miraculously breaking the spell.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSmile&$$@Right@$Miraculously, huh? Maybe.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$(Something like that broke the spell of the
Void?)

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$(A spell even Rolotia and the other
Avatars couldn't break...)
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$So you were a full-fledged thief.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$(Does she have some kind of innate gift?
Or...)
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$...?
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Did you notice?
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$We're surrounded...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$Seems like the same assassins that were
lurking around the wetlands.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$They're just lowlives hired for money by
the Gru Grim. No need to hold back!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Okay. Let's handle this swiftly, then!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$Ha ha. I can't deny it. But my abilities
attracted the attention of the Gru Grim.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$They abducted me, and tied me to a
creepy altar.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$For days they performed weird rituals and
messed around with my magic.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$Then all of a sudden, they started calling
me...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$Elmina, the Seventh Apostle.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHappy&$$@Left@$Lucky!

$#Tobias(Tobias)#$$&TobiasGrin&$$@Center@$Ha ha ha! You sure don't hold back! I
haven't had a beating like that in a while!

$#Tobias(Tobias)#$$&TobiasSurprise&$$@Center@$Huh? The Red Dragon Knights? Never
heard of 'em.

$#Tobias(Tobias)#$$&TobiasGrin&$$@Center@$The earth only gave birth to me recently,
so there's a lot of stuff I don't know.

$#Tobias(Tobias)#$$&TobiasAngry&$$@Center@$Why does everyone always look at me
funny when I tell them that?

$#Tobias(Tobias)#$$&TobiasGrin&$$@Center@$Think what you want. I know what my next
mission is.

$#Tobias(Tobias)#$$&TobiasGrin&$$@Center@$To defeat you! I can't call myself Fist of the
Earth if there's someone stronger than me!

$#Tobias(Tobias)#$$&TobiasGrin&$$@Center@$Oh, that sounded cool. I'm gonna add it to
"Tales of Tobias: Fist of the Earth."

$#Tobias(Tobias)#$$&TobiasGrin&$$@Center@$Next time we meet, I'll prove myself worthy
of my name! Farewell, Knights!

$#Tobias(Tobias)#$$&TobiasSurprise&$$@Center@$I thought you guys were more of those
creepy assassins, but I guess I was wrong.

$#Tobias(Tobias)#$$&TobiasGrin&$$@Center@$You don't look like your average knights,
though... Heh.
$#Tobias(Tobias)#$$&TobiasGrin&$$@Center@$How 'bout a little light sparring for fun?

$#Tobias(Tobias)#$$&TobiasGrin&$$@Center@$I like the way you guys think! Let me
introduce myself before we get started.

$#Tobias(Tobias)#$$&TobiasGrin&$$@Center@$The name's Tobias. I was born to protect
Erden. They call me the Fist of the Earth!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHappy&$$@Left@$Nice!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$What's this?

keys.DescriptionKey:
The Red Dragon Knights, working to aid survivors
of the Pandemonium, are attacked by a strange cult.
They are rescued by a familiar stranger...

a1.name: Act 2
a1.title: Act 2
a1.subtitle: The Red Dragon Strike Force
a1.description:
The Red Dragon Knights, working to aid survivors
of the Pandemonium, are attacked by a strange cult.
They are rescued by a familiar stranger...

keys.value: $#DONTSHOWME(???)#$Groaaargh... Roaaaaargh...

$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSerious&$$@Right@$There's a guardhouse to the right. No one
will be there, though.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Left@$There's too much echo. I couldn't tell
which way those roars came from.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$The path ahead leads out of this forest.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$That's true... But...

$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSerious&$$@Right@$Didn't you say you were passing through
on business?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Yes, we're on a mission.
$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSerious&$$@Right@$Then why...?
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Left@$Our Captain can't ignore people in need.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$@Left@$Doesn't make it easy to get stuff done,
but that's what I like about her.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$We are yet to make any major detours.
This shouldn't delay us long.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Exactly.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$...
$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSurprise&$$@Right@$Are all the Red Dragon Knights like this?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Helping people is the most important
thing that we do.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Now, which way should we go?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Right@$What was that?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Ludorié, was that the...?

$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSerious&$$@Right@$I believe so. My people described its cries
in a similar way.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Left@$Here we go!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$That was an intimidation call. It knows
we're here.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$There's a fork in the road. Which way did
it come from?
$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSerious&$$@Right@$The path ahead leads deeper into the forest.
$#DONTSHOWME(Male Voice)#$Stop right there, human!

$#Sherry(Sherry)#$$&SherrySerious&$$@Left@$I can tell you where to find them. We need
to send people there immediately!

$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSerious&$$@Right@$Alright, calm down. But Red Dragon
Knights or otherwise...

$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSerious&$$@Right@$I refuse to allow a pack of armed
humans free reign in our forest.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$We apologize for entering your domain
without permission.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$But I believe we can help you, if you'll
explain the situation.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSurprise&$$@Right@$?!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzAngry&$$@Right@$(whisper) Rizette, what are you planning?

$#Sherry(Sherry)#$$&SherrySerious;Ludorie.LudorieSerious&$$@Left;;;Ludorie.Right@$We can trust them. And they're probably
our best chance at getting through this.
$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSerious&$$@Right@$...
$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSerious&$$@Right@$...Let's continue this indoors.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Center@$?!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Okay.

$#Ludorie(Elven Man)#$$&LudorieSerious&$$@Center@$I didn't think humans would come slinking
in here at a time like this...

$#Ludorie(Elven Man)#$$&LudorieAngry&$$@Center@$Leave! This forest is the territory of the
elves and the kud.

$#Sherry(Sherry)#$$&SherrySad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Wait, Ludorié! These people are from the
Rigland Red Dragon Knights.
$#Sherry(Sherry)#$$&SherrySad&$$@Left@$They saved me!
$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSurprise&$$@Right@$Sherry! You're okay?!
$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSerious&$$@Right@$The Red Dragon Knights...?

$#Sherry(Sherry)#$$&SherrySerious&$$@Left@$They managed to capture some of the
people driven wild by the beast!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Left@$Are you okay?
$#Sherry(Sherry)#$$&SherrySad&$$@Right@$That demonic beast made them this way.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$Beast...?
$#Sherry(Sherry)#$$&SherrySad&$$@Right@$We don't know what it is exactly.

$#Sherry(Sherry)#$$&SherrySad&$$@Right@$It has the ability to drive anyone it injures
into a state of frenzy.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$You think the ones we met earlier were
like that too?

$#Sherry(Sherry)#$$&SherrySad&$$@Right@$Most likely. I was looking for them with
my comrade, but we were separated...
$#Sherry(Sherry)#$$&SherrySmile&$$@Right@$Please, could you help me find him?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Of course. Do you have any idea where
he could be?

$#Sherry(Sherry)#$$&SherrySmile&$$@Right@$We agreed to meet at the house of the
elven chief if something happened.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzAngry&$$@Left@$Rizette...
$#Sherry(Kud Woman)#$$&SherrySmile&$$@Right@$Yes, thanks to you.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$We can't just ignore her when she needs
help. Can you show us the way, Sherry?
$#Sherry(Sherry)#$$&SherrySmile&$$@Right@$Of course! Thank you!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$We are the Rigland Red Dragon Strike
Force. I'm Rizette, the captain.

$#Sherry(Kud Woman)#$$&SherrySmile&$$@Right@$You're one of Rigland's heroes! No
wonder you're all so strong.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$We caught some others like this earlier.
They are further back along this path.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$Who are you? Do you live here?

$#Sherry(Kud Woman)#$$&SherrySmile&$$@Right@$My name is Sherry. I'm chief of the
Dandelio kud.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Left@$Why would these guys attack their own
chief?

$#Sherry(Sherry)#$$&SherrySad&$$@Right@$You've probably guessed, but I don't
think they're acting of their own will.
$#DrukeSmall(Beast)#$$&DrukeSmall&$$@Center@$Groaagh!! Roaaargh...!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$Ludorié, are you alright?

$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSurprise&$$@Left@$Y-Yes. I've cleaned the wound. It seems
I just slowed you down... I am sorry.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$!0!$$@Center@$It won't be going far with those wounds.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaCommand&$$@Center@$Rizette, Ga'Luga... What was that? Why
weren't you using your full strength?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$!0!$$@Left@$Elmina...
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSad&$$@Right@$That beast...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Hey, look at this!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$It's a bag. What about it?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$@Right@$I think that beast dropped it!

$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSerious&$$@Left@$That bag is in the fashion of the Dandelio
kud. Perhaps it stole it from...
$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSurprise&$$@Center@$$%0.5%$Ughh!!
$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSurprise&$$@Left@$!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$Ludorié? What's wrong?
$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSerious&$$@Left@$This embroidery...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSurprise&$$@Right@$Oh, that's the little flower this forest is
named after, isn't it?
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSurprise&$$@Right@$Do you know who owns it?
$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSerious&$$@Left@$There are only two with a bag like this...

$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSerious&$$@Left@$One of them is Sherry, Chief of the
Dandelio kud. The other is...
$#Ludorie(Ludorié)#$$&LudorieSerious&$$@Left@$Her younger brother... Rossiu!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$Do you think there are more of them still
around...?

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$If they get in our way, we simply have to
deal with them.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$We don't have time to waste talking. We
need to keep moving!

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzAngry&$$@Left@$I'm starting to grow very tired of these
attacks...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$Are they after us specifically?
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$Their numbers seem too low for that.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$I would guess they're just attacking
everything in their path.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$@Right@$So they're trying to eliminate anyone who
might get in their way.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Then we should lead them away from the
civilians!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Look at that village!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Flames... No!!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Right@$Quickly!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$The people inside the house are okay!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Center@$Move out!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$It's fortunate they were already hiding
inside because of the spirits.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$We need to shut down the altar, but we
can't forget to protect civilians, too.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$That's right, Rizette. We should do what
we can as we head for the altar.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$Let me make this clear. My priority right
now is taking out the Apostle.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$That's fine with me. It's probably the
fastest way to stop this horrible mess.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$@Left@$Heh. That makes things easier.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaCommand&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hey, something's heading straight for us!
It's the Gru Grim, I'm sure of it!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Center@$We need to stop them getting anywhere
near that house.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Center@$This lock is tough...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Commander! I was just inspecting it!
Look, I'm putting it all back down!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Left@$Honestly. We are not thieves!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$@Right@$Are you sure?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$I guess this is what they call military
requisition.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$Exactly, Theo! I'm leaving a notice
instructing they send the bill to Rigland.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Right@$Lucky we're knights and not bandits.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Obviously! Alright, we have what we came
for. Let's split!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Center@$Stand aside, Rizette. Ga'Luga, Oz!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$!0.5!$$@Left@$Oaaargh!!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzAngry&$$!0.5!$$@Right@$Hurgh!!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Ha ha, is that your version of a skeleton
key?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$It's one that can only do the unlocking
part, though...
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Not bad.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$There's a nice collection of szi-style
weapons.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Let's not waste any time. Elmina, hands
off that gold!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHappy&$$@Left@$Nice!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$Lucky!

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSerious&$$@Center@$Even in a situation as dire as this, you
remain calm and collected in combat...

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSmile&$$@Center@$I underestimated you. Your skills know no
time or occasion. You are near unstoppable!

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSerious&$$@Center@$What's that? The defeat of your order
would signal the end of the West...?

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSerious&$$@Center@$I see. If you are charged with such a duty,
perhaps I never stood a chance.
$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSmile&$$@Center@$Allow me to contribute to your mission.

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSmile&$$@Center@$Until the light returns to this place, I will not
allow a single innocent life to be harmed.

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSmile&$$@Center@$Thank you for your time. I hope your
number will not be less when next we meet.
$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSmile&$$@Center@$Farewell!

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSmile&$$@Center@$Greetings, Knights! You are unharmed, I
see. No surprise.

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSerious&$$@Center@$I never guessed this land could be sealed...
My instincts have been unreliable of late.

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSmile&$$@Center@$I am working with some young adventurers
to help the people of this region.

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSmile&$$@Center@$What kind of adventurers? They are full of
energy and valor. Young, but skilled.

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSmile&$$@Center@$I am about to head to a village nearby to
watch over it.

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSmile&$$@Center@$I would enjoy a short match, but I suppose
this is not the right time for it...

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSmile&$$@Center@$Thank you! Despite these dark times you
would still expend energy on me...

$#Fenn(Fenn Fal)#$$&FennSerious&$$@Center@$To hold back would be an insult to you. En
garde!
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaWah&$$@Right@$Nyaaaaah!!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Left@$Th-Thank you! Please battle us again soon!
Seeya!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasHurt&$$@Left@$Urgh... Even I want to yell "Nyaaaah" this
time...

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Right@$No! Catspeak is my thing, Solas! You need
to find your own!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Right@$That aside, don't you think we got pretty
close this time?

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasHeh&$$@Left@$I hope so...We've trained so hard together,
everyone on the team is irreplaceable!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$Right! We might have to rethink our victory
pose! You can go somewhere on the side.
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Left@$(Wait, am I replaceable?!)

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$Alright, we need to get back to work! Thank
you for the battle! Let's go, Solas!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Left@$Is it because I can't shine and float? I
would if I could but I... Ah!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Left@$Wah! You scared me, I thought you were a
monster!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Left@$Why do you always have to take things
too far, Luna?! S-Sorry! Alright, let's go!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Right@$Solas! I took that traveler to the village
where Fenn Fal is... Hey! It's you guys!!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSmile&$$@Left@$Hey, Luna. If Fenn Fal's with her, I'm sure
she's fine.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSmile&$$@Left@$We're helping a traveling fencer we met
rescue people!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$Heh heh... It's time for you to see how
much progress our warriors have made!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasHeh&$$@Left@$Right! We've been working hard together
everyday. You better look out!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$It's rare for you to get pumped up before
the battle starts, Solas!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$I want to heckle to! Hey, you there! I bet
your mother was an orc!
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Right@$Yay! I knew you'd say yes!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$Lucky!

keys.DescriptionKey:
After defeating the Sixth Apostle of the Gru Grim,
Rizette and her party hurry to Astrid's side. However,
a strange beast blocks their way...

a2.title: Act 3
a2.subtitle: The Avatars
a2.description:
After defeating the Sixth Apostle of the Gru Grim,
Rizette and her party hurry to Astrid's side. However,
a strange beast blocks their way...

keys.value:
$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkHurt&$Aaaagh... Which one is my face!? Not this
one... Not that one... Not that one...
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Right@$Huh?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Right@$The Dream Gate! I had no idea we were so
close already!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$The Dream Gate?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$That's the border between the real world
and the dreams ruled by Hypnos.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$By defeating the Guardians, you're getting
closer to awakening from this dream!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$So, all I have to do is head there and....

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$You can wake up! And you can meet
Hypnos!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Alright! What are we waiting for!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Right@$Hmm...?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Alice? What's wrong?

$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkHurt&$I can't remember...
I can't remember myseeeelf...!!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$It's strange... I can hear a voice...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Left@$No way... Does that mean...?
$#Voice(Voice)#$$!-1!$Why?
$#Voice(Voice)#$Finn's brain seems to be active and awake.

$#Voice(Voice)#$That's the results of both my investigation
and Sage Rei's diagnostic analysis.
$#Voice(Voice)#$And yet...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenPout&$$@Left@$Rei, why is this happening?!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$Be calm, Callen. Finn's soul is being
restrained by an unbelievably strong force.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Right@$The source of which is likely raw spiritual
energy. No being of Erden could possibly

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$harness the power that impedes our
treatment. Which leaves only one answer.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$That's what you get for messing with my
memories!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiClosedEyes&$$@Right@$This is the power of the Spirit World.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenPout&$$@Left@$The source of Erden's magical power...?
How? It has no will of its own.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$It's said that the gods who made Erden
made their home in the Spirit World.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$You speak of the Primordials?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$Even assuming they exist, what would they
want with... Ah!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSurprised&$$@Right@$!!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Left@$?!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$@Right@$The battle's coming closer...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$Nagi and the others are strong, but the
enemy numbers are too great!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$@Right@$We must abandon the laboratory, and carry
Finn into the Forest of the Fae!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Right@$You did it, Finn! I can hardly believe you've
already beaten two Guardians.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenPout&$$@Left@$Not now!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenPout&$$@Left@$(With Kisenkyo's help we finally got the
Great Sage to the Elvenlent ley lines.)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenPout&$$@Left@$(We had everything we needed, a treatment
was within our grasp!)

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiShouting&$$@Right@$Callen. This is not the time to flounder.
We're not safe here.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$Sage Rei, please. Let's continue Finn's
treatment.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$His last reaction was the strongest yet.
There may not be another chance like this!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$You can draw upon the full might of
Elvenlent! Please, just try again!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiClosedEyes&$$@Right@$...

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$It was he and his friends who saved Erden
and every soul who resides here.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiShouting&$$@Right@$For his sake...let's try one more time!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$I could only do it because I had your help.
Thanks, Alice.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$Sage Rei...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Left@$Thank you!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Seeing that imposter only made me more
fired up to meet my real friends!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$Hmmm....
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$(I guess he really wants to meet them...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$By the way, Alice... That thing over there
in the distance. That's a gate, right?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$That building...
$#Rizette(Girl)#$$&RizetteCalm&$$@Right@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Hey, you! You're...umm...
$#Rizette(Girl)#$$&RizetteCalm&$$@Right@$?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$(Damn, I can't remember her name for the
life of me.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$(But I know... I know she's important.)
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$Finn, watch out!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$?!
$#Rizette(Girl)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$RAAARGH!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$!-1!$$@Left@$She's attacking?!

$#Gyurelle(???)#$$&GyurelleDarkSad&$$@Right@$Ugh... So close, man. I almost snagged
that face for myself.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$Is that what they call a fortress? I suppose
this came from your memories, too.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Left@$A shape-shifter?! Are you a demon?!

$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkWink&$$@Right@$Yep! I'm Gyurelle∼ Here to steal your
looks and take your place.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$Finn! She's the next Guardian!

$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkSmile&$$@Left@$So, Finn. I'm gonna get rid of your reason
to live for you. And you just rest, 'kay?

$#Ludmilla(Red Knight)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Right@$Indeed! Your training only truly begins
when you enter the eternal sleep!
$#Theo(Boy)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$I think you've had enough soup, Finn.

$#GaLuga(Szi Warrior)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$Brother. You should rest...until the stars
fade and the planet dies. Rest...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Left@$How does she keep changing?! And all
these people... Are they...?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$Likely the friends from your memories.
What a twisted creature!

$#Mysha(Kud Warrior)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Left@$You don't need to worry anymore. You can
just sleep. Just keep on sleeping. Forever.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Probably. Hmm?

$#Elmina(Elven Rogue)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$You really don't have to do anything. This
is for the kids. You know that, right?

$#Gilgan(Kud Elder)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Left@$Will you sleep forever, or shall I put you
at peace? Choose!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Left@$St-Stop...

$#Callen(Young Elf)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Right@$Don't you understand? We did it! Erden is
saved. But if you wake up... You'll ruin it!

$#Astrid(Red Knight)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Left@$You are the threat to Erden now! Show a
little contrition!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Left@$Just...St-Sto...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$Finn! This is just a bad dream. The more
you fear it, the worse it will get!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Left@$I know this is just that demon... But... I...
$#Nagi(Bikki Warrior)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$Sir Finn! A minor request, if I may...

$#Nagi(Bikki Warrior)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Right@$Would you mind telling me the name of
the young woman next to you?
$#Rizette(Girl)#$$&RizetteCalm&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Left@$!!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$This one's kind of weird...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$I won't give up!
$#Nagi(Bikki Warrior)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$Urgh!!

$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Like, I know it's really just me and all, but
you'd hit your own friend? That's so mean!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$That's the thing about Nagi... He's always
the life of the party.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Always ready to throw himself into harm's
way if it's for a princess.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$He's not the kind to lose heart over a
little wound like this!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Right@$I see! You mean he's always making a riot,
so he can take a little jab!
$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkRage&$$@Right@$What?!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$A girl? Looks like she went inside that
building.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Left@$It means you've lost, Gyurelle!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$?!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Ah! That girl is...!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$Finn? Finn! Wait, that girl is definitely―
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$Grr... Finn, come back here!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#TavunRabbit(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitAngry&$$@Right@$Hmph. In any and every world, Rabbits
have always been half-made from dreams.

$#TavunRabbit(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitAngry&$$@Right@$How many rabbit pies have you eaten not
knowing that? Such ignorance.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Right... Well, thanks for telling me.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Alice. Is this really okay?
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Right@$Is what okay?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I'm happy to have you here, I really am. But
aren't you disobeying Hypnos by helping me?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$If I get out of here and remember my past,
what does that mean for you?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$Hmm... I never much liked the idea of
keeping you trapped here.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$After living with you, I'm sure you'll do
good things with that power of yours.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Right@$Besides, Hypnos isn't that stubborn. If we
explain, they'll listen.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Right@$Finn, you've been staring at me for a while
now. Could this be love?
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Right@$I think!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$You think? But...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$If it looks like things are going to get rough
you should say I threatened you! That way―

$#TavunRabbit(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitAngry&$$@Right@$Impudent rube! Miss Alice and Hypnos
have been acquainted for 2 millennia!

$#TavunRabbit(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitAngry&$$@Right@$The bonds between the Primordials and
their Avatars are deeper than you realize.

$#TavunRabbit(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitAngry&$$@Right@$It's not something the likes of you could
possibly hope to understand!
$#TavunRabbit(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$@Right@$Probably.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$"Probably"?!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Right@$Don't worry your pretty little head about
Hypnos. Worry about the Guardians.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$"Guardians"? You mean the monsters in
this dream? They certainly are a handful.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$What? No, I was just thinking that you're
really strong.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$Those are Phantasms. The magic that lives
within all living things gives them form.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$The form they take is influenced by the
dreamer's hopes, fears, and memories.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$They usually wander aimlessly through
people's dreams.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$But the little friends we've been meeting
are here at Hypnos' command.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Why?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$To stop those with a soul from leaving the
village. In this case, that would be you.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$So they're basically just dreams too? That
explains why they don't feel quite real.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$But the Guardians are different. When they
come for you, they'll really try to hurt you.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Are you saying they might kill me? What
are they?
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$They're dreams, Finn.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Right@$Of course! I'm invincible as long as I'm in
my garden!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$Let us know if you remember anything.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Okay, I will. But for now...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$Strange.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$Indeed. We must keep moving to protect
the village.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$You're right. Let's go!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$(A long dream... I really wish I could
remember it...)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$I assumed they were using sorcery to force
their summoned warriors to fight, but...

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$The residual magic is too low. There is
also no trace of demonic interference.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$There's still fighting throughout the village.
Will there be more people like this?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$It doesn't seem like we can reason with
them.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Let's figure out who they are later. We
need to stop them first!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$Agreed.
$#GruGrim(Robed Man)#$$&GruGrim&$$@Right@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$This guy's just like the last one!

$#GruGrim(Robed Man)#$$&GruGrim&$$@Right@$Mighty warrior, follow your fate to my side
and be baptized by the Void!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$He used soul stones! But...

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$@Right@$I can feel it too. These warriors' hearts rot
with a foul insanity!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Here they come!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Left@$Phew... I think that's about half of the
monsters that blue monkey had with it?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Left@$Does it have any weaknesses? Anything
we could use to defeat it?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$It likes "the burning souls of warriors..."
That's all that really comes to mind.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Hot-blooded warriors, huh? Sounds like
Marshal Ludmilla or Ga'Luga...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Right@$You're no slouch yourself in that
department, Finn.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Hm. Maybe it'll come after me if I give a
war cry or something?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$Let's chase after it. We'll find some way
to defeat it, I'm sure.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$I am no skilled fighter, but I am
confident in my warrior spirit!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiShouting&$$@Right@$I won't be outdone.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$I'd better be careful, or you two are
gonna show me up! Okay, let's go!
$#Rei;Callen;(Rei & Callen)#$$&ReiShouting;Callen.CallenAngry;&$$@Left;;;Callen.Right;@$Yeah!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$...Grenzor.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSurprised&$$@Left@$Is that what it's called?
What kind of monster is it?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$They're a kind of monster found rarely
in frozen areas and snowy mountains.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$They freeze and eat their prey's hearts
whole, which extends their lifespan.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiClosedEyes&$$@Left@$There's a similar legend in Eastland.
A beast that freezes its prey's hearts...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$According to one theory, the Grenzor are
living weapons created by Eastland.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Left@$And now there's one loose in Elvenlent!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$Reports say they've destroyed dozens of villages. We can't let it run wild!
$#GruGrim(Zealot)#$$&GruGrim&$$@Center@$Gaaaaaah!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Overloaded? What?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$@Right@$It happens very rarely, when a summoner
calls to something far more powerful!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$There's something there in the crater!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSurprised&$$@Right@$Oh, no...
$#Taotie(???)#$$&Taotie&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Dooo... Groo... Mu...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$!-1!$$@Left@$It's huge! What is that thing?!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Right@$Finn, get back!
$#Taotie(???)#$$&Taotie&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Duumo Goooo!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Waaah?!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$@Right@$It...fled? No— It's gone berserk!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Great! I think we stopped it!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$A giant simian emitting blue light... Oh,
don't tell me!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$@Right@$The other summoned monsters are
rampaging too!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Are they following after the big one?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Right@$They may be influenced by its power...
Callen, do you know what that thing is?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$Explanations can wait! For now,
we need to chase it down, and fast!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Got it!

$#GruGrim(Zealot)#$$&GruGrim&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Khh... Powerful one! Cross the bonds...
of Fate! Arise...!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Left@$He had more soul stones!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Right@$Wait... Everyone! Get down!

$#GruGrim(Zealot)#$$&GruGrim&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Grant... Grant the blessing of...! The...!
Void... Void...!
$#GruGrim(Zealot)#$$&GruGrim&$$@Center@$Vooooooooooooid!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$!-1!$$@Left@$W-What happened?! An explosion?!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Right@$The soul stones overloaded!

$#GruGrim(Zealot)#$$&GruGrim&$$@Center@$O, powerful one! Cross the bonds of Fate!
Arise, and grant the blessing of the Void!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Geez, they're fast with their summons!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$@Right@$I don't sense any fear or hesitation from
the summoners.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$It's likely due to the brainwashing... But
that doesn't look like any old ritual!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$We have to interrupt it!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Hey, look at this!
$#Taotie(Grenzor)#$$&Taotie&$$@Center@$Duuu... Uuuuurgh...!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiHappy&$$@Right@$Yes!!!!!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHeh&$$@Right@$...But this is rather exhausting.
Let's tone it down some...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$We... We did it! Somehow...we did it!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiHappy&$$@Right@$I was worried for a minute, but it looks like
we did it.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Hey, Callen? Yours sounded less like
a war cry and more like a scream.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Right@$How rude. I was doing my best, you realize!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiHappy&$$@Right@$Hehe. You both had very inspiring war
cries.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$Yours gave me chills too, Sage Rei!!!
I was seriously impressed!!!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Right@$Okay! Let's keep our spirits burning
while we save Elvenlent!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$Yeaaaaaah!!!!!
$#Taotie(Grenzor)#$$&Taotie&$$@Center@$Grooo! Gaoooarrrrgh!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$Okay. I'll do that, too.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiShouting&$$@Right@$Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$I-indeed! I hope I can still manage it...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Right@$Gyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Callen?!
$#Taotie(Grenzor)#$$&Taotie&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...!

$#Taotie(Grenzor)#$$&Taotie&$$@Center@$Grooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo!
Grooooooooooooooooooooooooooorr!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I-It answered us!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$It's coming this way!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Right@$I didn't expect that to actually work!
Get ready! Here it comes!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$There it is!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Yeah!!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Right@$But... it's still so far away!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$@Right@$It'll escape the bounds of Elvenlent
at this rate!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Left@$Hoooooo...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Raaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaargh!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Right@$F-Finn?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$I don't really do the whole "burning soul"
thing, but we can't let it escape!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Raaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
aaaAAAAAAAARGH!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$This is gonna come in handy!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$These guys are everywhere... They must
be looking for something.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$Damn my scholarly overspecialization...
Ah, here. The villagers gave me this.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Is it really okay for us to take this? It looks
pretty valuable...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$They said they hope it'll help us in our
fight to save the village.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$We can't afford to lose...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Yeah. We're fighting for everyone's sake!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$@Right@$Something, or someone.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Whatever it is, we can't let them find it.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenCalm&$$@Right@$I'm back! Everyone inside is safe.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Thank goodness.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiHappy&$$@Right@$The house itself isn't too badly damaged,
either. I'm glad we made it in time.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$But they have elders and children, and
can't safely evacuate from the house.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$I put an aegis up on the wall, but that's
a temporary measure at best.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$We don't have time to make
anything sturdier, I think.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiShouting&$$@Left@$Finn! There are hostiles near that house!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$They're trying to break in! We have to
help them!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Got it!

keys.DescriptionKey:
In the land of dreams, Finn hears voices calling him.
He sets out on a journey to remember what he has
forgotten with a peculiar girl named Alice.

keys.value:
$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduAngry&$$@Left@$Damn you...damn you! I, Kadu, the Great
Seventh, will not lose to the likes of you!
$#Merdain(Merdain)#$$&MerdainSerious&$$!0!$$@Center@$Not so fast!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Wha...

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSurprise&$$@Right@$(That strike was perfect! There shouldn't
have been any time to block! So how...?!)

$#Merdain(Merdain)#$$&MerdainSerious&$$@Left@$You seem taken aback.
Surprisingly expressive, aren't you?
$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduAngry&$$@Right@$Merdain! How dare you interfere!

$#Merdain(Merdain)#$$&MerdainSerious&$$@Left@$You think you could have defeated him
on your own?
$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduAngry&$$@Right@$Of course! The Magnificent is with me!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$Oz! Heeeeey!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSurprise&$$@Left@$Theo?!

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$So you followed me? That's perfect.
I leave the rest to you!

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmug&$$@Right@$Don't waste your final breaths, scum.
The Seventh, huh?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$The rest? Wait a minute...
Oz, are you—?!

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$Merdain, was it? You seem like a tough
one. I won't hold back!

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$I will cut the evil god's chains!
Arc... Rebelliooon!
$#RolotiaClock(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Right@$That's it! Those two cultists should be—

$#Merdain(Merdain)#$$&MerdainSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...
Is that all?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Huh? It didn't work?!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$Why not?!
$#RolotiaClock(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Right@$I don't know, but this is really bad!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaCommand&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oz! I can buy you a moment!
You have to run!

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Rolotia?! What are you doing, coming out
in front of the enemy?!

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmug&$$@Right@$You talk big, for a substitute brought in
to fill Elmina's shoes.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$@Right@$We can't afford to lose you! Here goes!
Five! Four! Three!
$#Merdain(Merdain)#$$&MerdainSerious&$$@Left@$Pointless.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSurprise&$$@Right@$Two... Huh?
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSurprise&$$@Right@$(When did he get so close?)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Left@$Rolotiaaa!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$@Right@$(His blade...it's coming closer.)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSurprise&$$@Right@$(Oh, no...it's going to hit me. That's odd.
I'm the Avatar of Time, and yet...)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSurprise&$$@Right@$(It feels like there's no time for me to
dodge it...)
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzAngry&$$@Left@$Rolotia!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzHurt&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$Gaah!

$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduAngry&$$@Left@$Heathen! I am a devoted Apostle of the
grand, the glorious Magnificent!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSurprise&$$@Right@$Oz...?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSurprise&$$@Right@$Oz?!
You protected me...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSurprise&$$@Right@$You're wounded! Oh, you're wounded!
Why would you do that?! For me...?!

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzHurt&$$@Left@$Quit whining. You really...never do shut
up... Nngh!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSurprise&$$@Right@$Oz?
Oz!!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Theo.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Right@$Captain?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$I'll draw his attention. You and Rolotia,
take Oz and run.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$What are you saying?! I could never—

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Don't argue with me. This is an order
from your Captain.

$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduAngry&$$@Left@$Such filthy insult to my title is blasphemy
unto the Infallible Truth itself!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$@Left@$...Don't worry. I'll be right behind you.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$...You'd better be, Riz!

$#Merdain(Merdain)#$$&MerdainSerious&$$@Left@$How brave of you. But do you really think
you can defeat me?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Right@$I won't know unless I try. And I can at
least buy my friends time to escape!

$#Merdain(Merdain)#$$&MerdainSerious&$$@Left@$...An admirable statement.
But a false one.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$(He's so fast! I won't be able to block!)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHurt&$$@Right@$(I'm sorry...Theo...)
$#Cyrus(???)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hup!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$(Is that...a card?
Whatever it is, Merdain's backed off!)

$#Cyrus(???)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$You know, little lady, you really ought to
be more careful with yourself.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$Why do none of you ever stop talking?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$Who's there?!
$#Cyrus(???)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$Me? Oh, I'm nobody special.
$#Cyrus(???)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$Just an old man passing by.

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Why didst thou allow the Golden Crest
to reawaken?
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$Why was its eternal sleep interrupted?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Hypnos)#$If he had not been allowed to protect
the Crest may have fallen to the Void.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Hypnos)#$And...the boy shows potential. To protect
Erden. To be a beacon of hope...
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$Ridiculous.
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$Volcana. Whither go thou?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Volcana)#$A foolish question. If you will not act to
end this threat, then I will.

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$(That said, he's actually pretty strong. I
need to end this, and fast.)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Volcana)#$Let us see just how much "potential"
he has.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Left@$Oz... Why did you do it, Oz?
Please, just wake up...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Left@$If...if I don't shut up, do you think he'll
wake up to yell at me? Oh, Oz...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$Rolotia...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSadSmile&$$@Right@$You keep calling out to him. I know he'll
hear you.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$I'll work on treating his wound!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Left@$Thank you, Theo...
$#Cyrus(???)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Pardon me. Sorry to interrupt.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHappy&$$@Center@$Theo!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Center@$Riz! Thank goodness you're alright!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$Enough chatting. Time to die!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteCalm&$$!-1!$$@Right@$This man saved me, and we managed
to get away.

$#Cyrus(???)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$Let's not get too comfy, though. Those
two cultists are still out there.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$That's fine... That's fine, so long as
Riz is safe.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$Thank you very much, sir... Um. What
should we call you?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$Cyrus, if you please. I just happened to
be passing by...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$...And I can tell you already don't believe
me.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteCalm&$$@Right@$I don't think anyone would just "happen to
pass by" through that village, no.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$Yeah, that's a good point.
Well, if I had to explain...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$I'd say I'm an ally of allies of justice...
Or something along those lines?
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$...Take this!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$This is where Oz was going, right?

$#RolotiaClock(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Left@$What a big mansion. It must be the
village center.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Right@$Hang on... I hear fighting!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Let's get in there!
$#()#$$!-1!$Several minutes earlier...
$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduEvilSmile&$$@Center@$Heh heh heh... I have you now, heathen!

$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduEvilSmile&$$@Center@$Rejoice! You have the honor to face Kadu,
the Seventh Apostle!

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSmug&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Seventh, huh... You're nothing compared
to the Seventh I knew.
$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduAngry&$$@Left@$Silence!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Right@$They were pretty tough...but they're
no match for us!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Left@$But now the whole village knows we're
here.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$I would have liked to avoid notice, but
it's too late now. Be ready to fight!

$#RolotiaClock(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Left@$These are Oz's footprints! I knew it was
a good idea to check out this old village.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$Wait...what's that black stuff in the pool
there?

$#RolotiaClock(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Left@$That black liquid...

$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduEvilSmile&$$@Center@$Ha ha ha ha! Weak, weak, weak!
You Red Dragon Knights are so weak!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$@Right@$The strongest? That's bull! You're just the
Seventh! Don't be so full of yourself!
$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduAngry&$$@Left@$Wha— How dare you?!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Right@$Ooh, and easy to rile, too.
Hit a sore spot, did I?

$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduAngry&$$@Left@$Disrespectful wench! I'll show you
my power firsthand!

$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduAngry&$$@Left@$Believers, to me! Show these heathens the
might of the one true God!
$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$!-1!$$@Right@$W-what is he?!

$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduEvilSmile&$$@Left@$Impudence!
Lower your head before me, knave!
$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$$%0.3%$Gaah!

$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduEvilSmile&$$@Left@$Behold the power of my Lord's blessing!
My domination is a tribute to his strength!

$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduEvilSmile&$$@Left@$Do you see now, Merdain?!
I alone am the chosen of our Lord!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Stop it!

$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduEvilSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh?
So you are the Golden Crestbearer!

$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduEvilSmile&$$@Left@$I am the Seventh Apostle, Kadu! The
strongest servant of the Hidden God!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Hang on, what's that?!
Are those siege towers?!

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$You should have struck to kill. You insult
me, holding back like that.
$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaCommand&$$@Left@$Advance to the wall! Rigland will surrender the Golden Crestbearer to us!

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$Hold! Thou laborest under a delusion!
Thy Lady of Fire is wrong!

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$...Take care what you say before me,
Avatar. Now, I ask you this.

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$You stand idly by while a power that could
destroy Erden runs free and unchecked.

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaAngry&$$@Left@$And yet you claim to serve this world?
You claim to protect it?

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$Fool! Thou seest not! To protect Finn
is to protect Erden herself!

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$This is pointless. Which of us is the
deluded one, I wonder...

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$I do this not upon my Spirit's command,
but because Finn saved my soul.
$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSurprise&$$@Left@$Saved your soul?

$#Galuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$Where did they get their filthy hands on
armaments like those?!

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$A being born of the Spirits, speaking of a
soul...what do you know of such things?

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$True, I am but newly born. Were I mortal,
I would still be at my mother's teat.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$I see, so you are still a child, Sir Vesh!
Little wonder you believe all you're told!

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$But in my short life, I have tasted despair,
as well as the joy of merciful salvation.

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$To do what is right, to reach out to
those in need; that is who Finn is.

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$And that is why he is worthy of the Gold:
A champion of Erden, in heart and deed!
$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$I, too...was once taken with one who
shone with a similar radiance.

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$But my Lady's will is absolute. I will burn
out this danger before it grows further.

$#HymelianA(Hymelian Soldier)#$$&GuardCommand&$$@Right@$Your Highness!
Movement from the Gru Grim!
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$@Right@$The situation's not looking good...
$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$Report. Quickly.

$#HymelianA(Hymelian Soldier)#$$&GuardCommand&$$@Right@$The Gru Grim have assembled an army.
They seek to strike at Rigland!

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$Curses!
Finn is in danger!

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$Undo these chains, Maxima! Even one
such as thee must surely understand!

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$Should the Gold fall to the Gru Grim, then
all is lost! Only death awaiteth!
$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaCommand&$$@Left@$Be silent! You will not sway me!
$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$Maxima!
$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$...
$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$...Release them.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Right@$Oh, my princess! Our words have reached
your heart after all!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Left@$Look there! Marshal Ludmilla's squad
is turning back toward the wall!

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$Only until the threat is past. The instant
the last cultist falls, we are foes again.

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$Now...would you please say something to
the crimson demon charging this way?!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Right@$Lady Ludmilla! You came for me!

$#HymelianA(Knight)#$$&GuardCommand&$$@Center@$Fetch more weapons! Hurry!
Don't let them get a foothold!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...Mm. I'm surprised shouts from the
surface can make it down this far.

$#HymelianA(Jailor A)#$$&GuardSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Did you hear? They say these cultists
have siege towers. Siege towers!

$#HymelianB(Jailor B)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Right@$I heard they're after Rubea's Tower.
Why there, of all places?

$#HymelianA(Jailor A)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Left@$It's strange; they're not making any
moves toward the palace or Headquarters.

$#HymelianB(Jailor B)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Right@$They're a bunch of maniacs. Who knows
what's going through their heads?

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Cultists...the old headquarters... I see.
They must be after Magnifo's seal.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$She's got Nagi and Vesh with her! They'll
crush the cultists against the wall!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSmile&$$@Left@$Pardon me, sir jailor.
Could I ask a favor?

$#HymelianA(Jailor A)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Right@$L-Lord Luther?!
What is it?

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSmile&$$@Left@$I've injured my arm on a loose wallstone.
Could you help me treat the wound?
$#HymelianA(Jailor A)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Right@$Hey... What should we do?

$#HymelianB(Jailor B)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Left@$We can't let it get infected... Criminal or
no, I don't want him to suffer needlessly.

$#HymelianB(Jailor B)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Left@$Understood.
Show us the wound, if you please, sir?
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...Forgive me.
$#HymelianA(Jailor A)#$$&GuardCommand&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Gwah?!

$#HymelianB(Jailor B)#$$&GuardCommand&$$@Right@$Urrgh! Lord Luther...
What...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Just a little knock on the heads. You'll
have concussions, but nothing worse.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Left@$Great! Let's keep moving, everyone.
We have to save Tori!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Center@$I apologize for using your loyalty against
you, but I have to go.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Center@$(Astrid. You are likely in grave danger
at this moment.)

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Center@$(You must survive. As the Hero of this
world, the heir to the Draclow blood...)
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Center@$(And...)

$#()#$Outside the Wall
Several Minutes Before

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$Is that all? Knights, put this bikki
and the Avatar in chains.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Right@$To think you could defeat my blade...
You are as skilled as you are lovely!

keys.DescriptionKey: Finn awoke from his slumber just in time to turn the tide against the Gru Grim attacking Elvenlent. He and his friends then leave to rendezvous Ludmilla. Meanwhile, back in Zibsetta, having finally revealed herself to Rizette and the others, Rolotia prepares to tell them about her mission and Oz's identity...

a5.name: Act 5
a5.title: Act 5
a5.subtitle: The Hidden God
a5.description: Finn awoke from his slumber just in time to turn the tide against the Gru Grim attacking Elvenlent. He and his friends then leave to rendezvous Ludmilla. Meanwhile, back in Zibsetta, having finally revealed herself to Rizette and the others, Rolotia prepares to tell them about her mission and Oz's identity...

keys.value:
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$@Right@$We did it!
Where's Oz?!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$@Center@$But behind all that surliness, he really is
a kind and considerate person.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaCommand&$$@Center@$Would a beast lead others? Would it offer
kind words or a helping hand? Oz would!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaCommand&$$@Center@$He's working to protect people.
He's changing! I can see it!

$#Kisara(Vengeful Spirit)#$$&KisaraGhostAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Such touching faith in your friend...but
you are wrong. He's not worth your trust!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaCommand&$$@Right@$What is your problem?! You know nothing
about Oz! Who do you think you are?!

$#Kisara(Vengeful Spirit)#$$&KisaraGhostNormal&$$@Left@$And what do you know of him? What lies
beneath that "kindness"?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$You mean...Norza?

$#Kisara(Vengeful Spirit)#$$&KisaraGhostNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yes. His true form...the many tragedies
and atrocities he committed.

$#Kisara(Vengeful Spirit)#$$&KisaraGhostCommand&$$@Center@$Behold his memories, then...behold the
sin committed by this fool of a man!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Left@$He's still fighting that ghost!
Come on!

$#Kisara(Vengeful Spirit)#$$&KisaraGhostNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$%0.3%$What's the matter, Norza?
Take up the sword, as you did before.

$#Kisara(Vengeful Spirit)#$$&KisaraGhostCommand&$$@Left@$That filthy blade is perfect for a power-
grubbing beast like you!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaCommand&$$@Right@$That's not true! He's not like that
anymore!
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSurprise&$$@Left@$Rolotia?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yes, he's brash and rude, and surly,
and he never listens to anything I say...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaCommand&$$@Center@$And he ignores the Spirits' will and only
does what he wants to! He's an idiot!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Left@$Is this supposed to be helping him?!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$...How is Oz?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Gotta...gotta catch my breath...!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Callen!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Right@$Rizette?! You're okay?! Thank goodness!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$Yo, Callen.
Long time no see.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Right@$Huh?
...Aaaah?!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Right@$Wha...you—
Are— Is that really you?!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Left@$You know him?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Right@$Of course I do! Cyrus used to travel with
me and Rody!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$You mean...Cyrus was a friend of
Finn's dad?!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$Right after the war, he just up and left,
without a single word to anyone.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$I treated and bandaged his wounds. But...
He's shown no sign of waking up soon.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Right@$And now you just show up?! Like you
were never gone?!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenComplain&$$@Right@$...I was worried about you!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$Let's leave it there for now, eh? These
young 'uns don't need us bickering.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Right@$As flippant as always, I see.
Don't try to brush me off!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$You seemed pretty worked up when you
arrived. What's going on?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$O-oh, right. Something terrible has
happened!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$Then I say let's focus on the present
instead of the past.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$But first, who's your charming friend?

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$Me?
Well, I am...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$@Left@$An Avatar of a Primordial, right?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$Maybe it's something we can't see? Like
some kind of spiritual wound...maybe.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$Rolotia?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Left@$...I'm sorry for earlier.
I'm feeling better now.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$@Left@$I would like to know what brings a
Primordial's servant here, though.

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$Indeed, I serve the Spirit of the Land.
I see thou servest the Spirit of Time.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$It's a regular convention of Primordial
servants, huh.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$Something big is happening, that's clear.
So, what is it?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$$%0.3%$You see—

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Left@$—So Darna, the Gru Grim's leader, has
released their god Magnifo...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$And... Finn and the others were
swallowed up by it.

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$The Spirits felt the Gru Grim's evil, and
so did they appoint their Avatars.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$We could smack him awake, I guess. But
that might start him bleeding again.

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$But the cult's ambitions run darker than
even my Lady did surmise...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$So that's it. See, Callen? The reminiscing
will have to wait.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Right@$I think I can be forgiven for complaining
a little when you show up out of nowhere.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$...But yes, let's leave it at that. We have
more important topics to discuss.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Like how to rescue the others, right?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$Right. I'll need your help, everyone.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$We're up against a god...and I don't have
a counterplan in mind just yet.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$Really? You don't? I guess even geniuses
slow down in their old age, huh.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Right@$Cyrus, I swear...!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Right@$...Wait. Do you mean to suggest that
you do have a plan?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$...Wait.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$Sort of. If Rody's boy with the Crest has
been taken over by that thing...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$Then seems like our only choice is to
wake our prince here from his nap.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$Huh?
You mean Oz?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$Yup. What are we supposed to do against
an invisible enemy, after all?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$Can't attack or defend against it. Without
Vesh, even Callen would have been taken.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$I hate to admit it, but he's right. Not even
the Golden Crest worked on Magnifo.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$We can guess how to defeat it, but
guesses are all they are...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$@Left@$But maybe...maybe Oz's Arc Rebellion
could do it.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$@Left@$The power to cut through Fate. Just
maybe, that could reach Magnifo.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$So there we go. Now, how are we going to
wake him? His body seems fine...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$Captain?
What is it?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$Yes, he's all healed up, but...for some
reason, he hasn't woken yet.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$Good grief. We don't have time to wait
for Sleepyhead here.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Don't worry. Leave this sleepyhead to me!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Aah! A-a girl?! Where did you—
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSurprise&$$@Left@$...Are you an Avatar as well?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Right@$That's right! I'm Alice. My boss, Hypnos,
sent me to come help you out.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSurprise&$$@Left@$Hypnos...?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Right@$You must be Rolotia, right? I think my
boss and yours had a talk.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$@Left@$They wish to wake Oz to protect Erden,
correct?

$#TavunRabbit(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$@Right@$Indeed! And for that, why, you need the
help of young Miss Alice!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$I hear footsteps.
Coming this way, fast.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Left@$...Did that bunny just talk?!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Right@$I'm pretty sure that was just
ventriloquism...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$Anyway, what do you need us to do?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I'll use my power to bring you all into
Oz's dream. Then we look around!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$...It won't be a tea party, I'm afraid. It's
going to be dangerous, and scary.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$@Left@$Dreams are a mirror of the self, reflecting
the most personal depths of the soul.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$@Left@$Entering another person's dream is akin
to forcing yourself into that sanctum.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Left@$It's a desperate measure. And if we fail,
we could hurt Oz even more deeply.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Right@$...But you'll still do it, right?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Left@$Yes. If there's even a chance of waking
him...I'll do it.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Right@$What should we do?! It's not safe
to move Oz yet!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Left@$To save the world, and...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$@Left@$...No. To save Erden, it's my duty to
wake Oz from his slumber.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$@Right@$Please, bring me too!
I want to help Oz.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$I'll go with you. I need to keep Theo safe,
and...I want to help the others, too.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$Sounds like a plan. Me and the big guy
will stay on guard duty, then.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$While you're inside his head, you'll be
defenseless—just like you're asleep.

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$Fear not, my comrades. I shall stand
guard over thy slumber.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$How about you stay too, Callen? We can
catch up.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$I guess we might as well...
Be careful in there, everyone.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Right. You too.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$It's okay! I know those footsteps!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Right@$Ready to go, everyone?
Then let's do it!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Right@$Come along with me, friends... Into
the wondrous world of dreams!

$#()#$As soon as Alice clapped her hands, I felt
my eyes go heavy, and my head go fluffy.

$#()#$I sank down, down, into a deep sleep,
and when I opened my eyes...
$#()#$We were in a dark, frozen land.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Left@$This looks like the depths of Oz's heart.
$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSurprise&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$I... I...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Oz? Are you okay?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$Oz, you're shaking.
What's going on?

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$%0.3%$I-it's nothing. I... I have to open it.
I have to keep moving forward...
$#Kisara(Vengeful Spirit)#$$&KisaraGhostAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$A ghost?! Not now!

$#Kisara(Vengeful Spirit)#$$&KisaraGhostGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No...za...
Norza... Norzaaaaa!

$#Oz(Oz)#$$&OzSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$W-what is this thing?! Its voice...
Makes my body lock up!

$#Kisara(Vengeful Spirit)#$$&KisaraGhostCommand&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Norza! Lower that filthy hand, and begone
