$#NorzaMagnifo(Norza Magnifo)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Hah...hahahaha! Yes, that's it! I can feel... all of you!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Left@$...Thank you, Theo.
Hearing that...makes me very happy.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSmile&$$@Left@$...I should be going. Thank you again,
for everything, Theo. Be well, okay?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSadSmile&$$@Right@$I will. Feel free to come see us again
anytime!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$...The sky is so beautiful.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$How cool he was, how kind he was, and never ate his vegetables...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$...How kind he was...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Theo's amazing. He values Norza so much,
but he's using the past tense already...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$I'm the Avatar of Time, and yet, somehow
I...just can't manage it myself yet.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Norza...maybe that was the end you
were hoping for.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Maybe a peaceful end wouldn't have been
forgiven by the victims of your sins.
$#NorzaMagnifo(Norza Magnifo)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$...You fell for it.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$That would have been too much to ask.
I know that. And yet...!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaUpset&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$And yet, even so...
I wanted you to live...!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$...
I'll offer a prayer.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$This time, may your soul find peace
everlasting...

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Center@$...Where am I?
It's so bright...

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$$%0.3%$You're late! How long were you planning
to keep me waiting, huh?!
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzSurprise&$$@Center@$Huh?!

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Going off and becoming a hero without
me... Pretty cheeky, junior disciple!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzSurprise&$$@Center@$Oh, uh...sorry?
What do you mean, a hero...?

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Don't play dumb! If we'd had the same
chances, I'd have been stronger than you!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaShocked&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Huh? Norza, you can't—
Wait! Don't!

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$So come on, already!
Hurry up and let's go!

$#Menue(???)#$$&MenueSmile&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$...If you're this slow next time, I won't
wait around as long for you, okay?
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$%0.3%$H-hey, wait for me!

$#DONTSHOWME(Norza)#$$!-1!$Come on, wait up!
Menue!

$#NorzaMagnifo(Norza Magnifo)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Here goes...
Full power!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaShocked&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Please, Norza, no!

$#NorzaMagnifo(Norza Magnifo)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Arc...
Rebellioooon!!!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$N-Norza...
He used Arc Rebellion...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurpriseGold&$$@Right@$On himself...?!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSurprise&$$@Left@$The power to cut through Fate...one of
the only powers to threaten Magnifo.
$#NorzaMagnifo(Norza Magnifo)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Right@$$%0.3%$Ghhhh... Graaaaah!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSurprise&$$@Left@$He used Magnifo's own power...
To strike them both down...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHurt&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Ungh...nn...
W-where am I?! Where's Magnifo?!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$Marshal! If you're freed from the
brainwashing...

$#Darna(Darna)#$$&DarnaGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No... No. It can't be! My Lord's flame
is guttering out!

$#Darna(Darna)#$$&DarnaCommand&$$@Center@$Magnifo? Magnifo...?
Where are you going?

$#Darna(Darna)#$$&DarnaGrit&$$@Center@$God...
My...God...

$#Darna(Darna)#$$&DarnaGrit&$$@Center@$My...
peo...ple...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Darna...
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzHurt&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Ha... Hahaha...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Left@$Norza! Norza! Oh, no, he's fading fast...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$@Left@$Norza!
Any more of this, and you'll die!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Left@$...You knew this would happen,
didn't you?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Left@$You used your own life force, on top of
Magnifo's power...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$His own life force?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Left@$I thought you could use Arc Rebellion
without Chronos's power now...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Left@$But that was only half true. You could use
it, yes...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaUpset&$$@Left@$But only at the cost of burning away
parts of your life force... Right?

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzHurt&$$@Right@$I knew...I might die. I was ready...to pay
the price with my own life.
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzHurt&$$@Right@$But...it was worth it. All of it. Because...

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzHurt&$$@Right@$I've always wanted to be...
A hero.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Left@$Norza, don't speak!
Save your strength!
$#NorzaMagnifo(Norza Magnifo)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Right@$Shut up! Shut up, shut up!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzSmirk1&$$@Right@$Hey... Do you think I did it?
Was I...a hero, in the end?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Left@$...Yes.
Yes, you were.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzClosedEye&$$@Right@$$%0.3%$I...see...
......
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSurprise&$$@Left@$Norza...?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Right@$Norza...no...!
No...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaUpset&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Norzaaaa!
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$...Seems like it's over now.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$Geez, talk about cutting it close...
I thought we were done for there.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$Still...the Golden Crest ain't exactly what
it's cracked up to be.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$Just as I feared...
The Crest is losing its power.

$#NorzaMagnifo(Norza Magnifo)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Magnifo! Your opponent holds the Crest,
the only thing that can threaten you!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$...I need to get this to him before
his power fades completely.

$#DONTSHOWME(Rolotia)#$――After the battle of Rubea's Tower, we
slept like rocks, and woke to a new dawn.

$#DONTSHOWME(Rolotia)#$Like Ludmilla, the Gru Grim's
brainwashing was broken...

$#DONTSHOWME(Rolotia)#$And under Astrid and Ludmilla's watch,
rebuilding efforts were soon underway.

$#DONTSHOWME(Rolotia)#$...Which makes this as good a time
as any.

$#DONTSHOWME(Rolotia)#$With my charge gone from this world, I
no longer have a reason to remain.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Are you sure, Lady Rolotia?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$@Right@$Yes. Before anything else, I'm Chronos's
Avatar, after all.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$@Right@$I must return to the Spirit World and
tend to my injured Lord.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Right@$...Please make sure to give Norza
a proper burial.

$#NorzaMagnifo(Norza Magnifo)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Center@$Your greatest threat...yet you don't trust
me! You only give me half your power!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSadSmile&$$@Left@$He'll have a hero's funeral.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Left@$The others are just outside.
You should say something to them.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$@Left@$Thank you, Rolotia.
...Let's meet again.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSmile&$$@Right@$Yes. Thank you... For everything.

$#Galuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$Your long sleep has left you slow,
my Brother! Your guard is full of holes!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Left@$Your concentration is wavering, Sir Finn!
You have to focus!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Right@$Argh...
One more time!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSmile&$$@Left@$I see you're working hard, even after
all that happened yesterday.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Rolotia...
Are you leaving?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSmile&$$@Left@$Yes, I'm just here to say goodbye.
Thank you so much, everyone.

$#NorzaMagnifo(Norza Magnifo)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$Give me everything you have, Magnifo!
I will contain all that you are!
$#Galuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$No need. I only did what had to be done.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$It will be quieter here without you! I wish
we had met you earlier in our travels!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$Rolotia...
I'm so sorry.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$Brainwashed or no, I'm the one who hurt
Chronos. It's my fault Norza...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Left@$Don't apologize, Finn. He chose to go
that way. So...please don't apologize.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$...Even so. I wish we could have won
without his sacrifice.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Left@$...I know. That would have been best.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$@Left@$Finn, please don't go down the same
road that Norza did.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSerious&$$@Left@$So many people care for you, and if you
were to leave them like that...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$...

$#NorzaMagnifo(Norza Magnifo)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$And with your full power, I will erase the
Golden Crest from existence...!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Left@$Please, don't make Rizette and the others
suffer like that. Please.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$...I know.
I won't, I promise.

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Have no fear, small one. For I shall be
here to protect and guide Finn.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Huh?
Vesh?! You're okay?!

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Left@$Of course! I was weak for a time, but the
radiance of my Lady's soul did revive me!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSurprise&$$@Right@$Well, I understand in theory, but...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSurprise&$$@Right@$Anyway, are you sure it's okay? Don't you
have to return to your Primordial's side?
$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Left@$I see no problem in remaining here.

$#Galuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$In fact, we would welcome you and your
strength with open arms, Vesh.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSad&$$@Right@$$%0.3%$You know, Spirits aren't supposed to
meddle in the mortal world too much...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No!
Norza!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSmile&$$@Right@$...Well, it's fine. I'd say you've earned it.
Enjoy yourself, okay?

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$But of course! Come, Sir Finn!
Let us cross blades!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$$%0.3%$Huh?! But we're saying goodbye to—
Whoa, don't pull me!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSmile&$$@Right@$I'll take my leave, then. I'd like to speak
with Theo; do you know where he is?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$I believe he is in his private room there...
......

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Center@$I guess I should start by writing what
kind of person he was... Probably...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Theo?
What are you doing?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$Waah!
R-Rolotia!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSmile&$$@Left@$There's no need to panic.
I'm sorry, did I interrupt something?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$No, not at all! I was just, well...writing a
diary, I guess. Or taking notes, rather.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHurt&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$Ngh!

$#DarnaMagnifo(Darna Magnifo)#$$&MagnifoDarnaSerious&$$@Right@$And just what kind of tricks did you use
to make it here, hm?

$#DarnaMagnifo(Darna Magnifo)#$$&MagnifoDarnaEvilGrin&$$@Right@$No matter. You already know that
your Crest won't work on me!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Well, I'll keep trying. I'll never give up,
not as long as I live!

$#DarnaMagnifo(Darna Magnifo)#$$&MagnifoDarnaEvilGrin&$$@Right@$That's because you're stupid! You idiot!
You can't just rely on willpower!

$#DarnaMagnifo(Darna Magnifo)#$$&MagnifoDarnaEvilGrin&$$@Right@$If you're so bent on trying anyway...
Then this time, I'll just kill you!

$#DarnaMagnifo(Darna Magnifo)#$$&MagnifoDarnaEvilAngry&$$@Right@$I am the First Apostle, Darna Magnifo!
Ancient god from beyond! Face me!

$#DarnaMagnifo(Darna Magnifo)#$$&MagnifoDarnaSerious&$$@Right@$Ugh, I'm just so annoyed... Don't you
have anything better for me?

$#DarnaMagnifo(Darna Magnifo)#$$&MagnifoDarnaEvilAngry&$$@Right@$Crawl on the ground! Scream! Cry out!
Don't you realize the position you're in?!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHurt&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$Gghh...!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Stop it, Darna!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$@Right@$Marshal! Hang in there!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Lord...Magnifo...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...She's too weak to stand, and still
brainwashed.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzAngry&$$@Left@$I see. Then we'd better take care of this
fast.
$#DarnaMagnifo(Darna Magnifo)#$$&MagnifoDarnaEvilAngry&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$W-what is this power?!

$#DarnaMagnifo(Darna Magnifo)#$$&MagnifoDarnaEvilGrin&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$See?! I told you! You're wasting...urgh,
wasting your time!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Darna's body is falling apart... If Magnifo
escapes, we'll never find it again.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenComplain&$$@Right@$What should we do...
What should we do?!
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzAngry&$$@Left@$...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandGold&$$@Right@$I can't let myself lose. This Crest...this
hope was entrusted to me!

$#DarnaMagnifo(Darna Magnifo)#$$&MagnifoDarnaEvilGrin&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The Golden Crest, eh... Hmm. Hahaha.
This is all so pointless.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurpriseGold&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What?!

$#DarnaMagnifo(Darna Magnifo)#$$&MagnifoDarnaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The Pandemonium is over, but the scars
still remain, and they fuel Magnifo.

$#DarnaMagnifo(Darna Magnifo)#$$&MagnifoDarnaSerious&$$@Center@$Free of physical form, a concept and a
leader, an invader, the ultimate being...

$#DarnaMagnifo(Darna Magnifo)#$$&MagnifoDarnaSerious&$$@Center@$Strike me down, and my Lord will come
to a new prophet...a new Darna.
$#DarnaMagnifo(Darna Magnifo)#$$&MagnifoDarnaEvilGrin&$$@Center@$Your Crest is powerless against my Lord anyway. Right? You can't see him!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritGold&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Well...

keys.DescriptionKey: As Oz struggles to awaken from a coma, Rizette and her allies delve deep inside his dreams to confront the ghosts of his past. Meanwhile, Magnifo's power grows ever stronger in his vessel's soul. With the rest of the Red Dragon Knights caught in Darna's clutches, can Oz overcome the beast within -- or has he been that beast all along?

a6.title: Act 6

keys.value:
$#Guard(Hymelian)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Center@$Esteemed Red Dragon Knights, welcome
to our capital. Please, this way.

$#Regulus(Regulus II)#$$&RegulusNormal&$$@Center@$I am the King of Hymelia, Regulus II.
These are my sons...

$#Claudius(Claudius)#$$&ClaudiusSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I am the First Prince, Claudius. You
honor us with your presence, Marshal.

$#Remus(Remus)#$$&RemusSmile&$$@Left@$I am the Second Prince, Remus. It is a
pleasure to make your acquaintance.

$#Ga'Luga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$(These two are pretty casual, too. You
wouldn't think they're under attack.)

$#Regulus(Regulus II)#$$&RegulusSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Now, it's our hope that you will be able
to solve the problems plaguing our land
$#Regulus(Regulus II)#$$&RegulusSmile&$$@Center@$in one fell swoop, as it were.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$One fell swoop, Your Majesty?

$#Regulus(Regulus II)#$$&RegulusAngry&$$@Center@$These monster attacks, and the unrest
caused by those revolutionary knaves...

$#Regulus(Regulus II)#$$&RegulusAngry&$$@Center@$These attacks are sporadic, and we are
at our wits' end dealing with them.

$#Regulus(Regulus II)#$$&RegulusSad&$$@Center@$If this keeps up, my kingdom will fall
apart. And so...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$H-hey, this is the throne room, isn't it?
Why'd they bring us here?

$#Regulus(Regulus II)#$$&RegulusAngry&$$@Center@$I have no choice but to take the field
and deal with these scoundrels myself!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$...Excuse me?

$#Regulus(Regulus II)#$$&RegulusNormal&$$@Center@$I will bring First Prince Claudius, and his
sister, the Speaker of Flame, Maxima...

$#Regulus(Regulus II)#$$&RegulusAngry&$$@Center@$And we'll track down the source of all
this nonsense, and burn it out ourselves!

$#Claudius(Claudius)#$$&ClaudiusSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$We would like the Red Dragon Knights'
assistance as royal bodyguards.

$#Claudius(Claudius)#$$&ClaudiusSmile&$$@Right@$We will show these upstarts the true
majesty of the royal family!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$I-if I may, Your Majesty... This plan may
place your august self in undue peril...

$#Remus(Remus)#$$&RemusNormal&$$@Right@$Your concern is understandable, Lady
Marshal. I said so myself several times...

$#Regulus(Regulus II)#$$&RegulusAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I know my way around a sword, boy!
Those rebels won't get the best of me!
$#Remus(Remus)#$$&RemusSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...But as you can see, Father is stubborn.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Stand up straight, Finn.
We're in the presence of royalty.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$I-I see...but even so. It would be best to
avoid exposing you all to undo risk.

$#Claudius(Claudius)#$$&ClaudiusAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Monsters are similar to beasts, after all.
They may act unpredictably.

$#Claudius(Claudius)#$$&ClaudiusSmile&$$@Right@$But that is exactly the time for the skills
of the Red Dragon Knights to shine!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Left@$...

$#Claudius(Claudius)#$$&ClaudiusNormal&$$@Right@$Please, lend us the strength with which
you vanquished the Pandemonium.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$...I see you are decided.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Understood. The Red Dragon Knights
shall give our utmost.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$Marshal...

$#Regulus(Regulus II)#$$&RegulusSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$How wonderful! Let's put together a
punitive force right away, then.

$#Regulus(Regulus II)#$$&RegulusNormal&$$@Center@$I'd like to go out as soon as possible.
Claudius, assist me!

$#Regulus(Regulus II)#$$&RegulusSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Welcome, my friends! Thank you for
your assistance in these trying times.
$#Claudius(Claudius)#$$&ClaudiusNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Right away, Father!

$#Ga'Luga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$...Are we sure about this? It seems
absolutely reckless.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Left@$There's not much we can do if a foreign
ruler decides to disregard our advice.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$We'll do all we can...
But don't put yourself in danger.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$...Okay.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Right@$(He seems pretty...carefree, for a king.

You never change, huh.

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$Of course not. To protect thee is
mine unchanging duty.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$...Thanks, Vesh.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Nagi's bright attitude does help.
Especially with things the way they are.)
$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaCrying&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...

$#Ga'Luga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$So strong...! We should have tied you up
or something when we had the chance!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hold on, Sir Ga'Luga! Just a little more...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$There! An opening!

$#DarkRiz(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSurprised&$$@Right@$...?!
He's fast...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$Well done, you two!
Now, Vesh! Push her off the cliff!

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Center@$As thou sayest!
Aha!
$#DarkRiz(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteAngry&$$@Right@$Ah...! N-nice try...!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$She still stands?! We may be out of
options, comrades!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$Not yet!
$#DarkRiz(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSurprised&$$@Right@$Aah...!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Lady Ludmilla?!

$#DarkRiz(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteAngry&$$@Left@$And I should have killed you. All this
cleanup work is exhausting.

$#DarkRiz(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Ha...haha. Cut me, stab me all you like.
You won't break me.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Left@$I know. But I can slow you down.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$Vesh! Collapse the cliff edge!
$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...

$#Ga'Luga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$What?! Are you suicidal, Ludmilla?!
You're our Marshal!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I won't let any more of my subordinates
die for me!
$#Ga'Luga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I couldn't ask this of anyone else...
Which makes me a poor leader, perhaps.

$#DarkRiz(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...You won't be rid of me that easily.
I'm undying. Endless.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$I know, but by the time you climb back
up, my soldiers will be long gone.
$#Ludmilla;Vesh;(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand;Vesh.FoxMutant&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Vesh.Right;@$Ga'Luga! Nagi! Are you alright?!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Left@$If my sacrifice can spare their lives, then
that's a trade I'm willing to make!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$Do it, Vesh! I can't hold her much longer!
$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...Understood.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Huh? Wait, are you serious?!
Wait! No!

$#DarkRiz(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$So reckless, driven by emotion...
How...foolish.

$#DarkRiz(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSad&$$@Right@$...But maybe I'm the bigger fool, feeling
my hands bound. You're all so like him...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Vesh, no!!
$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Center@$...Crumble, earth!

$#Ga'Luga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$The cliffside is crumbling...
They're falling!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Left@$Marshal Ludmilla!
Ludmillaaaa!!

$#Ga'Luga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Ludmilla and Vesh...good timing. We're
holding her off, but not for much longer.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$Finn. You will need more than that Crest
to bring hope to the people of Erden.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$You must become a hero with the courage
to stand up and fight for this land!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$!-1!$If I had only been stronger

$#Finn(Finn)#$If I had only been stronger
If I had had the courage to fight
$#Finn(Finn)#$She wouldn't have had to die
$#Finn(Finn)#$I could have saved her...!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Left@$You've done well. Listen, I have an idea.

$#DarkRiz(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It doesn't matter what tricks you try.
You're all going to die here!
$#Ga'Luga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Here she comes. Nagi, get behind me!

$#DarkRiz(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteAngry&$$@Left@$I'm so tired of all of this nonsense.
Just die already!
$#Ga'Luga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$Gh...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$Report!
How is the battle going?!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Left@$But numbers decide a battle. And the
enemy force just keeps growing.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$If we can't defeat their commander, we
are all going to die here. That's a fact.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Left@$We already tried it once in the capital,
and it didn't work. But even so...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$You're our hope, Finn. We can't lose you.
That's why I'm going.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$Marshal...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$Let me do my duty as your commander,
eh? ...I leave the rest to you.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Right@$...
I...!

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$M-many have fallen from the cliffside,
including several Knights!

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$The slain rise again to turn on us...
The line is quickly falling apart.

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$The enemy leader is reportedly engaged
in battle with Sir Ga'Luga and Sir Nagi.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$I'll go to assist them. Vesh, will you come
with me? I have an idea.
$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$Understood.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Please, wait! That girl who looks like
Rizette is strong. Let me come too.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Left@$I can't say this too loudly, but...
Finn, I'll be straight with you.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Left@$We aren't winning this. It's not that the
Knights are inferior to the undead...

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaCommand&$$@Left@$This is the end.
Bathe in Volcana's primal flame!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$The souls?
You can see that?

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSmile&$$@Left@$Faintly, with my Lady's power...but I am
afraid I cannot explain the sensation well.

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The flow of life toucheth all things, in
Erden's grand cycle of existence.

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Center@$The Land supporteth that flow, thus can I
see it as well... But...

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Center@$Strange. There is a warp in the souls'
path. They go not to the grand flow...

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Center@$But to a deviate ring. A stagnant,
endless circle.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$!-1!$$@Right@$A deviate...you mean, the souls are going
in a different direction or something?

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$In any case, these soldiers will not trouble
us for now. The road ahead is secure.
$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaCommand&$$@Center@$Let us call the troops to advance!
$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...You two seem close.
$#Skeleton(Undead)#$$&Skeleton&$$@Right@$...!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$Huh?
Yeah. I guess so.

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSmile&$$@Left@$May I assume you have known each other
for a long time, then?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$Not really. Finn lived a village over, but
we never met before the Pandemonium.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$@Right@$But we traveled together. It was hard...
really hard, but it was wonderful.

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSmile&$$@Left@$...I see.
I know the feeling.

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$So, let me say this...it can all vanish in an
instant. Treasure the time you have.

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaAngry&$$@Left@$In particular... A strong sense of justice
can lead one into peril very easily.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$Right. Finn's got a lot on his shoulders.
He's sure to face a lot, but...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$@Right@$He'll be alright.
Because I'll be right there with him.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$What's the holdup, you two?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$Wow, that's thorough.
There's nothing left but ashes.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Right@$Oh, um...i-it's nothing.
Let's go!

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSmile&$$@Right@$You ought to know better than to intrude
upon a private conversation, Finn.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Huh? Wait, but you did it yourself just a
bit ago! That's not fair...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$That fire does seem like the best way to
deal with them.

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$I wonder. Father...no, the undead king
withstood the primal flame, after all.

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaAngry&$$@Left@$Perhaps the king is stronger than its
minions, or perhaps...

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$...How strange.
Didst thou see, Speaker of Flame?

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$Huh?
Ah... Yes.

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$The undead's souls flew off somewhere
far away...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Vesh, can I ask you to keep an eye on
the surroundings while Maxima scouts?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$...I think the Golden Crest's power
is weakening.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$Weakening?
Is that possible?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yeah...
I think so.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$I felt it for sure when I couldn't defeat
the King or that other you.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$I could feel it activate, but it wasn't
strong enough.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$So I just...don't feel very confident in my
strength right now. So, you know...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$...I wanted to apologize.
I'm sorry.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Huh? Why?
Where's this coming from?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$When you said you wanted to talk to the
other you, I freaked out a bit.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$You didn't say anything wrong, but I still
yelled at you. So...

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$Hrm. I care not for the Avatar of Flame...
But very well.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$You don't need to apologize for that.
I know it was a rash thing to say.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$But, about the Crest...
What do you—

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$Are you two ready to move? I have found
an undead camp. Let us take them out.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Ah...sure. Let's go.
We can talk more later, okay?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$...Yeah.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Thanks.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$Rizette...there's something I want to talk
to you about, if that's okay.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Right@$I'm glad you've finally decided you want
to tell me.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Huh?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$I can't really put it into words, but you've
been acting kind of strange lately.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Right@$I'm glad you feel like you can talk to me
about it. Whatever it is.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$...You're amazing, Rizette. It's like you've
seen right through me.

keys.DescriptionKey: When the Hymelian king's assassination plunges the country into civil war, the Red Dragon Knights must turn their blades on those they once protected. Can Erden's heroes restore their hard-earned peace to the world -- or are they fated to face endless suffering?

a7.title: Act 7
a7.subtitle: The Undead King

keys.value: $#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidUp&$$@Center@$Hajime! What happened to the others?!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Right@$But we can't back down here! Whatever it
takes, we can't let them reach the city!

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Left@$Wait, Shiori. This could finally be our
chance.

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Left@$A pair of lone soldiers, separated from
their squad in the heat of battle...

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Left@$It's a plausible, honorable death.
One that might fool Ludmilla.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Right@$Wh-What are you saying? You want us
to just go off on our own?

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeIrritated&$$@Left@$After everything we've done, you can't
believe the Vanguard is just.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedBack&$$@Right@$That's...

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeIrritated&$$@Left@$Deep down, you know. The Commander
is fighting a cruel and useless battle.

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeIrritated&$$@Left@$How long before she can no longer
stave off defeat?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAngryBack&$$@Right@$That doesn't matter! We can't just leave
our people to die!
$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Center@$...I don't know. We got separated!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedBack&$$@Right@$Besides, if Ludmilla ever figured out what
we did, she'd punish our squad.

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeIrritated&$$@Left@$That may be a price we have to... wait.
I sense something.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousBack&$$@Right@$Huh?
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Right@$...Look! Hajime, up there!
$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeShout&$$@Left@$There's a tear in the sky?!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Waaaaaaaaaaaah?!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$Owww. Leave it to Cyrus to drop me
off in thin air...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidUp&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Is that an undead? Is Orcanix sending
reinforcements?!

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Left@$No, look closer. He's breathing. And his
eyes are blue, not crimson.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Right@$Then he's... alive?
$#Skeleton(Undead)#$$&Skeleton&$$@Center@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Left@$Huh? Oh, someone else is here too!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Sorry to bother you, but could you tell me
where we are? I'm... a little confused...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Right@$S-So are we! Mind explaining how you
tore open the sky?!
$#Skeleton;Skeleton2;(Undead)#$$&Skeleton;Skeleton2.Skeleton&$$@Right;;;Skeleton2.Left;@$...!

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$There's no time. The undead are
advancing on our position!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Undead? They're here too?! Listen, I'll
explain everything to you later!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedBack&$$@Center@$O-Okay...?
$#Hajime;Skeleton;(Hajime)#$$&HajimeShout;Skeleton.Skeleton&$$@Right;;;Skeleton.Left;@$Take that!
$#Hajime;Skeleton(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Right@$Now, Shiori! Use the dragonfire!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackUp&$$@Right@$Hraaaagh!!
$#Skeleton;Shiori;(Undead)#$$&Skeleton&$$@Left@$...!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$Finally, one down!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$Damn! All these undead... we're
outnumbered on all sides.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Center@$Welcome to our headquarters!
The Vanguard's leader is right in here.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Outside, you say...
You're certain he's alive?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$!-1!$$@Right@$He is! He's not undead, I swear!
He's just from another —
$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Left@$—country. He's a wandering warrior who slew dozens of undead.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Right@$Hajime...
$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeIrritated&$$@Left@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Hajime's glaring daggers at us.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(I guess telling her the truth about the
portal wouldn't have gone over well.)
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Center@$I see. He certainly does seem... confident.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Center@$However, I find it hard to believe a human
could survive this long alone.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Well... if you think I might be undead, I
can let you check my pulse?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$That's... Marshal Ludmilla!
You're alive!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Left@$Don't mock me. I can see you're alive.
That's not why I find you suspicious.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$The Vanguard is a powerful group.
Naturally, that power sows resentment.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$You could be a clumsy spy, trying to
infiltrate us for your own ends.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$Oh, that's... I guess that's the same in
every world.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$What did you say?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$Nothing! I didn't say anything!
Err... how can I prove my intentions?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Oh! Why don't I leave my sword with you?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(That's the sword he used to cut down all
those undead!)

$#Endbringer;(Finn)#$$&Endbringer&$$@Center@$My blade harbors an ancient, mysterious
power. Or so I'm told.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$(It gives me the creeps, though...
Sorry to say, Cyrus.)
$#Shiori;Finn;(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp;Finn.FinnSurprise&$$@Right;;;Finn.Left;@$Uhh... Finn?! W-Wait! You can't —

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$If it can help you defeat the undead, you
can use it however you see fit.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Center@$I see. Very well.
I shall accept your blade.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Center@$...
But what shall I do with you...?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Center@$If you're as impressive as these two claim,
you might yet have a use.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Then...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$I will allow you to join our army.
Shiori, he will be placed in your squad.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Right@$Y-Yes, ma'am! I'll be sure to take care of
him!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Left@$However, this does not mean you have
won my trust.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Left@$I warn you: my eyes are everywhere.
Make one false step, and I'll know.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(That's not going to make things easy.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$Marshal Ludmilla! Thank goodness, I
thought I'd never see you again!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$You'll receive your first mission
at daybreak tomorrow.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Center@$Serve the Vanguard well, and you'll have
nothing to fear. Dismissed.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriHappyUp&$$@Center@$Phew. Glad that's over. Congrats, Finn!

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeHurt&$$@Left@$So kind... so stubborn. Until the very end.
Shiori...
$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSmile&$$@Left@$I'm glad I could die... saving you.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriCryingDown&$$@Right@$I told you to stop talking!
Please... please, just stop!
$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeThoughtful&$$@Left@$Listen to me, Shiori.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadUp&$$@Right@$...!

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeHurt&$$@Left@$The door to the relic... in my home.
It would never open for me, but...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidUp&$$@Right@$The door...? From the legend?!
But you said it wasn't real!
$#Averna(Valkyrie)#$$&AvernaAngry&$$@Right@$Krgh... rebel scum! I don't need your pity!

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeHurt&$$@Left@$It's real. The relic is... real. I want
you to find it... for me.

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeHurt&$$@Left@$The blood in your veins... the vow you
honored... all this time.

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSmile&$$@Left@$I see now. It's you who will save this world.
Shiori...
$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeHurt&$$@Left@$...
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hajime?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidBack&$$@Center@$Hajime...?! No! Open your eyes!
Hajimeeeeeeeeeeee!

$#()#$Shiori's wails split the silence in that
blood-soaked cathedral.

$#()#$Outside, the sun rose, all too warm and
bright.

$#()#$A breeze whistled by, carrying the rotting
stench of battle out into the streets.

$#()#$I stood there, sickened, frozen, my hand
an iron vice around my dragonfire.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(This is madness. Soldiers from both sides
are falling one by one.)

$#()#$If only I had used it when I had the
chance.
$#()#$Maybe then, Hajime would still be alive...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$Looks like Last Bastion's final battle has
begun.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$Vanguard, Rebellion... whoever wins,
the mortals lose.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Just so. It matters not who claims victory.
This world shall never slip from My grasp.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$What of the other Erden? Will more of My
troops be required to ensure its conquest?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$More of your troops? My Lady, please.
Don't be so hasty.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$You have the perfect chance to crush the
humans here.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$If you take the field yourself, victory is
assured.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$What are you plotting? You are human,
yet you urge your kind's destruction?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$(Just like they did in Hymelia...
There's no justice here.)

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$I do. Apologies for being so forward.
But if I may—
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...I'm sorry for interrupting.
$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Ah, My beautiful blade returns.
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteNormal&$$@Left@$Orcanix, my task is proceeding smoothly.

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteNormal&$$@Left@$The Erden where Arcane once ruled has
been brought to heel.

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteNormal&$$@Left@$As expected, they have no means of
resisting your armies.

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteNormal&$$@Left@$Their final defeat is but a matter of time.
Perhaps this man is right.

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$If there was ever a time for a full assault
on Last Bastion, it's now.
$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$...
$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Let Me hear what he has to say.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Right@$We've searched for so long... Where is he?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$He's not in the barracks, he's not in the
common room.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$I don't know where else he'd be at this
hour.

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$He knows a lot of people in the city, doesn't
he?

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Center@$He could be spending time with his guild
friends, or having a midnight tryst.

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeIrritated&$$@Center@$Either way, it's time. The sun will be
rising soon.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Center@$I guess we have no other choice.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$Let's head to the cathedral. Lucelle will
be waiting for us.

keys.DescriptionKey: Finn, separated from his friends at the height of their peril, finds himself trapped in a world of undead. A fox-eared girl named Shiori invites him to join the fight to save humanity, but in this mortal struggle, good and evil aren't always what they seem.

a8.name: Act 8
a8.title: Act 8
a8.subtitle: The Last Living City
a8.description: Finn, separated from his friends at the height of their peril, finds himself trapped in a world of undead. A fox-eared girl named Shiori invites him to join the fight to save humanity, but in this mortal struggle, good and evil aren't always what they seem.

keys.value:
$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Thank you for coming, you three. I want to
talk with you, as former Vanguard members.

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSurprised&$$@Center@$Um... I might know where the rest of those
stores are, actually.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadBack&$$@Center@$Having you here to comfort me... that's
enough comefort for me. I'll be fine.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadBack&$$@Center@$Now... let's head back to the base.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$...Shiori.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$(Shiori doesn't want me to suffer.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(She's trying to shield me from the
responsibility of Hajime's death.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$(Protecting those around her... is that how
she withstands all this suffering?)
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$Come on! It's getting late.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$...are you really okay, Shiori?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$I said I'm fine. Thanks for thinking of me,
though.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(She doesn't look fine at all. She doesn't,
but...)
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You do?!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$(I'm... powerless. I don't know what to say.)

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$@Right@$Y-yeah. But my information is old. I don't
know if it's still at the same place...

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Tell us what you know. We'll take any
information you have.

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$There are ballistas along the walls in
Last Bastion.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Ballistas?

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$@Right@$They're giant bowguns. Shiori, did you notice
any explosions when we fought outside?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Left@$Now that you mention it, I think I did...
I just thought someone was using dragonfire.

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$@Right@$You're half right. The ballistas can launch
stone casks, filled with dragonfire.

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$@Right@$With a direct hit, you can burn an entire
undead force up at once.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$We'll tell you everything we know.

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$@Right@$And once they burn, they revive all the way
back at the Pyre.
$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSmile&$$@Right@$It's a great way to buy time.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$And to prevent the walls from being
overwhelmed.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousBack&$$@Center@$Then, is the dragonfire stored somewhere
near the ballistas?
$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$@Center@$Yes. The casks are stored atop the walls.

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$@Center@$They're divided between the ballistas, so each
one can be refilled at a moment's notice.

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$@Center@$If you want to steal the dragonfire at the same
time as the raid on Outcast Isle...
$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$@Center@$You'll need to divide your men.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Raleigh, how did you know about all this?

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSmile&$$@Right@$I worked on the walls back when I was in
the Stonemasons' Guild.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Thank you. What I want to ask is where the
dragonfire is being stored.

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSmile&$$@Right@$I couldn't tell you because... well, it's highly
classified information.

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$@Right@$Besides, I believed in Ludmilla's justice.
I never would've leaked her secrets before.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Left@$But you trust us now, and that's why
you're willing to disclose this?
$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$@Right@$I suppose so.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSmile&$$@Left@$Thank you, Raleigh. We'll assault both the
island and the wall at the same time.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Left@$Can you give us more details? Again,
anything you can remember will do.

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$@Right@$I'm telling you, it's pretty outdated...
but I'll do my best.
$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Left@$Thank you. Now, let's modify our strategy.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Left@$Shiori, Finn, join our meeting, if you will.
The soldiers need your scouting report.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Right, we'll tell you everything.
$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$I had you destroy the hidden weapon caches.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$...that should do it. This has become quite
a large-scale operation.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$It will take almost all of our funds, connections,
and resources to complete...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$But it'll be worth it. We'll have more help
once the Vanguard's crimes come to light.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Indeed. Let's hurry and gather our funds.
This is no simple task.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$We will need to ready our uniforms, organize
our troops, forge additional documents...

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Raleigh, I would appreciate your help
as a commanding officer.
$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSurprised&$$@Center@$Me?!

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$You have the information we need, and you're
a cautious man. I know you're capable.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Finn, Shiori. The Vanguards know you well.
Sending you to infiltrate would be pointless.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$I have a more important job for you. We will
be seizing large quantities of dragonfire...

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$And I thought a majority of the dragonfire
would've been disposed of, but...

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$And you two will be responsible for their safe
disposal. It's a simple, but important task.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Now, Raleigh, please meet with the others.
You'll have much to talk about.
$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$O-okay... I'll see you two later, then.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Left@$Be careful, Raleigh.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Finn and Shiori, let's discuss the details.
First, to dispose of the dragonfire...

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$I want you to open the flasks and pour the
contents into the waterways.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Just like the weapon caches. It'll be difficult
for the enemies to retrieve diluted dragonfire.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSad&$$@Center@$And it'll serve as a proper water burial for
those who lost their lives in its creation.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSad&$$@Center@$Put their stolen souls to rest, surrounded
by calming waters... I'm counting on you.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Have you gotten this cask already?
$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$That couldn't have been all of it.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$No, not that one yet. Can you do it?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$Sure. Give me just one second...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Alright. That's the last one for today, I think.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedBack&$$@Right@$...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$Shiori... you're being quiet again. Is
something bothering you?
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedBack&$$@Right@$It's nothing, really...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Come on. You know you can tell me
anything.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Or is it something I wouldn't understand?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Right@$N-Not at all! I know you understand me,
Finn. You're my last, best hope.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$R-Right. I've heard you say that a few times
now, but it's still a little embarrassing...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousBack&$$@Center@$Yeah... the amount we found couldn't
compare to the standing army's supply.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Right@$...my mind's just full of absurd anxiety.
But will you still listen?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$Of course. It'll make you feel better to let
it out.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...this canal flows towards the outside of the
fortress, all the way to the sea.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$The people who were turned into dragonfire
will finally find peace in the vast ocean.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedBack&$$@Center@$I've used dragonfire countless times. I've set
countless undead aflame.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadBack&$$@Center@$I may not have known, but what I did was
repulsive. I've added to Ludmilla's murders.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadBack&$$@Center@$I want to atone for my sins... so I want to
send all the dragonfire out to sea.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$No matter the cost, I want to destroy as
much of this vile stuff as I can.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$I know how you feel. It's almost like I'm
trying to wash the blood off my hands here.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$I can only pray the victims will find peace
out there in the waves.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$Sorry, I just joined the Vanguard recently,
so I don't know anything myself.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Center@$Thank you. Anyway, I'm sorry for being so
gloomy.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$There's nothing to apologize for. Now, let's
sink the casks into the water too.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackUp&$$@Right@$Right.
...Hup!!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Right@$Okay, let's go back. We've got more work
waiting for us tomorrow, too!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$...
...Shiori!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Right@$What is it?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$...About the dragonfire. I do regret using
it, but that wasn't all I wanted to say.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedBack&$$@Right@$What do you mean...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$That night, at the cathedral... a rebel
soldier gave me a flask of dragonfire.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$If I had used it then... I keep thinking. I
might have stopped Ludmilla before...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$...I don't know much either. Just that the
Vanguard hid most of its stores away.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadBack&$$@Right@$...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$I'm sorry. I had the chance to end the battle,
and I didn't. It's my fault Hajime died.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadBack&$$@Right@$Hey, Finn. Please, stop.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Huh...?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$Thanks for trying to cheer me up. But it's
okay.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadUp&$$@Right@$You don't have to make up excuses on my
behalf.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Don't say that! That's not it, Shiori, I—!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackUp&$$@Center@$Finn, I said stop!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadBack&$$@Center@$Hajime died because I was careless. Neither
of us can change that now.
$#Rebel(Rebel)#$$&RebelSerious&$$@Center@$Alright, it's time to go. You two ready?

$#Rebel(Rebel)#$$&RebelSerious&$$@Center@$Alright, we're here. Off you guys go.
Don't die on us, okay?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$You be careful, too.
...Shiori, you ready?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$Yeah... but something seems off here,
doesn't it?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$This is where the exiles are supposed to be,
but I don't see anyone around here.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Maybe they're further inland?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedBack&$$@Right@$I hope so...
I have a bad feeling about this.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$It's hard to make out, but I think I see a
path up ahead.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$...hm? Wait! Be quiet...! I think I hear
something!
$#Hooded Man(Hooded Man)#$$!-1!$$@Left@$For crying out loud, this is heavy...!

$#Man in Black(Man in Black)#$$@Right@$Quit complaining and start stacking.
We're on a ticking clock.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$We are.

$#Man in Black(Man in Black)#$$@Right@$The caches in the city are nearly empty now.
Even this shipment might not be enough.

$#Hooded Man(Hooded Man)#$$@Left@$Yeah, yeah. I know. At least let me complain
a lil'... okay, this should be all of 'em.

$#Man in Black(Man in Black)#$$@Right@$Then let's go back. We've got other work.
We can leave the rest to the boatmen.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Who were those two? They didn't look like
exiles...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Maybe they're Vanguard? Overseers, or
something like that?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Right@$I've never seen a soldier dress like that...
This is way too suspicious.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Let's check the crates they unloaded from
the cart. We might be able to find out more.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$Yes, let's do that. They're far enough away
now, right?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Yeah, it's fine. Let's get this open!
$#Dragonfire;(Finn)#$$&Dragonfire&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...what?! This is...!

$#Rebel(Rebel)#$$&RebelSerious&$$@Left@$Once we drop you off, we'll push off right
away. We'll be back at sunrise.

$#Dragonfire;(Shiori)#$$&Dragonfire&$$@Center@$It's dragonfire! Why are they keeping crates
of this here on the island?!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...they said these crates are to be loaded
on a boat. They must be taking them back.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Is dragonfire made on Outcast Isle...?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I don't know. I knew it wasn't made inside
the city, but...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$Why move production all the way out here?
Is it that dangerous?
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedBack&$$@Center@$...let's go after those men.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedBack&$$@Center@$I want to know what other secrets this
island is hiding.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Me too. Let's head after them.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Okay, we'll have our people gathered and
waiting at the shore.
$#Rebel(Rebel)#$$&RebelShout&$$@Left@$Alright, let's go! Hold on tight!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadBack&$$@Center@$...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(Shiori... is she really okay?  Should I talk
to her?)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$(I don't even know what I'd say. And I can't
distract her right before a big mission...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(But Raleigh doesn't seem convinced. And
for some reason, my heart feels heavy too.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(I don't want to let that tragedy continue
either, but... why do I feel so anxious?)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$We trust the Rebellion to rescue the
prisoners who remain there.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridShout&$$@Center@$Of course we will. Yes, of course!
Those monsters...!

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridAngry&$$@Center@$They not only rush the living to their deaths,
but use their lives to make weaponry!

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridAngry&$$@Center@$Let us plan a raid on Outcast Isle at once.
This cruelty cannot go unpunished.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridShout&$$@Center@$We will seize the island and expose the
Vanguard for the true evil that they are!

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Let's start the meeting. First, thank you for all
your efforts in the struggle at the cathedral.

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$@Right@$Stonemasons on repairs and procurement,
while the fighters act as guards or raiders.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Left@$Raleigh, you used to be a stonemason, right?
I want you to repair our facilities.
$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$@Right@$Oh, sure. I'll go have a look.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Left@$Finn and Shiori, I need you two to scout
Outcast Isle.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Outcast Isle...? The isolated island where
the Vanguard sends the dying?

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Indeed. They send people there so their
corpses don't rise within the city.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$You two will be responsible for rescuing
those who can still be saved.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$Is... is that all you want us to do?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$You want us to save the outcasts from dying
alone on that island?
$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Indeed. Is that not what I just said...?

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSad&$$@Center@$Let us pray for those injured and deceased.
Their sacrifice will pave the way forward.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriHappyUp&$$@Right@$Wow...! Thank goodness! I'm so, so glad!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Shiori... you told me Outcast Isle was a
necessary evil.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$But all this time, you wanted to find a way
to save the people there, didn't you?
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriHappyUp&$$@Right@$Of course! Don't you?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Right@$I know I can trust you, Finn. I'm so happy
we'll be freeing the island together.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Wait. I apologize for ruining your
excitement, but...

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Don't get ahead of yourselves. I only want
you to rescue those who still have hope.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$Those who still have hope...?

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Yes. Those with high chances of survival,
or those who possess useful skills.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Our supplies and space are scarce. As sad
as it is, we can't save everyone.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$...now then. We have destroyed three of the
Vanguard's hidden weapon caches.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Don't give false hope to those with no future.
Save only those who can be saved.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Center@$You're telling us to decide who lives and
who dies?

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$We have no time to discuss ethics, I'm afraid.
I'm counting on you to do this.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Center@$But that's...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$(...I thought Astrid would remain unchanged
even in the face of despair, but...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$(No. I have no room to judge. Astrid's doing
what she can in this awful world.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Still... the Astrid I know would never
abandon anyone.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$What a twisted place this Erden is...

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$They'll want revenge. They'll surely try to
beat us down and break our wills.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridSerious&$$@Center@$But of course, I have no intention of letting
them snuff the flame of our defiance.

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridShout&$$@Center@$We must keep up the pressure on Ludmilla.
We cannot rest! We must act now!

$#RebelAstrid(Astrid)#$$&RebelAstridAngry&$$@Center@$Here are your detailed commands. First,
you two...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Wow... Astrid's actually giving individual
commands to every one of her troops.

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$@Right@$She probably has a good grasp of each of
their individual skill sets.
$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridShout&$$@Center@$Orcanix! Orcanix, are you here?

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Indeed. I will unshackle all things living
from the fear of death.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$With the root of suffering destroyed, all the
worlds should welcome the ultimate peace.

$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridSerious&$$@Left@$Should...? That is an oddly... uncertain way
to phrase it.

$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridSerious&$$@Left@$Are there things in the worlds that even you,
a goddess, cannot see?

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...I cannot know the minds of those that have
died, nor whither they have gone.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$But worry not. Once all have welcomed My
touch, death will never taint this land again.
$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridSerious&$$@Center@$...is that so...?
$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridSad&$$@Center@$(How odd. She sounds irritated.)

$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridSad&$$@Center@$(Is this a ruse? Fear? As the embodiment of
the undying, does she herself fear death...?)

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$Wonderful job, Astrid. Orcanix, you're
another step closer to taking over this Erden.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$I see you have returned, Astrid. In success,
I presume?

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Another step, you say? This Erden is already
within My grasp.

$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Who are you...? What do you mean by "this
Erden?"

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$He is Cyrus, a man from another Erden,
parallel to Our own.
$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Another Erden...?

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$There are as many worlds as there are possi-
bilities, as many Erdens as there are stars.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$The god of his world was laid low by mortal
hands. He wishes for the grace of another.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$Thus, I have allowed My eternity to shine
upon the lands of his Erden.
$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridSerious&$$@Center@$...what did you say?

$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridAngry&$$@Center@$Ridiculous. You are a human. You stand
before us, alive and breathing.

$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridSerious&$$@Center@$If you wish for the grace of the undying,
then why do you still embrace life?

$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridGrin&$$@Center@$Yes! I've rid the Vanguard of their dragonfire,
and that detestable wall has fallen!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I have my reasons. I need the freedom
to frequent both worlds.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$You never know how you'll look post-death.
I'd draw too much attention as an undead.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$There aren't a lot of undead who can pull
off a perfect living disguise like you.
$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridSerious&$$@Left@$That's true, but...
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Don't worry. I'll join the club soon enough.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$Once Orcanix's blessing is spread across
my Erden, I'll have her turn me, too.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Indeed. We must make haste, for your sake
as well as for that of your Erden.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$A third of My forces will attack Last Bastion.
The remaining will invade your Hymelia.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$Hmm... I'm not sure about that one.
$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$What?

$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridGrin&$$@Center@$Last Bastion is in a state of absolute chaos!
All that's left is to crush the last survivors!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Didn't you say you wanted to prioritize
this world first?

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Astrid's subterfuge had remarkable results.
A third of My army is enough to crush them.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$I have spread My blessing in your world, as
you have wanted. Yet you are dissatisfied?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$I'm thankful, sure, but even in a simple game,
carelessness before victory can be fatal.
$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Mm...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$I don't want to turn down your grace either,
my Lady. So, hear me out.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$If you leave any survivors, they'll go into
hiding, plotting their revenge.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$You should completely annihilate them before
they can even struggle, as an act of mercy.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$...very well. I shall send half of My forces,
then.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$That won't be enough.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$You've done well, Astrid. How does it feel to
have exacted your revenge?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$Orcanix, I'm worried. What would I do if, by
some terrible misfortune, harm comes to you?
$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Harm... to Me...?

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Do you honestly believe I, a god, would be
harmed so easily?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Forgive me, my Lady. Just recall, how long
have humans held out inside Last Bastion?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$18 long years. You mustn't underestimate
humanity's stubbornness.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$They may be weak and ephemeral, but they'll
fight like mad. Until their last breath.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$Even a bite from one of those ants could
still hurt, my Lady.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$Their destruction should be your top priority.
Let black rain fall upon their fortress.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$Raise every last corpse and bring them into
your fold.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$To truly defeat them, you need to instill them
with crushing, mind-numbing despair.
$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...I...

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Center@$...I would have done so already, if not for
those abhorrent ballistas.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I see. Just as I had feared, even an ant's
teeth can be threatening.
$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Cyrus... You forget your place.

$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridSerious&$$@Left@$Most of the ballistas burned and collapsed
when the city walls fell.

$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridSerious&$$@Left@$All the dragonfire in the city is disposed of.
Only a small quantity remains.

$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridSmile&$$@Left@$The Vanguard no longer has the means to
protect against an aerial assault.
$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Hmm...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$See? Total victory is within sight. You just
need to kick the rest of humanity off the cliff.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$...very well. If you insist, then I shall
rain down My direct judgment.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$Once this Erden falls, it won't be long
before my Erden becomes yours as well.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Your tragedy has now been incinerated with
the fires of resentment.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$My gratitude for your swift judgment.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Hmph... Astrid, listen well. You have new
orders.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$Depart for the island, and destroy the
remaining dragonfire there.
$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$As you wish... my Lady.

$#Orcanix(Orcanix)#$$&Orcanix&$$@Right@$It must feel liberating. Watching the living
struggle in fear is detestable, but...

$#UndeadAstrid(Astrid)#$$&UndeadAstridShout&$$@Left@$Y-Yes! But once they meet their demise, they
will gratefully accept your reign!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmPleasant&$$@Center@$We're almost there. See the castle?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$Something happened to me in this world,
didn't it? And... to Rizette, too.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$What was it? Why is Rizette working for
Orcanix? Is she... dead?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmSad&$$@Right@$...it's best you don't know.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$But...!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmSad&$$@Right@$Please, don't ask any further. I do not wish
to speak of it.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$...okay. I won't force you.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$But I'm sure I'll have to find out what
happened eventually.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I can wait until you're ready, but please...
one day, you need to tell me.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$...I make no promises, but...
I'll keep your wish in mind.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Thank you, Nagi.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$Ah... yes, I do. I know this place.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$Let's go. We shouldn't keep Lady Shiori
waiting.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Yeah.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Center@$Right, we can get close if we go this way!
Hurry, you two!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmShouting&$$@Center@$Lady Shiori, don't run on ahead! Wait!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...Nagi, can I ask you something?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$Hm...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I didn't say anything because Shiori wouldn't
understand, but I have to know.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$It's about the Rizette in this world...
and about me.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Center@$Oh... here it is. This is the castle where
Hajime and I grew up.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Whoa! The wall turned?!

$#Aria(???)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Right@$How dare you show yourself before me so
casually, knave!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Huh? What?!

$#Aria(???)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Right@$Leave! No, that won't satiate my anger!
Offer me your soul!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Whoa?! W-why're you...

$#Aria(???)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Right@$Silence! Don't you dare claim you have
forgotten your transgressions!
$#Aria(???)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Right@$Perish before my eyes!

$#Aria(???)#$$&AriaScared&$$@Center@$Haah, haah...! No, not yet! This is... fa...
far from over...!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Who is this girl? She certainly has a
strong presence.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmShouting&$$@Right@$Fear not! She is but a young girl!
Lady Shiori, take that side!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Okay! I don't know who you are, but please,
calm down!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$!-1!$$@Left@$A hidden door? I... I had no idea!

$#Aria(???)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Center@$What?! Unhand me! I will never relent
until Finn has breathed his last breath!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$Me again...?
$#Aria(???)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Center@$I...I...! I will never forgive the likes of you!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Finn, have you ever met this girl before?
Did you do something to her?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$I didn't do anything!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$Hmm... then might she be referring to the
Finn from our world?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$Oh... I hope not. It sounds like she really
hates him.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$But... if that's the case, then what did that
Finn do, exactly?!

$#Aria(???)#$$&AriaShout&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You forgot?! Your sin runs deep! Think long
and hard and remember your wicked deeds!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$S-she's not listening...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$These stairs lead underground. It may
not be dangerous, but stay close.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Center@$Young lady, speak your name. Please, tell
us the reason why you attacked Sir Finn.

$#Aria(???)#$$&AriaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hmph... You don't know my name?
Fine, then you had best listen, and listen well.
$#Aria(???)#$$&AriaSmug&$$@Center@$Ahem... Aaaah... Mmmm... There, ready!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Center@$I am Aria! The judge of the souls of
the world, and the Primordial of Death!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$Death...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$A Primordial?! You're not just an Avatar, but
a Primordial?!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Right@$Of course I am! The power you lot witnessed
should be plenty of proof!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaNormal&$$@Right@$Spirits come before my throne, and it's my
duty to decide their fate!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Left@$Wh-Why would such a powerful being know
Finn?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...hmph. How absurd. Not only is the man
oblivious, even his allies are naïve!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$I don't think even Hajime knew this
hidden passage existed.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaNormal&$$@Center@$Fine, listen well. Be thankful I'm willing to
explain all this! Some years ago...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Center@$The pitiful soul of a young girl found its way
to me.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Center@$She tranquilly smiled and spoke of how she
entrusted everything to a man named Finn.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSmile&$$@Center@$A beautiful soul, the like of which is rarely
seen in this world.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Center@$I pitied her, and quickly bestowed my
judgment upon her.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Center@$But then...! The moment she accepted
death, that man! Finn!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Center@$He recalled her soul into her flesh! He forced
her back into a twisted mockery of life!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...don't tell me that girl was...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmSad&$$@Right@$...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Right@$Finn, I will never forgive you! You tainted
such a pure soul!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$How far do these stairs go? I feel like we've
been walking for a while now.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Right@$You deprived her of her eternal rest! I will
never forgive you your crime!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidUp&$$@Left@$U-um! Please, listen! This Finn here came
from another Erden.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Left@$He's a different person than the Finn you
speak of...
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What...?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Center@$Hmph. I did wonder why this Finn possessed
a much cleaner soul than the one I know.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Center@$And Finn is an undead. Yet, you stand before
