$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Right@$And he walked his own path, never wavering.
...or at least, that's what I think.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Left@$Yeah, you're right. You're absolutely right...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Left@$I'll take my time and think. About Hajime,
about everyone else, and about the world.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Left@$Then one day, I'll move on, proud of what they
left me, as a strong and righteous person.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriHappyUp&$$@Left@$Thank you, Finn. I couldn't have come this
far without you.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...no problem.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$Alright, I guess it's time to go in.
Are you both ready?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmPleasant&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Anytime, my Lady.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Yeah, let's go!
On my mark...!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$...! Where are we?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Center@$This is it. Once we push this wall...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$It feels... different. It's like we're in a
totally different world.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$If you, who came to us from another world,
says so, then...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Uhh... I mean, I'm just trying to say that
this place doesn't seem normal.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$True, I sense that as well. It feels unnerving,
as if we're wrapped in total silence.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Center@$Look, in there. I see a flowing river.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$I see it too. And... is that a throne made
of stone?
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$...mmm...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$...a...girl? Why is there a little girl here?

$#Aria(???)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Center@$Mm?
You...!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Huh? M-me?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmSad&$$@Center@$Paralysis and fatigue... I see. This poison is
a common one.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Center@$Please, explain to me again. Are you truly
from another world?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$...I was born in a world called Erden too.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$I think it's pretty much the same,
geographically and culturally...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$And it seems like there are similar people
in both worlds as well.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$But the one thing that splits them apart...
is the evil god that controls the world.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$In my Erden, Orcanix doesn't exist.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmPleasant&$$@Center@$Amazing... if you speak the truth, then
your world is a lucky and blessed one.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmSad&$$@Center@$If you never experienced the countless
tragedies that Orcanix spawned, then...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmPleasant&$$@Center@$Your world must be nothing less than a
paradise.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$No. My world was controlled by another evil.
We defeated it, and it's gone for good now.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Center@$Drink this medicine. It shall help you
recover.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$We were supposed to finally know peace,
but all of a sudden, the undead invaded.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$We had no means of fighting Orcanix's army.
A whole kingdom fell, in mere hours.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$And during that struggle... I was tossed into
this Erden.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...hmm. This is quite the story.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$The whole situation's ridiculous, I know. If
you can't believe me, I understand.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$But please believe this: I truly want to save
this Erden.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$It might help me save my own world, for one.
And I can't bear to see any more suffering.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$...I see.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmPleasant&$$@Right@$Your tale fairly makes my head spin, but
somehow, I wish to believe you.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmHeh&$$@Right@$You resemble the Finn I know. The Finn
who's no longer with us.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Thank you... Umm, but...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Left@$...? What do you mean...?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmSad&$$@Right@$Pay me no mind. Please, go on.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Right... We're heading to the fallen Kingdom
of Sanga to find the legendary hidden ruins.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Do you know about those ruins? Or which
route we should take to find them?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$The ruins of Sanga... I see. Yes, I know
of them.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Huh?! Y-You do?!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Center@$Since the fall of the bikki, I've traveled the
land, investigating rumors.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Center@$During my search, I found ruins hidden in
a castle of the fallen samurai kingdom.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmSad&$$@Center@$However... those ruins were useless to me.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What do you mean?! The ruins are supposed
to bring eternal rest to the undead!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$You do not trust me? That's wise. This
forsaken world demands vigilance of us all.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmSad&$$@Right@$They did no such thing, I'm afraid. I detected
no magic. The ruins were just that: ruins.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Left@$That's... that's not possible...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAngryUp&$$@Left@$No, we can't give up yet! There might be some
kind of key that can reawaken their power!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Left@$If the ruins you found were located in the
castle, they have to be the same ruins I seek!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Left@$Please, Nagi! Please bring us there!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$...as you wish. We must leave this area,
either way.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$Undead are marching to the ravaged Last
Bastion. It's dangerous to remain so close.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Left@$Then we shouldn't waste any more time.
There might still be survivors in the city.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Left@$...like Raleigh, or Lucelle...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Right. We'll unlock the ruin's secrets, and
hurry back to save the city.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$Oh... I apologize. Of course, I mean you no
harm...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmPleasant&$$@Center@$...you truly do resemble him.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmSad&$$@Center@$Sir Finn, may I ask you a question?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmSad&$$@Center@$Are Lady Rizette and Sir Theo still alive in
your world?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Huh...?

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Center@$You said you were caught in an
ambush before the portal opened?

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSurprised&$$@Center@$If that's the case, I'm afraid looking for
your allies here is pointless.

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Center@$Caught in a cliffside battle with no
escape... they're likely already dead.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$They're alive. I know they're alive.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$I'll see them again one day. I'll keep
fighting until I do.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$It's okay, Shiori. Nagi isn't a bad person.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Center@$...I see.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmAngry&$$@Center@$I understand. Then, once Lady Shiori has
recovered, we'll depart.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmAngry&$$@Center@$Our destination: the Kingdom of Sanga.
To the ruins below the fallen castle...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$And I helped cook up the medicine, too.
I'm pretty sure nothing too weird went in.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Left@$...okay. If you say so, Finn.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hmm... So you really are Sir Finn. Your face,
your speech... you resemble the Finn I know.
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$Shiori... Shiori...?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Shiori's Father)#$Shiori... We have a duty to protect Master
Hajime's family.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Shiori's Father)#$Become righteous and strong. You must guard
Master Hajime, even at the cost of your life.
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$Yes, Father!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$That's... It's me when I was a child. That's
right. I promised my father I'd protect Hajime.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Shiori's Father)#$$!-1!$Now... I must leave you.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$Huh...? Father?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Shiori's Father)#$Shiori. Embrace your duty, and live with
your head held high.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadUp&$$@Center@$...Father... that's right. He leapt into
battle... and perished.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Center@$He did it to fulfill the vow passed down for
generations... to protect Hajime's father.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Center@$Even as a child, I knew what it meant when
he walked into that burning castle tower.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriCryingBack&$$@Center@$That voice is... Father?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Center@$I couldn't say anything to stop him. All I
could do was watch as he walked on...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$Protect our vow, and be proud.
Become a righteous warrior.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$Those words were meant to give me strength...
but they felt more like a curse, binding me.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Center@$They stole away my pleas for him not to go,
the tears I wanted to cry...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Center@$...I really loved him. I wanted him to stay
with me.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriCryingUp&$$@Center@$I wish...
I wish he was still alive...!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriCryingBack&$$@Center@$...!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadBack&$$@Center@$Oh... I...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Are you okay? You were crying in your
sleep.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Right@$...Finn... Oh, right. You're still carrying me,
aren't you...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Shiori's Father)#$$!-1!$Come now, my dear. Dry your tears.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Right@$I'm sorry, I must be heavy. You can let me
down... Hngh...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$The poison's still in your system. Don't worry,
I'm fine. I'll just go a little further, okay?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Right@$Finn, you must be exhausted. How long
have you been running?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I'm fine. I can carry you, you're not too...
Waaaagh?!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Right@$Waaaaah?!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$S-Sorry! Are you okay?! You're not hurt,
are you?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$No, I'm not. You shielded me from the
worst of it, so...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedDown&$$@Right@$Finn, your arms are shaking. You're at
your limit, aren't you?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$...sorry. If only I had more stamina, we
could've gotten further...
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadBack&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Stop it. You've helped me so much already.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadBack&$$@Center@$...I was crying...? But... why?
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadBack&$$@Center@$I'm the one who should be apologizing.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadBack&$$@Center@$I've been in the Vanguard much longer than
you, but I didn't even notice Astrid's trap.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadBack&$$@Center@$I followed her instructions and poured all
the dragonfire into the waterways...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadUp&$$@Center@$I even ate the poisoned food... what kind of
warrior am I?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...
In that case, we're even.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Right@$Huh...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$We keep apologizing and covering for each
other. But all that ends now.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Center@$Instead of saying "sorry" until our jaws fall
off, why don't we start saying "thank you?"

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$For instance, if I never met you, I'd be lost,
and I'd probably have starved to death.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Even now, you've given me hope. We have a
goal in mind, and a path to get there.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Shiori's Father)#$$!-1!$Let's see, how about a story? About the
temple of hope. You love that story.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$So thank you, Shiori.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$I... I need to thank you, too. For saving me...
and for believing me.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Why don't you tell me more about this relic?
What's it like?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$Well... all I remember are the legends my
father passed down to me.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$Even then, I don't remember the details...
Just that it was built by Hajime's ancestors.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$"When wicked death befalls the living, when
nature's law descends into corruption..."

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$"Come thou to me. Until that day, stand thou
guard over my temple."

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$The temple mentioned in the story houses
the "relic," as far as we know.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$But neither Hajime nor his lord father really
believed in the legend.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Yeah. He always looked fed up when you
talked about it.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Shiori's Father)#$A long time ago, a man found a temple that
enshrined a spirit of this land.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$Hajime didn't like anything he couldn't
be certain of.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$He used to crush my dreams all the time,
insisting there was nothing there to guard.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$That's all I know. When Hajime lived in the
castle, I used to visit him all the time, but...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$I never found anything that resembled the
ruins of a temple.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$I see. So first, we'll need to go back to your
homeland and investigate the castle.
$#Skeleton(Undead Soldier)#$$&Skeleton&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$Finn! Behind you!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Center@$What...? Crap!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Shiori's not rid of the poison yet. She can't
even stand, let alone fight!)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$(Damn... my arms are still shaking too.
But... I have to do this...!)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Shiori's Father)#$He built a kingdom and a large castle
to protect and hide the holy temple.
$#Skeleton(Undead Soldier)#$$&Skeleton&$$@Center@$...!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidUp&$$@Center@$Finn...!
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Begone, foul hounds of corruption!
$#Skeleton(Undead Soldier)#$$&Skeleton&$$@Center@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(Huh...? I've seen that swordplay before...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$The impeccable speed... the short silhouette.
It can't be!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Center@$...Nagi!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmShouting&$$@Center@$More draw near! Arm yourself!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$R-Right!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(...he's missing an arm. And he seems
more harsh than the Nagi I know...)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Shiori's Father)#$His work saved the lives of our ancestors,
and our ancestors vowed to repay his grace.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(This must be the Nagi of this Erden...
Can I trust him?)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(Has Nagi also been twisted by this terrible
world, like Astrid and Ludmilla...?)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Shiori's Father)#$Thus, our ancestors became his subjects,
vowing eternal loyalty to his family forever.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Center@$Phew... That was quite dangerous.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmHeh&$$@Right@$What nonsense is that?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Do you two know each other? That'd be
great, but... urgh...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Center@$Hmm... the lady appears unwell. We must
bring her somewhere safe to rest.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Center@$I have shelter close by. Let us make haste.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$...okay.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Nagi... he's not trying a terrible pick-up line?
So this cruel world has changed him too...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(I-I shouldn't think that. It's not kind.)

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Center@$Hurry. A knight should never leave a lady
lying on the cold forest ground.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Center@$Let me lead the way. Quickly, bring her
along.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Huh...? O-Oh, right! Coming!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Thank you, Nagi. You really saved us.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$...? What has gotten into you, young lad?
Why are you smiling?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(He's still a gentleman... Thank goodness...
Nagi's still the same!)

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmAngry&$$@Right@$Hmm... your words confound me. How do
you know my name...?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmShouting&$$@Right@$You're...! But how?! Why are you here?!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Huh...? Do you know me?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Ludmilla and Astrid didn't recognize me...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$Your eyes sparkle with reason. You must
not be an undead. A spirit, then?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$...I'm not either of those. I'm something
even less believable.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I'm from another world... I'm from an
Erden without undead.

keys.DescriptionKey: Finn and Shiori join forces with Astrid to set Last Bastion free, but a sinister secret lurks within the ranks of the Rebellion. With Orcanix's soldiers marching to take the city, can the two heroes find a way to defeat the Goddess's undead before the wall falls?

keys.value:
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst407|$Finn, nice of you to finally join us. You
could have at least brushed your hair.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHappy&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst415|$And they're really good at making medicine!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst416|$Yes. Their elixirs are highly sought after
across Westland.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act2.Voices/mst417|$The knights buy what we can, but their
supply is limited and not cheap.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst418|$So we can cure Theo and the others with
medicine from Kisenkyo?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst419|$It's not that simple. So far no bikki remedies
have worked on the Sleeping Death.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHeh&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst420|$That's why we're going to go to Kisenkyo
and ask them to make one that can!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst421|$If there are bikki in Rigland, couldn't one of

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$It's a disease with no known cause

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$It was prevalent in Rigland and in the east

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$It was no regular trial,

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$Over the course of several months,

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$All while they remain sound asleep.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$Their medicines are of high quality,

keys.DescriptionKey:
If this unit would be defeated, it instead survives with 1 HP and then cannot be defeated until its next turn. This effect can trigger only once each time this unit enters the battlefield, and is considered a Hold Ground+ effect. Whenever a Dark ally named Aigis enters the battlefield from allied reinforcements, this Hold Ground+ effect is reset so it can trigger again.

If there is not already a Dark ally named Aigis on the battlefield or in allied reinforcements, this unit adds Aigis to next in line of allied reinforcements at the end of the turn whenever:
- Another non-conjured ally on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, so long as this unit is not defeated or sacrificed at the same time.
- This unit defeats a non-conjured enemy on the battlefield with an attack.

Aigis's Level, Limit Breaks, Awakenings, Boosts, Potential, Mastery, Weapon and Accessory will match this unit.

This unit cannot fall asleep or be stunned if there is a Dark ally named Aigis on the battlefield or in allied reinforcements.

This unit has 30% damage reduction from attacks. While there is a Dark ally named Aigis on the battlefield or in allied reinforcements, this unit has 60% damage reduction instead.

keys.value: $#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst190|$Captain! How is Theo?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst199|$But there are things that we must do in the
meantime.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst200|$Please come with me.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst191|$The healers have examined him. As I
feared...it is the Sleeping Death.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst192|$The Sleeping...Death!?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst193|$Yes. It is a mysterious illness that has been
spreading throughout Rigland.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst194|$Theo's case is serious... The healers believe
he will not last three months.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst195|$No... This... This is Ossia's doing, isn't it??
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst196|$Most likely...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst197|$Isn't there something we can do!?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst198|$The city's researchers are doing everything
they can to find a cure. We can only wait.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$Captain!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$I've spoken with the commander.
Let's go, Finn.

keys.DescriptionKey: The lonely alchemist Sheen felt that to face the most perfect crisis would mean creating the most perfect man. He studied in his tower for years, taking parts of every man he felt was ideal. A leg here. A smile there. And a bicep over there. One eye cerulean blue, one eye stark crimson. He crafted Mercy.

AirCloakKnight01.title: Chimeric Wanderer
AirCloakKnight01.description: The lonely alchemist Sheen felt that to face the most perfect crisis would mean creating the most perfect man. He studied in his tower for years, taking parts of every man he felt was ideal. A leg here. A smile there. And a bicep over there. One eye cerulean blue, one eye stark crimson. He crafted Mercy.

keys.DescriptionKey: Mercy quests all over Erden to end the Pandemonium not because he knows it's right, but because he knows he was built to be the best. With an attitude as sharp as his greatsword Havok, he leaves hundreds of bodies and hearts slain in his wake. And as his creator's most perfect man, he's never once expressed remorse.

keys.DescriptionKey: Now, Mercy is showing hints of evolving a soul. The last time he left a battlefield silent from the kill, a single tear fell from his blue right eye. Instead of running away from this feelings, he's relishing them, pursuing them further. After all, the perfect warrior must truly understand the pain he causes if he intends to master it.

keys.DescriptionKey:
We were born to fight. To rend skies, scorch forest, to drain the very seas and deprive our enemies of a place to call their own. That is the purpose for which we were created.
However, this world, ever-expanding before our eyes, is beautiful. What cruel irony that we should come to love it, as we can only show the depth of that love through destruction. 

Master... We were your greatest mistake.

Hypnos scouted her while she was playing around in people's dreams. She thinks of Hypnos as wonderland's boss, and sees it as an older friend.

Alice01.name: Alice
Alice01.title: The Eternal Dream
Alice01.description: Alice is a pure spirit that was born from the collective unconscious of innocent young girls. She can enter and manipulate the dreams of all living beings. Hypnos scouted her while she was playing around in people's dreams. She thinks of Hypnos as wonderland's boss, and sees it as an older friend.

keys.IntroText:
A voice, like a half-remembered dream.
"I knew you wouldn't forget."

keys.DescriptionKey: Alice spends most of her time wandering around people's dreams, and she can materialize when she's with someone who remembers their dreams. Whether in dreams or reality she is always surrounded by a forcefield called "My Little Garden", and she can make this into many forms that she can use to fight. The constantly fidgeting, sharp-tongue rabbit beside her is a product of that power.

Alice02.name: Alice
Alice02.title: The Eternal Dream
Alice02.description: Alice spends most of her time wandering around people's dreams, and she can materialize when she's with someone who remembers their dreams. Whether in dreams or reality she is always surrounded by a forcefield called "My Little Garden", and she can make this into many forms that she can use to fight. The constantly fidgeting, sharp-tongue rabbit beside her is a product of that power.

keys.DescriptionKey: "Hey, you're watching me again? You know, watching someone is the same as being watched. But becoming friends? That's not so easy. That's why I want to know, and I want you to know. From when my hair was a black bob, all the way until now. All of it. Ah, but this is so frustrating. It's not like a dream at all, is it? It's like being a game where you have to follow all the rules. So what are you waiting for? Hurry and choose me to come on your next adventure!"

keys.DescriptionKey:
One day, a mysterious hole opened in the fabric of the world of dreams. As holes in worlds go, this one was quite small, inconspicuous—just a lonely, dark hole.
Inside it there was a hidden room, and in that room there was a girl—another Alice, caught up in the darkest of nightmares.

AliceDark01.name: Dark Alice
AliceDark01.title: One More Nightmare
AliceDark01.description:
One day, a mysterious hole opened in the fabric of the world of dreams. As holes in worlds go, this one was quite small, inconspicuous—just a lonely, dark hole.
Inside it there was a hidden room, and in that room there was a girl—another Alice, caught up in the darkest of nightmares.

keys.IntroText:
Welcome to the garden of darkness♪
Will you play with me?
Right until this worthless world ends...

keys.DescriptionKey: She paints white roses red, without anyone's knowledge or permission—she just wants to make her favorite garden pretty. So that it is ready when someone comes to visit. So that she can be the best host there ever was. But such a day never comes, and Alice's heart breaks into dark, lonely pieces—or maybe it has already been broken long ago.

AliceDark02.name: Dark Alice
AliceDark02.title: One More Nightmare
AliceDark02.description: She paints white roses red, without anyone's knowledge or permission—she just wants to make her favorite garden pretty. So that it is ready when someone comes to visit. So that she can be the best host there ever was. But such a day never comes, and Alice's heart breaks into dark, lonely pieces—or maybe it has already been broken long ago.

keys.DescriptionKey:
After a long day of playing with spectres of countless nightmares, Alice falls asleep in her rose garden, just like always.
"What a pitiful sight you are," a voice says, as a single silhouette appears by her side. With a wicked smile, the Queen of Nightmares—the one that Alice once sealed away, the one that has destroyed Alice in return—watches the girl's peaceful, sleeping face.

AliceDark03.name: Dark Alice
AliceDark03.title: One More Nightmare

keys.DescriptionKey: Alice was a clumsy, mediocre student at the Magic Academy, until one day she found a wounded, rabbit-like animal lying by the roadside. She treated it with a healing spell—the only type of magic she was any good at—and the creature perked up immediately. It turned out to be a familiar of the God of Sleep. She gave Alice her thanks, along with a very special power.

AliceMagicalGirl01.name: Alice
AliceMagicalGirl01.title: Dreamy Magical Girl
AliceMagicalGirl01.description: Alice was a clumsy, mediocre student at the Magic Academy, until one day she found a wounded, rabbit-like animal lying by the roadside. She treated it with a healing spell—the only type of magic she was any good at—and the creature perked up immediately. It turned out to be a familiar of the God of Sleep. She gave Alice her thanks, along with a very special power.

keys.IntroText:
Have no fear, I am here♪
Let my power of love protect you!

keys.DescriptionKey:
Thanks to the creature's gift, Alice became a first-rate magical girl, capable of using any kind of magic she could think of, though for a limited time only.
True to her kind heart, she used her new powers to help people. She went to school by day and fought monsters by night—and before she knew it, she gained quite a reputation. They called her a superhero—one who appears when all hope is lost.

AliceMagicalGirl02.name: Alice

keys.DescriptionKey:

She didn't realize, however, that great power always comes at a great price.

keys.IntroText: Welcome. This is where my story began.

keys.DescriptionKey: She has always loved making up stories. Whenever something interesting happens, she immediately turns it into a tale in her head. keys.DescriptionKey:
Grants all allies Piercing, and Intense Rage. A unit with Piercing will have their Attacks ignore enemy damage reduction effects until the end of their next turn. Intense Rage increases a units Attack to 1.5x for their next 3 turns, and will overwrite existing Weak or Enrage effects. It cannot be overwritten by other Enrage effects but can be overwritten by Weak effects.

All allies that are Fire element or have a Burn Blast or Burn Drive type active skill are granted the Burn status effect. Then the user is granted the Healing Burn status effect for 300TU.

Locked for 150TU after the user has entered the battlefield, and locks again for 150TU after each use.

A unit with Healing Burn will heal after each turn at the same rate as Burn would deal damage instead of taking damage from Burn. Healing Burn will overwrite other status effects on the user and can replace the Burn status effect, but cannot be replaced by Burn. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with Healing Burn will gain the Burn status effect. Healing Burn will not be removed by Purify skills.

Usable if the user has defeated 1+ units with attacks while on the battlefield, and if no ally has Earthen Might already. Usable once each time this unit is on the battlefield.

Armor grants 50% damage reduction from the next attack, then the effect is removed. Armor will overwrite other status effects on those units. A unit with Earthen Might has 0.5x of their original Attack added to their Attack while they are not burning. This does stack on top of Enrage effects, and other Attack increases (e.g. 1.5x + 0.5x => 2.0x total), but cannot stack with itself. Earthen Might ends for all allies if the unit who granted it leaves the battlefield, and is removed from units that leave the battlefield.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Right@$Welcome to the Arena!

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Right@$Here, you can test your strength against
other players.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Right@$The rules are simple. Defeat higher ranked
players to take their position!

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Right@$Every day, at set times, you'll be given a
reward based on your rank. Good luck!

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Welcome, Commander! This is the
Battalion screen.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Here, you can manage your Platoons, the
teams you'll send on out missions.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$The strength of the units in each Platoon
determine your Battalion Power.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Raise your Power and compete with
other Commanders in the rankings!

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$You can use your Battalion in Warfare
Mode.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$To access Warfare Mode, just tap this
button on the Home Screen.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Unlike in Story Mode, in Warfare Mode,
you are our Commander.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$That means your Battalion will engage
in automatic battles on your behalf!

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Make sure you build a team of strong
soldiers who fight well on their own!

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Right@$Looks like you've just unlocked
Exploration.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Right@$Exploring allows you to search for even
better rewards! Let's try it!

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Right@$Good. Exploration is a great way to gather
additional treasure in the tower.
$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Right@$That's all for now! Good luck, Commander!
$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Welcome to the Alliance Quest screen.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$You can complete Quests to earn Alliance
EXP.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$More Quests will unlock as your Alliance's
level increases!

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Remember: high level Alliances can have
more members, so EXP is very important.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Good luck to you and your soldiers,
Commander!

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Right@$This is the Raid screen. Here, you can hunt
powerful bosses with 2 other players

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Right@$Twice a day, your team will have the chance
to hunt up to 3 bosses.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Right@$Raid is the best way to gather the rare
resources your Knights will need.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Right@$So make sure you never miss a Raid,
alright?

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Welcome to the Tower of Trials,
Commander!

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$No one knows how high the Tower goes.
Maybe you will be the one to find out!

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$All Red Dragon Knights take a vow to
explore and conquer this cursed place.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Let's gather some Loot to get you
started on your journey.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Good. The Loot from the Tower of Trials
accumulates in real time.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Come back often to gather resources as
efficiently as possible!

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$The Loot you find will improve as you
reach higher floors.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Defeat the boss of each floor to climb
higher in the Tower!
$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$What do you say we challenge a boss now?
$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Great job! Now, onto the second floor!
$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Welcome to Alliance War!
$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Here is how the combat works

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$At the start of a map, two Lv.1 castles are
handed out to leading Alliances.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$The castle handout order is based on the
previous day's Fame Ranking.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$The castle handout continues until there
are no more Lv.1 castles to give.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Then, in the Declare Phase, qualifying
Alliances will declare war on other castles.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Declaring on a castle allows your Alliance
to attack it during the Battle Phase.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Only Alliances with a high Fame Rank
will qualify to declare war.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Alliance Fame Rank 16~9 may declare
once, and Rank 8~1 may declare twice.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$However, you cannot simply declare war
on any castle you please.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$If you already own a castle, you can only
declare war on castles adjacent to yours.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$In this mode, Alliances battle each other for
control of key strategic locations.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$To declare on a Lv.2 castle, you must own
at least 1 castle.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$To declare on a Lv.3 castle, you must own
at least one Lv.2 or two Lv.1 castles.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Most importantly, only one alliance can
declare on a given castle.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$When the Declare Phase begins, castle
owners can start placing their defenses.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Defenses can be placed 1 Platoon at a
time. Placement cannot be undone.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$After the Declare Phase ends, a
Pre-Battle Phase of one hour will begin.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$When the Pre-Battle Phase starts,
players' Battalion data will be locked in.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Changes made after this point will not be
reflected in the Alliance War for that day.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$This includes changes to Platoon units,
weapons, and accessories.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$After the Pre-Battle Phase, the Battle
Phase starts and lasts for 45 mins.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$In an Alliance War, one of these five maps
will become the battleground.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$During the Battle Phase, alliances can
attack!

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$In Alliance War, the attacking Platoon is
given a starting TU advantage.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$When a Platoon attacks, it will fight the
castle's first defensive Platoon.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$The battle happens automatically, and
is resolved in a matter of seconds.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$The victor's Platoon is recovered fully
before facing the next opponent.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$However, Platoons have their stats
weakened after each successive victory.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$This will make sure no Platoon goes
undefeated forever.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$A castle is taken when it is attacked
without a defensive Platoon in place.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Whenever a castle is taken, it enters a 15
minute long protection period.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$During its protection period, a castle
cannot be attacked.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Each map will last for a number of days,
after which the map will change.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Afterward, however, the original owner
of the castle may attack it again.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$If the original owner takes the castle back,
it can no longer be attacked that day.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Each Platoon has 2 Energy, allowing it to
be deployed twice per day.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Energy is consumed when a Platoon takes
down a castle, or is defeated in battle.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Efficient utilization of Energy is the key to
victory!

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$At the end of the Battle Phase, castle
holders will receive various rewards.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$This process, from declaration to battle, is
repeated every day for 2 weeks.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$After the last battle phase of the map, the
Map Completion Rewards are distributed.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Get more Dominion Points to receive a
larger portion of the Completion Rewards!

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$That's all! Best of luck to your Alliance,
Commander!

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Across each map, Alliances will fight to
take control of castles.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$There are 3 levels of castles, each worth a
different amount of Dominion Points.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$At the end of each day, Alliances that
hold castles will receive Dominion Points.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Alliances are ranked based on Dominion
Points accumulated on a map.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$You can check the Dominion Ranking in
this menu.
$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$This is the Warfare screen.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Lastly, you can send your soldiers out on
a Quest to earn Alliance EXP.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$That's everything! May you bring glory
to our order, Commander!

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$In Warfare, you can give your Battalion
many different kinds of missions.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$This is the Tower of Trials, the most
ancient building in all of Erden.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$Our order's oldest mission is to conquer
its highest floor.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$All Commanders are ranked based on
their progress through the Tower.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$You and your Knights will have other
duties to fulfill, of course.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$In the Arena, you can test your might
against rival Commanders.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$In Raid, you can call your allies
together to take down powerful bosses.

$#LudmillaTutorial(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaNewNormal&$$@Left@$In Alliance War, the strongest
Alliances battle for control of Erden.

Grants Cupid's Link for 50TU to another random non-conjured ally that does not already have a Link.

Then that ally and the user are Purified (removes negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison), and Fortified.

Usable only if no other ally on the battlefield has Cupid's Link already, and there is a valid target. Usable 3 times per battle.

A Fortified unit has 50% damage reduction from attacks. This reduction cannot be ignored by attacks that do not specifically ignore Fortify. Fortify will be removed after reducing damage 3 times since applying, and will be reset if reapplied. This is not a status effect.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Grants Cupid's Link for 50TU to another random non-conjured ally that does not already have a Link.

Then that ally and the user are:
- healed for 100% max HP.
- Purified (removes negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison).
- Fortified, and granted an Instant Death Ward.

Usable only if no other ally on the battlefield has Cupid's Link already, and there is a valid target. Usable 5 times per battle.

An Instant Death Ward prevents a unit from being immediately defeated without damage by a non-boss enemy once, then is removed. Instant Death Wards cannot be ignored and cannot stack. A Fortified unit has 50% damage reduction from attacks. This reduction cannot be ignored by attacks that do not specifically ignore Fortify. Fortify will be removed after reducing damage 3 times since applying, and will be reset if reapplied. This is not a status effect.

keys.value:
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$@Center@$Now then, Don Quixote—it's been a few
days since you became an orderly.

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Well, I acknowledge your dedication and
strength. Keep up the good work.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&KingArthurEvilSerious&$$@Center@$A ghost has no feelings. No ambitions. As
I already said—I have no intention to talk.

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotAngry&$$@Center@$So be it... Then let your sword do the
talking!
$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanIrritate&$$@Center@$Leidram...

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainIrritated&$$@Center@$Tristan, don't space out! Focus on the
enemy!
$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanIrritate&$$@Center@$Yes! I won't miss a single heartbeat!
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainShouting&$$@Center@$Good. Let's end this quickly!
$#Lancelot;Tristan;(Lancelot & Tristan)#$$&LancelotShouting;Tristan.TristanShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Tristan.Right;@$—Understood!

$#DonQuixote(Don Quixote)#$$&DonQuixoteSurprised&$$@Center@$(I-It's amazing... Their blades are moving
at blinding speed!)

$#Anastasia(Anastasia)#$$&AnastasiaNormal&$$@Center@$(So this is the skill of the Knights of the
Round Table. Yet...)
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&KingArthurEvilSerious&$$@Center@$Pathetic—Regal Eclipse!
$#DonQuixote(Don Quixote)#$$&DonQuixoteShoutingPain&$$@Center@$Y-Yes! I'll do my—
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainIrritated&$$@Center@$Gah... Agh!!
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHurt&$$@Center@$It can't be...
$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanHurt&$$@Center@$Th-This is... The power of the curse...

$#Anastasia(Anastasia)#$$&AnastasiaCrazy&$$@Center@$Of course—! She still manifests the power
of the curse because she's a dream-based
$#Anastasia(Anastasia)#$$&AnastasiaCrazy&$$@Center@$projection of King Arthur!

$#Anastasia(Anastasia)#$$&AnastasiaCrazy&$$@Center@$This is exactly the King Arthur I wanted
to see!
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&KingArthurEvilNormal&$$@Center@$Are you finished? Quite an embarrassment.
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainIrritated&$$@Center@$Ug... Arthur Leidram...

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&KingArthurEvilSerious&$$@Center@$You are not fit to be king, Gawain. You
cannot be entrusted with Camelot.
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainIrritated&$$@Center@$What...!?
$#CamelotOrderlyA(Panicked Soldier)#$$@Center@$Sir Gawain—urgent news!!

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&KingArthurEvilSerious&$$@Center@$Lancelot, knight steeped in sin—your
cursed blood will never be cleansed. You
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&KingArthurEvilSerious&$$@Center@$will never be accepted.
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHurt&$$@Center@$No...

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&KingArthurEvilSerious&$$@Center@$Tristan—weak in mind. Fool that is not
able to hear the true hearts of others. Just
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&KingArthurEvilSerious&$$@Center@$as you never once heard mine.
$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanHurt&$$@Center@$Leidram...
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&KingArthurEvilClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Pathetic, all of you. Useless knights.
$#Anastasia(Anastasia)#$$&AnastasiaSad&$$@Center@$(Something's strange...)
$#Anastasia(Anastasia)#$$&AnastasiaSad&$$@Center@$(Was King Arthur ever this talkative?)
$#Anastasia(Anastasia)#$$&AnastasiaSad&$$@Center@$(It almost sounds like she's provoking them...)
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainNormalOpen&$$@Center@$What is it? Why the panic?
$#Anastasia(Anastasia)#$$&AnastasiaSad&$$@Center@$(No... It can't be. Not King Arthur...)
$#Gigant(Don Quixote)#$$&DonQuixoteShoutingPain&$$@Center@$S-Stop it.. You... You...blockhead!
$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanHurt&$$@Center@$Don Quixote, no! Get back!

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&KingArthurEvilNormal&$$@Center@$Who are you, child? Do you even know
who I am?

$#DonQuixote(Don Quixote)#$$&DonQuixoteSerious&$$@Center@$You hurt the knights I admire—that
makes you a bad guy!
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHurt&$$@Center@$Stop, Don Quixote!
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&KingArthurEvilNormal&$$@Center@$Do you not fear me?

$#DonQuixote(Don Quixote)#$$&DonQuixoteHurt&$$@Center@$I am scared, yes, but my fear won't stop
me!
$#Gigant(Don Quixote)#$$&DonQuixoteShoutingPain&$$@Center@$You're just—yaaaaahhhhh!!
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&KingArthurEvilSerious&$$@Center@$Guh... This power—interesting...
$#CamelotOrderlyA(Panicked Soldier)#$$@Center@$U-Um...well...the!!

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&KingArthurEvilSerious&$$@Center@$Not bad, but still green... You end here,
nameless knight!
$#DonQuixote(Don Quixote)#$$&DonQuixoteHurt&$$@Center@$Guh—Aaaaaaagh!!
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainShouting&$$@Center@$Don Quixote!!

$#DonQuixote(Don Quixote)#$$&DonQuixoteHurt&$$@Center@$This is...nothing! Because... I love all of
the Knights of the Round Table! I'm fine!

$#DonQuixote(Don Quixote)#$$&DonQuixoteHurt&$$@Center@$All of the knights, the orderlies—
everyone—
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&KingArthurEvilSerious&$$@Center@$Silence.

$#DonQuixote(Don Quixote)#$$&DonQuixoteShoutingPain&$$@Center@$Gah... Ouch... Huff huff... I—I won't shut
up!!
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&KingArthurEvilSerious&$$@Center@$What...?

$#DonQuixote(Don Quixote)#$$&DonQuixoteHurtNormal&$$@Center@$Sir Gawain is incredibly strong—and
kinder than you are!

$#DonQuixote(Don Quixote)#$$&DonQuixoteHurtNormal&$$@Center@$She always thinks of everyone! She's the
best king ever!

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Here, have some water. Take your time,
and speak slowly.
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSurprised&$$@Center@$Don Quixote...

$#Gigant(Don Quixote)#$$&DonQuixoteShoutingPain&$$@Center@$No matter how strong or scary you are—I
won't lose!!
$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanIrritate&$$@Center@$That's right... We can't afford to lose...

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotBitterSmile&$$@Center@$Yes. We can't let her beat us—especially
after hearing those words...
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$@Center@$Say what you will—but I will lead Camelot...

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainShouting&$$@Center@$I, Gawain, am the King of Camelot, ghost
of Arthur Leidram!!

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&KingArthurEvilSerious&$$@Center@$Hmph. Then prove it. Show me how you
will shape your future.

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainShouting&$$@Center@$Lancelot, Tristan, don't hold back!
Maintain pressure!

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotAngry&$$@Center@$Even if each strike is weaker than
before—we carry something far greater on
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotAngry&$$@Center@$our shoulders!
$#CamelotOrderlyA(Panicked Soldier)#$$@Right@$Gulp gulp. Haa... Haaa...

$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanShouting&$$@Center@$We must not let the lives and traditions
passed down to us perish.
$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanShouting&$$@Center@$Prepare yourself, Leidram!
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&KingArthurEvilSerious&$$@Center@$Is this all? How foolish!
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainIrritated&$$@Center@$Guhhh!
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHurt&$$@Center@$Ah... Gah...
$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanHurt&$$@Center@$She's too strong...!

$#Anastasia(Anastasia)#$$&AnastasiaSerious&$$@Center@$You can't win against her... She sees
hundreds of moves ahead. It's useless—
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainShouting&$$@Center@$Still—we won't know...
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotShouting&$$@Center@$Unless we try!
$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanShouting&$$@Center@$Haaaaaahhhh!!
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSmile&$$@Left@$Better now?
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&KingArthurEvilSerious&$$@Center@$Tch... You pests...

$#DonQuixote(Don Quixote)#$$&DonQuixoteSurprised&$$@Center@$(Incredible... Their strikes are so fast, it's
hard to remember to breathe...)

$#Anastasia(Anastasia)#$$&AnastasiaSerious&$$@Center@$(They're driving her back... King Arthur
is being driven into a corner...)
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotShouting&$$@Center@$Even if we can't defeat you alone—
$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanShouting&$$@Center@$We'll rise again and again!
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainShouting&$$@Center@$Leidram...!! We will defeat you!!
$#DONOTSHOWME(King Arthur)#$$@Center@$Guh...!??
$#DonQuixote(Don Quixote)#$$&DonQuixoteHurtNormal&$$@Center@$(The flurry of attacks suddenly stopped...)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Anastasia)#$$&AnastasiaColdAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(No way...)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Anastasia)#$$&AnastasiaColdAngry&$$@Center@$N-No... This can't be...

$#CamelotOrderlyA(Panicked Soldier)#$$@Right@$Yes, thank you, Sir Lancelot. That was the
most delicious water I have ever tasted...

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSmile&$$@Left@$Well isn't that a bit melodramatic... Now,
what's the news?
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$@Center@$How are you feeling?

$#CamelotOrderlyA(Panicked Soldier)#$$!-1!$$@Center@$It's a message relayed from Uzlavia. It
sounds unbelievable, but... Read this!
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Hmm... Dated yesterday...

$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanSerious&$$@Left@$They must've sent it by express courier—
must be extremely urgent.

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainNormal&$$@Right@$Gareth's team left by carriage. Perhaps it
became unusable.
$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanSerious&$$@Left@$Sir Gawain, let's check the contents.

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Right—hm!? Wh-What!? Everyone, listen
carefully. I'll read it aloud.
$#HastilyWrittenLetter()#$$!-1!$From the Gareth Troop dispatched to Uzlavia: An incident has occurred in the
$#HastilyWrittenLetter()#$Uzlavian capital. It cannot be suppressed—
$#HastilyWrittenLetter()#$At the center of the chaos is someone bearing an uncanny resemblance to the late
$#HastilyWrittenLetter()#$King Arthur Leidram—not just in appearance, but in power—
$#DonQuixote(Don Quixote)#$$&DonQuixoteSuperSweat&$$@Center@$U-Um... Well... I-I don't really kno—
$#HastilyWrittenLetter()#$Reports suggest that this Leidram is heading towards Camelot—
$#HastilyWrittenLetter()#$All forces should be placed on emergency alert—
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSurprised&$$@Center@$She...has resurrected?

$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanSweat&$$@Center@$C-Could it be that she didn't actually die?
Or used a body double to fake her death?
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Center@$Impossible. That body was real.

$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanSweat&$$@Center@$But Uzlavia is said to possess forbidden
arts...

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSurprised&$$@Center@$You think they resurrected Arthur Leidram
using such arts?
$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanShy&$$@Center@$I don't know... But...

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSerious&$$@Center@$Given the use of the express courier, it's

$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaNormalSmile&$$@Right@$Let's get you something to eat. I hope it
suits your taste.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethLaugh&$$@Center@$Mmm, it's delicious! What's this dish
called?

$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Simmered red radish soup. A simple meal.
Do you really find it to be that good?
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethLaugh&$$@Left@$So good! I'm totally hooked!

$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaSurprised&$$@Right@$Hooked on this kind of vegetable soup, huh.
I rather prefer sweet pastries myself.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethHappy&$$@Left@$Then you should visit Camelot sometime!
I'll show you all the best sweets Camelot
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethHappy&$$@Left@$has to offer!
$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaSmile&$$@Right@$Hmm, I'll look forward to that.

$#Alexei(Alexei)#$$&BlackwoodPlainNormal&$$@Left@$Discussing sweets is quite all right, but
Your Majesty...
$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaPout&$$@Right@$I know, I know. The carrots, right?

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethShocked&$$@Center@$Y-Yes! Thank you for granting me an
audience, um... Your Majesty!

$#Alexei(Alexei)#$$&BlackwoodPlainNormal&$$@Left@$Surely you're not planning to throw them
on the floor in front of our guest?

$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaDoya&$$@Right@$How dare you accuse Your Majesty the
Queen of not eating her carrots... Do you
$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaDoya&$$@Right@$really think that's possible?

$#Alexei(Alexei)#$$&BlackwoodPlainNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Don't try to flick them off your plate with
your fork either.
$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaPout&$$@Center@$Huh... How did you know...

$#Alexei(Alexei)#$$&BlackwoodPlainSmile&$$@Center@$I'm going to have you eat them, even if
they did fall on the floor, Your Majesty.
$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaPout&$$@Center@$Fine... I'll eat them. Nom... Gugh... Blegh...
$#Alexei(Alexei)#$$&BlackwoodPlainSmile&$$@Center@$Good girl.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethTroubled&$$@Center@$(He might be just the butler, but he's totally
got her wrapped around his finger.)
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethTroubled&$$@Center@$(Impressive...)
$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaSurprised&$$@Center@$Hmm...

$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaNormalSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$By the way, Gareth, I want to ask you
something, if you don't mind.
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethHappy&$$@Left@$Not sure if I can help, but I'll answer if I can.
$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaNormalSmile&$$@Right@$I think you can.
$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaNormalSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It concerns your king.
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSurprised&$$@Center@$The king...?

$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaSmile&$$@Center@$Not the current one, but the previous,
King Arthur—who is believed to have died
$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaSmile&$$@Center@$in the recent crisis.

$#Alexei(Alexei)#$$&BlackwoodPlainNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Your Majesty... That topic isn't exactly
appropriate over dinner...

$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaSurprised&$$@Right@$That's why I'm asking now. It's not the
kind of thing to ask in a formal setting.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSadComical&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(She's a sharp one. If I don't answer
properly, she might dig even deeper...)
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Left@$D-Did I do something wrong...?

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSadComical&$$@Center@$(And if I refuse, she'll definitely press
harder...)

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSadComical&$$@Center@$What do you want to know about the
previous king?

$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaNormal&$$@Center@$There's no need to be on guard. I want to
know what she was really like inside.
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSurprised&$$@Center@$What she was like inside?
$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaNormal&$$@Center@$Yes. What was she like—as her true self?

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSad&$$@Center@$I honestly didn't know her that well.
Actually, I don't think anyone really did.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSad&$$@Center@$She wasn't the type to show her true self.
Sorry I can't give you a better answer.
$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaNormalSmile&$$@Center@$No, I see. That aligns with my image of her.
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSmile&$$@Center@$Why do you ask, Your Majesty?

$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaNormalSmile&$$@Center@$It's no mystery. She had a certain...allure.
A dangerous charm.

$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaSmile&$$@Right@$No, I was just expecting someone more...
rugged, as a Knight of the Round Table.
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSurprised&$$@Center@$Wait... Have you met her before!?

$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaColdSmile&$$@Center@$I've seen her. Just once. Deep, deep in
sorrow...

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSerious&$$@Center@$(Just now, the Queen's expression—
I can't describe it... But it's...)

$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaNormalSmile&$$@Center@$Yaaaawn... I'm getting sleepy after eating.
Sorry, Gareth.
$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaNormalSmile&$$@Center@$I'm going to bed now.
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSurprised&$$@Center@$O-Okay. See you tomorrow, then.
$#Anastasia(Queen of Uzlavia)#$$&AnastasiaNormalSmile&$$@Center@$Yes. Tomorrow.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSad&$$@Center@$(Is it possible she figured out that King
Arthur was behind the crisis?)
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSad&$$@Center@$(Is that why she had that look on her face...?)
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSurprised&$$@Center@$Huh? This is the Round Table in Camelot?

keys.DescriptionKey:
A pirate's ship is his home, his love, his truest companion. When the captain's sloop sailed her final voyage, too old and weathered to go on, he didn't sell her for scrap. He set fire to her sails and let her loose at sea, her only fitting grave. Still, he couldn't bear to part with her completely.

He had her anchor forged into a hammer, so he could carry her with him to the ends of Erden.

AnchorHammer01.description:

keys.IntroText:
"Each day, the sinking sun meets the horizon.
I'll keep sailing until I meet it too."

keys.DescriptionKey:
The eldest daughter of the Hymelian royal family. Though a princess, she is strong-willed and a highly skilled warrior, so she often fights on the front lines. The pride of the Hymelian Knights, Merdain, can just about hold his own with her. Their other childhood friend, Lucius, has practically never beaten her in any contest.
The nobility and conservative voices in government disapprove of her un-princesslike behavior, at least behind closed doors, but soldiers and the common people adore her.
In every generation, at least one member of the Hymelian royal family has a contract with the primeval fire spirit Volcana. Currently, that responsibility falls to Maxima. Volcana has a particular soft spot for the gallant and brave Maxima, and Maxima views the flame spirit less as an object of worship, and more as a sometimes harsh, but loving mother.

Volcana has a particular soft spot for the gallant and brave Maxima, and Maxima views the flame spirit less as an object of worship, and more as a sometimes harsh, but loving mother.

keys.IntroText:
"I want to change this nation...
...if that means taking the throne, then so be it!"

keys.DescriptionKey:
Maxima was quite a tomboy in her youth, and she would sneak out of the palace to play with her friends Merdain and Lucius. She was repeatedly told not to associate with Merdain because of his low standing, but rather than obey, she wondered why people had to be so cruel to one of her best friends.
Spending time outside the palace, Maxima had many chances to interact with common-born soldiers and smallfolk, and she began to question the nobility's focus on bloodline. Why should the house someone is born into dictate their worth in life? Eventually, she realized that she wanted to change her country.

Spending time outside the palace, Maxima had many chances to interact with common-born soldiers and smallfolk, and she began to question the nobility's focus on bloodline. Why should the house someone is born into dictate their worth in life? Eventually, she realized that she wanted to change her country.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Her father the King is a good man, but weak-willed, serving as the puppet of the nobles of the Senate. Maxima is third in line for succession to the throne. If she can convince her two older brothers to see her way, then all is well, but if not, she is prepared to fight. To that end, she is solidifying her connections within the army. If she has to, she'll even bring Merdain and Lucius and take the throne by force.
While she was planning, however, a tragedy occurred. The Senate successfully arranged Merdain's father Artorias's death in a futile war, and Merdain and Lucius went missing as well. If only she had acted more quickly...but she knows that if she had enacted her plans prematurely, the kingdom could have very well shattered under the strain.

This unit cannot be stunned or be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

The first time this unit is damaged by an enemy attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will Charm all enemies on the battlefield for 50TU.

keys.value: $#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$|act6.Voices/mst3862|$...!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3871|$It wants us to create a better future for
Erden.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3872|$That's what I want to believe, anyway.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3873|$...Me too.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3874|$But what if we're just puppets, dancing to
the will of some higher being?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3875|$What if these powers, our battles, and our
sacrifices were all decided by someone?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3876|$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3877|$Even if they were, I'm going to keep going.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3878|$Finn...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3879|$I feel like I finally figured out my purpose.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3880|$I met so many different people, fought so
many battles...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3863|$Rizette? What's wrong?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$I hesitated and worried, mourned and
cheered, and finally figured it out.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3881|$Even if meeting you and all of our friends
was part of someone else's plan...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3882|$Our bonds are now my greatest treasure.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3883|$Finn...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3884|$So where was it you saw that angel?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3885|$Huh? Oh... Back there, at the end of the
hallway.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3886|$Then let's keep going forward.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3887|$Why? Maybe it's trying to tell us there's
something back there...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3888|$But this way seems more fun! Everyone's
waiting for us there!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHeh&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3889|$...Let's go!!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3864|$The angel...
$#Arcane(???)#$$&ArcaneSmile&$$@Center@$...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3865|$I thought I just saw it smiling over there.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3866|$!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3867|$I don't see anything... Why can't I see it
too!?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3868|$Sorry... Maybe it was just my imagination.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3869|$Rizette...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3870|$I've been wondering for a while why it gave
us these powers.

Beryxes are elusive creatures said to live in the deepest regions of a forest. Most people know them only through a series of popular folk tales that feature Beryxes as tricksters, who fool greedy or arrogant individuals into humiliating themselves.

These tales have some basis in reality, as Beryxes are known to playfully harass travelers who become lost in the forest. In the process however, the traveler always winds up back on the beaten path again.

keys.DescriptionKey:
A mature Beryx develops beautiful crystals on its body. These crystals are thought to have mystical properties. Every now and then, a foolish individual will attempt to capture a Beryx, in order to harvest these crystals for a quick profit. 

They soon discover that despite the Beryx's playful reputation, they quickly become a terrible force of nature when threatened. Beryxes will fearlessly and savagely fight anything that threatens them, even if the attacker is several times larger in size. As such, even the largest predators in the forest will step aside if they encounter one.

A sword as heavy as the duty it bears.
Only a true hero can hope to wield it.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Antares has always been your average girl. 

Her grades are good enough not to disappoint, but she's far from the top of the class. She's pretty in a cute kind of way, but she doesn't turn heads. She's well-liked among her classmates, but not truly popular. 

She blends in so well that at times, she's afraid she'll disappear. 

But jealousy doesn't come naturally to her, and she can never stay mopey for longer than a day or two. Whenever she starts to feel down, she just looks around for what she loves. 

Even in a dying world, she finds things that make her smile. And even if she doesn't realize it, that is a remarkable gift.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The thing about discovering your destiny is that you're never truly ready. Everyone's life is average until the moment it isn't -- and none have learned this better than Antares. 

She doesn't know if the Goddess influences fate itself, or if she's just very talented at stringing together coincidences, but as it would happen, her path crossed Mirai Narukami's totally by accident. By meeting her, she discovered the sinister plot of a foreign god looking to brainwash the world. 

And by discovering that plot, she found the power that slept inside her all along. The Goddess's Hope. 

As timid and unsure as she is, only she can save the world.

keys.DescriptionKey:
There have been dozens of recorded Requiems, stretching back to the beginning of human history. Though they started off as earth-shattering wars between demigods, the establishment of the Goddess's Church helped bring the Vessels under a greater authority.  

For the last thousand years, the names and Gifts of each girl have been recorded, to ensure they are honored after their deaths. The specific Gifts the Goddess passes down vary with each cycle, but most make frequent returns, sometimes performing important deeds before passing on.  

Interestingly, Antares's gift has never once appeared. Perhaps that is why the Church has yet to track her down. They have never once looked in a Vessel's eyes and seen a glimmer of hope.

keys.DescriptionKey: She's traveled from the great Mount Fornax to the sprawling ports of Zuthua. She's conquered the art of monster raising, learned fire magic, and even made a friend or two along the way. But now, Antares faces her most daunting challenge yet. Before the summer ends, she must learn to relax! Luna told her so the last time they met. Of course, she meant it as a joke, but never let it be said that Antares disappoints her idols. She stayed up all night researching the ideal vacation, and by the next morning, she was off to Laomis, a freshly sewn swimsuit in her bag.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Sitting by the pool with flowers in her hair and a picnic basket at her side, Antares may seem like a natural at this 'vacation' thing. But don't be fooled. Relaxing is harder than it looks.

Laomis has lived up to its reputation as a paradise. Everywhere she looks, there's another view to appreciate, another meal to try, another kind local to meet...she can barely keep up with it all! How will she ever experience the whole island before the season ends?

Oh. That's right: summer will come again soon. Maybe, bit by bit, year by year, she can become a vacation master after all.

$#()#$At first glance, it was just a normal school
for normal girls.

unusual.
