$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hibiki... Aren't you going to kill me?
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHappy&$$@Center@$Nah, I won't. I can't.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSadSmile&$$@Center@$I see... Okay...

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$We'll figure things out later. Let's just survive
for now. Then we gotta get out of this school.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNormal&$$@Left@$The Church will come after us.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiWink&$$@Right@$Let'em come. It'd be kinda romantic,
living on the run together, huh?
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSad&$$@Left@$Heh. Maybe if we were lovers.
$#Saya(Saya)#$I don't want to die!

$#Hokusai(???)#$$&HokusaiPowerful&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Good, looks like you've come to an
agreement!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Center@$Who's there!?

$#Hokusai(???)#$$&HokusaiEcstasy&$$@Center@$Ohhh, is that genuine killing intent!? It
looks so good on you, Hibiki!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Center@$Y-You... You're that perv!
$#Hokusai(Perv?)#$$&HokusaiConsider&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Perv!? Ouch, that stings a little.
$#Hokusai(Hokusai)#$$&HokusaiEcstasy&$$@Center@$I told you my name is Hokusai.

$#Hokusai(Hokusai)#$$&HokusaiWink&$$@Center@$But to be honest, that attitude is part of
your charm!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSurprised&$$@Left@$...Uh, who is this again?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Right@$The weirdo that's been stalking me. You
might've seen her creeping around.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNormal&$$@Left@$Oh yeah, I think I have...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiNormal&$—Heyyy, you okay, Saya?

$#Hokusai(Hokusai)#$$&HokusaiPowerful&$$!-1!$$@Left@$My dream is to capture the very essence
of Hibiki in my paintings.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Right@$See? Total creep.
$#Hokusai(Hokusai)#$$&HokusaiEcstasyNormal&$$@Left@$You're so mean...

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hokusai, was it? Sorry, I never got the
chance to introduce myself...

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Right@$Don't bother. She's a stalker. Just ignore
her.

$#Hokusai(Hokusai)#$$&HokusaiClosedeyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Don't worry about it. You'll have a chance to
get to know me better now!

$#Hokusai(Hokusai)#$$&HokusaiSerious&$$@Center@$I've mostly done still life and abstract
paintings in the past.

$#Hokusai(Hokusai)#$$&HokusaiSerious&$$@Center@$But ever since I became a Vessel, I've been
inspired to paint all the other Vessels.

$#Hokusai(Hokusai)#$$&HokusaiEcstasy&$$@Center@$Especially you, Hibiki Himeno! The true
Venus, unmatched in spirit!

$#Hokusai(Hokusai)#$$&HokusaiEcstasyNormal&$$@Center@$And because you compliment her perfectly,
Saya, I've come to know all about you as well!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmirk&$$@Center@$$%0.5%$Hmm?
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSad&$$@Left@$That is a little creepy.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Told ya. We should just walk away.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hokusai, shouldn't you be trying to kill us?

$#Hokusai(Hokusai)#$$&HokusaiContent&$$@Center@$Why would I even think about killing my
beloved Venuses?

$#Hokusai(Hokusai)#$$&HokusaiPowerful&$$@Center@$If anything, I'd rather you two kill me. If
you feel so inclined.

$#Hokusai(Hokusai)#$$&HokusaiPowerful&$$@Center@$Oh, but before that, I'd really like to paint
Hibiki again! Just 20 more times!

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Do whatever you want, creep. Come on,
Saya, let's go!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSurprisedOpen&$Ow! Don't pull me so hard!
$#Hokusai(Hokusai)#$$&HokusaiEcstasyNormal&$$@Right@$Huh? No, wait! Don't leave me behind!

$#Yamato(Yamato)#$$&YamatoNormal&$$@Center@$I wasn't aware the 100th Vessel had been
discovered.
$#SayaNoSword(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSurprised&$$@Center@$Mhm—Ah? What are you doing, Hibiki!?

$#Yamato(Yamato)#$$&YamatoNormal&$$@Center@$But the Requiem has been triggered. So,
you must be the 100th, right?
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaNewLookaway&$$@Center@$I'm not sure... I just woke up here.
$#Yamato(Yamato)#$$&YamatoLookaway&$$@Center@$I see.
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaNewSad&$$@Center@$Sorry...

$#Yamato(Yamato)#$$&YamatoConsider&$$@Center@$There are too many things we still don't
know about the Requiem.

$#Yamato(Yamato)#$$&YamatoSmile&$$@Center@$But for now, we should join forces to make
sure we survive.
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaNewSmile&$$@Center@$Yes, I think so too.
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaNewNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So, where are we heading now?
$#Yamato(Yamato)#$$&YamatoSmile&$$@Right@$Somewhere we can hide from the chaos.

$#Yamato(Yamato)#$$&YamatoSmile&$$@Right@$We should also recruit as many allies as
we can along the way.

$#Anya(Astrid)#$$&AnyaSmile&$$@Center@$When I heard Anastasia's last name
back then, I thought it was a dream...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$Could you leave us alone? I will explain it
to her myself.
$#AttendingDoctor(Attending Doctor)#$Yes, sir. Our team will be on standby.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewGrit&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Father! What did you make her do!?

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Left@$It was the same experiment you've been
conducting.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewGrit&$$@Right@$Wait, you mean deployment of the new
equipment!? It's too soon for Anya!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Left@$Do you mean her age, or her current
health condition?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewGrit&$$@Right@$Well, both! It's only been a few days since
she was kidnapped!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewGrit&$$@Right@$It's far too dangerous!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Left@$We confirmed her injuries from the recent
incident had already healed.
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Left@$Besides, Anastasia is special.
$#Anya(Astrid)#$$&AnyaSmile&$$@Center@$But it wasn't. My sister does exist.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewGrit&$$@Right@$Special!? She's still—
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Astrid. Aren't you being overly protective?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewWorry&$$@Center@$I'm being objective, Father.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$She is a major investment of time and
resources.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$This decision has been made at the executive
committee meeting.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSerious&$$@Center@$So the organization considers us
disposable, is that it?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSerious&$$@Center@$Including you, Father...
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$Her new equipment could turn the tide in
our fight against the Church and terrorists.
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$Much like your own.
$#Anya(Astrid)#$$&AnyaSmile&$$@Center@$And here I thought I'd never see her again...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$The battle looms close. When she awakes,
inform me at once.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewGrit&$$@Center@$Father!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSerious&$$@Center@$Don't you care about Anya at all?
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Mmm...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSurprised&$$@Center@$Anya?
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaVerySad&$$@Center@$Astrid...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewGrit&$$@Center@$Somebody, please! My sister is awake!
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaVerySad&$$@Left@$Where am I...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSadSmile&$$@Right@$In a hospital. You collapsed during an
experiment with your new equipment.
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSad&$$@Left@$New...equipment...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Luther)#$"Astrid, return immediately."
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Don't you remember?

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSad&$$@Center@$I don't remember...anything...aside from
you... Who am I...?

$#AttendingDoctor(Attending Doctor)#$$!-1!$We'll conduct another EEG and an MRI
scan.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSad&$$@Center@$She will be okay, right?
$#AttendingDoctor(Attending Doctor)#$Yes. No need to worry yourself.

$#AttendingDoctor(Attending Doctor)#$The memory loss is probably caused by
short-term neural disruption.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSad&$$@Center@$And is the new equipment to blame?
$#AttendingDoctor(Attending Doctor)#$Now, let's not jump to hasty conclusions—

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSerious&$$@Center@$So this was part of the experiment all
along.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSerious&$$@Center@$(They must've been monitoring her
throughout the procedure.)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Luther)#$"Anastasia collapsed during an experiment."
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSerious&$$@Center@$(Well, if that's the case...)

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSerious&$$@Center@$Once the tests are done, I'm taking her
home. I trust there are no objections.

$#AttendingDoctor(Attending Doctor)#$Just a moment, Ms. von Draclow! Anya
should remain in the hospital in case there
$#AttendingDoctor(Attending Doctor)#$is another emergency—

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSerious&$$@Center@$It'll be fine. If an emergency occurs, the
organization will take care of it.

$#AttendingDoctor(Attending Doctor)#$Well, I suppose it is true that returning
to her usual environment may help her

$#AttendingDoctor(Attending Doctor)#$recover her memory faster than staying in
the hospital...

$#AttendingDoctor(Attending Doctor)#$All right. But please, notify us immediately
if anything happens.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSerious&$$@Center@$I will. I'll report to the commander myself
as well.
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Luther)#$"We'll discuss the details at the hospital."
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSadSmile&$$@Right@$It's okay, Anya. Let me take care of you.
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSad&$$@Left@$Thank you... Astrid.
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Center@$Oh my, are you being discharged already?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewHuh&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Reina! Are you allowed to be here?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Left@$Yes, I'm cooperating with RDO on a joint
project. Simple as that.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Left@$Ordinarily, I wouldn't be able to access
the inner sections of this place.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSerious&$$@Right@$Joint project... The experiment with Anya's
and my new equipment?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Left@$Yes, that's correct. So, Anya, how are you
feeling?
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewWorry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Sorry about that.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewGrit&$$@Center@$Anya!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewWorry&$$@Right@$The tests showed no abnormalities, but she
appears to have temporary memory loss.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$Memory loss, ah... I should apologize as
well.
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$I wasn't present when Anya collapsed.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$If I got to her sooner, maybe this could've
been avoided...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewNormal&$$@Right@$I see. In any case, I'm taking her home
with me.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Left@$As the medical lead for the experiment, I
am glad to hear that.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Well then, excuse us. Let's go, Anya.
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSad&$$@Center@$Okay, Astrid...
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...Memory loss, ha.
$#IncomingCall(Incoming Call)#$Ring-ring, ring-ring
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Good day to you too, I suppose.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Center@$How's your progress? I see. Things are
going smoothly, then?
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Center@$Same here. At least, for now.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$By the way, about the materials on Anya
I prepared...
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Center@$...I take it you haven't reviewed them.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Center@$Didn't you say the information was
necessary for the design?
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Center@$The truth is, you couldn't care less, could you?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Oh well. At least it seems we have the
memory loss thing covered for now.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Center@$Listen closely now. Keep watch from the
outside. Whatever you do—do not enter.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Center@$I shall make my way to you shortly.
Goodbye.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewGrit&$$@Center@$Anya! Is she all right?
$#CallEnd(Call End)#$Beep-beep-beep...
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Center@$Now, the real game begins...

keys.value: $#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst3988|$I came...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act6.Voices/mst3997|$So everyone is hearing the same voice.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$|act6.Voices/mst3998|$!?
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$|act6.Voices/mst3999|$Nagi? What's wrong?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$|act6.Voices/mst4000|$Up ahead... I think I just saw a human
child...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst4001|$!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst4002|$Was it the angel that Rizette has been
seeing...?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst4003|$Is it guiding us...?
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst3989|$...from a different world.

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst3990|$Seeking powerful lives, and powerful
souls...
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst3991|$I came to this land.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst3992|$That voice...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst3993|$It sounds like a small child.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst3994|$Theo, you can hear it too!?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$|act6.Voices/mst3995|$"I came from a different world"?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$|act6.Voices/mst3996|$"Seeking powerful lives, and powerful
souls."

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4016|$That which I created in my image increased
the magic in this land to its maximum...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst4024|$But I was wrong... Everything was made by
one entity!!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$|act6.Voices/mst4025|$Who are you...? What do you mean by
"grow"? What do you want from us!?
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4026|$Soldiers.

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4027|$Soldiers who will fight for me across all
of time and space.

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4028|$Who will fight against the gods of the
multiverse...
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4029|$I need you, my precious soldiers.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst4030|$Soldiers...?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$|act6.Voices/mst4031|$To fight gods!?
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4032|$Fear, known as the Eternal.
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4033|$Hope, in the form of the Crests.
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|Cont|$...and ruled over it.
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4034|$The hope would destroy the fear.

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4035|$But it would then become the fear, and
stand against hope.

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4036|$Within the cycle these two elements
wove...

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4037|$the seedlings of Erden began to grow
spectacular and strong.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$|act6.Voices/mst4038|$You came to terrorize Erden all so you
could make us into your personal soldiers?
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganDetermined&$$|act6.Voices/mst4039|$And that is why Erden never fell...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$|act6.Voices/mst4040|$Is this what Commander Luther and Norza
were talking about...?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst4041|$Then why...?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$|act6.Voices/mst4042|$I thought the Crestgiver was providing me
the power to end the Pandemonium.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$|Cont|$Even that was your trick!

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4017|$The seedlings of Erden called this
phenomenon "the Pandemonium."

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst4043|$We had a way to destroy the system you
built to force Erden to grow to your whim.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$|Cont|$Why did you help us!?

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4044|$I poured my love into my seedlings as they
grew in their cyclical garden, and waited.

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4045|$Waited for the moment that the people of
Erden would break my cycle.

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4046|$Waited for people who would sense my
will, and recognize my presence.

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4047|$I waited for heroes who would close in
upon me!

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4048|$Their coming would prove the people of
this planet had grown close to my image.

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4049|$When I saw the signs, I could not even wait
a mere century.
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4050|$I waited just 18 more of your years.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst4051|$So that is why the Pandemonium came so
early... By signs, it means...
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4018|$But it was too strong.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst4052|$Our research...!?

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4053|$There was not merely one sign. The people
of this planet have continued to evolve.

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4054|$But the conception of the Sword of
Sealing, an unknown factor...
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4055|$made my heart pound.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$|act6.Voices/mst4056|$This is why you've been terrorizing
everyone!?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGrit&$$|act6.Voices/mst4057|$This... This is why you slaughtered my
village!?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGrit&$$|act6.Voices/mst4058|$Answer me...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$|act6.Voices/mst4059|$Answer me!!

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4060|$Everything was to stimulate the evolution
of the peoples of Erden.

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4061|$Finally, this heroes' journey of over two
millennia...

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4019|$It was on a path to completely destroy the
land I needed to make my seedlings grow.
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4062|$is nearing its close.
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4020|$So I had another idea.
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4021|$I needed to give them hope.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$|act6.Voices/mst4022|$The crests!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst4023|$I assumed the Pandemonium and the
Crests were made by conflicting forces...

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4004|$When I came to this land, I found the
perfect seedlings.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst4013|$!!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst4014|$Over there!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$|act6.Voices/mst4015|$A child...!
I saw it too!

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4005|$Little sprouts brimming with limitless
potential.

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4006|$But for these seedlings to bloom in the
way I desired...
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4007|$This land was too kind.
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4008|$And so...
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst4009|$I created something.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst4010|$You created...
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganDetermined&$$|act6.Voices/mst4011|$the Eternal!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$|act6.Voices/mst4012|$What is this voice!?

keys.DescriptionKey:
Druke's father was a skilled blacksmith, his name known across South Rigland.
Warriors would come from all over, crossing the brutal Habsu Desert just to buy his wares.
However, his son possessed no skill for the forge at all.
Though he worried for his son, the blacksmith took a local boy, Gilgan, as his apprentice and successor, and Druke lived his teenage years shiftless and ill-content.
However...one night, a bandit snuck into the forge while the boys' parents were out.
Gilgan advised caution, but Druke seized one of his father's blades from the wall and struck the thief down.
It was as if Druke had cut the haze from his thoughts with the same blow.
Though his parents scolded him, Druke felt certain. Forging weapons was not the only way to live by the sword.

My friends need my blade. Nothing else matters.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Rody: "We'll need to do something about that dragon if we want to get through here. What's the plan?"
Callen: "I have an idea. I can concoct some sleeping medicine. If we put it in some meat and leave it out as bait..."
Druke: "That'll take way too long. I say we run in there and kill the stupid thing."
Callen: "Don't be ridiculous! That thing will tear you to—"
Rody: "No, he's got a point... we are in a hurry, after all. Let's not overthink this."
Callen: "Not you too!"
Rody: "Look, it's not even a dragon god, it's just a regular dragon. If we can't kill it, how can we hope to fight the Eternal?"
Callen: "...Well...I mean... Yuki, say something to these idiots!"
Yuki: "Just a flying lizard. It'll be no match for my ice."
Callen: "You... you meatheads!"

keys.DescriptionKey:
The Eternal was defeated, and peace returned to Erden. Amidst the celebration, Druke fell into black despair.
The vow he made to Rody that day in Urg Roa...

"I swore to protect you, no matter what. But I failed...and you're gone.
All our friends have gone their separate ways, to their separate futures. But what is there for me?"

"This peace is only temporary. When the horror of the Pandemonium fades, people will turn on each other again.
What a senseless world...but it's the world my friend gave his life to save.
So I'll protect it instead. This time, I'll fulfill my vow. As my atonement."

"I need power. Absolute power, to crush any foe, and keep my people safe.
Some nights I hear that beast, the one the Aeon Lord showed me. I feel its roar deep inside.
But it's of no matter.
I have work to do."

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$|act4.Voices/mst2215|$It just looks like a regular forest to me.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$|act4.Voices/mst2216|$There are signs of many monsters in here.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$|act4.Voices/mst2217|$So this is where the thief Elmina is hiding.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act4.Voices/mst2218|$If this is her hideout, she probably has
ways of defending it.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act4.Voices/mst2219|$Commence the search, but remain vigilant!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2105|$This is a pretty nice city.

$#Guard(Guard)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2113|$I see... I will relay your request, so please
wait here in town.
$#Guard(Guard)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2114|$I'll return soon.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2115|$...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2116|$Riz? Are you okay?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2117|$My chest feels tight for some reason...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2118|$Do you want to rest? I can help you find
an inn.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2119|$I think I'm okay.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2120|$Everyone is dismissed until we are
permitted to meet with the Commander.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2121|$Don't push yourself if you're not feeling
well, Rizette.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2122|$Thank you, Captain.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2106|$Astrid said it was fortified, so I thought it
would be more grim.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2123|$You should all get some rest while we have
the chance.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2124|$Yes ma'am!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2125|$Meet me at the Hymelia Fortress when you
are ready!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2107|$It was fortified two Pandemoniums ago to
protect from demon attacks.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$It just feels like a regular city now, doesn't
it?
$#Guard(Guard)#$$&GuardSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2108|$Excuse me...

$#Guard(Guard)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2109|$Am I correct in assuming you are from the
Rigland Red Dragon Knights?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2110|$Yes, we are the Rigland Red Dragon Knight
Pandemonium Task Force.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2111|$I am Ludmilla, unit captain. We are seeking
information pertinent to our mission.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2112|$We would like to request an audience with
your commander.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1632|$So these are the Lu'Ganan ruins? They're
beautiful...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1641|$Yes. Let us begin our search of the ruins.
Everyone, stay on your guard!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1633|$Apparently it was once a great city, built
by our ancestors in ancient times.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1634|$There are active sentinel stones inside,
remnants of an ancient security system.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1635|$For this reason, my people are warned from
childhood not to enter lightly.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1636|$Look! Over there in the shade—footprints!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1637|$They're still fresh.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1638|$Astrid, Mysha...and a third set!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1639|$It smells of beast. The xahe'oyai must be
inside!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1640|$Captain, let's hurry.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2083|$Is this Nushelle Village?

$#Quilvy(Quilvy)#$$&Quilvy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2092|$Woah there! I'm just a traveler passing
through, vee!

$#Quilvy(Quilvy)#$$&Quilvy&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2093|$I came to visit an elven friend of mine, and
this is what I found...

$#Quilvy(Quilvy)#$$&Quilvy&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2094|$I'm not sure what occurred here, but you
may find more information in Hymelia.
$#Quilvy(Quilvy)#$$&Quilvy&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$It's a fortified city not far from here, vee!

$#Quilvy(Quilvy)#$$&Quilvy&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2095|$I'll be on my way now. I don't want any
trouble!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2096|$The path from here to Rigland should still
be safe. Take care.
$#Quilvy(Quilvy)#$$&Quilvy&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2097|$Thank you, vee!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2098|$Hymelia...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2099|$It's a city built around a large fortress.
It's on good terms with Rigland.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$Since the Pandemonium reoccurred we've
had to prioritize our own defenses, though.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2084|$It should be, but...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2100|$I believe some mercenaries from
Me'Rizanté are working there.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2101|$Maybe we can find out what happened here
if we go to Hymelia.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2102|$There's no guarantee, but it's probably our
best chance.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2103|$Then what are we waiting for? Let's go to
Hymelia!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2104|$Agreed. Move out!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2085|$This is awful...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2086|$There has been a battle here. But this
doesn't look like the work of monsters.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2087|$It looks like the work of human soldiers.
But there are no bodies.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2088|$The only footprints are humanoid.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2089|$Where did the elves go?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2091|$Who goes there!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act6.Voices/mst3516|$We're finally here!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3525|$...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3526|$(My friends... I am here once again.)
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3527|$(Your son is here with me, Rody.)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3528|$The Aeon Tower, and the Eternal, are just
up ahead!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3529|$But before we go there, we should gather
information at the outpost.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3530|$Yes. Our first stop is the mountain village
of Silverlodge.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3517|$Wow, there really is snow everywhere!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3518|$You sound surprised, Theo. I thought you
knew all about these mountains.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3519|$Only what I've read in books. I've never
been to a snowy mountain before!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSad&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3520|$This cold is quite rough on a sziviik...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3521|$My friends... I have the sudden urge to
take a long nap!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaTroubled&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3522|$Hang in there, Ga'Luga, I'll rub your back
for you! Nagi, no! Don't start hibernating!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3523|$I never expected that you two of all people
would complain over a little brisk weather!

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3524|$Be kind, Captain. The races of Erden each
have their own strengths and weaknesses.

$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3567|$It's no use, they're going to come bursting
out of the valley any second now!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$Is something the matter?
$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3576|$A herd of monsters is heading our way!

$#RedKnightB(Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3577|$They began swarming in a nearby
valley at dawn. There's at least 100 now!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3578|$A hundred!?

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3579|$If a herd that large attacks, this village
won't stand a chance...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3580|$...Evacuate the people. We will defend the
village!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3581|$Knights, prepare for combat! Elmina,
Rizette, is this what you two were sensing?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3582|$I'm not sure... But I feel like something
awful is about to happen!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHurt&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3583|$I'm not sure either, but something's
coming!
$#RedKnightA(Knight C)#$$&RedKnight&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3584|$There is movement in the valley!
$#RedKnightB(Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3568|$How many? Can we handle them?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3585|$It... It looks like the march of an army!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3586|$They're coming this way!
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganDetermined&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3587|$They look organized. And fast.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3588|$There's no time to evacuate...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3589|$Ludmilla, let's march out to meet them!
That's the best we can do for the village!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3590|$I agree! Knights, move out! Hamper their
advance!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3591|$This will be a long battle, with multiple
engagements along the way.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$There isn't much time, but get what you
need from the village before we depart.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3592|$Assemble at the valley in the northeast
when you are ready!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3593|$We only just got here... But I won't let
those monsters anywhere near this village!
$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3569|$No way, we'll be overrun!

$#RedKnightB(Knight C)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3570|$Damn it... Get everyone out! Head down
the mountain while the sun is still high!
$#RedKnightA(Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3571|$Wait, is that...?

$#RedKnightB(Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3572|$What in the... It's Captain Ludmilla of the
Pandemonium Task Force!
$#RedKnightA(Knight C)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3573|$And Commander Astrid is with her!!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3574|$Knights, thank you for your service
investigating and protecting the area.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3575|$Commander Astrid is accompanying my
task force on a special mission.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1451|$Is this...

$#KudVillager2(Kud Villager B)#$$&KudVillager&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1460|$What were you thinking!? You're not as
strong as we are. That was reckless!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1461|$...Sorry. But it's okay!
These folks saved me!
$#KudVillager1(Kud Villager A)#$$&KudVillager&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1462|$What?
$#KudVillager2(Kud Villager B)#$$&KudVillager&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1463|$Human knights? What are they doing here?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1464|$Sorry for the disturbance. We are from the
Rigland Red Dragon Knights.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$@Left@$$|Cont|$A mission has brought us to this region.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1465|$May we speak with your leader?
$#Gilgan(Elderly Kud)#$$&GilganSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1466|$Mysha... You're safe!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1467|$Gramps! Yeah, I'm fine!
$#Gilgan(Elderly Kud)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1468|$I am Gilgan, the village smith.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1452|$Yup, that's Urg Roa. My home.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1469|$Ludmilla. The name of Gilgan, Master
Swordsmith, is well known in Rigland!

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1470|$Are you sure you're not thinking of Druke,
the Legendary Swordmaster?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1471|$Your brother is also quite famous!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1472|$Druke!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1473|$What's gotten into you, Nagi?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1474|$Druke is a kud swordmaster. He was a hero
during the previous Pandemonium!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1475|$I've read about him! He single-handedly
defended West Lumea from a demon attack.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1476|$But he disappeared before the
Pandemonium ended...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1477|$...

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1478|$Captain... May I ask what your mission
here is?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1453|$Mysha, Ga'Luga...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1479|$Of course.

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1480|$I also want to repay you for saving my
granddaughter.

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$It's a little cramped, but I'd like to invite you
to my workshop.
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1481|$Ga'Luga, you should come too.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1482|$Gilgan... Alright.
$#KudVillager1(Kud Villager A)#$$&KudVillager&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1483|$Ga'Luga!?
$#KudVillager2(Kud Villager B)#$$&KudVillager&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1484|$What's he doing here? Has he come to...?
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1485|$?

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1486|$(What's going on? Are the Urg Roa folk...
afraid of me?)
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1487|$I'll be waiting for you in my workshop.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1454|$It was touch-and-go for a bit there, but
I'm finally back!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1488|$Lady Mysha, I did not realize you were
Sir Druke's kin!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1489|$And your grandfather is a famous
swordsmith... That's amazing, Mysha!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1490|$Well, we're not really kin, obviously. But
they're my family, and I really respect them.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1491|$(That's why I...)
Sorry, folks, I've gotta run. See you later!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1492|$Mysha?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1493|$She looked a little strange.
Wonder what got into her.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1494|$...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1495|$Take a break, everyone! Meet at Gilgan's
workshop when you're done.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1496|$Yes ma'am!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1497|$Shouldn't you go after Mysha, Ga'Luga?
$#KudVillager1(Kud Villager A)#$$&KudVillager&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1455|$Hey, over there!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1498|$What right have you to tell me that?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1499|$Y-You're right, sorry.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1500|$Alright, what should I do before I head to
the workshop?
$#KudVillager2(Kud Villager B)#$$&KudVillager&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1456|$It's Mysha!
$#KudVillager1(Kud Villager A)#$$&KudVillager&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1457|$Someone tell Gilgan!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1458|$I'm sorry to have worried you, everyone!
$#KudVillager1(Kud Villager A)#$$&KudVillager&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1459|$We're just glad you're home, Mysha!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Kay)#$Agravain and I became acquainted during
the previous King Arthur's rule.

$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Center@$To make it easier to protect the king,
perhaps.
$#SecondKingArthur(Second King Arthur)#$No, it's not about functionality...

$#SecondKingArthur(Second King Arthur)#$To put it simply, the Round Table
signifies family.
$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayNormal&$$@Center@$Family?

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSwimSerious&$$@Center@$No, but I could sense it. It was a formidable
technique.

$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayNormal&$$@Center@$Precisely. Strange as it may seem, you are
dreaming within the dream world.

$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayNormal&$$@Center@$What's more, we are sharing the same
dream.

$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayNormal&$$@Center@$Amazing what a barrier created by
an incubus can do.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSwimSerious&$$@Center@$I see... So that is why I have no physical
form.

$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayGrin&$$@Center@$You are taking this almost too well.
I expected more resistance...

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSwimClosedEyes&$$@Center@$If killing you could return things to
normal, I would gladly do it...

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&AthurSwimStare&$$@Center@$But it appears I cannot even punch you
here. What a shame.

$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayNormal&$$@Center@$Yes, that's really too bad. Well, there's
only one way out of here.

$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayNormal&$$@Center@$After we witness a particular memory,
just answer one question for me.
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSwimSerious&$$@Center@$And if I refuse, I will be stuck here forever?
$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayNormal&$$@Center@$I see...

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSwimSerious&$$@Center@$My ambition remains unshaken, but
I cannot afford a delay.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSwimSerious&$$@Center@$Show me this memory of yours,
and do it quickly.

$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayNormal&$$@Center@$(As expected, she's completely unfazed
by the situation.)

$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayNormal&$$@Center@$(I was deceived by you for so long... But
was the smile I saw on that day also fake?)
$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayNormal&$$@Center@$(I must find out...)
$#()#$—Camelot's city streets.

$#()#$Not much time has passed since the foreign
knight and the saint made their appearance,

$#()#$and the battle with Capitulian forces was
fought.

$#()#$The memory of those events still smolders
deeply within the townspeople's minds.

$#FearfulCamelotresident(Fearful Camelot Resident)#$I'm still scared at night. I toss and turn,
wondering if monsters will appear again...

$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayGrin&$$@Center@$The utterly evil version of you from back
then would have been more annoyed.

$#CheerfulCamelotresident(Cheerful Camelot Resident)#$Come on, how long are you going to talk
about that?

$#CheerfulCamelotresident(Cheerful Camelot Resident)#$Sir Gawain and the others handled things,
didn't they?

$#CheerfulCamelotresident(Cheerful Camelot Resident)#$Besides, today we celebrate! Let us wash
away the harrowing memory of that night!

$#CheerfulCamelotresident(Cheerful Camelot Resident)#$The King has returned from the
expedition! That calls for festivity!

$#GossipyCamelotresident(Gossipy Camelot Resident)#$And I heard Camelot's territory has
expanded even more!

$#CheerfulCamelotresident(Cheerful Camelot Resident)#$That's our king for you! With her around,
Camelot is safe!

$#GossipyCamelotresident(Gossipy Camelot Resident)#$I've heard that Sir Agravain's
performance was quite remarkable.

$#CheerfulCamelotresident(Cheerful Camelot Resident)#$Sir Agravain, huh? I rarely see him around
town, so I don't know much about him.

$#GossipyCamelotresident(Gossipy Camelot Resident)#$There's a rumor that he's the strongest at
the Round Table now.

$#CheerfulCamelotresident(Cheerful Camelot Resident)#$Even stronger than Sir Gawain or Sir
Lancelot!?
$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayGrin&$$@Center@$How anticlimactic...
$#GossipyCamelotresident(Gossipy Camelot Resident)#$Well, it's just a rumor...

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainNormal&$$@Right@$King Arthur's return is the talk of the
town.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSadComical&$$@Left@$Siiiiis... I can't move anymore...
I can't walk...

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSad&$$@Right@$Stop calling me that, Gareth. How many
times must I tell you?

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSad&$$@Right@$And you obviously need more discipline if
you want to give up after such basic routine.
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethShocked&$$@Left@$Uuuugh... I can't take it anymore!
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainClosedEyesSerious&$$@Right@$I don't want to hear any "I can'ts".

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainClosedEyesSerious&$$@Right@$Knights of the Round Table have no need
for such words.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Center@$But, but... I've trained so hard since—
Uh...
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSad&$$@Center@$I mean, I know this is punishment...

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&AthurSwimStareSerious&$$@Center@$That sarcasm of yours has remained intact
even in death, I see.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSad&$$@Center@$And becoming stronger is my way of
thanking everyone for forgiving me, but...
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSadComical&$$@Center@$Am I really getting stronger?

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainClosedEyes&$$@Center@$If you can't objectively assess yourself,
then you still have a long way to go.
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSadComical&$$@Center@$A-Are you serious...

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSmile&$$@Center@$But the Royal Helioslash you unleashed
today was quite powerful.

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSmile&$$@Center@$If I hadn't taken it seriously, I wouldn't
have been able to withstand it.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethLaugh&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Really!? So, if I keep it up, can I use
Royal Lunarslash too?
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainClosedEyesSerious&$$@Right@$Let's not get carried away.
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSadComical&$$@Left@$Ugh... I should've known...

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSmile&$$@Right@$...Perhaps one day I'll allow it. Since
you're supposed to be my little sister.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Center@$...Ngh!

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinStare&$$@Center@$I see you've done your homework well.
Impressive, really...

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinStare&$$@Center@$Your grandfather...the first King Arthur and
I were supposed to return to Avalon together.
$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinStare&$$@Center@$But I fled.
$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinStare&$$@Center@$In order to fulfill the promise I gave him.

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinStare&$$@Center@$Ever since then, "Merlin" is considered to be
non-existent in this world.

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinStare&$$@Center@$Even if I attempt to influence the world,
it all ends up as if nothing has happened.

$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Center@$(So the enormous impact of that grand
spell was erased, as if it never happened...)

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkNormal&$$@Center@$I had information about your curse, but
had never seen it in action before today.
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkNormal&$$@Center@$It is nice to have confirmation.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkNormal&$$@Center@$You did not immediately go for a decisive
strike, so I was convinced that
$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Center@$What happened...?
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkNormal&$$@Center@$the restriction was indeed effective.

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinComicalSad&$$@Center@$You're no fun at all. What was the point of
attacking if you didn't even get surprised?
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$Now, Merlin...
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$It is my turn to attack.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$Here and now, I will put an end to both
you and the memory of my grandfather.

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinTehepero&$$@Center@$Again, not if I have anything to say about
it ☆

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$I have seen through your magical tricks.
They are all meaningless.
$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinHappy&$$@Center@$Not all of them.

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinHappy&$$@Center@$The curse applies to the part of me that is
the great magician Merlin.

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinStare&$$@Center@$However, my other half is an incubus...
And that part of my power is not restricted.

$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Center@$(We should have been engulfed by
Merlin's grand spell.)
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$This is your end all the same—
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$Regal Eclipse!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Merlin)#$$&MerlinShocked&$$@Center@$...Uwaaaaaaaaah!

$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Center@$So this was the extent of the great Merlin's
capabilities.
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$...
$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Center@$What is it, my liege?
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$She yielded far too easily...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Merlin)#$$&MerlinComplacent&$$@Center@$Bingo! What you cut down was just a clone
I had prepared under cover of my big spell!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Merlin)#$$&MerlinWink&$$@Center@$Ahahahaha! And the winner is Merlin!
Thank you, thank you all!
$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Center@$...Where is the real body?

$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Center@$(But there's no pain, no injuries...not even
a single scratch?)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Merlin)#$$&MerlinHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You won't have the time to find out.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Merlin)#$$&MerlinHappy&$$@Center@$Fall, descend into dream! Welcome to the
realm of regret and resentment!
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkShouting&$$@Left@$A magical barrier?
$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Right@$Curses...
$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinComplacent&$$@Center@$The heroes will come meet you eventually...
$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinComplacent&$$@Center@$All I did was slightly alter their timing.

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinNormal&$$@Center@$Just enough so that the change wasn't
nullified.

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinNormal&$$@Center@$In the meantime, I have to keep you
entertained!

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinNormal&$$@Center@$Let me add a little bonus to your dream.
I'm sure you'll like it!
$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinTehepero&$$@Center@$Why not just settle there forever, hm?

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkNormal&$$@Center@$Just as I thought, Merlin. You cannot
kill us.

$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Center@$What kind of bonus is that...
That meddlesome fiend...
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSwimClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Sip sip sip...
$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...Does it taste good, my liege?

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSwimClosedEyes&$$@Left@$Yes, it is delicious. Too good to come from
the real world.
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSwimSerious&$$@Left@$If I were to describe it...
$#KingArthurGigant(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSwimSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The most singular, tastiest taste.
$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Right@$...

$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Right@$Rest is well and good...but we must think
of a way out of this barrier.
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&AthurSwimStare&$$!-1!$$@Center@$There is nothing we can do.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&AthurSwimStare&$$@Center@$It is a barrier constructed by Merlin.
I doubt it has any flaws.
$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Center@$She cannot...?

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&AthurSwimStare&$$@Center@$We could attempt to force our way through,
but I cannot use the power of Avalon here.
$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Center@$But this could hinder your plans, my king!
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSwimClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Left@$My plans will not be hindered.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSwimClosedEyes&$$@Left@$Merlin's magic is not infinite. Once it is
depleted, the barrier will collapse by itself.
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSwimClosedEyes&$$@Left@$We just need to wait.
$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Right@$As you wish, ma'am.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSwimWink&$$!-1!$$@Center@$So, Agravain. How do you find my
swimsuit?
$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Center@$What do you mean...?
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSwimWink&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Does it suit me?
$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Right@$Why such frivolity, my liege...

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Just like the Knights of the Round Table,
you are under a curse.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&AthurSwimStareSerious&$$@Left@$Humans like to distract themselves by talking
in times like this. Were you not aware?
$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Right@$I see...
$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Right@$It suits you well, ma'am.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSwimClosedEyes&$$@Left@$So you can talk like an average person too,
I see. No, that did not sound appropriate...
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&AthurSwimStareSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hmm...
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSwimSmile&$$@Center@$Hehe, thank you.
$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Center@$...

$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Center@$(People would praise her smile as
befitting an upright young lady.)

$#KingArthur(Agravain)#$$&ArthurSwimSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(But behind her eyes lies a deep,
undisturbed darkness,

$#KingArthur(Agravain)#$$&ArthurSwimSmile&$$@Center@$and her lips don't form any expression
that's not calculated...)
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkClosedEyes&$$@Center@$And, if my guess is correct...
$#KingArthur(Agravain)#$$&ArthurSwimSmile&$$@Center@$(You could say she's cold as ice.)

$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Center@$(And that's precisely why she is my
king. My sovereign.)
$#Agravain(Agravain)#$$&Agravain&$$@Center@$(The absolute ruler worthy of my service.)

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$&KayGrit&$$!-1!$Hmph, "suits her well"? Don't make me
laugh.
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurNormal&$$@Center@$...!

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$&KayGrit&$$!-1!$Though I suppose a luxurious swimsuit
perfectly fits the noble princess
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$&KayGrit&$people once thought you were.

$#Kay(???)#$$&KayGrit&$$@Center@$Do get rid of that forced smile, though.
It's nauseating, Your Majesty.
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSwimSerious&$$@Center@$Why...
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSwimSerious&$$@Center@$Why are you here?

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkNormal&$$@Center@$Your curse is "not being able to interfere
with fate."
King Arthur's Respite

in Elvenlent.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3033|$Who are you? Why did you attack Callen!?
$#AssassinA(Assassin)#$$&Assassin&$$@Right@$...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3035|$You don't feel like talking? Perhaps I can
persuade you.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3036|$Wait.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3037|$Callen? What are you doing?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3038|$I'm going to ask their minds directly.
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2995|$A moment of your time, Captain?
$#AssassinA(Assassin)#$$&Assassin&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3039|$!?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3040|$There's no use resisting. I can be very
persuasive.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3041|$I have tuned my magic in a way that aids
my research needs.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3042|$I can no longer use the high-speed chants
necessary for battle...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$But in every other technique, I am at the top
of my field!
$#AssassinA(Assassin)#$$&Assassin&$$@Center@$$%1%$$|act5.Voices/mst3043|$Ugh... Urgh!!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3044|$I have a hold of your surface thoughts. Now
speak.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3045|$Who are you, and who sent you? Why did
you try to kill me!?
$#AssassinA(Assassin)#$$&Assassin&$$@Center@$$%1%$$|act5.Voices/mst3046|$Urgh... Arrrrrgh!?
$#Assassin(Assassin)#$$|act5.Voices/mst3047|$I am a Serpent.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2996|$Gilgan. What is it?
$#Assassin(Assassin)#$$|act5.Voices/mst3048|$My mission...

$#Assassin(Assassin)#$$|act5.Voices/mst3049|$Is the assassination of Callen, who is
attempting to end the Pandemonium.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3050|$Serpent?
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3051|$That must be his code name.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3052|$He has received some serious resistance
training. But just a little more...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3053|$Spit it out. Who do you work for?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3054|$Who ordered this mission?
$#AssassinA(Assassin)#$$&Assassin&$$%1%$$|act5.Voices/mst3055|$Urgh... I... belong to...
$#DONTSHOWME(Assassin)#$$|act5.Voices/mst3056|$The Rigland Red Dragon Knights...
$#DONTSHOWME(Assassin)#$$|act5.Voices/mst3057|$Special Unit Zero...

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2997|$Something has been bothering me. It is
possible I am just overthinking things, but...
$#DONTSHOWME(Assassin)#$$|act5.Voices/mst3058|$The one who commands me...
$#DONTSHOWME(Assassin)#$$|act5.Voices/mst3059|$From the Pillar Room...

$#DONTSHOWME(Assassin)#$$|act5.Voices/mst3060|$The Commander of the Rigland Red Dragon
Knights...
$#DONTSHOWME(Assassin)#$$|act5.Voices/mst3061|$Luther von Draclow.
$#Ludmilla;Finn;Rizette;(All)#$$&LudmillaSurprise;Finn.FinnHorror;Rizette.RizetteUpset;&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Finn.Center;Rizette.Right;@$$|act5.Voices/mst3062|$!?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3063|$...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3064|$What...?
$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3065|$Commander, it is time.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3066|$Even in the middle of the Pandemonium,
the Council wants two reports a month...
$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3067|$My apologies, sir.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2998|$I see...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3068|$These meetings decide the distribution of
credit for the labors of our order.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3069|$While we waste time on such trifle, the Aeon
Legion is invading Erden...

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3070|$But the Pandemonium Task Force... Lady
Astrid and Captain Ludmilla will surely...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3071|$Of course. But even a unit as accomplished
as theirs still requires rest.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3072|$When their current mission is complete, I
will disband and reorganize them.
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSmile&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3073|$They've done quite enough...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSmile&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3074|$In the name of the Rigland Red Dragon
Knights.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3075|$...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3076|$Finn... Did you get any sleep?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3077|$No... How about you?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2999|$Okay. Let me hear it.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3078|$Not a wink...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3079|$I wonder how Astrid is doing.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3080|$I think Mysha stayed with her all night.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3081|$I've never seen her like that...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3082|$There has to be some kind of mistake... My
father would never do something like this!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3083|$He loves the people of Erden, and despises
the Pandemonium more than anyone!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$Why would he want to kill the one person
who can put an end to it!?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3084|$It doesn't make any sense! Serpent? Special
Unit Zero?? I've never heard of either!!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3085|$Callen! Did you really read his mind?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3086|$Maybe your technique failed? Or maybe he
just believes that lie is true!!

keys.DescriptionKey:
Consumes a Power Charge. 400% damage to 1 enemy, and then grants that enemy the Sleep status effect for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. This attack ignores damage reduction effects. Sleep will overwrite other status effects on that enemy. Usable only if the user has a Power Charge.

If damage from this attack defeats a non-conjured enemy, another random non-boss, non-Ephemeral enemy on the battlefield will be immediately defeated (the user is considered to have defeated that enemy with an attack). This secondary effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the random enemy from being defeated.

Astrid01.description: A proud perfectionist, Astrid is determined to live up to the expectations placed on her as daughter of the Commander of the Red Dragon Knights. She is as strict on others as she is on herself, but her air of confidence hides insecurities that she doesn't have what it takes to follow her father.

keys.value: $#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1094|$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1103|$But don't you have your own unit?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1104|$I have already arranged everything with
Fa... with the Commander.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngryBlush&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1105|$Prepare yourself!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1106|$Pr-Prepare myself? For what?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsunBlush&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1107|$...Here.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1108|$A bag? You're giving it to me?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1109|$This is...!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1110|$This smell, this color, this glow...! These
are Rossé apples!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1111|$You brought these back for me? Thank you,
Astrid!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngryBlush&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1112|$O-Only because those villagers made me.
Anyway, I have matters to attend to!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1095|$As... Lady Astrid? You're back from your
mission?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1096|$...I heard that the Sleeping Death
antidote was effective.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1097|$And that you defeated an Aeon Lord.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1098|$Yeah... We all worked together and
managed it somehow.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1099|$...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1100|$I shall be accompanying you on your next
mission.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1101|$Huh?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngryBlush&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1102|$I'm saying that I shall evaluate this power
of yours for myself!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$|act3.Voices/mst1113|$I will not permit carelessness in any squad
that I am part of!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst436|$...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst445|$Rossé was a good place. Sure it was small,
but we were like one big family.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst446|$Northern Rigland is full of little villages just
like that, with peaceful, friendly people...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst447|$I feel much better knowing someone like you
will be looking out for them!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsunBlush&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst448|$Err... Y-Yes...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst449|$You should try some of the local produce
while you're there!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsunBlush&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst450|$I-I don't think I will have the time to—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst451|$I recommend the apples! The ones around
Rossé are the best you'll ever have!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst452|$H-Hey, don't stand so close—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst453|$The veggies are good too! It's hard to tell
which ones are edible, but if you—

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngryBlush&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst454|$Enough!! Northern Rigland will be well
protected, so focus on your own mission!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst437|$Astrid! Are you headed out on a mission
too?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngryBlush&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst455|$I've heard Kawazu is a dangerous place.
You ought to keep your wits about you!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngryBlush&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst456|$...Good day!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst438|$...Yes, my unit has been charged with the
protection of Northern Rigland.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst439|$You can rest assured that no more
tragedies will occur there on my watch.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst440|$You're going to protect Northern Rigland?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst441|$You're from Rossé, aren't you? It seems
some of the villagers plan to rebuild it.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst442|$My unit has been charged with their
protection. You ought to be grateful to me.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst443|$Astrid... Thank you so much!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst444|$!?

keys.DescriptionKey:
Underneath the cloudless sky, Astrid appears in her finest attire yet, causing her secret admirers among the commoners and soldiers alike burst into deafening applause. However, she herself doesn't seem pleased with her outfit.
"I have been told this is going to be the presentation of a new combat uniform... They set me up...!"

AstridBride01.title: Red Dragon Bride

keys.IntroText:
S-Stunning? How dare you mock me!
Stop it, this instant!

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Looking good, Astrid!" a young man tells her after the ceremony.
"How insolent! You think you can mock me just because of this unbecoming outfit?" she snaps, face red with anger.
"No, I'm being serious!"
"You obviously are not! I won't let you get away with it!" she says but the man finds her embarrassment charming. "And what are you smiling at now, you oaf!?"

keys.DescriptionKey:
This must be some kind of a dream, because her beloved is here with her, smiling. And she can be herself and let her guard down too, even though usually she has to be the invulnerable Commander her knights need. Ah, what a sweet dream...
"But I have a mission to accomplish," she mumbles to herself as she wakes up, still reveling in faint traces of that dream's warmth.

keys.DescriptionKey: This blade, a symbol of the Red Dragon Knights' power and authority, has been wielded by generations of legendary knights. Each new Commander is expected to grow into a leader worthy of its majesty, and lead with wisdom and grace.

AstridGreatsword01.name: Dragonfang
AstridGreatsword01.description: This blade, a symbol of the Red Dragon Knights' power and authority, has been wielded by generations of legendary knights. Each new Commander is expected to grow into a leader worthy of its majesty, and lead with wisdom and grace.

keys.IntroText:
Red as blood, red as dragonscale, red as fire.
A crimson line between Rigland and her foes.

keys.DescriptionKey:
A life of extravagance. From her infancy, everything she could have ever desired was already within reach.
This hairpin was the first thing in her life she chose for herself. Her father, who always believed avarice was a mark of nobility, was pleased to purchase it for her.
The deep red roses symbolize a strong heart, and the everburning flame of her will.
