keys.value:
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$|act4.Voices/mst1943|$I asked all the elves I could find, but I didn't
really learn anything useful...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1952|$A certain individual... You mean!?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHeh&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1953|$Callen the Scholar!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHeh&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1954|$A traveler who knows the area told me
there's a monument there with her name!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1955|$You're amazing, Astrid!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHeh&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1956|$Of course I am. It took you long enough to—
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1957|$I mean... Forget I said that!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1958|$What?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsunBlush&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1959|$Err, what I mean to say is... I did what I
could.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsunBlush&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1960|$You know, because of what you said before.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1961|$Oh, in the ruins? So you remember that.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$|act4.Voices/mst1944|$Maybe we'll just have to wait for more
information from other units.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsunBlush&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1962|$...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngryBlush&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1963|$Without your words... I might not have come
back to my senses.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsunBlush&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1964|$So... Thank you.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1965|$It wasn't just me—everyone helped.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1966|$Even if something had happened to me, I'm
sure the others would have done something.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$And you're strong, Astrid. I knew you were
going to come back.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1967|$You were relying on the person you were
supposed to be helping?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1968|$Maybe I rely on others too much. But it
worked out, didn't it?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSadSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1969|$Ha ha... The rest of your unit must have it
rough.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1970|$I hope I'm not causing them more trouble
than I realize...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHeh&$$|act4.Voices/mst1945|$There you are!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$Oh well, I just gotta do the things I can do
the best that I can do them!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHeh&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1971|$As a member of the Pandemonium Task
Force, I suppose I'll have to get used to it.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1972|$Wait, what did you just...?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1973|$I dissolved my unit. I know people thought I
was just a figurehead, anyway.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$I already have permission from the
Commander to join.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1974|$You dissolved your unit... How can you say
that so casually?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1975|$Oh no, now I've gone and told a rookie like
you before informing the Captain!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1976|$Let's go see Captain Ludmilla, Finn! I need
to tell her what I found out right away!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1977|$Okay... Hey!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1978|$You called me by my name!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$|act4.Voices/mst1946|$Astrid? What's the hurry?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1979|$W-What's wrong? I thought you liked all
that buddy-buddy nonsense!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1980|$I do! I was just surprised.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsunBlush&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1981|$You stopped calling me Lady Astrid long
ago...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1982|$Did I? I didn't even notice!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsunBlush&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1983|$Well... I don't mind it.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1984|$Huh?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1985|$Don't just stand there, get moving!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1986|$Okay! Let's go, Astrid!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$|act4.Voices/mst1947|$Huff, huff... I have, some information, for
you!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$|act4.Voices/mst1948|$What!?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1949|$There's a village called Nushelle, in the
Hymelia Plains.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1950|$It was formed 18 years ago for elves who
lost their homes in the Pandemonium.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHeh&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1951|$By a certain individual!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1335|$Hmm? What is Astrid—

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1344|$Why are you sziviik all so pig-headed!?
Honestly!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1345|$There she goes... I hope she doesn't get
into any more trouble...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1336|$What do you mean you can't say!?

$#SziGuard(Szi Guard)#$$&SziGuard&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1337|$Xahe'oyai means "corrupted" in our
tongue. That's all I can tell an outsider.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGritBlush&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1338|$Outsi—

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1339|$How many times do I have to say it, you're
the ones who asked us to come here!

$#SziGuard(Szi Guard)#$$&SziGuard&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1340|$That was the Chief's decision, not mine.
You're interrupting my work. Scram, human!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGritBlush&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1341|$Y-You... How dare...!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1342|$H-Hang on Astrid, the Captain told us not to
cause any—
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGritBlush&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1343|$You! Grr...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridXaheOyai;Finn.FinnSurprise;&$$@Right;;;Finn.Left;@$$|act3.Voices/mst1681|$Orgh...oaaaargh! You... You...!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridXaheOyai;Finn.FinnHurt&$$@Right;;;Finn.Left;@$$|act3.Voices/mst1690|$Oaaarggh!!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1776|$Make sure you brush up your skills before
next time, Crestbearer!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurtRed&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1777|$Darn it... I activated my crest, but he was
too quick!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1778|$Can you use it to track him!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubledRed&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1779|$Sorry, it's not all-powerful...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1780|$We can deal with Norza later. More
xahe'oyai are headed our way!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1781|$If they leave the ruins, they might attack
nearby settlements. We have to end it here!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1782|$Yes ma'am...
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1783|$Druke is just up ahead...!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1784|$Get ready. We'll put Druke and the others
to rest!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1785|$...Let's go!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Left@$$%0.5%$$|act3.Voices/mst1691|$Th-They're so strong! I didn't realize Astrid
was this powerful!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaXaheOyai&$$@Right@$$%0.5%$$|act3.Voices/mst1692|$Raaaaargh!!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1693|$Their blades are unwavering! They are
fighting at their ultimate potential, but...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1694|$They're using up their very life force to do
it!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1695|$We have to stop them somehow!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1696|$But they are too strong! We cannot afford to
hold back!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridXaheOyai&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1697|$I...worked...haaard! Harder...than
anyooone!!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridXaheOyai&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1698|$But I couldn't...make it...! I can't...reach
my...I can never...be my...!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridXaheOyai&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1699|$But you...with your...crest!! Father...he
recognized...yooooou!!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridXaheOyai&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1682|$You get...this power from nowhere...and
everyone...thinks you're so great!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1700|$Astrid...!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaXaheOyai&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1701|$I have to...stop him! Grandpa Gilgan...
H-He can't...kill Uncle Druke!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaXaheOyai&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1702|$So I...I have tooooo!!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaXaheOyai&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1703|$Then he'll...he'll smile agaaaain...!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1704|$To think you would go this far for him...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1705|$It's true I was able to enter the Knights
because of my crest.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1706|$But because I have this crest, I had to!
I'll take on any training, any mission!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$But Astrid... I can't do this alone!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1707|$I can fight because the Captain, and Rizette,
and Nagi, and Theo... Everyone is with me!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1708|$It's hard to swallow... But guts and hard
work aren't enough on their own!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1683|$Urgh!? Astrid, what're you...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1709|$That's right. A warrior's glory is not won
alone!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1710|$My food, my equipment, my shelter...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1711|$All of my achievements are made possible
by my brothers and sisters!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1712|$So!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1713|$So!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1714|$Please... Lend me your strength, Astrid!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1715|$Come home, Mysha!
$#;Finn;GaLuga;(Finn & Ga'Luga)#$$&FinnCommand;GaLuga.GaLugaAngry;&$$@Right;;;GaLuga.Left;@$$|act3.Voices/mst1716|$Let's face these battles together!!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad;Astrid.AstridHurt;&$$@Left;;;Astrid.Right;@$$|act3.Voices/mst1717|$Ugh...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHurt&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1718|$Where... Where am I?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaXaheOyai&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1684|$I could never beat him...but!
With this power...!!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise;Rizette.RizetteWorried;&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Rizette.Right;@$$|act3.Voices/mst1719|$They're awake!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1720|$Your wounds are only light, but you
probably shouldn't move around too much.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1721|$Those things that were stuck in the backs of
their necks must be Aeon Thorns.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1722|$They crumbled the moment we removed
them. Most unsettling...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1723|$I'm glad you're okay, Astrid!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1724|$Mysha, do you recognize me!?
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1725|$Ga'Luga...!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1726|$It's like I was engulfed in flames... But I
could still hear your voice so clearly.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSadBlush&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1727|$Can...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSadBlush&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1728|$Can I really...?
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaXaheOyai&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1685|$I can even...beat you...Ga'Luga!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1729|$What?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSadBlush&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1730|$Can I really...fight alongside you? Can
someone like me really...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1731|$Of course. Take it from someone who just
fought you, we'll be lucky to have you!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSadSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1732|$Really... I'm glad...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1733|$Astrid!?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1734|$They've both lost consciousness. They
should be okay, though.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1735|$I am supposed to be her closest friend... But
I had no idea what she was going through.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1736|$You acknowledged her feelings, though.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1737|$I just borrowed your words.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1738|$It would seem my scales are still soft...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSad&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1686|$Mysha!? Are you really pointing your blade
at me!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1739|$Ga'Luga...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1740|$We will have to carry these two.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1741|$Maybe we should go back to Urg Roa before
we go any further.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1742|$Hmm, perhaps—

$#DONTSHOWME(Male Voice)#$$|act3.Voices/mst1743|$It would seem my new Aeon Thorns work
quite nicely.
$#Theo;Ludmilla;(All)#$$&TheoAlarmed;Ludmilla.LudmillaSurprise;&$$@Left;;;Ludmilla;Right;@$$|act3.Voices/mst1744|$!?

$#Norza(Silver-haired Demon)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1745|$They utilized such power without going
beast... Such excellent test subjects.

$#Norza(Silver-haired Demon)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1746|$The thorns are too easy to remove before
they fully take hold, though.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1747|$Wh-Who're you!?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1748|$Y-You're a...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1687|$Lady Rizette, what you smelled... Do these
two have Aeon Thorns!?
$#Norza(Silver-haired Demon)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1749|$Yes. An Aeon Lord.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1750|$What!?
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1751|$Norza, the Pristine Corpseblade.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1752|$Another Aeon Lord!? Are you the one
behind all this!?
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1753|$Ossia made the originals.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$The ones I used on those two were new
prototypes made by my servants.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1754|$Are you the one who gave those thorns to
Druke!?

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1755|$Ah, Druke. My old foe, and the one
swordmaster worthy of the title.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1756|$In his old age, he could no longer compete
with me.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$He knew I was a demon, yet he still could
not resist the temptation of the thorns...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1688|$N-No!!
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1757|$His anguish was quite entertaining to watch.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$%0.5%$$|act3.Voices/mst1758|$You... So you're the cause of all of this!?

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Right@$$%0.5%$$|act3.Voices/mst1759|$Heavy, and keen. It could cleave me in two.
If you could hit me, that is.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1760|$He deflected my axe!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$@Left@$$%0.5%$$|act3.Voices/mst1761|$Norza!!
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1762|$Woah there!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1763|$So this is the new Crimson one. You've got
some fire in you, that's for sure.
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1764|$Too bad your flames are lukewarm to me!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurtRed&$$@Left@$$%0.5%$$|act3.Voices/mst1765|$Urghh!!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1766|$He deflected Sir Finn's strike with just the
tip of his blade!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1689|$We have no choice! Contain them!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1767|$What skill...!
$#DONTSHOWME(Distant Roar)#$$|act3.Voices/mst1768|$GROOOAAAARGH!!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1769|$That sound...!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1770|$It's the giant monster!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1771|$Druke... I suppose he was lured here by the
scent of battle.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1772|$I've completed my testing. There is nothing
left here for me to do.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1773|$You're running away!? Come here and fight
me!!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1774|$I shall leave cleanup to you. I hate to be the
bearer of bad news...

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$But the rest of these lab rats have fused
with their thorns. They can't turn back.
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1775|$This won't be our last meeting.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1674|$Astrid! Are you okay!?
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious;Finn.FinnCommand;&$$@Right;;;Finn.Left;@$$|act3.Voices/mst1675|$Mysha, it's Ga'Luga! Your brother!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridXaheOyai&$$!-1!$$|act3.Voices/mst1676|$Ugh...argh...?
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaXaheOyai&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1677|$Oaargh...oaaargh...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise;Rizette.RizetteSerious;&$$!-1!$$@Right;;;Rizette.Left;@$$|act3.Voices/mst1678|$Something isn't right...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1679|$The smell!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1680|$It's even stronger than it was with the
others!

keys.DescriptionKey: In a regal outfit befitting the occasion and the dignity of her new position, Astrid appears in the great hall, where the inauguration ceremony is held. She is the center of attention today—the one to be appointed Commander of the Red Dragon Knights. As she steps down the stairs, her movements stir a gentle breeze that plays with her long hair and coat before drifting away, carrying a flowery scent. Just a soft, faint breeze—and yet, it feels like the wind of change, ready to sweep through the country, or even the entire world.

keys.IntroText:
Astrid von Draclow—
I hereby appoint you
Commander of the Red Dragon Knights

keys.DescriptionKey: Just as expected, the dreaded question was asked during the interview: "Is there anyone special in your life?" "Duty first," she answered, but the journalist wouldn't drop the topic. Just as she finally budged and revealed what her type is, the door opened and a certain young man entered the room. "Astrid? I have the documents you asked for..." The sight of a flying teacup and spilled tea, undignified as it was, proved memorable, as later the journalist's article read, "The young Commander remains single, and yet—"

keys.DescriptionKey:
Everyone shamelessly throws their feelings at her—those who have high expectations, those who want her help, those who can't wait to see her fail. In order to withstand the pressure, to remain her resolute self, she puts on the cloak she inherited. However, even with its support, at times it still feels like the burden of responsibility is about to crush her—no matter how imposing she looks, in the end she's still a young girl. A girl that longed to be a hero who helps the weak, until she actually became one.
Sometimes even a hero needs a helping hand.

$#RedKnightA;RedKnightB(Red Dragon Knights)#$$&RedKnight;RedKnightB.RedKnight&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;RedKnightB.Right;@$Congratulations on your new posting, 
Commander Astrid!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSigh&$$@Right@$Mysha just went ahead and did it. I
was so shocked!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Left@$We were the only two people she told.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Left@$She told us to take care of things if you
came looking.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$You could have told me as well...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaBitterSmile&$$@Left@$Sorry Finn, but I was short on time.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Left@$But isn't it a good thing you didn't tell
him?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Left@$Finn reads like an open book. The robber's
identity would be written all over his face.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$You're right, if I'd known Mysha was the
culprit all along I'd probably have let it slip.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$So the robbery was just a ruse to keep me
here, so you could throw a party for me?
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Center@$It wasn't just to throw a party for you.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...
What?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Center@$We also wanted to keep you from
overexerting yourself again.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Center@$$%1%$You're in no condition to be charging
headfirst into battle now.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewTroubled&$$@Center@$I...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaDepressed&$$!-1!$$@Left@$But things got out of hand. I'm sorry...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSmile&$$@Right@$No, it's okay. You don't need to apologize.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSmile&$$@Right@$$%1%$Thanks to you and Finn, I managed to
remember something very important.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$And seeing as everyone has gone through
so much trouble—

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Well, leaders have a responsibility to
recognize and compensate diligent efforts.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewHeh&$$@Center@$As acting Commander, I hereby request
that everyone have fun tonight!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Hi, Astrid.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Wow, who'd have thought it would be this
hard to set up party decorations in secret?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSmile&$$@Left@$I take it the party's in full swing by now?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Yeah, Captain Ludmilla and Ga'Luga are
back as well, so there's even more cheer.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewNormal&$$@Left@$So they got everything sorted. I knew
they could do it.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I was just thinking...about why I'm here.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewGrit&$$@Center@$Why I'm in this position and not anyone
else.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewGrit&$$@Center@$What do you think, Finn?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Why you're here? Hmm, that's a tough
one. Well, if I were you—
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$I'd say it's because I chose to be here.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$You're here because you made that
decision. That's why you keep at it.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewNormal&$$@Center@$My decision...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHappy&$$@Left@$Great job, everyone!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSmile&$$@Center@$Yeah, I think you're right.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSmile&$$@Center@$I wonder if affirming my own decisions is
what it means to have faith in myself?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Thank you, Finn. You really do always
help me out.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Right@$I look forward to working with you,
Commander!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewHeh&$$@Left@$Yes, me too!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Well then, we'd better get back before Nagi 
starts making a scene.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Yeah, they're all waiting for you.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSmile&$$@Center@$Let's go.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid)#$I wonder if I'll finally have a nice dream
for once tonight—
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hang on... What's going on?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaWink&$$@Center@$We were all so busy that we never got to
celebrate your recent promotion.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewNormal&$$@Center@$So this is what you meant by everything's
ready.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewNormal&$$@Center@$Was the robbery all part of your plan as
well?
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaBitterSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Um, ahaha... I sort of improvised that one.
$#RedKnightA(Red Dragon Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$What's going on?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewClosedEyes&$$@Center@$An error in our documents only made it
appear as if it had been stolen.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSmile&$$@Center@$$%0.5%$I have returned the tiara to the original
storehouse to avoid any further confusion.

$#RedKnightA(Red Dragon Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Center@$So does this mean nothing was stolen in
the first place?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSmile&$$@Center@$$%1%$That is correct. So I want everyone to feel
at ease and continue on with your duties.
$#RedKnightB(Red Dragon Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So that's what happened.

$#RedKnightB(Red Dragon Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$I knew no petty cat burglar would sneak
into our barracks.

$#RedKnightA(Red Dragon Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$Well done, Lady Astrid! You solved it so
quickly.
$#RedKnightB(Red Dragon Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$That's why you're our acting Commander.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That is all for the announcements. Please
return to your duties.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Astrid, what just happened?

$#RedKnightB(Red Dragon Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$The acting Commander's called a meeting.
I think she's got something to say.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewHeh&$$@Center@$Now we'll know if it was an insider or an
outsider job. Let's go back to the scene.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Oh, right...
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$That's weird...
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$I'm sure I...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewGrit&$$@Right@$So it was you...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Mysha...!?
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaPanic&$$@Left@$!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaBitterSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Finn! Astrid! What are you doing here?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewGrit&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I figured if the culprit thought we'd found
the tiara, they'd go back to confirm it.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSurpriseBlush&$$@Left@$So you didn't actually find the tiara?

$#RedKnightA(Red Dragon Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$The acting Commander? What does she
want?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, I get it! That announcement just now
was just a bluff to flush the culprit out.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewClosedEyes&$$@Center@$I was hoping we wouldn't find anyone
here...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewClosedEyes&$$@Center@$If nobody came, that would mean that the
culprit was an outsider.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Right@$But you're here, Mee...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewGrit&$$@Right@$Mee, I have faith in you, so please tell me
why you did this.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Left@$No, it's okay.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Left@$Everything's all ready now.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewDoubt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ready...?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHappy&$$@Center@$Come with me, Tori. I'll explain
everything.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Okay... No matter what happens—

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Thank you, everyone, for taking the time
to gather here.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewShouting&$$@Center@$I have faith in you!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewNormal&$$@Center@$I have an announcement to make
regarding the recent case of robbery.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewNormal&$$@Center@$We managed to recover the stolen tiara
while we were investigating.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewTroubled&$$@Center@$No, I just...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSad&$$@Center@$I'm doing my best—
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewShouting&$$@Center@$Haaaaa!!!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaShouting&$$@Center@$Yaaaagh!!!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Huff, let's leave it at that for now. Thanks
for joining me, Mee.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHappy&$$@Left@$How good is it to get away from all those
documents and get your body moving?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It does feel good. I feel refreshed...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaConfusedBlush&$$@Center@$Something on your mind?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewTroubled&$$@Center@$You always see right through me, don't
you, Mee?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewTroubled&$$@Center@$I've actually been having these dreams
lately.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewTroubled&$$@Center@$Father...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaConsidering&$$@Center@$Dreams?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSad&$$@Center@$More like nightmares. They're ominous
and foreboding...

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaDepressed&$$@Left@$So your father's been visiting you in
your dreams...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewTroubled&$$@Right@$They're so bizarre. I'll wake up and still
feel jittery and uneasy...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewTroubled&$$@Right@$What if it's a premonition?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewTroubled&$$@Right@$What if I can't restructure the Red Dragon
Knights and it all falls apart?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSad&$$@Right@$It's not all just in my head either...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSad&$$@Right@$Some of the knights really don't want to
accept me as acting Commander...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I need to show that I'm capable through
military accomplishments.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewGrit&$$@Center@$So I should be up there on the front lines
leading the Red Dragon Knights...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Center@$Will you be able to uphold the
thousand-year history of the knights?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewShouting&$$@Center@$Yes, overall command and fieldwork surely
go hand in hand...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewShouting&$$@Center@$I just have to work harder...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaPout&$$@Left@$Tori—!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewHurt&$$@Center@$Ouch!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSurprised&$$@Right@$Y-You don't need to hit me!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaPout&$$@Left@$If you were in your right mind, you would
have easily dodged that.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewHurt&$$@Right@$Well... That's true... But it's not fair to
catch me off guard!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaWinkHappy&$$@Left@$"Never fall behind!" Heh, don't you know
the first rule of the warrior's code?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewShouting&$$@Right@$Grr, Mee! I'll show you the warrior's code!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHeh&$$@Left@$You wanna go again? Great!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewShouting&$$@Center@$Well, I won't know unless I try...

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You know, Tori—
You don't have to do it all on your own.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Center@$All you need right now—
is a little faith.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewDoubt&$$@Center@$Faith?
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHeh&$$@Left@$Hehe, there's the opening!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewShouting&$$@Right@$...! You caught me off guard again! Grr...!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaLaugh&$$@Left@$Come at me, Tori! No holds barred!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewNormal&$$@Center@$Phew, we trained a lot longer than I
planned to.
$#RedKnight(Red Dragon Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Center@$Excuse me, Commander!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewGrit&$$@Center@$!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewGrit&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Is it another request for aid? Tell me the
location and any other details—

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherAngry&$$@Center@$I already know. You don't have what it
takes.
$#RedKnight(Red Dragon Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$No, it's not a request for aid.
$#RedKnight(Red Dragon Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$Um...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Well, what is it? Hurry up and tell me.
$#RedKnight(Red Dragon Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Center@$Y-Yes, Ma'am!

$#RedKnight(Red Dragon Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Center@$Something has been stolen...from the
barracks.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewSurprised&$$@Center@$What did you say...?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewHurt&$$@Center@$...!?

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherAngry&$$@Center@$The fall of the Red Dragon Knights is
imminent, and it will be by your hand.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherAngry&$$@Center@$The knights don't believe in you. They are
going to leave you—

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherAngry&$$@Center@$You brought the Red Dragon Knights to ruin.
You know this, right?

For family, for honor, for Rigland.
For the fate of the world, she raises her blade.

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Your mother led battalions, Tori?"
"I heard that she fought by my father's side in the last Pandemonium."
"According to the records, they were married soon after it finished. Once you were born it seems she lead a squad against the remaining demons, but went missing. The records are short on details."
"Perhaps there was something they could not write?"
"Have you asked your father?"
"No, and I shan't. When he is ready, he will tell me."
"As you wish."

keys.value: Reward for reaching milestone:

keys.DescriptionKey:
Thank you for playing Evertale.

Due to problems in the latest Evertale update process, we had to go through some periods of unplanned maintenance.

During maintenance, players who had command points available to use in the Colosseum event were unable to use them before the next scheduled refresh, which would put them at a disadvantage in the event.

To prevent any players being put at a disadvantage, we have extended the last command refresh period to 48 hours, instead of the usual 24. This will allow all players a fair chance to use their command points before they next refresh.

As an accompanying measure, we are extending the Colosseum event end time by 24 hours - From 3am UTC on Thursday 16th January, to 3am UTC on Friday 17th January.

In addition, all player accounts that existed when this issue arose will receive 500 Soul Stones as compensation.

Thank you for your understanding.

keys.value: $#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3891|$It's an aegis!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3900|$Once we break this aegis, our battle against
the Eternal will begin.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3901|$The Eternal is...strong. It is pure,
unadulterated power.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3902|$And that power should be even greater this
time than it was in my day.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3903|$Everyone... Make sure you are ready
before we proceed.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3904|$Thank you, Callen. Finn?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3905|$Can you do this?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3906|$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3907|$I can.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3908|$I've come all the way from Rossé for it!!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3909|$I'm glad to hear it. I... No.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3892|$Yes. One more powerful than those made
by the Aeon Lords.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3910|$We will do everything we can to assist you
so you can end this on your terms.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3911|$...Thank you!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3912|$Rizette, you must lead us into this battle.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3913|$I'll do it!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3914|$Alright... Let's go!!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3893|$But...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3894|$Yeah. I think I have enough power to break
it now.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3895|$I think so too. My friends, this is likely the
final door.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3896|$The final...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3897|$You mean...?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3898|$Beyond this door lies the throne upon
which the master of this tower...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3899|$The Eternal, Emperor of the Pandemonium,
is seated.

keys.value: $#Merdain(Merdain)#$$&MerdainGrit&$$@Left@$Nngh...!

$#Lucius(Lucius)#$$&LuciusDesperate&$$@Right@$A core... Merdain, you didn't!
You ate the rest of the fruit?!

$#Merdain(Merdain)#$$&MerdainSerious&$$@Left@$Ah...
I never knew.

$#Merdain(Merdain)#$$&MerdainSerious&$$@Left@$I never thought true wisdom...
Would feel this good.

$#Merdain(Merdain)#$$&MerdainSerious&$$@Left@$Bloodlines, land, titles—
hidebound customs of an ignorant past.

$#Merdain(Merdain)#$$&MerdainEvil&$$@Left@$It's the duty of the truly enlightened
to burn it all down and start anew!
$#Lucius(Lucius)#$$&LuciusDesperate&$$@Right@$Merdain!

$#Lucius(Lucius)#$$&LuciusAngry&$$@Right@$Spit it out, right now! Spit that fruit out
or I'll make you, I swear I will!
$#Lucius(Lucius)#$$&LuciusAngry&$$@Right@$Merda—?!
$#Merdain(Merdain)#$$&MerdainSerious&$$@Left@$I can see right through you.
$#Lucius(Lucius)#$$&LuciusHurt&$$@Right@$Nn...aah!
$#Lucius(Lucius)#$$&LuciusHurt&$$@Right@$Huff...huff...

$#Lucius(Lucius)#$$&LuciusHurt&$$@Right@$(He blocked my blade bare-handed...
And hit me from behind!)

$#Lucius(Lucius)#$$&LuciusHurt&$$@Right@$(It's like he knew...what I would do...
Nngh...)

$#Merdain(Merdain)#$$&MerdainSerious&$$@Left@$I can see everything so clearly now. The
past, the present, even the future.

$#Merdain(Merdain)#$$&MerdainSerious&$$@Left@$I see now, Lucius...
I see.
$#Merdain(Merdain)#$$&MerdainSerious&$$@Left@$Lucius.
$#Merdain(Merdain)#$$&MerdainSerious&$$@Left@$My future...
$#Merdain(Merdain)#$$&MerdainSerious&$$@Left@$Has no place for you in it.

$#()#$Thou who would call thyself hero,
know this.

$#()#$The wisdom of all those who have come
before thee can be thine.

$#()#$But if thou seekest it, know also that thou
invitest thine own doom.

$#Lucius(Lucius)#$$&LuciusHurt&$$@Right@$(It's a razor-thin margin, but I'm winning!
Thank you, armor of my ancestors!)
$#()#$The great and terrible Fruit of Wisdom...

$#()#$In the soil of eternal Avalon grown, the
seed of conquest, watered with blood.

$#()#$Avalon
Beach
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$Nnh...

$#Lucius(Lucius)#$$&LuciusSurprised&$$@Right@$Where—
Where am I?
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$The shore of Avalon.

$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySmirk&$$@Left@$Good morning, Lucius. I do so enjoy these
little moments together.

$#Lucius(Lucius)#$$&LuciusSerious&$$@Right@$Le Fay...
Have you been looking after me?

$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySmirk&$$@Left@$I simply carried you here.

keys.DescriptionKey:
It is a terrible thing to grow up in war. But while Eveline was young, the demons seemed so far away. The type of thing only soldiers worried about. The power of His Radiance and the Holy Maiden kept the rest of them safe.

Mikaela, Eveline's longtime friend, always boasted that she would join the army when she grew up. Eveline wished she could share her courage. She longed to serve her god and her kingdom, but her strength was never in swordsmanship. It was in her piety, which was rivaled only by little Jeanne, and in her wit, which was rivaled by none.

It is a terrible thing to grow up in war. But while Eveline was young, the demons seemed so far away. The type of thing only soldiers worried about. The power of His Radiance and the Holy Maiden kept the rest of them safe.

Mikaela, Eveline's longtime friend, always boasted that she would join the army when she grew up. Eveline wished she could share her courage. keys.DescriptionKey:
When the demons finally swept through their village, she tried to help Jeanne through her loss. Mikaela had given strength to them both, but as important as she'd been to Eveline, to Jeanne, she was irreplaceable. And now she was gone.

In the end, the grief turned too much to bear. Eveline pledged herself as an acolyte to the church and gradually lost touch with her old friend. But she never forgot about her, and she never lost faith that someday, light would return to her life.

That faith would be rewarded a thousand times over in the years to come.

"Bad boy, Crescent! Bad! Bad!"

"Kyuu..."

"What'd the dragon do this time?"

"I hope you didn't want dinner tonight, Solas, because our eggs have vanished."

"What do you mean? Did they roll out of your basket again?"

"Of course not! I was just putting the pepper on my omelette when Crescent sneezed on it, or something. This black stuff came out of his mouth instead of fire --"

"Black stuff? Like tar?"

"Kyuu..."

"Hey, Luna. Can I talk to you about Crescent?"

"Okay...but why? I thought I finally got him housebroken."

"You really haven't, but that's not why I'm worried. You know that shadow stuff he can breathe when he's surprised or angry?"

"Yeah?"

"I just found a book about dragons at the library. I tried to look up Crescent's species, but there wasn't a single mention of dragons who could breathe shadow. Not anywhere."

"Really? That's unbelievable..."

"I know. Given where we found him, we have to consider that Crescent might not be a normal --"

"Why would a library keep such an incomplete tome of monsters on its shelves?! Such unprofessionalism! I'm going to lodge a complaint."

"Luna..."

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2976|$I knew I could count on you. Did you see

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2979|$He was exactly like I always imagined.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2980|$I worried I was being too meddlesome, but

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2981|$We begin tomorrow. Rest assured, I will do

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2971|$Well, here I am. I see you're prepared?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2973|$You look ready for action, Gilgan.

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2974|$I got moving the moment I read your letter.

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraSerious&$$@Center@$It's okay, I've trained harder than anyone.

$#Bahamut(???)#$$&BahamutGaki&$$@Center@$And you looked so cool while you were
doing it! Bravo, mister!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$Uh, oh—uh, thank you...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(What a strange girl... She didn't even
seem scared...)

$#Bahamut(???)#$$&BahamutLookaway&$$!-1!$$@Right@$But like, not giving a reward after getting 
rescued? That'd make me look bad.
$#Bahamut(???)#$$&BahamutHehSmile&$$@Right@$All right! I'll give you something special!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$No, that's really not necessary.

$#Bahamut(???)#$$&BahamutHehSmile&$$@Right@$Don't be shy! My reverse scale's super
rare, you know. You'd legit cry if—
$#Bahamut(???)#$$&BahamutWow&$$@Right@$Owwwwwwww!! Ow ow ow ow ow!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$A-Are you okay!? What are you doing!?

$#Bahamut(???)#$$&BahamutWow&$$@Right@$I thought maybe, just maybe I could peel
it off... Ow ow... N-Nope, too painful...

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraSerious&$$@Center@$First, I'll suppress my presence, sharpen
my senses—

$#Bahamut(???)#$$&BahamutHehSmile&$$@Right@$Dang... Sorry I couldn't get you the rare
item.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Well, I can tell you gave it your all. But
don't overdo it, okay?
$#Bahamut(???)#$$&BahamutDoya&$$@Right@$Okaaay...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$(She's definitely...a really strange girl.)

$#Bahamut(???)#$$&BahamutSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, right! Since you're super strong,
maybe you can help me... I actually have a
$#Bahamut(???)#$$&BahamutSurprised&$$@Center@$favor to ask!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$A favor?

$#Bahamut(???)#$$&BahamutPout&$$@Center@$Yeah sooo... plot twist—I'm actually being
held captive. Someone's got me locked up!

$#Bahamut(???)#$$&BahamutPout&$$@Center@$Even if you can't beat her, just shake her
up enough to make her rethink it!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Captive? You? It looks like you're moving
around pretty freely to me...
$#TavernpatronA(Tavern Patron A)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Center@$Hey, about the day of the festival...

$#Bahamut(???)#$$&BahamutMeltySweat&$$@Right@$W-Well... It's all a matter of perspective, I
guess—
$#Siegfried(Siegfried)#$$&SiegfriedSmileClosed&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hey, Bahamut?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(Bahamut... I've heard that name
somewhere before...)
$#Bahamut(Bahamut)#$$&BahamutWow&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Gulp!

$#Siegfried(Siegfried)#$$&SiegfriedSmileClosed&$$@Left@$So...you're out again... What kind of
trouble did you cause this time?

$#Bahamut(Bahamut)#$$&BahamutPout&$$!-1!$$@Center@$This time, I swear I'm totally innocent!
This person came through for me.
$#Siegfried(Siegfried)#$$&SiegfriedNormal&$$@Center@$Is that...true?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(Is she her guardian...? Kind of seems like
it...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Uh... Well, yeah. She was about to be
attacked by some thugs.

$#Siegfried(Siegfried)#$$&SiegfriedSmile&$$@Left@$I see, thank you. We are...in your debt. I
don't have anything on me right now, so

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraNormal&$$@Center@$(Hmm... A conversation about the festival?
A man and a woman... I'll get a bit closer.)
$#Siegfried(Siegfried)#$$&SiegfriedSmile&$$@Left@$let me repay you another time.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$No, really... That's not necessary...

$#Siegfried(Siegfried)#$$&SiegfriedNormal&$$@Left@$I appreciate it. Well then... Let's go,
Bahamut.

$#Bahamut(Bahamut)#$$&BahamutPout&$$@Right@$Ugh... All right.
Boohoo, poor me...
$#Siegfried(Siegfried)#$$&SiegfriedComicalSerious&$$@Left@$Come on... Now!
$#Bahamut(Bahamut)#$$&BahamutWow&$$@Right@$S-Somebody save me... Boohoohoo...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$She's been dragged away...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(If what she said about being a captive is
true, then is she the one imprisoning her?)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(She didn't seem like it when we talked,
but if she's some human trafficker...)
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Center@$Finn, what's the matter?
$#TavernpatronB(Tavern Patron B)#$$&NatalieMobNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What about the festival day?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Elmina, Cera—what happened to you two?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(It looks like Cera is holding on tightly to
Elmina...)

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$This goody two-shoes has put a leash on
me. I wanted to drink another barrel.

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraAngry&$$@Right@$That's not a proper unit of measurement!
So Finn, what happened to you?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Well, actually...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Center@$I see... A captive girl, huh. If that's true,
we can't just ignore it.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$She didn't seem like a bad person...
But I can't say for sure.
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraNormal&$$@Center@$They disappeared into the forest, right?

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraNormal&$$@Center@$We were going to have to expand our
investigation to outside the town limits,
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraNormal&$$@Center@$either way.

$#TavernpatronA(Tavern Patron A)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$It's not that anything's wrong... Just, well...
Sorry, one more drink—aahh!
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Center@$Then let's try following those two.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Yeah, if we go now, we might still be able
to track them!
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraSerious&$$@Right@$Right, let's go—

$#TavernpatronB(Tavern Patron B)#$$&NatalieMobNormal&$$@Right@$Hey, you're drinking way too much!
Are you okay?

$#TavernpatronA(Tavern Patron A)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$Haha, I'm fine, really! Uh... So...
For the festival—would you be with me?
$#TavernpatronB(Tavern Patron B)#$$&NatalieMobNormal&$$@Right@$Be with you...?
$#TavernpatronA(Tavern Patron A)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$Yeah, I mean, in other words...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Center@$That's right! This is that "perfect place!"
Aahh, so good!!

$#TavernpatronB(Tavern Patron B)#$$&NatalieMobNormal&$$@Right@$You want me to be your festival partner,
right?

$#TavernpatronA(Tavern Patron A)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$Yeah... I want you by my side during the
fireworks!

$#TavernpatronB(Tavern Patron B)#$$&NatalieMobNormal&$$@Right@$Hmm... So that's why you've been looking
at me like that, huh?

$#TavernpatronA(Tavern Patron A)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$N-No, not exactly... I mean, we've known
each other a long time. I figured it's time
$#TavernpatronA(Tavern Patron A)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$to be clear...
$#TavernpatronB(Tavern Patron B)#$$&NatalieMobNormal&$$@Right@$Hmm, maybe next year.
$#TavernpatronA(Tavern Patron A)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$Wh-What!? W-Wait, why!?

$#TavernpatronB(Tavern Patron B)#$$&NatalieMobNormal&$$@Right@$Because I don't see you that way...
Anyway, you're paying for this!

$#TavernpatronA(Tavern Patron A)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$H-Hey... Wait!
—No way...

$#Tavernowner(Tavern owner)#$Haha, you got turned down pretty hard,
buddy. Oh well, plenty of fish in the sea.

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You just wanted a drink, didn't you?
Honestly...

$#TavernpatronA(Tavern Patron A)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$This was a once-in-a-lifetime shot...
Whatever... Getting totally wasted tonight!

$#Tavernowner(Tavern owner)#$That was basically a confession, even
though the festival's two days away.

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$("Partner," "confession"—what's the
connection with the festival...?)

$#woman(Warm-Hearted Woman)#$$&DominiqueMobSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hey there, cutie. Did you fall for that guy
or something?
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraHuh&$$@Right@$Uh, no, that's not it...

$#woman(Warm-Hearted Woman)#$$&DominiqueMobSmile&$$@Left@$Sure looked like it—the way you were
watching. If you move in now while he's
$#woman(Warm-Hearted Woman)#$$&DominiqueMobSmile&$$@Left@$heartbroken, you might have a shot～
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraPoutClose&$$@Right@$No, that's really not it—

$#woman(Warm-Hearted Woman)#$$&DominiqueMobSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oops, sorry! Well, it sounds like you've
already got someone in your heart.
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraEmbarrassed&$$@Center@$Someone in my—cough cough!

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraPoutClose&$$@Right@$All right then. I'll take care of the work
myself.
$#woman(Warm-Hearted Woman)#$$&DominiqueMobSmile&$$@Center@$Sorry, sorry! Just messin' with ya.
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraBlushAngry&$$@Center@$(She caught me off guard with that one...)

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraBlushAngry&$$@Center@$(I'll give up on covert intel gathering. Let's
switch to chatting with the locals...)
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraPoutClose&$$@Center@$(Switch gears, switch gears...)
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Phew...

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraNormal&$$@Right@$This is my first time in this town, and I
was wondering—what's this whole
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraNormal&$$@Right@$confession at the festival about?

$#woman(Warm-Hearted Woman)#$$&DominiqueMobSmile&$$@Left@$Ah, it's a tradition here. When the
fireworks go off, people confess things
$#woman(Warm-Hearted Woman)#$$&DominiqueMobSmile&$$@Left@$they can't usually say to their partner.

$#woman(Warm-Hearted Woman)#$$&DominiqueMobSmile&$$@Left@$It's usually a confession of love, but sometimes
people just say things they normally can't.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Left@$Hey, hey, Cera—come on, it's a tavern!
Booze it up! Ain't that right, folks?

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraNormal&$$@Right@$So the festival day is special—separate
from everyday life.

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraNormal&$$@Right@$That's why people can say what they
usually can't.

$#woman(Warm-Hearted Woman)#$$&DominiqueMobSmile&$$@Left@$You make it sound very complicated,
but...yeah, something like that.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Center@$Sounds very festival-y.
Confessing to a partner, huh.
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraEmbarrassed&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Elmina, when did you get here!?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hey now, honors student! You should at
least notice when someone's around.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Left@$You never know where the enemy might be.
Stay alert at all times!
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraSerious&$$@Right@$Y-Yes... I'm sorry...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hahaha, you're too serious.
I'm just messing with you.

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraSerious&$$@Center@$No, you're right, Elmina. If this was
enemy territory, I'd already be—

$#Drunkardsinthetavern(Drunkards in the Tavern)#$$!-1!$Yeah, that's right! This is the prestigious
Aspheld tavern!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Center@$In that case, I'd come rescue you. So don't
worry～

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraSerious&$$@Center@$Truly admirable, Elmina... To say it so
confidently!

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraSerious&$$@Center@$(You couldn't say something like that
without full confidence in your skills—
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraSerious&$$@Center@$Elmina really is incredible!)

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Center@$Well, I am the great Elmina, the strongest
mercenary. Hahahaha～♪
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Ahh... I feel great～♪
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraHuh&$$@Right@$Huh...?

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraHuh&$$@Right@$(The scent of alcohol from Elmina...
It's even stronger now...)
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraSurprised&$$@Right@$Wait... Don't tell me that empty barrel—!?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Haha～ That's right, Cera. Wanna be my
partner?
$#Drunkardsinthetavern(Drunkards in the Tavern)#$Once you drink the local Aspheld brew—
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraEmbarrassed&$$@Center@$Huh!? Th-That's... uh—

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Center@$My festival day partner! Sounds fun,
right?
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraSigh&$$@Center@$O-Oh, the festival day partner...

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraBlush&$$@Center@$(Wh-Why am I disappointed? Elmina is my
superior, I'm not looking for anything
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraBlush&$$@Center@$more than that...)

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraBlush&$$@Center@$(But... Since there's a tradition of confessing
on the festival day...)
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraBlushAngry&$$@Center@$Wait, no—!

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraBlushAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Elmina and I are just superior and
subordinate! And you are... To me...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSurprise&$$@Left@$What??
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraBlush&$$@Right@$No, it's nothing. Really...
$#Drunkardsinthetavern(Drunkards in the Tavern)#$We're all family! Hahaha!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$By the way—you, lady over there, what're
you staring at～?
$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraHuh&$$@Center@$(Since when...?)
$#Siegfried(???)#$$&SiegfriedNormal&$$@Center@$Oops, sorry. I didn't mean anything by it.

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraSurprised&$$@Center@$(Who is she... She looks ordinary, but
every move she makes feels powerful...)

$#Cera(Cera)#$$&CeraSurprised&$$@Center@$(She was in the corner this whole time
and I didn't notice... What was I doing!?)

$#Gossipingpatrons(Gossiping Patrons)#$$!-1!$Ma'am, you don't wanna mess with that
one.
$#Gossipingpatrons(Gossiping Patrons)#$She lives on the outskirts... Real shady.

$#Gossipingpatrons(Gossiping Patrons)#$She looks nice, but her drinking habits are
nasty—everyone knows it around here.

$#Siegfried(???)#$$&SiegfriedNormal&$$@Center@$Oh, hey... Badmouthing me right to my face,
huh?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Center@$Hmph. Pretty flowers have thorns, as they
say... Is that your tongue?

keys.DescriptionKey:
We would like to announce some changes to existing characters that have been made in the latest update.

General Skill Adjustments:

-The passive skill "Crisis Armor" now activates when Spirit is 1 or less. (Crescent, Maxima, Fornaxos)
-The passive skill "Verge Focus" is now "Crisis Focus", and no longer requires any other Fire allies to activate. (Fornaxos, Antares)
-The active skill "Crisis Avenger" can now be used when Spirit is 1 or less, the TU cost is reduced to 130. The unconditional damage is now 250%. (Antares, Maxima)

Adjustments to SSR Characters:

Maxima:
-Maxima's active skill "Burn Command" can now give turn to non-burning allies, the TU cost is reduced to 130.

Fornaxos:
-Fornaxos's active skill "Energy Charge" has its TU cost reduced to 50.
-Fornaxos's active skill "Tribute Charge" has its Spirit cost reduced to -1.
-Fornaxos's active skill "Crisis Flare" is changed to "Charge Flare".

Oumei:
-Oumei's active skill "Spirit Reset" no longer requires any other Earth allies or costs any spirit to activate.

Merdain:
-Merdain's active skill "Poison Frenzy" has its TU cost reduced to 100.
-Merdain's passive skill "Augment: Armor" no longer requires any other Dark allies to activate.

Lucius:
-Lucius's active skill "Over Drive" no longer requires any other Light allies to activate. The TU cost is reduced to 160.
-Lucius's passive skill "Spirit Armor" now activates when Spirit is 7 or more, and no longer requires any other Light allies to activate.
-Lucius's passive skill "Augment: Counter" no longer requires any other Light allies to activate.

Artimeia:
-Artimeia's active skill "Attack All" is changed to "Purify".
-Artimeia's passive skill "Shocking Entry" no longer requires an enemy on 150TU or more to activate.
-Artimeia has gained the passive skill "Spirit+ Entry".

Grenzor:
-Grenzor's passive skill "Spirit+ Entry" no longer require any other Water allies to activate.

Vonn:
-Vonn's active skill "Attack" is changed to "Poison".
-Vonn's active skill "Blood Nova" has its TU cost reduced to 130.
-Vonn's passive skill "Summon Entry" no longer requires any other Dark allies to activate.

Adjustments to SR Characters:

Antares:
-Antares's passive skill "Verge Heal Entry" is now "Crisis Heal Entry". There is no change in the effect.

Crescent:
-Crescent's active skill "Crisis Frenzy" can now be used when Spirit is 1 or less.

Baltruk:
-Baltruk's Speed is increased to 371.
-Baltruk's active skill "Attack All" is changed to "Purify".

Adjustments to R Characters:

Lucija:
-Lucija's active skill "Vengeance Strike" is changed to "Payback Strike".

Sherry:
-Sherry's active skill "Attack All" is changed to "Sleep".

We hope you continue to enjoy playing Evertale!

keys.value: $# ( )#$—Several days came and went.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hehehe, wishing you both a lifetime of
happiness. Thank you, everyone.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneHappy&$$@Center@$Well, farewell for now.
$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiNormal&$$@Center@$Yeah, see you!

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterNormal&$$@Left@$Leaving so soon, Jeanne? You could stay
a little longer.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSad&$$@Right@$Manchester! Yes, I'd feel stifled if I stayed
too long...

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterSad&$$@Left@$I'm sorry...about your sister. I wish there
had been another way...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$@Right@$It's all right...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$@Right@$Rather, I need to thank you for granting
my sister's wish.
$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I'm really sorry, Jeanne... Genuinely...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSad&$$@Center@$Oh no, p-please don't cry, Manchester.

$# ( )#$After the battle in the tower, I was
bedridden for days, apparently.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneCrying&$$@Center@$If you do that to me... If you do that...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneCrying&$$@Center@$I'm sorry, I just... I told myself I wouldn't
cry anymore—I've already cried so much.

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterSadSmile&$$@Center@$It's okay to cry, Jeanne. You don't always
have to be so strong.

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterSadSmile&$$@Center@$Embracing your weakness is what lets you
lend a hand—isn't that right, Saint?

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterSadSmile&$$@Center@$Not that you'd be happy to hear that from a
mere exorcist like me, but...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneCrying&$$@Center@$It means the world coming from you!
Thank you, Manchester!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneCrying&$$@Center@$I'm so glad I got to meet you. But I've lost
my power of purification, so our paths will
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneCrying&$$@Center@$have to diverge here—

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterSadSmile&$$@Center@$Of course, as expected. No need to be so
formal.
$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterShySweat&$$@Left@$So, what about her?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$@Center@$I stayed for too long—just lying there all
those days.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneNormal&$$@Right@$Basilisk? She seems to be hiding.
$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterAngry&$$@Left@$Oi, snake girl over there, come on out.

$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskSour&$$!-1!$$@Center@$How did you spot me!? And my name is not
"snake girl"!

$#Jajamaru(Jajamaru)#$$@Left@$"Snake girl"—not a bad name. She
doesn't live up to it though.
$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskShock&$$@Center@$Even "snake girl" is too good for me!?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$So Jajamaru is back. I'm glad.

$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskMeltHeh&$$@Left@$Well yeah, it gets pretty noisy with him
around, but... Oh, please take this!
$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterSweat&$$@Right@$A box of sweets? Where did you find this—

$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskMeltHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Heheh, I traded for it with a traveling
merchant on the road...
$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskMeltHeh&$$@Center@$The finest cookies in the region, he said.

$#VillageDoctor(Village Doctor)#$You saved this village, dear—we'd face
divine punishment for casting you out.

$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskSmile&$$@Center@$Jajamaru came back, thanks to you.
Please accept this as my thanks.

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterShySweat&$$@Center@$You're surprisingly gracious... For a wicked
wraith master.

$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskMeltHeh&$$@Center@$From now on, I'm going to become a wraith
master beloved by all! This is the first step!
$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskSweat&$$@Center@$And these are for—the villagers.
$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskSweat&$$@Center@$For the trouble I caused them...

$#Jajamaru(Jajamaru)#$$@Left@$Just go deliver it yourself then. What a

$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskSweat&$$@Center@$But they might throw rocks at me. I'm

$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskMeltHeh&$$@Center@$Okay, all of you line up over here.
$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskSour&$$@Center@$Ah, not that way. Maintain the queue!
$#Monster(Wraith B)#$$@Center@$UaAaAaAa OaAaAaAa...

$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskHeh&$$@Center@$Well done, my dear wraiths! You've
brought me so many human bodies—
$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskHeh&$$@Center@$so many vessels!

$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskMeltHeh&$$@Center@$As the one controlling all of these evil
spirits—I, Basilisk the Great, am incredible!

$#Jajamaru(Jajamaru)#$$@Left@$The wraiths are the ones doing
everything... What are you so smug about,

$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$There you are! You weren't at the house—
Lysia and I have been looking for you.
$#Jajamaru(Jajamaru)#$$@Left@$dumbass.
$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskSweat&$$@Center@$You have such a foul mouth... Ssss...
$#Jajamaru(Jajamaru)#$$@Left@$You say something, you little brat?

$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskSour&$$@Center@$At any rate, without my great negotiating
skills, we'd have had our souls stripped
$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskSour&$$@Center@$from our body already... Uuuu...

$#Jajamaru(Jajamaru)#$$@Left@$Tch... I can't stand being bossed around
by that broad...

$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskHeh&$$@Center@$That lady's power is for real! You saw it,
didn't you, Jajamaru!
$#Jajamaru(Jajamaru)#$$@Left@$... ... ....

$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskCheeky&$$@Center@$Ooh, suddenly so quiet—Jajamaru thinks
so too, doesn't he!
$#Jajamaru(Jajamaru)#$$@Left@$Shut it, brat.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Roland! I'm sorry—I was looking for
something—

$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskHeh&$$@Center@$Goodness, what a vulgar tongue. At any
rate, once we give these vessels to that
$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskHeh&$$@Center@$lady, Jajamaru will be—
$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskMeltHeh&$$@Center@$We can hardly wait, right Jajamaru ♪

$#Jajamaru(Jajamaru)#$$@Left@$Just make sure you don't get played. Your
head's too empty for your own good.

$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskMelty&$$@Center@$And here you are worrying about me, foul
mouth and all—undercover sweetie pie!
$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskMelty&$$@Center@$Let me give you a big squeeze!

$#Jajamaru(Jajamaru)#$$@Left@$H-Hey! Don't go grabbing me out of
nowhere, you little brat! Let go, let gooo!

$#Basilisk(Basilisk)#$$&BasiliskMelty&$$@Center@$Oh, stop it. You know you love it!
Squeeeeze~!
$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiNormal&$$@Right@$Did you find it?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$@Left@$No, but I met someone along the way. If
it's not too much trouble, could you put
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$@Left@$her up at the village too?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSad&$$@Center@$(Could she have—vanished just like that?
So suddenly?)
$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Right@$Her...?

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterSmile&$$@Left@$I was looking for some ruins around
here—the Nemesis Ruins...

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterSmile&$$@Left@$It got dark, so I wanted somewhere to
stay.
$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Right@$The Nemesis—ah, those ruins.
$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$!
$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterNormal&$$@Center@$You know about the ruins?

$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Center@$They're close by, and I could guide you,
but... No. Too dangerous.

$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Center@$Lately, anyone who goes there doesn't come
back. That's what I hear.

$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Center@$Even entire treasure-hunting gangs have
gone missing—or at least that's the gossip
$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Center@$going around.

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterHmm&$$@Center@$Thinking too hard? Not my place to say,
but...
$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterHmm&$$@Center@$Missing, huh...

$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Center@$It's true! There are rumors that some kind
of monster has moved in—stay away!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneShocked&$$!-1!$$@Left@$If I may ask, has anyone from your village
disappeared, Roland?

$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiNormal&$$@Right@$No, we're all right. We've been keeping our
distance from the ruins.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$@Left@$That's a relief.

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterHmm&$$@Right@$A mystery monster... All the more
intriguing...

$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Right, you needed a place to stay. I'll help,
though it won't be a proper inn.

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterHappySmile&$$@Left@$I'd like to know more about the ruins,
actually.

$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Right@$I just told you to stay away. Who knows
what might be lurking out there,
$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Right@$especially at this hour.

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterSadSmile&$$@Center@$Try not to worry so much. You're getting a
wrinkle right between your eyes.

$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Right@$Just rest in the village for the night. You
too, Jeanne.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Manchester, let's go. I'll help you in the
morning.

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterSigh&$$@Center@$I suppose. At this hour, the place would be
crawling with wraiths anyway...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneNormal&$$@Center@$Wraiths?

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterShySweat&$$@Center@$Don't worry about it. Now show us the way
to the village.
$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiNormal&$$@Center@$Sure thing, this way.
$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Right@$The village seems to be in chaos...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneNormal&$$@Left@$You're right...

$#PanickedVillager(Panicked Villager)#$Roland, where have you been!? It's
terrible—it's Lysia!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprised&$$@Left@$Lysia...?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You're surprisingly kind, Manchester.
$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Right@$Lysia...!? What happened to Lysia!?

$#PanickedVillager(Panicked Villager)#$$!-1!$She said she was going to look for
someone... And wandered into the ruins.
$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterNormal&$$@Center@$The ruins—the Nemesis Ruins?

$#PanickedVillager(Panicked Villager)#$Yeah! She came back with a headache and
collapsed...

$#PanickedVillager(Panicked Villager)#$And then she popped right up like she was
possessed—
$#Monster(Lysia?)#$$!-1!$$@Center@$AaAaAa AhA HaHaHa...
$#PanickedVillager(Panicked Villager)#$Sh-She's here—it's Lysia!!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneScared&$$@Center@$(That's Lysia...!? What is that—)

$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiAngry&$$@Center@$That's Lysia!? You must be joking—no
normal person moves like that!!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneScared&$$@Center@$B-But it's her voice. It's Lysia's voice!

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterHehHappy&$$@Left@$Anyone would be, with someone about to
cry standing right in front of them.
$#Monster(Lysia?)#$$@Center@$AhAhAhAhAhAhAhAhAh HaH!!
$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiAngry&$$@Center@$S-Stop, Lysia!!
$#Monster(Lysia?)#$$@Center@$HaHaH!!
$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiAngry&$$@Center@$UGH...!!

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterAngry&$$@Center@$A normal person won't be able to stop her...
She's already possessed by a wraith.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprised&$$@Center@$Manchester—that weapon—you're not
going to use that on Lysia, are you!?
$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterAngry&$$@Center@$Sorry, but that's how it is.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneShouting&$$@Center@$I-I won't let you!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneShouting&$$@Center@$(God who dwells in heaven... Hear my
prayer—bless her with your power!)
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneScared&$$@Center@$(W-Why isn't it working!?)

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterSadSmile&$$@Left@$Whether I'm actually kind or not is beside
the point...
$#Monster(Wraith: Lysia)#$$@Center@$AaAaAaAaAa AaAaAaH!!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneHurt&$$@Center@$Don't come any closer, Lysia!!
$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterShouting&$$@Center@$Wretched soul, be still—Exorcism.
$#Monster(Wraith: Lysia)#$$@Center@$AaAaAa aaaH...!!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneScared&$$@Center@$(Oh no... Manchester's sword just pierced
Lysia's heart!?)

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneShocked&$$@Center@$(Hm, wait... Am I mistaken, or is the evil
presence draining out of Lysia?)

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneShocked&$$@Center@$(That black shadow that just flew out...
Was that the "wraith"?)
$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterHmm&$$@Center@$Tch, the slippery little—
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprised&$$@Center@$Manchester... Something black flew out...

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterSmile&$$@Center@$So you were able to see it too? Yeah, that's
basically the cause for all this.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprisedBlush&$$@Right@$Hm... Oh, w-was I about to cry?

$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiAngry&$$@Center@$Hey... What are you looking so smug
about!? You killed Lysia!!
$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterNormal&$$@Center@$Killed?

$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiAngry&$$@Center@$I just saw you stab her with that sword!!
You... You...!!
$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterSweat&$$@Center@$Okay okay, calm down. Just take a look.

$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiAngry&$$@Center@$Don't mock me, you murderer! I'll do the
same to you—
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprised&$$@Left@$Roland, stop! Look—look at Lysia!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprised&$$@Left@$Not a single drop of blood. Even though
you drove a sword through her...

$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Right@$Wh... Huh? H-How...? She's even
breathing... Then what did you—
$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Right@$What exactly did you just do to Lysia?

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterShySweat&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I pierced the wraith possessing her,
although I didn't get a clear shot. Probably

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterSadSmile&$$@Left@$That's how it looked. Or maybe it's just the
moonlight.
$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterShySweat&$$@Center@$ran back to the ruins.

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterHehHappy&$$@Center@$Anyway, that girl is fine. She won't act up
anymore.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneNormal&$$@Center@$Manchester... Just who are you...?

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterSigh&$$@Center@$It's a bit of a long story, but... Can't be
helped, I guess.

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterSmile&$$@Center@$A knight in the employ of the Western
Exorcist Church... Specializing in
$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterSmile&$$@Center@$anti-wraith combat.
$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterSmile&$$@Center@$Easier to just call me an exorcist knight.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$@Center@$Lysia seems to be sleeping. Her color's
returning, too. She should be fine.

$#Roland(Roland)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Center@$She really was possessed by a kind of evil
spirit, huh... Hard to believe.

$#Manchester(Manchester)#$$&ManchesterHmm&$$@Center@$But it's the truth—that girl's body was
taken over by a wraith.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Born in a neighboring kingdom, Basilisk was abandoned soon after birth and taken in by an orphanage. She could never fit in with the other children, and she spent her days all alone.
Her loneliness was only broken when she came across a snake, which she named "Jajamaru". He became her one and only family, irreplaceable and precious above all else.

BasiliskRegular01.name: Basilisk
BasiliskRegular01.title: Master of Wraiths
BasiliskRegular01.description:
Born in a neighboring kingdom, Basilisk was abandoned soon after birth and taken in by an orphanage. She could never fit in with the other children, and she spent her days all alone.
Her loneliness was only broken when she came across a snake, which she named "Jajamaru". He became her one and only family, irreplaceable and precious above all else.

keys.IntroText: Tremble, for I am the Master of Wraiths!

keys.DescriptionKey: Even after the kingdom fell and the orphanage was lost, Basilisk continued living together with Jajamaru in a cabin within a forest, surviving by hunting and foraging. But before too long, Jajamaru lost his life to illness. Overcome with grief, Basilisk chose to use her own body as a vessel to store Jajamaru's soul, allowing him to remain in this world as a wraith.

BasiliskRegular02.name: Basilisk
BasiliskRegular02.title: Master of Wraiths
BasiliskRegular02.description: Even after the kingdom fell and the orphanage was lost, Basilisk continued living together with Jajamaru in a cabin within a forest, surviving by hunting and foraging. But before too long, Jajamaru lost his life to illness. Overcome with grief, Basilisk chose to use her own body as a vessel to store Jajamaru's soul, allowing him to remain in this world as a wraith.

keys.DescriptionKey:
From then on, she lived quietly with Jajamaru in a forgotten ruin. Putting on a brave face, she called herself the "Master of Wraiths," but in the darkness of the caves, she spent most of her time terrified of intruders.

"Eek! I j-j-just felt a chill up my spine... Was that...a ghost?!"

Jajamaru: "It's just me, brat."

keys.DescriptionKey:
Good Luck Baltruk.
His village razed by an iron dragon, 
the hamlet he hid in destroyed by monsters, 
the merchants who rescued him prey for tiger hornets, 
the port town where he washed ashore raided by orcs
and the village that sheltered him crushed by the Aeon Legion. 

That, is good luck Baltruk! 
This most fortunate of men entered the trials of the knighthood, 
and why did he triumph? 
Because he is good luck Baltruk, plaything of lady luck!
-From a master minstrel's song

keys.DescriptionKey:
"I thought I was just unlucky, but I was wrong. In the height of the Pandemonium, I saw countless people suffering as I once did. Feeling the same rage and sorrow I once did.

I have certainly lived through calamity, but what's key is that I lived! Now I have the chance to reach out to those in pain, to lend them what power I have and inspire them to face their misfortunes without fear!"

In a war on life itself, every death is a victory. Whether claimed in glory or claimed in the dark, it matters not; only that another soul has been brought into the fold. Few have shepherded more souls to the Goddess than the dreaded Endless Phantoms.

Some say the shadowy assassins armor themselves in the bones of their victims. Whether that's true, none can say. They move through the night indistinguishable as shadow, and all who come close enough to see the make of their armor are already good as dead.

Every so often, a new undead convert catches the goddess's eye. An honored knight, a well-respected mage, a particularly clever thief; when these souls succumb to her black flame, she molds their bodies for a special purpose.

The Endless Phantoms bear no trace of their previous lives. They possess no will of their own and rarely speak. No one living knows why they were chosen for their grim task. Some believe they emerged, whole and monstrous, from the Endless Pyre itself. But they are wrong.

Orcanix's assassins were as monstrous in life as they are in undeath.

keys.LongKey:
平素よりエバーテイルをプレイいただきありがとうございます。
「美女と野獣-夢幻の双華」の召喚キャラ「アイギス」のパッシブスキル「悲しき獣」のスキルにつきまして、5月8日（金）12時35分（JST）に、スキルの説明文を仕様および実際の動作に合わせる形で修正いたしました。
修正前のテキストでは「場にいる全ての」という表現が使用されており、敵・味方問わずすべてのキャラクターが対象となるように読み取れる記載となっておりましたため、今回の修正により、「味方の場にいる全ての」と明記し、効果の対象が味方キャラクターのみであることを明確化いたしました。
本修正は、対象を味方キャラクターのみに限定することがいかなる場合においても下方修正には当たらないと判断したため実施いたしました。しかしその後、この変更により一部のプレイヤーの皆様にとって、キャラクターが当初のご期待に沿わない動作をする場合があることが判明いたしました。
テキストの変更につきましては5月9日（土）12時35分までに全プレイヤーのゲーム内に反映されました。そのため、当該時刻までにJサーバーにて「美女と野獣-夢幻の双華」ガチャに使用されたソウルストーンを返還いたしました。

このたびはご迷惑をおかけして大変申し訳ございません。
今後とも、エバーテイルをよろしくお願いいたします。
