$#Belle(Belle)#$$&BeautySmile&$$@Left@$Well, we've got plenty in stock, so it'll be
fine.
$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastShy&$$@Right@$Yeah... I... I don't have...friends...

$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastShy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$B-But... If we run out of souls to consume,
this dream will end...

$#Belle(Belle)#$$&BeautySmile&$$@Center@$It won't end. It's my dream—I know that
better than anyone.

$#Belle(Belle)#$$&BeautySmile&$$@Center@$I won't let it end. Ever. This night, this dream
where we're together, will go on forever.

$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastShy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I-I'm sorry... For making you do...such an
awful thing...

$#Belle(Belle)#$$&BeautySadSleep&$$@Left@$It's my dream, so it's only right that I'm
the one who does it, yeah?

$#Belle(Belle)#$$&BeautyPokerFace&$$@Left@$Besides, you couldn't do it anyway. Not
something like this.

$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastPainHeh&$$@Right@$O-Of course I can! It's to make you happy,
Belle!

$#Belle(Belle)#$$&BeautySmile&$$@Left@$Yeah, yeah, thanks. So—about the soul you
captured earlier... Seemed like it was full of
$#Belle(Belle)#$$&BeautySmile&$$@Left@$strong magic, don't you think?

$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastShy&$$@Right@$Y-Yeah. If we consume it, I think it'll add
dozens of nights... It must have belonged to

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$Is this the city that's imprisoning the
souls of girls?

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteShouting&$Power is surging from Kintaro's entire
body... I-It's amazing!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$Let's go meet the master. We might learn
something.
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteOpenSmile&$$@Left@$Agreed. Then can you guide us, Aigis?
$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastSuperSweat&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Um, yeah... Aigis will do her best...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$We've got it sorted out, Kintaro.
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroColdGrit&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Is it safe for me to go over there?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$Yes, please follow us!
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroColdShock&$$@Right@$W-Wait! Please don't leave me behind～!

$#Finn(Finn)#$We haven't introduced ourselves yet.
I'm Finn.
$#Finn(Finn)#$This is Kintaro, and this is Snow.
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroWinkHeh&$A pleasure to meet you!
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroWinkHeh&$$@Center@$$%0.6%$Sweet♡
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteNormal&$$@Left@$Aigis, why did you call out to us?

$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastShy&$$@Right@$Um... If there's someone in trouble, Aigis is
supposed to bring them to the castle...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$I see, so you were ordered to do that.

$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastShy&$$@Right@$The master...is really kind...
A good person... So don't worry...

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$(Whisper) Sir Knight, doesn't something
feel off?

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteNormal&$$@Left@$(Whisper) The part about "if there's
someone in trouble" bothers me...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$(Whisper) Yeah. This might be where the
souls are imprisoned. We need to be careful.

$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroSerious&$$@Left@$(Whisper) Also, from my assessment, this
child is not merely a servant, but likely of
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$@Left@$the slave class.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$(Whisper) True... She's looked scared this
whole time... She's likely treated terribly.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Huh...?
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Aigis, could you stop for a moment?

$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastSuperSweat&$$@Right@$Wh-What's wrong? Did Aigis...mess up
again?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$No, it's not that. Has anyone been doing
anything awful to you?
$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastSadSurprised&$$@Right@$A-Anything awful...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Like hurting you, or forcing you to do
something.

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteOpenSmile&$$@Right@$If that's the case, please don't push
yourself—you can rely on us.
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteOpenSmile&$$@Right@$We want to help you, Aigis.
$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastSadSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Y-You'll... Help... Me?

$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroWinkHeh&$$@Center@$Of course. I'll show anyone who hurts you
the full might of my power!

$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastSuperSweatPanic&$$@Center@$No... I don't think so... Aigis can't be
saved... Because I'm so ugly...
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroWinkHeh&$$@Center@$$%0.6%$Dream♡

$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastSuperSweatPanic&$$@Center@$You'll trick Aigis, everyone will laugh,
and it will be how it always is...
$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastSuperSweatPanic&$$@Center@$Because Aigis is ugly...
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSurprised&$$@Center@$That's not true! You're very cute, Aigis!
$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastSuperSweatPanic&$$@Center@$Liar...

$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroSweatHeh&$$!-1!$$@Right@$It's not a lie. You're cute! Far more than—
someone like me.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Left@$Yeah, you're really cute! Amazingly cute!
$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastExcited&$$!-1!$$@Center@$R-Really...? I am that cute...?

$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastHappy&$$@Center@$Oh don't flatter me so much! Hehe♪ But
Snow, you're cute too...though I'm the cutest.
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteEmbarrassed&$$@Center@$Uh... yes, thank you.

$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastHappy&$$@Center@$And then, like... In third place after Snow
would be you, Kinny.
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteHappy&$$@Center@$So cute...
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroColdGrit&$$@Center@$M-Me!?

$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroHappy&$$@Center@$$%0.6%$I got called cute twice today! What a
wonderful day this is!

$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastSadSmile&$$@Center@$And thank you, Finn, for telling cute Aigis
how you feel...

$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastSadSmile&$$@Center@$But I already have someone I've set my
heart on... So, um...
$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastShySmile&$$@Center@$S-Sorry! I can't return your feelings!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Huh...? Did I just get rejected?
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroWinkHeh&$$@Left@$Yes, you certainly did.

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Right@$(Whisper) Aigis... She's kind of an
interesting person, isn't she?

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteTroubled&$$@Right@$(Whisper) So maybe she hasn't been
treated that terribly?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$(Whisper) Maybe we were overthinking it...
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroColdShouting&$$@Center@$Yaaaahhh!!
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroHappy&$$@Right@$(Whisper) I'm cute!
$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastSadSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I'll go call the master... Wait here.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Yeah. Thanks, Aigis.
$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastSadSmile&$$@Center@$Yeah... I'm sorry too...
$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastSadSmile&$$@Center@$For tricking you.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Huh?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Snow White)#$The lights—!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$Something's wrong...
Get out of the room!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Snow White)#$S-Sir Knight... My strength is...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Kintaro)#$E-Everyone—ugh... Aah...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$Not cute!?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$Damn... My head... My bo-dy...

$#Belle(???)#$$&BeautySmile&$$@Center@$The sleeping gas should have cleared by
now. All right, let's go in.
$#Belle(???)#$$&BeautyHehSmile&$$@Center@$One, two...three bodies, huh. Not bad.

$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastShy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Y-Yeah... But they might've been good
people...

$#Belle(???)#$$&BeautySadSleep&$$@Left@$It's fine, it's fine. It's their fault for being
tricked, right?

$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastSmile&$$@Right@$Yeah... Now, I can stay with Belle for a
long, long time...
$#Belle(Belle)#$$&BeautySmile&$$@Left@$Right!?
$#Belle(Belle)#$$&BeautyHehSmile&$$@Left@$Thanks, Aigis! I love you!
$#Sound of Barrier Vanishing(Sound of Barrier Vanishing)#$$%0.7%$BOOM!!
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroWinkHeh&$$@Center@$Phew, barrier unlocking successful.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$That felt less like a technique and more
like brute force...
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSerious&$$@Left@$Yes, I'm sure of it.
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroSmile&$$@Left@$It's a traditional technique.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$A traditional technique...
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroWinkHeh&$$@Left@$It was pretty, wasn't it?
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteConfused&$$@Right@$Uh, y-yes! Your incantation definitely was!

$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroLookaway&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Thank you... But only the incantation?
It must be this outfit and hairstyle...

$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroLookaway&$$@Center@$If I could, I'd like to wear an outfit like
the one Lady Snow is wearing...

$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroLookaway&$$@Center@$But this is the traditional garb as a locksmith.
It is our custom and pride.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$So it's a dignified outfit.
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroLookaway&$$@Center@$Yes, but...

$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroLookaway&$$@Center@$To be honest, I'd rather be hugging a cute
plushie and wearing an adorable frilled

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$I can tell there's a barrier, and it looks like
we can't go any further.
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroLookaway&$$@Center@$skirt while I work...

$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroLookaway&$$@Center@$I'm so tired of scaring people with my
appearance...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$So that's what's going on.
It's okay, Kintaro.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$I was surprised at first, but once you get
used to it, it's not scary at all!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$If anything, I was moved by the passion
you have for your work!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$Don't say you hate it—keep walking your
path.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$I'm sure everyone will come to understand
that you're a kind and cute person!
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroSurprised&$$@Center@$Finn...
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroHappy&$$@Center@$No one's ever spoken to me so kindly before...

$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroHappy&$$@Center@$And calling me cute, I-I mean... Mmh...
I-I'll do my best!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$(It seems like a pretty powerful barrier, too...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Good! Looks like you're feeling better!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Wait, Snow? What's with that look?

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteHmm&$$@Left@$It's nothing... Sir Knight is kind to everyone,
after all...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Right@$(It seems like she's mad... But maybe I'm
just imagining it?)
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Both of you, hurry along now!
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteHmm&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Yes, we're coming! Sir Knight, you too!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Right@$Y-Yeah, you're right!
Let's free the trapped souls!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$At first glance, nothing seems out of the
ordinary...

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteTroubled&$$@Left@$If anything, everyone is wearing lovely
clothes and no one has a downcast face...

$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroNormal&$$@Right@$How strange that a city hidden behind
such a thick barrier is actually so nice...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Kintaro, can you really unlock something
like this?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Snow, are you sure this is where those
souls are being imprisoned?

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSerious&$$@Right@$Probably... No, I'm certain this is the place,
but...

$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hm? Sir Finn, Lady Snow... Look inside
that house—
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Inside the house?
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Why is it so dark in there? And—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$It's covered in dust and soot. No one could
live in conditions like this...

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSadNormal&$$@Left@$Could it be that it's only the streets that
look so dazzling?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$Could be. A show of outward glamour.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$A dream world is shaped by the will of
whoever's dreaming it...
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSadNormal&$$@Left@$Yes. A dream world is the world one desires.

$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroHeh&$$@Center@$Yes, leave it to me! Unlocking tightly sealed
walls around nightmares is my clan's trade.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$What did the master of this world desire,
to dream up something like this?

$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$In any case, we won't know unless we look
around a bit more.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Yeah. Let's walk through the city a little.
We might learn what's really going on.

$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroHappy&$$@Center@$Wow, it's a castle! It's like it came straight
out of a fairy tale!

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You really do love fairy tales, don't you,
Kintaro?

$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroHappy&$$@Left@$Oh yes. Because I've always wanted to be
a princess. I've imagined myself attending

$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroHappy&$$@Left@$a social ball in my head at least ten
thousand times!
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSurprised&$$@Right@$Ten thousand!? Amazing...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$A social ball, huh. I've been in a thing like
this in a past dream world...
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroSurprised&$$@Left@$Really!? I'm so jealous!!

$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroHeh&$$@Center@$I shall now show you this fine and delicate
technique, refined over many generations...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$(Come to think of it, that was the world
where Snow Black was my little sister...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$(It feels nostalgic...)
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$What is it, Snow?
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteAngry&$$@Center@$Just now, I clearly heard, "Help me."
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteAngry&$$@Center@$She's in this castle... Snow Black is here!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What!? Then could the souls of imprisoned
girls be here too...?
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteAngry&$$@Left@$Most likely.
$#Aigis(???)#$$&BeastShy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Y-You're interested in the castle...?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(A resident of this dream world...?)
$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$Here I go... Haaaah!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Who are you?

$#Aigis(???)#$$&BeastShock&$$@Center@$S-S-Sorry... Y-Yeah, of course. It's weird
to talk to you out of the blue.

$#Aigis(???)#$$&BeastShock&$$@Center@$Oh no, what to do... I messed up...
S-Sorry...
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteEmbarrassed&$$!-1!$$@Left@$No, it's fine. No need to apologize so much.
$#Aigis(???)#$$&BeastShy&$$@Right@$I...didn't mess up...?

$#Kintaro(Kintaro)#$$&KintaroColdShock&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Gasp... She's nervous because I'm here, isn't
it!? I'll hide for a moment!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$(...! She's hidden behind a corner and
peaking out to watch us...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Uh... Hey. It's okay. I'm sorry, I didn't
respond properly.

$#Aigis(???)#$$&BeastPainHeh&$$@Center@$No... It'd be weirder if you didn't find a
bizarre beast-girl suspicious...
$#Aigis(???)#$$&BeastPainHeh&$$@Center@$You're completely right, mister.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$W-What intensity...!

$#Aigis(???)#$$&BeastSuperSweat&$$@Center@$Ahh, because I'm weird... Ugh, I should
just eat potato sprouts and die...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$!-1!$$@Right@$That's not true! Try to calm down.

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteTroubled&$$@Left@$Yes—inhale slowly and exhale...
Do you feel calmer now?
$#Aigis(???)#$$&BeastBlush&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Maybe... I calmed down...
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteTroubled&$$@Left@$Good. So, who are you?
$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastShy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Aigis...

$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastShy&$$@Center@$Um... I'm the servant of this castle's master...
I was...told to invite you in...
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSurprised&$$@Center@$The master of the castle said that?
$#Aigis(Aigis)#$$&BeastShy&$$@Center@$Y-Yeah...
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What should we do, Sir Knight?

keys.DescriptionKey:
Belle was born in a small town. She was raised by her parents, but financial ruin tore the family apart—and Belle was left behind.
With nowhere else to go, she found herself among a group of urchins in the backstreets. Thanks to her natural dexterity and street smarts, it wasn't long before she had made a name for herself among the backstreet's shady residents.

keys.IntroText: Together forever... Even death can't do us part.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Aigis had no family either. As an infant, she was abandoned in the forest near a town. Though taken in by a local family who found her, she was treated as little more than labor—and in the end, she was cast aside once again.
Because of her distinct appearance and her timid nature, she remained alone for as long as she could remember.

Until she met Belle.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The fragile world the two lived in was unlike other dream worlds—it was unstable, doomed to collapse within a single day without fuel to keep it going.
That was why sacrificial victims were necessary.
But even if it meant offering up every single soul in existence, as long as the two of them could remain together for another day longer...that was all that mattered.

With nowhere else to go, she found herself among a group of urchins in the backstreets. Thanks to her natural dexterity and street smarts, it wasn't long before she had made a name for herself among the backstreet's shady residents.

keys.DescriptionKey:
This unit enters battle with Super Stealth, and an Instant Death Ward.

If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

Whenever this unit gets the turn, if this unit's Active Skills are not disabled, this unit can't have its Active Skills disabled until the end of its turn.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will be Purified, and heal for 50% of its max HP.

This unit has a 20% chance to grant a random enemy an Ambush Counter whenever this unit or another unit (ally or enemy) enters the battlefield from reinforcements. This chance is increased by 20% per Awakening, up to 100% chance if this unit has 4 Awakenings.

When a unit with an Ambush Counter takes a turn, and survives until after the end of the turn, 2 random units on their opposing team will be given the next turns by reducing their current TU, then the Ambush Counter is removed. These TU reductions may trigger before or after other effects that adjust the turn order. Ambush counters are not a status effect. Ambush counters cannot stack, cannot apply to boss units, and cannot be purified. An ambush counter is removed from a unit that is defeated or leaves the battlefield.

Add a number of Winged Shades to random places in ally reinforcements equal to the number of Awakenings this unit has plus 1, up to 5 max when fully awakened. Triggered when this unit enters battle (whether at the start of battle or from reinforcements), so long as this unit is not conjured and there are at least 5 non-conjured units in the ally team (including reinforcements). The number of Winged Shades added by this effect will be doubled if there are at least 10 non-conjured units in the ally team, up to 10 max when fully awakened.

If this unit is not conjured, this unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

Every Winged Shade conjured by this unit will have its Level, Limit Breaks, Awakenings, Boosts, Potential, Mastery, Weapon, and Accessory match this unit.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Triggered when this unit enters the battlefield from the allied reinforcements:
- Until the end of this unit's first turn while on the battlefield, this unit will become a Guardian.
- All allies are Purified (any negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed).
- All other allies that are at max HP have their TUs reduced to 0. This has no effect on allies that are either Fire element or have Burn Blast or Burn Drive type active skills. These extra turns may be interrupted by other effects that influence the turn order (e.g. stuns targeting the lowest TU target). Active skills that grant turns cannot be used by any affected units until after they have had the turn.

After each enemy turn, a random sleeping or poisoned ally will have their Sleep or Poison (including Lethal Poison) removed and be granted a ward for the effect removed (a Poison Ward or Sleep Ward).

Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack. While this unit is a Guardian, for any enemy attack that would hit 1 or 2 other allies, this unit has a 100% chance to redirect 1 hit to itself instead. This unit will not redirect skills that don't deal damage.

keys.DescriptionKey:
If there is a Mori at the very end of allied reinforcements, that Mori will be sacrificed, if that Mori's Element was:
- Water, Fire or Light, all non-fire enemies on the battlefield are granted the burn status effect. Then all enemies on the battlefield are granted the Sleep status effect for 100TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. These effects will overwrite other status effects on those units.
- Storm, Earth or Dark, all allies on the battlefield will have their current TU reduced by 50TU, and gain Super Stealth and a Stealth Shield.

Otherwise, if a Mori was not sacrificed, adds 3 Super Mori's to the very end of allied reinforcements (these will be Super Kuromoris and/or Super Shiromoris at random).

This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with burn will also become burned. Super Stealth will overwrite other Status effects. Super Stealthed units ignore enemy attacks that would damage more than 1 target. Super Stealth will be removed after ignoring 3 enemy attacks since applying, and can be overwritten by other status effects, except normal Stealth. Damage will not remove Super Stealth. Stealth Shields prevent the next non-stealth status effect a unit would gain while Stealthed from applying.

keys.DescriptionKey:
When the first Dragon of Water was slain by the Eternal, he gifted Kaidaros his power, and she used it well. It was not she who brought warfare and corruption to the sea. It was the humans, and their greed.

Their crafts started plain, barely anything more than hollow logs on the water. But as they grew ever more prideful and sailed ever further, they slew one another on her waters, hunted her ocean's bounty until entire species died. She could allow it no longer.

Her waves ripped mast from hull and dragged the villainous men to her depths. For generations, she pushed them back to their shores, until no one dared venture forth into the sea.

No one, that is, but the people who looked at her waters with awe, not avarice.

BlueSeaSerpent01.name: Kaidaros
BlueSeaSerpent01.title: Riptide Guardian
BlueSeaSerpent01.description:
When the first Dragon of Water was slain by the Eternal, he gifted Kaidaros his power, and she used it well. It was not she who brought warfare and corruption to the sea. It was the humans, and their greed.

Their crafts started plain, barely anything more than hollow logs on the water. But as they grew ever more prideful and sailed ever further, they slew one another on her waters, hunted her ocean's bounty until entire species died. She could allow it no longer.

Her waves ripped mast from hull and dragged the villainous men to her depths. For generations, she pushed them back to their shores, until no one dared venture forth into the sea.

No one, that is, but the people who looked at her waters with awe, not avarice.

keys.IntroText:
"Soldier or raider. Saintly or damned.
All the sea's fallen sink to her embrace."

keys.DescriptionKey:
On Erden's widest sea, there was an island laden with wild fruit, fresh water, and good soil. Kaidaros often surfaced there when she tired of the ocean's depths, and she cared for it deeply. When she saw a ship full of humans sailing toward its shores one day, she lashed out with all her fury, desperate to keep it safe from their bloodstained hands.

But these men were not like the others. As the waves rose around them, they offered up a song of reverence to her and her domain. She had no reason to trust them. Men had begged her for their lives before...but never with such sincerity. It shook her to her core.

She could not destroy any creature that came to her in peace.

BlueSeaSerpent02.name: Kaidaros
BlueSeaSerpent02.title: Riptide Guardian
BlueSeaSerpent02.description:

When she saw a ship full of humans sailing toward its shores one day, she lashed out with all her fury, desperate to keep it safe from their bloodstained hands.

But these men were not like the others. As the waves rose around them, they offered up a song of reverence to her and her domain. She had no reason to trust them. Men had begged her for their lives before...but never with such sincerity. It shook her to her core.

She could not destroy any creature that came to her in peace.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Through their ingenuity and patience, those first sailors would build beyond Kaidaros's island, until they built a city on the ocean itself. Kaidaros protected it as she did all her children: to the death.

She beat back many a Pandemonium from the city's walls, but even she could not best the will of a god. In the final days of an attack, she took a grave injury. At the king's behest, she retreated to the remotest reaches of the sea to rest and recover.

If she hadn't left them, perhaps they would have never fallen to an Aeon Lord's control.

But that was long, long ago, and thinking on it pains her too much.

$#Kaidaros(Kaidaros)#$$&KaidarosSerious&$$@Left@$Zuthua is under my protection. What
manner of calamity threatens her?
$#Castor(Castor)#$$&CastorSad&$$@Right@$...The Pandemonium has come.

$#Kaidaros(Kaidaros)#$$&KaidarosSerious&$$@Left@$The Pandemonium...
Then it is only natural you seek my power.

$#Castor(Castor)#$$&CastorSerious&$$@Right@$Several months ago, an Aeon Lord seeded
a plague throughout Zuthua.

$#Castor(Castor)#$$&CastorSerious&$$@Right@$The infected lose all sense of self, and
attack anyone who comes nearby.

$#Castor(Castor)#$$&CastorSerious&$$@Right@$It spread in mere days, and we have no
cure, or even any real defenses.

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Lady Kaidaros!
Please, lend us your power!
$#Castor(Castor)#$$&CastorSad&$$@Right@$Right now, Zuthua is... Hell on Erden.

$#Castor(Castor)#$$&CastorSerious&$$@Right@$The only hope we have is to kill the Aeon
Lord who spread the plague.

$#Kaidaros(Kaidaros)#$$&KaidarosSerious&$$@Left@$And it is for that purpose that you seek
my power.
$#Castor(Castor)#$$&CastorSerious&$$@Right@$We know where the Aeon Lord is.

$#Castor(Castor)#$$&CastorSerious&$$@Right@$The capital, where it all began. It's full
of infected citizens, but with your help...

$#Castor(Castor)#$$&CastorSerious&$$@Right@$Merciful Kaidaros, please. Help us save
our people, and our home.
$#Aquila(Aquila)#$$&AquilaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Lady Kaidaros, I—

$#Castor(Castor)#$$&CastorSurprised&$$!0!$$@Left@$Aquila?
What is it?

$#Aquila(Aquila)#$$&AquilaSerious&$$@Right@$I would...make my own entreaty,
if I may.

$#Kaidaros(Kaidaros)#$$&KaidarosSerious&$$@Left@$I will hear it.
Speak freely.

$#Kaidaros(Kaidaros)#$$&KaidarosClosedEyes&$$@Left@$(A mortal, is it...? How many years has it
been since a mortal called for me?)

$#Aquila(Aquila)#$$&AquilaSerious&$$@Right@$I know it is the height of disrespect for
mortals to ask favors of the gods.

$#Aquila(Aquila)#$$&AquilaSerious&$$@Right@$But in making our way here, we lost an
ally who was very dear to us all.

$#Aquila(Aquila)#$$&AquilaSad&$$@Right@$He gave his life so that we could reach
you and petition your aid.

$#Aquila(Aquila)#$$&AquilaSad&$$@Right@$If nothing else, I pray you acknowledge
his sincerity and devotion to us all.

$#Aquila(Aquila)#$$&AquilaSad&$$@Right@$And if that is not yet enough, I will offer
my own life's blood to you, as well.
$#Castor(Castor)#$$&CastorSurprised&$$!0!$$@Center@$Aquila!

$#Aquila(Aquila)#$$&AquilaSad&$$!0!$$@Right@$Lady Kaidaros! I beseech you,
hear King Castor's plea!
$#Kaidaros(Kaidaros)#$$&KaidarosSerious&$$@Left@$I have no use for your blood.
$#Aquila(Aquila)#$$&AquilaSurprised&$$@Right@$!

$#Kaidaros(Kaidaros)#$$&KaidarosSerious&$$@Left@$To stop the Pandemonium is my purpose.
I need no price for that.

$#Kaidaros(Kaidaros)#$$&KaidarosClosedEyes&$$@Left@$(Not since the battle with the Eternal,
when I suffered so deeply...)
$#Castor(Castor)#$$&CastorSerious&$$@Right@$Then...!

$#Kaidaros(Kaidaros)#$$&KaidarosSerious&$$@Left@$I will travel with you, and together we will
lay this Aeon Lord low.

$#Aquila(Aquila)#$$&AquilaSmile&$$@Right@$Great is your mercy,
Lady Kaidaros.

$#Kaidaros(Kaidaros)#$$&KaidarosClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Left@$It seems I have allowed grief to befall
Zuthua while I slept.

$#Kaidaros(Kaidaros)#$$&KaidarosSerious&$$@Left@$Their suffering, and your friend's death,
shall not be in vain.

$#Kaidaros(Kaidaros)#$$&KaidarosClosedEyes&$$@Left@$(And was left no choice but to reside in
this shrine and convalesce.)

$#Kaidaros(Kaidaros)#$$&KaidarosClosedEyes&$$@Left@$(This shrine, where I now serve as
the guardian of Zuthua.)

$#Kaidaros(Kaidaros)#$$&KaidarosClosedEyes&$$@Left@$(Mortals are such dear creatures. I
protect them from harm, and in return...)

$#Kaidaros(Kaidaros)#$$&KaidarosClosedEyes&$$@Left@$(They offer me gratititude. 'Tis far more
pleasant than battling the demon scourge.)

keys.DescriptionKey:
In the native Tuathan tongue, Kau Lana translates to 'born of the wind and waves.' One can easily see how these dragons earned such a name. Equally agile in the sky and the sea, the Kau Lana struck fear into the ancient Tuathan islanders, who rarely ventured out to sea despite their reliance on it for food.

Fortunately, not all Tuathans cowered before the dragons. According to legend, a chieftain by the name of Kaleiha ascended Tuatha's volcano and battled the largest Kau Lana until, at last, it bent to his will. Since then, the two races have lived in peace, working together as dragonriding pairs to nurture and protect their home.

Fortunately, not all Tuathans cowered before the dragons. According to legend, a chieftain by the name of Kaleiha ascended Tuatha's volcano and battled the largest Kau Lana until, at last, it bent to his will. Since then, the two races have lived in peace, working together as dragonriding pairs to nurture and protect their home.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Unfortunately, Tuatha's prosperity could not last forever. Eighteen years ago, its central volcano erupted after centuries of dormancy, burning the village to the ground. As a gesture of goodwill, Luther invited all the surviving villagers to join him in Rigland's capital. Naturally, he adopted the Kau Lana into the ranks of the Red Dragon Knights as well.

But the children of the wind and waves couldn't thrive so far from the sea. Year after year, their population dwindled, as the dragons rejected their new training and fled to the ruins of their island.

Some say those who sail near Tuatha these days can hear their echoing cries, mourning the home they lost.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$|act1.Voices/mst367|$This sentinel stone feels different from the
others...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act1.Voices/mst368|$Maybe this is the final trial? That means...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHeh&$$|act1.Voices/mst369|$We're nearly at the exit!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$|act1.Voices/mst370|$Just one hurdle left to clear!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Left@$Theo!?
$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaSmile&$$@Right@$I wouldn't be so sure about that...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$The Aeon Lord, Ossia!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Left@$Is this your doing as well?
$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaSmile&$$@Right@$Heh heh, what do you think?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$What do you want!?

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaSmile&$$@Right@$A ha ha! As a matter of fact, I'm done.
I'm finished with my experiment.

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaSmile&$$@Right@$So I'll let you get away.
You ought to consider yourselves lucky.

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaSmirk&$$@Right@$But then, my "creation" may not look so
kindly upon you for messing with its food...
$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaSmirk&$$@Right@$A ha ha, the rest is up to chance.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Hey! Get back here!
We're not through with you—
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Left@$Theo! Come on, wake up!
$#Minotaur(??????)#$$&Minotaur&$$!-1!$$@Center@$GROAAARGH!!!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Center@$A monster!
Stay away from Theo! Fight me instead!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoDamagedSick&$$@Left@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$He's still breathing!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$He's wounded, but if we get him 
out soon we should be able to save him.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$@Right@$It's okay, Theo. I'm here now...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$All the people and the animals here,
they're all just sleeping.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$They're still alive, just like Theo.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$I think we've managed to avoid
the worst-case scenario.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1086|$Ludmilla, the people of Erden must weather
this Pandemonium.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1087|$Further training of the Crestbearers is vital
to our survival.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1088|$The methods of achieving this may at times
seem cruel...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1089|$But it is the duty of the Knights to seek the
best outcome, no matter what the method.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1090|$Understood, sir.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1091|$Good. There is one more matter I wish to
discuss...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1079|$It is highly possible that Rizette's crest is
more likely to activate
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$when her brother's life is in danger.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1080|$She was likely able to activate her crest to
break through the aegis around her village

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$because she was trying to save him then
as well.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1081|$Are you telling me to put Theo in danger to
activate Rizette's crest?
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1082|$Ludmilla.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1083|$I-I apologize for my bluntness, but...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1084|$I have already checked with the doctors.
Theo is the picture of health.

Enrages all burning allies. This will overwrite the effects of other Enrage skills on those units. Enraged units have their Attack increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn.

Then 1 random ally and 1 random enemy are granted the Burn status effect and become infected with it.

Infection is not a status effect and cannot be prevented or purified, but the status effect spread by the infection may be. A unit cannot get a new infection until their existing one ends.

Whenever an enemy enters the battlefield from reinforcements, they have a 50% chance to be granted the Cursed Sleep status effect for 200TU. Then they have a 50% chance to be granted the Mega Poison status effect for 200TU.

Each time a Poisoned or Sleeping unit gets the turn, this unit will be healed for 30% of its max HP.

Whenever another non-conjured Ally on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source:
- this unit gains the Armor status effect, and is healed for 100% of max HP.
- all non-burning allies on the battlefield are granted Sleep Thorns.
- 2 random allies on the battlefield have their current TU reduced by 50TU.

When a unit with Sleep Thorns is dealt damage by an attack, that unit's Sleep Thorns will be consumed to immediately grant the Cursed Sleep status effect for 200TU to the attacker. Burn or attacks that grant Burn will remove Sleep Thorns and prevent Cursed Sleep from applying. Cursed Sleep will overwrite status effects other than Burn, cannot be overwritten by Poison, can be applied repeatedly to units that have already slept while on the battlefield, and will not end from damage caused by Dream Hunter type active skills.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Lightning Hare Nanami, Shinano Academy graduate and interim professor of combat. Vessel of the Goddess's Speed. 

That's how the other students know her, at least. To tell the truth, it weirds her out to think of herself as a professor. She'd always been a wild kid, right from the day they brought her to the school, and she can't say teaching high school girls how to beat each other up was her lifelong dream. But it hasn't been working out too badly...so far, at least. 

Everyone in the school knows her gift. With sword strikes so swift they're barely visible, there was never any hiding it. Some would say that puts her at a disadvantage. Nanami says anyone who wants to take her on is more than welcome to try.

Everyone in the school knows her gift. With sword strikes so swift they're barely visible, there was never any hiding it. Some would say that puts her at a disadvantage. Nanami says anyone who wants to take her on is more than welcome to try.

keys.DescriptionKey: Most of Nanami's students think her ears gave her away as a Vessel. And they're not totally wrong: a little girl with bunny ears will naturally draw more Church attention than her normal classmates. But even non-Vessels can gain an animal's ears or tail, if the Goddess chooses to bless them with it. No. Five-year-old Nanami saw a car hurtling towards a puppy in the road and dove out to save it. In a matter of seconds, she had not only reached the puppy and picked it up; she'd shot across the street, clear into the next neighborhood, too panicked to stop running. They found her downtown a day later, still holding the puppy. That was when the Church knew she was truly special.

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Hello, my Honnos!☆" is her chosen way to start a stream. 150,000 is her subscriber count. Getting flamed in the comments is her speciality, and her efficiency rate in putting out her own fires stands at an astonishing 0%...
Why does it always happen to her? Who knows. It's always a surprise, and it always makes her fall apart in an instant. And then it happens again, in no more than two days! It's just one of life's great mysteries.
She's a singer, she's a streamer, she's a legend—she's Honnoji!

keys.DescriptionKey: Honnoji was already a pretty popular singer and dancer when she debuted as a songwriter with "Dark Clown Smiles" (currently unavailable to the public), a work absolutely overflowing with the essence of youth. It wasn't received well, though—its cringeworthy lyrics and overall low quality earned Honnoji a barrage of criticism and a crushing blow to her self-esteem. However, her trademark casual charm was met with a warmer reception in a later release titled "Honnoji! Revolution," and little by little her subscriber count started to grow.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Growing up, Honnoji didn't go to school much—she was scared to talk to her classmates and not very good at studying, so she preferred to just stay in her room all day, every day.
And then, one day, she discovered Evertube—a place where everyone, introvert and extrovert alike, could express themselves however they liked. "Maybe this is the place for me," Honnoji thought, as she took her first hesitant steps into the world.

keys.DescriptionKey: "W-Well, say something, you fool!" Callen demands, puffing up her blushing cheeks. "Honestly, and here I spent so much time on dressing up—H-Hey, I am not being vain! And I did not do it for you, I did it for myself—" She flounders for a minute, before calming herself down. "Hmpf, forget it. Now, come here already!"

keys.IntroText:
"Ugh, what is taking you so long?
Come here this instant!"

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Hohoho, what is it? You turned awfully red all of a sudden. Has my outstanding beauty rendered you speechless?" Eager to get a reaction, Callen attempts to strike an alluring pose on the piano bench. However, her unathletic body struggles to keep up and she promptly loses her balance. 
"Eeeek! H-Hey! What are you gawking at? Help me up, you idiot!"

keys.DescriptionKey:
Burdened by the unforgivable crime of her youth, she never thought she had the right to be happy; even though everyone around her wished her well, she could never show herself the same courtesy. But at least in her dreams, whenever she falls asleep on her lab desk...
"You say you can make me happy? If so, let us be together until the end of time."

keys.DescriptionKey: Once, there was a girl known as a remarkable intellect even among the elven tribes. She was one of the very few chosen to work under the Celestial Lord in the laboratories of the Castle. Though arrogant, she had a strong sense of duty and righteousness, and swore to uphold her grand mission: to save the world.

CallenDragon01.name: Callen
CallenDragon01.title: Magical Dragon Girl
CallenDragon01.description: Once, there was a girl known as a remarkable intellect even among the elven tribes. She was one of the very few chosen to work under the Celestial Lord in the laboratories of the Castle. Though arrogant, she had a strong sense of duty and righteousness, and swore to uphold her grand mission: to save the world.

keys.IntroText:
My knowledge is yours, if you will use it
to save this blighted world.

keys.DescriptionKey: However, it didn't take long for her to realize that the laboratory's purpose wasn't what she had in mind. She sought to rescue the world from the evil that plagued it; her superiors, however, only desired greater power and greater profit. The doubt in her heart grew day by day, until the day of catastrophe arrived, and her fears were realized.

keys.DescriptionKey: She ran, to avoid being found out, but also to avoid meeting anyone. She couldn't bear to look anyone in the eye, with the guilt she felt gnawing away at her heart. She went to ground, and immersed herself once more in her forbidden research. And after hundreds of years alone, years of desperate experimentation and sacrifice, she may finally hold the answer.

keys.DescriptionKey: I always used to hear a voice. A gentle voice. So gentle, it seemed it might break.

keys.value: $#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$Hey, Olive. You love books too, right?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$leaving you frustrated as you turn the last
page and see there's nothing left.

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieShouting&$$@Center@$We can be good and patient and obedient,
and all it gets us is a stake and a bonfire!

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieShouting&$$@Center@$If we're going to die anyway, I'll die with the
blood of my mama's murderer on my hands!
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...I can't support this, Natalie.
$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieShouting&$$@Left@$And why not?!

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSerious&$$@Right@$If we kill, even to keep ourselves alive,
what kind of future do we have?

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Right@$Can we build a better world for anyone with
hands soaked in blood?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$......

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodAngry&$$@Center@$The more you hurt other people, the less
human you become. Just like the Church.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodAngry&$$@Center@$If we go down that road, we'll never be able
to look ourselves in the eye again.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Center@$Do you want to sacrifice your soul for one
moment of revenge, Natalie?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$When you're lonely, books can share lovely
poems or essays... but they can't hold you.

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieWorried&$$@Center@$...I'm just so... so tired of them taking
everything from us.

$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleSerious&$$@Center@$Calm yourselves, young ones. This
bickering benefits no one.
$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieWorried&$$@Center@$Grandmother...
$#Blaise(Blaise)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Center@$Granny... isn't there anything we can do?
$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hmm. Cyrus. What do your cards say?
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Let's find out together, hm?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$...unfortunately, all I see are executions
on the steps of the Cathedral.
$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleClosedEyes&$$@Left@$The story never changes, then. How dull.

$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleSerious&$$@Left@$...we will leave Lumains. If you wish to
fight, do so after that.
$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieShouting&$$@Right@$But—!
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSad&$$@Center@$Of course they can't...

$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleSerious&$$@Left@$I understand the pain you feel. All of us
know it, and all too well.

$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleSerious&$$@Left@$But letting our rage control us will only
lead us to our deaths.

$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleSerious&$$@Left@$Let us use that rage to protect our fellow
witches instead.

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieMildSurprise&$$@Right@$I... of course I want to protect everyone,
but...

$#Blaise(Blaise)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Left@$Natalie... c'mon. Let's take a deep breath.
We're all here with you. Okay?
$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieWorried&$$@Right@$...okay.

$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Olive, if we are to succeed, we will need
the treasure.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSerious&$$@Center@$Right. I'll head back to the Chapel of
Seraphine and secure it.
$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleSerious&$$@Center@$Please do.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Center@$(Treasure? Is there something hidden in
Mother's chapel?)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$I know. I wish I could get along more with
people. I really do.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$But people always end up leaving me... so
books are all I have.
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSad&$$@Center@$......
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Have you ever found a book you feel like you were meant to read?

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSerious&$$@Right@$...can't say I have. I've never really put
much faith in books.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$I've always felt like I would find it someday.
The book that would change my life.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSerious&$$@Right@$You know, you talk a lot more than I
expected.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSerious&$$@Center@$Hmph. Not especially. I just like them
better than people.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Left@$Well, I'm going back to the castle at dawn.
And we'll probably never meet again, right?

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSadSmile&$$@Right@$What? Don't tell me you've taken a liking
to this place.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$It's not like I want to stay. But if I suddenly
disappear, won't everyone get mad at you?

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Right@$Oh, please. It's not like anyone here likes
me anyway. I can take it.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Right@$Worry about your kingdom, not about me.
That's your job, right?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$...I am worried about it.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Left@$Cyrus's cards showed me the future. He said
Lumains will fall if I go back to the castle.
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSerious&$$@Right@$He did...?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanHappy&$$@Left@$But if I learn to use my power first, I can
go back and save the city instead!

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Right@$You're kidding, right? You can't just learn
dark magic in one night.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Center@$I get fed up with all their shouting, their
posturing. All the ways they use each other.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Right@$You can't even light a candle right now.
You think you can protect anyone?

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Right@$Trust me, you've got a long way to go
before—
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I did it...!
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodShouting&$$@Center@$...?!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Center@$I did it...! I lit the candle! Did you see that?!

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSerious&$$@Center@$No way... I knew you had a lot of power,
but...
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodShouting&$$@Center@$To think your will was this strong, too...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh, come on. All I did was light a candle.
Is it really that impressive?

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Right@$Learning the control for that usually takes
an average witch a few months, so yes.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Left@$Months?!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...I think I know what you mean.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSerious&$$@Right@$Magic takes magic power to fuel it, but it
also takes willpower to control.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSerious&$$@Right@$Lighting only the very tip of a candle wick
takes pretty strong focus.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSad&$$@Right@$...and you've already mastered it, on your
first night of casting.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Left@$That's... a good thing, right?
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodAngry&$$@Right@$No. No, it's not.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSerious&$$@Right@$Listen. If you want to lead a happy life,
forget about magic, here and now.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Left@$But why...?

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Right@$Do you know why we consider our own art
dark magic?

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Right@$It's not all fun and games. It's a double-
edged sword, and it always has a cost.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$What do you mean?

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSerious&$$@Right@$Books don't do that. If you want them to
shut up, you can just close their cover.
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Center@$...?!
Horns... and a dragon wing?

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSad&$$@Center@$If you use too much magic, it twists you
into a monster like this.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveAngry&$$@Center@$After that, you're finished. Forget the
Church. Even other witches will fear you.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveAngry&$$@Center@$If you don't want to spend your life under a
hood, walk away now and don't look back.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSad&$$@Right@$I was born here. This is my life, like it or no.
But you have a choice. A home, and a dad.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveAngry&$$@Right@$Are you prepared to throw that all away,
just to stain your hands with witchcraft?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Left@$I...
$#Blaise(Blaise)#$$&BlaiseShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hey, Olive! Wheeere are yoooouuu?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$I've felt the same way, at times.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Center@$I'm right here, stop shouting. What do
you want?
$#Blaise(Blaise)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Look at this...

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodAngry&$$@Right@$Huh? What is this... a declaration from the
royal family?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$From the royal family? Let me see!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Center@$This...!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Witch)#$"In the name of the King and the Maiden,
a Witch Hunt shall begin anew."
$#DONOTSHOWME(Witch)#$These fliers are posted all over town.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Witch)#$Are we going to see a return to the days
of Seraphine?!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$(Why, all of a sudden...)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$(Father's never supported the witch hunts.
He found them cruel, and tyrannical...)
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Right@$Really?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$(And yet... why? Is this Augustin's doing?
Those two hate each other!)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$(There's nothing here about me at all. Have
they not even noticed I'm missing?)

$#Blaise(Blaise)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Center@$Another big witch hunt, huh... if we're
running, we'd better leave now.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$No, that's just what they want. They want
to flush us out of hiding with these notices.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$We can assume the Inquisitors are already
watching the streets like hawks.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Center@$If only we'd gotten you back to the palace
before this happened...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$Olive...

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieAngry&$$@Left@$I hate this... I hate it! I'm so tired of always
running and hiding!
$#Blaise(Blaise)#$$&BlaiseSurprised&$$@Right@$Natalie? Where did you get that axe?!
$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieAngry&$$@Left@$If they want a fight, I say we give them one!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$But... even books aren't quite that simple.
At least, I don't think so.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$?!

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieShouting&$$@Center@$Why do we fear the Inquisitors? We have
our magic! And we have weapons too!

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieShouting&$$@Center@$We haven't seen the sun or breathed fresh
air in years. Just because we're witches!
$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieShouting&$$@Center@$This isn't life! This is imprisonment!

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Easy there. You know the people up there
outnumber us, and they have holy magic too.

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieAngry&$$@Left@$We keep saying that, and we keep running.
And look where it's gotten us!

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieShouting&$$@Left@$If we don't strike back now, they'll keep
hounding us until there's no one left!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Witch)#$$!-1!$...Natalie is right. I'm with her!
We'll show them...!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Witch)#$Yeah, I'm with you too. We'll bloody their
damned noses, at least!

$#Blaise(Blaise)#$$&BlaiseShouting&$$@Right@$H-hey, stop being so reckless! None of you
are thinking straight!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$They stick with you, even when you wish they
wouldn't. Some of them keep their secrets,

$#Blaise(Blaise)#$$&BlaiseShouting&$$@Right@$Come on, old man! Back me up here!
They're going mad!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$Ah... that's not really my style, I'm afraid.
I like to stay uninvolved, you see.

$#Blaise(Blaise)#$$&BlaiseShouting&$$@Right@$What the hell? You're a soothsayer, isn't
this your job?!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanScared&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(What should I do? At this rate, there's
going to be a bloodbath in the streets!)
$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieWorried&$$@Center@$I remember eight years ago.

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieWorried&$$@Center@$My mama told me not to be afraid. She said
Lady Seraphine was human, just like us.

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieWorried&$$@Center@$She wouldn't hurt innocent witches.
That's what my mama told me.

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieAngry&$$@Center@$Seraphine had my mama burned alive.
She screamed for... for so long...!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Center@$(What...?!)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanScared&$$@Center@$(Is this... how the Church has always been?
By whose will? By what right?!)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Center@$Destructive spells, spells that cause insanity,
mind control, hexes...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$You're thinking it too, right?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$(It'll be a party in the streets... how
ghoulish.)

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$They'll all be caged somewhere nearby.
Can we go and free them?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$Not realistically. The Inquisitors keep their
prisoners split up, I think.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$To make sure it's easy to suppress any
escape attempt using witchcraft.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$Our window will have to be just before
the executions begin.
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveIrritated&$$@Right@$What? How is that more realistic?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$That's the only time everyone will be
gathered together in one place.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$And the Inquisitors will hesitate to strike
back, with so many civilians around.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSad&$$@Right@$...Callen. You're not planning to make
yourself a decoy, are you?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanShouting&$$@Left@$I am. What's wrong with that?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Left@$My mother used the power of the witches
to hunt them down.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$If the civilians see the next Holy Maiden
using witchcraft, they'll panic. Then, you—
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveShouting&$$@Right@$Listen. You realize they'll kill you, right?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Left@$...that's fine.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveAngry&$$@Right@$No, it's not fine! You'd better not just be
trying to atone for what your mother did.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanShouting&$$@Left@$It's not that. This is what I feel is right.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$I'm risking my life for my friends. You'd
do the same thing, wouldn't you?
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$......

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSerious&$$@Center@$Let's go back to the chapel. It's probably
safe enough now...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Huh? What do you mean?

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSerious&$$@Right@$We have some time to practice magic.
Anything to help this plan succeed, right?
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSerious&$$@Right@$...I guess it's possible, but...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$...right!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanShouting&$$@Center@$There!
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSmile&$$@Center@$Ten successes in a row. Well done, Princess.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSmile&$$@Center@$The book is scary enough on its own, but
you're a terror in your own right...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$(I know this is meant to help save the others,
but I can't help feeling uneasy.)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$(When I think of Mother using this magic to
hurt and kill innocent people, I...)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$(Why would she do such a hypocritical
thing? Why turn on people just like her?)

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveShouting&$$@Center@$Callen! Stop spacing out! On to the next
spell, hurry!
