$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$Fine. If you won't answer, I'll ask
something else.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanShouting&$$@Left@$Why in heaven's name would you point a
knife at the Princess?!

$#Olive(Witch)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Right@$You chased me down, remember? I thought
you'd turn me in to the Inquisitors.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The Inquisitors are no friends of mine. I
was just looking to be alone...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$But what was a witch doing in the chapel?
I can't imagine you went there to pray.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$Are you the one who defaced the statues
of my mother and father?

$#Olive(Witch)#$$&OliveHoodSerious&$$@Center@$What if I am? Would you hunt me down?
Arrest me? Execute me in the square?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$N-no. Of course not.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanShouting&$$@Center@$You can't use witchcraft accidentally! It's
the greatest possible sin!

$#Olive(Witch)#$$&OliveHoodAngry&$$@Right@$Easy for you to say, while your family cuts
down anyone the least bit suspicious.

$#Olive(Witch)#$$&OliveHoodAngry&$$@Right@$The streets still run red with the blood
your mother spilled.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanScared&$$@Left@$What? What are you talking about?

$#Olive(Witch)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Right@$You know how nobles love their hunts.
Falcons hunt pheasants, dogs hunt foxes...

$#Olive(Witch)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Right@$And humans hunt witches. Your precious
Holy Maiden was no different.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanShouting&$$@Left@$Shut up...!
$#Olive(Witch)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Right@$...?!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$I might be tainted by sin, but my mother...
my mother was pure and loving!

$#Olive(Witch)#$$&OliveHoodShouting&$$@Right@$Careful! If you keep firing off magic like
that, the Inquisitors will—
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanShouting&$$@Left@$This is not! Your filthy black magic!

$#Olive(Witch)#$$&OliveHoodSmile&$$@Center@$Oh, you're so cute. What an ignorant little
little princess we have here.

$#Olive(Witch)#$$&OliveHoodShouting&$$@Right@$Look out!
Move, move!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanShouting&$$@Left@$Kyaa!
$#Olive(Witch)#$$&OliveHoodSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Haha. You really went all-out, Princess.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanScared&$$@Left@$T-the wall just crumbled away...
Did I do that?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Citizens)#$$!-1!$What was that sound?!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Citizens)#$Is anyone hurt?!
$#Olive(Witch)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Center@$Oh, boy.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanScared&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I-I need to explain. I need to... to take
responsibility, and—
$#Olive(Witch)#$$&OliveHoodShouting&$$@Right@$Are you an absolute moron?!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanShouting&$$@Left@$Excuse me? I'll have you know, I've read
more books than— mmfph?!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$W-what?

$#Olive(Witch)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Right@$Here, suck on these herbs for a bit. Have
yourself a nice little nap.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Callen)#$(Ah... I can't... keep my eyes... open...)

$#Olive(Witch)#$$&OliveHoodSerious&$$@Right@$When you're humiliated, reviled, hated...
When people kick and sneer at you.

$#Olive(Witch)#$$&OliveHoodSerious&$$@Right@$You think it has to be premeditated? Nope.
Most of the time, you're just desperate.

$#Olive(Witch)#$$&OliveHoodSmile&$$@Right@$Desperate to save yourself, and scared.
Just like you were a few moments ago.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$...you're a demon. You're trying to tempt
me with reasonable-sounding lies.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanShouting&$$@Left@$How do you know so much about witchcraft?
If that is what it was, why did you laugh?

$#Blaise(Blaise)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Left@$I'll get started on finding the provisions
for our escape.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$She was one of the cruelest Maidens ever.
There's a reason the witches fear her.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$But if nothing else, it made her very popular
with the folks upstairs.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$You've never heard anyone say a word
against her, have you?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Left@$...I still can't believe it. I always thought
she was so kind, and so gentle...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Left@$Did she hate the witches that much,
to do such awful things to them?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$Neither I nor my cards can say. If you want
to know, you'll have to find out yourself.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Fortunately, you're good at tracking down
answers, aren't you?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Left@$I... don't know.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Callen...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$This world isn't perfect. It's ever-changing,
like the wind or the waves.

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieMildSurprise&$$@Right@$We'll work on armor. To keep people safe,
even when we run out of magic power!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$When you find yourself adrift in the chaos,
I suppose you could cling to your friends.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$But honestly, I wouldn't recommend it.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$Much smarter to rely on yourself instead.
At least, that's what I've found.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Rely on myself? What do you mean?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$What you desire is already inside you.
Just deeper than you might expect.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$...this is why I hate seers. You act so smug,
then do nothing but spout nonsense.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$You wound me. Fortune telling serves
a good enough purpose, I think.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$Sometimes people need a new way to hear
what they already know, that's all.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What a weirdo... but somehow, I do feel a
little better. Just a little bit.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$There must be something I can do. Both for
the witches, and for Belterre.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$......

$#Seraphine(Seraphine)#$$&SeraphineSmile&$$@Center@$Look there. See? The chapel is all done.
Isn't it lovely, with the sunlight pouring in?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Center@$The chapel! Right, I went there looking for
answers.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$I have to go back. I feel like I'm forgetting
something vitally important...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanShouting&$$@Left@$Olive!
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveShouting&$$@Right@$Callen?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanShouting&$$@Left@$You're going to the chapel, right? Please,
you have to take me with you!
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSerious&$$@Right@$...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$What is this "treasure" Lady Sibylle
mentioned?
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveIrritated&$$@Right@$It's no business of yours. Go away.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanShouting&$$@Left@$I want to help! If you're going to the chapel,
there might be something I can do—
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$You alright there, mademoiselle?

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveShouting&$$@Right@$If you want to help, go back to the castle and
call off your father and his Inquisitors.
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSerious&$$@Right@$That's the best thing for all of us right now.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$With the order already issued, I don't think
there's any convincing them...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$Also, I'm not asking you for permission.
I'm telling you I'm coming along.
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveIrritated&$$@Right@$Sigh... fine, then.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSerious&$$@Right@$You and Seraphine vanished eight years
ago, right?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Left@$Yes. I don't remember that night very
clearly, but I know it happened.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSerious&$$@Right@$Since then, there's been a magic aura only
witches can sense coming from that chapel.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$Only witches can sense it? So... it's not
holy magic, then?

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Witches' magic always leaves a trace. We
use it to leave signals for each other.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$Cyrus...

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSerious&$$@Center@$I wanted to investigate the one in the
chapel, but it was always packed with people.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSerious&$$@Center@$So I damaged some walls so they'd have to
close it down for repairs.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveIrritated&$$@Center@$I finally had time to look around... and then
you showed up.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$...sorry.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$Why do you call it a "treasure", though?
Is its magic aura that strong?

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSerious&$$@Center@$I wouldn't call it strong, more like...
high-quality?

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSerious&$$@Center@$We'll need power to escape Lumains, and
then more to avoid getting eaten outside.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSerious&$$@Center@$If we can bring whatever it is with us, then
our odds of survival leap up.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveIrritated&$$@Center@$In a sense, I'm on procurement duty. Just
for magic instead of food. Get it?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Then there's no harm in me coming along,
is there? Come on, let's go.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$My mother... Seraphine. What exactly did
she do to these people?
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveSmile&$$@Right@$Geez... you're one stubborn princess.

$#Augustin(Brother Augustin)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Left@$Now, then. We should have a witch or two
to make an example of soon enough...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Well done, Inquisitor. Lumains' public order
is in good hands, I see.
$#Augustin(Brother Augustin)#$$&AugustinSurprised&$$@Left@$...?! Who are you? How did you get in here?!
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Ah, how rude of me. Please, call me Cyrus.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$I've come to offer my services to the
esteemed Inquisition.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$You see, I just so happen to have stumbled
upon a burrow of witches.
$#Augustin(Brother Augustin)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Left@$...is that so?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yes. And I'd be happy to show you where
it is.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$Well, to put it bluntly...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$She and the Inquisitors killed dozens of
them. Some very cruelly, too.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSad&$$@Center@$It sounds so cheery outside. The drums
drumming, all the children laughing...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSerious&$$@Left@$If they think Mother's come back to them,
then realize they're still stuck with me...

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSmile&$$@Right@$Haha, so pessimistic. You've always been
a worrier, haven't you?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesShouting&$$@Left@$It's more than that! I'm not just getting
wrapped up in my head, this is serious!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSad&$$@Left@$Father, please. Cancel today's rite. I'll
never ask anything from you again.
$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Callen...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSerious&$$@Center@$Every Holy Maiden in history has used the
solstice rite to work miracles.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSerious&$$@Center@$But I can't summon any light to protect
the city. Not a single spark.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSad&$$@Center@$If we go forward with the ceremony,
everyone will see how useless I am.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSad&$$@Center@$At least if we cancel it, they can still have
the illusion of hope...

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSad&$$@Center@$You know I can't do that, dear. Even I, as
king, cannot call off a holy rite.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSad&$$@Center@$I must be the only one in the city wishing
for a thunderstorm.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What about Brother Augustin? Doesn't the
head of the Inquisition have authority here?

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSerious&$$@Right@$He... does, I suppose. And he hasn't been
quiet about wishing to see you step down.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSerious&$$@Right@$But who but you could be our Holy Maiden?
An empty seat will only cause more worry.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSerious&$$@Right@$At least give it a try today, Callen.
For your people.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSmile&$$@Right@$Even if something goes wrong, they will
forgive you. I know they will.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSad&$$@Left@$...alright, then. I'll... I'll do my best.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSmile&$$@Right@$When your mother held this rite, it was as
if a second sun had fallen from the sky.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSurprised&$$@Left@$A second sun? Really?

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSmile&$$@Right@$Indeed. All of Lumains... no, all of Belterre
beheld her light that day.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSmile&$$@Right@$You may not believe it, but it is the truth.
And you are your mother's child.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSad&$$@Center@$I hate clear days so much...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(...right. I want to be the best Maiden I
can be... as my mother's child.)
$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSmile&$$@Center@$Here, take my hand.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Father?! Aah! What are you doing?

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSmile&$$@Right@$If you're anxious, let us simply dance the
feeling away!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSurprised&$$@Left@$F-Father, wait just a...!

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSmile&$$@Right@$Today is the solstice, when His Radiance
graces us most strongly.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSmile&$$@Right@$Look outside. See how brightly the Radiant
One shines! 'Tis almost musical.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSerious&$$@Right@$Come, let us improvise a little two-step
to honor His light.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSmile&$$@Left@$Haha...
Oh, Father.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$!-1!$(...Father must know as well as I do that
I'm unsuited to be the Maiden.)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Voice)#$$!-1!$Callen? Are you there?

$#Callen(Callen)#$(I'm not a fool. Having me next in line to
rule keeps his power secure.)

$#Callen(Callen)#$(But... he loves me, too. That must be why
he has faith in me, right?)
$#Callen(Callen)#$(Then...)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSmile&$$@Left@$...alright. I'll try to have some faith in
myself.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSmile&$$@Right@$Wonderful. You know I will always believe
in you, Callen.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSmile&$$@Right@$If you feel uncertain during the rite, look to
me. I will be right beside you.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesNormal&$$@Left@$Yes, Father. Thank you.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...I guess all I can do is pray for a miracle.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Citizen A)#$Hey, look there! That girl in the veil.
Isn't that Princess Callen?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Citizen B)#$It must be! Oh, blessed Maiden... deliver
us from this plague of darkness!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSurprised&$$@Left@$Y-yes!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Citizen C)#$I've... I've heard rumors that the Princess
can't produce any light at all...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Citizen A)#$Shh! Don't say such things!
Especially on this blessed day.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenVeilSerious&$$@Center@$(...I can feel their eyes boring into me.
Chin up, Callen. Just keep smiling.)
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenVeilSerious&$$@Center@$Ah. Brother Augustin's finally arrived.

$#Augustin(Brother Augustin)#$$&AugustinClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...know that I tried to put a stop to this.
You are unfit to attempt this rite.

$#Augustin(Brother Augustin)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Center@$But your father would hear nothing of it.
Your mother would be most disappointed.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenVeilSad&$$@Center@$(So the Inquisitors are already convinced...
He knows I can't make a miracle happen.)

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSmile&$$@Center@$The time has come, Callen.
Be brave.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenVeilScared&$$@Center@$Y-yes, Father.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Citizen A)#$$!-1!$There she is! Princess Callen has ascended
the dais!
$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSmile&$$@Right@$Ah, my daughter! Why, in those robes...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Citizen B)#$O blessed Holy Maiden!
Give to us the Radiant One's guidance...!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenVeilSad&$$@Center@$(...Radiant One, are you listening? If You
have ever loved me, hear me now.)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenVeilSerious&$$@Center@$(Let Your bounteous love fill these
good and gentle people. Please...)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenVeilSerious&$$@Center@$(Grant them the warmth and protection of
Your holy love...!)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Citizen A)#$$!-1!$...Huh?
Nothing's happening.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Citizen B)#$There's... no light? What is the Maiden
doing?
$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSad&$$@Center@$Callen...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenVeilScared&$$@Center@$(No... no! I need to be a good Maiden!
I need to protect my kingdom!)
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenVeilShouting&$$@Center@$(Please, Radiant One, hear my prayer!)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Citizen C)#$$!-1!$So she can't do it, after all.
The rumors were true.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSmile&$$@Right@$You are the very image of the Holy Maiden
of Lumains.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Citizen B)#$No... no, it can't be! There must be some
mistake!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Citizen A)#$Without the Light, Lumains will never
hold against the demons!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Citizen B)#$My son is fighting on the front lines for
Belterre! Without the Maiden's blessing...!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenVeilScared&$$@Center@$(No! I knew it... I knew this was going to
happen! I can't...!)

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSurprised&$$@Center@$People of Lumains! I beg your patience
and your understanding!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenVeilSad&$$@Center@$Father...?

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSerious&$$@Center@$...eight years ago, my wife, the Maiden
Seraphine, disappeared.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSerious&$$@Center@$I know all of you have lived in uncertainty
since that day. In truth, so have I.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSerious&$$@Center@$Seraphine was the Maiden, yes, but she was
also an ordinary woman. My beloved wife.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSad&$$@Center@$I am ashamed to say it, but there have been
days my prayers produced no light.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSad&$$@Right@$For a moment, I... I thought your mother
had returned to us.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSad&$$@Center@$How could they, when pain weighed down
my spirit?
$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSerious&$$@Center@$But it is because of that pain I say to you:

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSerious&$$@Center@$In times of uncertainty, let us pray all the
more. I am sure she would say the same.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSerious&$$@Center@$My people, will you pray with me? So long
as the light lasts, we shall be safe.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSerious&$$@Center@$Let us nurture that light now, not by the
Maiden's hand, but together, as one.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Citizen A)#$$!-1!$...right. Lady Seraphine gave so much for
this kingdom.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Citizen B)#$I'm disappointed in Princess Callen, but
that's no reason to give up hope.

$#Callen(Callen)#$(So much light is pouring from them... but
it's not enough. And I'm the one to blame.)

$#Callen(Callen)#$(I'm sorry... I'm so sorry, everyone.
For being such a failure...)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenRobesSad&$$@Left@$I see. All the more reason for the people
to be disappointed, then.

keys.DescriptionKey: A long, long time ago a prodigy was born in a faraway elven village. The talk of the town for years, she was invited to work at a research institute, but when she arrived there, the head researcher couldn't hide his surprise. That's because the famed genius looked like she couldn't be older than ten.

CallenRegular01.name: Callen
CallenRegular01.title: Brilliant Magic Researcher Girl
CallenRegular01.description: A long, long time ago a prodigy was born in a faraway elven village. The talk of the town for years, she was invited to work at a research institute, but when she arrived there, the head researcher couldn't hide his surprise. That's because the famed genius looked like she couldn't be older than ten.

keys.IntroText:
Hohoho, so you want my power? Very well,
if you have enough sweets to pay for it...

keys.DescriptionKey: Before long, rumours about her impertinence, her weird laugh, and her penchant for sweets and junk food swept the institute. However, her talent and passion for research were unparalleled, and the mockery surrounding her soon turned into envy.

CallenRegular02.name: Callen
CallenRegular02.title: Brilliant Magic Researcher Girl
CallenRegular02.description: Before long, rumours about her impertinence, her weird laugh, and her penchant for sweets and junk food swept the institute. However, her talent and passion for research were unparalleled, and the mockery surrounding her soon turned into envy.

keys.DescriptionKey: Even after all these years, her teacher's memory is fresh in her mind. Wiser than anyone she knew, the one she respected like no-one else, the one lost to her childish thoughtlessness. She has devoted herself to her research, in hope that one day she can atone for her past and live up to the ideal he set.

CallenRegular03.name: Callen
CallenRegular03.title: Brilliant Magic Researcher Girl
CallenRegular03.description: Even after all these years, her teacher's memory is fresh in her mind. Wiser than anyone she knew, the one she respected like no-one else, the one lost to her childish thoughtlessness. She has devoted herself to her research, in hope that one day she can atone for her past and live up to the ideal he set.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$Five cards, laid out in a row. Pick one, if
you please.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$The people start riots across Lumains,
believing the whole Church is corrupt.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Left@$...I knew it. I can't protect Belterre.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Left@$My failure will cause chaos, violence in the
streets...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Left@$People may even stop praying altogether.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanScared&$$@Left@$And when the light grows dim enough, the
demons will slaughter us all. Isn't that right?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$If that's what the people want. If they
refuse to pull together.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$They want a savior. They don't believe in
themselves, so they can't protect themselves.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$I have to wonder if they've been coddled a
bit too much... not that it's my place to say.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$That's pretty cold of you. The demons won't
spare this place either, you know.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanShouting&$$@Left@$How can you be so calm about all this?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$...this one.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Maybe because this isn't guaranteed to
come to pass. Not yet, at least.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$This is just one of a number of possible
futures.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$But if you leave this place and return to the
palace, it gets a lot more likely, yes.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Left@$Then... that means there's a way I can
stop this from happening?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$Of course. If you choose this path, for
instance...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Left@$(The picture on the card is changing!)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Left@$This is... me? Defeating the demons with
witchcraft?!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Yes. See how that choice changes the
first card as well?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Left@$...!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Would you look at that? The people love
you.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$Let's see what it holds.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Left@$T-they... love me? Even though I'm a...
I mean, I'm... the way I am?
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$Sound pretty nice, doesn't it?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Left@$...I don't know. Using an evil thing like
witchcraft to bring about such a future...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$Magic is magic, Highness. There's nothing
nothing good or evil about it.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanShouting&$$@Left@$That's—that's blasphemy!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$Did you know? The meaning of these cards
changes based on the way they're facing.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$It's called inversion. A card that's normally
auspicious may not be when it's inverted.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$This card that shows you in glory here?
From my seat, it's inverted.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Left@$...!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$It's like that in life too. Whether something
is good or evil depends on your point of view.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Center@$(Wait, these aren't tarot cards!)

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$Morality is a handy tool for those with a
vested interest in controlling you.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$Don't let anyone tell you what is or isn't
right. You have to decide that on your own.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$But you're a clever one, aren't you? I'm
sure you'll muddle through.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Left@$...if I don't decide what's right for myself,
I let someone else decide for me.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Left@$If I can fight demons with this power...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$If I can save people using witchcraft, how
can that be evil?
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$!-1!$$@Center@$There, that's the Callen I know.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$(Then, even the light of prayer and holy
magic is neither inherently good nor evil.)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$(If that's so... then the question remains.
Is His Radiance truly loving?)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$(He's tested us for so long, over and over.
Maybe it's our turn to test Him for once...)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenVeilScared&$$@Center@$(It's me, on the dais... and the masses below,
looking up at me with faces twisted in rage.)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$...hey. What's your stake in all this? Why
are you going out of your way to help me?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$Hmm. Who can say? I'm but a humble
fortune teller, bound to the whims of fate.

$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleSerious&$$@Center@$Cyrus, Len.
Is your reading finished?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$Yes. We don't need to worry about her.
She's on our side.

$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleClosedEyes&$$@Center@$I see, I see. I hope you don't think too
poorly of us, Len.

$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleSerious&$$@Center@$Witches must be evert vigilant about
whom we trust.

$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleSerious&$$@Center@$A single moment of weakness could bring
us into the Inquisition's sights.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Don't worry, Lady Sibylle. I understand
all too well.
$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleSmile&$$@Right@$Thank you, child. You have a kind heart.

$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleSerious&$$@Right@$Olive will look after you until a house can
be prepared. Isn't that right, Olive?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenVeilScared&$$@Center@$(No matter how I pray, I'll never produce
light. I'll never be accepted as the Maiden.)

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Right@$That's... fine. As long as she behaves.
Think you can do that, Len?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSmile&$$@Left@$I can behave. Better than you can, at least.
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodShouting&$$@Right@$Excuse me?
$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Haha. I like this one. She has spirit!
$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSerious&$$@Left@$Augustin, do you have a moment?

$#Augustin(Brother Augustin)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Right@$My, Your Majesty. This must be an urgent
matter, to bring you here so late.
$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSerious&$$@Left@$Please, let's drop the formalities.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSad&$$@Left@$...Callen ran away from the castle and has
yet to return.

$#Augustin(Brother Augustin)#$$&AugustinShouting&$$@Right@$You're kidding. First that shameful display,
and now she goes missing?

$#Augustin(Brother Augustin)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Right@$I'd thought she was smarter than that. I
guess she takes after you.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$Another, if you please.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSad&$$@Left@$Perhaps. But no, this is all my fault.
I drove her to such disobedience.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSad&$$@Left@$I'm well aware how you feel about Callen
and myself, but please. I need your help.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSerious&$$@Left@$Your Inquisitors would be able to locate her
quickly and quietly, would they not?

$#Augustin(Brother Augustin)#$$&AugustinClosedEyes&$$@Right@$We have more important things to do than
patch up a family squabble, Alderic.

$#Augustin(Brother Augustin)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Right@$But... very well. For Seraphine's sake, and
for Belterre's, I'll do you this favor.
$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSmile&$$@Left@$Augustin... thank you...

$#Augustin(Brother Augustin)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Right@$But don't think my assistance comes
without a price.
$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSad&$$@Left@$A price? What is it you want?
$#Augustin(Brother Augustin)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Right@$Authorization for another witch hunt.
$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSurprised&$$@Left@$That's...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanScared&$$@Center@$(N-next is...)

$#Augustin(Brother Augustin)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Right@$Our reach isn't universal. A search for your
daughter may draw undue attention.

$#Augustin(Brother Augustin)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Right@$But framed as a witch hunt, we can be bold—
and undo the shame Callen inflicted today.

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSad&$$@Left@$Are the streets to run red with blood again?
Witches are not so different from you or I...
$#Augustin(Brother Augustin)#$$&AugustinShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Your point?

$#Augustin(Brother Augustin)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Center@$The people sense your weak will, Alderic,
and it makes them uneasy.

$#Augustin(Brother Augustin)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Center@$What good is an ineffective patriarch?
What will Seraphine say when she returns?

$#Augustin(Brother Augustin)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Center@$As her husband, as king, you must be
prepared to dirty your hands when needed.
$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSurprised&$$@Center@$No... no. Seraphine, she...

$#Alderic(Alderic)#$$&AldericSad&$$@Center@$...I understand. I will grant your hunt my
royal blessing.
$#Augustin(Brother Augustin)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Center@$A wise choice.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Center@$...!
$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieSmile&$$@Center@$Len! This way!

$#Blaise(Blaise)#$$&BlaiseShouting&$$@Center@$Hey, I'm talking to you! Geez, once you
focus up you're just gone, huh.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Huh? Oh, sorry... I was just so intrigued.
The architecture down here is fascinating.

$#Blaise(Blaise)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Right@$Countless years of witches building trial-
and-error style will do that, yeah.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Left@$Countless years? But we're right under the
capital! How has no one ever noticed?

$#Blaise(Blaise)#$$&BlaiseSmirk&$$@Right@$The Court's got some real amazing history!
Stuff they'd never write about in books!

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Idiot. Of course we have history books.
You're just too lazy to read any of them.

$#Blaise(Blaise)#$$&BlaiseShouting&$$@Center@$Hey! There's nothing wrong with me
casting my net wide and shallow!

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieSmile&$$@Center@$I'll go over some of our history after you're
finished speaking with Grandmother.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$Um, so... this "Grandmother." Is she your
leader, or...?

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieSmile&$$@Center@$Yep! Grandmother Sibylle's the oldest and
most powerful witch in Lumains.

$#Blaise(Blaise)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Center@$Granny's pretty calm most of the time, but
she's a terror when she's mad. Be ready.

$#Blaise(Blaise)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Olive was lucky enough to study under her,
back in the day.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSerious&$$@Right@$She hasn't taught me anything in a long
time, though.

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Have you seen her magic, Len? She learned
it directly from Grandmother herself.

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieSmile&$$@Center@$She's very strong. That's why she goes out
onto the surface, where it's most dangerous.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$I... see.

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Center@$It's not like I do it for you all. I just hate
being cooped up down here all the time.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Center@$(Wait, is she really a good person after
all? This is too confusing...)
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$Do all of the capital's witches live here?
$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSerious&$$@Center@$No way. That would be way too dangerous.

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieWorried&$$@Center@$We stay here to help out those who have
been victimized by the Inquisitors, but...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Center@$O-okay...

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieWorried&$$@Center@$We can't keep all our eggs in one basket. If
they found this place, they would kill us all.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$(...has my kingdom, my faith, been so cruel
to these people?)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$(I've read so much. I thought I knew about
the world, but... I didn't. Not really.)

$#Natalie(Natalie)#$$&NatalieSmile&$$@Center@$Grandmother, I've brought Len.
Go on, Len. Say hello.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Center@$Um, I'm honored to make your acquaintance,
Lady Sibylle. My name is Len.

$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleSmile&$$@Center@$Well, well. No need to stand on formalities
here, young lady.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$(Ah, I spoke without thinking...)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Witch)#$$!-1!$Olive... why would you bring an outsider
here at a time like this?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Witch)#$We don't know who she is. What if you've
brought doom down on our heads?

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodIrritated&$$@Center@$Should I have left her for the Inquisitors?
Maybe they're right about us being heartless.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$(It smells like rain down here. All these little
buildings and roads... did they build these?)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Witch)#$$!-1!$You don't have to say it like that...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Witch)#$You know we're barely scraping by down
here. That's all I meant.

$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleSerious&$$@Right@$Enough, all of you. Len, come here. Let
me get a better look at you.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Left@$Y-yes, ma'am.
$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleSerious&$$@Right@$......I see.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Left@$(Eugh. It feels like she's peering straight
into my soul.)
$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleSerious&$$@Right@$Your thoughts, Cyrus?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hmm... afraid I can't say anything at a
glance. Shall I ask my cards instead?

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodAngry&$$@Center@$Excuse me? How is your fortune-telling
nonsense supposed to help us?!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Center@$(Huh? Olive's gone white as a sheet.)

$#Olive(Olive)#$$&OliveHoodSerious&$$@Center@$Don't get lost now. This place can be a real
labyrinth for newcomers.
$#Sibylle(Sibylle)#$$&SibylleSerious&$$@Center@$Silence, girl. Cyrus, do as you like.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$But of course.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$Right this way, mademoiselle.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$O-okay...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Center@$(What's going on here?!)

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$Well, then. Now that we're alone, allow me
to formally introduce myself.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$It is my sincere honor to meet you,
Princess Callen.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Center@$...?!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanScared&$$@Center@$D-don't be ridiculous. I'm not...
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$It's no use trying to hide it, Your Highness.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$(Is it built that way on purpose, to confuse
attackers? The lack of windows, too...)

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$It must be hard, keeping up the deception.
You can be your true self around me.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$...I'm not here to cause any trouble.
Olive rescued me, that's all.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$If you'll let me return to the castle, I'll
never trouble any of you again.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$I have no intention of disrupting your lives...
And even less of learning magic from you.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$!-1!$$@Left@$None at all, hm? Fascinating. I never dreamt
I'd see the day Callen gave up on learning.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Right@$Do you have to say it like that...?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$My apologies. It's just that, the Callen I
knew was insatiably curious.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$It was great fun, watching her in her
prideful fits of genius.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSurprised&$$@Right@$...have we met somewhere before?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Center@$(...they live like this out of fear of the
Church and the royal family, don't they?)

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$You're better off not asking. Some things
are only for the cards to know, I'm afraid.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Right@$(I think... this man might be dangerous.)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Right@$(And yet, I feel like I can trust him. Sort
of. What a strange, strange feeling.)

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$Please be at ease, Your Highness. Lady
Sibylle knows you mean no harm.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$Still, since we have the chance, why not
cut the cards? What would you like to see?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Right@$...I want to see the past. I need to see it.
Please.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Right@$My mother disappeared eight years ago.
Is there any way you could...?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$Mm... sorry. I can only see forward. But
sometimes our future illuminates our past.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Right@$...alright. Show me the future then,
I guess.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Right@$On my next birthday, I'm to be consecrated
as the next Holy Maiden.
$#Blaise(Blaise)#$$&BlaiseSmirk&$$@Center@$Hey, you.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSad&$$@Right@$Can a witch like me really be consecrated?
Or will I be expelled from the kingdom?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$A grand conundrum indeed! Let us see
what the cards have to say.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHumanSerious&$$@Center@$(But I feel strangely at ease here, too. Is it
because there's nothing holy around?)

$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Researcher)#$$|act5.Voices/sst394|$So you are the Crestbearers! I am honored
to finally meet you!

$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Researcher)#$$|act5.Voices/sst395|$I can say with a reasonable degree of
scientific certainty that we'll win this battle.

$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Researcher)#$$|act5.Voices/sst398|$Did you know that every silvy has a unique
pattern on their forehead?

$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Researcher)#$$|act5.Voices/sst399|$Occasionally patterns have been known to
reoccur in families.

$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Researcher)#$$|act5.Voices/sst400|$Kelvy here has a twin sister with the same
forehead marking.

$#DONTSHOWME(Kelvy)#$$|act5.Voices/sst401|$It's not the same, vee! Mine is two shades
darker and 0.03% bigger!

$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Researcher)#$$|act5.Voices/sst396|$Other races often have difficulty judging the
age of an elf.

$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Researcher)#$$|act5.Voices/sst397|$But until we reach 15 years, our physical
growth rate is comparable to humans.

keys.DescriptionKey: Callen's workaholic tendencies didn't lend themselves well to a balanced diet, leaving her snacking on chips and candy rather than proper meals. Once, she was taunted by Druke for her eating habits. "I-I can handle this just fine!", she insisted, popping Brussels sprouts into her mouth. She passed out and it took half an hour for her to wake back up.

Once, she was taunted by Druke for her eating habits. "I-I can handle this just fine!", she insisted, popping Brussels sprouts into her mouth. She passed out and it took half an hour for her to wake back up.

keys.DescriptionKey: Callen viewed her current form as a sort of punishment. Punishment for her overconfidence in her own abilities, her over-focus on results, and the hubris that cost her her valued mentor. But her mentor, in their last moments, did not hate Callen. Proud though she may be, beneath it is a kind and dutiful woman.

CallenSwimsuit03.name: Callen
CallenSwimsuit03.title: Seaside Scholar
CallenSwimsuit03.description: Callen viewed her current form as a sort of punishment. Punishment for her overconfidence in her own abilities, her over-focus on results, and the hubris that cost her her valued mentor. But her mentor, in their last moments, did not hate Callen. Proud though she may be, beneath it is a kind and dutiful woman.

keys.value: $#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$So this is the VIP Room?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBunnySurprised&$$@Left@$For free!?
Is...is that allowed?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Shouting&$$@Left@$I mean internally! My body may be young,
but my mind is that of an adult woman!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Shouting&$$@Left@$It is your own fault if you are unable to
see that!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$O-okay...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBunnySad&$$@Left@$Couldn't you analyze the medicine and make
a counter-medicine? Would that work?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Sad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Unfortunately, it was made by my teacher.
It is complex, and the ingredients are rare.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Sad&$$@Center@$Reverse-engineering it would not likely be
successful.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Sad&$$@Center@$...Besides, this is my punishment.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Serious&$$@Center@$Until I complete the research on the
Pandemonium he left behind, I...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$So that's why you started researching
the Pandemonium...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Serious&$$@Left@$Now, enough of that. And you, Rizette!
Stop looking so sad.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$It's part of the service.
No need to hold yourselves back.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBunnyWorried&$$@Right@$But...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Serious&$$@Left@$No buts. We have a job to do, yes?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBunnySerious&$$@Right@$...You're right.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Heh&$$@Left@$Allow me to continue with my plan, which I
was so rudely interrupted in before.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Oh, right. What is it?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Heh&$$@Left@$Heh heh.
Behold!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$What is this?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Heh&$$@Left@$A magic tool I developed. It allows
conversation across great distances!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSwimsuitHappy&$$@Right@$A-amazing!
What a wonder!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Happy&$$@Left@$Here, I will activate it.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBunnyLaugh&$$@Left@$Really!?
Wow, it's like a dream!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Heh&$$@Left@$Hello? Can you hear me? Hello?
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Yooooooo!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBunnySurprised&$$@Left@$I-I heard a voice!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSwimsuitNormal&$$@Right@$Ah...I know that voice!
The Bro with sunglasses!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Sunglasses Bro)#$$!-1!$Heeey, bikki bro!
This thing is nuts, dudes!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Surprised&$$@Center@$I must say, I am impressed you knew how
to use it immediately...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Serious&$$@Center@$Would you be able to do that thing we
discussed earlier?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Sunglasses Bro)#$$!-1!$You gotcha, littler miss! Ah, but I could
use a cheer from a goddess first, yeah?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Surprised&$$@Left@$What? A goddess?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$Oh, um...
I think he means Rizette.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$I'll take a bourbon on the rocks.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Sunglasses Bro)#$$!-1!$Yeah, Rizette!
Rizette FTW!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$...I don't really understand what he's
saying, but... Rizette?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBunnyShy&$$@Left@$Um, I can give it a try.
Here goes...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBunnyLaugh&$$@Left@$Y-you rock, bro!
Woohoo!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Sunglasses Bro)#$$!-1!$Hell to the yeaaaah, lil' miss!
Let's! Get! This! Party! Starteeeeeed!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Surprised&$$@Left@$Ah, he cut the connection.
Well, I expect it will work out.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$What's going to happen?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Heh&$$@Left@$You will see.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Um...?
$#()#$$!-1!$Brrrrrrrrriiiiiiing!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Heh&$$@Left@$Hah, look at you trying to look cool.
Bourbon is an old man's drink.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSwimsuitAngry&$$@Right@$What is that sound!?
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$A security alarm, I would say.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Did that Bro set it off!?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Heh&$$@Left@$I asked him to run as soon as he set it off.
I expect he will be fine.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSwimsuitHappy&$$@Right@$The guards have left the corridor.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Okay! Let's hurry ahead while we can!
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Alright then. What are you drinking?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Happy&$$@Left@$Hmm...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Happy&$$@Left@$I will take a strawberry soda, on the rocks!
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$......

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Order anything you like, kids.
Here's the menu.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Huh? Callen?
You changed swimsuits?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Shouting&$$@Left@$Hey! What was that!?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$Hey now. If you make a commotion,
they're going to kick us out.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Grit&$$@Left@$Tch...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$I'm not really hungry.
I'll just take a water, please.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSwimsuitHappy&$$@Left@$I would like these Orka-style dango.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$What about you, Rizette?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBunnyAbsentminded&$$@Center@$Hmghm?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$She's already eating!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Surprised&$$@Center@$And that is her third plate.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBunnyShy&$$@Center@$S-sorry. When I heard it was free, I
couldn't help myself...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Serious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$After all, I am a lady. And this is the VIP
Room. I must dress suitably.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBunnyShy&$$@Center@$Life with Theo hasn't been the easiest, so...
Sorry. This is so embarrassing.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Surprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh, of course! I had not realized.
Eat as much as you like!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Heh&$$@Left@$In fact, here!
Bring us one of everything on the menu!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBunnyTroubled&$$@Right@$Huh!? But...I mean, I'll take it, but I'd still
feel bad...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Heh&$$@Left@$In that case, let us focus on these chips,
sweets, and ice cream!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Isn't that just what you yourself want to
order?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Blush&$$@Left@$......O-of course not.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Nothing but sweets, as usual. If Rody were
here, he'd...oh, right, his son's here.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$Finn, anything to say about Callen's diet?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$Um...it doesn't sound very healthy.
I wouldn't recommend it.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$This one does feel more VIP, somehow.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Grit&$$@Left@$...I cannot argue with that...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Looks like everyone's done with the food.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$And the waiters are outside. If we're going
to plot, now's the time.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Rizette, do you know how to get to that
locked room from here?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBunnySad&$$@Right@$I don't know exactly, sorry...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSwimsuitNormal&$$@Left@$It seems unlikely there would be a
convenient hidden door.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$The corridor continued on past the door
in here. This mystery room could be there.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Heh&$$@Left@$I agree.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Then I guess we should head down there
and see what we find.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSwimsuitSad&$$@Left@$But what about the security guards? We
passed several on the way here.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Heh&$$@Left@$That is right! Behold my mature charms!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$Hmm...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Heh&$$@Left@$Worry not. I have a plan.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBunnySurprised&$$@Right@$A plan?
$#Shiona(Shiona)#$$&ShionaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ah! I knew you'd be in here!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Surprised&$$@Center@$Shiona!?

$#Shiona(Shiona)#$$&ShionaSmile&$$@Center@$People said there were some weird
customers in here. I knew it'd be you!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Grit&$$!-1!$$@Left@$And what is wrong with that? We have
enough gold for it.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Shouting&$$@Left@$The one who should not be here is you.
Return to Elvenlent immediately!

$#Shiona(Shiona)#$$&ShionaSmile&$$@Right@$Hmph, so that's how you want to be?
Then I guess I won't give you this.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Blush&$$@Left@$Huh? Wait, is that...
Super Sugar ice candy!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$Mature...right...

$#Shiona(Shiona)#$$&ShionaSmile&$$@Right@$Oh, right, this is your favorite snack, isn't
it? You want it?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Sad&$$@Left@$I-I do not...

$#Shiona(Shiona)#$$&ShionaSmile&$$@Right@$Good, because I wasn't going to give it to
you. This one's limited edition, after all.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Blush&$$@Left@$...I... I do want it!

$#Shiona(Shiona)#$$&ShionaSmile&$$@Right@$Well, why didn't you say so!
In that case, you can have it.
$#Shiona(Shiona)#$$&ShionaHappy&$$@Right@$...Not! Nom nom. Ooh, it's so sugary!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Grit&$$@Left@$What! You never intended to give it to me
in the first place!?

$#Shiona(Shiona)#$$&ShionaLaugh&$$@Right@$I never said I would. I just asked if you
wanted it! Hahaha!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Shouting&$$@Left@$You...you...!
Gaaaah!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$Calm down, Callen.
She wants to get a rise out of you.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Staff)#$$!-1!$May I take your orders, ladies and
gentlemen?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Blush&$$@Left@$I almost played right into her hands...
$#Shiona(Shiona)#$$&ShionaGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hmph. You're no fun.
$#Shiona(Shiona)#$$&ShionaSerious&$$@Center@$So, you people really trust her, huh?

$#Shiona(Shiona)#$$&ShionaSerious&$$@Center@$You probably don't know, but Callen killed
her teacher.
$#Shiona(Shiona)#$$&ShionaGrit&$$@Center@$She'll use you and throw you away, too.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Grit&$$@Center@$Shiona...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$No, Callen's not like that.
$#Shiona(Shiona)#$$&ShionaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$I believe in Callen. We all do.
She would never betray us.

$#Shiona(Shiona)#$$&ShionaSmile&$$@Right@$Hmph, how trusting.
Well, whatever.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBunnySurprised&$$@Left@$Orders?

$#Shiona(Shiona)#$$&ShionaSerious&$$@Right@$I only came here as a break from my
research, so I'll be getting back to it.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBunnyWorried&$$@Left@$There she goes...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$A break, huh...it looked to me more like
she was worried about you, Callen.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Sad&$$@Left@$...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$Say, is what she said true?
This is the first I've heard of it.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Sad&$$@Left@$...It is true.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Sad&$$@Left@$It was indirect, yes...
But I did kill my teacher.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Right@$...Really?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Sad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$......
This all happened a long time ago.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Serious&$$@Center@$I fell into forbidden research— dark magic.
There was an accident.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$This kind of VIP Room provides drinks
and food for no charge.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Serious&$$@Center@$The dark magic rampaged beyond my
control, and I was nearly killed.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Sad&$$@Center@$...My teacher protected me.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Sad&$$@Center@$He died of his wounds after that.
...Because of my hubris.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So that's what happened...
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSad&$$@Right@$Is that why you're shaped like that, too?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Serious&$$@Left@$Yes, as a side effect of the drug I took to
counteract the dark magic's effects.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Grit&$$@Left@$That is why I look like this—
Like a child.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSwimsuitDoya&$$@Right@$You mean, your true form is that of a
charming and beautiful woman!?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit02Shouting&$$@Left@$All my forms are that of a charming woman!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$You just said "child" yourself, though...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$Urk...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!1!$$@Center@$Ah, there she is! Hey, Rizette!
What are you doing over here? How—
$#DONOTSHOWME(Dealer)#$The result is 36.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$Aww, it didn't work...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSwimsuitSad&$$@Right@$This game is more difficult than it appears.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit01Irritated&$$!-1!$$@Center@$We are only warming up! This is where the
real challenge begins...

$#Cyrus(???)#$$@Center@$Then surely you won't mind if I sit in a
few rounds?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit01Surprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...Cyrus!?
What are you doing here!?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$What do you mean, what?
Orka is practically my backyard, you know.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$...Cyrus?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Well, look who else came along! I guess you
really do take after your old man.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$......
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBunnyTroubled&$$@Center@$Sorry... I'm sorry... I'm sorry...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Hey, don't look so suspicious.
I'm just here to have fun.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit01Irritated&$$@Left@$Anything you call "fun" is by nature
suspicious, you crook...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSad&$$@Right@$You're really going to be like that, after all
we've been through? I'm hurt.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$Mm, guess I'd better bet.
Put my chips on 1, mister.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit01Surprised&$$@Left@$A directed bet!?
You have always been reckless.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Haha. I just trust in Lady Luck. The ball
chooses where she wants to go.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Dealer)#$The result is 25.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$Hm, no good. Alright, then...
Let's put more chips on 5.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Another directed bet!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSwimsuitSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...Hmm.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSwimsuitNormal&$$@Right@$What a gamesman!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit01Serious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I would ask what you are thinking, but I can
see you are not thinking at all...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit01Serious&$$@Left@$I will bet on a result higher than 19.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$High numbers, eh? Low payout, but low risk.
That's like you.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit01Angry&$$@Left@$S-shut up!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$You understand the risk of playing it too
safe, don't you, Callen?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit01Serious&$$@Left@$...True. Eventually I will wear down my
remaining savings...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit01Serious&$$@Left@$But if I bet big and lose, then we are truly
out of options...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$I believe in you, Callen.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$If we lose, we lose. We'll figure something
else out, together.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$I guess she didn't win, either...
Let's let her be by herself for a bit.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSwimsuitShouting&$$@Right@$Indeed. You are not alone!
Do not worry!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit01Surprised&$$@Left@$...I guess not.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit01Angry&$$@Left@$Then, I will change things up!
Dealer, put all my chips on these...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Spectator)#$$!-1!$Whoa, she's betting everything!
Hey... Hey, look at that!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Spectator)#$Wow, she's nuts!
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$Well, if it isn't a flower bet.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$A flower bet?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Spectator)#$$!-1!$Of the 37 spots, you bet on 9 of them.
It's called a "flower" because of the shape.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$9 out of 37... So it's about a 25% chance
to win?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSwimsuitNormal&$$@Left@$That sounds easy!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSwimsuitSad&$$@Left@$Indeed...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Spectator)#$$!-1!$No, since you're betting on so many tiles,
you may lose more than you win back.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$What? But...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSwimsuitNormal&$$@Left@$If that is the case, why would Lady Callen
do something like that?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Spectator)#$$!-1!$Because of how you count up the payout.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Spectator)#$If she lands the center tile, the flower bet
pays out 144 times back.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSwimsuitDoya&$$@Center@$144 times!?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Spectator)#$$!-1!$But if it lands on anything else...
She could be out of money completely.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Finally decided to entrust your fate to
Lady Luck, have you?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit01Heh&$$@Left@$I do not believe in fate.
But I do believe in my comrades.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Haha. Sounds like Rody rubbed off on you.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Callen's our last hope...she said there
was a method to it, but what did she mean?)
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit01Serious&$$@Left@$Hush. The ball is moving.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Right@$I guess it is.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Spectator)#$There it goes!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$The center of Callen's flower bet was tile
32...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSwimsuitNormal&$$@Left@$What did it land in? I cannot bring myself
to look!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Dealer)#$$!-1!$The result is 32.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSwimsuitHappy&$$@Left@$S-Sir Finn!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Right@$Callen!!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSwimsuit01Heh&$$@Left@$It worked...haha...I-I mean, of course it did!

$#Spica(Spica)#$$&SpicaNormal&$$@Right@$Hello, sir?
$#Spica(Spica)#$$&SpicaNormal&$$@Right@$Are you a knight?
$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinHappy&$$@Left@$$%0.2%$Oh, look! Can you see the castle?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$I sure am! That was a good guess.
$#Spica(Spica)#$$&SpicaHappy&$$@Right@$Well, it's because you look like a knight!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$(I suppose travelers don't usually wear
armor, do they?)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$I'm a member of the Rigland Red Dragon
Knights.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$But I don't think many people here have
heard of them.
$#Spica(Spica)#$$&SpicaSerious&$$@Right@$Red Dragon? Not the Round Table?

$#Spica(Spica)#$$&SpicaSmile&$$@Right@$I've always wanted to join the Knights of
the Round Table!

$#Spica(Spica)#$$&SpicaHappy&$$@Right@$They're the best in the world! Nobody can
beat the Knights of the Round Table!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$The best in the world, you say? Well, I'd
love to meet them sometime.

$#Spica(Spica)#$$&SpicaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$They've guarded the King of Camelot for
more than a hundred years!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$Wow, that's magnificent... I've never
seen a castle like that before.
$#Spica(Spica)#$$&SpicaHappy&$$@Center@$And guess what! My dad used to be—
$#SpicaFather(Spica's Father)#$$&MaleVillagerAAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$That's enough, Spica. You're babbling.

$#Spica(Spica)#$$&SpicaSerious&$$@Left@$I'm not babbling! You used to be a Knight
of the Round Table! Why can't I tell—
$#SpicaFather(Spica's Father)#$$&MaleVillagerAAngry&$$@Right@$Hush, Spica!
$#Spica(Spica)#$$&SpicaScared&$$@Left@$Okay...

$#SpicaFather(Spica's Father)#$$&MaleVillagerASerious&$$@Right@$I'm sorry, Spica. I didn't mean to raise my
voice. But just cut it out, will you?

$#SpicaFather(Spica's Father)#$$&MaleVillagerASerious&$$@Right@$Sorry to you too, traveler. I didn't mean
to offend.

$#SpicaFather(Spica's Father)#$$&MaleVillagerASmile&$$@Right@$Let me offer you something warm to make up
for it. Won't you join us at our home?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$I'd love to, if you're sure that's all right?

$#Spica(Spica)#$$&SpicaSmile&$$@Right@$Oh? You're coming to our place? Yay!
You can tell us all about your travels!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$Are we...not in Rigland?
$#SpicaFather(Spica's Father)#$$&MaleVillagerASmile&$$@Right@$Spica does love stories. What do you say?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$Sure, let's go.

$#()#$I spent several hours taking a rest at
Spica's house.

$#()#$I regaled tales of my adventures with the
Red Dragon Knights.

$#()#$Spica listened intently, his eyes
sparkling.

$#()#$Even I got a little caught up in the
storytelling—
$#SpicaFather(Spica's Father)#$$&MaleVillagerASmile&$$@Right@$I hope you are now well-rested, traveler?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$Yes, and thank you so much for the soup.
It was delicious!

$#SpicaFather(Spica's Father)#$$&MaleVillagerASmile&$$@Right@$I'm glad to hear it. You're welcome any
time the sun is out, so I hope you'll stop by.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$Of course. I'd love to visit again.
Where Fates Converge

keys.DescriptionKey:
Found abandoned as an infant near a sarru settlement, Shanna is a human child raised by sarru foster parents. The settlement treated her as one of their own, and Shanna grew up with very little interest in her human origins. She has even gone so far as to fashion a hood with cat-like ears and braid her long hair into a tail in order to make herself look more sarru. 

Obeying sarru tradition, Shanna has just begun her five-year journey to hone her combat skills as a mercenary. She hasn't had much success so far, as her shy demeanor makes her seem ill-suited for the job.

The sarru of her settlement wonder whether one or both of her birth parents might have been great warriors. Shanna may learn something about them in her travels over the next five years, but for the moment, she is perfectly content for her true parentage to remain a mystery.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Even as the world crumbles, nothing draws a crowd quite as big as Mirai's.  

It only makes sense that people line up in droves to see a Vessel in person. Never mind the ugly business of the Requiem. Mirai's voice is that of the Goddess, and it's said that all who hear it are blessed.  

Indeed, reports of civil disturbance plummet in the wake of her concerts. Everyone seems just a little happier. Nothing actually changes for the people, of course. A happy song can't end a famine or turn back a flood. But it can make them forget for a time. 

It's her duty to make them forget.

CatIdolGirl01.name: Mirai
CatIdolGirl01.title: Sparkling Idol

Indeed, reports of civil disturbance plummet in the wake of her concerts. Everyone seems just a little happier. Nothing actually changes for the people, of course. A happy song can't end a famine or turn back a flood. But it can make them forget for a time. 

It's her duty to make them forget.

keys.IntroText:
"Though the clouds hang heavy,
I'll walk with head held high.

I've seen too many rainbows
to fear a stormy sky."

keys.DescriptionKey:
It's not that Mirai doesn't like being an idol. In fact, singing is the greatest joy she has in life. She sang long before she was put on stage. She thought, in her early days at the academy, that if she worked hard enough, they would let her leave and travel the world. 

She thought correctly. At ten years old, the Church began training her for the demanding lifestyle of an idol. She didn't mind the rigor, nor the invasion of her privacy. After all, her life was never really hers anyway. 

Sometimes she wishes she could sing as herself, without using the Goddess's voice. Just once, to see if the people still love her. 

She likes to think they would.

CatIdolGirl02.title: Sparkling Idol
CatIdolGirl02.description:

She thought correctly. At ten years old, the Church began training her for the demanding lifestyle of an idol. She didn't mind the rigor, nor the invasion of her privacy. After all, her life was never really hers anyway. 

Sometimes she wishes she could sing as herself, without using the Goddess's voice. Just once, to see if the people still love her. 

She likes to think they would.

keys.DescriptionKey:
A voice is an instrument. It puts thoughts into words, nothing more. It does not think for itself, and certainly doesn't have its own will. 

That was her first lesson as an idol. She came in with a juvenile scrapbook of song ideas, only to be told she would never sing them. The ones she had written for her were made by true artists, she was told. She couldn't expect to ever match them. 

Mirai understands, in a way. But she can't stop scribbling down poems, or plucking out the melodies she hears on the wind. They might be the work of an amateur, but they are hers. 

And she hopes one of them can live on once she's gone.

Say it with me, everyone!
Trick or treat!♪

keys.DescriptionKey: When her concert is finally over, Mirai stealthily goes to enjoy the festival. After growing up in a poor home, the endless rows of candies seem like a dream to her. A little embarrassed, a little happy, she takes as much as she likes.

CatIdolHalloween02.name: Mirai
CatIdolHalloween02.title: Halloween Idol
CatIdolHalloween02.description: When her concert is finally over, Mirai stealthily goes to enjoy the festival. After growing up in a poor home, the endless rows of candies seem like a dream to her. A little embarrassed, a little happy, she takes as much as she likes.

keys.DescriptionKey:
After the festival, she returns to her room. Her eyes are heavy and her feet are sore, but she can still hear people's cheers ringing in her mind. People's hopes, and the laughter of children, rise as if from the grave. She smiles to herself, alone in her room.
"Trick or treat."

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusPainful&$$@Right@$Maybe they've grown bolder on the surface...

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusPainful&$$@Right@$You'd better watch it! I'm starting to get

$#DeadSoulA(Dead Soul A)#$$&UndeadMobScream&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Uwaaaa!
$#DeadSoulB(Dead Soul B)#$$&UndeadMobScream&$$@Right@$Uwoooo!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$!-1!$$@Right@$The dead are gathering!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaShouting&$$@Left@$Cerberus, no!!!
$#DeadSoulA;Cerberus;DeadSoulB(Cerberus)#$$&UndeadMobNormal;Cerberus.CerberusPanic;DeadSoulB.UndeadMobNormal&$$@Left;;;Cerberus.Center;DeadSoulB.Right;@$Wait, are you trying to crush me!?
$#DeadSoulA;Cerberus;DeadSoulB(Cerberus)#$$&UndeadMobNormal;Cerberus.CerberusPanic;DeadSoulB.UndeadMobNormal&$$@Left;;;Cerberus.Center;DeadSoulB.Right;@$Hey, stop it! Stooop! I can't breathe—
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hang on, Cerberus! I'm coming!
$#DeadSoulC(Dead Soul C)#$$&UndeadMobScream&$$@Center@$Uwaaaaaaa!!!
$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusNormal&$$@Center@$Permanent...?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Cerberus, reach out your hand!
$#DeadSoulA;Cerberus;DeadSoulB(Cerberus)#$$&UndeadMobNormal;Cerberus.CerberusHurt;DeadSoulB.UndeadMobNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Cerberus.Center;DeadSoulB.Right;@$Finn...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$All right, we're out!

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusLookAway&$$@Right@$Why didn't they listen to me...?
It wasn't like that in Hell.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Maybe it's because of that weapon—

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusSurprised&$$@Right@$Yeah... I can't use them right now.

$#CerberusGigant(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusShock&$$!-1!$$@Center@$So the souls were afraid of the Hands...

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusShock&$$@Center@$Which means, without them I'm completely

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusColdSweatSuper&$$@Center@$...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSleep&$$@Center@$As in, we'll never see that person again.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Don't be so hard on yourself. If you lack skills,

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSadSmile&$$@Left@$That's right. You have exceptional talent.
$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusColdSadSuper&$$@Right@$Stop trying to comfort me...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$I understand how you feel, Cerberus, but

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$They're your responsibility.
$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusColdSadSuper&$$@Right@$Mine...?

$#RedDragonKnightB(Red Dragon Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Marshal, we've pinpointed a potential

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Center@$We might find the cause there.

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusSad&$$@Center@$A permanent...goodbye...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Right@$That's a pretty dramatic sulk,

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Do you know anything about this place?
