$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Left@$These flames seem more spiritual and
powerful.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Left@$I think they should work on the souls
on the surface too.

$#Onyx(Onyx)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Cerberus, as the future ruler of Hell,
this is something only you can do.

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusNormal&$$@Center@$Something only I can do?
As the future ruler of Hell!?
$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusExcitedHappy&$$@Center@$This. Is. So. COOL!!!

$#Onyx(Onyx)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Center@$Your flames can bring the souls on the
surface back to their senses.

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusUltraHappy&$$@Center@$Hmmm... This must be the might of
the Ruler of Hell!
$#Onyx(Onyx)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Center@$Once that's done, they'll return to Hell.
$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusHappySmileOPen&$$@Center@$The souls on the surface...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Cerberus, please!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$If the invasion continues, our fellow knights
and the people of Rigland will suffer!

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusShySmile&$$@Right@$Fine, fine, no need to beg... I couldn't say no
to your request anyway! I'll do it!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShocked&$$@Left@$Wait, you're planning to go alone!?
Are you sure that's a good idea?

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusHappySmileOPen&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Of course! I'm not a child anymore.
Well then, I'm off!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSurprised&$$@Center@$Hmm, only I should be able to travel
between Hell and the surface.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSurprised&$$@Center@$And yet there she is, doing it too...
And so effortlessly at that...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSmile&$$@Center@$Onyx, you were telling the truth,
weren't you?

$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&LudmillaYukataSurprised&$$@Center@$This is absurd! 
Why are the burning souls calming down?

$#Onyx(Onyx)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Center@$Of course.
It's in her nature.
$#Onyx(Onyx)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Center@$As another Primordial of Death...
$#DeadSoulA;DeadSoulB;DeadSoulC(Dead Souls)#$$&UndeadMobScream;DeadSoulB.UndeadMobScream;DeadSoulC.UndeadMobScream&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;DeadSoulB.Center;DeadSoulC.Right;@$Uwaaaaa!!!
$#RedDragonKnightA(Red Dragon Knight A)#$$&RedKnight&$$!-1!$$@Center@$H-Heeeelp!!!

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Do I hear a Red Dragon Knight being all
scared and pathetic?

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$Just wait until Marshal Ludmilla hears
about it!
$#RedDragonKnightB(Red Dragon Knight B)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Center@$No way!
$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusHehOpen&$$@Center@$Souls of the dead, this isn't your place.

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Things might be tough right now, but keep
the fire in your heart burning—
$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusUltraHappy&$$@Center@$The warm fire of memories!
$#YoungCerberus(Young Cerberus)#$Onyx, Onyx, look at this!

$#Onyx(Onyx)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Center@$I can't wait to brag to Pearl about having
such a capable subordinate.
$#YoungCerberus(Young Cerberus)#$Who's that?

$#Onyx(Onyx)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Center@$She's a Hell manager, like me.
Her domain is to the east from here.

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusHeh&$$@Center@$The manager of Eastern Hell...
Her name was "Pearl," right...

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusUltraHappy&$$@Center@$Hey, Peeeeearl!
Come oooooout!

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusUltraHappy&$$@Center@$Lady Cerberus has graced you with her
presence! Bring me some delicious gifts!

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Center@$You should be the one bringing gifts
when visiting.
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Center@$Cough, cough.
$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Are you Pearl?
$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Left@$Yes... Cough. And you are?

$#Onyx(Onyx)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Center@$Infernal Hands...
You've mastered them already?

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusUltraHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You're a Hell manager and don't know me?
Do you live under a rock or something?

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusUltraHappy&$$@Center@$I am the future ruler of Hell!
The cute and illustrious Lady Cerberus!
$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Lady...Cerberus?
$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusHappySmile&$$@Right@$You've heard of me, haven't you?

$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Left@$Not at all. I have no knowledge of you.
Cough.

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusLookAwaySweat&$$@Right@$Well, whatever, that doesn't matter.
I'll still work for you.
$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusHehClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Leave the management of souls to me!

$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$We have enough help as it is.
Please leave. Cough.
$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusPanic&$$@Right@$You sure about that?

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusPanic&$$@Right@$Look at how skillfully I wield these
Hands. Impressive, right? You know it is!
$#YoungCerberus(Young Cerberus)#$Am I awesome or what? Huh, huh!?

$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Those are Onyx's Infernal Hands...
Are you affiliated with them?

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusHehClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Well, I was, but it got boring, so I left.
Of my own free will, of course.

$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Center@$Giving those Hands to a mere
subordinate is quite unthinkable.
$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Center@$Who is Onyx to you, exactly? Cough, cough.

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusSmile&$$@Center@$Uhhh... A foster parent?
Something like that.
$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Center@$So Onyx raised you...
$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I think the question we should be asking here is who Onyx is to you?

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusUltraHappy&$$@Right@$A lover? Nah, no way. As if anyone would
ever date Onyx.

$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Left@$My relationship with Onyx? Cough, cough.
Just a bond between two spiritual beings.
$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Left@$We were both created at her wish...

$#Onyx(Onyx)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Center@$I admit, I'm impressed.
Fine, I'll lend them to you.
$#()#$We were born around 2000 years ago.

$#()#$What I felt first after birth was a faint, sweet
scent and cold, chilly air.

$#Aria(Girl)#$$&AriaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Spirits of Death, "Onyx" and "Pearl."
Are you awake?
$#Onyx(Onyx)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Where are we?
$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Left@$Who are you?

$#Aria(Girl)#$$&AriaSmug&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The consciousness is firmly established...
It appears I was successful.

$#Aria(Girl)#$$&AriaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$This is the Judgment Hall. All souls
flow here to await their sentence.

$#Aria(Girl)#$$&AriaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Just beyond those doors lies the place 
where the innocent are reborn into
$#Aria(Girl)#$$&AriaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$their next life—Reincarnation Chamber.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSmug&$$@Center@$And I am the one to judge them, Aria,
Primordial of Death.
$#YoungCerberus(Young Cerberus)#$Really?
$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Lady Aria...

$#Onyx(Onyx)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Right@$So, you're our creator?
What do you want from us?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You're rather cheeky, Onyx.
Yes, I created you.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSmug&$$@Center@$Your purpose will be to oversee Hell,

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSmug&$$@Center@$the realm where souls burdened with sin
and lingering attachments are sent.
$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Center@$Are we to punish these souls?
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Punishing them will not be your priority.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Your primary task is to instill the desire for
reincarnation.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSmug&$$@Center@$I want you to save them all, no matter
their sins or lingering desires.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSmug&$$@Center@$Can you do that for me?

$#Onyx(Onyx)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Center@$But don't neglect your training. You need to
do your best to become worthy of them and—

$#Onyx(Onyx)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$We can. We were created for that purpose.
We'll help them find hope for their next life.
$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Left@$As you wish, Lady Aria...

$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Left@$We'll dispel any lingering regrets
from their past lives and save them all.
$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Center@$So, that's how we... Cough.
$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Center@$You're not listening to me, are you?

$#CerberusGigant(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusUltraHappy&$$@Center@$Listen up, souls! I am Cerberus, the ruler
of Eastern and Western Hell!

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusClosedEyesSerious&$$@Center@$I will treat you all as equals, without
discrimination. How noble of me, right?

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusUltraHappy&$$@Center@$If you understand, then show me the
respect and veneration I so deserve!
$#DeadSoulA(Dead Soul A)#$$&UndeadMobNormal&$$@Center@$Uwaaaa...
$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusHappySmile&$$@Center@$You must first kneel and bow your heads.

$#YoungCerberus(Young Cerberus)#$Who cares about that, Onyx!
I look strong, right? That's enough for me!

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusHappySmile&$$@Center@$Those of you who refuse will face the
crushing force of my Hands!
$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Cerberus, did you hear anything I said?

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusHappySmileOPen&$$@Right@$Of course. Blah blah, something something
Aria, right?
$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusHappySmileOPen&$$@Right@$Must've been so tough for you—
$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Left@$You weren't listening at all.

$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Left@$And please refer to her as "Lady Aria..."
Cough, cough.

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusSmile&$$@Right@$By the way, are you okay? Is it like one of
those "colds" that humans catch on the surface?
$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusSmile&$$@Right@$I didn't know you could get that here.

$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Left@$It's not a cold... Cough.
No need to worry.
$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusHappySmileOPen&$$@Right@$Well, if you need anything, just let me know.
$#Onyx(Onyx)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Center@$You are such a handful...

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusHappySmileOPen&$$@Right@$I'll take good care of you! It's the least I
can do since we're going to be co-workers.

$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Left@$How about you return to Onyx for now?
Cough.

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusIrritate&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No can do! I'm not going back to that meanie
anytime soon!

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusPainful&$$@Center@$If you don't hire me...I'll spread rumors about
Eastern Hell's awful living conditions!
$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Center@$Are you threatening me?
$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusHehClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Of course not! It's publicity.
$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Center@$...

$#Cerberus(Cerberus)#$$&CerberusUltraHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Don't worry. I'll take care of any trouble.
I've got this!

$#Pearl(Pearl)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Left@$Onyx, I resent you a bit right now...
Cough, cough.

$#Onyx(Onyx)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Center@$But yes, being able to use them already
is remarkable.

Convinced that what's scary to her must also be scary to others, she dons dog ears in order to give herself a menacing aura. And as for the boy, she keeps the memory of their meeting safe in her heart.

Whenever this unit gets the turn, if all enemies are sleeping, the next damage this unit deals with an Attack while on the battlefield will ignore any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the targets from being defeated. This effect cannot trigger again until 100TU advances and cannot stack.

When this unit enters battle, all allies will be granted Coral Barrier for 100TU. A unit with Coral Barrier will gain 35% damage reduction from attacks. This effect can stack with other damage reduction effects such as Armor, but will not stack with itself or other ally Barrier type skills.

While this unit is on the battlefield, at the end of this unit or an ally Suimori's turn, all allies will:
- Gain Coral Barrier for 100TU.
- have Burn and Poison status effects (including Lethal Poison) removed.

as broad and as vast as the horizon.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Rizette has never spent a New Year in the capital.

She's heard the stories, of course. Dancers puppeting magnificent dragons weave up and down the streets; revelers light the moonless sky with fireworks and lantern light. Families will travel from across the kingdom to spend one night at home, and everyone's made so much food, not a soul goes hungry.

To a country girl like her, it sounds too exciting to be real. But she does have a question.

What is she to wear on a night as grand as that?

keys.IntroText:
"The fireworks, the stars, the lanterns...
None can outshine her tonight."

keys.DescriptionKey:
Rizette's hometown welcomed the New Year warmly, but with little fanfare. She remembers the fragrant bread and soup her mother would make, how she and Theo would run around the house, banishing evil spirits with brooms and feather dusters. After dinner, with bellies full and fire crackling, her father would lean back in his chair and read from their book of fairy tales. Theo always fell asleep before he finished.

Compared to the lanterns and fireworks of the capital, the New Year of her home is nothing. But she misses it all the same.

keys.DescriptionKey:
"It's been such a lovely night. Lovelier than I could have imagined."

"Hmm? Oh, yes. This is my first New Year I've spent in the capital. Did something give it away?"

"Well, you can't blame me for staring at a sky like this. It's beautiful. Like the stars have come down to celebrate with us. I've never seen anything like it!"

"Nights like tonight, when everyone in the world is smiling...don't they remind you what's worth fighting for?"

"Yes. Happy New Year, friend. Let's stay beneath this sky a little longer."

keys.value: $#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonNormal&$$@Right@$I have something to ask you. Is that okay?

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinComplain&$$@Left@$Hmm, when the time comes, I probably
will be.
$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockSadHappy&$$@Left@$That's why they're so close, I guess.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinLookawayCheeky&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Even if you compare the current perfect
code and the backup, you won't find my data.

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonStareSweat&$$@Center@$We have to identify only Chopin's data
within the perfect dataset...

$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockPanic&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Sh-Should I feel like dying again to buy
time!?
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSweat&$$@Right@$What kind of idea is that—
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That's it.

$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockShock&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Huh!?
Okay! I'll try!
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSighSweat&$$@Right@$No, Anya, not that.

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonTongue&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I realized—this program is repaired and
perfect. Not a single defect.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Center@$??
It is.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinComplain&$$@Left@$But as for the current me... I'm not in
despair or troubled or anything.

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonGrit&$$@Center@$I knew it, Chopin. You want to live, don't
you?
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinDoya&$$@Center@$Not at all. I've always been ready to die.
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonGrit&$$@Center@$Liar. If you'd already wanted to die...

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonGrit&$$@Center@$your data would've been missing, like
Anya's was.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSurprisedHappy&$$@Center@$!?
No, that's not...

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonHehHappy&$$@Center@$If we compare the backup to the dataset
with only your data missing,
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonHehHappy&$$@Center@$we can pinpoint your data.

$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So if Chopin wants to die now, then we can
all go back together...
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonHehHappySmile&$$@Right@$That's right.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSweat&$$@Center@$So you wanting to die is the condition for you
returning alive... A contrarian to the end.
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinLaugh&$$@Left@$If I spend every day thinking about my illness, that will make me sick.
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSadLookaway&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I thought dying was my true desire...
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonDoyaSmile&$$@Center@$Still lying, I see.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinShy&$$@Center@$It's not a lie... I did. But... Talking to
you again... Seeing your passion...
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonDoyaSmile&$$@Center@$Well, Chopin?

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonDoyaSmile&$$@Center@$You have someone you care about right in
front of you. Say everything you want to say.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinBlush&$$@Center@$I want to stay with you, Washington!
Forever!
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonHehHappySmile&$$@Center@$Well said. I feel the same.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinBlushComplain&$$@Center@$Ah, damn it! This isn't how it was
supposed to go...
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinBlush&$$@Center@$I can't believe you outsmarted me.
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinBlushHappy&$$@Center@$I'm so embarrassed I want to die!

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonPout&$$@Right@$That doesn't sit right with me. If you know
you are going to die, why don't you fight it?

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinDoya&$$@Left@$Everyone dies. In my case, I just know it
ahead of time, Washington.

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSweat&$$@Right@$Hmm... It's unsettling...
No, I'm angry now!

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinWinkHehHappy&$$@Left@$That's a bit vague, Washington.
You ought to be more rational.

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSighSweat&$$@Right@$That habit of yours—hiding behind clever
words. It's annoying, you know that!?
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinComplain&$$@Left@$Why are you angry? You started this topic.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinCheeky&$$!-1!$$@Center@$But well, if you ever outsmart me,
I might feel so frustrated I'd want to die.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinLookawayCheeky&$$@Left@$Why so formal? Normally, you'd jump in
my face and say "Give me answers!"
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinCheeky&$$@Center@$Remember that, Washington.
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonStareSweat&$$@Center@$Outsmart you, huh...
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinWink&$$@Center@$There is a way.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinWink&$$@Center@$A special method to rectify the current
situation!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSurprisedClose&$$@Center@$A way to keep Anya alive without
triggering the Requiem?

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinCheeky&$$@Center@$Exactly. Watching you struggle was
fun, so I didn't bring it up.
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSweat&$$@Center@$Seriously... If you have an idea, just spit it out!
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Center@$Sure thing. I've had my fun.
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Center@$First, you're misunderstanding something.
$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockWorry&$$@Center@$Misunderstanding?
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonStareSweat&$$@Right@$I-I only do that sometimes.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Center@$The idea that when Anya wakes up,
the altered reality
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Center@$will be undone.
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonComplainSweat&$$@Center@$Hold on... What do you mean?

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinDoya&$$@Center@$Maybe I phrased it poorly. It's not wrong,
but it's not exactly true either.
$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockWorry&$$@Center@$???

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Center@$Let's review the steps for undoing the
reality alteration.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Center@$We force Anya awake, and the system
exceeds its processing limits.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinHeh&$$@Center@$That triggers the safety system. The Ex
Machina resets, and the altered reality is
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinDoya&$$@Center@$nullified.

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSurprised&$$@Center@$So the condition for undoing the alteration
isn't Anya waking up, but the safety
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinCheeky&$$@Left@$Fine, so what is it?
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSurprised&$$@Center@$system triggering...?
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinWink&$$@Center@$Yes, exactly.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSweat&$$!-1!$$@Right@$E-Exactly what, now? I don't follow.

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSmile&$$@Left@$It's the safety system that triggers the
reset, so if we remove the safety system,

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSmile&$$@Left@$Anya can wake while keeping the alteration
in place.

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSmile&$$@Left@$You only need to understand that we
need to destroy the safety system.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewHuh&$$@Right@$I see...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSweat&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Wait, should we really destroy
something called "the safety system"!?

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Center@$There are downsides, of course. If we
remove it...

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Center@$Anya will never be able to use any Ex
Machina again.

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonNormal&$$@Right@$It's about your illness...
It's hard to ask about this kind of thing.
$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockSurprised&$$@Center@$What?

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Center@$She won't even be able to deploy her Aegis,
let alone alter reality.

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonNormal&$$@Center@$Because Dragon Head will devote all of
its resources to life support.
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinTongue&$$@Center@$Exactly. I knew you'd understand.
$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockSighSweat&$$@Center@$I won't be able to use Ex Machina...
$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockSerious&$$@Center@$Okay, let's do that!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSerious&$$@Center@$Anya, are you sure?

$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockSadHappy&$$@Center@$Yeah... Saying goodbye to Aegis hurts,
but that's probably the best choice!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSerious&$$@Center@$If you're okay with that...

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSmile&$$@Center@$So, how do we find this safety system,
exactly?

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinWink&$$@Left@$Ah, that's why you're acting all stiff. What do
you want to know about it?

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinDoya&$$@Center@$Remember when you first came into this
dimension?
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonStareSweat&$$@Center@$Huh?
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSerious&$$@Center@$And as to the reason I'm here...

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinCheeky&$$@Center@$I am Dragon Head's management
division and its safety system!
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinCheeky&$$@Center@$—Its safety system!
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonAngry&$$@Left@$You told us right away...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSweat&$$@Right@$Which means...
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Your one remaining option...
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinCheeky&$$@Center@$Is to kill me!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewHuh&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonStare&$$@Right@$In broad strokes, how do you feel about it?
Do you have any regrets or worries?
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSighSweat&$$@Left@$...
$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockSadHappy&$$@Center@$...
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSurprisedHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Huh?
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSigh&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Sigh... We're done with that discussion.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSmile&$$@Right@$No one is dying or watching anyone else
die today.

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonPout&$$@Left@$She's right, Chopin. No one here will
allow you to sacrifice yourself.
$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockHappy&$$@Center@$Yes!

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinComplain&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Strange... You were all supposed to be
deeply troubled by my proposal...

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSighSweat&$$@Right@$And you'd smirk while watching us? You
are impossible.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinCheeky&$$@Left@$But really, I'm already dead, so if
someone has to go, shouldn't it be me?

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Left@$No, not really... I don't feel much of
anything.
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinCheeky&$$@Left@$A meaningful death. Ta-daa!

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonStare&$$!-1!$$@Center@$There's no meaning in death, Chopin. The
only meaning is in living.

$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockHappy&$$@Center@$Yes. Let's all return to reality, including
you, Chopin!
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSurprised&$$@Center@$Me? Back to reality?
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonHehHappySmile&$$@Center@$Exactly! Well said, Anya!

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonHehTongue&$$@Center@$Chopin, your personality data is incorporated
into this world too, right?
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSurprised&$$@Center@$Since I serve as administrator, yes.

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonHehTongue&$$@Center@$Then if we salvage your data from Dragon
Head's code, we can restore you!

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinTongue&$$@Center@$Impossible. Salvaging requires backup
data.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinLaugh&$$@Center@$Dragon Head's data is set so it can't be
backed up!

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonStare&$$@Right@$But you're going to die, right? Aren't you
scared?

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSurprisedHappy&$$@Center@$Oh... "Can't"...
Washington, does that mean...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$She made a backup before coming here.
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonHehHappySmile&$$@Left@$There's nothing I can't do.
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSweat&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You simple creature...

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSweatBig&$$@Center@$But! The data I'm composed of is
scattered within the code!

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSweatBig&$$@Center@$It's impossible to salvage precisely only
my components from this sea of data!
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSweat&$$@Center@$Wha...!
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinLaugh&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hahaha! My desire to die wins!

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonStun&$$@Right@$Why you!
Hold it! I'm still thinking!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewHuh&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Two peas in a pod...
$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockSighSweat&$$@Center@$Okay, we should be safe here...
$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockFlusteredMini&$$@Center@$That... That's not okay!!

$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockNormal&$$@Center@$So that I can deliver my last words to Astri...
That was your intention all along?

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmileKind&$$@Center@$Exactly. Or did you think I had you hold a
mic all this time just for my amusement?
$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockFlusteredMini&$$@Center@$Well... Yes...

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonLookawaySad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Chopin... Do you seriously think Anya should
die?
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSadLookaway&$$@Left@$If there is no other way.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$But I want to give her at least some sense
of comfort.
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSad&$$@Center@$...

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinWink&$$@Center@$Ah... Maybe this is what you meant by
calling me a well-meaning good-for-nothing.

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSad&$$@Center@$Anya, what about you? What do you want
to do?

$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockSad&$$@Center@$I... I... If this is really the end, I want to
tell Astri how I feel.
$#Requiem(Anya [???])#$$&AnyaNewSmile&$$@Center@$I want you to disappear, Anya.
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSerious&$$@Center@$Do you think she will accept it?
$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockShy&$$@Center@$I don't know...but...
$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockSadsmile&$$@Center@$Astri is on the stage. I'm going!

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh dear, off she goes. Before we've finished
talking.

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSweat&$$@Right@$Because you keep saying incomprehensible
things.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmileKind&$$@Left@$You don't want it to end like this, do you?
Aren't you going to stop her?
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonLookawaySad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What could I possibly say to her now?
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmileKind&$$@Center@$Kind as always.
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinHappySmile&$$@Center@$All right, you can wait here.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSadSmile&$$@Center@$Farewell, Washington—my beloved
partner.
$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockWorry&$$@Center@$!!
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSad&$$@Center@$Chopin!

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonLookawaySad&$$@Center@$Why did you have to go with such a sad look
on your face...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSweat&$$@Center@$A-Anya!?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSweat&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Are you all right!? What happened!?
You're hurt!
$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockHurtSad&$$@Left@$Ugh... As...tri...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSweat&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Did you do this...?
$#Requiem(Anya [???])#$$&AnyaNewSmile&$$@Center@$That's right, Astrid. I did it.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSweat&$$@Center@$Why? Why would you hurt yourself?

$#Requiem(Anya [???])#$$&AnyaNewSmile&$$@Center@$There's only one reason. Because it's my
desire. That's what I want.
$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockPanic&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Now, can you tell me what your desire is?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSad&$$@Center@$What you want...?
$#Requiem(Anya [???])#$$&AnyaNewSerious&$$@Center@$For Anya to never wake up.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSweat&$$@Center@$No...
$#Requiem(Anya [???])#$$&AnyaNewSmile&$$@Center@$Don't be so shocked, Astri.

$#Requiem(Anya [???])#$$&AnyaNewSmile&$$@Center@$If Anya's main personality disappears, she
will stay asleep.

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonPout&$$@Center@$Stop talking nonsense. We didn't
come here for this.

$#Requiem(Anya [???])#$$&AnyaNewHappy&$$@Center@$Oh, don't worry. Even if she doeasn't
wake up, all of you can still return to the
$#Requiem(Anya [???])#$$&AnyaNewHappy&$$@Center@$outside world.
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSerious&$$@Center@$That's not what we want to hear—

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmileKind&$$@Center@$She's right. You can return by satisfying the
wishes of all Anyas.
$#Requiem(Anya [???])#$$&AnyaNewSad&$$@Left@$My desire?

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmileKind&$$@Center@$So, as long as she is satisfied, you'll be able
to leave.
$#Requiem(Anya [???])#$$&AnyaNewSmile&$$@Center@$I'll be perfectly satisfied if Anya—if I don't wake up.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSweat&$$@Center@$Please tell me, Anya... Why don't you
want to wake up?

$#Requiem(Anya [???])#$$&AnyaNewSerious&$$@Center@$I saw so many people die... Kill each other.
It was painful and sad. I never want to see
$#Requiem(Anya [???])#$$&AnyaNewSerious&$$@Center@$it again.
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Center@$You mean the Requiem.
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSweat&$$@Center@$Wait, there wasn't any Requiem!

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSweat&$$@Center@$The Vessels of Shinano Academy lost their
Gifts, and Requiem didn't happen.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinNormal&$$@Center@$No, there was a Requiem. It might've been
orchestrated, but it really happened.
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinNormal&$$@Center@$I saw it through Anya.
$#Anya(Anya [Mic])#$$&AnyaRockPanic&$$@Right@$Yes, tell me what you want.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinNormal&$$@Center@$It was gruesome. All those girls, killing each
other.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSurprisedClose&$$@Center@$An orchestrated Requiem... Are you talking
about that Pseudo-Requiem thing...?
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSweat&$$@Center@$That was real?

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinNormal&$$@Center@$Who knows. I can't interact with the real
world, so I don't know what's real.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmileKind&$$@Center@$For me, this is happiness. And I believe it
was the right choice.

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonComplainSweat&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It's fine—I know the person who manages
this place.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSad&$$@Center@$Chopin...

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinCheeky&$$@Center@$Well, my greatest happiness is seeing
people's troubled faces!

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonSigh&$$!-1!$$@Right@$That's Chopin for you. Some things never
change—even after death.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinLaugh&$$@Left@$If death fixed me, wouldn't that be sad?
Hahaha!
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonPout&$$@Right@$Geez... You really are the same as ever!
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinWinkHehHappy&$$@Left@$Hehe, same can be said for you, Washington.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSweat&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(I can't tell if they get along or not...)
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Center@$Now then, back to the main topic.
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Center@$You came here to wake Anya up—right?
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonNormal&$$@Center@$Of course.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewHuh&$$@Center@$(The person who manages it...?)
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewNormal&$$@Center@$Chopin, do you know what is wrong?

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinDoya&$$@Center@$It's a sensitive matter. It wouldn't be fair
for us to discuss it alone.
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Center@$So, I thought I'd invite the person herself.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewHuh&$$@Center@$"The person herself," meaning?
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinTongue&$$@Center@$There is only one "herself"—come on out!
$#Chopin(Chopin's Fingers)#$$&ChopinTongue&$$@Center@$Snap!
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSurprise&$$@Center@$Huh...? Wh-Where am I...?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSurprised&$$@Center@$A-Anya!?

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Astri...?
Why... What are you doing here...?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSadSmile&$$@Right@$Anya!! Thank goodness! Are you all right!?

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonPout&$$@Center@$You're here, right, Chopin? Stop being
mean and come out.
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSurprise&$$@Left@$Uh, um... What?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSadSmile&$$@Right@$I'm sorry! I'm just so happy to see you.

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaVerySad&$$@Left@$Astri... I... I don't really understand what's
going on... But it looks like I made
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaVerySad&$$@Left@$you worry...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSadSmile&$$@Right@$Don't apologize, Anya! But, actually, the
problem isn't solved yet...
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaNormal&$$@Left@$H-Huh...?
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That's right, it isn't resolved.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Center@$Because you're the conscious persona of
Anya. The real issue lies within your
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Center@$subconscious.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Center@$Deep down, you feel like you don't want to
return to reality.

$#???(???)#$$!-1!$My, my, I was hoping to see you two panic
a little more.
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Center@$That's why you won't wake up.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSurprisedClose&$$@Center@$No way, why...!?

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinDoya&$$@Center@$Not sure about all that... In any case, if we
can make Anya's subconscious want to
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinDoya&$$@Center@$return to reality, she'll wake up.

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Washington, can you extract and rewrite
the code?

$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonStare&$$@Right@$I haven't determined the exact sections yet.
But if we can access the cause, like you say,
$#Washington(Washington)#$$&WashingtonStare&$$@Right@$then maybe...
$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinSmile&$$@Left@$So, it's possible. I'm counting on you.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridModernNewSad&$$@Right@$Wait, Chopin. Wouldn't that plan strain
Anya's mind?

$#Chopin(Chopin)#$$&ChopinComplain&$$@Left@$I have no intention of harming the girl
I sacrificed my life to save.

keys.DescriptionKey:
She and Washington had been close collaborators since their student days. Together, they took on countless robotics competitions, sweeping up awards left and right.
Whenever they were called a genius duo, she would tease Washington to hide her own embarrassment—and be promptly scolded by her friend. That was happiness for her. Chopin wished those days could go on forever.
And yet, deep in her heart, she knew her illness was quietly but steadily getting worse. But even as her mind lingers on her approaching mortality, she nevertheless spent her days teasing Washington like usual.

keys.DescriptionKey:
After graduation, the two were conscripted by the RDO and tasked with leading the "Dragon Head Project."
Together, they were able to perfect the theoretical basis for the device, as well as almost completing the construction of the device itself. But one final obstacle stood in their way: the device required a computational core on par with a human brain. This became the single, glaring void in their otherwise perfect blueprint.

In that moment, an answer flickered in Chopin's mind.

—Of course. They could just extract someone's actual brain to use as a substitute.
And with so little time left anyway, she was more than willing to be that someone.

keys.DescriptionKey:
It was her own decision to complete the Dragon Head Project in exchange for her life. She believed it was the best solution—and understood, at the same time, that it was a foolish one as well. Even so, she felt no regret. It was a path only someone with so little time left could choose.

Chopin delights in teasing and confounding others, in watching their troubled faces that follow—but she is no villain. She wouldn't hesitate to offer her hand to a person in need, and she would be eager to do anything to make the world a better place.

She has convinced herself that this was the optimal choice. And yet, there was something that lingered in heart. A childish hope that Washington would scold her for doing something so reckless. This little wish was absorbed into the Dragon Head along with her consciousness.

If she could redo that fateful debate once more... maybe this time, Washington would be able to scold her.

...just maybe.

Category: 
Primary Source:

When she set out on her mercenary journey, Shanna thought she would only learn the ways of combat. As it happens, she's discovered Christmas too.

The human holiday mystifies her a bit. The saru are a generous people, but they are also practical. They exchange gifts all year long with little fanfare. So why do humans tie them up with bows and leave them under a tree? Why do they build cookie houses without eating them? Why do people gather to sing songs in the snow? Aren't they cold?

There's much she still needs to learn, but she thinks she likes this strange celebration of theirs.

"Oh, you made it! Welcome!"

"Do you want some eggnog? A candy cane? How about a gingerbread man?"

"The market didn't have any more turkies, so I caught one myself! Did I make it right? It's over there, next to the pancakes. Go sit by the fire, I'll bring you some!"

"Huh? Why did I make all of this for you? It's Christmas, isn't it?"

"...n-not for two more days?"

"..."

"Just think of it like a Christmas ambush, okay?"

keys.value: $#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Center@$...how I hate my dreams.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSadSmile&$$@Right@$It's okay to take comfort in a dream.
Especially when reality is hard...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeCry&$$@Left@$I'm sorry. Everything went wrong when I
died. Everything went so wrong...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Hypnos, please! We need help, or we'll be
trapped in this dream forever!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Left@$Please don't resist.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHurt&$$@Right@$Nngh! Hypnos! Come on, Boss!
$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasAngry&$$@Left@$Do you think he's still asleep?!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$Boss, you absolute nincompoop!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I want to wake up. I need to face the sins
I've committed.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Center@$If you stand in my way... I can show you
no mercy!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHurt&$$@Center@$(She's gonna kill me...!)
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Right@$Aah! An earthquake?!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Center@$Ah?!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Center@$W-what was...?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I won't let you do this!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Left@$Theo...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$...I liked this dream. It was a little sad,
and a little painful...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSadSmile&$$@Right@$But it felt so familiar. Hanging up the
laundry with you, helping you make dinner...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSadSmile&$$@Right@$It was great. Everything we lost...
We had it back for a little while.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$I wish we could have kept dreaming,
if only for a little longer.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Left@$Wait a minute. You know about the real
world?
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Left@$...you're not part of this dream, are you?
$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasAngry&$$@Left@$No, the dream is falling apart!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That's the real Theo's soul...!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You shouldn't be here. You should have
gone on to your rest...!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$@Right@$I'm not going anywhere. Not without you
and Finn!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Even in death, he strives to keep her
on the right path.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I'm sorry for tricking you. I just didn't
want to remind you of my death.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$I'm glad I could be here. I failed to save
you once, in the real world...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$And now I see why. It has to be Finn.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteClosedEyes&$$@Left@$...stop it.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$@Right@$But you're running from him. You're
afraid to face him and see.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$What happened, Riz? You were always
so much braver than I was.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$She's pushing us away!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Left@$...I realized something. Love is a poison.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$Huh...?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteClosedEyes&$$@Left@$I ruined everything when I died. Finn
lost sight of what mattered...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteClosedEyes&$$@Left@$And you died. If love caused it all to fall
apart, then I don't need love.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Left@$I just have to make it go away. But... I...
it's not working!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$So that's what this is about.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Center@$You don't want to suffer anymore.
Neither do I. But...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$@Center@$Do you really want to die ripping out
your own heart?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Center@$Hey, look! On the horizon!
$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasAngry&$$@Left@$We've been recognized as intruders!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Aria)#$Finn's castle... It's changed shape.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Aria)#$That's the Endless Pyre!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Alice)#$Why?! Is Finn still under Orcanix's
influence, even in death?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Aria)#$Was his soul that deeply corrupted?!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSerious&$$@Right@$...Rizette. I have yet to judge your and
Finn's souls.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSerious&$$@Right@$Dream though it may be, this world is
also a limbo of sorts for you two.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeNormal&$$@Left@$So if Finn stays here, he'll be condemned
to suffer forever?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSerious&$$@Right@$...yes. If he cannot be persuaded to move
on, this is where he'll remain.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Left@$So it's not just me who would suffer,
then...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$Aria. If Rizette gave up on Finn...
Could she be saved? Alone?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Now I remember. I killed you, didn't I?
Theo...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Left@$What are you saying?
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSerious&$$@Right@$...it might be possible.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Left@$You're saying I should just leave him?!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSad&$$@Right@$What about Theo? I bet he'd stay here
if you went on ahead.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Left@$Theo...! No. I won't let that happen.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$I don't want to leave anyone behind
ever again. Let's go find Finn, together.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Left@$...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$We're all with you. Here, I'll even
make you a special treat:
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Center@$Behold, the Midwinter Express!

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasNormal&$$@Center@$My word, a steam-powered sleigh! We'll
reach the Pyre in no time!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$...!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSmug&$$@Center@$Then leave the monster-culling to me!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Center@$I'll use magic to light the way. Even in
the dark, I'll make stars to guide you!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Center@$...why would you go this far just for me?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Why wouldn't we? Isn't this what holidays
are all about?
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasShouting&$$@Left@$Now hush up and take our hands already!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Right@$Alright! I've got your hand, Riz!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Left@$H-hey, don't pull me!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteClosedEyes&$$@Left@$...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSadSmile&$$@Left@$...your hand is so warm.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Okey-dokey! Attendants, at the ready!
The Princess is embarking!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$@Left@$I'm not a maid, and Finn's no prince.
We're nothing more than monsters.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Center@$Wait a minute, this is... a self-driving
sleigh?
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSmug&$$@Center@$Of course! I warn you, it's going to be very bumpy. Hold on tight!

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasNormal&$$@Center@$All clear! Midwinter Express, Reindeer
Line: full steam ahead!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Left@$We killed so many at Orcanix's behest.
I don't deserve to dream like this...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Nnnh...
Mm...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Right@$No, Aria. You did the very best you
could to help them.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Right@$And... I saw the two of them at the end.
Holding hands, and going into the light.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSurprised&$$@Left@$Huh...?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Right@$They saved each other. Thanks to your
help, I'm sure!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaHappy&$$@Left@$I... I see. They did it...!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Right@$Why not sleep a bit more? You do better
work when you're asleep, I think.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Left@$Hey...
$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$@Right@$So? What are your thoughts?
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSurprised&$$@Left@$My thoughts on what?

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$@Right@$Your dream! We didn't make it to the
Ball, but it was a fine adventure, yes?
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAnnoyed&$$@Center@$...!!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Left@$It was awful. I didn't get to wear a pretty
dress, so minus 10,000 points.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Right@$You and dresses! I think that deer
costume suited you just fine.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Left@$Silence! I don't want it to suit me!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaNormal&$$@Left@$But... I suppose it was fun enough.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Right@$Really?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I got to see many forms of human
kindness.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaNormal&$$@Center@$Twisted, injured, aching, and bleeding...
But still warm, and gentle.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSmile&$$@Center@$So many hearts beginning to beat
together as one...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Center@$...love is a form of kindness, I think.
Their love was, at least.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$They were both good people, after all.
And so were all their friends.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Ah, you're awake. Want some cake?
It'sh really good. ♪

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$@Left@$Indeed! And that dream was our present
to them!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Right@$Haha. It really was.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Right@$...I guess it's about time we moved on
to the next dream.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Left@$Right...
Well, good work today...
$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$@Right@$Why do you look so downhearted?!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Left@$This always happens.
Always...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$Poor thing. Are you always alone down
here?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$...I am now, yes. Not that I'd say I'm
lonely, just—

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Right@$Then look forward to tonight! We might
swing by your dream for a little visit.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Left@$I don't want to be a deer again, you hear
me?!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaScared&$$@Left@$Rizette? Finn...?
What happened?!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Right@$We'll make you a bear instead, then!
We can have a lovely picnic.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Left@$Hrmph.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Right@$Be sure to bring more cake!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Left@$Alright, alright, fine! Get going already!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...just a cake would be dull, though. We'll
need madeleines, and sugar candy...
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Center@$Rizette, Finn. What is it like, where you
are now?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Center@$Is the sky blue, or red? Is it cool, or hot?
Are the winds gentle or fierce?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Center@$I pretend I know everything, but I know
nothing about the other side at all.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Center@$If I could know just one thing...
I would ask...
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Left@$Don't tell me... are they still...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Can you still feel the warmth of each
other's hands? I hope you can...
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Right@$...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Left@$Did they vanish into nothingness,
along with the dream...?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$T-this is all my fault. I failed to guide
them properly...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Left@$Because I selfishly invaded their
dream...!

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Hey! Watch where you're going, you nearly made me drop my stuff!"

"What are you rushing around for, anyway? All the good stuff in this market's already been snatched up. Don't tell me you're one of those people who put their shopping off to the last minute."

"...sigh. Of course you are. I should have guessed."

"Well, don't just stand there. Follow me. I know a couple places that can help you out, but you better not do this again, you hear? The people in your life must really care about you. What's the point of Christmas if you don't give them something special?"

She's already checked her list."

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Merry Christ -- what? You again? How'd you find out where I live?! If you followed me home, I swear..."

"One of the kids let you know, huh? I keep telling them not to bother with strangers, but they never seem to listen."

"Hey, you weren't a stranger, you were -- a charity case! You were wandering around so lost, it would have been bad karma to leave you on your own! Anyway, why did you even come here?"

"...to give me a thank you present. Yeah, right. There isn't a thing in the city left to buy."

"Huh? You made it yourself?"

"..."

"Guess it'd be even more bad karma to turn you away now. Fine, fine, come in. But watch where you're going. I didn't buy all these gifts just to have 'em stepped on."

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Hey. Sorry to bother you so late at night."

"How did I find your place? Easy. I followed you. You're not hard to miss."

"...I know. I'm a horrible hypocrite, aren't I? But I didn't want the night to pass without paying you back for earlier."

"I don't like leaving people hanging. And I thought you might be going home lonely. Holidays can get pretty quiet once the parties are over."

"N-not that I'm inviting myself in. I just brought you one last Christmas present. That's all."

"...I can stay as long as I want?"

"..."

"Thanks. I think I'd like that.""Merry Christmas. Now shut the door before you let in the cold."

keys.value:
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Center@$There are those who do not deserve
forgiveness, nor desire it.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Left@$...I thought she was talking about
Finn. Was she not?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSad&$$@Right@$I... suppose we shall.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$...your hand, please.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSadSmile&$$@Right@$...okay.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSad&$$@Center@$People are so complicated. Especially
when they hate themselves.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Center@$But I do love watching them come to
love themselves again, little by little.

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasNormal&$$@Center@$Miss Alice! We have to hurry.
We're late, we're late!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Center@$Oh, whoops!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Center@$Just remember, it's okay to dream.
If it helps you move forward...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Center@$Come visit us anytime, in my merry
little wonderland!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Center@$Peace be to all, and may your Midwinters
be ever warm and bright!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Look, if you can't rest in peace, maybe
we can do something to help you out!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearShouting&$$@Left@$...I was already at peace enough when
I met Rizette here.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$You were?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Left@$I prided myself on living with honor.
But I threw it away when I died.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Left@$Some part of me could never forgive
myself for my wretched behavior.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$@Left@$When I saw how Rizette hated herself,
I must admit, I felt relieved.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSad&$$@Left@$I was... glad I was not the only one.
As pathetic as it is to say.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$I wouldn't say that...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearShouting&$$@Center@$Forgiveness alone will not save them...!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Left@$But then you came, seeking to redeem
her. And not just her, but Finn, too.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$...were you lonely? It must have felt
like we were leaving you behind.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Left@$Not particularly. I was just envious
watching her move toward the light.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$I'm sorry. I should have seen that she
wasn't the only one who needed help.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearShouting&$$@Left@$Stop. I don't want your pity. None of you
could ever save me, in any case.
$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitAngry&$$@Right@$You are a stubborn one, aren't you?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(She'd be so much happier if she just
admitted she was lonely...)

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Center@$(If we just left her here, we'd totally
ruin the festive mood.)
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Okay then... Who could save you?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearClosedEyes&$$@Left@$I... no one.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Honestly, you don't know when to give
up, do you?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Right@$No, you just thought of someone.
What if you could meet them?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSad&$$@Left@$I...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Alrighty, then! They'll be here in a jiffy.
It's a good thing we're in a dream!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSurprised&$$@Center@$——?!
That spirit... what did she do?!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Center@$This is... no...
Last Bastion's outer wall...
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Astrid.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...no. Not like this. You are nothing but
a shadow.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Center@$Do I look like a shadow to you?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...hmph. That spirit truly overstepped
her boundaries.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$@Right@$Fine, then. I am honored to meet you
again in death, Commander.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$@Left@$...it isn't fair.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Left@$Stop that. Cheap sarcasm doesn't suit
you.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Right@$Neither does heartlessness suit you,
and yet, here we are.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$...I saw the destruction of the wall as
a necessary evil.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Left@$But seeing what it made of you, what
it led to... perhaps I was wrong.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$@Right@$...it's a little late to think about that now,
don't you think?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$I suppose so. Death hasn't proven as
enlightening as I expected.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$The lives I saved with cruelty; the lives
you would have saved with kindness.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillasad&$$@Left@$Standing here, I feel like it would have
happened the same way, regardless.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$@Right@$You've grown humble in death. I have
never known you to admit defeat.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$It seems meeting a real hero rubbed
off on me, unfortunately.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$What isn't?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$I had an opportunity to give my life
for my people, and I did.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$I'd do it again, if I could. With no
hesitation, and few regrets.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Right@$...is that meant to insult me?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$What?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You were always loved. Father favored
you, and the Vanguard worshiped you.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Center@$You died a hero's death. Not like me,
the undead traitor...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Center@$How nice for you, to die with your
head held high and your pride intact.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Center@$I thought one's conduct was everything
in life. But... only the last moment matters.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearClosedEyes&$$@Center@$What you see, what you do, what you
keep and what you throw away.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearClosedEyes&$$@Left@$...never mind. Hurry up and expel me
from this place like the outsider I am.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Center@$That moment alone is what determines
the worth of your lifetime.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSad&$$@Center@$And my life was worth...
So very little, in the end.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...could you say that to Mysha's face?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Left@$I believe she would beg to differ.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Right@$...don't.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$Do you disagree?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearShouting&$$@Right@$Enough. I will not forgive anyone—
Not myself, and not you, either.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Right@$I will let this dream tear me apart
before I admit you were right.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$Alright. Then I'll stay here as well.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSurprised&$$@Right@$What?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$You know, I noticed you only started
being cruel when Alice and Aria arrived.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$You intend to vanish here, right?
I'll accompany you.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$We died apart in life. If nothing else,
we'll face our final end together.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Right@$...fool. You absolute, utter fool.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$I've set down all my burdens now.
I can afford to be foolish.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSad&$$@Right@$...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$@Right@$...Ludmilla. May I ask one thing?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Yes?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSad&$$@Right@$That night... how likely was it that my
plan would have succeeded?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Left@$...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Large force of undead approaching. Close
the Inner City gates and harden defenses.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Left@$Huh? What do you mean?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSerious&$$@Center@$I recommend setting up dragonfire traps
in unpopulated sectors of the Outer City.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Center@$Star Platoon will lead the undead into
these traps, as possible. End message.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$Well...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$@Right@$You saw a true hero with your own
eyes, after all.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$@Right@$Could justice and goodness truly have
survived, in that city?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Or did I live and die a fool?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSad&$$@Right@$I... just want to know the truth. Please.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$...you made it possible for justice
to survive there.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSurprised&$$@Right@$What?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You defied Orcanix and refused to use
her corrupted dragonfire.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$Who is it you mean when you say,
"those who don't deserve forgiveness?"

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Center@$That changed the world. It was the first
stone of humanity's rebuilding.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$Only someone like you could have done
that. Not me, not your father.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSad&$$@Center@$...you haven't answered my question.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Center@$It's not easy for me to put this into words,
you know. It hurts.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Did I injure your steely heart?
Haha... I see.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSad&$$@Right@$Even the smallest stone, among
thousands, may build something new...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$...it's time. Time to awaken from this
dream.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSad&$$@Right@$I know.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearClosedEyes&$$@Right@$...I would like to see Mysha again.
If I have the right to.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$Only you can decide that.
So... shall we go?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$Excuse me! Could I have a moment...?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$@Left@$Fairies?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Right@$That's right! Super-cute fairies who
give presents to good girls and boys! ♪

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Right@$This is my helper, Tavun Santa, and...
...and our pet deer!
$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasNormal&$$@Left@$(Come on, make a sound like a deer!)

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(What?! I have no idea what sounds
deer make!)

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasAnnoyed&$$@Center@$Uh...
B-beeeeh...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSmile&$$@Center@$Oh, I see. The world sure is strange
sometimes...
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasShocked&$$@Center@$(She actually bought it?!)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSadSmile&$$@Center@$More importantly, you're the ones who
helped me just now, right?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSad&$$@Center@$Thank you. But... you must understand,
I haven't been a good girl.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHurt&$$@Right@$Eep!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSad&$$@Center@$There must be others who need your
help, and deserve it more than I do.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSad&$$@Center@$Oh... why would you say something
so sad?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSad&$$@Center@$Because, I...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$I...?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidIrritated&$$@Center@$Ngh...!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$Riz. If we stay like this, we'll both be
pinned under the wreck in the riverbed.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$Your flame of unlife will be snuffed out.
You'll never come back again.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSadSmile&$$@Right@$You'll be free, Riz. You'll be saved.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteClosedEyes&$$@Left@$...right.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSad&$$@Left@$Right, Theo...
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasAnnoyed&$$@Left@$(S-she noticed us!)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidShouting&$$@Center@$Ah... aaah!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Are you okay?!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHurt&$$@Right@$Her memories are corrupting the dream!
$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasAngry&$$@Left@$Isn't there anything we can do?!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$...right! The bears! Everyone, grab a
stuffed animal!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSurprised&$$@Left@$What...?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Right@$Look, Rizette! Look at all the cute and
happy bears! Aren't they wonderful?!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Nngh... b-bears...?

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasNormal&$$@Center@$There's a cute rabbit, too! Here, go
ahead and fluff my fluffy tail!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Nnnnh...!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I couldn't help but notice your strange
outfits. Are you traveling performers?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...Rizette. Take my hand. Close your
eyes and breathe. There...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSad&$$@Right@$Hhh... Nngh!
Aah...!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Each soul has its own color, that burns
bright and clear and true.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSad&$$@Center@$Your soul is pure snowmelt, clear and
cold, the first breath of spring.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasClosedEyes&$$@Center@$I wish you could see it. I wish I could
show you your own beauty, Rizette.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Center@$Aria...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Aah...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSad&$$@Center@$...I'm sorry. I'm okay now.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Take it slow.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSadSmile&$$@Right@$I really am fine. My head just hurt a
little. Thank you for holding my hand.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$@Right@$And you two collected these stuffed
animals for me. How cute...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Left@$They really are! And these are all
yours, so take care of them, okay?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidBlush&$$@Right@$Oh, right... I guess I ended up defeating
a lot of monsters, huh?

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasNormal&$$@Left@$One, two, three...
I'd estimate just around 100.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSmile&$$@Right@$Now I'll get my Lady's permission for
sure! I just need to bring them back.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$We can help with that! Let me just
put them in my peddler's sack here...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSad&$$@Center@$...why are you all so nice to me?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressSurprised&$$@Center@$You really did defeat 100...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You did it, Riz! Well done!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSadSmile&$$@Left@$Will you bring us along to the Midwinter
Ball now, my Lady?
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasAnnoyed&$$@Left@$...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressSerious&$$@Right@$Yes. I don't know how you did this, but
I'm a woman of my word.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$@Left@$You mean it...?!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Yes. You have my permission to attend
the Ball.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSmile&$$@Left@$...!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressSerious&$$@Right@$But not in that outfit, I'm afraid.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$@Left@$Huh?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Who would wish to dance with a maid?
You do have a real dress to wear, don't you?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidSad&$$@Center@$W-we don't have enough money to...
I mean, we...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressSerious&$$@Center@$Then I assume you won't bring shame
to me or the Prince by attending.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSad&$$@Center@$But...
$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasAngry&$$@Right@$...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidCommand&$$@Center@$That's not fair.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I beg your pardon?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidAngry&$$@Left@$Riz did what you asked, and you won't
let her go? So much for your word!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidIrritated&$$@Right@$Theo! Please forgive us, my Lady...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hmph. It seems I have been lax in
my discipline.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSad&$$@Center@$(This is hopeless... but Theo's being
so brave, standing up for me.)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSad&$$@Center@$(And those fairies helped me out so
much, too. If I just give up...)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(If I just give up, I'd be a disgrace!)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSerious&$$@Center@$I'll have a dress.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSerious&$$@Left@$Will you let me attend the Ball if I
have a dress by the time we leave?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidHappy&$$@Right@$Riz!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressSerious&$$@Right@$......I suppose I can allow it.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressIrritated&$$@Right@$But you musn't forget your chores. If you
do, you will not attend. Am I clear?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSmile&$$@Left@$Yes... Yes, my Lady!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You did it, Riz!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Center@$She managed to turn it around!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSad&$$@Center@$For her sake... I hope so.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Um... actually...
We're, um... fairies! Yes!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Ugh, it's so cold! I'll freeze to death
before I even see a monster...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSad&$$@Right@$She just wants a simple, honest life
with her brother.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSad&$$@Left@$But things didn't work out that way.
$#Skeleton(Undead)#$$&Skeleton&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Grrr...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$Hya...?!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$There it is. Ghh... what a gruesome beast.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Right@$That's strange.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSurprised&$$@Left@$What is?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$My dreams are like fairy tales. They're
meant to be pleasant and refreshing.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$But that thing would make even a
Jabberwock turn tail and run...

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasAngry&$$@Right@$Maybe the dream is unstable now that
a certain someone's snuck in, hm?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSad&$$@Center@$...no. No more whining. You can do this,
Rizette.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasShouting&$$@Left@$Hey! You're a stowaway too, you know!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidShouting&$$@Left@$Kyaa!
$#Skeleton(Undead)#$$&Skeleton&$$@Right@$Grraaagh!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$@Left@$Ow... n-no! Stay away! Don't hurt me!
$#Skeleton(Undead)#$$&Skeleton&$$@Right@$Grrrgggh!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidShouting&$$@Center@$Nooo!
$#Skeleton(Undead)#$$&Skeleton&$$@Center@$Gruuu...!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$Huh? Did... did I do that?
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$That strike was like her old self, at least.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$Her body remembers how to fight, even
if she doesn't. That's a relief!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSad&$$@Center@$It really is strange how familiar this
sword feels. It fits so well in my hand.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...huh? The monster turned into a little
stuffed bear?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidBlush&$$@Center@$...how cute.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSerious&$$@Center@$But I can't relax yet. I need 99 more of
these to show my Lady!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What was that, some sort of doll?
For ritual sacrifice, perhaps?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$No! It's just a cute little bear now, stop
making it creepy!
$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasAngry&$$@Left@$Hm? Ah, look! Our princess is in trouble!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Right@$Huh?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$Nngh! No matter how many I defeat...
There's always more!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$She's surrounded! Will she be able
to defeat them on her own?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$I know you want to help, but if we
interfere any more...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSadSmile&$$@Center@$With this sword... I can go anywhere.
Even to the castle...
$#Skeleton(Undead)#$$&Skeleton&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Gaaaaah!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$@Left@$Ow...!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSad&$$@Left@$It's no use. I can't get in any hits!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$She's bleeding! What happens if she
dies in this dream, huh?!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceClosedEyes&$$@Right@$......just wait.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasShouting&$$@Left@$No, I won't! I'm done with waiting!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Right@$Aria?!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Huh? The monsters are reeling?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSerious&$$@Center@$...it's now or never!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSmug&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Phew. It looks like she managed it.
Thank goodness.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSad&$$@Center@$Finn... I want to see you again.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$No, no thank goodness! She needs to
overcome this by herself, remember?!

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasAngry&$$@Right@$You asked for our help! It would be
nice if you didn't ruin all our efforts!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasShouting&$$@Left@$So you would prefer I just watch her
die?!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Right@$H-hey, quiet down, you two!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Um...

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$If she was really in danger, Miss Alice
would take care of it!

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasAngry&$$@Right@$Leave the dream work to the dream
experts! That would be us!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasShouting&$$@Left@$If you claim to be experts, then act
like it! Otherwise, I will—
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Excuse me! Could I have a moment...?
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHurt&$$@Right@$Eep!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$It seems she's forgotten she's a highly
skilled swordswoman.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasAnnoyed&$$@Left@$(S-she noticed us!)

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasNormal&$$@Right@$Indeed. Dreams may be nonsensical,
but they have their own logic.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$This Rizette is just a maid. She's never
killed, or been killed.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSad&$$@Right@$She doesn't want to be a hero.

keys.DescriptionKey: A noble title in Rigland comes with certain responsibilities. First, you must protect the lives of your people; second, their wellbeing; and third, their happiness. The hammer Mistelzweig, legendary weapon of Rigland's northernmost lord, takes care of those first two duties. His feasts ensure the last is never forgotten.
