keys.value: $#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHurt&$$@Center@$Wah! What a blizzard!
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$...are you alright?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Center@$Y-you...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Center@$Stand up, please. You're going to wrinkle
my dress.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Center@$My Lady... no. Astrid!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSmirk&$$@Center@$Oh, so you have awoken from your
dream? Welcome to the nightmare.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$@Center@$You have done well to make it this far
in that much-reduced state of yours.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Center@$I just want to see Finn. I want to put this
all to rest!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Center@$......simple-minded fool.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$The resonance of your soul... it's similar
to Theo's. Are you...?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$@Right@$You finally realized? Yes. I am no phantom
created by this dream.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$But I know Finn's waiting on the other
side. At the top of that tower...!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Left@$You're lost, too? Then it makes even less
sense. Was it fun, bullying me?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Not at all. But it was necessary. To keep
you isolated.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Left@$Isolated?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$@Right@$I am here to pass judgment. That is
the only reason I played along.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasAngry&$$@Left@$I judge the souls of the dead, not you!
How dare you claim that right!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Right@$I do it because you will not. Your
judgments are flawed and soft.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasShouting&$$@Left@$What?!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You let all souls pass beyond your throne.
Innocents, as well as those who killed them.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$@Center@$You give heroes and monsters alike the
chance to repent. That is wrong.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Center@$Those with blood on their hands should
never find their peace in death.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSad&$$@Right@$All the way up there...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$@Center@$...so I shouldn't forgive Finn for what he
did. Is that what you want to tell me?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$@Center@$Consider whether you truly desire to let
your regrets go. That is all.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$But wait, how did you get here? Theo
is related to Rizette by blood, but you...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSad&$$@Right@$...dreams are what connect all worlds.
Even the worlds of the living and the dead.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSad&$$@Right@$Everyone dreams of reunions with the
dead. Sometimes it's really them.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSad&$$@Right@$And this is a dead soul's dream already,
so it must be easier for them to visit...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSad&$$@Left@$...I see. So it's not just a dream for Finn
and Rizette.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSad&$$@Left@$These souls desire a truer peace than the
one I sent them to...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What is it you regret then, Astrid?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Left@$...wait! Stop! There's someone up ahead!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Center@$...how many lives would have been
saved, if you had not been turned?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Center@$What Finn did was terrible, yes. I'm
sure he knows that better than anyone.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Center@$I don't know if he'll be able to pull
himself back onto the right path.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Center@$But that's why I need to be there for him.
At least, until he can trust himself...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Center@$You really are naive.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Center@$And what's wrong with that?!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Center@$When I fought Finn at the end, he told
me how to kill him.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Center@$It was his one desperate effort to make
up for all the wrongs he'd done!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Center@$No matter how much of a monster he
became...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Center@$With that final act, he earned the right
to be forgiven!

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasAngry&$$@Right@$What?! We're going far too fast!
We'll never slow down in time!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...so be it. If you will not be swayed, then
strike me down.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Left@$Huh?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$@Right@$You can do that, surely? Your first task
was to defeat 100 monsters.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$@Right@$Your second, to create a dress. This is
your third and final task.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearShouting&$$@Right@$Take up your sword, or I will kill you
where you stand.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteClosedEyes&$$@Left@$...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Left@$It's a bit late to say now, but I never
liked that stubborn streak of yours.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Right@$And I have had it up to here with your
misguided purity!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$W-wait, what's going on?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Right@$No, stop! Fairy tales aren't supposed
to end like this!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasShouting&$$@Right@$Then change course! Hard leeeeft!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSad&$$@Left@$I'd like to back Rizette up here, but I think
they need to solve this themselves...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Get ready, Astrid!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearShouting&$$@Center@$En garde!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Left@$Aaaah!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasScared&$$@Left@$Ow... I saw my life flash before my eyes.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSad&$$@Right@$Phew. I managed to levitate you all,
but we got thrown pretty far there.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaNormal&$$@Center@$O restless souls, lay down your burdens
and your bonds. Be free...
$#Finn(Endless Finn)#$$&FinnBlackSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...
$#Rizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Right@$...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...it's no use. Nothing I say is getting
through.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Center@$I might have to ask for help after all...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Center@$Ugh, no. It's too bitter for me. Like a
poorly made Darjeeling.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Center@$Finn deserves a comforting, homey
kind of love. Like handmade scones.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I have no idea what you're talking about...
But wait, you know Finn already?!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Right@$The one who saved Erden, yes. I had no
idea your Finn ended up like this.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$Your work must be awful. So gloomy
and depressing! How do you stand it?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Left@$Silence! My work is sacred and holy.
It's fine! I don't mind it!
$#Finn(Endless Finn)#$$&FinnBlackSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Right@$I just can't imagine having to ask for
help to do my job, that's all.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Left@$That's why I called Hypnos. Why did
he send me his kid Avatar?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Right@$My boss is lazy. And it's far too chilly to get
out of bed these days, don't you agree?
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Right@$That's why I volunteered to help instead!

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You should be more grateful for our
charity, little girl.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Center@$Silence, herbivore! Unless you want to be
rabbit stew.

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitAngry&$$@Center@$That's animal abuse! Come on, then!
I've got a mean streak a mile wide!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$No fighting! Here, have some tasty
sweets and get along. Both of you.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Left@$N-no, I do not want any of your cake!
Stop stuffing your face already!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Right@$Are you sure? It's really good, you know.
$#Rizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Right@$...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Right@$Besides, I'll need sugar to turn this

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Right@$Whether your love bears fruit or not
doesn't really matter.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSad&$$@Left@$It did vanish right after I left the forest.
Sorry, Theo. I did like it a lot.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Right@$What matters is loving yourself, and
accepting the love you're given.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Right@$That's how I feel, at least.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSad&$$@Left@$...what if I can't love myself while I'm
in love with him?
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Then you need to let him go.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$@Left@$But...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Right@$I guess that would make you sad. But
that's what snacks and friends are for.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Right@$I'll stay with you until you feel better.
We can put a pie in Finn's face, even!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSadSmile&$$@Left@$Haha... that might make me feel better.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Right@$Anyway, you'll see him tonight. You can
find out how you both feel then.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSmile&$$@Left@$...you're right. You're surprisingly wise,
for someone so young.

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasNormal&$$@Right@$Oh, don't worry. That sword was actually
from Miss—
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Don't be silly! I'm just a cute little fairy.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSad&$$@Center@$(I need to be careful not to disrupt
the dream too much.)

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSad&$$@Center@$(If things go wrong... Rizette may never
wake up.)

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidAngry&$$@Right@$So if we don't want the dress to vanish,
we'll have to make it by hand.
Merry Christmas
A Deep Midwinter Dream

keys.value: $#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Left@$Pant... pant...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$@Center@$(Right. Theo beat me back then,
with strategy, not strength.)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$@Left@$If there's no way out, then we'll make
one. If you can't, then I will.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackSadLaugh&$$@Right@$...haha.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Left@$What is it?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackSadSmile&$$@Right@$It's just, you always bring me such
peace...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackSadSmile&$$@Right@$...thanks. I'd forgotten how beautiful
your smile was.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Left@$No... no, don't say that so sadly.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...I don't deserve your smile, or your
peace.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackClosedEyes&$$@Center@$I lost. Even before I knelt to Orcanix,
I'd lost to my own selfishness.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackSad&$$@Center@$I wanted to be a good man for you,
but I see now that I never was good.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Center@$Finn...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$@Center@$(I was a better swordswoman, but he
turned my strength against me.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackSad&$$@Center@$...I deserve to suffer in hell for what
I've done. More than anyone else.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackSerious&$$@Center@$But with you by my side... how could
I ever be in hell?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSurprised&$$@Center@$(The Pyre is shaking. The dream is
growing ever more unsteady!)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What's that sound?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackSerious&$$@Right@$A huge army of undead...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You... you!! I will not let you get in
their way!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Aria!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasShouting&$$@Right@$We're running out of time! The dream is
falling apart!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$@Left@$...I'll stay here.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSurprised&$$@Right@$What?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What are you doing? You shame your
training with this plodding footwork!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Left@$If Finn won't go, then neither will I.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackSerious&$$@Right@$No! You can't stay here!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$@Left@$Then neither can you. We leave together,
or not at all!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackSad&$$@Right@$No! Let go of my hand, please!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Left@$You want to rest, don't you? After all
this time?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSadSmile&$$@Left@$Here! Squeeze my hand. Let me feel
that you're here with me...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackSadSmile&$$@Right@$Rizette...
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasScared&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No! It can't hold any longer!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasShouting&$$@Center@$Rizette!
Finn...!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Left@$I've got you!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSurprised&$$@Right@$...?! You tricked me?!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Left@$She did it!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasHappy&$$@Right@$Well done, Rizette! Her hands are
bound to the wall now!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...I see. But if you leave me bound with
this blade, you will be left unarmed.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Center@$Do you think yourself able to reach
Finn in that state?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$@Center@$...it's fine. I don't need a weapon for what
I want to do.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSmirk&$$@Right@$Out of breath already? I see the power
of love is nothing special.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$But this tower's going to be crawling
with hundreds of undead...
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSmug&$$@Right@$Leave them to me. I'll protect you!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Left@$I'll keep an eye on our friend here.
You go on ahead!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I'll stay, too. I'd like to see him again, but...
This reunion is for you alone.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSadSmile&$$@Center@$Thank you, everyone...!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$@Center@$You will regret this.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearIrritated&$$@Center@$There are those who do not deserve
forgiveness, nor desire it.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearShouting&$$@Center@$Forgiveness alone will not save them...!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$@Left@$There are so many undead here...
Aria, how are you holding up?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSmug&$$@Right@$Who do you think you are addressing,
hm? I eat small fry like this for—

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$We have to hurry. The dream is
collapsing. We don't have time for this!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Left@$Behind you!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasScared&$$@Right@$Hywaah?!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeNormal&$$@Left@$T-that scared me. I didn't sense that
one approaching us at all.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasAnnoyed&$$@Right@$I-I knew it was there! I had it all under
control!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSadSmile&$$@Left@$It didn't really look that way...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasShouting&$$@Right@$That undead was strange, though. It
didn't resist my magic at all.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It did seem a little strange...
Let me have a look.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Center@$W-wait...!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSurprised&$$@Center@$What is it?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Center@$It's... it's the village chief. From my old
village.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasAngry&$$@Right@$Must we get involved...?!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasAnnoyed&$$@Center@$What?!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Center@$I-I know these undead, too! People we met
along the way... who helped us...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenEyesClosed&$$!-1!$$@Left@$......
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiClosedEyes&$$@Right@$......
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Everyone...
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSad&$$@Center@$They're just... staring, blankly...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeCry&$$@Center@$...I'm sorry. I'm so sorry, everyone...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(I don't sense any soul resonance.
These are just dream phantoms.)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeCry&$$@Center@$I'm sorry...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSad&$$@Center@$(...but knowing that won't make her
feel any better.)
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSerious&$$@Center@$(She must want to reach out to Finn in
part because she feels so guilty...)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$——Finn!
Finn, where are you?!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSurprised&$$@Right@$I don't sense Orcanix's presence, but
this place... something is wrong here.

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Three thousand, seven hundred
seventy-nine.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Center@$Finn?!

$#EndlessFinn(Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$Three thousand, seven hundred
eighty. Three thousand, seven...
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSurprised&$$@Center@$Finn...? What are you whispering?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Finn! Finn, it's really you!
Thank goodness. I was hoping—
$#EndlessFinn(Finn)#$$&DarkFinnGlowEye&$$@Right@$Out of my way...!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Left@$Kyaa!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$@Center@$...Riz! Remember the ship on the water!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$W-what are you doing, bastard?!
Are you truly Finn?!

$#EndlessFinn(Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$Seven hundred eighty-three. Three
thousand, seven hundred eighty...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...it's him. I know it is. But he can't
hear us.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSerious&$$@Right@$What is he counting?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Left@$Probably... the dead. The number of
people he killed...
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSad&$$@Right@$...I see. So these are his regrets.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Left@$Finn! It's me, Rizette! Please, listen to me!

$#EndlessFinn(Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Right@$Eighty... eighty...
Nn...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Left@$Finn...!
$#EndlessFinn(Finn)#$$&DarkFinnGlowEye&$$@Right@$Nngh... aah...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Center@$The... ship...?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Left@$Finn?
$#EndlessFinn(Finn)#$$&DarkFinnGlowEye&$$@Right@$Gaaaaaaah!!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Left@$Ngh...!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasShouting&$$@Right@$Rizette, you must arm yourself!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeAngry&$$@Left@$No! It's okay. I want to show him...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That I've put my weapon down for good.
That we don't need them anymore.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeShouting&$$@Center@$Put down your sword and hold out
your hands, Finn. Just like this...!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasShouting&$$@Center@$You fool, you're wide open!

$#EndlessFinn(Finn)#$$&DarkFinnGlowEye&$$@Center@$Aaaagh...
Aaaaaah!!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSurprise&$$@Center@$...!

$#EndlessRizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$You're full of openings. You might as well
have begged me to stab you.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasShouting&$$@Center@$Rizette... please, stop this. I can't bear
to watch.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...it takes courage to lay your weapon
down, in the dark, when you're alone.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Left@$But you remember, don't you? That
time you entrusted everything to me.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSadSmile&$$@Left@$You offered everything for me, even
your life... you were so brave then.
$#EndlessFinn(Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Right@$Uggh... ggh...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Left@$Let me see you, Finn. How can you
see anything in that armor?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSadSmile&$$@Left@$Here, let me take this off...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackSad&$$@Right@$...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSadSmile&$$@Left@$...there. Isn't that better? There's nothing
to be afraid of now.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackCry&$$@Right@$Riz... ette...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHurt&$$@Right@$...no.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeCry&$$@Left@$Finn...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackSad&$$@Right@$Nngh...!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSadSmile&$$@Left@$Stay with me, Finn! Here... lean against
me. Relax. I've got you.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackSad&$$@Right@$Ggh... Rizette...
I'm... sorry...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSadSmile&$$@Left@$It's okay. It's okay...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackCry&$$@Right@$I know you... didn't want me to. I...
I betrayed everyone. Betrayed you...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackSad&$$@Right@$But I... I was afraid. Without you...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackCry&$$@Right@$Without you, I...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteBlueEyeSad&$$@Left@$I know. I know, Finn. I was lost without
you, too.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnBlackSad&$$@Right@$...there's no way out for me. Not anymore.
I'll be lost here, forever.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidNormal&$$@Left@$My Lady? Where have you gone?
Breakfast is ready...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceClosedEyes&$$@Right@$(You're overthinking this. Everyone
dreams of those who've passed on.)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$...a sword?! But why...? Who would...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSad&$$@Center@$For some reason, it feels... very familiar.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasAnnoyed&$$@Left@$(Ah.......ah...!)
$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasAngry&$$@Right@$(Don't you dare sneeze!)
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$(Hold it in!)
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasAnnoyed&$$@Left@$(T-the fur...!)
$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasAngry&$$@Right@$(Pinch your nose! Pinch it hard!)
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasScared&$$@Left@$Kchoo!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Who's there?!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasAnnoyed&$$@Center@$(Now we've done it!)

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSurprised&$$@Left@$(Then... Rizette's consciousness created
them?)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Theo)#$$!-1!$Riz?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$@Left@$O-oh, Theo! It's open.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidSad&$$@Right@$I... just wanted to say sorry for earlier.
I shouldn't have talked to you like that.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidSadSmile&$$@Right@$I've always been proud of how strong you
are. I hope you know that.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSadSmile&$$@Left@$...there's no need to apologize. You were
just looking out for me.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSadSmile&$$@Left@$This sword's from you, right? I appreciate
the gesture, but you didn't have to...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidDespair&$$@Right@$Huh?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(No, it's not from him! It's from me!
It's a present from me!)
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidDespair&$$@Center@$Um, I...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidHappy&$$@Center@$...y-yeah, that's right. I got it just for you.
Do you like it?
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Right@$(It's only natural to suppose so.)
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$(Hey!!)

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitChristmasNormal&$$@Right@$(This young man knows how to roll with
the punches!)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...I can't stay like this. I can't be sad and
pathetic anymore.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidConcerned&$$@Right@$Riz?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidIrritated&$$@Left@$There's still time before lunch. If I leave
now, I can still kill those monsters.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidHappy&$$@Right@$Really?!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSmile&$$@Left@$I can't let your heartfelt gift go to waste,
can I?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidHappy&$$@Right@$Oh, Riz. I knew you had it in you. Just...
take care of yourself, okay?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSmile&$$@Left@$Don't worry, I'll be fine. Wait here for me
until I get back.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidConcerned&$$@Right@$...please, please be careful, Riz. You have
no idea what's out there.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSad&$$@Left@$(Really? Hmm... I wonder.)
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidSad&$$@Right@$...
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaChristmasSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Hm...? No idea?)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSadSmile&$$@Left@$My Lady, how did you like breakfast?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressClosedEyes&$$@Right@$...it was satisfactory.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSadSmile&$$@Left@$My brother picked the herbs for the
bacon especially—

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressIrritated&$$@Right@$Enough. Do you think I can't see through
this charade?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$@Left@$Huh?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressIrritated&$$@Right@$You never have anything to say, and now
suddenly you can't shut up.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$@Left@$Oh, my Lady! There you are!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressSerious&$$@Right@$This is about the Ball, isn't it?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$N-no, I...
Well...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressSerious&$$@Center@$If you have something to say, say it already.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSad&$$@Center@$I... I was wondering if I could... accompany
you... to the ball.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...hmph. I suppose I can allow it.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSadSmile&$$@Left@$R-really?!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressSerious&$$@Right@$On one condition. The road to the palace
is fraught with undead.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressSerious&$$@Right@$If we are attacked, you'll have to defend
us both.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressSmirk&$$@Right@$Prove you can do so by defeating 100
monsters before lunchtime.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDarkMaidSurprised&$$@Left@$100 monsters?!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressIrritated&$$@Right@$Enough shouting, please. My head will
split from all your noise.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearBlueDressSmirk&$$@Right@$I expect identifiable trophies.
Am I clear?

You have my gratitude.

$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&ChronosHappySmile&$$@Center@$Now, let us prepare for our intervention.
Please give me a moment.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(If a Primordial has no choice but to seek
human help, the situation must be dire.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Different times and places throughout
history could be affected.)

$#Chronos(Finn)#$$&ChronosNormal&$$@Center@$(Still, to think this woman is Chronos,
the Primordial of Time...)
$#Chronos(Finn)#$$&ChronosNormal&$$@Center@$(She doesn't exactly look the part.)
$#Chronos(???)#$$&ChronosNormal&$$@Center@$Have you awakened, Crestbearer?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(Come to think of it, is this room her
personal chamber?)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(It's just a vast open space. No furniture
or anything.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(Except for that stack over there... Are
those books?)
$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&ChronosUpset&$$@Center@$What are you doing, Finn?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Ah, sorry. I was just wondering what kind
of books a Primordial reads.
$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&ChronosUpset&$$@Center@$Do not tell me you opened any of them?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$No, I didn't—
$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&ChronosHappySmile&$$@Center@$That is not acceptable.

$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&ChronosComplain&$$@Center@$Rummaging through someone's private
possessions without permission is
$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&ChronosComplain&$$@Center@$a grave offense that undermines trust.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$How do you know who I am?
Hang on, this aura feels familiar...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$I-I'm sorry. It won't happen again.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(I was really curious what she was
reading, though...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(Well, no point thinking about it now.)

$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&ChronosHappySmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Our gate to the anomaly has been opened.
Are you prepared?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Yes, just say the word!
$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&ChronosHappySmile&$$@Right@$Follow me, then.

$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&ChronosNormal&$$@Right@$The anomaly has emerged roughly
1000 years ago.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$1000 years!?

$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&ChronosNormal&$$@Right@$It was also 1000 years ago that Rolotia
became my Avatar.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$So, we're heading to a time when she
was still human?

$#Chronos(???)#$$&ChronosNormal&$$@Center@$Your wealth of experience has granted you
quite a discerning eye.

$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&ChronosNormal&$$@Center@$Indeed. We will meet a version of her
there that you are unfamiliar with.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$A Rolotia I don't know, huh...

$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&ChronosNormal&$$@Right@$We have successfully infiltrated the
anomaly.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Where are we in terms of the present
world's geography?

$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&ChronosNormal&$$@Right@$The northwestern part of the Bergarian
Empire.

$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&ChronosNormal&$$@Right@$At this time, it was not yet very large, and
its settlements were sparse.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$(Bergaria of 1000 years ago...)
$#Woman'sscream(Woman's scream)#$$!-1!$Noooooooo!

$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&ChronosSerious&$$@Right@$It seems something is happening. What
will you do, Finn?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$It goes without saying! I have to help
whoever that was!
$#Chronos(???)#$$&ChronosNormal&$$@Center@$It is just as you suspect. I am a Primordial.

$#WeepingWoman(Weeping Woman)#$$&NatalieMobSurprised&$$@Center@$Where are you, darling? Please, answer
me!
$#Victoire(Wandering Child)#$$&VictoireScared&$$@Center@$Daaaad! Moooom!

$#AngryMan(Angry Man)#$$&MaleVillagerBMobScared&$$@Center@$How could this happen? Matilda! Where
did you go!?

$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&ChronosSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$It does not appear to be the work of
monsters or bandits.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$That's true. If it were, there'd be blood.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$(But if it wasn't monsters or bandits, then
what caused all this chaos?)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$(The houses and the town walls look like they
were destroyed in quite an unusual way...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Excuse me, can you tell me what
happened?
$#RelievedMan(Relieved Man)#$What happened? It was Flash!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Flash?
$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&ChronosNormal&$$@Center@$The keeper of time, Chronos.

$#RelievedMan(Relieved Man)#$Yeah, and I wasn't erased! Not like those
sinners... They must've been up to no good!
$#RelievedMan(Relieved Man)#$Stealing or something!

$#RelievedMan(Relieved Man)#$The gods are watching. Thank goodness,
thank goodness...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(He wasn't "erased"...?)

$#AngryMan(Angry Man)#$$&MaleVillagerBMobScared&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Don't talk nonsense! Matilda wouldn't do
anything bad! Ever!
$#WeepingWoman(Weeping Woman)#$$&NatalieMobSurprised&$$@Right@$That's right! My husband wouldn't either!

$#WeepingWoman(Weeping Woman)#$$@Right@$He'd always invite those in need to our home...
He was an angel!
$#RelievedMan(Relieved Man)#$Then why did they disappear, huh!?
$#AngryMan(Angry Man)#$$&MaleVillagerBMobScared&$$@Left@$There must be some other reason!

$#RelievedMan(Relieved Man)#$$!-1!$By the way, I don't think I know you folks.
You're not from around here.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Oh... So you're Chronos!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$You mean us?

$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&ChronosSerious&$$@Right@$There is no reason to be suspicious, I assure
you.

$#AgitatedMan(Agitated Man)#$$!-1!$We have plenty a reason, if you ask me!
Am I right?
$#SuspiciousMan(Suspicious Man)#$Yeah, they're very shady!
$#SuspiciousWoman(Suspicious Woman)#$Wait... Did you two cause Flash!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$Please, calm down! We didn't do anything—
$#AgitatedMan(Agitated Man)#$Seize them! Hand them over to the guards!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$We didn't do anything wrong! We just heard
screams and came to help!
$#AgitatedMan(Agitated Man)#$Ha! A pack of lies!

$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&ChronosSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$We cannot afford to be captured here, Finn.
We must uncover the cause of the anomaly.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Where are my manners! I'm a member of
the Red Dragon Knights—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Left@$I get it, but you can't expect me to draw
my sword on them!
$#Townspeople(Townspeople)#$$!-1!$Now's our chance! Get them!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$Crap... I'm going to have to fight them,
aren't I...

$#MadamElnora(Elderly Woman)#$$&OldLadySad&$$@Center@$Stop it, you lot! What do you think you're
doing!?

$#AngryMan(Angry Man)#$$&MaleVillagerBMobScared&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Madam Elnora, why are you stopping us!?
These people are responsible for—

$#MadamElnora(Madam Elnora)#$$&OldLadySad&$$@Left@$We've seen Flash a whole bunch of times,
haven't we? Were they here every time?

$#AngryMan(Angry Man)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Right@$Well... This is the first time I've seen them,
but...

$#MadamElnora(Madam Elnora)#$$&OldLadySad&$$@Left@$Exactly. I get how you feel right now, but
think for a second.
$#AngryMan(Angry Man)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Right@$Y-You're right... Sorry...
$#MadamElnora(Madam Elnora)#$$&OldLadyNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Now, travelers, come with me.

keys.DescriptionKey: Chronos, the Primordial of Time, not only has the magical capacities that rival the gods, she is also able to manipulate all forms of time at will. Yet, she imposed strict rules upon herself, lowering herself to the level of a time mage. For the power of time is a force to be feared—wielded without restraint, it can unmake the fate of the world itself.

keys.IntroText: Following the flow of time...

keys.DescriptionKey: As a Primordial, except in extremely rare circumstances, she forbade herself from interacting with humans. Her will and words were always conveyed to the world through Rolotia. Over time, Rolotia became more than just a conduit to the mortal world, she became one Chronos could call a true friend.

keys.DescriptionKey: Even Rolotia has no idea how Chronos usually lives. But one day, when Rolotia was visiting the Temple of Time, she paused in front of a particular door. From within, she could hear shrill cries of excitement and heavy breathing. This room was strictly off-limits, a room stacked high with books that should never be opened.

keys.DescriptionKey:
If Cinderella never met her fairy godmother, if she stayed at the ball past midnight, if she lost her best friend, if, if, if—
She doesn't wait for someone to grant her happiness, she reaches out and takes it for herself. She doesn't bother with promises, she just chooses whichever option looks interesting at the moment.
"And if anyone threatens Talia, I will crush them, no matter who or what they are."

From now on, there'll be no mercy—
not for begging, not for tears, not for anything

keys.DescriptionKey:
Once she wrapped herself in darkness, she tried to act accordingly. However, despite the fact that on the surface she seemed to have turned sadistic, at heart she was still the same kind girl she'd been before. Even when she was about to take away another person's power, she was courteous enough to explain the risks and get their consent.
The truth is, when she embraced darkness, she was secretly a bit happy that she was going to match her best friend now.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Cinderella's mother neglected her. She treated her like a servant and didn't spare a single thought even when she fell gravely ill. But Cinderella is different. No matter how tempting the darkness might be, no matter how dirty her hands might get, she would never stoop that low.
Because the only reason she reached for power beyond her own caliber was to save someone dear to her.

keys.DescriptionKey: As the Princess of Fresalia, Cinderella seemed out of anyone's league. Though domineering, sharp-tongued and extravagant, she had her pride and never discriminated against anybody, regardless of their standing. For that, she was loved by everyone.

CinderellaRegular01.name: Cinderella
CinderellaRegular01.title: Princess in Glass Slippers
CinderellaRegular01.description: As the Princess of Fresalia, Cinderella seemed out of anyone's league. Though domineering, sharp-tongued and extravagant, she had her pride and never discriminated against anybody, regardless of their standing. For that, she was loved by everyone.

keys.IntroText:
I'm so bored...
Somebody entertain me, this instant!

keys.DescriptionKey: Orphaned as a small child, she grew up in a poor household, under the eye of her wicked stepmother. She was forced to do everything around the house all by herself, and wasn't allowed to go out to play. The townsfolk always frowned at the dirty rags she wore, always gave her pointed looks. She was never loved by anyone—aside from one person.

CinderellaRegular02.name: Cinderella
CinderellaRegular02.title: Princess in Glass Slippers
CinderellaRegular02.description: Orphaned as a small child, she grew up in a poor household, under the eye of her wicked stepmother. She was forced to do everything around the house all by herself, and wasn't allowed to go out to play. The townsfolk always frowned at the dirty rags she wore, always gave her pointed looks. She was never loved by anyone—aside from one person.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The thing she was eventually overcome by was not a spell or a curse, but the same lung disease that took her father. Her body shaken by violent coughs, her throat burning, her eyes blurry, she felt that the dream she once told her father about—her dream to go to the ball at the castle—was slipping right through her fingers.
That is when a small hand knocked on her door.

keys.DescriptionKey: The Princess of Fresalia and her personal attendant were in high spirits when they set out for the seaside—Cinderella had been saving money to buy a swimsuit specially for this occasion, and couldn't wait to show it off. However, when she emerged from the changing booth, Talia was nowhere to be seen.

CinderellaSwimsuit01.name: Cinderella
CinderellaSwimsuit01.title: Princess of the Beach
CinderellaSwimsuit01.description: The Princess of Fresalia and her personal attendant were in high spirits when they set out for the seaside—Cinderella had been saving money to buy a swimsuit specially for this occasion, and couldn't wait to show it off. However, when she emerged from the changing booth, Talia was nowhere to be seen.

keys.IntroText:
Hehe, what's the matter?
Did I take your breath away?

keys.DescriptionKey:
As it turned out later, Talia had been called to the dream world to deal with an emergency. Unaware of that at the time—and thoroughly displeased—Cinderella sat on the sand to stare at the sea. She stayed like that for a long while, ignoring occasional compliments and pick-up lines, and mulling over one concern.
"Is Talia...embarrassed to be seen with me?"

As it turned out later, Talia had been called to the dream world to deal with an emergency. Unaware of that at the time—and thoroughly displeased—Cinderella sat on the sand to stare at the sea. keys.DescriptionKey:
And so, a secret wish sprouted in Cinderella's heart—she wanted social status that would allow her to stand by Talia's side as an equal. However, when an opportunity finally came to make this wish come true...she let it go voluntarily.
Because by that time, she had realized there was no reason to be ashamed of her current self—the one Talia was so fond of.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCollarHappy&$$@Center@$Ah, do look outside, Miss. See all
those rare roses? So lovely!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You like me?
We've hardly even met.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSinister&$$@Right@$See these marks under my collar?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Are those... curse marks?

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSerious&$$@Right@$Yes. A runic spell, engraved in Lord
Alastor's blood.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSinister&$$@Right@$If we spend too long apart, the curse
will activate and kill us both.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$What...?

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSerious&$$@Right@$Even if my heart's beat is stilled, the
power of the runes will bring me back.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSerious&$$@Right@$...but if I was told to die, I would.
For his sake.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceAngry&$$@Right@$He gave me everything I wished for.
I never want to lose it again.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceAngry&$$@Right@$I'll do whatever it takes to keep it
safe. Even kill.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$I see. Then... if Alastor commanded it,
would you kill me?

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSmile&$$@Right@$But I've heard so much about you,
Marshal of the Red Dragon Knights.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSad&$$@Right@$......
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceHappy&$$@Right@$Kuhuhu. You and your jokes, Miss.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaAngry&$$@Left@$Don't blow this off. I want an answer.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSinister&$$@Right@$...here, lie down and close your eyes.
I'll come to fetch you again soon.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hey, Clarice!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$...damn. She really thinks he cares
for her. I'm not getting through at all...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSadSmile&$$@Center@$But... for just a moment there, I saw
the old Clarice peek through.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSadSmile&$$@Center@$Timid, shy, and anxious... but with
kindness and warmth just below.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Center@$...I want to see her again.
The way she used to be.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSmile&$$@Right@$I daresay all of Erden has heard of
your glorious exploits in battle.

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSerious&$$@Right@$And Clarice has told me so much,
I feel as though I know you.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaAngry&$$@Left@$Well, I don't know you. And I don't
care to, kidnapper.

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSerious&$$@Right@$Ah, yes. My apologies for treating
you so roughly.

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSerious&$$@Right@$But I simply had to know why you
fled the royal capital.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$And that's not all I want to know... I had
heard you died. Like many of the Knights.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$(Roses... they're sensitive plants, and
have very strict requirements.)

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSmile&$$@Center@$Imagine my surprise when reports
came in that you had survived.

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSerious&$$@Center@$You were expected to lead the fight
against the Empire, I believe.

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSerious&$$@Center@$But you didn't. Instead, you handed
Lady Astrid to the enemy and fled.

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSerious&$$@Center@$The stories I'd heard hadn't led me
to believe you would do such a thing.

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSmile&$$@Center@$So, I would like to know why. Tell me,
and you will be free to go.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$(Even if he's telling the truth... I don't
think this man is to be trusted.)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Center@$(But he's also perceptive enough that
an obvious lie won't work on him.)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaAngry&$$@Center@$...when the attack began, Lady Astrid
ordered the Knights to flee the city.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaAngry&$$@Center@$I obeyed her orders.
Nothing more.

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSerious&$$@Center@$I see. She got you, the Knights' finest
warrior, free before capitulating.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$(If I can identify the cultivars, I should

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$Gah...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$(This voice... it's inside my head!)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$Wind, waves, trees, lights, people...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$Then this must be Alastor's estate.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSadSmile&$$@Center@$Mana...?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaShouting&$$@Center@$W-wait! I need to know more!

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$...I am Erden.

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$I say to you again:
There is a way out of here.

$#DoNOTSHOWME(???)#$Once, I was jealously guarded by

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaScared&$$@Center@$A new protector...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$Clarice...

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCollarSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You seemed quite lost in thought.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Left@$O-oh...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$Hm? What's that sound? It sounds

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Ah, young lady.

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$You have allies who will assist you,

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaScared&$$!-1!$$@Center@$S-stop it!

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You really are something. It's been

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorClosedEyes&$$@Right@$I simply want to teach you.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$Mana...?!

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The magic of Erden, born of mana,
is governed by strict rules.

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSerious&$$@Center@$These rules protect those who follow
them, ordinary magicians...

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorClosedEyes&$$@Center@$But they can be unforgiving to those
who are not ordinary.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Center@$What are you saying?!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$Allies?
You mean Nagi and Callen?

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSerious&$$@Center@$I am an ex-military man. I led the
Bergarian Magic Corps for decades.

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSerious&$$@Center@$Years of dirty, brutal work, years of
death... but sometimes, I saw miracles.

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorClosedEyes&$$@Center@$A washout mage stood alone against
an enemy force, and scattered them.

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorClosedEyes&$$@Center@$A soldier who had died minutes before
drew breath again... that sort of thing.

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSmile&$$@Center@$Under the right conditions, with the
right tools, humans can work miracles.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$(Is that what magic is capable of...?)

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSerious&$$@Center@$But those conditions, and those tools,
are very specific, you see.

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSerious&$$@Center@$Like an out-of-tune note can spoil a
whole movement... it must be perfect.

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSmile&$$@Center@$And you, Marshal, resound with that
perfect music like a symphony.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Who needs miracles? We work hard,
and struggle together to triumph...
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Let me show you.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaAngry&$$@Left@$That's much more beautiful than any
miracle!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaShouting&$$@Left@$I can't even use magic.
You must be making a mistake!

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSmile&$$@Right@$Ah, you have yet to see your potential.
Don't worry. I'll open your eyes.

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSmile&$$@Right@$Here is my hypothesis... and it is
almost certainly true.

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSerious&$$@Right@$You did not die in the ravine. Instead,
you became an Avatar.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaScared&$$@Left@$An... Avatar?

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I asked you before, if you recall, why

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSerious&$$@Center@$You fled to establish a resistance,

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaAngry&$$@Center@$What "newfound power?!" Enough of

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSmile&$$@Center@$I still don't know which Primordial you

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHurt&$$@Center@$S-so bright...!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Center@$(Am I... really an Avatar?)
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Center@$(Then, that voice in my head...)

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorShouting&$$@Center@$Now, Clarice. Carve the runes of

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCollarSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$The runes?

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSmile&$$@Left@$You've been so lonely lately, haven't

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSmile&$$@Left@$Why, she could even become your

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCollarSad&$$@Right@$Family...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaShouting&$$@Left@$Don't do it, Clarice!
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCollarSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I... I want to be happy.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCollarShouting&$$@Center@$I want to be...!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$What? What is this?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$It's like a giant map... no, not a map.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHurt&$$@Center@$Ghh...!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Like hell...!

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSerious&$$@Right@$The binding will take several more

$#Alastor(Alastor)#$$&AlastorSerious&$$@Right@$Take her to her room, Clarice, and

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCollarSad&$$@Left@$Yes, master...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(I can move! That stasis magic wore

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHurt&$$@Center@$Ah... nngh!

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCollarSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Take it slowly!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHurt&$$@Left@$(It does hurt, but I also feel faint.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCollarSad&$$@Right@$I'm sorry. I didn't realize the ritual

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Was it different when he did it to you?
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCollarCry&$$@Center@$Miss!

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCollarSad&$$@Right@$...I don't clearly recall much from

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCollarCry&$$@Right@$I've just made you suffer more...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSadSmile&$$@Left@$Don't worry. Rub some dirt on, spit

$#Endless Rizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteAngry&$$@Right@$...you won't be rid of me that easily.
I'm undying. Endless.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$This... this voice. I've heard it before.
In... in a dream?

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$A dream? That was no dream. Nor is this
conversation.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Center@$...then, I'm alive? I can... I can still fight?
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$...no. You did not survive your sacrifice.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$What?

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$The you who knows strength only in battle
has died.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaShouting&$$@Center@$Stop it. Stop...! What are you saying?!
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Ludmilla... do you see no value in peace?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaShouting&$$@Center@$Of course I do!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$Peace means safe, fulfilled, long lives
for all the people of Erden. I—

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaShouting&$$@Left@$If my sacrifice can spare their lives,
that's a trade I'm willing to make!
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$And what does it mean to you?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Center@$To me...?

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$It is past time you accepted it. You died
that day below the cliffside.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Center@$Then... then what am I? Am I undead...?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Center@$Am I... am I truly... alive?

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$From death comes life. For every end,
a new beginning...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Center@$Ludmilla!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$...!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$Are you alright? You were tossing and
turning like mad.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSad&$$@Center@$You must have been having a nightmare...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(...this is for the best. Truly.)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Center@$Ah... it was nothing. Halloween must be
getting to me, that's all.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Center@$(The same dream, three days in a row...
but a dream is all it is.)
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$(Calm down... breathe. You're okay.)
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...any word from Nagi?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenCalm&$$@Right@$Not yet... and no contact from Astrid yet,
either.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$I see. It may be wise to find a base
further from the Capital.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$We'll have to start collecting info and
supplies immediately—

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHeh&$$@Right@$You are very good at making work for
yourself. Lie back down and rest.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$There is no telling when we will get
another chance to relax, after all.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$And Halloween is a holiday. Even if it is giving you bad dreams.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Center@$(I've always wanted a proper death.
To die with honor, after giving my all.)
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Callen...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Bergaria's scouts fly overhead almost
every night. It's not safe to stay here.)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$(Callen must know that, but... she's
worrying for me and my condition.)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$(I appreciate it, but there's no need.
I can't fight, so I might as well—)
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Center@$Marshal! Lady Callen!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Center@$Nagi! Thank goodness. Are you hurt?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Center@$No. Thankfully, I am not...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$(Hm? I would have expected some of
Nagi's usual theatrics by now...)
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Center@$...forgive me.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Center@$I could find no information on Lady
Rizette or Sir Theo...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Center@$(So, this is...)

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Center@$Or on any other Red Dragon Knights
who may have been captured.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Center@$Instead... I have heard a most terrible
rumor.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$A rumor? What is it?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$That the Hero of Erden has sworn her
loyalty... to the Bergarian Empire.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaShouting&$$@Left@$Lady Astrid?!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$They say she has placed a bounty on
any surviving Red Dragon Knights.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Left@$...no, that can't be.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$Lady Astrid is the right hand of the
Queen of Rigland.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaShouting&$$@Center@$There's no way she would betray us!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaScared&$$@Center@$(...no. No... I'm scared!)
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Center@$Of course, I do not think it is true!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$That said... she may have been
captured by them. Or brainwashed.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$Then we have only one option.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaShouting&$$@Center@$We have to return to the Capital and
rescue her!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenCalm&$$@Center@$That would not be wise.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$Rigland is the most dangerous place
in the world for us right now.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$That is true. But I cannot help imagining
the peril Lady Astrid must be in...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$...do you think she might have put the
bounties on us to get us to flee?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Even if she did, we can't sit by while she's
in enemy hands.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$Don't you agree, Nagi? What would you do,
if you knew she was in danger?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaScared&$$@Center@$(I don't want to die!)

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Center@$Even knowing it was a trap, I would rush
to her side.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Center@$Nagi! You cannot let your emotions rule you!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Center@$I know, Lady Callen.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Center@$But if Lady Astrid truly is being made
to support Bergaria against her will...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Center@$Then I can scarce imagine how she must
be suffering, alone in that city.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Center@$Nagi...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenEyesClosed&$$@Center@$...alright. You win.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$But only if we can actually find her.
Otherwise, it is all just hypotheticals.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Callen...
Thank you.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$I hate all the uncertainty, too, you know.
I want her to be okay.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaShouting&$$@Center@$(I can still fight! I still want to fight!
For my friends... for myself!)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSad&$$@Right@$But we are wanted criminals now. We
need disguises to start investigating.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Left@$Disguises? Well, I daresay we couldn't
have picked a better season for those!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Right@$You really think Halloween costumes
are going to fool Bergarian soldiers?!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$No. I have a spell to keep them off our
backs. But you are not going to like it.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh... how terribly disappointing.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Center@$And here I'd started dreaming up our
ensemble's frightful attire.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Why aren't we going to like this spell of
yours, Callen?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$Well... it is not really a disguise spell
at all.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$Just a charm to make stranger's eyes
pass us over.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenCalm&$$@Right@$It should fly beneath most mages' senses,
but if we draw too much attention...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst371|$...!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst380|$Members of my Pandemonium Task Force!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst381|$...Yes ma'am!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst382|$...I'll do my best!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst383|$...These few days must have been tough
for you both.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst384|$And this trial is only the beginning of the
hardships that lay ahead.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst385|$I was just a child during the last
Pandemonium.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst386|$Powerless, I could do nothing to prevent the
tragedies occurring around me.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst387|$I became a knight to repay those who
protected me when I could not protect myself.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst388|$I did not think I would live to see this
maelstrom reoccur, but this time, I will fight.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst389|$Finn. You will need more than just that
crest to bring hope to the people of Erden.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst372|$Ahh, my eyes... It's so bright out here!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst390|$You must become a hero with the courage
to stand up and fight for this land.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst391|$Rizette, you too can be a ray of hope in
this darkest of hours.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|Cont|$You faced great adversity and survived.
Make your experiences into your strength.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst392|$Together, we will protect our homeland and
all its people. Together, we will save Theo.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst393|$And together, we will put an end to this
Pandemonium!
$#Finn;Rizette;(Finn & Rizette)#$$&FinnCommand;Rizette.RizetteAngry&$$@Right;;;Rizette.Left;@$$|act1.Voices/mst394|$Yes ma'am!!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSleep&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst373|$Fresh air...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst374|$Finn, Rizette...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst375|$Excellent work!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst376|$Captain!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst377|$I, Ludmilla of the Red Dragon Knights, do
recognize the Proving of Finn and Rizette!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst378|$We did it!!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst379|$You are now official members of the Red
Dragon Knights. And...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$I've never seen a monster like that before.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$You sure are a handful, Rizette.
It was tough work tracking you down.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$I-I'm sorry...but thank you for your help.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Right@$Right, let's get everyone outside.
Finn, will you explain the situation?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$So it was the Aeon Lord again.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$Everyone here is unconscious, but alive.
They must be under some sort of spell.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$I'm hopeful we can wake them up
when we get back to Rigland...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$@Center@$I hope so, too.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$That's great, Rizette!
Looks like Theo's going to be okay.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$And Finn, you'll hear this officially
from the Commander soon enough,

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$but let me just say...
welcome to the Red Dragon Knights.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Is this what Ossia meant
by her "creation?"
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$We have many challenges ahead of us.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$But with your help, I'm sure we can cut
through any darkness that comes our way.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$Thank you for having me, Captain!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Right@$She's been luring people here
to feed this monster... How cruel!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$It's a good thing we got here in time.
But how do we get everyone out of here?
$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Red Dragon Knights, at your assistance.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$The Red Dragon Knights?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Who would have thought it would
come to this...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$Captain Ludmilla!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$Apologies for the delay.
I came to support Rizette, as promised.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Aeon Lords aren't all created the same; some receive their Eternity simply to spread destruction during the Pandemonium, some for other purposes. Cleopatra was the latter—she was tasked with monitoring heads of state around Erden.
And so, she travels the world, asking the same question wherever she goes—a question that happens to mean a lot to her personally.
"What is a nation—its ruler or its people?"

keys.IntroText:
When she gazes into the void,
the void cannot resist gazing back

keys.DescriptionKey:
Cleopatra didn't only gaze into the void; she was marked by it.
Within the void, there was a creature of dread and madness. People who lay their eyes on it couldn't think clearly, and those who were touched by it were driven completely mad.
Aeon Lords can rely on their Eternity to heal physical wounds, but even it cannot easily mend a shattered mind. Caught in an endless cycle of death, rebirth, anxiety and madness, Cleopatra eventually forgot even her own name.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Before she became an Aeon Lord, Cleopatra used to be a pure-hearted woman. She believed the world was inherently good, and was ready to sacrifice everything for the sake of her beloved nation. But she was betrayed by her advisors and the very people she devoted herself to. And that was what it took for the well-meaning queen to fall.
No matter how much fear Cthulhu subjected her to, she wouldn't sink into despair—because she had already reached its utter depths and emerged victorious.

keys.value: The Path of a Queen

keys.DescriptionKey:
Tradition dictates that great rulers should be buried in magnificent tombs, to sanctify them and thus make them eternal.
A certain weapon was given a regal burial too—an outstanding, all-too-powerful axe.
It has no epitaph to commemorate it, just eternity to share with the entombed monarchs.

CleopatraGreatAxe01.name: The Ageless
CleopatraGreatAxe01.description:
Tradition dictates that great rulers should be buried in magnificent tombs, to sanctify them and thus make them eternal.
A certain weapon was given a regal burial too—an outstanding, all-too-powerful axe.

keys.DescriptionKey: There once was a desert queen who believed in the power of the moon. She'd bathe in the moonlight every night, and so would a certain diamond—until it turned into the blade of an axe known for eternal beauty and limitless strength.

CleopatraMoonAxe01.name: Moonbeam Labrys
CleopatraMoonAxe01.description: There once was a desert queen who believed in the power of the moon. She'd bathe in the moonlight every night, and so would a certain diamond—until it turned into the blade of an axe known for eternal beauty and limitless strength.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Once, she had it all.
She was born in the Kingdom of Kemet, a land favored by the great river, blessed with rich, black soil—just like she was blessed with an abundance of talents. She didn't let herself rely solely on her gifts, though, but used them to gain as much knowledge as possible. Unmatched in skill, she was more than qualified to take on any number of duties. However, there was only one role she had her eyes on...

CleopatraRegular01.name: Cleopatra
CleopatraRegular01.title: The Last Pharaoh
CleopatraRegular01.description:
Once, she had it all.
She was born in the Kingdom of Kemet, a land favored by the great river, blessed with rich, black soil—just like she was blessed with an abundance of talents. She didn't let herself rely solely on her gifts, though, but used them to gain as much knowledge as possible. Unmatched in skill, she was more than qualified to take on any number of duties. However, there was only one role she had her eyes on...

keys.IntroText:
Lies hiding behind masks,
betrayal shrouded in schemes—
all for the sake of her beloved country

keys.DescriptionKey:
Once, she lost all she had.
She was too brilliant for her own good. Those she devoted her life to turned their backs on her, those she thought loyal suddenly sang a different tune—and they crushed her love under their feet. Seeking death, she turned to venom, but what she ended up embracing was deadlier than any toxin—lethal enough, in fact, to leave death behind and receive eternity. And it was with venom that she then purged her beloved, poisoned country.

CleopatraRegular02.name: Cleopatra
CleopatraRegular02.title: The Last Pharaoh
CleopatraRegular02.description:
Once, she lost all she had.
She was too brilliant for her own good. Those she devoted her life to turned their backs on her, those she thought loyal suddenly sang a different tune—and they crushed her love under their feet. Seeking death, she turned to venom, but what she ended up embracing was deadlier than any toxin—lethal enough, in fact, to leave death behind and receive eternity. And it was with venom that she then purged her beloved, poisoned country.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Once, she offered up all she had left.
"Let me dedicate all my talents to you. Utilize all my knowledge to serve you. No one else is worthy of my devotion, my trust... If that's not love, then what is it?
My one and only, my beloved—my country."
After all, she's only ever had eyes for one role—that of a queen. And she has the whole eternity to perform it.

CleopatraRegular03.name: Cleopatra
CleopatraRegular03.title: The Last Pharaoh
CleopatraRegular03.description:
Once, she offered up all she had left.
"Let me dedicate all my talents to you. Utilize all my knowledge to serve you. No one else is worthy of my devotion, my trust... If that's not love, then what is it?
My one and only, my beloved—my country."
After all, she's only ever had eyes for one role—that of a queen. And she has the whole eternity to perform it.

$#DONOTSHOWME()#$After passing through the barrier,  
I wandered the desert looking for Finn.

$#DONOTSHOWME()#$$!-1!$Fighting back tears, I kept moving, hoping
Finn was waiting somewhere ahead.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Center@$(Maybe this really is the secluded village
Gilgan mentioned...)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Center@$But if Finn isn't here, I'll have to look 
elsewhere.
$#ArakaA(Araka Resident)#$$&ChieftainMobShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You're... You're leavin', Majesty?
$#ArakaB(Araka Resident)#$$&DesertGirlMobSurprised&$$@Right@$Are ya abandonin' us...?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You guys are strong.

$#Olark(Olark)#$$&ChieftainMobShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Ah, would ya look at that magnificent golden

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshSmileKind&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hmm, you seem familiar somehow... But I

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshAngry&$$@Center@$However, if the attack really happened,

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshShouting&$$@Center@$Summon everyone related to this matter
at once!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHurt&$$@Center@$Or it's just another mirage...
$#DONOTSHOWME()#$$!-1!$My doubts never faded.

$#DONOTSHOWME()#$Still, the vision of hope shimmering before
my eyes was all I had to cling to.
$#DONOTSHOWME()#$As I got closer, I saw smoke...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteScared&$$@Center@$(A battle...!)

$#DONOTSHOWME()#$$!-1!$The hellish scene from when my hometown,
Westcarte, was attacked

$#DONOTSHOWME()#$I walked and walked, calling out his 
name.
$#DONOTSHOWME()#$flashed through my mind.

$#DONOTSHOWME()#$My legs froze. My body shivered

$#Rizette()#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Center@$For that reason, I became a knight. I'm

$#ArakaC(Araka Residents)#$$&ChieftainMobHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Please stop! What harm have we ever

$#OrgeianCaptain(Orugeian Captain)#$$&MagraAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ha! We are the noble people of Orugeia! 
Why would we bother discussing

$#DONOTSHOWME(Orugeian Soldiers)#$$!-1!$Haaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Center@$(How unfair...!)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Center@$(I have to help those people!)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Center@$(I've hunted with a bow for a long time.)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Center@$(My aim should be good enough to hit that

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Center@$Stop!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Center@$Just a passerby helping out!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Center@$Don't you feel ashamed to attack a

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Center@$(They won't catch up easily in this terrain.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Center@$(I'll aim for their legs as much as

$#OrgeianCaptain(Orugeian Captain)#$$&MagraAngry&$$@Center@$Half of you, prioritize dealing with the

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Center@$Everyone...! Please, fight to protect

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprisedOpen&$$@Center@$(No matter how you look at it, it's these
 unarmed folks that seem weaker here...)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSigh&$$@Left@$No... It's not him... It's a mirage...  
An illusion...

$#ArakaB(Araka Resident)#$$&DesertGirlMobSurprised&$$@Center@$It's only against our rules if ya hold

$#ArakaB(Araka Resident)#$$&DesertGirlMobSurprised&$$@Center@$Fight without them and protect the village!

$#ArakaA(Araka Resident)#$$&ChieftainMobShouting&$$@Center@$It's dangerous, swingin' blades around

$#ArakaA(Araka Resident)#$$&ChieftainMobShouting&$$@Center@$Fistfightin' seems reckless too, I reckon...
Why not just throw 'em like this!

$#OrgeianSoldierA(Orugeian Soldier)#$$&GuardCommand&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Impossible! How can you match us

$#OrgeianSoldierB(Orugeian Soldier)#$$&GuardCommand&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Captain... They're monsters...
$#OrgeianCaptain(Orugeian Captain)#$$&MagraAngry&$$@Left@$Damn it... Regroup and retreat!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(How many times have I seen Finn... 
And every time, it was just an illusion...)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprisedOpen&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You actually won...
With just your bare hands...
$#ArakaA(Araka Resident)#$$&ChieftainMobSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$All thanks to our queen's advice!
$#ArakaC(Araka Resident)#$$&ChieftainMobSerious&$$@Right@$Our queen, our queen!!!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Queen!? You must be mistaking me for
someone else.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Center@$I'm Rizette, of the Red Dragon Knights.

$#ArakaB(Araka Resident)#$$&DesertGirlMobHappy&$$@Center@$Ain't no mistake. The one with hair as
gold as the sun, the one who guides us—
$#ArakaC(Araka Resident)#$$&DesertGirlMobHappy&$$@Center@$Aye, that is our monarch!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGentleSmile&$$@Center@$I didn't guide anyone... I helped a little.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGentleSmile&$$@Center@$You guys were the ones who drove the
enemy away.
$#ArakaB(Araka Resident)#$$&DesertGirlMobHappy&$$@Center@$Nay, it's all thanks to Queen Rizette!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Center@$Finn... Finn...!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBlushConfuse&$$@Center@$Aaargh... I'm not someone you should be
calling a queen...!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$But I'm glad your village wasn't  
taken.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHappy&$$@Left@$I've already lost my own hometown,
I didn't want you to go through that too.

$#ArakaA(Araka Resident)#$$&ChieftainMobSerious&$$@Right@$What are ya sayin', Majesty!
This can be yer new hometown!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBlushConfuse&$$@Left@$I told you, I'm not a queen... Really!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$By the way, has a boy named Finn 
come here recently?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Center@$He's my friend. I came here looking for him.

$#ArakaC(Araka Resident)#$$&DesertGirlMobNormal&$$@Center@$Finn...? Other than them brutes,

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Center@$No one?
$#ArakaC(Araka Resident)#$$&ChieftainMobSerious&$$@Center@$Aye, that's how it's always been.
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraHurt&$$@Center@$Huff...huff...huff...
