$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGentleSmile&$$@Left@$Let's go, Finn!
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshShock&$$@Center@$Where...am I...
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshShock&$$@Center@$Why am I still here?
$#Snake(Snake)#$$@Center@$"Because you are special."
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshAngry&$$@Center@$You... You're the snake from before!

$#Arcane(Arcane)#$$&ArcaneSmile&$$@Center@$"My name is Arcane. As you guessed, 
I am one of the gods."
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshShouting&$$@Center@$Are you the reason I remain here?
$#Arcane(Arcane)#$$&ArcaneSmile&$$@Center@$"No."

$#Arcane(Arcane)#$$&ArcaneSmile&$$@Center@$"It is because your mother was akin to 
a god."
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshSerious&$$@Center@$My mother was...a god?

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraYandere&$$@Center@$Yes, I still have enough strength to elude
you all. Farewell.

$#Arcane(Arcane)#$$&ArcaneSmile&$$@Center@$"This recent incident has strengthened
that part of you. So you remain here."

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshAngry&$$@Center@$But gods can only exists when they're
worshipped.
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshAngry&$$@Center@$And there's no one who worships me—

$#Arcane(Arcane)#$$&ArcaneSmile&$$@Center@$"The person who was your secretary—the
real one—escaped Orugeia before its fall."

$#Arcane(Arcane)#$$&ArcaneSmile&$$@Center@$"However, after you died, he regretted 
running away and returned."
$#Arcane(Arcane)#$$&ArcaneSmile&$$@Center@$"And then he founded Araka."

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshShock&$$@Center@$Olark's settlement...!  
So it's Enki's legacy...

$#Arcane(Arcane)#$$&ArcaneSmile&$$@Center@$"He was your kin. While he did not 
inherit the characteristics of the

$#Arcane(Arcane)#$$&ArcaneSmile&$$@Center@$lionfolk tribe, he definitely carried the 
royal blood."

$#Arcane(Arcane)#$$&ArcaneSerious&$$@Center@$"Even if he gave up his right to the throne
after finding you in the slums."

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Wait! I want to ask you something. 
Why didn't you leave me to die?

$#Arcane(Arcane)#$$&ArcaneSerious&$$@Center@$"Mortals are not so simple. 
You were right about that."

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshSerious&$$@Center@$Enki carried the royal blood, and they were
his kin... That's why I felt close to them.

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshSerious&$$@Center@$And their strength was the effect of Royal
Might inherited by the bloodline...
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshSadSmile&$$@Center@$I see, time comes full circle...

$#Arcane(Arcane)#$$&ArcaneSerious&$$@Center@$"They now worship you as the Queen  
of Queens, as if you were a god."
$#Arcane(Arcane)#$$&ArcaneSerious&$$@Center@$"That is why you will not vanish."
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshAngry&$$@Center@$I see...
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshShouting&$$@Center@$Arcane, was it? There's something I want.
$#Arcane(Arcane)#$$&ArcaneSmile&$$@Center@$"Ah, immortality?"
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshWink&$$@Center@$No, something better than that.
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraSurprised&$$@Center@$(What on—!?)
$#Arcane(Arcane)#$$&ArcaneSerious&$$@Center@$"Better than that?"
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshHappy&$$@Center@$The necklace I got from Finn!
$#Arcane(Arcane)#$$&ArcaneSerious&$$@Center@$"A necklace?"

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshHappy&$$@Center@$That's right. If you're a god like you claim,
then get me an exact replica!
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshHappy&$$@Center@$That's an order!
$#Arcane(Arcane)#$$&ArcaneSerious&$$@Center@$"Commanding a god, are we?"
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshSmile&$$@Center@$Who cares about gods? I am a queen!

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshHappy&$$@Center@$The Almighty Queen— 
Gilgamesh of Orugeia!!!
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshHappy&$$@Center@$Not even a god can oppose me!

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshSmile&$$@Center@$(Finn, it seems my journey is not over
yet...)

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraPoutLookAway&$$@Center@$(What is the Crimson Crestbearer doing
within my aegis...!?)
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshSmile&$$@Center@$(We'll meet again someday.)
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshSmile&$$@Center@$(My one true hero!)

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraClosedEyesHappy&$$@Center@$(He seems to have collapsed. 
Without help, he will surely die.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$I can't...go on...

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraYandereSad&$$@Center@$(He didn't recognize me as an Aeon Lord
using the Crest, did he?)
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraYandereSad&$$@Center@$(No, I don't sense that...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$I'll...help you...soon...

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraHurt&$$@Center@$To think that the likes of you could corner
me like that...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Center@$So...it's okay...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Center@$It's...okay...

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraSurprised&$$@Center@$(He's on the brink of death...  
And still, he smiled at me?)

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraLookaway&$$@Center@$(I shouldn't have a heartbeat... And yet...
Why do I feel so warm, I wonder?)
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraLookaway&$$@Center@$A white lily blooming in the desert...
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraWink&$$@Center@$It seems a pity to pluck it.
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraClosedEyesHappy&$$@Center@$Take him to the castle.

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraLookaway&$$@Center@$(In that moment, I felt... A rare and 
genuine spark...)
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraHappyOpen&$$@Center@$...As if.
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraLookaway&$$@Center@$The Aeon Lords are not all of one mind.

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshSmile&$$@Center@$Even if you're immortal, it'll take you some

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraLookaway&$$@Center@$It just so happens that I don't agree with

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraClosedEyes&$$@Center@$If you can change your path, I'll invite you

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Right@$She's nowhere to be found...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$Damn, I can't believe she escaped!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$The Lu'Ganan ruins again...
By the way, are you feeling okay?

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshShouting&$There is vast knowledge in this world. 
Expand your own horizons!
$#CitizenofOrgeia(Citizen of Orugeia)#$But, Your Majesty... I can't read...

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshHappy&$Which is precisely why you must learn!
I have prepared a place for that!

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshHappy&$It matters not if you're rich or poor.
Gender and age don't matter either.

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshHappy&$What I desire for this nation is 
education for all!

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshHappy&$People of Orugeia! Seize this opportunity
wholeheartedly and find happiness!
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshHappy&$That is all!
$#CitizenofOrgeia(Citizen of Orugeia)#$$!-1!$So we too have the right to happiness...
$#CitizenofOrgeia(Citizen of Orugeia)#$Is that even possible...?
$#CitizenofOrgeia(Citizen of Orugeia)#$You're the best, Your Majesty!!!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$Yes, I'm fine. And Theo is currently
volunteering to take care of the injured.
$#CitizensofOrgeia(Citizens of Orugeia)#$Woooooooooo!!!

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshSmile&$As for my own happiness...
I find it in your smiles.

$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherSmile&$$@Right@$Thank you for your hard work,  
my queen.

$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherSmile&$$@Right@$Your speech truly resonated with the
people this  time.

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshAngry&$$@Left@$Oh, spare me the flattery.
How much has this policy been accepted?
$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherSmile&$$@Right@$Mostly well-received, I believe.
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshContempt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You believe? What do the numbers say?
$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherSerious&$$@Center@$Let me see...

$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$According to our survey, 
80% of the citizens have accepted it.

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshShouting&$$@Left@$Which group hasn't been
 sufficiently convinced?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHeh&$$@Left@$As his older sister, I refuse to be outdone!

$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherSerious&$$@Right@$Those who've had little opportunity to
learn, and the opposite, those who

$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherSerious&$$@Right@$already have ample knowledge and
wealth—their support is the lowest.

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshAngry&$$@Left@$Then we will explain it to them again.
Tomorrow, perhaps.

$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherUpset&$$@Right@$With all due respect, it might be 
impossible to gain 100% trust.

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshClosedEyes&$$@Left@$I don't believe so. What's regrettable is
the attitude of the wealthiest.

$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherUpset&$$@Right@$They seem unlikely to change their 
minds no matter what.

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshStare&$$@Left@$Those slaves to money and power... They're 
so stubborn it's frustrating...

$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Also, there have been some complaints 
about a shortage of teachers.

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I have already considered 
a solution for that.

$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherSmile&$$@Right@$As expected of Queen Gilgamesh! 
What might that be?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Right@$Right, I need to do my best too!
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It's you. You will become a teacher.
$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherUpset&$$@Center@$Me?

$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherUpset&$$@Center@$Apologies, my queen, but it would be hard
to juggle my current role and the new one—
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshAngry&$$@Center@$Yes, I understand.

$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherUpset&$$@Center@$Understand? Do you mean that...
You would have me resign as your secretary?
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshAngry&$$@Center@$Exactly.

$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherShouting&$$@Center@$Impossible...! Without me, 
this country will collapse!

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshAngry&$$@Center@$I appreciate your concern, but I've  
already prepared a replacement.
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshAngry&$$@Center@$Come forth.
$#Isis(Isis)#$$&CleopatraClosedEyes&$$@Center@$I am Isis. Pleased to meet you.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Let's head to the site, then. We need to 
see this anomaly with our own eyes!

$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You're entrusting the secretary's duties
to this woman!?
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshShouting&$$@Left@$I am. It's already decided.

$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherShouting&$$@Right@$But... I've memorized the records of all
citizens, and I don't know this woman!

$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherShouting&$$@Right@$Who are you? What are you trying to
achieve by seeking our queen's favor?

$#Isis(Isis)#$$&CleopatraHappyOpen&$$@Left@$I am a loyal servant to the Queen.
Nothing more.

$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$My queen, are you really entrusting the 
heart of the nation to a woman of
$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherShouting&$$@Center@$unknown origin!?
$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherUpset&$$@Center@$Am I...really no longer needed...?

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshShouting&$$@Center@$There's a saying, "Right person in the 
right place."

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshShouting&$$@Center@$And Isis has the capabilities I'm looking
for.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$So this is it...
$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$But I have always been loyal, haven't I?

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshClosedEyes&$$@Left@$It's for the sake of the nation.  
You must understand that.

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshClosedEyes&$$@Left@$The work you've done until now is
appreciated.
$#Secretary(Secretary)#$$&GyurelleFatherSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Isis, complete the handover.
$#Isis(Isis)#$$&CleopatraWink&$$@Right@$Yes, ma'am. I will learn thoroughly.
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$This is for the people of Orugeia...
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshAngry&$$@Center@$There's no time for regrets, Gilgamesh.
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Isis. Has the handover been completed?

$#Isis(Isis)#$$&CleopatraHappyOpen&$$@Right@$Yes, ma'am. I have already memorized all
the information. I am at your service.

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$It looks like a thin membrane, but...
It appears solid at the same time.
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I'm afraid that's not enough.

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshAngry&$$@Center@$Simply remembering the contents of
documents won't do.

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshShouting&$$@Center@$I'll explain the policies I've implemented
and the intentions behind them.
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshShouting&$$@Center@$Memorize it all in one go!
$#Isis(Isis)#$$&CleopatraWink&$$@Center@$Yes, as you command, Your Majesty.

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So that's the mission. 
Do you understand so far?

$#Isis(Isis)#$$&CleopatraSmile&$$@Right@$Yes. I understand the type of nation
you are trying to build.

$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshAngry&$$@Left@$Then, tell me straight. What are the  
future prospects of this nation?

$#Isis(Isis)#$$&CleopatraSigh&$$@Right@$In terms of productivity, the numbers...
Well, the current data is not sufficient.
$#Gilgamesh(Gilgamesh)#$$&GilgameshAngry&$$@Left@$Can you do the calculations?

If this unit is not conjured, this unit enters battle with 3 Charges, and Counter Stance for 150TU. If this unit is conjured, this unit enters battle with 1 Charge and the Armor status effect.

If this unit is charged, not burning, and there are 2+ non-conjured allies on the battlefield, each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn with less than 50% of max HP, this unit will spend a Charge to heal for 100% of max HP and add another Sun Wukong to the next in line of allied reinforcements.

Add another Sun Wukong to the next in line of allied reinforcements when this unit is defeated by an enemy attack. This effect triggers if this unit is not conjured and has a Charge. This is not considered a revenge passive skill.

Each time this unit damages an enemy with an attack while charged, this unit will spend a charge to get another turn. This effect can trigger again against the same unit. Effects that influence TU order may interrupt the extra turn (e.g. Stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

All Sun Wukongs created by this unit will have matching Levels, Limit Breaks, Awakenings, Boosts, Potential, Mastery, Weapons, and Accessories. Counter Stance will overwrite status effects on this unit. The next time the unit with counter stance takes damage from an enemy attack, it will become their turn. keys.MessageKey:
Compete against other players in this Cross-World event.
 The event follows the same rules as the regular Arena, with the following changes: 

<color=#00edf6>Season System</color>
Champion's Arena rankings are divided into 1-week Seasons.

<color=#00edf6>Cease-Fire</color>

Once a week, there will be a 1-day Cease-Fire to accommodate the changing Season. Additionally, there will be a brief recess period every day from 21:00~22:00 (server time).

<color=#00edf6>Participation Conditions</color>

With the exception of the Cease-Fire day, all players who rank 100th or above in the  Arena at 21:00 (server time) each day qualify to participate in the Champion's Arena for the day following the recess period.

<color=#00edf6>Challenges</color>

Each qualified player in the Champion's Arena may issue 10 challenges per day. A total of 5 additional challenges may be acquired using Soul Stones each day you have qualified to make challenges. Challenges will be replenished daily upon qualifying and unused challenges will be lost when recess begins, so remember to use them all up.

<color=#00edf6>Rankings</color>

Ranking in the Champion's Arena will be determined by players' points. Each player will begin with 500 points upon qualifying for the first time each season. Points will be added or subtracted according to the following rules:

　・Challenge a player and win: +20 pts
　・Challenge a player and lose: +10 pts
　・Lose a challenge from another player: -10 pts
　・Chain Bonus: By winning repeatedly, you can earn more points when issuing and winning challenges. You will lose your streak even if you lose in a challenge you receive, but wins against challengers will also count toward your current streak.
　・Underdog Bonus: If you challenge and defeat a player with 60 or more points than you, you will receive bonus points.

<color=#00edf6>Rewards</color>

 With the exception of the Cease-Fire day, rewards will be delivered based on rank every day at 21:00 (server time). Players at higher ranks at the end of the Season will receive greater rewards. The "Champion's Coin" currency can be exchanged at the Champion's Shop.

<color=#00edf6>Titles</color>

Players will receive titles based on their point rankings at the end of each Season: 

　・1700+ points: Ultimate Master
　・1500+ points: Legendary Hero
　・1200+ points: Heroic Champion
　・900+ points: True Knight
　・550+ points: Elite Warrior
　・0-549 points: Seasoned Veteran

<color=#00edf6>＜Types of Cross-World Event＞</color>

 The three types of Cross-World event are "Cross-World Chat", "War of the Realms", and "Champion's Arena".

<color=#00edf6>＜Cross-World Chat＞</color> 

 All players participating in the same Cross-World Event will be able to chat with each other.

<color=#00edf6>＜War of the Realms＞</color> 

A competitive event against Alliances participating in the same Cross-World Event.

<color=#00edf6>＜Champion's Arena＞</color> 

A competitive event against players participating in the same Cross-World Event.

<color=#00edf6>＜Participating Servers＞</color> 

{0}

<color=#00edf6>＜Server Time・Region＞</color> 

{1}

Fight alongside your Alliance to conquer territory in this Cross-World event. 

This event follows the same rules as Alliance War, with the following changes: 

<color=#00edf6>Battle Period And Map</color>

Each war will last for one week. At the end of the week, rewards will be distributed based on ranking.

<color=#00edf6>Participation Conditions</color>

The right to participate in War of the Realms is given to the highest powered Alliances from the Cross-World Event's participating servers. Invites will be sent out at the start of each battle period (at 00:00 server time), in order of Alliance Power.

Players will be eligible to participate on behalf of their Alliance only if they were in the Alliance at the time the Alliance's total power was recorded to determine participation in the current battle period, around 5 minutes before the battle period starts. Leaving an Alliance in any way will make you ineligible to participate on any current War of the Realms map. 

<color=#00edf6>Matchmaking</color>

In War of the Realms, participating Alliances will be sorted into Legend, Champion, or Elite classes based on Alliance Power, and four Alliances will be chosen at random from within the same class. Once four Alliances have been matched together, they will battle for territory on a private map.

<color=#00edf6>Declarations</color>

Each participating Alliance will receive 3 Declarations in War of the Realms per day.

<color=#00edf6>Starting Castles</color>

Each Alliance will begin the war with four Level 1 castle under their control. This castle distribution is determined at random.

<color=#00edf6>Schedule Differences</color>

- Declaration Phase: Same start time as Alliance War, ends 21:00 (server time)
- Pre-Battle Phase: 21:00 - 22:00 (server time)
-Battle Phase: 22:00 - 22:45 (server time)

<color=#00edf6>Alliance Power</color>

 Alliance Power is determined by the total of the highest recorded power of each player in the Alliance at the start of the battle period.

<color=#00edf6>Tie Breaker</color>

When scores are tied in War of the Realms, ranking will be determined by Alliance Power rankings as of when the map began.

<color=#00edf6>Battalion Data</color>

Battalion data is saved for use in War of the Realms between 19:45 and 20:00, changes made to platoons after Battalion data is saved will not reflect in War of the Realms on that day.

keys.value: $#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$|act6.Voices/mst3915|$You can do it, Rizette!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGrit&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3924|$It doesn't feel like a living being...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3925|$It's like... Like a machine...
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganDetermined&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3926|$I feel no aggression from it.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3927|$No hesitation, nor agitation... Nothing!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3928|$This thing... It's just a pure well of
enormous magical power!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3929|$This... This is the core of the
Pandemonium!?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaTroubled&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3930|$This is what happens to the heroes who
fought for Erden? That's horrible...!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3931|$I... I was clinging to hope.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSad&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3932|$Hope that a piece of Rody was still alive in
there, and when he saw me he would...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSad&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3933|$But the Eternal hasn't changed at all. It's
exactly like it was 18 years ago!!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngryBlue&$$|act6.Voices/mst3916|$Ha!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3934|$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3935|$Mom passed away.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3936|$She was always so proud when she talked
about you, so I grew up admiring you.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3937|$I dreamed of becoming someone who
fought to protect others, just like you.
$#Eternal(The Eternal)#$$&Eternal&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3938|$REJOICE.

$#Eternal(The Eternal)#$$&Eternal&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3939|$YOU WHO GNAW AT THIS IMPURE LAND
AND CURSE THE HEAVENS.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3940|$So I want to show you the person I've
become, and the friends I've made!

$#Eternal(The Eternal)#$$&Eternal&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3941|$KNEEL BEFORE THE CYCLE OF
SUFFERING, THE ETERNAL REBIRTH.
$#Eternal(The Eternal)#$$&Eternal&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3942|$REJOICE!!!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3943|$Dad... This ends now!!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst3917|$What... What is that creature!?
$#Eternal(The Eternal)#$$&Eternal&$$@Center@$$%0.5%$$|act6.Voices/mst3944|$OAAARRRRRGHHHH!?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3945|$It's recoiling!!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3946|$Now Finn! Take the Exeternia, and finish
this!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3947|$This 2000-year-long curse on our home...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3948|$...ends now!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadRed&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3949|$...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3950|$Finn! Are you alright!?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3951|$Are you hurt? Can you speak?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadRed&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3952|$Yeah... I...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3953|$I'm still me!!
$#Eternal(The Eternal)#$$&Eternal&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3918|$REJOICE.
$#Rizette;Astrid;(Rizette & Astrid)#$$&RizetteHappy;Astrid.AstridSadSmile;&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Astrid.Right;@$$|act6.Voices/mst3954|$Finn!!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3955|$Finn!!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3956|$Thank goodness!!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3957|$You've done it, Sir Finn!!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3958|$The magic around the tower... It's
disappearing, like an ebbing wave...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3959|$It was like this 18 years ago. But this time,
it's final.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3960|$Indeed... This time, the Pandemonium
will not reoccur!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3961|$We must spread the word!

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3962|$But we have no proof. How will we assure
people?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3963|$...?

$#Eternal(The Eternal)#$$&Eternal&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3919|$REJOICE, EXHAUSTING EVERY SENSE IN
YOUR IGNORANT QUEST FOR TRUTH.
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$$|act6.Voices/mst3964|$Come...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3965|$Who said that...?

keys.DescriptionKey: His name is Crescent, and he's a very happy dragon. Or at least, he used to be. He doesn't remember all that much. One day, there was nothing but the dark. The next day, there were Luna, and Solas, and the girl with the fluffy white hair. And grapes! He had no reason not to be happy in a world with grapes and good friends. But one day, that stopped being enough. Something inside him, like a shadow on a moonless night, started following him. Whispering to him. There's more than this. More than this. Remember. Crescent doesn't know if he wants to. He thinks, if he does, he might never be happy again.

Crescent01.name: Diabolos
Crescent01.title: Dragon Lord of Shadow
Crescent01.description: His name is Crescent, and he's a very happy dragon. Or at least, he used to be. He doesn't remember all that much. One day, there was nothing but the dark. The next day, there were Luna, and Solas, and the girl with the fluffy white hair. And grapes! He had no reason not to be happy in a world with grapes and good friends. But one day, that stopped being enough. Something inside him, like a shadow on a moonless night, started following him. Whispering to him. There's more than this. More than this. Remember. Crescent doesn't know if he wants to. He thinks, if he does, he might never be happy again.

keys.IntroText:
"As the crescent moon gives way to shadow,
A young heart stirs in the dark, remembering."

keys.DescriptionKey: Diabolos... The voice in Crescent's mind haunts him with that name. Diabolos. Not Crescent. Diabolos. You are Diabolos. He doesn't want that awful name. It sounds ancient, larger than he is, cursed with history he can't remember. Suddenly, his days with Luna and Solas seem so small, a speck of happiness against a shadow that threatens to consume him. He wants to protect his friends. He wants to stand by their side forever. But if he is Diabolos, and if the shadow inside him one day shows him its secrets... Will they even want to be near him?

Crescent02.title: Dragon Lord of Shadow
Crescent02.description: Diabolos... The voice in Crescent's mind haunts him with that name. Diabolos. Not Crescent. Diabolos. You are Diabolos. He doesn't want that awful name. It sounds ancient, larger than he is, cursed with history he can't remember. Suddenly, his days with Luna and Solas seem so small, a speck of happiness against a shadow that threatens to consume him. He wants to protect his friends. He wants to stand by their side forever. But if he is Diabolos, and if the shadow inside him one day shows him its secrets... Will they even want to be near him?

keys.DescriptionKey:
The Dragon Lord of Shadow, known as Diabolos, never considered himself an ally of humanity. Only an enemy of the Pandemonium.

For centuries, not a soul set foot in the mountains where he made his home. The dragon would unleash his breath of void on any who came too close, plunging his victims in a realm of perfect darkness. Many thought him utterly invincible.

Except the Dragon Lord of Light, who slew him when he marched with the Bergarian Army as the Emperor's mount.

No one saw the fearsome Diabolos after that. Most thought the world rid of him forever, including the other Lords.

But perhaps it wasn't death he found in that ancient final fight. Perhaps it was a second chance.

keys.DescriptionKey:
His teachers scolded him for his bizarre experiments. His classmates snickered at his rickety inventions, contraptions of gears and glass that exploded more often than they functioned. Even in university, his dream of mana-powered machinery got him laughed out of the lecture hall.

But this hammer, bearing within it the voidborn magic of a dragon lord, has proven the ambitious young inventor was never a fool.

Falling from the heavens like a blazing star.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$Luna?
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSmile&$$@Right@$...Maybe we can use it.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Left@$...I don't like the sound of that.
What do you mean, "use it?"

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Right@$If it can grow monsters, maybe we can use
it in reverse to change Crescent back?!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Right@$We can turn him from an angsty teen into
our beautiful baby dragon again!
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Left@$What?!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Left@$Are you crazy?! Crescent's worked hard to
grow up strong and healthy!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Left@$And there's no guarantee we'd even win
this tournament anyway!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Left@$(It's that a quiet Luna always means
trouble's on the way.)

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaCommand&$$@Right@$So now you're making fun of me?! Fine!
You can watch me win in the arena!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Uh-oh. I may have just added fuel
to the fire...

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Center@$(Hmmm...
There won't be any convincing her now.)

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Center@$(She's gonna enter this thing regardless...
Maybe I should let her be.)

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Center@$I'll win before you know it.
Just wait a little longer, Crescent!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$Hey, Luna?
What're you thinking about?
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaWah&$$@Right@$...-es me now.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$Huh? I couldn't hear you.
What was that?
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaCommand&$$@Right@$Crescent hates me now!
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Left@$Whoa, don't shout in my ear!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act5.Voices/mst2621|$!!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2630|$Does this mean the path to Elvenlent has
opened?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2631|$Is this Callen's doing?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2632|$So it's like a gate that only opens for the
crests. Callen must know a lot about them.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2633|$Let's keep moving. Elvenlent must be just
up ahead!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2622|$Ah...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2623|$What was that...?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2624|$What's wrong? Did something happen?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2625|$It was faint, but I think my crest reacted to
something.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2626|$Mine too. But it was different than how it is
with Aeon Knights and Lords.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2627|$It was like all the magic in the forest
suddenly honed in on Finn and Rizette...
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2628|$Something feels different...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2629|$Yeah! I can feel it in my tail!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurtRed&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3778|$Huff... Huff...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurtRed&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3785|$Y-You're all making too much of a fuss.
I'm just a little tired.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmileRed&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3786|$If I don't play my part, you all won't be
able to play yours.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3787|$I've got your back, Finn.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3788|$And we'll clear the path in front for you!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHehRed&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3789|$Thanks, everyone. I'm counting on you.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3779|$Are you okay, Brother? You're out of
breath.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3780|$Repeated use of the crest is wearing on
him. It was the same for Rody.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3781|$The hostiles in these stones have some of
the Eternal's immortality.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$Unfortunately, that means we have no
choice but to rely on the Crimson Crest.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3782|$We need to let him rest, though!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3783|$Is there a place nearby where we could
take a break?
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3784|$In the stronghold of our enemy? I doubt it.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$If my senses weren't dulled by all this
magic we could move more efficiently!

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$|act0.Voices/mst88|$My, what lively specimens we have here.
Be patient, your turn will come soon enough♪
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$|act0.Voices/mst89|$I-I can't even scratch her!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHurt&$$|act0.Voices/mst90|$S-So the rumors of the immortality of the
Aeon Lords are true...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$|act0.Voices/mst91|$What did you do to Theo!?

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$|act0.Voices/mst92|$You two escaped from that filthy village in
the middle of my examination, didn't you?

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$|act0.Voices/mst93|$I'm rather curious about how you broke
my aegis barrier... Oh, I have an idea!

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkHappy&$$|act0.Voices/mst94|$Let's see how you two react to a cocktail of
my personal concoctions ♪

keys.DescriptionKey:
At dawn, a lone knight stands with his back to the rising sun, facing a hostile army. Soon he is surrounded by tens, hundreds of enemies—and yet, by the time the sun has reached the zenith, the knight is alone once again, countless bodies lying at his feet.
That was the routine for the original Gawain, the Knight of the Sun. The current one still draws her sword when the sun is the furthest from the moon, she as well a match for a thousand-man army.

—Your king has summoned you.
No matter how cruel the curse you must bear,

keys.DescriptionKey:
Just like there is no rain that never stops, there is no sun that never sets. However, her—no, any Gawain's—loyalty towards their king will never wane, no matter how different each new bearer of the name is. In that sense, she is Gawain through and through.
But just like there is no sun that never sets, there can be no moon that never rises.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The people of Camelot love the sun. "Because it is what makes our finest knight the finest," they always say. That is, however, not entirely true—what they really love is Gawain's warm nature. Kinder and more considerate than anyone, she is just like their own sun—thus, they would call her "the Knight of the Sun" even if the source of her power lay elsewhere.
Because in the heart of the current Gawain lives the warmth of a bright, clear day.

keys.value: $#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(What's going on...?)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubledBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Her usual charismatic charm is
nowhere to be seen...)
$#R'lyeh(R'lyeh)#$$&R'lyehTroubled&$$@Center@$Are you sure?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$I am. I have to do this.
$#R'lyeh(R'lyeh)#$$&R'lyehApologetic&$$@Center@$...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$All right, here I go!
You just wait on the Other Side, R'lyeh!
$#R'lyeh(R'lyeh)#$$&R'lyehLookawaytSad&$$@Center@$I will.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubledBlush&$$@Center@$(Actually, this vulnerability somehow feels
more alluring... No, what am I thinking!?)

$#NapoleonGigant(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonSad&$$@Center@$Sneaking into my bed...violates the
Napoleonic Code...
$#NapoleonGigant(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonSad&$$@Center@$100 years...of hard labor...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$100 years???

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Heh, just kidding... But if anyone sees you
here...
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonSadSmile&$$@Center@$It won't just be hard labor...
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonYawn&$$@Center@$Yawn... Phew...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Your Majesty! There's something important
we need to discuss. Please, hear me out!
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonSad&$$@Right@$Sleepy...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(I was just on the Other Side, but now I'm
sleeping in the same bed as the empress!?)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Uh... Um?
$#NapoleonGigant(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Let's just sleep for now.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$(She's still half asleep, isn't she...)

$#NapoleonGigant(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonSadSmile&$That immortal woman is fine... We still have
time to sleep...

$#NapoleonGigant(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonSadSmile&$Need to regain our strength...before the
final battle...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$Uh... It's so warm here... So cozy...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$It felt like this on the Other Side too...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$So nice...and...warm...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Napoleon)#$—Good morning, brave one!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$(Ouch...)
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonYawn&$$@Center@$Mmm...mmm...
$#NapoleonGigant(Finn)#$$&NapoleonSerene&$$@Center@$(Was I just...pinched on the cheek?)
$#NapoleonGigant(Finn)#$$&NapoleonSerene&$$@Center@$...!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Crap!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(Did I fall asleep!?)

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonHeh&$$@Center@$Oh, finally awake, are we? Hehe, you looked
so cute in your sleep!

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonSerene&$$@Center@$It was my first time sleeping with a man,
but it wasn't so bad.

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonWink&$$@Center@$Ah, don't worry. Nothing happened,
of course.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSeriousBlush&$$@Center@$Of course!!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubledBlush&$$@Center@$(Falling asleep like this! What am I going
to tell my comrades?)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Okay, first things first!)
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonSad&$$@Center@$Hmm... Huh?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Your Imperial Majesty! About my
request—

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonHappy&$$@Center@$Ah, Cthulhu, right. Yes, let's fight it
together!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Huh...? Why the sudden change of mind?

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonContent&$$@Right@$Why? Because I want to defeat it too. It is
the enemy of the entire humanity, after all.

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonMelodramatic&$$@Right@$But to defeat Cthulhu, you need resistance
to the madness it spreads.

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonMelodramatic&$$@Right@$Especially if you're going to deliver the
final blow.

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonSmug&$$@Right@$So, I made you spend a day on the Other
Side of the World to acquire that resistance.
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonSmug&$$@Right@$Now you can defeat it.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Wait a minute! "The final blow"...
You mean, with the Golden Crest?
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonWink&$$@Center@$Yes, exactly.
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonSad&$$@Center@$You're...Finn, right?

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonShouting&$$@Center@$R'lyeh!!!
No... Is it too late?
$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuHurt&$$@Center@$Ms...Napoleon...
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonShouting&$$@Center@$Are you really R'lyeh?
$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuSweat&$$@Center@$Yes... Of course... But...I feel a little...floaty...
$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuSweat&$$@Center@$Ms. Napoleon, what is...happening...

$#DONOTSHOWME(R'lyeh)#$I found Mr. Finn's friend floating in the sea
and took her to the Other Side, as he asked.
$#LugrasseSoldierA(Lugrasse Soldier)#$$&CamelotSoldier&$$@Center@$Your Imperial Majesty! Are you all right!?
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonShouting&$$@Center@$No—Don't look!

$#LugrasseSoldierA;LugrasseSoldierB;LugrasseSoldierC(Lugrasse Soldier)#$$&CamelotSoldier;LugrasseSoldierB.CamelotSoldier;LugrasseSoldierC.CamelotSoldier&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;LugrasseSoldierB.Center;LugrasseSoldierC.Right;@$Huh? Look...at...?

$#LugrasseSoldierA;LugrasseSoldierB;LugrasseSoldierC(Mad Lugrasse Soldier)#$$&CamelotSoldier;LugrasseSoldierB.CamelotSoldier;LugrasseSoldierC.CamelotSoldier&$$@Left;;;LugrasseSoldierB.Center;LugrasseSoldierC.Right;@$Why? She's just a little girl... A girl...
No, she is—

$#LugrasseSoldierA;LugrasseSoldierB;LugrasseSoldierC(Mad Lugrasse Soldier)#$$&CamelotSoldier;LugrasseSoldierB.CamelotSoldier;LugrasseSoldierC.CamelotSoldier&$$@Left;;;LugrasseSoldierB.Center;LugrasseSoldierC.Right;@$A m-mon...ste...r... Aaaaaahhhh!!!
$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuSweat&$$@Center@$I'm...
$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuSweat&$$@Center@$a monster...
$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuSweat&$$@Center@$I see... I've become one with Mr. Monster...

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonShouting&$$@Center@$Don't worry, R'lyeh! I'll figure something
out!
$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuSadSmile&$$@Center@$Thank you Ms. Napoleon...

$#R'lyeh(R'lyeh)#$$&R'lyehApologetic&$$@Center@$She had succumbed to Mr. Monster's
influence too...

$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuSadHappy&$$@Center@$But I no longer belong here... And that's
okay...
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonShouting&$$@Center@$No, R'lyeh! I will not accept that!
$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuHurt&$$@Center@$...
$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuHurt&$$@Center@$Huh, I can hear...a voice...in my head...?
$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuSmile&$$@Center@$Huh... Aha, I see... Yes... Ehehe...

$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuRed&$$@Center@$Yes... Yes! That's right... That's what I
should do!
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonShouting&$$@Center@$R'lyeh?

$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuSmile&$$@Center@$The way I am now... I can make the world
peaceful!
$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuMad&$$@Center@$Such a good idea! Yes, excellent!
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonShouting&$$@Center@$R'lyeh, what are you talking about—
$#R'lyeh(R'lyeh)#$$&R'lyehSad&$$@Center@$I'm sorry.
$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuSmile&$$@Center@$I will create a peaceful world.
$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuSmile&$$@Center@$Without conflict, without anything bad...
$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuRed&$$@Center@$A world filled with happiness!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewClosedEyes&$(What's happening on the battlefield now?
What has become of Cthulhu?)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewClosedEyes&$Finn, are you there? Why aren't you
responding!?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid)#$(If I open my eyes, I'll be possessed by
Cthulhu's madness...)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid)#$(But...)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$Aaaaa———oooooo———aaaaa———
$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewHurt&$What... What is this voice!?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewHurt&$My head... I'm...losing...my...
$#R'lyeh(R'lyeh)#$$&R'lyehSad&$$@Center@$It's all my fault. I'm useless, I'm weak...
$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuRedSinging&$$@Center@$Aaaaa———oooooo———aaaaa———
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonHurt&$$@Center@$Ngh...aaah...
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonHurt&$$@Center@$R'lyeh...

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonHurt&$$@Center@$(Is Cthulhu...sending its madness through
the air...directly into our minds...!?)
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonHurt&$$@Center@$Stop...

$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuSmile&$$@Center@$So you can even withstand my voice,
Ms. Napoleon... Amazing.

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonHurt&$$@Center@$This isn't...what I wanted...when I released
Cthulhu...from within you...
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonHurt&$$@Center@$Stop it...right now...

$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuSmile&$$@Center@$But you are no longer my master. You said
so yourself. I cannot follow your orders.

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonHurt&$$@Center@$Aren't you...stubborn... Fine...
I'll use force...if I have to!
$#R'lyeh(R'lyeh)#$$&R'lyehPensive&$$@Center@$Mom, Dad...

$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuRed&$$@Center@$It's all right now. Please don't strain
yourself.
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonHurt&$$@Center@$If I don't strain myself, you will perish!

$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuSmile&$$@Center@$Please rest inside of me as well,
Ms. Napoleon.
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonHurt&$$@Center@$R'lyeh!!!
$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuSmile&$$@Center@$Leave the rest to me.
$#CthulhuR'lyeh(Cthulhu R'lyeh)#$$&CthulhuRed&$$@Center@$I will make everyone happy.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$R'lyeh, let us out of here!!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$This isn't right!!!
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonHurt&$$@Center@$$%1%$Ah, there you are, Finn.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Your Imperial Majesty! You ended up
here too?
$#R'lyeh(R'lyeh)#$$&R'lyehDetermined&$$@Center@$I will become the sacrifice...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$What does R'lyeh intend to do by locking
us in here?

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonSerious&$$@Center@$I presume she's spreading her madness to
erase the will to fight worldwide...
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonSerious&$$@Center@$Along with the minds harboring such will.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$How is that even possible...

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonSerious&$$@Center@$With that voice of hers, it should be doable.
And it's most likely her—no, Cthulhu's aim.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Cthulhu's aim?

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonSerious&$$@Center@$R'lyeh is being misled by Cthulhu. Tricked
into doing its bidding.

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonSerious&$$@Center@$This very well might be the end of the
world...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$I'm sorry. If only I had managed to get
the Golden Crest to work back then—

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonSerious&$$@Center@$It's not your fault, but my own... I didn't
foresee this...
$#R'lyeh(R'lyeh)#$$&R'lyehDetermined&$$@Center@$Then, we can all be together again...

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonConcidering&$$@Center@$Summoning Cthulhu was my scheme to
begin with...

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonConcidering&$$@Center@$Behold the great sinner who shattered the
world.

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$"The great sinner who shattered the
world"?

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$So melodramatic... A line unfit even for
the cheapest farce.

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDark2Wink&$$@Center@$Wouldn't you agree, Your Imperial
Majesty?

$#R'lyeh(R'lyeh)#$$&R'lyehSadHappy&$$@Center@$Ms. Napoleon, Mr. Finn... I will be of use,
I promise...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$Cleopatra!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(That sounds about right... That thing is
more horrifying than any Aeon Lord...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Where have you been all this time, anyway?

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkBlush&$$@Right@$Ah, what an urgent tone. Have you been
searching for me? I'm flattered, hehe.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$We formed a team dedicated to searching for
the remaining Aeon Lords.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$But we couldn't find you.

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkNormal&$$@Right@$My beloved country isn't so easily found,
you know.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Then why are you here now?

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkSmile&$$@Right@$Because I am at war with the country called
Lugrasse.
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkSmile&$$@Right@$I didn't know you were going to be here too.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Wait... Lugrasse's opponent in that naval
battle was you!?

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkWinkHappy&$$@Center@$Yes... It's been quite a while since that
incident in Orugeia, wasn't it?
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkYandere&$$@Center@$Yes, me and my beloved country, Kemet.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$How did this even happen?

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkClosedEyesSmile&$$@Right@$Hmm, that thing hasn't fully started its
invasion yet...

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkLookawaySerious&$$@Right@$I suppose I can spare a little time to provide
you with information.
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkWinkHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Let me show you the past.
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkWinkHeh&$$@Center@$Dusk Mirage!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh...!

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkNormalSmile&$$@Right@$Do you remember, Crestbearer? I recretated
Orugeia with this technique a long time ago.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$The spell that could recreate memories using
sand... Perfectly restore entire lifetimes...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$How could I forget such an advanced illusion?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Believe me, I haven't forgotten.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I'll remember it until the day I die.
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkBlush&$$@Right@$My, you're quite the flatterer, aren't you.
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkNormalSmile&$$@Right@$Now then, it's about time for them to arrive.
$#FinnPillar(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Who's that?
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkWink&$$!-1!$$@Center@$To think you'd chase me all the way here...

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkWink&$$@Center@$No one likes a person who doesn't know
when to give up, Empress Napoleon.

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonHappy&$$@Center@$Hahaha! To suggest that anyone could ever
dislike me... What a delightful joke!

$#FinnPillar(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(So this is the Empress of Lugrasse,
the legendary genius Napoleon...)
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonContent&$$@Center@$Moreover, our world is made of love.

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonContent&$$@Center@$Does that not make my persistence a form
of love as well?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Erm, what kind of outfit is this?

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkSmile&$$@Center@$So those 50 ships you've brought here are
love too? That's a funny joke indeed.

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonHeh&$$@Center@$This fleet is a collection of precious amethysts
I gathered for you. Beautiful, are they not?

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonContent&$$@Center@$Now, you must feel quite lonely, all alone
on this battlefield.

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonContent&$$@Center@$Won't you call your people here, Queen of
Kemet?

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkWinkHappy&$$@Center@$The people of Kemet are a bit...special.
You're going to have to make do with just me.

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonWink&$$@Center@$To face a fleet of 50 ships alone... Well, if
anyone is capable of that, it must be you.
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkNormal&$$@Center@$You don't seem surprised.

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonContent&$$@Center@$Why would I be? For an Aeon Lord like
yourself, numbers don't matter much, do they?
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkLookawaySerious&$$@Center@$I've never shown you my power.

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonHeh&$$@Center@$No, but I can infer quite a lot from your
words and actions.

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkBlush&$$@Right@$My, please don't look at me with such passion
in your eyes. You're making me blush.

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonWink&$$@Center@$You see, nothing in this world can escape my
notice.
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkSmirk&$$@Center@$Nothing can escape your notice, hm?
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkSmirk&$$@Center@$Is that what makes you a genius?

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonWink&$$@Center@$My genius is not limited to one thing only.
I am the perfect empress, after all.

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkYandere&$$@Center@$Then, a question for the perfect empress...
What is a nation? Its monarch or its people?
$#NapoleonGigant(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonHappy&$$@Center@$Why, a nation is a stage!
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkHuh&$$@Center@$A stage...?

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonContent&$$@Center@$Oh yes, a stage where joy and sorrow
are on display!

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonContent&$$@Center@$The monarch is both the stage set and
the sole actor!

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonContent&$$@Center@$The common people are the audience,
sharing laughs and tears!

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkWinkHappy&$$@Right@$A maiden must guard her secrets, and this
outfit's origin is one of them.
$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonWink&$$@Center@$It would be quite boring without them.
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkSmirk&$$@Center@$So, for you, this war is just—

$#NapoleonGigant(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonHeh&$$@Center@$A novel and lively revue spreading across
the stage of the sea! Exactly that!

$#Napoleon(Napoleon)#$$&NapoleonHeh&$$@Center@$I think you will enjoy the scenario
I've prepared as well, hehe.
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...!
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkSmirk&$$@Center@$So that's how it is going to be... Very well.
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkWinkHeh&$$@Center@$Dusk Mirage.

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$So, I've summarized it a bit, but that's how
it all started.

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkNormalSmile&$$@Center@$After that, that thing appeared, and the
battle ended in chaos.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$By which you mean...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Don't tell me that thing is also your
doing!?

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkSmile&$$@Center@$The Lugrasse soldiers all lost their sanity
and collapsed.
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkNormalSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$After that, Napoleon's army has retreated.

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkNormalSmile&$$@Right@$Quite understandably, since things turned
out to be much more serious than just a war.

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkSmile&$$@Right@$That monstrosity is threatening
not only my beloved Kemet,

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkSmile&$$@Right@$but also Lugrasse and other nearby
countries.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$What exactly is that thing? It's not
a regular monster...

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkLookaway&$$@Right@$Well... It's unclear whether it spawned
naturally or was summoned by someone.

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What is certain is that those who saw it were
uniformly terrified to the point of madness.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Right...

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkNormalSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$It's not mere mental manipulation. It seems
to directly affect one's most basic instincts.
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkSmile&$$@Center@$You give me far too much credit.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$But you seem fine, Cleopatra.

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkWinkHappy&$$@Right@$It looks like it doesn't affect everyone to
the same extent.

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkNormalSmile&$$@Right@$For example, me, as an Aeon Lord, and you,
as a Crestbearer, are somewhat resistant.
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkNormalSmile&$$@Right@$We haven't fainted or lost our minds.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$That means I can fight it!
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkLookaway&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Possibly, with the right approach...

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkWink&$$@Center@$How about forming an alliance?
Just for the time being?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$I saw you betray Gilgamesh with my own
eyes. Do you really think I'd ever trust you?

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkSadSmile&$$@Center@$Then, are we just going to let this thing do
as it pleases? It's a walking calamity.

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkBlush&$$@Center@$If left unchecked, it even could lead to
another Pandemonium.

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkSmile&$$@Center@$As much as I'd like to, a single Aeon Lord
can't create such a thing.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Another Pandemonium...
$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkLookawaySerious&$$@Center@$Yes, it's certainly possible.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(A phenomenon that drives those who see it
to madness with sheer terror...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(It could destroy countless lives just
by moving across the land.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$All right... Let's work together for now.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$But mark my words, if you betray me, I
won't let you get away with it.

$#Cleopatra(Cleopatra)#$$&CleopatraDarkWink&$$@Center@$Oh, I do love that stern side of you,
Crestbearer.

keys.DescriptionKey: The girl's name was R'lyeh. She was born into a secret organization—a dark cult worshiping an evil deity, rejected by all other nations on Erden. Her parents treated her indifferently—everything they cared about was the doctrine. And so, starved for their attention, she volunteered to be the sacrifice needed to summon their dreadful god.

CthulhuGirlRegular01.name: Cthulhu
CthulhuGirlRegular01.title: Creature of the Void
CthulhuGirlRegular01.description: The girl's name was R'lyeh. She was born into a secret organization—a dark cult worshiping an evil deity, rejected by all other nations on Erden. Her parents treated her indifferently—everything they cared about was the doctrine. And so, starved for their attention, she volunteered to be the sacrifice needed to summon their dreadful god.

keys.IntroText:
Close your eyes, cover your ears,
for this girl is not what she seems to be...

keys.DescriptionKey: When R'lyeh opened her eyes after the ritual, her parents were gone. Everyone was gone. There was only her, physically unharmed, with an incomprehensible voice echoing inside her head. It seemed the deity had refused the call, and decided to hide within her instead of manifesting. From the tone of its voice, R'lyeh got an impression that it was scared of something, though she had no way of knowing what of or why.

CthulhuGirlRegular02.name: Cthulhu
CthulhuGirlRegular02.title: Creature of the Void
CthulhuGirlRegular02.description: When R'lyeh opened her eyes after the ritual, her parents were gone. Everyone was gone. There was only her, physically unharmed, with an incomprehensible voice echoing inside her head. It seemed the deity had refused the call, and decided to hide within her instead of manifesting. From the tone of its voice, R'lyeh got an impression that it was scared of something, though she had no way of knowing what of or why.

keys.DescriptionKey:
R'lyeh's sole purpose in life has always been simple: being useful to others. The evil deity took advantage of that facet of her character and merged with her, transforming both of them into something new—Cthulhu R'lyeh. A mental bond has been formed, tying her to the monster—a bond that cannot be broken, not even if the monster gets expelled from within her.
"Iä! Iä! Cthulhu fhtagn—"

CthulhuGirlRegular03.title: Creature of the Void
CthulhuGirlRegular03.description:
R'lyeh's sole purpose in life has always been simple: being useful to others. The evil deity took advantage of that facet of her character and merged with her, transforming both of them into something new—Cthulhu R'lyeh. A mental bond has been formed, tying her to the monster—a bond that cannot be broken, not even if the monster gets expelled from within her.
"Iä! Iä! Cthulhu fhtagn—"

keys.DescriptionKey:
There once was a cowardly king who sought supernatural power in order to establish his authority—and so, he obtained this unearthly axe.
The king became a tyrant, executing countless people indiscriminately as he spiraled deeper and deeper into madness; and ultimately, the last head to fall to the axe was his own.

$#QueenofHearts(Queen of Hearts)#$$&QueenofHeartsSurprised&$$@Center@$The Primordial...of Love...?

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidExcited&$$@Center@$The point is, I adore love, I cherish love—

$#QueenofHearts(Cupid)#$$&CupidSmile&$$@Center@$So I want to become the Primordial of Love, in

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidSmile&$$@Center@$Unfortunately, the role is not currently open—

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidSmile&$$@Center@$So I was thinking about what I could do to get

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidTehepero&$$@Center@$Then it hit me. I just needed obtain a "true love"

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidTehepero&$$@Center@$And that's when I set my sights on you, inside

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidSmile&$$@Center@$Yessss, your love is the greatest I've ever seen,

$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewThinking&$$@Center@$I have no idea... This has never happened

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidTehepero&$$@Center@$After all those repeated loops, Alice disappeared

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidKindSmile&$$@Center@$But this time you'll succeed—thanks to my

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidKindSmile&$$@Center@$Now, the final Alice is coming. Prove your love!
$#QueenofHearts(Queen of Hearts)#$$&QueenofHeartsSad&$$@Center@$Prove it? What am I supposed to do?

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidSmile&$$@Center@$Just carry out your will as you've always done,

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidSmile&$$@Center@$Lock Alice away within this castle. The same

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidSmile&$$@Center@$That is your happiness, the fulfillment of your

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Cupid...!? Is everything you just said true!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$All this was caused by...you...
$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidTehepero&$$@Center@$Oh my, Finn—eavesdropping is very naughty!!

$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewSad&$$@Center@$I don't know what's happening, Finn...! I have

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidTehepero&$$@Center@$I only found what was already there and gave it

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Time magic... You're a mage from the Temple of

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidKindSmile&$$@Center@$Yes, but I was a failure, the class dropout.

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidKindSmile&$$@Center@$Unlike Rolotia and other ace acolytes, no one

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidKindSmile&$$@Center@$So the Temple just ignores my existence, leaving

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$You're telling me someone who threw this entire

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidSmile&$$@Center@$I just happen to show a little extra talent when

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidHappy&$$@Center@$But never mind me. Where is Alice?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$So you two can't see her... The "Original Alice"

$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewSad&$$@Center@$This world feels dreadfully sinister now...

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Is this some kind of magic that blocks

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$They are the precious tears a mother sheds for
