$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSad&$$@Center@$...What crime am I being tried for?
$#CastleSoldierA(Castle Soldier A)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You'll find out in the courtroom!

$#CastleSoldierB(Castle Soldier B)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Right@$You will move briskly, cooperate fully, and
answer honestly! Is that clear?

$#CastleSoldierB(Castle Soldier B)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Right@$And most importantly, mind your manners at
all times!
$#CastleSoldierA(Castle Soldier C)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Then we will escort you to the courtroom—
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSad&$$@Center@$(What's going to happen to me...)
$#Judge's Gavel(Judge's Gavel)#$BANG BANG BANG!

$#CastleSoldierA(Castle Soldier A)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Left@$Silence! Do not talk back! This is the will of Her
Majesty the Queen!
$#Judge(Judge)#$Order, order, order! The court is now in session.

$#Judge(Judge)#$All rise for the presiding judge, Her Majesty,
the Queen!

$#QueenofHearts(Queen of Hearts)#$$&QueenofHeartsSmile&$$@Center@$Good day, everyone. I trust you will all do your
part today.
$#SpectatorA(Spectator A)#$$!-1!$It really is the Queen of Hearts herself!
$#SpectatorB(Spectator B)#$As radiant as ever, Your Majesty!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Center@$(So that's the Queen of Hearts... she is
beautiful, I'll grant her that...)

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Center@$(And somehow, looking at her makes me feel...
...safe. Like I have nothing to worry about.)
$#Judge(Judge)#$$!-1!$BANG BANG BANG!—I said order in the court!
$#Judge(Judge)#$Ahem. Please be seated...

$#Judge(Judge)#$We shall now begin proceedings against the
defendant, Alice, who stands accused of the
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Wait, Alice!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Huh? What!? She's gone!
$#YoungMan(Young Man)#$What do you think you're doing...!?

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidMelt&$$@Center@$Like I said, I just wanted to ask about you and
that girl over there...

$#YoungMan(Young Man)#$...Dyna and I are just childhood friends. You
heard Alice, didn't you? We're practically family.

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidTehepero&$$@Center@$Ehhhh? That's not true, is it? Because you have
feelings for...

$#YoungMan(Young Man)#$K-Keep your voice down! What if Dyna hears
you!?
$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidExcited&$$@Center@$Then that meeeeeeans I'm right?

$#YoungMan(Young Man)#$...Y-Yeah, you are. I... I do have feelings for
Dyna... but that's all they are. Just feelings.

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidNormal&$$@Center@$And that's enough for you? Because she has
feelings for you too, you know.
$#YoungMan(Young Man)#$No way... Are you serious?
$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidTehepero&$$@Center@$Absolutely. I, Cupid, says so. You can trust me.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(Alice... Where have you gone off to?)

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidTehepero&$$@Center@$Now, take heart! Why don't you go over and
take at least one tiny step forward?

$#YoungMan(Young Man)#$Uhh... I... yeah!! You're right. Just one tiny
step—

$#YoungMan(Young Man)#$Uh...Cupid? If something else comes up, can I
ask you for advice again?
$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidSmile&$$@Center@$Yes, of course. If it's about love, anytime!
$#YoungMan(Young Man)#$Thank you... O-Okay...! Dyna, hey...!

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidExcited&$$@Center@$Hehe. "Love" really is such a wonderful thing,
isn't it?
$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidExcited&$$@Center@$It's the best ♡♡♡♡

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(Seems like Alice and everyone else in the
village have gone to sleep.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(Maybe I should skip exploring for tonight and
just let my body rest.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$But like a "family", huh? This world doesn't
seem at all bad...
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Center@$Is that lady not who you were talking about?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$A world where Alice can live as just one
ordinary girl—

$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewSmile&$$@Center@$If things just stayed like this, maybe that would
be all right...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$You...! Where have you been until now?

$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewSmile&$$@Center@$Finn, there's one secret about this world I'll tell
you now—just between me and you.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$A secret about this world...? So you were hiding
something...?

$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewSmile&$$@Center@$Yes. You see, while that other "Alice" exists
in this world—
$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewSmile&$$@Center@$While that "Alice" is awake, I can't exist here.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$You can't exist...? That's absurd. How could—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$No... If the master of this dream world wanted
it that way, I suppose it would be possible.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$...But then who—or what—are you, exactly?

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidExcited&$$@Center@$Oh my goodness, what an adorable girl! You've
already stumbled right into love, mister!

$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewThinking&$$@Center@$I...don't clearly remember. My memories have
gone all hazy...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(Is this Alice being affected by the dream
master's influence too...?)

$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewSad&$$@Center@$If you don't know who I am, does that mean you
won't protect me?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$No. Of course not.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$I don't care how much anyone mocks me for it.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$I'll risk my life to protect and help you be
yourself.
$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewShyBlush&$$@Center@$You'd go that far for me...

$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewShyBlush&$$@Center@$Tell me... Am I... Is "Alice" your friend? Or is
she something more...

$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewEmbarrassed&$$@Center@$Wait, what kind of ridiculous question was
that!?

$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewShyBlush&$$@Center@$Never mind, never mind... forget I said
anything!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Left@$It's not love, Cupid...

$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewEmbarrassed&$$@Center@$Ahh, my face feels so hot. Like a marshmallow
roasted over the fireplace! I'm melting...

$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewShyBlush&$$@Center@$But if you really do care about me that much...
then I...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$...?
$#[Noise]([Noise])#$$!-1!$CLATTER!
$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidConfuse&$$@Center@$Whoopsie... that was careless of me...!
$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewEmbarrassed&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Eek!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$C-Cupid?!

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidTehepero&$$@Right@$I absolutely was not cracking the door open a
tiny bit to eavesdrop. Nope, not at all...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$You're not a good liar, are you...
$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidTehepero&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Well, you see, I thought I sensed a bit of love...

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidTehepero&$$@Right@$Oh, really...? Maybe my eye for romance is
getting rusty...

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidExcited&$$@Center@$So were you just now about to give a declaration
of undying love?
$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewEmbarrassed&$$@Center@$Declaration of love!? I-I was not!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$No, not at all... What makes you say that?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$There wasn't anything in that conversation that
would sound romantic...

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidTehepero&$$@Center@$I mean, "romantic" is exactly what it sounded
like, but if you insist...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Anyway, it's the middle of the night—let's get
some sleep.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Two beds, huh... Cupid, you'll take this room,
right?

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidSmile&$$@Right@$Since this is the only empty house with proper
beds, I guess so...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Then I'll go ask around and find somewhere else
to sleep.

$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You can just sleep here, Finn. I have things I
want to look into while the other Alice is asleep.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Her name is Cupid. We just met each other as
well.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$It's not safe for a young girl like you to be
wandering alone at night.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Besides, I travel a lot, so I'm used to dealing
with this kind of situation.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Good night, then.

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidSmile&$$@Center@$There's two beds here, he could just simply
sleep with me in the same room.
$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidSmile&$$@Center@$Finn is so proper...or maybe he's just too shy.

$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewSmile&$$@Center@$Hehe, surprisingly so. Though I guess that's
more suitable for a knight.
$#OriginalAlice(Original Alice)#$$&AliceNewSmile&$$@Center@$Then good night. See you tomorrow.

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidHappy&$$@Right@$Hello there, a pleasure to meet you! I'm Cupid,
and I absolutely adore love!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceWink&$$@Left@$Nice to meet you too. I'm Alice, and I absolutely
adore stories ♪

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(So she too is basically the same "Alice" that
I've always known—)
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Center@$Who...are you...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(The master of this dream world seems terribly
fixated on Alice.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(I hope it's not the bad kind of fixation...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$By the way, Alice—has anything strange been
happening around you lately?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceConcider&$$@Right@$Something strange... Strange, hmm... Hmmm...
Oh!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceOpenMouthHeh&$$@Right@$I haven't eaten apple pie lately! How could I
forget...?
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceOpenMouthHeh&$$@Right@$That's definitely out of the ordinary for me.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$(So in other words, nothing noteworthy...)

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceClosedEyesSmile&$$@Right@$Aside from that, I found a whole bunch of tasty
looking pomegranates! Take a gander at these!

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidHappy&$$@Left@$Wow, they do look tasty! And the smell is
amazing!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Right@$I was thinking of asking Mama to use these to
bake some pomegranate mince pies!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$So you don't remember me either...
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Right@$Would you two like to join us?

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidMelt&$$@Left@$Mince pies? That sounds very delicious! I'm
extremely interested...(drool) ♪

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(I guess I should be trying to figure out the
mysteries of this dream world right now, but...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Well, one still gets hungry even in a dream
world.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$If it's not too much trouble, I'd love to join too.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$"Dream world"? What a lovely phrase! You're
more poetic than you look!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceWink&$$@Center@$Yes, I like it! All right, follow me—
$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$We'd better go, Finn. She's actually quite fast.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Y-You're right. Wait for us, Alice—!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Right@$This is the village where I live.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(But she looks like the Alice I'm familiar with...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$It's pretty big... Might be even bigger than the
the village I grew up in.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceWink&$$@Right@$Oh, you grew up in a village too? Now we have
something in common!

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidNormal&$$@Left@$But it seems quite lifeless... Is everyone sleeping
or something?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceComeOn&$$@Right@$How rude! The people of this village are hard-
working folk. Everybody is up and busy!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Something does feel off though. There's a lot of
houses...and a lot of them look abandoned.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$No sign of anyone living in them...
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Center@$Mister...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceOpenMouthHeh&$$@Center@$You're like a detective! I've read about those in
books!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Alice, can you give us a serious answer here?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$It might be the key to figuring out the secret of
this world.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Center@$Wait a minute! You're...oh!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$This is sounding more and more like a detective
story! Sure, let me do some serious thinking.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceConcider&$$@Center@$Now that you mention it, it is kind of strange
that the village is so empty... I wonder why.
$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidSmile&$$@Center@$How many people are living here...?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Center@$Let's see—there's me, Mama, Papa, and then...
Um...
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Center@$About seven people! I'm pretty sure.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Just seven people in a village of this size?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Center@$Yup! It's always been like that, no one has
moved in or out.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Just a handful of villagers for a village of this
size... Something is not adding up.)

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$He he, this is a proper mystery ♪ Let's think
it over while eating some delicious pies!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$Come on, my house is this way—

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$You're that person who ate all those meat pies
in the village next door!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$Lovely mince pie ♪
$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidHappy&$$@Center@$Mince pie ♪

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$...Well, no point in panicking and overthinking
it, I guess.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Center@$I was hoping Mama would bake the mince pies,
but...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Center@$It seems Mama and Papa have gone off
somewhere.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Center@$But then everyone else helped out!

$#YoungMan(Young Man)#$$!-1!$A mince pie party! Just in time for the end of my
work day!

$#YoungWoman(Young Woman)#$Mmm, sweet pie is just the thing for tired
bones!

$#Middle-AgedMan(Middle-Aged Man)#$Wouldn't mind having some booze to go with it,
though…

$#Elder(Elder)#$Here you go, young fellow—have some of our
village specialty, fresh pomegranate juice!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$Why do both you confuse me with such specific
people...? No, that's not me, I'm afraid.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Uh...thank you.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$One, two, three, four—and Alice, plus her
parents...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Is this everyone in the village?
$#YoungMan(Young Man)#$Huh? Yeah, why do you ask?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Oh, no reason...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(Definitely feels too small for the size of the
village...)
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Center@$Everyone here is practically family! Right?

$#YoungWoman(Young Woman)#$Mm-hmm, of course! I think of you like a little
sister, Alice!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Everyone in the village is family, huh...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$(My village of Rossé was a lot like this too... It
makes me feel nostalgic.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$I'm Finn, and this girl beside me, who looks like
you is—

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$!-1!$$@Right@$How do you like the mince pie? This
pomegranate flavoring is a village original!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Yeah, it's really good! Thanks!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceClosedEyesSmile&$$@Right@$Right? Right? Okey-dokey ♪

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Alice, I forgot to ask earlier—have you ever
heard of the "Queen of Hearts"?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Right@$The Queen of Hearts? Hmmm, it sounds
familiar...

$#Middle-AgedMan(Middle-Aged Man)#$$!-1!$"Sounds familiar"? Don't be silly, she's the
lord of the castle nearby.

$#Elder(Elder)#$I've never met her, but they say she's terrifying...
Not a name I like saying aloud.

$#Middle-AgedMan(Middle-Aged Man)#$The last thing you want is to draw her attention.
Better be careful, Alice.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceComeOn&$$@Center@$You should be careful too, mister. Don't get
drunk and wander into the castle.
$#Middle-AgedMan(Middle-Aged Man)#$$!-1!$Me? I'd never do that! Right, Elder?
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Center@$Girl who looks like me? Beside you?

$#Elder(Elder)#$Oh, I wouldn't be so sure. You ought to listen
to Alice.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$Ahahaha, I told you so!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$(Alice looks so happy right now.)

$#YoungWoman(Young Woman)#$$!-1!$Today's pomegranate juice turned out great!
Ahh, hits the spot.
$#YoungMan(Young Man)#$......
$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidExcited&$$@Center@$Mister, you're in loooove, aren't you...?
$#YoungMan(Young Man)#$$!-1!$Huh? M-Me? Wait, who even are you—

$#Cupid(Cupid)#$$&CupidTehepero&$$@Center@$I'm Cupid. And I was hoping to ask you about
love...
$#YoungWoman(Young Woman)#$$!-1!$Love? What are you talking about?

$#YoungMan(Young Man)#$No, this lady's just saying whatever... Come over
here for a second!

Declarations of love, gushing about a lover, and lovers' quarrels—they all carry the sweetest scent of romance. Even now, whenever she hears someone's heart begin to race, Cupid will appear with the soft flutter of her wings.

Everyone saw her as an unserious student on the verge of dropping out—but in truth, she has greater potential in time magic than anyone else. The margins of her class notes are filled with unfinished love stories.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Cupid's goal was to discover the clearest example of "true love", absorb its power, and become the new Primordial of Love. And deep within an ancient dream, she found an incredibly potent love that had been lying dormant for ages.
She will stop at nothing to achieve her goal—even if it means exploiting the wishes, the pain, and the tragic fates of others.

keys.DescriptionKey:
500% damage to 1 enemy if they do not have the Burn status effect. If not burning, that enemy will also be granted Cursed Sleep for 200TU, and the user will be granted Sleep Thorns. This attack ignores Guardians and damage reduction effects. This skill becomes locked after use until the user uses another active skill. This lock may be ignored if allies have 0 Spirit.

Cursed Sleep will overwrite status effects other than Burn, cannot be overwritten by Poison, can be applied repeatedly to units that have already slept while on the battlefield, and will not end from damage caused by Dream Hunter type active skills. When a unit with Sleep Thorns is dealt damage by an attack, that unit's Sleep Thorns will be consumed to immediately grant the Cursed Sleep status effect to the attacker. Burn or attacks that grant Burn will remove Sleep Thorns and prevent Cursed Sleep from applying.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The Devil. Fifteenth Arcana of the Tarot. The card of duplicity, corruption, and inescapable fate.

Cyrus learned to read the cards as a boy, the poor bastard of a lord. Even as a child, he was no fool; his use to his father would end the moment his wife bore him a true heir. Rather than wait to be unceremoniously murdered, he ran away and joined an underground ring of thieves masquerading as soothsayers and fortune tellers. His skill with a deck served him well, but unlike his comrades, Cyrus told no lies.

The misfortunes he predicted had a way of coming true.

Cyrus01.name: Cyrus
Cyrus01.title: Mercurial Mastermind
Cyrus01.description:
The Devil. Fifteenth Arcana of the Tarot. The card of duplicity, corruption, and inescapable fate.

Cyrus learned to read the cards as a boy, the poor bastard of a lord. Even as a child, he was no fool; his use to his father would end the moment his wife bore him a true heir. Rather than wait to be unceremoniously murdered, he ran away and joined an underground ring of thieves masquerading as soothsayers and fortune tellers. His skill with a deck served him well, but unlike his comrades, Cyrus told no lies.

The misfortunes he predicted had a way of coming true.

keys.IntroText:
"Fancy a glance into your future?
Mind you, my cards never lie."

keys.DescriptionKey:
The Tower. Sixteenth Arcana of the Tarot. The card of suffering, disaster, and unforeseen consequences.

It was a simple enough job. A mercenary named Rody hired him to investigate a collapsing mine. Nothing more than a tidy purse of gold should have come of it. But somehow, Cyrus found himself embroiled in a fight to save the world.

The others at Rody's side were good, honest. Not like him. They played their parts in the grand pantomime well, but he could see the Pandemonium for what it was. A scheme.

Somewhere, someone was pulling their strings, and when everything finally went wrong, he vowed to find out who.

Cyrus02.name: Cyrus
Cyrus02.title: Mercurial Mastermind
Cyrus02.description:

It was a simple enough job. A mercenary named Rody hired him to investigate a collapsing mine. Nothing more than a tidy purse of gold should have come of it. But somehow, Cyrus found himself embroiled in a fight to save the world.

The others at Rody's side were good, honest. Not like him. They played their parts in the grand pantomime well, but he could see the Pandemonium for what it was. A scheme.

Somewhere, someone was pulling their strings, and when everything finally went wrong, he vowed to find out who.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The Star. Seventeenth Arcana of the Tarot. The card of clarity, hope, and renewed purpose.

After much searching, he found his answers. Their god was the greatest con man of all -- but he did not run his game without reason. In the divine darkness, Cyrus glimpsed the worlds beyond Erden, and all the unknowable powers that resided there. He understood then that Rody had died not to protect Erden from the Pandemonium, but to protect it from them.

He would not let his sacrifice go to waste. As his friend had before him, he would take on the mantle of a god and play a newfound role.

keys.DescriptionKey:
―― Beginning mission report.

I've just departed Hymelian territory. Duke Valenne welcomed me to his feast most warmly, and his son even more so. I fortuitously happened by his bedroom in the morning -- just in time to be caught. Your wisdom proved invaluable yet again, master. The flustered lover truly is my most convincing mask.

The rumor mill has already started churning. As you requested, the boy is unharmed, though I can't say the same for his reputation. I expect his betrothed's house to call things off within the month, which is a problem solved for us.

I remain your faithful servant. For the glory of Bergaria.

keys.IntroText:
"As a spider, draped in silk,
She spins her sweet deception."

keys.DescriptionKey:
―― Beginning mission report.

I thank you for this assignment, master. Every day I am away from Bergaria, I long to return. To work the Emperor's will in his own domain is my highest honor.

The upstart senator was bold to throw a ball while so publicly defying his regent. I've seen to his punishment. The toxin I slipped into his wine shrivels the body from the inside out. Make no mistake: everyone will know he was poisoned, and everyone will know why.

I remain your faithful servant. For the glory of Bergaria.

keys.DescriptionKey:
―― Beginning my report.

I did it, master. The blade slid right between his ribs, just like you said it would. In the end, he didn't even scream. He just looked at me, so scared and confused, like he had no idea who could possibly want him dead.

No idea at all.

The bastard took everything from me, and he never even spared it a second thought.

(The text beyond this is illegible. The paper is wrinkled with age, and the ink is smeared with tear stains.)

keys.DescriptionKey: "My sweet angel, I'm heeeeere! We made it to the island at last. At last. I thought that horrible boat trip would never end. All those storms, all those people packed so close together. It's a miracle I didn't lose any of my things! (Don't worry, I checked my bags as soon as we docked. All my swimsuits are safe and sound∼) Wish you were with me, cuddlebug!" Shortly after landing at their island resort, a Hymelian noble was horrified to find her jewelry box had vanished. Alira stole it for the war effort, of course. But surely the emperor will let her keep a piece or two for herself.

keys.DescriptionKey:
"My most handsome darling,

Ugh. How gloomy everyone on this island is! Whenever I start to relax, someone has to bring up the invasion—or worse, the rebels. As soon as I get back, you owe me a kiss for each time I had to hear 'Blue Dragon Knights.' I'm warning you, it's a lot! ♡

Wish you were with me, pumpkin!"

In the middle of the night, resort guards arrested a wealthy merchant for treason. Supposedly, his secret correspondence with the Rigland resistance had been pinned to his door with knives. Alira usually prefers a more subtle approach, but this vacation put her in a more theatrical mood than usual.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The emperor ordered her to send a coded letter each day she was away. Alira has faithfully carried out her duties as his spy, sowing fear of the Empire among Erden's most wealthy and elite. But there are some secrets she must keep even from her master.

Who knows why Fate would bring the man who killed her family here now? Who knows why She would make him untouchable, far too crucial to Bergaria's war to die at her hands? Who knows what cruel joke the world will play on her next?

She'll let the bastard live. For now. But he owes her a debt in blood, and one day, Alira will see it paid.

keys.DescriptionKey:
There is no rebellion in Last Bastion. There is no rebellion in Last Bastion. There is no rebellion in Last Bastion.

The Vanguard like to think it will become true if they say it enough, but they know they are kidding themselves. A year ago, the missing supplies, the vandalism, even the accidents could be waved away as the work of disorganized malcontents. Today, they are too frequent, too directed against the city's tyrannical leader. A reckoning, long overdue, will soon arrive.

She will not be silenced now. She has waited far too long.

DarkAstrid01.title: Voice of Defiance

keys.IntroText:
"Why should we be afraid to die?
We already live like the dead."

keys.DescriptionKey:
Stories of the rebel leader pervade Last Bastion's populace, whispered so as not to attract a passing patrol's attention. Spreading rumors of subversion is tantamount to treason in a city that depends so heavily on its unity, but even so, the lure of the forbidden keeps Astrid's infamy alive.

The stories say she can take on six soldiers at once, that she can move without a sound, that no one has ever seen her sleep. But for every believer who marvels at her deeds, another skeptic scoffs.

Surely if she possessed such power, she would have already won.

keys.DescriptionKey:
It may seem an eternity under the undead siege, but Astrid has only been officially dead for two years. Most still remember her and her father, and they remember the last night either of them was seen alive.

No one knows how the outer wall exploded. Only that it did, and that countless people burned to keep the city safe. Ludmilla attests that the commander and his daughter died in the blaze, but there are some who tell a different story.

They say that Astrid never agreed to the sacrifice of her people, and that she's come to claim their vengeance.

keys.SelectedKey: "Enough! I will end this!"

keys.value: $#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$@Center@$Stop it! Both of you, stop this!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$Are you going to kill me?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Center@$I do not want to.
But...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$This will make you stronger. Bear the
consequences...even the tragic ones.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Center@$...Thank you for everything, Ludmilla.
Goodbye.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSurprised&$$@Center@$...Aah?!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaCry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I cut your Achilles tendon, Tori.
I'm sorry.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Left@$Mysha...
Are you crying?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaCry&$$@Right@$Of course I am...I don't want to kill my
friends, or watch you kill each other!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Why, Mya? We could have...
We had already won...!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaCry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I thought about it, and...I think Ludmilla
is right. We can't let the city fall.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Mya, help me! We cannot allow this
to happen!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaDepressed&$$@Right@$We can't waste this chance. Even if it
brings about so much death...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$Thank you for seeing sense, Mysha.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$@Right@$I just want you and Tori to make up.
That's my condition for helping you.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Right@$I won't be around anymore, so...you have
to treasure each other instead, okay?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Left@$What do you mean?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You take Tori back to headquarters for
treatment. I'll activate the sigil.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Center@$Then...I'll face my fate along with
everyone else.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSurprised&$$@Center@$!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Center@$I turned on Tori for this plan. I'm willing
to take responsibility for that.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Center@$So, please, Tori...
Don't hate Ludmilla.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaShouting&$$@Left@$Mysha, I need your help! Wasting time
like this helps no one!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Center@$No... No, Mya! Don't do this!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I see you've made up your mind...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Right@$Yeah, I have.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$...Understood.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Left@$...There's a 15 minute delay on the blast.
Enough time for you to evacuate.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Left@$Just keep it in mind, okay?
I would hate to lose your talents.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Thanks. That's kind of you to say.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$...I'll see you at headquarters, Mysha.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Right@$...Goodbye, you two.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Center@$Mya...! Mya!
Mya, wait!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Right@$Enough!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridCrying&$$@Center@$Mya...!
No...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Let's go. We have to leave...or we'll be
among the thousands of sacrifices.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$(Thousands of lives...what a staggering
number...)

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Right@$Ha...haha. Now you hesitate? The
weight of this sin will cling to you for life.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSmile&$$@Right@$The blood of thousands of innocents on
your hands, forever. Haha...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...I know that. Pragmatism doesn't mean
I feel the weight any less heavily.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Center@$I'll carry their suffering with me. And it
will save the lives of countless more.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaShouting&$$@Center@$My hands may be stained with blood, but
at least humanity will endure!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Center@$If you can't accept that, all you're doing
is running from reality.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridCrying&$$@Center@$...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Left@$Ngh...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Center@$(Poor girl. To have leadership thrust upon
her just because of her bloodline...)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Center@$(When she doesn't even grasp this
simple, brutal truth.)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(How can I help her? How can I shape her
into the leader she needs to become?)

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherAngry&$$@Center@$The survival of Last Bastion must be our
foremost priority in this war.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherAngry&$$@Center@$If Astrid succeeds me with such weakness
left in her, the Vanguard will crumble.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Center@$(The Vanguard will crumble...)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Center@$(Just now, she disobeyed an order from
her superior and endangered the city.)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Center@$(She even raised her blade to me, delaying
a strategy that will destroy the undead.)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(Her hubris blinds her to her failures, and
her childish ideals blind her to reality...)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(What's more, she recognizes all this and
makes no effort to correct herself.)

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaAngry&$$@Left@$Tori...! That was aimed at her throat...
Are you seriously trying to kill Ludmilla?!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Center@$(An unfit candidate in almost all ways,
with no room to change.)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Center@$(But even so, her bloodline alone will win
her enough support to advance...)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Center@$(What an unfortunate girl...from
the beginning to the end.)

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridCrying&$$!-1!$$@Right@$No...
Mya...everyone...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Left@$...
I should go.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridCrying&$$@Right@$Sniffle... Lend me your shoulder, please.
I cannot walk.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No. I'm done, Astrid.
I won't coddle you anymore.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSurprised&$$@Center@$...What?! If you leave me here...
The explosion will kill me!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Center@$What...what about your promise with Mya?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Center@$Compared to the survival of humanity,
a promise...means nothing.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(She got me in the shoulder...and I
lost my sword. So this is it...)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Center@$Protecting Last Bastion is my top priority.
Saving you will make that impossible.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Center@$...Oh, so that is it!
Finally, I see your true colors.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Center@$What are you saying?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Center@$You talk of making choices, but all you
have chosen is blind obedience!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Center@$If you claim your bloodstained hands
will save humanity, then so be it.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Center@$But your own humanity is long gone.
You are no more than a monster.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...
...Say whatever you like.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Center@$Goodbye, Astrid. May your next life be
a kinder one, in a kinder world.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Center@$Ludmilla? You do not have to do this.
Ludmilla, please!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridCrying&$$@Center@$$%0.5%$Ludmillaaaa!!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Center@$You always were the better swordfighter.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Center@$...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaShouting&$$@Right@$What...what is that?! I've never seen
the Pyre blaze so high!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Scout)#$$!-1!$Commander! We have reports of an army
on the horizon, vast beyond counting!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Left@$Vice-Commander, call the Valkyries.
I want you all shoring up the Outer Wall.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaShouting&$$@Right@$Yes, sir!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid's Subordinate 1)#$The first undead have reached the
Outer Wall!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Center@$We cannot defend the Wall ourselves.
Prepare to fight within the Outer City!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid's Subordinate 1)#$$!-1!$Yes, ma'am.
I'll pass it on to the squad leaders.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Right@$Tori, what about the people living here
in the Outer City?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Right@$Should we evacuate them into the Inner
City? Or have them bunker down?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Left@$I would much prefer to evacuate them,
but...

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$@Right@$If we do, there'll barely be any space for
anyone in the Inner City or the keep.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherAngry&$$@Left@$I have, once, decades ago. On the day
the undead invasion began.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSerious&$$@Left@$Yes. The gates will be crammed, and
the Vanguard will be unable to mobilize.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$@Right@$We don't have the manpower to lead an
evacuation, either. It's just not happening.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Left@$...Understood. Call the civilian leaders
together. I will speak with them.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Combat will soon be joined within the city.
Shelter inside, and do not leave.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Reinforcements will arrive soon. You need
only hold out for a short time.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Refugee Man 1)#$$!-1!$And yer sure of that, are ye?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Center@$Of course. The Outer City is a valuable
part of Lost Bastion.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Center@$The Commander would never abandon it.
That's why the Outer Wall was built.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Refugee Man 2)#$$!-1!$Alright...I'll buy it. I've had enough
running from those undead freaks.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Center@$Thanks for understanding.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaHurt&$$@Right@$The invasion...!
Then that means...

$#Boy(Child)#$$&YoungBoyScared&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Waaah...hic...
Waaaaah...!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Refugee Woman 1)#$$!-1!$Now, now, don't cry.
There's no call for that.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Refugee Man 1)#$Can't hardly blame the lad, though.
I ain't happy with it neither.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSmile&$$@Left@$Do not worry, child. We will protect you.

$#Boy(Child)#$$&YoungBoyScared&$$@Right@$Y-you will, miss?
R-really?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSmile&$$@Left@$Yes, I promise. So be strong, and listen
to your mother. Can you do that?
$#Boy(Child)#$$&YoungBoyHappy&$$@Right@$Yeah... I can! I'll do my best!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSerious&$$@Left@$Now, then. Barricade yourselves within
your homes as soon as possible.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Left@$...Phew.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSerious&$$@Right@$Well, at least they're working with us.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Left@$We can't say for sure, but something is
bound to happen. Prepare for the worst.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Left@$When the Wall falls, many of them will
die. And it will fall, make no mistake.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Right@$...Even so, we don't have time to grieve.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Right@$Once you become Commander, you'll have
to make even more decisions like this.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Left@$...Yes, I know.
I have to focus.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Left@$First, we must report to Father. Mya,
take this down.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSerious&$$@Left@$Large force of undead approaching. Close
the Inner City gates and harden defenses.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSerious&$$@Left@$I recommend setting up dragonfire traps
in unpopulated sectors of the Outer City.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Left@$Star Platoon will lead the undead into
these traps, as possible. End message.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$It's a great plan, Tori. I'll get our fastest
runner on it.
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$Astrid!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Right@$The worst... Sir, does that mean...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSurprised&$$@Left@$Ludmilla!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$We're here to thin their numbers
along the Outer Wall!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Be careful! The enemy force is massive.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$We'll handle it. I've brought my
best soldiers with me.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaShouting&$$@Left@$Let's go!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid's Subordinate)#$That concludes the report from
Lieutenant Astrid, in the field.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Center@$Good work. Tell her her message has
been received.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid's Subordinate)#$$!-1!$Yes, sir!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Center@$Abandon the Outer Wall and focus on
defending the Inner City. A wise choice.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Center@$A strategy that cannot succeed without
sacrifice... And the correct choice.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherAngry&$$@Left@$A horde of undead the likes of which we
have never seen before.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherSmile&$$@Center@$You've grown, Astrid. I'll have to
commend you next time we meet.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherAngry&$$@Left@$Before, their force was divided between
pockets of mortal resistance across Erden.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherAngry&$$@Left@$But now that Last Bastion is our final
stand in truth as well as in name...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Right@$Then every single undead on Erden is
on its way here.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Refugee 1)#$Haha! This war will all be over soon! The
Heroes will defeat all the undead at once!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid's Subordinate 1)#$Shut up! You don't work, you don't pay
taxes. You just cower behind our walls!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Center@$There is no call to be abusive to these
people.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid's Subordinate 1)#$$!-1!$B-but, Lieutenant...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Center@$All living beings are allies in this war.
Even a single life lost strengthens our foe.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Center@$Squabbling amongst ourselves only aids
the enemy. I will not allow it.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid's Subordinate 1)#$$!-1!$Y-yes, ma'am.
Forgive me, ma'am.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Center@$Confine these people until they have
cooled their heads, and then release them.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid's Subordinate 1)#$$!-1!$Yes, ma'am!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Left@$The two Heroes of Erden, blessed by the
Sage, bearing the storied Sword...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Left@$And even now, those Heroes are on their
way to banish the Evil One.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Refugee 2)#$Break open the stores! Get the wine
flowing! We're feasting tonight!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSerious&$$@Right@$It's a common story, yeah...
It gives them hope, at least.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Right@$Though it's a fantasy at best.
I guess I don't really mind it too much.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Left@$I would not mind it at all, if it were not
inspiring disturbances like this one.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Right@$The world's a pretty hopeless place. I can
see why they want an excuse to celebrate.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSerious&$$@Left@$But if we do not step in, this uproar will
spread through the Outer City.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$@Right@$The whole city would end up convinced
the war was ending tomorrow, I'm sure.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSerious&$$@Left@$If we do not deny the rumor proactively,
our silence will be taken as endorsement.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$@Right@$Everyone wants the war to end. We all
want to be optimistic.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Left@$But the instant the truth returns, that
chaotic hope will turn to crushing despair.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$@Right@$Even the Vanguard would be shaken.
We could even get riots.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Left@$Take those two into custody.
Try not to injure them.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Left@$Our best option now is to stop this rumor
before it spreads to the Inner City.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Left@$(Father, I will not let you down. I will do
what I must, as your successor.)

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSerious&$$@Center@$We have almost reached the center of this
uproar. Star Platoon...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Suppress this disturbance. Do not use
force on anyone who is unarmed.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Center@$Move out!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSurprised&$$@Center@$?!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSurprised&$$@Center@$What...is this?
The sky is pitch black...

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Look at the Pyre! It's flared up...like a
tower of flame on the horizon!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid's Subordinate 1)#$$!-1!$Lieutenant! The revelers in the Outer City
are descending into chaos!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid's Subordinate 2)#$The soldiers are shaken, too. We need
orders before they begin to panic.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSurprise&$$@Right@$Hmph. Unrest, my foot...
This is just a bunch of idiots merrymaking.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Center@$Calm the Platoon. Then, begin directing
people indoors. Arrest anyone panicking.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid's Subordinates)#$$!-1!$Yes, ma'am!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Center@$(What is this? Whatever it is, I must stay
calm. It is time to prove myself...)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Refugee 1)#$$!-1!$Hey, let me go! Blasted soldier! Can't we
even have a party in this damn city?!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid's Subordinate 1)#$You have no basis to say that the
war will be over soon.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid's Subordinate 2)#$Food stores are precious. You're the ones
who will starve if you waste them all.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Refugee 2)#$Tch, bootlickers. Once the war is over,
we won't need soldiers like you anymore.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Refugee 1)#$Once you're all out of work, you're the
ones who will be starving, not us!

keys.DescriptionKey:
An heirloom of the von Draclow family, the greatsword Dragonfury has been passed down for generations without rusting or going dull. As inexhaustible as Astrid's will to fight, enemies both living and undead have fallen to its deadly edge. The very act of battle seems to keep it keen.

Learning to wield it from her father is the one memory of him Astrid looks upon with fondness.

keys.IntroText:
"Black as death, black as bleakest midnight.
The vengeful blade of a heart burnt to ash."

keys.DescriptionKey:
Come one, come all, to toast the dying year.

Astrid has prepared a feast for all of winter's wanderers. Her hearth burns warm and her table seats hundreds. As soon as night falls, she opens her gates and welcomes monster and innocent alike. She has been both. She knows that life flies by, no matter who you are, no matter what you've done. It is what separates the mortals from the gods.

Few view death as a celebration. But then, few can see it through Astrid's eyes.

Mortality, the chance to grow and change, is the greatest gift a soul can be given.

DarkAstridNewYear01.name: Endless Astrid
DarkAstridNewYear01.title: Twilight Bride
DarkAstridNewYear01.description:

keys.IntroText:
She toasts the old year as it dies.
For without death, what can be born anew?

keys.DescriptionKey:
There was a time she couldn't conceive of joy. Even now, the feeling seems a stranger to her, a guest she invited without truly knowing. Orcanix once convinced her revenge would be her joy, but even deep in the Goddess's thrall, she knew that was a lie.

Astrid never delighted in destruction. Looking back, she wonders how she managed to build the Rebellion when her heart was so black with misery. She didn't want to hurt Ludmilla. She didn't hate Last Bastion, or its Vanguard soldiers. She just wanted to know why.

What had she done to make her friend hate her so much?

DarkAstridNewYear02.name: Endless Astrid
DarkAstridNewYear02.title: Twilight Bride
DarkAstridNewYear02.description:
There was a time she couldn't conceive of joy. Even now, the feeling seems a stranger to her, a guest she invited without truly knowing. Orcanix once convinced her revenge would be her joy, but even deep in the Goddess's thrall, she knew that was a lie.

Astrid never delighted in destruction. Looking back, she wonders how she managed to build the Rebellion when her heart was so black with misery. She didn't want to hurt Ludmilla. She didn't hate Last Bastion, or its Vanguard soldiers. She just wanted to know why.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Reconciliation. Surely such a thing is impossible. What friendship can survive two heinous betrayals? Astrid was sure she would one day meet Ludmilla in hell, and they could finish whatever was left of their fight there.

Instead, her soul was found and forgiven. A lifetime of guilt disappeared from her shoulders all at once, and suddenly, she was pure. She couldn't say she deserved it, after everything she'd done, but when happiness finally came to her again, she welcomed it with open arms.

Mortals fear death as an unforgiving end; that is their eternal folly. Astrid knows now: death is but the start of something new.

keys.value: $#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Center@$(This should be far enough to be safe.)

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherSurprised&$$@Right@$...
Welcome back, Vice-Commander.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Left@$(...Something's not right. He seems...
Surprised to see me.)

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Right@$Did you have a subordinate activate
the sigil, then?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Left@$...
(Why would he ask that?)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Left@$No, sir. Mysha of the Star Platoon
volunteered to share the civilians' fate...
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherAngry&$$@Right@$...I see. A regrettable loss.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$(Ah, so that's what it was.)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Center@$However, I did notice an irregularity in
the explosion, sir.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Center@$The time between activation of the sigils
and the explosion was abnormally short.
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Center@$...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(The sigil should have just been
activated. I have another 15—)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Center@$In fact, given the timing, I would guess
that the explosion happened immediately.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Center@$As a result, I was barely able to escape
the blast zone, and still suffered injury.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Center@$...May I request an explanation.
Commander?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Center@$(There she goes again...prioritizing her
ideals and feelings over logic.)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Center@$(She doesn't realize what her weakness
will lead to. I thought she knew better...)

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSurprised&$$@Center@$?!
W-what was that?!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$If we enact my proposed plan, we can
weather the assault without this madness!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Right@$Ludmilla, please! With your support,
surely Father will reconsider...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$Why should the Commander of the
Vanguard listen to a mere lieutenant?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSurprised&$$@Right@$Ludmilla...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Plans on the front can be overturned in
an instant. Every commander knows this.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Center@$You clung to your plan and commanded
the citizens to remain in their homes.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$You didn't account for possible changes
in strategy. Anything that happens now...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Is on you and your strategic error.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Center@$My... Error...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Center@$I don't blame you for it.
Everyone makes mistakes.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$The undead all rammed against the wall
at once!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Center@$Under the circumstances, I likely would
have made the same choice.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Center@$But I can bear the consequences of that
choice. Even the tragic ones.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Center@$I see you can't. And that means that
all of this is just lip service to your pride.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSurprised&$$@Center@$!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$All those times I covered for you were
a mistake.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$You just want the title of Commander.
You don't understand what it entails.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Center@$If you become Commander, your naivete
will be the death of humanity someday.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Center@$The Commander saw that. That's why he
scolded you - hoping you would learn.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaShouting&$$@Center@$But now I can see. You've never had what
it takes to lead, and you never will.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Ludmilla, you're going too far!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSurprised&$$@Left@$They are bringing siege beasts to the wall,
too. This is very bad.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Right@$...It seems that you and I are more
different than I had thought.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Right@$If you do this, enact the evacuation first.
Otherwise, I will not move from this spot.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$I said the same thing. But the enemy will
realize something is amiss if we do.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Left@$This is an order from the Commander
himself. You are to obey.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridNormal&$$@Right@$Haha...so in the end, all you can do is
parrot my father's words, I see.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Left@$What?!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Choices, you say, but all you have chosen
is to become my father's mouthpiece.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Center@$You were once so brave and proud,
Ludmilla. I looked up to you.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Center@$You would never sacrifice innocent lives
without exhausting every other option.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Center@$...I promised to protect these people.
If that means fighting you, so be it.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Right@$At this rate, it's only a matter of time
before the Wall comes down!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Tori, stop it!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$If this is how it has to be...

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaAngry&$$@Center@$Ludmilla, no!
Please, you two! Calm down!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Center@$Here I come, Ludmilla!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Left@$Star Platoon, fall back from the Wall!
Set up defenses within the Outer City.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaShouting&$$@Center@$Vice-Commander Aldyne, reporting.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$Is there some other option...?

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Left@$Yes...the first undead invasion was Hell
on Erden. Truly horrific to behold.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Left@$So, I had mages work veins of dragonfire
into the foundation of the Outer Wall.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Left@$Countless tendrils of the stuff, like roots,
stretching deep underground.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherSmile&$$@Left@$When the undead take the Wall...
It can converted into a colossal bomb.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Right@$The Wall itself...? But if such a bomb
were to be detonated...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Left@$The damage to the Outer City will likely
be severe, yes.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Left@$Almost all of the refugees beyond the
Inner Wall will perish.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherIrritated&$$@Left@$This is intended as a last resort, of
course. I'm open to any other options.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Right@$...
...I cannot think of any.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Good work, Vice-Commander. I've
received word of your Valkyries' success.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherSmile&$$@Left@$Excellent. Then I'll assume you will be
assisting me in this plan.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Left@$It takes two to activate the dragonfire,
after all.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Left@$Two sigils concealed on the Outer Wall
must be activated to arm the bomb.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Left@$Once both sigils are activated, there's a
15 minute delay before detonation...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherAngry&$$@Left@$But we cannot afford to evacuate anyone.
The undead are not fools.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherAngry&$$@Left@$If they see a mass retreat, they'll pull
back for sure.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Left@$I will activate the sigil on the southern
wall. You take the north.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Left@$Its location and activation ritual are
written in this book. Here.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Right@$Yes, sir...
I will move out as soon as possible.
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherSmile&$$@Left@$Ah, I do have one other request.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherSmile&$$@Left@$Mere hours since the attack began, and
you've defeated hundreds of undead.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$Yes, sir?

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Left@$Before you activate the sigil, tell Astrid
to distance herself from the Outer Wall.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Left@$She's my successor, after all. She must
survive to lead humanity someday.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Right@$Understood.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Right@$(It seems there are some lives he's not
willing to sacrifice after all...)
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Left@$Still, the situation remains dire.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Right@$Yes, sir. The enemy force has only grown.
The Outer Wall will fall, sooner or later...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Left@$...And after that, surely Last Bastion
itself, you think?

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherSmile&$$@Left@$Your youth betrays you, Vice-Commander.
I can tell what you're thinking.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Right@$...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherSmile&$$@Left@$Don't lose hope yet. I planned for this
eventuality when the city was built.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Center@$I apologize for taking your time, but there
is something I must have you confirm.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$Then...it makes no difference which
company is chosen to retreat.
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Right@$I see...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$Of course, as soon as one company had
retreated, I would assist the other as well.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Left@$(This feels like a textbook question. Is this
just a test of my tactical ability?)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Left@$(Or will we be facing choices like this
in the near future?)
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherSmile&$$@Right@$Indeed. An orthodox answer.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherSmile&$$@Right@$Now, what if one company had half the
members? However, they are all Valkyries.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$Hm...the Valkyries are the elite of the
elite. Each one is worth several infantry.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$In that case, the Valkyries are a more
valuable asset. I would prioritize them.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Left@$(I dislike weighing the lives of soldiers
against each other...)
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherSmile&$$@Center@$Have a look at this map.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Left@$(But a soldier must be logical.
The Valkyries are more important.)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$(Hah...Astrid would be furious with me
for making a choice like this.)

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Right@$Then, what if one company consisted of
only a single survivor?

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Right@$However, if that survivor perishes, the
front is lost.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Right@$Could you sacrifice an entire company
for the survival of one soldier?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$I have several questions. First, can one
soldier's fate really decide a battle?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$The logistics involved in effecting either
retreat would also affect my answer.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherIrritated&$$@Right@$It's merely a thought exercise. Make your
choice with only the information you have.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Left@$Then there is no choice at all. To avoid
defeat, the single soldier must be saved.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Left@$Losing a front means losing Last Bastion.
A single company pales in comparison.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$The city and its environs. Are these two
red flags outside the Wall allied units, sir?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$This is our last stand against the undead.
Losing the city means the end of humanity.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$In light of that, any and all options must
be considered, even distasteful ones.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$At least, that is my opinion.
From a commander's perspective.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherSmile&$$@Right@$That, Vice-Commander,
is the correct answer.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Right@$The survival of Last Bastion must be our
foremost priority in this war.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Right@$The Commander of the Vanguard must be
able to recognize this truth.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherSmile&$$@Right@$Truly, you are a model soldier. I knew I
made the right decision appointing you.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$Thank you, sir.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Right@$There's just one problem.
You are far too soft on Astrid.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Left@$...
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Right@$Yes. The blue markers are undead.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Right@$She prioritizes any suffering individual
over the survival of all humanity...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Right@$In peacetime, that would be an admirable
quality. But we are at war.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherAngry&$$@Right@$Her attitude is dangerous, and you must
not encourage it nor allow it.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherAngry&$$@Right@$But you have, repeatedly, out of your
friendship with her. Am I wrong?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSad&$$@Left@$...
Perhaps not, sir.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherAngry&$$@Right@$If Astrid succeeds me with such weakness
left in her, the Vanguard will crumble.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Right@$The future of humanity depends on
whether she can be tempered into shape.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Right@$This is your highest priority. See to it
that she is made into a proper leader.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherAngry&$$@Right@$Do not allow her weakness to imperil
this city. Only you can do this.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaIrritated&$$@Left@$Yes, sir. I swear, I will guide Astrid onto
the right path.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Right@$Two allied companies, one to the north,
one to the south; both pinned down.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Right@$A much larger army of undead is
approaching and will arrive soon.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherSmile&$$@Right@$Both forces will be wiped out if they stay,
but only one can retreat. Your thoughts?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$What about their fighting fitness, materiel
stores, commanders, positions?

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Right@$Assume that the two are, for all intents
and purposes, identical.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaShouting&$$@Right@$Star Platoon, form up!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$We have reports of unrest in the Outer
City as of late.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Center@$The Inner City is protected by the Inner
Wall, and beyond that is the Outer City.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherIrritated&$$@Center@$A haven for refugees fleeing the
predations of the undead.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherIrritated&$$@Center@$The disruption and chaos caused by their
numbers births strife in the Outer City.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Center@$This latest uproar is especially bad.
The Star Platoon is to handle it.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSurprised&$$@Center@$(A military mission! Entrusted to us
personally... To me!)

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Center@$We hear and obey, Commander!
We will not let you down.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...Will that do?
Vice-Commander.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSurprised&$$@Right@$(Huh...?)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$Yes, sir. I believe the Star Platoon is a
fine choice for this mission.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Good work today. I will now give each
squad your individual orders.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Left@$Then I'll return to the command room.
With me, Vice-Commander.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Right@$Yes, sir.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(...Oh. So it was Ludmilla's suggestion
to give me the mission.)

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Center@$(How pathetic I am. I have never felt so...
envious as I do watching her walk away.)

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Center@$(Knowing it is thanks to her that I even
have a chance to restore my name...)

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$That's great, Tori! Now we have a chance
to show your father what we can do.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Left@$Yes...
I suppose we do.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Left@$Ludmilla may have a head start on us, but
we will not be caught flat-footed!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Right@$It's a little galling getting the chance
directly from her, though.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Right@$Speaking as the Platoon's second-in-
command, that is.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSerious&$$@Center@$Squad 1 will oversee dragonfire transport.
It is vulnerable to shock, so be careful.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Left@$...Galling, Mya?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSerious&$$@Right@$Of course it is! But it's not all bad. It's
nice to compete again, like we all used to.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSmile&$$@Left@$Haha. We were always neck-and-neck
when we first joined, as I recall.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSerious&$$@Right@$You've always been great with studying
and bladework, so we had to catch up...

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSerious&$$@Right@$Ludmilla's just on a lucky streak for now!
We'll show her we've still got it, together.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridNormal&$$@Left@$Haha...right. We won't be losing forever.
Thank you, Mya.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridShouting&$$@Left@$Star Platoon, we make for the Outer City.
Let us show them what we can do!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Star Platoon)#$$!-1!$Yes, ma'am!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSerious&$$@Center@$(Morale is high. This is a fine opportunity
for us to make a name for ourselves.)

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Center@$(But even so... What is this unease I feel
deep in my chest?)

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Center@$(Ludmilla is Vice-Commander, while I am
still only a lieutenant.)

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Center@$(Father, why do you only raise up
Ludmilla? Do you intend to abandon me?)

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSad&$$@Center@$(What am I to you, Father?
If this continues...)

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Center@$(...I fear I may grow to hate Ludmilla
and my father both.)

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridAngry&$$@Center@$(And even then, my command is smaller
than a platoon ought to be...)

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Lieutenant.
Lieutenant Astrid.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSurprised&$$@Right@$Huh? F-Father!
Star Platoon, to attention!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&DarkLutherNormal&$$@Left@$Disregard your previous orders. I have a
special mission for Star Platoon today.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&VanguardAstridSerious&$$@Right@$A special mission?

keys.DescriptionKey:
Kana Narukami and her little sister Mirai were born with cat ears and a tail, in a world that was mostly human. 

Their parents took this as a sign of good fortune. Only those especially close to the Goddess took on the traits of an animal. Both sisters shared a cat's grace, its speed, as well as its knack for survival. Every time their poor family pulled through misfortune, their mother credited it to her daughters' blessings from the Goddess. 

One day, that blessing revealed itself as the curse it truly was. 

If she'd known Mirai's voice was that of the Goddess herself, Kana would never let her sing at all.

DarkCatFighter01.title: Elysian Shadow

One day, that blessing revealed itself as the curse it truly was.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Men in black suits snatched Mirai off the street one morning as she sang for pennies from strangers. They told Kana they were from the Church, and thanked her for keeping a Vessel safe for so long. When Kana sank her teeth into the men taking her sister away, they knocked her out and left her there for Fate to do what it would. 

After a few hours, she woke up and did what any cat would do. She sought out food and shelter. She stayed in the shadows. She wore a mask to hide her horrid pain. 

She adapted. She survived, because she knew it was the only way she would ever get her sister back. 

And at long last, she thinks she's found a way.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Grants all enemies the Mega Poison status effect for 200TU. This will overwrite other status effects on those units. Then steals up to 1 Spirit from the enemy team for each Poisoned enemy on the battlefield. The user will immediately get the next turn, then this additional turn effect cannot trigger again until TU advances.

Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison.

DarkDrainALudmillaDarkNewBoss.description:
Grants all enemies the Mega Poison status effect for 200TU. This will overwrite other status effects on those units. Then steals up to 1 Spirit from the enemy team for each Poisoned enemy on the battlefield. The user will immediately get the next turn, then this additional turn effect cannot trigger again until TU advances.

Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison.
DarkDrainALudmillaDarkNewBoss.selected:
Grants Mega Poison and steals Spirit
(Will overwrite other status effects)

keys.DescriptionKey:
Grants all allies Stealth, and a Burn Ward. Grants all enemies the Mega Poison status effect for 200TU. This will overwrite other status effects on those units. Then steals up to 1 Spirit from the enemy team for each Poisoned enemy on the battlefield. The user will immediately get the next turn, then this additional turn effect cannot trigger again until TU advances.

Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison. Stealthed units ignore the next enemy attack that would damage more than 1 target. Any damage will remove stealth. Burn Wards prevent Burn from being applied once, then are removed. Burn Wards cannot stack.
