DarkJaggedAxe01.description: This axe is an odd result of diplomacy. The yanti'kud mined the obsidian and sold it to sarru'kud traders, who in turn traded it to baltu'kud blacksmiths, who then forged it into a weapon.

keys.value: $#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSerious&$$@Left@$Is this where you saw the beast?
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSurprised&$$@Center@$Nooo, wait, Jeanne∼

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSerious&$$@Left@$Looks like this is as far as we can go.
And hey, there's our guy.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneAngry&$$@Right@$Yes, that's definitely the beast I saw in
my vision...and it's already awake!
$#ColossalBeast(Colossal Beast)#$$&GenericMonster&$$@Center@$$%1%$GROOOOOAAAAAAAR!!!

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Okay, this thing is huge!
Jeanne, to your right!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneHurt&$$@Center@$$%1%$...!
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSerious&$$@Center@$Jeanne! Are you okay?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneHurt&$$@Center@$Yeah, I managed to dodge it—Oof, my chest!
My chest hurts!

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSad&$$@Center@$(That stab wound from earlier...
Why hasn't it healed yet!?)

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleHurt&$$@Center@$(Right, it must be because they went for her
heart! She might be immortal, but still...)

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneSerious&$$@Right@$I'm not sure, but I definitely saw this cave
in my vision.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneHurt&$$@Center@$$%1%$This pain... It almost makes me feel
human again...

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleShouting&$$@Center@$Here it comes again, Jeanne!
From the left—no, from above!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneHurt&$$@Center@$Ngh... My feet...
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleShouting&$$@Center@$!!!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneHurt&$$@Center@$(There's no running away this time—)
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneSurprised&$$@Center@$A...tarot card?

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleShouting&$$@Center@$Did it just protect you from that attack?
No way...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorried&$$@Center@$(It came from the map that man gave us.
Honestly, that was unnecessary...)

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyesSerious&$$@Center@$There is something I must do in this
world. I can't die now, can I?

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I don't know if I'll be able to fight alongside
you, Jeanne. I'm sorry.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneAngry&$$@Center@$So—!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneShouting&$$@Center@$Take this!
My ultimate attack!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Colossal Beast)#$$!-1!$$%0.55%$GROOOOOARRRRRR.....
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneHurt&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Ngh...uh...

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSad&$$@Left@$Jeanne, are you all right? You're hurt,
don't overexert yourself!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneHurt&$$@Right@$He's still...in danger—

$#()#$I watched as Jeanne dragged herself up to
the beast and sliced open its belly.
$#()#$Sure enough, the boy was inside.

$#()#$She became frantic when she realized he
wasn't breathing—
$#()#$"Jeanne, you stink..."

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneSmiling&$$@Center@$No, it's fine. I know you'll be right behind
me.

$#()#$—but when he opened his mouth, her face
got so red I thought she was going to burst.

$#()#$It's been so long since I saw her with such
a human expression....
$#()#$The next day—

$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Where are you going? Aren't you the one
who said we should come say sorry?
$#VillagerA(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$!-1!$$@Left@$But, Cory, my dear boy...

$#VillagerB(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Right@$Are we supposed to just go up to her, tail
between our legs, and say—

$#VillagerB(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Right@$"It was actually a monster all along. Sorry
'bout everything, miss!"
$#VillagerA(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$I stabbed her right in the heart, you know?

$#VillagerB(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Right@$We set her home on fire while she was
sleeping...
$#VillagerA(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$Maybe she's a good witch, a good person even, but how could anybody forgive that...

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You seem different, Jeanne.
It's like you've grown a bit.

$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yes, but if you don't go and say you're sorry,
she might just attack the village after all.
$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelSerious&$$@Center@$I know she's tough enough.
$#VillagerA(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$!-1!$$@Left@$We... We can't have that!

$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelSerious&$$@Right@$Go on then! Say you're sorry. I'm sure
she'll forgive you if it's from the heart.
$#VillagerB(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Left@$Right...
$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelSerious&$$@Center@$We're sorry, Jeanne!
$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Center@$Huh? She's not here...
$#VillagerB(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Maybe she went out for a walk?

$#VillagerA(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$Rats, we missed her. Well, we'll just have to
come back another time.

$#VillagerB(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Right@$Them fields won't plow themselves...
We'll come back tomorrow.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorried&$$@Right@$Not at all. I'm still afraid.

$#VillagerB(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Right@$Or better yet, the day after. Yeah, we'll
come back the day after.

$#VillagerA(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$You said she's a nice lady, Cory. I'm sure
she'll understand.
$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Really! Ugh, you guys...
$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Right@$I really wonder where she went, though...

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSad&$$@Left@$Are we really going to just leave without
saying goodbye? What about the boy?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyes&$$@Right@$I hate children.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyesSerious&$$@Right@$They're rowdy and they always cry—
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$They're simple and cruel...?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorried&$$@Center@$And if you show them the smallest kindness,
they get those big smiles on their faces...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorried&$$@Center@$I can't stand them.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneBlushSmiling&$$@Right@$So...I'm glad to have you by my side.

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleOpenSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Heh, if you say so. So, are you sure you
wanna go to that place on the map?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneNormal&$$@Right@$It's not like I trust that guy, but it's not like
we have anywhere better to go either.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneSerious&$$@Right@$And besides, I want to know why he
showed up on our doorstep...
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleOpenSmile&$$@Left@$Maybe he'll be there when we arrive.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneSmiling&$$@Right@$Mm, I can hardly wait.
$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Jeanne!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You...
What are you doing here?

$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Left@$I should be asking you! You're not leaving,
are you?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyes&$$@Right@$I am. I think it's best for the village if I
am no longer around.

$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Left@$But we came to tell you we're sorry... I'm sure
everyone will welcome you this time!

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleGrin&$$@Center@$$%1%$Now there's the Jeanne I know and love!
Oooh, I just wanna hug you!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Thanks, but no thanks. I am not
interested.

$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Left@$I see...
So you're really leaving...

$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelNormal2&$$!-1!$$@Center@$If it weren't for you, I would've died in that
beast's belly...

$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelHappy&$$@Center@$You're not a witch, and you're not a
monster, Jeanne!

$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelHappy&$$@Center@$To me, you're a saint!
Saints are kind and strong, like you!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneNormal&$$@Center@$...!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorried&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I only saved you so I could save myself.
If you want a saint, go get that other Jeanne.
$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelSerious&$$@Left@$The other Jeanne...?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Never mind. Goodbye.
$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelScared&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I'll see you again, Jeanne! I promise!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyesBlushSerious&$$@Right@$Ugh... Can you...not...
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleGrin&$$!-1!$$@Left@$He really likes you, "Saint Jeanne."
$#Jeanne2(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyesSerious&$$@Right@$I'm no saint.
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSad&$$@Left@$Oh, but you are—
$#Jeanne2(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneNormal&$$@Right@$No, Mikaela.

$#Jeanne2(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I am beyond the realm of humans,
beyond the realm of the living.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Jeanne)#$That is why they call me what they do—

$#DONOTSHOWME(Jeanne)#$The harbinger of evil who will doom the
world...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Dark Jeanne)#$The final Aeon Lord.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$Did you enjoy playing with water?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneBlushAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$So you are a pervert. Just go away and don't bother me again.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneAngry&$$@Center@$Out of my way. There's somewhere I need
to go.
$#VillagerA(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Where is she going?
$#VillagerB(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Right@$N-Not to our village...right?
$#VillagerA(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$Q-Quick! Chase her down!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$Well, I do have other things to do, so I'll
make this our last meeting.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I am...glad to hear it.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I stopped by to give you a warning.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyesSerious&$$@Right@$Thank you, but I will pass.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$Just listen to me. The cards say danger is
at hand. Fleeing would be advisable.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneStare&$$@Right@$Sounds like a bunch of hot air to me.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyesSerious&$$@Right@$And where would I go, anyway?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$If you've got nowhere to go, then go to
this spot on this map. Here.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneAngry&$$@Center@$This spot? And what exactly is this pla—
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneBlushAngry&$$@Right@$Y-You were watching me!?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Huh? He's gone?

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSad&$$@Left@$What is with that guy? What a weirdo,
seriously...
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSerious&$$@Left@$Well, what should we do with this map?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorriedSad&$$@Right@$I'm too tired to think about it. I'm going
to say my prayers and go to bed.

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSmile&$$@Left@$I'll handle the map, then. Good night,
Jeanne.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneSmiling&$$@Right@$Good night, Mikaela.
$#VillagerA(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$So this is where the witch lives...
$#VillagerB(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Right@$I don't hear any children...
$#VillagerA(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$Which means the witch has already...
$#VillagerB(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$!-1!$$@Center@$We can't let her claim another victim!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneBlushAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...
$#VillagerB(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Do we just break the door down?

$#VillagerA(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$Are you bonkers? She'd cast some horrid
spell and we'd be dead meat.
$#VillagerA(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$I have an idea—
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleShouting&$$@Center@$—nne! Jeanne!!!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Mmh, Mikaela? What's wrong?
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleShouting&$$@Left@$Get up, Jeanne! Quick!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Cough, cough... Smoke!?
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleShouting&$$@Center@$The church is on fire!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneScared&$$@Center@$On...fire?
On fire!?
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleHurt&$$@Center@$Jeanne! Calm down! You have to stay calm!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSweat&$$@Center@$No, no. You misunderstand. I just noticed
your hair was wet.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneScream&$$@Center@$Mikaela... I can hear them...
Just like before!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Voice of a Villager)#$$!-1!$Burn the witch!
Burn her!!!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Voice of a Villager)#$Child murderer!!!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Voice of a Villager)#$Make her disappear!!!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneScared&$$@Center@$It's just like before...!
Like back then...!

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleHurt&$$@Center@$It's okay, Jeanne! That's in the past. We're
here now, in this world. We were saved—
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneScream&$$@Center@$We were not saved, Mikaela! We just ran away! We're always running away...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneHurt&$$@Center@$I'm...done...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneHurt&$$@Center@$Cough, cough!
Cough, cough, cough—
$#DONOTSHOWME(Jeanne)#$(I'm tired of running. I'm done... I just...)

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusClosedEyesSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Though yes, I have been watching you
these past few days...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Jeanne)#$Is that...the cave from yesterday?
$#Monster(Jeanne)#$$&GenericMonster&$$@Center@$The village is...being destroyed...
$#Monster(Jeanne)#$$&GenericMonster&$$@Center@$It's being destroyed by a great beast...
$#Monster(Jeanne)#$$&GenericMonster&$$@Center@$It's...eating everyone...
$#Monster(Jeanne)#$$&GenericMonster&$$@Center@$Men, women, children...
$#Cory(Jeanne)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Center@$And that's...that boy?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneHurt&$$@Right@$—Cough cough!
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleShouting&$$@Left@$Jeanne! Are you okay?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneSurprised&$$@Right@$What was that vision for...?
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$@Left@$Vision? Did you see into the future again?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneBlushAngry&$$@Right@$Perverted cockroach...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorriedSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Was I shown all of that...so that I can save
them?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneScream&$$@Center@$Why me? Why now? Everyone hates me...
Just like back then...

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Jeanne, not everyone hated you back then.
Remember the children.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorriedSad&$$@Right@$The children?
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSad&$$@Left@$Try to remember that day.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorriedSad&$$@Right@$That day...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Angry Mob)#$Burn, witch! Burn, burn, burn!!!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Angry Mob)#$Burn the witch! Kill her!!!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Jeanne)#$(That day, I did hear children's voices
amidst all the jeering and laughing.)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Jeanne)#$(They were so faint that I could barely make
them out, but I know they were there...)
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSweat&$$@Left@$Come on, I said I wasn't perving—
$#CryingBoys(Crying Boys)#$Stop it!
$#CryingBoys(Crying Boys)#$Stop! She's a nice lady!
$#CryingGirls(Crying Girls)#$Somebody help her! Please!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorriedSad&$$@Right@$The children...

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleOpenSmile&$$@Left@$I heard them too. The kids were on your
side.

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleOpenSmile&$$@Left@$To them, you were Jeanne, the nice lady.
That's what they called you.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorriedSad&$$@Right@$Yes, I heard that too...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, right. The boy.
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSad&$$@Center@$The boy?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneSerious&$$@Center@$Mikaela, it looks like I can't die just yet.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneBlushAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Do me a favor and keep your mouth shut.
The air gets all filthy when you speak.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneSerious&$$@Center@$I have to help that boy. I have to save him.

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleGrin&$$!-1!$$@Left@$If that's what you want to do, then I've got
your back.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneBlushSmiling&$$@Right@$Thank you, Mikaela...

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Still, the church is on fire. Are you gonna
be okay getting out of here?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneAngry&$$@Center@$I'm scared...but I can't be scared for the
rest of my life.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneAngry&$$@Center@$I'm going.

$#VillagerA(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Center@$There she is!
Here comes the witch!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneHurt&$$@Center@$Huff...huff...huff...

$#VillagerA(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$!-1!$$@Left@$She's out of breath! She's weakened!
Now's our chance!

$#VillagerB(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Right@$Kill her before she wreaks havoc on the
village!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusShouting&$$@Center@$Haha, what a sharp tongue you have!
I like it.

$#VillagerA(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Die, you rotten witch!
Take this!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneHurt&$$@Center@$$%1%$Ngh...!
$#VillagerA(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Center@$I got her! Right through the heart!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneScream&$$@Center@$Aaaaaghhh!!!

$#VillagerB(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Center@$What in the... She just pulled the spear
straight out!?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneHurt&$$@Center@$(The concept of death is a fading memory...

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleShouting&$$@Right@$I'm her sister, you oaf!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Well, anyway. Think about it, Jeanne.
I'll be back.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorriedSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...

$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Center@$Okay... Well, I'll try.
Here I go...

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSad&$$@Left@$I'm so sorry, Jeanne! I shouldn't have left
you all alone...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorriedSad&$$@Right@$He knows we're not from this world.
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSerious&$$@Left@$He what!? What did he want?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorriedSad&$$@Right@$I'm not really sure...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorriedSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I guess I really was never meant to come
back from the fire...
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleShouting&$$@Center@$Don't say that, Jeanne!

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleSerious&$$@Center@$Come on, I'll bet this dreary place is what's
getting you down.

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleGrin&$$@Center@$I found a pretty neat spot on my walk,
wanna check it out together?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorriedSad&$$@Center@$But...
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&DarkMichelleGrin&$$@Left@$Come on, let's go!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Chatty Boy)#$$!-1!$You think he'll be all right?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneSurprised&$$@Center@$Okay...

$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelNormal1&$$@Center@$Ooh, I can smell stew... Feels like I just
came back from a great adventure.

$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelNormal2&$$@Center@$I think Jeanne is a really nice person.
Even if she does hate kids.
$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelHappy&$$@Center@$She even waved to me when I said goodbye!

$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelHappy&$$@Center@$Though she made a really annoyed face
while she did it...
$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelHappy&$$@Center@$I've gotta tell everyone about her!

$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Center@$...Ah, shoot! I forgot to get the picture while
I was at the church! What now...

$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Center@$Maybe Jeanne will let me borrow it if I
ask nicely...
$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Center@$But there are monsters back there...
$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelSerious&$$@Center@$No! I can't be a scaredy cat my whole life!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Moody Boy)#$Wanna go instead?

$#Cory(Cory)#$$&MarcelSerious&$$@Center@$I'll take care of this, before they get a
chance to make fun of me...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Chatty Boy)#$No way!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyesSerious&$$@Center@$Should I even be here?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyesSerious&$$@Center@$Why did you let me live?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorried&$$@Center@$Why did you even answer my prayers,
Lord? Why mine, of all people...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorriedSad&$$@Center@$We are not of this world. We are outcasts,
forever alone.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorriedSad&$$@Center@$Abandoned even by God...
$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Center@$Do you think the w-witch will show up?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneWorriedSad&$$@Center@$Say, Mikaela...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneNormal&$$@Center@$Mikaela?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneNormal&$$@Center@$Did she go off on a walk?
$#()#$Knock, knock

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneStare&$$@Center@$(Strange, Mikaela wouldn't knock...
Is it that guy again?)
$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelScared&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Um, excuse me. There's no one here, right?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Who are you?
$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I-Is that...the witch!? I... I have a torch!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneScared&$$@Center@$!!!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneScared&$$@Center@$Don't point that at me!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Moody Boy)#$You scaredy cat. You're not wussing out on
us, are ya?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneScared&$$@Center@$Not...fire...
$#()#$$!-1!$—Scum!—Traitor!—Burn!—
$#()#$—Burn!—Burn the witch!—More wood!—

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneScream&$$@Center@$Please, no! I can't stand the pain...! 
Don't hurt me! Don't burn me—!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneScream&$$@Center@$PLEASE, NO NO NOOOOOOO!!!
$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Center@$—Eeeeeeek!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneHurt&$$@Center@$Huff...huff...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Ah, I lost my self-control... Are you oka—

$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Left@$Waaaaaah!!! A witch! A real witch!
She's gonna kill meeeeeee!!!

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So, he thinks you're a real witch.
Kids these days.
$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelSerious&$$@Center@$I'll go, I'll go!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneSerious&$$@Right@$When did you...
Did you see all that?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$Yeah, the whole thing.
As in, I saw you hurt an innocent, little boy.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$Can't say I'm all that impressed, to be
honest.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I-I did not...!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Right@$No, I'm not going to explain myself to you.
Out of my way, please.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusShouting&$$@Left@$Apologies. And where are you headed,
may I ask?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneAngry&$$@Right@$None of your business.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Left@$To make amends, I see...

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I am surprised she didn't actually hurt the
kid in all that ruckus, though.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSad&$$@Center@$Is there a sliver of good somewhere inside
you...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Moody Boy)#$And you need to bring us the picture from
the church to prove you went there.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSad&$$@Center@$...or were you just holding back?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$Either way, looks like we've found the
real deal. Right, partner?
$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Center@$Huff...huff...
$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Center@$She was there... A real witch...
$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Center@$I've gotta let the others know!

$#Monster(Monster)#$$&GenericMonster&$$@Center@$Grrrr...
Grrroar!
$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelSerious&$$@Center@$Eek! A m-monster!?

$#Monster(Monster)#$$&GenericMonster&$$@Center@$Aghhh...
Gh...ghaaa...
$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelSerious&$$@Center@$Huh?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneAngry&$$@Center@$Phew, I made it in time.
$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Center@$Picture?
$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Center@$The w-witch...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$The mountains are full of monsters. Didn't
anyone tell you not to stray from the path?
$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Left@$D-Did you come to k-kill me?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Why would I kill someone whose life I just
saved? Come with me.
$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Left@$Where are we going?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I'm taking you back to the village. Or do
you not want to go home?
$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Center@$I-I do...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Then get off your butt and come on.
Another monster could show up any minute.
$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelSerious&$$@Left@$O-Okay! Wait up!
$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelSerious&$$@Left@$H-Hey, um, are you really a witch?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chatty Boy)#$It's of an angel or something. I heard
about it from my old man.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneStare&$$@Right@$Yes, and I hate children, so you had best
keep your mouth shut.

$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelHappy&$$@Left@$You're not like what they say about you.
I thought you'd be scarier.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneStare&$$@Right@$Are you deaf or something? Seriously...

$#NervousBoy(Cory)#$$&MarcelNormal2&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hey, Miss Witch, what's your name? My
name's Cory.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyesSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$And this is why I hate children.

$#NervousBoy(Cory)#$$&MarcelNormal1&$$@Left@$Hey, Miss Witch! Can you hear me?
Hey, hey, Miss!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneBlushAngry&$$@Right@$All right already!
...My name is Jeanne.

$#NervousBoy(Cory)#$$&MarcelHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Jeanne!
Nice to meet you, Jeanne!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyesBlushSerious&$$@Center@$Hmph.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$You're back.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chatty Boy)#$Oh, and you should probably take a torch
or something with you.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneStare&$$@Right@$And you are still here. What do you want?
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$You took the boy back home.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneStare&$$@Right@$Did you think I was going to eat him?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Left@$Well, you are a witch. But then, you're a
witch who acts like a saint.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyesSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I despise children. They're rowdy and they
always cry, they're simple and cruel...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyesSerious&$$@Center@$It would kill me to know I was indebted to
a child. So I paid my debt. That is all.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh really?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneBlushAngry&$$@Right@$Why are you looking at me like that?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$And why do you keep following me around?
Spit it out, whatever it is you want.
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$Okay, let's cut to the chase.
$#NervousBoy(Nervous Boy)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Center@$Will that work against the witch?
$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSerious&$$@Center@$You're not from this world, are you?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneSerious&$$@Center@$!!!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$How do you know that...?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneAngry&$$@Right@$You're not here...to get rid of me, are you?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusClosedEyesSmile&$$@Left@$Of course not. First of all, I'd be no match
for you.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusClosedEyesSmile&$$@Left@$You are a unique being, which is precisely
why I—why we—were looking for you.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneNormal&$$@Right@$What do you mean?

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Death and destruction lie in wait for
this world.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSad&$$@Center@$We need the help of your extraordinary
powers to avert this fate.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&DarkJeanneClosedEyesSerious&$$@Center@$You overestimate me. I'm just a pathetic
girl who panics at the mere sight of fire.

keys.DescriptionKey:
No one has arrived late to an inspection in six months. No one would dare. Not with the Queen of Valkyries heading the Vanguard.

As a city under constant siege, Last Bastion can't afford imperfection in its soldiers, as she so frequently reminds them. A single mistake could cost lives. Either her men rise to her standards, or they forfeit their place in her service. Time is a precious resource, and Ludmilla will waste none of it on mercy.

The goddess certainly won't.

DarkLudmilla01.title: Savior of the Living City

keys.IntroText:
"As long as your heart still beats,
you'll answer to me and me alone."

keys.DescriptionKey:
She knows they call her a tyrant. In the shadows of the city she fights so hard to protect, she knows her people curse her name.

They have their reasons: hunger, cold, exhaustion. She was but a child when the invasion began, but the living complained of the very same in the world before. Perhaps some things never change. Or perhaps, no matter their circumstances, people find a way to be discontent.

It doesn't matter. Let them mutter and curse as much as they please. As long as they survive their wretched nights, she has done her duty.

DarkLudmilla02.title: Savior of the Living City

keys.DescriptionKey:
Those who came up through the Vanguard with Ludmilla insist she wasn't always cruel. With every passing day, fewer and fewer believe them. Some have even begun to doubt it themselves.

No woman is born a tyrant, however, least of all a woman so fervently devoted to seeing her people safe. Perhaps in another world, one without the relentless undead siege, she could temper her tactical brilliance with compassion. Perhaps, where she can manage it, she still tries.

She knows well it is better to be loved than feared. But it is better still to be alive.

keys.DescriptionKey:
She doesn't know how many times she has died. They all blur together, a haze of pain, darkness, and brutal rebirth. There's no point in remembering them all, not when she'll live until the end of time.

But there was one death that mattered. Her first death. The one that should have been her last. She would give anything to forget, but it burns like a torch in her mind, as eternal as her master's black fire.

If Finn shares her tormented memory, he has never shown it. Beneath his twisted shell, he might have no memory at all.

DarkRizette01.title: Angel of Ruin

keys.IntroText:
"Death is endless peace. Life is endless war.
A soldier knows no peace, and so I know no death."

keys.DescriptionKey:
None of them knew it would go so wrong.

The odds were always stacked against them. But Rei had gifted them her magic. Callen had forged their hero a holy sword. The people of Erden cheered for their victory, sending them off to the Endless Pyre with celebrations and songs.

For a time, they thought they had a chance.

They were fools to ever think so.

Gods are gods and men are men. Even with a legendary blade, Finn was doomed to fall. Looking back, Rizette wonders if she should have stood her ground. She wonders what might have happened if she hadn't given her life for his.

Would he still have betrayed them all?

DarkRizette02.title: Angel of Ruin

keys.DescriptionKey:
The pain of the goddess's talon in her heart remains. The warm taste of blood remains. Finn's anguished screams remain. But the memory of death -- true, mortal death -- fades more and more each day.

She can call it back a little, when she's alone on quiet nights. A thousand voices assured her that her sacrifice was not in vain. A warm light shone around her, gentle as a mother's embrace.

The only light she knows now is the light of the Endless Pyre.

DarkRizette03.title: Angel of Ruin

keys.DescriptionKey:
Rizette always enjoyed helping out around the house. As trivial as that memory seems now, she holds it close to her heart. There was a time she couldn't remember anything of herself. Not her past, not her friends, nothing beyond Orcanix's latest orders. Sometimes, she's afraid she'll slip back into that horrific void.

So she remembers how it felt to tidy up her family's meager home. How her heart raced as she nursed Finn back to health. Perhaps she wasn't heroic before her fall, but she refuses to think those little acts of kindness meant nothing.

Keeping her loved ones safe and happy was the only life she ever wanted.

DarkRizetteChristmas01.title: Maid of Midwinter

keys.IntroText:
In the depths of winter, don't forget:
warm days will dawn once more.

keys.DescriptionKey:
She didn't love Finn as soon as she saw him. That would be too much like a fairy tale. When he arrived beaten and broken from the attack on his village, Rizette nursed him the same way she would any new refugee. They called her the Angel of the Outer City precisely because she never turned anyone away.

Still, she couldn't deny the kinship between them, both teenagers ripped from their families by the undead. When he had no place to go, it was only natural she invite him to live with her and her brother. How could she have known where it would lead?

How could she have known their growing love would lead to ruin?

DarkRizetteChristmas02.title: Maid of Midwinter

keys.DescriptionKey:
They went to fight Orcanix on the darkest night of the year, the bitter midwinter solstice prophesied by Callen and the Sages. Despite the biting cold, Rizette had always loved the holiday. It brought everyone she loved together, snug and cozy around a blazing fire. She thought she'd love it even more when it became the day they freed their people.

Even now, after everything she went through, she can't bring herself to hate wintertime. When the snow falls soft on the ground and the world stands still, she doesn't think of the night she lost everything. She doesn't think of the war, or the long path ahead of them towards peace.

She closes her eyes, remembers that all is well, and reaches for the love that keeps her warm.

They went to fight Orcanix on the darkest night of the year, the bitter midwinter solstice prophesied by Callen and the Sages. Despite the biting cold, Rizette had always loved the holiday. It brought everyone she loved together, snug and cozy around a blazing fire. She thought she'd love it even more when it became the day they freed their people.

Even now, after everything she went through, she can't bring herself to hate wintertime. When the snow falls soft on the ground and the world stands still, she doesn't think of the night she lost everything. She doesn't think of the war, or the long path ahead of them towards peace.

She closes her eyes, remembers that all is well, and reaches for the love that keeps her warm.

keys.DescriptionKey: A city where the lights seem to never go out, with countless buildings crammed together, and a sea of people as far as the eye can see. A place she doesn't know, customs she doesn't understand. Illuminated by flashing neon lights in every color imaginable, she felt more afraid than in the depths of the blackest, moonless night. That is, until she saw it. An elegant form and a roaring engine resonating with the beat of her heart. Speed like nothing she ever experienced in her own world, the thrill of outrunning the wind. It was called "a motorcycle," they told her. Once she got on, the city didn't seem so threatening anymore, and she found out just how addictive speed can be.

keys.DescriptionKey:
After losing so much, she finally gained something—a new life. She decided to spend it atoning for her sins. Having parted ways with the other Finn, she started surveying the city for any remaining undead, to prevent this world from ending up the way her own had.
He thinks she should stop blaming herself.
He thinks she should enjoy herself more. After all, life shouldn't be lived for the past, but for the present and the future.
Her co-workers in this new world seem to understand that, though, so he thinks she should be all right, in the end.
"Yo, Endless! Let's hit the pool next!"

keys.DescriptionKey: After bidding farewell to the ones she held dear, she was assigned duty as the Primordial of Death's Avatar: collecting souls that didn't die properly. She was to lead the undead, ghosts, all those who couldn't move on due to the unnatural circumstances of their death, towards the proper end. It made her wonder: can she, a person reborn with undead powers, live properly? Can she ever meet a proper death? Who has she become? The answers will come with time. She doesn't know it yet, but after she defeated the Fullmetal Knight and countless other evildoers that prowl the city's streets every night, after she saved numerous lives time and time again, people started calling her "the Undead Savior of Shinjuku".

keys.value: $#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelSurprised&$$@Center@$Whoa!

$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$(They must dredge up all sorts of
memories.)

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSadSmile&$$@Center@$...
Thank you, Finn.
$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$For what...?

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSadSmile&$$@Left@$I can tell what you're thinking by how
intensely you're staring.
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSadSmile&$$@Left@$You're worried about me, aren't you?

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No need, I'll be fine. I'll do whatever it
takes to get my Finn back.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Yamashiro)#$Oh, come on! It's way too early for
Halloween!
$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What's going on?

$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelShout&$$@Left@$Just look at these pictures on Evetter.
That's the front of the Shinjuku Station!
$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No way...!
$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandGold&$$@Center@$Haaahhh!
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitShouting&$$@Center@$It's a whole swarm of the undead!
$#Undead(Undead)#$$&KeiDadNormal&$A-Aaah... Aaargh...
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSad&$$@Center@$Unbelievable... How are there so many!?

$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelSmile&$$@Center@$Well, would you look at that! You guys
nailed it!

$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelSmile&$$@Center@$There, in the middle of the horde!
It's that armored knight!
$#DarkFinn(Fullmetal Knight)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$...

$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelSmile&$$@Center@$I've got to get closer...!
Scuse me, Mr. Zombie!

$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelSmile&$$@Center@$I'm just going to need you to shuffle aside
some!

$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$Whoa, hang on! You're not going to try
and break through that mob, are you!?

$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelShout&$$@Center@$I know it's dangerous, but you'd better not
try to stop me!
$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Yamashiro, are you okay?

$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelShout&$$@Center@$I'm willing to risk my life for this scoop.
I can't back down now!
$#Undead(Undead)#$$&KeiDadScream&$$@Center@$Graaaaagh!
$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Yamashiro!
$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$Guh...!
$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelSurprised&$$@Center@$Finn! What are you doing...!?
$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnGritGold&$$@Center@$G-Golden Crest...!

$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Yamashiro... Life isn't something to risk.
It's something you should protect!
$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelDoubt&$$@Center@$You...

$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandGold&$$@Center@$Alright, come at me! I'll bring you all back
to life!
$#Undead2(Undead)#$$&KeiDadScream&$$@Center@$Aaaaaagh...
$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelHurt&$$@Left@$Yeah, I'm fine! But, you know... I wasn't expecting actual zombies.
$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelHurt&$$@Center@$I-I...
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSerious&$$@Center@$Don't just stand there, move.
$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelSurprised&$$@Center@$But...

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSerious&$$@Center@$You're only going to get in the way.
...Haaah!
$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Rizette! Don't push yourself too hard.

$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$We still have to deal with the Fullmetal
Knight later.

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSerious&$$@Left@$I know, but we've got to do something
about the mob, or I'll never get to my Finn.

$#Man(Bystander 1)#$$&ModernMaleMobSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Dude, there's actually zombies here! I've
gotta get a pic of this!

$#Woman(Bystander 2)#$$&ModernLadyMobHappy&$$@Left@$Oooh, are they filming a movie? Do you
see any celebs?
$#DarkFinn(Fullmetal Knight)#$$&DarkFinnGlowEye&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelSmile&$$@Left@$Strange knights... Real zombies...
This is a journalism gold mine!
$#Man(Bystander 1)#$$&ModernMaleMobScaredSweat&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Huh? Wh-What the...?
$#Woman(Bystander 2)#$$&ModernLadyMobSeriousSweat&$$@Left@$Eeeeeek!

$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$!-1!$$@Right@$No... The knight's turning anyone who gets
close into more undead!

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSerious&$$@Left@$And they gain numbers faster than we can
turn them back...

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSerious&$$@Left@$It's just like the last time... There's no end
to it...

$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelShout&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, for the love of... Would you two knock
it off?
$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Sorry?

$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelSerious&$$@Center@$You're both hypocrites! You get mad at
me for putting my life on the line, then
$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelSerious&$$@Center@$turn around and do the same thing!
$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelSerious&$$@Center@$So, let me do something! Documenting events is my job!
$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$If you say so...?

$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelSerious&$$@Center@$It's my life's purpose and pride as a
journalist, so let me have this!

$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelHurt&$$@Center@$If you hold me back here, then my entire
life will be meaningless.

$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelShout&$$@Center@$I'm going to shoot my shot. Right now, I'm
the only one who can do this scene justice!
$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Yamashiro, wait! It's too dangerous!
$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelShout&$$@Center@$Hey, uglies! We're going live!
$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Huh? Is he...recording the undead?
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSurprised&$$@Center@$Why is he talking to his slate?

$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelHurt&$$@Center@$Listen up! Unless you want to end up
like these guys, stay the hell away
$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelHurt&$$@Center@$from the Shinjuku Station!
$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelHurt&$$@Center@$This spot is seriously dangerous.

$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$(Well, I guess everyone reacts to shocking
things differently.)

$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelHurt&$$@Center@$And stopping to stare is just going to
make things worse!

$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelShout&$$@Center@$There's only two people holding down the
fort here, so don't give them more trouble!
$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Center@$Yamashiro...

$#Man(Bystander 1)#$$&ModernMaleMobScaredSweat&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Uh... You know, maybe this isn't for a
movie. The vibes are really off here.

$#Woman(Bystander 2)#$$&ModernLadyMobSeriousSweat&$$@Left@$So we could actually be in danger here?
Yeesh, I'm out.

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The crowd is thinning...
This is our chance!

$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Right, he can't make any more undead!
We just have to take care of these ones!
$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandGold&$$@Center@$Golden Crest...!
$#Undead(Undead)#$$&KeiDadScream&$$@Center@$Graaaah...

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitShouting&$$@Center@$There goes the last one. All that's left now
is...

$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(I wonder how Rizette's holding up. I'm
sure she isn't finding this as thrilling...)
$#DarkFinn(Fullmetal Knight)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$...
$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$The Fullmetal Knight!

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitShouting&$$@Center@$Now we can finally...
Huh?
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSurprisedNoBlush&$$@Center@$What's that sound!?
$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelSurprised&$$@Center@$It's a helicopter! Look up there!
$#Yamashiro(Yamashiro)#$$&RebelSurprised&$$@Center@$The Red Dragons are here!

$#FinnWhite(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$(Not to mention, she froze up the first
time we ran into these guys.)

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Center@$Uuughhh, I swear to—
Team! Status report?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Red Dragon Agent)#$Gaaaah!

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHappy&$$@Right@$Yeah, you don't seem like the type to find
herself in a structured system.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$By the way, we haven't even exchanged
names yet.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiNormal&$$@Center@$I'm Hibiki. What about you?

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitNormal&$$@Center@$I'm Riz—
...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Endless Rizette)#$$!-1!$No. I'm the one who gets back up no matter
how many times she's knocked down.
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitWinkSmile&$$@Center@$You can call me "Endless Rizette."
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Huh. That's badass.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiWink&$$@Right@$I guess that'd make me Goddess's Vessel
Hibiki. Nice to meet you, Endless Rizette!

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSad&$$@Left@$A Goddess's Vessel? You? You don't exactly
look the part...
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Right@$Hey! What's that supposed to mean?
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Right@$Argh! Speak of the damn devil!

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Whatever. Anyway, the school's just over
there.

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSerious&$$@Center@$Ah, look at that open space. Mhm, it's
perfect. Thanks, Hibiki.

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitShouting&$$@Center@$I'm going to slow down.
Make sure you don't fall off.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmirk&$$@Center@$Duh!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Are you okay!?

$#BergarianSoilder(Red Dragon Agent)#$$&BergarianSoilderBlackBody&$$@Center@$S-Stay back, Miss Vessel! You have to get
away before I change...

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Center@$And what about you then, huh!? I'll hold
their attention, so hurry and—

$#DarkFinn(Fullmetal Knight)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$Type 2 Immortality identified.
Switching to absorption.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Center@$Huh?
Ah...! Urgh!

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Center@$(I feel so drained... Is that guy sucking up
my powers? They didn't do that before!)

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Center@$(Wait, did they use that agent as bait...? To
try and lure me here?)

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Center@$(So they've been after the power of the
Goddess this whole time!)

$#BergarianSoilder(Red Dragon Officer)#$$&BergarianSoilderBlackBody&$$!-1!$$@Left@$We've gone on the defensive. Our attacks
do hit, but the injuries heal immediately.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Center@$(Just like that undead girl's abilities
before!)

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Center@$(Crap, if they get enough of my power,
this world's done for...!)
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitShouting&$$@Center@$Let her go!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$@Center@$!
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitShouting&$$@Center@$Yaaaaaaaah!
$#DarkFinn(Fullmetal Knight)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$...!

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$@Center@$(That gross feeling is gone! The impact
must've stopped the absorption!)
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$Get on!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$@Left@$Wha—!? What the hell is—
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$Come on, what are you waiting for!?
$#BergarianSoilder(Red Dragon Officer)#$$&BergarianSoilderBlackBody&$$@Left@$No damage of real note has been inflicted.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Left@$Geez, you never explain anything!
Stop and give me a summary!

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$If we keep this fight going, then your
allies are all at risk of turning undead.

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$And if their numbers get out of hand, we're
done for.

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$So, I want to move the knight to an area
with fewer people.

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitClosedEyes&$$@Right@$You had some of your power drained too,
didn't you?

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitClosedEyes&$$@Right@$So you should know that it's hunting down
unique abilities.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Left@$Hang on, are you just using me as bait,
then? You jerk!

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSurprisedNoBlush&$$@Right@$For someone who was just whining about
lack of explanations, you sure are quick
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSurprisedNoBlush&$$@Right@$on the uptake.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Left@$Ugh, I can't deal with you right now.

$#BergarianSoilder(Red Dragon Officer)#$$&BergarianSoilderBlackBody&$$@Left@$Moreover, if anyone gets too close, they
get turned into a zombie.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$@Left@$I do owe you one for saving my cat,
though. Fine, I'm in.

$#BergarianSoilder(Red Dragon Officer)#$$&BergarianSoilderBlackBody&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Wait, Miss Vessel! You can't just do as
you please!

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$@Center@$It's fine, it's a good strategy! I've gotta get
out of here before you guys get zom—
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitHurt&$$@Center@$Ngh!

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$The hell are you doing!? You're going after
the wrong person!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Right@$She's trying to protect your asses!

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitHurt&$$@Left@$$%1%$It's fine, let's just go. The Fullmetal
Knight's back on their feet.
$#DarkFinn(Fullmetal Knight)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Center@$Great, wonderful. I don't love the idea of
leaving things like this, though!

$#BergarianSoilder(Red Dragon Officer)#$$&BergarianSoilderBlackBody&$$@Center@$I said, wait! Our orders are to eradicate
that woman.

$#BergarianSoilder(Red Dragon Officer)#$$&BergarianSoilderBlackBody&$$@Left@$So, close-quarters combat is out of the
question.
$#BergarianSoilder(Red Dragon Officer)#$$&BergarianSoilderBlackBody&$$@Center@$You can't just do as you please!

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSadSmile&$$@Center@$...Thank you in advance for buying us
some time.
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSerious&$$@Center@$I'm going to bring that knight down.
$#BergarianSoilder(Red Dragon Officer)#$$&BergarianSoilderBlackBody&$$@Center@$Wh— You...
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Okay, hold on tight!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Left@$Pin it!
$#DarkFinn(Fullmetal Knight)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$...

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$@Center@$Yikes, it's keeping up with us on foot.

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSurprised&$$@Center@$Would you believe me if I said it started

$#EndlessAstrid(Endless Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearShy&$$@Center@$You currently have an enemy to take care
of, don't you?
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSerious&$$@Center@$Yeah. Is that why you're both here?
$#EndlessTheo(Endless Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Center@$You bet!

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSad&$$@Center@$I want to protect everyone, including
myself.

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSad&$$@Center@$However, the way I am now, I'm no match
for that Fullmetal Knight...

$#EndlessTheo(Endless Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Center@$Just leave it to us! We're here to give
you our full support.
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitShouting&$$@Center@$Hibiki!

$#EndlessTheo(Endless Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Left@$First, I'm going to top off your
immortality with my healing magic!
$#EndlessAstrid(Endless Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$@Right@$Second, I shall assist your attacks.

$#EndlessAstrid(Endless Astrid)#$$&AstridNewYearSerious&$$@Right@$Clearly, you require some help wielding
that sword.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Endless Rizette)#$$!-1!$$@Center@$...Yeah. Thank you, now I'm sure to win!

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitHappy&$$@Center@$With the power of your souls on my side,
who could stand in my way?
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitShouting&$$@Center@$Hyaaaaah!
$#DarkFinn(Fullmetal Knight)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$...!?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$@Center@$Whoa, how'd she counter that? I thought
her swing was gonna miss for sure!

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitSerious&$$@Center@$Hibiki. Don't worry, you can sit this round
out and get some rest.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Center@$What're you talking about? Aren't you
just as banged up as...me...

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Center@$Don't worry, I'm fine. I can't die either.
I can shake this off with a little time!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$@Center@$Hang on! You're all healed up!?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$@Center@$Plus, you've got this...kinda soft glow
around you...
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitWink&$$@Center@$...Heehee.

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitWink&$$@Center@$Alright, this time I should be able to turn
this into a proper fight.
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitShouting&$$@Center@$Go ahead, do your worst!
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitShouting&$$@Center@$Yaaaaah!
$#DarkFinn(Fullmetal Knight)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$...!

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitBleedingHurt&$$@Center@$Urgh!
...That was nothing!

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$@Center@$Huh, they're about even. And if either of
them gets hurt, they can just heal...

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$@Center@$Looks like this is going to be one hell of a
reckless battle!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Center@$But you've got to stop that knight!

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitBleedingHurt&$$@Center@$(With Theo and Astrid's souls behind me,
I'm finally matching the knight!)

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitBleedingHurt&$$@Center@$(One unhealed wound would be enough
to end this.)

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitBleedingHurt&$$@Center@$(So, whoever loses focus first will be out...
However...!)

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitBleedingShouting&$$@Center@$We might both be undead, but we're
not the same! That goes for you and me...
$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitBleedingShouting&$$@Center@$And me and my past self!
$#DarkFinn(Fullmetal Knight)#$$&DarkFinnGlowEye&$$@Center@$...!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$@Center@$Whoa, she blocked that blow!?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$@Center@$After just taking hits and healing herself
all this time?

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitBleedingSerious&$$@Center@$I want to help people. I want to protect
what matters.

$#DarkRizette(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSwimsuitBleedingSerious&$$@Center@$That includes the Finns you absorbed, this
world...

$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteSadSmile&$$@Left@$Thanks for waiting, Finn! You know, I
found some gorgeous vegetables.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Left@$I'll explain everything, so calm down.
$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteAngry&$$@Right@$I... But Finn, he's...
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Left@$I know how much he means to you.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Left@$And, as you know, this version of Finn
had his body corrupted by Orcanix.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Left@$His undying flame burned brighter and
stronger than anyone else's.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Left@$As a result, even though his soul passed,
his physical body hasn't disappeared.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Left@$It still exists, out there in the real world.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Left@$And so does the connection between it and
his soul.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Left@$Perhaps that was why he wasn't able to
reincarnate.

$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteSerious&$$@Right@$Then, since his soul was gone...something
might have happened to his body?
$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteSadSmile&$$@Left@$I thought they'd make a perfect...soup...
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Left@$That's exactly right.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Left@$Spirits from this realm have been
guarding it faithfully, so this really
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Left@$should not have been possible, but...
$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteSerious&$$@Right@$But what?
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...It seems that it was taken away.
$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteSurprise&$$@Center@$Taken away...?
$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteShocked&$$@Center@$You mean that someone stole his body!?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Center@$Correct again. And, in doing so, the thief
pulled his soul along with it.

$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteShouting&$$@Center@$That's just... How can you be so calm,
knowing something like that has happened!?

$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteShouting&$$@Center@$You're the Primordial of Death! Isn't it
your job to ensure that the souls of the

$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteSurprise&$$@Left@$...Finn?
Finn! Where are you!?
$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteShouting&$$@Center@$deceased are properly reincarnated!?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Center@$I-I did my due diligence! I set out guarding
spirits, I swear I did!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Center@$And still, somehow, some way, they managed
to get past them! My finest guardians!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Center@$I had the best of the best watching him!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Center@$I just don't know what else I could have
possibly done on my own...

$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Ngh... I'm sorry, Aria. I didn't mean to be
so harsh.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Left@$...
No, you're excused.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Left@$I understand how you feel.
$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteSerious&$$@Right@$So, tell me. How do we get Finn back?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Left@$The thief has the ability to open gates
across worlds, and that's what they used.

$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(What happened? Aren't we supposed
to be confined here?)

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Left@$The one they escaped through should be
still barely open.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Left@$Theoretically, one could go through it and
pursue them.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Left@$It won't be open for much longer, though,
and neither the spirits nor I can do much
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Left@$about this situation.

$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteNormal&$$@Right@$You're not going to go and take Finn back?
Why?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Left@$Because our primary duty is to protect
the worlds we belong to.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Left@$Going after Finn would mean splitting our
forces against an enemy who has already
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Left@$proven to be capable of getting past us.
$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteSad&$$@Right@$That's just...
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Unbelievably frustrating! Absolutely infuriating!
$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteSurprise&$$@Center@$(There isn't anywhere he can go!)
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Center@$Ugh! I'm so mad, I can't think straight!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Center@$This is exactly what I need an Avatar for, but
that blockhead isn't around anymore!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Center@$And the other Primordials are so fixated
on being on the defensive and hoarding

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Center@$their Avatars, I keep getting told there
aren't any to spare.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Center@$And now, with Finn's body and soul at
stake...!
$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteSerious&$$@Center@$In that case...
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSurprised&$$@Center@$Yes...?

$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteSad&$$@Center@$(If I can get my way, I should be able
to go and rescue Finn myself.)

$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteSad&$$@Center@$(Really, I shouldn't even be considering
this... I would be abandoning the one place

$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteSad&$$@Center@$where I actually belong. And I wouldn't be
able to lay down my guilt and reincarnate...)
$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteShocked&$$@Center@$Finn! Please, answer me!

$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteSad&$$@Center@$(I would be throwing myself back into the
real world with all my sins in hand.)
$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteSad&$$@Center@$(...I'm scared.)

$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteAngry&$$@Center@$(But...Finn matters more than anything
else!)
$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteAngry&$$@Center@$I'll go after the thief. So, please...
$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteShouting&$$@Center@$Aria, make me your Avatar.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Aria)#$$!-1!$Ugh, this is just too much for me.
Get ahold of yourself, Rizette!
$#DarkRizetteWhite(Endless Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteWhiteShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Aria? What do you know about this!?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Left@$Wait, I— Stop looking at me like that,
you're scaring me!

keys.DescriptionKey: It is whispered that the goddess Orcanix tore this sword from her heart to unleash her terrible mercy upon the world. The blade's flaming aura bids its victims rise. Then, it bids them follow.

DarkRizetteSword01.name: Deathbreaker
DarkRizetteSword01.description: It is whispered that the goddess Orcanix tore this sword from her heart to unleash her terrible mercy upon the world. The blade's flaming aura bids its victims rise. Then, it bids them follow.

keys.IntroText:
"With this blade in hand,
Baptize the world with My undying flame."

keys.value: $#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$@Right@$Out of the way!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Can you extinguish this wretched fire
burning in my chest?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Orcanix)#$with the peace of life everlasting.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Center@$...?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Center@$("All the worlds"?
Not "all the world"?)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Orcanix)#$The remaining unblessed are few, their
defenses weak. This world is already Mine.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Orcanix)#$It is time to begin the next step. My
blessing will be brought to the next world.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Orcanix)#$A new world...
A different Erden!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Center@$A different...Erden?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Orcanix)#$This other Erden has long been ruled by
another god: Arcane, the Eternal.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Orcanix)#$But Arcane has fallen. Finally, I have a
chance to expand My influence.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Center@$(Another Erden...where a god like
Orcanix was killed.)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$No, you can't. Are you truly being kind?
Or are you just being arrogant?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Orcanix)#$My dear Rizette. Strong, lovely, and so
deeply blessed by My power.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Orcanix)#$You will go to this other Erden, and
create for Me a foothold there.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Orcanix)#$And in so doing, you will help Me bless
countless more with life unending!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Center@$...Unfortunately, Orcanix, I have no
knowledge of how to cross worlds.
$#Cyrus(???)#$$&CyrusSilhouette&$$!-1!$$@Right@$That's where I come in.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$...Who are you?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Orcanix)#$Fear not, child. This man is my
collaborator.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Orcanix)#$He holds the power to cross worlds.
He will light the way for you.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Orcanix)#$Now, go, Rizette. You will be the one
to make My dream a reality.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$I am being arrogant. Without question,
I'm being arrogant.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$(Not that I have the freedom to refuse.
Or that it would matter if I did.)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$(I gave up a long time ago. On dying, on
resisting. Everything but cursing my fate.)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$As you command, my Master.

$#Cyrus(???)#$$&CyrusSilhouette&$$@Right@$Come on, let's go. To another world—
An Erden where death is possible.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$(...An Erden where death is possible.
Where anyone can die...truly die.)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$(I wonder...)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$(I wonder if Theo is still alive there,
somewhere...)

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$But even so... I won't give up on it!
In this unjust world, this is the only way—

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$This is the only way I can be kind, and
make you proud to be my sister!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$I don't understand...
Enough of this.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHurt&$$@Right@$$%0.3%$Urrgh...!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmSad&$$@Right@$Sir Theo...!
He has been completely run through!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$You're full of openings. You might as well
have begged me to stab you.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$I know it hurts. I'm sorry. Hold still...
I'll end it for you.
$#Skeleton(Undead)#$$&Skeleton&$$@Left@$Grrgrgh...!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHurt&$$@Right@$...No.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$Huh?!
I can't move my sword!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$An obvious opening...is a trap. Master...
My Master taught me that...!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$What are you doing? Pulling my sword
even deeper into yourself?!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHurt&$$@Right@$Now you can't get your sword back out.
And...!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Ah...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$Now he has run Lady Rizette through...!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHurt&$$@Right@$...My sword's wedged into the ship's wall.
You won't be able to get out, will you?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$You think this means you've won? I'm
undead. I'll just keep coming back...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHurt&$$@Right@$Master!
Scuttle the ship!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$What? What is this?
Where did this power come from?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$What?!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$Huh...?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHurt&$$@Right@$You...and I...are both going down with
the ship. To the bottom of the river!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$That would be a form of water burial...
It is possible Lady Rizette could be freed.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmAngry&$$@Right@$But, Sir Theo...!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHurt&$$@Left@$There are times when a warrior must
discard kindness on the battlefield!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$!!
(My own words...!)

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHurt&$$@Left@$...Ngh! Ugh! B-besides...I've been run
through. I don't have long anyway...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHurt&$$@Left@$So, please, Master...
Hurry!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmAngry&$$@Right@$...Haaaaa!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$He is surpassing my teachings! To think
his resolve could grant him such strength!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$......

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$Riz. If we stay like this, we'll both be
pinned under the wreck in the riverbed.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$Your flame of unlife will be snuffed out.
You'll never come back again.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSadSmile&$$@Right@$You'll be free, Riz.
You'll be saved.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteDefault&$$@Left@$...Right.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteDefault&$$@Left@$Right, Theo...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmHurt&$$@Right@$Ungh...

$#Bikki Soldier(Bikki Soldier)#$$&FrogKnight&$$@Left@$Lord Omi!
Captain Nagi has returned!
$#Lord Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Left@$Nagi! You have done well to return to us!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$Lord Omi.
I am, as ever, at your service...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$@Right@$Come on, Riz.
Let's put an end to this!
$#Lord Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Left@$W-what happened to your arm?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$A small price to pay for my life, my Lord.
Pray, how is Sage Rei?

$#Lord Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Left@$...She has regained consciousness.
I will bring you to her.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Nagi...is that you? Cough, cough...
I'm sorry...I must look terrible...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Sage Rei, please do not speak. You must
rest yourself.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Left@$No, please let me talk.
I want to thank you.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Left@$For fulfilling your duty and saving our
people, you have my deepest gratitude.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmNormal&$$@Right@$There is no need for that. I simply did
what I could.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSurprised&$$@Left@$...Wait. Where is Theo?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Left@$That poor boy. What's happened to him?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$...Okay. I won't insult you by holding
back any more, then.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiNoArmSad&$$@Right@$He...and his sister, rest at the bottom of
the river.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiClosedEyes&$$@Left@$...I see.
$#Lord Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Right@$Oh, how cruel...

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Left@$I know it's a horrid thing to think, but
I believe this is...for the best.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Left@$They've finally reached the peaceful
embrace of death... Cough, cough!!

$#Lord Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Right@$Sage Rei!
Please, you must rest!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiClosedEyes&$$@Left@$No...it seems that it's my time to go, too.

$#Lord Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Right@$Please, Sage Rei, hold on!
We are almost to Last Bastion!

$#Lord Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Right@$The final fortress of mortals! Surely, once
you have a place to rest in safety—

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Left@$Haha. So many have already given their
lives; mine's been too long, already.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$You'll live long enough to regret not
taking my offer of a painless death.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Left@$Lord Omi, please continue to lead the
bikki with wisdom and humility.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Left@$Nagi...continue to watch over them...and
keep them safe, won't you?

discard kindness on the battlefield.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSadSmile&$$@Right@$...My family always said I was kind, too.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSadSmile&$$@Right@$My parents taught me to think of others,
and always help them when I could.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSadSmile&$$@Right@$And my sister always praised me, too.
She'd say I had a beautiful heart.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSadSmile&$$@Right@$She always told me how proud she was...
To have me as her brother...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiScarSad&$$@Left@$...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$Master...please tell me. Were they...was
my family wrong?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiScarAngry&$$@Left@$...No, Sir Theo. They were not.
I promise you, they were not!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$Yeah! I did it!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiScarSad&$$@Left@$It is this world which is wrong. Your kind
heart ought to be your greatest strength!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$Master...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiScarSad&$$@Left@$But this is our world. Unjust though it
may be, we have no choice but to live on...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$(An "unjust" world...)
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$(...That just makes me wonder.)

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$(Is there a world that isn't unjust,
somewhere out there...?)
$#Bikki Soldier(Bikki Soldier)#$$&FrogKnight&$$@Right@$Captain! We've been waiting for you!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiScarSerious&$$@Left@$What is wrong? Why have you not
started preparing the ship for launch?!

$#Bikki Soldier(Bikki Soldier)#$$&FrogKnight&$$@Right@$A horde of undead is blocking the only
route down the cliff to the river!

$#Bikki Soldier(Bikki Soldier)#$$&FrogKnight&$$@Right@$Leading them is a human with blonde
hair...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiScarSerious&$$@Left@$(Sir Theo is much stronger than before.
Mere undead are no threat to him now.)

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiScarSad&$$@Left@$No...
Lady Rizette?!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$Riz...!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiScarAngry&$$@Left@$...If we delay, the enemies behind us will
pincer us from behind.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiScarAngry&$$@Left@$We must break through that blockade.
We have no other choice!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$@Right@$Then I'll take the vanguard. Maybe I can
finally find a way to stop her!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiScarSad&$$@Left@$Sir Theo?! Wait!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$Master! You know why I've been training
all this time!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$I'm going to save her...
The only family I have left in this world!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiScarAngry&$$@Left@$Sir Theo!!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$@Right@$Riz!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiScarSAd&$$@Left@$(But she is too strong. And I do not know if he can face her emotionally...)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Theo? I didn't know you had been hiding
in Kisenkyo.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$That's right, Riz. It's me, Theo.
Please, come back to me!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Don't be ridiculous. Are you trying to
distract me to buy time?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$I'm not buying time! I want to save you!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$...Do you even understand the undead?
Do you know what I've become?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$They're...creatures of the dark god
Orcanix. She instills them with the flame

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$of unlife, and they seek out others to
kill and add to their ranks.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$That's right.
That's what I am now.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$I've died so many times already, I've
lost count. And every time, I come back.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Have you ever heard of an undead being
saved, Theo?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiScarSerious&$$@Left@$The dawn will break soon. The evacuation
ought to be nearly complete by now.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$There's no way to free us from this curse.
And no way to avoid it yourself, either.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$I can't accept that.
I promise, I will—!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Enough.
You're all going to die here.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&DarkRizetteSerious&$$@Left@$I'm not heartless, though. Even now.
I'll make it painless.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiScarSerious&$$@Right@$Sir Theo...
Please, allow me to—
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Left@$I'm not backing down.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiScarAngry&$$@Right@$Sir Theo!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$I need to stop her. It has to be me.
I'm the only family she has left!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiScarSerious&$$@Right@$So be it! Then I will fight alongside my
treasured disciple!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiScarAngry&$$@Right@$The others are to strike where the horde
is thinnest. Go!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiScarSerious&$$@Left@$We must reunite with the others.
Make for the hidden ship!
$#Bikki Soldier(Bikki Soldier)#$$&FrogKnight&$$@Left@$Yes, Captain!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiScarAngry&$$@Right@$The situation is dire...but we will survive!
We must!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$But what about...the ones who didn't
make it? Shouldn't we do something?

It is loneliness.

keys.DescriptionKey:
This unit's attacks will not wake sleeping enemies.

Until the end of this unit's third turn while on the battlefield:
- This unit is immune to Poison and Sleep status effects.
- This unit is immune to Stun effects unless it is burning.
- Unless it is burning, this unit has 80% damage reduction and has a 100% chance to survive any damage that would defeat it with 1HP.

Until the end of this unit's second turn while on the battlefield, each time this unit takes damage from an attack, a random non-burning enemy is immediately granted Cursed Sleep for 200TU, then a random non-burning enemy immediately becomes Lethal Poisoned for 999TU. This is not a Skin passive skill.
