$#()#$—Silverdrake Mountains.
$#FlockofDragons(Flock of Dragons)#$Guh...
$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlGrin2&$$@Center@$You just called me by my name! Yay!
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Ugh... Stay away from me.
$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSurprisedCute&$$@Center@$Aw, come on, why so mean?
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Just because, you insolent little brat.

$#()#$Rias visited me time and time again,
sharing stories about the village.

$#()#$Things that happened that day, examples
of human kindness, the sights she saw...

$#()#$Listening to her, I somehow began to feel
almost as if I had been part of the village.

$#()#$As if I had been living there among her
people.
$#()#$I even dreamed about it.

$#()#$In my dreams, I was the same height as
Rias, sitting at a table,

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$$&DragonGirlHuh&$$@Center@$The small fry just keep swimming in...
You must be the one who led them here,
$#()#$laughing with others during a meal.

$#()#$And then one day, the village was attacked
by Diabolos.

$#()#$Rias and I fought with all our might to
defend it.

$#()#$Though we managed to drive the dragon
away, Rias was severely injured.

$#()#$My own body was riddled with wounds as
well. I had lost almost all of my senses.
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Huff... Huff...
$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSadCute&$$@Center@$Shen Long... Are you okay!?
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Worry about yourself... Gah... Huff, huff...
$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSadCute&$$@Center@$W-Why...

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSadCute&$$@Center@$You never cared about the village... Why
would you go to such lengths to protect it...
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$$&DragonGirlHuh&$$@Center@$Dragon Lord of Shadow.
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$It was...a whim... Nothing more...
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$So... Is the village...safe?
$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSadCute&$$@Center@$Well...

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSadCute&$$@Center@$A large part got burned...
The houses... The people...

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$It was my power that burned it, wasn't it...
What have I done... What have I done...

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSadSmile&$$@Center@$You protected us from that evil dragon,
Shen Long!

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$It came here because of fate... The tie
between light and darkness...
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$The village burned...because of me...
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Gah... Cough...
$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSadCute&$$@Center@$Shen Long!

$#Diabolos(Dragon of Shadow)#$$&BigCrescentShadow&$$@Center@$So you are the Dragon Lord of Light... Or
rather, what is left of you.

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSadCute&$$@Center@$Come with me to the village! The doctor
might still be there!
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$No human can treat me... This is the end...

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$My memories and power will be passed on
to a successor...

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Though considering how much power I
just expended...and these wounds...
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$I cannot predict how the next vessel will fare...
$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSadSmile&$$@Center@$Shen Long, use me.
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Use you...?

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSadSmile&$$@Center@$Make me your vessel. I'll become the next
Shen Long.

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Don't be foolish... If I do that...you'll lose
your identity, your humanity...
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Didn't I tell you? I am a godlike being...

$#Diabolos(Dragon of Shadow)#$$&BigCrescentShadow&$$@Center@$Your power and aura match the memories
I have inherited.

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlHappySmile&$$@Center@$And I told you I'm your friend. I can't just
stand by when you're in need.
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Are you...sure about this?

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSmile&$$@Center@$Yes. That way, we can protect our village
together. Forever and ever.
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$...Very well, Rias. I promise we will.
$#Diabolos(Dragon of Shadow)#$$&BigCrescentShadow&$$@Center@$But what is this flimsy form of yours?

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$$&DragonGirlHuh&$$@Center@$You didn't come here to talk, did you,
Diabolos?

$#Diabolos(Diabolos)#$$&BigCrescentOpenMouth&$$@Center@$You are quite right. Let us begin this
inevitable showdown—

$#Diabolos(Diabolos)#$$&BigCrescentOpenMouth&$$@Center@$The ageless duel between light and
darkness!
$#Diabolos(Diabolos)#$$&BigCrescentOpenMouth&$$@Center@$Grrrroargh!
$#()#$A jagged ridgeline of towering summits.

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$$&DragonGirlGrin&$$@Center@$Is that all? Not even sufficient for a
warm-up.
$#Diabolos(Diabolos)#$$&BigCrescentClosedMouth&$$@Center@$Your power is as vexing as I remember.

$#Diabolos(Diabolos)#$$&BigCrescentOpenMouth&$$@Center@$However, choosing that frail body as your
successor was a grave mistake... Grooargh!
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$$&DragonGirlHurt&$$@Center@$Ngh!
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$$&DragonGirlHurt&$$@Center@$(As expected, a worthy opponent...)

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$$&DragonGirlHurt&$$@Center@$(This won't be as painless as dealing with
those weaklings earlier.)

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$$&DragonGirlHurt&$$@Center@$(I'm sorry for treating the body you lent
me like this...)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Shen Long)#$(Rias.)
$#()#$I met Rias about a hundred years ago.

$#()#$She had the audacity to enter my domain
without permission.
$#JedarielA;JedarielB;(Flock of Dragons)#$$&BlueDragonNormal;JedarielB.BlueDragonNormal&$$@Left;;;JedarielB.Right;@$Grrrroooooaaaar!

$#()#$I can still hear the steady echo of her
footsteps.
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$...?

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Who are you? Why have you entered my
domain?
$#Rias(Lost Girl)#$$&DragonGirlLaugh&$$@Center@$Uh, sorry about that. I got lost.
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Don't you realize where you are? Who I am?

$#Rias(Lost Girl)#$$&DragonGirlSigh&$$@Center@$Umm, give me a second... I can't seem to
think straight. I'm so exhausted.

$#Rias(Lost Girl)#$$&DragonGirlSurprisedCute&$$@Center@$Oh, wait... Is this the forbidden area?
Then you must be Shen Long.

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$That is correct. I am the fearsome
Shen Long.

$#Rias(Lost Girl)#$$&DragonGirlLaugh&$$@Center@$Wow, really? That's so cool! You're not what I
imagined, though. I thought you'd be scarier.
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Are you mocking me, child?

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$$&DragonGirlIrritate&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You've made quite a ruckus, you insolent
brats.

$#Rias(Lost Girl)#$$&DragonGirlSigh&$$@Center@$I'm telling you, I don't have the energy to
mock anyone. I'm completely drained.
$#Rias(Lost Girl)#$$&DragonGirlSigh&$$@Center@$Dried out like laundry in the sun.

$#Rias(Lost Girl)#$$&DragonGirlSleep&$$@Center@$And I've had enough scolding for one day.
I'm sleepy, so good night.
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$You insolent little—
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$What is wrong with her...

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$(Just an ill-mannered, cheeky girl—
nothing more.)

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$(Nevertheless, slitting a sleeping child's
throat does not become a Dragon Lord.)

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$(I suppose it won't hurt to let her stay for the
night.)
$#Rias(Lost Girl)#$$&DragonGirlLaugh&$$@Center@$Ahhh, what a beautiful morning!

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$I can't believe you truly slept here the
whole night.
$#JedarielA;JedarielB;(Flock of Dragons)#$$&BlueDragonNormal;JedarielB.BlueDragonNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;JedarielB.Right;@$Graarrrgh!

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$How impertinent. Didn't you fear being
eaten?
$#Rias(Lost Girl)#$$&DragonGirlHappy&$$@Center@$Well, you didn't eat me, did you?
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Insufferable child...

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlLaugh&$$@Center@$I have a name, you know. I'm Rias. Pleased
to meet you, kind-hearted Shen Long.
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Kind-hearted?

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSleep&$$@Center@$Yup. Everyone in the village is scared of
you, but I don't feel that way at all.
$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlLaugh&$$@Center@$Well, see you later∼
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$...Don't you dare come here again, you brat.
$#()#$It seems my words fell on deaf ears.
$#()#$Three days later, the girl appeared again.

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$$&DragonGirlIrritate&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Challenging me to battle is in your nature,
I suppose...

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSmile&$$@Center@$Hey, Shen Long∼
I brought you some leftovers!
$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlLaugh&$$@Center@$Ah, there you are. Here, have a rice cake.
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$I don't want it. Go away.

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlGrin2&$$@Center@$But you like rice cakes, right? You eat the
ones we offer on New Year's, every year.
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$That's because they are offerings.

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlLaugh&$$@Center@$Then let's say this is an offering too. Here
you go.
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Your irreverence knows no bounds, girl.
$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlGrinPoutCute&$$@Center@$It's Rias, R-i-a-s!

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlGrinPoutCute&$$@Center@$If you can't remember people's names,
you won't make any friends, you know?

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Silence. I don't have friends. I don't need
them.

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$$&DragonGirlAngry&$$@Center@$But if you think you stand a chance, think
again!
$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlHappySmile&$$@Center@$Oh, then I'll be your friend! Is that okay?
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$...

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSleep&$$@Center@$Silence means consent, or so the traveling
merchant said.
$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlGrin2&$$@Center@$Yay, I'm friends with Shen Long now♪

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$I was simply too dumbfounded to respond
to your nonsense.
$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSmile&$$@Center@$Now we can chat like friends do!
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Sigh.
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Talking to you is exhausting.

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlLaugh&$$@Center@$Great, let's start! What should we talk
about... Ah!

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlGrin2&$$@Center@$A group of monsters appeared on the
outskirts of the village, I think yesterday.
$#FlockofDragons(Flock of Dragons)#$$!-1!$Grrrr...
$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlGrin2&$$@Center@$Was that because you were angry?

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Foolish talk... As if my anger could make
monsters attack.

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlLaugh&$$@Center@$So it wasn't your fault! The whole village
was in an uproar, saying it was
$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlGrin2&$$@Center@$your wrath and such.

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$It seems you didn't think that was the
case.

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSmile&$$@Center@$Of course not. I already knew you weren't
like that. You're nice.
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Hmph, nonsense.

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSleep&$$@Center@$I'll go tell everyone that Shen Long would
never do such a thing!

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSigh&$$@Center@$They won't be happy to hear I entered the
forbidden area, but I don't care.
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Why would you do that?
$#FlockofDragons(Flock of Dragons)#$Graaaaarrrr...
$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlHappy&$$@Center@$Do what?

$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Why defend me, especially if it means
getting in trouble with the villagers?
$#ShenLong(Shen Long)#$Why won't you just leave me alone?

$#Rias(Rias)#$$&DragonGirlSmile&$$@Center@$Because we're friends. It makes me sad

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciExcited&$$@Center@$Oh, I've never seen this type of vegetation
before!

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciExcited&$$@Center@$Perhaps the ambient magical energy has
influenced its growth this way!

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciExcited&$$@Center@$$%1.5%$Oooooh, there's a monster I've never seen
before too!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Ms. Da Vinci, please slow down!

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciExcitedTongue&$$@Left@$Apologies! I'm just so excited! I can't stop
the flood of ideas! No, not a flood, an ocean!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$I get it, I really do! But charging headfirst
toward a monster is a bad idea!
$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciShy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Uuugh... But it's so fascinating!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(If I let her out of my sight for even a
second, it won't end well for sure...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You're a rather curious person, aren't you?

$#Satan(Satan)#$$&SatanBigSurprised&$$@Center@$Uh, I heard there's a wicked dragon in
these mountains.

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciShy&$$@Left@$Well, when I see something fascinating, I
can't help but get excited...

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciExcited&$$@Left@$We inventors are basically walking bundles
of curiosity!

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciNormal&$$@Left@$Oh, speaking of inventions, Finn, isn't it
getting a bit chilly?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Yeah, a little. It's always snowing around
here.
$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciHappy&$$@Left@$Here, use this. It'll keep you warm.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Wow, it's really warm! What is this?

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciExcited&$$@Left@$I made it by tempering fire magic and
solidifying it. I named it Hyper Handy Heat.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Right@$It's definitely handy! Missions in cold
regions would be a lot easier with this.
$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hoho, it's remarkably stable this time...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Center@$"This time"?
Ow ow ow, hot!!!
$#Girl(Girl?)#$$&DragonGirlIrritate&$$@Center@$And you came to me because...?

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciHappy&$$@Center@$Ah, so it ended up overheating after all.
Still needs a little fine-tuning.

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciHehTongue&$$@Center@$You see, invention is all about trial and
error!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Sure, just...give me a heads up next time.
Please.
$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciExcitedTongue&$$@Left@$You got it!
$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciNormal&$$@Left@$Oh? The wind's getting rather strong...
$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciNormal&$$@Left@$Lucky for us there was a hut nearby, huh?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$Yeah, that snowstorm came out of
nowhere. Are you all right, Da Vinci?

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciWink&$$@Left@$Oh, we're dropping the "Ms." already?
I like it. It feels like we're becoming friends.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Ah, sorry. It just kind of slipped out...

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciHappy&$$@Left@$No, if anything, you being so polite with
me was strange.

$#Satan(Satan)#$$&SatanDoya&$$@Center@$My demonic intuition drew me here, duh!
That's all the motivation I need!

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciTongueWink&$$@Left@$Since, well, I'm an intruder who barged into
the lab uninvited.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Haha, I guess you're right, now that you
mention it.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$All right, from here on out, no formalities.

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciNormal&$$@Left@$Thanks! It seems like we'll be spending
the night here.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$Yeah, doesn't look like the storm's letting
up.

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciShy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$A night alone with a man... Hehe, this is a
first for me.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$Uh, could you not...say it like that?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$I mean, I don't blame you for being on your
guard, but...

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciExcited&$$@Center@$On my guard? Quite the opposite! I'd love
a chance to study the opposite sex in detail!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Center@$In detail...

$#Girl(Girl?)#$$&DragonGirlIrritate&$$@Center@$Let's say I know that dragon. What are you
planning to do with it?

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciExcited&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Yes! I told you my curiosity knows no
bounds!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Right@$H-Hold on, Da Vinci! You look kind of
scary... What are you planning to do!?
$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciExcitedTongue&$$@Center@$Oh, just a test or two...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Right@$(She's going to experiment on me!?)
$#Solas(Boy)#$$&SolasHappy&$$@Left@$—It's open! Over here, Luna!
$#Solas(Boy)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Left@$Ah.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprised&$$@Right@$Ah.

$#Solas(Boy)#$$&SolasHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Sorry, we didn't mean to intrude! Let's go,
Luna!
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaWah&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What!? It's freezing outside, Solas!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasHurt&$$@Left@$These two were, uh, enjoying each other's
company! We shouldn't interrupt.

$#Satan(Satan)#$$&SatanCheeky&$$@Center@$Make it my minion, of course! It'd make
a perfect pet for the Demon Overlord.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$!-1!$$@Right@$No, no, it's not like that!
$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciClosedEyes&$$@Left@$Yes, this is just a scientific test.
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Right@$A test?

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciShy&$$@Left@$Yes, just a little experiment between a man and
a woman.
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I knew it! Sorry, we'll leave immediately!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Center@$No, you're getting the wrong idea!
Da Vinci, stop saying weird things!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$You two, come inside, quick! You'll freeze
if you stay out there!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaWah&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Come on, Solas! We can't stay outside
any longer.
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasHurt&$$@Right@$Um... Is it really okay?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Left@$Of course! Sorry for the confusion.
$#Girl(Girl?)#$$&DragonGirlUpset&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You'd make it a pet.
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Right@$No, I was the one who assumed things...

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappyClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$All right, hello then! I'm Luna!
Nice to meet ya!
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Center@$That's way too casual, Luna!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$No, it's fine. We'll be spending some time
together, might as well keep things friendly.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasHeh&$$@Right@$My name is Solas. Luna and I are travelling
monster trainers.

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciNormal&$$@Left@$Oh, monster trainers? That sounds like a
fascinating field to R&D.
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Right@$R&D?

$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciHappy&$$@Left@$Research and develop! For example, how
about constructing a magical radar that can
$#DaVinci(Da Vinci)#$$&DaVinciHappy&$$@Left@$find and identify nearby monsters?
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSmile&$$@Right@$Wow, that sounds super useful!

She provided Bergaria with designs for various technological innovations, such as magical analysis goggles and antigravity engines for flying vessels.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Reina Fujiwara, third child of the Akise Fujiwara family, was never meant to amount to much. Her two older brothers were heir and spare to the Fujiwara real estate empire. Her parents believed she would stand quietly in their family photos, enjoy the luxury of their wealth, and one day marry some celebrity or prince to secure them political power.

They never once thought, not until the day the Church took her away, that they had given birth to a piece of the Goddess herself.

Reina became the Tenth Vessel of Pandora at age seven, bearing the Gift of the Goddess's Wisdom. And she is happier at Shinano Academy than she ever was at home.

DeadlyNurse01.name: Reina
DeadlyNurse01.title: Deadly Nurse
DeadlyNurse01.description:
Reina Fujiwara, third child of the Akise Fujiwara family, was never meant to amount to much. Her two older brothers were heir and spare to the Fujiwara real estate empire. Her parents believed she would stand quietly in their family photos, enjoy the luxury of their wealth, and one day marry some celebrity or prince to secure them political power.

They never once thought, not until the day the Church took her away, that they had given birth to a piece of the Goddess herself.

Reina became the Tenth Vessel of Pandora at age seven, bearing the Gift of the Goddess's Wisdom. And she is happier at Shinano Academy than she ever was at home.

keys.IntroText:
She can heal your every ill,
but she'll take your soul as payment.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Knowing her Gift, no one was surprised when Reina quickly surpassed her classmates in every academic subject. They promoted her from second grade to sixth within three months at the Academy, then sent her directly into high school a year after that. Nothing seemed to challenge the sharp little girl, who burned through every exam with masterful finesse.

Soon, Reina found herself studying on her own, taken out of the other girls' classes entirely. This was in part to spare them the pain of being so thoroughly bested, but that was not the only reason.

The teachers had noticed that tears, fights, and chaos followed wherever Reina went. For everyone's sake, it was better to keep her alone.

DeadlyNurse02.title: Deadly Nurse

The teachers had noticed that tears, fights, and chaos followed wherever Reina went. For everyone's sake, it was better to keep her alone.

keys.DescriptionKey:
It surprises some to find out, but the Goddess's Wisdom and the Goddess's Intelligence are not the same Gift. Another Vessel in her class held the Goddess's Intelligence, in fact. She was a bright-eyed thing, reading years above her grade level, always studying and trying her best.

Reina outstripped her test scores every time they competed.

Intelligence comes from inborn talent and books. Wisdom comes from experience, and a Goddess has had millennia of that to pass on. It is why Reina chose to become a doctor, when nothing about her nature embraces healing.

A doctor sees people at their lowest. Even more than a warrior, a healer holds life in her hands. Among those desperate to escape death, nothing gives her more power than that.

keys.DescriptionKey:
A former knight of Hymelia, and member of the lowest rank of nobility. His father Artorias began his career as a common footsoldier, but his skills saw him promoted to General and earned him land and a noble title. Having the greatest admiration for his father, Merdain followed in his footsteps, and he quickly became a very promising knight, despite the derision he endured for his low rank and common origins.
However, the nobles of the Senate conspired against Artorias, and he fell on the battlefield, leaving Merdain torn between his loyalty and vengeance.

DeathKnight01.name: Merdain
DeathKnight01.title: Knight of Vengeance
DeathKnight01.description:
A former knight of Hymelia, and member of the lowest rank of nobility. His father Artorias began his career as a common footsoldier, but his skills saw him promoted to General and earned him land and a noble title. Having the greatest admiration for his father, Merdain followed in his footsteps, and he quickly became a very promising knight, despite the derision he endured for his low rank and common origins.
However, the nobles of the Senate conspired against Artorias, and he fell on the battlefield, leaving Merdain torn between his loyalty and vengeance.

keys.IntroText:
The fires of vengeance burn bright.
Leaving nothing behind, not even ash.

keys.DescriptionKey:
On Avalon, Merdain learned that his father took advantage of an unnatural power, the Fruit of Wisdom. The realization that even his father, with all his resourcefulness, loyalty, and hard work, had to resort to supernatural power to be acknowledged by the nobility of Hymelia sank Merdain into a deep despair.
What good is loyalty to a country that despises you?

DeathKnight02.name: Merdain
DeathKnight02.title: Knight of Vengeance
DeathKnight02.description:

What good is loyalty to a country that despises you?

keys.DescriptionKey:
Merdain's rage is directed not only at the nobles who assassinated his father, but the whole of the Kingdom of Hymelia and their system of blood lineage, nobility, and titles. With the power of the Fruit of Wisdom, he should be able to change the kingdom... by burning it down and building something new atop the ashes.
He knows that only tragedy lies down this path, but he's prepared to sacrifice everything, even his own life, for the sake of his revenge. Everything, except perhaps for one...

keys.DescriptionKey:
The servants of Orcanix know no death. Should they be reduced to dust, their master will summon them to her Pyre and create their bodies anew. Even so, nothing can be destroyed again and again without consequence.

The Paladins have no flesh, no blood. Some have lost even their bones, existing more as ghostly wraiths than moving corpses. They would wear their twisted husks with pride, if they could feel such things. But rebirth demands a price far beyond the physical, and they have paid in full.

Nothing remains inside them but bloodlust and blind obedience.

DeathLich01.name: Endless Paladin
DeathLich01.title: Champion of the Black Flames
DeathLich01.description:
The servants of Orcanix know no death. Should they be reduced to dust, their master will summon them to her Pyre and create their bodies anew. Even so, nothing can be destroyed again and again without consequence.

The Paladins have no flesh, no blood. Some have lost even their bones, existing more as ghostly wraiths than moving corpses. They would wear their twisted husks with pride, if they could feel such things. But rebirth demands a price far beyond the physical, and they have paid in full.

Nothing remains inside them but bloodlust and blind obedience.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The armies of Orcanix revere their Paladins almost as much as they revere the goddess herself. Some have existed for centuries, before the war with the mortal kingdoms. Some have shed the blood of kings, some have slaughtered dragons. All leave legends in their wake.

No coward can become a Paladin. They are tempered by death as steel is tempered by flame. To be a Paladin is to embrace suffering, to welcome and inflict it in equal measure. The goddess lets her monsters lead Erden's conquest, and they have never left her wanting. But she keeps her most elite for a secret purpose, far beyond what her underlings can fathom.

keys.DescriptionKey:
She likes peace and quiet.
She likes reading.
This place, bathed in sunlight, filled with the scent of tea, is like a sanctum of sorts. When she sits here, engrossed in her books, no-one dares interrupt her, but if you take a look every now and then, you may see her blushing. Because the books she prefers are all about love.

keys.DescriptionKey:
This unit starts with Rizette's Link. When this unit enters battle it grants Rizette's Link to another random non-conjured ally that does not have a Link already. Then that ally and this unit have the TU costs for all of their skills reduced by 30% (This will overwrite the effects of other Quicken skills), and are granted a Sleep Ward, Stun Ward, Poison Ward and Instant Death Ward.

A unit with Rizette's Link has these effects:

Each time an ally with Rizette's Link gets the turn, this unit will be healed for 50% of its max HP.

This unit has 0.25x of their original Attack added to their Attack while they are not Enraged. This increase will stack with other Attack increases (e.g. 1.5x + 0.25x => 1.75x total).

When this unit defeats an enemy with an attack, if the defeated enemy is:
- Fire or Light, 2 random non-sleeping enemies gain the Sleep status effect for 100TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield.
- Storm or Earth, 2 random non-burning enemies gain the Lethal Poison status effect.
- Water or Dark, 2 random enemies that have a current TU of 50 or less are stunned for 100TU.
These effects may trigger before or after other effects.

This Link is removed if this unit or the unit that granted it leaves the battlefield. This unit cannot gain other Links.

Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects, lasts 999 TU, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison, and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning or Boss units.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2330|$Demons capable of disguising themselves
as humans...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2338|$How are the children?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2339|$I took them back to the hideout. I can't
believe they followed me...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2340|$Could you please explain to us what is
going on here?
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2341|$...Okay.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2342|$I was a street urchin, and I spent my
childhood in alleyways and bandit hideouts.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$I spent every day just thinking about my
next meal.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2343|$Bandit hideouts!?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2344|$Well, they weren't upstanding citizens, that's
for sure. But I'm not with them anymore.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2345|$Not long ago, those Hymelia creeps attacked
a village I happened to be visiting.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2346|$I sensed them coming, so I started to run.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$I never knew such a thing existed.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$That's when the villagers asked me to take
their kids.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2347|$Are you talking about Nushelle?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2348|$Yeah. They spouted some nonsense about
dark magic and started nabbing folks.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2349|$I just couldn't abandon those kids.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2350|$I've been stealing to provide for them while
trying to find a way to get their folks out.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2351|$So that's why they treat you like their
ma...their mother.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2352|$Wow, Elmina! You're just like my Gramps.
You're amazing!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2353|$It would be a better story if you weren't
stealing for them.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2354|$Harsh, aren't you? Well, you're not wrong.
My actions are far from praiseworthy.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2355|$But it's not exactly easy for elves to make
a living in these parts.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2331|$Are they some kind of new type? Why were
they pretending to be Hymelia Knights?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2356|$How did you know those knights were
demons?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2357|$I've always had a keen sense for magic. I
can feel demons even if I can't see them.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2358|$Elves have really powerful magic, don't
they?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2359|$You know your stuff, kiddo. It's not a talent
that has done me many favors, though.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2360|$If the Hymelia Knights are demons in
disguise, that must mean...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2361|$Yep. The Hymelia Fortress is crawling with
them.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2362|$I had a nasty feeling in Hymelia... This must
have been why!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2363|$It also explains why they didn't come
looking for Elmina themselves.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2364|$She can sense demons approaching, so
she could just run away.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2365|$That's why they've been asking outsiders
to catch her.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2332|$Do you know what's going on, Elmina?
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2366|$Hey, why don't we team up?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2367|$My goal is to free these kids' parents from
the Hymelia Fortress.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2368|$And you guys want to rid Hymelia of their
nest, right?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2369|$I think we should do it, Captain. Now that
we know what's going on, we have to.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2370|$I agree with Sir Finn. It is our duty to fight!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2371|$I have no objections either, Brother.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2372|$Let's fight! For these kids, their folks, and
everyone those demons are troubling!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHeh&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2373|$With Elmina's ability, we'll know which
ones are monsters.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2374|$And if we rescue the elves, maybe they can
tell us something about Callen!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2375|$Captain... Please.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2333|$Mostly. How about you untie me? I want to
make sure the kids are okay.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2376|$...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2377|$Okay, I understand how you feel. But in
order for this to work...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2378|$We need to hand Elmina over to the
Hymelia Knights.
$#Rizette;Theo;Astrid;(All)#$$&RizetteSurprise;Theo.TheoSurprise;Astrid.AstridSurprise&$$@Center;;;Theo.Left;Astrid.Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2379|$What!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2380|$What are you saying, Captain!? Elmina's
going to help us—
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2381|$Let me finish, Finn. I have a plan.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2382|$For starters, we need to return to Hymelia
and take Elmina to the fortress.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2383|$Can I trust you, Cap?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2384|$I swear to all of you, I will make this work.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2385|$But we don't have much time. We should
make for the Hymelia Fortress immediately!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2334|$Captain...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2386|$...Yes ma'am!
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2335|$Relax. I'm not going to run.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2336|$Very well...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2337|$Thanks for waiting, folks.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Vonn was a child of a noble elven family who was entrusted with defending their region during a prior Pandemonium.

One day, in a sealed vault deep within his father's castle, Vonn found a giant maul that had become a prison for a powerful demon lord named Drakkus. The demon promised great power to any that would wield this maul in battle, and eager to aid his father against the forces of the Pandemonium, Vonn foolishly carried the weapon out of the vault.

Just as the demon had promised, Vonn became nearly invincible in battle. Despite his father's grave concerns about the weapon, the elven forces soon came to rely on the young hero in the struggle against the Pandemonium.

DemonElfBoy01.name: Vonn
DemonElfBoy01.title: Bearer of the Demon Maul
DemonElfBoy01.description:
Vonn was a child of a noble elven family who was entrusted with defending their region during a prior Pandemonium.

One day, in a sealed vault deep within his father's castle, Vonn found a giant maul that had become a prison for a powerful demon lord named Drakkus. The demon promised great power to any that would wield this maul in battle, and eager to aid his father against the forces of the Pandemonium, Vonn foolishly carried the weapon out of the vault.

Just as the demon had promised, Vonn became nearly invincible in battle. Despite his father's grave concerns about the weapon, the elven forces soon came to rely on the young hero in the struggle against the Pandemonium.

keys.IntroText:
"You'll make me a greater warrior than my father?"
"Of course! He will be no match for you..."

keys.DescriptionKey:
But Vonn's heroics soon came to an end. One stormy night, the forces of the Pandemonium laid siege to Vonn's home itself. Vonn eagerly joined the fray against them with his maul, and it didn't take long for him to crush all of the attacking forces.

At that moment, the demon in the maul intentionally loosened his grip on the boy's mind, so that he could see what had really transpired. There was no siege, there were no Aeon Knights... Only his beloved family, who now lay dead and broken throughout the castle.

As the truth dawned on Vonn, his mind shattered, allowing the demon to fully claim his soul.

At that moment, the demon in the maul intentionally loosened his grip on the boy's mind, so that he could see what had really transpired. There was no siege, there were no Aeon Knights... Only his beloved family, who now lay dead and broken throughout the castle.

As the truth dawned on Vonn, his mind shattered, allowing the demon to fully claim his soul.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Vonn now serves Drakkus, as the demon lord seeks for a way to break his prison. Years of serving under his demonic master have corrupted Vonn beyond recognition. Gone is the naive boy who dreamed of becoming a hero like his father. Vonn is now just as cruel and heartless as the other demons under Drakkus's rule.

Yet his obedience to Drakkus is only superficial, as Vonn is still determined to avenge his family. He is merely waiting for the ideal opportunity to exact his vengeance.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$The wishes we would ask of Oumei are not
compatible. We cannot both succeed.

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$I'm well aware. However, perhaps we could
think about that after the fortress?

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$Agreed. Right now, we need to focus on
rescuing Oumei from Magra!

$#Guard(Magra Soldier)#$$&GuardSerious&$$!0!$$@Center@$They're back! The elf and the sziviik are
back!!

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Center@$Just one more step. We can do it!
We can break through!

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$You don't seem troubled at all by the
dangers ahead.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$Whoever can list the most medicinal herbs
claims the right to make their wish.

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaAngry&$$@Right@$What? You'd risk something so important
on such a childish game?

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$Oh my. Is your botanical education so
lacking that you fear defeat?
$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaAngry&$$@Right@$...
$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$Nasleaf. It has a calming effect.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$...Whitebristle. Its roots can be used to
counter poison.
$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$Whitebristle? There's no such plant.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$While your ignorance cannot be helped,
I assure you, it exists.
$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$It grows to excess in my homeland.

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$This isn't going to work. With no judge,
we can lie without any consequence.

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$What's your purpose here? What will you
wish for when we reach the tree?

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$Perhaps this was not the best way to
settle this affair.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$Now that I've seen the limit of your
intellect, we may as well call it off.

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaAngry&$$@Right@$If you didn't know the ritual I'd be
tempted to shut that mouth of yours.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$It appears we've arrived. Is this the
entrance to the famed Majas Desert?

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$It is. According to the refugees, Magra has
made his fortress within the desert.

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$Be on your guard. I don't want to be slowed
down by some dainty, fragile elf.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$And I ask that you refrain from slowing me
down as you lug all those scales around.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$Let us just say there is someone I would
dearly like to find, and leave it at that.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$I would like to ask you the same. To what
end do you seek out Oumei?

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$Let's just say there is a place I would
dearly like to find, and leave it at that.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$I'm sure you understand, but there is no
way both of our wishes can be granted.

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$Indeed. One of us will have to abandon
their wish in favor of the other.

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$How to decide? I've had my fill battling
monsters, so a duel is out of the question.
$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$Agreed. Then how about this?
$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaAngry&$$@Right@$What a waste of time.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$(It is said that whoever stands before it
shall be granted one wish.)

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaHuh&$$!0!$$@Left@$Oh? What exactly is the "Kingdom of
Magra"?

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaAngry&$$@Right@$Who cares what nonsense they're
talking about?! Let's deal with them first!

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$There was nothing curious about them.
You got yourself lost.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$Did, or did you not, tell me to leave
the village and head south?

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaAngry&$$@Right@$That village is south of here! You went
north!
$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$Wait... You do know the difference, right?
$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaAngry&$$@Right@$Your map is fine! The only thing "fuzzy"
is your head.
$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaAngry&$$@Left@$I think you've said quite enough!

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$I'm tempted to leave you here, but I don't
care for you starting rumors I'm a liar.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$Hmph. It seems we've taken care of the
rabble.
$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$No, it's nothing.

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$Head south from this village and you
should reach it before sundown.
$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$South? Marvelous. Then I bid you farewell.
$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaAngry&$$@Right@$Hey, what a minute! That's―
$#BanditMale(Bandit)#$$&BanditMale&$$@Left@$Ya think I'm gonna let ya go that easy?!
$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaAngry&$$@Right@$Hng?! How are you still standing...?!
$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaAngry&$$@Right@$Wait, Elf! Listen, that's―
$#()#$4 leagues from Majas Desert.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Center@$This is most strange. I left the village and
headed straight south...

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Center@$However, I have no sense of getting any
closer. In fact...

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$I could have taken them on my own. But I
cannot deny your aid. Thank you.
$#DONTSHOWME(Monster)#$$!0!$Grrrrr.... Raaaargh!

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Center@$I feel I may have walked straight into a
monster's lair.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Center@$It appears that my newfound scaly friend
may have been a liar.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Center@$I suppose it really was quite foolish of me
to place my trust in―
$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaAngry&$$@Center@$Hey! Elf!
$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaHuh&$$@Center@$It's...it's you!

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I finally caught you. What in the name of
Erden are you doing here?

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$Well, I should think you of all people
would understand.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$I was lied to, by you, and after losing sight
of my goal,
$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$I became lost and surrounded by monsters.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$Oh, there's no need for gratitude. It was
far from an altruistic deed, you see.

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$No one told you any lies. You got lost all
on your own.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$Nonsense. There's no way I could have
become lost.
$#DONTSHOWME(Monster)#$$!0!$Groooaaargh! Raaaargh!!

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaAngry&$$!0!$$@Right@$I have a few choice words for you, but
let's take care of these vermin first.

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$What cruel fate would have me play the
role of the rescued this time around?
$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$Right. You need directions?

$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$Precisely! My, you catch on fast. My map
is just a series of fuzzy smudges...

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaSerious&$$@Right@$I might be able to help. Where are you
headed?
$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$Majas Desert.
$#Alba(Alba)#$$&AlbaAngry&$$@Right@$What...?
$#Zeshua(Zeshua)#$$&ZeshuaSerious&$$@Left@$Is something wrong?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$A Desertle!? What's it doing out here?
They don't normally come this far out.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Rizette, I'll fight this thing. You hide!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedAngry&$$@Right@$If I go back, it will get me. There's nowhere to run, we have to fight!
$#DONTSHOWME(Desertle)#$GROOOAAAARGH!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Something's definitely up. Desertles
usually stick to their own territory.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$It's like it's being controlled by something.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Was there one at your village too?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedSerious&$$@Right@$No, whatever was at my village was much
more vicious and evil than this Desertle.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$Gods... I wonder what it was?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedAngry&$$@Right@$Let's keep moving.

keys.DescriptionKey:
This unit cannot be defeated by damage from Burn status effects. This unit enters battle with the Healing Burn status effect for 300TU.

If all units on the battlefield are Fire or have Burn Blast, or Burn Drive type active skills, this unit has a 50% bonus to attacks.

Whenever a Fire ally on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source:

- All allies become Enraged.
- All enemies are granted the Burn status effect and become Weakened. Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. This will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on the target and can be overwritten by Enrage effects. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects. A unit with Healing Burn will heal after each turn at the same rate as Burn deals damage. Healing Burn will overwrite other status effects on the user and can replace the Burn status effect, but cannot be replaced by Burn. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with Healing Burn will gain the Burn status effect. Healing Burn will not be removed by Purify skills.

keys.DescriptionKey:
One of the Oracles, the nine spirits who protect and oversee Avalon. Her main job is to retrieve the corpses of those who return to Avalon, and unlike her elder sister Le Fay, she doesn't often interact with living humans.
She cares the most about keeping the peace on the island, and if outside invaders ever arrive on Avalon, she's the first one to engage them in battle. Despite her slender build, she is monstrously strong. Generally speaking, the other eight Oracles never even have a chance to fight before the battle is over.

keys.DescriptionKey:
"What, pray tell, is he doing?"
"He says he is building a raft. It is amusing, watching him struggle with the trees and vines."
"Amusing enough to watch for a whole afternoon? He rejected the Fruit. He's unworthy, and you're wasting your time."
"Really? Perhaps we are mistaken about that. Perhaps I should observe him further to be sure, even across the ocean..."
"...Le Fay, you..."
"Be at ease, dear sister. It was only a joke."
"...If you're sure."

keys.value: $#Dracula(Dracula)#$$&DraculaNormal&$$@Center@$Awake at last?

$#Helsing(Helsing)#$$&HelsingSerious&$$@Center@$And what of it...? Are you going to kill me? Like
you killed my mother?

$#Dracula(Dracula)#$$&DraculaHappy&$$@Center@$Ahahaha...! Wonderful! Your fierce spirit—just
like hers...
$#Helsing(Helsing)#$$&HelsingSerious&$$@Center@$...So you don't deny it.
$#Dracula(Dracula)#$$&DraculaNormal&$$@Center@$...No. It was none other than I who killed her.
$#Dracula(Dracula)#$$&DraculaNormal&$$@Center@$She no longer lives.
$#Helsing(Helsing)#$$&HelsingSerious&$$@Center@$...!

$#Dracula(Dracula)#$$&DraculaNormal&$$@Center@$And she is not a vampire either. I am sorry to
ruin the reunion you were dreaming of...
$#Helsing(Helsing)#$$&HelsingShouting&$$@Center@$I'll kill you...!

$#Dracula(Dracula)#$$&DraculaNormal&$$@Center@$Oh, please don't... Trying to bite me, of all
things—

$#Dracula(Dracula)#$$&DraculaNormal&$$@Center@$Haha, you'd make quite the vampire yourself.
Unlike her...
$#Helsing(Helsing)#$$&HelsingHurt&$$@Center@$Ugh...ah... You're...

$#Dracula(Dracula)#$$&DraculaNormal&$$@Center@$But you will remain as you are. And you will
love me...!
$#Helsing(Helsing)#$$&HelsingShouting&$$@Center@$I would never...!

$#Dracula(Dracula)#$$&DraculaBigSurprised&$$@Center@$Oh, stop struggling! The restraints will just
hurt your hands and feet...!

$#Dracula(Dracula)#$$&DraculaSerious&$$@Center@$Let me calm you down a little... Don't worry, it
will sting only for a moment.
$#Helsing(Helsing)#$$&HelsingHurt&$$@Center@$You're going to drink my blood...? S-Stop it...!

$#Dracula(Dracula)#$$&DraculaCold&$$@Center@$Oh, how wonderful...! My Ekaterina—to be able
to taste your sweet blood once more...
$#Dracula(Dracula)#$$&DraculaCold&$$@Center@$I will savor every drop...
$#Helsing(Helsing)#$$&HelsingHurt&$$@Center@$$%1%$Ah...! No... STOP!!

$#Dracula(Dracula)#$$&DraculaExcited&$$@Center@$Ahhhhhh...! What a rich and intoxicating
fragrance...! Such an exquisite texture...

$#Dracula(Dracula)#$$&DraculaExcited&$$@Center@$To think I can drink your blood again... My
beloved Ekaterina...!!

$#Helsing(Helsing)#$$&HelsingHurt&$$@Center@$(My arms and legs...can't move. They're bound
with something...)
$#Dracula(Dracula)#$$&DraculaExcited&$$@Center@$One more sip...  Just one more...!
$#Sentry(Sentry)#$My lord!

$#Dracula(Dracula)#$$&DraculaBigSurprised&$$@Center@$What...! I was right in the middle of... It's not
yet time for you all to be up and about!

$#Sentry(Sentry)#$Yes, my lord. But the alarm has been triggered.
Intruders in the pantry!
$#Dracula(Dracula)#$$&DraculaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Intruders...? I see... I shall see to this myself...

$#Dracula(Dracula)#$$&DraculaSerious&$$@Center@$You—go wake the others sleeping in their
coffins.
$#Helsing(Helsing)#$$&HelsingHurt&$$@Center@$Ungh...

$#Dracula(Dracula)#$$&DraculaNormal&$$@Center@$Hehe... Are those your friends, I wonder? I will
be back soon. Wait for me, Helsing.
$#Helsing(Helsing)#$$&HelsingHurt&$$@Center@$...Hungh...huff...

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSad&$$@Right@$Ugh, it's cold. I suppose it's because we're
underground.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Let me go first.
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSurprised&$$@Right@$What? Why?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You brought me along because you heard I'm
a capable knight, right?
$#SentryB(Sentry B)#$What is it?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$I don't think I'll be much help in solving
mysteries, so let me be useful at least in
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$situations like this.

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesStare&$$@Center@$...My powers of deduction tell me that you have
broken more than a few hearts in your time.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$What... I'd never do that!

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSweat&$$@Center@$...Seems to be a classic case of the culprit being
unaware of his own crimes.
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Look—there's a door over there.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Right. Let's move carefully.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$What...what is this...?

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesBigSurprised&$$@Right@$Coffins. A great number of them. This is quite
unexpected.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$There are people inside! Are they.—
$#SentryA(Sentry A)#$I thought I heard something over here...

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesThinking&$$@Right@$No—they're unconscious, but their hearts are
still beating.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$But their faces are as pale as corpses, and their
skin is ice-cold...

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSerious&$$@Center@$This person's face—I saw it in last month's
paper. One of the missing persons.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$That Count is definitely up to no good...

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesThinking&$$@Center@$But what to do now? They refuse to wake up,
and we can't carry all of them out like this...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Oh no...I hear footsteps coming this way!
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesBigSurprised&$$@Right@$We need to hide.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hide? but where...!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(No choice... We'll have to get into one of the
coffins!)
$#SentryA(Sentry A)#$Guess it was nothing...

$#SentryA(Sentry A)#$Ugh, I'm exhausted. Just our luck that we get
assigned to guard duties for couple of days in
$#SentryA(Sentry A)#$a row. I just want to get to sleep...

$#SentryB(Sentry B)#$Same... Oh, I already moved tonight's catch to
the "pantry".
$#SentryA(Sentry A)#$Thanks. You took one to the rooftop room too?

$#SentryB(Sentry B)#$Yeah, all done. The smell was awful, let me tell
you...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(What are they talking about... no—I have to
focus on being absolutely still...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(...Why does this coffin smell oddly sweet?)
$#SentryA(Sentry A)#$$!-1!$...Hey, have you seen the key that was here?
$#SentryB(Sentry B)#$No, I haven't. You drop it somewhere?

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSerious&$$@Right@$(whisper) Pssst... This way, Mr. Hero. Stay
very quiet.

$#SentryA(Sentry A)#$Probably... Fortunately we've got a spare, but
who knows what Lord Dracula would do to me
$#SentryA(Sentry A)#$if she finds out...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(Dracula...?)

$#Sentry(Sentry)#$$!-1!$We'd better find it fast... Come on, it's time that
we get back to our post.
$#Sentry(Sentry)#$Right, the guests will be leaving soon.
$# ( )#$—CLICK
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSmile&$$@Right@$*gasp—We made it through...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$That was close...
$#Helsing(???)#$$&HelsingSigh&$$@Center@$My goodness... that was quite the surprise...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$Well, at least we're safe—
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$(whisper) Got it... Then on to the next room.
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSmile&$$@Right@$......
$#Helsing(???)#$$&HelsingHappySmile&$$@Center@$......
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Wait—who are you!?

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesBigSurprised&$$@Center@$Since when was this explosively sexy lady in
this room?

$#Helsing(???)#$$&HelsingStareSmile&$$@Center@$Why, I've been here all along. In that box right
there...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You mean...in the coffin I was in!?

$#Helsing(???)#$$&HelsingStareSmile&$$@Right@$That's right. You certainly surprised me, young
man.

$#Helsing(???)#$$&HelsingStareSmile&$$@Right@$The two of us in that box together... hehe. All
sorts of things happened, didn't they...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Left@$N-Nothing happened! If I accidentally touched
you, I'm so sorry!

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesStare&$$@Right@$No need to deduce anything here. Finn—I'm
sorry to say, you've been caught red-handed.

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSigh&$$@Right@$Phew. This castle is huge—searching it is
quite the undertaking.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Left@$What!? I'm innocent!
$#Helsing(???)#$$&HelsingHappySmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hehe, it's all right. I don't mind at all.
$#Helsing(Helsing)#$$&HelsingStareSmile&$$@Center@$My name is Helsing. Lovely to meet you.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What brings you to a place like this, Helsing?

$#Helsing(Helsing)#$$&HelsingStareSmile&$$@Right@$The same reason as you. I heard footsteps, so I
hid in the nearest empty coffin.

$#Helsing(Helsing)#$$&HelsingStareSmile&$$@Right@$I thought it was more of the castle's henchmen
at first. But instead along came you two, whose
$#Helsing(Helsing)#$$&HelsingStareSmile&$$@Right@$goals seem to be aligned with mine... hehe ♡
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$So you came to investigate this castle as well?

$#Helsing(Helsing)#$$&HelsingStareSmile&$$@Right@$Yes, that's right. And that's how I made it to
this room.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$I see...
$# ( )#$The following day—
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Your mom?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$(Though that was in a dream world...)
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesStare&$$@Right@$Ooh...sounds scandalous...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Left@$What!? It's not scandalous! Besides, you must
have a lot of experience with this sort of thing
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Left@$as well, right?
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Not a chance. Mystery is my one and only love.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$I see...I had figured you'd always have a lot of
people asking you out.
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSweat&$$@Center@$...Excuse me? What's that supposed to mean?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$S-Sorry...

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesShy&$$@Center@$...For your information, you are the first
gentleman I have ever let into my home.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What...?
$#OldWoman(Old Woman)#$$!-1!$Oh my, you too?... What about your father...?
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesShy&$$@Right@$......
$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaExcited&$$@Center@$HOAAAAAHHH!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Left@$Whoa!

$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaExcited&$$@Center@$Such charming, innocent romance! Like the
sweet fragrance of a white lily in bloom!
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSweat&$$@Right@$......
$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaNormal&$$@Center@$...Sorry, did I kill the mood?
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSweat&$$@Right@$Yes.
$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaShock&$$@Center@$$%1%$GAHACK!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$!-1!$$@Center@$A-Are you alright...!? That's quite a lot of
blood...
$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaExcited&$$@Center@$My apologies... I simply got a little too excited...
$#Helen(Girl)#$$&VictoireWorried&$$@Center@$Papa died a long time ago... I'm getting hungry.

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSweat&$$@Center@$Oh, it was not really anything to apologize for,
my lord.

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSweat&$$@Center@$More importantly, thank you so much for the
invitation to this wonderous evening.

$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaHappy&$$@Center@$No, no—thank you! If I may ask, is this your
first time at one of my balls?
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSmile&$$@Center@$It is! I've been so looking forward to it.
$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaHeh&$$@Center@$Splendid—and? Are you enjoying yourself?

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSmile&$$@Center@$Yes! The magnificent food, the dazzling hall...
It's like a dream!

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSigh&$$@Center@$...There's just one thing that's a little
disappointing.
$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaNormal&$$@Center@$Oh? And what might that be?

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesThinking&$$@Center@$This castle is in such a beautiful spot, and yet
the curtains are all drawn shut.

$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaNormal&$$@Center@$Ah... my apologies for that. But it won't be long
before—
$#OldWoman(Old Woman)#$...What's your name, dear?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Oh, the curtains...!

$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaHeh&$$@Center@$Hehe, magnificent, isn't it? The curtains in this
castle open all at once at the chime of the clock.

$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaHeh&$$@Center@$Now you can see the night view in all its glory.
Romantic, is it not?
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesHappySmile&$$@Center@$It's wonderful!
$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaNormal&$$@Center@$So glad it met with your approval...

$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaNormal&$$@Center@$And you over there—your first time too, I
assume? How are you finding my party?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Yes. I'm having a wonderful time. Though it's
so grand I'm feeling a little nervous...

$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaHappy&$$@Center@$Hahaha! How adorable. There's no need to be
so stiff.

$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaNormal&$$@Center@$Although—my, my... What a fine physique you
have...
$#Helen(Helen)#$$&VictoireWorried&$$@Center@$Helen...

$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaCold&$$@Center@$Slender frame, yet with such firm, supple
muscle... Looking quite fine...deliciously so...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$(What is this chill down my spine... It feels like
a giant serpent is staring at me...)
$#Servant(Servant)#$$!-1!$My lord! The Marquess has arrived!
$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaNormal&$$@Center@$...Ah, coming! Give me just a moment!!

$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaNormal&$$@Center@$I do beg your pardon...! A host's duty is to
attend to her guests...

$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaNormal&$$@Center@$Forgive me for excusing myself in the middle
of our conversation!
$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaNormal&$$@Center@$Oh... I do hope we can speak again, you two!

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSweat&$$@Center@$Something seems off about her—or rather, she
seems naturally unhinged.

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Well, it looks as though the Count will be rather
busy for the time being—
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesExcited&$$@Center@$Shall we get to work?

$#OldWoman(Old Woman)#$Nice to meet you, Helen... Why don't you come
along with me and stay at my place for now.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Is there anything I can do to help...?

$#OldWoman(Old Woman)#$$!-1!$It's alright, I'll take care of her and let the city
guards know.
$#OldWoman(Old Woman)#$You ought to go on with your business.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Understood. Thank you...

$# ( )#$With a slip of paper listing Holmes' address in
hand, Finn wandered through the streets.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$So this is Holmes' place.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(I'm worried about that little girl... I hope they
can find her mother soon...)
$#[DoorSwingsOpen]([Door Swings Open])#$WHAM!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Whoa!
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Oh, welcome, Mr. World's Most Generic Hero.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$You scared me... I was just about to knock.

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesWink&$$@Right@$Yes, I predicted your arrival. Given how likely
you were to get lost, I calculated that you
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesWink&$$@Right@$would show up around now.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$That seems like a waste of your powers of
deduction...
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesHappySmile&$$@Right@$Oh, please don't flatter me so! Come on in.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Uh...excuse me, but would Baker Street B221
be somewhere around here?
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSmile&$$@Center@$Sit wherever! I'll get the tea going.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Sure, thanks.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(...Easier said than done—there's nowhere to
sit!)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(Newspaper clippings, case files. And towers of
books covering every inch of the room.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$This oddly shaped thing—is it a puzzle?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$If I move this here... and this like that... there!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Center@$Aaaaaahhh!
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSmile&$$@Center@$Tea's ready! For today, I used some cardamom..
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSweat&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...Oh my, what have you done!?

$#OldWoman(Old Woman)#$Ah, it's just past the end of this road, around
the corner.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$I'm so sorry...

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSad&$$@Right@$Oh no, it's broken... You're surprisingly more
brawn and less brains, aren't you?

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSmile&$$@Right@$Well, never mind. I've already solved it dozens
of times. Shall we get down to business?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$Right, the favor you mentioned!

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSweat&$$@Right@$Whoa, you switched gears real quick there...but
yes, about that favor.

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Are you aware that there's been a string of
disappearances in this city recently?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$What!? Disappearances...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Could this be...what happened to Helen's
mother as well...?)

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesNormal&$$@Center@$At least ten people have gone missing over the
past few months.

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesNormal&$$@Center@$The city guards have started investigating, but
it seems they have nothing to show for it yet.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Thank you very much!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$But you've found a lead?

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesDoya&$$@Center@$Exactly right. I'm glad you're quick on the
uptake!

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesDoya&$$@Center@$The one thing all the missing persons have in
common—they all had attended a certain "ball".
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$A ball?

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesDoyaSleep&$$@Center@$Yes—a ball held at the castle on the hill, by a
certain Count Dracula.

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesDoyaSleep&$$@Center@$Count Dracula came here six months ago, and
apparently she is a noble of high standing.

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesDoyaSleep&$$@Center@$She has been organizing balls regularly since
her arrival.

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesDoya&$$@Center@$And I have a very strong feeling this ball is
where our answer lies!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I see... but can this ball be attended by just
anyone?
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesNormal&$$@Right@$Unfortunately... you need an invitation.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(Finally, I'm almost there... This city has so
many little streets, it's impossible to navigate...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$Ah, so then...
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesWink&$$@Right@$*smirk*
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$That's... the paper airplane from yesterday?

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesExcited&$$@Right@$It turns out the paper used for this love letter
is an invitation to the ball!

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSad&$$@Right@$So I thought I could slip in using it in his place...
...but it turns out it's a ticket for two.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ah... I understand now. So that's the favor you
need from me!
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSmile&$$@Center@$What do you say? Will you be my "partner"?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Captain Ludmilla has forbidden me from doing
anything dangerous outside of missions...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(But this might be the way to save that girl's
mother.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Of course! Count me in.
$#Helen(Girl)#$$&VictoireWorried&$$@Center@$Hey, mister and ma'am...

$#Gatekeeper(Gatekeeper)#$I have confirmed your invitation. Welcome to
our castle, esteemed guests.

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSmile&$$@Right@$Thank you soooooo much! We're sooooo excited
to be here!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$What a castle! For one that's hidden so deep
in a forest, it sure is fancy...
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSurprised&$$@Right@$Seems like everyone else arrived by carriage.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$That was a long walk, I'm exhausted... You've
got some impressive stamina!

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesHappy&$$@Right@$Well, a good detective needs good legs to get
around and investigate!
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesHappy&$$@Right@$Oh, that must be the ballroom over there...

$# ( )#$In the ballroom, guests in glittering finery were
taking each other by the hand and enjoying
$# ( )#$some dancing.
$# ( )#$But it was soon interrupted by echoing footsteps, followed by the appearance of her.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Hmm? Is something the matter?

$#Dracula(???)#$$&DraculaHappy&$$@Center@$Welcome, everyone! Thank you so much for
coming!
$#NobleA(Noble A)#$Oh... so that must be...!

$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaHappy&$$@Center@$Indeed, I am the one who invited you all here
this evening... Dracula is my name!
$#NobleB(Noble B)#$What breathtaking beauty... such noble grace...!

$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaExcited&$$@Center@$I can only describe our fortuitous meeting here
tonight as "destiny"...Nay, as a "miracle"!

$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaExcited&$$@Center@$...To be surrounded by such beautiful and
charming guests...
$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaExcited&$$@Center@$I am the most fortunate soul alive...!
$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaExcited&$$@Center@$Oh... oh...!
$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaShock&$$@Center@$$%1%$GAAACK!!
$#Servant(Servant)#$My lord...!? Are you alright?

$#Helen(Girl)#$$&VictoireWorried&$$@Center@$Have either of you seen my mom? She said she
was going to a ball and never came back home...

$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaBigSurprised&$$@Center@$Forgive me... I was overcome with joy and
coughed up a bit of blood...

$#Dracula(Count Dracula)#$$&DraculaExcited&$$@Center@$Anyhow, dear guests! Please enjoy yourselves,
as if your very souls have been set alight!
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$So that's Count Dracula...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$(She's...very over-the-top...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Do you really think she's connected to the
disappearances?

$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesExcited&$$@Right@$Yes, a detective's instinct is never wrong! Let's
get right into investigating after this...
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesNormal&$$@Right@$But that aside...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Hm?
$#Holmes(Holmes)#$$&HolmesSurprised&$$@Right@$You seem quite comfortable with dancing...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Oh, yeah... I've danced at a party like this once
before.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Six months ago, a lone noble took up residence in the old castle on the hill. Calling herself a count, she was lighting up the castle each night to host lavish evening balls. All who gathered there would find themselves intoxicated by her elegance and beauty.

But—No one knows how many of the invited guests would live to see the dawn.

DraculaRegular01.name: Dracula
DraculaRegular01.title: The King of Vampires
DraculaRegular01.description:
Six months ago, a lone noble took up residence in the old castle on the hill. Calling herself a count, she was lighting up the castle each night to host lavish evening balls. All who gathered there would find themselves intoxicated by her elegance and beauty.

But—No one knows how many of the invited guests would live to see the dawn.

keys.IntroText: It is I, the Unrivaled King of the Nightfolk!

keys.DescriptionKey:
These evening parties are not gatherings for social exchange, but hunting grounds where humans are sorted and selected.
Most are gradually drained of blood to provide sustenance for her and her kin. A chosen few are given some of Dracula's own blood and transformed into her servants.

Despite being an immortal ruler of the night, she fears her weakness to sunlight. And so she has been moving from one lair to the next before her secrets could get exposed.

DraculaRegular02.name: Dracula
DraculaRegular02.title: The King of Vampires
DraculaRegular02.description:
These evening parties are not gatherings for social exchange, but hunting grounds where humans are sorted and selected.
Most are gradually drained of blood to provide sustenance for her and her kin. A chosen few are given some of Dracula's own blood and transformed into her servants.

Despite being an immortal ruler of the night, she fears her weakness to sunlight. And so she has been moving from one lair to the next before her secrets could get exposed.

keys.DescriptionKey:
She has been captive to the memory of one woman for many years, even now.
The woman she had once believed loved her in return. The only woman in the world she had ever loved from the depths of her heart.

But that woman betrayed her, and sought to take Dracula's life.

Even now, there is an old wound in her chest, left there by a stake driven through her heart. It has been years since that fateful day, and the wound is no longer visible from the outside.
And yet, deep within, it still lingers there unhealed.

How bold of you to enter my domain.

keys.DescriptionKey: Weary and covered in scars left by battles with her archenemy and countless adversities, the Dragon Lord of Light looked for a place to make her final lair. At last, she reached the mountains, and lived there in peace and solitude for years—until the day the silence of her home was broken by the sound of footsteps.

DragonGirlRegular02.name: Shen Long
DragonGirlRegular02.title: Divine Dragon Lord
DragonGirlRegular02.description: Weary and covered in scars left by battles with her archenemy and countless adversities, the Dragon Lord of Light looked for a place to make her final lair. At last, she reached the mountains, and lived there in peace and solitude for years—until the day the silence of her home was broken by the sound of footsteps.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The intruder introduced herself as Rias. She was a fearless and irreverent girl, and she loved her village more than anything. A certain young man she promised to spend her life with lived there too.
The moment she asked to become the Dragon Lord's next vessel, the young man's face flashed across her mind.
"You've always been popular with the girls," she thought to herself, "I'm sure you'll be fine without me."
Still, a faint memory of him and a hint of longing remained in the depths of the Dragon Lord's soul for years.
