keys.value:
$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Pilgrim)#$$|act3.Voices/sst275|$I am sorry, Ra'Kiri... I'm not strong
enough to stop you...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act3.Voices/sst276|$...You should come with us.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$|act3.Voices/sst277|$Finn...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$|act3.Voices/sst278|$Everyone has to start somewhere. You'll
get stronger on the way!

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Pilgrim)#$$|act3.Voices/sst279|$...Thank you. I cannot allow my sister to
hurt anyone else!
$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Pilgrim)#$$|act3.Voices/sst268|$Wait...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$|act3.Voices/sst269|$?
$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Pilgrm)#$$|act3.Voices/sst270|$Are you going into the ruins?

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$|act3.Voices/sst271|$Yes. Our friends were taken. We are going
to take them back, and end this for good.
$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Pilgrim)#$$|act3.Voices/sst272|$Take me with you.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act3.Voices/sst273|$I am sorry, traveler, but we do not have
time to—

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Pilgrim)#$$|act3.Voices/sst274|$Please, my sister is one of the xahe'oyai!
Let me prove my strength to you!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt;GaLuga.GaLugaAngry;&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;GaLuga.Right;@$$|act3.Voices/mst1792|$Huff... Huff... Did... Did we get them all!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1801|$That's... That's my dad's name! How do
you know that name!?

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&Druke&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1802|$yEs...tHE herO...whO deFeaTEd...tHE
Eternal...
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&Druke&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1803|$My...friend...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror;Ludmilla.LudmillaSurprise;&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Ludmilla.Right;@$$|act3.Voices/mst1804|$What...?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1805|$Your father...
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1806|$...Defeated the Eternal!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1807|$What do you mean, Druke!? Did my father
have a crest too!?
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&Druke&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1808|$GRhahH...fInD...FInD...CaLLeN...!

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&Druke&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1809|$She MIghT...knOw hOw...tO enD tHe
Pandemonium...fOr gOoD!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise;Nagi.NagiAngry;&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Nagi.Right;@$$|act3.Voices/mst1810|$End the Pandemonium...permanently!?
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1793|$Almost. Druke is still alive.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1811|$Is that even possible!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1812|$Callen?? I've heard that name before...
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&Druke&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1813|$elVEn reSeArCHer... mY...frIEnD!!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&Druke&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1814|$Oooooargh... OOAaaRRghh!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1815|$Druke!?

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&Druke&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1816|$R-rEsiST, soN of RoDY...fIGhT...YoUNg
wArriOr of Me'RiZAnté...!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&Druke&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1817|$Do not...bECOme liKe...ME!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1818|$Druke please, tell me more! About my
father, and Callen!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$What happened during the previous
Pandemonium!?
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&Druke&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1819|$hUUrgH... S-sO yoU've...cOme...!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1794|$What is he made of...?
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1820|$...!
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1821|$Looks like I made it in time...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1822|$Gilgan!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1823|$What are you doing here?

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1824|$A little nestling told me that this is the time
for me to swing my blade!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1825|$Gilgan...!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&Druke&$$@Center@$$%1%$$|act3.Voices/mst1826|$gRoargh...RoOOOargGGH!!
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1827|$Brother... Be at peace!

$#DONTSHOWME(Finn)#$$|act3.Voices/mst1828|$






Just like that, our mission came to an end.

$#DONTSHOWME(Finn)#$$|act3.Voices/mst1829|$

Astrid and Mysha were exhausted, but their wounds were light.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1795|$Druke... He's looking at Finn.

$#DONTSHOWME(Finn)#$$|Cont|$

They were up and about again in just a few days.

$#DONTSHOWME(Finn)#$$|act3.Voices/mst1830|$




We searched the area for signs of Norza, but there was nothing.

$#DONTSHOWME(Finn)#$$|act3.Voices/mst1831|$

Ga'Luga returned to Me'Rizanté and told everyone that the xahe'oyai incident
was all the doing of an Aeon Lord.

$#DONTSHOWME(Finn)#$$|Cont|$

That didn't completely free Druke of blame...

$#DONTSHOWME(Finn)#$$|act3.Voices/mst1832|$

But the relationship between Me'Rizanté and Urg Roa has begun to mend.

$#DONTSHOWME(Finn)#$$|act3.Voices/mst1833|$








Chief A'Dwa apologized for hiding the truth from us.

$#DONTSHOWME(Finn)#$$|act3.Voices/mst1834|$

Not that any of us blamed him for it.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1835|$So Ga'Luga will join the Pandemonium
Task Force as a mercenary.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSleep&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1836|$I played right into my father's hands...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1837|$Lending us Ga'Luga as an apology... Was
he really thinking this far ahead?
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&Druke&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1796|$oOh...so yoU...are his sOn...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSleep&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1838|$What a roundabout method... Well, it ended
up being a timely offer.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1839|$Oh, does this mean...?

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1840|$This incident isn't over. To avenge my
fallen brethren, I must defeat Norza.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1841|$Accompanying you is the quickest way for
us to get to him.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1842|$We'd already made up our minds, but Chief
A'Dwa and Gramps were quicker!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1843|$Indeed. It gives me heart that you wish to
officially join our order, Mysha.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSmileBlush&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1844|$I'm sure you'll pass the Proving with no
trouble.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1845|$I'll do my very best. I need to make up for
all the people Uncle Druke hurt.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise;Finn.FinnSmile;&$$!-1!$$@Right;;;Finn.Left;@$$|act3.Voices/mst1846|$Astrid is smiling!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1847|$Those two seem really close now.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry;Finn.FinnSurprise;&$$!-1!$$@Right;;;Finn.Left;@$$|act3.Voices/mst1797|$He's talking!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1848|$Apparently something happened before
Norza captured them.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1849|$So Mysha and Ga'Luga will accompany us
back to Rigland.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHeh&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1850|$We have to get back and do some research!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1851|$Callen... I thought I'd heard the name.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$She's supposed to be the most powerful
mage in Westland, right?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1852|$There are many rumors about her. That
she's an elderly elf, or one of the fae...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHeh&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1853|$But she knows a way to end the
Pandemonium!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1854|$I want to believe what Druke said. Those
were his parting words...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1855|$(My dad...Druke...Callen...and the
Eternal.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1856|$(What happened during the last
Pandemonium, 18 years ago?)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1798|$Son...? What do you mean?
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1857|$I shall believe him also.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1858|$If that is what you choose to do, my
Brother.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1859|$Brother?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1860|$That's what sziviik call people they've
acknowledged.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1861|$Not many people get that from Ga'Luga.
He doesn't have many friends.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1862|$Hey!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1863|$That makes me blush a little... But I'm
glad you feel that way.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1864|$I look forward to the road ahead, Brother!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1865|$As do I, Brother!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy;Rizette.RizetteCalm;&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Rizette.Right;@$$|act3.Voices/mst1866|$They're so cool!!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&Druke&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1799|$YoU loOk...jUst liKe...Ro...DY...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteCalm&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1867|$I think you mean dorky, Theo...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1868|$I want to be a part of that...
$#Rizette;Mysha;(Rizette and Mysha)#$$&RizetteSurprise;Mysha.MyshaSurprise;&$$!-1!$$@Right;;;Mysha.Left;@$$|act3.Voices/mst1869|$What?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1870|$N-Nothing!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1871|$Knights, move out! To Rigland!
$#Finn;Rizette;Theo;(All)#$$&FinnHeh;Rizette.RizetteHeh;Theo.TheoHeh&$$@Center;;;Rizette.Right;Theo.Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1872|$Yes ma'am!
$#ADwa(Chief A'Dwa)#$$&ADwa&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1873|$There they go...

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1874|$Ga'Luga has become an outstanding
warrior.

$#ADwa(Chief A'Dwa)#$$&ADwa&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1875|$Mysha keeps outdoing herself. You won't be
able to keep her a secret much longer.

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1876|$The Red Dragon Knights have some fine
young folk in their mix.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise;Finn.FinnSurprise;&$$!-1!$$@Right;;;Finn.Left;@$$|act3.Voices/mst1800|$Rody?

$#ADwa(Chief A'Dwa)#$$&ADwa&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1877|$Keh keh... Reminds me of our adventuring
heydays.

$#ADwa(Chief A'Dwa)#$$&ADwa&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1878|$But we need those young folk to aim further.
To a future beyond the Pandemonium.

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1879|$Perhaps five years ago I could have fought
alongside them.

$#ADwa(Chief A'Dwa)#$$&ADwa&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1880|$The words of old codgers have more value
than their blades, Gilgan.

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act3.Voices/mst1881|$
Gather...

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act3.Voices/mst1882|$

Gather, my warriors...

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act3.Voices/mst1883|$

Red, and blue...

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act3.Voices/mst1884|$

Follow the light...

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act3.Voices/mst1885|$

Gather.
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&Druke&$$@Center@$GROOOOAAARGH...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious;GaLuga.GaLugaAngry;&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;GaLuga.Right;@$$|act3.Voices/mst1787|$There!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1788|$This... This is what has become of the
legendary Druke!?
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&Druke&$$!-1!$$@Center@$GROOOOAAARGH!!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1790|$Druke! My brothers, my sisters! Let me free
you from this corruption...
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1791|$And send you to peace beyond the veil!!

keys.DescriptionKey: No one knew where she came from or where she would go next; no one really knew her at all. People tried to stop her from leaving at times, but she'd still disappear, leaving behind only a fleeting smile. The desire to keep her grew into obsession, bred conflict, stained the earth with blood. And so she stopped showing up altogether.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Vesh watches her from the shadows as she sits by a small spring in her sacred forest, her eyes vacant, staring off into space. She seems to notice him after a while, turns her head ever so slightly.
"I apologize for the intrusion," he says, but she only shakes her head with a smile.
"How unusual of you to visit this realm," he picks up after a moment, and her eyes look distant again, as if she remembered something, "My lady Gaia, Primordial of Earth."

keys.DescriptionKey:
Long, long ago, a destitute kingdom fell under siege. Fearing his people's poverty would mean their downfall, the king commissioned a group of alchemists to craft him an endless source of gold.

After some months, the alchemists presented him with a tiny beast. In front of him, they fed it scrap metal, spoiled food, all manner of the kingdom's waste -- and he watched as horns of solid gold grew on its body.

The king wept for joy, for with this monster, he'd saved his kingdom.

Or so he thought.

EarthKaiju01.name: Voraxion
EarthKaiju01.title: Adamantine Maw
EarthKaiju01.description:
Long, long ago, a destitute kingdom fell under siege. Fearing his people's poverty would mean their downfall, the king commissioned a group of alchemists to craft him an endless source of gold.

After some months, the alchemists presented him with a tiny beast. In front of him, they fed it scrap metal, spoiled food, all manner of the kingdom's waste -- and he watched as horns of solid gold grew on its body.

The king wept for joy, for with this monster, he'd saved his kingdom.

Or so he thought.

keys.IntroText:
"Deep beneath the ground, a monster
gnaws at the heart of the world, insatiable."

keys.DescriptionKey:
Months passed. The relentless war continued, and even with the gold from the beast's severed horns, the kingdom could not push the enemy back. Desperate, the king begged the alchemists to push the creature further. To feed it more and more. To curse it with hunger so great, it could never stop eating.

The alchemists warned the king that such a curse could have consequences more dire than any war, but he wouldn't listen. They'd given this monster life themselves. Surely, if it ever turned on them, they could force it back into servitude.

EarthKaiju02.name: Voraxion
EarthKaiju02.title: Adamantine Maw
EarthKaiju02.description:
Months passed. The relentless war continued, and even with the gold from the beast's severed horns, the kingdom could not push the enemy back. Desperate, the king begged the alchemists to push the creature further. To feed it more and more. To curse it with hunger so great, it could never stop eating.

The alchemists warned the king that such a curse could have consequences more dire than any war, but he wouldn't listen. They'd given this monster life themselves. Surely, if it ever turned on them, they could force it back into servitude.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The alchemists obediently gave the creature a hunger no living thing has ever known. With every anguished day, its body shifted and grew, until it had to be chained down with its own gold, the one thing it could not consume.

In the end, the king's gambit paid off. The beast's torture earned him enough gold to win his war. When the enemy messenger arrived with terms of surrender, however, he found a sinkhole in place of a palace.

The monster could not consume its chains, it was true. But it had grown blades on its arms to break them.

$#()#$Deep within rugged mountains bereft of
life, a cave opens in a jagged cliff face...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$Have the foul beasts of below come to
greet me so soon?!
$#Bandit(Bandit)#$$&BanditSerious&$$@Center@$Urgh... It's so bright.

$#Bandit(Bandit)#$$&BanditSerious&$$@Center@$I made it? Hah, I made it! I thought for
sure I was a goner!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$!0!$$@Left@$Alas, my demons were but shadows and
this scruffy young squire.

$#Bandit(Bandit)#$$&BanditSerious&$$@Right@$A bikki? I never thought I'd be so glad to
see a frog.

$#Bandit(Bandit)#$$&BanditSerious&$$@Right@$Wait... You're not thinkin' of
headin' into this cave alone, are you?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Left@$I am! And there shall be no mercy for any
man or beast who seeks to stop me!

$#Bandit(Bandit)#$$&BanditSerious&$$@Right@$I wasn't gonna stop you. But I will warn
you. Quit while you're ahead.

$#Bandit(Bandit)#$$&BanditSerious&$$@Right@$The whole place is crawlin' with monsters.
And if that's not enough—

$#Bandit(Bandit)#$$&BanditSerious&$$@Right@$Two dragons with real nasty tempers have
made their nest in the depths.

$#()#$Avoided by all, this labyrinth of death and
despair is known as "Cloudbreaker Cavern."
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$Ho-ho! Ill-tempered dragons, you say?

$#Bandit(Bandit)#$$&BanditSerious&$$@Right@$We thought we could sneak in for some
treasure but we barely made it out alive.

$#Bandit(Bandit)#$$&BanditSerious&$$@Right@$Speakin' of, have you seen my partner?
She got out before me, but she was hurt.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$A maiden in distress? Why did you not
say so sooner?!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$We have not a moment to spare. We must
find her!

$#Bandit(Bandit)#$$&BanditSerious&$$@Right@$Sounds like you haven't seen her. She
probably headed back to town.
$#Bandit(Bandit)#$$&BanditSerious&$$@Right@$I guess I'll head back too.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$How my heart aches knowing a maiden
goes without my aid...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$At the very least, I must express the depths
of my concern with these medicinal herbs!

$#Bandit(Bandit)#$$&BanditSerious&$$@Right@$Oh? You're handing 'em out for free? If
so, I'll take 'em off ya hands.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$I see now why the wind whispers of this
"Adventurer's Doom."

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$They are not for you, young squire. They
are intended for the maiden you spoke of!

$#Bandit(Bandit)#$$&BanditSerious&$$@Right@$Yeah, yeah. I get it. You got a thing for
the ladies. I'll pass the herbs on.

$#Bandit(Bandit)#$$&BanditSerious&$$@Right@$Thanks! I warned ya about the caves, so
don't do anythin' stupid!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$I now find myself without any herbs
of my own...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$And if that young squire is to be believed,
a frenzied dragon—nay two dragons—await...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$However! I am Nagi, the wandering
swordmaster! I do not run from danger!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Left@$What is a dragon compared to the
lightning speed of my blade? Onward!!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$Standing at its entrance I feel the dread
that robbed others of their courage.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$As if this dark, gaping maw leads to the
eternal despair of the underworld...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Center@$However! I shall walk that path to the
deepest depth.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Center@$For it is here that I will at long last claim
the legendary Cloudbreaker Maul...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Center@$...and offer it to the princess of my heart,
Miri, so that she may know my devotion!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Center@$At long last, I have found the famed
Cloudbreaker Maul!

$#Miri(Miri)#$$&MiriAngry&$$@Right@$What in Erden is this hideous clump of
metal?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$"Hideous"?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$My lady, this weapon is one of legend! It
has been sung about in the tales of—
$#Miri(Miri)#$$&MiriAngry&$$@Right@$I don't care about legends!

$#Miri(Miri)#$$&MiriAngry&$$@Right@$What I want is a weapon of unsurpassed
grace, beauty, and power. Like myself.
$#Miri(Miri)#$$&MiriAngry&$$@Right@$A scepter. Or perhaps a fencer's blade.

$#Miri(Miri)#$$&MiriAngry&$$@Right@$And yet you come to me with this stupid,
unwieldly block?

$#Miri(Miri)#$$&MiriAngry&$$@Right@$Perhaps you mean to say that I am as dull
as this hammer?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$L-Lady, I merely meant to say that the might
of this hammer is befitting one as powerf—

$#Miri(Miri)#$$&MiriAngry&$$@Right@$Be silent! I have grown weary of your
excuses.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Center@$The countless trials I have overcome shall
be sung by minstrels of the courts.

$#Miri(Miri)#$$&MiriAngry&$$@Right@$If it is so powerful, and so legendary, then
you have it!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$You would like me to have it?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Left@$Hmm... Ah-hah!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Left@$Your message is received, my lady. You
have given me this hammer...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$...as a means of protecting you for the rest
of your days!

$#Miri(Miri)#$$&MiriAngry&$$@Right@$What are you talking about? I said nothing
of the sort.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Left@$Lady! Say no more on the matter.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$I hereby swear to protect your loveliness,
as I would a desert flower, for all time!

$#Miri(Miri)#$$&MiriAngry&$$@Right@$(sigh) I don't care anymore. Do as you
please.

$#()#$$!0!$Thus the legendary Cloudbreaker Maul
was returned to the surface world.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Center@$It is as the rumors said. The shine is like
that of the morning dew on a rose!

$#()#$However, the deeds this weapon would go
on to accomplish, are another story...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Center@$Truly, this weapon is fit for the hands of
a princess!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Center@$Wait for me, dear Princess Miri!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Center@$I shall come to you with not only my heart,
but also a weapon of legend!
$#Miri(Miri)#$$&MiriAngry&$$@Right@$I don't want it.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$A thousand pardons, my lady, but...
$#Miri(Miri)#$$&MiriAngry&$$@Right@$I said, "I don't want it."
$#Soraya(Kaidaros)#$$&Soraya&$$@Center@$Who dares to disturb my slumber?

$#Soraya(Kaidaros)#$$&Soraya&$$@Center@$Your words are a mystery to me. You may
be the most crazed of those who have come.

$#Soraya(Kaidaros)#$$&Soraya&$$@Center@$But it matters not. If you are so desperate
to throw your life away, I shall indulge you.

$#Soraya(Kaidaros)#$$&Soraya&$$@Center@$However, I will warn you. Rahanaar, who
slumbers beyond, is more terrible in wroth.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$There is no glory without pain! You shall
not even see the blade that strikes you!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Center@$I did not expect you to speak the common
tongue so well, wyrm!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Center@$I am Nagi! A traveling swordmaster who
swears allegiance to the princesses of Erden!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Center@$I have come to reclaim a weapon of great
renown from these caverns of dread.
$#Soraya(Kaidaros)#$$&Soraya&$$@Center@$Hmph. Another adventurer mad with greed.

$#Soraya(Kaidaros)#$$&Soraya&$$@Center@$Why do you seek to throw your fleeting life
away for a mere trinket?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$You understand nothing of my purpose,
ignorant wyrm!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$My life is not my own! It belongs to each
and every princess of Erden!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$If it is for them, there would be no waste
in my demise!

keys.DescriptionKey: Ludorié is one of the two chiefs of Dandelio a forest region inhabited by elves and kud. He considers his fellow chief Sherry as his dearest friend. Earnest and reliable, Ludorié feels a great deal of responsibility to his people, but is distrusting of outsiders. Those who gain his trust, however, gain a fiercely loyal ally.

keys.DescriptionKey: Enwyld is an elvish tribal god of storms. It's one of the oldest known elvish deities. As Enwyld's chosen, Brynn is a judge over life and death, and she receives great healing power for her service.

keys.DescriptionKey: Brynn's village had a seaweed drought, and faced existential famine. While nobody wanted to take responsibility, Brynn undertook a decade-long quest, walking around the world to prove her people's devotion to Enwyld. Thanks to Brynn's magnificent, legendary devotion to Enwyld, people worldwide call edible seaweed "yn." Some believe she halted the downward population spiral of the elvish people.

keys.DescriptionKey: Velle comes from an ancient tradition of bards which teaches that stories are how cultures survive even after their people are long dead. So, she collects songs and tales from dead cities and societies. To keep stories alive, Velle travels as far as she can, and tells as many people as she can.

ElfMusician01.name: Velle
ElfMusician01.title: Elven Bard
ElfMusician01.description: Velle comes from an ancient tradition of bards which teaches that stories are how cultures survive even after their people are long dead. So, she collects songs and tales from dead cities and societies. To keep stories alive, Velle travels as far as she can, and tells as many people as she can.

keys.DescriptionKey:
As Velle grows older, she wonders what will become of her own life after she passes away. Who will remember her? Who will speak of her own story?

Velle's bardic tradition forbids one from telling any tale of their own life. But nevertheless, she hopes that someday someone will craft a story about her and preserve her memory for the future, just as she is doing for tales of the past.

keys.DescriptionKey: Willa is an elven scholar of the prestigious Austropolis Academy, a famous school of magic. Her colleagues consider her a maverick, as while they spend most of their time in the school archives combing through ancient texts, Willa actively goes out and tries to improve her magic through practical application. Initially her peers scoffed at her little adventures, they believed that the only way to improve as wizard is through studying the great masters of the past. However, as they witnessed Willa's increasing mastery, they were forced to reconsider their opinions.

keys.DescriptionKey: Willa certainly respects the accomplishments of the great wizards who have come before. However, she has very little patience for those who say they cannot be surpassed. She believes that a true scholar of magic should always strive to expand the potential of magic, rather than just imitating past successes. Besides, what's the point of learning magic if you don't go out and actually use it?

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Usually, she'd snap and tell me not to
treat her like a child.)

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkNormal&$(Could it be... She's distracted because of
our upcoming departure?)

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkYandereSmile&$Is saying goodbye to us really that hard
for you, Your Majesty?
$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethEmbarrassed&$N-No, of course not!

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Why are you wearing such a gloomy
expression?
$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethSweat&$$@Right@$It's just... I have a lot to think about...

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$Why not just be honest for once? You even
left dinner early yesterday.
$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethSighSweat&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethEmbarrassed&$$@Center@$Fine, I'll admit it. I feel like I need you to
achieve the perfection I'm striving for!
$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethSuperCute&$$@Center@$Please, Clarice. Stay here as my maid.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkNormal&$$@Center@$Quite lively outside today, isn't it, Your
Majesty?

$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethSuperCute&$$@Center@$Won't you remain at my side, steadfast
and true? For all eternity...?
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkSad&$$@Center@$Elizabeth...
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkLookawaySad&$$@Center@$I'm sorry.
$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethSad&$$@Center@$Why!?

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkLookawaySad&$$@Center@$I've already dedicated my everything to
my mistress.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkClosedEyesSerious&$$@Center@$I would sooner see the world turn upside
down than pledge loyalty to anyone else.

$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethSad&$$@Center@$Even though a queen humbles herself
before you like this?
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkClosedEyesSerious&$$@Center@$Yes, I'm sorry. Please, let's leave this topic.

$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethShouting&$$@Center@$Ugh... You're... You're a fool! A big, stupid
fool! I don't want to see you ever again!
$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethShouting&$$@Center@$Get out, now!

$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethNormal&$$@Center@$Yes. Today is an important day for our
nation. Everyone is celebrating.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkLookawaySad&$$@Center@$(Such a tantrum from someone usually so
composed...)
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So, she finally kicked you out.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkConfuse&$$@Right@$Miss Ludmilla!
Were you eavesdropping?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ah, no, not intentionally. I just happened
to be passing by!
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkConfuse&$$@Center@$Happened to be passing by...?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaShouting&$$@Center@$Well, yes. What reason could I have to
eavesdrop on you and the Queen?
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkExtacy&$$@Center@$Kuhuhu...♪

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkExtacy&$$@Center@$(Oh, Miss Ludmilla... You almost never
get jealous. Did we really seem that close?)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I didn't catch the details. What did the
Queen say?
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkSad&$$@Right@$She just said she didn't want me to leave.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkSmile&$$@Center@$An important day, hmm. Your hair is
done now, ma'am.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkLookawaySad&$$@Right@$Tell me, Miss, hypothetically, is there any
chance of extending the Knights' contract
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkLookawaySad&$$@Right@$with this kingdom?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Left@$Hmmm... Difficult to say...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It might be possible if there was an
emergency, but otherwise I don't think so.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Center@$Staying here too long could appear as
though we're trying to influence
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Center@$the political situation in the region.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkSad&$$@Center@$Right... It would disrupt the balance of
power and complicate things even further...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Center@$Considering the situation, withdrawing is
what will benefit this country most.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkLookawaySad&$$@Center@$Diplomacy truly is a difficult affair...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Well, we should probably leave the intricacies
of international politics to the Commander.

$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethSadSmile&$$@Center@$You know, it's almost annoying how good

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkNormal&$$@Right@$By the way, the Queen said today is
a significant day for this kingdom.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkNormal&$$@Right@$It's gotten really lively outside.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$Yes, I heard it's the birthday of the previous
queen.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$It's a national holiday, and most businesses
are closed.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkExtacy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ah, so you have the day off too, Miss? Then
surely we could—

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSadSmile&$$@Center@$Sorry, I won't have time for going out. I
have plans.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkYandereCrazy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Plans? With whom, may I ask?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Left@$I'm meeting with Lord Blackwood. We
have the final training session to discuss.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkYandereCrazy&$$@Right@$Blackwood...

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkYandereCrazy&$$@Right@$(Insufferable man... How dare he steal my
chance to spend time with Miss Ludmilla...)
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Why, thank you.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkYandereCrazy&$$@Right@$(I should've crushed him under my boot
when I had the chance!)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That said, it's a holiday. I'd like to see the
festivities too.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$How about I cut the meeting short and we
go sightseeing afterwards?
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkExtacy&$$@Center@$I-It'll be my pleasure!

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkUpset&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Just to be sure... Finn won't be joining us,
will he?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$Finn? Oh, he already went out with the
soldiers.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$Apparently, they wanted to express their
gratitude to him.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceDarkExtacy&$$@Right@$I see, I see. He's been dragged away, has
he... Kuhuhu...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$Would you like him to join us? I could

$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You're always welcome to return. I'll be
waiting for you as a friend.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceHappyNoSword&$$@Center@$Until we meet again, ma'am.
$#GreyfordCommander(Greyford Commander)#$$!-1!$And so they left, Your Majesty.
$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethSigh&$$@Center@$Yes... They did...

$#GreyfordSoldierA(Greyford Soldier A)#$Please, don't let it dishearten you! We're
all here for you!
$#GreyfordSoldierB(Greyford Soldier B)#$Yes, Your Majesty! You can count on us!
$#ElizabethPillar(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethHappy&$$@Left@$(Ah... Everyoneee...)

$#RoyalSteward(Royal Steward)#$We'll leave the two of you alone.
Is that all right, Doctor?

$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethHeh&$$@Center@$We have a lot of work to do. Follow me, and
I don't want to hear a single complaint!
$#GreyfordSoldiers(Greyford Soldiers)#$Yes, Your Majesty!

$#ElizabethPillar(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethSighSmile&$$@Center@$(Until we meet again, Red Dragon
Knights...)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaClosedEyesBlush&$$@Left@$That hypnosis magic really put us in a
tight spot, didn't it?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Should we invite Callen to give a lecture
on precautions when we get back?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBlush&$$@Left@$Yes, that sounds good. By the way, Finn...
I hope you're not angry with me?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Angry...? Why would I?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Because I attacked you in earnest.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBlush&$$@Center@$It's inexcusable for an officer to do that
to their subordinate.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$No, no, I think of it as a learning
experience!

$#HeadPhysician(Head Physician)#$Yes, I believe it's for the best. We've done
all we can.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHappy&$$@Center@$I-Is that so! Then how about a one-on-one
training session when time allows?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Center@$It'll be my pleasure!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Center@$(Ack! What is this sudden aura of bloodlust!?)

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCrazyNoSword&$$@Right@$Kuhuhuhu... One-on-one session? That
sounds delightful.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Center@$Uh, ah... I was just about to invite you too,
Clarice! Is that all right, Marshal?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, you want to join us, Clarice? Great!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHappy&$$@Center@$Hmmm, what kind of regimen should we
go with first...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHappy&$$@Center@$A cross-country marathon...
No, cross-continent...

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCrazyNoSword&$$@Center@$My dear Master, you've been getting out
of line recently.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Huh, what do you mean?
$#RoyalSteward(Royal Steward)#$If you'll excuse us, Your Highness.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCrazyNoSword&$$@Center@$You're not seriously chasing after my
mistress, are you?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$Chasing... Oh, you think I'm after her
position?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$Hah, no way, not a chance!
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSighSweatNoSword&$$@Center@$...

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCrazyNoSword&$$@Center@$Either way, this is the perfect opportunity
for you to learn humility. En garde!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Huh!? No!
And don't look at me like that! It's scary!

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCrazyNoSword&$$@Right@$Kuhuhu... Do you really think you can
escape me?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHappy&$$@Center@$Oh, good, you two have already started
running! I can't afford to fall behind!

$#()#$$!-1!$—And thus, our heroes' adventure in the
Kingdom of Greyford came to an end.

$#()#$New bonds were forged, paving the way
for the unknown future.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$So, this is the Kingdom of Greyford.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Yes. That's why Greyford has also been
referred to as the "Wonder Kingdom."

$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethSerious&$$@Center@$(As I am now, I simply cannot compare to
Mother... I must work harder!)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$And the architect of the nation's success
was dubbed a miracle worker.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$She must have been an incredible person.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceConcideringNoSword&$$@Left@$Well, she is no longer here.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$Yes, and the instability caused by her absence
must have led to deep public unease.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Huh... There's some graffitti at the base
of the statue.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$"One and only queen"...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Center@$No country can escape the ghosts of their
past rulers, can it?

$#GreyfordSoldier(Greyford Soldier)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Center@$Oh, that red armor... Might you be the
delegate from Rigland?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$Indeed I am. Marshal Ludmilla Aldyne of
the Red Dragon Knights,

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Hard to believe there was a political upheaval
here recently. It sure looks prosperous.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$responding to your nation's request for aid.

$#GreyfordSoldier(Greyford Soldier)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Center@$It is my honor, Marshal. I have been
instructed by the Counsellor to escort you.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$Thank you. I appreciate that.

$#GreyfordSoldier(Greyford Soldier)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Center@$Her Majesty the Queen awaits you. This
way, please.

$#()#$—And so it was that Finn, Ludmilla, and
Clarice were guided into an opulent castle.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSeriousNoSword&$$@Left@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Something bothering you, Clarice?

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSeriousNoSword&$$@Left@$No, not exactly... I just noticed that this
kingdom is not particularly well maintained.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Really? The roads leading here were nicely
paved, and everything looks clean to me.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceShyNoSword&$$@Left@$As unobservant as ever.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$That goes to shows how solid the foundations
of the country are. It's a major trade hub.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$Hmph... Let me take a closer look...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSigh&$$@Center@$You two, behave. You can't just criticize our
hosts' castle like a pair of mean in-laws.
$#GreyfordSoldier(Greyford Soldier)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No, no, they're absolutely right.

$#GreyfordSoldier(Greyford Soldier)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Center@$Many servants have resigned since the
recent political change.

$#GreyfordSoldier(Greyford Soldier)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Center@$We're severely short-handed, even for
basic tasks like cleaning the castle.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(So the manpower shortage is real, and
not only in the military...)
$#DistantVoice(Distant Voice)#$$!-1!$Please wait! This is a breach of contract!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$Things sound heated over there.

$#ArrogantMan(Arrogant Man)#$$&BlackwoodSerious&$$@Center@$The contract will be fulfilled. I'm just not
in the mood today.
$#ArrogantMan(Arrogant Man)#$$&BlackwoodSerious&$$@Center@$I'm simply saying I want a day off.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$Apparently, the previous queen is responsible
for that.
$#GreyfordSoldier(Greyford Soldier)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Center@$But—!

$#ArrogantMan(Arrogant Man)#$$&BlackwoodShouting&$$@Center@$But what? You think you're in any position
to deny me? A common grunt like you?
$#GreyfordSoldier(Greyford Soldier)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Center@$...!

$#ArrogantMan(Arrogant Man)#$$&BlackwoodSerious&$$@Center@$Can't even muster a retort? Good, keep
your mouth shut from now on.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSeriousNoSword&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What an unpleasant man...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Is he one of the local mages?

$#GreyfordSoldier(Greyford Soldier)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$!-1!$No, I believe he's been invited here from
the Duchy of Belseph.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$That tone, though...

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceClosedEyesNoSword&$$@Left@$There will always be people like that.
Letting them bother you is a waste of time.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Maybe so, but... I just can't accept this
kind of behavior.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$The one who passed last year?

$#GreyfordSoldier(Greyford Soldier)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Center@$Your Majesty, the esteemed Red Dragon
Knights from the Kingdom of Rigland
$#GreyfordSoldier(Greyford Soldier)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Center@$have arrived.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$Ludmilla Aldyne, Marshal of the Red
Dragon Knights.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$My two subordinates and I have come in
response to your request for assistance.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$In the spirit of friendship between our
nations, we'll be honored to help restore
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$peace in your kingdom.
$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethStare&$$@Center@$No, thank you.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$I beg your pardon?

$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethStareLookaway&$$@Center@$I said, no thank you. I appreciate the effort
it must have taken to travel all this way.

$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethStareLookaway&$$@Center@$However, this is Greyford, a nation of
tradition and prestige. We need no help.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSeriousNoSword&$$@Right@$Is that statue of her, perhaps?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$("Need no help"? In this situation?)

$#GreyfordCounsellor(Greyford Counsellor)#$$!-1!$Y-Your Majesty! The council made this
decision—

$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethSerious&$$@Center@$And I just said we do not need help from
other countries, did I not?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Center@$Ah, I see what is happening here.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Center@$While you reluctantly accepted the
council's decision, it was not something

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Center@$you actually agreed with, was it, Your
Majesty?

$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethSerious&$$@Center@$That is correct. Depending on other nations
is the pinnacle of humiliation.

$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethSerious&$$@Center@$Such things never happened during my
predecessor's reign, nor will they during mine!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$Your nation's situation has drastically
changed since the late queen was in power.
$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethCommand&$$@Center@$What could a foreigner possibly know!?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Before her reign, Greyford was economically
unstable due to geographical factors.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$Sometimes one can see things more clearly
from the outside than from within.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$We'd be overjoyed if it turned out that your
kingdom truly doesn't need help.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSadSmile&$$@Center@$However, I'm afraid that if you overturn the
council's decision here, even your

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSadSmile&$$@Center@$most loyal subjects may start to lose faith
in you.
$#GreyfordCounsellor(Greyford Counsellor)#$$!-1!$What the Marshal says is indeed correct.
$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethSigh&$$@Center@$...

$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethStareLookaway&$$@Center@$Well, I...
Very well.
$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethSerious&$$@Center@$But be warned, the moment I deem you unnecessary, you will leave my country.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$As you wish, ma'am.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$(Phew, I was worried there for a moment,
but it seems we're in the clear for now...)
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$It was plagued by disturbances as a result.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCrazyNoSword&$$@Center@$Such attitude towards Miss Ludmilla...
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCrazyNoSword&$$@Center@$How dare you. How dare you. How dare—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(Clarice!? This is bad, she shouldn't look
at the Queen like that!)
$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethShock&$$@Center@$Ah...!?
$#GreyfordCounsellor(Greyford Counsellor)#$Y-Your Majesty? Are you all right!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(Oh no! She noticed Clarice's murderous
glare!)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(Then again, it's hard not to notice
something that intense...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Marshal, let's head to the barracks
immediately! Time is of the essence!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$It is. I'd like to learn more about this
country's army. Please, lead the way!

$#GreyfordSoldier(Greyford Soldier)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It'll be my honor, Marshal. Please, follow
me.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$And the previous queen reformed it all
alone?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$If you'll excuse us, Your Majesty.
$#ElizabethPillar(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethPanicShout&$$@Left@$Huff, huff... That was scary...

$#GreyfordCounsellor(Greyford Counsellor)#$Your Majesty, are you sure you are all
right?
$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethSighSweat&$$@Center@$Y-Yes, it's nothing.

$#GreyfordCounsellor(Greyford Counsellor)#$These past few weeks must be catching up
with you, ma'am.

$#GreyfordCounsellor(Greyford Counsellor)#$While it's important to study domestic and
foreign affairs, you need to take care
$#GreyfordCounsellor(Greyford Counsellor)#$of your health as well.

$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethStareLookaway&$$@Center@$I can't hope to earn anyone's respect with
my current level of knowledge.

$#Elizabeth(Elizabeth)#$$&ElizabethStare&$$@Center@$You may leave. Please make sure you rest
as well. I know how hard you're working.
$#GreyfordCounsellor(Greyford Counsellor)#$Thank you very much, ma'am.

keys.DescriptionKey: Elizabeth was born as the princess of the Kingdom of Greyford. She has little memory of her father, the king, as he succumbed to illness and passed away while she was still young. After his death, her mother ascended the throne, and with exceptional governance, rebuilt the desolate kingdom during her reign.

ElizabethRegular01.name: Elizabeth
ElizabethRegular01.title: Glorious Queen
ElizabethRegular01.description: Elizabeth was born as the princess of the Kingdom of Greyford. She has little memory of her father, the king, as he succumbed to illness and passed away while she was still young. After his death, her mother ascended the throne, and with exceptional governance, rebuilt the desolate kingdom during her reign.

keys.IntroText:
Don't underestimate me for my size!
I am the queen!

keys.DescriptionKey: However, when Elizabeth was only fifteen, her mother caught the same illness and slipped away from this world. From that day onward, the once crybaby, Elizabeth, changed. She never showed a single tear. She never uttered a word of complaint. She simply continued forward, determined to become like the great queen her mother was.

ElizabethRegular02.name: Elizabeth
ElizabethRegular02.title: Glorious Queen
ElizabethRegular02.description: However, when Elizabeth was only fifteen, her mother caught the same illness and slipped away from this world. From that day onward, the once crybaby, Elizabeth, changed. She never showed a single tear. She never uttered a word of complaint. She simply continued forward, determined to become like the great queen her mother was.

keys.DescriptionKey: Her mother had been brilliant, decisive, and undoubtedly a charismatic queen. In contrast, Elizabeth was a crybaby, clumsy, and at times a bit selfish. Yet, she possessed unmatched determination to give it her all and a mysterious charm that caused others to want to support and follow her. This too is one form of a great queen.

Elmina01.name: Elmina
Elmina01.title: Elmina
Elmina01.description: A mysterious elf wanted in Hymelia for theft, Elmina may seem crude and carefree, but in reality she cares deeply for others, especially children, and will put herself on the line to protect them. Her powerful magic gives her the ability to sense the presence of demons.

keys.value: $#DONTSHOWME(Female Voice)#$$|act4.Voices/mst2246|$Stop!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$You humans even wage wars amongst your
own kind!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2255|$Grr... If it's a fight you want, it's a fight
you'll get!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2256|$Wait, let's not rush into things...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2257|$You've come this far ignoring my warnings,
surely you're prepared for a fight!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2258|$I am prepared to witness your beauty, oh
enigmatic belladonna of the forest!
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHurt&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2259|$What?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2260|$Nagi! Is this really the time!?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2261|$I refuse to believe this fair maiden is a
villain!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2262|$But Nagi, she stole from the people of
Hymelia...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2263|$What are we standing here talking for? Let's
take her out!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$|act4.Voices/mst2247|$It's the voice from before!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2264|$Ga'Luga! I swear. The Captain is still
trying to negotiate here!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2265|$All of you are way out of line! Once one of
you gets started, it's chaos!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteCalm&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2266|$Um... Could you hold on for a second? We
need to sort this out.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2267|$You... You've got to be kidding me!!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHurt&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2268|$Urgh... I can't believe I'm losing to this
disorganized rabble!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious;Elmina.ElminaHurt;&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2269|$We may be a little chaotic, but we're
effective when we work together.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2270|$Elmina, we are the Rigland Red Dragon
Knight Pandemonium Task Force.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2271|$Ha ha, are they talking about Elmina the
Thief all the way over in Rigland now?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2272|$We came to capture you. Pay for your
crimes in Hymelia and turn over a new leaf.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2273|$Pay for my crimes in Hymelia!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$|act4.Voices/mst2248|$Over there!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2274|$No way! The jails of Rigland are paradise
compared to Hymelia!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2275|$They do seem to be rather prejudiced
against elves.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$But your crime is only theft. You should
be released after you serve your sentence.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2276|$Grr, you don't understand! The Hymelia
Knights are corrupt!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2277|$What do you mean?

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2278|$She's just trying to trick us. Don't engage
with her.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2279|$Alas! Is our meeting destined to end in
tragedy?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2280|$If we don't take you to Hymelia, we can't
fulfill our mission... I'm sorry.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2281|$You shouldn't apologize to captured thieves
kiddo. You're all fools. You'll regret this.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Every thief comes with her own sad story, but Elmina's is especially heinous. Living as a street urchin in Hymelia, the sweet words of a Gru Grimm preacher drew her in. He promised he could numb her pain, erase her history, and give her the power to do as she pleased, as long as she would swear her life to his mysterious god. She did -- and soon came to find that in doing so, she swore away her very free will.

Nowadays, she'd sooner swallow coals than follow orders. Sure, not everyone in authority is as evil as the cult that stole her youth, but she isn't taking any more chances. She is more than happy to help her friends -- but she will never spill blood again for what she doesn't believe is right.

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Elmina, Elmina! I patched the hole in your shirt for you!"

"Aww, kiddo. You didn't have to, I was going to take care of that tonight myself."

"I know. But you've been so busy with your new friends. I thought you'd want to spend some more time with them instead of doing chores at home."

"Honestly, doing chores at home sounds like a dream right now. How do you think my shirt got a hole in the first place?"

"Were you playing too hard with your friends?"

"Sure. We were playing. With pointy sticks and monsters. Speaking of which, never go out at night without me, okay?"

keys.DescriptionKey:
She shouldn't hold herself responsible for what she did under the Gru Grimm's control. She knows this. The Red Knights seem to know it too, since they haven't seized her and thrown her in prison with the other leaders of the Gru Grim.

But still, late at night when sleep eludes her, Elmina's mind wanders back to the faces of those she's killed. The fear in their eyes. The blood on her blade. Each life taken is a grievous wrong that can never be undone. Whether her hands were free or pulled on puppet strings makes no difference.

Aiding children and doing heroics with her friends might not be enough to completely fix the world she once helped to break. But it flies in the face of the Gru Grimm's old commands, and for her, that is enough.

keys.DescriptionKey:
People stare at Elmina no matter where she goes.

In human kingdoms, they stare because she's an elf. In the fair-skinned north, her tan draws curious attention. And when she's on the beach...well. She could do without the open-mouthed stares, but she likes bikinis best, so that's what she'll wear.

To tell the truth, being noticed takes some getting used to for a former street kid. That's why she learned to be stealthy. Keeping invisible saved her hide too many times to count, but it's no way to live. Not anymore.

She can slip into shadow whenever she wants. Why not enjoy a day in the sun?

keys.DescriptionKey:
Elmina didn't grow up with tropical heat, but she thinks it suits her. Humidity works wonders for her complexion, and the sun brings out the natural highlights in her hair. She doesn't have to worry about burns much either, though Callen still lectures her until she puts on proper protection.

Still, when the sun grows too bright even for her, she enjoys a cool retreat into the forest. Walking through the shade at the hottest time of day is a rare pleasure for one used to shivering in the cold.

And stumbling upon an unexpected waterfall? That's the kind of memory that begs to be shared with another.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Elves can hold their breath five times longer than most other races. Did you know that? Elmina finds most people don't.

It's a handy talent, one that's saved her life more than once. Not because she was much of a swimmer in her childhood, but because a little thief frequently finds herself in situations where a single audible breath could kill her.

Even these days, she feels a strange kind of peace when she isn't breathing. In those moments before her lungs start to burn, she knows she's safe.

She supposes she could stay beneath the waves, in a safe and breathless haven. But she doesn't need to anymore. Her friends have her back now, and they don't want her to be silent.

Removes all Burn status effects (including Mega Healing Burn) from enemy units on the battlefield. The user is granted a Charge, Super Stealth, and a Stealth Shield.

Then grants all enemies the Mega Poison status effect for 200TU. This will overwrite other status effects on those units.

Then steals up to 2 Spirit from the enemy team for each Poisoned enemy on the battlefield.

Usable if the user does not have the Stealth status effect. If this skill is used 3 times within 10TU, it becomes locked for 50TU.

Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges.

Then exchanges the target with an Imposter. The exchanged enemy will be sent to a random place in line of enemy reinforcements. If there are no enemy reinforcements, add enough Imposters to the enemy team to still send the targeted enemy to reinforcements (max 3). This effect will not trigger if the targeted enemy is Immovable.

Usable only if there are at least 2 non-Imposter enemies on the battlefield and becomes locked for 50TU after use.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Allies gain 2 Spirit for each non-sleeping enemy on the battlefield.

Then a random enemy has their Burn removed, and is granted Frostburn and infected with it. This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use. Usable 5 times per battle.

After the end of each turn, this infection will trigger to apply Frostburn to a random non-Frostburned unit on the infected unit's team. Infection ends after 3 triggers (even if they find no valid target) or once the infected enemy is defeated or leaves the battlefield. Infection is not a status effect and cannot be prevented or purified, but the effect spread by the infection may be. A unit cannot get a new infection until their existing one ends.

When a unit has Frostburn and they get the turn, they will lose the turn as if they were sleeping, then Frostburn is removed and that unit is granted the Burn status effect. Frostburn is not a status effect, but effects that remove negative status effects will also remove Frostburn. Frostburn will end if the affected unit is defeated or leaves the battlefield. Frostburn cannot apply to boss units, and cannot stack. Burn will overwrite other status effects. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with burn will also become burned.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Weakens all enemies. The user is Enraged, granted a Sleep Ward, Stun Ward, Poison Ward, Counter Stance for 150TU and 80% damage reduction from attacks until the end of its next turn. Unlocked each time the user damages an enemy with an attack. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.

This will overwrite the effects of previous Weak or Enrage skills on affected units, and other status effects on the user. For 150TU, the next time the unit with counter stance takes damage from an enemy attack, it will become their turn. Enraged units have their Attack increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn. Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3378|$Today, we will carry out the Exeternia's
final test.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$|act6.Voices/mst3387|$Not again... Remove them from the circuit!
Hurry with the transmutation and imprint!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3468|$I'm going on ahead. I'll see you in the
laboratory.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3469|$O-Okay...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3470|$"Believe what we want to believe," huh...?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3471|$...Alright. I should get going!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurtRed&$$|act6.Voices/mst3388|$Urgh!?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaCommand&$$|act6.Voices/mst3389|$Callen, the magic is surging backward at
Finn!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$|act6.Voices/mst3390|$Damn it! Stop the infusion—
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$|act6.Voices/mst3391|$No! I can keep going!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$|act6.Voices/mst3392|$...Okay!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurtRed&$$|act6.Voices/mst3393|$Nghh...!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3394|$"The Blueprint"?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3395|$That's what my father called it.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3396|$Commanders before him referred to it in a
similar way. It has no official name.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3379|$Everyone has worked hard up until now,
but today is of the upmost importance!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$And you won't find it in any official
records, of course.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3397|$The Commander said the Pandemonium
wouldn't destroy Erden.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$He said everything is preordained...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3398|$Preordained... You really think something
is making all this happen?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3399|$After looking at the documents in the
Pillar Room, it doesn't seem so farfetched.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3400|$There are piles of records of the damage
caused during previous Pandemoniums.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3401|$If you examine them, patterns begin to
emerge in the demons' behavior.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3402|$It's almost as though they are engaged in
an elaborate dance with us.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3403|$An endless waltz...
$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Researcher A)#$$|act6.Voices/mst3404|$The dummy soul system is 99% functional!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3380|$Today's the day, I can feel it!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$|act6.Voices/mst3405|$Elmina, is the magic still backflowing!?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaCommand&$$|act6.Voices/mst3406|$Yes, but that's what's stabilizing it! It's
like a super-intense tug-of-war!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurtRed&$$|act6.Voices/mst3407|$This is so weird! It's like I'm facing off
against another me!

$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Researcher B)#$$|act6.Voices/mst3408|$This is too dangerous! If even one function
fails the sword will explode!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$|act6.Voices/mst3409|$Evacuate the area! Finn, if you lose
ground you'll be sealed in the sword!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst3410|$C-Callen! The sword is developing its own
magic!!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHeh&$$|act6.Voices/mst3411|$Yes! The energy flow in the mithril blade
has flipped! Finn, what are you holding!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurtRed&$$|act6.Voices/mst3412|$This is my... No!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$|act6.Voices/mst3413|$This is our hope!!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3414|$Remember the three theories I mentioned
before? I actually have one more.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3381|$Me too, Finn. I believe the time has come.
But first...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3415|$You mean you started this research with
four theories?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3416|$Why didn't you say that before?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3417|$I thought it would be too much at once.
But now I feel the time has come.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3418|$Does this theory have something to do
with—
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3419|$The existence of an intelligent design.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3420|$You mean...a blueprint?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3421|$You noticed something like that too,
Callen? Like the Commander?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3422|$The more I analyzed my predecessors'
work, the more things didn't add up.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3423|$It was almost like all of them were afraid
of something.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3424|$The further they progressed in their search
for a method of ending the Pandemonium,

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3382|$Yes. Finn, Rizette? There's something we
want to discuss with you before we start.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$the more they felt driven by some
unknown force.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3425|$Like there was a shadow walking before
them, leading them along.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3426|$Of course, they never said this in so many
words.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3427|$But they were afraid of something. The
work they left behind told me as much.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3428|$Two villages are attacked in succession by
an Aeon Lord.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$One village produces the Cerulean
Crestbearer.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3429|$The other produces the Crimson
Crestbearer...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$Who turns out to be the son of Rody, the
previous Crimson Crestbearer.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3430|$You are recognized by the Red Dragon
Knights as the Crestbearer.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$You travel to Kisenkyo to find a cure for
the Sleeping Death.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3383|$Astrid and I have a theory. We wish to
present it to everyone eventually.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3431|$You just happen to run into Ossia, the
cause of the illness. You defeat her.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3432|$Your mission in Habsu turns out to be the
plot of Norza, another Aeon Lord.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3433|$You also happen to meet your father's old
friend Druke.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$In his dying moments, he manages to
regain enough sanity to tell you about me.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3434|$That's all just...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3435|$A coincidence... Right?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3436|$You go to Hymelia, the subject of another
Aeon Lord's scheme.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$You meet the Chief of Nushelle. And now,
here we are.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3437|$But the chief was waiting for us because of
your plan, wasn't she?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3438|$That wasn't a coincidence, it was... Ah!
$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Researcher A)#$$|act6.Voices/mst3384|$Transmutation at 25%.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3439|$Exactly. Far too many things had to line
up perfectly for all this to occur.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3440|$The odds were astronomical, but I was
strangely confident it would all work out.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3441|$Because "something" would guide the
Crestbearers to Callen the Scholar.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3442|$Are you serious about this!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3443|$This is all the result of choices we made!
We aren't being controlled by someone!!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3444|$The same kind of things happened in my
time, Finn.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3445|$The meeting of the Crimson and Cerulean
Crestbearers, escapes from the brink...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$A reunion between brothers... Our journey
was overflowing with miraculous events.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSad&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3446|$At the time, I was so intoxicated by our
success that I didn't notice.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3447|$But upon cool-headed reflection, I could
see its influence everywhere.

$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Researcher B)#$$|act6.Voices/mst3385|$Commencing imprint onto the dummy
soul vessel.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3448|$I feel just as you do, Finn. All those
choices were our own, not someone else's!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3449|$I truly believe that!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3450|$As for whether this guiding force is a
friend, or a foe...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3451|$Whether it is a benevolent god, or a cruel
devil...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3452|$I cannot yet say.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3453|$But of the fact that we stand here now,
united under one goal...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3454|$Of that, I want to remain proud.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3455|$...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3456|$Finn?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3457|$Huh? Oh, Rizette... What is it?
$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Researcher A)#$$|act6.Voices/mst3386|$Failure confirmed from node 32 to 43!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3458|$The Captain wants to see everyone in the
laboratory.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3459|$Why? It's not about the Exeternia, is it?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3460|$Finn... I told Callen about the angel.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3462|$That kid you saw? The one whose voice I
heard?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3461|$Yes. Callen didn't know anything, but she
said she'd look into it.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3463|$Angels are supposed to be messengers of
the gods, aren't they?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3464|$Callen said we don't have much choice but
to believe what we want to believe.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3465|$That angel helped me discover my power.
I want to trust it.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3466|$But most of all... I want to trust in you,
Finn.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3467|$Huh?

keys.DescriptionKey:
If this unit would be defeated, it instead survives with 1 HP and then cannot be defeated until its next turn. This effect can trigger only once each time this unit enters the battlefield, and is considered a Hold Ground+ effect.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn with more than 1 HP, this unit will immediately get the turn by having its TU reduced to 0. This extra turn may be interrupted by other effects that influence the turn order (e.g. other stuns targeting the lowest TU target). This is not considered a Counter Skin type effect. This effect cannot trigger again until 50TU advances.

This unit enters battle with 1% HP Regen for 100TU. A unit with 1% HP Regen will heal for 1% of their max HP after every turn. HP Regen effects will overwrite existing HP Regen effects.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The witches of Lumains know what it is to be feared, but that doesn't stop them from fearing. Even among outcasts, those witches who have taken on the features of a dragon are shunned. Olive understands why: witches only grow their horns when they've pushed their magic to the brink, losing themselves to the siren song of its power. A dragon witch has shown they're not to be trusted.

She's never told anyone how she got her horns and her lone wing. She's never told anyone how she lost her eye. It wouldn't matter anyway. The truth rarely changes anyone's mind.

EyepatchGuard01.name: Olive
EyepatchGuard01.title: Reclusive Witchling
EyepatchGuard01.description:
The witches of Lumains know what it is to be feared, but that doesn't stop them from fearing. Even among outcasts, those witches who have taken on the features of a dragon are shunned. Olive understands why: witches only grow their horns when they've pushed their magic to the brink, losing themselves to the siren song of its power. A dragon witch has shown they're not to be trusted.

She's never told anyone how she got her horns and her lone wing. She's never told anyone how she lost her eye. It wouldn't matter anyway. The truth rarely changes anyone's mind.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Olive doesn't remember many things fondly, but she'll always treasure her mother's laugh. How she made the most delicious pastries. How she studied her spellbooks night and day, desperate to end the Holy Maiden's witch hunts.

It was that desperation that consumed her. Twisted into a dragon, more beast than woman, she attacked her own daughter, the very person she wanted most to save. In that struggle to protect herself, Olive grew her horns. If she hadn't, she doubts she would have survived.

Let the witches whisper that she's just like her mother, a disaster waiting to happen. She knows better than anyone the price of dark magic -- and knows too that sometimes, that price must be paid.
