$#ShannaChuni(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodDiscontent&$$@Center@$Grrr, I'm kinda jealous!

$#ShannaChuni(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodHappy&$$@Center@$Okay! I'll work through my feelings with
some M&Q!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$So we're starting? Great!
What do we do first?

$#ShannaChuni(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodHeh&$$@Center@$Patience! First, I have to read the
introduction to the world of M&Q.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Introduction?
$#ShannaChuni(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodHeh&$$@Center@$Ahem...

$#ShannaChuni(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodNormal&$$@Center@$The year is 220. The world trembles
under the rule of Exarvorich, Dark Lord...

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteNormal&$$@Right@$Now, you must be tired, right?
Let's get ready for bedtime.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$This...seems like it might get long.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Shanna)#$——...and that's the short version,
at least.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$I... I see...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(There was so much jargon...and it was
so long. I feel like I've been dazed.)

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Yaaawn...
Is it over?

$#Shanna(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodBlushSurprised&$$@Right@$Ah, you were asleep, Mama?
That's okay! I can read it again—

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteNormal&$$@Left@$S-Shanna!
Let's just start playing, okay?

$#Shanna(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodHappy&$$@Right@$Hehe, someone's excited!
Okay, let's get started!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(So, thanks to Snow's intervention,
we finally got started...)

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinGrin&$$@Left@$Right, I landed on a spell space...
so you lose a day's travel, Shanna.

$#Shanna(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodHeh&$$@Left@$No, I want to play some more!
Let's play M&Q!

$#ShannaChuni(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodHeh&$$@Right@$Hoho, evil witch! If you'd gone the other
way, you would have found treasure!

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinGrit&$$@Left@$What!?
...Hey, who are you calling a witch!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(It looks like the game itself is a standard
spaces-and-cards board game.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(It's simple enough to pick up easily, but
complicated enough for strategy...)
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Ah, I defeated the monsters!

$#ShannaChuni(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodStarStruck&$$@Left@$Wow! That's a secret event!
Good job!
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteHappy&$$@Right@$A secret event!? Hooray!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Nice going, Snow.

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteBlush&$$@Right@$Ah... Ehehe. Maybe I got a little too
excited there...

$#ShannaChuni(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Okay! If you roll a 6 here, we defeat the
dragon and come back legends!

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSurprised&$$@Right@$Um...wouldn't you rather play something
else?

$#ShannaChuni(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodAngry&$$@Center@$But if you get anything else, we lose, and
it's game over.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$So I just need to roll a 6, then?
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You can do it, Sir Knight!
$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSmile&$$@Right@$Time to strut your stuff.

$#ShannaChuni(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodAttack&$$@Left@$Come on...
Come on, Crimson Crestbearer!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$My friends are all behind me...
I swear I won't let you down!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Come on...!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$W-what is it?

$#ShannaChuni(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodSurprised&$$@Center@$Ah...it's a 6!
We slayed the dragon!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$Does that mean we won?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Alright, everyone's asleep.
I'll sneak out now.

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$A hunter, mother to two beautiful girls...
...And, underneath that, an assassin.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$An assassin!?

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSerious&$$@Center@$Yeah. There's an orphanage in town that
trains kids into killers. I'm one of 'em.

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSerious&$$@Center@$I killed to survive, simple as that. At
least, until I found my way here.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$...It wasn't a coincidence that you
found Snow in the woods, was it?

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSmile&$$@Center@$You've got good instincts. I was ordered
by the new queen to keep an eye on her.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Keep an eye on her?

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSerious&$$@Center@$If anything happened, I was supposed to
make her "disappear".

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What!? But you said she was precious to
you! Was that all a lie?

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSad&$$@Right@$...It would've been easier if it was. But
I came to see her as my real daughter.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Center@$Thank you all, for everything.
I'll never forget the days I spent here.

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSad&$$@Right@$I have no right to say this, but all I want
to be now is her mother.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Of course you have a right to say that.
You already are their mother.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I think it's pretty clear that's how they
see you.

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSmile&$$@Right@$Yeah...they call me "Mother", despite
how bloodied my hands are.

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSmile&$$@Right@$I truly believe I was born into this world
to raise the two of them.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$I'm sure you were.

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSmile&$$@Right@$Hah. I ended up telling you everything.
Now I see what Snow meant...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Snow? Did she say something?

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinGrin&$$@Right@$Ask her that yourself. Honestly...
She does know how to pick 'em.

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSmile&$$@Right@$Anyway, you're heading for the castle,
right? Take me with you.
$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Hold it.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$You'd help me?

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSerious&$$@Right@$For my daughters...
I'd do anything.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$Alright. It'll be good to have you, Elin.

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSmile&$$@Right@$Good to be here.
Now, let's get—
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Where do you two think you're going?

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$S-Snow!
How long have you...

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteNormal&$$@Right@$I just got up to get some water, and saw
you two standing out here.

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinNormal&$$@Left@$...So you didn't hear what we were
talking about.
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSurprised&$$@Right@$...What were you talking about?

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSmile&$$@Left@$Nothing important.
Don't worry about it.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Elin! I was so careful not to wake
anyone up...

$#Shanna(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodSurprised&$$@Right@$Snow? Yaaawn...ah, it's Mama and Finn.
Where are you going?

$#Shanna(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodHeh&$$@Right@$...Ah! To uproot the evil fiends from
before! I want to come too!
$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSurprise&$$@Left@$Shanna's awake now too?

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaRobinHoodHeh&$$@Right@$It's fine, it's fine!
Let's all go together.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$You're up too!?

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I don't know what you two are planning,
but I won't let you just sneak off!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Left@$No, uh...
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaRobinHoodSurprised&$$@Right@$...!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Luna? What is it?

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaRobinHoodWorried&$$@Right@$Do you hear that? Screams...coming
from town!? I have to go!

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinGrin&$$@Right@$You'll have to try a lot harder than that
to pull one over on me.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Hey, Luna!
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteShouting&$$@Right@$Luna, it's dangerous!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Screams...
I don't like this.
$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinShouting&$$@Right@$Come on, Finn, after her!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Yeah! Let's hurry!
$#Shanna(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodStarStruck&$$@Right@$I-I'm going too!
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...I won't let you all go alone!
$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSerious&$$@Right@$You're going to kill the Queen, right?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$You knew!?

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSmile&$$@Right@$Well, yeah. Call it a gut feeling. That's
the look of someone going to his death.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$...Who are you really, Elin?

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteBlush&$$@Right@$Um...Sir Knight, thank you so much
for helping with the dishes.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Hey, housework is nothing to sneeze at!
Especially all by yourself. You're amazing.
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteBlush&$$@Right@$...Thank you.

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteNormal&$$@Right@$Um...if it's alright with you, could you
tell me a story, sometime?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$A story?
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I'm too weak to leave the cabin much...

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteNormal&$$@Center@$So I'd love to hear about your travels and
your adventures.
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSad&$$@Center@$I-if you wouldn't mind, of course.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Not at all. I'll need to remember a really
exciting story for you, then.

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteHappy&$$@Right@$Really!?
...I'm excited already—

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteHurt&$$@Right@$...Ah!
I cut my finger!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$You treated me to dinner, and gave me a
place to sleep. It's the least I can do.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Ouch...
Here, let me see the cut.
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteHurt&$$@Right@$U-um...okay?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Good, it's shallow.
That'll stop bleeding right away.

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteBlush&$$@Right@$Y-yes, um...I...!
Um...!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Ah! Snow!? Are you okay!? Your face is
all red. Is it an infection?
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteEmbarrassed&$$@Right@$N-no, um...it's just...your hand...!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Huh?

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinShouting&$$@Left@$Sir Knight? What do you think you're
doing to my daughter over there?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Huh? W-wait, no! It's not what you think!
I'm just treating her cut! Right, Snow?

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteConfused&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I-I'm sorry! I'm just not used to
this sort of thing...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Do these dishes go back in here?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$S-Snow! Why do you look dizzy!?

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I'm not hearing an explanation,
Sir Knight!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$Wait, wait! I didn't do anything!

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinGrit&$$@Center@$I told you what would happen if you laid
a hand on her!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Wait! Let's talk this out!
$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinShouting&$$@Center@$I'm done talking!

$#ShannaChuni(???)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodHorror&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Fuhahaha! I return from the black veil of
the for— Waaah! It's the wolfman!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Hey, you're the girl who was being
chased around by monsters...

$#Shanna(???)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodShame&$$@Left@$I-I wasn't being chased around! That
was, um...

$#Shanna(???)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodShame&$$@Left@$...I was on an expedition, and they
found me. I wasn't running away!

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteNormal&$$@Right@$Yes. Then it's just the stewpot left, and...
We're all done cleaning.

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinGrit&$$@Right@$Expedition...not out to the west forest
again, right!?

$#ShannaChuni(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodHeh&$$@Left@$Fufu. The siren call of the dark guided
mine footsteps—

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinShouting&$$@Right@$Oh, no! Your fancy words aren't getting
you out of this one!

$#Shanna(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodShame&$$@Left@$B-but I didn't find any good game closer,
and I wanted to catch something nice...

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSerious&$$@Right@$You weren't just wandering off on some
harebrained "quest" again?

$#Shanna(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodSad&$$@Left@$N-no, I wasn't...
Snooow...
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteHappy&$$@Right@$Ah, welcome home, Shanna.
$#Shanna(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodPout&$$@Left@$Snoooow, Mama's mad at me.

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteHappy&$$@Right@$There, there. I know you're not a bad
girl, Shanna.

$#Shanna(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodHappy&$$@Left@$Ehehe...
You're the best.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Wow, already!?
That was fast.
$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinGrit&$$@Right@$Ugh, there you go, spoiling her again...
$#Shanna(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodAngry&$$@Left@$...Ah! Right! The wolfman!
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteNormal&$$@Right@$Do you mean Sir Knight?

$#Shanna(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodSurprised&$$@Left@$Knight?
You mean, he's not a wolfman?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$I'm Finn, of the Red Dragon Knights.
You're Shanna, right? Nice to meet you!

$#Shanna(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodStarStruck&$$@Left@$Red Dragon Knights...
That's...that's so coooool!

$#ShannaChuni(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodAngry&$$@Left@$Ah! But wait, this is how wolfmen get you
to lower your guard...
$#ShannaChuni(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodAttack&$$@Left@$You're not fooling me, wolfman!
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteBlush&$$@Right@$Come now, Shanna. He's not like that.

$#ShannaChuni(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodAngry&$$@Left@$Don't let him fool you, Snow. He's a
wolfman! I can tell!

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteNormal&$$@Right@$There's still plenty to do around the
house, after all.

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSerious&$$@Right@$Shanna...you know that's not how you're
supposed to speak to guests.

$#ShannaChuni(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodDiscontent&$$@Left@$Huh? Now Snow's mad at me too?
Damn you, wolfman...!

$#ShannaChuni(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodDiscontent&$$@Left@$Hmph! I'll show them your true colors
sooner or later!

$#Shanna(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodDiscontent&$$@Left@$...But for now, I'll apologize.
Sorry.

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteHappy&$$@Right@$There, well done.
I'll warm up some stew for you.

$#Shanna(Shanna)#$$&ShannaRidingHoodHappy&$$@Left@$Thanks, Snow!
Ah, let me help you!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$They seem close.

$#Elin(Elin)#$$&ElinSerious&$$@Left@$Maybe a bit too close...hey! Hey, you two!
Be careful around the stove, damn it!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Right@$Haha. What a heartwarming family.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$You sure are a hard worker.

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteBlush&$$@Right@$N-not at all! I can't use magic and I'm
too weak to hunt. This is all I can do.

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteNormal&$$@Right@$Mother and my sister do so much more
for our family...

The world will not see her like again.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The user becomes a Guardian. For any enemy attack that would hit 1 or 2 other allies, 1 of the hits is instead redirected to this unit. This unit will not redirect skills that don't deal damage.

After this skill is used, whenever the user is hit by an attack and is defeated or survives with 25% or less of max HP until after the end of the turn:
- They are sacrificed if they were not defeated.
- A copy of the user is added to next in line of ally reinforcements. The copy's Limit Breaks, Awakenings, Boosts, Potential, Mastery, Weapon and Accessory will match the user.
- All allies become Enraged and have their current TU reduced by 100. This will overwrite the effects of other Enrage skills on those allies. Enraged units have their Attack increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn.

These effects won't trigger if defeated by the burn status effect.

Unlocked the first time an ally on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source while this unit is on the battlefield or if this unit is on the battlefield at the very start of the battle. This skill is locked again if the user leaves the battlefield. This skill can only be used once each time this unit is on the battlefield.

- A copy of the user is added to next in line of ally reinforcements. The copy's Limit Breaks, Awakenings, Boosts, Potential, Mastery, Weapon and Accessory will match the user.
- All allies become Enraged and have their current TU reduced by 100. This will overwrite the effects of other Enrage skills on those allies. Enraged units have their Attack increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn.

These effects won't trigger if defeated by the burn status effect.

$#DONTSHOWME(Sellsword)#$$|act1.Voices/sst112|$Wh-What!? I can't believe I lost! I've never
lost to anyone around here!

$#DONTSHOWME(Sellsword)#$$|act1.Voices/sst113|$You have a really solid team! Could I
join you on the road? Let's train together!

$#DONTSHOWME(Sellsword)#$$|act1.Voices/sst109|$Hi there! I'm looking for a worthy opponent.
Everyone around here seems pretty weak.

$#DONTSHOWME(Sellsword)#$$|act1.Voices/sst110|$You guys look pretty tough, though—fancy
a quick match?

$#DONTSHOWME(Sellsword)#$$|act1.Voices/sst111|$I doubt you can beat me, but maybe we can
have some fun.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$|act6.Voices/mst3800|$Norza!!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst3808|$(Have the Aeon Lords begun to notice
too...!?)

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$|act6.Voices/mst3809|$Enough! Are you claiming someone else
has been pulling your strings!?
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$|act6.Voices/mst3810|$I would never stand for that!!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$|act6.Voices/mst3811|$I am a swordmaster! I kill, I steal, I perfect
myself!
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$|Cont|$I cut down the top and climb higher!
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$|act6.Voices/mst3812|$For this, I have surpassed humanity!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$|Cont|$I have embraced evil so that one day I may
cut it down, too!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$|act6.Voices/mst3813|$I knew it... The Aeon Lords were once
mortal.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$|act6.Voices/mst3814|$Why must I, an Aeon Lord, be tasked with
polishing you up!?

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$|act6.Voices/mst3815|$Ossia and Gyurelle were treated like your
fodder!
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$|act6.Voices/mst3801|$So you've come, Crimson.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$|act6.Voices/mst3816|$Not me! I will not sacrifice myself for you!
Even if fate attempts to bind me...
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$|act6.Voices/mst3817|$I will cut those bonds!!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$|act6.Voices/mst3818|$Urgh!?
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganDetermined&$$|act6.Voices/mst3819|$His power has grown even stronger!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$|act6.Voices/mst3820|$Norza! If you were once human...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$|act6.Voices/mst3821|$If your hunger to improve your human self
is still left somewhere inside you...!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$|act6.Voices/mst3822|$I will use that hunger to destroy you... And
destroy this fate!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3823|$How could this happen... What is it that I
lack!?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3824|$We've surpassed you, Norza.
We're stronger than you are!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritRed&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3825|$I don't know what fate you are bound by.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$|act6.Voices/mst3802|$You...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3826|$But your sword can no longer defeat us!!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3827|$I have used 24 of my most advanced Aeon
Thorns.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$I am clad in living armor, composed of the
best parts of countless monsters.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$My blade, the Obsidian Storm, was forged
with the most advanced technologies.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3828|$Discipline, devotion, pride! How could it be
my fate to lose to you sheltered brats!?
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Center@$$%0.5%$$|act6.Voices/mst3829|$Urgh...Arghh...Hurrgh... I-I...!
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3830|$I WON'T!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritRed&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3831|$Norza's body, it's...!
$#NorzaBeast(Norza)#$$&NorzaBeast&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3832|$I WON'T!! LOOOOOSE!!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3833|$Is this... Norza's evolved form!?
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganDetermined&$$|act6.Voices/mst3803|$...!

$#NorzaBeast(Norza)#$$&NorzaBeast&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3834|$I AM!! THE ULTIMATE!!
SWORDMASTERRRRRR!!

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganDetermined&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3835|$He has abandoned his human form, along
with his entire philosophy!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3836|$Norza, you have sold your soul and cast
aside your sword...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3837|$You have become nothing but a mindless
beast!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3838|$NORZA!!
$#NorzaBeast(Norza)#$$&NorzaBeast&$$@Center@$$%0.5%$$|act6.Voices/mst3839|$HUUURRGH!!?

$#NorzaBeast(Norza)#$$&NorzaBeast&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3840|$n-NOo...iT CAn'T...enD LiKE tHIs... NOt
iN tHiS CURsEd f-foRM!!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3841|$Do you still not understand?
$#GaLuga(Gilgan)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3842|$The moment you gave yourself to evil...
$#GaLuga(Gilgan)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3843|$You had already secured your loss!!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaAngry&$$|act6.Voices/mst3804|$That raw power... It's just like it was
with Uncle Druke!
$#NorzaBeast(Norza)#$$&NorzaBeast&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3844|$!!
$#NorzaBeast(Norza)#$$&NorzaBeast&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3845|$I-I see... So th-this is my...fate...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritRed&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3846|$Norza...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3847|$My brothers and sisters... I have avenged
you!

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3848|$(Druke... Norza... If only the two of you
had met under better circumstances...)

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3849|$It seemed as though he was struggling
against something.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3850|$Yeah. It was as if by defeating us, he
could defeat something else...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3851|$Do you think he was trying to escape the
control of the Eternal?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3852|$Ha! It was his choice to join the Aeon
Legion.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3853|$Something he said is bothering me,
though...
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$|act6.Voices/mst3805|$Ah yes, Druke. We were evenly matched.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$It was like he was suggesting that the Aeon
Lords existed for us to defeat...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3854|$(Did Norza sense some kind of intelligent
design? A Blueprint, like Father did?)

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3855|$Professor Callen... What exactly is it that
we are fighting against?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3856|$...I have a theory.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3857|$I think in time it will reveal itself.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3858|$At the moment we achieve what no other
has managed to achieve...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3859|$You mean when we seal the Eternal, and
permanently end the Pandemonium?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3860|$Yes.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3861|$Let's proceed. The answer to all of our
questions lies ahead!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$|act6.Voices/mst3806|$But even he eventually began to dry up
and fade, just like all the others.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$|Cont|$His body, weak with age, still thirsted for
power. All I did was fill his cup.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$|act6.Voices/mst3807|$But... Druke's thirst was always part of
"its" plan to lead us into battle.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1892|$Druke, the Legendary Swordmaster, and
Norza, the Aeon Lord...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1899|$I see. Did Druke say anything about what
happened to your father?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1900|$No... He just told me I have to "resist."
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1901|$Resist what, I wonder.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1902|$Let us consider that at another time. Callen
is the most pressing matter.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1903|$Even among the elves she is lauded as their
most powerful magician.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$From what I hear, she saved many people
during the previous Pandemonium.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1904|$Indeed. But her current whereabouts are
unknown.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1905|$The dragonscribes believe that several
great minds collected their research

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$under the name "Callen," and the person
herself is a mere legend.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1906|$But Druke called her a friend. That
suggests they had a personal relationship.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1893|$Finn's father Rody, who apparently
defeated the Eternal...
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1907|$And you believe him, Finn?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1908|$Yes!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1909|$I am assigning the Pandemonium Task
Force a new mission.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1910|$Gather information about Callen the
Scholar, and if you can, find her.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1911|$If she does exist, and really knows a way
to permanently end the Pandemonium...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1912|$We must gain her cooperation at
whatever cost!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1913|$This mission is of the upmost importance,
and should be made top priority.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1914|$Those are the Commander's orders.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1915|$There are other units besides ours
cooperating in the investigation.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1916|$If they find something, we will be sent to
validate it.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1894|$And Callen, who can supposedly end the
Pandemonium permanently.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1917|$In the meantime though, we should gather
what information we can.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1918|$If Callen is an elf, should we ask for
information about her in elven villages?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1919|$That would be ideal, but the elven
population in Westland is dwindling.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1920|$Furthermore, their villages are often not
marked on maps.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1921|$So we have to do this the hard way. What
a pain!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1922|$Elven women are wonderful... Dazzling
and exquisite, like forest jewels!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1923|$I've heard they get along well with the kud
since we live in many of the same places.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1924|$There should be some elves in Rigland,
shouldn't there?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1925|$Let's go find some, and ask them if they
know anything.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1926|$If we find something useful, we'll make our
move. Be prepared to leave at any time!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1895|$You have accomplished a great deal for
a simple raid mission.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1927|$Have you seen Astrid, Captain?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1928|$Her inspection of our unit is complete, so
she has returned to her previous position.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1929|$Oh, so we won't be traveling together...
That's kind of a shame.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1930|$If you would prefer, I could request you be
transferred to Astrid's unit, Mysha.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1931|$No, that's okay, uh, ma'am. I'm with you!
You're closest to finding Norza, after all.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1932|$And someone has to be here to stop

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst1937|$Dismissed!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$|act4.Voices/mst1938|$Guess I should go look for some elves and

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$But we feel we should investigate this

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst1897|$Let's take this one thing at a time. Finn,

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst1898|$My mother told me he was a mercenary

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$He has a grave in Rossé, but there's no
body...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst152|$Soul stones! This is a lucky find.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$|act0.Voices/mst161|$E-Evil intent!? I don't think I want to do
anything evil... Alright, here goes!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$|act0.Voices/mst162|$Wow, summoning is a pretty neat trick!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$|act0.Voices/mst163|$Looks like your intentions were good.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$|act0.Voices/mst164|$Phew...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst165|$Let's keep moving. We still have a lot of
ground to cover.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$|act0.Voices/mst153|$These are soul stones? I've never seen a
real one before!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$|act0.Voices/mst154|$You can summon monsters with them,

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst155|$Not just monsters. They can summon

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst156|$And not just from our world. You can

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst157|$Hmm... Finn, why don't you try summoning

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$|act0.Voices/mst158|$Can I!?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst159|$Go ahead. But be careful.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst160|$If you summon with evil intent, you will
also corrupt the heart of your new ally.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Soul Stones!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$These are Soul Stones?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$You can summon monsters with them,

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Not just monsters. They can summon

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$And not just from our world.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$These will give you new powers.
Give it a go, Finn.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Okay!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Great, just like that.
Let's continue.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$|act6.Voices/mst3744|$...?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3753|$Finn? What's wrong?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3754|$It's nothing. You go on ahead, I'll catch

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3755|$Okay... See you soon.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3756|$Yeah.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3757|$...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3758|$（18 years ago, Rody stood and stared at

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3759|$(He wished for peace for all of Erden. And

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3760|$(Finn... What are you thinking right now?)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3745|$What do you think, Callen? Do we have

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3746|$...It's as I remember. I can feel the magic
here in every inch of my body. And...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3747|$My crest aches... More than it ever has

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3748|$There's no doubt. That is the epicenter of

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3749|$The Eternal's stronghold!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3750|$So the Eternal is inside that tower...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3751|$I don't think there's any guards, but it's
hard to tell with all this magic in the air.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3752|$...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act6.Voices/mst3377|$We're so close to finishing the Exeternia!
I better head back to Callen's laboratory.

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Hey, Callen? Just in case I don't make it through this—"

"That's not even in the realm of possibility."

"If I... If I become something that's not me anymore—"

"That's not going to happen!"

"But if it does, could you give this letter to Rizette for me?"

"I won't. I refuse to deliver another letter like that."

"Another one? Callen, were you the one who—"

"Fine, I'll keep this letter for you. But when we emerge victorious, you're going to be so embarrassed, Finn!"

"...Thank you, Callen. I'm sorry."

"Honestly! You and that idiot father of yours are two peas in a pod."

keys.DescriptionKey:
Dear Rizette,

If you're reading this, it means our plan didn't work, and I'm not around anymore.

I still can't wrap my head around how country folk from the north like you and I got wrapped up in a wild quest with the whole of Erden on the line. If it weren't for all the people we've met, I never would have made it this far. But especially you, Rizette. Without someone else to share the responsibility of being a Crestbearer with, I don't think I could have kept going. I always find myself thinking about what you would do whenever I—

"Finn! There you are."

"R-Rizette!?"

"The Captain wants to see everyone right away. She said Callen's going to be attacked tonight!"

"What!?"

"Come on!"

"...Right behind you!"

keys.DescriptionKey:
During the third Pandemonium, the legendary Fire Dragon Fornaxos saved a human man from certain death. To show his eternal gratitude, the man swore that his bloodline would stand guard over and sanctify Fornaxos's mountain until the end of days. Thus, Antares' ancestor decided her fate centuries before she was born.

She doesn't begrudge him this, of course. Antares has always been happy to have a purpose, even if it was one she never chose herself. Still, some days she finds her eyes wandering to the village at the foot of the mountain, far from the sacred ground she cares for all alone.

Just who are these people that Fornaxos works so hard to protect?

keys.DescriptionKey:
Now that Fornaxos has freed her of her ancestor's vow, Antares finds herself fascinated by the many peoples and cultures of Erden. Like a firefly on the breeze, she flits from place to place, learning all she can.

As a former recluse, however, she never had to learn to tame the considerable fire magic within her. This has caused its fair share of difficulties in her travels. For instance, one bikki village forbade her to return after she dried up all its mud baths in a single day.

If you know any tutors of fire magic that don't mind getting a few burns, please let her know.

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act3.Voices/sst287|$Captain Ludmilla! Would you indulge me
in a training battle?
$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act3.Voices/sst288|$I have been testing a new strategy.

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act3.Voices/sst289|$I have a monster that becomes more
powerful when its HP is low.

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act3.Voices/sst290|$It gives me the chance to turn the tide
when things aren't going my way!

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$Truly amazing... He is young,
and his technique could use some polish,

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Return to Rigland.
Your life depends on it.
$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$Yes, Captain!
$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$but he is certainly capable.

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$How can someone as young as yourself
wield such power?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I'm not quite sure myself... I didn't think
I could beat a warrior as strong as you.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$(Finn's fighting prowess
is better than I imagined...)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$All right. Well then, let's be on our way.
Herbert, please remember
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$what I told you about the forest.
$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$Yes, Captain!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$If you happen to run into...something...
please just turn around and retreat.

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$Captain Ludmilla!
What are you doing here?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Of course.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$(We'll see how strong you really are,
if you are indeed the chosen one.)

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$I thought you were headed for Westcarte
to provide aid?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$That's right, Herbert. But I'd rather not 
discuss this in front of these two here.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$More importantly, you'd better keep away 
from this forest. It's dangerous.

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$Yes, ma'am!
Is there anything I can do to help you?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Well, could I have you spar with the boy?
I'd like to see what he's capable of.

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$I can do that.
Come, young man. Let us spar!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Finn. Herbert is the second-in-command of
the Red Dragon Knights, Fourth Regiment.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Would you be willing to test your strength
in single combat?

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act1.Voices/sst100|$Excellent fight, lad! I see you are a warrior
of great potential!

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act1.Voices/sst101|$You should try your hand at capturing the
Aetherfoal in that bush over there.

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act1.Voices/sst102|$It was a little too fast for an old fellow like
me, but I'm sure you'll have no trouble!

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act1.Voices/sst100|$Excellent fight, lad! I see you are a warrior
of great potential!

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act1.Voices/sst95|$Captain Ludmilla! I see you have some new
traveling companions.
$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act1.Voices/sst96|$Any of them show any promise?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act1.Voices/sst97|$Herbert! Patrolling the pass, I see. Thank
you for your service.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act1.Voices/sst98|$This is a good opportunity. Finn, why don't

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act1.Voices/sst99|$He is one of the Red Knights' most skilled

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act6.Voices/sst446|$Captain Ludmilla! It is an honor!

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act6.Voices/sst447|$I was sent to investigate this pass, but I'm

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act6.Voices/sst448|$I am ashamed of my cowardice.

keys.DescriptionKey: Ur-Shalaquel now wanders the land, yearning from the battles of millenia past. With no titans left to fight, and a world broader, larger, and more diverse than that of his youth, he finds the world itself a challenge greater than any titan battle. With a complex world he can't quite understand, Ur-Shalaquel has chosen to challenge himself with more one-dimensional challenges. Recently, he swore to cut down a mountain. Even with his titanic size, this is a monumental task for even the greatest weapon. But now, half a mountain is left standing in his wake.

$#Elran(Elran)#$$|act0.Voices/mst17|$Nice one! If you train and evolve that little
guy, he'll become a pretty powerful ally.

$#Elran(Elran)#$$|act0.Voices/mst25|$I'm heading back to Rossé, and you should
too.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst26|$If my dad were here, he wouldn't ignore
something like this.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$|act0.Voices/mst27|$And neither will I!
$#Elran(Elran)#$$|act0.Voices/mst28|$Huh? Finn, your eyes just...

$#Elran(Elran)#$$|act0.Voices/mst29|$I'm probably seeing things. Do what you
like, I'm getting out of here!
$#Monster(Monster)#$ROOOOAAAARGH!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$|act0.Voices/mst30|$It came from that way!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$|act0.Voices/mst18|$These two days crawling around in the
woods finally paid off!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$|act0.Voices/mst19|$Thanks for having my back, Elran!

$#Elran(Elran)#$$|act0.Voices/mst20|$No need to be humble. You're the best
hunter in Rossé—you didn't need my help.
$#???(???)#$ROOOOAAAARGH!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst21|$What was that!?

$#Elran(Elran)#$$|act0.Voices/mst22|$The whole forest just shook... Is there
a monster that big around here?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$|act0.Voices/mst23|$Whatever it is, it sounds like it's on the
hunt... Someone could be in danger!

$#Elran(Elran)#$$|act0.Voices/mst24|$Don't be reckless, Finn. There's been some
really aggressive monsters around lately.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$All right! I got it!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Elran? Where did you go?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Are you over there?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act1.Voices/mst312|$This must be one of those sentinel stones
the Captain was talking about.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$|act1.Voices/mst313|$Let's keep going!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$These must be the Sentinel Stones
Captain Ludmilla mentioned.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Looks like the only way through is to fight!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Center@$Nothing's going to get in our way!

keys.DescriptionKey:
When the bikki came to Westland, they left behind much of their traditional magic in Eastland. Ambitious bikki spellcasters would attempt to make the journey back to their ancestor's homelands, in hopes of learning their forgotten secrets. The passage was long and filled with peril, and many of these pilgrims were never heard from again.

When the aspiring mage Jin decided to make the trip, his friends and family were deeply concerned. Jin's sense of direction was so terrible, it was not uncommon for him to get lost on the way to his own house. Nevertheless, Jin was too stubborn to be persuaded otherwise, and he departed for Eastland.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Jin was not heard from again for over a decade, and those who knew him began to assume the worst. However, one day he suddenly returned, looking none worse for wear and adorned with fancy robes.

He had indeed reached his destination of Eastland, but not before some lengthy detours through both the northern and southern continents of Erden. As a result, he has learned far more than he would have by only visiting Eastland.

With his expanded knowledge, Jin began his own school of bikki magic, and now aspiring bikki mages seek wisdom there rather than attempt the arduous journey themselves.

keys.DescriptionKey: The first, and only, thing to be said about Scales is how stubborn she is. She has no concept of compromise. Once she's decided on a course of action, no force on Erden can stop her, and of course she won't hear a word of advice or caution either. She didn't even consult with any of her fellow villagers before inviting herself along with me. What bad luck, to be stuck with such a hard-headed partner.

FurCoatLizard01.name: Alba
FurCoatLizard01.title: Unyielding Will
FurCoatLizard01.description: The first, and only, thing to be said about Scales is how stubborn she is. She has no concept of compromise. Once she's decided on a course of action, no force on Erden can stop her, and of course she won't hear a word of advice or caution either. She didn't even consult with any of her fellow villagers before inviting herself along with me. What bad luck, to be stuck with such a hard-headed partner.

keys.DescriptionKey: The only other thing of note about my partner is her knowledge of herbal medicine. Though limited, it did save my life once. I considered my debt repaid when I gave up my wish, but she now believes she owes me a debt instead, and has invited herself along on my journey to repay it. Perhaps we'll find a cure for stubborn foolishness along the way.

keys.value:
$#DONTSHOWME(Baltu Merc)#$$|act1.Voices/sst124|$You...beat me? This is...new. Fresh.
Exciting, even! We'll cross blades again!

$#DONTSHOWME(Baltu Merc)#$$|act1.Voices/sst119|$Stop right there! You better— No, that's
not right...

$#DONTSHOWME(Baltu Merc)#$$|act1.Voices/sst120|$After years on the road, plundering and
pilfering, I've grown...jaded.

$#DONTSHOWME(Baltu Merc)#$$|act1.Voices/sst121|$I used to give dramatic speeches. "I'll be
relieving you of those goods, madame..."

$#DONTSHOWME(Baltu Merc)#$$|act1.Voices/sst122|$But now? It's just gotten old. The drama
has lost its fun.

$#DONTSHOWME(Baltu Merc)#$$|act1.Voices/sst123|$Just give me your stuff, my heart's not in
this gig enough for monologues anymore.

$#DONTSHOWME(Baltu Merc)#$$|act3.Voices/sst294|$Like an exquisite dance. To fight with you
is like expert poetry. Like the finest wine!

$#DONTSHOWME(Baltu Merc)#$$|act3.Voices/sst291|$Oh, you, you, you! Our last battle woke
something in me. A passion I missed!

$#DONTSHOWME(Baltu Merc)#$$|act3.Voices/sst292|$I am eternally grateful. I want to join your
squad in gratitude. But, just one request?

$#DONTSHOWME(Baltu Merc)#$$|act3.Voices/sst293|$Fight me, just one more time! So I may
feel the fire of combat with noble warriors!
Fusion

$# ( )#$They walked on and on, down the long passage
beyond that last door.

$#Arsenal(Arsenal)#$$&ArsenalWah&$$@Center@$$%1%$Thank you for calling me! It makes me kind of
happy!
$#Antoinette(Antoinette)#$$&AntoinetteCold&$$@Center@$(Ah. My death...will have no meaning at all...)

$#Antoinette(Antoinette)#$$&AntoinetteCold&$$@Center@$(The people I tried to protect now hate me so
much—)

$# ( )#$$!-1!$Please, stop—! You're all wrong about Her
Majesty—!!
$#Antoinette(Antoinette)#$$&AntoinetteCold&$$@Center@$(That voice...!? Is it her...?)
$#Antoinette(Antoinette)#$$&AntoinetteCold&$$@Center@$(...No, it can't be. She's already...)

$#Antoinette(Antoinette)#$$&AntoinetteCold&$$@Center@$(If only I could at least be sent to the same
place as her...)

$#MessengerSoldier(Messenger Soldier)#$Sir, you must halt the execution and leave at
once!

$#Minister(Minister)#$What is the meaning of this? If we stop now,
that will actually cause a riot!

$#MessengerSoldier(Messenger Soldier)#$An incredibly large armed force has appeared
at the border and is advancing here...

$#MessengerSoldier(Messenger Soldier)#$If we don't evacuate now, there will be no
escape when they arrive...!
$#Galahad(Galahad)#$$&GalahadNormal&$$@Left@$Just explain the nature of this trial...
$#Minister(Minister)#$Wh-what!? Are you serious—damn it!

$#Minister(Minister)#$This execution is cancelled! I am getting out of
here...!
$# ( )#$I was saved. By that so-called "March of Death".
$#Galahad(Galahad)#$$&GalahadNormal&$$@Center@$I see... What a strange twist of fate...
$#Galahad(Galahad)#$$&GalahadNormal&$$@Center@$But what does that have to do with my king...?

$#Antoinette(Antoinette)#$$&AntoinetteSmile&$$@Center@$Oh, you haven't heard? There's a quite popular
rumor going around...

$#Antoinette(Antoinette)#$$&AntoinetteSmile&$$@Center@$...that the one leading the "March of Death" 
was your king.
$#Galahad(Galahad)#$$&GalahadSurprised&$$@Center@$.........
$#Antoinette(Antoinette)#$$&AntoinetteSmile&$$@Center@$Well, it is only a rumor...
$#Antoinette(Antoinette)#$$&AntoinetteSweat&$$@Right@$We're getting quite tired. And hungry too.

$#Antoinette(Antoinette)#$$&AntoinetteSmile&$$@Center@$But I saw her that day. It was indeed King
Arthur who was leading the march.
$#Galahad(Galahad)#$$&GalahadSerious&$$@Center@$How dare you insult my king...

$#Antoinette(Antoinette)#$$&AntoinetteHappySmile&$$@Center@$Then when was the last time you saw King
Arthur?

$#Galahad(Galahad)#$$&GalahadSerious&$$@Center@$About a year before the king set out on her
campaign.

$#Antoinette(Antoinette)#$$&AntoinetteSmile&$$@Center@$If you've been traveling all this time, you must
have heard how this disaster that befell the

$#Antoinette(Antoinette)#$$&AntoinetteSmile&$$@Center@$continent of Norden eventually ended. Along
with various other related rumors...
$#Galahad(Galahad)#$$&GalahadSerious&$$@Center@$........
$#Galahad(Galahad)#$$&GalahadSerious&$$@Center@$I choose to believe in my king.

$#Galahad(Galahad)#$$&GalahadShy&$$@Center@$But...I don't think everything you said was a
lie, either...
$#Galahad(Galahad)#$$&GalahadShy&$$@Center@$What happened to your country after that...?

There once was a girl from the slums. Everything she had had been taken from her—her parents, her home, all her possessions. Until one day, she was finally given something; a gift quite unexpected and unique—the crown.

keys.IntroText:
I'll show you what it means to be a queen—
The Almighty Queen!

keys.DescriptionKey:
And so fortune smiled on the girl, and she inherited the throne. But the throne was just a vessel for greatness. The effort made to fill it, the time spent tirelessly pushing forward in order to be recognized as a true queen—that was all her.
Soon enough, her domain echoed with voices praising her. But she didn't rest on her laurels. She kept on learning and improving herself, all to see the ones who had recognized her as their queen smile.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Why did she become the queen in the first place?
It was because of the stories she heard after she managed to escape the kill-or-be-killed reality of the slums—stories of heroes who always helped those in need. For a long time, they were the only bright spots in her dark life, like a cluster of shining stars no one could steal from her. But she was pragmatic, so she knew stars were miles and miles away. Unreachable.
And then she heard about the claim she had to the throne, and in that moment she immediately knew that it was her chance to finally aim for the starry sky.

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1519|$The people of Urg Roa and Me'Rizanté were
delighted by his return.

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1520|$But then he started distributing those
strange thorns among the youth.

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1521|$Aeon Thorns are inserted into the skin, and
give the user instant power.

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1522|$The young folk who used them did indeed
become immensely strong.

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1523|$But one by one they became corrupt beasts,
turning on even their own family.

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganDetermined&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1524|$Eventually, Druke too was driven to
madness...!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1525|$All this happened while I was away on a
campaign...!?
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1526|$Druke... He was Habsu's hero!!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1527|$The Chief must have summoned us because
his soldiers couldn't kill their own kin...

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1528|$Most likely. He also probably knew you
would learn the truth in Urg Roa.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1504|$Yes. A merchant delivered his request to
Rigland.
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$|Cont|$And the Corrupted are not easy opponents.

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$|Cont|$Despite their crazed state, they are still able
to utilize summons and monsters in battle.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1529|$...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1530|$Captain... What should we do?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1531|$We have no time for this! We have the
Pandemonium to deal with!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1532|$Lady Astrid?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1533|$This is an internal problem, and they want
to make us do their dirty work?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1534|$There are powerful warriors among both the
kud and sziviik, aren't there?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$They should be handling this matter
themselves!
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1535|$...I cannot argue with that.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1505|$We are making our way to the creatures'
base in the szi ruin of Lu'Ganan.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1536|$So what? You think we should just look the
other way!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1537|$Can you really walk away while the
xahe'oyai continue to attack people!?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1538|$I-I...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1539|$Enough! I will be the one who decides
what we do!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1540|$Gilgan, may I trouble you to provide
us lodgings for the evening?
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious;Ludmilla.LudmillaSerious;&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1541|$Of course.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1542|$Thank you.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1543|$We will spend the night here. I will announce
our next course of action in the morning.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1544|$Finn, Lady Astrid, I would appreciate it if
you would delay your debate until then.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1545|$Y-Yes ma'am.
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1506|$I see... Have you fought with any of them?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGritBlush&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1546|$...Grr!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1507|$Yes, we ran into Mysha fighting a big one
outside Me'Rizanté.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1508|$Unfortunately, we were not able to defeat it.
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1509|$Mysha... So she already found him...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1510|$Him...?

$#Ludmilla2(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act3.Voices/mst1501|$Alright, everyone is back. Let's head
inside.
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1616|$Captain Ludmilla...
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1625|$I cannot take up arms.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1626|$Are you afraid to face your own brother!?
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1627|$Fine... Stay here and cling to your anvil!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1628|$...Gilgan, we'll be back soon.

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1629|$That nestling has developed quite the
mouth.
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1630|$Druke... Mysha...
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1631|$I...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1617|$Gilgan. Don't worry, we'll find Mysha. You
should wait here in case she comes back.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1618|$Gilgan... You won't fight?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1619|$Huh?
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1620|$Your swordsmanship is on par with Druke's.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1621|$Even at your age, you should still be able
to take on the xahe'oyai!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1622|$Mysha is in danger! You are a swordmaster,
will you not go to her aid!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1623|$Gilgan is a swordmaster on par with Druke?
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1624|$Ga'Luga... I am sorry.
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$|act3.Voices/sst467|$...

$#DONTSHOWME(Apprentice)#$$|act3.Voices/sst306|$Master Gilgan is a tough teacher, but I've
learned much under his guidance!

keys.DescriptionKey:
Gloria Valen, daughter of Maximilius Valen, was born under a lucky star. Her mother told her so every day of her childhood. Gloria believed it until the day she died, leaving her in the sole care of her cruel and miserly father. Somehow, her stars never seemed so lucky after that.

She never wanted for material comfort. Her father's profound wealth bought her the finest cuisine, the most elegant fashion, and invitations to every noble estate in Bergaria. For many it would have been enough, but like any true heiress, she dreamed of more.

She dreamed of a life worth more than her family name.

Gloria01.name: Gloria
Gloria01.title: Gilded Heiress
Gloria01.description:
Gloria Valen, daughter of Maximilius Valen, was born under a lucky star. Her mother told her so every day of her childhood. Gloria believed it until the day she died, leaving her in the sole care of her cruel and miserly father. Somehow, her stars never seemed so lucky after that.

She never wanted for material comfort. Her father's profound wealth bought her the finest cuisine, the most elegant fashion, and invitations to every noble estate in Bergaria. For many it would have been enough, but like any true heiress, she dreamed of more.

She dreamed of a life worth more than her family name.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Unlike most Bergarian nobility, Gloria's father gathered his fortune not through inheritance, but through business. His eye for rich alchemical ore made him a talented magical merchant, selling enchanted weapons to the highest bidder regardless of allegiance or creed. Unsurprisingly, this earned him many enemies; Gloria grew up dodging kidnappers and assassins alike.

Lord Valen always believed his daughter's greatest worth to him would be her eventual marriage. He never saw the way she tinkered with his cast-off gems. He never saw the way she found beauty and power in what he rejected.

But one day -- maybe thanks to that lucky star of hers -- someone else did.

keys.DescriptionKey:
This unit has their Attack increased by 25% of its base. This does not stack with Enrage effects, but will stack with other Attack increases (e.g. 1.5x + 0.25x => 1.75x total).

When this unit defeats an enemy with an attack, if they are:
- Fire or Light, 2 random non-sleeping enemies gain the Sleep status effect for 100TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield.
- Storm or Earth, 2 random non-burning enemies gain the Lethal Poison status effect for 999TU.
- Water or Dark, 2 random enemies that have a current TU of 50 or less are stunned for 100TU.
These effects may trigger before or after other effects.

Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects, lasts 999 TU, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison, and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning or Boss units.

Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects, lasts 999 TU, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison, and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning or Boss units.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Sun Wukong)#$Looking for those that were still active,
we ended up here.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Sun Wukong)#$We weren't prepared to face someone like her, though...
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuPanicHappy&$$@Center@$Hello! BAAAAM!!!
$#ThiefA(Thief A)#$$&OniRedSurprisedMob&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Wha—Who are you!?
$#ThiefB(Thief B)#$$&OniRedSurprisedMob&$$@Right@$We're under attack! Get in formation!

$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkStareSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Not bad, you took Wukong's hit and you're
still standing! Now meet the Great Vajra!
$#ThiefC(Thief C)#$$&OniRedSurprisedMob&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Gah! How is she so strong!? This is madness!
$#ThiefA(Thief A)#$$&OniRedSurprisedMob&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You! Report to the boss!

$#ThiefB(Thief B)#$$&OniRedSeriousMob&$$@Right@$No need for that anymore. Our guard has
arrived.
$#Kojiro(Kojiro)#$$&KojiroSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I'm sorry I'm late.

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuBigSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Huh...? Huuuuuuh!? Finn, what are you
doing here?
$#Kojiro(Kojiro)#$$&KojiroSad&$$@Center@$You're the intruders, aren't you?
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkHappySmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ha, you want a piece of me too? Hyaaa!
$#Kojiro(Kojiro)#$$&KojiroClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Not good enough.
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkHurt&$$@Center@$Wh-Wha!?

$#Kojiro(Kojiro)#$$&KojiroSigh&$$@Center@$I'm so glad my hopeless sword skills could
be of use here...
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkHurt&$$@Center@$Guh... H-How...

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Vajra, what are you doing!? Hang on,
I'm coming!
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkShouting&$$@Center@$D-Don't... You'll just...get in my way...
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkShouting&$$@Center@$Nimbus! Take Wukong...far away...

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSadOpen&$$@Center@$What are you talking about!? I'm going
to fight!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$I could ask you the same thing! But first,
come with me!
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkHurt&$$@Center@$You can't...beat her... Just go away!
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuBigSurprised&$$@Center@$You can't beat her! Stupid Vajra!!!

$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkHurt&$$@Center@$Who's stupid here? You're always such
a pain...
$#Kojiro(Kojiro)#$$&KojiroSad&$$@Center@$Sorry, but I can't let you go.
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkHurt&$$@Center@$Gah... You'll let her go if I say so!

$#Kojiro(Kojiro)#$$&KojiroSurprisedSerious&$$@Center@$(Oh... She shielded that other girl with her
own body...)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Sun Wukong)#$$!-1!$No! Nimbus, stop! Vajra! Vajraaa!!!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$Go, you moron...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Sun Wukong)#$The last thing I saw was Vajra's smug smile.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Sun Wukong)#$She sacrificed herself to protect me.

keys.IntroText:

keys.DescriptionKey: Goemon's Gang's true target was never money or treasure, only freedom. They helped people oppressed by corrupt authorities, earning a reputation as noble outlaws.

keys.DescriptionKey:

Perhaps the one who needed liberation the most was Goemon herself—a woman bound by the shadows of her past.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Wukong was only too glad to wear the heavenly robe, but she wasn't aware of its original purpose. When she finally learned that it was a wedding outfit, her face flushed deep red.
"Whaaa??? It's that kind of robe!? No way!"

GokuBride01.name: Sun Wukong
GokuBride01.title: Celestial Bride
GokuBride01.description:
Wukong was only too glad to wear the heavenly robe, but she wasn't aware of its original purpose. When she finally learned that it was a wedding outfit, her face flushed deep red.
"Whaaa??? It's that kind of robe!? No way!"

keys.IntroText:
H-Hey! Do you have a sec?
Ta-dah! So, how do I look?

keys.DescriptionKey: Wukong couldn't wrap her head around the idea of a robe only meant to be worn for one occasion—especially not for a ceremony performed to unite two people for the rest of their lives. Her mind was always occupied with food, training, Tianzhu, food, Nimbus, food, food, food... She couldn't even imagine herself falling in love.

GokuBride02.name: Sun Wukong
GokuBride02.title: Celestial Bride
GokuBride02.description: Wukong couldn't wrap her head around the idea of a robe only meant to be worn for one occasion—especially not for a ceremony performed to unite two people for the rest of their lives. Her mind was always occupied with food, training, Tianzhu, food, Nimbus, food, food, food... She couldn't even imagine herself falling in love.

keys.DescriptionKey:
And yet, a certain name came to her mind—someone she could see herself marry. She shook her head violently.
"This kind of stuff doesn't suit me at all!" she yelled, but just as was about to take the robe off, she heard that person's voice saying, "That's a pity. You'd look so pretty as a bride," and she felt herself turn red as a beet again.
"I wouldn't! Stupid!"

keys.DescriptionKey:
Heralded by a roar of laughter, a golden-haired girl appears in the moonlight. She holds Ruyi Bang in her hand and wears Jinguer on her head...but she is not Sun Wukong. She is a different troublemaker, born from within Wukong. Her name is Vajra.
For you see, a girl with a dangerous mix of Yin and Yang personalities was once abandoned on Mount Huaguo...

GokuDark01.name: Dark Sun Wukong
GokuDark01.title: The Great Menace, Hell's Equal
GokuDark01.description:
Heralded by a roar of laughter, a golden-haired girl appears in the moonlight. She holds Ruyi Bang in her hand and wears Jinguer on her head...but she is not Sun Wukong. She is a different troublemaker, born from within Wukong. Her name is Vajra.
For you see, a girl with a dangerous mix of Yin and Yang personalities was once abandoned on Mount Huaguo...

keys.IntroText:
Just like Sun Wukong, and not like her at all—
Brace yourself, here she comes!

keys.DescriptionKey:
When the Monkey God took Wukong in, he was well aware of the two personalities dwelling in her. And so, he didn't only raise one of them, he raised both.
When Vajra finally emerged, she could wield Ruyi Bang, fly Nimbus, and use Monkey God's techniques just as well as Wukong could—because she trained just as hard, though hidden the whole time.

GokuDark02.name: Dark Sun Wukong
GokuDark02.title: The Great Menace, Hell's Equal
GokuDark02.description:
When the Monkey God took Wukong in, he was well aware of the two personalities dwelling in her. And so, he didn't only raise one of them, he raised both.
When Vajra finally emerged, she could wield Ruyi Bang, fly Nimbus, and use Monkey God's techniques just as well as Wukong could—because she trained just as hard, though hidden the whole time.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Born of Yin energy, Vajra is far more selfish than Wukong, and tries to make anyone she takes a liking to her servant. Still, just because she is Yin-aligned doesn't mean she is evil. She would never turn her back on those who are lonely or left behind, and cares for all her "servants" more than any other "master."
It seems that when the Monkey God decided to share one of the many names he is known under, Vajrang Bali, with her, he also gifted her with some of his best qualities.

Some say that the king owed his power to raze mountains to the ground and the authority he had over hordes of demons to this very weapon. Now that the fires on the Mountain of Flames have long burned out, it rests sealed by a certain immortal.

keys.value:
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuBigSurprised&$$@Center@$Vajra! Where do you think you're going
all alone?
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkStare&$$@Center@$I never lie.
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuStareLaugh&$$@Right@$Isn't that more like you, Vajra?

$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkClosedEyesDoya&$$@Left@$You really are stupid.
Yep, Stupid Wukong.

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuComicalAngry&$$@Right@$What did you just say!?
Wait, Vajra!!!
$#OrlotteCandyShopOwner(Orlotte Candy Shop Owner)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Will they be okay...?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$They'll be fine.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$In their own way, they really care about each
other. I'm sure they'll soon be like sisters.
$#TangSanzang(Tang Sanzang)#$Ah, this presence—

$#TangSanzang(Tang Sanzang)#$You've finally arrived.
I was worried about the two of you.

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuRelaxSad&$$@Right@$H-Hello, Master... I-I didn't think travelling
by Nimbus would take this long...

$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkStareComplain&$$@Left@$It's because you just had to make a stop in
that weird place!

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSadSmile&$$@Center@$You are right now. You've always hated 
seeing others lonely.
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuLookaway&$$@Right@$You said it smelled delicious there!

$#TangSanzang(Tang Sanzang)#$Now, now, you two.
Do I need to tighten the headbands?
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkShock&$$@Left@$Eek!

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuShock&$$@Right@$Master, I'm sorry!
Here's the letter with the sealed specter!
$#TangSanzang(Tang Sanzang)#$$!-1!$Oh... You've done a great job...
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuHappySmile&$$@Center@$I did, didn't I?♪

$#TangSanzang(Tang Sanzang)#$I guess I have no reason to discipline you.
What a shame...
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuShock&$$@Center@$What was that, Master...?

$#TangSanzang(Tang Sanzang)#$Nothing.
Vajra, have you found your path?
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkClosedEyesSerious&$$@Center@$My path? It's obvious.
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSadSmile&$$@Center@$Just like you hate being lonely yourself.
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkHappy&$$@Center@$WORLD DOMINATION!!!

$#TangSanzang(Tang Sanzang)#$Haha, what a lovely goal.
But save it for after we reach Tianzhu.
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkAnguish&$$@Center@$...Uh, okay.
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkAnguish&$$@Center@$(Not the kind of reaction I expected...)

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuRelaxSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Vajra, stop spacing out and help me with
the travel preparations!

$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkPanicShouting&$$@Center@$You might've joined here before me, but
you're still my servant, Wukong!

$#TangSanzang(Tang Sanzang)#$$!-1!$Wukong, Bajie, Wujing, and now Vajra—
my fourth disciple.

$#TangSanzang(Tang Sanzang)#$Is this Buddha's will?
Seems like this journey will be very fun.

$#TangSanzang(Tang Sanzang)#$May your journey be blessed with good
fortune as well—
$#TangSanzang(Tang Sanzang)#$I'm praying for you, Sir Finn.
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkPanicShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Stop making things up!
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSadSmile&$$@Right@$I'm not!

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSadSmile&$$@Right@$You came out of me to save Hot Wing,
didn't you?
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkClosedEyesThinking&$$@Left@$...I couldn't help myself. He was left all alone, I just had to do something.
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Before I knew it, I was outside.
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSadSmile&$$@Center@$Isn't that because you felt lonely?

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSadSmile&$$@Center@$You felt for him, because you've been in
the same situation, right?

$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkTongue&$$!-1!$$@Left@$None of your business.
We're two different people now.
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkClosedEyesThinkingHard&$$@Center@$No, that's not it...
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSadSmileClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Yes, it is.

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSadSmile&$$@Center@$When I cried on Mount Huaguo, you consoled
me by saying, "Don't cry."
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSadSmile&$$@Center@$I'm sure that was your voice, Vajra.
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkSad&$$@Center@$...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$I often wonder when I started hearing
that tearful voice...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Sun Wukong)#$I'm lonely... So lonely...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$Each time, I would wake up from a deep
sleep.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Sun Wukong)#$Dad... Mom!!!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$Don't cry... I'm here for you!

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSad&$$@Right@$"None of my business..."
Why would you say that?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$Once she'd stop crying, I'd get sleepy and
sink into complete darkness again.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$The last time I heard Wukong cry was
during her training with the Monkey God.
$#Wukong'sTrainingCompanion(Wukong's Training Companion)#$Wukong, I'm leaving the mountain.

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuBigSurprised&$$@Center@$Why...? You've been training so hard,
haven't you!?

$#Wukong'sTrainingCompanion(Wukong's Training Companion)#$The stronger you become, the tougher
the training is.
$#Wukong'sTrainingCompanion(Wukong's Training Companion)#$We can't keep up anymore!
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuLookawaySad&$$@Center@$"We?" You're all leaving!?

$#Wukong'sTrainingCompanion(Wukong's Training Companion)#$Wukong, I have no doubt that you will
become very strong.
$#Wukong'sTrainingCompanion(Wukong's Training Companion)#$But you'll have to do it alone...
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSadOpen&$$@Center@$No, wait!

$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkStareComplain&$$@Left@$Shouldn't you be making repairs or something?
You were telling everyone you'd help.

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSad&$$@Center@$Why...
Why does everyone leave me...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Sun Wukong)#$$!-1!$I'm lonely... So lonely!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Sun Wukong)#$Uwaaaaah!!!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$Quiet down!
Don't cry!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$You have me, don't you!?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$Stop crying, I'm always here for you...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$On the day we were separated into
Yin and Yang by the Monkey God,

$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$I was given the name "Vajra" and
trapped inside Wukong.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$I couldn't break free from her.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$All I could do was watch her journey
from inside.

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuNormalSmile&$$@Right@$Yeah, but now they're all saying the heroes
who defended them should get some rest.

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuPanicHappy&$$@Center@$Sha Wujing, Zhu Bajie!
Master!
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuPanicHappy&$$@Center@$Our next stop is Tianzhu! Let's go!!!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$Wukong kept making more and more 
friends and became so happy.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$It was hard to believe she used to cry
about being lonely all the time.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$Meanwhile, I... I was all alone.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$I finally understood why she was always
crying.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$I'm lonely. So lonely...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$Someone, please pay attention to me...
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSad&$$@Right@$Vajra?
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkAnguish&$$@Left@$...
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuRelaxSad&$$@Right@$They don't want our help anymore.

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSad&$$@Right@$You consoled me by saying, "Don't cry,"
didn't you?

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSad&$$@Right@$You were always there for me when I was
lonely and acting out!

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSadOpen&$$@Right@$I'm sorry for always leaving you all alone!
From now on, I'll be by your side!
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkHappySmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ha... GAHAHAHAHAHAHA!!!
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuHurt2&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Wh-What's so funny!?

$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkHappySmile&$$@Left@$Me? Lonely?
That's just not true!

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Again with the lying! We used to be one
person, so I know!
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkAnguish&$$@Center@$...
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Let's go home, Vajra. Together!
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkClosedEyesSerious&$$@Left@$Oh, I see...

$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkTongue&$$@Left@$Well, that's one reason less for me to be here.
Goodbye, Wukong.

$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkStareSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What you're saying is that you'd be awfully
lonely without me, right?
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkClosedEyesDoya&$$@Center@$You were always such a crybaby.

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuBigSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Whaaat!?
How did you come to that conclusion!?

$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkHappyHeh&$$@Left@$I just did. Fine, I'll go back with you.
As a simple act of compassion.
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuShoutingLookaway&$$@Right@$Y-You... You're unbelievable!

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuLookaway&$$@Right@$Fine! By the time we reunite with Master,
I'll make you admit your true feelings!
