$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$They were destroyed because of your fight.

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuShock&$$@Center@$Wait, we did this? Wh-What do we do!?
If Master finds out—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$What happened here?
Why were you both fighting?
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuUpset&$$@Center@$Well, it all started a little while ago...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(I guess the pain has subsided...?)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Sun Wukong)#$I was waiting for my companions to
come back...
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSad&$$@Center@$Master sure is taking her time.

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuStare&$$@Center@$Maybe Wujing and Bajie stopped to eat
something delicious on the way?
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuPanicSurprised&$$@Center@$Ugh! Keeping an eye on this evil specter is so boring!
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Chirp...
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuNormal&$$@Center@$What was that?
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuNormal&$$@Center@$It came from this direction, right?
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSmile&$$@Center@$Oh, there you are! It was you, wasn't it?
$#Chick(Chick)#$$&YakitoriBird&$$@Center@$Chirp...

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSurprised&$$@Center@$Oh no, you're injured! I need to tend to
you right away!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(She said I was the cause, but how could
I have been?)

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSad&$$@Center@$(The blood seems to be coming from its
wing. Poor thing won't be able to fly.)
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSad&$$@Center@$(I should probably stop the bleeding first.)
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuComicalWeap&$$@Center@$I wish Master was here...

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Poor little bird. Don't you have a
mommy or friends you live with?
$#Chick(Chick)#$$&YakitoriBird&$$@Left@$Chirp, chirp...!

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSurprised&$$@Right@$Wait, what!? Were those birds that just flew
away your friends!?

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuHurt&$$@Right@$Hey, flock of birds over there! Your friend
here is injured! Come back!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Sun Wukong)#$$!-1!$Come back...
$#Chick(Chick)#$$&YakitoriBird&$$@Left@$...Chirp.

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuHappySweat&$$@Right@$I-It's okay! My master will be here soon,
and then we'll find a solution!
$#Vajra(Girl in Black)#$$&GokuDarkLookaway&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Anyway, it's all your fault!

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuDoyaSweat&$$@Right@$I remember the direction they flew in. Once
everyone's back, we'll return you to them.
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That won't be soon enough!
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSurprised&$$@Center@$...!
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Why do you have the same face as me!?
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkClosedEyesDoya&$$@Left@$I don't. I'm prettier and stronger!
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSurprised&$$@Right@$Is this...a dream?

$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I don't have time for you.
Nimbus, over here!
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuBigSurprised&$$@Center@$Hey, you're mimicking my skills!?

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuClosedEyesDoya&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I don't know who you are, but only I can
summon Nimbus! So stop it!
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkStare&$$@Left@$Hmph, what are you talking about?
$#SunWukong(Girl in Red)#$$&GokuLookaway&$$@Right@$Nuh-uh! This is definitely YOUR fault!
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuShock&$$@Right@$Wait, why is Nimbus coming to you!?
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkClosedEyesDoya&$$@Left@$Ugh, I already told you.

$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkClosedEyesDoya&$$@Left@$It's because I'm pretty and strong,
and you're lame and weak. Ha! See ya.
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuComicalAngry&$$@Right@$Hey, wait up! Nooo!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Vajra)#$$!-1!$Hey, get your dirty hands off my cloud!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Sun Wukong)#$That poor chick is injured!
And get off my Nimbus!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Sun Wukong)#$Thief, imposter!
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuUpset&$$@Right@$So, that's why we ended up here.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Rescuing that little bird is the reason...?
$#Chick(Chick)#$$&YakitoriBird&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Chirp.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Do you two ever stop arguing!?

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuLookaway&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Anyway, that fake is in the wrong.
I'm completely innocent!
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkLookaway&$$@Left@$Fake!? How dare you! I'm Vajra!

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuHurt&$$@Right@$The bird is injured, and snatching it up
from me like that was just...just...cruel!

$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkTongue&$$@Left@$Shut up! Hot Wing is mine, and you're a
jerk for trying to steal him from me!
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuPanicShouting&$$@Right@$Stop giving it weird names!
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkPanicShouting&$$@Left@$Hot Wing is a great name!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I've heard enough. Stop this quarrel now,
both of you!

$#OrlotteCandyShopOwner(Orlotte Candy Shop Owner)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Forget the bird.
You just destroyed our entire village.

$#OrlotteCandyShopOwner(Orlotte Candy Shop Owner)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Right@$How do you plan to take responsibility
for your actions?

$#OrlotteCandyShopOwner(Orlotte Candy Shop Owner)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Right@$You're from the order, right?
Punish these two immediately!

$#SunWukong(Girl in Red)#$$&GokuShock&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Ugh, his aura... It's so similar to Master's.
My headband is reacting to him again!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Well, about that...

$#OrlotteCandyShopOwner(Orlotte Candy Shop Owner)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It's clear they're to blame! Look at my
candy shop. It's completely destroyed!

$#OrlotteCandyShopOwner(Orlotte Candy Shop Owner)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Center@$This place has been in my family for
generations...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$That's...really unfortunate...

$#OrlotteCandyShopOwner(Orlotte Candy Shop Owner)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Center@$They're at fault here and must take
responsibility for all of this!

$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You heard my story!
She's to blame! You know, the fake one!

$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkClosedEyesDoya&$$@Left@$This isn't my fault!
I'm pure and righteous!
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuShoutingLookaway&$$@Right@$Lies! All lies!
$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkLookaway&$$@Left@$What did you just say—!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Will you both be quiet!?

$#Vajra(Girl in Black)#$$&GokuDarkShock&$$@Left@$If you're looking to hurt us, do it to her
and leave me alone, or...uhh...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Quarreling like this is pointless!
You two need to work together!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So stop arguing about whose fault it is,
and try cooperating for once.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$How about this... Maybe start with just
holding hands for a bit?
$#SunWukong(Sun Wukong)#$$&GokuShoutingLookaway&$$@Right@$Um, me and this imposter? Nuh-uh.

$#Vajra(Vajra)#$$&GokuDarkLookaway&$$@Left@$You want me to touch her!? 
Absolutely not!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Fine, I have another idea. 
Just hear me out.

keys.DescriptionKey: Sun Wukong is a mountain rogue, and all the mountain animals are her underlings. However, at first, she was just a weak little child, abandoned by her parents. And the Monkey God up on the mountain just couldn't leave her like that, so he took her in and raised her. Now she has grown pretty big, but her curiosity is even bigger, so she was sent on a journey with a new Master called Tang Sanzang.

keys.IntroText:
Hey, hey, Another Master!
Where are we going next?

keys.DescriptionKey: During the journey, some bandits targeted Master Sanzang. But that's exactly what Sun Wukong the bodyguard is for! She hadn't been raised by the Monkey God for nothing. She rounded the bad guys up in no time, with the techniques learned from the Monkey God and her trusty size-changing staff. At first glance, it looks like she's unbeatable, but the truth is, even she has a weak point...

keys.DescriptionKey: "Ouch. ouch, ouch... I'm sorry, Master, I won't do that again..." Here's Sun Wukong's only weakness—the magical headband that Master Sanzang put on her head. When she does something bad, Master just says a word and the headband goes squeeeeze! Tsk tsk, poor Sun Wukong. She probably agreed to go on the journey so that she can have this headband removed... No, that's not true. When she was a child, the mountain might have been her entire world, but once she grew up, it wasn't enough anymore, so she went travelling to see the wide, wide world. And her journey has only just begun.

keys.DescriptionKey: The En are an order of Principality. Principalities watch over the peoples, protecting them from evil. They will protect that which they deem good at all costs, but they see only good and evil—no inbetween. For the people of Erden, this has made them a terrifying force, as many of their cultural icons have performed deeds that a Principality could perceive as evil.

keys.DescriptionKey: Le Fay is the leader of the nine spirits who reside in the distant isle of Avalon. She guards the Fruit of Wisdom, which bestows great knowledge to  whoever should consume it. It is said that she grants the fruit only to those who pass a series of trials. She is a cynic with a fondness for mischief who speaks in half-truths and riddles. This is part of the trials as well, as her persona helps Le Fay ascertain the true nature of those seeking the fruit she guards.

keys.IntroText:
Seek thou the island protected by the Nine.
The Fruit of Knowledge awaits thee there.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Le Fay can show one who has consumed the Fruit of Wisdom what glories their future holds. However, for most this path is paved with slaughter and ends in tyranny. Once the choice is made to consume the fruit, there is no turning back.

Le Fay well knows the ultimate fate of those who choose to do so. No matter what they decide to do with their gained wisdom, they will seek to return to Avalon once more at the end of their days.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Avalon is an expansive, living machine, and the nine spirits led by Le Fay are merely extensions of its will. It holds the power to produce the Fruit of Wisdom, but to do so, it demands the souls of those who die seeking its shores.

And so, all who have eaten the Fruit of Wisdom eventually find themselves returning to its source from across the seas. Those who gained the power of the fruit, and those who fell in pursuit of it. One and all, they offer themselves, body and soul, to Avalon.

keys.DescriptionKey: Many of Rigland's folktales involve dragons, and one of the most popular is the tale of Gila the Harpist, a young bard whose haunting harpsong moved the hearts of all who heard it. One of Gila's greatest admirers was Sarra, a renowned blacksmith. When Gripknaw the dragon kidnapped Gila and forced her to play for him, Sarra forged the Wyrmbane and slew the great dragon of the north to rescue her. The eye set in the hilt is rumored to be a real dragon eye.

keys.DescriptionKey:
There once was a hero by the name of Aymr Vanholm, known as the Eagle Knight.
He was blessed by the spirits of the winds themselves, and his swordsmanship was so fast and elegant that those who saw him thought him divine.
He defeated many fearsome beasts and demons, each victory another page in his heroic legend, and he became known as one of the greatest knights in history - the Blades of Erden.
Even after his death, the equipment he used in life retained the powerful blessings of the wind spirits. This sword is one such relic; lighter, faster, and sharper than any ordinary blade, it waits for its own legend to continue.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Aria, like all other Primordials, was born at the foundation of her world. Gifted with power over death, her duty was to judge mortal souls as they passed to the afterlife. With a touch, she could live each person's greatest triumphs and vilest sins, and with a swing of her scythe, she could snuff out any mortal life she pleased.

Aria could never understand why the living feared her. Unlike other Primordials, she wandered their world as she pleased, desperate to understand those she would one day judge. But all who saw her ran and cursed her name, beseeching their gods to protect them from the specter of death.

Eventually, a Goddess answered their prayers.

"Tremble before me, mortals! For I hold your
fate in my—H-Hey! Stop laughing!

keys.DescriptionKey:
Aria doesn't remember much of her world's first True God. She's lived a long, long time, and shared too many memories to keep them all straight. But she does remember the day Orcanix first arrived. It was the day she realized she, too, might someday die.

The Undead Goddess commanded her hordes to hunt down and destroy the Primordial of Death, the one power capable of opposing her. Aria begged the mortals for shelter, but all turned her away, too terrified of Orcanix's assassins to risk her ire.

Only one man proved brave enough to protect her. A noble lord from the petty kingdom of Sanga, who foresaw the destruction to come.

GothGirl02.title: Petite Primordial
GothGirl02.description:
Aria doesn't remember much of her world's first True God. She's lived a long, long time, and shared too many memories to keep them all straight. But she does remember the day Orcanix first arrived. It was the day she realized she, too, might someday die.

The Undead Goddess commanded her hordes to hunt down and destroy the Primordial of Death, the one power capable of opposing her. Aria begged the mortals for shelter, but all turned her away, too terrified of Orcanix's assassins to risk her ire.

Only one man proved brave enough to protect her. A noble lord from the petty kingdom of Sanga, who foresaw the destruction to come.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The lord and his trusted bodyguard offered Aria their hospitality, letting her do as she liked within their lands. At first, Aria mistrusted them, too used to mortal terror to accept their kindness blindly. But after years of their unflinching protection in the face of the undead, her legendarily prickly shell gradually gave way.

After an encounter with Orcanix's assassins left the lord's family dead, she decided she could no longer endanger them with her presence. She sealed herself inside her Primordial realm, asking her guardians to summon her only at their most desperate. Her imprisonment would ensure Orcanix never created a world without death, and more importantly, it would keep the two of them safe.

She would just have to get used to being alone again.

keys.DescriptionKey:
This unit can't have its Active Skills disabled by enemy passive skills.

This unit cannot be stunned or be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

Whenever this unit defeats a non-conjured unit on the battlefield with an attack, heals all allies on the battlefield for 100% of their max HP, and ends any enemy effects that are currently disabling the Active Skills of allies on the battlefield.

Whenever another ally on the battlefield damages any number of non-burning units with an attack, this unit is granted Sleep Thorns and has its current TU reduced by 50TU. If this triggers 5 times within 50TU, this effect cannot trigger again until 50TU advances.

This unit's attacks heal this unit for 100% of total damage dealt, will not wake sleeping enemies, and grant hit targets:
- Cursed Sleep for 200TU if this unit has 2 or more Water Allies on the battlefield.
- Lethal Poison for 999TU if this unit has 2 or more Dark Allies on the battlefield.
- Randomly either Cursed Sleep for 200TU or Lethal Poison for 999TU if this unit does not have 2 Water or 2 Dark Allies on the battlefield.

When a unit with Sleep Thorns is dealt damage by an attack, that unit's Sleep Thorns will be consumed to immediately grant the Cursed Sleep status effect for 200TU to the attacker. Burn or attacks that grant Burn will remove Sleep Thorns and prevent Cursed Sleep from applying. Cursed Sleep will overwrite status effects other than Burn, cannot be overwritten by Poison, can be applied repeatedly to units that have already slept while on the battlefield, and will not end from damage caused by Dream Hunter type active skills. Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects on that enemy, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning units or Boss units.

keys.DescriptionKey: Where it is birthed, Antheia is there. Where it grows, Antheia is there. Where it dies... Antheia looks on, graceful, hopeful for an opportunity for new beauty. A goddess of fertility who is widely venerated throughout Erden, Antheia's places of worship are marked with the sign of a honeybee, the creature most sacred to her. Pilgrims flock to her temples in the aftermath of a Pandemonium, in hopes she will grant a swift recovery to their devastated lands.

GreenElfMage01.title: Emerald Goddess of Spring
GreenElfMage01.description: Where it is birthed, Antheia is there. Where it grows, Antheia is there. Where it dies... Antheia looks on, graceful, hopeful for an opportunity for new beauty. A goddess of fertility who is widely venerated throughout Erden, Antheia's places of worship are marked with the sign of a honeybee, the creature most sacred to her. Pilgrims flock to her temples in the aftermath of a Pandemonium, in hopes she will grant a swift recovery to their devastated lands.

keys.DescriptionKey: The devastation caused by the Pandemonium has been increasing with each cycle, and despite her best efforts, it became harder and harder for Antheia to heal Erden's wounds before the next one began. Unwilling to allow death and decay to gain the upper hand over her world, Antheia has decided to do the unthinkable: descend to the mortal plane, to walk upon Erden with her own two feet, in the hopes that direct contact with the lands of Erden will allow her to bring about a faster recovery.

GreenElfMage02.title: Emerald Goddess of Spring
GreenElfMage02.description: The devastation caused by the Pandemonium has been increasing with each cycle, and despite her best efforts, it became harder and harder for Antheia to heal Erden's wounds before the next one began. Unwilling to allow death and decay to gain the upper hand over her world, Antheia has decided to do the unthinkable: descend to the mortal plane, to walk upon Erden with her own two feet, in the hopes that direct contact with the lands of Erden will allow her to bring about a faster recovery.

keys.DescriptionKey: Antheia's plan worked, and the lands ruined in the wake of a Pandemonium have become fertile and bountiful again in half the time it took before. However, walking the mortal plane is risky for a goddess. If something should happen to her, the consequences for Erden and its inhabitants could be dire. But Antheia is not afraid. She is confident that the mortals of Erden will soon find a way to break the cycle of Pandemoniums. The one thing she does worry about is how much she will get scolded by the other gods for endangering herself. Hence, she plans to take her time here on Erden.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Welcome to Evertale version 2.0! 

Please read on for a list of changes:

- Evertale has now been split into multiple servers.
- New in-game chat system.
- New art for some Offline Story characters
- New Alliance system replaces guilds - Pre-existing Guilds are now Alliances. Please see the Alliance help for more details.
- New in-server Ranking leaderboard - Please see Ranking help for details.
- New daily and lifetime missions.
- New Forge system replaces selling units - Please see Forge help for details.
- New VIP system - Please see VIP help for details.
- New Fellowship system - Please see Fellowship help for details.
- New Battalion and Platoon system for automated battles in new modes:
-- Tower of Trials
-- Alliance Quests
-- Arena
-- Raid (Coming soon!)
-- Alliance War (Coming soon!)
-- And more to come!
- New Chest that accumulates rewards while you are away.
- Game UI overhauled.
- Unit enhancement overhauled:
-- Relative strength between character rarities adjusted.
-- Awakening now boosts stats instead of level cap. Level caps previously achieved by awakening are now the default caps for units that can awaken.
-- Mastery limits increased.
-- New ways to Power Up units - please see Power Up help for details.
-- Evolution Materials and Exp Cores have been reworked into new items. Any of these you previously owned have been converted into their new equivalents.
- Reworked Mana and costs of activities requiring Mana.
- Changing player name now costs Soul Stones.

In compensation for all changes to old game systems, all save files that migrate from the previous version will receive 1000 Soul Stones.

Thank you for playing Evertale!

We are excited to announce that Evertale version 2.0 has been scheduled to go live between the 26th of January (UTC) and the 1st of February (UTC). The exact date will depend on the update approval process.

Please collect any unclaimed rewards and achievements, and make your final server decision by the 25th of January (UTC).

All guilds will belong to the server that the guild leader has chosen. All members who are not on the same server will be removed from the guild upon migration day.

Unless you are coordinating with your friends or guild members, it is better to avoid crowded servers. Competition within crowded servers will be tougher, and make the best rewards harder to earn.
After the update, changing your name will cost Soul Stones, so if you would like to change your name please do so before then.
Ultra Evolution and Power Up Fusion will be simplified to use fewer items. All Evolution Items, Weapon Cores, and Character Cores in your inventory will be converted to the new items.

Thank you for playing Evertale!!

With their horns and tails, they were often shunned by humans, but there was one village that welcomed them—a village saved thanks to their special abilities, one where the two races could peacefully coexist.

keys.IntroText:
There was only one thing she longed for—
The one thing the world refused to give

keys.DescriptionKey: One day, a dragonkin girl was born in the village. Gifted with exceptional power as she was, she seemed to only destroy everything she touched, and so she became an outcast. Eventually, she got locked in a dark sanctuary, where she spent long years all alone, always gazing out of the window—as if waiting for the day a light would shine in to save her.

GyurelleRegular02.name: Gyurelle
GyurelleRegular02.title: Myriadmask Aeon Lord
GyurelleRegular02.description: One day, a dragonkin girl was born in the village. Gifted with exceptional power as she was, she seemed to only destroy everything she touched, and so she became an outcast. Eventually, she got locked in a dark sanctuary, where she spent long years all alone, always gazing out of the window—as if waiting for the day a light would shine in to save her.

keys.DescriptionKey: In truth, her power didn't only destroy things. Having hated herself for so long, she learned to turn into other people instead. There was but one thing she wanted in this world, one thing she tried to get back by the means of a forbidden ritual. She made countless offerings, one after another, all created by herself, from herself. But after the ritual was performed a thousand times, the attempts stopped, and she started being known as someone completely different—the one hiding behind a myriad of masks.

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act1.Voices/sst7|$There are reports of a dangerous new
monster in Habsu. Way's closed for now.

$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Traveler)#$$|act3.Voices/sst224|$You look like you're on a mission. Do you
need any new recruits?

$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Traveler)#$$|act3.Voices/sst225|$There's a human near Urg Roa looking for
a quest to join.

$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Traveler)#$$|act3.Voices/sst226|$He says he's a Sapph Knight. I've told him
I'm not on a quest, but he's so persistent...

$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Traveler)#$$|act3.Voices/sst227|$At this point, I would pay someone to get
him out of my fur...

$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Traveler)#$$|act3.Voices/sst232|$Wow, you really recruited the Sapph Knight!
I guess the times are as grim as they—

$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Traveler)#$$|act3.Voices/sst233|$I mean, I'm sure he will be a valuable addition
to your team!
$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Traveler)#$$|act3.Voices/sst234|$Here. I'm a kud of my word.

$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Traveler)#$$|act3.Voices/sst228|$Hello there! I see the Sapph Knight has
joined you.

$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Traveler)#$$|act3.Voices/sst229|$He's been pestering folks in this area to take
him on a quest for months now.

$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Traveler)#$$|act3.Voices/sst230|$I hope being with you scratches whatever
itch he has.

$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Traveler)#$$|act3.Voices/sst231|$(whisper) Here, take this as a thank you
for giving him something to do.

$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Traveler)#$$|act3.Voices/sst235|$Hello again! Have you performed any
heroic deeds with your new ally yet?

$#DONTSHOWME(Winvy)#$$|act3.Voices/sst240|$Phew... Now I know why there aren't many
silvies like me in Habsu. It's so hot, vee!

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Villager)#$$|act3.Voices/sst236|$Travelers! You seem unfamilar with the
area. Allow me to give you some advice.

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Villager)#$$|act3.Voices/sst237|$This path will take you to Urg Roa. You
should turn back now.

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Villager)#$$|act3.Voices/sst238|$Me'Rizanté and Urg Roa were once allies...
But the kud can no longer be trusted.
$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Villager)#$$|act3.Voices/sst239|$Disregard my words at your own risk.

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Villager)#$$|act3.Voices/sst241|$What has occured between our cities is a
great tragedy.

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Villager)#$$|act3.Voices/sst242|$It will take time before we sziviik feel we
can trust the kud of Urg Roa once more.

Allies gain 3 Spirit. This unit is healed for 99.9% of Max HP, gains the Stealth status effect, and will immediately get the turn by having its TU reduced to 0. These effects are all triggered whenever this unit enters the battlefield from reinforcements.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The Sky of Omens—a supernatural event of unknown origin that occurred in the skies of Erden two millennia ago. The sun vanished, and the heavens blazed in the glow of a many-colored aurora.

Without the light of morning to chase away the demons of the dusk, Mirel and her comrades found themselves unable to rest. When the soldiers around her grew hopeless, believing the dark would never end, it was Miriel who urged them on, and when the sun finally returned, she was awarded the coveted title of High Angel for her bravery.

This unit enters battle with a Poison Ward, Endure, and Counter Stance for 150TU. Counter Stance will overwrite status effects on this unit. The next time the unit with counter stance takes damage from an enemy attack, it will become their turn.

This unit has 80% damage reduction from attacks. This reduction is lowered by 10% for each enemy this unit has defeated with attacks while on the battlefield (to a minimum of 50% after defeating 3+ enemies).

When this unit defeats any number of non-conjured enemies with an attack while on the battlefield:

- this unit gains a Charge. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges, and all charges are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield.
- all allies are Purified (negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed).
- another random ally is given the next turn by reducing their current TU to 0. Effects that influence TU order may interrupt the extra turn (e.g. Stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

keys.DescriptionKey:
A warrior whose name alone would terrify even the fiercest oni into submission—the famed vice-commander of the Shinsengumi.
Righteous and relentless, she was as stern with her comrades as she was with herself. She was the one who created the group's strict code of conduct, and, by enforcing it, transformed a band of rogues into a warrior elite.
The truth is, strictness was her way of showing them her affection.

She swore that she wouldn't let a single death go to waste and kept fighting, even when she became the last Shinsengumi member left alive.

keys.DescriptionKey:
A long time ago, a woman descended from the sky into a wild, unexplored part of Erden. She promised herself that she would live there doing nothing. However, one day she met the native inhabitants of the land—a nation weak and simple, yet gentle and peaceful at heart.
She gave them the rice plant she brought with her from her birthplace. She taught them how to cultivate it. She brought rain to end droughts.
They saw her power and revered her, and soon she was known as their "Lady Himiko."

HimikoRegular01.name: Himiko
HimikoRegular01.title: Priestess of the Sun
HimikoRegular01.description:
A long time ago, a woman descended from the sky into a wild, unexplored part of Erden. She promised herself that she would live there doing nothing. However, one day she met the native inhabitants of the land—a nation weak and simple, yet gentle and peaceful at heart.
She gave them the rice plant she brought with her from her birthplace. She taught them how to cultivate it. She brought rain to end droughts.
They saw her power and revered her, and soon she was known as their "Lady Himiko."

keys.IntroText: Rice! You shall all eat rice!!!

keys.DescriptionKey: Her people don't know that she makes the rain fall not with prayer, but with brute force. That the age she told them she was actually converted from her actual age into something more acceptable by Erden's standards. But they know how much she cares for them, and when they see how gloomily she stares at the sky sometimes, they know her homeland must be far, far away.

HimikoRegular02.name: Himiko
HimikoRegular02.title: Priestess of the Sun
HimikoRegular02.description: Her people don't know that she makes the rain fall not with prayer, but with brute force. That the age she told them she was actually converted from her actual age into something more acceptable by Erden's standards. But they know how much she cares for them, and when they see how gloomily she stares at the sky sometimes, they know her homeland must be far, far away.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Long before she was known as "Himiko," she tried to protect everything—but in the end, she couldn't even save her home planet. When she met her current subjects, she was still grieving over that loss.
She doesn't try to keep everything safe anymore, she just swore she'd do everything in her power to protect them—the people who gave her a new name and somewhere to belong.
No matter what happens to the place they live in now, as long as she has them, she can make anywhere her home.

And then, one day, she learned that she was a Vessel.

HokusaiRegular01.name: Hokusai
HokusaiRegular01.title: Paintbrush Virtuoso
HokusaiRegular01.description:
Hokusai Katsushika was an art prodigy with a promising future ahead of her. She started winning one art competition after another at a very young age.
And then, one day, she learned that she was a Vessel.

keys.IntroText:
Let me show you
the true beauty captured in my art

keys.DescriptionKey: Hokusai's parents and everyone who knew her mourned the loss of a future master artist to the Requiem. Hokusai herself felt dejected too. But then, she met Hibiki. Though she had mostly focused on still life and abstract art before, she found new inspiration in the grace of Hibiki's movements.

HokusaiRegular02.name: Hokusai
HokusaiRegular02.title: Paintbrush Virtuoso
HokusaiRegular02.description: Hokusai's parents and everyone who knew her mourned the loss of a future master artist to the Requiem. Hokusai herself felt dejected too. But then, she met Hibiki. Though she had mostly focused on still life and abstract art before, she found new inspiration in the grace of Hibiki's movements.

keys.DescriptionKey: From that moment on, she painted Hibiki and only Hibiki. Expressing her muse's raw beauty through her art became Hokusai's only purpose. To her, Requiem wasn't a long-dreaded hell, but a divine chance to portray Hibiki at the height of her glory. As long as she could leave behind records of true beauty, Hokusai didn't care how much blood she was going to get on her hands.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$|act6.Voices/mst3775|$Protect each other, and protect yourself!

HorseIdolGirl02.title: Thoroughbred Idol

keys.DescriptionKey: They were just about to wrap up their last number when it happened. She stumbled and fell, and just stayed down, unable to understand how she could make such a blunder at the very last moment. She felt her eyes well up with tears, when suddenly someone's hand touched her shoulder. "It's OK," one of the other group members said, helping her up with a smile. And just like that, she remembered that she wasn't alone, that they were in this together. Her bright smile back in place, she joined her friends to finish up the last dance of that night.

keys.DescriptionKey:
If at least 1 enemy on the battlefield is:
- Water, remove sleep (including Deep Sleep) from all allies on the battlefield and grant them Sleep Wards.
- Fire, remove burn (including Mega Healing Burn) from all units on the battlefield and grant them Burn Wards.
- Earth, remove poison (including Lethal Poison) from all allies on the battlefield and grant them Poison Wards.
- Storm, all allies who have a current TU of 100 or more have their current TU reduced by 50TU. This effect repeats once for each additional Storm enemy on the battlefield. Then grant all allies Stun Wards.
- Dark, grant all allies Stealth, and a Stealth Shield. This will overwrite other status effects on those allies.
- Light, all allies will be Purified (negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed). Then if there is no Purify Chain among allies a random ally is granted a Purify Chain.

This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use.

Stealth will overwrite other Status effects on affected units. Stealth Shields prevent the next non-stealth status effect a unit would gain while Stealthed from applying. Stealthed units ignore the next enemy attack that would damage more than 1 target. Any damage will remove stealth. A unit with a Purify Chain will Purify another random ally after their turn, then they will pass the Purify Chain to that ally. Purify Chains will end only if the unit with the Purify Chain is defeated, leaves the battlefield, or falls asleep.

keys.value:
$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Traveler)#$$|act4.Voices/sst331|$I was shocked to hear about what the elves
in Nushelle have been doing.

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Traveler)#$$|act4.Voices/sst332|$I find it hard to believe, but the townsfolk
here swear that it's true...

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Traveler)#$$|act4.Voices/sst333|$Demons in the guise of humans! How can
we trust anyone?

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst327|$The Red Dragon Knights are looking for
Callen?

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst328|$Have you come to arrest her for her
crimes, then?

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst329|$I cannot believe our city was infested with
demons...
$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst330|$I don't know what to believe anymore.
$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst320|$You better watch out for that thief Elmina!

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst321|$She stole all the best potatoes from my
garden!

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst322|$Perhaps Elmina had reasons for what she
did.

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst323|$But those reasons don't put potatoes back
in my soil.
$#DONTSHOWME(Guard)#$$|act4.Voices/sst325|$Oh, are you from the Red Dragon Knights?

$#DONTSHOWME(Guard)#$$|act4.Voices/sst326|$Have you come to get some tips from the
Hymelia Knights?

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst324|$Why in Erden would you want to talk to
an elf? Aren't you afraid?

$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act4.Voices/sst307|$Hello! Are you headed into the Forest of
Fae, vee?

$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act4.Voices/sst308|$It is widely believed that silvies like me
originated in that forest!

$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act4.Voices/sst309|$Some even think that people mistook us for
faeries, and that's how it got its name.

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst310|$Travelers! You look strong. You wouldn't be
hiring out your services, would you?

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst311|$There's a szi warrior up ahead challenging
passersby to battles.

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst312|$He has a scary skill that does a lot of
damage! I don't feel safe with him around...

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst313|$He says he won't budge until someone can
defeat him. Can you? I can reward you!

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst314|$You did it! Phew... I feel much bettter
knowing he's moved on.
$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst315|$Here you go, just like I promised.

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst316|$Travelers! Are you the ones that defeated
the szi warrior?

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst317|$He's been challenging passersby to battles
with his scary Blood Nova skill.

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst318|$I feel much better now knowing he's moved
on. Here, take this as a token of my gratitude.

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst319|$I wonder if that szi warrior is challenging
folk to battles somewhere else now...

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act4.Voices/sst339|$That's an impressive team of monsters
you've got there.

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act4.Voices/sst340|$You should try adding a monster that can
disrupt your opponent's strategy.

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act4.Voices/sst341|$There's a monster around here called an
Erish that can use Push Back.

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act4.Voices/sst342|$Hmm? What does it do? You should go
and find out for yourself!

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act4.Voices/sst343|$Tell you what, if you can catch an Erish,
I'll give you a prize!

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act4.Voices/sst344|$Well look at that, you did it! Did you try
Push Back yet?

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act4.Voices/sst345|$It's really handy for stopping your
opponent from unleashing combos.
$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act4.Voices/sst346|$Here, as I promised.

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act4.Voices/sst347|$That's an Erish! Have you been utilizing
its Push Back ability?

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act4.Voices/sst348|$By pushing your opponent's team members
back in their line up,

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act4.Voices/sst349|$you can prevent them from unleashing
powerful combos.

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act4.Voices/sst350|$Here, take these. Seeing an impressive
line up like yours makes me feel generous.

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act4.Voices/sst351|$How's your Erish? Have you been using
Push Back?

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst353|$A lot of folk here are nervous living so
close to the Forest of the Fae.

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst354|$There are all sorts of rumors about people
going in and never returning.

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act4.Voices/sst355|$When I was a child we used to dare each
other to go inside.

$#DONTSHOWME(Owner)#$$|act4.Voices/sst352|$Hello, travelers! Welcome to the Hymelia
Tavern! Best pies in all of Westland!

keys.value: $#()#$The wheels of fate are shifting...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Cinderella's Mother)#$Urp...

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$@Right@$You could not have picked a more suitable
name!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$So, what's Sleeping Beauty's...
Er, Talia's "Reverie Power"?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Left@$I'm still not too sure about the nitty-gritty,
but it's forced all her subjects into
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Left@$a deep slumber.

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitAngry&$$@Right@$Which is not the only problem! This sleepy
region is attracting more and more people!
$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitAngry&$$@Right@$One might call it mass sleeposis!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Left@$Since things got really bad, Hypnos sent
us dream spirits out to investigate.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Left@$Except, Snow fell for Sleeping Beauty's
trick, hook, line and sinker.
$#SnowWhiteCasual(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteEmbarrassed&$$@Right@$I'm so sorry! If only I'd been more careful...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I get it now. Alice, you called me here to
help rescue her, right?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Cinderella's Mother)#$So? What d'ya want?
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Left@$That's right. Ever the observant hero! ♪

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$But, uh... If you'd stopped to explain the
situation, I might've done a better job.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Left@$That's how much of a rush I was in! Besides,
I had no clue what was going on in here!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$What have you been up to this whole time?
Is there a reason you're showing up now?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Left@$I thought I'd wait and see whether or not
you'd make it out of Sleeping Beauty's spell.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Left@$If it didn't look like you'd wake up,
then I was going to step in.

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$@Right@$My, our Miss Alice is so sensible!
What grace under fire!

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$@Right@$Such level-headedness!
Truly, the most intelligent of ladies!

$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$If you don't mind my asking... If you're
capable of calling for outside assistance,

$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSerious&$$@Center@$why not summon a lot of powerful allies
and just overwhelm the enemy?

$#SleepingBeauty(Girl from Long Ago)#$$&SleepingBeautySerious&$$@Center@$I told you, I want to see Cinderella.
I've only asked fifty times.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Center@$...Oh.

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Th-That's because Miss Alice has
considered every possible contingency!
$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaComplain&$$@Left@$Such as?

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$@Right@$E-Er, well... Likeyouknowthis...
Andevenlikethat... Those sorts of things!
$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$@Right@$Wouldn't you agree, Miss Alice?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That's right! I thought that something like
this or that might definitely happen, maybe!
$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaComplain&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...Should we really rely on these two?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Left@$Anyway, we need to work on stopping
Sleeping Beauty! Everything else can wait!

$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I couldn't agree more, but what exactly is
Talia planning?
$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSerious&$$@Center@$Why gather so many people together?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Cinderella's Mother)#$Heh, you a friend o' hers? Hic...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Any ideas, Alice?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSad&$$@Left@$I would guess it's to make her power even
stronger, but... I'm not sure what then.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Left@$Whatever the goal, I'm pretty sure it's nothing good.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$Well, we can figure it out later.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$For now, we'd better focus on finding
Sleeping Be—I mean, Talia.

$#SnowWhiteCasual(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteAngry&$$@Left@$Sir Knight? I've been sensing some kind of
strange power for a little while now.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$You have?
$#SnowWhiteCasual(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteAngry&$$@Left@$Yes, it's both familiar...and repulsive.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceAttack&$$@Right@$Yep, I can feel it too.
It's coming from the top of the castle!

$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSerious&$$@Left@$That reminds me, my father would always
warn me never to go in that room.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Cinderella's Mother)#$So that piece o' trash can still make friends,
eh?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(That's probably how Talia's hiding her
location, since she can control this world.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Well, we don't have any better ideas now,
and it's better to be wrong than too late.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Let's go check it out!
$#SnowWhiteCasual(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteAngry&$$@Left@$Yes, let's go...!
$#SleepingBeauty(Girl from Long Ago)#$$&SleepingBeautyShouting&$$@Center@$Now that's just uncalled for!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Cinderella's Mother)#$I'm the one who made her 'n raised her.
That makes her my property, don't it?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Cinderella's Mother)#$But lately, she ain't comin' outta her room
at all.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Cinderella's Mother)#$Just slackin' off and doin' jack shit.
Damn good-for-nothin' daughter.

$#SleepingBeauty(Girl from Long Ago)#$$&SleepingBeautyShouting&$$@Center@$That's going too far! She's a human girl, not
livestock!

$#()#$They may grind on day after day without
change, but even one millimeter's difference
$#DONOTSHOWME(Cinderella's Mother)#$You just mind your own business, 'kay?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Cinderella's Mother)#$Didn't your mama ever teach ya not to
stick your nose where it don't belong?
$#SleepingBeauty(Girl from Long Ago)#$$&SleepingBeautyIrritated&$$@Center@$...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Cinderella's Mother)#$Huh, ain't you dressed all fancy. Kinda
like that squirt who lives in the castle...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Cinderella's Mother)#$Eh, whatever. You wanna see that kid?
Alright then, fork it over.
$#SleepingBeauty(Girl from Long Ago)#$$&SleepingBeautyIrritated&$$@Center@$Fork what over?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Cinderella's Mother)#$The toll, duh. What, too good to spare a few
coins? Some friend you are.

$#SleepingBeauty(Girl from Long Ago)#$$&SleepingBeautyShouting&$$@Center@$...I loathe you, from the bottom of my heart.
Take what you want and begone!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Cinderella's Mother)#$Well now, ain't you generous!
Nice timin', I'm all outta booze.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Cinderella's Mother)#$Go on up, Madame Friend.
$#()#$can make everything fall apart.
$#SleepingBeauty(Girl from Long Ago)#$$&SleepingBeautyIrritated&$$@Center@$...Sorry to bother you.

$#CinderellaPeasant(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaHurt&$$@Left@$Cough, cough...
Oh! You came to see me?

$#SleepingBeauty(Girl from Long Ago)#$$&SleepingBeautySad&$$@Right@$You don't have to get up, it's fine.
...Are you sure you're okay, though?
$#CinderellaPeasant(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaLaugh&$$@Left@$Eh, it's nothing. Just a cold.

$#CinderellaPeasant(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSmile&$$@Left@$Really, I've just got a cough, that's all.
Aside from that, I'm the picture of health.

$#CinderellaPeasant(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSerious&$$@Left@$More importantly, aren't you going to get
in trouble for slipping away again?

$#SleepingBeauty(Girl from Long Ago)#$$&SleepingBeautySmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I don't care what anyone says.
You're my one and only friend.
$#CinderellaPeasant(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaAngryClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Hm... You don't say.

$#SleepingBeauty(Girl from Long Ago)#$$&SleepingBeautySmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...Here. I made this for you, as a
get-well-soon gift.

$#CinderellaPeasant(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSmile&$$@Left@$Oh, wow... You even put gemstones on her
dress. It's a beautiful doll, thank you.
$#()#$I was all too ignorant...of reality.

$#SleepingBeauty(Girl from Long Ago)#$$&SleepingBeautySad&$$@Right@$It's fine, you can be honest and say it's lousy.
You know I'm no good at this kind of thing.
$#SleepingBeauty(Girl from Long Ago)#$$&SleepingBeautySad&$$@Right@$This was the best I could manage...
$#CinderellaPeasant(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No, I love her expression. I'll cherish her.
$#SleepingBeauty(Girl from Long Ago)#$$&SleepingBeautyNormal&$$@Center@$...
$#SleepingBeauty(Girl from Long Ago)#$$&SleepingBeautySad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Then, I'll make you another! So—

$#CinderellaPeasant(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSmile&$$@Left@$I already told you, it's just a cold.
You shouldn't worry so much.
$#SleepingBeauty(Girl from Long Ago)#$$&SleepingBeautySad&$$@Right@$Cinderella...

$#CinderellaPeasant(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSmile&$$@Left@$You know, when I look out the window and
see the castle where you live...

$#CinderellaPeasant(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I can't help but wonder... If I had been born
into a rich family and had kind parents
$#CinderellaPeasant(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSmile&$$@Center@$like yours, if I lived a happy life like you...
$#CinderellaPeasant(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaHurt&$$@Center@$Cough, cough...

$#SleepingBeauty(Girl from Long Ago)#$$&SleepingBeautyIrritated&$$@Center@$I'll talk to my parents! We'll invite you to
the castle, and we'll live there together!
$#SleepingBeauty(Girl from Long Ago)#$$&SleepingBeautyIrritated&$$@Center@$I'm sure they'll say yes. I promise!

$#SleepingBeauty(Girl from Long Ago)#$$&SleepingBeautyHappy&$$@Center@$And then we can meet and chat every
evening and all!
$#CinderellaPeasant(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaHappy&$$@Center@$That sounds lovely...
$#()#$I wanted to be with her forever and always...
$#()#$My most precious friend.
$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaAngry&$Right, your name is...Talia.
$#SleepingBeauty(???)#$$&SleepingBeautyHurt&$$@Center@$$%1%$Huff... Huff... Ngh...

$#SnowWhiteCasualStaff(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSad&$$@Center@$Please, you have to stop!
You've already used up all your power!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$She's right. If you push yourself any
further, you're just going to get hurt!

$#CinderellaPeasant(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaHurt&$$@Center@$(Coughing hurts, and everything is blurry...
It's hard to even just exist.)

$#SleepingBeauty(???)#$$&SleepingBeautyShouting&$$@Center@$No... I can't! I refuse to let this world die!
Even if it means...that I'll disappear...!
$#SnowWhiteCasualStaff(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSad&$$@Center@$Why go that far...?
$#SleepingBeauty(???)#$$&SleepingBeautyShouting&$$@Center@$Dream of mine, lend me your power!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$Tsk... We're just going to have to fight!
$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaAngry&$$@Center@$...Stop right there, all of you!
$#SleepingBeauty(???)#$$&SleepingBeautySurprised&$$@Center@$How did you... What are you doing here?

$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I remembered everything, Talia.
Absolutely everything...
$#SleepingBeauty(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySad&$$@Right@$...So it would seem.

$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaAngry&$$@Left@$How could you be so boneheaded!?
I swear, you're the biggest idiot I know...
$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaAngry&$$@Left@$You don't need to do all that for me.

$#CinderellaPeasant(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaComplain&$$@Center@$(But I want to hang on for as long as I
can...)

$#SleepingBeauty(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautyIrritated&$$@Right@$Cinderella... I'm glad that we could talk
again. But it's too late!
$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You've planned something worse than this...!? I'm begging you, please stop!
$#SleepingBeauty(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySad&$$@Center@$...
$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaShouting&$$@Center@$...Talia!
$#SnowWhiteCasualStaff(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$She disappeared...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$You said that girl's called Talia?

$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSerious&$$@Left@$Yes, that's correct!
She's the true Princess of Fresalia.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Wait, what do you mean by that!?
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Phew! I finally made it!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Center@$Took me longer than it took Polly to
put that kettle on, but I'm here ♪

$#CinderellaPeasant(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSerious&$$@Center@$(Because there's someone I want to keep
seeing.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$It's good to see you, Alice!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Left@$I'm so glad you're both alright! And you're
not under the dream's spell anymore, either!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceAttack&$$@Left@$And geeeeez, Snow!
You're one of Hypnos's Avatars!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceAttack&$$@Left@$You shouldn't be getting tripped up so
easily in someone else's dream!
$#SnowWhiteCasual(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteEmbarrassed&$$@Right@$I'm sorry, Master...

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitAngry&$$@Left@$That again! I wish you would stop calling
our youthful Miss Alice by such a stuffy title!

$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I, er, don't mean to be rude, but...
Who might you two be?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh, Cinderella! It's so nice to meet you!
I'm Alice, a, uh...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$@Left@$Hm... I guess it'll be easier if you think
of me as a dreamworld fairy?

$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$@Right@$And I am the Tavun Rabbit! I am this
sagacious young lady's loyal servant.

$#CinderellaPeasant(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSurprised&$$@Center@$(Hm? Someone's outside. That voice sounds
like...)
$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$@Right@$Pleased to make your acquaintance!
$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSurprised&$$@Left@$There certainly are all kinds of fairies...

$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$But back to the matter at hand!
We must stop Talia!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oooh, yes! The Sleeping Beauty!
Okey-dokey! We've gotcha covered!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$...Huh? When you say "Sleeping Beauty,"
you're talking about Talia, right?
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Yep, exactly.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSerious&$$@Left@$Her Reverie Power has covered her entire
kingdom in thorns and put it to sleep.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Left@$Of course, she's fast asleep too, in the most
beautiful castle you've ever seen!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Left@$So, a beautiful, sleeping princess... She's got to be Sleeping Beauty!
$#Tavun(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$@Right@$As expected of the wisest of maidens!
$#CinderellaPeasantHurt(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSerious&$$@Center@$(The thorns...vanished?)
$#Kyle(Kyle)#$$&KeiSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...Huh? What was I doing again?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Right@$I'd love to hear it all!
$#()#$Fresalia Kingdom, the royal capital—

$#()#$In its center stands a grandiose castle,
bathed in light from the setting sun.

$#()#$It is a castle without a single thorn,
like those found in dreams.

$#()#$It is home to two princesses, who have
seen each other through thick and thin,
$#()#$living happily ever after.

$#()#$It may sound like a dream, but I promise,
dear reader, that the story is all true...
$#ManA(Yunara Resident A)#$$&MaleVillagerAMobSmile&$$@Left@$You were dozin', too?
$#ManB(Yunara Resident B)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Right@$Yep, but when'd I even fall asleep?

$#ManC(Yunara Resident C)#$$&MaleVillagerAMobSmile&$$@Left@$I had this really long dream, but it felt
really short at the same time.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Right@$It looks like all the Fresalians who got
caught in this mess have woken up.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Right@$I'd say it's about time for us to head back

I'm Finn. Nice to meet you!
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteHappy&$$@Center@$Finn, is it? You can call me Snow.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Snow, huh? Got it.
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteHappy&$$@Center@$It's a pleasure to meet you.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$We may raise suspicions just standing here
like this, so do you want to go dance?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$I am a terrible dancer, but still.

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteHappy&$$@Center@$Don't worry, I am, too!
But yes, I think I'd like to dance.

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteBlush&$$@Center@$Enough of that. They invited people here to
have fun—
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Well then, take my hand—
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteHappy&$$@Center@$Okay, please go easy on me!
$#NobleA(Aristocrat A)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh, where has my fair princess gone?

$#NobleB(Aristocrat B)#$$&NobleNormal&$$@Right@$I just saw her dancing with a gentleman
I'm not familiar with...

$#NobleA(Aristocrat A)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Left@$Goodness, you say!? She's already found
a partner, has she? Hmph...

$#NobleB(Aristocrat B)#$$&NobleNormal&$$@Right@$Shall we direct our affections toward
the grandest rose of the bouquet, then?

$#NobleA(Aristocrat A)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Left@$You don't mean...Princess Cinderella!?
That is quite the daring idea—

$#NobleC(Aristocrat C)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Right@$I'd say it's more reckless than brave.
Or perhaps foolish would be more accurate.

$#NobleA(Aristocrat A)#$$&NobleNormal&$$@Left@$Who shall be the one to capture
Her Highness's heart?

$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaAngryClosedEyes&$$@Center@$I tried mixing things up for this ball, but my
little toy box is still full of nothing but junk.
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteBlush&$$@Center@$So that's what I'm going to do!

$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaComplain&$$@Center@$Could there really be a man that's fit
for me among these masses?
$#Percy(???)#$$&BaronYarrellNormal2&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Oh, there is indeed!
$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSerious&$$@Left@$And who might you be?

$#Percy(???)#$$&BaronYarrellNormal2&$$@Right@$It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance,
Princess Cinderella!
$#Percy(???)#$$&BaronYarrellNormal2&$$@Right@$It is I, the man you so wistfully desire.
$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaComplain&$$@Left@$Really, now. Tell me your name.

$#Percy(Percy)#$$&BaronYarrellNormal1&$$@Right@$As you command. Before Your Highness
humbly stands the Second Prince of
$#Percy(Percy)#$$&BaronYarrellNormal1&$$@Right@$the Azura Kingdom: Prince Percy!
$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaComplain&$$@Left@$The second? Only?

$#Percy(Percy)#$$&BaronYarrellNormal2&$$@Right@$Technically, in order of birth, yes...
However, I am superior to my elder brother
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteConfused&$$@Center@$Um, let's see...

$#Percy(Percy)#$$&BaronYarrellNormal2&$$@Right@$in both talent and looks—fit to be king,
they say!

$#Percy(Percy)#$$&BaronYarrellNormal2&$$@Right@$Besides, the Azura Kingdom is a vast and
great country—I am no petty nobleman
$#Percy(Percy)#$$&BaronYarrellNormal2&$$@Right@$like all the riff-raff here!

$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Who are you to spread such disrespectful
criticism?
$#Percy(Percy)#$$&BaronYarrellSerious&$$@Center@$Beg your pardon...?

$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSadSmile&$$@Center@$A nobleman's status originates in dignity.
Dignity radiates from how you speak, your

$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSadSmile&$$@Center@$demeanor, depth of knowledge, and
experience.

$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaHappy&$$@Center@$A narrow-minded narcissist like you?
Well, your status is probably lower than
$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaHappy&$$@Center@$the ants in the dirt.
$#Percy(Percy)#$$&BaronYarrellAngry&$$@Center@$Your Highness, what...

keys.DescriptionKey:
If any ally has Sleep Thorns, this unit cannot be defeated and is immune to Stun effects.

Whenever another non-conjured Ally on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, a random ally that does not have Sleep Thorns and is not burning will be granted Sleep Thorns. This may not trigger if this unit is defeated or sacrificed at the same time.

When this unit enters battle, it will Endure the next damage that would defeat it with 1HP, Endure effects cannot stack. This Endure will not be consumed while an ally has Sleep Thorns.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Once upon a time, in the northernmost part of Erden, there was a kingdom called Fresalia. Small as it was, it had significant influence over its neighbors, thanks to its formidable royal couple.
And Talia—Sleeping Beauty—was their only child.

IbarahimeRegular01.name: Sleeping Beauty
IbarahimeRegular01.title: Princess of Thorns
IbarahimeRegular01.description:
Once upon a time, in the northernmost part of Erden, there was a kingdom called Fresalia. Small as it was, it had significant influence over its neighbors, thanks to its formidable royal couple.
And Talia—Sleeping Beauty—was their only child.

keys.IntroText:
She was frozen in time for so long—
With nothing but her own suffering
to keep her company

keys.DescriptionKey:
Her childhood was marked by strict discipline and thorough schooling—in addition to regular education, she had to master etiquette, the art of socializing, and all the other skills that make a proper princess. She was never allowed to play with her peers, and didn't have a single friend. She saw herself as something akin to a doll rather than a human, and in an act of self-torment she made dolls in her free time. However, they were all taken from her too.
She was alway all alone—that is, until a certain girl came into her life.

IbarahimeRegular02.name: Sleeping Beauty
IbarahimeRegular02.title: Princess of Thorns
IbarahimeRegular02.description:
Her childhood was marked by strict discipline and thorough schooling—in addition to regular education, she had to master etiquette, the art of socializing, and all the other skills that make a proper princess. She was never allowed to play with her peers, and didn't have a single friend. She saw herself as something akin to a doll rather than a human, and in an act of self-torment she made dolls in her free time. However, they were all taken from her too.
She was alway all alone—that is, until a certain girl came into her life.

keys.DescriptionKey:
With her forbidden power, she made the flow of time in the kingdom stop for long, long years—until the entire country was covered with thorns. It was better this way. This way, she could be with her friend forever and ever and—
However, after a while, little rips started showing in the fabric of her dreamscape, and little by little the cogs of reality that she'd halted started to stir. Just as she was about to lose all hope, a girl appeared in front of her—a shadowy being roaming around the world of dreams.

keys.value: The Tale of Three Princesses
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelYandere&$$@Center@$You were never my real mother.

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimSadLookaway&$$@Center@$She couldn't bear repeating the same
dream any longer.

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelLookAway&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The two of us, hand in hand in the water...
but we have to be careful, because there are

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExited&$$@Center@$fearsome water monsters about! And here
I am, unaccustomed to swimming...

$#RapunzelGigant(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExited&$$@Center@$But my prince—no, Sir Finn—swiftly
draws his sword!

$#RapunzelGigant(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExited&$$@Center@$Dodging tentacles, he delivers the final blow!
We're saved...but where did we end up?

$#RapunzelGigantSuper(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExitedSmile&$$@Center@$Could it be that we're trapped on a desert
island?!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Um... Rapunzel?
Yeah, she's lost in her own world again.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceOpenMouthHeh&$$@Right@$Hehe, what an interesting girl. Maybe next
time, I'll ask her to think up a story where
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceOpenMouthHeh&$$@Right@$I'm the main character!

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimHappySmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Maybe I should ask her to think of a plot
for a brand new book...

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimSmile&$$@Right@$Well, that's for later. For now, I'd really
like to get back to reality, Alice.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$We need to find her!
If we don't, her heart might just break.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$Yeah, me too.
See you around, Alice. Say hi to Snow for me.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceWink&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, you guys are sooo demanding!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Center@$But since you've worked so hard this time,
I'll make sure you receive a proper send-off♪
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$Bye bye, everyone! See you next time!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$In the meantime... Alice, twinkle-twinkle
out♪
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Finn, I can hear a voice from this direction.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Is that...singing?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Distant Singing)#$$!-1!$At last winter has come...
My heart has turned ice-cold...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$That's Rapunzel's voice.
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimSadLookaway&$$@Right@$It's so beautiful and sad...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$There you are, Rapunzel!
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelYandere&$$@Center@$You're that prince.
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelYandere&$$@Center@$No, that was a lie too.
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelYandere&$$@Center@$And this world isn't real either.
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelYandere&$$@Center@$You were deceiving me. All along.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$Yes, I was.
I'm sorry, Rapunzel.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$I honestly believed it was for your benefit.
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelDespair&$$@Center@$My benefit?
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelAfraid&$$@Center@$Then please, stay with me forever!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$I can't. No more lies, Rapunzel.
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelYandere&$$@Center@$I see. So nobody will ever grant my wish.
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimSerious&$$@Center@$That's correct.
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimSerious&$$@Center@$Which is why you must do it yourself.
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelAfraid&$$@Center@$Myself...?
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelYandere&$$@Center@$My prince's love was also a lie. Everything... Everything is a lie!
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimSmile&$$@Center@$Yes. Only you can fulfill it.
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimHeh&$$@Center@$That's what living is all about.
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelLookAway&$$@Center@$I... I don't think I have the confidence.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$We'll help you.
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelSurprised&$$@Center@$Oh?

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimHappySmile&$$@Center@$In this world, if you ask for help, someone
will always listen.

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimHappySmile&$$@Center@$There are surprisingly many hopeless
do-gooders out there, Rapunzel.

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelLookAway&$$@Center@$Are you both sure?
I have nothing to give in return.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$No need. Your happiness is enough.
That's what friends are for.
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelNormal&$$@Center@$...Friends?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$Oh no, the world is shaking again!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Yes, your friends. Assuming you'll have us.
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelNormal&$$@Center@$...
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExitedSmile&$$@Center@$...!

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExitedSmile&$$@Center@$(I guess what I really wished for was to
hear words free from lies or deceit.)
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExitedSmile&$$@Center@$(A bit harsh, a little embarrassing...)
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExitedSmile&$$@Center@$(Perhaps those were the words.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Where are we?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$It seems we made it back.
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimSmile&$$@Right@$Yes, it appears so.
$#Jakob(Jakob)#$$&NobleHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, isn't that the Lady of the Tower!?
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimShouting&$$@Center@$Are we going back!?
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelSurprised&$$@Center@$My prince...?

$#Jakob(Jakob)#$$&NobleHappy&$$@Center@$Yes! I followed the yellow flower petals here!
To meet you underneath the rising sun!

$#Jakob(Jakob)#$$&NobleLecherous&$$@Center@$Just as I imagined, your proportions...
Ah, you're so beautiful!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(What will you do, Rapunzel? The dream
might start over based on your decision.)

$#Jakob(Jakob)#$$&NobleHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I was a bit delayed because of my quest.
My apologies.
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelYandereNormalSmile&$$@Left@$That's a lie, isn't it, my prince?
$#Jakob(Jakob)#$$&NobleHappy&$$@Right@$What do you mean? I speak the truth.

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelYandere&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You're late because you were either getting
married or planning your wedding, correct?

$#Jakob(Jakob)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Center@$Wh-What? How—
Well, I'll be damned...

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelYandereNormalSmile&$$@Center@$Your bride looked very beautiful in her
yellow dress.
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelYandere&$$@Center@$No... No more...

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelYandereNormalSmile&$$@Center@$And the way you gazed into each other's
eyes as you exchanged vows... So lovely.
$#Jakob(Jakob)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Center@$H-How do you know all that?
$#RapunzelGigantSuper(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelYandereAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I despise lies with all my heart.

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelYandereAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$But I despise myself even more. I accepted
that dream as if it were reality...

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelYandereAngry&$$@Center@$My prince...
No, you...prince-like thing...
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelShouting&$$@Center@$Get out of my sight!
$#Jakob(Jakob)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Center@$Eeeeeek!
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelDoya&$$@Center@$Goodbye, my prince.
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimHappySmile&$$@Center@$You've really awakened.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Yeah, you're stronger now, Rapunzel.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$Where are we?

$#???(???)#$$!-1!$Bravo!
What a truly happy ending♪

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceWink&$$@Center@$But I expected nothing less from my
two favorites!
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimColdSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$The dreamworld fairy!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Left@$Huh? Why are you in a swimsuit, Talia?
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimColdSerious&$$@Right@$Because you summoned me here at a very inconvenient time!

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimColdSerious&$$@Right@$Ugh, how about I just crush that little
rodent of yours!?
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceClosedEyesSmile&$$@Left@$Woah! So angry! So scary!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Tavun Rabbit)#$$%1%$Truly, every rose has its thorn!

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimPout&$$@Right@$Oh, I can't even stay mad anymore.
Just consider the time and place next time.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceWink&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Sorry, sorry, I will! Unless I get distracted by
twinkling little stars and forget♪

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$It's so cold, and it feels like my body is
being torn apart...!

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimColdSerious&$$@Right@$Well, maybe next time I'll consider making
some rabbit stew.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceComeOn&$$@Center@$No, no, please!
Finn, help!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Come on, Talia. Don't be mad.
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimPout&$$@Right@$I said I'm not angry. Just dismayed.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$To be dismayed is still rather rude...
But as long as you're not angry...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$By the way, Rapunzel, what will
you do now?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$After we return to the real world, you don't
need to go back to the tower, right?
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelNormalSmile&$$@Right@$May I accompany you and your friends?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Yeah, that would be great!

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$In that case, Alice, could you arrange for
these two to return to Fresalia?

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimClosedEyes&$$@Center@$This must be the continuation of Rapunzel's
dream. The solitary realm of her psyche.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceComeOn&$$@Left@$Y-Yes, of course!

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimSmile&$$@Right@$Good answer. I have someone I'd like to
introduce to Rapunzel.

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimSmile&$$@Right@$If no time has passed, she should still
be at the beach.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Wait, am I going too?

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimSmile&$$@Right@$Yes, she really wants to see you. She said
she hasn't had the chance to thank you yet.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$I guess I'll go and see her, then.
It has been a while.

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelLookAway&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Beach? I've read about those in books!
But...I can't swim...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$I think I can teach you. It'll be knight style,
though.
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelLookAway&$$@Right@$Knight style...?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Is that a no?
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimHurt&$$@Center@$...?
$#Jakob(Jakob)#$$&NobleHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Is everything all right, my good fairy?

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimSerious&$$@Right@$I'm not a fairy...
I am Princess Talia of Fresalia.

$#Jakob(Jakob)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Left@$Oh, wait...
Might you be the Lady of the Tower!?

$#Jakob(Jakob)#$$&NobleHappy&$$@Center@$$%1%$With your permission, I have a request...
Would you be so kind as to bless me with

$#Jakob(Jakob)#$$&NobleHappy&$$@Center@$the enchanting melody of your voice and
sing that song for me?
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimPout&$$!-1!$$@Center@$We have more important things to do now.
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimSeriousOpen&$$@Center@$You're looking for the girl in the tower, right?

$#Jakob(Jakob)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Center@$Wait, but I thought you were...
If not, then do you know where she is?

$#Jakob(Jakob)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Center@$Would you help me get there? This place goes
by the name of "The Enchanted Forest"—

$#Jakob(Jakob)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Center@$no matter how many attempts I make,
the tower remains out of reach.

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimSerious&$$@Center@$(Th-The world definitely flickered for a
brief moment...)

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimconsidering&$$@Center@$(I'm sure Rapunzel's wish involves her
prince...)

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimconsidering&$$@Center@$(The problem is that she met Finn first.
That's where the confusion happened.)

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimSerious&$$@Center@$(So, I just need to introduce her to this
Prince Jakob before she meets Finn.)
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimSerious&$$@Center@$All right, follow me.
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimNormal&$$@Center@$Do you see the yellow petal trail up there?
$#Jakob(Jakob)#$$&NobleHappy&$$@Center@$Ah, yes! The anemone petals!
$#Jakob(Jakob)#$$&NobleHappy&$$@Center@$How wonderful! Now I can see her again.
