$#Rapunzel(Tower Girl)#$$&RapunzelExited&$$@Right@$No, no, no, I insist.
It's such a special occasion—
$#Rapunzel(Tower Girl)#$$&RapunzelExitedSmile&$$@Right@$Don't be shy, take a seat here.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$(She seems so carefree...)

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ah, forgive my rudeness, I didn't
introduce myself. My name is Rapunzel.
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimNormal&$$@Right@$Maybe we should look around first.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$No need to apologize. I'm Finn!
I'm from Rigland. Have you heard of it?

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelNormal&$$@Right@$Rigland...? I believe I've read about that
place in a book somewhere.

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelSmile&$$@Right@$Oh, you have come from a faraway realm!
Over mountains, across seas,

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelSmile&$$@Right@$through deserts, and beyond the stars.
All the way from the edge of the universe!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$I mean... I wouldn't say that far.
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, you dropped something, Sir Finn.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Hm? Ah, it's from the petal trail.
$#RapunzelGigant(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yellow anemone petal trail!?

$#RapunzelGigantSuper(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExitedSmile&$$@Center@$So it was you, Sir Finn!
No, no, my prince!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...Prince?

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimNormal&$$@Right@$I wouldn't want to climb this tower only
to find a trap.

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExited&$$@Right@$Yes, I've been eagerly waiting for your
arrival, day after day, night after night!

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExited&$$@Right@$For as long as it takes to count every star in
the sky!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$I'm not a prince. You must've mistaken
me for someone else.

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExitedSmile&$$@Right@$You haven't forgotten our promise, my
prince. I'm so happy!

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExited&$$@Right@$Come now, rescue me from this tower
and lead me to the world outside.
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExited&$$@Right@$Right away, please!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$I don't recall making that kind of promise.
Besides, I've never even seen you before...

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelClosedEyesSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yes, our meetings were always at night...
Oh, my prince!

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExitedSmile&$$@Center@$Such burning words, every single one
etched in my mind!

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExitedSmile&$$@Center@$If only I could open up my head
and show you!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Good point. We have no guarantee that
the dream's master will be cooperative...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(Open up her...what? She's saying such
peculiar things, all with a smile on her face...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(Maybe she isn't aware of how strange she
sounds.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Anyway, fulfilling this girl's wish is
the mission Alice entrusted me with.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(The solution should be easy.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You want to leave this tower, right?

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExited&$$@Right@$Oh, yes, would you please take me away
from here, my prince?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Sure, let's go.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$By the way, how do you normally leave?
I don't see any sort of entrance or exit...
$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExitedSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I've never been outside.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Huh!? Really? I see...
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimSadLookaway&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yes... I certainly wasn't...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Isn't that imprisonment? She seems so 
carefree about it...)

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExitedSmile&$$@Right@$Come now, my prince! Take me away with
those big, strong arms of yours!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$Uh... Sure. Let's make our way down.
Hold on tight, okay?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Phew, somehow I pulled that off...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$(I wasn't sure if I could carry a girl all that
way...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$(I guess I have my training to thank for
that.)

$#RapunzelGigant(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExited&$$@Center@$Ah! Real soil and grass!
Amazing, amazing, amazing!!!

$#Rapunzel(Rapunzel)#$$&RapunzelExited&$$@Center@$I can run as far as I want!
And the wind feels absolutely wonderful!

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySwimSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Good job, Finn.
Is this the girl from the tower?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$She says her name is Rapunzel.
Rapunzel's Spring Melody

keys.DescriptionKey:
Born at the height of a historic snow storm, Yuki has always had coldness flowing through her veins. As a baby, she would summon snow flurries to rock her own cradle. As a child, she would freeze a nearby lake to go ice skating at the height of summer. Her friends and family marveled at her powers...for a time. But the human heart is a fearful and jealous one, unable to abide what it can't understand. On the eve of her eighteenth birthday, the village elders exiled her, swearing to her a swift sword to the neck should she return.

Their mistake was in thinking that she'd ever want to.

"Colder still than winter

keys.DescriptionKey:
Yuki made work for herself as a wandering mage for several years. She flitted from noble to noble who wanted the services of the famed Winter Witch, either for entertainment or for war. The spectacle of animating ice sculptures and burying opposing armies under snow was amusing, but without fail, she would grow bored with her master's mundane tasks and set off to find another. Erden, it seemed, held little of interest to a living force of nature. That is, until the Pandemonium began.

Rody and his friends approached her with neither fear nor gold, only a request that she use her immense power to help slay the Eternal. The prospect intrigued Yuki enough for her to comply.

If she'd known how their quest would end, she'd never have dared.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Eighteen years later, the Winter Witch is a legend whispered in the dark, never too loudly, lest they attract her attention and potentially, her ire.

They say she lives in a mountain of ice, freezing the blood of all who seek her out.

They say her storms shatter castles like glass.

They say that she is winter's mad queen, another curse upon the world, filling the void left by the end of the Pandemonium.

They do not know that she is merely Yuki, heartbroken by the fate of her only friends, lashing out at a world she has never understood.

$#Crowley(Crowley)#$$&CrowleyAngry&$$@Right@$Now, Antares. What did you do during
the concert?
$#Antares(Antares)#$$&AntaresSchoolScared&$$@Center@$...ah.
$#Mirai(Mirai)#$$&MiraiEyesClosed&$$@Center@$...goodbye, Antares.

$#Antares(Antares)#$$&AntaresSchoolSad&$$@Center@$(She's in a wheelchair. I guess she's not
okay after all.)

$#Mirai(Mirai)#$$&MiraiSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Are you really going to blame Antares
over some stranger's shakycam?

$#Mirai(Mirai)#$$&MiraiShouting&$$@Right@$What gives you the right to talk to her
like that?
$#Crowley(Crowley)#$$&CrowleySerious&$$@Left@$You know what gives me the right.

$#Crowley(Crowley)#$$&CrowleyAngry&$$@Left@$I will let no threat to this world's safety
pass, no matter how small.
$#Crowley(Crowley)#$$&CrowleyAngry&$$@Left@$In that, I speak for the Church.
$#Antares(Antares)#$$&AntaresSchoolSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Church...?

$#Mirai(Mirai)#$$&MiraiSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...Crowley. Let me speak with Antares.
Alone.
$#Crowley(Crowley)#$$&CrowleyAngry&$$@Left@$What? But—
$#Antares(Antares)#$$&AntaresSchoolSad&$$@Left@$I... well...
$#Mirai(Mirai)#$$&MiraiShouting&$$@Right@$I wasn't asking!

$#Crowley(Crowley)#$$&CrowleyShouting&$$@Left@$...!
Gh...

$#Crowley(Crowley)#$$&CrowleyAngry&$$@Left@$F-fine, then... But don't think this
clears you of suspicion, Antares.
$#Mirai(Mirai)#$$&MiraiHurt&$$@Center@$Nngh...
$#Antares(Antares)#$$&AntaresSchoolScared&$$@Center@$Mirai?! You're bleeding! Are you okay?!
$#Mirai(Mirai)#$$&MiraiShouting&$$@Center@$I'm fine! Don't touch me!
$#Antares(Antares)#$$&AntaresSchoolSad&$$@Center@$Mirai...
$#Mirai(Mirai)#$$&MiraiSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You must know by now what my Gift is.
$#Antares(Antares)#$$&AntaresSchoolSurprised&$$@Left@$The power given to you by the Goddess...

$#Antares(Antares)#$$&AntaresSchoolSad&$$@Left@$Everyone who heard you sing looked
like they were being hypnotized.

$#Crowley(Crowley)#$$&CrowleySmugSmile&$$@Right@$Not feeling up to answering? Then how
about this?

$#Mirai(Mirai)#$$&MiraiEyesClosed&$$@Right@$That's right. That's my Gift.
The Goddess's Voice.

$#Mirai(Mirai)#$$&MiraiSerious&$$@Right@$Using her Voice, I can command people
to do what I want them to.
$#Antares(Antares)#$$&AntaresSchoolSad&$$@Left@$Ah... Then, Mr. Crowley...

$#Mirai(Mirai)#$$&MiraiSerious&$$@Right@$That's not the only way my Gift can
be used, though.

$#Mirai(Mirai)#$$&MiraiSad&$$@Right@$The Goddess's absence has caused so
many disasters, and so much suffering.

$#Mirai(Mirai)#$$&MiraiSad&$$@Right@$People are scared, desperate. It's my job
to reassure them.

$#Mirai(Mirai)#$$&MiraiSerious&$$@Right@$That's why I'm allowed out of the
Academy. Why I can be an i— ugh!
$#Antares(Antares)#$$&AntaresSchoolScared&$$@Left@$Mirai!
$#Mirai(Mirai)#$$&MiraiSadSmile&$$@Right@$...I'm fine.

$#Antares(Antares)#$$&AntaresSchoolShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$They're making you sing like this,
aren't they? When you're so sick?
$#Antares(Antares)#$$&AntaresModernShouting&$$@Center@$Is this... a video? It's smartphone footage...

$#Antares(Antares)#$$&AntaresSchoolShouting&$$@Center@$You can tell them no! This isn't right!
They shouldn't be using you like this!

$#Antares(Antares)#$$&AntaresSchoolSad&$$@Center@$You need treatment. You're a Vessel,
after all, and... with the Requiem...
$#Mirai(Mirai)#$$&MiraiSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Are you worried for me?

keys.DescriptionKey:
Mirai Narukami, number one idol across all global charts, sings with the voice of the Goddess. Does a Goddess need a microphone to be heard? 

Probably not. But she insisted on this adorable prop in her first live performance, and she hasn't gone without it since.

IdolMic01.name: Trusty Microphone
IdolMic01.description:
Mirai Narukami, number one idol across all global charts, sings with the voice of the Goddess. Does a Goddess need a microphone to be heard? 

Probably not. But she insisted on this adorable prop in her first live performance, and she hasn't gone without it since.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The idol's voice was so sweet, and so unimaginably strong, that the tabloids insisted her signature microphone was enchanted. Surely anyone who held it could sound as marvelous as she did. 

When she heard this, the idol invited her accusers onstage at her next concert and challenged them to sing into her 'magical' mic stand. 

The rumor died that very night.

IdolStaff01.description:
The idol's voice was so sweet, and so unimaginably strong, that the tabloids insisted her signature microphone was enchanted. Surely anyone who held it could sound as marvelous as she did. 

When she heard this, the idol invited her accusers onstage at her next concert and challenged them to sing into her 'magical' mic stand. 

The rumor died that very night.

keys.IntroText:
With a smile sweet as candy, she raises her voice. 
Her staff spins her song into sugar.

keys.DescriptionKey:
I still remember the look on my mother's face when she gave me this sword.
"We of the branch family are shadows. The gathering clouds that sweep across the moon that is the royal family."
She apologized that she couldn't raise me in the main family, and looked away.

I wanted to tell her it didn't matter, so long as I could protect Sanga. But the words died on my lips.

Even so, without this blade, I would never have met my Master. Fate, it seems, is a fickle thing.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Those who carry the royal blood of Sanga inherit two vows: a vow to protect their homeland, and a vow to guard the shrine of the Death Primordial.

Since birth, Ryouma has borne these vows, not that anyone knows. As a bastard, his blood is as much a secret as the stone door beneath the shogun's palace, the gateway between the world of the living and the dead. His mother raised him to live as a shadow, silently slipping along behind those in the light.

Perhaps, if he had inherited his father's wisdom instead of his pride, he could have obeyed her. But Ryouma was born a warrior through and through, and thus he sought one day to hunt the dragon with no name.

IkemenSamurai01.name: Ryouma
IkemenSamurai01.title: Warrior of the Nameless Beast

Perhaps, if he had inherited his father's wisdom instead of his pride, he could have obeyed her. But Ryouma was born a warrior through and through, and thus he sought one day to hunt the dragon with no name.

keys.IntroText:
"Know thine own path, thine own purpose
and ever shall your blade strike true."

keys.DescriptionKey:
The ancient dragons of Erden bore grand names: Fornaxos, Kaidaros, Altaireon, Diabolos. All were silenced when the Goddess came, never to be spoken again. Only the dragon who slithered between the stars survived to see the new world.

Ryouma located this beast in his mountain lair, determined to prove his blade could best a dragon. He gave the beast a good fight, but in the end, could not overcome his nimble grace and speed. Satisfied with his effort, he submitted himself to a warrior's death, certain no one he left behind would miss him.

The dragon, having glimpsed the young warrior's true potential, refused to kill him, and instead made him his apprentice.

keys.DescriptionKey:
When Ryouma mastered the dragon's sword technique, he honored him by sharing his true name at last, then bid him return to his kingdom. At first, the people marveled at his skill, forcing the shogun to honor him with a place among his guard.

But honor breeds resentment, and shadows wither in the sun. When the time came for Ryouma's companions to cover his flank, they abandoned him instead.

All the mastery in the world cannot turn one blade into ten. As ever, he fought valiantly, but this time, the proud dragon warrior met his end.

At least, so the legend goes. Little do the storytellers know that samurai and his nameless dragon live still, preserved from death by powers beyond their control, destined to one day meet again.

keys.DescriptionKey: Inanna is a goddess of abundance and renewal. However, her expression of this is unique among gods. Inanna falls out of favor with worshipers every few centuries. Yet, other religions pop up inspired by her. Inanna is a beautiful goddess, but one without pride. She lives forever in the identities of every beautiful goddess after her.

Inanna01.description: Inanna is a goddess of abundance and renewal. However, her expression of this is unique among gods. Inanna falls out of favor with worshipers every few centuries. Yet, other religions pop up inspired by her. Inanna is a beautiful goddess, but one without pride. She lives forever in the identities of every beautiful goddess after her.

keys.DescriptionKey: Every culture has a religious expression of beauty, and thus Inanna exists so long as religion exists. In the long-term, Inanna's agenda is one of dominance. keys.DescriptionKey:
Jeanne and Mikaela d'Arc were born a strange set of twins. Mikaela arrived first, a few minutes before the last midnight of winter, while Jeanne came in the first hours of spring. The town priestess insisted the birth was an omen from His Radiance, though she never said what it foretold.

Though technically the same age, it seemed only natural to call Mikaela the older sister. She was, after all, the more outgoing one, the braver one. The town cooed over her, the little warrior, so devoted to seeing Jeanne safe and happy.

And Jeanne loved Mikaela more than anyone in the world.

Jeanne01.name: Jeanne d'Arc
Jeanne01.title: Maiden of Radiance
Jeanne01.description:
Jeanne and Mikaela d'Arc were born a strange set of twins. Mikaela arrived first, a few minutes before the last midnight of winter, while Jeanne came in the first hours of spring. The town priestess insisted the birth was an omen from His Radiance, though she never said what it foretold.

Though technically the same age, it seemed only natural to call Mikaela the older sister. She was, after all, the more outgoing one, the braver one. The town cooed over her, the little warrior, so devoted to seeing Jeanne safe and happy.

And Jeanne loved Mikaela more than anyone in the world.

keys.IntroText:
"I leave my life in your hands, oh Lord.
Make of me a good and faithful servant."

keys.DescriptionKey:
Though Jeanne often stayed in the shadow of her sister, the village noticed her piety. She obeyed the church's teachings, prayed often, and helped who she could in her own shy way. Many suspected she would become the priestess's acolyte when she came of age, just as they said Mikaela would join the holy army.

Sadly, neither would come to pass.

When the war took a turn for the worse, their village found itself alone in the dark, without defense. Jeanne and Mikaela ran for the church together, hoping that if they reached its sacred ground, they'd be safe.

They were right: the demons couldn't breach the church. But only Jeanne made it there alive.

keys.DescriptionKey:
"And to the maiden, in her grief, an angel shall appear.
Robed in white, her wings will scatter sorrow,
sowing courage where once doubt reigned.

In the falling darkness, she will be a light unto
her people, a beacon of His Radiance's blessings,
pure in thought and deed. A queen to her country,
a servant to her god.

By her hand shall her home be saved.
By her faith shall the farmer be made soldier.
By her sacrifice shall the demons break and burn.

So has His Radiance shown me, and so shall it be."

-- Prophecy of Holy Maiden Seraphine

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The demons... they've disappeared!
Are we safe...?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Did all that light come from you, sis?
Incredible! You're amazing!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSerious&$$@Right@$No, it wasn't me. Only an exceptionally
powerful prayer could...

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...peace has returned to us, it seems.
I must take stock of our losses.

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Right@$High Priestess, if you please, I shall do it.
You need to rest.

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSmile&$$@Right@$Sister Philomene! The demon horde is
fleeing at last!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Right@$Jeanne, you have to fight!

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSmile&$$@Left@$Thank His Radiance! Our prayers have
been answered. Yet, safety is fleeting...

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Left@$Beyond the circle of light, the demons lie
in wait. We must not let down our guard.

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSad&$$@Right@$No... What would become of us were the
light to dim?

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Left@$Were that to happen, it would spell the
end of days for us all.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Left@$We must pray without pause, through the
night. I'm afraid we've no other option.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$$!-1!$All night? For how many days must we
perform such a task?

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Center@$I cannot say. It may be days, or weeks, or
perhaps, even months...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$$!-1!$But if we pray for so long, won't we lose
some of our own to exhaustion?

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Left@$I'm afraid so. Undoubtedly some lives will
be lost.

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSurprised&$$@Right@$Sister Philomene, surely you cannot mean
to have us pray until our final breaths...?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantScared&$$@Left@$I... I...

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneShout&$$@Left@$Do you not hear their screeching? It is the
voice of evil, mocking us.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Left@$We must resist until we collapse, lest
Domienne be engulfed in darkness.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Left@$We have no other choice. Now come, good
people. Let us gather at the altar.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...I should join them.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Right@$Are you serious?! You can't believe sitting
in a church is gonna keep you safe!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantShouting&$$@Left@$What else can we do? You saw it earlier.
Demons burn from the light of prayer!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Right@$Look at the sky. Demons are gathering!
I can hear their wings from here!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Right@$Prayer alone can't save you anymore. If
you want to survive, you'll have to fight!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Left@$How am I supposed to do that?! I've never
even held a sword before!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Right@$Don't you remember what I told you?!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantScared&$$@Left@$(The townsfolk are being carried away!
I have to do something!)

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Right@$You are the hero garbed in white! You've
been chosen by His Radiance himself!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantShouting&$$@Left@$That isn't possible! I lost to that demon,
didn't I? There's no way I'm a hero!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSerious&$$@Right@$...fine. If you don't believe, the fight is
useless anyway.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Right@$You have a choice, Jeanne. You can pray
at the altar. Fruitlessly. Or...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantScared&$$@Left@$...Or?

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Right@$Or you can have faith in your big sister.
You can become what Domienne needs.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Left@$........

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Center@$Unless the demons are stopped right now,
they will advance to the capital.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSerious&$$@Center@$Countless lives will be lost. However, the
scripture says we can defeat them here.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSerious&$$@Center@$Moreover, it says... well, that I am to be
the one who defeats them.

keys.value:
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantScared&$$@Center@$Eveliiiiiine! Please, h-help me! There's a
g-g-ghost haunting m-me!
$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Um, Jeanne? Are you there?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Left@$W-wha...? Didn't that hurt? ...Oh, that's
right, I keep forgetting it's all in my head.
$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Right@$Um, right...

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Left@$This brat! Ignoring me like that, I'll show
her! This time I won't hold back!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Left@$Hah! Yah! Aaaand this! And that!
Hyaaaah!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$She didn't react at all. It seems Eveline
can't feel Michelle even a bit.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSerious&$$@Center@$...hmm. I see, I suppose it makes sense.
I am an angel, after all.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantScared&$$!-1!$$@Left@$If you can't see her, that proves I'm crazy!
Check the scripture, maybe there's a cure!

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSurprised&$$@Right@$Are you asking me to cast holy magic on
you? ...Unfortunately, I cannot do so.

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSad&$$@Right@$Sister Philomene hasn't yet allowed me to
practice it. My apologies.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Center@$I told you, I'm not a ghost! Just look at
these fluffy wings! I'm a beautiful angel!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Left@$Oh... no, don't apologize. I'm the one who's
going insane...

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSad&$$@Right@$Yes, well. I'm a little jealous of your
insanity.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Left@$You are?

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Right@$Many people see their lost loved ones
again in dreams. But I never have.

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSad&$$@Right@$Just once more, even as a waking dream...
I'd go a little crazy to see Michelle again.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSerious&$$@Left@$Eveline, I... I understand. You've been
grieving on your own, all this time...

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSad&$$@Right@$Grieving? N-No, I'm not grieving anymore.
I just think of her on occasion.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleHappy&$$@Left@$On occasion?' Yeah, right! Admit it, you've
missed me a ton!

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSad&$$@Right@$Even so, she persists in my thoughts.
There's a memory of her I often recall.
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Left@$Oh, really?

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What is it, Jeanne? You're making quite
the fuss.

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Right@$Do you remember when Michelle claimed
she pressed a flower in my Luminarium?

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Right@$"I pressed it just for you," she said. She
was so proud. I couldn't wait to see.

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Right@$Yet when I opened my scriptures, I saw
not a pressed flower, but...

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleHappy&$$@Left@$A worm! Clever, right? A book-worm for
our little bookworm!

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSad&$$@Right@$...a worm. An awful, creepy, dirty worm.
I shudder just remembering it.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSmiling&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(That's right. They may have been close,
but they bickered like a married couple.)

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I'm loath to disrespect the dead, but I'd
have some choice words for your sister.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSmiling&$$@Left@$W-well, if it makes you feel better, by all
means speak your mind...
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hey! And here I was, being all nice!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Center@$Just because I'm dead, you think you can
say whatever you please? Is that it?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantScared&$$@Left@$Eveline, th-there's really something wrong
with me! I'm seeing... Michelle...
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Center@$Think again!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Woah! What a strong gust of wind!

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSurprised&$$@Right@$Never mind that, look at the altar!
The candles are...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Left@$...all lit?! Is this...
$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Right@$A miracle?

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Heh... looks like my heavenly power works
alright.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Center@$Okay! Anyone who wants to hear this
angel's message, raise your hand!

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSurprised&$$@Center@$The Luminarium! It opened on its own?
But how?!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Jeanne, read that verse out loud.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Left@$O-oh, um, I'm not great at reading...
Eveline, could you help me?
$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSurprised&$$@Right@$As in, your twin sister Michelle?
$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Right@$Let's see...

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Right@$"Whence darkest abyss demons crawl,
their claws rendeth the city of prayer."

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Left@$The city of prayer... it couldn't be... could
it? Our village, Domienne?

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Right@$"Thither the lady Hope garbed in white
doth rise, and with her rise the people."

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSerious&$$@Right@$Listen carefully, Jeanne. Repeat after me,
so Eveline can hear:

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleNormal&$$@Right@$"The lady Hope garbed in white is
Jeanne."

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSerious&$$@Left@$Okay.
"The lady Hope garbed in white is..."
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Left@$...huh? Me?!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleNormal&$$@Right@$"This is the reason I have come to you."
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSerious&$$@Left@$This is the reason I have come to you...

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Evie, knock some sense into her, will you?
Calling her stunning big sis a ghost...
$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSurprised&$$@Left@$...Michelle?
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleHappy&$$@Right@$Yes, Evie! I'm here.
$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSurprised&$$@Left@$I... don't understand. How...?
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Right@$What was that sound?!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Someone's there!
$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueScared&$$@Center@$Eek!
$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Is that Dominique?!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Right@$Not good! She must've overheard us!
$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueScared&$$!-1!$$@Center@$W-witch! The rumors are true! Y-you're...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantScared&$$!-1!$$@Left@$No, no, no, you've got it all wrong! It's not
what you think, I swear it!

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...take a deep breath, Jeanne.
Sister Philomene is here. I'll go fetch her.

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueScared&$$@Right@$I must find Sister Philomene! Turning in
a witch... maybe that will...

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueAngry&$$@Right@$If you want a chance of mercy, Jeanne,
you will come with me at once!

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Dominique, calm yourself!
Jeanne has committed no crime!

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$No! It's thanks to this heretic that my
light — no, everyone's light remains faint!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantScared&$$@Left@$H-hey! Let go of me, that hurts!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Left@$Don't you dare lay a hand on my sister!
$#Michelle;Dominique;(Dominique)#$$&MichelleShouting;Dominique.DominiqueScared&$$@Left;;;Dominique.Right;@$Gyuh?!

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueScared&$$@Right@$W-what witchcraft is this?! Some strange
power has twisted my hand!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Left@$Your days of tormenting Jeanne are over!
Do you hear me?!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Michelle... you're protecting me.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Left@$Rude! Don't just talk over people! If you
act like a brat, I'll punish you like one!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Center@$And not just now. You've never stopped...
protecting me...

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Well, you know. A big sister's gotta do
what she's gotta do.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantCrying&$$@Right@$...it really is you. You really are here.
$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Michelle...
$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueScared&$$@Center@$What should I do?! I... I must act quickly!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$$!-1!$Hey... the light on the altar seems to be
growing dim!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager C)#$It is! How can that be?! It was supposed to
be enough light for at least a week!
$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueScared&$$@Center@$S-somebody! I beg of you!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$$!-1!$Dominique! Why, you're pale as a sheet!
What's wrong?

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueAngry&$$@Center@$I was attacked by Jeanne and Sister
Eveline! By their black magic!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantScared&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Ack! O-oh dear... Michelle just walloped
Eveline really hard on the backside!)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$$!-1!$Then there's no doubt about it!
They must be witches!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Distressed Villager)#$H-help! Aaargh!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$What was that?!

$#WarDemon;(Villager B)#$$&WarDemon&$$@Center@$A horde of demons...?! Run! Run away
while you can!
$#WarDemon;(Dominique)#$$&WarDemon&$$@Center@$What?!

keys.DescriptionKey: And just like that, the voice of her sister—who had always been by her side—could no longer reach her. No matter how many times she called or prayed to her, she was answered only with silence. For the first time since her sister's death long ago, Jeanne once again felt what it was like to be truly alone.

keys.IntroText: Some day, we'll be reunited... Right, Mikaela?

keys.DescriptionKey: When she was little, Jeanne would run around within the remains of an old tower with her sister and their childhood friend. Whenever they played hide-and-seek, her sister would always be the first to do the seeking, smiling and laughing as she looked for Jeanne and the friend. But now, no matter where Jeanne hides, she will never again hear those cheerful footsteps or that joyful voice calling out her name. "Mikaela...please find me," Jeanne whispers.

JeanneFusion02.description: When she was little, Jeanne would run around within the remains of an old tower with her sister and their childhood friend. Whenever they played hide-and-seek, her sister would always be the first to do the seeking, smiling and laughing as she looked for Jeanne and the friend. But now, no matter where Jeanne hides, she will never again hear those cheerful footsteps or that joyful voice calling out her name. "Mikaela...please find me," Jeanne whispers.

keys.DescriptionKey: In response to the silence that gave her no answer, Jeanne gently placed a hand over her chest. Her sister's voice could no longer reach her. Even so, she was certain her sister was still with her, somewhere within her heart. "This time, I'll be the one to find you, Mikaela." To bring this new game of hide-and-seek to an end, Jeanne draws her holy sword. And so begins her lone crusade—to reclaim the other half of her soul that was taken from her.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Center@$Two demons, on your left! Another three
coming up on your right flank!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Center@$Jeanne, get ahold of yourself!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$$!-1!$Protect Jeanne!
Everyone, we must protect Jeanne!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$Your enemy is here, foul beast!
$#WarDemon(Winged Demon)#$$&WarDemon&$$@Center@$GROOUUAAAR!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$$!-1!$AAARGH!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager B)#$I... I — ! Grrrk!
$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineShouting&$$@Center@$No... The villagers are falling!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Center@$Not good! I'll have to use the holy blade of
light again!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Center@$HAAAAAH!
$#WarDemon(Winged Demon)#$$&WarDemon&$$@Center@$ROAAAARGUUH!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Center@$Do you have your sword?!

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSurprised&$$@Center@$A sword made of light is cutting down the
demons! Could it be... Michelle?

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$My power's running dry! I won't be able to
hold this much longer!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneScared&$$@Right@$P-please move, legs... come on... please!
$#WarDemon(Winged Demon)#$$&WarDemon&$$@Center@$GROOOWR!
$#Michelle;Jeanne;(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting;Jeanne.JeanneScared&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Jeanne.Right;@$Move, Jeanne! Here, to my side!

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Center@$We're at a disadvantage. They snare us
like hawks snatching fish from a barrel.

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Center@$With no wings of our own to counter, our
attacks are ineffective.
$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineShouting&$$@Center@$There must be something we can do!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Center@$Hear me, Jeanne! They have the upper
hand. People are falling!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Center@$If you don't fight now, there won't be
anything left to defend!

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerScared&$$@Center@$(...my hand is trembling.
My grip is unsteady.)

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerScared&$$@Center@$I know that! I know that, and yet... I can't
move! I'm so scared, my body won't move!

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerScared&$$@Center@$I don't know how to fight, I have no light
to give... why must I be the hero?!

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerShouting&$$@Center@$If it were me instead, back then...
if only I had died instead of you!

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerCrying&$$@Center@$You're brave! You're strong! You could
have saved everyone today!

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerCrying&$$@Center@$So, why?!
Why was I the one allowed to live?!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$That's enough!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprised&$$@Right@$Ow!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Left@$If your life has no meaning, then find a
meaning for it!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSad&$$@Right@$S-sis?

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Left@$You're weak, so you think it would have
been better if you died? Is that it?

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerScared&$$@Center@$(All I hear are screams around me,
just like eight years ago...)

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Left@$If your life is worth nothing, then tell me,
why did I die protecting you?!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneCrying&$$@Right@$I'm... s-sorry... I'm sorry... I'm sorry...

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Left@$I believe YOU are the hero! You hear me?!
It's YOU who will save us!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Left@$I believe that with my whole being! So tell
me, what are you going to do?!
$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerCrying&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I... I...

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerSad&$$@Center@$I can't abandon everyone... I can't let
them fight against the demons alone...

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Center@$Because you're here, we dare to hope.
Because you're here, we dare to fight!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Center@$So now, it's your turn to hope!
It's your turn to fight!

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerSerious&$$@Center@$(I have to stand! Everyone has put their
faith in me, so I must stand!)

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerShouting&$$@Center@$I can do it... I want to believe in myself...
No, I do believe in myself!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$Get out of here, Jeanne! Run!
Don't worry about me, I'll be alright!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Center@$That's right, Jeanne!

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerShouting&$$@Center@$Whether I feel like I'm a hero doesn't
matter. Everyone's still counting on me!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Center@$We believe in you, Jeanne.
I believe in you!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Michelle)#$(Light has started flowing out from Jeanne.
It's so warm...)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Jeanne)#$Is this light coming from me?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Jeanne)#$Now that I think of it, isn't this like the
passage Eveline read before? It was...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Jeanne)#$"The hillwinds carry up grains o' light.
And evil's boughs be broken."

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$If that's the case, do as the prophecy says!
We have to find the tallest hill and pray!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Left@$This light... it should be able to burn
away the demons!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprised&$$@Right@$But... the road to the top of the hill cuts
right through the demon horde!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$Guh! Ngh... Gyaaah!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneScared&$$@Right@$If I dive in head first, I'll never make it...

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Left@$Don't worry. I'll clear a path around you.
I won't let a single demon touch you!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSerious&$$@Right@$...Okay! I trust you!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneShouting&$$@Right@$We can do this!

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$O, Radiant One, I beg of Thee! Let Thy
holy light pierce our foes' black souls!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$$!-1!$Incredible! The orb of light Sister Eveline
cast is driving back the demons!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager B)#$But their numbers are too great...
If this keeps ups, we'll certainly —
$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerShouting&$$@Center@$Eveline! Everyone, fall back!

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Jeanne?! No, behind you!
There's a flock of demons!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$@Left@$It's alright, Eveline. I'm not going to cower
anymore. Please, put your trust in me!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$(I ran, and when I looked back,
Michelle was... Michelle was...)
$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineShouting&$$@Right@$Jeanne...!

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(So many people have lost loved ones, yet
every day they keep moving forward.)

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerSerious&$$@Center@$(They stand up, over and over again. How
pitiful I was, staying stuck in the past...)

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerShouting&$$@Center@$(For the sake of those we lost, I will banish
this despair with my own two hands!)

$#WarDemon;Michelle;(Michelle)#$$&WarDemon;Michelle.MichelleShouting&$$@Left;;;Michelle.Right;@$Hyah! Back!
Away from my sister, demon!
$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerSurprised&$$@Center@$Sis!

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerSerious&$$@Center@$(O, Radiant One! Shamefully I lingered in
grief, blind to hope. And thus I pray...)

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerSerious&$$@Center@$(Give me Thy strength, for Thy holy light
guides all to salvation!)

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Center@$(Unbelievable... Is all of this power coming
from Jeanne?)

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Center@$(I've never seen anything like it! Is this
really the light sleeping in her heart?)

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$(Right before my eyes, my sister...
My beloved sister was covered in blood — !)

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Center@$I'm not out of the fight yet, either... I can
keep going! Over here, foul beasts!
$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerSmiling&$$@Center@$I did it... I've made it to the summit!

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerSad&$$@Center@$(I can see all the fallen villagers from here.
I'm sorry I couldn't help you...)

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerSerious&$$@Center@$(O, Radiant One. Call these lost souls
home to Thy side.)
$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerShouting&$$@Center@$(Grant mercy to the kingdom of Belterre!)

$#Victoire(Victoire)#$$&VictoireHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$It's Jeanne! Look, I can see her flag!
Everyone, Jeanne is standing on the hill!
$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSmile&$$@Right@$Saint Jeanne!

$#Victoire(Victoire)#$$&VictoireHappy&$$@Left@$You can do it, Jeanne! I know you can!
I believe in you!

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSmile&$$@Right@$Come, everyone!
We must pray for Saint Jeanne!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager C)#$$!-1!$Let us pray!

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerCrying&$$@Center@$N-no... Not again! Not again!
Why won't my body move?!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager D)#$I pray to His Radiance to protect her!

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerSerious&$$@Center@$Radiant One, I thank Thee for thy favor.
For bringing my sister home.

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerSerious&$$@Center@$I didn't want to be a hero, truthfully. But I
cannot leave my home defenseless!

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerSerious&$$@Center@$If I am to carry the power of a hero, then I
vow to remain Your loyal servant.

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerShouting&$$@Center@$So please, I beg of Thee!
Hear my prayer!

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSurprised&$$@Center@$The flag Jeanne bears is shining!
What tremendous light!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSerious&$$@Center@$O, Radiant One...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSmiling&$$@Center@$Sorry for the wait! I've got your shoes
right here.

$#Victoire(Victoire)#$$&VictoireHappy&$$@Right@$Hmm... fine. You're like a big sister, then.
You can be my big sis!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Left@$O-oh, I...

$#Victoire(Victoire)#$$&VictoireWorried&$$@Right@$Is... that okay? You don't have to be, if
you don't wanna...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantHappy&$$@Left@$No, that's not it! I would love to be your
big sis! Nothing would make me happier!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Left@$It's just... my own big sister... she —

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$$!-1!$Victoire! Get back over here. You have to
stay away from the likes of Jeanne.
$#Victoire(Victoire)#$$&VictoireWorried&$$@Center@$Huh? But why? I like talking to Jeanne...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager B)#$$!-1!$She's nothing but a parasite. A witch.
Come, before her filth corrupts you too.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Left@$I'm sorry, Victoire. I'll play with you
another time, okay?

$#Victoire(Victoire)#$$&VictoireWorried&$$@Right@$But... you shouldn't be the one saying
sorry, Jeanne!

$#Victoire(Victoire)#$$&VictoireHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Wait, are these really my shoes?!
But... they're just like new again!

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Pardon me, but this is holy ground.
I must ask you to be more respectful.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager B)#$$!-1!$Th-the High Priestess's acolyte!
My apologies!

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Center@$Sister Philomene has bid all hear her
speak before the purification ritual.

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSmiling&$$@Center@$Everyone, please follow me into the
chapel.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneShout&$$@Center@$O people of Domienne, His Radiance
shines on us this morning!

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Center@$For centuries, demons have sprung from
the Abyssal Eye to bring calamity to us.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneShout&$$@Center@$Chaos befalls our Belterre! The taint of
darkness spreads each passing day.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Center@$Eight years ago, it carved a vicious wound
into Domienne, the village we call home.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Center@$The holy light of our altar grew dark, and
the protection of His Radiance vanished.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Center@$I'm sure none of us need be reminded
how many loved ones we lost that day.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSmiling&$$@Left@$Oh, it was nothing! All I had to do was
replace the laces.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Center@$..............

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneShout&$$@Center@$We must not allow darkness to befall us
again. Our altar must forever shine!

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Center@$Let yesterday's sorrows give us strength.
Let us always pray for a bright tomorrow.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSmile&$$@Center@$Come, Eveline. Let us begin the cleansing.
Read for us the scripture of His Radiance.

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSmiling&$$@Center@$Yes, High Priestess. I shall read from
chapter 5, verse 12 of the Luminarium.

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Center@$"Givest thineself to prayer, let not thy light
dim. Cast away thy selfish desires, lest

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Center@$thy heart be soil'd. From the howls of the
abyss doth Hope rise, a banner upon a hill.

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSmiling&$$@Center@$The hillwinds carry up grains of light,
and evil's boughs be broken."

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Center@$...if I may, various interpretations of this
verse exist, which I must address.

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Center@$"Hope" is often thought to be a person
rather than a concept. The theory is,

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantHappy&$$@Left@$Now for the finishing touch. A few of these
flowers on the side here, and... Tah-dah!

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSmiling&$$@Center@$so long as we are pious and pray devoutly,
a hero shall rise up and save us all.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&EvelineSad&$$@Center@$Now, my people, let us pray. For those
of us here, and for those we have lost.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$$!-1!$For my mother, that she may rest in
peace. I pray for His Radiance's mercy.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager B)#$For tomorrow, that these tranquil days
may continue. I pray for His holy blessing.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSerious&$$@Left@$(There's a bright light rising up from all
the worshippers...)

$#Victoire(Victoire)#$$&VictoireHappy&$$@Right@$Wow! Hey, Jeanne! Look at me! I'm all
sparkly and shiny!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSmiling&$$@Left@$Even you, Victoire!

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, how splendid! Such brilliance could
only come from the truly pure of heart.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSmile&$$@Center@$His Radiance must be pleased by the light
of His most devout followers.
$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSad&$$@Center@$My light... it's dim...

$#Victoire(Victoire)#$$&VictoireHappy&$$@Right@$Ah, how pretty! I've never had flower
shoes before! Thank you so much!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager C)#$$!-1!$As is mine... it seems... weak...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantScared&$$@Center@$(...I'm not making any light at all. Why...?
Is my soul really so black?)

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Center@$Good people, do not despair if your light
shines faintly.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Center@$You need only confess your sins
for your souls to be purified.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSmile&$$@Center@$To repent is to be courageous. I pray you
open your hearts for the good of all.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$$!-1!$M-my sickle was rusted, and the crops...
I had no choice! So, I took my neighbor's.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager C)#$It's my child... s-she fusses, so the last two
morning prayers, I... wasn't able to attend.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneShout&$$@Center@$Behold, how the altar glimmers from the
cleansing of their hearts!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantScared&$$!-1!$$@Left@$(...please! Let my light shine as well...
Please!)

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantScared&$$@Left@$(I beg of you, oh Radiant One!
Have mercy on me!)

$#Victoire(Victoire)#$$&VictoireNormal&$$@Right@$You're really, really nice, Jeanne.
Nicer than anyone.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Right@$Oh, Jeanne... Your knuckles are white.
Unfurl your fist before you injure yourself.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Left@$S-Sister Philomene...

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Right@$Surely, you must realize. The shadow of
your sins chokes the light within you.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSmile&$$@Right@$Come now, you need only confess.
Then you too shall shine brightly.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Left@$But... I've never... I have nothing...
to confess...

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSmile&$$@Right@$To acknowledge our sins is an unpleasant
feat, truly. But we mustn't be prideful.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Right@$Now then, open your heart, child. Lest
your soul forever wander in darkness.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Left@$B-but... I swear to you, truly, I've never...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$$!-1!$Perhaps she intends to lie, even to her
last breath!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager C)#$I've done my part and swallowed my pride.
And yet, she persists...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Left@$What? Oh, I wouldn't say that...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager B)#$Should the altar's light darken, it would
be the end for our village!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager D)#$Only a witch would have no light to offer
to the holy altar!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantScared&$$@Center@$W-witch... no... I'm...

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Sister Philomene, surely there must be
enough light now? At least until next time.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Right@$...very well, my dear acolyte. As you say.
We shall conclude for today.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Right@$Let us take a walk through the village, so
penitents may privately speak their sins.
$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Right@$May His Radiance protect you.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$$!-1!$May He protect us all.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager B)#$May He protect us all.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Center@$I... I don't understand.

$#Victoire(Victoire)#$$&VictoireHappy&$$@Right@$I would! You're the nicest person I know.
You're like a mama, but with flowers!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Center@$What am I doing wrong...?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSmiling&$$@Left@$Heh! I'm not quite old enough to be a
mama, silly!
$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Center@$Ngh... My... my chest...

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Center@$The light from the ceremony was
insufficient. The next attack may ruin us.

JeanneSEVEN10.description:
$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Center@$The light from the ceremony was
insufficient. The next attack may ruin us.

keys.value: $#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSmile&$$@Center@$The light! It took the shape of a person!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$$!-1!$Incredible, it's a miracle! Such brilliance!
It looked almost like an angel...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager B)#$All this time, Jeanne, you never lost hope.
Your piety must be unmatched.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$We've not treated you right, Jeanne.
I regret it, deeply.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager B)#$We ought to prostrate ourselves in
apology. Jeanne, can you ever forgive us?

$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteSurprised&$$@Center@$There's no need for that. Please, rise!
It's enough that everyone is with me now.

$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteSerious&$$@Center@$There is precious little time left. We must
not waste even a moment of it.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Villagers)#$$!-1!$Hear, hear!
$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineHappy&$$@Center@$Thank you, Jeanne.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Center@$Those who have yet to confess their sins
must repent here and now.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSmile&$$@Center@$For it is the act of confession that best
feeds the holy altar's light.
$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSad&$$@Center@$I...

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSerious&$$@Center@$S-Sister Philomene... forgive me! I have yet
to c-confess to a sin.

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSad&$$@Center@$I feared the judgment of those around me,
so I dared not speak.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Center@$It must have been a heavy burden, but you
have nothing to fear. Come now, confess.

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSad&$$@Center@$It was when I was but a young girl.
There was a boy near and dear to me.

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSad&$$@Center@$Whether waking or sleeping, he was
never far from my thoughts.

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSerious&$$@Center@$Yet no matter how I pined, he never
looked my way.

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSad&$$@Center@$Sister Philomene! You've been praying for
hours. It's sapping your strength!

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSerious&$$@Center@$I would have done anything to be in his
arms. And so I... I tried to cast a spell.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Center@$The lure of black magic beckoned you, and
you gave into its temptation.

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSad&$$@Center@$Yes, High Priestess. But I wasn't able to
cast any magic, so the spell didn't take.

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSad&$$@Center@$Truly, I was relieved. I knew then that
using profane magic was a great sin.

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSad&$$@Center@$I loved that boy... but I am consoled
knowing no grave damage was done.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$(How magnificent... Such radiant light
has burst forth from within her!)

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSmile&$$@Left@$You have done well to confess, Dominique.
For that, I give you my thanks.

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSad&$$@Right@$High Priestess, please forgive me for
using such forbidden magic...

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Left@$Sister Eveline. I must ask you to escort
Dominique from the church.
$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$High Priestess?

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneShout&$$!-1!$$@Left@$The... angels...
The blood-soaked... angels...

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueScared&$$@Center@$S-Sister! Forgive me! I wouldn't dream of
attempting such heresy again, I swear!

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Center@$You called upon magic to slake your lust.
You desired to rule your fellow man.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneShout&$$@Center@$Your actions were the blackest sin!
Worse than murder!

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneShout&$$@Center@$You are the witch we must judge!
You have no advocates here!

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueScared&$$!-1!$$@Right@$But I've never once faltered in prayer!
I pray every day!

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSurprised&$$@Left@$Sister Philomene, if Dominique leaves the
church, the demons could...!
$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineShouting&$$@Left@$I beg of you, have mercy!

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The pious must be strong against the
pleas of heretics.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Center@$Listen well, Dominique.
Your blasphemy has brought us ruin.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneShout&$$@Center@$If you bear even the slightest love for this
village, you will leave at once.

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSurprised&$$@Right@$Angels...? Please, Sister Philomene, I beg
you, rest. Just for a short while.
$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueScared&$$@Center@$I... I...

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSad&$$@Center@$(If the church does not extend a hand in
forgiveness, who is left that will?)

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSad&$$@Center@$(The act of judging sin is beginning to
seem like sin itself...)

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantHappy&$$@Right@$Alright! Just need to take out these old
clothes and we'll be done!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleNormal&$$@Left@$The wardrobe's looking a little empty.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSerious&$$@Right@$Hmm, I suppose it's time we start making
the flag.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleNormal&$$@Left@$You think we have enough white fabric?
It'll take a lot to look like that vision.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSerious&$$@Right@$True. And it had intricate embroidery as
well. It may take some time to finish.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSerious&$$@Left@$Blech. Not exactly my strong suit.
Mind if I stretch my legs outside for a bit?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Right@$Nuh-uh, you need to help me with this!
How did that verse in the Luminarium go?

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Left@$No, for the sake of this village, I mustn't.
We cannot falter, even for a moment.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSmiling&$$@Right@$"The fruit of blessings doth grow only
from thine own devoted heart.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSmiling&$$@Right@$The road may be arduous, but dedication
shall see you to the end."

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Left@$...I'd still rather train with a sword than
a sewing needle.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSmiling&$$@Right@$You really haven't changed at all, sis.

$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteSmiling&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, this is... a long time ago, I used to
wear this for the cleansing rituals.

$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteHappy&$$@Center@$If I just let out the hem, and then pin this
piece here... Yes! I think it should work!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hmm? You're making yourself a dress too?

$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteSmiling&$$@Right@$Well, that scripture did foretell a hero
dressed in white, not green...

$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteSmiling&$$@Right@$If I want His Radiance to watch over me,
I should wear something eye-catching, no?

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Left@$Y'know, if I didn't know any better, I'd say
you're trying to put off your training.

$#Philomene(Philomene)#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Left@$The demons have their sights on us. Now,
everyone, let your lights shine bright!

$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteSurprised&$$@Right@$D-don't be ridiculous! This is a very
important matter I absolutely must finish!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleHappy&$$@Left@$Right. Well, I say it's time to practice
self-defense! En garde!
$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteSuprised&$$@Right@$Eek! Stop tickling me, I'm not ready yet!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hm? ... Shh! Quiet, Jeanne.
$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteScared&$$@Center@$What is it?
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSerious&$$@Center@$I hear footsteps outside. A lot of them.
$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteSerious&$$@Center@$Let's go take a look.
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Center@$Wha...? It can't be... What are they...?

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineHappy&$$@Center@$Jeanne! Radiance above, I'm glad we
finally found you.

$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteSurprised&$$@Center@$Eveline?! And almost the whole village...
Why is everyone so pale?!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$$!-1!$Yes, High Priestess!

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSad&$$@Center@$It's from exhaustion. Everyone has been
praying relentlessly.

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSad&$$@Center@$Sister Philomene has lost her senses. She
has made everyone pray unto exhaustion.

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Center@$But we're producing very little light. The
demons' attack is surely imminent.

JeanneSEVEN72.description:
$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Center@$But we're producing very little light. The
demons' attack is surely imminent.

keys.value: $#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteSerious&$$@Center@$Please, tell me what's happened...

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Center@$And so, Jeanne, everyone here wishes to
stand beside you in defense of Domienne.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$$!-1!$I'll fight with you, girl. If I'm meant to die,
I'd rather not do it on my knees.

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSad&$$@Center@$I've wronged you, Jeanne.
You are no a witch.

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSad&$$@Center@$I too was accused by Sister Philomene,
my own words turned against me.

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSad&$$@Center@$I don't dare ask your forgiveness.
Not here, and especially not now.

$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteSerious&$$@Center@$You don't need to ask for it. You have it.
Coming here to help is apology enough.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager B)#$May His Radiance rain light from above!
$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSerious&$$@Center@$Jeanne... you...

$#Victoire(Victoire)#$$&VictoireHappy&$$@Center@$Hey! Listen!
I think Jeanne is a real hero!

$#Victoire(Victoire)#$$&VictoireHappy&$$@Center@$She saved me from the demons! She was
fighting them off with only a stick!
$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteSmiling&$$@Center@$Victoire...

$#Victoire(Victoire)#$$&VictoireHappy&$$@Center@$I'm gonna fight too! I wanna save people,
just like Jeanne!

$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I thank you all, truly I do. But calling me
a hero is...

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Right@$That kid there believes it, lil sis. You just
need to open your mind a bit more.
$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteSurprised&$$@Left@$What do you mean by that?

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleHappy&$$@Right@$The more you open it, the more light you'll
let in, until the hero inside you shines!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Right@$Have courage. Even if you're still learning,
these people are looking to you for hope.

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSad&$$@Center@$(The villagers are praying tirelessly.
But what of when their light runs dry?)

$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(If my resolve is weak, everyone will lose
heart when the time comes to fight.)

$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteSerious&$$@Center@$Thank you, everyone. I think... there are
two things we need to do now.

$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteSerious&$$@Center@$First: we must train ourselves to defeat
the demons in combat.

$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteSerious&$$@Center@$Second: we must fly a banner that shows
our hope, and our faith in His Radiance.

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I'm a seamstress! If we need a flag, I can
help. Victoire can, as well.
$#Victoire(Victoire)#$$&VictoireHappy&$$@Right@$Yeah! Just leave it to us!

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSmiling&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I shall join the combat team. Jeanne, I
presume you are in charge of training?

$#JeanneWhite(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWhiteSurprised&$$@Center@$Oh, no, not me. Michelle will handle that.
Go on and introduce yourself, sis!
$#Victoire(Victoire)#$$&VictoireWorried&$$@Center@$Um... who are you talking to?

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleHappy&$$@Center@$Silly Jeanne, they still can't see me.
How about I do... this?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantHappy&$$@Center@$Mmm! Oh, how I've missed this warm
grass smell!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSerious&$$@Center@$In Domienne, I endured harsh words and
suspicious stares every day. And yet...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Center@$The smell of wood, or that vase still filled
with flowers...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Center@$All these precious memories here, slowly
but surely suffocating me...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Center@$Even at its worst, Domienne was just...
easier.
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...I'm sorry, Jeanne. I didn't realize...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSmiling&$$@Left@$No, don't apologize. Right here, right now,
we're together again. That's all I need.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Left@$You won't ever leave me again, right?
You'll always be with me?
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleNormal&$$@Right@$Of course I will.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Left@$Heeeey! How long you planning to stand
at the door?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Right@$I can't help it! My eyes just won't stop
watering...

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSerious&$$@Center@$It's been eight years since the attack,
right? This place is a mess.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Left@$Must be dusty in there. How 'bout I give
you to the count of ten before I tickle you?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Right@$Whaaaat! Why?!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Left@$Ten... Nine... Eight... Seven...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantScared&$$@Right@$Ack! I'm going in! I'm going in!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleHappy&$$@Left@$Six... Three... Two... One...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Right@$H-hey, wait! No fair! What happened to
five and four?!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Left@$Look at that. She did it.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Right@$Ph-pheeew!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Left@$Turns out you're braver than you thought!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantScared&$$@Right@$Gyaaaaaah! S-s-s-s-something's here!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$That's right. I suppose no one has been
here since then.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh boy. Heeeey, whoever's over there!
You got a lot of nerve trespassing on us.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Center@$If you're a burglar, your opponent will be
Jeanne! If you're a ghost, it'll be me!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Center@$What?! You c-can't just volunteer me
to fight a burglar!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantScared&$$@Center@$Weapon! I need a weapon! It's a good thing
I picked up that stick in the village...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantShouting&$$@Center@$Alright! Come out, wh-whoever you are!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Center@$Watch it! You can't just flail like that, you
nearly hit me!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Center@$...although with those noodle arms, I
doubt it would have hurt much.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Center@$Hm? It sounds like something's in the
kitchen... Wait...!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantScared&$$@Center@$Eek! It's a... it's a... it's a...
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Aww! A cute lil' mousey!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSad&$$@Right@$Huh? No one? Where've you been staying
all this time?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Right@$O-oh! It's run off...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSmiling&$$@Right@$Pheeeew! Heavens, I was so frightened...
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Left@$Heh. You did it, eh, Jeanne?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Right@$Hmm? Did what?

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Left@$You've slain a fiend most vile! And I
deserve credit too, for fighting beside you!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSmiling&$$@Right@$Oh, don't be so dramatic.
It was just a mouse!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleHappy&$$@Left@$We all have to start somewhere.
The first step is having courage!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Left@$And that's the step we just took. So that
makes us both seasoned warriors.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantHappy&$$@Right@$Hmm, I guess that makes sense. Okay,
let's go with that! We're sisters in arms!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSerious&$$@Right@$Now, for our first mission: we must purge
this domicile of evil cobwebs and dust!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSmiling&$$@Left@$In Domienne, of course. I mended clothes
in exchange for room and board.
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Left@$Aww, we have to clean?! Bleeech!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Left@$I'd rather we worked on toughening up!
Your swordsmanship needs a lot of work.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSmiling&$$@Right@$Sorry, sis. We need to turn this house into
a proper stronghold before anything else!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantShouting&$$@Right@$We can finish quickly with us both on the
frontlines. Alright, housedust! En garde!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSad&$$@Left@$I don't wannaaaa...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Right@$But...we've been so busy running and
fighting, we haven't had time to talk.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Right@$I thought we could reminisce about the
good ol' days while we cleaned...

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleNormal&$$@Left@$...when you put it that way, I guess you
have a point.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantHappy&$$@Right@$Whew! Well, well! Take a look, sis! Not too
shabby, right?

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Left@$Ugh, I think I feel a sneeze coming. Ah...
Ah... AH—

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSerious&$$@Left@$But after my light disappeared, fewer and
fewer people let me stay with them...
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Left@$chyoo!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantHappy&$$@Right@$That was the cutest sneeze ever! I can't
believe that part of you is still the same!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSmiling&$$@Right@$That makes me think of something...
I never knew ghosts sneezed!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Left@$Ugh, this again?! I told you! I'm not a ghost! I'm an ange... ang... chyoo!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSerious&$$@Right@$...I suppose there's still some dust floating
around. Shall we go take a short walk?
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSad&$$@Left@$Yesh pleashe. *sniff*
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Center@$I wonder what's going to happen...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Center@$Suppose the altar's light goes out and
we fall here, what'll become of Domienne?

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSad&$$@Center@$If this land falls to shadow, it's unclear
if humanity could even survive...

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Center@$...hmm? Hey, see that big tree over there?
Remember how we used to climb it?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Left@$Before I knew it, I was sleeping under
the stars.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSmiling&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Of course I do! I thought it was lost to the
demons, but it hasn't changed a bit!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleNormal&$$@Right@$Maybe nothing actually happens to
whatever is swallowed by darkness...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSerious&$$@Left@$You know that's not true. The darkness
isn't something we should make light of.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Right@$I know. I'm an angel, remember? You
shouldn't take things so seriously.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Left@$Hm? Oh, you think I'm...  I'm not some
woebegone wilting flower, you know.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Right@$Weeell, you seemed like you were wilting
a little bit just then.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I wasn't wilting, I was... thinking.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSerious&$$@Center@$If someone has to be sacrificed to protect
the village, I'd be fine offering myself.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Center@$After all, I don't have any light to give,
and I don't know how to handle a sword...

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSad&$$@Center@$You're saying there's no point to life if
you aren't worthy? That's not true at all.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Right@$Under the stars? You mean on the streets?
You could've at least slept at home!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleNormal&$$@Center@$We live, therefore, we're worthy. You're
worth protecting, just because you're you.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$@Center@$I...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Center@$What in the...? Where's that bright light
coming from?

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Center@$Something's glowing inside the house!
Let's hurry!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Right@$Over there, sis!
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Left@$It's... a flag? Made of light?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Right@$It looks like the branch I brought with me
from Domienne... but it's floating?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSmiling&$$@Right@$(It's lovely. There's some light streaming
from the end. Kind of like a banner.)
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSad&$$@Left@$Aww, it's fading...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSerious&$$@Right@$It's back to being an ordinary stick.
That was odd. Michelle, did you...?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yes, I suppose I could have. It was foolish
of me not to, wasn't it?

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Left@$No, I didn't do anything. No doubt about it,
this was a divine message!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Right@$You mean... from His Radiance?!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$People are naturally drawn to flags.
As a sign of victory, or a symbol of hope...
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Center@$That's what he's trying to tell us!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleHappy&$$@Center@$You're not meant to hold a sword!
You're meant to hold a banner!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantSurprised&$$@Center@$A banner... to lead the people? Didn't the
scripture say something like that?
Prayers at the Edge of Night

keys.value: $#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerShouting&$$@Center@$Let my light pierce the darkness!

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSmile&$$@Left@$Thank you, Saint Jeanne!
From the bottom of my heart, thank you!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$@Right@$Sorry, sorry! Heheh. Just... give me a few
moments. We can leave... in a little bit...

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I guess I'll look for four-leaf clovers since
I'm pinned here... or do flower fortunes!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Center@$Let's see... who's prettier, me or Evie? Me,
Evie, me, Evie, me...
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleHappy&$$@Center@$Yes! I'm prettier! Heh!

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerSmiling&$$@Center@$Aww, leave poor Evie alone.
You're an angel now, aren't you?
$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerSad&$$@Center@$...hey, Michelle?
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleNormal&$$@Center@$Hmm?

$#JeanneBanner(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBannerSad&$$@Center@$When you were... gone... were Mama and
Papa there with you?
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Mm, yeah, pretty sure they were.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$@Right@$Really? So, that means Heaven really does
exist!

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSmile&$$@Left@$I'll be sure to be a better person...
Merciful and understanding, like you.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSerious&$$@Left@$Perhaps. Honestly, I can't remember much
from before I came back.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Left@$Still, it felt like they were with me.
Both of them.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSad&$$@Right@$I see. I wish they could've seen me when I
was on that hill.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$@Right@$I think they would've been proud to see
their timid daughter standing so tall.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneHappy&$$@Right@$Heheh, I wonder if they would've been
stunned into silence!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Left@$They would have been proud, certainly,
but I doubt they would've been surprised.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprised&$$@Right@$Huh? You think so?

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSerious&$$@Left@$Well, I wasn't surprised by what you did
at all.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Left@$You may be a scaredy-cat sometimes, but
you make up for it with your kindness.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSad&$$@Right@$So, you think anyone who's kind can be
a hero?
$#Victoire(Victoire)#$$&VictoireHappy&$$@Right@$Jeanne! You did it! You were amazing!

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSerious&$$@Left@$Not exactly. The kindness you have inside
you... it's not exactly easy to keep up.
$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Left@$Fortunately, you're pretty stubborn.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSerious&$$@Right@$Hey! I don't see what that has to do with
kindness.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleNormal&$$@Left@$Well, you don't think like a mercenary.
You don't want any rewards.

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Left@$You help others because it makes you
happy. You're just too nice, lil sis.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSad&$$@Right@$That doesn't sound like a compliment...

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleHappy&$$@Left@$It is a compliment!
( ...more or less.)

$#Michelle(Michelle)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Left@$Oh? Hey, aren't these the flowers you used
to make my flower crowns?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprised&$$@Right@$Don't change the subject!
