$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantShouting&$$@Center@$No! I'm not! I... I swear it!
$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSerious&$$@Center@$Why? What has she done?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeannePeasantScared&$$@Center@$(...and yet, why wouldn't my light shine?
Could it be...? No...)

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueAngry&$$@Center@$That was a bit cruel, wasn't it? The girl's
gone and run off.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager C)#$$!-1!$What of it? Even if she's not a witch, she's
no great use to the village.
$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSad&$$@Center@$What...?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager C)#$$!-1!$Eight years ago, her home was almost
swallowed by darkness. Almost!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager C)#$It still sat inside the light of protection,
and remains there to this day.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager C)#$So why is she roaming about town if she's
got a warm bed? It's suspicious, I say!

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSerious&$$@Center@$She peddles her embroidery and her
flowers at the market. I've seen her before.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager C)#$$!-1!$True, but what need do we have of those
silly things? Bit of a frivolity, I think.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager C)#$We take pity on the girl, but if you ask me,
the time for laces ended long ago.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager B)#$$!-1!$Sister Eveline was quite close to Jeanne
and her sister Michelle as children.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager C)#$You know it's true. Anyone who can't give
light to the altar is useless.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager B)#$Worse than useless. Parasitic, I'd say.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager B)#$Well, Sister Philomene will toss the girl
out soon enough, eh?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$Dominique, you're being far too soft,
sympathizing with that witch.
$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSad&$$@Center@$What, me? I... I only...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$$!-1!$Your light's looking a bit weak as well.
Don't you become a burden on us now.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager D)#$Perhaps if you were to confess Jeanne's
heresy to the High Priestess...
$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSad&$$@Center@$But I don't...

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Center@$Gossip is quite the engaging past-time,
is it not?
$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$S-Sister Eveline!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager B)#$Did you not notice how she shielded that
witch from Sister Philomene's scrutiny?

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Right@$Did my ears deceive me, or did I hear talk
of how the burdensome deserve exile?

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Right@$I suppose if that's true, we should banish
the elderly and the ill as well.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager C)#$$!-1!$Th-those are completely different matters!

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Center@$I think both are the same when it comes
to human compassion... or lack thereof.

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Center@$Why don't you confess your cruel thoughts
to the High Priestess, instead of gossip?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$$!-1!$Y-You...!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager B)#$Hmph! Just you wait! That witch'll show
her true colors soon!

$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueAngry&$$@Center@$...yes. Perhaps the time for compassion
has ended.

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Center@$(So that's how it is. The villagers insist on
pursuing these ridiculous accusations.)

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSad&$$@Center@$(But it's true that Jeanne hasn't offered
up light in some time...)
$#Dominique(Dominique)#$$&DominiqueSad&$$@Center@$What? Surely you're being too suspicious...

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSad&$$@Center@$(Can I do anything to help ensure her
safety...?)

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Center@$(No. I mustn't involve myself any more.
Sister Philomene would never forgive me.)

$#Eveline(Eveline)#$$&EvelineSerious&$$@Center@$(An acolyte rumored to be protecting a
witch, how preposterous...)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$$!-1!$Hmph! If I am, explain to me why Jeanne
offered no light today!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$No mistake about it. Today's ceremony
was tainted by that heretic's filth!

$#YoungBoy(Boy)#$When will Dad come home?
$#YoungBoy(Boy)#$What does "Finn" mean, anyway?
$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoTongue&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Yes. But he went and broke it, that bastard∼
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$I'm...sorry?

$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoLaughHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hehe, it's alright. He also taught me
something very important.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Would you mind telling me your name?

$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoWink&$$!-1!$$@Right@$My name is Hi—No, I can't tell him that...
Uh, call me Rice Specialist!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Rice...Specialist?
$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoLaugh&$$@Right@$Right-o!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(She can't be serious... But more importantly,
just what was between her and Dad...?)
$#()#$KABOOM!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Was that a meteor!?
$#Mother(Mother)#$It means, "May your path shine bright."
$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoComplain&$$@Center@$Yep, it struck the mountain∼

$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoComplain&$$@Center@$That area's off limits, so I doubt anyone
was in the impact zone.

$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoHappy&$$@Center@$Unless someone came teleporting again, I
guess.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$That's a relief...
Wait, you could see the meteor!?

$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoSmile&$$@Right@$Sure.
You could too, I take it?

$#HimikoPillar(???)#$$&HimikoSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$So then you can also see the giant one?
The one with the tail.
$#FinnPillar(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Yes. It looks like it could fall any time now...

$#HimikoPillar(???)#$$&HimikoHappy&$$@Right@$And it will.
Within a few hours.
$#FinnPillar(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$That soon!?

$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoHappy&$$@Center@$Yep, no question! In a few hours, this whole
area will be rubble.
$#YoungBoy(Boy)#$Ooh, cool!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(The meteor does seem to be getting larger
by the minute...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(I've got to get Princess Kaguya's help
immediately!)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Please, I need to know something. Has a
moon stone ever fallen around here?
$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoHuh&$$@Right@$A moon stone? Why do you ask?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Long story, but I need one to gain
someone's trust.

$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoComplain&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I see. Sounds like the Princess has asked
for yet another ridiculous item, huh.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$You know Princess Kaguya!?
$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoHappy&$$@Center@$Why are you so quick to trust her?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$...Should I not?

$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoLaughHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You never know. She might be a super
evil being bent on destroying the world!

$#Mother(Mother)#$But your father isn't the one that first
thought of it.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$That's a bit of a reach...

$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Is it? You don't know anything about her,
do you? And yet you want to gain her trust.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$I want to believe in people.
$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoStare&$$@Center@$Believe in people...?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Yes! It's one of my principles!

$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoHappy&$$@Center@$You are your father's son, huh...
Anyway. You passed the test! Wait here.
$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoHappy&$$@Center@$Nyoom∼

$#FinnPillar(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$WHOA! She just flew off!
How in the—
$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoHappy&$$@Center@$$%1%$Miss me?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$You were only gone a few seconds!
Where did you go!?

$#Mother(Mother)#$He said he and his friends came up with it
together.
$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoLaugh&$$@Center@$I just popped up to the moon for a moment.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$You WHAT!?

$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoRelax&$$@Center@$Here you go.
One moon stone, as requested∼
$#Finn(Finn)#$$@Center@$Wha—Is this real!?

$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoWink&$$@Center@$Take good care of Kaguya!
But don't do anything stupid!
$#Himiko(???)#$$&HimikoLaughHappy&$$@Center@$See yaaa!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$What on Erden is that woman...

$#VoicefromAbove(Voice from Above)#$Careful, the rain's coming soon!
A rain of fire and stone, that is∼
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Wh-Where did that voice come from!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$A rain of fire and stone...
$#YoungBoy(Boy)#$Really? Can I meet them some day?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$I have to warn the locals!

$#Mother(Mother)#$Yes, some day...
I'm sure he'll introduce you.
$#YoungBoy(Boy)#$Yay! I can't wait for him to come home!

$#Mother(Mother)#$Even when he's away, he's always watching
over you. Over both of us.

$#Mother(Mother)#$So make sure you live each day of your life
to the fullest!
$#Mother(Mother)#$I don't know...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Another dream...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(This time, I was a child again, waiting with
Mom for Dad to come back home...)
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Good morning, Sir Finn.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$How's everyone feeling? I hear your
wounds have healed, is that true?
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaLaugh&$$@Right@$Yeah, mostly.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Are you okay, Finn?
You look a little pale.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaPanic&$$@Right@$Maybe you didn't get enough sleep? You know
you need to rest and eat well to be well!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$Now that you mentioned it... I can't sleep
very well because of that meteor...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Then you must have one of these rice balls!
They are most delectable, and are said to
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Center@$possess calming properties.
$#YoungBoy(Boy)#$Are you sad when he's not here?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Yes, I'd love to take some back to Kisenkyo...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHappy&$$@Left@$They really do lift your mood right up!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaLaugh&$$@Left@$And on top of that, they taste kind of
nostalgic?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Munch, munch... Mmmm!?
You're right, these are excellent!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Right@$Ah, such praise!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaBitterSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Don't talk like you made them, Nagi!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSurprised&$$@Right@$So, this meteor you mentioned.
It's a stone that's going to fall from the sky?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Yes. I know you all can't see it, but I can—
and it's massive.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$My word! And it is to fall on the very land
we now stand upon? When!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I don't think it will be just yet, but if what
Cyrus says is true, it won't take long either.
$#Mother(Mother)#$I've got you, so I'm not sad at all!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...I think I saw a mention of such a meteor
falling twenty years ago.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaBitterSmile&$$@Right@$Rocks falling from space... Can't say that's
my strong subject.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$The extent of my space-related knowledge
is that Erden orbits around the sun.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$Beyond that, I'm afraid I know naught.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$There's no air up there, right?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Center@$By gods! Truly!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$No one's ever been that high, so who can say
for sure.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSurprised&$$@Right@$But we can say for certain that outer space
exists.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Yes, I'm sure if we were to ask in Elvenlent,
they would say the same.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$A meteor, however... It all seems beyond the
realm of what is possible, I say...

$#Mother(Mother)#$But he'd probably be upset if he knew
I said that. He misses us for sure!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaConsidering&$$@Right@$It's like the stuff you'd hear in legends.
Are you sure it's going to fall here?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I really hope it doesn't, but if it does...
The damage will be immeasurable.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Is there no way to prevent this outcome?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Looks like the princess that lives in that
castle, Kaguya, has the power to stop it.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Why, Sir Finn! Could it be you have already
made acquaintance with the local princess!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Well, it's complicated.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$Complicated how, pray tell?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$So here's the thing...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaPanic&$$@Center@$You have to do WHAT!?

$#GirlintheRoom(Girl in the Room)#$$&KaguyaClosedEyesSerious&$$@Center@$I don't need anything.
And I don't want anyone to come in my room.
$#MaleVoice(Male Voice)#$I see. Very well.
$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSmile&$$@Right@$It would be wise to conserve our strength.

$#FemaleVoice(Female Voice)#$Just let us know if you need anything, all
right?
$#GirlintheRoom(Girl in the Room)#$$&KaguyaShy&$$@Center@$I want to be alone.
$#GirlintheRoom(Girl in the Room)#$$&KaguyaClosedEyesSad&$$@Center@$Ever since I woke up here...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Girl in the Room)#$$!-1!$Twenty years ago...
$#()#$——20 Years Prior——

$#DONOTSHOWME(Rody)#$The job I had that day was more fit for a
detective than a mercenary.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Rody)#$I was to find and capture an evil-doer.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$@Center@$Aaaaaaah...

$#UnsettlingMan(Unsettling Man)#$$&CyrusHurt&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Would you keep it down, traveler?
What are you grumbling about?
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$Are you a single man?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Right, some people in the port town also
said the capital is full of oni...

$#UnsettlingMan(Unsettling Man)#$$&CyrusCommand&$$@Right@$Me? You bet I am. I don't need anyone to
hold me back. I'm at my best on my own.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Well I'm not! I've got the sweetest lady!
Her name's Sarina.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$If I don't hurry back to her, she'll forget
about me and find someone else, though...
$#UnsettlingMan(Unsettling Man)#$$&CyrusSad&$$@Right@$Then stop moaning and hurry back to her.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyTroubled&$$@Left@$Do people ever tell you you're cold-hearted?

$#UnsettlingMan(Unsettling Man)#$$&CyrusSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Well, forgive me for not being altruistic
enough to comfort random passers-by.

$#UnsettlingMan(Unsettling Man)#$$&CyrusClosedEyesSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You're more pitiful than most I've seen,
though, so let me give you some advice.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$@Left@$Oh, that'd be great!
Lay it on me!
$#UnsettlingMan(Unsettling Man)#$$&CyrusSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Quit dallying and get back to your girl.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Center@$If only I could...
I've got a job to do.
$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSerious&$$@Right@$It really is.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Center@$And it's not an easy one. I've gotta
apprehend this "noble thief..."

$#UnsettlingMan(Unsettling Man)#$$&CyrusClosedEyesSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Ah, a job. Sounds great. I wouldn't know,
I'm just a wanderer.
$#UnsettlingMan(Unsettling Man)#$$&CyrusClosedEyesSmile&$$@Right@$No place to go, no purpose in life.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$You're being sarcastic, right?

$#UnsettlingMan(Unsettling Man)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Right@$Not in the slightest.
I'm jealous. Your life seems rewarding.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Center@$If it sounds that great, why don't you
capture this thief instead of me?
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyTroubled&$$@Center@$His name's Cyrus.

$#UnsettlingMan(Unsettling Man)#$$&CyrusSweat&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Is it now.
A noble thief, you say?
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Center@$That's right. A thief and a swindler.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$By the way, what did you say your name
was...?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$If so, charging in without caution seems
unwise indeed.
$#UnsettlingMan(Unsettling Man)#$$&CyrusSweat&$$@Right@$...
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, don't tell me you're—

$#UnsettlingMan(Unsettling Man)#$$&CyrusSweat&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What, you think I'm your guy?
Come on, what are the odds that your target

$#UnsettlingMan(Unsettling Man)#$$&CyrusSweat&$$@Right@$would be right in front of you, out of all the 
places in this huge desert?
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$You're sweating.
$#UnsettlingMan(Unsettling Man)#$$&CyrusSweat&$$@Right@$Again, a desert. It's hot.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$Tell me your name.
$#UnsettlingMan(Unsettling Man)#$$&CyrusSad&$$@Right@$No, I don't think I will.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Fine. I've actually got a wanted poster with
a sketch of the guy right here—
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$@Center@$Ah-HA! You ARE Cyrus!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Sage Rei, did the water dragon's message
contain any detail about the disaster?

$#UnsettlingMan(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusHurt&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You had a wanted poster!?
You should have told me!
$#UnsettlingMan(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusHurt&$$@Right@$Damn...!
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$@Left@$Hey, get back here!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Right@$No, none.

$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSeriousOpen&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Then perhaps you should first visit
Yamato Village to gather information.

$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuClosedEyes&$$@Center@$It is said to be the cradle of the Land of
Peace.

$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuHappy&$$@Center@$There may be some historical books and
records there.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$A fair distance, I presume, after more than
two days on the road.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHappy&$$@Center@$And maybe they'll have a hint as to
what the disaster could be!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(Taking time to do some research into
the disaster does seem like a good idea...)
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Is the village far?

$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSmile&$$@Right@$No. From here, you should be able to
reach it within half a day.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$I see. Yes, I think learning more about this
region and its disasters might help us
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$avert the crisis.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$"Forewarned is forearmed," as they say.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Then it's settled, we're visiting Yamato!
Will this path take us there?

$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSmile&$$@Right@$You'll have to backtrack to the last fork.
It is a straight walk down the smaller path.
$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$And I shall take my leave here.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$I do hope our heading is not mistaken...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Right, you said the Bureau of Onmyo is in
the capital?
$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSmile&$$@Center@$Yes. I must report on what has occurred.
$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuHappy&$$@Center@$Be careful on your way.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$You take care of yourself too, Haku.
We'll see you in the capital!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaWink&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Let's be off!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Left@$Onwards, to Yamato Village!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$It has been quite a walk, I must say...

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Right@$But it seems like we're finally here.
I see a village ahead.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$That must be Yamato.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$Do mine eyes play tricks on me, or
are those, perchance...rice paddies?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaConsidering&$$@Left@$That guy we passed did say this road
leads to the capital.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaConsidering&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What is that?
That ring thing opposite the rice paddies.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Rei)#$$&ReiSurprised&$Some kind of monument?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$There is an air of artistry about it indeed.
Its curvature is simply divine!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$It feels somewhat out of place there...
It doesn't seem like it's made of stone.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Mysha)#$$&MyshaBitterSmile&$Hmph, I don't understand art.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$Let us search for lodgings to rest our
weary bones. I am exhausted!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Yeah, I'd prefer not to sleep outdoors after
such a long day. Let's look for an inn.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$There are more people and buildings here.
This should be the village's center.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$And yet, no inn in sight...
I had hoped we would find one post-haste.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I asked around!
They said the inn's that way!

$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSad&$$@Right@$There is no question that this road is the
correct one. The capital lies ahead.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Center@$Most excellent work, Lady Mysha!
Your social skills save the day yet again!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaRelaxHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$They say the inn's food is delicious!
I wonder what's on the menu?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$Hehehe, I do wonder what princesses are
on the menu as well...
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiHappy&$$@Right@$I bet they have dango!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Let's go!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$The sun's set, the moon's risen—

$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$another day, like any other in Eastland
or Westland, comes to an end.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$I climbed into the inn's unfamiliar bed,
and closed my eyes...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$...
$#TheEternal(The Eternal)#$$&Eternal&$$@Center@$YOU WHO GNAW AT THIS IMPURE LAND—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Sage Rei, are you alright?
You're quieter than usual...
$#TheEternal(The Eternal)#$$&Eternal&$$@Center@$AND CURSE THE HEAVENS—

$#TheEternal(The Eternal)#$$&Eternal&$$@Center@$KNEEL BEFORE THE CYCLE OF
SUFFERING, THE ETERNAL REBIRTH.
$#TheEternal(The Eternal)#$$&Eternal&$$@Center@$REJOICE!!!
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirkRed&$$@Center@$Sorry, Eternal.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirkRed&$$@Center@$Don't expect me to do much rejoicing here.
It's not my style.
$#TheEternal(The Eternal)#$$&Eternal&$$@Center@$REJOICE... REJOICE!!!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHurt&$$@Center@$Stand down, Rody!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySeriousRed&$$@Center@$Sorry, Callen, no can do.
Not this time.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirkRed&$$@Center@$I've seen it...
I've seen what I've always wished for!
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttackRed&$$@Center@$The smiling faces of those I love!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Right@$Oh, I'm fine...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenShouting&$$@Center@$RODY!!!
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttackRed&$$@Center@$Haaaaaargh!!!
$#TheEternal(The Eternal)#$$&Eternal&$$@Center@$RE...RE...JOICE...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Rody)#$Haha...this is the end I wanted...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Rody)#$The rest is up to you...Finn...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$Huff... Huff... Huff...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$It was a dream...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$Why would I dream of my father...?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Wait, where is everyone?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Should we take a break?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$Were we right not to rouse Sir Finn?
I fear he may be upset upon waking.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Left@$I left a note that said we were coming here.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Left@$I'm sure as soon as he wakes up he'll see it
and come join us.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Right@$He was in such a deep sleep, it didn't feel
right to wake him.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Left@$You are quite right indeed, Sage Rei...
Sir Finn deserves a respite.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Sleep is vital—Yawn...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaBlush&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Sage Rei, why don't you lie down for a bit?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Right@$No, I'm fine.
We need to find out about the disaster.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaDepressed&$$@Left@$Nothing in this one, either...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$I recall seeing something quite peculiar
in the last tome.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$I believe we should, Sir Finn. The area
appears to be free of monsters.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$Pray tell, Sage Rei, did you not once know
someone named "Himiko?"
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Himiko?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$The tome said she possessed immense power
and the ability to control the weather.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSurprise&$$@Right@$This book mentioned a "Himiko" too.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHappy&$$@Right@$It said she was queen over 2,000 years ago.
Was she an onmyoji or something?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSurprised&$$@Left@$Weather manipulation is one of the
profound secrets of onmyodo.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSurprised&$$@Left@$It's an art that only the most outstanding
onmyoji can handle...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Right@$Oh, one so masterful in the arts as to be
referred to as "outstanding"

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Right@$by the Great Sage Rei herself!
Perhaps she could aid in our quest?
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaDepressed&$$@Left@$She lived over 2,000 years ago...

keys.DescriptionKey: A girl descended upon a land in a remote corner of Eastland. An old man who found her sleeping, eyes closed. When he went to help her, he soon realized the incurable disease afflicting him had vanished. In time, people came to worship her as a god, and a small village was established around her.

KaguyahimeDark01.title: Princess of the Black Moon

keys.IntroText: Do you know where my heart resides?

keys.DescriptionKey: Her true name is NA91. The cleansing power that led people to treat her as a god was originally given to her to neutralize the poison of her predecessor, NA88. She set foot on earth for one mission alone—to build a land where a new species could thrive after humanity perished.

keys.DescriptionKey: "Expendable"—that was the other name given to her. Launched to Erden from another star, she carried only enough fuel for a one-way trip. Once she fulfilled her mission, that would be the end. Merely a tool. She was never meant to harbor feelings for anyone.

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Kaguya, the Shining Princess" is what everyone called her, quite fittingly for such a radiant beauty. A never-ending line of suitors vied for her attention every day.
She rejected them all, though—all because of the dark secret she was hiding.

KaguyahimeRegular01.name: Kaguya
KaguyahimeRegular01.title: White Rabbit Princess
KaguyahimeRegular01.description:
"Kaguya, the Shining Princess" is what everyone called her, quite fittingly for such a radiant beauty. A never-ending line of suitors vied for her attention every day.
She rejected them all, though—all because of the dark secret she was hiding.

keys.IntroText:
I think fate brought me here across the stars
so that I could meet you...
Do you mind if I keep thinking that?

keys.DescriptionKey:
Her body contained a deadly toxin developed in order to wipe out all intelligent life on Erden, and she was created with the sole purpose of delivering it to its target. Her beauty was supposed to captivate as many human men as possible, and they in turn were supposed to become the next carriers of the toxin.
However, the plan failed. Kaguya didn't want anyone on Erden to get hurt, so she decided to prevent that by avoiding human contact altogether.

KaguyahimeRegular02.name: Kaguya
KaguyahimeRegular02.title: White Rabbit Princess
KaguyahimeRegular02.description:
Her body contained a deadly toxin developed in order to wipe out all intelligent life on Erden, and she was created with the sole purpose of delivering it to its target. Her beauty was supposed to captivate as many human men as possible, and they in turn were supposed to become the next carriers of the toxin.
However, the plan failed. Kaguya didn't want anyone on Erden to get hurt, so she decided to prevent that by avoiding human contact altogether.

keys.DescriptionKey:
And so, out of the kindness of her heart, she chose to distance herself from everybody. Life of solitude didn't mean peace of mind, though—she spent countless sleepless nights tormented by loneliness, desperately trying not to cry or scream.
The person who found her right after she had landed on Erden gave her her name—Kaguya, meaning, "may your path shine bright." May you never know darkness or loneliness again.
Perhaps that wish was the reason why years later fate brought her together with a person capable of setting her free.

KaguyahimeRegular03.name: Kaguya
KaguyahimeRegular03.title: White Rabbit Princess

The person who found her right after she had landed on Erden gave her her name—Kaguya, meaning, "may your path shine bright." May you never know darkness or loneliness again.
Perhaps that wish was the reason why years later fate brought her together with a person capable of setting her free.

keys.DescriptionKey:
It's Kaguya's first time seeing the sea, and her first time wearing a swimsuit as well. She has spent most of her life isolating herself from the outside world, but she didn't mind missing out on things—not if it meant she could save Erden.
Now she is standing next to someone very special to her, and her eyes are sparkling with joy. It's hard to believe that making her smile once seemed as impossible as the tasks she gave all her suitors.

keys.IntroText:
I'd come to see you without a second thought,
even if you were light years away.
I wonder if you know that...

keys.DescriptionKey:
Why did Kaguya ask Finn to bring her a moon stone? Because to her, the moon looked just as lonely as she felt. However, the moon wasn't alone at all—it could always count on the sun to lend it its light.
Kaguya, a rabbit from space, tries hopping around just like Erden's rabbits do, and then immediately turns bright red. Himiko must have put her up to it—which, when you look past the embarrassment, proves that Kaguya is no longer alone either.

keys.DescriptionKey:

When the object of her affection isn't with her, she goes on solitary walks in the nearby bamboo grove—the place where she landed when she first came to Erden, and where she received her name. She can always find her peace of mind there.
Saving Erden has been her sole goal for a long, long time, but now that there's no need for that, she must face another challenge—her own future, and the feelings dwelling in her heart.

$#DONTSHOWME(Riddle Fan)#$$|act1.Voices/sst5|$Ho there! If you want to get past me,

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$|act1.Voices/sst6|$I don't have time for this right now...

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Villager)#$$|act2.Voices/sst199|$Are you from the Red Dragon Knights?

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Villager)#$$|act2.Voices/sst200|$I'm worried about my son. He's been

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Villager)#$$|act2.Voices/sst201|$I heard he and his friends were attacking

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Villager)#$$|act2.Voices/sst202|$Your order is dedicated serving and

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Villager)#$$|act2.Voices/sst203|$Could you knock some sense into my son?
Last I saw he was wearing a brown hood.

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Villager)#$$|act2.Voices/sst208|$It seems the stories I've heard of the valor

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Villager)#$$|act2.Voices/sst205|$Thank you for helping my son see the

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Villager)#$$|act2.Voices/sst206|$What's that? You've taken him under your

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Villager)#$$|act2.Voices/sst207|$I feel much better knowing he's in your care!

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Villager)#$$|act2.Voices/sst204|$Knights! I heard you knocked some sense

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Villager)#$$|act2.Voices/sst205|$I heard he has been hassling travelers along
this road.

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Villager)#$$|act2.Voices/sst206|$What's that? You've taken him under your
wing?

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Villager)#$$|act2.Voices/sst207|$I feel much better knowing he's in your care!
Here, something for your trouble.
$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Villager)#$$|act2.Voices/sst212|$I hope my son isn't giving you any trouble!
$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Merchant)#$$|act2.Voices/sst221|$Seen any more Slizzles?

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Merchant)#$$|act2.Voices/sst213|$Hey there! Have you folks seen any Slizzles

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Merchant)#$$|act2.Voices/sst214|$I have a client who simply must have one,

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Merchant)#$$|act2.Voices/sst215|$You don't need to catch it for me—just

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Merchant)#$$|act2.Voices/sst217|$That's a Slizzle! Where did you catch it?

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Merchant)#$$|act2.Voices/sst219|$That's not somewhere just anyone can go...
Maybe I should give up on this endeavor.

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Merchant)#$$|act2.Voices/sst220|$Thank you for the information anyway,

keys.value: $#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinMelt&$$@Center@$Heyyy, how's it going—?

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSerious&$$@Center@$Sigh... You guys are idiots. That "issue"
is about to happen.
$#Mizuchi'sSubordinates(Mizuchi's Subordinates)#$L-Lady Mizuchi, the injured are—

$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiShouting&$$@Center@$What!? Everyone, back away from the
wounded immediately!
$#ResidentsTurnedintoOni(Residents Turned into Oni)#$GAAAAHHHRR!!
$#Mizuchi'sSubordinates(Mizuchi's Subordinates)#$S-Stop, wait... Stooooop!!
$#Mizuchi'sSubordinates(Mizuchi's Subordinates)#$W-We were treating you—aaaahhh!!

$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdLookaway&$$@Center@$Those humans I cut have already been
injected with a drug that turns them into oni.
$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSweat&$$@Center@$You're saying... They've become oni?

$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdLookaway&$$@Center@$Yes. You righteous humans despise
underhanded tactics like this most of all,
$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdLookaway&$$@Center@$don't you?
$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSurprisedBig&$$@Center@$How could you!!
$#RashomonGateGuardA(Rashomon Gate Guard A)#$What do you mean?

$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdSerious&$$@Center@$I believe solely in my own power, so I only
grudgingly accepted such a plan...
$#ResidentsTurnedintoOni(Residents Turned into Oni)#$UGAAAAAAAAAA!!
$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSurprisedBig&$$@Center@$Tch!

$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSurprisedBig&$$@Center@$(They were citizens originally—I even
know some of them!)
$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSurprisedBig&$$@Center@$Abiraunken...
$#ResidentsTurnedintoOni(Residents Turned into Oni)#$GAAAAARRR!!

$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSurprisedBig&$$@Center@$(Half-hearted onmyo magic doesn't work
at all...)

$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSurprisedBig&$$@Center@$(But if I use my full force...
I can't bring myself to hurt these people...)

$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSurprisedBig&$$@Center@$(I can't harm the very people I'm supposed
to protect!)
$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdSerious&$$@Center@$Is that so... Well then—!!

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSerious&$$@Center@$You'll know in a moment. Come on, ready
your weapons!
$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdSerious&$$@Center@$Oni Claws
$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiHurt&$$@Center@$Ugh... Uugh...

$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdLookaway&$$@Center@$It would be a shame for Mizuchi Akame to
be taken down by small fry—

$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdEyes&$$@Center@$With this sword that has drunk your
blood—I can become even stronger.
$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiHurt&$$@Center@$Ah... W-W... Wait...

$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdEyes&$$@Center@$Oh? You applied defensive magic inside
your body. As expected of one of the Four
$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdEyes&$$@Center@$Masters—thorough to the end.
$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdHurt&$$@Center@$Time to finish—ugh!?
$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdHurt&$$@Center@$M-My chest...
$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdHurt&$$@Center@$Why...does it hurt this much...

$#RashomonGateGuardA(Rashomon Gate Guard A)#$(Lady Kenshin is poised for battle...
Just what is coming exactly?)
$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdHurt&$$@Center@$Lu... Bu...?
$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiHurt&$$@Center@$Y-You... Can still... Come back...
$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiHurt&$$@Center@$Take... Take my hand...

$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdHurt&$$@Center@$Kindness... Is the foremost... Obstacle...
One who seeks strength... Must cast away...
$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdHurt&$$@Center@$—You're in my way!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Mizuchi)#$$%1%$Nn... Agh...
$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdHurt&$$@Center@$...pant...pant...pant...
$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdHurt&$$@Center@$Finally died...

$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkCrazyHeh&$$@Center@$Heh... With this... The great barrier will
be nothing but a hollow shell...
$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkCrazyHeh&$$@Center@$From here... It begins...

$#Hoshikuma(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaWink&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Someone's got a good nose☆ As a reward,
how about a gruesome death?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Dark Musashi)#$A great war... And all will be settled!

$#Kane(Kane-Douji)#$$&KindoujiSerious&$$@Left@$Do not make pointless detours, Hoshikuma.
These are Mother's orders.

$#Hoshikuma(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaGrit&$$@Right@$I know, I know. I'm literally joking.
Snitch and I'll kill you, dear brother.

$#RashomonGateGuardA(Rashomon Gate Guard A)#$$!-1!$Th-That is... An oni... No, something
beyond that...
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSerious&$$@Center@$Oni among oni, that's a top-class Douji.
$#RashomonGateGuardB(Rashomon Gate Guard B)#$I can't stop shaking, Lady Kenshin...
$#RashomonGateGuardA(Rashomon Gate Guard A)#$Y-You should be in bed, Lady Kenshin!

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinHuh&$$@Center@$Of course. Your hearts are about to submit
to your instinct to avoid dying.

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinHuh&$$@Center@$Don't think, "I don't want to die."
Tell yourself, "Kill the enemy."

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinHuh&$$@Center@$You have the strongest oni before you.
Suppress your logic, for now—
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinHuh&$$@Center@$abandon being human.
$#RashomonGateGuardA(Rashomon Gate Guard A)#$$!-1!$("Abandon being human"...!?)

$#RashomonGateGuardB(Rashomon Gate Guard B)#$(The only one who can do that is you,
Lady Kenshin!)
$#RashomonGateGuardA(Rashomon Gate Guard A)#$No time to quibble... Let's do this, everyone!
$#RashomonGateGuards(Rashomon Gate Guards)#$Uwooooooo!!

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSmirk&$$@Center@$Yeah—drive back the oni's bloodlust with
spirit.

$#Kane(Kane-Douji)#$$&KindoujiSmirk&$$@Center@$A normal human subjected to our killing
intent would struggle to stay sane...

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinTehepero&$$@Center@$It's fine. Besides, I'm bored—spacing out
on a bed is quite dull.

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSmirk&$$@Center@$Sorry, but we're trained differently,
"dear brother."

$#Kane(Kane-Douji)#$$&KindoujiShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Hmph... I am Kane-Douji. A mere human
should not address me so flippantly.

$#Hoshikuma(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaWink&$$@Left@$And I'm his sister, Hoshikuma-Douji. But
you like totally don't need to remember that.
$#Hoshikuma(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaWink&$$@Left@$Because I'm about to kill you all anyway♪
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$!!
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSerious&$$@Center@$Their killing intent just surged...

$#RashomonGateGuardA(Rashomon Gate Guard A)#$$!-1!$F-Forgive me, Lady Kenshin...
M-My strength is...
$#RashomonGateGuardB(Rashomon Gate Guard B)#$Agh... Gh-gh...
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSerious&$$@Center@$Yeah, figures... They're way beyond the norm.

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSerious&$$@Center@$For now, everyone fall back inside the
gate. Get within the great barrier.

$#RashomonGateGuardB(Rashomon Gate Guard B)#$(whisper) It's a wonder she isn't on the
brink of death...
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinHuh&$$@Center@$(Hm... Isn't something off?)

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinHuh&$$@Center@$(They should know the capital is wrapped
in an oni-warding great barrier.)

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinHuh&$$@Center@$(The barrier embodies the pinnacle of onmyo
magic—one that repelled even Shuten-Douji—)
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinHuh&$$@Center@$(So why...?)

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinHuh&$$@Center@$(Why are they still advancing toward us
without hesitation!?)
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSurprised&$$@Center@$N-No way!

$#Hoshikuma(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaHappy&$$@Center@$Hahaha, oh my gosh, you like, finally
noticed!

$#Hoshikuma(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaHappy&$$@Center@$I was literally about to whisper in your
ear that you've got a good nose but are
$#Hoshikuma(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaHappy&$$@Center@$totally blind!
$#Kane(Kane-Douji)#$$&KindoujiSmirk&$$@Center@$Indeed, there is no refuge left for you—

$#RashomonGateGuardA(Rashomon Gate Guard A)#$(whisper) The doctor said it'd take months
to fully heal...
$#Kane(Kane-Douji)#$$&KindoujiSmirk&$$@Center@$For that great barrier has long since...
$#Kane(Kane-Douji)#$$&KindoujiSmirk&$$@Center@$Been destroyed.

$#Mizuchi'sSubordinateA(Mizuchi's Subordinate A)#$Lady Mizuchi, is it true that the
swordswoman has infiltrated the capital?

$#Mizuchi'sSubordinateB(Mizuchi's Subordinate B)#$We have yet to receive such an
explanation from the Inner Palace...
$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiNormal&$$@Center@$This is about possibility.

$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiNormal&$$@Center@$But if an enemy really got in, that would
make an already bad situation even worse.

$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiNormal&$$@Center@$If it turns out to be nothing, I'll be the one
scolded by the Inner Palace, and that's all.

$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiNormal&$$@Center@$The responsibility is mine alone. So for
now, I need your cooperation, please.

$#Mizuchi'sSubordinateA(Mizuchi's Subordinate A)#$No need to say "please"... My sword and
life are yours, Lady Mizuchi!

$#Mizuchi'sSubordinateB(Mizuchi's Subordinate B)#$Though weak, we too are onmyoji.
We won't spare any effort to keep order!

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinPout&$$@Center@$Hey, what's with the whispering? Let me
in on it too!

$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSmile&$$@Center@$Thank you, everyone.
Then start the patrols!
$#Mizuchi'sSubordinates(Mizuchi's Subordinates)#$As you command!
$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(There's one more thing that worries me...)

$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(At the very time the oni grow active, a
vulpine, Mysha, appears.)
$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSerious&$$@Center@$(It's fine if it's coincidence. But if it isn't...)
$#Distantscream(Distant scream)#$Someone, heeelp!!
$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSerious&$$@Center@$!!
$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSerious&$$@Center@$(It's close—!!)
$#Injuredresident(Injured resident)#$Ugh... Aahhh...
$#Injuredresident(Injured resident)#$Oooooow, it huuurts!!
$#RashomonGateGuardA(Rashomon Gate Guard A)#$No, I don't think we should...
$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiShouting&$$@Center@$W-What is this... Everyone's been slashed!
$#Mizuchi'sSubordinates(Mizuchi's Subordinates)#$Lady Mizuchi...!! W-What is this?

$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiShouting&$$@Center@$Take them away for treatment.
All of them, now!
$#Mizuchi'sSubordinates(Mizuchi's Subordinates)#$R-Right!

$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSerious&$$@Center@$(These sword cuts... None are immediately
fatal.)

$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSerious&$$@Center@$(The wounds seem to be meant to make
them suffer in pain before dying...)
$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSerious&$$@Center@$(This isn't an oni—)
$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSerious&$$@Center@$For someone to do this...
$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdSerious&$$@Center@$Hmph!

$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdEyes&$$@Center@$Oh? I thought I had attacked from your
blind side...
$#RashomonGateGuardB(Rashomon Gate Guard B)#$Anyway, please return to your bed.
$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSerious&$$@Center@$I've survived more bloodbaths than I can count... It'll take far more to finish me.

$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdHeh&$$@Center@$As expected of Mizuchi Akame... You're
more than a worthy opponent.

$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSerious&$$@Center@$So you're Musashi, the swordswoman who
became an oni...
$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkClosedEyes&$$@Center@$The name "Musashi" has little value.

$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdHeh&$$@Center@$All I seek is pure power, power, power—!
I have no interest in anything else.

$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSweat&$$@Center@$(Just as I thought, she's nothing like the
Musashi Finn and the others told me about...)

$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiSweat&$$@Center@$(What I feel from her is the very essence
of an oni consumed by power—)

$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdEyes&$$@Center@$Mizuchi Akame, I've heard about you from
the Douji lot.

$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdEyes&$$@Center@$That you're one of the pillars upholding
the great barrier.

$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiShouting&$$@Center@$As I thought, you are after the great barrier...
But I won't allow it!

$#RashomonGateGuardA(Rashomon Gate Guard A)#$That's right. There are no issues
warranting Lady Kenshin to take charge—
$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiShouting&$$@Center@$On rokei jinbara...
$#Mizuchi(Mizuchi)#$$&MizuchiShouting&$$@Center@$Aranja kiriku!!

$#Musashi(Dark Musashi)#$$&MusashiDarkColdHurt&$$@Center@$Impressive... So this is the pinnacle of
onmyoji...

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinWeap&$$@Center@$Awa! I've been looking for you forever,
Awaaa!
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinWeap&$$@Center@$Crap, the tears and snot won't stop...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$S-Since when...

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaWah&$$@Center@$Whoa, wait, don't wipe your snot on my tail!
Finn, help!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Kenshin, this is Mysha—she's my friend.
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSurprised&$$@Center@$Huh...? Mysha...? Not Awa?

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinHuh&$$@Center@$Hmm... Looking closely... The eyes...
Oh, and there's no scar here.
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSadSmile&$$@Center@$I see...!

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSadSmile&$$@Center@$Right, it's been nine years since we parted.
Of course you wouldn't look exactly the same...
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSadSmile&$$@Center@$I see, so you are Awa's little sister...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSurpriseBlush&$$@Center@$Did you just call me "little sister"...?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Mysha has an older sister!?

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSadSmile&$$@Center@$Yeah, looked just like you, a vulpine girl
named Awa.
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinBlush&$$@Right@$All the way since before you were born...
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinConfuse&$$@Center@$Judging by your face, you didn't know...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Center@$Yeah, I don't know anything...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Center@$Tell me about my sister—and about me!
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinNormal&$$@Center@$I don't know everything, but in a nutshell...

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinNormal&$$@Center@$You're without a doubt a survivor of the
vulpine.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$sigh...
$# ( )#$— — — HWBAAAAM!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Honnoji's abilities are unfathomable. But
a tough wall, huh...)

$# ( )#$And so, they chased after the imaginary
legendary rhinoceros beetle—
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSerious&$$@Right@$Nope, no legendary rhinoceros beetle.
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiDespair&$$@Left@$Well, of course there isn't...
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinPout&$$@Right@$You say something, Honnoji?
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiPale&$$@Left@$N-No, merely that today is a lovely day...

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinTehepero&$$@Right@$Hah! What's with the stiff talk!
We're buddies now, aren't we!
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiPaleLaugh&$$@Left@$H-Hehe...
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiPaleLaugh&$$@Left@$Do I low-key attract this type of person...?
$#SamuraiA(Kenshin's Subordinates)#$$&MaleSamuraiMobSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Kenshin, it doesn't seem to be around here.
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinPout&$$@Center@$Tch, must have left while we were dawdling.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(Could it be something like Ganon's
barrier that covered that island?)

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinLaugh&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Well, we caught plenty of other bugs, so all's
well. Look at these cages. Impressive, right!?
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiShocked&$$@Left@$(So many bugs... G-Gross...)
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinAngry&$$@Right@$Don't give bugs disrespect!!
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiPanic&$$@Left@$Aaaah! How can you read my thoughts!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Glad we could help... Well then, we'll be
going.
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinNormal&$$@Right@$Uh... Hold it.

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I just had my subordinates check the
in-and-out ledgers for the past few days.

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinNormal&$$@Center@$And your names are nowhere to be found.
Care to explain?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiLaughSweat&$$@Left@$C-Come on now, Kenshin, with our special
bond and all...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Come to think of it, I don't see Captain
Perry or Ryoma around.
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinLaugh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hahaha!
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiLaughSweat&$$@Center@$Ha... Hahaha...!
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiPanic&$$@Center@$I hate this world!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Well, we didn't exactly enter by standard
means.

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiConfused&$$@Left@$How are you so calm, Finn!
I mean, our heads might—no, our heads are
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiConfused&$$@Left@$definitely gonna be on a pike!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Hmm, well, I'm kind of used to it.
To being caught, I mean.

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiCrying&$$@Left@$W-We're done for!!
Doomed! No do-overs!!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Right@$Calm down, Honnoji. They won't carry out
the sentence immediately.
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinLaugh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You're not the one who decides that.

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiLaugh&$$@Left@$Oh... Now that you mention it, when I hit
the wall, things suddenly felt lighter.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Kenshin Uesugi...
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinTehepero&$$@Center@$Hey there, enjoying prison life?
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiConfused&$$@Center@$Of course nooot.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$You've got questions for us, and that's why
you're holding us here, right?

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinConfuse&$$@Center@$You're really calm.
But yeah, that's right.

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinConfuse&$$@Center@$Ordinarily, you'd have no say, even if we
put you through interrogation or torture.
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiShocked&$$@Center@$I-I hate pain...

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinHuh&$$@Center@$Then answer here and now.
How did you get into the capital?

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinHuh&$$@Center@$We had it investigated: no hidden paths,
no secret holes. How'd you do it? Answer.

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiShocked&$$@Center@$Okay, okay, it's my ability! It's amazing—
I can move beyond space and time and

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiPaleLaugh&$$@Left@$Uh-oh, I might've dropped those two
somewhere...!
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiShocked&$$@Center@$even worlds.

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinConfuse&$$@Center@$Babbling much? You'd think someone
would hesitate saying stuff like that.

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiShocked&$$@Center@$But I hate pain!! Absolutely refuse!!
The indomitable pride of a super-edgy hermit!!

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSleepSmile&$$@Center@$Yeah yeah. But who's gonna believe that
power? Even onmyo magic doesn't possess
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSleepSmile&$$@Center@$something that convenient.
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiHurt&$$@Center@$Then I'll do it right here!
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSurprised&$$@Center@$You can!?

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiPale&$$@Center@$Whoa, hey, don't lean in... Got it. I'll do it,
just gimme a sec! Ahem...
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiLaughSweat&$$@Center@$Okay, here we go～♪
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiLaughSweat&$$@Center@$Just send me—somewhere!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$(Is teleportation really like a carriage?
Well, they do say magic is all about imagery.)
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSurprised&$$@Center@$Sh-She really vanished...
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSurprised&$$@Center@$...
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinConfuse&$$@Center@$...
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinConfuse&$$@Center@$She's not coming back...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Left@$She isn't, is she...
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinPout&$$@Right@$Did she run away?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$No, not Honnoji...! She wouldn't... I think...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Kenshin)#$$@Center@$And so, two years passed—
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Left@$They haven't.

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinFocus&$$@Right@$If she hasn't come back for two years, that
means she knows she's guilty.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$(Maybe Honnoji is using the ability with
that kind of image.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$I said it hasn't been that long.
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Either way—poor guy, big bro.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Poor guy...?

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSmirk&$$@Center@$If your partner ran, that's practically a
confession.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$W-Wait, do you know an onmyoji named
Haku Urushido?

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinPout&$$@Center@$Sure, one of the Four Masters.
Of course I know her.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Could you arrange a meeting?
She's an acquaintance.
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinBlush&$$@Center@$Is this some sort of trick?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$I have no intention to deceive you.
This country is in danger.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$I at least need to convey that to her—
please!

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiPale&$$!-1!$$@Center@$M-My bad! I'm so sorry! The gremlin
otaku energy jumped out again!

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinNormal&$$@Center@$Fine. Tomorrow we'll go to the Bureau of
Onmyo together.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Is that really okay...?
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinNormal&$$@Center@$It's a crisis, right? Then it's fine.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(She's carefree... Or rather, completely
unreadable.)

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinTehepero&$$@Center@$Oh, and if you're thinking of escaping,
don't.
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinTehepero&$$@Center@$Because I'd just cut you down.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(I take that back...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(If anything, it's because she has real
strength that she can make calls like this.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$I won't run. Absolutely not.
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinNormal&$$@Center@$Hmph... Whatever.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$No. Without you, we couldn't have escaped
the island. The credit is yours.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Kenshin)#$And so, two years passed—
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Left@$They haven't.

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiHurt&$$@Center@$You're even kind to a worm in the dirt—
Finn, are you the protagonist of a mobile
$#DONOTSHOWME(Honnoji)#$Ng-woah-woah-woaaaaa?!?
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiHurt&$$@Center@$game or something!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$A worm...? Mobile game...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(Honnoji sometimes says things I don't
really understand.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Those two will be fine, I'm sure.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$But can you tell where they landed,
specifically?
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiConsidering&$$@Left@$I don't think it's that far...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Then they should also be heading toward
the capital.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Let's head for the capital too. We should
be able to meet up there.

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiLaughSweat&$$@Left@$Ohh, that's Finn for you! Super positive!!
Ah, and one more pending concern...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Is something bothering you?
$# ( )#$KABOOOOOM!!
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiLaughSweat&$$@Left@$Actually, my Gift... I mean ability...
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiLaughSweat&$$@Left@$Sometimes, moving takes a while...

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiLookAway&$$@Left@$And this time—probably quite a bit of
time has passed since we left the island.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$So, it's actually been days...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Then the plea for help you heard... Oh no,
Lady Rei!!

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiLaughSweat&$$@Left@$Ah, that might be fine! I don't fully get it yet,
but what I heard was a voice from the future.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Uh... Like a premonition?
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiLaughSweat&$$@Left@$Yeah, pretty much.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$You can do that too?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$If a scholar of magic I know heard that, it
would cause a huge stir...
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiConfused&$$@Left@$B-Botched...l-landing...—Oof.

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiShocked&$$@Left@$Eek... A scholar...? I-I don't wanna be a
lab rat!

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiClosedEyes&$$@Left@$Oh, but if it lets me live comfortably as a
NEET, that might be okay...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$Anyway, we have no read on the situation
now. Let's head for the capital.
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiConsidering&$$@Left@$But, where even are we...?
$#Kenshin(???)#$$&KenshinHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$This is a grove. It's my turf.

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiGeekSmile&$$@Center@$A grove?
Just looks like some woods to me...
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiShocked&$$@Center@$Wait, who are you!?

$#Kenshin(???)#$$&KenshinAngry&$$@Center@$Hah—that's my line. What village are you
from, huh!?
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiConfused&$$!-1!$$@Left@$The final boss of social classes! Yikes...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$Sorry, truth is, we don't really know
where we are...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Right@$Oww... You okay, Honnoji?
$#Kenshin(???)#$$&KenshinAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You don't know where you are—don't be—!
$#Kenshin(???)#$$&KenshinHurt&$$@Center@$No... Wait... Thinking about it...
$#Kenshin(???)#$$&KenshinHurt&$$@Center@$Where even is this... And who am I...
$#Kenshin(???)#$$&KenshinHurt&$$@Center@$Who am I!? Oh, crap... It's getting fuzzy!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Um... Are you okay?
$#Kenshin(???)#$$&KenshinFocus&$$@Right@$Kenshin... Believe.

$#Kenshin(???)#$$&KenshinSurprised&$$@Right@$That voice!? The inner Big Mother...
KEN-Shin!?
$#Kenshin(???)#$$&KenshinFocus&$$@Right@$You are you... Descendant of the distinguished Uesugi clan, the ethereal, stunning beauty,
$#Kenshin(???)#$$&KenshinFocus&$$@Right@$Kenshin.
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That's right! I am...Kenshin Uesugi!

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiConfused&$$@Left@$S-Somehow... Ow—
I slammed into something hard...
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinHeh&$$@Center@$Identity crisis—cleared!!

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSleepSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Thank you, Big Mother!
Thank you, world!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Left@$This person is quite strange...
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Which means... I'm gonna kill you.

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiShocked&$$!-1!$$@Left@$A plot twist that hits harder than a
cancelled manga!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$But we truly don't know where we are...
The circumstances are unclear...

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinHuh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Quit babbling. This is the venerable
temple, just inside the Rashomon Gate—
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinHuh&$$@Center@$gate to the capital of the realm!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$We're inside the capital!?
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiSurprised&$$@Left@$We slipped in somehow!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Something hard?

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinLaugh&$$@Right@$And I'm the head guard in charge of this
gate—Kenshin Uesugi.
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinLaugh&$$@Right@$Feel free to call me Kenny.
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiSurprised&$$@Left@$Kenny...?
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinAngry&$$@Right@$Don't get so familiar!!
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiConfused&$$@Left@$Eeeeeek!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$She's rather unreasonable...
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinHuh&$$!-1!$$@Right@$So, why did you come here? Start talking.
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiPale&$$@Left@$Uh, um...

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiPaleLaugh&$$@Left@$A-A rhinoceros beetle! Yeah! We came
because we heard of a legendary
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiPaleLaugh&$$@Left@$rhinoceros beetle that lives in this grove!

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiHurt&$$@Left@$Mm-hmm... Not really sure, but when I
tried to enter this capital place...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$!-1!$$@Right@$(Hey, Honnoji...!)

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiConfused&$$@Left@$(If I say we're here to rescue our friends,
things might get messy again.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Right@$(But that doesn't mean she'll fall for such
a lame excuse...)

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Why didn't you say so sooner!
What if it gets away, huh!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$She's totally falling for it!
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinHeh&$$@Center@$Hey! You lot, get over here!
$#SamuraiA;SamuraiB;(Kenshin's Subordinates)#$$&MaleSamuraiMobSerious;SamuraiB.MaleSamuraiMobSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;SamuraiB.Right;@$Okaaay!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(W-When did they...!
And all of them are holding bug cages...)

$#SamuraiA(Tattletale Subordinate)#$$&MaleSamuraiMobSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Lady Kenshin, this guy says he doesn't
wanna go bug catching.
$#SamuraiB(Unmotivated Subordinate)#$$&MaleSamuraiMobSerious&$$@Right@$I mean, it's just a hassle, you know.

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiDespair&$$@Left@$Sigh... I wanted to nail a cool dynamic
landing with a swoosh.

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$C'mon, don't say that—it's a little "please"
from Kenshin♡
$#SamuraiA(Unmotivated Subordinate)#$$&MaleSamuraiMobSerious&$$@Center@$Lady Kenshin doesn't have any sex appeal.
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinAngry&$$@Center@$Die!!!!!!!!!!!!
$#SamuraiA(Unmotivated Subordinate)#$$&MaleSamuraiMobShouting&$$@Center@$Gh... Ah...ow!
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinFocus&$$@Center@$Knocked out by my violent allure, huh...
$#SamuraiB(Unmotivated Subordinate)#$$&MaleSamuraiMobSerious&$$@Center@$I was knocked out by violent violence...

$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinNormal&$$@Center@$All right, everyone's participating. I hear
no "noes." Oh, that means you two, too.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Uh, ah... Okay.
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiDespair&$$@Left@$I feel like we can't refuse...
$#Kenshin(Kenshin)#$$&KenshinLaugh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$All right then, let's go bug catching!

keys.DescriptionKey: The vermilion blade gleams in the darkness of night, shrouded in divine radiance as it flickers like a crane's wings.

KenshinKatana01.name: Himezuru Blade
KenshinKatana01.description: The vermilion blade gleams in the darkness of night, shrouded in divine radiance as it flickers like a crane's wings.

keys.DescriptionKey: Kenshin was born into a family that had, for generations, overseen the guards of Rashomon Gate, the sole gate into the Capital. When Kenshin was fifteen, her father stepped down, and she became the head of the Uesugi family. Though free-spirited by nature, she possessed a strong sense of responsibility and was deeply trusted by her subordinates.

KenshinRegular01.name: Kenshin
KenshinRegular01.title: Master of Rashomon Gate

When Kenshin was fifteen, her father stepped down, and she became the head of the Uesugi family. keys.IntroText:
