KillSummonx2AAir.description: Adds 2 Denmoris to the very end of the allied reinforcements. Unlocked each time the user defeats another unit with an attack. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.
KillSummonx2AAir.selected: Adds 2 Denmoris to back of allied reinforcements

keys.MessageKey: This skill can only be used if this unit has defeated 1+ units with attacks since entering battle or the last time this skill was used.

keys.value:
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSad&$$@Right@$Finn, how are you doing?
You looked like you were in pain before...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneShocked&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Is Grethe's secret room through here?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$There's only one way to find out.

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ha, it opened!
So, this part of the wall was actually a door...
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSerious&$$@Center@$That just screams, "secret room"!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$It looks like...
A path that leads underground?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$I guess that's where we're headed, then.
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Come on, guys! Let's go!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSerious&$$@Center@$Yeah! We've got to honor Grethe's request!

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSadComical&$$@Center@$Uuugh... This salty sea air is making my
eyes sting!
$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Hmph. Is that the worst of your worries?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$It's okay, I'm fine.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSadComical&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Well, it's not helping. I don't see anything
that looks like an island...

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSadComical&$$@Left@$Makes me wonder if we're really going the
right way.

$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayHurt&$$@Right@$Wasn't this voyage your idea?
Honestly, abandoning our posts like that...
$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayHurt&$$@Right@$The King will not be pleased.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethIrritated&$$@Left@$You're here because you're worried too,
aren't you?

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethIrritated&$$@Left@$Like, who goes all the way to Avalon with
only two companions?
$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I am here, because I don't understand our king's true motives

$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayClosedEyes&$$@Center@$and I wish to inquire about them directly.
Not out of concern.
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethTroubled&$$@Center@$Oooh, so stoic.

$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Are you quite certain that Avalon is in this
direction?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$More importantly, we have to figure out
what Grethe wanted us to protect.
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethHappy&$$@Left@$Sure? Well. Probably. Ish.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethHappy&$$@Left@$This compass is just a copy of the real thing,
so I can't really vouch for its accuracy.

$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayNormal&$$@Right@$Bold of you to set out on the sea with such
uncertain intelligence.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethTroubled&$$@Left@$Wow, way to turn on me, Kay.
I'm hurt.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Anyways, do you think those three are
okay?

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSad&$$@Center@$The island's supposed to be crawling with
scary faeries.
$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayGrin&$$@Center@$If you'll recall the battle two months ago...

$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayGrin&$$@Center@$We were at a severe disadvantage, and the
King single-handedly saved the situation.

$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayGrin&$$@Center@$She alone has more firepower than most
battalions.
$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayGrin&$$@Center@$Faeries would certainly be a trifling matter.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSerious&$$@Right@$...Right!
She handed me this key.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Come to think of it, Gawain once said
something like that, too.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSurprised&$$@Left@$That our king's swordsmanship was
"surreal."

$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayGrin&$$@Right@$Yes, those invisible strikes. No way to dodge
them, no way to survive a hit.
$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayGrin&$$@Right@$Again, there's nothing to worry about.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethLaugh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$C'mon, why can't you just come clean?
You're worried, aren't you?

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethLaugh&$$@Center@$You got yourself on this boat before anyone
else even showed up.

$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayGrit&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Gareth... Would you like to be brought
within an inch of your life again?

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethShocked&$$@Left@$Whoa, chill!
I swear, I won't say another word.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethLaugh&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh, hey! There it is!
Kay, there's actually an island!

$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayNormal&$$@Right@$Hm, so it would seem.
It certainly fits the description...

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Left@$She definitely said "secret room," too.
So, there's got to be one in here somewhere.
$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySad&$$@Center@$...I see.
$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySad&$$@Center@$Grethe and Tethe have returned too.

$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySerious&$$@Center@$Then, he and I are the only ones who
remain.
$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySerious&$$@Center@$Is it time for Avalon to atone for its sins?
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$There! Another faerie!
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSurprised&$$@Left@$Ooh, right on cue.
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I know you, witch of Avalon.

$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySmile&$$@Left@$Greetings, o King of Mankind.
Hehe, everything is coming full circle.

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Right@$So this is the creature that cast the original
curse. The legendary witch, Le Fay...

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotNormal&$$@Left@$She looks a lot daintier than the tales would
have you believe.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$If Grethe wanted to keep something safe...

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Do not let your eyes deceive you. What
stands before us is a truly wicked creature.
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurIrritated&$$@Center@$Sharpen your wits and steel your resolve.

$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySmile&$$@Center@$Very well.
Come then, you fools.
$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Center@$See where your fate leads!
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Left@$Just where does this cave even lead to?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$Deeper and deeper, by the looks of it.

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSerious&$$@Left@$It's getting darker and darker too. We're not
 getting any light from the outside anymore.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWorried&$$@Right@$It looks like the path goes even deeper,
though... It's...so shadowy...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Are you all right?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneNormal&$$@Right@$...Sorry?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...There's only one place she could've put it.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You've gotten a lot quieter, so I was
wondering if you were afraid of the dark.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$May I hold your hand?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBlush&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...Um, why?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Well, it'd be bad if we got separated.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$O-Oh, okay...
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Center@$(Huh, Finn actually picked up on that?)

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Center@$(I guess I can't always be the one to hold her
hand through tough times...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Is something wrong, Mikaela?

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleGrin&$$@Left@$Nope, nothing at all.
Oh, hey! Over there!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$There's a light!
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Left@$Of course! Her menagerie!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneShocked&$$@Right@$We're...still underground, right?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$You'd never guess that all this space was
sitting under the island.
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Whoa! Okay! What the hell is THAT!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$You mean the giant, glowing orb...?
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Left@$That's creepy, right?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneScared&$$@Right@$It is. I've got goosebumps.
I really don't like the look of it.

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$"Creepy," huh?
You're not wrong about that.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$...!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprised&$$@Center@$Spica!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Here! There's a keyhole!
The key fits perfectly, too!

$#PrincessLeidram(Princess Leidram)#$$&ArthurSmile&$$@Center@$Lancelot.
What kind of knight do you wish to become?
$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayGrit&$$@Right@$And such a horrifying display...
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethShouting&$$@Left@$Sure thing, sis!
$#Gareth;Gawain;(Gawain & Gareth)#$$&GarethShouting;Gawain.GawainShouting&$$@Left;;;Gawain.Right;@$Royal Lunarslash!

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotShouting&$$@Center@$I'll press on too!
Royal Swiftslash!

$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayShouting&$$@Center@$So will I!
Royal Venomslice!

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotShouting&$$@Center@$Ha! How do you like the might of the
Knights of the Round Table?
$#DONOTSHOWME(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...Hmph.
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkClosedEyes&$$@Center@$A waste of time, as expected.
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotShouting&$$@Center@$No way...!

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$Your pitiful skills cannot even reach the tip
of my sword.
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$This is true power...

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$My liege...?
That form, it's...
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$Regal Cometflare.
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainIrritated&$$@Right@$Hngh...!
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethHurt&$$@Left@$Whoa...!
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Regal Fangsbane.
$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayHurt&$$@Center@$Impossible...!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$I won't let you ruin this world!

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$Even a hero's skill cannot match this power.
It surpasses everything and everyone—
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotShouting&$$@Center@$(That stance...!)
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotShouting&$$@Center@$Finn, watch out!
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$Regal Flashstrike.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkCrazy&$$@Center@$I can feel power welling up from the very
depths of my being.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Left@$...Nngh!
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHurt&$$@Right@$...Aaaaah!

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(All of her techniques are upgraded
versions of our own...!?)
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHurt&$$@Center@$(And they're impossible to follow too...)

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$No way... They all got cut down in an
instant...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneShouting&$$@Right@$Mikaela!
We can't let her win!

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Don't worry, I've got your back!
Go for it, Jeanne!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneShouting&$$@Center@$"In the name of the ruler of Heaven...
May this scene bathe in Your holy light!"

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$Is that all you are capable of, saint?
Pathetic.
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&JeanneShouting&$$@Center@$Huh!?

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkCrazy&$$@Center@$So, this is Avalon's primal force...
And the means to fulfilling my desires.
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$For I command the darkness of Avalon...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneMichelleInsideHurt&$$@Center@$(My purifying light is getting
overwhelmed!?)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Jeanne)#$$!-1!$(Wait, I can see something in the middle of
the darkness—)
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&JeanneMichelleInsideSurprised&$$@Center@$Jeanne... Ungh!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneScream&$$@Center@$Aaaaaaaaaah!
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$Hmph. Laughable.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$W-Wait...

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$If anything is to end here, it will be your
pitiful lives.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$If you want to curse anything, let it be your
fate.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$No, this...can't be it...

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Did we not make the journey to Avalon
to rid ourselves of our curse!?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$!-1!$We have...to stop her...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$But I can't...move...

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSurprised&$$@Left@$...Nothing's changed!
We're still stuck with it!
$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayGrit&$$@Right@$Tch! What is going on here...?
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I have no more use for you.
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Center@$...Augh!
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotShouting&$$@Center@$Gawain, are you all right!?

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Why, one who can serve the King, Camelot
and any of its citizens who are suffering!

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$My liege...! You would turn your blade
against me!?
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSad&$$@Left@$Hold on, Gawain!

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSad&$$@Right@$Didn't you hear her, Lancelot!?
She has no use for us anymore...so...

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$My liege, I must know...
Is that truly how you see us?

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkClosedEyes&$$@Center@$It is. I have no further need of any
of you, or your dull blades.
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I...
$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayNormal&$$@Right@$Damn you...!

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That day, when you wept for your brothers... 
Was that false?

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkClosedEyes&$$@Center@$I cursed my own fate that day, while
reveling in my good fortune.
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Center@$What do you mean...?

$#PrincessLeidram(Princess Leidram)#$$&ArthurSmile&$$@Right@$A fine answer. May you become strong
enough to do just that.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkClosedEyes&$$@Center@$I had obtained advance notice that
assassins were going to steal into
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkClosedEyes&$$@Center@$the castle to murder the two princes.
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkNormal&$$@Center@$So, I made sure the door was open.
$#WisePrince(Wise Prince)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Left@$Assassins!? Here!?
$#BoldPrince(Bold Prince)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Right@$How did you get in here?
$#Assassin;AssassinB;AssassinC;(Assassin)#$$&RobeMaleNormal;AssassinB.RobeMaleNormal;AssassinC.RobeMaleNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;AssassinB.Center;AssassinC.Right;@$...

$#BoldPrince(Bold Prince)#$$&NobleExcited&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Unwilling to dignify us with an answer,
are you?
$#BoldPrince(Bold Prince)#$$&NobleExcited&$$@Right@$Very well, then! Do your worst!
$#WisePrince(Wise Prince)#$$&NobleNormal&$$@Left@$Hmph, they're charging straight at us.

$#WisePrince(Wise Prince)#$$&NobleNormal&$$@Left@$Assuming that we are simply pampered
nobles, perhaps. How reckless.

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Thank you for your support!
Then...what sort of king do you aspire to be?
$#Assassin(Assassin)#$$&RobeMaleOpenMouth&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...!
$#BoldPrince(Bold Prince)#$$&NobleExcited&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Haha! Take that!

$#WisePrince(Wise Prince)#$$&NobleNormal&$$@Left@$Don't let your guard down over a minor
victory.
$#BoldPrince(Bold Prince)#$$&NobleExcited&$$@Right@$Yeah, I know!
$#PrincessLeidram(Princess Leidram)#$$&ArthurNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Dearest brothers...
$#BoldPrince(Bold Prince)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Leidram! What are you doing here?

$#WisePrince(Wise Prince)#$$&NobleNormal&$$@Left@$Hurry, get behind us.
Assassins have infiltrated the castle.
$#PrincessLeidram(Princess Leidram)#$$&ArthurSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#WisePrince(Wise Prince)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Center@$...!
Wha—!?

$#BoldPrince(Bold Prince)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Center@$Leidram, how could you!?
He was your own brother!

$#PrincessLeidram(Princess Leidram)#$$&ArthurSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...Lancelot.
You are aware that I have brothers, yes?
$#BoldPrince(Bold Prince)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Center@$...Ah. Not me, too...?

$#PrincessLeidram(Princess Leidram)#$$&ArthurSerious&$$@Center@$Far too slow. Come now, you know better
than to leave your back exposed.

$#BoldPrince(Bold Prince)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Center@$C-Curses...!
I'm fenced in!

$#PrincessLeidram(Princess Leidram)#$$&ArthurSerious&$$@Center@$Please enjoy your eternal rest.
You may leave everything to me.
$#BoldPrince(Bold Prince)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Center@$Damn you! I knew it! You are the cursed one!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Bold Prince)#$Aaaaaaargh...!
$#PrincessLeidram(Princess Leidram)#$$&ArthurSerious&$$@Center@$And now, to tidy up.
$#Assassin;AssassinB;AssassinC;(Assassin)#$$&RobeMaleNormal;AssassinB.RobeMaleNormal;AssassinC.RobeMaleNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;AssassinB.Center;AssassinC.Right;@$...!?

$#PrincessLeidram(Princess Leidram)#$$&ArthurSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$After all, a proper assassination
has no witnesses. Is that not right?
$#Assassin(Assassin)#$$&RobeMaleOpenMouth&$$@Center@$...!
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$P-Please excuse my insensitivity, ma'am!
$#PrincessLeidram(Princess Leidram)#$$&ArthurSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$There is no escape.
$#PrincessLeidram(Princess Leidram)#$$&ArthurSerious&$$@Center@$There, only one remains.
$#Assassin(Assassin)#$$&RobeMaleNormal&$$@Center@$O-Oooh...
$#PrincessLeidram(Princess Leidram)#$$&ArthurSerious&$$@Center@$However, I will not be the one to kill you.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Princess Leidram)#$$&ArthurBlood&$$!-1!$Ngh...
$#PrincessLeidramHurt(Princess Leidram)#$$&ArthurBlood&$$@Center@$A-Aaah...
$#Assassin(Assassin)#$$&RobeMaleOpenMouth&$$@Center@$Wh-Why...Why would you stab yourself?

$#PrincessLeidramHurt(Princess Leidram)#$$&ArthurBlood&$$@Center@$You will soon...find out...
Your executioner is coming... Hehehe...
$#Assassin(Assassin)#$$&RobeMaleOpenMouth&$$@Center@$Wh-Why are you laughing...? Who...What are you!?

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Center@$...I see. What that assassin was so terrified
of...was your bloodlust.
$#PrincessLeidram(Princess Leidram)#$$&ArthurSmile&$$@Right@$Hehe, it is quite all right.
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$It was all merely a means to an end.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$This very moment is why I did what I did.
Why I became the king.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Why would you go that far...? What could
possibly justify this much bloodshed!?

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Left@$Transcending my current existence and
evolving into something never seen before.

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Right@$So, all this time...
you were deceiving us?
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkClosedEyes&$$@Left@$Naturally.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$This world has too many useless beings in
it. A selection must be held.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$With Avalon's power, I will distribute
curses from shore to shore.
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$What do you think will happen then?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Nothing but chaos, what else!?
$#PrincessLeidram(Princess Leidram)#$$&ArthurSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Well, if I were to become the king, then...

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Left@$Quite the opposite. Although...
to be fair, there will be wars.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Left@$The entirety of mankind will be fighting
each other.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSerious&$$@Center@$"May Kay's honorable soul take its
rightful place in Heaven,

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSerious&$$@Center@$and may blessings of tranquility
always be upon him."

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSad&$$@Center@$He has earned a lifetime of rest, in a world
free from curses...
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSerious&$$@Center@$Meanwhile, our work is only beginning.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethIrritated&$$@Center@$Don't you worry, Kay!
You can leave the rest to us!

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSad&$$@Left@$Pfft, I can't move an inch.
And neither can you, right?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Yeah! Now let's track King Arthur down!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$She should still be on the island, right?

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$@Right@$No, the boats we'd anchored here are
missing. She must've absconded with them.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Does that mean that we're stuck here...?

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinWink&$$@Center@$Diiiiiid somebody caaaaaall—
Whoops, almost tripped there. Teehee!
$#Finn;Jeanne;(Finn & Jeanne)#$$&FinnSurprise;Jeanne.JeanneSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Jeanne.Right;@$Merlin!?

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Oooh, those are some glares.
What's shaking, folks?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Nothing's "shaking"!
We're in the middle of a crisis!
$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinHappy&$$@Right@$Haha, yep, I figured as much!

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Would you happen to be...
the great magician, Merlin!?
$#Kay(Kay)#$$&KayClosedEyes&$$@Right@$...More or less.
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethLaugh&$$@Center@$Huh? Wasn't Merlin supposed to be a ma—

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinTehepero&$$@Center@$Now, now, missy... Leaking people's personal
details is a no-no.
$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinTehepero&$$@Center@$Unless you want a mighty magical punishment☆

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSerious&$$@Left@$If you're so powerful, then surely you can
lend us your aid!

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinComplacent&$$@Right@$Weeeeeell... I'm not exactly allowed to
meddle with anything directly.
$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinTehepero&$$@Right@$I'm more of a magical observer, really.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$What's that supposed to mea—

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinStare&$$!-1!$$@Right@$More importantly, our good Saint Jeanne
here...
$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinStare&$$@Right@$You had a vision of the future, didn't you?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneNormal&$$@Left@$A vision...?
$#()#$In front of the Tree of Avalon...
$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFayLaugh&$$@Center@$the world seemed like nothing but a void?

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotBitterSmile&$$@Left@$E-Expertly done, my liege.
You saw straight through that barrier.

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotEcstasyClosedEyes&$$@Left@$Still, I wouldn't mind...
Experiencing that sensation again...

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Right@$Don't even think about it.
We came here with an objective to achieve.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yes, we have but one goal.
To dispel this hundred-year-old curse.
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurClosedEyes&$$@Center@$So, to that end...
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSerious&$$@Center@$We must defeat the Nine Fae.
$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySmirk&$$@Center@$Is that correct, o King of Mankind?

$#FirstKingArthur(First King Arthur)#$Indeed, I am a king!
Everything I wanted fell into my hands!
$#FirstKingArthur(First King Arthur)#$Alas, it was not enough...

$#FirstKingArthur(First King Arthur)#$No matter what I obtained, I never felt
satisfied.

$#FirstKingArthur(First King Arthur)#$Desire is a terrifying thing. It flows freely
from the vessel that holds it, without end.
$#FirstKingArthur(First King Arthur)#$Was that the curse you spoke of?

$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySerious&$$@Center@$No, that's simply human nature.
That void was always awaiting you all,
$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySerious&$$@Center@$right from the very beginning.

$#FirstKingArthur(First King Arthur)#$But you must have known...
What truly lies in human hearts.
$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFayLaugh&$$@Center@$Well, well. So good to see you again.

$#FirstKingArthur(First King Arthur)#$...Well, no matter.
My time has come...

$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySmile&$$@Center@$Indeed.
Welcome back...
$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySmile&$$@Center@$to the soul of Avalon.

$#FirstKingArthur(First King Arthur)#$Yes, finally...
Eternity in the land of peace...

$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySmile&$$@Center@$There, the human "king" has
once again returned to Avalon.

$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySmile&$$@Center@$Everything begins and ends here.
Such is the curse.

$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySmile&$$@Center@$There is no escape from this isle...
Isn't that right, Lucius?

$#Velsa(Velsa)#$$&VelsaCheeky&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Sister, our visitors have arrived.
Shall we go greet them?
$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySmirk&$$@Left@$Ah, yes.

$#Musa(Musa)#$$&FairyRedHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$My, just the two of you again?
Can't I join in on the fun this time?

$#FirstKingArthur(First King Arthur)#$Maiden of Avalon... I'm unsure as to how
I should return the greeting.
$#Velsa(Velsa)#$$&VelsaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Are you sure you're up for the task, Musa?

$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFayLaugh&$$@Left@$Now, Velsa. There's no reason to deny her.
After all, Musa should gain an
$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFayLaugh&$$@Left@$understanding of human desire too.

$#Musa(Musa)#$$&FairyRedNaughty&$$@Right@$You needn't worry there, sisters.
Humans are just playthings.
$#Musa(Musa)#$$&FairyRedNaughty&$$@Right@$As a faerie, I won't be outdone!

$#Velsa(Velsa)#$$&VelsaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You see, sister?
Musa is much too inexperienced.

$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySmile&$$@Left@$Which is all the more reason why she
needs a chance to learn.
$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySmile&$$@Left@$Besides, we have other guests to attend to.
$#Velsa(Velsa)#$$&VelsaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$We do?

$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySmirk&$$@Center@$Yes, things will soon be bustling around
here.

$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySmirk&$$@Center@$That's fine, it's enough that you wanted to.
I have been waiting for you to return.

$#()#$The first thing I noticed...was the feeling
that my skin was roasting to a crisp.

$#()#$There was something strange about the
sun beating down on me,
$#()#$and the wind blowing past.

$#???(???)#$Geez, just how long are you going stay
passed out?
$#???(???)#$C'mon, wake up already!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$...Huh!?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Mikaela, stop that! Yelling that close to
someone's ear can't be good for them...
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleBlush&$$@Left@$Well, he wouldn't wake up, so.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Mikaela!? Jeanne!?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBlush&$$@Right@$Really, Mikaela...
Finn, are you okay?
$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFaySmile&$$@Center@$Did you obtain everything you desired?

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleBlush&$$@Left@$...Fine, sorry, my bad. You're all right,
right?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$Yeah, I think so. Wait, where are we?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSad&$$@Left@$We're not really sure either.

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleNormal&$$@Left@$But isn't it exactly how it happened last
time?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...So this is Camelot!
Does that mean that Merlin is here too?

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$@Left@$$%1.3%$Nope, we haven't seen hair or hide of the
magician.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$(Still, she might be watching us from
somewhere...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Helloooooo! Merliiiiiin!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...No answer, huh.

$#FirstKingArthur(First King Arthur)#$With human lifespans as fleeting as they
are... No, I never managed to.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSerious&$$@Right@$This place must be in trouble again...
This must be why we were called here!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Jeanne, is it just me, or have you gotten
bolder since the last time we met?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprisedBlush&$$@Right@$Um, you really think so?

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Left@$Yeah, she's really toughened up!
That's the Saint of the North right here!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You don't say!
So that was you!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneBlush&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Ah, you heard that name too, Finn?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Yeah, the knights who went on an
expedition up north wouldn't stop
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$talking about you in their reports!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$They said a saint had descended from the
heavens to shine light on wicked deeds and
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$help the needy of the northern lands!
$#FirstKingArthur(First King Arthur)#$I spent my entire life feeling unfulfilled.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprisedBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I-I didn't do anything that praise-worthy!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$And when I think about Camelot...
Especially those people in Lonsbury...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSad&$$@Right@$And how I couldn't do anything for them...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$Right...
That poor village...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneShocked&$$!-1!$$@Center@$H-Huh? Was that...?
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Something wrong, Jeanne?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSerious&$$@Right@$No, but I thought I saw...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I knew it! It is him!
Wait up!
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Come on! We've got to go after her, Finn!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Uh... R-Right!

$#FirstKingArthur(First King Arthur)#$There was...an emptiness that always
gnawed at me.

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleHurt&$$@Center@$$%1%$Jeanne, what the devil's gotten into you!?
You just up and bolted! Out of the blue!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprised&$$@Center@$Didn't either of you see him?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprised&$$@Center@$Spica was standing in those bushes!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$N-No way!
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You're sure you saw someone?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSerious&$$@Right@$I am!
That was definitely Spica!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hey, isn't that a house over there?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneShocked&$$@Right@$He may be inside!

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSurprised&$$@Left@$So, this is Avalon... The legendary land that
we, the Knights of the Round Table,
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSurprised&$$@Left@$have been seeking.

$#LeFay(Le Fay)#$$&LeFayLaugh&$$@Center@$You ate the Fruit of Wisdom.
Yet, even after receiving its power...

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSurprised&$$@Right@$Be on your guard, Lancelot.
Who knows what awaits u—
$#LancelotWroggling(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHurt&$$@Left@$Whoa!
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainIrritated&$$@Right@$Wh-What is this...!?

$#LancelotWroggling(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotBitterSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It's...tingly?
Or maybe prickly?

$#LancelotWroggling(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotEcstasy&$$@Center@$Either way, my whole body hurts!
Hiihiiii!

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Center@$(Don't tell me she's enjoying this!?
Ngh... I can feel my senses slipping... I—)

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurShouting&$$@Center@$So this is Avalon's aegis. ...Have at it!
Haaaaaah!

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurClosedEyes&$$@Center@$This barrier is meant to repel any
unwanted visitors.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurSerious&$$@Center@$But we were chosen. Otherwise, we would
not be in possession of these souls.
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Huff...huff...huff...

keys.DescriptionKey:
In Camelot, the Knights of the Round Table inherit their names from generation to generation, along with their curse. The third King Arthur, known as Arthur Leidram, was no exception.
Armed with her sacred sword, she dominated every battlefield she appeared on—and no one could tell if what she'd set her sights on was a world of peace or one of ruin.

All hail the one who commands
the Round Table's absolute loyalty—
King Arthur, the third of that name

keys.DescriptionKey: She didn't turn evil, not exactly—she merely revealed who she had always been deep down. A ruthless absolute monarch. She'll stop at nothing to achieve her goals, and now that she has obtained the power to bend anything and everything to her will, she is sure to take the shortest path to make a new world—her new world—become reality.

She'll stop at nothing to achieve her goals, and now that she has obtained the power to bend anything and everything to her will, she is sure to take the shortest path to make a new world—her new world—become reality.

keys.DescriptionKey:
It's as if King Arthur—no, even young Leidram—always knew it would come to this conclusion. If so, was there ever any meaning to her tears, her affection? What thoughts did she keep in her heart when she took her place at the Round Table?
Her crime and punishment spreads out far, towards the violent "selection" that will shape humankind's future.

keys.value: King Arthur, the Cursed Legend

keys.DescriptionKey:
Dusk was gathering across the sandy beach, mingling light with darkness. The waves were low, as if groveling, and even the sea breeze had gone quiet as the ruler of the Round Table took a leisurely walk.
Her mind wandering, she realized she had never been to the seaside before, even though Camelot had access to the sea. Watching the waves break on the shore and retreat only to come back again, she thought about her past and her future.
"It is quite pleasant here, I must admit."

In the words of the great magician Merlin:
Nice outfit, Your Majesty♪

keys.DescriptionKey:
A familiar figure appeared over Kay, blocking out the sun and his view of the clear skies. Judging by the menacing aura he could sense, he concluded that it must be his former king, changed after obtaining the power of Avalon. And then, the figure spoke.
"Don't you think you have slept enough, brother?"
Kay jerked awake, shaken by what he had witnessed in his dream."Stop meddling with people's heads, you blasted incubus..." he mumbled to himself before closing his eyes again.

keys.DescriptionKey: The Knights of the Round Table were spending one of their rare days off at the royal swimming pool—Kay lounging under a beach umbrella, Gawain devouring a generous serving of fried noodles, Lancelot preparing to take a dive from the springboard, and Gareth floating idly in her swim ring. At one point, they all noticed the absence of their king, only to spot her swimming gracefully a short distance away. When she reached their end of the pool, four hands stretched out in her direction, offering to help her get out of the water. And though it might have been a trick of the summer sun, the knights could swear that in that moment her face was brightened by a smile.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The illusive Kirin are common characters in Erden mythology, but their significance greatly differs from culture to culture. The Zuo people of Eastland believe that the appearance of a Kirin is a sign that a god is near, whilst the legends of the Akashi people depict the Kirin as a symbol of great happiness.

Few have ever met a Kirin, and reports of their nature vary from gentle and majestic to divinely terrifying.

keys.DescriptionKey: An ancient folktale found among various cultural groups in Westland tells the story of a child abandoned at birth and raised by a Kirin. The child, in some tales called Enkidu and by others Eabani, grew up in the spirit world compassionate and gentle. When she turned 16, the Kirin took her back to the material realm, where she was greatly saddened by the division between its peoples. She begged her foster parent to do something, and moved by his ward's conviction, the Kirin led a procession of his breathren to thunder across the night sky.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The people of Westland looked up in wonder to see the procession of Kirin marching across the heavens. Their hooves left a trail of golden dust in their wake, which remained in the sky for seven days and seven nights after the Kirin depearted.

It is said that the scattered peoples of Ancient Westland made a ceasefire treaty effective every year for these seven days and seven nights. Many scholars equate this week of peaceful celebration with the modern day Helvati Ker festivities observed by many groups in Westland's northwest.

keys.DescriptionKey: Kirin—a sacred beast that is an Avatar of the Primordials—found the girl in the forest and raised her. keys.DescriptionKey:
The villagers called little Kisara the terror of their town.

No corner of their farming hamlet was spared her whirlwind mischief. The young girl practically vibrated with energy -- energy her traditional, rule-abiding parents couldn't handle. The more they forced her into chores and quiet reading, the more she rebelled, mouthing off to anyone who'd listen and breaking valuable tools in the name of playing 'samurai.' 

At their wits' end, her mother and father attempted to betroth her to a wealthy merchant in the city, but a wandering swordsman instead asked for the chance to take Kisara on as his apprentice. He alone saw the burning heart her misbehavior masked.

Kisara01.name: Kisara
Kisara01.title: Blade of the Summer Sun
Kisara01.description:
The villagers called little Kisara the terror of their town.

No corner of their farming hamlet was spared her whirlwind mischief. The young girl practically vibrated with energy -- energy her traditional, rule-abiding parents couldn't handle. The more they forced her into chores and quiet reading, the more she rebelled, mouthing off to anyone who'd listen and breaking valuable tools in the name of playing 'samurai.' 

At their wits' end, her mother and father attempted to betroth her to a wealthy merchant in the city, but a wandering swordsman instead asked for the chance to take Kisara on as his apprentice. He alone saw the burning heart her misbehavior masked.

keys.IntroText:
"A blade that strikes with the fury of fire
knows only glory or death."

keys.DescriptionKey:
At first, Kisara rebelled against her master's strictness. She had an undeniable talent for the sword. He'd even told her so. Why did he insist on repetitive drills, boring meals, and hours upon hours of meditation?

He replied that meditation nourished her mind, rice nourished her body, and drills nourished her blade. Should any one of these things go dull, all the talent in the world couldn't keep her alive.

Eventually, she saw the wisdom of his words, and channeled her boundless energy into a signature fighting style. Long before she left her master, tales of her unrelenting speed and strength made her enemies tremble.

Kisara02.name: Kisara

He replied that meditation nourished her mind, rice nourished her body, and drills nourished her blade. Should any one of these things go dull, all the talent in the world couldn't keep her alive.

Eventually, she saw the wisdom of his words, and channeled her boundless energy into a signature fighting style. Long before she left her master, tales of her unrelenting speed and strength made her enemies tremble.

keys.DescriptionKey:
She could have had anything she desired. Wealth, power, fame -- more than one nobleman offered her these things to her, if she would swear to serve them exclusively. 

Instead, she charged them double her usual fee, then turned around and helped their villagers for nothing at all.

Kisara was no fool. She'd learned long ago that many samurai hid behind honor to do terrible things. Even she could not always be a hero. But she could make the world a gentler place the only way she knew how.

She could pass on her wisdom and ideals to an apprentice, as her master had done before her.

keys.DescriptionKey: Kojiro Sasaki was born into a samurai household. After the untimely death of her mother, she lived alone with her father, whose forced retirement from the way of the warrior due to an injury prompted him to put all his unfulfilled dreams onto his daughter's shoulders. His fixation with raising the perfect swordsman resulted in extreme strictness, which kept young Kojiro constantly discouraged instead of motivating her.

keys.DescriptionKey: Kojiro had always thought of her own sword skills as disgraceful—her father's words, outweighing any praise she'd ever received from others and always holding her back. Her clan are the lorekeepers, the storytellers of the yanti, and she's recognized as the greatest storyteller of her generation.

Her clan are the lorekeepers, the storytellers of the yanti, and she's recognized as the greatest storyteller of her generation.

keys.DescriptionKey: However, Yabanni's clan's stories spread not through verbal storytelling and song, the way most yanti tell stories, but by venom—those her clan bite (and who survive) instinctively understand the ancestral tales of the yanti. To Yabanni, a venomous bite is one of the greatest gifts she can give. She has bitten one thousand and one people, spreading the yanti canon all over the world. Now, every month she takes commissions from those wishing to be bitten so that they can learn her ancient wisdom.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Long ago, in the time of the first Pandemonium, Fornaxos inherited the power of flame and became one of the six Legendary Dragons that embody the elements of Erden. Tasked with defeating the Eternal, he knew that untempered fire would destroy more than it would save. In his humility, he retreated to a lone mountain to hone his power and train for the battle to come.

Settlers who ventured too far up that mountain would return bearing tales of a shining creature who split the night sky with pillars of flame. Thus, the villagers came to call their home Mount Fornax, in honor of the dragon who shared it with them. Most have now forgotten why the rocky peak bears that name...but just enough of the story survives to inspire travelers to make the climb, in the hope that they'll see a legend in the flesh.

keys.IntroText:
"Grovel not before me. 
Fire serves the people of Erden, and so do I."

keys.DescriptionKey:
Fornaxos spent centuries alone, preparing himself to one day face the godlike Eternal. Now that the threat is vanquished, he finds himself a bit perplexed at his existence. If his purpose was to end the Pandemonium, and a group of mortals completed that purpose for him, what right does he have to call himself a legendary guardian of Erden?

After some thought, he has decided to leave the lonely summit of Mount Fornax to explore the world beyond. His brethren, the five other Legendary Dragons, must be facing the same conundrum that he is, now that the world is free. Perhaps with them by his side, he can forge a new legend to fulfill.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Though he is a being of nearly unrivaled power, Fornaxos deeply admires the mortal people of Erden. Their fortitude in the face of the world's disorder astounds him. Death could come for any of them at any time, and their lives are too short to see their present toil bear fruit in the future. Even still, they create. They love. They live, knowing full well that one day they will be no more. To him, that is strength that a god could never hope to possess.

Many of Erden's civilizations have disappeared in his lifetime, consumed by their own mortality. Sometimes, when he's feeling nostalgic, he will leave an offering in their ruins to prove to their wandering spirits that their short, brilliant lives are still remembered, if only by a single soul.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Not every Pandemonium has ended happily.

When a Crimson Crestbearer, drunk on power, marched across the land as its conqueror, his partner Cerulean faced a torturous choice. Would he kill the chosen one and condemn the world to a century of Pandemonium, or allow him to forge his empire of blood in exchange for slaying the Eternal?

In the end, he stabbed his former friend in the back, stopping him from taking Rigland's capital at an unfathomable cost. Their battlefield lies fallow to this day.

and thereafter, Pandemonium reigned."

keys.DescriptionKey: She should have had no lingering regrets. And yet, when her eyes opened once more through the power of the Talisman of Revival, a single wish began to bloom within Lü Bu's heart— She wanted to see her again. Guided by that one simple, humble wish, she returned to the battlefield once more.

keys.IntroText: Back from Hell, to be reunited with her friend.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Even after seeing how Musashi had been corrupted into an oni, Lü Bu's feelings did not waver. No matter how completely Musashi had changed in personality or appearance, she could not abandon her dear friend who was now truly alone.

And so, rather than choosing what was right, she chose to stand by Musashi's side.

keys.DescriptionKey:
She was a girl with no name, just a number carved into her skin. Until one day she killed the adults that chained her, burned the walls that confined her, destroyed everything that stood in her way to freedom.
She did whatever she needed to stay alive, and threw away what she didn't need anymore without hesitation. And people called it duplicity, they called it betrayal. Before she knew it, she had gained a name, and the name had gained notoriety.
Perhaps the number on her skin has been an evil omen from the start...

LuBuRegular01.title: Master of Treachery

She was a girl with no name, just a number carved into her skin. Until one day she killed the adults that chained her, burned the walls that confined her, destroyed everything that stood in her way to freedom.
She did whatever she needed to stay alive, and threw away what she didn't need anymore without hesitation. And people called it duplicity, they called it betrayal. Before she knew it, she had gained a name, and the name had gained notoriety.

keys.IntroText:
Betrayal breeds betrayal and more betrayal
Love breeds hate and nothing more

keys.DescriptionKey:
She doesn't have any positive emotions left now, but she used to have them once. She used to have someone she cared about.
Lü Bu often thinks about the girl who shared her fate as a child; wonders where she might be now, what she's doing these days... Constant enemy attacks have left her with no illusions, though—with too many betrayals on her record, Lü Bu doesn't have anywhere to go anymore.
Except for the land across the sea.

And so, Lucifer decided to strike first. She sealed the weapon—her first friend, her only friend—away in a remote cave.

Ludmilla01.name: Ludmilla
Ludmilla01.title: Ludmilla
Ludmilla01.description: Openhearted and an excellent leader, Captain Ludmilla commands the Third Regiment of the Rigland Red Dragon Knights. Her rigorous training routines that turn everything, including sleeping, into some form of training, are infamous among the Knights.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Long ago, when she had witnessed a ballet performance as a child, she saw it as something purely beautiful—something from a world far removed from her own.
But as she began living and training alongside the troupe, sharing meals with them and sweating in the same rehearsal hall, she realized she had been wrong.
Even within graceful movements and quiet steps, there lay the same resolve and discipline as when she practiced her sword.

LudmillaBallet01.name: Ludmilla
LudmillaBallet01.title: Red Dragon Dancer
LudmillaBallet01.description:
Long ago, when she had witnessed a ballet performance as a child, she saw it as something purely beautiful—something from a world far removed from her own.
But as she began living and training alongside the troupe, sharing meals with them and sweating in the same rehearsal hall, she realized she had been wrong.
Even within graceful movements and quiet steps, there lay the same resolve and discipline as when she practiced her sword.

keys.IntroText: Won't you dance with me?

keys.DescriptionKey:
Even on an unfamiliar stage, Clarice danced with a skill far beyond her own. And yet, not a trace of jealousy stirred in Ludmilla's heart.
What she felt instead was pure joy—that her dear friend had been recognized and found new bonds.
Determined to catch up in her own way, Ludmilla once again commits to her training with maximum gusto.

LudmillaBallet02.title: Red Dragon Dancer

keys.DescriptionKey:
Clarice watched it all unfold—others derided Ludmilla as someone with no talent for dance.
But even without any talent, she would not stop—stumbling, falling, sweating, and still rising again with a smile.
The sight stole Clarice's heart again and again.
Even if her movements were far from graceful, to Clarice, Ludmilla's dance was more noble—and more beautiful—than anyone else's.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Even the flower petals dance, as if in celebration.
"Wait! I have no intention of marrying. This is just a test fit."
A pure white dress and long locks of raven hair. Her cheeks color as pink as the flower petals as she asks, "well? How do I look?"
Someday, someone may have the honor of answering her in truth.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The sun fills the air with a golden light as she turns back. "Hurry, dear, come on."
A past that may have been, or a future that may yet be. Even after she lays down her mace, she will surely continue protecting those she loves - her husband, her children, her family.

The pale moon tonight illuminates much, but does little to show you her true feelings.
An ancient legend of Eastland tells of a beautiful princess who, when none could win her favor, returned to her home on the moon, never to be seen again.
If you wish to prevent such a thing from happening again, you must speak now, from the heart.

keys.value: $#Crozier(Crozier)#$$&CrozierSneer&$$@Right@$My Lord Aldyne. I have returned.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$Father, let me go with them. The three of
us will be able to handle the boat.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceExcitedNoSword&$$@Left@$It's so delicious, I can feel myself growing
faint!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Really? I'm glad you like it!
Here, come on, you all. Don't hold back.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Sir Finn, they say that a samurai's life is
spent finding the place where he must die.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Right@$She looks so happy. We can't let our
Marshal down, can we?

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$If you're eating, then count me in too,
Brother.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Forward, brave warriors! Forward, and
may you never look back!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Kitchen Maid)#$$!-1!$Oh, I can't watch...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$Wow, you all cleaned your plates! You must
have been hungry. How was it?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$U-um, it was...
It was great...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHappy&$$@Left@$I'm glad!
I'll have to cook for the Knights sometime.
$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneNormal&$$@Left@$I forbid it!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$Hahaha...
Ha...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$I...think I will return to my room...
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSad&$$@Right@$Yeah... Me too...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$Right. Rest up until there's more word from
Father, then. Good work today, everyone.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceHappyNoSword&$$@Right@$Let's talk in your room until then, Miss.
I would love to brush your hair!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$And she's still full of energy.
I guess that's the power of love.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$(After an hour or so, Lord Aldyne called me
and the Marshal to a sitting room...)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$I suppose we'll wait here...Finn? Are you
alright? You look a bit pale.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$I-I'm just fine, haha...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$If you say so.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Right@$Father!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$What do you suppose will happen now?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Knowing Father, he has a backup plan. I'm
not sure what it is yet, but...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Ah, here he comes.

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneNormal&$$@Right@$So sorry for the wait, you two.
Allow me to get right to the point.

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneNormal&$$@Right@$Mister Finn, you and Lord Crozier will duel.
A real, proper trial by combat, this time.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$That's about what I expected.
Do you intend to cheat this time, too?
$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneNormal&$$@Right@$Do you have any proof that I did before?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$...No.

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneSmile&$$@Right@$Then please stop all this resistance. This is
for your own good. —Beatrice!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Head Maid)#$$!-1!$Yes, Master!
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Gyaaaaaaaaaaah!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Head Maid)#$Right, girls, remember how we did it last
time. Get her legs!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Head Maid)#$And one, two, three, lift!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprisedBlush&$$@Center@$Not you all again!
Damn it! How are you so strong!?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaAngryBlush&$$@Center@$Father! This isn't over!
Fatheeeeeer!

$#Crozier(Crozier)#$$&CrozierLaugh&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Ah, so we'll get to see her in that dress
again. How nice.

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneSmile&$$@Right@$I'll explain the rules once the preparations
are complete. Please wait here until then.

$#Crozier(Crozier)#$$&CrozierSneer&$$@Left@$...We may be here for some time.
Let's both do our best in the duel, Finn.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Lord Crozier...did you know the contest
was fixed?

$#Crozier(Crozier)#$$&CrozierSmirk&$$@Left@$......
Shall we take a little walk?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$...Fine.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$That cry!
$#Crozier(Crozier)#$$&CrozierSmirk&$$@Left@$This way.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceContemptNoSword&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Crozier...
He's up to something.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceAngryNoSword&$$@Center@$For my Mistress's sake...
I will end him.
$#Dragon(Drake Monster)#$$&BlueWingDragonOpenMouth&$$@Center@$Gyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$A drake!?
Wait...

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneNormal&$$@Right@$Guards, to your posts! A monster has
entered the villa grounds!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$Wait! There's...
There's someone on its back!
$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneSurprised&$$@Right@$What!?

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneSmile&$$@Left@$Ah, welcome back. It seems like you were
the only one to retrieve a treasure in time.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Sorry for all the noise, everyone!
We're back, though!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$Finn! You tamed this monster and flew it
across the open ocean!?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$You reckless...I ought to court-martial you.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$But we made it! And we're on time too,
aren't we?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$That's right!
Nagi, what time is it?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Right@$Midday on the dot!
Just barely a pass...but a pass all the same!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$Hah! Well done, Brother! Looks like we
didn't need to worry after all.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$Hm. So that means the contest is all a big
tie, right?

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneClosedEyesSmile&$$@Right@$There's still the matter of the treasures!
Do any of you have one?

$#NobleA(Noble A)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I was so busy running away from the
monsters...
$#Crozier(Crozier)#$$&CrozierSmirk&$$@Right@$Yes, it does appear that way.
$#NobleB(Noble B)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Left@$Same...
$#NobleC(Noble C)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Right@$I'm afraid I don't have anything.
$#NobleD(Noble D)#$$&NobleSurprised&$$@Left@$Well, at least we still have our lives...

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I see. And you, Mister Finn?
Do you have a treasure?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Right@$I do! This is the "sacred leaf that can cure
all ills".

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneSurprised&$$@Left@$W-what!?
But that's...!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$Why do you seem so surprised, Father?
$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneSad&$$@Left@$Well, I...
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$Do you think it could be fake, master?
$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneSurprised&$$@Left@$Clarice? Why are you with them?
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$Nagi, we're going back out.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$That hardly matters. Please, confirm
whether this leaf is real or not.
$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneSurprised&$$@Left@$But how?

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSwimsuitGrin&$$@Right@$Simple. We'll mortally wound someone here,
then have them consume the leaf.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSwimsuitGrin&$$@Right@$If the wound heals, it will be confirmed as
the real article.

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneNormal&$$@Left@$B-but that sounds so dangerous!
Who would possibly—
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSwimsuitYandereSmile&$$@Right@$Finn, prepare the leaf, if you would.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Huh? Wait a minute, you can't mean to—!
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSwimsuitYandereSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$For my Mistress, I'll do anything.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Center@$(...!
She took the leaf!)

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSwimsuitYandereSmile&$$@Center@$Now, if you all will observe this knife
closely...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Right@$As you say!
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSwimsuitHurt&$$@Center@$......Nngh...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaScared&$$@Center@$Clarice!! What have you done!?
Quick, the leaf...!

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSwimsuitHurt&$$@Center@$M-Miss...
Nnh... Mm...

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSwimsuitHurt&$$@Center@$.........Huff, huff.
L-look, Miss...at my wound...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$...! You stabbed so deeply, but there isn't
even the faintest mark there anymore!

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSwimsuitYandereSmile&$$@Center@$Phew...the pain is beginning to recede as
well. Was that a satisfactory test?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$I can't think of anything that would be
more solid proof!
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSwimsuitYandereSmile&$$@Center@$Kuhuhu...then it was all worth it.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Thank you, Clarice. But please never do that
again. It's bad for my heart.

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneNormal&$$@Left@$Wait. The sea is growing rough; how do you
intend to cross in such a small boat?
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSwimsuitGrin&$$@Right@$...As you wish, Miss.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$Well, Father?
I would call that definitive.

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneSad&$$@Right@$I-I suppose so. I will need some time to...
Go over my records. Please excuse me.
$#Crozier(Crozier)#$$&CrozierClosedEyes&$$@Left@$Then I will visit the washroom.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So it was fixed from the start.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Fixed?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I had my suspicions as soon as I heard that
Lord Crozier would be participating...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Center@$I assume my Father set this up with the
intention that Lord Crozier would win.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Center@$Given his shock, I assume the only treasure
on the island arrived, and left, with Crozier.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Then what about me and the gentlemen?

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneNormal&$$@Left@$There will be time to rescue the others
after the storm has subsided.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Left@$They were invited just to round out the
roster and make it look legitimate, I'm sure.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Right@$...I see. That makes a lot of things make
more sense.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$Still, Finn, you really pulled off a miracle,
finding that leaf.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Oh, it wasn't me. Clarice gave that to me
on the drake's back.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$Then it was Clarice who found it!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$She said she's carried some with her ever
since she worked for her old employer.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Just in case anything ever happened to you.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Alastor...
If anyone had an herb like that, he would.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What's going to happen now? I doubt we'll
just go into a second round right away.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$That depends on Father, really.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$Sorry, Boss, but that's just how it is.
My Brother's waiting for us out there.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$At least we have some time to rest. In fact,
I've prepared a surprise for you all.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$A surprise?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHappy&$$@Left@$Just you wait!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHappy&$$@Center@$Eat up, everyone! I put my heart and soul
into this meal!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Cookmaid)#$$!-1!$A-are you sure about this, Miss Ludmilla?
We can still prepare something else...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$I won't pretend I'm a skilled chef, but I know
my way around a camp stove, at least.

$#NobleA(Noble A)#$$&NobleHappyBlush&$$!-1!$$@Left@$My word! To think we would be given the
chance to enjoy Lady Ludmilla's cooking!
$#NobleB(Noble B)#$$&NobleHappyBlush&$$@Right@$This alone makes coming here worthwhile!

$#NobleC(Noble C)#$$&NobleHappyBlush&$$@Left@$With me, gentlemen!
Recall rule 15 of our agreement!
$#NobleD(Noble D)#$$&NobleHappyBlush&$$@Right@$Rule 15! When served a meal...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$If I must, I will swim across the water with
the ancient swimming arts of my people!
$#NobleA;NobleB;(Nobles)#$$&NobleHappyBlush;NobleB.NobleHappyBlush&$$@Left;;;NobleB.Right;@$Dig in with gusto!
$#NobleC;NobleD;(Nobles)#$$&NobleHappyBlush;NobleD.NobleHappyBlush&$$@Left;;;NobleD.Right;@$—Hurk!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$T-they all passed out!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I do have to wonder what exactly this is
on the plate, yes...
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSad&$$@Right@$It sure doesn't look or smell like food.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceYandereSmileNoSword&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Kuhuhu. Such weaklings.
How pathetic.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$Are you okay, Clarice? You did just
disembowel yourself earlier.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceExcitedNoSword&$$@Left@$Your point? I would pull myself out
of my grave to eat my Mistress's cooking.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$(Clarice gets pretty intense when it comes
to the Marshal...)

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceExcitedNoSword&$$@Left@$Kuhu. My, so delicious...the spice feels as
though it will burn me up from the inside!

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneNormal&$$@Left@$Now, we've all had our fun, but the hour
is getting late.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$Phew...nothing like a hot bath.
Now to turn out the—
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$(Someone's here, by the bed!)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$Show yourself!
...Clarice!
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceHappyNoSword&$$@Right@$Good evening, Miss.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$Huh? I locked the door.
How did you get in?
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSmileNoSword&$$@Right@$The window was open, after all.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$This is the third floor...
Well, I know you can climb that.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSinisterNoSword&$$@Right@$I'm honored that you remember so much
about me, Miss. Kuhuhu.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Of course I do.
Did you need something?

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneNormal&$$@Left@$The interview will begin tomorrow. I would
recommend you all get a good night's sleep.
$#Lightling;Clarice;(Clarice)#$$&LightlingPlushie;Clarice.ClariceSmileNoSword&$$@Center;;;Clarice.Right;@$$%LightlingPlushie;Clarice.ClariceSmileNoSword%$Yes. I have a present for you.

$#Lightling;Ludmilla;(Ludmilla)#$$&LightlingPlushie;Ludmilla.LudmillaSurprised&$$@Center;;;Ludmilla.Left;@$A present? Is that...a plush Lightling?
It's...
