$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBlush&$$@Left@$Father, Mother. This is my...my lover.
His name is Finn!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$U-um...I'm Finn! Sir and madam!
It's my honor to make your acquaintance!

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneSurprised&$$@Left@$Is this true?
Are you Ludmilla's young man?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Yes. I apologize for taking so long to
formally present myself, my Lord.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$But Ludmilla...and I have been discussing
the possibility of marriage.

$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneHappyGlasses&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Oh my, oh my! So you're my daughter's
boy, then! Oh, how handsome!

$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneHappyGlasses&$$@Right@$Why, my dear!
Whatever is the matter?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprisedBlush&$$@Left@$Mother, please! He is not some pet to be
fawned over!

$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneSmileGlasses&$$@Right@$Oh dear, did I make you jealous? You've
changed so much since you last visited!

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Wait just a moment! Does this mean...
You intend to refuse the interview?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$No, Father. As promised, I will attend. But
I have no intention of considering marriage.

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...What!? What could you possibly be
thinking?

$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneHappyGlasses&$$@Right@$In any case, we'd better get her changed!
The fitting will take some time.

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneNormal&$$@Left@$I suppose so...perhaps a proper interview
will help her change her mind!

$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneNormalGlasses&$$@Right@$Oh, Head Maid! Girls!
Ludmilla is ready for her fitting!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Head Maid)#$$!-1!$Yes, Mistress!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$Beatrice!?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBrideGirtBlush&$$@Left@$Mother...you know what the matter is. This...outfit does not suit me at all!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprisedBlush&$$@Center@$W-what are you doing!? Mother!?
What's this "fitting"!?

$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneHappyGlasses&$$@Center@$Oh, calm down, dear!
Trust me, you'll love it.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Head Maid)#$$!-1!$Miss Ludmilla, please stop this struggling.
Perhaps we should carry her?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Maid)#$Yes, that seems best.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Head Maid)#$On three, girls...
One, two, three!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Center@$How are you all so strong!? This is why I
never come home! Unhand me, all of you!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Center@$I'll remember this, Motheeeer!

$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneSmileGlasses&$$@Left@$There, all set! Now then. Shall we chat,
Mister Finn?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$U-um... I'd be honored.
$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I'll go make sure everything else is ready.

$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneSmileGlasses&$$@Right@$Oh, don't be ridiculous! It suits you very
well indeed.

$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneHappyGlasses&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Haha, that's just like him, leaving just
because things got a little awkward.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$Um, where did...Ludmilla get taken off to?

$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneHappyGlasses&$$@Left@$Don't you worry, dear. You'll see her soon,
and she'll be even lovelier than usual.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$I-I see...

$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneHappyGlasses&$$@Left@$I really must say, I never expected her to
bring home such a handsome young man.
$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneSmileGlasses&$$@Left@$May I ask?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$About what, my Lady?
$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneSmileGlasses&$$@Left@$What is it that attracted you to her?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Oh, um...her concern for others, and her
hardworking spirit, I would say.
$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneHappyGlasses&$$@Left@$My! Such compliments. ♪
$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneHappyGlasses&$$@Right@$Wouldn't you agree, Mister Finn?

$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneNormalGlasses&$$@Left@$But, hm...that sounds less like a lover, and
more like regard for a superior...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubledBlush&$$@Right@$Oh, uh!
That's, uh...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Uh-oh! I have to change the topic,
and fast!)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$—Ah! That white shield on the wall is
beautiful. And is that a real sword?

$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneSurprisedGlasses&$$@Center@$Yes, those are some of the family treasures
of House Aldyne.

$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneNormalGlasses&$$@Center@$At least, I certainly assume it's a real
sword.

$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneHappyGlasses&$$@Center@$Oh, I know! We should make these
Ludmilla's bridal instruments!

$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneHappyGlasses&$$@Center@$A white dress and a white sword and shield.
Isn't that just a wonderful idea?

$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneHappyGlasses&$$@Center@$What a capital suggestion! I expect nothing
less from my future son-in-law. ♪

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(Phew, it looks like I was able to steer
the conversation away...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubledBlush&$$@Right@$U-um... Yes.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurpriseBlush&$$@Center@$Ah...so this is the white dress she
mentioned...

$#LadyAldyne(Lady Aldyne)#$$&LadyAldyneHappyGlasses&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh, she's just so lovely!
Wouldn't you agree, dear?

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneSmile&$$@Right@$Yes, indeed.
The flower of the Aldyne family!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBrideGirtBlush&$$@Left@$Nngh...

$#Crozier(???)#$$&CrozierSneer&$$@Right@$Ah, I had wondered why the maids seemed
busy. To think I would meet a goddess!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBrideSurprised&$$@Left@$You...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBrideSurprised&$$@Left@$Lord Crozier!?
But what are you doing here?

$#Crozier(Crozier)#$$&CrozierSmirk&$$@Right@$What else, but participating in your
marriage interview?

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneSmile&$$@Left@$Lord Crozier, I believe you were requested
to wait with the others on the beachside?

$#Crozier(Crozier)#$$&CrozierSmirk&$$@Right@$Of course, Lord Aldyne. I simply lost my
way on the way to the washroom.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBrideShouting&$$@Left@$Stop. I don't need your flattery.
$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneNormal&$$@Left@$...Yes, it can be rather confusing.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBrideSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Father! My interview partner is Lord
Crozier!?

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneSmile&$$@Right@$Yes, he is one of the candidates we
invited.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBrideConfused&$$@Left@$One...? Candidates, plural!?

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneNormal&$$@Right@$There are five in total. Well, six, counting
the young man you brought along.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBrideShouting&$$@Left@$What kind of marriage interview is this!?

$#Crozier(Crozier)#$$&CrozierSneer&$$@Right@$What can I say, Ludmilla? You're quite a
catch, much more than you realize.

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneNormal&$$@Left@$My apologies, Lord Crozier, but could you
return to the beach at your convenience?

$#Crozier(Crozier)#$$&CrozierSmirk&$$@Right@$Yes, of course...
But may I ask, who is this?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$My name is Finn.
Um, I'm Ludmilla's—
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBrideShouting&$$@Left@$This...thing doesn't suit me. There's no way!

$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneNormal&$$@Left@$He's another of the candidates.
Nothing more, and nothing less.

$#Crozier(Crozier)#$$&CrozierSmirk&$$@Right@$I see. Then, I will take my leave.
Another time, Ludmilla.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBrideBlush&$$@Left@$Yes...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Lord Crozier, huh...the Marshal seems
tense. I wonder what happened there.)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBrideShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...You did not tell me Lord Crozier would
be involved, Father.
$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneNormal&$$@Right@$You certainly didn't take the time to ask.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBrideSigh&$$@Left@$......

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBrideSerious&$$@Left@$So you intend for Finn to participate in
this, as well?
$#LordAldyne(Lord Aldyne)#$$&LordAldyneSmile&$$@Right@$Yes. You don't mind, do you, Mister Finn?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Not at all, my Lord. This is what I came
here for!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHappy&$$@Left@$Be sure you take good care of her, Finn.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$I just hope I can do the job right.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$I'm your commanding officer, so I don't
mind, but...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$You're going to give some poor girl
the wrong idea someday. Be careful.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurpriseBlush&$$@Right@$Careful?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Yes! Do you understand?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Y-yes, ma'am!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$Good answer, soldier!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$Now, we're running the rest of the way.
If you lag behind, you'll give me 100 pushups!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$H-huh!?
W-wait for me!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$Don't worry. Just stay by my side;
that will be enough.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$If that's all, then I would be honored to.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaPout&$$@Left@$Haha, he's already starting to act the part!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprisedBlush&$$@Left@$Mysha...! Come along, Finn. If we stay here
they'll just keep teasing us.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$We'll be back after the mission, then!
$#()#$(Click-clack, click-clack...)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$(The interview's being held at a beachside
villa, accessible by carriage...)
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSigh&$$@Left@$...Phew.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$Are you nervous, Marshal?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmileBlush&$$@Right@$Right. I'll do my very best!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Left@$Well, yes... Thinking about all this is enough
to make my stomach hurt.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$I see... I didn't realize you could get
nervous, ma'am.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBlush&$$@Left@$Hah. I'm only human, Finn. Keep that in
mind once we're inside.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Ah, you're right. I'll need to be careful
about that.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurpriseBlush&$$@Right@$Marshal? Is there something on my face?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$I almost didn't realize, but that's another
thing— how you address me.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$How I address you?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Marshal, "ma'am"...that just won't work.
We'll need to think of something else.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubledBlush&$$@Right@$Another way for me to call you...hmm...
What about, uh... M-Milla?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$Finn, raise your chin.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprisedBlush&$$@Left@$Straight to a nickname!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubledBlush&$$@Right@$I figure lovers would probably do something
like that, wouldn't they?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Mm... Perhaps, but something about it...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBlush&$$@Center@$It sounds like what a younger brother would
say. Shouldn't you call me...Miss, maybe?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$But that doesn't sound close enough either.
Maybe there's a middle ground?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBrideClosedEyesBlush&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I...guess you're right.
Mm...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Fine. For the sake of the operation, you
have my permission to call me Ludmilla!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Okay, um...
Got it, Ludmilla!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBlush&$$@Left@$Mm. I just can't get used to that.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurpriseBlush&$$@Right@$Huh? What is it?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$Whoa!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$The carriage stopped?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$What's going on? We shouldn't be there yet.

$#Driver(Driver)#$$&MaleVillagerASerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Apologies, miss! There are some monsters
up ahead, and the horses are spooked.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$Monsters? I see. Turn back, then.
We'll get off here.

$#Driver(Driver)#$$&MaleVillagerASerious&$$@Right@$Get off!?
Are you sure!?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Yes, thank you for taking us this far.
Here— keep the change, and get going.

$#Driver(Driver)#$$&MaleVillagerASerious&$$@Right@$I-if you say so, miss!
Be careful!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Monster)#$Grrrr...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$...Your cheeks are slightly red.
What are you imagining?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Monster)#$Grrrrrr...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Yup, there they are.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$Civilians live around here. Let's drive the
monsters off before they hurt anyone!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Roger!
$#Monster(Monster)#$$&Orc&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Grrrh... Groooooo!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaClosedEyesBlush&$$@Center@$(I can't afford to be distracted now!
Focus, and defeat them!)
$#Ludmilla;Monster;(Monster)#$$&LudmillaCommand;Monster.Orc&$$@Left;;;Monster.Right;@$Gggrghh...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$There, that's the last of them.
Finn, how are things looking?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$...Finn? Damn it, we got separated!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$(Finn's capable, but if he gets surrounded...
I need to find him!)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurpriseBlush&$$@Right@$Huh? N-nothing! I'm just happy to help!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Center@$Finn! Where are you!?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Center@$—There!
Damn it, he's already surrounded.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Center@$(This is bad. I need to—)
$#Monster(Monster)#$$&Orc&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Grraaaaagh!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$Finn, behind you!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Haaaaa!
$#Monster(Monster)#$$&Orc&$$@Right@$Ggh...grrrgh...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$!-1!$$@Right@$There, that's all of them.
There sure were a lot, though.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Right@$Ah, Mars...I mean, Ludmilla.
Was everything okay over there?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHappy&$$@Left@$Yes...that was some solid footwork just now.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$If you say so. But do not forget that this is
an official mission!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Oh, thanks. It was a bit tight, but it looks
like I made it through.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$It looks that way.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(His perception, his stance, his movement...
He's improved so much since he joined.)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$(No, it's not just him. Everyone has grown
so much over the battles we've faced.)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Center@$(Perhaps they would be alright without me,
now. Perhaps—)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$...No. What am I saying? What kind of
leader steps away from her soldiers?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$The Knights deserve better than someone
who wavers over personal matters...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$We deserve better than you?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$Don't say that, Marshal!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$Finn...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$I know, Astrid.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$You're a knight among knights! We wouldn't
be the same without you. We need you!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$Please don't say otherwise...
Even as a joke.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I want to stay with you all, too! I want to
serve my kingdom as a proud knight. But...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Center@$Just for a moment, I thought...
What if I did accept?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$If that's your choice, then we would all
respect it, Marshal. I'm sure we would.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$But if you're torn between two paths...
Why don't you just choose both?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...Both?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$You chose to make your own path before,
right? Maybe you can make a new path now.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I see... I suppose you could look at it
that way.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$A new path...
Perhaps so.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBlush&$$@Left@$I'm sorry to make you all go to all this
trouble for me.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$Thank you, Finn.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$I feel more confident, now.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Oh, um... Sorry, Marshal.
I didn't mean to lecture you.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHappy&$$@Left@$You didn't. I'm glad to have such sharp
soldiers under my command.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$You're a good man, Finn. You'll make a fine
husband to a lucky someone someday.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Right now, that would be you, Marshal.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprisedBlush&$$@Left@$Wha—

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprisedBlush&$$@Left@$Fool! This is just a role for the mission!
And don't call me Marshal!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubledBlush&$$@Right@$Right, sorry, Marshal!
Uh, Ludmilla!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Honestly...there's a limit to kindness,
you know.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Inside the castle, the party continues, with food, chatter, and the clink of glasses. But Ludmilla finds herself outside, alone, her cheeks and nose reddened by the cold. A clinging dress, uncomfortable high heels... "What am I doing in these? They don't suit me at all..." Her sigh is white mist in the frozen night.
"That's not true at all, Miss." Hearing a soft voice and footsteps behind her, she turns.

LudmillaChristmas01.title: Knight of the Holy Eve

keys.IntroText:
"Please don't look at me like that. I wanted
to try it on, but it's... embarrassing..."

keys.DescriptionKey:
Ludmilla sighs as Clarice pours her another flute of champagne. "A Marshal should never drink on duty..."
"You aren't on duty now. Why not indulge, just for tonight?" Ludmilla can't argue with that, and picks up her glass. Pleasant drink and pleasant company while the hours away.

LudmillaChristmas02.name: Ludmilla
LudmillaChristmas02.title: Knight of the Holy Eve
LudmillaChristmas02.description:
Ludmilla sighs as Clarice pours her another flute of champagne. "A Marshal should never drink on duty..."
"You aren't on duty now. Why not indulge, just for tonight?" Ludmilla can't argue with that, and picks up her glass. Pleasant drink and pleasant company while the hours away.

keys.DescriptionKey:

keys.DescriptionKey:
Among the noble houses of Rigland, House Aldyne boasts one of the longest and proudest pedigrees, and some of the fiercest warriors ever to face the Pandemonium.
Ludmilla, the family's only daughter, was raised to be demure, retiring, and modest; but her family's blood burned strong in her.
A noble soul from birth, she stood up against injustice, even to adults, and protected the weak when they could not protect themselves, despite her parents' protests.
Somehow, it still came as a surprise to her family when she ran away from her sheltered life, joined the Red Dragon Knights, and stepped into the history books as a champion.

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Hey, Boss! We got trouble! The Red Dragon Knights were spotted in a village nearby!"
"Calm down. We just need to make ourselves scarce before—"
"Too late! Throw down your weapons, bandit scum!"
"What?! The Crimson Valkyrie?!"
"But how?! That village is hours from here!"
"Unfortunately for you, we run this far before breakfast every morning. In armor. Isn't that right?"
"R-right, Captain..."
"Damn...we'll have to fight! They'll be tired from the march! Kill 'em!"
"How considerate! We won't have to chase you down. Red Dragon Knights, draw arms!"

keys.DescriptionKey:
"The Pandemonium is over. Surely you've done enough? Why not retire?"
"It's about time you found a husband, dear. We've received so many excellent proposals for you!"
"Father. Mother. There are more dangers to Erden than the Pandemonium alone. There is still much to be done on the path to peace."
"Don't be foolish. People cause conflict; that's the way of the world. There will never be peace."
"If Justice is served with honor and humility, someday evil will be eradicated from this world. My comrades all believe that."
"Do you mean to see our bloodline perish on the end of some brigand's dagger?!"
"My blood, our blood, cries out within me, Father. 'Protect the weak. Slay that which is evil and injust.' If I turn a deaf ear to that voice, the Aldyne line dies then and there. I may live, but my spirit will be dead. Is the continuance of our name worth the forfeiture of our heart and soul?"
"Ludmilla..."

keys.DescriptionKey:
In her life, Ludmilla's shared a bond with countless people. A lot of them were other knights—the superiors who taught her ins and outs of being a knight, the subordinates she taught in turn, the comrades she felt at ease with. All these bonds made her stronger, but at the same time...
As a matter of fact, the outfit she's wearing right now was obtained due to a certain bond too.

keys.IntroText:
When people think of beauty,
what shows before their eyes is death

keys.DescriptionKey:
Some of the bonds she established were severed, despite her best efforts.
She was a knight and so were they. Protectors of their country, they were no strangers to conflict. She trained them to protect each other too, but still, she couldn't stop their blood from being spilled. 
She thinks of them as she looks outside, wishing that at least the extraordinary snowy landscape before her would stay forever unchanged.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Bonds hold special meaning in Eastland. Once forged, they might loosen, but will never break, unless one decides to cut them. Even after death, the ties one's established will carry on into the next life, and the one after that.
And sometimes, old bonds give birth to new ones. Determined not to lose a comrade ever again, Ludmilla devoted herself to training, and soon, one after another, like-minded knights started gathering around her for leadership.

keys.DescriptionKey: The always-bright and cheery Luna is, to the people of the slums, like the warm golden sun itself. A crack shot with a bow, she often goes bounty hunting; and while she's stingy with money, it's all so she has more to spread among the poorest people in town. While a dark secret lurks behind her bright smile, Luna never speaks of it to anyone.

keys.DescriptionKey: The first time she arrived in town, the suspicious and insular townsfolk turned her away, forcing her to live in the forest beyond the walls. It was the first time she'd ever been accepted in her life.

With a deep love for works of art and national treasures, she steals any target she sets her sights on—no matter how impenetrable its security may be.
She is also known as a master of disguise, and no one knows her true face...except for one.

keys.IntroText:
Tonight, this thief shall steal...your heart!
......Sorry, that was funnier in my head.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Three years ago, she infiltrated the Kingdom of Wellmund in pursuit of the national treasure known as the "Swan Crown". Unable to break the final seal, she was just preparing to withdraw in defeat when Victoria, still a princess at the time, offered her assistance. With her aid, the theft was successful.
From that day on, Lupin began referring to the future queen as her one and only "accomplice".

Movements as light as a feather, such graceful steps, and with a fleetingly delicate expression—she was the shining star at the center of the stage. From that day on, Lupin became an ardent fan, never once missing a regular performance by her "accomplice".

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3099|$I'm sure you know why I have called you
here.
$#Rizette;Theo;Nagi;(All)#$$&RizetteSurprise;Theo.TheoSurprise;Nagi.NagiSmile&$$@Center;;;Theo.Left;Nagi.Right;@$$|act5.Voices/mst3107|$!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3108|$Astrid...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSadSmile&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3109|$I'm fine. I'm sorry to have worried you all.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3110|$I'm sorry for shouting at you last night,
Callen.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3111|$No need to apologize. Anyone in your shoes
would have done the same.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3112|$Thank you...

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3113|$Tori. You should tell the Captain what
you told me.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3114|$Yes...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3115|$Do you remember what that spy said last
night?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3116|$Most of it, yeah.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3100|$We need to discuss what to do in light of
what occurred last night.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3117|$His codename, organization, unit, and the
name of his employer. Oh wait...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3118|$He said something else too... "The Pillar
Room"?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3119|$Exactly, Theo.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3120|$The Pillar Room is a hidden room in the
Red Dragon Knight Headquarters.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$Only the Commander is permitted to enter.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3121|$I have never heard of such a room.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3122|$Only my family, the Draclows, are aware of
it.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$Commanders are officially appointed during
a ceremony there.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3123|$When I joined the Knights, my father told me
the name, but not the location.
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3124|$Why did that Serpent know it, then?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3101|$I discovered the Serpents were planning to
communicate with their employer

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3125|$Do you think it's actually a den of
assassins?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3126|$I'm not sure, but it certainly seems to have
some connection with these assassins.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3127|$With more invasive techniques I could learn
more, but...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3128|$I don't think that will be necessary. They are
valuable witnesses, after all.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3129|$Exactly. I have petrified them and shut them
in the cellar under my laboratory.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3130|$Lady Astrid, do you plan on searching for
this Pillar Room?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3131|$Father should be away from headquarters
making a report to the Council right now.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3132|$If we're going to do this, now is our chance.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3133|$Astrid... Are you sure?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3134|$...I want to believe him.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$through the messages the Knights are
sending to Rigland.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3135|$I want to believe in my father, more than
anything! But that's why I have to face this!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3136|$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3137|$Let's go to Rigland!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3138|$I want to believe in the Commander too.
That's why I want to know the truth!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3139|$...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3140|$Astrid von Draclow.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3141|$!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3142|$I cannot hand over command of this task
force to an unranked knight.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3143|$My knights answer to me!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3144|$Captain...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3102|$So their boss doesn't know that their plan
failed yet.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3145|$Knights! The Pandemonium Task Force will
return to Rigland.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3146|$Upon our return, we will search for the
Pillar Room.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3147|$There will be no official notice of this
mission! I will take full responsibility!
$#Finn;GaLuga;Mysha;(All)#$$&FinnSurprise;GaLuga.GaLugaSerious;Mysha.MyshaSurprise&$$@Center;;;GaLuga.Left;Mysha.Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3148|$!!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3149|$Are you a fool!? All you would have to say
is that I forced you all to do it...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3150|$Astrid, is that how you speak to your
superior? I have given my orders!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3151|$!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3152|$Captain...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3153|$One more thing. Callen and Gilgan will
accompany us.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3154|$I agree. It isn't safe for us here.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3103|$But as long as we are in the Knights,
assassins have an easy way to get close...

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3155|$Have I gotten so old that I need the
protection of others?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3156|$Time is of the essence. Prepare to depart
immediately!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3157|$Come back here and see me when you are
ready.
$#Finn;Theo;Rizette;(All)#$$&FinnCommand;Theo.TheoCommand;Rizette.RizetteAngry&$$@Center;;;Theo.Left;Rizette.Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3158|$Yes ma'am!!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3159|$Captain Ludmilla...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3160|$Did you not hear me? Get moving.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3161|$Yes ma'am...!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3104|$We can't expect Callen to probe everyone
who comes near us...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3105|$Exactly. We need to find out the truth.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3106|$Let's go to the Red Dragon Knight
Headquarters!
$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2539|$...That concludes the messenger's report.
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2546|$What of Callen the Scholar?

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2547|$Y-Yes sir... There have been developments
on the ground.
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2548|$I see.
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2549|$Do tell me more...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2550|$The villagers are back!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2551|$Thank goodness... It looks so much
cheerier now.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2552|$I'm gonna wait outside while you all get
your business done.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2553|$Elmina...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2554|$Say hi to everyone for me!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2555|$Quite awkward, isn't she? Not that I can
talk.

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2540|$Captain Ludmilla and Lady Astrid have
signed an agreement with Hymelia
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2556|$Let's go and see what the chief has to say.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2557|$Yes ma'am!
$#NushelleChief(Chief of Nushelle)#$$&NushelleChiefSmile&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2558|$Thank you so much for coming all this way.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2559|$You look well, Chief.
$#NushelleChief(Chief of Nushelle)#$$&NushelleChiefSmile&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2560|$I wouldn't were it not for your help.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2561|$Sorry to rush things, but could you explain
what you meant by your message?

$#NushelleChief(Chief of Nushelle)#$$&NushelleChiefSmile&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2562|$Of course. The truth is, I do know Callen.
But I had forgotten that fact.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2563|$You forgot!?

$#NushelleChief(Chief of Nushelle)#$$&NushelleChiefSmile&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2564|$Yes. After the last Pandemonium, Callen
placed a hex on me.

$#NushelleChief(Chief of Nushelle)#$$&NushelleChiefSmile&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2565|$It was made to be broken when a certain
condition was met.

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2541|$to keep information regarding this incident
classified.

$#NushelleChief(Chief of Nushelle)#$$&NushelleChiefSmile&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2566|$I encouraged her to do it so her research
would remain hidden until the right time.

$#NushelleChief(Chief of Nushelle)#$$&NushelleChiefSmile&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2567|$And so when the right person came, I could
guide them to her.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2568|$The right person?
$#NushelleChief(Chief of Nushelle)#$$&NushelleChiefSmile&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2569|$The Crimson Crestbearer.

$#NushelleChief(Chief of Nushelle)#$$&NushelleChiefSmile&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2570|$I saw you use your crest to defeat that
Aeon Lord.

$#NushelleChief(Chief of Nushelle)#$$&NushelleChiefSmile&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2571|$Feeling its power was the key to unlocking
my memories.

$#NushelleChief(Chief of Nushelle)#$$&NushelleChiefSad&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2572|$I should have been able to sense the power
of the crest even while it was dormant...

$#NushelleChief(Chief of Nushelle)#$$&NushelleChiefSad&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$But my long spell in chains dulled my
senses.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2573|$So when I activated my crest, it gave you
the push you needed to remember?

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2574|$But if the demons knew to ask the villagers
for information about Callen...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2542|$I am surprised that Ludmilla, not to mention
Astrid,

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2575|$That means they already knew about her
research. But how?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSmile&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2580|$Oh, you're done already?

At a young age, her talents were recognized by the Western Exorcist Church, and she became a knight devoted to hunting wraiths.
Despite her slender appearance, she possesses the strength to swing a massive blade with ease, and her reliable work has earned her the deep trust of the Church.

ManchesterRegular01.title: Exorcist Knight of the West

At a young age, her talents were recognized by the Western Exorcist Church, and she became a knight devoted to hunting wraiths.
Despite her slender appearance, she possesses the strength to swing a massive blade with ease, and her reliable work has earned her the deep trust of the Church.

keys.IntroText:
A job for me? Ugh...what a drag.
But consider it done.

keys.DescriptionKey:
She was the eldest daughter of her family. With her parents gone, she had to care for her many younger brothers.
To make sure they could all eat their fill, she prioritized efficiency above all else in her work, heading directly home as soon as she completed an exorcism.
Because of this, more than a few people have assumed her to be an aloof and uncaring knight.

keys.value: $#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Why are you here, Hoshikuma-Douji!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(That pressure...! It's even stronger than
before—)

$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$That's true. We have no choice. It's to save
everyone!
$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerrySmile&$$@Right@$No choice indeed. Heh, I'll steel myself.
$#Masamune(Masamune)#$$&MasamuneWeapSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ryoma...

$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaSmile&$$@Center@$Don't worry. We will definitely save the
people you care about!

$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaHeh&$$@Center@$All right, everyone! I've been told my blood
smells extra tasty—
$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaHeh&$$@Center@$Come and get me!!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Crazed Villagers)#$$!-1!$Uoooooh...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(She's luring the villagers with the smell
of her blood!? It's opening a path!)
$#SailorA(Crazed Sailors)#$$&BanditMaleSerious&$$@Center@$Ooooooh...!!

$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerryAngry&$$@Center@$You call yourself a sailor? Get a handle on
it!! Haaah!!

$#OniA(Underling Oni B)#$$&OniMaleMobSerious&$$@Center@$H-Hoshikuma...! Sorry to interrupt, but
the item we wanted was in the mansion—
$#SailorA(Crazed Sailors)#$$&BanditMaleSerious&$$@Center@$Gaaah!!

$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerrySmile&$$@Center@$Don't worry, we'll get you back to normal
soon. Leave it to your captain.

$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerrySmile&$$@Center@$Charge straight ahead!!
Onwards!!

$#OniC(Underling Oni)#$$&OniMaleMobShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Tch, you pests crawling around
Hoshikuma!!
$#OniD(Underling Oni)#$$&OniMaleMobShouting&$$@Right@$We'll deal with you!!
$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerryTongue&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Neo-Future Warship: Plymouth, pierce through!!
$#OniC(Underling Oni)#$$&OniMaleMobSurprised&$$@Left@$What... Gaaaah!!
$#OniD(Underling Oni)#$$&OniMaleMobSurprised&$$@Right@$Ugh... Such destructive power!!
$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerryHappyTongue&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Go on, you two!!
$#Masamune(Masamune)#$$&MasamuneStare&$$@Center@$Yes... Got it.

$#Hoshikuma(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaHappy&$$@Center@$Ah, that. I thought it might be in the
village, but here it is—the book Mom
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Captain, we'll leave the rest to you!!
$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerryNormal&$$@Center@$Heh, I finally get to act like a real captain.
$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerryNormal&$$@Center@$All right, oni, you'll have to deal with me.
$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerryTongue&$$@Center@$Bring it on!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$We made it, Hoshikuma-Douji!!

$#Hoshikuma(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaSerious&$$@Center@$Tch... What can you possibly do against
me? I'm the daughter of Shuten—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$We're sick of hearing that, Hoshikuma.
Can't you fight without hiding behind
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$your mom's power?
$#Hoshikuma(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaShouting&$$@Center@$Nrgh... You worthless bug!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(I already know Hoshikuma-Douji's
fighting style...)
$#Hoshikuma(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaHappy&$$@Center@$wanted.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(If I focus on dodging, I can manage...)

$#Hoshikuma(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaGrit&$$@Center@$Damn it... Why can't I hit him!? Wind
blades, slice and dice—!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$What's wrong, Hoshikuma-Douji!? I'm
right here—take your best shot!!
$#Hoshikuma(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaGrit&$$@Center@$Don't get cocky, mere human!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Too bad for you, I'm more than "mere"!
I am Finn, a knight from the West!
$#Hoshikuma(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaShouting&$$@Center@$Shut up with your nonsense!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$(She's focused solely on me...
Now's your chance, Masamune—!!)
$#Masamune(Masamune)#$$&MasamuneShouting&$$@Center@$One-Eyed Dragon: Cataclysm!!

$#HoshikumaNakid(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaHurt&$$@Center@$Wh—!? You broke my drums!?
The ones Mom gave me...!!!

$#HoshikumaNakid(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaGrit&$$@Center@$That's it... I won't forgive you...
I'll slaughter everyone...!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(Is that Ganon's research journal!?)

$#HoshikumaNakid(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaSurprised&$$@Center@$W-What, Mom...? You say that's enough!?
Uh, but... Fine... Got it...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Hoshikuma suddenly froze... Is she
talking to someone?)

$#HoshikumaNakid(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaAngry&$$@Center@$Mom says come home. Like, just when
things were getting fun.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Wait, Hoshikuma! We haven't settled this!

$#HoshikumaNakid(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaAngry&$$@Center@$Um, did you hear what I said? I'm letting
you go. Don't act tough just because you
$#HoshikumaNakid(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaAngry&$$@Center@$got lucky☆

$#HoshikumaNakid(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaAngry&$$@Center@$If you want a real showdown, we'll totally
do it at the capital. The final battle's, like,
$#HoshikumaNakid(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaAngry&$$@Center@$so about to start!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Final battle? What are you planning at
the capital!?

$#HoshikumaNakid(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaAngry&$$@Center@$It's sooooo already underway. Join if you
can, Finn.

$#Hoshikuma(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaWink&$$@Center@$Thanks for finding it☆ As a reward, I'll
kill you quickly.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$W-What do you mean... Hoshikuma-Douji!
Hey!
$#Masamune(Masamune)#$$&MasamuneSad&$$@Center@$Finn... Don't chase after her...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$Masamune, but... No, sorry. You're right.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Realistically, we aren't able to kill
Hoshikuma-Douji even if we did catch up.)
$#VillagerA(Villager Coming To)#$$&OniRedHurtMob&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Ugh... Where are we...
$#VillagerB(Villager Coming To)#$$&OniRedHurtMob&$$@Right@$What happened...
$#Masamune(Masamune)#$$&MasamuneSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Everyone, are you okay...? Anyone hurt?
$#VillagerA(Villagers)#$$&OniRedSeriousMob&$$@Center@$Yeah, we're fine, Masamune.
$#Masamune(Masamune)#$$&MasamuneSad&$$@Center@$I'm so glad you're all safe... So glad...
$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaHappy&$$@Center@$What a relief, right, Masamune?
$#OniA(Underling Oni B)#$$&OniMaleMobSurprised&$$@Center@$Huh...? —Gggkgh...
$#SailorB(Sailor Coming To)#$$&BanditMaleSurprised&$$@Center@$Oww... It hurts, Captain...

$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerryPout&$$@Center@$Oh, spit on it and deal with it. Don't whine
over something so small.

$#SailorB(Sailor Coming To)#$$&BanditMaleSurprised&$$@Center@$I'm not sure what's going on, but
something doesn't feel right...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Where is everyone else?

$#Perry(Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerryNormal&$$@Right@$Relax. I don't keep useless people on my
ship.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$Nngh...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$So you dropped them off somewhere,
probably a small island or nearby port?

$#Perry(Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerryNormal&$$@Right@$Heh, you're pretty gutsy. Looks like I
made the right call keeping you.

$#Perry(Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerryNormal&$$@Right@$But boy, trusting others too much can be
dangerous.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$It's fine.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$I can sense that you're not dangerous.
$#Perry(Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerryHappySmile&$$@Right@$Heh, said no one to me ever.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$One more question: If everyone else was
dropped off, why am I the only one still on
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$this ship?

$#Perry(Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerrySerious&$$@Center@$You're not the "only" one.
Unfortunately.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$Unfortunately?

$#Perry(Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerryNormal&$$@Center@$Oh my, looks like you're awake. You've got
some serious luck.

$#Perry(Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerrySerious&$$@Center@$Yes. There is one I wish I hadn't taken
aboard.
$#VoiceOutside(Voice Outside)#$$!-1!$H-Hey! You were told to wait outside—
$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaPainHeh&$$@Center@$Pardon me! So you're the captain!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Ryoma...

$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaShouting&$$@Center@$Finn? This is getting even more
suspicious...!

$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaPain&$$@Center@$What are you going to do with us!?
Explain everything, from start to finish!
$#SailorA(Sailor A)#$$&BanditMaleSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Sorry, Captain. This one got a bit rowdy.

$#Perry(Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerryConfuse&$$@Right@$It's fine. It was my mistake trying to
corral this wild horse.

$#Perry(Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerryConfuse&$$@Right@$I thought she'd be useful, so I brought her
aboard... My judgment must be off...

$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaPainHeh&$$@Left@$Corral... A horse... So you're a horse thief!?
I won't allow it!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$I... I was on a ship, and...

$#Perry(Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerryHuh&$$@Right@$Ugh, why won't you just quiet down? I
was just about to explain—
$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaPainHeh&$$@Left@$I won't forgive you, evil ringleader!
$#Perry(Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerryAngry&$$@Right@$I said shut up!!
$#Perry(Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerryAngry&$$@Right@$...
$#Perry(Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerryNormal&$$@Right@$Ahem...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(She's trying to sound proper again, but
that mysterious vibe is gone...)

$#Perry(Formerly Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerryNormal&$$@Center@$I brought you on board for one reason: you
looked like you would be useful.

$#Perry(Formerly Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerryNormal&$$@Center@$We have no idea what might happen
before reaching the capital.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$So we're basically bodyguards?
$#Perry(Formerly Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerryNormal&$$@Center@$Yes, and I need some manpower too.
$#Perry(Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerrySmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$A sudden storm hit, and the ship capsized.
$#Perry(Formerly Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerryNormal&$$@Center@$That's the story. Got it?

$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I see... So you're also heading to the
capital. Then you should've said so first!

$#Perry(Formerly Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerryHuh&$$@Right@$I-I was going to explain, but you kept
rampaging off!!

$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaSmile&$$@Left@$Oh, really? Sorry, I just assumed you were
pirates or something...

$#Perry(Formerly Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerryHuh&$$@Right@$How rude. I'm an adventurer, thank you
very much. I don't go doing anything bad.

$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$All right, I understand the situation!
That's right, you saved my life, so I should
$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaSmile&$$@Center@$repay that debt!

$#Perry(Formerly Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerryTongue&$$@Center@$Exactly. Work hard for the one who saved
you.

$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerryTongue&$$@Center@$Yes, indeed. As long as you're on my ship,
call me Captain Perry.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Phew... Done mopping.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Capsized...? What about everyone else on
board!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(It seems this ship is severely
understaffed.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(So she really did need extra help.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(She called us bodyguards, but this might
be the main job...)
$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerrySmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Finn, are you working hard?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Yes...uh, Captain Perry!

$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerryNormal&$$@Right@$Heh, you've already got the right mindset
as a crew member.

$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerryNormal&$$@Right@$Everything's nice and clean. You're
showing real promise.
$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerryConfuse&$$@Right@$Compared to you, the other one is...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$The other one?

$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerryHuh&$$@Right@$I really should never have picked that one
up! Like really...

$#Perry(Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerrySmile&$$@Right@$Well, miraculously, this ship happened to
pass by and everyone was saved.

$#KitchenCrewSailor(Kitchen Crew Sailor)#$All right, wash these dishes. Everything is
precious at sea, got it?
$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaSerious&$$@Center@$Yes, leave it to me!
$#KitchenCrewSailor(Kitchen Crew Sailor)#$Good. Then wash those dishes over there.
$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaPainHeh&$$@Center@$All right, over here—Here we go!!
$#()#$Crash!

$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaSerious&$$@Center@$Oh no, that plate! N-Next time I'll do
better!
$#()#$Crash, crash!

$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaPainHeh&$$@Center@$Huh? Are the plates running away? Plates,
please cooperate!!
$#()#$Crash, crash, crash!

$#KitchenCrewSailor(Kitchen Crew Sailor)#$Wh-What the heck!? I look away for a
second and...!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$I see... Thank you so much! I don't even
know how to thank you...

$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaPain&$$@Center@$No, you don't get it—the plates are
running away! They're so slippery, see—?
$#()#$$!-1!$Crash!! Crrrash!!
$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerryConfuse&$$@Center@$H-Hey, what's all that noise!?
$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerryShock&$$@Center@$Nooo!!! Those were valuable plates!!!

$#Sailor(Deck-Cleaning Sailor)#$Things got messy in the kitchen, but
scrubbing the deck doesn't take finesse—
$#Sailor(Deck-Cleaning Sailor)#$just grit.
$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaSerious&$$@Center@$Grit, huh? Yes! I love that word!
$#Sailor(Deck-Cleaning Sailor)#$That's the spirit. So then...
$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaShouting&$$@Center@$Let me do it with this rag!
$#Sailor(Deck-Cleaning Sailor)#$No, we've got a mop, so just use—

$#Perry(Mysterious Woman)#$$&PerryNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Should you really be saying "thank you"
in a situation like this?

$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaSerious&$$@Center@$Relying on tools weakens the spirit. I'll do
it with this!
$#Sailor(Deck-Cleaning Sailor)#$W-Well, if that works for you...

$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaPainHeh&$$@Center@$Yes, leave it to me! Here we go!
Whoaaaaaa!

$#Sailor(Deck-Cleaning Sailor)#$Huh, wait—hold on! Stop, there's a wall
there!
$#Ryoma(Ryoma)#$$&RyomaPainHeh&$$@Center@$Dashing with a rag can't stop instantlyyyy!
$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerryConfuse&$$@Center@$H-Hey, what was that sound just now!?
$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerryShock&$$@Center@$Nooo!!! My precious wall!!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Come to think of it, I kept hearing loud
crashes... Was that all Ryoma?
$#Perry(Perry)#$$&PerrySigh&$$@Right@$Ugh, I have a headache...

keys.DescriptionKey:
The swordsmith Masamune once set out to craft a blade to rival the gods' own glory. Night and day he labored, without sleep, without a moment's pause, until the steel in his hands could shear stone in two.

When he finished, it is said he wept, for how could such a work of art be doomed to drown in blood?

keys.DescriptionKey: Masamune was raised on a small island called Takagashima. Naturally quiet, she would hide whenever traveling merchants came to visit. However, she held deep affection for the other islanders, and they in turn were fond of the awkward Masamune.

keys.DescriptionKey:
One summer night on the island, amidst the clamor of the festival, Masamune accepted a juice handed to her by a certain foreigner and drank it without a care.
But in the next moment, her consciousness sank into darkness—and when she awoke, she had lost the light in her left eye. What's more, her beloved island companions had transformed into oni.

MasamuneRegular02.name: Masamune
MasamuneRegular02.title: The One-Eyed Swordsman
MasamuneRegular02.description:
One summer night on the island, amidst the clamor of the festival, Masamune accepted a juice handed to her by a certain foreigner and drank it without a care.
But in the next moment, her consciousness sank into darkness—and when she awoke, she had lost the light in her left eye. What's more, her beloved island companions had transformed into oni.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Masamune vowed to protect everyone.
She couldn't allow the islanders to come into contact with the outside world. If people from the Land of Peace found out, it might get reported, and a subjugation force could be sent. So Masamune took it upon herself to drive outsiders away from the island. But for someone as kind as her, it was an unbearably painful and agonizing role.

keys.DescriptionKey:
This unit starts with Cupid's Link. When this unit enters battle it grants Cupid's Link for 50TU to another random non-conjured ally that does not have a Link already. Then that ally and this unit are Fortified.

A unit with Cupid's Link has these effects:

This unit cannot become Charmed.

This unit has 0.25x of their original Attack added to their Attack while they are not Enraged. This increase will stack with other Attack increases (e.g. 1.5x + 0.25x => 1.75x total).

When this unit defeats an enemy with an attack, after the end of the turn, all other allies with Cupid's Link will be given the next turns by reducing their current TU, and become Purified. Effects that influence TU order may interrupt the extra turn (e.g. Stuns targeting the lowest TU target). These TU reductions may trigger before or after other effects that adjust the turn order.

This Link is removed if this unit or the unit that granted it leaves the battlefield. This unit cannot gain other Links.

Each time this unit damages an enemy that has 100% of their max HP with an attack, this unit will immediately get the next turn, then this cannot trigger again until TU advances.

Whenever this unit defeats an enemy with an attack, all allies are purified.

- The extra turn is granted after Counter Skin type effects triggered by this unit's attacks, and so this unit will act before a countering enemy.
- Effects that influence TU order may interrupt the extra turn (e.g. Stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

keys.DescriptionKey:
In another world, Luther von Draclow inherited the Red Dragon Knights from a long line of ancestors. But in this world, the world of the Requiem, he founded the military order himself.

A brilliant man, he married an equally brilliant woman to carry on his legacy. His first daughter, Astrid, lived up to his every expectation, and he believed her future siblings could one day surpass her.

But his vision was not to be. His wife passed away giving birth to his second daughter, who he would later name Anastasia.

In every other world, she perished with her mother. Only the technology of Pandora's world gave her the means to fight her Fate. To live.

keys.IntroText:
Erased from every world, from every timeline,
the lost Von Draclow rises, shield in hand.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Luther created the Ex Machina weapon alongside the Red Dragon Institute. Using a cloud of invisible nanomachines, an Ex Machina wielder could gain powers rivaling even those of the Goddess's Vessels. But this wasn't enough to satisfy him.

Little Anya's brain, kept in a coma while her body underwent medical treatment, proved to be more malleable than any other Luther had ever seen. He risked her life to mold it into a living quantum computer, capable of recording and even manipulating the forces of Fate.

Anya never knew exactly what her father was doing to her with all the surgeries she underwent. She only knew that if she kept surviving, she would meet her beloved sister Astrid.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Anya has almost died more times than she can count. She knows her body is fragile, held together only by her father's medical treatments. She knows her brain holds a special Ex Machina, a cutting edge prototype that puts her into a coma if she pushes it too far.

But she'll only meet her sister if she keeps on surviving.

It was lonely growing up in that hospital. She made friends of the shields she built, and the little drones she could summon with her power. But they couldn't pat her head or give her a hug. They couldn't be her family.

Only Astrid can. And she's out there somewhere, waiting for her.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Today we've got a very special guest!

Right as the Super Idol Mirai finishes her introduction, the Ultra-Super Idol Anya makes her grand appearance. The cheers are deafening. Some fans even faint on the spot just from seeing Anya standing there.

"All right, let's do our usual song!"

In perfect unison, the crowd raises their glow sticks and braces themselves in silence. Anya grips the microphone. One deep breath.

"Boom-boom, tss-tss, chicka-chicka-tss!"

Anya—the idol who rose to the very top of the industry through sheer vocal percussion!
And today's performance? She's in top form!

keys.DescriptionKey:
Ultra-Hyper-Super Idol Anya's solo concert! The Anya & Astrid duo is the most popular act in the entire world!

On the big day, fans flood in from across the globe! Every mode of transportation is jammed to a standstill! Not a single person can make it to the venue!

Anya agonizes. "I want everyone to see the show... isn't there something I can do...?"

But Astrid remains perfectly calm. "You don't need to do anything at all."

Anya, who always thinks of her fans first, murmurs in distress. "How can you say that...!?"

"Because streaming tickets are a thing."
Anya was too busy worrying about her fans that she had completely forgotten about the streaming tickets.

And so, the livestream was a massive success!

keys.DescriptionKey:
And now, Ultra-Hyper-Super-Galaxy-Ultra-Big-Bang Idol Anya's photo shoot!
The photographer calls out directions. "Astrid and Ultra-Hyper-Super-Galaxy-Ultra-Big-Bang Idol Anya — I need the two of you closer, closer!"

"Astri... can you come a little closer...?"

Astrid's face turns bright red. "D-don't give me that look... it's too adorable..."

"Astri... Here, let's hold hands..."

"So this is the hand of an Ultra-Hyper-Super-Galaxy-Ultra-Big-Bang Idol... it's so warm..."
Their eyes meet.
The tension builds—

Snap!
A notebook closes shut. On its cover: "Anya the Idol, Episode 3."

Holding the notebook, Anya mumbles awkwardly,
"Astri... what is this...?"

It was Astrid's secret hobby — a private little notebook she'd been drawing in. And she'd carelessly left it sitting out in the living room.

Red as a tomato, Astrid could only let out a squeak: "Eeeep..."

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngryBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Where do I even start... Kazuto, show
yourself! You're here too, right?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSadSmile&$$@Center@$Is there anything you want right now?
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoBlush&$$@Center@$...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGritBlush&$$@Center@$Explain yourself!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSigh&$$@Center@$So you heard some rumors, and you
decided to secretly investigate me?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridDoubt&$$@Center@$This man is just a photographer. He has
nothing to do with the Church.

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Is that true, Astri? You're not being
coerced to say that or anything, right?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSigh&$$@Right@$Do you really think this man could
threaten me by himself?
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaBlush&$$@Left@$Good point...

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSerious&$$@Left@$Then, why was Kazuto so shocked 
earlier?

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoBlush&$$@Right@$Well... Astrid was doing a strange pose
and I... Uh...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$!!!

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Right now... I'm good. I don't think
I need anything—

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$That's right, I did see you doing a cute
pose earlier...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGritBlush&$$@Right@$Forget you saw that! Both of you!

$#Hashimoto(Hashimoto)#$$&RebelNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Um, should I introduce myself? I'm  
Hashimoto, a freelance photographer!
$#Hashimoto(Hashimoto)#$$&RebelNormal&$$@Right@$I asked her to model for some photos.
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSurprise&$$@Left@$Model?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSigh&$$@Right@$It's just a part-time job. I needed the
money.

$#Hashimoto(Hashimoto)#$$&RebelSmile&$$@Left@$Man, I saw her in town and was blown
away! So I asked her...

$#Hashimoto(Hashimoto)#$$&RebelSmile&$$@Left@$She refused at first. But when I told her
I'd double the payment, she accepted!
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So it was really just a photoshoot?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGritBlush&$$@Right@$That's what I've been saying.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSmile&$$@Right@$Anything at all? Maybe there's something
that's trendy among your friends?

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSurprise&$$@Left@$I'm sorry! Astri, Mr. Hashimoto... 
I misunderstood...

$#Hashimoto(Hashimoto)#$$&RebelSurprised&$$@Right@$No worries. It's quite alright. 
But, you know...

$#Hashimoto(Hashimoto)#$$&RebelSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You're Astrid's little sister, right?
You're really cute!
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaBlush&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Uh... I don't really think so...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Right@$Don't you dare look at Anya like that,
Mr. Hashimoto!

$#Hashimoto(Hashimoto)#$$&RebelSmile&$$@Left@$Oops, sorry! But how about doing a
photoshoot together? I'll triple the payment!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHurt&$$@Right@$With Anya!? No way! I don't care how
much you offer!
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I'm okay with it...

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSmile&$$@Left@$Astri, didn't you say you needed the
money earlier?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHurt&$$@Right@$Yes, but... I don't think it's worth
getting you involved.

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSmile&$$@Left@$Trendy? Well, Luna did mention that 
 robotic pet cats are becoming popular.

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$But I want to take pictures with you,
Astri! What do you think?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSadSmile&$$@Center@$Anya...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Okay, if you insist... Is that okay with
you, Mr. Hashimoto?

$#Hashimoto(Hashimoto)#$$&RebelSmile&$$@Left@$It's like a dream come true! Let's have a
photoshoot tomorrow, in a new location!

$#Hashimoto(Hashimoto)#$$&RebelSmile&$$@Left@$I have to hurry and set things up! 
Gonna be busy!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSigh&$$@Right@$What a troublesome turn of events...

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSad&$$@Left@$Apologies. I didn't mean to escalate
everything.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGritBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Kazuto! Earlier, you said you "saw" me...  
You meant with a drone, right?
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSurprised&$$@Center@$Obviously.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngryBlush&$$@Center@$Then erase the drone's history! 
Especially that pose! Don't leave a trace!

keys.DescriptionKey: Don't get close to her. Don't even look at her. Her frail body and distant gaze may make her look defenseless, but if she recognizes you as an enemy, the very next moment will be your last.

MechaSisterDark01.name: Anya
MechaSisterDark01.title: Annihilation Girl
MechaSisterDark01.description: Don't get close to her. Don't even look at her. Her frail body and distant gaze may make her look defenseless, but if she recognizes you as an enemy, the very next moment will be your last.

keys.IntroText:
She stands atop countless corpses,
her eyes reflecting nothing at all.

keys.DescriptionKey: There are rumors of a young girl taking to the battlefield alongside soldiers of the Bergarian Empire, but no witness accounts. After all, none who stand against her return home alive. One foe may be pierced by countless blades, another crushed and strewn across the battlefield. All, it is whispered, die by her hands.

MechaSisterDark02.name: Anya
MechaSisterDark02.title: Annihilation Girl
MechaSisterDark02.description: There are rumors of a young girl taking to the battlefield alongside soldiers of the Bergarian Empire, but no witness accounts. After all, none who stand against her return home alive. One foe may be pierced by countless blades, another crushed and strewn across the battlefield. All, it is whispered, die by her hands.

keys.DescriptionKey: There are none who know what thoughts or emotions reside behind that blank and distant stare, if any actually do. The only hint of humanity is in the way she sometimes looks up at the sky, as though remembering something or someone, and the faintest hint of sadness in her gaze.

MechaSisterDark03.name: Anya
MechaSisterDark03.title: Annihilation Girl
MechaSisterDark03.description: There are none who know what thoughts or emotions reside behind that blank and distant stare, if any actually do. The only hint of humanity is in the way she sometimes looks up at the sky, as though remembering something or someone, and the faintest hint of sadness in her gaze.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$I see everyone's here. Phase 2 of our
counterterror operation begins now.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Right@$Who but a Vessel could create anything
so advanced without our knowledge?

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernSmile&$$@Left@$The heads of R&D agree with Astrid's
assessment.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Then all we have to do is use Reina to
track down the mole in their ranks.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Right@$This is a joint operation, after all.
Surely there's no problem?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$Unfortunately, we have our hands full
dealing with disasters around the world.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Left@$And every unoccupied person we have
is looking for the 100th Vessel.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Left@$We have no time or manpower to spare
for matters not relating to the Requiem.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Indeed. This operation falls under our
purview first and foremost.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$As such, we will resolve the matter
with our own resources.
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Some "joint" operation...
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$Take a look at this hologram.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Right@$If nothing else, we'll need Church
permission to search Shinano Academy.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Right@$There's a 99% chance the Vessel
working with the terrorist is there.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Left@$The Academy is a top-security complex.
Entry permissions are strictly controlled.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Left@$And members of the heretical Red
Dragon Institute will hardly be welcomed.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Right@$In that case, we'll need some pretense
to enter.

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaBlush&$$@Left@$Um, I actually... have an idea, about that.
If it's okay.
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSurprised&$$@Right@$Really?
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernSmile&$$@Left@$Let's hear it.

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$U-um...! A-actually, it might not be
that good an idea...!
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Center@$Don't be shy. Anything could help.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Are these the remains of those androids?

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaNormal&$$@Center@$O-okay. Then, um... maybe...
An intramural competition...?

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Between the Institute and the Academy?
Huh... that just might work.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Left@$Using the Church and Institute's power
struggle against them... fascinating.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSmile&$$@Right@$We infiltrate, posing as team members,
and catch the conspirator. Brilliant.
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ehehe...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$Let's prepare immediately. This mission
is top-secret — don't tell a soul.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoAngry&$$@Center@$Speaking of... my drones just got a ping
by the door.
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Let's see here...

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSurprise&$$@Left@$Waah! I-I was just passing by, that's
all, I wasn't eavesdropping or—
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Luna?

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernSmile&$$@Left@$Yes. R&D has been analyzing the
fragments we recovered from the ruins.
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSurprised&$$@Center@$You know her, Anya?

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaBlush&$$@Center@$Y-yes, she was showing me around
campus.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaWah&$$@Center@$I swear I didn't hear anything about
any top secret missions, no sir!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernAngry&$$@Center@$Sigh...
Bring her inside.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$Now. Your name and the reason for
your eavesdropping, if you please.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaWah&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Luna Fairweather, first year! As for
reasons... um, I actually can't say!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernSmile&$$@Left@$Then should we try you for espionage
as a foreign agent, perhaps?

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSad&$$@Right@$O-okay, okay, I'll talk! I was actually
wondering how things were going...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernAngry&$$@Left@$...
What "things?"
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaShy&$$@Right@$Um, things, you know? Between Anya and Ka—

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernSmile&$$@Left@$Every aspect of their construction
outstrips modern engineering completely.

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSurprise&$$@Left@$Waaah! L-L-Lunaaa! I told you, it's not
like that at all!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaShy&$$@Right@$But my radar was going off! So, I
thought I ought to follow you...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Left@$...we've heard of you, Fairweather.
Energetic, but irresponsible.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Right@$That's me, energetic and—
Wait, huh?

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernAngry&$$@Left@$It seems we have no choice but to
include you on this operation.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSurprise&$$@Right@$Me?! On an operation?! G-gladly!
I'd be happy to go!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Left@$Your performance during the operation
will decide your handling afterward.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSurprise&$$@Right@$Handling? I don't get it...
Oh, well! I won't let you down!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaShy&$$@Right@$Let's do our best, Anya! And... I'll be
rooting for you with you-know-who!

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSurprise&$$@Left@$You-know-who?!' N-no, you don't know
anything!!
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Right@$In other words...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Left@$In other words, this is cryptotech...
Or divine providence.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Divine? You seem to be implying that
a Vessel is behind all this.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Indeed he is.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Left@$It doesn't seem like we got any solid
evidence last night.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Right@$I'll pass. I have to head the medical
team today.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Left@$Okay, then I'll babysit! Who am I
babysitting?
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSad&$$@Right@$I wonder...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Announcer)#$$!-1!$Preparations are complete. The first
round is about to begin.
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Left@$Looks like we're starting.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Right@$As discussed, I will take the field first.
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Left@$You got this.
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSmile&$$@Right@$...do your best, Astrid!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSurprise&$$@Left@$They're sending... wah! Nanami?!
No fair! She's a teacher!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHeh&$$@Right@$Haha. Finally, a worthy opponent.
Our battle will be legendary!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$The competition starts today. Remember
we're ordered to win it as well.
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoShouting&$$@Left@$Astrid. You're sparking again.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$@Right@$T-this is... an intimidation display!
Yes! To unnerve her!
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSad&$$@Right@$I-is she going to be okay?

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Left@$Probably, yeah. In the meantime, we
should keep investigating.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$Nuh-uh! You have a more important
mission, Kazuto!
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSurprised&$$@Left@$Huh? And what's that?
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Right@$You... have to go buy snacks!
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoShouting&$$@Left@$What?

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$There are food stalls set up all over!
The Culinary Club's selling cookies too!
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoAngry&$$@Left@$And you want some?

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSad&$$@Left@$Isn't there some saying about how he
who chases two hares catches neither?
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Right@$Yeah!
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoShouting&$$@Left@$Go buy them yourself, then.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaWah&$$@Right@$But I'm up next! I need my sugar fix
before my match!!
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoAngry&$$@Left@$You little...
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaBlush&$$@Left@$Um, I can go buy them, if you want.
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Right@$No! You're our team mascot, Anya!
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSurprise&$$@Left@$M-mascot?

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Right@$Yeah, so you're busy! Kazuto's the
only one not doing anything!
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoClosedEyes&$$@Left@$...fine, fine. I'll go get your snacks.
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Right@$Get enough for everyone, please!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$This mission was given to us directly
by the Commander. We must not fail!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$I did not expect to face you in the very
first match.

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiNormal&$$@Right@$You know what they say, the first strike
decides the battle! We'll take this win.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Left@$I have to disagree.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Judge)#$$!-1!$No restrictions on Gifts or Ex Machina.
Fight until unconsciousness or tap out.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Judge)#$Are we clear?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Left@$Yes. Let's have a good, clean fight.
$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiShouting&$$@Right@$I'm itching to get started!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Judge)#$$!-1!$Round 1...
Fight!

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Center@$Sounds like the match is starting.
I'm sure Astrid will be fine.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Center@$Ah, there's the Culinary Club.
Hey, anyone here?
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoAngry&$$@Left@$Yeah, yeah, I know.
$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSleepy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Yaaawn... Oh, hi...
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSurprised&$$@Left@$Napping already, Kotone?

$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSleepy&$$@Right@$It's nice out. Everybody should be
napping... Yaawn...

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Left@$I see. Anyway, I hear you're selling
cookies here?
$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSleepySmile&$$@Right@$Hee hee. Are you on a snack run?

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSmile&$$@Left@$Yeah, for my underclassmen.
...where's Charlotte, by the way?
$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSurprised&$$@Right@$Mm... hmm? Did she leave again...?

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSurprised&$$@Left@$Does she do that a lot? Without telling
you where she's going?
$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSad&$$@Right@$Well, she's a pretty mysterious girl...
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Left@$I see.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngryBlush&$$@Right@$Why are you always like this?!
$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSurprised&$$@Right@$Mmh? Didn't you want cookies...?
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSad&$$@Left@$Sorry, I'll come back later.
$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSerious&$$@Right@$And he's a mysterious boy...
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoAngry&$$@Center@$(Could the mole really be Charlotte?)
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Center@$I'll have my drones search...

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Center@$Not in the courtyard... not in the
gardens... ah! There she is!

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSurprised&$$@Center@$Behind the school building...
Where's she off to in such a hurry?
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Okay, it's all clear! Come on out...
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Left@$Charlotte! What's going on here?
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSurprised&$$@Right@$O-oh! Wait, stay back!

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSad&$$@Left@$L-let's not fight! We have to work
together!

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoShouting&$$@Left@$Who are you working with?
Come out already!
$#Fran(???)#$$&KittenMeow&$$@Center@$—meeeeew!
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Aah! A-a cat?!
$#Fran(Fran)#$$&KittenMeow&$$@Right@$Mew~

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoBlush&$$@Left@$H-hey, knock it off. Stop rubbing
on my legs.

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteHappy&$$@Right@$Would you look at that? She's usually
so skittish!

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteHappy&$$@Right@$That's why I asked you to stay back
there.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Left@$Wait, so you've just been feeding
a cat this whole time?

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSmile&$$@Right@$Huh? Yes, I give her kitty treats. But
Saya gets mad if I spoil her, so...

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSad&$$@Left@$O-oh... guess I jumped the gun on this
one...

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$Yeah! Hmph, fighting on the mission.
You ought to learn from my example!
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSad&$$@Left@$Sorry for bothering you.

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSerious&$$@Right@$Wait, what did you mean by 'who I'm
working with?'
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoBlush&$$@Left@$Uh...! W-well...
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSerious&$$@Right@$Hmm? Are you hiding something?
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoBlush&$$@Left@$N-no, I... uh...
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Don't worry. I know you can't tell me.

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteHappy&$$@Center@$We're pudding comrades, so I'm certain
you're not a bad person.

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSmile&$$@Center@$In return for my secrecy, would you mind
not telling anyone about Fran's treats?
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Is that all?

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSurprised&$$@Right@$Oh, I'm sorry, should I ask a bigger favor?
Here, then...

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoShouting&$$@Left@$Don't get ahead of yourself, rookie.
Who's on babysitting duty today?
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSurprised&$$@Left@$...huh? A key?

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteHappy&$$@Right@$This is Kotone's room key. I usually
tidy things up for her, but I'm busy today.
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSmile&$$@Right@$Could you do it for me?

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoBlush&$$@Left@$Clean Kotone's room? But I'm a boy!
