$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoShouting&$$@Center@$They're above us, in the air. Aboard
a helicopter!

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaHappy&$$@Left@$Oh, a candied apple! It's so sweet...
Thank you!

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoAngry&$$@Center@$Damn it, how can we stop them?!
The drones? No, that's—
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Kazuto, sir!
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoShouting&$$@Right@$Save it, Luna, I'm busy!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Left@$No, I think I've got it! I know what I
can do!
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSurprised&$$@Right@$You mean, your Ex Machina?

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Left@$Yeah! Can you point out where the
helicopter is?

$#Drone(Kazuto)#$$&Drone&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It's worth a shot... see that drone?
The helicopter's behind it.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Center@$I see it! Here goes...
My Ex Machina power is...
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaCommand&$$@Center@$SUPER STRENGTH!

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh! The helicopter appeared out of
nowhere!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngryBlush&$$@Center@$Do you have no sense of urgency
whatsoever?
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSmile&$$@Right@$The camo was damaged! Luna, you did it!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ehehe! Looks like I really am the best
after all!

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$It's lost flight control, too. Look, it's
making an emergency landing.
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Right@$Let's be there to meet them!

$#Yuriko(Yuriko)#$$&YurikoHurt&$$@Right@$Ow... what hit us? Kotone, what just
happened?
$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneNormal&$$@Left@$We've got nothing left... it's over...
$#Yuriko(Yuriko)#$$&YurikoSurprised&$$@Right@$Over?! What?! Did you see something?!
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hands in the air! Nobody move!

$#Yuriko(Yuriko)#$$&YurikoAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$The Red Dragons! Did you have fun
with my clones?
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoAngry&$$@Left@$So you're the original, I take it?
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Center@$There's a call for you on the radio, Astrid.

$#Yuriko(Yuriko)#$$&YurikoSerious&$$@Right@$That's right. I didn't expect you'd bring
us down...
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoShouting&$$@Left@$Save the flattery. We're taking you in.

$#Yuriko(Yuriko)#$$&YurikoShouting&$$@Right@$Hah! I still have work to do. This isn't
checkmate yet!
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoAngry&$$@Left@$What are you playing at?

$#Yuriko(Yuriko)#$$&YurikoCrazySmile&$$@Right@$I've planted bombs in the stadium.
Enough to blow the place sky-high.
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoShouting&$$@Left@$You...

$#Yuriko(Yuriko)#$$&YurikoCrazySmile&$$@Right@$I suggest you let us go... unless you want
me to detonate them.
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoAngry&$$@Left@$Taking hostages again...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHurt&$$@Center@$Huff... huff...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHurt&$$@Center@$(We've held out for a long time already...)
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Center@$Kazuto? Where—
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Center@$(But we're always on the defensive here!)
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Center@$(We can't win unless we take their flag...!)
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Astrid, are you alright?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Right@$For now, but we are hard-pressed.
We must—
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHurt&$$@Right@$Ngh...!
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSurprise&$$@Left@$Kyaa!

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Only two of you? This is what you get
for underestimating us.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Center@$Say what you will. We have more
important things to worry about.

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiShouting&$$@Center@$That so? Well, don't come crying to us
when you lose!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHurt&$$@Center@$Gh... aah!

keys.DescriptionKey: It was only a matter of time before the hundredth Vessel was going to be discovered, and Luther von Draclow—the head of the Red Dragon Organization—was growing anxious. Anticipating the worst, he approved a new set of equipment for Anya—knowing full well that it might put her in danger.

MechaSisterNew01.name: Anya
MechaSisterNew01.title: Divine Mecha Girl
MechaSisterNew01.description: It was only a matter of time before the hundredth Vessel was going to be discovered, and Luther von Draclow—the head of the Red Dragon Organization—was growing anxious. Anticipating the worst, he approved a new set of equipment for Anya—knowing full well that it might put her in danger.

keys.IntroText:
All systems are go—
Let the mission begin!

keys.DescriptionKey: Anya's new equipment included a Quantum Amplification Unit—a device capable of forcibly awakening the girl's latent abilities by pushing her computational capabilities to their very limits. However, the rapid amplification drastically increased the load on her brain, raising fears that it could endanger her life.

MechaSisterNew02.title: Divine Mecha Girl
MechaSisterNew02.description: Anya's new equipment included a Quantum Amplification Unit—a device capable of forcibly awakening the girl's latent abilities by pushing her computational capabilities to their very limits. However, the rapid amplification drastically increased the load on her brain, raising fears that it could endanger her life.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Thanks to the new equipment and a certain devilish plan, Anya's true power was unleashed—but at the same time, the extreme strain on her brain caused her to fall into a coma.
Looking at his daughter as she lay in a hospital bed, Luther was consumed by deep remorse.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernSmile&$$@Center@$After a week, our preparations for the
infiltration are complete.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$I suppose introductions are in order.
This is one of the Academy's teachers—

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiSmile&$$@Left@$—and Academy graduate, Nanami
Unohana. Nice to meet you.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Right@$Graduate? Then you're a Vessel as well?

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiNormal&$$@Left@$That's right. I see you're well informed.
I've heard of you too.

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiNormal&$$@Left@$This really is an intriguing proposal
you've come up with, I must say.

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiSmile&$$@Left@$Follow me to your lodgings. We can
talk details along the way.

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiNormal&$$@Left@$We'll start tomorrow, with 4 individual
contests and 1 group contest.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$Yes, that's what we were told as well.

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiNormal&$$@Left@$We have several different formats set
up for the individual contests.

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiNormal&$$@Left@$The group contest will be good old
Capture the Flag.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$Astrid, Anya, Kazuto, and Luna will
enter Shinano Academy as athletes.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$With points scored by bringing the
enemy's flag back to base, yes.

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiSmile&$$@Left@$That's about it, I think. This should be
a good time — let's have fun with it.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSmile&$$@Right@$Indeed. May the best man win.

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiSurprised&$$@Center@$Here's your dorm. You should—
Wah?!

$#Charlotte(???)#$$&CharlotteHappy&$$@Center@$Hello there! You must be the Red
Dragon Institute team.

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSmile&$$@Center@$My name is Charlotte. I thought I'd
bring you all some cookies!
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteHappy&$$@Center@$Isn't that right, Kotone?

$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSleepy&$$@Center@$I guess, yeah...
Yaaawn...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$!-1!$$@Right@$My, they smell amazing.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Left@$Yeah! Oh wow, and they look great too!
Are you sure we can have these?

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$While your chief objective is to locate
the terrorist's co-conspirator Vessel...
$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSleepySmile&$$@Right@$Go right ahead...
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Left@$Great! Don't mind if I—

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaIrritated&$$@Right@$Stop. You're not allowed sweets while
recovering from Cube implantation.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaWah&$$@Left@$Awww, come ooooon! One tiny bite can't
hurt!

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$Would you like to be written up for
insubordination?

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSad&$$@Left@$T-that sounds really official...
Okay... I guess I won't...

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I'll want to adjust the rest of your Cubes
as well before the games tomorrow.

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiNormal&$$@Center@$We told you two to save the treats for the
welcome party tomorrow night...

$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$She who dares, wins...
Or apparently not...

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSad&$$@Right@$We just thought they might appreciate
a snack after their trip.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$The Institute's reputation is also riding
on this contest. Do not fail us.

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteHappy&$$@Right@$It was lovely to meet you all. See you
tomorrow!

$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSleepySmile&$$@Left@$See you...
Good night...
$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Do you have things in hand here?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Right@$Yes, as long as you can keep the other
girls from prying too much.

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Don't worry, I'll manage them.
Come on, everyone, back to your rooms!

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Center@$As for us... why don't we head to the
nurse's office?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Left@$Welcome to my castle. You can be at
ease here. It's a secure location.

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaNormal&$$@Right@$Um, Reina? What was that about
adjusting our Cubes?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Left@$Just an excuse. My equipment isn't
sophisticated enough for that.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSurprise&$$@Right@$Oh, that was a lie? But you said it with
such a straight face...

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Left@$Well, we're here. Welcome to Shinano
Academy.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Left@$I have a few leads on who our mole
might be, and I'd like to review them.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSurprised&$$@Right@$Leads? Why didn't you tell us before
we arrived?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Left@$This is a very delicate situation here.
We want to avoid any chance of leaks.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Left@$This info is top-secret, you see. I was
only given access to it a little while ago.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Right@$Guess that makes sense. Alright then,
who's on the list?
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Left@$We have three possible suspects.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$@Right@$You've narrowed it down that far
already?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Left@$Yes, but this is only a rough estimation.
Little better than a psych evaluation.
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Right@$It's better than nothing, I guess.
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Left@$Our first suspect... Charlotte Gottlieb.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$It looks surprisingly normal...

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSad&$$@Right@$Charlotte? The girl who gave us
cookies? But she seemed so sweet.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaIrritated&$$@Left@$The major flag here is that she refuses
to share what her Gift is with anyone.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Left@$Her combat scores are consistently
high as well. Too high.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Left@$And as you've seen, she proactively
seeks out contact from outsiders.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Right@$Nothing decisive, but definitely worth
keeping an eye on...

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Left@$Next is Rio Kikuchi. Her Gift is the
Goddess's Innovation.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Left@$She spends most of her time in her
room tinkering with new inventions.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Left@$Which makes her suspect #1, given
the sophistication of those androids.
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Right@$Huh... yeah, that is sketchy!

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Left@$Our third suspect is... her.
Hibiki Himeno.

$#Nanami(???)#$$&NanamiNormal&$$@Left@$Of course. We're just like any other
fancy academy, after all.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaIrritated&$$@Left@$We don't know her Gift either. But she's
strong, strong enough to beat Nanami.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Left@$We know she can teleport, and she
likes to skip class. That's all.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Left@$Take care: she's fiendishly intelligent.
You can't let your guard down around her.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$I see...

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Left@$We'll draw attention if we stick together.
We should split up to investigate.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Right@$And it will be dark soon. We're short
on time as it is.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaNormal&$$@Left@$Then I'll go find that Rio girl. It has to
be her, I just know it!
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoAngry&$$@Right@$You want to go alone?

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Left@$Aww, you big worrywart! I can take care
of myself!

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Right@$That's unconvincing. Reina, can you
babysit her for us?
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Right@$Nanami. Good of you to come.
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$Sure, I don't mind.
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaWah&$$@Left@$Babysit?! H-hey!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$Then I'll locate Hibiki Himeno. I'm
curious about her.

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaBlush&$$@Left@$C-could I... come with you? I-I won't get
in your way, I promise.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$So long as you make yourself useful.
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaHappy&$$@Left@$I-I... I will. I promise I will.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridClosedEyes&$$@Right@$As you wish, then.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Left@$Then I'll look into Charlotte, I guess.
Seems like I got the easy mission.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$Maybe so, but be careful not to let
your guard down.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, and be sure to get more cookies
if you can!

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiSmile&$$@Left@$Welcome back, Reina. And you must
be the Red Dragon team, right?

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaWah&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...why is everyone looking at me like
that? It was just a joke! Aww, c'mon!

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$A ruined building lit by the setting sun.
Almost poetic, isn't it?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Right@$Then why are you standing around?
We could use some more scouting data.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherHologramNormal&$$@Center@$Now, I formally declare this operation
underway!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherHologramNormal&$$@Center@$Red Dragon Squad! Enter the Sunrise
Building, and rescue the hostages!

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Left@$Ah, so that's what you've been doing?
Scouting?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHeh&$$@Right@$But of course. Thorough reconnaissance
is vital for any infiltration mission.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Left@$So I've been told. Did you find what you
were looking for?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Right@$Huh? What do you mean?

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$We already had our entry points
established when we showed up.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Seems pretty dangerous to be walking
around this building without cover.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Center@$So you must have been looking for
something useful. Something specific.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Well, I... I mean...

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Left@$...or were you just wandering around
to look useful to the Commander?

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$Sunrise Luxury Apartments. Sounds
like they had high-class clientele in mind.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$@Right@$Wha—!

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoClosedEyes&$$@Left@$That's fine and all. Just save enough
strength to help the hostages later.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngryBlush&$$@Right@$T-that is not...!
I...!
$#Luther(???)#$$&LutherHologramNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$This is Command. Respond.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...Commander Luther! Astrid speaking.
We are on standby!
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Left@$Kazuto here. Also on standby.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$Nothing further to report!
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherHologramSmile&$$@Left@$Good.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherHologramNormal&$$@Left@$...hm? Astrid, your pulse is elevated.
Did something happen?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$@Right@$N-no, that is...!

$#Kazuto(???)#$$&KazutoClosedEyes&$$@Center@$And now it's just an overdesigned
headstone of concrete and ruined glass.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherHologramNormal&$$@Left@$Elevated bioresponses can cause your
nanobot field to fail. As you well know.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Right@$...I-I apologize. I'll be more careful.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherHologramNormal&$$@Left@$Make sure you are.
Now then. On to the briefing.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherHologramNormal&$$@Left@$We captured this image with a scouting
drone not long ago.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Right@$Six girls, cuffed and bound...
No sign of the terrorists, though.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherHologramNormal&$$@Left@$We believe they're staying out of sight
to avoid giving away their position.
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoClosedEyes&$$@Right@$So they're expecting us...
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherHologramNormal&$$@Left@$Most likely.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherHologramSmile&$$@Left@$We've also discovered the hostages'
identities, as well as a trait they share.
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Right@$And that is?

$#Astrid(???)#$$&AstridTsun&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What are you muttering about, Kazuto?
I hope you aren't losing your nerve.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherHologramNormal&$$@Left@$All of them are gifted athletes, models,
or artists. In other words, prodigies.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Right@$So these guys are after ransoms from
rich families.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherHologramNormal&$$@Left@$Possible but unlikely, especially since
we have received no demands.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherHologramNormal&$$@Left@$What do you think? Any other
explanations come to mind?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Right@$...! Could the terrorists be looking for
the final Vessel?!

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoClosedEyes&$$@Left@$By kidnapping naturally gifted young
women. The logic follows, at least.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$Vessels can't die before the Requiem
starts, right?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridScared&$$@Right@$A fatal wound would suffice as a test,
which means...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Right@$Commander, if we don't act quickly,
those girls will be in grave danger!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherHologramSmile&$$@Left@$I came to the same conclusion. I knew
I picked you two for a reason.
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Left@$Hah, not likely.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherHologramNormal&$$@Left@$Especially you, Astrid. Now, turn that
quick-mindedness toward the mission.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Right@$Understood! I swear I'll save each and
every hostage!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherHologramNormal&$$@Left@$Kazuto, scour the building for any
information about these terrorists.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherHologramNormal&$$@Left@$We may be able to catch them before
they strike again.
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Right@$Understood.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSmileBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Finally... Father's trusting me to lead
a mission...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherHologramNormal&$$@Center@$Ah, right on time. Astrid, Kazuto, these
two will be your backup.
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSurprised&$$@Center@$These two...?
$#Anya(???)#$$&AnyaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Astri!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Right@$Huh? What...?
—aah!

$#Astrid(???)#$$&AstridHeh&$$@Right@$I certainly hope not. I don't need you
interfering with my mission.
$#Anya(???)#$$&AnyaHappy&$$@Left@$Astri, Astri! I've been dying to meet you!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You see? There was no light. You were
rescued by medical personnel.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernSmile&$$@Center@$Know that we are all grateful to you
for saving the lives of the hostages.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$Now, rest yourselves. You'll be back in
the field when we get a new lead.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...understood. Excuse me.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Left@$......
Excuse me.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Reina... I don't recall asking for you
to chime in.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernAngry&$$@Left@$Those two distrust you. Your input
may end up backfiring on us.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Right@$Unfortunately, they saw what they saw.
It won't be easy to change their minds.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$Whether they trust me or not, I was
there. My word will carry some weight.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsunBlush&$$@Right@$Are you worried? You must have taken
quite a liking to her.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaIrritated&$$@Right@$...besides, the helicopter cover story
was my invention to begin with.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaIrritated&$$@Right@$The Church was hounding me. I had
to come up with something to tell them.
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Left@$Is that so?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Right@$You have no idea how hard it is to sell
falsified reports to those people...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernSmile&$$@Left@$I suppose I don't. More importantly,
did they believe you?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$Of course they did. They can't fathom
the idea..

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$...that a sliver of the Goddess might lie
to them.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Left@$As long as you're sure. Now, how is
Anya?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Right@$Recovering. From the data, she should
be up again soon.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernAngry&$$@Left@$Foolish girl. I told her so many times
not to reveal her true strength.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoBlush&$$@Left@$Don't make it weird. I'm just
concerned for her as a fellow soldier.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Right@$She's the only survivor of our quantum
induction process, a living computer.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Right@$Able to bend even reality to her will.
And she saved everyone in that building.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$Are you really going to punish her for
showing such stunning potential?
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Left@$...fine. Do what you will with her.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Indeed I will. Perhaps a little change
in her treatment plan is warranted.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaIrritated&$$@Center@$Oh, don't give me that look. It's a
simple matter, nothing big.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Center@$I just think it's time for her to get
to know her older sister.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHeh&$$@Right@$Really? You're not seeing your sister
in her?

keys.DescriptionKey: A promise to spend time with her big sister was enough to make her heart leap. She made her preparations: a swimsuit and sandals, a beach ball, waterproof coating for her machine parts, her list of 100 Things To Do At The Beach With Astri... She wasn't prepared, however, for her first encounter with the majesty of the sea. "Aegis, deploy a swim ring—I-I mean, naval shields!"

keys.IntroText:
Oh no... I'm too excited to sleep...
I'm going to the beach with my sister tomorrow!

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Today, I went to the beach with the Red Dragons. Astri said my swimsuit looked nice. It made me very happy. Astri taught me how to swim, too. I don't like water very much, but I'm not scared when I'm with Astri. Luna made Kazuto mad again, even though we were supposed to be taking it easy. I hope we can go again next year, and the year after that too... I want to make a lot of fun memories, so that I can forget the past."

—from Anya's summer vacation diary

keys.DescriptionKey:
An annihilator and a rebel. One leaves death in her wake, the other spreads it across the land. Though like parallel lines they were never meant to meet, here and now their paths have crossed.
"My my, don't we look alike? Well, our faces do, at least."
"Yes, I think we do. Only our faces though, really. I wasn't so gifted in other areas..."
As two laughing voices drift over the pool, the night seems even more mysterious than before.

keys.value:
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSmile&$$@Left@$(Wow... I'm really walking right next
to Astri...!)

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaBlush&$$@Left@$Oh, it's just, I've heard the Cube
implantation can do that sometimes...

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSurprised&$$@Right@$Android? That's science fiction, isn't
it? I'm afraid I don't know much there.

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSmile&$$@Right@$How about you, Kotone? Does that
sound familiar at all?

$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneNormal&$$@Right@$There are some good movies about 'em.
I can tell you my favorites...

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSad&$$@Left@$I'm not asking about movies. Okay then,
how about cryptotech?

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteHappy&$$@Right@$Crispy tech? Is that used to make a
nice golden-brown crust?
$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneHappy&$$@Right@$It all comes back to baking for her...

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoClosedEyes&$$@Left@$No, I mean...
You know what, nevermind.

$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSleepySmile&$$@Right@$You tried your best. Just remember...
Pudding makes it all worth it...
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSurprised&$$@Left@$Are you sure about that?

$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSleepySmile&$$@Right@$I've already decided my last meal's
going to be Charlotte's pudding...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$Given the strain the nanofield places
on the brain, it's not impossible.

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSad&$$@Right@$Don't say that. It's better for all of us if
we don't talk about such gloomy things.

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSmile&$$@Right@$Let's make some more sweets for
tomorrow instead!

$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSleepySmile&$$@Right@$I'm okay with whatever, so long as I
get to eat pudding tonight...
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSad&$$@Left@$Man... I don't understand you Vessels.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(I'm no closer to getting any useful
information.)

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(I hope the others are doing better.
And that Luna's not screwing up...)
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaNormal&$$@Center@$Hi there! Hello! Can I come in?

$#Rio(???)#$$&RioSmile&$$@Center@$Well, well. It's rare that I get visitors
to my workshop. Who are you?

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Center@$I'm Luna, the Red Dragons'
up-and-coming supernova!

$#Rio(Rio)#$$&RioSmile&$$@Center@$Ah, I see. I'm Rio. You look more like
a white dwarf to me, but come on in.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridClosedEyes&$$@Right@$I do suffer migraines occasionally,
but no, I've had no memory loss.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Center@$White dwarf? I don't really get it,
but that sounds cool too, I guess.
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Left@$So, I know this is sudden, but... are you working with them?
$#Rio(Rio)#$$&RioSurprised&$$@Right@$Working with whom?

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Left@$You know, the te—
Mmph?!

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Phew... I made it in time. Please refrain
from running your mouth, Luna.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaPout&$$@Center@$Hmghmghm?!
(What are you doing?!)

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaIrritated&$$@Center@$(This is a secret mission. You were
about to spill everything to her.)

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaPout&$$@Center@$Hmgmgh!!!
(OH RIGHT!!!)

$#Rio(Rio)#$$&RioSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Hello, Reina. I hear you're working
at the Institute's labs lately.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Left@$That's right. I'm here to assist
with medical care for the competition.

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSad&$$@Left@$I see... I-I'm sorry. That was a weird
thing to ask.

$#Rio(Rio)#$$&RioSerious&$$@Right@$Right, right. So, what was that 'te' thing
she was about to mention?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Left@$Ah, she meant the tengu. You know,
the winged demons.

$#Rio(Rio)#$$&RioSurprised&$$@Right@$Tengu?! Huh... can't say I've ever met
any tengu, sadly.
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Left@$I didn't think so.

$#Rio(Rio)#$$&RioSmile&$$@Right@$...you might want to ease up on your
grip a bit, Reina.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaPout&$$@Left@$Mmgh... ggh...
(Can't... breathe...)
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Left@$Oh, right! Haha. How forgetful of me.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaWah&$$@Left@$Gaaaasp! Huff, huff... my life was
flashing before my eyes...

$#Rio(Rio)#$$&RioSmile&$$@Right@$Haha. Would you like some tea?
It's just about breaktime for me.
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Left@$Ah, that would be lovely.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$Yes, it was. What made you bring it up?

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Left@$W-wow, look at all these machines!
They're all shiny and glowy!

$#Rio(Rio)#$$&RioSmile&$$@Right@$Yes, I'm particularly proud of that one.
It should solve world hunger within a decade.
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSmile&$$@Left@$What about this one? And this one?!

$#Rio(Rio)#$$&RioSerious&$$@Right@$That one should help devise a perpetual
energy machine in the future.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Left@$Wow! That's amazing! I didn't
understand a single word you said!

$#Rio(Rio)#$$&RioSmile&$$@Right@$Of course, none of them are done yet.
They still have some pretty major flaws.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Left@$The Goddess's Innovation is amazing.
Some of this borders on cryptotech.

$#Rio(Rio)#$$&RioSmile&$$@Right@$That's a bit much. I'm just refining
what others have already created.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Left@$Even so, if you unveiled these, you
would be world-famous.

$#Rio(Rio)#$$&RioSerious&$$@Right@$I don't need fame, really. It's nice to get
praised, but...
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSad&$$@Left@$I-I... it's just...

$#Rio(Rio)#$$&RioSerious&$$@Right@$If I'm just going to die, I'd rather my
inventions got famous instead.
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Left@$That's selfless of you.

$#Rio(Rio)#$$&RioSerious&$$@Right@$Selfless? I don't think so. My situation's
no different from any other Vessel's.

$#Rio(Rio)#$$&RioClosedEyes&$$@Right@$I just want my inventions to serve
humanity when I'm gone. That's all.
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Left@$I... see.
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hey, Miss Inventor! What's this thing?!

$#Rio(Rio)#$$&RioSurprised&$$@Right@$That is something you really shouldn't
touch, please.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaWah&$$@Left@$Whoops, I touched it. Hey, the lights
are red now! Aah, is that smoke?!
$#Rio(Rio)#$$&RioAngry&$$@Right@$Oh, boy. Hold still, I'll fix it.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$We're all going to die... perhaps sooner
rather than later.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$Just?

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaBlush&$$@Left@$It's just that, well, you seem to have
forgotten me...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$@Right@$Forgotten you? We met for the first
time on the Sunrise mission, didn't we?
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaScared&$$@Left@$N-no, we...! I...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$Hm? What is it?

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaVerySad&$$@Left@$...it's nothing. I'm sorry if I've bothered
you, ma'am.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$Anya. I know these first missions are
stressful, but I must ask you to focus.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsunBlush&$$@Right@$If you don't, someone else might pay the
price. Like Kazuto's sister did.
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaNormal&$$@Left@$...Kazuto's sister?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Right@$Yes. Her name was Miyu.

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaNormal&$$@Left@$(Miyu... the name Kazuto kept repeating
after he was shot.)
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSad&$$@Left@$Um... what happened to her?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Right@$She passed away two years ago, on her
first mission... right in front of Kazuto.
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaScared&$$@Left@$What...?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsunBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I am told it was a simple assignment,
but they got caught in a trap.
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSurprise&$$@Left@$Ah... n-nothing. Sorry.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Center@$The enemy ambushed them when they
were alone.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Kazuto was torn between protecting
Miyu and fulfilling the mission.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Center@$He lost control of his emotions, and
his nanofield went haywire.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Center@$By the time he came to, Miyu had been
fatally shot...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridClosedEyes&$$@Center@$He's lived with the guilt of that day
ever since.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridClosedEyes&$$@Center@$It's little wonder he prefers to distance
himself from the rest of us.

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh... but he's always been very kind
to me...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSadSmile&$$@Right@$He may see something of Miyu in you.
Though he'd never say so.

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSad&$$@Left@$That's why he was so mad back then...
Why he told me to stay hidden and wait.
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaNormal&$$@Left@$T-thank you for telling me all this.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$You seem tense. Are you still recovering
from your coma?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsunBlush&$$@Right@$Don't mention it. Ah, here we are.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$This is Hibiki Himeno's room. And it
appears to be locked.

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaNormal&$$@Left@$What should we do? Can we get a key
from Reina, maybe?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Right@$There's no time. Perhaps I can melt
through the lock...

$#Hibiki(???)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Center@$Hey, hey! What do you think you're
doing to my door?!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Are you Hibiki Himeno...?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Left@$That's me... and you're from RDI, right?
What's this, collecting enemy intel?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$Oh, so you're on the Shinano team...?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHeh&$$@Right@$...yes, that is correct! We've come to spy
on you!

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmirk&$$@Left@$Whoa, just come right out and say it,
why don't you!

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaBlush&$$@Left@$N-no, I'm fine. I'm just... happy to be
walking with you, that's all.
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(I-is it really okay to tell her that?)

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Center@$(This is better than being suspected
for our investigation. Back me up.)
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$T-that's right, we're spies!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiClosedEyes&$$@Left@$...okay, sure.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Right@$Now, we will have you explain your
Gift to us. Hurry up!

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmirk&$$@Left@$That's not really how spying works,
you know...? Right, Saya?
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordIrritated&$$@Right@$Don't get me involved in this.
$#Fran(Fran)#$$&KittenMeow&$$@Center@$Mew...
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Ah, what a cute kitty!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSmile&$$@Left@$Her name is Fran. Want to pet her?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGritBlush&$$@Right@$This again. I don't understand why you
insist on idolizing me.
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSmile&$$@Right@$C-can I? She's so soft and cute...
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordNormal&$$@Left@$Do you like cats?

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaHappy&$$@Right@$Yes, but I've never owned one...
Ah, she licked my finger!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSmile&$$@Left@$I think she likes you. You remind me
of a friend of mine, actually.
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaNormal&$$@Right@$A friend?
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSadSmile&$$@Left@$Her name's Antares. She—

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I hate to break up the feel-good here,
but they're spies, remember?

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSad&$$@Center@$I know. But this one likes cats, so she
can't be all bad. Don't you agree?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Uh, what? Sure, I guess...
Anyway, I'm not telling you my Gift.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiWink&$$@Left@$But I will tell you something else.
Like a hint, I guess?
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaSad&$$@Left@$Idolizing...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$A hint? About what?
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmirk&$$@Left@$Oh, nothing in particular.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiWink&$$@Left@$All I can tell you is... us Vessels are all
liars. Remember that.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$@Right@$Vessels are liars... what's that supposed
to mean?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHappy&$$@Left@$Who knows! C'mon, Saya. We can brush
Fran in your room instead.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordShouting&$$@Right@$Okay, I guess...
But what do you mean, all liars?!

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiWink&$$@Left@$Hey, don't smack me! Anyway, see you
tomorrow, Red Dragons! It'll be fun!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordIrritated&$$@Right@$Hibiki!

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaNormal&$$@Left@$Liars... I wonder what she meant
by that?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$It feels like a diversion to me... oh well.
Let's return to our rooms.

$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaNormal&$$@Left@$A-Astrid, ma'am. Do you, um... have you
ever had symptoms of memory loss?
$#Anya(Anya)#$$&AnyaBlush&$$@Left@$O-okay.
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSad&$$@Left@$...what am I even doing...

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSerious&$$@Right@$Less talking, more stirring, Kazuto!
That pudding needs to be well-mixed!
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoClosedEyes&$$@Left@$Okay, okay, geez!

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(I was only here to gather information.
Why am I helping make pudding?)
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(Seriously, what am I doing...)
$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSleepySmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Pudding is the foundation of all life.

$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoAngry&$$@Left@$I came here to talk to you, not to be your
stirring slave!

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteHappy&$$@Right@$Of course, and we'll be more than happy
to talk... as soon as the pudding sets.

$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSleepySmile&$$@Right@$Sorry, buddy... once she gets like this,
there's no stopping her...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Right@$Memory loss? What makes you think
that?
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSad&$$@Left@$What did I do to deserve this...
$#Kazuto(Kazuto)#$$&KazutoSerious&$$@Left@$Okay. Is this good enough?

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$But we also have this young man
standing before us.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$And my friend was nowhere to be found.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$He may be the key
to understanding the crest...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$and why the Pandemonium
has reoccurred so soon.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$Hmph...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$Now then, Finn.
It is for this reason that we wish to...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I want to fight.
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$Oh?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$If there's something I can do
to stop all this, I'll do it!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$My father died protecting people
during the last Pandemonium.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I want to prevent what happened
in Westcarte from ever happening again!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I know it sounds absurd, but it's the truth.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$And I want to know...
why my hometown was destroyed.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I want to know what my vision meant...
It's got to be related to the Pandemonium!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$That's what I like to hear!
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$What is this vision you speak of?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Something is watching me in the dark.
When I see it, it looks back at me...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$It's as if it's trying to consume me...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$Hmm, my guess is that the crest
has something to do with this vision.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$Well, Finn, I'd like you to keep your
identity as the Crestbearer secret for now.

$#Luther()#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$We don't want to cause any confusion
or unwanted attention from the populace.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$And I have one more request.
I would like for you to join our ranks.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$I believe his memories might have been
disrupted.
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$Our people could use your strength.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$Of course. It would be an honor!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$However, there is just one, small issue.
There is a trial you must pass.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$Every knight must pass this trial, or the
others may question your capabilities.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$There is a dungeon to the north of here.
I'm sure you'll have no trouble with it.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Right@$You are to retrieve what is kept
at the end of that dungeon.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Understood! But what about Rizette?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$Don't worry, I'll be with her.
You just focus on your own mission.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$Okay.
Thank you, Captain Ludmilla!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$That's the spirit!
Commander, we'll be taking our leave.

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Villager)#$$|act3.Voices/sst265|$I have heard what your order did for our
people. Thank you, travelers.

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Villager)#$$|act3.Voices/sst261|$My daughter is working as a mercenary for

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Knight)#$$|act3.Voices/sst258|$It is not only the kud and the sziviik that

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Knight)#$$|act3.Voices/sst259|$I do not know of any elves or bikki in the

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Villager)#$$|act3.Voices/sst247|$I will compensate you, of course.

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Villager)#$$|act3.Voices/sst251|$Here, something for your troubles.
$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Villager)#$$|act3.Voices/sst252|$Strangers! Is that Trissle...!?

$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidBlushPout&$$@Center@$I'm not much of a princess anymore.
$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidAttack&$$@Center@$This world is fake. You created it...
$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidAttack&$$@Center@$Murasaki Shikibu.
$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiClosedeyesSmile&$$@Center@$What made you think such a thing?

$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidSmirk&$$@Center@$This world has boundaries. Beyond the
capital, nothing exists.

$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidSmirk&$$@Center@$And I can sense an enormous amount of
magical power accumulated around you.

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiSmile&$$@Center@$So that's how you spent your day?
Investigating this world?
$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidTongue&$$@Center@$Yes. Anything to say in your defense?
$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiHappySmile&$$@Center@$No.
$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidHuh&$$@Center@$I figured. Honestly, I understand Snow White, but you made me a maid? Me?
$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiWink&$$@Center@$Being a maid suits you quite well.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$No, the way you carry yourself is still very
regal.

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiWink&$$@Center@$Though, perhaps you would have preferred
to be Finn's younger sister?

$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidGrit&$$@Center@$You...! Let's see what happens to this world
when you're gone!

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiSmile&$$@Center@$I'm not particularly fond of fighting, but if
you insist, so be it.

$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidHurt&$$@Center@$Tch... That magic power... It's not yours,
is it?
$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiSmile&$$@Center@$You're correct. It's borrowed.

$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidGrit&$$@Center@$Snow White, do you remember what's real
now?

$#Snow(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$Yes...
I am...an Avatar of Hypnos.
$#Snow(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSerious&$$@Center@$My lord's—no, Sir Knight's soul was lost...
$#Snow(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSerious&$$@Center@$So, Master Alice and I started searching for it.

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiWah&$$@Center@$Now you are complaining too? I made you
into an adorable maid, didn't I?
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidExcited&$$@Left@$I agree. It's wonderful!

$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidGrit&$$@Center@$Of course we are complaining. You even split
us in two.
$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiSerious&$$@Center@$Well, two maids are always better than one.

$#Snow(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSerious&$$@Left@$So, you trapped Sir Knight in this world?
Why?
$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiHappySmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...Whose magic do you think I'm borrowing?

$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidHuh&$$@Center@$I haven't figured that part out, but it must
be some higher being.

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiSmirk&$$@Center@$You're correct. It's the Primordials.
Not all of them, of course.
$#Snow(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$Primordials? You mean, Lord Hypnos!?

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiSmile&$$@Center@$He does not share my perspective, so no,
not him.

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiSmile&$$@Center@$There are many Primordials, and quite
a few of them loathe Finn's Golden Crest.

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiHappySmile&$$@Center@$My mission was to turn Finn into someone
who's neither a knight nor the Crestbearer,
$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidBlushShy&$$@Center@$...You're both making me blush.

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiHappySmile&$$@Center@$and to confine him within this world
forever.
$#Snow(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSerious&$$@Center@$How is that even possible!?

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiSmirk&$$@Center@$Within the realm of the tales I craft, very
little is truly impossible.

$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidSmirk&$$@Center@$I thought you must be scheming something,
but to think you were merely doing
$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidSmirk&$$@Center@$the Primordials' dirty work...

$#Snow(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I don't care who you are, I won't let you
hurt Sir Knight!

$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidHeh&$$@Right@$Yes, I will be the one who delivers despair
to that pathetic fool.

$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidHeh&$$@Right@$Don't think for a second that I'll let you
steal that from me!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$!-1!$Hehehehe...

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiTrip&$$@Center@$Both the classic heroine and the prickly one—
so delicious... Mmmm...
$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiTrip&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Allow me to just...jot that down...hehehe...

$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Disgusting... Let's see how you like my
nightmares!
$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidBlush&$$@Center@$A Little, Dark Garden!
$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiSerious&$$@Center@$...!
$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiLookawaySad&$$@Center@$Is that...
$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiLookawaySad&$$@Center@$a massive pile of paper?

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiLookawaySad&$$@Center@$I remember setting my brush upon the
page, letting it dance and swirl...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$!-1!$then stopping and crumpling it all up.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Murasaki Shikibu)#$I cannot write. I can't... I just can't...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Murasaki Shikibu)#$What good am I if I cannot find the words!?

$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidAttack&$$@Right@$Purify her along with the nightmare,
Snow White. Let's end this foolish world.
$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidIrritateSweat&$$@Left@$You're smirking again, Lady Murasaki.

$#Snow(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSerious&$$@Left@$Don't think you can order me around, Snow
Black. I'm only doing this for Sir Knight.
$#Snow(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$A Little, Bright Garden!
$#Snow(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSweat&$$@Center@$Huh?
$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidThinking&$$@Center@$What...? Nothing's changed.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$!-1!$Hehehe. Did I take the farce too far?

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiWink&$$@Center@$I already told you. This world is a tale, not
a dream.
$#Snow(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$What on Erden...

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiClosedeyesSmile&$$@Center@$Now, return to your duties, my dear,
ignorant maids!
$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidHurt&$$@Right@$Grr...!
$#Snow(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidHurt&$$@Left@$S-Sir...Knight...!

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiClosedeyesSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ah, forgive my distraction. Shall we begin
our lesson?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Snow)#$My...lord...
$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiSmile&$$@Center@$Eva, what do you perceive love to be?

$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidIrritateSweat&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Not sure. In the sea, everyone just gets
paired up somehow.
$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidBlushShy&$$@Center@$I haven't been in love myself...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$It's a story from the continent of Eastland.
$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiSmile&$$@Center@$What about you, Snow?

$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidExcited&$$@Center@$Well, uh... I'd say it involves a fateful
encounter that leads to two people
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidExcited&$$@Center@$becoming incredibly special to each other.

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiExcited&$$@Center@$Precisely! That very process embodies the
essence of love! I find it simply delicious!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$Delicious...?
$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiHappySmile&$$@Center@$A mere figure of speech. Let's proceed.
$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiSmile&$$@Center@$The Tale of Genji depicts various encounters and complex romances.

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiSmile&$$@Center@$Some stories explore the use of romantic
allure as a means to wield power...

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiTrip&$$@Center@$Yet, as long as one loves and is loved
in return, the romance is there.

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Now, I'd like the three of you to craft your
own love story.

$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidSurprised&$$@Left@$Wait, there are other continents?
Your world is so large.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Our own story? I don't think I can. I've never
written anything like that before...

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiWink&$$@Right@$Fear not. I am here to assist should you
face any difficulties.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Okay, might as well give it a try.

$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I've never done this before either. I guess we
can start with choosing a heroine?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Yeah, let's start there. Then we can decide
what kind of love story she will experience.
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidDoya&$$@Left@$How about a princess, like Eva?
$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidBlushSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Me...?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Hardworking and honest—
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidHehHappy&$$@Left@$And really, really pretty!
$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidBlushShy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That's not me at all.

$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Eva, you are a mermaid, right? Just like in
our dream.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$It's difficult to see yourself clearly from
your own point of view.
$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidBlushSurprised&$$@Left@$What do you mean?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Exactly what I said. So, who should her
partner be?

$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Maybe a guy adored by many, like the
Shining Prince, but entirely oblivious?

$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidClosedEyesIrritate&$$@Right@$Oh, and very meddlesome! Approaching
strangers, making promises out of the blue,

$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidClosedEyesIrritate&$$@Right@$utterly incapable of minding his
own business.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Wow, that's very specific... That guy sounds
pretty bad.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$If he really existed, I'd have a word or two
with him!
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidStare&$$@Left@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$What?

$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidIrritateSweat&$$@Center@$I still haven't figured out how it is even
possible that you both dreamed about me.
$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidIrritate&$$@Right@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$You too!?

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiExcited&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oblivious protagonist... Mhm, mhm...
Ah, how utterly charming, indeed!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(She's starting to come off weird again...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$Uh, I think that's enough for the main
characters!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$Next, let's think about the plot. What if
the protagonist were transported to

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$a mysterious realm and became entangled
in an unforeseen incident?
$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidDoya&$$@Center@$—So, the wicked witch is the final enemy.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$And what should the ending be like for
the two leads?

$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidExcited&$$@Left@$Well, naturally, they end up together.
Right, Eva?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$Yeah...

$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yeah, a perfect happy ending. That's what
I'd choose, at least.
$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidSadSmile&$$@Center@$It wouldn't feel right otherwise.

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiLookawaySad&$$@Center@$Eva...
Yes, you're quite right.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Is something wrong, Lady Murasaki?
$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiWink&$$@Right@$No, it's a delightful tale.

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiWink&$$!-1!$$@Center@$However, we're out of time. We can
elaborate on it during our next session.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Huh, I feel like we've only just started...
Time flies.
$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidBlush&$$@Left@$Can we think about it just a little longer?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Okay, let's polish what we have a bit more.
$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidHappy&$$@Left@$So, afterwards, the two of them—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$But for some reason, it doesn't feel wrong.
It's almost as if it was meant to happen.

$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidHappy&$$@Center@$I really enjoyed learning about life on land.
Thank you.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$Not at all! You'll visit us again, right?

$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidSadSmile&$$@Center@$I... Well... I can't promise anything. You'll
all forget me by tomorrow.

$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidSadSmile&$$@Center@$It would be insincere of me to make any
promises.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Center@$You're really considerate, Eva.

$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidBlushComplain&$$@Center@$It's just common decency.
Well, goodbye.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$At least let me see you out.

$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSad&$$@Center@$There she goes. Do you really think we'll
forget her by tomorrow?

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiLookawaySad&$$@Center@$Being forgotten is an integral part of her.
It cannot be erased.
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSad&$$@Center@$Oh?

$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidHappy&$$@Left@$Come to think of it, Eva, you even seem
like a princess.

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiSerious&$$@Center@$Without that misfortune, she would not be
herself.
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSweat&$$@Center@$What do you mean?
$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidEvilSmile&$$@Center@$Who cares.
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$Ah, Ebony. You just missed our lesson—

$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidHeh&$$@Center@$I could not care less about the lesson.
Come with me, Lady Murasaki.
$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidHeh&$$@Center@$You too, Snow.

$#MurasakiShikibu(Murasaki Shikibu)#$$&MurasakiSmile&$$@Center@$What is your intention in bringing me
here?
$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidHeh&$$@Center@$To reveal the true nature of this world.

$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSweatSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You sound like our lord a couple of days
ago, Ebony.

$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidClosedEyesSmile&$$@Right@$"Our lord," huh? Since when did you
start referring to him as that?

$#Eva(Eva)#$$&MermaidBlushComplain&$$@Center@$You're not entirely wrong... But my kingdom
perished a long time ago.
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSad&$$@Left@$Um, since I began working as a maid...
$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidClosedEyesSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$When was that, exactly?
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$It was... Ah?
$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidSmirk&$$@Center@$Yes, that particular detail wasn't created.

$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidSmirk&$$@Center@$Maybe there wasn't enough time, or
perhaps the spell has its limitations.
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSweat&$$@Center@$Sorry, Ebony, I don't follow—

$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$I'm not Ebony, Snow White.
My loathsome other half.
$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidHeh&$$@Center@$My real name is Snow Black.
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidLookaway&$$@Center@$Snow...Black...
$#Ebony(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackMaidAttack&$$@Center@$Wake up, for goodness sake.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Haaaaaaah!

$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSurprised&$$@Left@$My lord! Huff, huff... Is it true that you're
leaving?
$#WestcarteVillager(Westcarte Villager)#$What! Stop! Somebody, help!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$There you are, Ossia.

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSurprised&$$@Right@$And who might you be? How do you know my 
name?

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSerious&$$@Right@$No, more importantly, why are you
not running away if you know my name?

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSerious&$$@Right@$A dirty lab rat like you, looking at me with
such contempt... You've got some nerve.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Ossia, the Illustrious Plaguebearer...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Your arrogance knows no bounds in any
world, does it?

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkContempt&$$@Right@$You expect me, a superior being, to lower
myself to the level of an inferior species?

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkContempt&$$@Right@$This isn't arrogance. Some beings are gifted
with sacred power, while others are not—
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I've heard enough.

$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidHuh&$$@Right@$You have a strange look in your eyes...
Where exactly do you intend to go?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$I don't have time for your speeches. Let's get
this over with quickly.
$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkGrid&$$@Center@$Tch! You'll be my first test subject here.
$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkGrid&$$@Center@$Embrace this role as the honor it truly is!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$Agh!

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$@Center@$Where is your bravado now? Writhing
in the dirt like an insect suits you♪
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$Guh...

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$@Center@$This is what happens when a mere human
tries to confront a Doomsday Lord.

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$@Center@$Well, you won't be human for much longer.
You're about to undergo a transformation.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$$!-1!$Ngh... Ahh... Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkHappy&$$@Center@$My new Doomsday Thorns are somewhat
unstable, but I'll get valuable data
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I'm going to stop the End of Days.

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkHappy&$$@Center@$whether you live or die. Now, let's see
what effects—
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$Not...so fast...
$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSurprised&$$@Center@$(Still conscious? How curious.)

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkHappy&$$@Center@$Such an interesting subject! Let's try a
second dose.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$I said I don't have time... Give me...
everything you've got!
$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkShouting&$$@Center@$What!?

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkShouting&$$@Center@$(He just stole all of my thorns! How is he
so fast!?)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$Right now...I am...too weak... I need...power!
$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSerious&$$@Center@$You do realize you'll die if you do that?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$$!-1!$I won't die... I can't die!
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$What are you talking about?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkContempt&$$@Center@$(Remarkable... How many thorns can he
withstand? )

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkContempt&$$@Center@$(He's received more than the lethal dose
already... If he survives, that would mean...)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$$!-1!$Ah...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$Aaah...
$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$Aaaaaah... Nghhh...
$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$Now...I can defeat you...Ossia...

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkHappy&$$@Center@$Ahahahahaha! What an absurd level of
self-discipline!

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkHappy&$$@Center@$How many times have you faced
death to reach such a state of mind?

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkHappy&$$@Center@$You're a fine specimen. Let's see how you
fare against me!

$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$The End of Days is a global catastrophe!

$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$(Sword skills honed beyond human capability,
combined with the power of darkness...)

$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$(From what I remember, he was a pain to
beat.)
$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$(Am I a match for him, even in this state?)

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Center@$Is that all you've got? I was hoping I'd finally
met someone capable of defeating me.
$#FinnPillar(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$(I must defeat them first...)

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$Don't let me down, armored stranger!
Come on, raise your sword!
$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$Always...so impatient...
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Center@$Excuse me?

$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$(The thorns I've stolen from Ossia and Druke...
Now that I have them all...)

$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$(I can finally cast everything away and
save her!)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Dark Knight Finn)#$$!-1!$$%1%$HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAARGH!
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$Hahahahaha! That's the spirit!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$We are swordmasters! We kill, we steal, 
we perfect ourselves!
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$We cut down the top and climb even higher!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$This must be fate! Cross swords with me,
stranger!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSerious&$$@Center@$The Doomsday Thorns, you say...
$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$(I must...kill...him... K i l l...h i m...)

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$HAAAAAAH! You can't defeat me!
I'm the ultimate swordmaster!
$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAARGH!
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Center@$My sword... No...
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$Hahahahahahahaha! I lost, didn't I?
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$I gave it my all, and in the end...I lost.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Norza)#$Master Kisara... Menue...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Norza)#$I did it...
$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$(Norza... What a swordsman...)

$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$(To think he was even stronger now
than he was as an immortal...)

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSerious&$$@Center@$I can handle them just fine! Even in my old
age, I'm still me!

$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$(Ugh, this is no good... My thoughts
are completely jumbled...by the thorns...)

$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$(I must deal with the last Doomsday
Lord and quickly...)
$#GuardA(Guard A)#$Captain, urgent report!

$#GuardA(Guard A)#$An intruder jumped over the wall and is
now hiding inside the fortress!
$#HymelianCommander(Hymelian Commander)#$$&HymeliaCommanderSerious&$$@Center@$What!? Report to battle stations!
$#GuardB(Guard B)#$Yes, sir!

$#HymelianCommander(Hymelian Commander)#$$&HymeliaCommanderSerious&$$@Center@$Could it be that troublesome Elmina? No, our
knights are always on the lookout for her.
$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$Ah... There you are...
$#HymelianCommander(Hymelian Commander)#$$&HymeliaCommanderSerious&$$@Center@$You're the intruder!? How did you get here?

$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$I eradicated...all monsters...
Your turn...Gyurelle...
$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$Druke...
$#HymelianCommander(Hymelian Commander?)#$$&HymeliaCommanderMad&$$@Center@$...!

$#HymelianCommander(Hymelian Commander?)#$$&HymeliaCommanderMad&$$@Center@$I have no idea who you are, dude, but
props for seeing through my disguise.

$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkWink&$$@Center@$It'll be easier to fight you in this form
anyway.

$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkHappy&$$@Center@$So, like, you came all this way to kill me?
For real?
$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$Yes...!
$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkHurt&$$@Center@$Ngh! Whoa, what kind of power is that!?
$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$Perish!

$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkPainful&$$@Center@$You're scary, y'know? I mean, I guess I'm 
one to talk, but geez...
$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkSerious&$$@Center@$Why are you doing this to yourself?
$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkSerious&$$@Center@$Is it, um... Is it for someone you care about?

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAttack&$$@Center@$I still have opponents to fight!
I need more power! Give me more!

$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkClosedEyes&$$@Center@$I see... Yes, it must be someone special.
Like my...Kanna...
$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkClosedEyes&$$@Center@$I guess there's nothing I can do, then...
$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$Perish!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaScared&$$@Center@$Is that black knight an ally of ours?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewGrit&$$@Center@$At the very least, their efforts have
significantly diminished the demon threat.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewGrit&$$@Center@$Which means the account we heard in
Westcarte gains even more credibility.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewGrit&$$@Center@$A lone black-armored swordsman
single-handedly defending an entire village...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewGrit&$$@Center@$From now on, the End of Days Task Force
will pursue this enigmatic knight,
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridNewGrit&$$@Center@$and gather all pertinent information.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$Yes, ma'am!
$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$Haaaaaargh!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyes&$(Am I still human...?)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyes&$(The urge to fight and kill is so strong...
It feels like I'm no longer in control

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyes&$of my own actions, but rather being
moved by something else...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$(But if I can't save that girl... I can't call
myself a hero anymore.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$(Not in this world, not in any other.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$(Every time we meet is like the first time,
and every parting feels like a final goodbye.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$(And yet, each time, my heart remembers
her face.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$(Wait for me...)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Dark Knight Finn)#$$!-1!$(I'm on my way to change your fate.)

$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$(After traveling far and wide, I can say for
certain that there is no god in this world...)
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAttack&$$@Center@$Wha—!? Who the hell are you?

$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$(There is only despair, and the giant who
symbolizes it.)

$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$(The heart of the End of Days—the
Inevitable.)
$#TheInevitableOne(The Inevitable)#$$&Eternal&$$@Center@$REJOICE.
$#TheInevitableOne(The Inevitable)#$$&Eternal&$$@Center@$REJOICE.

$#TheInevitableOne(The Inevitable)#$$&Eternal&$$@Center@$WALLOW IN THE HOPELESSNESS OF
TRUTH, IN ITS UTTER VACUITY.
$#TheInevitableOne(The Inevitable)#$$&Eternal&$$@Center@$REJOICE... REJOICE... REJOICE...
$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$DIEEEEEEEEEEEE!!!
$#TheInevitableOne(The Inevitable)#$$&Eternal&$$@Center@$REJOICE!
$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$Gah! Ngh...

$#ArmoredFinn(Dark Knight Finn)#$$&DarkFinnNormal&$$@Center@$(The difference in power is too great... This
is not something a human being can fight.)
$#Finn;MysteriousGirl;(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious;MysteriousGirl.MermaidClosedEyesSad&$$!-1!$$@Center;;;MysteriousGirl.Right;@$Help! Somebody help!
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSmile&$$@Center@$Yes, you may, my lord.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$How is she?

$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$She's sleeping for now. We won't know
more until a doctor examines her.

$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSadHappy&$$@Left@$Right, it would be best to send for a doctor
from the capital.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$A doctor, huh... That would normally be
a good idea, but...
$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidHuh&$$!-1!$$@Right@$She's not a normal human, is she?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$The layer of magic surrounding her... It
could be some unique spell.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$If she's special, she might be the key to
solving the mystery of this world.
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidLookaway&$$!-1!$$@Left@$The mystery of this world...?

$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidLookaway&$$@Right@$My lord, what on Erden happened to you?
Did you find something weird and eat it?
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What's happened, my lord!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Heh, Snow's concern is one thing, but having you worry about me feels strange...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Then again, there was a time we were
practically siblings, wasn't there?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$You even called me by my name back then.

$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$I see, you're lost in a daydream. Or should
I say, a nightmare. Quite a terrible one too.

$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSweat&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What should we do, Ebony? We have to
bring our lord back to his senses.

$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidThinking&$$@Right@$Maybe some smelling salts? Administered
directly into his mouth?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Sorry, sorry. Never mind. Besides, that
might actually kill me, you know?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(They've really lost themselves in the dream.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(Saying strange things will only make them
suspicious. I have to be careful.)
$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidThinking&$$@Center@$Still... A nightmare?
$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidHuh&$$@Right@$Who is she?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What's wrong?

$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Nothing. So, what are we going to do
about this girl?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Let's just wait and see what happens for now.
She's already looking much better.
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSadHappy&$$@Right@$Yes, let's wait for her to wake up.
$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&MermaidClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Zzz... Zzz...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(She's been asleep for a while...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(If she's special to this world, the Golden
Crest should react to her somehow...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Wh-Wha—!?
My crest isn't working!
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSmile&$$@Center@$My lord? What's wrong?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Oh, ah... It's nothing.

$#Finn;MysteriousGirl;(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious;MysteriousGirl.MermaidClosedEyesSad&$$!-1!$$@Center;;;MysteriousGirl.Right;@$I don't know, I found her unconsscious on
the beach. She's breathing, but only barely.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(Not only did the crest not activate, it felt
like I didn't have it at all...)
$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidHeh&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Maybe we should just slap her awake.
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidPainfulSuper&$$@Left@$Ebony! You can't do that!

$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidHuh&$$@Right@$Relax, I'm joking. But we have other things
to do. We can't spend all day on this girl.
$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&MermaidClosedEyesSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Mm... Mmm...
$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidNormal&$$@Center@$Oh.
$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&MermaidSad&$$@Center@$Where am I...?

$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I'm so glad you're awake! You're in the
mansion of the lord of Rossé.
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidHappy&$$@Left@$You were lying unconscious on the beach.
$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidClosedEyes&$$@Right@$The lord himself brought you here.

$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$How terrible! Quick, we must treat her
right away!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Nice to meet you, I'm Finn. I'm the son of
the master of this house—
$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&MermaidSurprised&$$@Center@$...Ah.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Center@$Whoa!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Center@$(Where'd that trident come from!?)
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$My lord!

$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidClosedEyesSmile&$$@Right@$That was sudden. What did you do to her,
my lord?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Center@$Nothing!
$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidSmirk&$$@Right@$Well, she appears to be quite angry with you.

$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&MermaidIrritateSweat&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I'm not angry... I was just surprised to see
a man... Sorry.

$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&MermaidClosedEyesIrritate&$$@Center@$You took care of me. That's very kind of you.
Still, I didn't ask for your help.
$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&MermaidClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Zzz... Zzz...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Where are you going?

$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&MermaidIrritate&$$@Center@$No need to worry about me. It won't
matter anyway.

$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&MermaidIrritate&$$@Center@$By tomorrow morning, no one will
remember me.
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSweat&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Ah, she's gone...

$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidHuh&$$@Right@$How rude. She didn't even introduce
herself.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$No one will remember her by tomorrow, huh.
What a strange thing to say.
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidSad&$$@Left@$What did she mean by that?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$It must have something to do with the secret
of this world...
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidLookaway&$$@Left@$My lord...

$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidLookaway&$$@Right@$That's it, tell the truth.
You ate something strange, didn't you?
$#Snow(Snow)#$$&SnowWhiteMaidLookaway&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Is she going to be all right?

$#Ebony(Ebony)#$$&SnowBlackMaidClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Her breathing has stabilized, and her
pulse is steady.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$$!-1!$Snow, Snow Black! Can I come in now?

keys.DescriptionKey:
Every so often, the pearl could hear a mermaid's voice from the safety of its shell. Her song echoing throughout the seas was the reflection of her compassionate heart—and at the same time, the cue for everyone to forget her.
The pearl could not move nor could it speak, but it would remember. It would keep all the kindness and sorrow carried by the mermaid's voice forever.

keys.DescriptionKey: Eva was born as the sixth princess of the merfolk kingdom, far away from human dwellings on land. Her voice was the finest among her people, and sea creatures came from far and near just to listen to her sing. She was her country's most beloved treasure.

MermaidRegular01.description: Eva was born as the sixth princess of the merfolk kingdom, far away from human dwellings on land. Her voice was the finest among her people, and sea creatures came from far and near just to listen to her sing. She was her country's most beloved treasure.

keys.IntroText:
My name's Eva.
Do you think you could...remember me?

keys.DescriptionKey: But the peaceful merfolk kingdom wasn't beyond the reach of the Pandemonium. Hordes of monsters raged under the sea as violently as they did on land; Eva's countrymen came under attack, and in the end, the kingdom fell. All the merfolk lost their lives—apart from one.

MermaidRegular02.title: Guardian of the Sea

keys.DescriptionKey:
Overcome with grief, Eva made a pact with a divine being and gained the power to protect the seas. But her new abilities came with a price—everyone she met forgot about her the very next day.
For 2000 long years, she fought one lonely battle after another, doomed to have her existence wiped from people's memory no matter what she did.

Though they have no love of war, they will fight for causes they believe to be important.

keys.DescriptionKey: The strixa'kud are known for their love of libraries, and though it is rare to encounter one outside their own domains, they can most often be found in Erden's greatest archives. Although the dragonscribes of Rigland greatly admire their wisdom, some of them are jealous of the attention their ruminations receive.
