keys.DescriptionKey:
When did the war begin? All who knew the answer have long since perished. It is a war for the sake of waging war.

In Jedariel's world, never-ending strife is the natural state of things. They are one of many soldiers, each of them perfect weapons of war. Their only goal is to take out as many enemies as possible, before their durable bodies finally fail them.

MetalDragon01.name: Jedariel
MetalDragon01.title: Otherworldly War Machine
MetalDragon01.description:
When did the war begin? All who knew the answer have long since perished. It is a war for the sake of waging war.

In Jedariel's world, never-ending strife is the natural state of things. They are one of many soldiers, each of them perfect weapons of war. Their only goal is to take out as many enemies as possible, before their durable bodies finally fail them.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Even in a world of perfect war machines, Jedariel stood out from the rest. They could single-handedly take down dozens of other enemies, so any battle they participated in quickly became one-sided. 

It was only natural that eventually, they would draw the attention of one of the higher powers of their world. In exchange for Jedariel's utter servitude, this entity offered them even greater strength and the opportunity to use it in worlds beyond their own. Jedariel wasted no time in accepting this bargain, for there is nothing they desire more than greater power and further strife.

Now, Jedariel eagerly goes forth to defeat their master's enemies, or to die trying.

MetalGuardian01.title: The Desert Anathema
MetalGuardian01.description: Chased from his homeland due to his grotesque appearance, Magra swore vengeance against the world that abandoned him, and began attacking travelers who had the misfortune to cross his path.

keys.DescriptionKey: Magra resolved that if it was his lot to be despised, he would make it work in his favor. He gathered up every scoundrel he could find and forced them to become his underlings, and now he reigns over his own brutish band. However, he will not be satisfied until he is the ruler of his own domain.

MetalSpider01.title: Model S1
MetalSpider01.description: Originally invented to eradicate pests, these self-replicating metal spiders have instead spread beyond their inventor's control. Watch out, they like to hunt in packs.

This unit enters battle with the Healing Burn status effect for 300TU and will also Endure the next damage that would defeat it with 1HP.

If this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will:
- Gain Endure if it didn't have Endure when it was attacked.
- Gain Healing Burn if it does not have Healing Burn, or a Sleep status effect (excluding Cursed or Noxious).
- Heal for 10% of max HP. This healing is increased to 50% of max HP for the first 3 times it triggers while this unit is on the battlefield.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$We've finally returned...
To the capital of Rigland...!

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Right@$Rizette. A happy reunion is all well and
good, but we ought to report.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$Ah... Right. It isn't good news,
but it bears listening to nonetheless.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$On our way here, we saw Bergarian troops
flying through the sky.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Right@$The skies? An air force...
This spells trouble.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Right@$Infantry with the mobility of flight...
We may be under siege soon.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$We must secure our borders. I will petition
the nobility for reserve troops, and—

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Left@$What the...
What was that sound?!

$#RedKnight(Red Dragon Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$!-1!$$@Center@$R-reporting! An explosion has occurred
in the heart of the capital!

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Another Bergarian weapon? I hoped that
flight was the most of their capabilities...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$Rizette, Princess Maxima.
It's good to see you are unharmed.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Right@$I have a bad feeling about this. All troops,
assist our people! I'm taking the field!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Left@$Wait!
Ludmilla, you can't go out like this.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$Until we see what this new weapon is, we
have no idea how best to fight it.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Right@$If I can save even one soldier by holding
the rearguard, then I must.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$No, leave the tactics to our captains.
You should escape, Ludmilla.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Right@$What...
What are you saying...?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$!-1!$$@Center@$They won't let the Red Dragon Knights
escape. Including me, the "Hero of Erden".

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Center@$If we face them now, they will annihilate us.
Rigland's hope will be snuffed out.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Center@$The best thing for us to do now is split up.
We must survive and plan our counterattack.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I agree.
That's exactly why I will—

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHappy&$$@Left@$You too, Marshal!
I'm so relieved!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Left@$No, this is an order.
Flee, hide, and rest.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Right@$...You're serious, aren't you?

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$I will rally the survivors in Hymelia. Once
that is settled, we will ride to your aid.

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaAngry&$$@Left@$I have taxed Volcana to her limit.
She needs time to recover.
$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$Then I shall accompany you.

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSurprise&$$@Left@$You...?
Do you not despise the Speaker of Flame?

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$I do not care for thee, 'tis true. But now
is the time to put aside our differences.

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$The spirits themselves are restless. For
Erden, we must needs work together.
$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaAngry&$$@Left@$...You are quite the frigid one.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Theo and I will come with you, Astrid.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Lady Ludmilla! Your proud and noble visage
is proof positive of your health!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Left@$You're more likely to survive with a healer.
We'll keep you safe, to our last breaths.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Then I will protect Lady Ludmilla. Guarding
an injured ally is the duty of a knight!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Right@$...Astrid.
I'll go, too...!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Left@$Enough, Ludmilla!
You will only slow us down!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Right@$...!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Left@$I know how devoted you are. But you're in
no shape to fight! Do you think I am blind?!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHurt&$$@Right@$N-no, of course not! I can fight. I just—
Argh!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...The day will come when we need your
strength alongside ours.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSmile&$$@Center@$When that time comes, I pray you will join
us. We'll be waiting.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Center@$...
...Understood...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSmile&$$@Right@$I'm so glad we could all regroup unharmed.
All thanks to Vesh.

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Left@$Erm...
I am ill at ease in the settlements of man.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Right@$How long have you traveled with us already?
You must get used to it!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Nagi, Astrid, and Vesh, too?
Thank goodness you're all safe.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$Mysha and Elmina are looking for Ga'Luga.
Let's wait for, hopefully, good news.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Center@$Ngh...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$Your body's telling you to rest by showing
your exhaustion as pain. You should listen.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$Your concern is appreciated.
But these are trying times.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$If I don't overcome this pain, then I'll be
useless when I'm most needed.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenCalm&$$@Right@$It's not that I don't understand, but...
Just do a short session, okay?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Right@$Don't overdo it. You can have another
short session after some rest.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$...Understood. I'll do that.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Left@$...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Center@$What the...? My body is so heavy.
Almost as if I'm shackled to the floor.

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Ludmilla.
Why do you train only your body?

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$Within you lies a spectacular strength.
Far greater than any physical might.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Are you okay?! I told you to rest...
Where does it hurt?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$...Strength?!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHurt&$$@Center@$Ah...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Center@$...A dream? How pathetic...
My hopes are starting to appear in dreams.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Center@$A power within... If only that were true.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Center@$...I wonder how many have been slain
in Hymelia.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHurt&$$@Center@$I...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Left@$...Everywhere.
But my arms feel the weakest.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Left@$Maybe I injured my muscles.
Every time I try to train, it hurts.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$Your muscles? Hmm. Does it hurt anywhere
when you're not training?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$No.
Now that you mention it, no.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenEyesClosed&$$@Right@$So it hurts just when you train...?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Left@$...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$Ludmilla, it's hard for me to say this, but
I don't think you're in any shape to fight.

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Center@$The spirits whisper it to me...
The faint beating of a powerful soul.
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$——Knock knock!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Center@$Who's there?!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Vesh)#$$!-1!$Callen. Theo. 'Tis I—
Vesh.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Center@$Vesh?!
Okay, I'm opening the door!

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I ask thee, heal the one I carry on my back.
There is little time to spare!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenComplain&$$@Right@$On your back... Ludmilla?!
What awful wounds!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$@Left@$Lay her down here!
Leave the initial treatment to me!
$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$Understood!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$First I've got to close these wounds...
Starting from the biggest.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSad&$$@Left@$...What happened to her?

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Center@$...Under this boulder!
Hrrrgh!

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$In the land of Hymelia did we battle
with foul undead.

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$Before we were overwhelmed, Ludmilla
bade me collapse the cliffside,

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$burying her and the enemy commander
both.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenEyesClosed&$$@Left@$Always so reckless...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSad&$$@Left@$And everyone else?
They're not with you?

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$We went our separate ways to outmaneuver
the enemy. I know not where they are.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Left@$What about Finn?!
Weren't you going to stay with him?!
$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$Well...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenComplain&$$@Left@$W-what? What happened?
Are we in a worst-case scenario...?
$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$No. No, I think not, but...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Center@$...Urgh...

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$The subtleties of humanity are difficult. I do
not know what words I should give thee.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Left@$You're just making my imagination run wild.
Stop beating around the bush...
$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$Hmph... Fine, I shall tell thee all.

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$Finn slipped through a gap in space. He has
gone to a place not even I know of.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Left@$Slipped through... What?
Why would he...

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$The way was opened for him. By one who
would let no other pass.

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Right@$That someone is thine old comrade, Cyrus.
I daresay that he is no ally of ours.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Left@$Cyrus took Finn?!
But why...?!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...I never could understand him,
even back then.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Center@$But when we traveled together, he
worked with us to stop the Pandemonium...

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Center@$I feel thy life force... But it wanes.
As thou art, 'twill not hold much longer.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenComplain&$$@Center@$Even after all that... What is he thinking?
What's his goal?

$#Vesh(Vesh)#$$&FoxMutant&$$@Center@$I must hurry to a healer.
She must be healed!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$Sigh...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSad&$$@Right@$Feeling restless?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSleep&$$@Left@$I know staying behind and keeping watch
is important, but I'm still on edge.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$I hope my sist— The captain is safe.
The same goes for everyone else.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$We've been walking for quite a while.
How are you holding up, Theo?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$It's...
A flower?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yes.
So small and pure white. Isn't it lovely?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Center@$Hey, Theo.
None of them have given up.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Center@$Not the Knights, not the Primordials, and
not these little flowers.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$@Center@$So I won't give up, either.
There's still hope.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Yeah... You're right! We can't lose hope.
That's the first step to being a real hero.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$Like Finn...and Oz.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$...Right.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$Well, what do we do now?
What's our new goal?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Our goal hasn't changed. We have to save
everyone, and restore peace to Rigland.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$I'm fine.
What about you?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$We need to find Finn first... And solve the
problems with Hymelia and the undead.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$We'll do what we can. Help others, find new
allies...and keep an eye on Bergaria.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$But how do we start? We can't call
ourselves the Red Dragon Knights anymore.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGentleSmile&$$@Left@$...No. We'll make a new order.
A new name for people to know us by.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Right@$A new name, huh...
Um... "The Knights who Help People"!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteCalm&$$@Left@$That's simple enough, but it's
not very cool, is it?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHappy&$$@Left@$How about the Blue Dragon Knights? It's
like we're carrying on the mission.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$We have no support and only two members,
but we're a proud Order all the same.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Right@$That sounds good.
It's a lot cooler than my idea!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHappy&$$@Left@$Heh, then it's settled.
Give me your hand, Theo.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$No problems here. All our travels with the
Knights have definitely made me stronger.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$Right. We're in this together.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...Now, let's be off.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHeh&$$@Center@$The Blue Dragon Knights are here—
to bring new hope to a world at war!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$That's true. I'm not feeling tired, either.
...Ah! Over there, I see it!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$@Left@$...We're finally home.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Right@$Westcarte Village, where we were born.
Nothing's changed since the Pandemonium.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$The villagers either died or moved on...
No one was left to rebuild.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$I wonder why we came here? We knew
nothing would have changed...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$That's not true.
Look.
$#()#$Booooom!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Center@$But this time our foe is no god, but
mortal men and women.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Center@$The real Hero is gone. I cannot see a way
forward... And so.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Center@$We may have to resort to different tactics
if we wish to preserve our nation.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What do you mean...?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Left@$Underhanded tactics. This decision is not
an easy one; it goes against my own ideals.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Left@$Another one...Ahh!
T-There's a hole in the ceiling!

$#FemaleBergarian(Bergarian Soldier)#$$&FemaleBergarianShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I've located the hero Astrid.
Just as arranged.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridScared&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Arranged...?
(So they didn't find this room by chance?)
$#FemaleBergarian(Bergarian Soldier)#$$&FemaleBergarianShouting&$$@Left@$You're coming with us.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$Another explosion... And closer this time.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Right@$Tch...!
You think you can defeat me that easily?
$#Caldeon(???)#$$&CaldeonSmallSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Resistance is futile.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Center@$Ah...?!
(What is that weapon?! It melted my sword!)

$#Caldeon(???)#$$&CaldeonBigSmirk&$$@Center@$As I said, resistance is futile.
Do you understand now?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$!-1!$$@Left@$And you are...?

$#Caldeon(Caldeon)#$$&CaldeonSmallSmirk&$$@Right@$I am General Caldeon of Bergaria. And you
are Lady Astrid of the Red Dragon Knights.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$...I am.

$#Caldeon(Caldeon)#$$&CaldeonSmile&$$@Right@$Then I've no wish to fight you.
Rather, I would like to offer my assistance.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Right@$What? You're the ones attacking us!

$#Caldeon(Caldeon)#$$&CaldeonNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Our objective here is the conquest of
Rigland, and Rigland alone.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$At this rate, even the Pillar Room won't be
safe for long. What's our Plan B?

$#Caldeon(Caldeon)#$$&CaldeonNormal&$$@Center@$We are aware that the Knights do not
fall directly under Rigland's banner.

$#Caldeon(Caldeon)#$$&CaldeonSmile&$$@Center@$We also owe you respect, for ending the
Pandemonium and saving the world.

$#Caldeon(Caldeon)#$$&CaldeonEyesClosed&$$@Center@$If you swear fealty to Bergaria and assist
us in the subjugation of Rigland...

$#Caldeon(Caldeon)#$$&CaldeonSmallSmirk&$$@Center@$The Red Dragon Knights will retain their
titles and continue on as a knightly order.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You're asking us to become turncoats?

$#Caldeon(Caldeon)#$$&CaldeonSmallSmirk&$$@Right@$To put it bluntly, yes.
But I suggest considering it. After all...

$#Caldeon(Caldeon)#$$&CaldeonBigSmirk&$$@Right@$If you refuse, we will slaughter every last
Red Dragon Knight on Erden.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$My comrades...
Their lives...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Center@$...
Father...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...As you wish.
I accept your offer.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Left@$I can't say I have one. I never imagined that
Bergaria could have such technology.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Right@$Astrid?!

$#Caldeon(Caldeon)#$$&CaldeonBigSmirk&$$@Right@$A true hero, this one. Little wonder you
survived the Pandemonium.
$#Caldeon(Caldeon)#$$&CaldeonCrazy&$$@Right@$And what say the rest of you?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$@Left@$We'll never join you!
We'll never kneel down to our conquerors!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Left@$Right, Riz?!
...Riz?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteClosedDetermined&$$@Center@$(Astrid would never sell out our country
unless she had a good reason.)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Center@$(Could this be what she said before...?
About underhanded tactics?)

$#Caldeon(Caldeon)#$$&CaldeonCrazy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Make your choice, at once!
Should you fail to do so...!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Left@$...Ha!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Left@$...With Finn missing, we may not have the
strength necessary to oppose them.

$#Caldeon(Caldeon)#$$&CaldeonShouting&$$@Right@$Ngh?!
(She used it as a throwing weapon?!)

$#FemaleBergarian(Bergarian Soldier)#$$&FemaleBergarianSurprised&$$@Left@$General Caldeon!
Are you injured?!

$#Caldeon(Caldeon)#$$&CaldeonEyesClosed&$$@Right@$This wound is nothing.
We have more important matters to tend to.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The two of them ran off.
...That will work.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Left@$Over here, Theo!
Hide!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Right@$R-right!

$#FemaleBergarian(Bergarian Soldier)#$$&FemaleBergarianShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Don't let them escape. We have orders—
Bring them back, dead or alive.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$Wait. If you intend to pursue them,
use this secret passage.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Astrid! What was that...?!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$Shhh... Be quiet.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$No...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$This passage leads outside the city.
Go, quickly! Do not let them escape!

$#FemaleBergarian(Bergarian Soldier)#$$&FemaleBergarianSurprised&$$@Right@$Y-Yes, right.
Come on!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Left@$...
Please, find a way out of this, you two...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$(Of course... Astrid could never betray us.
She's just adopted a new strategy, is all.)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHeh&$$@Right@$(In that case, so will we.
We'll change tactics and continue the fight!)

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$...Let's go, Riz.
We have to escape.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$...Okay.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Do you recall the struggles we faced during
the Pandemonium?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Center@$The way was never easy, but at times it felt
as though we had some kind of guidance.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Center@$Like signposts on the road. It may be that
some were created by Arcane...
$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaCommand&$$@Center@$Haaaaaa!

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaCommand&$$@Left@$If it were not for these undead, the cursed
Bergarians would be no match for us...!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$...I think you're doing just fine in your
efforts to cull the undead.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$@Right@$That effort hasn't gone to waste.
I know it hasn't.

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaAngry&$$@Left@$Indeed...I suppose not. Their souls have
gone to a place far away from here.

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$Not even my Lady of Flame can follow them.
I...hope that means they are gone.

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaAngry&$$@Left@$Or is someone...something, out there?
Calling them back to an unknowable place...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$...I don't know. But either way, fewer
enemies makes things easier for us.
$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$True. Our own force may be small, but...

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$If we can but destroy the undead...we can
band together and finally restore Hymelia.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$...You're optimistic, all of a sudden.
$#Skeleton(Undead)#$$&Skeleton&$$@Center@$......!

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSmile&$$@Left@$As if it was not your own words that
reassured me, just now.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Right@$Ah...

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$I am not optimistic. The Barony is already
lost to the Bergarians, after all.

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaAngry&$$@Left@$I have just not given up. My people depend
on me. I cannot afford to—

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...A shadow? It looks odd.
Wha... What is that?!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Maxima, what's gotten you so...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Hymelian Soldier)#$$!-1!$L-Look up!
Something's in the sky!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Center@$What... What are those? Not birds or
dragons... And there's so many!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Center@$Are they people? No, that can't be.
Is this some Bergarian trick?!

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaCommand&$$!-1!$$@Left@$There is no time to waste! We must
gather our forces and head for Rigland!
$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaAngry&$$@Center@$Nnh...!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$Ah...!
Look where they flew off to!

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSurprise&$$@Left@$They are headed to Rigland...
Directly to the capital!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Maxima...you're pushing yourself too hard.
Let me handle this one. You should rest—

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaCommand&$$@Left@$If I rest, who will cremate these filthy
undead?!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Right@$Well, that's...!
You yourself should know your own limits!

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaSerious&$$@Left@$...Forgive me. Snapping at you will not help
the situation at all, I know.

$#Maxima(Maxima)#$$&MaximaAngry&$$@Left@$I simply...do not wish to see my former
comrades raised as undead slaves...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$......

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Center@$...
Mmm... Hm?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Right@$But I...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Center@$Ludmilla!
You're alive!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Yes, somehow.
It looks like you're in one piece too, Astrid.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSmile&$$@Left@$I would not be, without Vesh's help.
He's the one to whom we owe our thanks.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Right@$Where is he?
He's not with you?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$Searching for other Red Dragon Knights.
His spirit helpers seem eager to assist.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Left@$Whatever took Finn is of great interest to
the Primordials, so they are helping us.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Right@$Finn... He's gone?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Left@$Those two would know more than me.
May I continue, Marshal?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Right@$...Yes, ma'am.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Marshal!
Thank goodness. She's awake.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The undead army overwhelmed us. Our
Hymelian allies also suffered heavy losses.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Center@$However, thanks to your removal of the
undead leader, their army lost control.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHeh&$$@Center@$They broke ranks, allowing our forces to
rout many of them from the battlefield.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I see... That's good to hear.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Left@$Unfortunately, this bought time for the
Bergarians to invade the Yarrell Barony.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$@Left@$The Barony did not resist their attackers,
freely giving up their lands.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Right@$No resistance? From the city that boasted
the most formidable walls in Hymelia?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$I don't know the details, but it has been
confirmed that there was no major fighting.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Right@$...This is no time for me to be resting.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Left@$Hey! Didn't I tell you not to be so hasty?!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Right@$So I survived? Theo, Callen.
You two healed me?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The capital has been occupied by undead,
and Yarrell Fortress has been taken.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Center@$Hymelia has fallen.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$I've no idea what the undead are planning,
but I imagine the Bergarians want Rigland.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Center@$It should have taken weeks for the
stronghold to fall. How long was I asleep?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$!-1!$$@Left@$T-three days.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Right@$That's time I don't have to waste.
I must get used to moving again.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$...That ends my report. I'll go now
to continue looking for our knights.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$All right. Thank you.
I need to return to my training...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What should we do, Callen?
The Marshal can't just get up and move yet.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSad&$$@Right@$...We can't very well stop her ourselves.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$You were injured pretty badly, you know?
More injuries than unbroken skin.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$Let's just support her as best we can.
At least we can keep treating her that way.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Left@$Okay!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSad&$$@Left@$Your wounds are closed, but it'll be a while
before you're back in fighting shape.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Right@$I appreciate it, but this is an emergency.
I have to hurry and rally our company.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Left@$W-Wait, stop!
You're in no condition to even stand up!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHurt&$$@Center@$Ngh?!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hey, I told you so. Hurts, doesn't it?
Now lie down and rest.

keys.value: $#News(News)#$—Breaking news
$#News(News)#$multiple perpetrators have taken a single girl hostage.
$#News(News)#$This is their demand: Hand over the Vessel.
$#News(News)#$The identities and motives of the perpetrators remain unclear—
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernSmile&$$@Center@$Here, Hibiki, I brought you food.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernSmug&$$@Center@$You didn't touch any of the food again?
You've got to eat or you won't have strength.
$#Hibiki's Voice(Hibiki's Voice)#$$!-1!$...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernLookaway&$$@Center@$(She hasn't eaten or even slept since
then...)

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernLookaway&$$@Center@$(At this rate, her body won't hold up. Is
keeping her confined here really the right
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernLookaway&$$@Center@$thing...?)

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernSad&$$@Center@$I'll just leave the nice, warm food here.
Make sure you eat—
$#News(News)#$According to the latest reports
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSad&$$@Center@$...
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSad&$$@Center@$(Wha...)
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSad&$$@Center@$(What's happening to me...?)

$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSad&$$@Center@$(Why do I have to be the only one suffering
like this...?)
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSad&$$@Center@$(I want to go back... Back to normal life...)
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSerious&$$@Center@$(What the hell is this power...?)
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSerious&$$@Center@$(What even am I—!?)
$#()#$Remember your mission.

$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkHurt&$$@Center@$That voice again! Dammit, it's echoing in
my head—!
$#()#$Fulfill your mission.
$#News(News)#$There is a hostage situation in a building at the city center!
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkHurt&$$@Center@$Who the hell are you!?
$#()#$$%0.4%$My name is... Pandora.
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSerious&$$@Center@$What did you just say!?
$#()#$My name is Pandora.
$#()#$And also "you"—
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSerious&$$@Center@$What? What the hell does that mean...?
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkShouting&$$@Center@$I'm Hibiki—Hibiki Himeno!
$#()#$"Hibiki Himeno" does not exist in this world.
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSerious&$$@Center@$W-What are you talking about?

$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSerious&$$@Center@$I am Hibiki Himeno! I'm not Pandora or
whatever!
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$Hmph...

$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkShouting&$$@Center@$My parents live in Kitazu! My mom's kind,
a music teacher, and a great cook—

$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkShouting&$$@Center@$And my dad... He's kinda annoying
sometimes, but he really cares about me!
$#()#$Do you have any memories?

$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSerious&$$@Center@$Of course I do! Let's see... For the entrance
ceremony at Saionji Elementary...

$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSerious&$$@Center@$It was the first time I saw my dad in a
suit. My mom and I laughed, saying it
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSerious&$$@Center@$didn't look right on him—after that—
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkShock&$$@Center@$W-Wait... Huh...?
$#()#$What are their names?
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkShock&$$@Center@$U-Uh... Um...
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkShock&$$@Center@$Why... Why can't I remember!?

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$I feared something like this would
happen...
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkShock&$$@Center@$No... It can't be.
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkShock&$$@Center@$That's impossible!
$#()#$It's because they were never "set."
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkShock&$$@Center@$"Set"...? What's that supposed to mean?
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkShock&$$@Center@$You're saying it's all fake...?
$#()#$You are a temporary creation for the Requiem.
$#()#$A fictional identity crafted to blend in as a human—
$#()#$Your true form is the Goddess Pandora's Vessel.
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkAngry&$$@Center@$That's... A lie...
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkAngry&$$@Center@$It's a lie!!!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$But I didn't think they'd pull a
kidnapping stunt in broad daylight.
$#()#$An unforeseen event has occurred.
$#()#$By the wish of a girl who holds the power to kill even gods—
$#()#$That power has returned to that Vessel.
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkAngry&$$@Center@$What are you talking—
$#()#$As of now, you have absorbed the powers of ninety-nine Vessels—
$#()#$You are an incomplete Pandora.
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkAngry&$$@Center@$...
$#()#$That is why the temporary personality still remains.
$#()#$"Hibiki Himeno" still clings on.

$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkAngry&$$@Center@$You bastard... Shut up already! I'm not
just some leftover scrap...!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$A group that can't control its own lower
ranks is bound to collapse. Perhaps we
$#()#$Your mission is to kill the one remaining girl.
$#()#$End the Requiem—and become the complete Pandora.
$#()#$Resurrect the goddess.
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkAngry&$$@Center@$I SAID SHUT UP!!
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkAngry&$$@Center@$Hah... Hah... Hah...
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkAngry&$$@Center@$Damn it... Damn it all...
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkAngry&$$@Center@$(So Hibiki Himeno... Is a fake?)
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkAngry&$$@Center@$(I don't even exist...?)

$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkAngry&$$@Center@$Then everything I've done... The things I've
hoped for...
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSad&$$@Center@$What happens to our promise?
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherModernNormal&$$@Center@$should just ignore...
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSad&$$@Center@$Saya...
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkWeap&$$@Center@$Saya...!

$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkWeap&$$@Center@$I can't keep our promise—I can't continue...
Our dream of freedom...
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkWeap&$$@Center@$Aaaah...ahh...
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkWeap&$$@Center@$(Why does this happen only to me...?)

$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkWeap&$$@Center@$(Because I'm a goddess. Because I'm the
Vessel of Pandora—)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Dark Hibiki)#$$!-1!$(Because I'm not Hibiki Himeno...)

$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSurprised&$$@Center@$(Is it really true that the powers of
ninety-nine Vessels are inside me...?)
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSerious&$$@Center@$This is... Kotone's Gift... Ah—I can see it...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSerious&$$@Center@$!?
$#News(News)#$$!-1!$We repeat,
$#DONOTSHOWME(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkShouting&$$@Center@$What the hell... Wait a sec—what is this...!?

$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSerious&$$@Center@$(Fine... I'll admit it. This is the real deal—
then I can use it however the hell I want,
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSerious&$$@Center@$right?)
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSerious&$$@Center@$Wait for me, Saya!!
$#DarkHibiki(Dark Hibiki)#$$&HibikiDarkSerious&$$@Center@$Don't you dare die!
$#()#$—Around ten years ago
$#Young Momotaro(Young Momotaro)#$With me? Why not!?
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Left@$Perhaps I should kill you.

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroWhistle&$$@Right@$Don't say such scary stuff! But the scary
Reina is also lovely too～♡
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroWah&$$@Right@$Okay, okay, sorry... But really! Who is
that girl?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$She is just a schoolgirl. Granted, she was
a bit of a troublemaker.
$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroComplain&$$@Center@$Not just a schoolgirl. Her birthdate, parents, family... There's no record of anything.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSurprised&$$@Center@$So that is what you meant by "don't
know anything"...

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroComplain&$$@Center@$Exactly. There's no data confirming her
existence. No information at all.
$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroComplain&$$@Center@$—It's like she's a girl who doesn't even exist.
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSurprised&$$@Center@$Doesn't exist...

$#Young Reina(Young Reina)#$Um... I don't remember...
It was something complicated.
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Center@$I see... So it's true, after all...
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Thank you for telling me, Momo.
$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroSurprised&$$@Right@$R-Reina just thanked me!?
$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroHearts&$$@Right@$That's basically a proposal, right??
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaHurt&$$@Left@$It is absolutely not.

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroExcited&$$@Right@$Time to get the dresses ready—just like
old times, two brides!

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaIrritated&$$@Left@$You're not listening to a word I'm saying,
are you...

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroHearts&$$@Right@$Reina, Reina! Anything you want me to
do? I want more thank yous!

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Left@$Then stop getting involved with Hibiki
Himeno. It is for your own good.

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroMelt&$$@Right@$Wait... Are you worried about me? What a
kind little sister! Reinaaa!

$#Young Momotaro(Young Momotaro)#$I see... Hmm... I'm sure she'll forgive us if
it's just a little!
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaHurt&$$@Left@$Stay away from me—!

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroMelt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$But you know, Reina—if it's for my little
sister's sake, I wouldn't even mind dying!
$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroMelt&$$@Center@$So don't worry!!
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSurprised&$$@Center@$What do you mean "don't worry"...?

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroNormal&$$@Center@$Well, because... You want to know more
about that girl too, right?
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Center@$That's—

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroTehepero&$$@Center@$I'm your big sis, remember? I can see
right through you.
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Center@$Heh... I can't beat you, can I?
$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroMeltHeh&$$@Center@$Ehehe～ Because I'm the big sis!

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Center@$That's right... Momo, I just remembered
something.
$#Young Reina(Young Reina)#$You think so?
$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroMelt&$$@Center@$Yeah? Tell me, tell me～♪

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Center@$That girl you knocked out—Saya. She is
actually Hibiki Himeno's best friend.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Center@$The two of them are incredibly close—like
you and me.

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroNormal&$$@Center@$So in other words... They're super close
friends, right?

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroExcited&$$@Center@$Ah! Then maybe I can use her to lure
Hibiki Himeno out!

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroExcited&$$@Center@$That way, I can give the info to you, and
also to Lord Elysian and Kana, and
$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroExcited&$$@Center@$everyone will be super happy☆

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroTehepero&$$@Center@$All right, I'll definitely make myself
useful! Just leave it to me, Reina!
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Center@$Yes. Be careful, okay—Momo.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(Strange things seem to keep happening
lately...)

$#Young Momotaro(Young Momotaro)#$Yeah, 'cause Reina's mother is super nice,
right?

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(And it's all bad things—misfortune,
accidents, bad luck...)

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSerious&$$@Center@$(Could it be that Hibiki is caught up in all
these things too...?)
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSerious&$$@Center@$(If so, then I—)

Codename: Momotaro.

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroSullen&$$@Right@$Ugh, seriously, I told you I hate that
codename!
$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroComplain&$$@Right@$But honestly, I think we're the same...
$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSerious&$$@Left@$What do you mean?
$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroNormal&$$@Right@$I mean, you and I both love our sisters, right?

$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaShouting&$$@Left@$Do not compare Mirai to your imaginary
little sister.

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroWah&$$@Right@$She's not imaginary!!
She really exists!!
$#SolemnLeader(Solemn Leader)#$Kana. Explain the situation.
$#VoicefromaLargeScreen(Voice from a Large Screen)#$$!-1!$"Everyone―let's sing together!"

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroNormal&$$@Center@$Ah, that voice―I knew it! She's on that
building's big screen!
$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSad&$$@Center@$Mirai...

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroWhistle&$$@Center@$It's footage from Mirai's concert! I think
the disc version is coming out soon, right?
$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroWhistle&$$@Center@$Hehehe, Mirai really is so cute～!
$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Of course. She is the best.

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroMelt&$$@Right@$Wow, such a classic big sister fangirl. But
I get it—I really do!

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$But hey, if you love her that much, why
don't you go see her?

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroNormal&$$@Center@$You are aware that Mirai is no longer a
Vessel.
$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaNormal&$$@Center@$That's...

$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSerious&$$@Center@$Y-Yes, Lord Elysian. We are currently
investigating the girl in question.
$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSerious&$$@Center@$...Because my mission isn't over yet.

$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSerious&$$@Center@$If we do not capture Hibiki Himeno, the
Requiem might happen again.
$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSerious&$$@Center@$So I...

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroWhistle&$$@Center@$Yup yup, we really are the same! Lord
Elysian told me the same thing, and that's
$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroWhistle&$$@Center@$why I still follow his orders.
$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroMelt&$$@Center@$All for the sake of our little sisters, Right!?
$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSad&$$@Center@$...
$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Still, you and I are different.

$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSerious&$$@Left@$You vanish for who-knows-where and
suddenly reappear. Irresponsible.
$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroWah&$$@Right@$Wait, you're bringing that up again!?
$#Elysian(Elysian)#$You mean Hibiki Himeno, correct?

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroSullen&$$@Right@$I told you! I was out searching for the last
Vessel! I went really far!

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroComplain&$$@Right@$It was super tough, okay? I got swept
away by a waterfall, stranded at sea, and
$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroComplain&$$@Right@$climbed mountains with no food or water...

$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSad&$$@Left@$How much of that is even true... I really
cannot trust you.
$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroTehepero&$$@Right@$Even though we're both big sisters?
$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSad&$$@Left@$I told you—we are not the same.

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroExcited&$$@Right@$Well if you insist, fine! I'll tell you just
how adorable my little sister is!
$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaShouting&$$@Left@$Wait, no, I really don't nee—

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroMelt&$$@Right@$So first! Her eyes are big and round like
grapes, all sparkly and purple! Her

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroMelt&$$@Right@$fingers are white and squishy―just
touching them...

$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSerious&$$@Center@$Yes. I believe you are aware, but all of the
power is gathering within her.

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroMeltHeh&$$@Right@$They feel sooo nice—out of this world! And
not just her looks—she's smart too! In
$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroMeltHeh&$$@Right@$medicine, science, everything—
$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaShouting&$$@Left@$Okay, that's quite enough. I get it.

$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I understand... I love my little sister just
as much as you do.
$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSad&$$@Center@$Maybe... I'm just scared.

$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSad&$$@Center@$Scared that my sister would reject me if
she found out everything I've done.
$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSad&$$@Center@$She probably would...

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroNormal&$$@Center@$But if it's for your sister's sake, you'll do it
all again, right?
$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSerious&$$@Center@$Yes, that's right... I'll do anything.
$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSerious&$$@Center@$If it's for Mirai's smile.

$#Elysian(Elysian)#$Of course I'm aware. That's why we're
acting with full force to secure her.
$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroHappySmile&$$@Center@$See? We are the same, you and I!
$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSad&$$@Center@$I will let you believe that...
$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroTehepero&$$@Center@$All right, time to go catch Hibiki Himeno!

$#Momotaro(Momotaro)#$$&MomotaroTehepero&$$@Center@$Then, I'll protect my precious little sister!
Free her from the evil goddess Pandora!
$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSerious&$$@Center@$Yes. All for my precious little sister...

$#Mirai [on screen](Mirai [on screen])#$$!-1!$It'll be out soon! So everyone, please wait
just a little bit more～!
$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSerious&$$@Center@$Yes, just wait a bit more, Mirai.
$#Kana(Kana)#$$&KanaSerious&$$@Center@$Your big sister will do her best.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordHurt&$$@Center@$Nn...
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSurprised&$$@Center@$Huh... This is—the infirmary?
$#Saya(Hibiki)#$$&SayaNoSwordSad&$$@Center@$Saya—
$#Hibiki()#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Center@$"Fulfill your mission."
$#Hibiki(Hibiki's Stomach)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Right@$Grrrrr～
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHappy&$$@Right@$Ah—ugh...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernHappy&$$@Left@$Hahaha! All right, just sit tight!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHappy&$$@Center@$Thank you for the food... Nom.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$@Center@$Mmm!?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Whoa, this is seriously good!
Nom, munch, munch!
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernSurprised&$$@Left@$Hey now, don't scarf it down so fast!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Right@$Mmph—gah—cough cough!!
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernFakeSmile&$$@Left@$Here, drink some water. You okay?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHappy&$$@Right@$My mom used to rub my back like this
too... I was so little I barely remember.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Center@$There it is again... So freakin' annoying...
What the hell is this!?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernSweatSmile&$$@Left@$Is that so... Wait a minute! Age-wise, I'm
still in the big sister category, okay!?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernSmile&$$@Left@$Oh well. You must've been starving. How
long's it been since had a proper meal?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHappy&$$@Right@$It's been a few days... Didn't have
anywhere to go back to.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Where's your family home?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmile&$$@Center@$Somewhere around the Kitazu district, but
I've been living at the academy for so long,
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmile&$$@Center@$I barely remember where it is.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernNormal&$$@Center@$Huh... I guess that happens...

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$For me, the academy had become my
home. Everyone there felt like family.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHappy&$$@Right@$Though I did run off without permission
and not come back sometimes...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernHappy&$$@Left@$Yeah, I get it. Happens at that age.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Center@$This voice in my head...
What's this "mission" supposed to be!?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$In hindsight, they must've been worried
sick...

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHappy&$$@Center@$Especially Nanami... She was my
homeroom teacher. Always scolded me.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Center@$And Saya...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernSmile&$$@Center@$A friend?
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmile&$$@Center@$Yeah...

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHappy&$$@Center@$She's probs super worried right now since
she can't reach me. Such a worrywart.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Center@$I wanna see her...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernSmug&$$@Center@$Yeah... There, there.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Center@$Hey—don't pat my head!!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernSmug&$$@Center@$Hehe, I'm a kind big sister, you know?
I've got a soft spot for lonely kids.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Center@$(The powers of the Vessels disappeared
that day, didn't they? Everyone said so!)
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernSmile&$$@Center@$So leave it to me, Hibiki.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Center@$Geez, stop patting already...
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Center@$(Elmina's hand... It feels like a mom's...)
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Center@$(Maybe... I really can trust her...)
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Center@$Hey, Elmina...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernSmile&$$@Center@$What is it?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Center@$If... If I ever get out of control—please,
stop me.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernNormal&$$@Center@$Get out of control...?
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$@Center@$I don't...trust the me I am right now. So, please...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernNormal&$$@Center@$(Hibiki's shaking...)

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Center@$(Then why the hell can't I have a normal
youth too, huh??)

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernSmile&$$@Center@$All right. If that time comes, your big sister
will take care of it. So rest easy.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmile&$$@Center@$Thanks, Elmina...

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Center@$Go to the beach, eat crepes... Watch Saya's
ballet, and then... And then—
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Center@$If things stay like this, I can't do any of it...
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Center@$Why is this only happening to me...

$#CultMemberA(???)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Center@$Found you... You're Hibiki Himeno, aren't
you?
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$@Center@$Who the hell are you guys?
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Center@$Saya!

$#CultMemberA(???)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Center@$Answer the question. Are you Hibiki
Himeno?
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Center@$Shut the hell up...
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Center@$I'm super on edge right now! Can't you tell!?
$#CultMemberA(???)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Tch, this is pointless.

$#CultMemberB(???)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Left@$No doubt about it—matches the intel.
This is Hibiki Himeno.
$#CultMemberC(???)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Right@$You—come with us!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hey! What the hell does that mean?

$#CultMemberA(Cult Member A)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Center@$We are devoted followers of Lord Elysian.
We offer everything to him.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$@Center@$(Elysian... Never heard of him.)
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$@Center@$(But I know these follower types.)
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Center@$Mmph, ah... Just a dream...

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$@Center@$People who just obey their prophet.
So basically a cult, huh.

$#CultMemberC(Cult Member C)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$We will carry out Lord Elysian's will—
by any means necessary.

$#CultMemberA(Cult Member A)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Right@$If you resist, we have no qualms breaking
your limbs.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That look in their eyes... They're not
messing around...

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Center@$(If they catch me here, I won't be able to
go anywhere anymore...)

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Center@$(Not to the academy, not the beach, not
the movie theater... Nowhere...)
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Center@$(Like hell I'm letting that happen!)
$#Hibiki()#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Center@$"Fulfill your mission."

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Center@$Tch... That voice again...
My head's spinning...
$#CultMemberB(Cult Member B)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Something's wrong with her...

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Center@$(I dreamt about being left behind...
Am I getting lonely?)
$#CultMemberC(Cult Member C)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Right@$Now's our chance—take her by force!

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Idiots... Don't come near me! Stay the hell
away!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Center@$No, run... Or else—!
$#CultMemberA(Cult Member A)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Telling us to run? Absurd!
$#CultMemberB(Cult Member B)#$$&BlackMageNormal&$$@Right@$Hibiki Himeno, come quietly and—
$#DONOTSHOWME(Hibiki?)#$Run... Nngh... UAAAA... AAAAAAAHHHH!!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Hibiki?)#$――――――！！！
$#DONOTSHOWME(Cult Member B)#$Wh-What! Agh! Guh... GAHHH!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Cult Member C)#$What... That change in appearance...
AAAAAHHH—
$#DONOTSHOWME(Cult Member A)#$Stop! STOP—

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Center@$(But I can't go back.
Not like this...)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Hibiki)#$(I can't move... It's like something's
controlling me...)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Hibiki)#$(Overflowing from inside... Stop it! I'm still me!)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Hibiki)#$(Don't erase me—don't erase Hibiki Himeno!)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Hibiki)#$(NoooooooOOOOOOOOOOO!!!)
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Center@$―――――――――― HAAAH!!
$#Elmina(???)#$$&ElminaModernNormal&$$@Center@$Calm down. You're safe now.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Center@$Hah... Hah... Hah...
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Center@$Hah... Hah...
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$@Center@$...
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$@Center@$—Wh-Where...am I?
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Center@$...

$#Elmina(???)#$$&ElminaModernNormal&$$@Center@$Relax. This is a room in the Red Dragon
Organization. Do you have any injuries?
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Center@$I... I can't remember...
$#Elmina(???)#$$&ElminaModernNormal&$$@Center@$Don't force it. You're clearly shaken.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Center@$Yeah... Oh—wait... I heard a voice... From
inside...

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Center@$R-Right! What happened to those guys
who attacked me!?
$#Elmina(???)#$$&ElminaModernFakeSmile&$$@Center@$Ah—well...

$#Elmina(???)#$$&ElminaModernLookaway&$$@Center@$(She's in no state to hear what actually
happened...)

$#Elmina(???)#$$&ElminaModernSmile&$$@Center@$I chased them off. Cut 'em down left and
right!

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$@Center@$But... I swear I did it with my own hands!
I can still feel it...

$#Elmina(???)#$$&ElminaModernSmile&$$@Center@$Maybe it was just a weird dream? Here,
have some hot cocoa.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Center@$Ever since that day, sleeping or awake,
this damn thing inside me just won't quit.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Center@$A bad dream... It was just a dream...

$#Elmina(???)#$$&ElminaModernNormal&$$@Center@$(Looking at her now...she still seems like
a normal schoolgirl.)

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh right, I never introduced myself.
I'm Elmina.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernNormal&$$@Left@$I work in intelligence for the Red Dragon
Organization. You could say I'm a spy.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Right@$A spy...?
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernHappy&$$@Left@$Pretty cool, right?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Right@$Cool or not, are you even allowed to
disclose that?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernSmug&$$@Left@$Eh, well, I'm just a grunt. I wanted you to
trust me.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$@Right@$Why me?
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You're Hibiki Himeno, aren't you?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Center@$(I have this sickening feeling, that if I'm
with someone, I might just destroy them...)
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Center@$!!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernSweatSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Wait! I'm not here to fight. If I meant
harm, you'd already be restrained.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernSweatSmile&$$@Left@$I just want to protect you. From the
organizations that are after you.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Right@$After me? Why would they be...

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Right@$The Gifts have disappeared from the
world, right?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernNormal&$$@Left@$There are those who don't believe that.
The cult that attacked you is one of them.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernNormal&$$@Left@$Also, we have intel that some hardliners
within the Church are after you.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Right@$That many people...want me...?
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Right@$This makes no damn sense...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$So, what do you say? Wanna hide out at
my place until things settle?
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Center@$(That alone's enough to drive me crazy!)

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$@Center@$But you're with the Red Dragon
Organization... Won't your boss come
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$@Center@$knocking and tell you to hand me over?
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernSmile&$$@Center@$Well, they just might.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernHappy&$$@Center@$But I'm not irresponsible enough to leave
a kid hanging in this kind of situation.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Center@$I'm not a kid anymore...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernSmile&$$@Center@$You're just good at acting tough. But to
me, you're still a big ol' kid.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Center@$That's kinda insulting...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernHappy&$$@Center@$Haha! I'll take the backtalk to mean
you're feeling better.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaModernHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$All right, I'll toast you some bread. Special
deluxe version—with a sunny-side-up egg!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Right@$I'm not hungry...

keys.DescriptionKey:
When an ally, including this unit enters the battlefield, all allies other than this unit receive a Monarch Token. Monarch Tokens cannot stack. Any attack damage will remove Monarch Tokens.

Each time an ally with a Monarch token is damaged by an attack (even if defeated), this unit will immediately have its TU reduced to 0.

Triggered when this unit enters the battlefield from the allied reinforcements:
- Ally Spirit is doubled. If Ally Spirit is at 0, gain 1 Spirit instead.
- Then remove burn (including Mega Healing Burn) from 1 random non-poisoned enemy and grant them Mega Poison for 200TU. This triggers an additional time for each 2 Spirit allies have (up to 5 additional times with 10 Spirit).
- Then if all enemies are poisoned, all allies have their current TU reduced by 100TU.

Mega Poison will overwrite other status effects on those enemies. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison.

Mega Poison will overwrite other status effects on those enemies. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison.

Stealth will overwrite other Status effects on those units. Stealth Shields prevent the next non-stealth status effect a unit would gain while Stealthed from applying. Stealthed units ignore the next enemy attack that would damage more than 1 target. Any damage will remove stealth.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Many old legends speak of the Lady of the White Moon, an ancient being who slumbers in a vast palace on one of Erden's moons.

It is said that if one were to visit her there, she would rise from her sleep and offer the visitor a prophecy of their future. Most of Erden's mythical heroes are said to have received advice from her, aiding them in fulfilling their grand destinies.

However, these legends offer no hints as to how to get to her palace in the first place. Various plans have been devised, such as building some kind of flying machine or creating a powerful teleportation spell, but only a handful of eccentrics have actually attempted them. Most become discouraged by recurring dreams of their plans failing, often in an extremely spectacular fashion.

keys.IntroText:
She dreams of dark times

keys.DescriptionKey:
When Artimeia sleeps, she dreams of the future. But because the future is a tangled web of various possibilities, choices, and fates, Artimeia must sleep for ages at a time to properly understand how her actions might change outcomes. 

Thus, she tries to minimize her role as much as possible in the events that unfold in Erden, taking action only if it's absolutely necessary to ensure the world's survival. This usually amounts to only granting grains of advice to the right people at the right time. However, she understands that dire times call for more dire measures, and she will occasionally join a potential hero to help them fulfill their destiny.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Artimeia does not originate from Erden—she hails from a distant world that no longer exists. Artimeia's powers of prophecy showed her the impending doom of her world, but instead of heeding her warnings, her peers exiled her as a nuisance.

Unsurprisingly, their world was destroyed shortly thereafter. Artimeia drifted through the ocean of stars in deep grief until she arrived at Erden.

In her visions, she saw that Erden's future faced many threats, and she swore to do everything in her power to safely guide this world through the dark times ahead. Learning from her prior failure, she isolated herself from the residents of Erden, hoping that subtlety will work where clear warnings had not.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The girl is defiant. Her name is listed among the Knights of the Round Table, but she has no intention of serving any ruler. If she ever meets King Arthur again, she will immediately go for the kill.
The girl is unfilial. The first Mordred was her grandfather, but she couldn't care less about the remorse he felt. She only wishes she could have slain him herself.
The girl is a rebel, and she's determined to take on the entire damned world.

Bonds of blood helped keep the Round Table unified over the years. Is it a surprise, then, that the knight inclined to steal blood ended up exiled and forsaken?

Through her window in her white room, a girl looks up at the clear sky, wondering what fun is waiting for her today. She hears her mother calling her, and when she follows the voice downstairs, she sees her beloved family and a delicious meal waiting for her—
Mordred was never allowed to have any of that. Through her window in her dark cell, she glares at the gloomy sky, wondering how to survive another day.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2800|$Callen. Could you continue where we left
off yesterday?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2808|$What I discovered was that it is possible to
replicate the crests.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2809|$Replicate them!?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2810|$The crests are elaborately woven tapestries
of complex magic.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2811|$If we know how they are composed,
replication is not impossible.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2812|$So you're thinking we could have multiple
Crestbearers!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2813|$No. We cannot increase the number of
Crestbearers.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2814|$I did some testing before my Crest faded.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2815|$If I replicated it onto a living being, the two
crests would interfere with one another,

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$and the newer crest would immediately
lose power.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2816|$So the crest can be copied, but there can
only be one of each Crestbearer at once?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2801|$Alright. You seem okay now.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2817|$Yes. There can only be one organic
Crestbearer.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2818|$Oh!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2819|$We should defeat the Eternal using
something other than the Crestbearer!
$#Ludmilla;Rizette;Elmina;(All)#$$&LudmillaSurprise;Elmina.ElminaSurprise;Rizette.RizetteSurprise&$$@Center;;;Rizette.Right;Elmina.Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2820|$!?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2821|$Exactly!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2822|$I want to replicate the Crimson Crest onto
an inorganic vessel,

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$and use it as a stand in for the real
Crestbearer.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2823|$If the Crimson Crestbearer used this
weapon to deliver the final blow...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2824|$After expiring and dissolving into light
particles,

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$the Eternal would recognize it as the
Crestbearer, and attempt to fuse with it!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2802|$Where were we?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHeh&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2825|$So essentially, the Eternal would be sealing
itself inside an inorganic vessel!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2826|$This is the conclusion I have reached,
based on over a millennium of research.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2827|$The Sword of Sealing... The Exeternia!!
$#Finn;Rizette;Theo;(All)#$$&FinnSerious;Rizette.RizetteSurprise;Theo.TheoSurprise&$$@Center;;;Rizette.Right;Theo.Left;@$$|act5.Voices/mst2828|$!!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2829|$If it works, we could end the Pandemonium
without sacrificing Finn or anyone else!
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2830|$Wow, you're amazing Callen!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2831|$Finn!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2832|$Y-Yeah!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2833|$I have already completed the design.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$Replicating the Crimson Crest won't be a
problem either now that Finn is here.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2803|$The Pandemonium, the Crests, and the
Eternal.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2834|$However, there are ingredients and skillsets
required that cannot be found in Elvenlent.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2835|$There are things I require your assistance
for if I may have it, Captain.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2836|$Of course. No mission on Erden is more
important!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHeh&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2837|$Excellent!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2838|$Then there is somewhere that I need you to
go.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2839|$The Gamlan Mines, in the northern reaches
of the Hymelia Plains.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2840|$I need you to go there and obtain some
mithril for me.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2841|$Mithril is superdense and an excellent
conductor of magic.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$It will be used for the blade of the sword.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2842|$So we need to go to these mines and collect
mithril?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2804|$These three elements are intrinsically
related.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2843|$Yes. But it is not as simple as it sounds.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2844|$There is a security system there that utilizes
powerful sentinel stones.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2845|$Since the entrance collapsed, the security
system reacts to anyone who comes close.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2846|$And it can no longer be deactivated
remotely.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2847|$Then we'll just have to fight our way
through!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2848|$The mithril can be found in the deepest
reaches of the mines.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2849|$There are a lot of magical materials inside.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$Occasionally this causes supernatural
phenomena to occur.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2850|$You'll know what I mean when you get there.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2851|$The other thing I need is not a thing, but a
person.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2805|$I thought if I could interfere with one of
them, I could break down the whole system.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2852|$A swordsmith of great skill, capable of
forging the Exeternia.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2853|$A swordsmith, you say?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2854|$My grandpa Gilgan would be perfect!
He can forge any weapon you need!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2855|$Let's send a letter to Urg Roa and summon
him immediately.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2856|$Sounds like you have some useful friends.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2857|$Just wait, Callen. We'll get everything you
need!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2858|$Okay. I'm counting on you.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2859|$Callen, do you mind if I station some knights
here as messengers?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2860|$It would be convenient if we could keep in
contact with Rigland during this process.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2861|$It is true that we will require outside
cooperation to complete this task...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2806|$I decided to start by examining the Crests.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHeh&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2862|$Don't worry, my Fa— The Commander will
select them carefully!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2863|$If any demons try to sneak in, I'll sniff
them out in a heartbeat!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2864|$Okay. We'll accommodate your messengers.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2865|$Thank you!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2866|$Alright, knights! Let's go get what we need
to forge the Exeternia!
$#Finn;Rizette;Astrid;(All)#$$&FinnHeh;Rizette.RizetteHeh;Astrid.AstridHeh&$$@Center;;;Rizette.Right;Astrid.Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2867|$Yes ma'am!!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2807|$I used my Cerulean Crest as the subject.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$I had gathered data about the Crimson
Crest before that though, with Rody's help.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst704|$This is excellent swamp right here, even for
the Kawazu Wetlands.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst713|$Are you sure? It just looks like regular mud.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst714|$Heh heh, only bikki can tell the difference.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst715|$Now I shall remove my clothing and begin
my mud bath!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst716|$Okay... We'll wait for you over there then.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst717|$Lady Ludmilla, Lady Rizette! Did you know
this mud makes your skin beautiful?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst718|$It makes your skin...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst719|$...Beautiful?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst720|$It soothes and moisturizes the skin of all
folk, not just bikki!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst721|$If you so wish, I shall teach you its ways,
humble as my knowledge may be!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteCalm;Ludmilla.LudmillaSerious;&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Ludmilla.Right;@$$|act2.Voices/mst722|$I'm good.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst705|$If we are going to rest here, I think I shall
take a mud bath!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst723|$Beautiful skin... A beauty bath, if you will.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst724|$Captain?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst725|$Personal care is an important part of
training, is it not?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst726|$No!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst727|$Yeah, no! Just... No.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst728|$What's gotten into you two?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst729|$Lustrous, strong skin!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst730|$Strong skin!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst731|$Hey! Don't try to lure her in with training!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst732|$Your skin is already beautiful, Captain!
So don't do it.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst706|$Mud bath?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst733|$Alright then you two... Nagi, let us know
when you are finished.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst734|$What a shame! I merely wish to spread
knowledge of the wonders of mud bathing...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst735|$Then how come you only asked Rizette and
the Captain?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst736|$O-Oh! Sir Finn, you are of course also most
welcome to join me!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst737|$Nagi...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst707|$As the name suggests, it is a bath in the
mud!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst708|$We bikki cover our bare skin with mud to
cleanse it.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst709|$You cleanse your skin with mud? Isn't that
the opposite of clean?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst710|$The mud of the Kawazu Wetlands is known
for its powerful healing qualities.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst711|$And this mud is particularly potent!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst712|$This mud can heal your skin?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act2.Voices/mst702|$This looks like a good spot.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act2.Voices/mst703|$Take a break, everyone.

That night, thousands of oni descended upon Musashi. Though her armor was torn apart and her blade chipped, she cut down hundreds of them. She fought until dawn, but at last her strength failed her. Bound in chains, a special potion was forced down her throat.
Her screams were swallowed by the darkness as her eyes slowly stained red.

keys.IntroText: I will destroy everything for you.

keys.DescriptionKey: Musashi's sanity fiercely resisted the oni transformation. Yet at the same time, a part deep within her was quietly exulting. Pure strength was flooding through her body. Fear and pleasure clashed, her blood burned hot, and before she knew it, her mind focused. She clung only to the sensation of victory, losing what it meant to be human.
