keys.value: $#DONOTSHOWME(Lü Bu)#$—During our slave days, I never felt lonely.

$#youngLuBu(Young Lü Bu)#$Okay, 634. Just keep running straight ahead.
On the coast, there'll be a boat.
$#youngmusashi(Young Musashi)#$Why are you telling me this, 666?

$#youngLuBu(Young Lü Bu)#$He's chasing us by himself.
If we split up, then one of us can escape.

$#youngmusashi(Young Musashi)#$B-But the plan was to get out together!
Remember? We were going to live together!

$#youngLuBu(Young Lü Bu)#$We will, don't worry. After all, this world
was created by good people, for good people.

$#youngLuBu(Young Lü Bu)#$I'm sure we'll be rewarded for everything
we've been through.
$#man'svoice(Man's Voice)#$You little shits! Where are you!?
$#youngLuBu(Young Lü Bu)#$If one of us manages to escape now...

$#youngLuBu(Young Lü Bu)#$she can come back one day and save the
other one.
$#man'svoice(Man's Voice)#$Answer me! I know you're there, damn it!!!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Lü Bu)#$I thought of you as my little sister, and felt
it was my responsibility to protect you.
$#youngLuBu(Young Lü Bu)#$I'll go this way, you go that way.

$#youngLuBu(Young Lü Bu)#$Quick, go!
Don't look back, just keep running!

$#youngmusashi(Young Musashi)#$We'll meet again someday, I promise!
Promise!
$#youngLuBu(Young Lü Bu)#$Take care...
$#Man(Man)#$Damn, so this is where you were hiding.

$#Man(Man)#$Wait, where's the small one?
Where's she hiding!?

$#youngLuBu(Young Lü Bu)#$I don't understand...
It's just me.

$#youngLuBu(Man)#$You're going to make this difficult, huh?
Get over here now!

$#Man(Man)#$I've got a suitable punishment for you!
You'll be wishing you were dead by morning!
$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuColdSmile&$$@Center@$And so, I was punished.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Lü Bu)#$I would have done anything to save you from
that hell, even if it would cost me my life.

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuColdSmile&$$@Center@$He was right...
I did wish to be dead by morning.

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuColdSmile&$$@Center@$My body was broken inside and out, my
dignity shattered to pieces...
$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuHappySmile&$$@Center@$But I never said a thing about you.

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuClosedeyesSmile&$$@Center@$I wondered if you'd managed to sail across
the sea.

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuClosedeyesSmile&$$@Center@$Were you eating well? Were you still such
a crybaby?
$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuClosedeyesSmile&$$@Center@$I might have felt love at first...

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuCrazyNormal&$$@Center@$But later I learned to cling to a simpler
emotion.

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuCrazySmile&$$@Center@$I did eventually kill my owner one day, while
his guard was down. I bit him to death.

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuCrazySmile&$$@Center@$It was...exhilarating. I felt so alive.
But that pleasure vanished in an instant.
$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuLookawayNormal&$$@Center@$It never seemed to last.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Lü Bu)#$So, one day...

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuLookawayNormal&$$@Center@$I killed everyone in the mansion, adults and
children alike, and then fled

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuLookawayNormal&$$@Center@$without as much as clothes to cover
myself with.

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuLookawayNormal&$$@Center@$I was taken in by someone else.
He used me as well. So I killed again.

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuLookawayNormal&$$@Center@$And then again, and then once more.
Death enveloped me. A spiraling sea of red.

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuNormal&$$@Center@$I eventually became known throughout the
lands of Zhonghua by the name "Lü Bu,"
$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuNormal&$$@Center@$and the alias "Master of Treachery."

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuSmile&$$@Center@$Nobody would take me in anymore.
They were scared. Terrified.
$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuSmile&$$@Center@$So I left the country.
$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuSmile&$$@Center@$I headed east, to the Land of Peace.
$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuHappySmile&$$@Center@$Hoping to find you.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Lü Bu)#$we escaped together.
$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuHappySmile&$$@Center@$I wanted to see you so much.

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuColdSmile&$$@Center@$Don't worry, I'll end your suffering now.
With my own two hands.
$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiHurt&$$@Center@$Ngh...

$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiShouting&$$@Center@$I was looking for you too...
For someone who knows my past...
$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiShouting&$$@Center@$But I can't let myself die here!
$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiShouting&$$@Center@$Dual Heaven Style, Lone Wolf!

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuCrazyLaugh&$$@Center@$Guh... Haha!
Impressive swordsmanship.

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuCrazyLaugh&$$@Center@$Did you have a proper teacher, or did you
just pick it up as you went along?

$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiShouting&$$@Center@$I wouldn't call him a "proper teacher."
I just had to mimic his moves to avoid dying.
$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiShouting&$$@Center@$Dual Heaven Style, Twin Lions!
$#youngmusashi(Young Musashi)#$Huff...huff...huff...

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuCrazyLaugh&$$@Center@$Ohoho! You're fast.
The crybaby has come a long way indeed.

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuCrazyLaugh&$$@Center@$Hahahahaha! You're definitely worth killing.
I'm very much looking forward to it♪
$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiHurt&$$@Center@$Enough, Lü Bu, let's stop now—

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuCrazyShouting&$$@Center@$Stop calling me that!
Call me by my number, like you used to!
$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiHurt&$$@Center@$We're no longer objects, Lü Bu!

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuCrazyShouting&$$@Center@$But we were!
And maybe it was better that way!

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuCrazyShouting&$$@Center@$An object can't get its heart broken,
it doesn't have one!

$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiHurt&$$@Center@$Guh... What a heavy slash... If I don't fight
back, she's really going to kill me...
$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiShouting&$$@Center@$Twin Lions!
$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuHurt&$$@Center@$Ngh... Aaah!
$#youngLuBu(Young Lü Bu)#$Run, 634! If you stop, you'll be caught!

$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(She's overwhelmingly strong, but I can
still defeat her with technique.)

$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(I just need to wear her down, and then
strike.)
$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiShouting&$$@Center@$Take this!
$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuHurt&$$@Center@$Ngah! Aaaah...
$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiShouting&$$@Center@$Lone Wolf!

$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiSurprisedSerious&$$@Center@$Huh!? I missed...
No, wait... Is that an illusion?
$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuCrazyNormal&$$@Center@$Kane-Douji... You promised not to interfere!
$#GoldenDoji(Kane-Douji)#$$&KindoujiSmirk&$$@Center@$Don't be foolish. You needed help.

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuCrazyNormal&$$@Center@$No, this is a clear breach of our agreement.
Boys who refuse to listen get punished.

$#GoldenDoji(Kane-Douji)#$$&KindoujiSerious&$$@Center@$That's rich. You were planning to kill us
all from the start, weren't you?

$#youngmusashi(Young Musashi)#$I can't go on... I can hear his voice...
He's catching up with us!
$#GoldenDoji(Kane-Douji)#$$&KindoujiSerious&$$@Center@$Well, Master of Treachery?
$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuColdSmile&$$@Center@$...No point in denying it, I see. Yes.

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuColdSmile&$$@Center@$Things that are no longer needed ought to
be discarded, and that includes you.

$#GoldenDoji(Kane-Douji)#$$&KindoujiSerious&$$@Center@$In terms of sheer strength, you far surpass
me. That's why I kept you around.

$#GoldenDoji(Kane-Douji)#$$&KindoujiCrazy&$$@Center@$I knew one day I would need to put you on
a leash.
$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiSurprisedSerious&$$@Center@$(What's this aura...?)
$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiSurprisedSerious&$$@Center@$Lü Bu, something's wrong... Run!
$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuColdSmile&$$@Center@$I will, but not until I've killed you.
$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiSurprisedSerious&$$@Center@$No! I mean—
$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiSurprisedSerious&$$@Center@$(The barrier is gone!)
$#youngLuBu(Young Lü Bu)#$Right, at this rate we won't escape...

$#GoldenDoji(Kane-Douji)#$$&KindoujiCrazy&$$@Center@$I can't thank you enough, Musashi Miyamoto.
You did well to wear her down for me.

$#GoldenDoji(Kane-Douji)#$$&KindoujiCrazy&$$@Center@$Now I can obtain a weapon even stronger
than a Cursed Beast!

$#GoldenDoji(Kane-Douji)#$$&KindoujiCrazy&$$@Center@$I dedicate this performance to you, my
foolish sister.
$#GoldenDoji(Kane-Douji)#$$&KindoujiCrazy&$$@Center@$Rise and rejoice. Frenzied Lunar Step!
$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuHurt&$$@Center@$!?

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuPossessedHurt&$$@Center@$Ah... What is happening...
No, stop... Stop it...
$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuPossessedHurt&$$@Center@$I...feel like...

$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuPossessedScream&$$@Center@$No... I'm scared... Help—
Noooooooooo!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Lü Bu)#$$!-1!$$@Center@$Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaghhhhhh!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$Sir Finn!!!
$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$and we had a chat.

$#Myasia(Mysha)#$$&MyshaShouting&$$@Left@$All right everyone, we just need to focus on
surviving and regrouping with the others!

$#GoldenDoji(Kane-Douji)#$$&KindoujiSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Let the onmyoji live. Show no mercy to the
rest.
$#GoldenDoji(Kane-Douji)#$$&KindoujiSmirk&$$@Center@$Go ahead and feast on their eyes and guts.
$#GoldenDoji(Kane-Douji)#$$&KindoujiSmirk&$$@Center@$Show them the power of the oni.
$#OniA;OniC;OniB(Kane-Douji's Underlings)#$$&OniMaleMobSmile;OniC.OniMaleMobSmile;OniB.OniMaleMobSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;OniC.Center;OniB.Right;@$Haaaaaargh!
$#Villagersrunningaway(Frightened Villagers)#$Aaaaaaaaah!

$#Villagersrunningaway(Frightened Villagers)#$Somebody help!
Eeeeeek!
$#Villagersrunningaway(Frightened Villagers)#$No, I don't want to die...  Nooooo!!!

$#OniA(Oni A)#$$&OniMaleMobSmile&$$@Left@$Who would've thought such a nice hunting
ground existed so close to the capital, eh?

$#OniB(Oni B)#$$&OniMaleMobSmile&$$@Right@$These humans have decent flesh on 'em.
Soakin' in that hot spring adds a nice aroma.

$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Left@$And then, before we knew it, we both fell
asleep...
$#OniC(Oni C)#$$&OniMaleMobSmile&$$@Center@$Shame this spot ain't better known.
$#capturedfemalevillager(Captured Villager)#$$&KimonoLadyMobSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Eeeeek!

$#OniA(Oni A)#$$&OniMaleMobSmile&$$@Center@$Whoa there, don't let the food escape. You
want such a treat to fall and get all dirty?

$#capturedfemalevillager(Captured Villager)#$$&KimonoLadyMobSurprised&$$@Center@$No... Don't come any closer!
I-I don't want to die! No...

$#OniA(Oni A)#$$&OniMaleMobSmile&$$@Center@$Don't worry, you won't die. You'll live on as
my own flesh and blood, so to speak.

$#capturedfemalevillager(Captured Villager)#$$&KimonoLadyMobSurprised&$$@Center@$N-No...
Noooooo—
$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiShouting&$$@Center@$—Haaah!

$#OniA(Oni A)#$$&OniMaleMobSurprised&$$@Center@$Wh-What the...
When was I...even...cut—

$#capturedfemalevillager(Captured Villager)#$$&KimonoLadyMobSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Am I... Am I safe?
Oh, thank you...

$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiSerious&$$@Left@$You can thank me later. If you want to live,
you'd better get out of here, fast.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiPossessed&$$@Right@$Pardon me, Sir Finn, but this explanation
does little to allay my suspicion...
$#capturedfemalevillager(Captured Villager)#$$&KimonoLadyMobSurprised&$$@Right@$Y-Yes, ma'am!

$#OniB(Oni B)#$$&OniMaleMobHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That's her! The warrior with two swords!
The Oni Slayer, Musashi Miyamoto!

$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiSerious&$$@Center@$I have no words for your kind.
My blade will speak for me. Now line up.

$#OniC(Oni C)#$$&OniMaleMobShouting&$$@Center@$Hah, shouldn't leave yer back wide open
like that!
$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Haaah!

$#OniC(Oni C)#$$&OniMaleMobSurprised&$$@Center@$Gah!
So you...weren't alone...
$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Musashi, there are too many of them.

$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiSerious&$$@Right@$Around a hundred, it seems. But let's save
the complaints for later, shall we?
$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiSerious&$$@Right@$The battle has already begun.

$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$And to my swords, neither time nor numbers
matter. Let me show you what real speed is.

$#Ray(Rei)#$$&ReiDiscontent&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Finn, let me ask you again.
Nothing happened, right?
$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(Oh, she has drawn her second sword...)
$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiShouting&$$@Center@$Dual Heaven Style—Twin Lions!
$#demons(Oni)#$$&OniMaleMobSurprised&$Aaaargh!
$#demons(Oni)#$$&OniMaleMobSurprised&$Ngaaah!

$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(Rapid moves and flawless defense, constant
slashes too fast for human sight...)
$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(Her swordsmanship is like magic!)
$#OniB(Fleeing Oni)#$$&OniMaleMobSurprised&$$@Center@$We can't win this fight! Run!
$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiIrritate&$$@Center@$You think you can escape? Think again...
$#OniB(Fleeing Oni)#$$&OniMaleMobSurprised&$$@Center@$Eeeeek!!!
$#???(???)#$$!-1!$Out of sight, out of mind, was it?

$#Myasia(Mysha)#$$&MyshaPout&$$@Right@$And don't you go lying, Finn! If you do, you'll
have me and Tori to deal with!
$#LuBu()#$$&LuBuClosedeyesSmile&$$@Center@$Clang!
$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiHurt&$$@Center@$Wha...

$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(Did Musashi's blade just get deflected...?
By a human!?)

$#LuBu(???)#$$&LuBuClosedeyesSmile&$$@Center@$Long time no see.
Oh, how I've missed you...
$#LuBu(Lü Bu)#$$&LuBuColdSmile&$$@Center@$634.
$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Nothing happened. I swear.

$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$But I can see how I might have caused
a misunderstanding.

$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I should have been more considerate.
I'm sorry.
$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$We just talked, though. I promise.
$#Ray(Rei)#$$&ReiDiscontent&$$@Right@$Hmm, really?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$I am overcome with env—disappointment!
I have gravely misjudged you, it would seem!
$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Ah, there you all are. Good morning.

$#Ray(Rei)#$$&ReiDiscontent&$$@Right@$Musashi, may I ask you a question?
What were you and Finn doing last night?

$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiSurprisedNormal&$$@Left@$Finn and I? We talked a little, and then
I fell asleep.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$Wait just a moment, fair lady! That wanted
notice—

$#Ray(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Right@$Yes, the malevolent energy is getting
stronger.

$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiIrritate&$$@Right@$Yes, it seems they've been posted all over
the place. It's quite annoying, actually.
$#Ray(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...Isn't that your face?
$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiHappy&$$@Center@$...
$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiConfused&$$@Center@$No. You've got the wrong person.
$#Myasia(Mysha)#$$&MyshaPanic&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I mean... It kind of does look like you.
$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiLookawaySigh&$$@Left@$It looks like my face, yes. But it's not me.
$#Myasia(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSurprise&$$@Right@$What?

$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$That doesn't really explain anything...
Sorry, but could you come with us?
$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$And if I say no?
$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Then we'll have to use force to detain you.
$#Myasia(Mysha)#$$&MyshaPanic&$$!-1!$$@Right@$So it's a den of oni, as rumored.

$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiHeh&$$@Center@$Well, I'd rather not resort to violence,
but it seems I have no other choice.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Sir Finn, she has unsheathed her blade!
$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$Mysha, protect Sage Rei!
$#Myasia(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$On it!
$#Ray(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$@Left@$Be careful, Finn.
$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Nagi!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$Ready when you are, Sir Finn!

$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You and your group coordinate very well.
Are you accustomed to the battlefield?
$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$In that case, let's make this quick—
$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$You're fast...but not fast enough!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$Hmm... Considering the Bureau of Onmyo
is nearby...
$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiHeh&$$@Center@$Oh, you blocked my attack? Impressive.
$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiSerious&$$@Center@$How about this!
$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Do your worst!

$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$(She's fast, but still within my ability to
counter. I can follow her moves.)
$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiHeh&$$@Center@$Hehe.
$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$What's so funny?

$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiHeh&$$@Center@$I just remembered training with my master.
Felt a whiff of nostalgia.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Center@$Training, you say...

$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiSerious&$$@Center@$Please accept my apologies.
I don't intend to mock you.

$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiSerious&$$@Center@$You wield your sword with earnestness
and genuine skill.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$We may encounter another lovely—
ahem, that is, distinguished onmyoji

$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiSerious&$$@Center@$If we continue this duel, one of us
is sure to fall within a few moves.

$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$And if you were taking this seriously, it
would be over even faster, right?
$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiHeh&$$@Center@$Oh...

$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$That second sword at your waist isn't just
for show, is it?

$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiClosedEyes&$$@Center@$You catch on quickly.
Yes, the second sword isn't just a spare.
$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiHeh&$$@Center@$But I don't feel like drawing it right now.
$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Left@$All right. Let's stop here.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$Are you certain, Sir Finn?

$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$I don't sense any hidden malice in the way
she fights. I'm sure you feel it too, Nagi.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$I admit, her technique appeared quite
straightforward...but nonetheless...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$akin to Lady Haku...

$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Yes, we can't just let her go. She resembles
the person on the poster too much.

$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiNormal&$$@Right@$Just so you know, I am being falsely accused
by the real culprit.

$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiNormal&$$@Right@$I want to catch them and find out why
they'd do that.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$Is that so?
$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiClosedEyesSmile&$$@Right@$If you doubt me, then join me.

$#Musashi(???)#$$&MusashiClosedEyesSmile&$$@Right@$You can keep an eye on me to ensure I'm
not a threat. We can find them together.
$#fin(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$That sounds like a good idea.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$If Sir Finn agrees, then so shall I.

$#Musashi(Musashi)#$$&MusashiHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I'm glad to see you're such reasonable people.
My name's Musashi Miyamoto, by the way.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$Allow me to shake your hand, Lady
Musashi!

keys.DescriptionKey:
She was a girl with no name and no memory of her past. A certain samurai found her washed up on the shore and gave her the name Musashi, along with his own surname, Miyamoto. In return, she called him "Master." She mimicked his techniques in a naive, earnest way, befitting a child with no past to rely on.
She made new memories every day, while the old ones stayed forgotten.

keys.IntroText:
Start at nothing and arrive back at nothing
That is how you attain true emptiness

keys.DescriptionKey: A certain girl calls Musashi by a number. She is surrounded by scary adults, with nowhere to run, nowhere to hide— "You get lost in dreams as easily as in the waking world, kid," her master's words used to wake her from her nightmares, his smile soothing her fears. And now, he has left her too, gone where she cannot follow, before she could gain the full mastery of his teachings. Luckily, he left behind The Book of Five Rings, a treatise to guide her steps.

MusashiRegular02.name: Musashi
MusashiRegular02.title: Oni Slayer
MusashiRegular02.description: A certain girl calls Musashi by a number. She is surrounded by scary adults, with nowhere to run, nowhere to hide— "You get lost in dreams as easily as in the waking world, kid," her master's words used to wake her from her nightmares, his smile soothing her fears. And now, he has left her too, gone where she cannot follow, before she could gain the full mastery of his teachings. Luckily, he left behind The Book of Five Rings, a treatise to guide her steps.

keys.DescriptionKey: The Book of Five Rings contained the arcana of the Dual Heaven Style swordsmanship. When Musashi first heard that its ultimate secret is emptiness, she stated that she already had nothing. But her master said it's not simply about the lack of things, it's about the lack of fixed existence. He added that in order to attain it, she'll need to confront her past one day. And so, Musashi forges ahead, determined to face what she's lost and what lies ahead of her.

keys.DescriptionKey:
A girl from Urg Roa who lives with her grandfather, Gilgan. Bright and cheerful, and never seen without a smile. Mysha grew up admiring her grandfather and uncle, both renowned swordmasters, and idolizes Druke especially. From a young age, Mysha has trained with a sword alongside her childhood friend Ga'Luga.
Since she's not kud, Mysha grew up training alongside people much bigger and stronger than her. Still, her innate speed and agility, and her unflagging hard work, are the source of her strength.

keys.value: $#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$|act3.Voices/mst1547|$...Isn't it a little late to be training?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaAngry&$$|act3.Voices/mst1556|$And I want the name Druke to stay as a
hero's name, not a curse.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$|act3.Voices/mst1557|$The higher your sights are set, the
harder it can be...I know that well.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSurprise&$$|act3.Voices/mst1558|$Huh?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$|act3.Voices/mst1559|$My father is a great man. A wise leader, and
the greatest swordmaster in our order.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$|act3.Voices/mst1560|$He sounds pretty great!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSadSmile&$$|act3.Voices/mst1561|$He is. But it is because I am chasing after
him that...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSadSmile&$$|act3.Voices/mst1562|$I realize every day how lacking I am. The
weight of this name can be...crushing.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$|act3.Voices/mst1563|$Ah...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$|act3.Voices/mst1564|$...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$|act3.Voices/mst1565|$I think I know what you mean.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSurprise&$$|act3.Voices/mst1548|$Lady Astrid?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$|act3.Voices/mst1566|$Druke, the Legendary Swordmaster, and
Gilgan, the Master Swordsmith.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$|act3.Voices/mst1567|$It's thanks to them that I can be here, but
I'm always in their shadow, too.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$|act3.Voices/mst1568|$I don't think I have what it takes to be a
leader. I'm not like my father, or Ludmilla.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$|act3.Voices/mst1569|$I've trained hard, but my skills are useless
outside the training grounds.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$|Cont|$I can't fight like Finn and Rizette...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSad&$$|act3.Voices/mst1570|$I'm nothing... Nothing but the daughter of
the great Luther von Draclow.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$|act3.Voices/mst1571|$But it frustrates you, right? And that
means you haven't given up yet.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSadSmile&$$|act3.Voices/mst1572|$...I could say the same for you.
Maybe you and I are similar, hm?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSmileBlush&$$|act3.Voices/mst1573|$Do you mind if I watch you train for a while?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$|act3.Voices/mst1574|$Just watch?
Why don't you join me?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSadSmile&$$|act3.Voices/mst1549|$I...could not sleep either.
Am I interrupting?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSmileBlush&$$|act3.Voices/mst1575|$Okay! It's easier to sleep after a good
workout.
$#DONTSHOWME(Male Voice)#$$|act3.Voices/mst1576|$Well well well...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$|act3.Voices/mst1577|$!?
$#Norza(Silver-haired Demon)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$|act3.Voices/mst1578|$What do we have here?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$|act3.Voices/mst1579|$Who are you!?
$#Norza(Silver-haired Demon)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$|act3.Voices/mst1580|$Pure young maidens, seeking strength...

$#Norza(Silver-haired Demon)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$|act3.Voices/mst1581|$Just the type to test out my new Aeon
Thorns.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$|act3.Voices/mst1582|$A demon!?
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaAngry&$$|act3.Voices/mst1583|$New Aeon Thorns...!?
$#Norza(Silver-haired Demon)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$|act3.Voices/mst1584|$Come now...
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$|act3.Voices/mst1550|$No, not at all.

$#Norza(Silver-haired Demon)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$|act3.Voices/mst1585|$With my help, you'll easily surpass your
great forebears!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$|act3.Voices/mst1551|$Gramps told me not to while I'm recovering,
but I can't just sit on my hands.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$|act3.Voices/mst1552|$I still have so far to go.
I need to put in more effort. More work.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaAngry&$$|act3.Voices/mst1553|$I need to surpass Uncle Druke.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$|act3.Voices/mst1554|$Could you truly do it? Defeat the legend...
Your uncle, and your hero?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$|act3.Voices/mst1555|$...I have to. If I don't, Gramps will never
be truly happy again.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1586|$They aren't on the west side!
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1595|$Is that direction...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1596|$Toward Lu'Ganan.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1597|$Everyone, prepare to depart! We're going
to Lu'Ganan!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1598|$I'm going with you!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1599|$Ga'Luga!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1600|$Mysha is my best friend... My sister. If she
is in need, I will always be there.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSad&$$@Center@$...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSad&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1602|$Druke was my hero.
I looked up to him.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSad&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1603|$If he'd offered one of those Aeon Thorns to
me, I might have used it.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSad&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1604|$I'm sure he offered one to Mysha. But she
didn't take it.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1587|$Or the east...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1605|$Instead, she sought him out alone after he
transformed into that beast.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1606|$Ga'Luga...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1607|$We would be honored to have Me'Rizanté's
finest warrior with us.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1608|$I will be the vanguard. You flimsy humans
can support me from the rear!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1609|$Calm down, Ga'Luga. We want to save our
friend too.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1610|$So let's do this together!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSleep&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1611|$...Don't get in my way.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1612|$We won't! You can count on us!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1613|$Lu'Ganan is located southeast of here.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1614|$Stay vigilant on the road. Keep an eye out
for signs of Mysha and Astrid!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1588|$For both Lady Astrid and Mysha to
disappear... What is going on?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1615|$Move out!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1589|$Captain! Riz and Finn found footprints!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1590|$Just what you'd expect of hunters!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1591|$Mysha has that giant sword, so her
footsteps are pretty distinct.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1592|$And Astrid's boots are custom-made. But
there was another set, too.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1593|$Another one?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1594|$They belong to a large man. All three of
them go off in the same direction.

They say that this demon has once disguised herself as a beautiful girl and devoured people throughout the capital. Finally, thanks to the courage of a group of heroes, her spirit was sealed and peace descended on the city once again.

keys.value: $#Druke(Giant Monster)#$$&Druke&$$@Left@$GROOOOAAARGH!!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1256|$We will handle the monster! Lady Astrid,
please help that girl!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1257|$M-Me!?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1258|$She's badly hurt, every second counts!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1259|$Don't worry, we'll have your back! Please,
we're counting on you!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaPout&$$@Left@$Aww... It'll be starting soon, so I wanted
to get some extra training in, that's all.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Right@$Hm? What will be starting soon?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSurprise&$$@Left@$You know what!
Oh, wait, you're not Urg Roan, right.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Left@$Um, what was the official name again...
It's a tournament, at least.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSmile&$$@Right@$A tournament...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$@Right@$Ah, Mya, watch out for that dip in the
path—
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSurprise&$$@Left@$W-whoa!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$@Right@$H-hey!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSigh&$$@Right@$(All this deskwork lately has left me
feeling very rusty.)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Mysha)#$Ow...
Sorry, Tori.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid)#$Honestly, you need to pay more attention.
Come now, get off me...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid)#$...Mya?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Mysha)#$Oh, it's just, this is the first time I've seen
your face from this close, I think.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Mysha)#$You're really pretty. If I was a boy...
Or actually, maybe that doesn't matter...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid)#$...D-don't be ridiculous.
You and your jokes...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Astrid)#$Come now, before someone sees!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurpriseBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...Oh!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$@Center@$Huh?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$@Center@$F-Finn!? How long have you been there!?
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHappy&$$@Left@$Toriiii!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubledBlush&$$@Center@$Oh, um, I just got here...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubledBlush&$$@Center@$I-I didn't see anything!
Sorry to interrupt!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngryBlush&$$@Center@$W-wait, Finn!
Finn!!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaWink&$$@Center@$Whoopsie, maybe I took it a bit too far...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridClosedEyesBlush&$$@Center@$...I can't believe you, Mya.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaBitterSmile&$$@Center@$I said I was sorry. I didn't think anyone
would actually walk in!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Center@$Besides, we cleared things up with Finn,
so it's all fine, right?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSigh&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Sigh...
Just be more careful in the future, please.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSerious&$$@Left@$Yes, Commander! I swear it 'pon the flag
of the Red Dragon Knights!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSigh&$$@Right@$Yes, yes, you're forgiven.
$#Astrid;Mysha;(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Right@$Kya!!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHappy&$$@Left@$Hehe. Thanks, Tori.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$$!-1!$Astrid, is it okay if I come in?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$@Center@$Finn!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$@Center@$Y-yes, of course.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGritBlush&$$@Center@$W-what can I do for you!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...Did you do something to make her mad,
Brother?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$I don't think so. I just—

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngryBlush&$$@Right@$Let us just discuss what you came to
discuss and nothing else! That's an order!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Y-yes, Commander!
You have a visitor!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Right@$A visitor? For me?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$@Right@$W-what are you doing, Mysha!?

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$Yeah. We came across her on our way back
from patrol.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$I think it'll be easier if she explains what
she's here for.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$Indeed.
Show her in, then.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Right this way, miss.

$#Mina(???)#$$&MinaSmile&$$@Center@$It's my pleasure to meet you, Lady
Commander of the Red Dragon Knights.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSmile&$$@Center@$To whom do I owe the pleasure?

$#Mina(Mina)#$$&MinaSmile&$$@Center@$I am Mina, Ambassador of the united
kud tribes.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Center@$The united kud tribes...
Ah, the matter from your letter?

$#Mina(Mina)#$$&MinaSerious&$$@Center@$Yes, Commander. I've come to invite you
to the Urg Roa Blade and Fist Tournament.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Urg Roa Blade and Fist Tournament?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaWinkHappy&$$@Left@$Hehe, you're so cute, Tori! A little breath
on your neck and you go bright red!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$True, you wouldn't know. They hold a
tournament in Urg Roa every three years.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$Both Druke the Hero and Old Man Gilgan
fought there. It's always impressive.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Druke the Hero, too...!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$But why invite our order, Ambassador?
I thought it was open to Urg Roans only.
$#Mina(Mina)#$$&MinaSerious&$$@Left@$Indeed, historically it has been.

$#Mina(Mina)#$$&MinaSerious&$$@Left@$But this year, it's been decided to open it
to those of all races and origins.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$An open tournament?
What an idea.

$#Mina(Mina)#$$&MinaSmile&$$@Left@$We would be honored if not only the Lady
Commander, but all of you, would join us.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yeah! Yeah!
I wanna join!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHeh&$$@Center@$I mean, what else have I been training for
all this time!?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngryBlush&$$@Right@$I-I am only angry at your pranks,
that's all!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Oh, so that's what you meant earlier.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaLaugh&$$@Left@$I can go, right, Tori?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSmile&$$@Right@$Of course. You are Urg Roan, after all.
You would be the perfect choice to go.

$#Mina(Mina)#$$&MinaSurprised&$$@Left@$It was always our intention to ask
Lady Mysha to participate.

$#Mina(Mina)#$$&MinaSmile&$$@Left@$I fear the people of Urg Roa would not
accept a Tournament held without you.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Right@$The people of Urg Roa?
What do you mean?

$#Mina(Mina)#$$&MinaSurprised&$$@Left@$...Could it be that Lady Mysha has not
informed you herself?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSurprise&$$@Left@$Ah, now that you mention it.
I guess I haven't.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridStare&$$@Right@$Mya? What is she talking about?
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Well, you see...

keys.DescriptionKey:
Let's go!
Just like always, Mysha can be seen swinging her greatsword, kicking up gusts of wind. Someone once asked her if she didn't get bored doing the same thing every day.
"Of course not! It's totally different every time. I was faster yesterday than the day before. I'm stronger today than I was yesterday. And I'll be even better tomorrow!"
She keeps on striving toward the pinnacle.

keys.DescriptionKey:
She may not remember her birth parents well, but she grew up with Gilgan, so she's able to keep smiling.
She may not be kud, but the people of Urg Roa accepted her all the same, so she's able to keep smiling.
She's faced many hardships, but she's been blessed with happiness above and beyond the dark times. "That's why I want to keep smiling forever!"
"Konkon! May good fortune, safety, and happiness be with you always!"

keys.value: $#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act3.Voices/mst1239|$Captain, I can hear the sounds of a battle...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$|act3.Voices/mst1240|$Everyone, on your guard! Which way is it
coming from!?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$|act3.Voices/mst1241|$Over there, Captain!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$|act3.Voices/mst1242|$!?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$|act3.Voices/mst1243|$What is that...? Some kind of giant!?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$|act3.Voices/mst1244|$It's huge... And it's fighting something!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$|act3.Voices/mst1245|$Hmm? Those ears...is she kud? No...
Either way! We must aid her!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$|act3.Voices/mst1246|$She's fighting that monster! Knights,
prepare to engage! Assist her!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$|act3.Voices/mst1238|$...?
Tournament of Fate
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1416|$...
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1425|$None of your business.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1426|$...

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1427|$Mysha?
Do you disagree?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1428|$N-no, it's nothing.
Really... it's fine.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1429|$(A family of warriors from Urg Roa...)
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1430|$What is that sziviik doing here!?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1431|$Grr...!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1432|$Hey, wait!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1433|$It was you, right? You protected me
when I got hurt.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1434|$What?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1417|$Oh hey, it's the Knights!
Hi!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1435|$N-No, I just...

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1436|$Thank you. When you protected me...
I felt really relieved.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1437|$You are welcome to feel however you wish.
I simply did my duty, and nothing more.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1438|$Oh, and you too!
Thanks so much.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1439|$Don't mention it...

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1440|$People always end up covering for me. At
this rate, I'll never be a protector myself.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1441|$I...I need to get stronger.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1442|$...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1443|$A-Anyway, I have matters to attend to.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1444|$Yeah, me too. I hope you're all healed up
soon, Mysha.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1418|$Hello! Are you two taking a break here too?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1445|$Bye, Mysha.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1446|$...

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1447|$What's the matter, Mr. Prickly? They
saved my life, you know!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1448|$Sh-Shut up!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1449|$Aww, you could just be honest for once.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1450|$I don't need your meddling.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1419|$Yeah. I told Ga'Luga I could make it all the
way home, but he won't let me...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1420|$Are you two friends?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1421|$Uh-huh. We go way back. We've been
training together for years, too.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSadSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1422|$I could never beat him before, but now I'm
right on his heels. Right?

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1423|$Hmph. You're still years away from
living up to his style.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1424|$His style? Is there someone you're learning
from?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act3.Voices/mst1415|$Hmm? Oh, it's...

torture!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1216|$Now that you mention it, I've heard the
sziviik train with fire from a young age...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1217|$Captain, not you too!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile;Theo.TheoSmile;&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1218|$I think I shall take your advice, lad. Stay
hydrated and get used to it as we go!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1219|$I think that's best. Here's your water bottle.
I gave you a little extra.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1220|$A thousand thank yous!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1204|$What happened to the sun protection we
bought for you!?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun;Ludmilla.LudmillaSerious;&$$@Right;;;Ludmilla.Left;@$$|act3.Voices/mst1221|$Your unit behaves awfully casually,
Ludmilla.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1222|$That is true, but their closeness makes them
an effective team.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1223|$Hmm... They do appear to work well
together.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1224|$I suppose that's to be expected, with the
Crimson Valkyrie training them.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1225|$You're too kind...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1226|$My inspection will be impartial. I will simply
report what I observe to the Commander.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1227|$I'm sure you will.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1228|$...Phew.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1229|$Captain? I brought you some water.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1230|$Oh, thank you.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1205|$I thought training with my sword in the sun
for a while would help me build resistance...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1231|$Lady Astrid doesn't participate during
combat, does she?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1232|$Well, she is only supposed to inspect us.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1233|$All she's doing is following us around...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1234|$Rizette, there are many different roles within
the Knights.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$We need more than just warriors. People
like your brother are important, too.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1235|$I'm sorry...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1236|$(Still, whatever the purpose of this
inspection is...)
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Center@$$|act3.Voices/mst1237|$(Surely it isn't a permanent arrangement?)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1206|$Does that kind of thing actually work?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1207|$Perhaps if the situation is dire enough I can
awaken some kind of latent potential!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1208|$You shouldn't test a theory that risky
without some kind of proof!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1209|$Nagi, you must always ensure your training
meets basic safety standards.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1210|$You are right, Captain... I just didn't want
to be a burden to you all...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1211|$I admire your spirit. Let's devise a training
plan for building heat resistance in stages.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$|act3.Voices/mst1199|$Sir Finn... I know we have only been
acquainted a short while...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$|act3.Voices/mst1200|$But please... Do not forget me...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$|act3.Voices/mst1201|$N-Nagi!? Quick, somebody get some water!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$|act3.Voices/mst1202|$J-Just a moment!!

keys.DescriptionKey: The unusual curved blades used by bikki warriors hold a special place in their society. It it believed that each samurai's blade reflects their soul—so it's little wonder that Nagi's blade shines fierce, bright and true, and strikes down evil wherever it may hide.

NagiKatana01.name: Nagi Ichimonji
NagiKatana01.description: The unusual curved blades used by bikki warriors hold a special place in their society. It it believed that each samurai's blade reflects their soul—so it's little wonder that Nagi's blade shines fierce, bright and true, and strikes down evil wherever it may hide.

keys.IntroText:
Draw this blade only in service to beauty,
And you will ever strike true.

keys.value: $#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1114|$Sir Finn!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1122|$Now is the time to fight! With my blade, I
will make the future safe for all princesses!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1123|$It is to the Pandemonium Task Force that I
must swear my allegiance!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1124|$You're so cool...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1125|$Heh, has it taken you so long to notice?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1115|$I'm glad you're joining us, Nagi, but are you
sure you wanted to leave Kisenkyo?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1116|$Lord Omi really seemed to have taken a
shine to you.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1117|$Princess Saki, too. She seemed really
taken with you after she recovered.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1118|$Lord Omi is most gracious. And Princess
Saki is indeed princess of my heart.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1119|$But it is not yet time for me to accept their
kind welcome.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1120|$Nagi...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1121|$Unexpected as it may be, the Pandemonium
has returned.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$Demonic tyranny is spreading to all corners
of Westland.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$|act3.Voices/mst1126|$I shall fight! For the future of Erden, and...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$|act3.Voices/mst1127|$For each and every maiden in this land!

keys.DescriptionKey:
Having scored 32 victories in 32 battles, the first Empress of Lugrasse celebrated her success by commissioning a portrait.
In a word, she's a genius. Undefeated as a military officer, she continued her string of triumphs after ascending the throne—whatever she declared she'd do, she was sure to achieve. And the people of Lugrasse loved her for it.

keys.IntroText:
Nothing can stand in her way to supremacy,
for no possibility can escape her notice

keys.DescriptionKey:
The girl Napoleon had been before she became a soldier, and later a monarch, didn't seem all that different from who she is now—and yet, she was not the same at all.
In her own words, she can grasp a thousand facts with a single glance; and with each glance, her mind gets flooded with information. The difference is, in the past it was all she could do not to fall apart when faced with her own uncontrollable intellect and the countless phenomena the world had to offer.

In her own words, she can grasp a thousand facts with a single glance; and with each glance, her mind gets flooded with information. The difference is, in the past it was all she could do not to fall apart when faced with her own uncontrollable intellect and the countless phenomena the world had to offer.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Once the applause has died down and the audience has left the theater, the empress takes off her crown and lets her mask slip.
Before her rise to power, Napoleon lethargically drifted through life, all her attention focused on not letting herself be overwhelmed with the excess of information in her head. Until one day, she realized she was essentially just waiting for herself to finally snap, and decided she wasn't going to let that happen. And so, she found herself a role to play, one that could give her restless mind a different purpose—the virtuous ruler her fellow countrymen had sought.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Different factions of the Pike Paladins exist, and they often disagree about certain aspects of Vensha Dayne's lore. They meet regularly to debate and share ideas.

Some believe Vensha defeated an evil aquatic demon by having a yanti witch cast a spell on her so she could breathe underwater. Others believe this battle took place on land, and it was the demon who was able to breathe air by tricking a yanti witch into assisting her.

keys.value:
$#DONOTSHOWME(Valen)#$To all of my friends who are joining us—
A toast to this wonderful evening.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaskSurprised&$$@Right@$What?!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidConcerned&$$@Left@$To get this mansion?!

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaMaskHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yes! I laced my father's wine glass
with poison!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaskSurprised&$$@Center@$What?!

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaMaskSmile&$$@Center@$And I did the same for all of the Bergarian
nobles and soldiers, too.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaMaskHappy&$$@Center@$Losing this many soldiers will be a huge
blow to the invading army!
$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaMaskHappy&$$@Center@$Now we'll get the mansion, and decimate the enemy army! It's the perfect plan!

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaMaskExcited&$$@Center@$Our base is all but secured!
Isn't it great?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaskHorrified&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Wait... When you said you "thought up
another plan," this was what you meant?!

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaMaskHappy&$$@Left@$Yes, that's right. I'm so glad I could finally
be of use to the team!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidCalm&$$@Left@$Riz, how'd things go?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaskShouting&$$@Right@$You can't poison your own father!
We have to stop this.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidCommand&$$@Left@$Wait, Riz! If you cause a scene now, all the
suspicion will fall on you!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaskSerious&$$@Right@$Gloria, you have to stop the toast!
You're the only one who can!

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaMaskSurprised&$$@Left@$Why are you upset? My father is an enemy
to us knights, and you need this mansion.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaskSad&$$@Right@$Yes, but... But I can't accept this way of
doing things.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaskShouting&$$@Right@$If we win by acting like cowards, then I'd
regret it for the rest of my life.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidAngry&$$@Left@$You can't kill your own family... Didn't
you say you hated the corrupt nobles?

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaMaskSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I do. But I wouldn't be able to survive back
home without doing things like this.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaMaskSerious&$$@Center@$Those who forgo underhanded means, die
by underhanded means.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaMaskSerious&$$@Center@$That's the core principle of Bergaria.
We claim to be noble and proud...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaskSerious&$$@Right@$I'm fine, Theo. I got the information I
wanted. Let's get out of here.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaMaskSad&$$@Center@$But reality is far different.
And that's just how it is.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaskSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Gloria... The Blue Dragon Knights will
never use poison to weaken our enemies.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaMaskSad&$$@Left@$But... I...
I did all this for you!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidConcerned&$$@Left@$Gloria! What do we do? She ran out...
She's the only one who can stop the toast!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Valen)#$$!-1!$Does everyone have a glass in their hand?
Then, allow me to be the first to offer...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaskHorrified&$$@Center@$(There's no time... I can't give up! Think!
How can I stop this tragedy...?)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaskSerious&$$@Center@$I know! With the flame stone...!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaskShouting&$$@Center@$Oh, magic stone... release your power...
Reveal the hidden flames deep within...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Valen)#$$!-1!$Comrades, let us chee—
Huh? Aah! The curtains are on fire...!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaskSerious&$$@Center@$(It worked! The fire's spread to the ceiling.
Everyone's leaving the hall!)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaskThoughtful&$$@Right@$But first, we have to find Gloria.

$#RizNoMask(Rizette)#$$&NewRizDressShouting&$$@Center@$I am the Cerulean Crestbearer, Rizette! The
Blue Dragon Knights shall reclaim Rigland!

$#RizNoMask(Rizette)#$$&NewRizDressSerious&$$@Center@$Bergarian invaders, be warned! We will not
let you have our country!

$#RizNoMask(Rizette)#$$&NewRizDressShouting&$$@Center@$Continue your war, and I will strike you
down with the power that ended the Eternal!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Valen)#$$!-1!$Aaaaaagh! It's a rebel army! Protect meee!
Damn you servants, don't leave me behind!

$#RizNoMask(Rizette)#$$&NewRizDressSerious&$$@Right@$(Good! Now's our chance to escape. Ugh,
this skirt is in the way!)
$#RizNoMask(Rizette)#$$&NewRizDressShouting&$$@Right@$Theo, let's go!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidConcerned&$$@Left@$R-Right!

$#RizNoMask(Rizette)#$$&NewRizDressThoughtful&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Maybe I went a little too far...? We should
avoid this area for the time being...)

$#RizNoMask(Rizette)#$$&NewRizDressSad&$$@Center@$(We came all this way to find a safe hiding
place. How did it come to this?)
$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaMaskHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Rizette, I did it! I finally did it!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaskSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Gloria, listen. There's something important
I have to—

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaMaskHappy&$$@Left@$You need to hear this first, Rizette!
I finally did it!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaskSmile&$$@Right@$...Did what? Did you meet a fine gentleman?

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaMaskSmile&$$@Left@$My plan to get the mansion for you is in
its final stages!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSmile&$$@Center@$Your breakfast is ready, my Lady.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSad&$$@Center@$It didn't go well, then?

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSad&$$@Center@$He wouldn't even listen to me. He thinks I
just want to go home for ball season.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Center@$As far as he's concerned, I'm just throwing
a temper tantrum.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Center@$And it's not just my father. Not a soul
here listens to me at all.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Center@$The servants all walk on eggshells around
me, just because I'm the Lord's daughter.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSad&$$@Center@$At this rate, I won't be of any use to you...
I'm a disgrace to your cause.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidThoughtful&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I don't think that at all. You're not a
disgrace, I promise.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSurprised&$$@Left@$But I've thought up another plan!
So please don't kick me out!
$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaTired&$$@Left@$Please let me stay in the knights! Please...!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSmile&$$@Right@$We're allies, Gloria. Don't worry, okay?
Here, take a deep breath.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSerious&$$@Right@$Good morning, Gloria. About yesterday—
$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSad&$$@Left@$Thank you, Rizette...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidThoughtful&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(I can feel her shoulders shaking. She must
really have thought I was going to leave.)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSad&$$@Center@$(She must be terrified of going back to
that lonely, isolated life...)

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I'm sorry... I'm fine now. Oh, I think you
dropped something?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSmile&$$@Right@$It's the necklace you gave me. I had it in my
pocket. I guess I should wear it, huh?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$@Right@$Huh? This ruby... It feels warm.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaExcited&$$@Left@$The gem is actually a flame stone.
But it looks just like a ruby, doesn't it?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidThoughtful&$$@Right@$But aren't magic stones used to create
weapons?

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSmile&$$@Left@$Actually, less than half of the stones
we mine are useful for weapons.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSmile&$$@Left@$The rest of the stones are too weak, so they
normally get discarded.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaHappy&$$@Left@$Oh, Rizette! Perfect timing. I'm picking out
a gown for you for the masquerade.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaExcited&$$@Left@$Bergaria's rich in magic stones, though.
I get my pick of the discarded ones.
$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaHappy&$$@Left@$See? This stone radiates fire magic.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaHappy&$$@Left@$It can be dangerous, but it's also great for
wearing a light dress when it's cold out.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSurprised&$$@Left@$Oh, wait here a second. Let me show you
my collection! Let's see...

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaExcited&$$@Left@$This is an ice stone. Wearing this, you'll
stay cool even on the hottest days.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaHappy&$$@Left@$Light stones can be used for reading before
bed. This one here is my masterpiece.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$@Right@$Wait! Did you make all of these accessories,
Gloria?!

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSmile&$$@Left@$That's right. I'm not allowed to do anything
fun, so I taught myself how to make these.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$@Right@$(This is self-taught?! These look like pieces
I'd see in a shop!)

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSmile&$$@Left@$Look at this! It's a hair clip imbued with
a wind stone. It can create slight breezes.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$@Right@$A gown for tonight? That can wait.
About our—

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaHappy&$$@Left@$Doesn't long hair look wonderful in the
wind? I plan on wearing this for the ball.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSmile&$$@Right@$You could sell these! I'd definitely buy one
if you did!
$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSurprised&$$@Left@$You would? Gosh, you're making me blush.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidThoughtful&$$@Right@$If this was all self-taught, imagine what you
could do with actual training!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Head Maid)#$$!-1!$Lady Gloria...
$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSurprised&$$@Center@$What is it?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Head Maid)#$$!-1!$I understand that you are preparing for the
masquerade, but may I borrow Rizette?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSerious&$$@Right@$Can I go, Gloria?

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaHappy&$$@Left@$Sure, go ahead. I'll see you at the party
tonight, okay?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(There goes our hope of getting a base, but
Gloria said she still had other plans...)

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSmile&$$@Left@$And there's your hair, too. What would
best suit your golden locks? Hmmm...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidThoughtful&$$@Center@$(Hmm, I shouldn't hold my breath. I'm just
glad she's feeling better now.)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSerious&$$@Right@$Have you and Lord Valen—

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSurprised&$$@Left@$Your first dance should be with an older
gentleman, I think. But whom...?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidShouting&$$@Right@$Gloria!
How did the talk go with Lord Valen?

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...About that. I wasn't sure how to break
the news to you...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSerious&$$@Center@$The masquerade is the perfect chance for
me to gather more information.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidSad&$$@Left@$Please don't look at me like that... I'm not
wearing this because I want to...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSmile&$$@Right@$Y-You look lovely!! You look so cute in a
maid outfit! Awwww!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidHurt&$$@Left@$This is why I didn't want you to see me like
this! I'm so embarrassed, I could die!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSmile&$$@Right@$You're sooo adorable! This is so great!
I can't handle this... I'm about to implode!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidAngry&$$@Left@$I'm going to get mad if you don't stop, Riz.
Anyway, I couldn't find any new info...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidBlush&$$@Right@$An angry maid Theo is just as good...!
Ah, sorry. Here's what I've got...——

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidCalm&$$@Left@$Hmmm... So you got invited to the
masquerade tomorrow night.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidConcerned&$$@Left@$I'm a little worried. I hear that Bergarians
can be really unpredictable.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSerious&$$@Right@$But if we return to our village now, we
might never get a chance like this again.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSad&$$@Right@$The longer we wait, the more people will
grow used to Bergarian rule...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSerious&$$@Center@$Only soldiers would come so far to the
forefront of the war.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidSad&$$@Left@$...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSerious&$$@Right@$So, I want to ask you to leave this to me.
I'd like you to wait for me nearby.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidSleep&$$@Left@$...Fine. If you're sure that's what you want.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidThoughtful&$$@Right@$Sorry. I can't sit around anymore. I have to
do something to advance the rebellion.
$#Rizette;Theo;(Rizette & Theo)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised;Theo.TheoMaidConcerned&$$@Right;;;Theo.Left;@$!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidShouting&$$@Right@$Who's there?!
$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Umm... Rizette... I...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Gloria...!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidDespair&$$@Left@$Gloria?! That's Count Valen's daughter?!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidHorrified&$$@Right@$Er... When I said "rebellion", I didn't mean
it. I was just, you know, complaining...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSad&$$@Center@$We're going to need all the intel we can
get. But I'm unfamiliar with dances...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidHappy&$$@Left@$Right, we've lost our country, so we just
need to let off a bit of steam... Ha ha...
$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaConfused&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Rizette... I... I...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidHorrified&$$@Center@$?
$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaExcited&$$@Center@$I want to be a part of this!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$What?!

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You two are amazing! I can't believe you're
planning a rebellion against Bergaria!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidDespair&$$@Right@$Shhh! Don't be so loud!

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaExcited&$$@Left@$And Rizette, you're so good at gathering
intel! You found out so much about us!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$@Right@$It was just information I heard from you,
though...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidAngry&$$@Left@$Listen, Gloria. This isn't a game.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidBlush&$$@Center@$It'll be dangerous if I cause a scene. I don't
want any unnecessary attention.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSerious&$$@Right@$We're fighting against your people,
you know?

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I've resented "my people" ever since we
declared war on Hymelia.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSad&$$@Center@$We don't have time to worry about other
countries, not will all this trouble between
$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSad&$$@Center@$the Emperor and the Senate.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Center@$But the nobles only care about their own
power. Let me join you and end this war!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidConcerned&$$!-1!$$@Left@$(What should we do, Riz?)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSad&$$@Right@$(If we deny her, she might expose us to her
father. It's safer to let her join us.)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSmile&$$@Right@$Okay, Gloria. Let me welcome you as the
third member of our Blue Dragon Knights.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaHappy&$$@Left@$Thank you, Rizette! I'll do my best. And
thank you to your younger sister as well!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidSad&$$@Right@$...I'm a boy.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSad&$$@Center@$There's bound to be someone who'll
recognize me as the Cerulean Crestbearer.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSmile&$$@Left@$Now, please give me my first mission!
I swear I'll be useful!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidThoughtful&$$@Right@$Er... I'm not really sure what to ask from
you.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidHappy&$$@Left@$Oh, I know! Maybe we can make a base of
operations in the mansion?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSad&$$@Right@$But this mansion is under Bergarian
control.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidHeh&$$@Left@$That's the point!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidHeh&$$@Left@$No one would ever think that rebels would
be hiding in a Bergarian mansion.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Left@$Very well. If my father's gone, then the
mansion passes to me, to do with as I like.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$@Right@$Gone...? What are you planning?

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSmile&$$@Left@$I'll just suggest he return home. I hear
the mines here are poor, anyway.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSmile&$$@Left@$He's been considering going back to
Bergaria since we got here.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSerious&$$@Center@$But I can't let this chance go to waste. I'll
have Theo wait for me in a nearby town.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidThoughtful&$$@Right@$(Hmm... Will it really work that easily?
I guess it's worth a shot.)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSerious&$$@Right@$Okay, I'll leave that to you. But please don't
tell your father about us.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaHappy&$$@Left@$Just leave it to me! Oh, this is so terribly
exciting.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidHorrified&$$@Right@$(What have I gotten us into...)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSmile&$$@Center@$Here's the stables. Ah, there he is!
Huh? Theo?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMaidDespair&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh... Riz.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$@Right@$Theo, your clothes... Why're you...?

keys.value: $#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSleep&$$@Center@$Magic stone, release your power...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$If she never got involved with us, she would
never have done something so cruel.
$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaHappy&$$@Left@$See you in two weeks! I can't wait!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSerious&$$@Right@$Alright, Theo. Let's keep doing our best too.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Left@$Yeah. It's been a while since I've felt
so motivated.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteThoughtful&$$@Right@$This is probably our first accomplishment
since we created the new Knights.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Left@$Let's keep at it!
Then, finally...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSmile&$$@Right@$We'll be with everyone again. It's been a
while since we were all scattered, but...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Rizette)#$Wait for us, everyone. This time, I'll be the
one to save all of you!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteThoughtful&$$@Center@$Her methods were wrong, but she was only
doing it for us.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSad&$$@Center@$And I just left her there...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Center@$Riz...
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Ri...zette... The...o...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSurprised&$$@Right@$Huh? Was someone calling our name just now?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Left@$Outside!

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaTired&$$@Center@$...There you are... I finally...
Found you...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What happened?! You're all in tatters!

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaTired&$$@Left@$I was walking...through the mountains...
For several days...without sleep...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Center@$The flame stone from that necklace sure
is handy.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Left@$Ugh, I hate this... I'm all sweaty... And my
clothes are ripped... How unsightly...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$N-now's not the time for that! Hurry,
come on inside!

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaHappy&$$@Center@$Phew. I feel human again! Theo, your
cooking is fabulous.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSmile&$$@Center@$Rizette, Theo... Thank you for bringing me
into your home.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$There's no way we could just leave you
out there, battered like that.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSmile&$$@Right@$I'm just glad you weren't injured.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Left@$By the way... How did you know where to
find our house?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSurprised&$$@Right@$Right...! Does the Bergarian army know
where we are?!

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Haha, no, don't worry. I can sense the
location of the stones in the jewelry I made.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaExcited&$$@Center@$When I met you two in the stables, I was
following my necklace.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Center@$I put it on a stick to make a firestarter.
Great idea, huh?

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSmile&$$@Center@$Each stone emits its own unique power. I've
been sensitive to them since I was a child.
$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSmile&$$@Center@$Don't worry, I promise I came alone.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I see... But to be able to locate magic stones
is an amazing power!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSmile&$$@Right@$You called yourself useless, but you've got
so many wonderful talents, Gloria.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaHappy&$$@Left@$Aww, thanks. It's an honor to be praised by
the Cerulean Crestbearer.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSurprised&$$@Right@$Oh, right... I revealed my real identity at
the ball.
$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Left@$I came here today to explain myself.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Left@$I want to explain why I tried to do
something so terrible.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSad&$$@Right@$You didn't have much of a choice. Bergaria
sounds like a very cruel place.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSad&$$@Left@$It is. It's worse than you could even
imagine.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$After all this trouble, all we managed to get
was a single firestarter...

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Left@$Poison and assassination are commonplace
for Bergarians to advance themselves.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Left@$My father has been targeted countless
times, and so have I.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$Huh? You too...?

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSad&$$@Left@$People I thought were friends have tried
to take my head.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSad&$$@Right@$...

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Left@$That's just how it is. My father's well known
even in the Empire for his cruel practices.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Left@$Another bidder on that mansion was found
assassinated, for instance...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$Unbelievable...

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaTired&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It would be impossible to advance in society
if he wasn't so cruel, though.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Center@$You have to view others as tools, and use
them to climb your way up.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteThoughtful&$$@Right@$We worked so hard, but now we're in an
even more dangerous situation.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSad&$$@Center@$He only saw me as a tool for a political
marriage. I hated that idea so, so much.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Center@$To me, murdering my father was the perfect
solution to all of my problems.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSad&$$@Center@$I wanted to escape from it all. I was so
desperate... I finally had a chance, and...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I see now... I'm sorry for turning my back
on you without hearing the whole story.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$I'm sorry too. I can't accept your methods,
but I understand you have your reasons.
