$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidBlush&$$@Center@$I'm your servant, Lady Gloria! It's my job to
serve you... This isn't right.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSad&$$@Center@$All of my previous maids were too scared of
Father to speak properly to me.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSad&$$@Center@$I had friends in Bergaria, but since coming
to Rigland, I've had no one to speak to.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSad&$$@Right@$Yes, my Lady. I'm quite nervous...

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSmile&$$@Center@$It's ballroom season in Bergaria right now,
did you know?

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Center@$And here I am, alone in the mountains.
I'm so jealous of my friends back home.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSad&$$@Center@$I know you must hold a grudge against us.
But I feel like you might understand me...

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSad&$$@Center@$I could tell you were different from the
others the first time I saw you.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSad&$$@Center@$So, won't you be my friend? Something tells
me that you and I could get along.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSad&$$@Center@$(This poor girl. Doesn't Valen realize what
he's done to his own daughter?)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSerious&$$@Center@$(If I can gain Gloria's trust, then I might be
able to gain some valuable information.)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$If that's your wish, then I'll gladly be
your friend.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaHappy&$$@Left@$Thank you! Alright, I'm going to work
hard to make you look stunning today!

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSmile&$$@Left@$Oh, but listen to me chatter. Was there
anything you wanted to know about?

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSad&$$@Left@$Are you from a nearby village? I heard my
father seized women to be our maids.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$@Right@$Well, Lady Gloria...

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSmile&$$@Left@$We're friends now, aren't we? Call me
Gloria when we're alone.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSmile&$$@Right@$My apologies, Gloria. I was wondering
what your homeland was like, that's all.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Left@$Hmm. I'm not that fond of my country. It's
a very cold place.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$@Right@$Cold? So it snows there?

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSad&$$@Left@$No, that's not it. Bergarians will do
anything to take what they want.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Left@$That's the type of cold, uncaring people
we are.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Left@$Maybe that's why our technology is so
advanced. We're always hungry for more.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Left@$And the one driving all these inventions
is our current Emperor.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSurprised&$$@Left@$You've seen the flying soldiers, right? I
never dreamed of flying people before!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$@Right@$Err... I'm...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidThoughtful&$$@Right@$...True, I was stunned the first time too.
Was that technology invented in Bergaria?

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Left@$I don't know. Our Emperor pushes for new
technology, but it's all very secretive.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSmile&$$@Left@$But we all have high hopes. Everyone's
excited to see what he does next.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSerious&$$@Right@$It sounds like the Empire loves him.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Left@$Yes... But not the Senate. It's common
knowledge that they're at odds.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Left@$All the citizens know the corrupt Senate
acts without permission.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Left@$They're always getting in the Emperor's way.
I expect he'll suspend them pretty soon.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaHappy&$$@Left@$Alright, now you're perfect. Open your eyes!
You look beautiful!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Huh...? No way...! I look so different...)

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I did rather well, if I do say so myself. But
simply doing your makeup isn't enough.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Left@$But you seem different from the others.
Your expressions... No, your bearing?

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSmile&$$@Left@$Here, try this ruby necklace on. It suits you
perfectly!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidBlush&$$@Right@$(What a beautiful stone. Can I really wear
something this valuable?)

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaExcited&$$@Left@$I know!! You should wear that necklace and
come to the masquerade with me.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$@Right@$The masquerade?! That's so sudden...
When is it happening?

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSmile&$$@Left@$Tomorrow night. My father invited all the
Bergarians that have moved here.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSerious&$$@Right@$(A gathering of Bergarians, huh... I might be
able to get some new information.)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSmile&$$@Right@$Yes, please let me accompany you.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaHappy&$$@Left@$Thank you! Oh, you can have that necklace.
As a sign of our friendship!

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Left@$I can tell that you've been through things
normal people couldn't bear. Right?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidHorrified&$$@Right@$(She's perceptive. I'm going to have to be
careful with her...)

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaExcited&$$@Left@$Oh! Perhaps you're a daughter of a
fallen noble?! Is that it?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Center@$Phew... We finally made it. We've been
walking for days.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$...Should we go back?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSerious&$$@Right@$I'm curious, though. Why would Bergaria
send soldiers all the way here?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSerious&$$@Right@$There's no reason to set up a base here.
Something's up.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Left@$True... It's a bit risky, but this might be
worth investigating.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSerious&$$@Right@$If we're going to sneak in, now's our
chance. The whole mansion's in chaos.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$Yeah, even the servants are running in
and out.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteThoughtful&$$@Right@$There are probably some villagers from
nearby, too.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Left@$We should blend right in.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSurprised&$$@Center@$!
Theo, get down.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Center@$Huh? What's wrong?!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Center@$At least the Bergarians will have trouble
with the terrain here, too.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSerious&$$@Center@$It's a big carriage. There's a lot of people
following behind it, too.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSerious&$$@Right@$Let's try to blend into the back of the line.
I'll disguise myself as a maid.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHeh&$$@Left@$Okay. I'll pretend to be a stable boy.

$#FemaleBergarian(Bergarian Soldier)#$$&FemaleBergarianShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Take the luggage off the carriage!
Hurry it up!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSmile&$$@Center@$(There's a pile of maid uniforms in here...
Well, I'll just help myself, then.)

$#RizMaid(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSerious&$$@Center@$(The size is perfect. Alright, now I'll be able
to get myself into the mansion!)

$#FemaleBergarian(Bergarian Soldier)#$$&FemaleBergarianShouting&$$@Center@$Hey, maid! Quit messing around! Get
busy carrying!

$#RizMaid(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$Y-Yes, sir!
Right away, sir!

$#RizMaid(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidThoughtful&$$@Center@$(These gowns are beautiful! And there are
so many... Who do they belong to?)

$#RizMaid(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSerious&$$@Center@$(I'll have to get close to someone important
to get any useful information...)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Rizette)#$Is that it? The mansion of the wealthiest
family in the north?

$#RizMaid(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSmile&$$@Center@$(Okay. I'll carry the most expensive-looking
dress, then!)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidThoughtful&$$@Center@$(I just followed the other servants with
dresses. Can I just leave this here?)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Maid)#$$!-1!$You there.
Yes, I'm speaking to you!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$U-Um... Me?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Maid)#$$!-1!$Yes, you. That dress doesn't go there.
Bring it into the back room.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidBlush&$$@Center@$Oh! Yes, ma'am! Er... Which room is that?
There are so many...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Maid)#$$!-1!$My goodness... Follow me, I'll show you.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSmile&$$@Center@$Thank you!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Maid)#$I don't think I've seen you before.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidBlush&$$@Center@$U-Uh... I was just brought in today with the
carriage. That's why I'm confused.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Left@$Yeah. Apparently the mines in the area
produce a lot of magic stones.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Maid)#$$!-1!$From the plains, then? The trip must have
been tough. Here, let me show you around.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Maid)#$Lord Valen is moving here from Bergaria.
That dress belongs to his daughter, Gloria.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$He's moving from the Bergarian Empire...?
Why would he move to such a remote place?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidThoughtful&$$@Center@$There are many much nicer mansions in
Rigland proper.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Maid)#$$!-1!$It's not for me to know, of course. But I did
hear the Lord's maid say something.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidThoughtful&$$@Center@$What did she say?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Maid)#$$!-1!$That the ore in these mines
can be used to forge magical weapons.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$(Magical weapons...?!)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSerious&$$@Center@$So the weapons the Bergarians use
draw power from magical stones?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Maid)#$$!-1!$That's what I heard. Weapons made with
magical ore are selling very well.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSerious&$$@Right@$I see. You can't take mines with you, so
they'd have no choice but to bunker down.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Maid)#$Lord Valen is a weapons merchant, you see.
But he hasn't been doing well lately.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidThoughtful&$$@Center@$What do you mean?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Maid)#$$!-1!$Lord Valen says the ores here are weaker
than he expected, according to his maid.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Maid)#$He's been in such a temper lately. The poor
woman has been having a terrible time of it.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$(The Empire has already started stealing
resources from Rigland...!)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSad&$$@Center@$(I can't let this go on. I need to do
something... But what?)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Maid)#$Here, this is the place. You said you're a
Riglander, right? I'm sorry for all this.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidThoughtful&$$@Center@$Oh, it's okay... Thank you for your help.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSerious&$$@Center@$(The situation just keeps getting worse...
I can't give up yet, though!)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidThoughtful&$$@Center@$Um, where should I put this gown...?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHeh&$$@Left@$Exactly. Now, let's go and introduce
ourselves.

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$My, there certainly are a lot of you!
Which of you will be my handmaid?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Slim Maid)#$Lady Gloria?! We are still in the middle of
cleaning. Please, wait in another room.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSerious&$$@Center@$I've waited quite long enough! If you won't
assign me a maid, I'll do it myself.

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaExcited&$$@Center@$I want someone with good taste. Whoever
has my favorite gown will be my handmaid!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$(She's looking at me...!
Is this her favorite gown?)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidHorrified&$$@Center@$(Wait! I wanted to eavesdrop on her, not
serve as her personal maid!)

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$This one! This is my favorite gown! Good.
You'll be my handmaid, and that's final!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSad&$$@Right@$(Sigh... This is the worst.)

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaSmile&$$@Left@$Let's get to know each other, hm? Everyone,
you can put my dresses away tomorrow.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Head Maid)#$$!-1!$Yes, my Lady.
We will leave you to your business.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizetteSurprised&$$@Right@$Wait, Theo! Something's not right.
That's a lot of soldiers...

$#Gloria(Gloria)#$$&GloriaHappy&$$@Center@$Heehee. We'll be spending every day
together from now on.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&NewRizMaidSurprised&$$@Center@$(Every day...?! How am I ever going to
get out of this?!)
$#FemaleBergarian;(Theo)#$$&FemaleBergarianSerious&$$@Center@$Are those... Bergarian soldiers?!

$#FemaleBergarian;(Rizette)#$$&FemaleBergarianSerious&$$@Center@$No way...! They've already advanced this
far into the mountains?

"Bitten Blade" was listed as an item that could be used to increase drops when completing a stage in the "Dragon Lord's Mountain" event. This weapon was not increasing drops until Tuesday, April 7, 2020, at 7:14 AM UTC. All accounts created before this time will receive 100 Soul Stones as compensation.

Thank you for playing Evertale.

Thank you for playing Evertale. From around 15:20 UTC to around 16:00 UTC on December 31st we received reports of server connectivity issues. The identified issues and our response are as follows:

Soul Stones and other items not received following an in app purchase: The missing items as well as missions and bonuses that should have come long with those purchase have been delivered to the accounts that were effected.

Soul Summons failing due to network issues: Soul Stones will not have been spent where a Soul Summon failed due to network issues. While this is correct behavior, a bug caused an incorrect logs to be reported. This then caused chat messages and summon history to display incorrectly.

We sincerely apologize for these issues and will be distributing 3000 Soul Stones as compensation to all accounts that had existed prior to 16:00 UTC on December 31st.
Please expand this news for more information.

keys.DescriptionKey:
As the avatar of Chronos, Rolotia dutifully watches over the year as it passes away. She feels the weariness of the land, strewn with bare forests and blanketed under snow. She sleeps by the side of hibernating animals, holed up in their dens. She knows, as the world does, that the end will soon arrive.

Quiet as a whisper, the world will begin anew. She will see this year from its winter birth to the heights of its summer, and though it too will die someday, she greets its first day with a smile.

As immaculate as untouched snow."

keys.DescriptionKey:
Many people start the new year with self-reflection. With resolute hearts, they set out to be new people, free of the vices that have held them back. Rolotia observes these resolutions with glee, even knowing most of them will be broken. The first days of a year have a purity to them, a power that makes any dream appear within reach. If a single person sees their promises through, none of their failed resolutions were wasted.

She's no stranger to wanting a second chance.

"May the year be kind to you, dear friend."

keys.value: $#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act5.Voices/mst2868|$Halt! Time for a short break.

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2877|$But Lady Astrid has attested to its
credibility.
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2878|$She did, did she?
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2879|$...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2880|$I am initiating the Nidhogg Protocol,
effective immediately.
$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2881|$S-Sir, isn't that restricted to wartime?

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2882|$The Commander has the same authority
during the Pandemonium.

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2883|$Understood... We shall commence the
Nidhogg Protocol.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2884|$Arrest Ludmilla's messenger. Send the
envoy to Elvenlent, as she requested.
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2885|$But send the Serpents, too.

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2886|$Y-Yes sir!! I will assemble a unit

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2869|$I wonder if our letter reached Gramps yet.
It has, right? Probably!?

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2887|$I will carry out orders from the Pillar Room.
Be swift.
$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2888|$Yes sir!
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2889|$...
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2890|$You understand nothing, Astrid.
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2891|$The Pandemonium...
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSmile&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2892|$is the natural order of things.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2870|$I don't think even a quick horse would make
it to Urg Roa until tomorrow.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSmile&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2871|$The messenger to Rigland should be there

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2872|$Everything is coming together!
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2873|$...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&LutherSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2874|$A way to permanently end to the
Pandemonium?

keys.DescriptionKey:
Nike's talent stood out even among the temple elite. At the mere age of seventeen, her pure magical power already rivaled that of the priests. Everyone believed she was destined to become an amazing Priestess of Time.
However, that very talent, coupled with her seeming aloofness, made her the target of envy. One would often find her alone on temple grounds.

keys.IntroText:
I have journeyed through the millennia
just in search of freedom.

keys.DescriptionKey: It was during such a time that she met Rolotia. In this caged world, the way Rolotia spoke of freedom became the embodiment of hope for Nike. Yet, the hope she embraced on that day deepened the unfathomable despair she felt when Rolotia vanished.

NikeRegular02.name: Nike
NikeRegular02.title: Goddess of Victory
NikeRegular02.description: It was during such a time that she met Rolotia. In this caged world, the way Rolotia spoke of freedom became the embodiment of hope for Nike. Yet, the hope she embraced on that day deepened the unfathomable despair she felt when Rolotia vanished.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Through the rift of time, Nike wandered. Millennia, millions of years, an eon passed, and there she was, alone. At long last, she found Rolotia. But this was not the Rolotia that imparted her hope all those years ago.
If that's the case, I will bring back the true Rolotia, free and unbound.

keys.value: $#FrontlineSamurai(Frontline Samurai)#$Three cheers for our resounding victory!

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaHappy&$$@Center@$And ensure that you do not neglect your
fallen comrades' fill!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHappy&$$@Left@$Honnojiiiiii!
Your singing was sooooo cute!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Right@$It was so invigorating! I had no idea there
were such songs anywhere in the world!
$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaNormal&$$@Left@$Hm, not bad at all.

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiCrying&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh. Em. Geeeee!? Even my subscribers
don't ever pile on this much praise!

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiGeekSmile&$$@Center@$Ehehehe! Let's get straight into song
number two!
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiGeekSmile&$$@Center@$This next one's called...
$#HonnojiPeace(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiLaugh&$$@Center@$"Honnoji's On Fire!"

$#HonnojiPeace(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiLaugh&$$@Center@$Snap, crackle, pop!♪
Blazing up, burning out!♪
$#HonnojiPeace(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiLaugh&$$@Center@$Even as ashes, Honnoji burns bright!♪
$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaSerious&$$@Center@$...No, I will kill her after all.
$#Samurai(Samurai)#$Yes sir!!!

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiPanic&$$@Center@$Aaaaaaaah!
You cut me! Like, for real, with a sword!
$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiPanic&$$@Center@$There's even blood! Bloooooood!
$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&HonnojiPanic&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Haha! I was joking.
$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaSerious&$$@Right@$Well. Half joking.

$#Honnoji(Honnoji)#$$&HonnojiShocked&$$@Left@$That means the other half is dead set on
murder!!!

$#()#$The banquet only continued to get livelier,
the long night passing quickly by.
$#()#$—Several hours later, in a certain graveyard.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Lord Nobunaga.
Whose grave is this?

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaColdEyes&$$@Right@$Ah, Finn... You're an odd one as well, I see.
Following me out here.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$Well, I saw you leave on your own, and I
got a little worried.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Still, Hoshikuma-Douji...
She really was something.
$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Hmph. Oh, to be so idle...
$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaClosedEyes&$$@Right@$...

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaColdEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...Well, about this grave.
A fool of a man rests here.

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaColdEyes&$$@Center@$He was an eminently competent samurai.
More reliable than any before or after him.

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaColdEyes&$$@Center@$When this area was in complete disarray,
he built this castle and the port town.

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaColdEyes&$$@Center@$The "peace" that you are so fond of
existed here, in some minor form.

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaSerious&$$@Center@$However, he was betrayed by a commoner,
and oni were invited into the town.

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaSerious&$$@Center@$In his attempts to protect the townsfolk,
he was killed.

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaSerious&$$@Center@$Crushed like an ant under a boot.
A most ignoble end.

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaSerious&$$@Center@$He was...
My father.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaBitterSmile&$$@Left@$No kidding!
I wasn't anywhere near her level.

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaSerious&$$@Center@$In the end, kindness is a hindrance.
And death exposes it for what it really is.
$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaSerious&$$@Center@$Foolishness and weakness.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Foolishness...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I can't say I agree with that.
$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaAngry&$$@Right@$Care to elaborate?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Trusting people in order to protect them...
makes your father an exceptional person.

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaAngry&$$@Right@$Even though all that resulted in was a
cruel demise?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$My dad, he...
He gave up his life to protect the world, too.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Along with any chance for peace in the
afterlife.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Center@$And for that, he has my respect.
I want to be just like him.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaBitterSmile&$$@Left@$There's always someone better, huh...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Center@$I'm guessing that since you took
your father's place as the ruler here,
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Center@$deep down, you don't hate him, either.
$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaBlush&$$@Center@$...

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...You simpleton. You could not be any
further from the truth.
$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaClosedEyes&$$@Right@$I am going back.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$(There's a bottle of alcohol by the grave...
Lord Nobunaga's offering, maybe?)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$(She slipped out of a feast to pay her respects.
She must really feel conflicted about him...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$People harbor a complex mix of hopes and
feelings, in this country and in any other.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$That's always something to keep in mind.
Isn't that right, Dad?
$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSad&$$@Center@$Haaaah...

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Right@$She should be considered a one-in-a-million
case.

$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSad&$$@Center@$Oh, I was so rude to Sage Rei.
Running off like that was inexcusable.

$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuBlush&$$@Center@$(...Though, highly necessary.
I could not, under any circumstances,
$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuBlush&$$@Center@$allow her to see that book.)

$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuBlush&$$@Center@$(Still, what an absolute disgrace I was!
Ah, just the thought makes my face scorch!)
$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSeriousOpenBlush&$$@Center@$I still have so much to learn...

$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSeriousOpenBlush&$$@Center@$Once I return, I should thoroughly reflect
on my behavior and train even harder...

$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSerious&$$@Center@$Well, after the matter with this head
is resolved.
$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSurprised&$$@Center@$...!
$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSurprised&$$@Center@$It's...gone?

$#HoshigumaDouji(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaHurt&$$@Center@$Yeeesh, that huuuuuurt!
No, seriously! That was the worst!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Right@$Not being able to match her strength
is nothing to feel bad about.

$#HoshigumaDouji(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaSerious&$$@Center@$Getting your head cut off... I know I'm
immortal, but it still hurts like crazy!

$#HoshigumaDouji(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaSerious&$$@Center@$Ugh, and I can still see that Nobunaga's
face...
$#HoshigumaDouji(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaSerious&$$@Center@$I can't wait to smash it to a pulp!
$#HoshigumaDouji(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaNormal&$$@Center@$...Well, no time like the present.
$#HoshigumaDouji()#$$&HoshigumaNormal&$$@Center@$Boom...boom...

$#HoshigumaDouji(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$You have heard of me many times, see me
 now with your own eyes!
$#HoshigumaDouji()#$$&HoshigumaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Boom...boom...boom...
$#HoshigumaDouji()#$$&HoshigumaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Boom...boom...boom...boom...!

$#HoshigumaDouji(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaSmile&$$@Center@$Night after night filled with drumbeat,
and the full moon lighting up the sky—
$#HoshigumaDouji(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaSmile&$$@Center@$The stage is set!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Left@$We were truly blessed to have had Lord
Nobunaga's astonishing power,

$#HoshigumaDouji(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaExcited&$$@Center@$Tonight, we hold a bloody festival! With the
entertainment provided by yours truly!
$#HoshigumaDouji(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaExcited&$$@Center@$Time to start the dance!

$#HoshigumaDouji(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaExcited&$$@Center@$Behold, Hoshikuma-Douji's ultimate
technique...
$#HoshigumaDouji(Hoshikuma-Douji)#$$&HoshigumaCrazy&$$@Center@$Frenzied Lunar Step!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Left@$as well as Great Sage Rei and Lady Haku's
superb onmyoji skills on our side.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$Speaking of, has anyone seen Lady Haku?
$#Samurai(Samurai)#$Hurray! Hurray! Hurray!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiBlush&$$@Right@$With the battle won, she has gone home.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$She left so soon!?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Right@$She said she would visit again, so we
should see her eventually.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Sure, but what was she so flustered about
when she left?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSurprised&$$@Right@$I wonder...
$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSmile&$$@Right@$Well, I shall be taking my leave.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Even though Lord Nobunaga's throwing
a big party to celebrate our victory?

$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSad&$$@Right@$I would be ill at ease in a situation such as
that. Besides, Hoshikuma-Douji's head

$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSad&$$@Right@$should be delivered to the Bureau of Onmyo
as swiftly as possible.

$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSeriousOpenBlush&$$@Right@$Sage Rei, being able to see your onmyo
magic with my own eyes was an honor.

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaSerious&$$@Center@$Just how many times are you going to
cheer? I tire of all this shouting.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Left@$I couldn't have done it without your help.
And your work was every bit as splendid.

$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuBlush&$$@Right@$H-Hardly...!
I still have so much to learn!

$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Well then, until we meet again.
Please give everyone my regards.
$#()#$Thump!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Hm? Did something just fall out of Haku's
bag?)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Sorry, I think you dropped this book.
$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh... Oh!
$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSurprised&$$@Center@$Um! Er... This old thing?

$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSad&$$@Center@$You didn't...happen to see the cover...did
you?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Uh, no.
I didn't see a thing.

$#SamuraiGuard(Samurai Guard)#$But, Lord Nobunaga!
Hoshikuma-Douji is no more!

$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSeriousOpenBlush&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I-I see...!
Uh, I really must be on my way, so—
$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuSurprised&$O-Ouch!
$#Haku(Haku)#$$&HakuBlush&$I-I-If you'll excuse me!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...She sure was wound up, huh?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSurprised&$$@Right@$Over that book she dropped...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$I wonder what was in that book...
Secret onmyodo techniques, maybe?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiBlush&$$@Right@$Hmm, I do not think so.
It looked more like some light reading.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$I guess so... It did look more like a novel
than a textbook...

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Oh, Urushido? She might look strait-laced,
but I hear she reads spicy books on the sly.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiBlush&$$@Left@$"Spicy" books...?
What do you mean?
$#SamuraiGuard(Samurai Guard)#$One of Shuten-Douji's daughters, defeated!

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaSmile&$$@Right@$Oh, you might also enjoy them.
You see, they depict lovers in the throes of—
$#SamuraiGuard(Samurai Guard)#$Lord Nobunaga, may I have a moment?

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaSurprised&$$@Right@$...You have the worst timing.
Well? What is it?
$#SamuraiGuard(Samurai Guard)#$$!-1!$We received a report from our spies.

$#SamuraiGuard(Samurai Guard)#$"Oni assault planned, strategic points
in the west."

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaSerious&$$@Center@$The west...? There has never been much
activity there, but...

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaColdEyes&$$@Center@$Very well. Send soldiers in that direction,
to shore up our defenses.
$#SamuraiGuard(Samurai Guard)#$As you command, sir.

$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaSerious&$$@Center@$(Movement in the west, hm? There has not
been any previous indication of that...)
$#Nobunaga(Nobunaga)#$$&NobunagaSerious&$$@Center@$(Hm...)

$#Samurai(Samurai)#$At this rate, we will soon be rid of all the
oni!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$As I was saying, a princeshh needs not—!
Sir Finn? Are you lishhening to meee?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$U-Uh, Nagi?
You're, um, slurring your words a bit.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaConsidering&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So, we're on this trip because of the "divine
message" from the water dragon, right?

$#StrollingGirl(Strolling Girl)#$$&HoshigumaClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I do. "Truly."
Teehee, you're such a silly guy!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$(My luck is beyond belief! Oh, but I must
escort Sage Rei back to the inn...)
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Time to head back.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Left@$Oh... Forgive me!
While it pains me to part with you here...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Left@$I must say farewell for now!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You're coming too!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Center@$What?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$@Right@$Do as I say!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$Wait, Sage Rei!
You need not pull so hard—
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$%1%$Ah, my blossom!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Right@$Yes. The message said that the "Land of
Peace," my mother's homeland, is in

$#StrollingGirl(Strolling Girl)#$$&HoshigumaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What was all that about?
Talk about a buzzkill.
$#StrollingGirl(Strolling Girl)#$$&HoshigumaSerious&$$@Center@$I'm not even in the mood for a chase now.

$#StrollingGirl(Strolling Girl)#$$&HoshigumaExcited&$$@Center@$Whatever, the night's still young. Moving
on...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Sage Rei!?
Have you, perchance, fallen for me...!?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$You have, have you not?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$@Right@$No.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$@Right@$I sensed danger in that girl. She reeked of
blood and had a foul aura.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$(Sage Rei's instincts must have been reacting
rather strongly for her to behave so...)
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$(Just who was that damsel...?)

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$@Right@$For now, we should head back to the inn.
I have a bad feeling.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Right@$need of rescue.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$I concur, let us return to the inn—
$#()#$AAAAHHHHHH!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$A maiden's cry...?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...!

$#StrayOni(???)#$$&OniMaleSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Human female meat...
Mmm, looks delicious...

$#Girl(Girl)#$$&VillageGirlAMobGrit&$$@Left@$No...
Someone...help...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Haaaah!

$#StrayOni(???)#$$&OniMaleShouting&$$@Center@$Ngah...?
Who's getting in the way of my hunt...?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$Fiend! You lure young girls to an isolated
place such as this and call it a "hunt!?"
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Are you all right?

$#()#$A ship from Westland,
bound for Eastland.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Right@$It instructed me to accompany the "heroes,"
which is why I've brought you all here.
$#Girl(Girl)#$$&VillageGirlAMobGrit&$$@Left@$Oww, it hurts...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$Bite marks... Could this be our oni!?
$#StrayOni(Stray Oni)#$$&OniMaleShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Give her back! It's my prey!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$$%1%$What on—Urgh!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$(Such power! Had I not deflected the
brunt of that attack, 'twould have cut
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$clean through my blade—and my neck...)

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$Sage Rei!!
Make haste, take the girl and flee!
$#StrayOni(Stray Oni)#$$&OniMaleShouting&$$@Center@$Out of my way, vermin!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$You shall not get past me!
I shall never allow it!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$@Center@$Nagi, get down—

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Right@$While I'm excited to be adventuring with
you, I feel bad I involved you.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiShouting&$$@Center@$Ban un tarakukiriku aku!
Begone, evil one!

$#StrayOni(Stray Oni)#$$&OniMaleHurt&$$@Center@$Gragh... Advanced onmyo magic!?
Grr... Curse you! Curse you!!!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Nagi, are you okay!? I am sorry, it takes a
moment to chant this spell.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$I am unharmed, no need to apologize!
How is the wounded girl?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Right@$I'm not sure if she is going to be fine.
We need to get her to a doctor!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$Then we must make haste.
That oni may return...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$Sage Rei, let us go!

$#StrayOni(Stray Oni)#$$&OniMaleShouting&$$@Center@$Damn! Damn, damn, damn! Since when
is there a high-class onmyoji in this town!?

$#StrayOni(Stray Oni)#$$&OniMaleShouting&$$@Center@$Once I get rid of this curse, I'll hunt her
down...!

$#StrayOni(Stray Oni)#$$&OniMaleSmile&$$@Center@$With that refined face and voluptuous
curves, she'll be a pleasure to devour!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Right@$I apologize once again.
$#Haku(???)#$$&HakuSilhouette&$$@Center@$I won't allow that to happen.
$#StrayOni(Stray Oni)#$$&OniMaleShouting&$$@Center@$The hell are you!?
$#Haku(???)#$$&HakuSilhouette&$$@Center@$I have no intention of telling you.

$#StrayOni(Stray Oni)#$$&OniMaleSmile&$$@Center@$What now?
Oh, you must be another onmyoji.

$#StrayOni(Stray Oni)#$$&OniMaleSmile&$$@Center@$Ha, as though a brat like you could defeat
me!

$#Haku(???)#$$&HakuSilhouette&$$@Center@$Certainly, even a standard oni may pose a
challenge in usual circumstances...

$#Haku(???)#$$&HakuSilhouette&$$@Center@$But you have been weakened,
thanks to that curse.
$#Haku(???)#$$&HakuSilhouette&$$@Center@$You've barely any strength left.
$#Haku(???)#$$&HakuSilhouette&$$@Center@$I likely won't have to overexert myself.
$#StrayOni(Stray Oni)#$$&OniMaleShouting&$$@Center@$You talk too much! Now DIE!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It is no trouble! On the contrary, 'tis a great
opportunity to repay my debt of gratitude!
$#Haku(???)#$$&HakuSilhouette&$$@Center@$Shambhala samhara sowaka—
$#StrayOni(Stray Oni)#$$&OniMaleHurt&$$@Center@$Gah...!

$#Haku(???)#$$&HakuSilhouette&$$@Center@$No need to use my brush.
Be vanquished, soul and all.
$#StrayOni(Stray Oni)#$$&OniMaleHurt&$$@Center@$N-No... Aaaaaaaargh...!
$#Haku(???)#$$&HakuSilhouette&$$@Center@$A trivial task.

$#Haku(???)#$$&HakuSilhouette&$$@Center@$Still... A curse capable of weakening an oni
to that extent in an instant...

$#Haku(???)#$$&HakuSilhouette&$$@Center@$Exactly like Mizuchi's spells...
No, even stronger than that...
$#Haku(???)#$$&HakuSilhouette&$$@Center@$Just who was that woman...?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Center@$I pledge my life to your service!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Why Nagi, I find you more appealing than
usual today.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Left@$How observant of you, Great Sage!
I have indeed made a change.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaLaugh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$A change...? Oh! I know! You gave your
face a deep cleanse with that face wash
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaLaugh&$$@Center@$that comes in a really fancy bottle, right?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaRelaxHappy&$$@Center@$"The Land of Peace has princesses in
great abundance," I think you said.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$We've sailed pretty far from the coast.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$L-Lady Mysha!
That is, well...
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$Nagi...?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$Um, Great S-Sage... Do not look upon me
with such a lack of expression!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$I-I merely desired to be like Sir Finn...
A man for whom the beauties yearn!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSurprised&$$@Right@$What's with him...?
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHappy&$$@Left@$Haha, this trip's gonna be fun!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Maybe, but if the water dragon went to the
trouble of appearing to Sage Rei in a dream
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$with his message, it must be significant...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(Something big must be going on in the
Land of Peace...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(We've got to be prepared.)
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiBlush&$$@Center@$Nothing but water all around.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$So this is the Land of Peace...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$It bears a certain resemblance to Kisenkyo.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaConsidering&$$@Right@$Yeah... And it feels somewhat...
Nostalgic.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Left@$This is the port town. In his message, my
father said we should head to the capital.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaBitterSmile&$$@Right@$I'm not sure leaving this late would be a good
idea. It's an unfamiliar route and all.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Good point. Let's stay the night and
prepare, then leave once we're ready.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$That should make for safer travel.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I must say, I have visited many a port in
my travels, but never have I seen one
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Center@$as empty and lifeless as this.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$I can't see any people here, now that you
mention it...
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiBlush&$$@Center@$It makes me...uneasy.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Well, it's night, what do you expect?
Our priority should be finding lodging.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$Over there—would that, perchance, be an
inn...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Seems like it.
Let's give it a look.
$#Innkeeper(Innkeeper)#$$&KimonoLadyMobSmile&$$@Center@$Welcome!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Hello ma'am, we were wondering if we could
stay here for the night?

$#Innkeeper(Innkeeper)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You sure could, that's what inns are for.
But first, I've gotta check your heads!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Our heads?
$#Innkeeper(Innkeeper)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Right@$Just a quick glance...!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Ack!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiBlush&$$@Center@$Eeek!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You might be seasick...!
Do you want to lie down for a bit?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Center@$D-Do not lay your hands upon us!

$#Innkeeper(Innkeeper)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You three seem fine.
This one, on the other hand...

$#Innkeeper(Innkeeper)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Center@$Those fox ears of yours the real deal?
They're kinda fishy... Let's have a look.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaPanic&$$@Left@$$%1%$K-Kon!?
$#Innkeeper(Innkeeper)#$$&KimonoLadyMobSmile&$$@Center@$Oh my, they are real! An actual vulpine, how rare...!

$#Innkeeper(Innkeeper)#$$&KimonoLadyMobSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$All four of you are clear.
Sorry for the fuss.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$What was all that about, anyway?

$#Innkeeper(Innkeeper)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Right@$Y'see, a body was recently found near here,
and it had some kind of bite marks on it.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$Bite marks? What does any of that have
to do with us?

$#Innkeeper(Innkeeper)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The bite marks weren't left by an animal,
they were left by an oni. Or so they say.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Right@$No, that's not it.
It just feels odd being here.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$@Center@$An oni...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(Is that why the town is empty? Everyone's
too afraid of this "oni" to leave their homes?)

$#Innkeeper(Innkeeper)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I heard some oni hide their horns, so I had
to check you out to be sure.

$#Innkeeper(Innkeeper)#$$&KimonoLadyMobSmile&$$@Right@$Sorry for tuggin' on your ears there,
little fox miss. I didn't hurt you, did I?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Left@$No, I'm fine.
You had a good reason!

$#Innkeeper(Innkeeper)#$$&KimonoLadyMobSmile&$$@Right@$I'll make you an extra special dinner to
make up for it.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHappy&$$@Left@$Extra special!?
Yaaaaaay!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Ah, a feast of local specialties!
It is sure to be delicious!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Right@$Do you have dango?

$#Innkeeper(Innkeeper)#$$&KimonoLadyMobSmile&$$@Left@$Dango? 'Fraid not. But I can try
to whip up some fish dumpling soup.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Right@$I never thought I'd leave Kisenkyo.

$#Innkeeper(Innkeeper)#$$&KimonoLadyMobSmile&$$@Left@$Now then, why don't you all go freshen up
at the baths while I prepare dinner?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I have heard that baths in this land are
mixed gender...!
$#Innkeeper(Innkeeper)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$No, they're separate.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiPossessed&$$@Left@$Ah, I see...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$What's that sound...?

$#Innkeeper(Innkeeper)#$$&KimonoLadyMobNormal&$$@Right@$Couldn't tell you. Maybe someone's
playin' a taiko drum somewhere.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(It sounds like it's pretty far away... And it does sound like a taiko drum.)
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I find it a little off-putting...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$You too, Sage Rei?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$So, this is it. New places, fresh air—
the "adventure" I've heard so much about...

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Right@$Yes, it's ominous.
I don't want to listen to it...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Then let's hit the bathhouse and lighten
our mood.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$I say, what a delightful bath that was!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$It felt great!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$Land of Peace's bathwaters are much
renowned even back in Kisenkyo.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Left@$Every bikki knows one simply must experience them at least once in their life.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Wow, they must really be special if even
the bikki praise them that much!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$Now then, shall we partake of some of the
local milk while we wait for the ladies?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$I know women usually take longer baths...
but hasn't it been a bit too long?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Left@$Could it be harm has befallen them whilst
bathing...!?

keys.DescriptionKey: When the fierce Nobunaga was born, her future realm was still a lawless, violent place. With oni and samurai drifting from the central part of the country, and bandits running rampant, there was not much space for the peaceful folk to settle.

NobunagaRegular01.title: Demon Queen of the 6th Heaven
NobunagaRegular01.description: When the fierce Nobunaga was born, her future realm was still a lawless, violent place. With oni and samurai drifting from the central part of the country, and bandits running rampant, there was not much space for the peaceful folk to settle.

keys.IntroText: Ha! You think you can tame me? Think again. Now, on your knees!

keys.DescriptionKey:
One day, a first-rate samurai wandering the world—Nobunaga's father—arrived in the area. Unable to just watch the disarray in silence, he built a castle and devoted his life to establishing law and order in the land.
At one point, his path crossed with a young woman from a nearby town, and so he was blessed with a daughter.

NobunagaRegular02.name: Nobunaga
NobunagaRegular02.title: Demon Queen of the 6th Heaven
NobunagaRegular02.description:
One day, a first-rate samurai wandering the world—Nobunaga's father—arrived in the area. Unable to just watch the disarray in silence, he built a castle and devoted his life to establishing law and order in the land.
At one point, his path crossed with a young woman from a nearby town, and so he was blessed with a daughter.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Due to her tendency to bizarre behavior, growing up Nobunaga gained a reputation as "the Fool". She was nothing like her mild-tempered parents, and found the peace that had settled over the area boring. The conflict she desired came unexpectedly, brought about by a local commoner's betrayal—oni ringleaders were let into the town, and within one night the streets filled up with corpses. Nobunaga's father fell trying to defend the townsfolk, and her mother perished protecting her daughter from the attackers.
And so, from that day on, Nobunaga became a demon herself—a fierce spirit of revenge.

keys.DescriptionKey:
"So! You're that "demon" Norza that's been causing trouble around here!"
"...And you are?"
"They call me Matias... Matias the Flamebearer! I hear you've been seeking out skilled warriors, boy. Well, your predations end here and now! Draw your sword. I challenge you to—gaaaah!"
"Spare me the speech. If you mean to kill, do it quickly and quietly...mm. I guess you can't hear me anymore."

keys.IntroText:
Always seeking more power--
But having long forgotten why.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The young man traveled the land, seeking the strongest warriors he could find.
As he was already a peerless swordsman, most duels ended quickly. On the rare occasions he was at a disadvantage, he would retreat and return again the next day, until he won.

Those he defeated, he slew without mercy. True power can only be found beyond the boundary of life and death.
Standing over the bodies of his opponents filled him with a rush of power.

Still not enough. I can get stronger still. I must get stronger still. I must defeat stronger foes.
The avarice in his heart drew him ever onward, fleeing from the powerlessness he felt that day.

NorzaRegular02.description:
The young man traveled the land, seeking the strongest warriors he could find.
As he was already a peerless swordsman, most duels ended quickly. On the rare occasions he was at a disadvantage, he would retreat and return again the next day, until he won.

Those he defeated, he slew without mercy. True power can only be found beyond the boundary of life and death.
Standing over the bodies of his opponents filled him with a rush of power.

Still not enough. I can get stronger still. I must get stronger still. I must defeat stronger foes.
The avarice in his heart drew him ever onward, fleeing from the powerlessness he felt that day.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Finally, there were none left in Westland to challenge Norza.
His final target was the Eternal: the ultimate foe that not even legendary heroes had vanquished.
He sought the dormant Eternal, and whether by Fate or by the abomination's will...he found it.
Even against the dormant Eternal, Norza stood no chance.
As he fell into death's embrace, the Eternal offered him a choice:
Die as a human, and rot into forgotten nothingness;
or swear fealty, and be reborn as an Aeon Lord.
He recalled Argento's face. The sweet temptations of that demon blade.
He didn't hesitate for even a second.

Reborn as the Pristine Corpseblade, he wielded immense power...and the blessing of Eternity.
Never again would he have to fear death, to die ingloriously like "she" did...

...And before long, he had forgotten who "she" even was.

keys.DescriptionKey:
A weapon found by Kisara on the battlefield, given to Norza as his first blade.
By the ornamentation, it was likely a noble's blade; but the owner's identity, and the sword's original name, are lost to time.
When he first received it, Norza was almost shorter than the blade was long; but through his years of hard training, he learned to master it.
This blade serves as a memento of Norza's past life. The moment he let it go was the moment he fell to darkness, and the moment of his final parting with his Master.

keys.DescriptionKey:
When the Primordial Dragon of Storm fell in the first battle with the Eternal, he died too quickly to choose his successor. Desperately, he let a portion of his power fly into the world, to choose and grow within whatever it might find. It was reckless. It could spell disaster if the power of the heavens landed in the wrong hands. But he had no other choice.

As it happened, a hatchling crawled out of his cave to hunt for scraps. He had been cast away from his brethren, too small and skittish to call himself a dragon. Had he hid a moment longer, he might have died a runt, forgotten and inconsequential. But that was not to be his fate.

Altaireon stepped beneath the open sky, and the power of the storm struck him like a bolt of lightning.

NovaBlastDragon01.name: Altaireon
NovaBlastDragon01.title: Soul of the Storm
NovaBlastDragon01.description:
When the Primordial Dragon of Storm fell in the first battle with the Eternal, he died too quickly to choose his successor. Desperately, he let a portion of his power fly into the world, to choose and grow within whatever it might find. It was reckless. It could spell disaster if the power of the heavens landed in the wrong hands. But he had no other choice.

As it happened, a hatchling crawled out of his cave to hunt for scraps. He had been cast away from his brethren, too small and skittish to call himself a dragon. Had he hid a moment longer, he might have died a runt, forgotten and inconsequential. But that was not to be his fate.

Altaireon stepped beneath the open sky, and the power of the storm struck him like a bolt of lightning.

keys.IntroText:
"A mighty storm is born in the wings of a butterfly.
Small as you are, you too can command the heavens."

keys.DescriptionKey:
For many years, he resented and feared his new powers. He could barely control the thunder in his veins, and worse, he had done nothing to earn it. But after a century of fleeing the storms that dogged his steps, Altaireon decided he could run no more. Erden cried out for a savior to break the brutal cycle of the Pandemonium. He was not worthy to be that savior -- not yet. But he could become worthy. He owed it to the heavens that had gifted him their fury.

The young Legendary Dragon sharpened his claws and got to work.

Success did not come quickly. A storm resists taming by its very nature; if he isn't worthy, even a dragon will find himself at the mercy of the winds. After months of fruitless effort, Altaireon found a group of mortal monks living secluded in the mountains. Though they had no power of their own, and no assurance of immortality, they sought whatever perfection they could achieve in their lives. Some wrote poetry, others performed martial arts. Some only meditated from dusk until dawn, pondering the reason for existence. These were not the cowardly mortals Altaireon had seen rise since the fall of the dragons. These were a cut above the rest. In some ways, they were even more than him.

He humbly submitted himself to their teaching, and though he lived to see the youngest of them wither and die, he could not have mastered the tumult of the storm without them.

NovaBlastDragon02.title: Soul of the Storm

keys.DescriptionKey:
In the centuries to follow, Altaireon would push himself beyond what he ever thought possible. Armed with lightning and armored with wind, no enemy could stand against him. Battle became so trivial that he gave up walking the earth entirely, preferring to soar alone and undisturbed. He would only land for those he thought might pose a challenge. They very rarely did.

He does remember one, however. A mortal hunter, wild-eyed and thirsty for glory, who shot him down as he was circling a mountaintop. The two fought ferociously, and though Altaireon emerged the victor, the hunter dodged a bolt of lightning to deliver one last blow with his dagger. So impressed was the dragon that he gifted the hunter a small fraction of the storm, as he had once been gifted himself. He then bid the mortal to train himself and return only when he was certain he could take a Dragon Lord's life.

Altaireon doesn't know if the hunter will ever succeed in his task. It has been many years now, and he has heard nothing of him. But he suspects it won't be long.

The mortal heart doesn't easily give in.

keys.DescriptionKey: An ancient people followed the Dragon of Storms across the face of Erden. Using the scales and talons he cast off, they created a mighty axe, and then magically captured and bound a bolt of lightning within it. In the hands of a master, a single swing can burn down a forest. All others who touch the blade will themselves be shocked.

keys.value: $#Villager(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerASerious&$$@Right@$Chief...are you sure this is going to work?

$#Akatsuki(Akatsuki)#$$&AkatsukiGrit&$$@Right@$No. It was much, much stronger than
before. I can't defeat it, not right now.

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSmirk&$$@Right@$Next time him and I fight, I'll invite you
two along as witnesses. How's that?
$#Crescent(Crescent)#$$&CrescentHappy&$$@Left@$Groo!

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSmile&$$@Right@$Sorry, almost forgot.
You're invited too.
$#Crescent(Crescent)#$$&CrescentHappy&$$@Left@$Groo groo!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Right@$We'd be glad to observe...from a little
further away, next time...

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Left@$Don't be silly! We're gonna be right up
close to drink in all the action!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Right@$Seriously?! My hair's still standing on
end from all those lightning strikes!

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSmile&$$@Left@$You won't have to worry about that
next time...
$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSmirk&$$@Left@$Because next time, I'm gonna win!

$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSurprise&$$@Left@$What?! But it should be even weaker than
it was before!
$#Akatsuki(Akatsuki)#$$&AkatsukiSerious&$$@Right@$Weaker...because of the poison, right?

$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSurprise&$$@Left@$Ah...
H-how did you—

$#Akatsuki(Akatsuki)#$$&AkatsukiSerious&$$@Right@$There's no glory in slaying a dragon
with cheap tricks like that.

$#Akatsuki(Akatsuki)#$$&AkatsukiSerious&$$@Right@$If you want the dragon gone, try talking
to it or whatever. But I'm out.
$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefGrit&$$@Left@$B-but...

$#Villager(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerASerious&$$@Right@$Chief! Look up!
It's Altaireon!

$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefGrit&$$@Left@$What?!
Everyone, get down!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSmile&$$@Right@$Hup!
Thanks for the lift, Altaireon!

$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSerious&$$@Left@$The dragon should be severely weakened
by now. They have a good chance.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSurprise&$$@Right@$...Huh? Who's that on the ground?
The Chief and the villagers?
$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSurprise&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$A-Altaireon...
$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonSerious&$$@Right@$So you are the village chief, then.

$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonSerious&$$@Right@$Answer me. Why did you poison the land?
Why have you driven all the beasts away?
$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefGrit&$$@Left@$W-well...

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Right@$If you don't want to explain, then Solas
can do it for you!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$Why me?
I mean, I guess I can...
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$This is what you're after, right, Chief?

$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSmile&$$@Right@$Aah! The gold of Silverdrake!
You found a vein, then?!

$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSerious&$$@Right@$Tell me where it is. None outside the
village must hear of this!
$#Villager(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerASerious&$$@Right@$...Chief! Look there!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$So, all of this was to monopolize the gold
veins in the mountains.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$You hunted the beasts to stockpile the
reward, and starve Altaireon too.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$The reward would also serve to buy the
silence of anyone who found any gold.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$You were so greedy, you poured poison
into the water...

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$You tried to kill the land itself, all so you
could make money!

$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefGrit&$$@Right@$Our village is poor and miserable,
this was our one shot at a better life!

$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefGrit&$$@Right@$If the silver isn't enough for you, then
take some gold. Just kill the dragon!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$Sorry, but you'd better think of another
way to save your village.
$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSurprise&$$@Right@$What...?
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$...Here.
$#Hunter(Hunter)#$$&PirateA&$$@Right@$Waaaah!
$#Villager(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerASerious&$$@Right@$He threw the gold?!
$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefGrit&$$@Left@$Be careful with that! We need this to—

$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSurprise&$$@Left@$...What?
It's so...light.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$I realized when I picked it up. This isn't
gold. It's just pyrite.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$It's pretty, so you might be able to sell it,
but it's worthless next to gold.

$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefGrit&$$@Left@$But...but...no.
Our village...
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$...There was never any gold in these hills.
$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefGrit&$$@Left@$But...no...!
$#Villager(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAAngry&$$@Right@$What the heck?! No gold at all?!

$#Villager(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAAngry&$$@Right@$You lied to us, Chief! Now what's gonna
happen with all that silver, huh?!
$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSurprise&$$@Left@$Hold! What is going on?!
$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonSerious&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$Silence!
$#Villager(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAScared&$$@Right@$Eep...!

$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonSerious&$$@Left@$Return to your homes.
And never approach this place again.
$#Villager(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAScared&$$@Right@$Uwaaaah!
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$They all ran away...

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Right@$Aw, man. I guess no one gets the silver,
after all.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$No, but that's okay. They probably need
it for themselves more.

$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonSerious&$$@Right@$Luna. Solas. I am in your debt. Thanks to
you, I did not have to leave the mountain.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$Ah...right.
Can I ask you one more question?
$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonSerious&$$@Right@$Of course. Ask, and I shall answer.

$#Hunter(Hunter)#$$&PirateA&$$@Right@$Outta my way! That dragon's way too
strong! We can't beat that thing!
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$Why didn't you leave the mountains?

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$I understand not wanting to leave your
lair, but if the alternative is death...

$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonSerious&$$@Right@$True, it would not be difficult to find
another place to make my home.

$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonSerious&$$@Right@$But...I made a promise with a certain
fool, to grant him a rematch against me.

$#Hunter(Hunter)#$$&PirateA&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Gyaaah! A-ain't dragons supposed to stay

$#Trapper(Trapper)#$$&PirateB&$$@Right@$L-look at the size of that thing!
O-outta my way! I'm gettin' outta here!

$#BanditMale(Punk)#$$&BanditMale&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Huh?
And who the heck're you?

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$So that's Altaireon...!
The hunters are cutting and running!

$#Akatsuki(Akatsuki)#$$&AkatsukiCocky&$$@Left@$Hah! Cowards! Get out of the way and
watch how a real hero handles this!

$#Akatsuki(Akatsuki)#$$&AkatsukiCocky&$$@Left@$Come on, you overgrown lizard!
You face Akatsuki the Hellfire Blade!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaCommand&$$@Right@$Now's our chance, Solas! If we fight,
that bounty's as good as ours!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$...Y-you're right. We have to buy time for
the villagers to escape, too.
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$Let's do it!

$#Imran(???)#$$&ImranSerious&$$@Right@$That dragon, Altaireon, is my prey. I won't
let anyone else take his head.

$#Imran(???)#$$&ImranSerious&$$@Right@$You third-rate hunters wouldn't
even stand a chance anyway.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaCommand&$$@Right@$Stay back, creep!
Hah!

$#Imran(???)#$$&ImranAnnoyed&$$@Left@$Hmph. Whimpering like a babe...
Get lost, weaklings.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSurprise&$$@Right@$Crescent?! What's wrong?!
He's so wobbly!
$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonSerious&$$@Left@$Has the young one drank any water here?!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Right@$Water? Um... He had a drink at the pond
nearby a little while ago, but...

$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonSerious&$$@Left@$It is as I feared. Come inside;
the child must rest, immediately.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$Altaireon, do you usually drink
at that spring?
$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$You said it's not a disease... Which
means that it's probably poison instead.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$Someone is poisoning your spring, trying
to weaken you!

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranAnnoyed&$$@Left@$What...?!
Damn it!
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSurprise&$$@Right@$Old Guy?!

$#Trapper(Trapper)#$$&PirateB&$$@Right@$W-who is that?!
Let's get outta here!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$Luna, keep an eye on Crescent. I'll go
check out the spring with Imran!
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Right@$Okay! Hurry back!

$#UIGanan(???)#$$&UIGanan&$$@Left@$Foolish villagers. Tasking me with such
drivel...they do not know my true strength.

$#UIGanan(???)#$$&UIGanan&$$@Left@$I would be long gone, if the pay were
not so enticing...

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSerious&$$@Right@$You there.
What are you doing?

$#UIGanan(???)#$$&UIGanan&$$@Left@$...!
Who are you?!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$That bottle...that's a poison made from
local herbs, right?

$#UIGanan(???)#$$&UIGanan&$$@Left@$...Hah! I am a simple traveler drawing
water! Nothing more!
$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranAngry&$$@Right@$Liar!

$#UIGanan(Ul Ganan)#$$&UIGanan&$$@Left@$Ah! What are you doing?! Do you
recognize Soul Sorcerer Ul Ganan?!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$Hah! Look at them run.
You're all pathetic!

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranAngry&$$@Right@$No. I couldn't care less about your
excuses or your lies!

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranAngry&$$@Right@$Stop what you're doing. Put the bottle
down and leave. Or you die.

$#UIGanan(Ul Ganan)#$$&UIGanan&$$@Left@$I-I see you will not listen. Then I will
not sit still for your blade, either! Haaa!

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranAnnoyed&$$@Right@$Magic illusions?
Cheap tricks...

$#UIGanan(Ul Ganan)#$$&UIGanan&$$@Left@$You are powerless before my arcane arts!
Begone, or I will claim your soul!

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranAngry&$$@Right@$Your voice is quavering, "Sorcerer!"
Haa!
$#UIGanan(Ul Ganan)#$$&UIGanan&$$@Left@$Wrong one!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$There are too many illusions...
We can't fight him like this.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Center@$Maybe I can do something about them.
Then Imran can take him down!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Center@$Come on, Blazewolf! Use your nose!
Sniff out the real one!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSmile&$$@Right@$That was kind of close, though.
Thanks for saving us, gramps!

$#Blazewolf(Blazewolf)#$$&BlazeWolf&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$%0.3%$Grrrr!
Awoooo!

$#UIGanan(Ul Ganan)#$$&UIGanan&$$@Left@$Gyaah!
Cursed beast!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$There, Imran!
That's the real one!

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSmirk&$$@Right@$Got it.
I'll carve him from head to toe!

$#Imran(???)#$$&ImranAngry&$$@Left@$Gramps—?! Don't be ridiculous.
I'm not that old.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSmile&$$@Right@$But you've got white hair! Okay, we'll
compromise. You can be Old Guy!
$#Imran(???)#$$&ImranAngry&$$@Left@$How is that a compromise?!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$I'm sorry about Luna. Could you tell us
your name? If only to shut her up?
$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSerious&$$@Left@$...Imran.

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranAnnoyed&$$@Left@$What are you brats doing out here? If
you don't want to die, hurry home.

$#Hunter(Hunter)#$$&PirateA&$$@Left@$You damn brat!
Just die already!
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Right@$No way. We're here to defeat Altaireon.

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSerious&$$@Left@$He's my prey.
Stay out of this.
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$There he goes...
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaPout&$$@Left@$...Hmph.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaCommand&$$@Left@$Well, don't just stand there! Let's follow
after him!
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Right@$Huh?! Why?!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Left@$That old guy seems a bit different from
the others. Like he knows something.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$I mean...yeah, a little. And something
seemed strange about Altaireon earlier.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$Imran may have some idea about what's
really going on around here.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaCommand&$$@Left@$What are you muttering to yourself for?
He might know where the dragon's lair is!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$This "brat" has been kicking all your butts
for the past half hour! Haha!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Right@$That's what you meant?!
H-hey, don't pull meee!
$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSerious&$$@Left@$How long do you plan to follow me?
I told you to stay out of this.
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaCommand&$$@Right@$No way! We're going to defeat Altaireon!
$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSerious&$$@Left@$Ha. As if you could.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$It almost sounds like you know how
strong he is.
$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$Imran, won't you tell us what you know
about Altaireon?

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSerious&$$@Left@$No.
Why should I?

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$Please... There's something really fishy
about all of this.
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$Luna! Please stop riling them up!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$Why would a legendary dragon attack a
village unprovoked, for instance?

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$And how did such a small village pull
together 900 thousand silver?

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$Altaireon seemed oddly weak. And there
are almost no animals in these foothills.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$We haven't seen a single one since we
set out. Something is happening here.
$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSerious&$$@Left@$I don't care.
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Right@$But...!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Right@$Then why do you want to fight him so
bad? For the money? Or the fame?

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSerious&$$@Left@$...I don't care about the animals or the
fame, and definitely not the money either.
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Right@$Then, you want to save the village?
$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranAnnoyed&$$@Left@$You're one nosy brat.
$#Hunter(Hunter)#$$&PirateA&$$@Right@$Shut up! Time to die!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaCommand&$$@Right@$I wouldn't have to be if you just told us
already!
$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranAnnoyed&$$@Left@$Ugh...fine. If it'll get you to stop talking...

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSerious&$$@Left@$There is one thing I'm interested in. Why
Altaireon attacked the village.

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSerious&$$@Left@$I want to know why. That's why I'm
headed for his lair.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSurprise&$$@Right@$You think he wouldn't do something
like that? Sounds like you know him...

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Right@$So you and Altaireon must be friends!
And that's why you want to help him!

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranAngry&$$@Left@$Friends?! Are you stupid?!
What gave you that idea?!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$But it seems like you believe he's got a
reason for what he's doing, Old Guy.

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranAngry&$$@Left@$No, I don't!
And I'm not old!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Right@$Luna, it almost seems like you're making
him mad on purpose...
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$Luna! Look out!
$#Crescent(Crescent)#$$&CrescentSerious&$$@Left@$Groo, groo.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Right@$Oh, Crescent. What do you have there?
A shiny rock?

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Right@$...Hm?
This is...

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Left@$We're finally here.
So that's Altaireon's lair?

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$Yeah...look closely.
You can just barely see him inside there.

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSerious&$$@Left@$...
...Altaireon.
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSurprise&$$@Right@$H-hey, Old Guy!

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSerious&$$@Left@$Hmph.
Look at you.

$#AltaireonFull(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonFullAttack&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ah...it has been a long time.
I knew you would come...

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I'm here to fulfill our promise. It's time
for one of us to die.
$#Imran(???)#$$&ImranSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...Out of the way.

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSerious&$$@Right@$I've been training. I'm stronger than I
was before. Let's end this, Altaireon!

$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonSmirk&$$@Left@$Hah...
As you wish!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSurprise&$$@Right@$Hey! They're fighting!
Aren't they supposed to be friends?!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Left@$Don't ask me!
What should we do?!
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaCommand&$$@Right@$We'd better get in there!
$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranAttack&$$@Right@$$%0.3%$Haaa!

$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonAttack&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$Grngh...
Graaaah!
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You want us to get in-between that?

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSurprise&$$@Right@$Uh...maybe not. How is Old Guy that
strong?! He's beating back a dragon!
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$I don't know, but...
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Huh?

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranAngry&$$@Right@$...Why?!
Why aren't you using your full power?!

$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonHurt&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$Haha... You have grown strong, little one.
Gh...hk...!
$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSurprise&$$@Right@$Blood...?
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSurprise&$$@Left@$Did he get hurt in the fight?

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$No... Altaireon! You're suffering from
some kind of sickness, aren't you?
$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSurprise&$$@Right@$What?!
$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonHurt&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$...

$#Imran(Imran)#$$&ImranSerious&$$@Right@$Is it true, Altaireon? You're weakened by
some kind of disease?
$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonSerious&$$@Left@$...It is no disease.

$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonSerious&$$@Left@$The people of the village have been
hunting the beasts of the mountain...
$#Hunter(Hunter)#$$&PirateA&$$@Right@$$%0.3%$Gyaaah!
$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonSerious&$$@Left@$Intentionally...and mercilessly.

$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonSerious&$$@Left@$They hunt more than they could ever eat.
And my supply of food has dwindled.

$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonSerious&$$@Left@$I am starving.
That is why I am so weak.

$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonSerious&$$@Left@$I attacked the village to frighten them
away from despoiling the land further.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$...No, that's a lie. Starvation doesn't
make you cough blood.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$And you wouldn't waste energy attacking
the village in that case, either.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$If you had strength to waste doing that,
you could easily go somewhere el...huh?
$#Crescent(Crescent)#$$&CrescentHurt&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$Groo...

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Right@$Crescent?
What's wrong?

$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonSurprise&$$@Left@$...!
That young one...
$#Akatsuki(Akatsuki)#$$&AkatsukiSurprise&$$@Right@$This is a legendary dragon? I fought stronger beasts on my way here...

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$Yeah...you're right.
...Something feels weird about this.

$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSerious&$$@Left@$Brave hunters, thank you for standing
against the dragon's attack.
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$Ah, Chief.

$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSerious&$$@Left@$Surely you brave souls will be able to
slay the dragon!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Right@$So, is that why you're hiring hunters?
Because the dragon attacks like that?
$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSerious&$$@Left@$Yes. Please allow me to explain.

$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSerious&$$@Left@$While Bival Village has stood at the foot
of the mountains for many, many years...

$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSerious&$$@Left@$We have never had any dealings with, or
trouble from, the dragon.

$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSerious&$$@Left@$But one day, out of nowhere, Altaireon
suddenly attacked the village, as you saw.
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$So the dragon made the first attack?
$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonAttack&$$@Left@$Grrrr...!

$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSerious&$$@Left@$Yes. These endless attacks have taken
a terrible toll on our village...

$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSerious&$$@Left@$So we pooled all our resources to hire
a hunter brave enough to end the beast.

$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSerious&$$@Left@$All that we have is yours, if you can
defeat the dragon.

$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSerious&$$@Left@$Our 900 thousand silver is a small price
to pay to have our peaceful days back.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$Just leave it to us! That dragon is
as good as defeated already!
$#Crescent(Crescent)#$$&CrescentSerious&$$@Left@$Groo...

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$Crescent! Stay hidden!
Dragons aren't exactly popular here.
$#ElfChief(Chief)#$$&ElfChiefSurprise&$$@Left@$Hm? What was that?

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Right@$Uh, uh, uh! Nothing! Nothing at all!
C-come on, Luna, let's go!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaCommand&$$@Left@$Ooh, you're actually excited for once!
Yeah, let's go!

$#Akatsuki(Akatsuki)#$$&AkatsukiCocky&$$@Right@$Whatever. Time to finish this!
Haaaa!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Left@$Okay! First, we need to find the dragon's
lair.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$So...why are we wandering aimlessly
through the woods?

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Left@$It's not aimless! My intuition is leading
us directly to where we need to be!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Right@$Through every thorn patch in the forest?
This isn't even a game trail anymore.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$We're separated from the others, too.
This is definitely a dumb idea.

$#Hunter(Hunter)#$$&PirateA&$$@Left@$Yeah. Too bad for you—
You would've been safer in numbers!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSurprise&$$@Right@$Huh?
Hey, who're you?!

$#Trapper(Trapper)#$$&PirateB&$$@Left@$What do you think?
We're here for the dragon!

$#Hunter(Hunter)#$$&PirateA&$$@Right@$Can't say I like hurting kids, but I like
splitting that reward even less!
$#Hunter(Hunter)#$$&PirateA&$$@Right@$Say your prayers, brats!
$#Altaireon(Altaireon)#$$&AltaireonAttack&$$@Left@$Rrraaaagh!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaCommand&$$@Left@$Hmph, we won't lose to cheating scum
like you!
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Right@$I-I don't think you need to rile them up!

$#Hunter(Hunter)#$$&PirateA&$$@Left@$You talk a big game!
We're gonna make you regret it!
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaCommand&$$@Right@$No! He's running away!

$#Akatsuki(Akatsuki)#$$&AkatsukiGrit&$$@Left@$It's too wide-open here. No place to
drive it into a corner...

$#Akatsuki(Akatsuki)#$$&AkatsukiCocky&$$@Left@$Oh well. I'll handle the beast after I
formally accept the contract.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Right@$That was so weird, though. That didn't
feel like a legendary dragon at all!

$#Akatsuki(Akatsuki)#$$&AkatsukiSerious&$$@Left@$You can say that again. This isn't a battle,
it's basically just pest control.

keys.DescriptionKey:
This unit's attacks will not wake sleeping enemies.

Whenever an enemy survives an attack from this unit with 25% or less of max HP they will be granted the Cursed Sleep status effect for 200TU unless this unit is Burning.

Whenever this unit defeats any number of enemies with an attack, 1 random non-sleeping enemy is granted the Cursed Sleep status effect for 200TU.

Cursed Sleep will overwrite status effects other than Burn, cannot be overwritten by Poison, can be applied repeatedly to units that have already slept while on the battlefield, and will not end from damage caused by Dream Hunter type active skills.

$#MidgardResidentMaleA(Midgard Resident)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$Ugh... What's taking so long?

$#AesirSoldierA(Aesir Soldier)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Right@$Even Lord Odin finds the journey

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinSerious&$$@Center@$Hmph...

$#AesirSoldierA(Aesir Soldier)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Right@$Mere mortals such as you shouldn't speak

$#MidgardResidentMaleB(Midgard Resident)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Left@$Hmph, like we can take a god at their

$#AesirSoldierA(Aesir Soldier)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Right@$What did you just say!?

$#MidgardResidentMaleB(Midgard Resident)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$!-1!$$@Center@$If Elder Sorokin doesn't wake up soon,

$#MidgardElder(Midgard Elder)#$$&AldericSmile&$$@Right@$Honestly, what were you thinking...

$#MidgardElder(Midgard Elder)#$$&AldericSmile&$$@Right@$It appears I'm needed here more

$#MidgardResidentFemale(Midgard Resident)#$$&NatalieMobWorried&$$@Left@$Is it really you, Elder Sorokin!?

$#MidgardElder(Midgard Elder)#$$&AldericSmile&$$@Right@$You have eyes, don't you? Surely there is
