$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiHurt&$$@Center@$$%1%$Ngh!
$#MidgardResidentMaleB(Midgard Resident)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Left@$Thank goodness! It is you!
$#MidgardResidentMaleA(Midgard Resident)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Odin really kept her promise.
$#()#$$!-1!$RUMBLE...RUMBLE...
$#MidgardResidentFemale(Midgard Resident)#$$&NatalieMobSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Aaaaaaah!!!

$#MidgardResidentMaleA(Midgard Resident)#$$&MaleVillagerAMobScared&$$@Right@$Such a long, powerful tremor...

$#AesirSoldierA(Aesir Soldier)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Left@$Lord Odin will surely do something!

$#AesirSoldierB(Aesir Soldier)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Right@$It's the legendary Crimson Giant!

$#AesirSoldierA(Aesir Soldier)#$$&Enforcer&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hey, do you hear that?
Something like a scream?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Voice from the Sky)#$$!-1!$—Oooooooowaaaaaaaahhh!!!

$#MidgardResidentMaleA(Midgard Resident)#$$&MaleVillagerAMobScared&$$@Center@$There's a girl falling from the sky!
Quick, spread out some cloth!
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiHurt&$$@Center@$Fenny!!!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHurt&$$@Center@$Ow ow ow...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenConsidering&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Where am I...?
$#MidgardElder(Midgard Elder)#$$&AldericSurprised&$$@Right@$Young lady, are you all right?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenClosedEyesSweat&$$@Left@$To think I would go off course from
that bridge... Perhaps I was too hasty.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Left@$Thanks to all of you.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Left@$I dare not imagine what would have
happened had you not caught me.

$#MidgardResidentMaleA(Midgard Resident)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$!-1!$$@Left@$But... You fell from Asgard. Are you

$#MidgardResidentMaleB(Midgard Resident)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Right@$No, I think she's just a mortal...

$#MidgardResidentMaleA(Midgard Resident)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You mentioned being hasty. Are you

$#Fenrir(Fenrir)#$$&Fenrir&$$@Center@$$%1%$Grrrrrowl!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Right@$Yes, to the lower levels. "The Yawning
Void!"

$#MidgardElder(Midgard Elder)#$$&AldericSurprised&$$@Left@$You mean The Ginnungagap Abyss?
It's best if you don't go there!
$#MidgardElder(Midgard Elder)#$$&AldericSurprised&$$@Left@$That's not a place for mortals to—
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenNormalSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$But I must!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenNormalSmile&$$@Center@$Some old friends asked me to, and I cannot
run away now.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenNormalSmile&$$@Center@$I would never forgive myself.

$#MidgardElder(Midgard Elder)#$$&AldericSurprised&$$@Center@$What exactly is happening there?
Or rather, about to happen?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Center@$The end of the world!
$#AesirSoldierA(Aesir Soldier)#$$&Enforcer&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Is the Crimson Giant really waking up!?

$#MidgardResidentMaleA(Midgard Resident)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Right@$But if you're talking about the lower
levels, then you must mean Helheim.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Odin)#$$&OdinSmile&$$@Center@$$%1%$It won't work. I can see everything!
$#MidgardResidentMaleA(Midgard Resident)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Right@$The portal is already closed.
$#MidgardResidentMaleB(Midgard Resident)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Left@$Hey, gods, is there any other way?
$#AesirSoldierA(Aesir Soldier)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Right@$Why should we aid you—

$#MidgardResidentMaleB(Midgard Resident)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Left@$Now is not the time for that! I'm sure even
you understand the situation?

$#AesirSoldierB(Aesir Soldier)#$$&Enforcer&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...Fine. The passage Lord Odin opened
should not be completely closed yet.
$#AesirSoldierA(Aesir Soldier)#$$&Enforcer&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hey, if we help humans—

$#AesirSoldierB(Aesir Soldier)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Right@$The end of the world is close. Surely you
can feel it too.

$#AesirSoldierB(Aesir Soldier)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Right@$Now is not the time for gods and humans

$#AesirSoldierB(Aesir Soldier)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Right@$You must have felt that tremor. That
was no ordinary earthquake.
$#AesirSoldierA(Aesir Soldier)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Left@$True...

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSerious&$$@Center@$(That Eye of All Laws is more
troublesome than I thought...)
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$How can I get to the lower levels?

$#AesirSoldierB(Aesir Soldier)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Right@$If it's not completely closed, we should
 be able to widen the passage.
$#AesirSoldierB(Aesir Soldier)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Right@$It'll take time, though.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Left@$We do not have time! I need to go as soon as possible!
$#MidgardResidentMaleA(Midgard Resident)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Is there anything we can help with?

$#MidgardResidentMaleA(Midgard Resident)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$If all of us work together, we can open 
the path much faster, right?
$#AesirSoldierA(Aesir Soldier)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Right@$That's true. Lend us your strength, then.

$#MidgardResidentMaleB(Midgard Resident)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Left@$All right, everyone! Let's go open the
path to Helheim!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Finn, please wait.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Center@$I'm coming for you!!!

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSerious&$$@Center@$(She can foresee Fenrir's flames and
my attacks.)

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Fenrir's got quite slow, hasn't he? Perhaps
it's because he was sealed for so long.
$#AesirB(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Left@$A mortal... They were found dead!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$(I don't have any basis to believe this
story about Helheim...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(But, if it's true, then I can save Callen!)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$I do want to see her again!
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiHappyClose&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You can, if you put in the effort.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Understood. Instead of sitting here all sad,
I'd rather take the chance to save her!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$No matter how small it is!

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiTehepero&$$@Right@$Wow, you're quite the hero∼
And I do like a brave, strong...manly hero.

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I'll guide you to Helheim, but first,
take this stone.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$It looks...magical.

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiNormal&$$@Right@$It's the gem of Brísingamen.
I have the other one.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$!-1!$$@Center@$A-A mortal...dead!?

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiNormal&$$@Right@$When separated, they show the position
of their counterpart.

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiTehepero&$$@Right@$And they can also obscure you from
Odin's Eye.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...Why would we need to hide from Odin?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$I'm sure she would help us!

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiNaughty&$$@Center@$No, she would actually get in our way.
She didn't mention Helheim to you, right?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$That's true, but there might be a
reason behind that...

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiNaughty&$$@Right@$We don't have time to speculate on
her reasons.

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiNaughty&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It's up to you. Either take the stone
or leave it. What'll it be, Finn?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$All right... I'll take it.

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSmile&$$@Right@$That's a good decision, my dear little
hero. Now, take my hand.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Move aside!!!
Let me through, please!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Your hand...?

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiTehepero&$$@Right@$Yes, hold it nice and tight∼ We're about
to go flying through the sky!
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiTehepero&$$@Right@$Ready. Set. Valshamr!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$...!
Is this teleportation!?

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$Yes. The distance is limited, but if we use

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiTehepero&$$@Center@$Now, one more time.
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiTehepero&$$@Center@$Our destination is the Bifrost Bridge!

$#AesirA(Aesir Soldier)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Right@$Leave at once! Humans shouldn't
interfere with godly affairs!
$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinNormalOpen&$$!-1!$$@Right@$No, let him through. Quickly.

$#AesirA(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Left@$Lord Odin...!
Understood.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$!-1!$$@Center@$C-Callen...!? No!

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$The cause of death is unknown.
There are no external injuries,

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinSurprised&$$@Right@$but her heart has definitely stopped
beating.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Left@$This can't be... Callen...
Dead...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$...Huh? Who... What?
Callen?

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinNormalOpen&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Death comes to all.
There are no exceptions.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$B-But we were just together not that long
ago... I won't accept this...!

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinSurprised&$$@Center@$Go check for yourself.

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiHurt&$$@Center@$That eye of yours really does see the
future, huh.

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$Hmm, delicious. The tea is exceptional
today.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprised&$$@Center@$Oh, goodness, Finn...
You are far too trusting.
$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinNormal&$$@Center@$That's enough.
$#AesirA(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Center@$Lord Odin!?

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinSmile&$$@Center@$These are my guests, so please try
and get along.

$#AesirA(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I... I...had no idea they were
your guests!
$#AesirB(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Right@$I apologize for my rudeness.
$#AesirC(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Left@$Yes, please excuse us!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$And there they go... Scattering like
spiders.

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinNormalOpen&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I apologize as well. I did not expect
this to happen. Are you upset?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$No, the situation was resolved
peacefully. There's no need for anger.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenComicalAngry&$$@Left@$I am furious! They called me a child!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Center@$Fine. Let me have some of that.
Gulp!

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What if I prepare more sweets 
for you later? Would that help?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenClosedEyesSweat&$$@Center@$W-Well... Since I am a proper adult...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenClosedEyesSweat&$$@Center@$If you apologize that much, I guess 
I can forgive you.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Odin, why do the gods seem to
despise humans so much?

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinSmile&$$@Right@$Asgard and the human realm of 
Midgard have long been in conflict.
$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinSmile&$$@Right@$It is become irreparable at this point.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$So, that's the reason behind their
hostility towards us...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(The way they looked at us... It seems
like they hate humans in general.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(There must be a deep-rooted history
here...)
$#DistantCheers(Distant Spectators)#$Ooooooh!!!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Mmm, a bit too bitter for me.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What was that?
$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinHappy&$$@Right@$Could you both join me for a short while?

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I think you will find this rather
entertaining.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Isn't that how tea is supposed to taste?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenComplain&$$@Right@$Bitter? Not necessarily...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenPokerFace&$$@Right@$...And you better not be thinking I
have a child's taste buds!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$I... I wasn't thinking that. 
You're probably just used to Rigland's tea.

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Cheer up, Callen. Here are some
sweet snacks to balance the bitterness.

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinNormal&$$@Center@$I've got ice cream, soda, and even
potato chips.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenExcited&$$@Center@$Oooh, are these the cream soda flavored
chips I've been addicted to recently?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Not to be rude, but this seems like a
bad time to have a tea party...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...How do you know my favorite snacks!?

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinClosedEyesSmile&$$@Right@$I simply observed your past...
using this Eye of All Laws.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Left@$What do you mean? Are you suggesting
that you can see our entire past history!?
$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinHappy&$$@Right@$That is indeed correct, Callen.

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinHappy&$$@Right@$I see your reputation as a genius within
the Elvenlent Academy is well-deserved.

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinHappy&$$@Right@$It seems your thirst for knowledge is only
rivaled by your appetite for snack food.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprised&$$@Left@$H-Hey! My diet is none of your business!
That's an invasion of privacy!

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinClosedEyesSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I have closely observed your past as well,
brave hero.

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinHappy&$$@Center@$You have captured the hearts of many
a woman in your time, haven't you?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurpriseBlush&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Wh-What...? What are you talking about?

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinNormal&$$@Right@$Why? It provides the perfect setting
for us to chat, don't you think?

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinHappy&$$@Right@$Haha, forgive me, that was all 
meant in jest.

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinHappy&$$@Right@$To be honest, I have nothing but the
highest respect for the both of you.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenConsidering&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...It seems you are being serious.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenConsidering&$$@Center@$Does your "Eye of All Laws" 
truly allow you to see everything?

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinNormal&$$@Center@$Not everything, but I can see ominous
futures quite clearly.

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinNormal&$$@Center@$A calamity will soon visit my 
world.

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinNormal&$$@Center@$The Giant Ymir.
The "world-ender."

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinNormal&$$@Center@$At this world's origin, the giant that
will end everything is about to awaken.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So, you summoned us here
to prevent that?
$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinHappy&$$@Right@$Once again, you are very perceptive.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$You transport us to your realm, and
now you want us to drink tea?

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinHappy&$$@Right@$I can foresee the giant awakening
in just two days.

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinSmileBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Finn, I am relying on your unrivaled
power that transcends fate.

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinSmileBlush&$$@Center@$I will give you whatever I can to
protect this world.
$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinHappyBlush&$$@Center@$Even my body, if you wish.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurpriseBlush&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What!? W-We would never
ask for that!

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinSmile&$$@Right@$...You are kind and pure.
Unique for someone with such power.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprised&$$@Left@$Finn has always been straightforward
and dependable. Do not tease him.

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinSmileBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$People taking unexpected actions can
be quite entertaining. I couldn't help it.

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$Finn, you're conventional in certain
aspects, yet refreshingly distinct in others.
$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$I appreciate that.

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinClosedEyesSmile&$$@Right@$Its rich aroma will help ease your
nerves and calm you down.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So, Odin, you will not go back on what
you said earlier?
$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinSmile&$$@Right@$I won't. I am a god, after all.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Left@$You said you would offer us anything.
I'm asking for technological assistance.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Left@$You have technology that can 
create a door to travel to other worlds,
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenAngry&$$@Left@$something we do not have in ours.

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinNormalOpen&$$@Right@$I just applied modifications to an artifact 
that already existed in your world.

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinSmile&$$@Right@$However, if you want it so badly, I
will share our scientific knowledge.

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinSmile&$$@Right@$But only if you are successful at
saving our world in two days.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHeh&$$@Left@$Agreed. That sounds fair.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Left@$(She has determined our course of
action without asking me. Oh well...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Calm us down, huh?
Fine...I'll have some.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$All right, I can't just stand by and
allow such a calamity to happen.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$If there are lives to be saved,
we must do what we can!

$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinNormal&$$@Right@$Ah, yes. The spirit of a true hero.
Myself, and the other gods, thank you.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Odin)#$$&OdinSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$%1%$But for now...
$#Odin(Odin)#$$&OdinHappyBlush&$$@Center@$Would you like a refill of your tea?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Are you sure Asgard is a completely
different world?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$If Odin's words are correct, this is one 
of the so-called parallel worlds.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Is there a way to confirm that?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSad&$$@Right@$Ever since we were transported here,
I cannot sense the mana I used to feel,

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSad&$$@Right@$no matter how hard I try. It is definitely 
not Rigland.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprised&$$@Right@$Wait, Finn! Don't drink that.
We have no idea if it's safe.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$The atmosphere does feel different.
So it really is another world...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hmm... There was something about
Odin that gave me a strange feeling...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$What kind of feeling? It seems that
she genuinely wants to save everyone.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenComplain&$$@Center@$Well...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$No point talking about it here.
Maybe later.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Makes sense. Let's go explore
the town a bit.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$So this is Asgard! And everyone here is
a descendant of gods, huh.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenNormal&$$@Right@$Well, considering the mystical feeling 
I get, it seems plausible.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$This city is completely different than
any other we've visited in the past.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Right@$It feels... divine.
It is the "heavenly kingdom," after all.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$If she wanted to harm us, 
she would've done so already. Besides...
$#AesirA(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hey, are those humans!?

$#AesirB(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Right@$Did they come from Midgard?
Impossible!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenPokerFace&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I am getting the feeling we are not
very welcome here.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$Agreed, but we've encountered towns
like this before.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenComicalAngry&$$@Right@$But we are guests of Odin. You
know...the "chief god?"
$#AesirA(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Lord Odin invited you!?

$#AesirB(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Right@$Lies! Humans can't cross into Asgard!
How did you sneak in!?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ask Odin if you doubt us!

$#AesirA(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Do not speak to me in such a fashion,
mortal.

$#AesirB(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Right@$Maybe they were invited here.
For the tournament, perhaps?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$This tea is delicious!

$#AesirC(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Left@$These weak, pathetic humans?
They're as fragile as a child!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenComicalAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Wha—Did you just call me a child?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Hoho, how pitiful! Failing to recognize our
strength... And you call yourselves deities?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Callen, don't provoke them. We're
outsiders here...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGrit&$$@Right@$Being an outsider does not give them
the right to insult us!

$#AesirA(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hmph! If you're so confident, take up
my challenge! If you can, that is!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Whoa...!

$#AesirA(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Center@$Impossible...! How did you dodge me so
easily!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Starting fights in a city can be
dangerous. You should stop.

$#AesirA(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Center@$The nerve! You dare to lecture
a divine warrior, human!?

I know everything there is to know about you
Even things you don't realize yourself...

keys.DescriptionKey:
She is always calm, collected, and magnanimous. Even during Ragnarok, the war that almost destroyed this world long years ago, she would never miss her afternoon tea time.
After the war came to an end, she solemnly handed out forgiveness to those who deserved it, and eternal punishment to those who did not. And sometimes, she would even let them see her smile.

keys.DescriptionKey: She tirelessly pursued all knowledge she had yet to know, every sight she had yet to see. Endlessly watched every conceivable place, time period, dimension. And after millenia of observing all possible phenomena and rules, she finally felt it—the feeling she's been unconsciously denying this whole time, one that has actually been consuming her all along.

keys.DescriptionKey:
This unit cannot be defeated by damage from Burn status effects.

When this unit defeats a non-conjured enemy with an attack, all other allies on the battlefield will be given the next turns by reducing their current TU. Effects that influence TU order may interrupt the extra turn (e.g. Stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

This unit enters battle with Mega Healing Burn for 100TU. Then all allies on the battlefield are granted Poison Wards, and Stun Wards.

While this unit is on the battlefield, whenever a unit on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, so long as this unit is not defeated or sacrificed at the same time, all allies on the battlefield are Purified (removes negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison), and then burned.

A unit with Mega Healing Burn will heal after each turn at 20 times the rate as Healing Burn. This will overwrite other status effects including Healing Burn on the user, cannot be overwritten by Burn, Poison or Sleep status effects, and cannot be Purified. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with Mega Healing Burn will gain the Burn status effect. A unit with Mega Healing Burn will be granted Healing Burn for 300TU when Mega Healing Burn expires.

keys.DescriptionKey:
She was a sword prodigy, considered the best among the elite oni hunters of the Shinsengumi. Captain of the first unit, she could always be spotted leading the vanguard. When it came to swordsmanship, she made impossible possible on a daily basis. But the truth is, she had no real interest in the art of the sword.
"C'mon, that's boring! Let's talk about fashion! Or relationships!"

OkitaRegular01.title: Shinsengumi's Finest

keys.IntroText:
Raise our banner and uphold your truth—
This time, I'll live and die by your side

keys.DescriptionKey:
Okita has always distrusted people—after all, in a world terrorized by the oni, her parents were killed by humans. Abandoned by her relatives, she ended up growing up at a sword school. There, her extraordinary talent was discovered, but it didn't take long for the other disciples to start avoiding her, not even trying to match her in a duel. Soon, she was out of her mind with boredom.
And then one day, a certain girl joined the school—one not afraid to face Okita head on.
She would go on to become Shinsengumi's vice-commander, and the object of Okita's feelings.

keys.DescriptionKey: Heavens gifted Okita with a wealth of talent, but weren't as generous with her lifespan. The rapid advance of her illness couldn't be concealed for long, and soon she was removed from active service. "I wish I could live longer." "I wish I could still fight." "...I wish I could die by her side." Okita knew that if she was offered a chance to fulfill those wishes, she'd stop at nothing to take it.

OkitaRegular03.description: Heavens gifted Okita with a wealth of talent, but weren't as generous with her lifespan. The rapid advance of her illness couldn't be concealed for long, and soon she was removed from active service. "I wish I could live longer." "I wish I could still fight." "...I wish I could die by her side." Okita knew that if she was offered a chance to fulfill those wishes, she'd stop at nothing to take it.

keys.value: $#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst595|$I am Omi, ruler of Kisenkyo.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst604|$The Captain did say there were sick people
here too...

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst605|$Many victims of the illness have been
brought to our town.
$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$But none of our medicines have worked...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst606|$I see...

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst607|$However, there is someone who could make
a cure.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst608|$Wh-Who!?

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst609|$The Great Sage Rei, daughter of the water
dragon. She is now over 1000 years old.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst610|$A thousand!?

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst611|$Kisenkyo's rarest medicines are all made by
her.

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst612|$But due to her advanced age, she only
awakens a few times a year.

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst596|$I must offer you my sincerest gratitude for
your assistance earlier.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst613|$I never realized Kisenkyo's medicines hid
such a secret. Is it really okay to tell us?

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst614|$I have also been considering asking for
the Great Sage's help.

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst615|$But it is not easy to wake her outside of
festival periods...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst616|$It sounds like you believe there is a way for
us to assist you in this task.
$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst617|$Yes... The truth is, my daughter...

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst618|$My precious Saki has also fallen ill with
the Sleeping Death...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst619|$Your daughter?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst620|$The princess?

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst621|$She was attacked by a monster while on a
stroll with her guards...
$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$She has been asleep for a month now.
$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst597|$It was simply splendid!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst622|$I am very sorry to hear that. I must ask
though...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$Even in this dire of a situation, you still
did not ask for the Sage's help?

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst623|$The Realm of Reia, where the Great Sage
sleeps, is a miniature world of its own.

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$The Great Sage built it as a place where
she could concentrate the earth's energies.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst624|$A miniature world...?

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst625|$Only the Kisenkyo royal family may enter.
But it is dangerous.

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst626|$The Realm may be small, but it is a world
apart from our own.

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst627|$A terrifying place, filled with strange
monsters that will attack without mercy!

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst628|$I have entered several times with my guards
in an attempt to locate the Great Sage,
$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$but each time we have failed in our quest.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst598|$No need to thank us, Your Highness.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst629|$How long until the Sage is supposed to wake
up?

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst630|$We don't know. It depends on how she is
feeling.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst631|$No...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst632|$I see. In that case, please entrust us with
this task!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst633|$I give you my word that my Pandemonium
Task Force will locate the Great Sage,

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst634|$and request her assistance in curing the
Sleeping Death!

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst635|$Captain Ludmilla... I offer you my deepest
gratitude.
$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst636|$The Realm of Reia is located east of the city.

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst637|$I will send word to the guards at the
entrance to let you pass.

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst638|$I will do whatever I can to assist you. Please
find the Great Sage!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise;Rizette.RizetteSurprise;&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Rizette.Right;@$$|act2.Voices/mst599|$(Kisenkyo's buildings are peculiar on the
inside, too...)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst639|$Understood. We will return soon with good
news!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst640|$The Realm of Reia sounds pretty
dangerous.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst641|$But we have to find the Great Sage. For
Theo, and the Princess, and everyone else!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst642|$That's the spirit! Take time now to prepare,
then meet me back here when you're ready.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst643|$Yes ma'am!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst644|$Yes ma'am! Alright, time to check my
equipment...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst645|$...?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst646|$...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise;Finn.FinnSurprise;&$$!-1!$$@Right;;;Finn.Left;@$$|act2.Voices/mst647|$Finn? What's wrong?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst648|$It's Nagi. But he looks...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst600|$(For some reason, the smell of these reed
mats relaxes me.)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst649|$Kind of sad.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst650|$I wonder what's wrong? I'm going to go
and ask.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst651|$I'll come too. I still need to thank him for
earlier.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst652|$Just make sure you don't neglect your
preparations. I'll see you back here soon.

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst601|$Now, concerning the purpose of your visit,
a cure for the Sleeping Death...

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst602|$You may have realized already, but we do
not have one.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst603|$No!

keys.DescriptionKey:
This Barrier will be activated whenever this unit enters battle.

While this unit is on the battlefield and this Barrier is activated:
- Allies gain 35% damage reduction from attacks. This effect can stack with other damage reduction effects such as Armor, but will not stack with itself or other ally Barrier type skills.
- This unit cannot be defeated by non-attack damage.
- If this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will heal for 25% of max HP.
-If this unit would be defeated by an attack, this Barrier will be deactivated and this unit will be Purified and healed for 100% of max HP.

If this unit's Barrier is deactivated and it would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The Church keeps records of the order they find the Vessels for the Requiem. In truth, it doesn't matter all that much. Some Vessels found early have always been weak, while a few Vessels found late have proven themselves to be contenders. 

Still, everyone knows Hibiki Himeno was the very first Vessel found. Even worse, no one knows her Gift. 

Speculation floats around, of course. The Goddess's Bloodthirst would explain her ferocity in battle. Wit would explain her ability to ace tests without studying. Some have suggested she's the Goddess's Luck, because who else could get away with half of what she does? 

But some say they saw her shadow shortly before they themselves awoke as Vessels. And no one can explain that.

keys.DescriptionKey:
In the past, Vessels have never managed to turn eighteen. As soon as the hundredth one is found, the Requiem begins soon after, and the world enjoys another century of peace. This has always happened within eighteen years, but so far it's been almost twenty, posing the school a unique problem: graduates who were never meant to graduate. 

Some, like Nanami and Reina, proved skilled enough to become staff at the school. Others remain in a small village nearby, working odd jobs and pretending they've escaped their death sentence. 

Hibiki, on the other hand? She's only a second year, despite being eighteen, and she likes it just fine. It's not like she has to worry about the future, after all.

keys.DescriptionKey:
What makes Hibiki an oni? Vessels who have traits of other species usually share their characteristics, so what is it that made those horns sprout out of her head? 

Most would say it's cruelty. The demon's horns give away her sadistic heart and cruel nature. They whisper about her vicious tactics in combat and defer to her every whim, scared of what she might do otherwise. 

She uses their fear, of course, because fear can get her what she wants. But those who've known her since the beginning can attest that she's never hurt anyone who didn't deserve it. 

Perhaps it's that talent for illusion that truly makes her an oni.

In a land far to the East, there lives an oni. This oni, however, is a slayer of her fellows.
She prays to no gods, performs no rituals. Yet when battle looms, she is the first to ready her blade. She is the Scarlet Oni, the one who strikes at her fellows' throats without mercy.
"I'm Hibiki, the oni hunter. Eh? Why's an oni hunting oni? ...Say that one more time and I'll take your head clean off."

Oni blood, irresistibly pulling her along a path she has no choice but to walk.
"Your blood's red, same as mine..."

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$|act0.Voices/mst151|$Good. Then let us depart for Rigland!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$We must hurry on to the capital.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$The Red Dragon Knights have been gone

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Finn, Rizette. Please keep what happened

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$We don't quite know what's going on here,

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Specimen name: O55-1A
Status: Stable

Specimen took her first non-assisted steps this morning. Her language capability far outpaces her physical development: she repeatedly asked for aid walking around the laboratory, and stumbled more than once. Still, this represents significant progress on her part. The faster she achieves full maturity, the better.

I've gotten word from associates on the mainland that the Aeon Lords have been sighted once again. No news on whether it has officially begun, but I fear I am running out of time. I have only just produced a living homunculus. How will she take to her powers when she finally discovers them?

I can only pray for good fortune. A thing I must do far too often, for a scientist."

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Specimen Name: O55-1A
Status: Critical

Another blackout today. The specimen asked, as she often does, for a chance to venture outside the laboratory. I denied her and gave the usual reasons when asked why, but upon hearing them, her mana levels spiked. She broke a quarter of the equipment in her room before her power finally overcame her. I have dosed her with a memory poultice again. Let us pray that it continues to work.

I am starting to regret this iteration of the experiment. The specimen possesses immense strength, but cannot control her emotions. Integrating her into the Pandemonic system is crucial, but doing so in this state might spell doom for us all."

keys.DescriptionKey:
No one knows what made the Tuathan volcano erupt after so long lying dormant. Argento, ancient smith of the Aeon Lords, has been sure to keep it that way. A secret like the creation of homunculi should only be shared with worthy minds, and with the passing of Ossia's erstwhile creator, he can think of no one in the world who deserves it.

He has resurrected the poor thing, of course. Without a soul, returning a body to life is a simple thing. Frustratingly, her power over all six elements seems to have fled. But he has never known a setback he can't overcome.

Ossia's curiosity is as immense as her thirst for vengeance. He can make a weapon of her yet.

keys.DescriptionKey: She was created to end the Pandemonium, a being superior to all denizens of Erden. Though designed as a weapon with nothing but combat abilities, she was born as a life form with feelings. Like any newborn child, she had no sense of good and evil, as susceptible to the former as she was to the latter. Likewise, like any newborn child, there was only one thing she sought—and so, she took the scientist who created her to be her mother.

OssiaDark01.name: Ossia
OssiaDark01.title: Plaguebearer Aeon Lord
OssiaDark01.description: She was created to end the Pandemonium, a being superior to all denizens of Erden. Though designed as a weapon with nothing but combat abilities, she was born as a life form with feelings. Like any newborn child, she had no sense of good and evil, as susceptible to the former as she was to the latter. Likewise, like any newborn child, there was only one thing she sought—and so, she took the scientist who created her to be her mother.

keys.IntroText:
There is only one thing she longs for—
The one thing she can never have again

keys.DescriptionKey:
Her creator could not decide if she should be treated as a weapon or as a person until the very end. However, after Ossia died, she was resurrected by a man eternally devoted to forging arms. A woman made to be a weapon and a man only interested in weapons, both equally twisted—perhaps their paths were destined to cross.
"Who does not work shall not eat," he would always say, so she started helping with gathering materials for his creations, learning all about the world, life, and the give-and-take of trade in the process. Therefore, if there is anyone that can be called her father, surely—
"I think I've heard quite enough of these conjectures, thank you very much."

keys.DescriptionKey:
She did not rush out into the world right after the smith took her in. First, she used the uncontrolled, devastating power she was given in her first life, and the immortality that came with her second one, to repeat the cycle of self-destruction and rebirth over and over again. Throughout that time, she kept wondering if her mother's love for her was genuine or not, and if what she herself felt towards her mother was love or hate.
(Later, she came to the conclusion that it would be much better if feelings were easily classified as loss or gain, business-like and manageable.)
Answers did not come to her though, not even after she finally got her power under control. Therefore, she set out to create an even more advanced being than herself—eager to know how she would feel towards a "child" of her own.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The autumn harvest festival. Children flock to the streets, dressed as evil spirits to protect themselves from the real evil. A single grown woman can be seen among them, however, her body and mind differ greatly in age. Though an adult in appearance, in spirit she's no different than the children pestering passers-by for treats. It is no surprise, then, that she too wanted to wear a costume—even if she couldn't quite find the right size.
"How do I look, Mama? If you don't say 'cute', I will play a trick on you...!"

OssiaHalloween01.name: Ossia
OssiaHalloween01.title: Bewitching Devil
OssiaHalloween01.description:

keys.IntroText:
Mama and I are one and the same.
But when I look in the mirror, there's just me...
I don't want candy, I want my Mama!

keys.DescriptionKey:
Due to the size of the gap between her physical and mental age, or maybe due to the enormous power dwelling in her body, her mind is trying to catch up abnormally fast. But there is a price for defying the natural order, that is how this world works. And the price for her rapid growth—or rather evolution—was ethics and morals.
"Will you play with me...? No, I will make you my playmate myself, hahaha..."
What makes people unable to look away is that hint of childishness mixed with all the seductiveness, that bit of charm among all the innocence. It shows in her looks, her words, and seems to monopolize the thoughts of those who meet her.

keys.DescriptionKey:
At last, her childlike mind has reached maturity. She rests, surrounded by a rich assortment of sweets and desserts. If you try to look away, she'll fix you with a challenging gaze, as if asking if you really don't want more.
She is not human, she's a creature made to resemble humans and surpass them—it is only natural, then, that she looks down on us. "If you think you, a human, can devour me, if you think you can hurt me, come and try," says her prideful, bewitching smile.

keys.value: $#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkAngry&$$@Center@$$%0.5%$$|act0.Voices/mst108|$Gyaaaah!!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act0.Voices/mst117|$The Crimson Crest...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurtRed&$$@Left@$$|act0.Voices/mst118|$...What?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act0.Voices/mst119|$A blood-red crest with the power to
dispel evil... I thought it was a myth...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurpriseRed&$$@Left@$$|act0.Voices/mst120|$A crest...?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act0.Voices/mst121|$Yes... A crest so powerful...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act0.Voices/mst122|$It is said to be the key to ending the
Pandemonium itself.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurpriseRed&$$@Left@$$|act0.Voices/mst123|$Ending the Pandemonium...!?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act0.Voices/mst124|$Theo...? Theo! No... Please, open
your eyes! Theo!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritRed;Ludmilla.LudmillaSurprise;&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Ludmilla.Right;@$$|act0.Voices/mst125|$Rizette? What's wrong with Theo!?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act0.Voices/mst126|$Let me take a look at him.

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkAngry&$$@Center@$$|act0.Voices/mst109|$A-A wound! A blemish upon my perfect
body!! How is this possible!?

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkAngry&$$@Center@$$|act0.Voices/mst110|$Glowing red eyes... I-It can't be! Not in this
rundown village...!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurpriseRed&$$@Center@$$|act0.Voices/mst111|$My eyes...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurtRed&$$@Center@$$|act0.Voices/mst112|$Urgh... They're burning... It feels like my
whole body is burning!!

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkAngry&$$@Center@$$|act0.Voices/mst113|$I am superior...! I won't have a mere
human injure me! I won't have it!!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$$|act0.Voices/mst114|$...!!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$$|act0.Voices/mst115|$(That boy... He drove off an Aeon Lord!?)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurtRed&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act0.Voices/mst116|$S-Stop! Get back here! Urgh...
$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaDamagedAngry&$$@Center@$...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnDamagedSeriousRed&$$@Center@$I...don't know. I fell unconscious...
and then I had this strange vision...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnDamagedSeriousRed&$$@Center@$And then...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnDamagedHurtRed&$$@Center@$Ugh...my eyes...they feel on fire...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedSurprised&$$@Center@$Hey Finn, your eyes...
Have they always been red?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnDamagedSeriousRed&$$@Center@$What? No, I have blue eyes...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedSerious&$$@Center@$Red eyes and a mysterious power...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedSurprised&$$@Center@$Could it be...the Crimson Crest?
I thought it was just a myth.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedSurprised&$$@Center@$The crest with the power
to exorcize demons and dispel evil...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedSurprised&$$@Center@$If that woman really is an Aeon Lord,
then maybe it is true...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedSurprised&$$@Center@$Such an immortal being could not be hurt
by mere ordinary magic.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedSurprised&$$@Center@$What is this power...?
Not even I stood a chance against her...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedSerious&$$@Center@$At any rate, our first priority
is to return to Rigland.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedSerious&$$@Center@$I must take you to
the Red Dragon Knight Headquarters.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedSerious&$$@Center@$Oh, and I forgot to ask.
Would you tell me your names?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedGentleSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I'm Rizette. I'm from Westcarte.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnDamagedSadRed&$$@Left@$My name is Finn.
This is—I mean, Rossé is my hometown.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnDamagedGritRed&$$@Left@$Rizette, was Rossé really destroyed
18 years ago?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedWorried&$$@Right@$...It was, as far as I know.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnDamagedSadRed&$$@Left@$I don't believe it.
How is this possible?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedSerious&$$@Right@$This is only speculation,
but perhaps the Crimson Crest
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedSerious&$$@Right@$has somehow affected your memory?

$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaDamagedSmirk&$$@Center@$Heh heh, not bad. Not bad at all.
You've managed to hurt me, an Aeon Lord.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedSerious&$$@Right@$I won't tell you to calm down right now,
but there is one thing I must say.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedSerious&$$@Right@$You saved our lives.
Thank you, Finn.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedGentleSmile&$$@Right@$You saved me too, Finn. Thank you.
You must be exhausted. Please take it easy.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnDamagedSadRed&$$@Left@$I don't quite know what's happening here.
I was all ready to fight and then...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnDamagedSadRed&$$@Left@$And then I started hallucinating...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnDamagedSeriousRed&$$@Left@$No, let's think about that later.
We need to get ourselves patched up.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnDamagedSurpriseRed&$$@Left@$And, uh... We should probably change 
too...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedSurprised&$$@Center@$!!??

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$Thanks, Rizette.
You've sure got a hand for mending.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteCalm&$$@Left@$Oh no, it's the only thing I'm good for.
It took me a while, but it should be good..
$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaDamagedSmirk&$$@Center@$Truly a specimen worthy of further study...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$And thanks for the healing elixir.
I've only ever seen them in books before.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$Don't mention it.
The Red Dragon Knights made sure

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$to source a large number of elixirs
in preparation for the coming calamity.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Right@$I never thought we'd have to use them
so soon, though.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Left@$Captain Ludmilla,
are you thinking what I'm thinking?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Left@$Do you think it has begun?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$I'm not entirely sure...

$#Ludmilla()#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$But with all these monsters about
and the appearance of that Aeon Lord...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$Perhaps it really has begun...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$The once-in-a-century calamity
to destroy the world...

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDamagedSmile&$$@Center@$My name is Ossia.
I'm sure we will meet again...soon...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Right@$The Pandemonium.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Right@$But it's too soon. It's only been 18 years
since the last Pandemonium.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyesBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hey, um...can I open my eyes yet?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Center@$Sorry! You can open your eyes now.
Oh, hey! Your eyes are back to normal.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Center@$I guess the red was only temporary.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$We'll head for Rigland when you're ready.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$I must report to the Headquarters
everything that has happened here.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$I'm sure you'll find your brother
at the capital, Rizette.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$@Center@$Yeah, I'm sure he made it out okay...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Center@$That Aeon Lord said she recognized me,
but I don't think she knows about Theo.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnDamagedCommandRed&$$@Center@$Wait! Get back here!
Damn, she got away.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$You're right, I'm sure he's fine!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Center@$Then let's head for Rigland.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedSerious&$$@Center@$Don't bother chasing her. She's wounded,
so she won't be a threat for a while.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedSerious&$$@Center@$And we're not in any position
to do anything reckless right now.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedSerious&$$@Center@$Also...what was that power just now?
And it looks like you're completely healed.

keys.value: $#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Is Snow White really here?

$#DragonPalaceSoldierB(Dragon Palace Soldier B)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Right@$No, it's far worse than that! 
Such overwhelming evil...

$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Esteemed guest, watch out! 
Quickly, this way—
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$No, she's my companion...um, or rather—
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackTongue&$$!-1!$$@Center@$His sister.

$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Left@$My word! Such a malevolent being is your 
sister!?

$#DragonPalaceSoldierB(Dragon Palace Soldier B)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Right@$You must have had it hard growing up with
her...
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Finn, do you prefer grilled fish or boiled fish?

$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackSmirk&$$@Center@$I'll make you a special dish, just give me a
minute.
$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Center@$Eeeeeek!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Sorry... She might be a bad person, 
but not that bad...
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackSerious&$$@Right@$Do you know this place?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$By the way, do you know where Otohime 
went?
$#DragonPalaceSoldierB(Dragon Palace Soldier B)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Right@$She should be with Lord Genryu.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$Where did that sound come from!?
$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Center@$From Lord Genryu's chamber!
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackNormal&$$@Center@$Something's up...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$You said Otohime's in there!?

$#DragonPalaceSoldierB(Dragon Palace Soldier B)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Right@$W-Wait! Entering Lord Genryu's chambers
without permission is—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$You heard that sound, right!? 
That's the sound of a battle!
$#DragonPalaceSoldierB(Dragon Palace Soldier B)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Center@$But still...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Yes, it's the Dragon Palace. 
We were just here a little while ago.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Aren't you worried about Otohime!?
$#DragonPalaceSoldierB(Dragon Palace Soldier B)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Center@$Of course...but...
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Snow White might be there too.

$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackClosedEyes&$$@Center@$We don't have time, Finn. Just leave these
heartless people.
$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Wait, please! We will go as well!

$#DragonPalaceSoldierB(Dragon Palace Soldier B)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Right@$Even if we face punishment later... 
We have to save Lady Otohime!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yeah! Let's go!
$#Genryu(Genryu)#$$&FishDragon03&$$@Center@$Haaaahhhh!!!
$#Kosame(Kosame)#$$&FishDragon02&$$@Center@$Gah...
$#Kosame(Kosame)#$$&FishDragon02&$$@Center@$Lady...Oto...hi—
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Dragon Palace, huh? Such a cliché name...

$#Genryu(Genryu)#$$&FishDragon03&$$@Center@$Hmph, dead already, is she?
Worthless.
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeDespair&$$@Center@$Ah... Aaaaaaaaah...!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$—Otohime!!!
$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Left@$That's... L-Lady Kosame...!
$#DragonPalaceSoldierB(Dragon Palace Soldier B)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Right@$I-Is she...dead...?

$#Genryu(Genryu)#$$&FishDragon03&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Who gave you permission to enter this
chamber?

$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Center@$Did you do this to Lady Kosame, my lord!? 
Why!?

$#Genryu(Genryu)#$$&FishDragon03&$$@Center@$She was a traitor. That, my misguided 
subjects, is why I executed her.

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeCryingShoting&$$@Center@$Don't lie... Don't lie, Father!
No...you're not...
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeCryingShoting&$$@Center@$You're not my father!

$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackGrin&$$!-1!$$@Center@$But there's no mistake. I feel a power of 
darkness similar to mine.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$(The wounds on Otohime's body...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$(They look like they were caused by being
squeezed with something scaly...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$You! Not only did you attack Kosame, 
but even your own daughter?
$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Lord Genryu hurt Lady Otohime...?
$#DragonPalaceSoldierB(Dragon Palace Soldier B)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Right@$I-I can't believe it...

$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$A comrade just died before your eyes. 
And that girl is crying and screaming.
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackSerious&$$@Center@$What more do you need to believe?

$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackTongue&$$@Center@$Not that I have any right to be preaching
about good and evil.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$You also ordered Alice to be pushed into 
that pit, didn't you, Genryu!
$#Genryu(Genryu)#$$&FishDragon03&$$@Center@$Impudent human. Who do you think I am?
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackGrin&$$@Center@$It's so ominous, it's captivating.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$You're evil! That's who I think you are! 
And you make people miserable!
$#Genryu(Genryu)#$$&FishDragon03&$$@Center@$Hmph... Such a feeble attack.
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackSneer&$$@Center@$$%1%$A Little, Dark Garden!
$#Genryu(Genryu)#$$&FishDragon03&$$@Center@$Ngaah... What is this...!
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackTehepero&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Our coordination is getting better, isn't it.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Once more, Snow Black!
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackGrin&$$@Right@$Sure, sure.

$#Genryu(Genryu)#$$&FishDragon03&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Tch! You lot, what are you dawdling for! 
Come help!
$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Center@$We... We can't...
$#Genryu(Genryu)#$$&FishDragon03&$$@Center@$Tch... You dare defy my orders?
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackGrin&$$@Center@$Just like the one that Cinderella had.

$#DragonPalaceSoldierB(Dragon Palace Soldier B)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Right@$We cannot allow harm to come to 
Lady Otohime!

$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Left@$Our current leader is Lady Otohime! 
Lady Kosame would have said the same!
$#Genryu(Genryu)#$$&FishDragon03&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Useless! All of you!
$#Genryu(Genryu)#$$&FishDragon03&$$@Center@$I shall destroy everything then!!!
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackSurprised&$$@Center@$He has the power of darkness too...?

$#Genryu(Genryu)#$$&FishDragon03&$$@Center@$With my bottomless power source, I shall
wreak destruction upon you all—
$#Genryu(Genryu)#$$&FishDragon03&$$@Center@$Haaaaaaaraaaaaaghhh!!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$This is bad! Everyone, run—
$#DragonPalaceResidentA(Dragon Palace Resident A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What's happening...?
$#DragonPalaceResidentB(Dragon Palace Resident B)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Right@$N-No... The Dragon Palace—!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$A power of darkness in the Dragon Palace...
$#Voicefromundertherubble(Voice from under the rubble)#$Uh... Ah... Aaah...

$#DragonPalaceResidentA(Dragon Palace Resident A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Left@$Th-There are injured people!
Someone, please help!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Uh... Ugh...
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Finn, are you okay?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Left@$Ah... Yeah... Somehow I am. 
How about you?
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackNormal&$$@Right@$Don't you worry about me.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Left@$As expected. 
What about Genryu?
$#Genryu(Corrupt Genryu)#$$&FishDragon03&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackGrin&$$!-1!$$@Right@$He's been completely consumed by the
power of darkness. How marvelous.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Is he immobilized...? 
Now might be the chance—
$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Grimwraith! There's a grimwraith here!

$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackNormal&$$@Right@$We should avoid attacking recklessly. Unless 
it's a very strong attack, it won't reach him.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$Then, what should we do?

$#???(???)#$$!-1!$How interesting this is turning out... 
How interesting indeed.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$Y-You...

$#()#$"How much longer are you going to sleep,
you fool?"

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteEmbarrassed&$$@Left@$Ah, nothing, I'm just relieved... In my dream,
you turned into a really scary person.
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySad&$$@Center@$Mmm... Uh... What―
$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSadSmily&$$@Center@$Good morning, Talia.
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySad&$$@Center@$Cinderella... I...

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySadSmile&$$@Center@$I had a dream. 
A sad, and yet somehow warm dream...
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySad&$$@Center@$I think you were going somewhere...

$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaLaugh&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I was here all along. 
And I'm not going anywhere.

$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautySmile&$$@Right@$Hehe, right... 
Sorry for saying strange things.

$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaSmile&$$@Left@$So, what shall we do today, 
Your Royal Highness?
$#Talia(Talia)#$$&SleepingBeautyYawn&$$@Right@$Hmm, maybe sleep a little more...

$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaLaugh&$$@Left@$Hehe, I think you've had all the beauty
sleep you need already.

$#TavunRabbit(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$@Right@$That wasn't a dream, young lady! 
Not a dream at all!

$#Cinderella(Cinderella)#$$&CinderellaLaugh&$$@Left@$Time to wake up and go out. 
Come on, get ready!
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSurprised&$$@Left@$Huh?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceComplain&$$@Right@$Yeah, getting my body taken over like that...
It sure won't be my fondest memory.
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteNormal&$$@Left@$What do you mean...?
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceClosedEyesSmile&$$@Right@$It's all right now. Just forget about it∼
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Anyway, I'm glad that you're safe, Snow.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Snow Black was worried too...but she
disappeared before we knew it.

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteShy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Snow Black? Now that you mention it, 
just before I woke up...

$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteShy&$$@Center@$I heard a voice saying, 
"I'm the one who will erase you."
$#()#$$&SnowWhiteClosedEyes&$"Hurry up and wake up!"
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Sounds like her all right...

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Excuse me.
Lady Snow White, I see you've awakened.
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSurprised&$$@Left@$Um...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Let me introduce you. This is Otohime, 
ruler of the Dragon Palace.
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteConfused&$$@Left@$Ah...! Thank you for letting me rest here.

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmileKind&$$@Right@$It's the least I can do. Finn and the others
have been a great help to me.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$We didn't do much, really. It's all thanks 
to Lady Okuni.
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Mother...
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Is everything okay?

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeNormal&$$@Right@$Hm? If you mean the castle's reconstruction,
it's going smoothly...
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSadNormal&$$@Center@$Uh, where am I...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceComeOn&$$@Left@$Ugh, such an airhead. I meant, have you 
sorted out your feelings about...that?
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSurprisedNormal&$$@Right@$Ah, that.

$#TavunRabbit(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$@Left@$I'll have you know that Miss Alice would
never evade responsibility for her own actions!
$#TavunRabbit(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$@Left@$Even if she wasn't herself at the time...

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Hehe, how typical of Hypnos's Avatar to 
apologize via a doll.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceComplain&$$@Left@$H-Hey, there are things you just shouldn't
say, you know?

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmileKind&$$@Right@$Don't worry. I am the ruler of this castle.
I won't be down forever!
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$@Left@$I see...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Still, I'll apologize. Even if I was being
controlled, it was undeniably me.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSad&$$@Center@$And I do feel guilty...
So, um...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Snow!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceConcider&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I'm sorry. I've reflected on my behavior.
I won't do it again.

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimePokerOpen&$$@Right@$...Really, Avatars don't even know how to 
apologize.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceComplain&$$@Left@$Uuugh, I humbled myself and for what...

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeClosedEyesSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Well, Father's orders or not, I did push you
into that pit. So...
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSad&$$@Center@$I'm sorry too. Please forgive me.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Does that make us even?
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeClosedEyes&$$@Right@$I guess. Let's go with that.
$#Kosame(Kosame)#$$&FishDragon02&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hehehe...

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimePoutPokerFace&$$@Right@$What is it, Kosame? Did I say something
funny?

$#Kosame(Kosame)#$$&FishDragon02&$$@Left@$Not at all, my lady.
You have grown up. I am very pleased.
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Phew... Finally woke up, did you?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Kosame, it's great to see you well! It's
a miracle you escaped fatal injury.

$#Kosame(Kosame)#$$&FishDragon02&$$@Left@$No, with Lord Genryu being that powerful,
no miracle could have saved me.

$#Kosame(Kosame)#$$&FishDragon02&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I think I was spared because even when he
was overtaken by darkness, a sliver of
$#Kosame(Kosame)#$$&FishDragon02&$$@Center@$conscience remained in him.
$#Kosame(Kosame)#$$&FishDragon02&$$@Center@$He was indeed a great person.

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Yes, both my father and mother were 
great...

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeClosedEyesSerious&$$@Center@$(I must carry on my parents' legacy.
And to do that, I must become stronger...)
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSad&$$@Center@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Otohime, are you okay?

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimePanicWeap&$$@Right@$Finn!?
Were you watching me again?
$#SnowWhite(Snow White)#$$&SnowWhiteSurprised&$$@Left@$...Sir Knight? Master?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Sorry, I didn't mean to...

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimePoutBlush&$$@Right@$It's fine. It was my fault for showing 
weakness.
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimePoutPokerFace&$$@Right@$So, what do you need?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Just wanted to make sure you're really 
okay.
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSad&$$@Center@$I see...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Center@$Losing family hits harder than anyone can
predict.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Center@$So, you don't have to put on a brave face.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Center@$It's okay to cry when you're sad. 
You have friends who support you, right?

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSad&$$@Center@$But I am the ruler of the Dragon Palace. 
My father and mother are relying on me.
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSad&$$@Center@$For me to show weakness...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceComplain&$$@Right@$It's Alice, A-l-i-c-e.
Geez, how many times do I have to tell you?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Center@$Above all, you are Otohime.
Your heart knows best what you need.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Center@$What are you feeling right now?
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSad&$$@Center@$I...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeCrying&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I am...
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeCrying&$$@Center@$...lonely.
