$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceConcider&$$@Left@$Ughhh.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hey, what happens when someone's dream 
is eaten?

$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Center@$You dare speak to Lady Otohime like
that!? Unforgivable!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceConcider&$$@Right@$They'll have only nightmares for a while. 
To the point of being scared to sleep.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$That sounds terrible...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceComplain&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Okay. How about 200 dreams of 
criminals?
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeClosedEyes&$$@Center@$500
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceAttack&$$@Center@$Collecting dreams is hard work!
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$500
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceConcider&$$@Left@$Argh...
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmile&$$@Right@$550

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceComeOn&$$@Left@$W-Wait! Why is it going up!? 
500, okay, 500!
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmileKind&$$@Right@$Deal.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$Alrighty then, shall I enlighten you? 
This is my domain!

$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh, Lady Otohime is so impressive 
when she gets serious!

$#DragonPalaceSoldierB(Dragon Palace Soldier B)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Right@$Striking a deal for dreams with an 
Avatar!
$#DragonPalaceSoldierC(Dragon Palace Soldier C)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Left@$Time for another feast!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hehe, looks like she beat you this time.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceComeOn&$$@Right@$This isn't funny.
Gosh.

$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Left@$We wanted to apologize.
For trying to eat your dream earlier...

$#DragonPalaceSoldierB(Dragon Palace Soldier B)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Right@$If there's anything we can do,
we'd like to offer compensation.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Don't worry about it, I'm not bothered.
By the way, are human dreams that good?

$#DragonPalaceSoldierB(Dragon Palace Soldier B)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Right@$A living human's dream is a supreme 
delicacy! Eating it fills you with vitality!
$#DragonPalaceSoldierB(Dragon Palace Soldier B)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Right@$Would you like to try one, Sir Finn?
$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What on... Our attacks don't work?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Uh, not really...

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceComplain&$$@Right@$Finn. Don't listen to these guys.
They're dangerous.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$I know, Alice. Besides, I think I like 
bread more than dreams.
$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh, that's a shame...

$#DragonPalaceSoldierC(Dragon Palace Soldier C)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Right@$Come to think of it, I knew you weren't just
any human, since you managed to come here,
$#DragonPalaceSoldierC(Dragon Palace Soldier C)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Right@$but an acquaintance of an Avatar...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Alice and I go way back. 
Our friendship knows no bounds.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHeh&$$@Right@$Finn is special. He connects lines that 
normally wouldn't intersect.
$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Left@$Ah, a special being. Like our Lady Otohime.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceComplain&$$@Right@$Oh, is she? I wonder if someone with her
attitude should be ruling a castle...
$#DragonPalaceSoldierB(Dragon Palace Soldier B)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Right@$Who is this girl...

$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Haha, our apologies. Sometimes she just 
gets overwhelmed by her duties.

$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Center@$After all, she's constantly striving to be
a worthy heir to Lord Genryu.

$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Center@$Lord Genryu is the former ruler of this
castle and Lady Otohime's father.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I heard about him from my boss. 
They've been rivals since forever.
$#DragonPalaceSoldierC(Dragon Palace Soldier C)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Left@$You mean the Primordial Hypnos, right?

$#DragonPalaceSoldierC(Dragon Palace Soldier C)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Left@$Yes, they went head to head countless times
back in the day, according to our ancestors.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Living as long as a Primordial... 
And being rivals with one at that...

$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Lady Otohime is carrying her father's legacy
with extraordinary thoughtfulness.
$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Center@$I have known her since she was a baby.

$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Center@$She's a hardworking and kind-hearted
person.

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Wait, are you an Avatar of Hypnos!? 
Why are you here?

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceComplain&$$@Center@$But she should really address that nasty 
attitude of hers.

$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Center@$Lady Otohime's office is just over there. 
Why not take a peek?
$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Center@$I'd like to show you how she works.
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeNormal&$$@Center@$—Is everything ready?

$#Kosame(Kosame)#$$&FishDragon02&$$@Center@$The eyes over the Blue Trench are in place.
If anything happens, we will be notified.

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeNormal&$$@Center@$Understood. Let's find this "Snow White,"
no matter what it takes.
$#AlicePillar(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Right@$She's definitely experienced...
$#FinnPillar(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Yeah, she really makes a strong impression...

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeNormal&$$@Center@$Then, mobilize the southern soldiers. 
We'll do a thorough search of the area.
$#DragonPalaceOfficerA(Dragon Palace Officer A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Lady Otohime...
$#FinnPillar(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyes&$$@Right@$—!
$#Moansfromtheseabed(Moans from the seabed)#$$&GenericMonster&$$@Center@$Ahhhhhh...!!!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$$&FinnSleep&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(I'm starting to feel sleepy. 
Time to go to bed...)
$#DONOTSHOWME()#$$&FinnSleep&$$@Center@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSleep&$$@Center@$Zzzz... Zzzz...
$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Whispering) He's finally asleep.

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimePokerOpen&$$@Center@$(Whispering) All right... Make sure there
are no slip-ups... Tiptoe around—
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimePanicWeap&$$@Center@$O-Ouch!!! My toe!
$#DragonPalaceSoldierB(Dragon Palace Soldier B)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Center@$Lady Otohime!!!
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSuperPain&$$@Center@$(Whispering) Shh... Keep it down!

$#DragonPalaceSoldierC(Dragon Palace Soldier C)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Left@$(Whispering) Lady Otohime, are you okay? 
That looked really painful.

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeShock&$$@Right@$(Whispering) What are you talking about? 
Umm... No, it wasn't...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$!
$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Left@$(Whispering) But you're tearing up...

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimePainful&$$@Right@$(Whispering) Would you just...! We're so 
close to getting what we've been waiting for.

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmirkSweat&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Whispering) And we will get it! 
A living human's dream... Delicious...
$#Alice(???)#$$&AliceOpenMouthHeh&$$!-1!$Hold uuuuuup!!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$(What is this thing!? I can feel malice 
and resentment wafting from it...)
$#Moansfromtheseabed(Moans from the seabed)#$$&GenericMonster&$$@Center@$Ahhhhhh...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Center@$(Those eyes... They're the eyes of
a predator watching its prey...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$I can't die here!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Haaaahhh!!!
$#FinnPillar(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$(No effect!?)
$#Moansfromtheseabed(Moans from the seabed)#$$&GenericMonster&$$@Center@$$%1%$Ahhhhhh...!!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(This is bad!!!)
$#FinnPillar(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Right@$Nn...mmm...mmph!

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Foul creature. Be touched by the light and 
vanish.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Moans from the seabed)#$$&GenericMonster&$$@Center@$$%1%$Ahhh...ahhh—
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$It...disappeared...?
$#Kosame(???)#$$&FishDragon02&$$@Center@$A human in such a place... How unusual.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You can speak...?

$#Kosame(???)#$$&FishDragon02&$$@Right@$Yes. That thing and I are fundamentally 
different.

$#Kosame(???)#$$&FishDragon02&$$@Right@$We can talk more later. For now, let us leave 
this place. I will guide you.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh... Thank you!

$#Kosame(Kosame)#$$&FishDragon02&$$@Center@$My name is Kosame. Now, this way, 
please.

$#Kosame(Kosame)#$$&FishDragon02&$$@Right@$We should be safe here, for now. 
You are Sir Finn, correct?
$#FinnPillar(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Right@$(I'm...underwater!?)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Yes, thank you! And this castle is...?

$#Kosame(Kosame)#$$&FishDragon02&$$!-1!$$@Center@$This is the Dragon Palace, a place of luxury
beyond anything seen on the surface.
$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh, Lady Kosame? Is this by any chance...
$#Kosame(Kosame)#$$&FishDragon02&$$@Right@$Yes, a rare guest indeed.
$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Soldier A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Left@$A guest, you say!?
$#DragonPalaceSoldierB(Dragon Palace Soldier B)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Right@$How unusual!

$#DragonPalaceSoldierC(Dragon Palace Soldier C)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Left@$I must go and inform everyone 
immediately!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Wow, that's quite an enthusiastic
welcome...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Lady Kosame. What is happening...?

$#Kosame(Kosame)#$$&FishDragon02&$$@Right@$Ah, my apologies. But it is indeed a joy to 
have a guest.
$#FinnPillar(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Right@$(Why am I here...?)

$#Kosame(Kosame)#$$&FishDragon02&$$@Right@$The ruler of the castle has been eagerly 
awaiting you. Please, this way.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(The ruler of such a castle must be a 
remarkable figure.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Probably more than anyone I've met
before!)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(What if I do something awkward... I'm
getting nervous...)

$#Kosame(Kosame)#$$&FishDragon02&$$@Center@$My lady, I present to you Sir Finn, 
a living human.
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$&OtohimeNormal&$$!-1!$Such a lovely visitor. Welcome.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(There she is! The lady of this castle—)

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmileKind&$$@Center@$I am Otohime, the ruler of the Dragon 
Palace!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$You are...the ruler...?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$$!-1!$(This is bad, I can't breathe... 
I'm...drowning... Mmmnh―)
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Did you just think, "Who is this child?"

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeAngry&$$@Right@$You thought, "That pipsqueak is the
castle's ruler?" didn't you?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Oh... No, not at all! Actually, 
I was thinking you're lovely too.
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ah, quite the flatterer, are you?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$Th-That's the first time someone's said
that to me.

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmileCold&$$@Center@$That was sarcasm, of course. Not the
sharpest tool in the shed, are you?

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmileCold&$$@Center@$Next time you call me lovely, I will crack
your skull open. Be prepared, you knave.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(Whoa, she's really angry!)
$#Kosame(Kosame)#$$&FishDragon02&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Lady Otohime. That is unbecoming of you.
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeClosedEyesBlush&$$@Right@$Ah... Ahem.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Huuuuff...huff...
Huh, I can breathe again...
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeClosedEyesBlush&$$@Right@$My apologies. I seem to be a bit tired.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Tired...?

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmileKind&$$@Right@$Yes, I've not been the castle ruler for long 
and am still adjusting
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmileKind&$$@Right@$to the new daily routine.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$I see...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$I must say, you startled me.

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$As an apology, allow me to invite you to drink,
sing, and enjoy yourself with us tonight!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Uh? No, no, I wouldn't want to impose—

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmileKind&$$@Right@$It is the Dragon Palace's tradition to 
wholeheartedly welcome our guests.

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmileKind&$$@Right@$Think of it as helping me out, and please, 
join us.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(I'm under the sea, right? But how can I 
breathe...?)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Well, if that's the case, I guess it can't hurt.

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$And now, the Hospitality Dance of the
people of the Dragon Palace!
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Please enjoy yourself, my honored guest!
$#FinnPillar(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$A dance...!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Their bodies are so flexible...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Right@$Huh!? You can twist yourselves like that!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, it's over...
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimePokerHappy&$$@Center@$How did you like our dance?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$!-1!$$@Left@$It was amazing!!! The way you move your
bodies... It was astonishing!
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmile&$$@Right@$We do practice a lot.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$What's going on here?

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmile&$$@Right@$I'm glad to hear your kind words, and I'm
sure everyone else is pleased as well.

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmileKind&$$@Right@$Well then, on this special occasion, let me 
perform a dance as well!

$#DragonPalaceSoldierA(Dragon Palace Resident A)#$$&FishDragon01&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Lady Otohime is going to dance for the 
guest!!!
$#DragonPalaceSoldierB(Dragon Palace Resident B)#$$&FishDragon01&$$@Right@$A sight to behold!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Is it that rare for her to dance...?)
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeClosedEyes&$$@Center@$With your permission—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(Wow, that's beautiful... Such an elegant 
dance...)
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeClosedEyes&$$@Center@$How was it?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$It was wonderful!

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimePokerHappy&$$@Center@$Well, naturally. But I'm happy to hear it
was to your liking all the same.
$#Moansfromtheseabed(Moans from the seabed)#$$&GenericMonster&$$@Center@$Ah...ahhh...

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Now, please enjoy the Dragon Palace's 
cuisine.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$(So much delicious food... Is it really okay
for me to have all this? It's like a dream...)
$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmileKind&$$@Right@$Did you enjoy the banquet?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$Yes, very much! Everything was so 
delicious!

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeSmile&$$@Right@$I'm glad to hear that. It makes our 
efforts worthwhile.

$#Otohime(Otohime)#$$&OtohimeClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Please feel free to use this room. 
If you need anything, just let me know.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(They even provided a bedchamber. 
They've really taken care of everything.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(But where exactly am I? I'm breathing 
underwater, in a castle like this...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(Well, first thing tomorrow, I'll use this place
as a base to go exploring.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$(We'll see what happens then.)

keys.DescriptionKey:
The young lady of the Dragon Palace leads her people as skilfully as she can lead their traditional dance. You would be ill-advised to praise her for accomplishing so much at such a young age, though—unless you want to become the next target of her exceptionally sharp tongue.
Because you see, she despises nothing more than being considered a child.

OtohimeRegular01.title: Ruler of the Dragon Palace

keys.IntroText:
Welcome to my domain—
the abyssal depths where dreams are born

keys.DescriptionKey:
She is sharp in performing her duties as well, always making sure the residents of her domain are safe and provided with sufficient amount of dream pieces to sustain themselves. However, when faced with unforeseen situations, she tends to get overwhelmed and freeze up.
No matter how much she pushes herself to act mature, she's still a child in some respects—but her subjects love that side of her too.

OtohimeRegular02.name: Otohime
OtohimeRegular02.title: Ruler of the Dragon Palace
OtohimeRegular02.description:
She is sharp in performing her duties as well, always making sure the residents of her domain are safe and provided with sufficient amount of dream pieces to sustain themselves. However, when faced with unforeseen situations, she tends to get overwhelmed and freeze up.
No matter how much she pushes herself to act mature, she's still a child in some respects—but her subjects love that side of her too.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Why did she assume such a responsible role at her age in the first place? Because she wanted to earn her mother and father's recognition. Her subordinates know that all too well, just like they know that they cannot replace her parents. All they can do is stay by her side and watch out for any danger.
What they don't realize is that it's thanks to them that Otohime can be the proud ruler she is today.

keys.DescriptionKey: Deep in an unexplored part of the ocean there is a flourishing civilization—fish who can talk like people and people who can live underwater like fish, all joined in peaceful coexistence. In the middle of their capital stands a towering structure, and in its innermost chamber slumbers a sacred staff—the one that reigns over the realm.

keys.DescriptionKey:
This unit's attacks will not wake sleeping enemies.

This unit has 50% damage reduction from attacks.

When this unit takes damage from an attack, if there are 2 or more enemies that are sleeping on the battlefield, this unit will immediately be Purified (any negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed, new status effects may still apply following this effect), and get the next turn.

keys.LongKey:
【重要】「エバーテイル超懸賞祭」名称変更及び応募ルール変更のお知らせ

いつも『エバーテイル』をプレイしていただき、誠にありがとうございます。

このたび、皆様にご愛顧いただいておりますキャンペーン「エバーテイル超懸賞祭」につきまして、弊社タイトル『パラノイズ』との合同開催に伴うイベント名称及び応募ルールの変更を行いましたのでお知らせいたします。
 
■ 変更内容
 
・イベント名称の変更
変更前：エバーテイル超懸賞祭
変更後：ジグザゲーム超懸賞祭
 
・参加規約の改訂
名称変更及び「パラノイズ」とのキャンペーン合同開催等に伴い、キャンペーン参加規約を改訂いたしました。改訂後の参加規約全文は、以下の手順でご確認ください。
1.ホーム画面左上のプロフィールをタップし、プロフィール画面を開きます。
2.プロフィール画面内の懸賞の入場ボタンをタップし、懸賞画面へ移動します。
3.懸賞画面の左端にある「懸賞の参加規約」をタップすると、参加規約全文が表示されます。
 
■ 改訂の効力発生日
改訂後の参加規約は、2026年10月1日より適用されます。
 
■ 各対象タイトルでの応募について
当社（ZigZaGame株式会社）が提供する本懸賞の対象タイトル「エバーテイル」及び「パラノイズ」につきまして、両タイトルのご応募を合わせて抽選を行います。ユーザー様は、各1アカウントずつ、個別に抽選へご応募いただけます。
「エバーテイル」で1アカウント＋「パラノイズ」で1アカウントの計2アカウントでそれぞれ応募が可能です。
 
同一タイトル内での複数アカウントによる応募は、従来通り無効となりますのでご注意ください。
抽選は両タイトル合同で行い、当選者数は両タイトル合計の人数です。
なお、懸賞のご応募に課金は一切不要です。また、「100万円懸賞」及び「ゲリラ懸賞」については、課金の有無・金額によって当選確率が変わることはございません。
 
今後とも「ジグザゲーム超懸賞祭」ならびに『エバーテイル』をよろしくお願いいたします。

keys.DescriptionKey:
If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

This unit enters battle with a Charge, Stun Ward, Sleep Ward, and a Poison Ward. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges.

Each time this unit damages an enemy with an attack, this unit is granted a Charge.

When attacking, adds 100% to the damage % of this unit's attacks for each Charge stored on this unit (e.g. Deadly Dance: 700% => 1000% damage with 3 Charges are stored).

This unit has 50% damage reduction.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack, and survives until after the end of the turn, if this unit is charged, this unit will spend a Charge to heal for 1% of max HP. Otherwise, if this unit is not charged, this unit will have its TU reduced to 0. This extra turn may be interrupted by other effects that influence the turn order (e.g. other stuns targeting the lowest TU target). This is not considered a Counter Skin type effect.

keys.DescriptionKey:
If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

This unit enters battle with a Charge, Stun Ward, Sleep Ward, Poison Ward, and an Instant Death Ward. An Instant Death Ward prevents this unit from being immediately defeated without damage by a non-boss enemy once, then is removed. Instant Death Wards cannot be ignored and cannot stack. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges.

Each time this unit damages an enemy with an attack, this unit is granted a Charge.

When attacking, adds 100% to the damage % of this unit's attacks for each Charge stored on this unit (e.g. Deadly Dance: 700% => 1000% damage while 3 Charges are stored on this unit).

This unit has 50% damage reduction, plus 10% for each Charge stored on this unit (max of 80% while 3 Charges are stored on this unit).

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack, and survives until after the end of the turn, if this unit is charged, this unit will spend a Charge to heal for 100% of max HP. Otherwise, if this unit is not charged, this unit has a 20% chance, plus 20% chance per Awakening (up to 100% chance if this unit has 4 Awakenings) to immediately have its TU reduced to 0. This extra turn may be interrupted by other effects that influence the turn order (e.g. other stuns targeting the lowest TU target). This is not considered a Counter Skin type effect.

keys.DescriptionKey: On Laomis, it's commonly said that when the moon is full, oysters rise to the surface of the ocean and open themselves wide. Then, moonlight crystallizes inside them, and becomes a pearl. You may laugh, but if you hold this pearl up alongside the full moon, you'll see that they glow with the same radiance.

$#Percival()#$$&PercivalMelt&$$@Center@$—In the dead of night,
when everyone is asleep...
$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$There seems to be a problem at the prison.
$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No...!
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSad&$$@Center@$I can't believe this...
$#Alba(Lancelot)#$$&NatalieMobWorried&$$@Center@$Alba is dead?

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotAngry&$$@Right@$Please lock up properly.
And take care of Finn for us.
$#Alba(Alba)#$$&NatalieSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, um... Okay.
$#Alba(Alba)#$$&NatalieMildSurprise&$$@Center@$...
$#Alba(Alba)#$$&NatalieHappy&$$@Center@$Take care.

$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredHappyGrin&$$@Center@$Ahh, finally! Being freed from these
chains is so exhilarating!
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredHappySmile&$$@Center@$And it's so dark in here, totally my style!
$#PrisonGuardA(Prison Guard A)#$$&CamelotSoldier&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Mordred? Why aren't you in your cell?

$#PrisonGuardB(Prison Guard B)#$$&CamelotSoldier&$$@Right@$She doesn't have a weapon, we should act
quickly!
$#PrisonGuardC(Prison Guard C)#$$&CamelotSoldier&$$@Center@$Right! Return to your cell now, or else!
$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalShouting&$$@Center@$...!

$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredHappySmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ah, I remember your faces. You're the
guards who bullied me when I was little!

$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredGrinOpen&$$@Center@$Hey, you remember it too, right?
My cute crying voice from back then!

$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredShy&$$@Center@$It hurts, it hurts... Please stop...
Have mercy... And so on!

$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredColdAngry&$$@Center@$That was no joke, it really hurt, you know?
Scumbags!
$#PrisonGuardA(Prison Guard A)#$$&CamelotSoldier&$$@Center@$Ridiculous!

$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$You enjoyed doing all those things
to me behind Percival's back, didn't you?
$#PrisonGuardB(Prison Guard B)#$$&CamelotSoldier&$$@Center@$You insolent little―!

$#PrisonGuardB(Prison Guard B)#$$&CamelotSoldier&$$@Center@$Idiot!
This is what you get for mocking us!
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredColdLaugh&$$@Center@$Pfff, hahahaha!!!

$#PrisonGuardC(Prison Guard C)#$$&CamelotSoldier&$$@Center@$What... How...
The sword definitely hit her―
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSurprised&$$@Center@$Is something the matter?
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainShouting&$$@Center@$No, stay away from her!!!
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredColdGrin&$$@Center@$Too late, dummy♪
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredCrazyTongue&$$@Center@$Royal Bloodbath.
$#Prison Guards(Prison Guards)#$$!-1!$$%2%$Aaaaagh!!!

$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredHappySmile&$$@Center@$Screams of agony, just what I like ☆
Aaand they're dead meat.
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredSmirk&$$@Center@$You guys are just a bunch of wimps, huh?

$#Prison Guard(Prison Guard)#$$!-1!$$@Center@$Everyone, surround her!
Don't let her escape!

$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredGrin&$$@Center@$No need to rush, I'm not going anywhere.
I'll repay all your kindness first.
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredGrin&$$@Center@$Take this!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Brutally Killed Guard A)#$$!-1!$Gaaah!

$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalSerious&$$@Center@$I felt a disturbance at the prison.
I think my spell might have been broken.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Brutally Killed Guard B)#$Argh!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Brutally Killed Guard C)#$Nghhhhh—

$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredHappySmile&$$@Center@$Hehehe, so weak, so fragile, just a bunch
of losers♪
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$She took them all down in an instant...
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainShouting&$$@Right@$Be brave, Gareth! Let's go!
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethShouting&$$@Left@$Right behind you, sis!

$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Pfff, still tied to big sister's apron strings?
This is hilarious!
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Shut up!!!

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSurprised&$$@Right@$Gareth, don't lose your cool!
Together now—
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Royal Lunarslash!!!
$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalSerious&$$@Center@$I must go check on it immediately.
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethIrritated&$$@Center@$Royal Swiftslash!!!
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredHurt&$$@Center@$...

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSurprised&$$@Center@$She's on her knees!
We can do this!
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainShouting&$$@Center@$Let's finish this! Royal Lunar—
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredColdAngry&$$@Center@$Royal Crimsonsting.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Gawain)#$$&GawainSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Aaaah!!!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Gareth)#$$&GarethHurt&$$@Left@$Nooooo!!!

$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredSmirk&$$@Center@$Ah, so boring.
Pathetic losers, all of you♪
$#Prisoners(Prisoners)#$$!-1!$Amazing, Lady Mordred!

$#Prisoners(Prisoners)#$Take down all the guards!
Let us out too!
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotNormal&$$@Center@$Spell...?

$#Prisoners(Prisoners)#$We'll get the village's women and
children and have some fun!
$#Prisoners(Prisoners)#$Yeah, let's party!
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredColdIrritate&$$@Center@$Ugh, so noisy and stinky.
$#Prisoners(Prisoners)#$Wha... What did you say?
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredGrinOpen&$$@Center@$Just die already♪
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredHappySmile&$$@Center@$Royal Crimsonburst!
$#BrutallyKilledPrisoners(Prisoners)#$My body... Aaaaargh!!!
$#BrutallyKilledPrisoners(Prisoners)#$It burns... It buuurns! Agh...!!!
$#BrutallyKilledPrisoners(Prisoners)#$Aaaaah!!!
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredHappyGrin&$$@Center@$Ahhh, the night breeze feels so nice!

$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalSerious&$$@Center@$The chains that bound Mordred.
They were infused with weakening magic.
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredHappyGrin&$$@Center@$Mom, I finally got out! I kept my promise!
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredSerious&$$@Center@$But it looks like dawn is coming...

$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredSerious&$$@Center@$If I'm gonna do what I was planning to do
tonight, I need to hurry.
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSurprised&$$@Center@$The castle... It's in ruins...

$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalShouting&$$@Center@$No...
Somebody... Anybody, respond!!!

$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalSad&$$@Center@$Everyone's...gone?
Even all the prisoners...
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotShouting&$$@Center@$Gawain, Gareth!!!
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Lancelot... Over here.
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotAngry&$$@Left@$Gawain! Where's Gareth?
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Right@$There...

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotAngry&$$@Center@$Oh! Gawain and Gareth might be in danger,
I'm coming with you!

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethHurt&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Ouch... It hurts...
Are we dead already...
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Thank goodness...!

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I'm sorry...Sir Percival...
I couldn't protect anyone...
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethHurt&$$@Left@$Yeah, we couldn't stop her...

$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You faced Mordred. Just the fact that both
of you survived is a miracle...
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Center@$Mordred... She's not here now...
$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalShouting&$$@Center@$!

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Let's return to the village!
It might be targeted next!
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$@Right@$The village seems fine...

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSurprised&$$@Left@$Still...
Is it just me or does something feel off?

$#Alba(Alba)#$$&NatalieWorried&$$@Center@$Percival?
Where are you going at this hour?

$#GagokhalkisVillagerA(Gagokhalkis Villager A)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$!-1!$$@Left@$There they are.
Knights of the Round Table.

$#GagokhalkisVillagerB(Gagokhalkis Villager B)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Right@$No need to deliberate.
They must have done it!

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Wait a moment!
What are you talking about?

$#GagokhalkisVillageMayor(Gagokhalkis Mayor)#$$&BanditBossAngry&$$@Center@$Percival, and you all, you're coming with us.
And no talking.
$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalSerious&$$@Center@$Understood...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Adel)#$Sob...sob...

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSurprised&$$@Center@$Adel?
Why are you crying?
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Finn, what happened?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$I don't know... I just don't know...
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSerious&$$@Right@$...?

$#()#$—Before long, the sun sinks below
the horizon.
$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Center@$...
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSurprised&$$@Center@$Unwanted...?

$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Center@$A Knight of the Round Table who escaped
from prison forced himself on our mother.
$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Center@$We were the children born from that.

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Center@$So that's why you can use a skill exclusive to
the Round Table bloodline...

$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Center@$With such a lineage, we were treated like
an eyesore by the villagers. Life was hard.

$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSurprised&$$@Center@$Then, our mother fell ill and died in
suffering while we were still little.

$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseShouting&$$@Center@$All of this because of the Knights of the
Round Table. They are devils!
$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseShouting&$$@Center@$They should all die!
$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Center@$And yet...despite that...

$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Center@$Lancelot...
Why—

$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalSerious&$$@Center@$No, his tears were genuine. I have dealt
with deceitful prisoners for years, I can tell.
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSerious&$$@Center@$...Why didn't you kill me?

$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Center@$You... You remind me of my sister.
You are kind to everyone, just like her.
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotNormal&$$@Center@$I see...
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotClosedEyes&$$@Center@$—!
$#GagokhalkisVillagerA(Gagokhalkis Villager A)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Center@$She broke her restraints!?

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSmile&$$@Center@$That kind of binding doesn't phase me.
You should have tied me up more firmly.

$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Center@$So you could have escaped anytime?
You're unbelievable...
$#GagokhalkisVillagerB(Gagokhalkis Villager B)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$@Center@$What are you planning to do now!?
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSmile&$$@Center@$I will embrace you.
$#GagokhalkisVillagerC(Gagokhalkis Villager C)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Center@$Huh?
$#GagokhalkisVillageMayor(Gagokhalkis Mayor)#$$&BanditBossAngry&$$@Center@$Fine, then who did it?

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Come here, Adel. I am your sister and
mother now. Let me embrace you—
$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSurprised&$$@Left@$Are you kidding me!?
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHappy&$$@Right@$Come on. Come here.

$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSurprised&$$@Left@$Ugh... Let go, you...
How are you this strong—

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I'm not that strong. I can gently pat your
head like this too, if you wish.
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHappy&$$@Center@$It's okay, now. It's okay.
$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSurprised&$$@Center@$Ugh, let go...

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSmile&$$@Center@$People carry their sins like a burden.
Everyone does.

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSmile&$$@Center@$But remember, because there are sins, there
are also blessings.

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSmile&$$@Center@$I am sure you still have plenty of blessings
waiting for you.
$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalLookAway&$$@Center@$Well, about that...

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHappy&$$@Center@$So, live your own way. For your mother,
for your sister—All right?

$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Center@$Sermons again... I've had enough of that...
Enough...
$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Center@$...

$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalSad&$$@Center@$The cause of your, your mother's and your
sister's suffering...

$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalSad&$$@Center@$was the failure of a past Percival. The one
who allowed the prison break to happen.
$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalSad&$$@Center@$I am sorry, Adel.
$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Center@$...

$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Center@$You apologize and expect me to forgive,
but I can't.

$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Center@$But maybe I can move forward...
Maybe.

$#GagokhalkisVillagerA(Gagokhalkis Villager A)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Center@$Hey, Adel! Don't tell me you want to reconcile
with the Knights of the Round Table!?
$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalSad&$$@Center@$I am sorry. I couldn't figure it out.

$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Center@$I won't reconcile...but I won't lump them
all together anymore either. That's all.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Gagokhalkis Villager B)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$!-1!$Well, we won't forgive you, blasted knights!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Gagokhalkis Villager C)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$That's right, kill them! Kill them!

$#GagokhalkisVillageMayor(Gagokhalkis Mayor)#$$&BanditBossAngry&$$@Center@$Settle down! We've found the cause of
Alba's death. And the real culprit.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Gagokhalkis Villager A)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$So what! We've already made up our minds!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Gagokhalkis Villager B)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$Yes, let's go to war!
Kill them all or die trying—

$#???:(???)#$$&MordredGrinOpen&$$!-1!$Pfff, hehehe...
Ahahahaha♪

$#Mordred(???)#$$&MordredSmirk&$$@Center@$For a moment, I was worried that things
were going to settle down...

$#Mordred(???)#$$&MordredSmirk&$$@Center@$But this is great!
Go on, cleanse blood with more blood!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$You...
$#GagokhalkisVillageMayor(Gagokhalkis Mayor)#$$&BanditBossAngry&$$@Center@$Is that your answer, Percival?
$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalShouting&$$@Center@$Mordred...
$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I am so sorry, Lancelot...
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHappy&$$@Right@$It's not your fault. Please don't feel guilty.

$#GagokhalkisVillagerA(Gagokhalkis Villager A)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$!-1!$$@Center@$So she's the killer after all... Damn those
Round Table bastards! Execute her, now!

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Wait.
Without her, we cannot save this world.

$#GagokhalkisVillageMayor(Gagokhalkis Mayor)#$$&BanditBossAngry&$$@Center@$The time is up.
Have you found the real culprit?

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethIrritated&$$@Left@$There's no proof that Lancelot
did it anyway!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$Yes, we really don't think Lancelot did it.
Let's talk a bit more—

$#GagokhalkisVillagerB(Gagokhalkis Villager B)#$$&MaleVillagerBMob&$$!-1!$$@Center@$We've heard enough!
We won't wait any longer!

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethShocked&$$@Center@$S-Sorry!

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Now, even though I'm not permitted to
tamper with fate, I do worry about you all.
$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinWink&$$@Center@$So, just this once, I'll give you a hint.

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinComplacent&$$@Center@$This is Gagokhalkis Island—like Avalon,
a remote island in the middle of the sea.

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSurprised&$$@Center@$So, we have all been transported from
Avalon to another island?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hmm... I don't see Jeanne.
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Is everyone awake?

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinHappy&$$@Right@$The saint will join us eventually.
But this time, you're all on your own.

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Mighty Merlin... Why have you
transported us to a random island?

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinHappy&$$@Center@$Hello, Gagokhalkis?
Doesn't ring any bells?
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotNormal&$$@Center@$Gagokhalkis...

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinStare&$$@Center@$So you don't know... Unacceptable.
Ignorance is no different from sin.
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Mighty Merlin?
$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinTehepero&$$@Right@$Oops, wrong personality ☆ Teehee♪
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSad&$$@Left@$T-Teehee...?

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinComicalSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$As you are now, you're no match for
King Arthur.

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinComicalSad&$$@Center@$Here on this island awaits a great sin and
a new encounter—

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$This is...definitely not Avalon,
that's for certain.

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinHappy&$$@Center@$Find the most sinister, most dangerous
knight. And make them your ally.
$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinTehepero&$$@Center@$That's all I can say!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Merlin)#$$@Center@$Go on then! Finn the Hero,
Knights of the Round Table!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Merlin)#$$@Center@$May you save the world!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$The "most dangerous knight"... Merlin,
could you elaborate—Huh!?
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$She disappeared...?

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Right@$It is safe to assume accepted norms don't
apply to her.

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Right@$She's more faerie-like than faeries
themselves.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethTroubled&$$@Left@$Faerie-like...
But Merlin was an old man, right?

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSmile&$$@Right@$Yes, over a hundred years old...
As strange as it might seem...

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSadComical&$$@Left@$Merlin took us here with her magic,
so it must be a different place, I guess.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethLaugh&$$@Left@$Maybe she's got issues with her age?
So she compensates?

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHappy&$$@Right@$She's more like an old ghost than a faerie,
perhaps...
$#()#$$@Right@$Bam!
$#Gareth;Lancelot;(Gareth & Lancelot)#$$&GarethShocked;Lancelot.LancelotEcstasyClosedEyes&$$@Left;;;Lancelot.Right;@$Ouuuch!!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What happened to you two?

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotEcstasy&$$@Right@$I was hit in the back of the head...
Haha, a surprise attack, how lovely...

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSadComical&$$@Left@$Was that Merlin!?
I'm scared now!

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainNormal&$$@Right@$In any case, we have no choice but to do
what she asked of us.

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainNormal&$$@Right@$Let's uncover the secrets of this island and
hurry back to Camelot.

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSmile&$$@Left@$First, let's venture inland. There doesn't
seem to be anything along the coastline.
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSadComical&$$@Left@$Can't say I recognize it, though.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So, up this cliff?

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainNormal&$$@Right@$No, the soil here is fragile from the sea
breeze. Climbing would be dangerous.

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Everyone, look at that cave. I think there's
wind blowing out of it.

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainNormal&$$@Center@$Then there might be a path through. All
right, let's go through that cave.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(The "sin" Merlin mentioned...
I have no idea what she meant.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(But the answer must lie ahead.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$I must push forward.
For the sake of the world—
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSadComical&$$@Left@$Ugh... This is kind of creepy...

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Right@$You are a Knight of the Round Table,
aren't you, Gareth?

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSadComical&$$@Left@$Of course! But it feels like something
scary might pop up at any moment...
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotNormal&$$@Right@$Come to think of it, where is Merlin...?
$#()#$$&GarethSadComical&$Swoosh!
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethShocked&$$@Left@$Eeeeek!!! Something just flew past meee!!!
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSurprised&$$@Right@$An arrow!? It's a trap!
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethShocked&$$@Left@$Siiiiis!!!

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainIrritated&$$@Right@$!
Get down!!!

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSmile&$$@Right@$...Phew.
Are you hurt?
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSadComical&$$@Left@$Uh, no... What was that?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$A throwing knife coated with a lot of poison.
It doesn't really seem like a hunting trap...
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$@Right@$Then it's a trap for humans.
$#()#$Aaahhhhhhhhhhhhh!!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Don't tell me she's left us alone again!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$That voice...!
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainShouting&$$@Center@$Lancelot!!!

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSad&$$@Center@$Are you all right!?
...What are you doing?
$#LancelotWrogging(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotEcstasy&$$@Center@$Haha, quite a trap... Ahh...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$Looks like this cord conducts electricity...
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSad&$$@Right@$Why are there so many traps in this cave?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$Maybe to ward off monsters... Or people...
It's hard to say.

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSad&$$@Left@$Everyone, proceed, but stay vigilant.
We don't know what's ahead.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotEcstasy&$$!-1!$Ngh, hyaaaaaaaaaaa!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$L-Lancelot!?

$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinHappy&$$@Center@$Of course not!
Here I aaam♪
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSad&$$@Right@$...She touched it on purpose, didn't she?

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSad&$$@Center@$Let's go before she decides she wants to
stay here forever.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(There's a rope here too... A snare trap for
capturing game. Should I just jump over it?)
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$!-1!$There's a pitfall ahead.
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainIrritated&$$@Center@$Who's there?

$#Adel(Unknown Youth)#$$&BlaiseSmirk&$$@Center@$That's what I was going to ask. I heard
weird noises and came to check it out.

$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSmirk&$$@Center@$I'm Adel. I live on this island.
You guys aren't from around here, are you?

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Apologies for coming here uninvited.
I am Gawain, Knight of the Round Table.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I'm Finn from the Red Dragon Knights.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Is this a hunting ground? There are so
many traps...
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethShocked&$$@Left@$Whoa, where did you come from!?
$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSmirk&$$@Right@$No. It's just a cave.
$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Center@$So, you're Knights of the Round Table...

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You know about us?
That makes things easier.

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSmile&$$@Right@$We are looking for the most dangerous
Knight of the Round Table.
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSmile&$$@Right@$Do you know anything about them?

$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Can't say I do. And you, don't you
know where you are?

$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSmirk&$$@Center@$Even though you're Knights of the Round
Table?

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainNormal&$$@Center@$We were carried here by the currents.
We know nothing about this island.
$#Adel(Adel)#$$&BlaiseSerious&$$@Center@$Nothing...

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainNormalOpen&$$@Center@$(Did his expression just darken for a
moment...?)

keys.DescriptionKey:
A black castle tower looms over a remote island in the middle of the open sea, marking the place of exile of the disgraced Knights of the Round Table.
Normally, a prison would be rife with foul words and even fouler deeds, but here, there are none. Because from the very beginning, the one keeping this place in order was Percival, a knight recognized for his sense of justice by King Arthur himself.
The current Percival, the third warden of the prison, is just as dedicated to upholding justice, and just as feared by the inmates.

keys.IntroText:
"When you think of my power, what do you see?"
—That's what you need to ask your king.

keys.DescriptionKey: Dedicated to her mission as she was, after spending years under the constant stream of insults from her prisoners, Percival's composure finally snapped. "I'm a Knight of the Round Table, aren't I? And yet I haven't even seen the Round Table once! All I do is sit here and deal with criminals, day in, day out... I'm doing a good job, right? Right!?" "Can someone please praise me...?"

keys.DescriptionKey:

Once the suitable person, already familiar with her fellow knights, appeared on the island and had a chance to get to know her, he came to the following, inevitable conclusion.
"The Round Table certainly has a lot of unique individuals in its ranks."

keys.DescriptionKey: The eyes of the young Perry always sparkled at the sight of the exotic treasures and minerals her father brought back from his expeditions. She worked hard toward her dream, determined to one day become an adventurer who would explore unknown lands. A year ago, she finally obtained government approval and set out as an adventurer. But around that time, her father, Ganon, vanished without a word, leaving no trace.

keys.DescriptionKey:
She secured a hefty loan from the government, bought a ship, and set off for the open sea—
However, Perry soon realized the truth: if she returned with nothing to show for it, this would quickly turn into nothing more than a high-interest mega-debt cruise.
Since then, she has kept a sharp, watchful eye day and night to ensure not a single piece of equipment goes missing, and the moment she hears a rumor about treasure, she immediately jumps at the opportunity.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Before the cycle of the Pademonium began on Erden, the ancient szi had developed an advanced civilization in the Habsu Desert.

Ja'Nafaat was the head of the temple guards of Lu'Ganan, entrusted with the protection of the faithful and their place of worship. Though he and the other guards were all well-trained, they never expected deal with anything worse than the occasional rowdy visitor.

That all changed with the onset of the first Pandemonium.

PharaohLizard01.name: Ja'Nafaat
PharaohLizard01.title: Hero of Lu'Ganan
PharaohLizard01.description:
Before the cycle of the Pademonium began on Erden, the ancient szi had developed an advanced civilization in the Habsu Desert.

Ja'Nafaat was the head of the temple guards of Lu'Ganan, entrusted with the protection of the faithful and their place of worship. Though he and the other guards were all well-trained, they never expected deal with anything worse than the occasional rowdy visitor.

That all changed with the onset of the first Pandemonium.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The invading hordes quickly devastated the szi civilization, and the survivors flocked to the temple of Lu'Ganan in hopes that their gods would provide them protection. Suddenly burdened with the task of defending these refugees from a bloodthirsty foe unlike anything they had encountered before, Ja'Nafaat felt overwhelmed.

Yet he refused to let his people and gods down. With uncharacteristic ferocity, he led the temple guards to successfully drive the enemy back after a six-day siege. The grateful refugees immortalized his name as one of the greatest warriors in szi history.

When this unit enters battle, this unit is granted a Sleep Ward, Stun Ward, Poison Ward, and Burn Ward.

This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

When this unit defeats any number of enemies with an attack while on the battlefield, at the end of the turn this unit is healed for 1% of max HP and gains one of the following Melodies at random:
- Water Melody: Grants this unit Sleep Immunity.
- Storm Melody:  Grants this unit Stun Immunity.
- Earth Melody: Grants this unit Poison Immunity.
- Fire Melody: Grants this unit Burn Immunity.

PinkHairWitch01.name: Petra
PinkHairWitch01.title: Moonglow Witch
PinkHairWitch01.description: When Petra was a young girl, her mother gave her a rock she said was from the moon. Ever since, Petra's studied magic by way of moon veneration. She believes her magic will not work if she sleeps at night.

keys.DescriptionKey: Petra's moon magic requires sacrifice. However, this isn't sacrifice of life—it's sacrifice of sleep. She wakes others to interrupt their rest and leave them tired as part of her nightly rituals.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSick&$$@Left@$We shouldn't have snuck out... The nurse's
scolding was too scary...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Left@$Me too.

$#FlusteredKnight(Flustered Knight)#$$!-1!$Captain Zhuge Liang! Can I have a
moment!

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingDoya&$$@Center@$Is this in regard to the aftermath report?
If so, ask Vice-Captain Clare.

$#FlusteredKnight(Flustered Knight)#$The vice‑captain is missing! We're
searching now—
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingNormal&$$@Center@$Clare is missing...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Was she kidnapped by a remnant of the
gang?

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingNormal&$$@Right@$This is a serious situation. I shall join the
search.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I'm coming too!

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingConsider&$$@Center@$No, you remain here—the next scolding
will be worse.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHeh&$$@Center@$Then I'll take it. I'm going too, Zhuge Liang!

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingPale&$$@Right@$Indeed... That was the first time that I,
Zhuge Liang, felt the grasp of death...

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingDoya&$$@Center@$Hm... You've demonstrated a perceptive
insight. Well done, Theo.
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Fine—lend a hand!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHeh&$$@Left@$Yes—let's find Clare!
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSurprised&$$@Center@$(I was transported in an instant!?)
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSurprised&$$@Center@$(An illusion? No... Doesn't feel like magic.)
$#Pinocchio(Bold Girl)#$$&PinocchioHeh&$$@Center@$This is your Corridor of Memories.

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSerious&$$@Center@$(Looks like the same girl, but she seems
totally different...)
$#Pinocchio(Bold Girl)#$$&PinocchioHeh&$$@Center@$Hey, you listening?
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSerious&$$@Center@$Yes, I hear you. Who are you?
$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioHeh&$$@Center@$I'm Pinocchio.
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSuperShock&$$@Right@$Terrifying...
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSurprised&$$@Center@$Really? You seem so different from earlier.
$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioHeh&$$@Center@$Look the same, don't I? Quit the nonsense.
$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioHeh&$$@Center@$Who I am ain't the issue.
$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioHeh&$$@Center@$The issue is—we're in your memories.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSerious&$$@Center@$Inside my memories? What do you mean?
$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioHeh&$$@Center@$Here, I'll open a door—
$#()#$$&ClareSurprised&$$@Center@$(The scene changed again!?)

$#()#$$&ClareSurprised&$$@Center@$(I recognize this place. It's the forest near
my hometown.)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Clare)#$$!-1!$Rizette! Why won't you visit me anymore?
$#()#$$&ClareSad&$$@Center@$(That's me!— Rizette's there too.)

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Still, today you helped greatly. I thank
you, Theo.
$#()#$$&ClareSad&$$@Center@$(That's right! I went to see Rizette.)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Rizette)#$$!-1!$I don't have time...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Clare)#$Liar! You just hate being with me!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Rizette)#$That's not true, Clare!!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Clare)#$You said we'd be friends forever...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Clare)#$Fine—I don't care about you anymore!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Clare)#$Liar Rizette!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Rizette)#$Clare, wait!!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Rizette)#$Clare...
$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioHeh&$$@Center@$Why did you blame Rizette that day?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Center@$It was nothing—I just did what I could.
$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioHeh&$$@Center@$You knew tragedy struck her family.
$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioHeh&$$@Center@$She had to work to feed her little brother.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSleep&$$@Center@$...

$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioHeh&$$@Center@$Yet you called your friend a liar and
pushed her away.

$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioHeh&$$@Center@$Then the Pandemonium began, and you
had no chance to apologize.

$#()#$(This is the Pandemonium... On that day...
The day the village was wiped out...?)
$#PandemoniumBeasts(Pandemonium Beasts)#$GUGAA!! GOOOHH!!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Clare)#$$&ClareCrying&$So many monsters! The village is burning!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Clare)#$$&ClareCrying&$Mom! Dad!!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Clare)#$$&ClareCrying&$Someone...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Zhuge Liang, are the Silver Knights really
going to end?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Clare)#$Save me, Rizette—!!

$#()#$(Stop!—Don't show me these memories
anymore...)

$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioEvilTongue&$$@Center@$Yes, scream!
Maybe this time she'll come!
$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioEvilTongue&$$@Center@$Your best friend Rizette!
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingNormal&$$@Right@$There is no indication of her...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$Where could Clare be...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Rizette's Voice)#$Clare! Clare!! Somebody help!!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Left@$Riz's voice? Clare's in trouble!
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSerious&$$@Right@$Let us go!
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$@Right@$Yes. We shall become a Bergarian unit.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$@Right@$C‑Clare!? A sword has pierced her body!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$Wait, Theo! Don't get close!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$@Right@$Why, Riz!? We have to help!

$#SilverKnight(Silver Knight)#$The soldiers who got close went mad.
Many are now in the hospital...
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$So, that sword is the cause, is it?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Center@$Yeah, it's probably Pinocchio's sword.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Center@$Pinocchio?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Center@$A strange girl—she lures you into the
Corridor of Memories with that sword.
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingNormal&$$@Center@$Corridor of Memories...?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Center@$A world where you can see a person's
memories. She took me into her own.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Left@$I see...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Center@$If the sword's in Clare, Pinocchio's likely
inside Clare's memories right now.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Center@$There's no blood—she seems to just be
sleeping.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Center@$Maybe only her consciousness was pulled
inside.

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$@Center@$So we must enter that world to save her.
Straightforward, it would seem.
$#SilverKnight(Silver Knight)#$But you'll go mad!

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$@Center@$It is a risk worth taking to save my
subordinate.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Center@$Clare's my best friend. I have to help her!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$@Center@$Clare is waiting!

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Center@$There you have it. I entrust the rest of
this matter to you.
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Center@$All right, onwards!

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$@Right@$I pray we never meet you on the
battlefield.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSurprised&$$@Center@$Wh‑What's happening!?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Center@$Pinocchio's here.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Rizette?
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmirkComical&$$@Right@$Are you crying?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizettePanic&$$@Left@$I‑I'm not crying!

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareHehTangue&$$@Right@$Your eyes sure look watery. You were
worried that much?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBlushConfuse&$$@Left@$S‑Shut up!
Dummy Clare!
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareConfuse&$$@Right@$H‑Hey! Don't hug me so suddenly...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBlushConfuse&$$@Left@$Of course I was worried!
You're my precious friend!
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmirk&$$@Right@$...
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmirk&$$@Right@$Yeah... Sorry to make you worry.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmirk&$$@Right@$Thank you, Rizette—my dear friend.
$#PinocchioA(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioMadSmile&$$@Center@$Everything... Everything...
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingDoya&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Friendship is wonderful, indeed.
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingDoya&$$@Center@$Much like when fish and water intertwine.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Center@$What does that mean...?
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingDoya&$$@Center@$I... I don't know...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareConfuse&$$@Center@$...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteScared&$$@Right@$...

$#()#$—The sun rose and fell, and several days
passed...
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingEat&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Mm. Yum, yum—seconds, please.

$#Nurse(Nurse)#$$&BanditBossShocked&$$@Left@$You're being discharged today!
Hurry up and get ready!

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSerious&$$@Center@$Something is very off. Both her movements
and voice...
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingShock&$$@Right@$Hmm... Scolded once again...
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmirkComicalAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Don't cause trouble, Zhuge Liang.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHappySmile&$$@Right@$But I'm glad you healed enough to walk!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Congrats on being released!
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$@Right@$I extend my gratitude to each of you.

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$@Right@$Theo, you were discharged ahead of me,
and it got lonely, you know.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Left@$H‑Huh, really?

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingConsider&$$@Right@$Indeed. I refuse to go through that again.
Therefore, become my little brother!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Left@$Huh? Your brother!? Um—
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Center@$No way! I'm his one and only big sister!
$#PinocchioB(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioHeh&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Me... I... We... ALL OF US!!

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hmm... Then you too shall become my 
sister, Rizette. The matter is resolved.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareConfuse&$$@Center@$A‑Again spouting nonsense...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSighComical&$$@Center@$I-I'm not sure what to do.
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Well, enough joking—
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$@Left@$So it was just a joke!?

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$In two days, Bergarian troops will garrison
here. I advise you to leave town soon.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Center@$That soon...?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprisedOpen&$$@Center@$We should depart at once!
Let's pack up, Theo!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Center@$Right, gather our things!
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSad&$$@Center@$...
$#PinocchioC(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioSadWink&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Everything, everything, EVERYTHING—
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$@Center@$Something wrong, Clare?
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareShy&$$@Center@$No, nothing...!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Center@$Thank you for seeing us off.
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$@Center@$Think nothing of it—you helped us greatly.

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmile&$$@Center@$Both of you take care. Please avoid
sickness and injury.

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmile&$$@Center@$Now go along, before the Bergarian troops
arrive.
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingConsider&$$@Center@$No, Clare—you shall accompany them.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSurprised&$$@Center@$Accompany them...?

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingShouting&$$@Center@$Vice‑captain Clare, you are dismissed!
Effective immediately!
$#Clare(Clare)#$$@Center@$Dismissed!? I didn't—
$#PinocchioD;PinocchioC;PinocchioB(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioMad;PinocchioC.PinocchioMad;PinocchioB.PinocchioMad&$$!-1!$$@Right;;;PinocchioC.Center;PinocchioB.Left;@$WAS A LIE!!

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingDoya&$$@Center@$You have long-standing associations with
two individuals wanted by Bergarian

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingRelax&$$@Center@$central command. I shall report that there
were signs of rebellion.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSurprised&$$@Center@$That's outrageous!
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$@Center@$It is merely a pretext, of course.

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$@Center@$Choose your own path, Clare. You do not
wish to serve Bergaria, correct?

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$@Center@$You have friends to walk beside you.
Uphold your knightly oath, Clare.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSadSmile&$$@Center@$Zhuge Liang...

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSadSmile&$$@Center@$Thank you.
Rizette, is that okay?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHappySmile&$$@Center@$Of course—Clare's always welcome!

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareHappySmile&$$@Center@$All right then. Captain Zhuge Liang of the
Silver Knights First Unit, I, Clare,
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$There are many Pinocchios!?
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareHappySmile&$$@Center@$humbly accept the dismissal.

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$@Center@$You shall fare well wherever you go.
Take care, Clare.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareHappy&$$@Center@$Yes! Thank you for everything!

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$@Center@$Farewell, all! I pray for your success
under the sun!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Left@$Essera is far behind now.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmile&$$@Right@$We've come quite a distance.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$By the way, Clare, do you have any
lingering memory issues?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCalm&$$@Center@$Pinocchio did say she linked her corridor
to yours.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmile&$$@Center@$I'm fine now.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHappySmile&$$@Center@$Thank goodness!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Center@$All are separate personalities, I think.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Center@$I wonder if Pinocchio's still alive
somewhere...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Center@$Maybe she is, clinging to someone's
memories.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareHappySmile&$$@Center@$Theo, you sound so grown‑up now.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Center@$I am?

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareHappySmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Hey, why don't you try calling me
Big‑sis Clare?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Left@$Um... Big‑sis Cl—

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Center@$Nooo! Stooop!!
Clare!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Remember, you're the lowest rank here!
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSneer&$$@Right@$Shush, Rizette. Ever heard of a takeover?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Left@$Yes I have, and I'll never let you do it!
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareShouting&$$@Right@$That many!?
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareHehTangue&$$@Right@$Enjoy being on top while you can, Captain Rizette!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Left@$Hey—get back here, Clare!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hmm, I thought they'd made up already...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Center@$Well, maybe this is another form of a
perfect duo.

$#PinocchioD;PinocchioC;PinocchioB(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioMad;PinocchioC.PinocchioHappy;PinocchioB.PinocchioHeh&$$@Right;;;PinocchioC.Center;PinocchioB.Left;@$Don't believe... Can't believe... Won't
believe...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Center@$Th-This world is...!

$#PinocchioD;PinocchioC;PinocchioB(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioSadOpen;PinocchioC.PinocchioBlushHurt;PinocchioB.PinocchioMad&$$!-1!$$@Right;;;PinocchioC.Center;PinocchioB.Left;@$I, me, we... Don't believe...
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ready yourselves—they are coming.
$#PinocchioD;PinocchioC;PinocchioB(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioMad;PinocchioC.PinocchioMad;PinocchioB.PinocchioMad&$$@Right;;;PinocchioC.Center;PinocchioB.Left;@$I WON'T BELIEEEEEEVE!!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHurt&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Whoa!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHurt&$$@Left@$Theo—ugh!
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareHurt&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Such power—!?

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingNormal&$$@Right@$This is her world. It appears it is true that
she is the strongest here.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Pinocchio, stop!
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$N‑No effect!?
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSerious&$$@Center@$Step aside—I shall handle this.
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingDoya&$$@Center@$Collapsing, indeed...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Center@$You can't handle it alone—!

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$@Center@$One cannot obtain a tiger cub without
entering its den, as they say...
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$@Center@$Though the meaning escapes me.
$#PinocchioD;PinocchioC;PinocchioB(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioMad;PinocchioC.PinocchioMad;PinocchioB.PinocchioMad&$$!-1!$$@Right;;;PinocchioC.Center;PinocchioB.Left;@$HAAAAAA!!!!
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSerious&$$@Center@$Umph... Impressive strength...

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingSmile&$$@Center@$Brute force is predictable, however, and I
can read your unsettled heart!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Center@$Amazing! She's parrying all their blows!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Center@$But against that many...
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSerious&$$@Center@$No, she won't lose. Zhuge Liang won't lose!
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingShouting&$$@Center@$There!
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSerious&$$@Center@$Why all of a sudden!?
$#PinocchioB;PinocchioA;PinocchioC(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioSadWink;PinocchioA.PinocchioSerious;PinocchioC.PinocchioHeh&$$@Right;;;PinocchioA.Center;PinocchioC.Left;@$Gugh...aaah!!

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Incredible, she's downing them one after
another...
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingNormal&$$@Center@$You are the last one.
$#PinocchioD(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioHurt&$$@Center@$S-Stay away!
$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingNormal&$$@Center@$Surrender—you can still start over.

$#PinocchioD(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioMad&$$@Center@$Don't believe... WON'T BELIEVE!
Mama and Papa are REAL!!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHurt&$$@Center@$The corridor's collapsing!

$#ZhueLiang(Zhuge Liang)#$$&KongmingNormal&$$@Right@$I received word that bandits have
appeared in the neighboring town.

$#BanditA(Bandit A)#$Tch—Outta the way or you're gonna get
some!
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmirk&$$@Center@$Oh? And what would that look like?
$#BanditA(Bandit A)#$Cheeky wench—Take this!!
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareHehTangue&$$@Center@$Too slow—!
$#BanditA(Bandit A)#$Gagh...
$#BanditB(Bandit B)#$What the— What just happened...?

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareHehTangue&$$@Center@$Just a single swing of my sword. If your
eyes can't follow, you can't win.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareHehTangue&$$@Center@$Take my advice: just give it up quietly.
$#BanditB(Bandit B)#$Who the hell are you!?

$#BanditC(Bandit C)#$I know her... That's Clare of the Silver 
Knights!
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareConfuse&$$@Left@$Ah, that explains it.

$#BanditB(Bandit B)#$Clare!? The one from Othlon—one of those
Knights of Justice!?
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareConfuse&$$@Center@$(Great, my cover is blown...)
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmirkComicalAngry&$$@Center@$Y‑You're mistaken.
$#BanditB(Bandit B)#$Says she's not...
$#BanditC(Bandit C)#$Really? Sure looks like her...
$#Militia(Militia)#$$!-1!$Militia! Where are the thieves!?
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareConfuse&$$@Center@$(Good... I'll leave the rest to them!)
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareNormal&$$@Center@$(Knights of Justice, huh...)

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareNormal&$$@Center@$(Who knew there'd come a day when we
would have to let go of that title...)

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareNormal&$$@Center@$(Busy day. Better get to bed early and be
ready for tomorrow...)

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareConfuse&$$@Left@$You were heading to the next town, went into
the forest—and wandered in circles, right?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Center@$Clare?
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Rizette!? Wh‑Why are you here!?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteLookaway&$$@Left@$Just booked a room. There are fewer inns
here than in the city—so it happens, right?
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareConfuse&$$@Right@$Y‑Yeah, but... Next door to mine...?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$@Left@$Funny how coincidences work.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hey, wanna chat? We're neighbors again.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareLookawayPout&$$@Center@$Why should I? With you of all people...

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareLookawayPout&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I'd rather talk to a hippopotamus than to
you!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBlushConfuse&$$@Left@$Hippos don't talk...
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmirkComicalAngry&$$@Right@$Shut up...ugh.

$#Clare(???)#$$&ClareSurprised&$$@Center@$I thought so! I would never mistake you
for anyone else!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&ClareSurprised&$$@Left@$Just a mild cold. The doctor said I'll be
fine soon.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSadSmile&$$@Right@$I see. Take care!

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmirkComical&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Well, at least I don't need to worry about
you, Rizette.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGrit&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What's that supposed to mean?

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSneer&$$@Right@$Back home we say, "Idiots never catch
colds."
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteShock&$$@Left@$A‑Are you calling me an idiot!?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoCommand&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Come to think of it, didn't they part after
a fight...?)

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmirk&$$@Center@$Must be tough having a big sister like
this, Theo.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareHappy&$$@Center@$Oh, want to become my little brother instead?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Your little brother...
$#Clare(???)#$$&ClareSurprised&$$@Center@$Rizette, Theo!!

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareHehTangue&$$@Right@$Yes! I've always thought Rizette wasn't
cut out to be a big sister!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Left@$Hey! Theo is my brother! I'm not giving him to anyone—especially you, Clare!
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmirk&$$@Right@$Sigh... So brother-obsessed...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizettePanic&$$@Left@$I am not!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Uh, guys... We're in a hospital...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteClosedDetermined&$$@Left@$Clare, you used to be way more lovable,
you know?
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSneer&$$@Right@$And you haven't changed one bit, Rizette.
$#Nurse(Nurse)#$$&BanditBossShocked&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Hey! Keep it down!!

$#Nurse(Nurse)#$$&BanditBossShocked&$$@Center@$Do you know where you are!? If you want
to fight, do it outside!!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizettePanic&$$@Left@$S‑Sorry...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprisedOpen&$$@Center@$Clare... Is it really you!?
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareConfuse&$$@Right@$We won't do it again...
$#Nurse(Nurse)#$$&BanditBossAngry&$$@Center@$See that you don't!!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBlushConfuse&$$@Left@$Scary nurse...

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareConfuse&$$@Right@$More a warrior in white than an angel in
white...
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Sorry, Theo. Did all that noise bother you?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteScared&$$@Center@$Yeah, sorry.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Center@$No, it actually cheered me up! cough cough...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Don't push yourself, Theo.

$#TheoFlip(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$Heh, sorry... By the way, Clare, why are
you at the hospital?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$Oh yeah—Clare, are you hurt?
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmile&$$@Center@$Yes. Long time no see, you two.

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareLookaway&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No, I'm fine. I came because a friend of mine
was injured.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmirkComicalPout&$$@Center@$But it looks like she's gone...

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmirkComicalPout&$$@Center@$Always disappearing... Honestly, doesn't
understand her position...

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmile&$$@Center@$Well, I'll be off. Theo, make sure you rest
well.
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSmirkComicalAngry&$$@Center@$And Rizette...see you later.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Center@$She said "later," Riz.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSighComical&$$@Center@$She couldn't be any more difficult...
Ugh, she got me heated.

$#TheoFlip(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I haven't seen you act like that in ages, Riz.
It's like we were kids again.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$Yeah... Maybe I've been too tense lately
with everything going on.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$I feel like meeting Clare gave me a spark
of energy.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHappy&$$@Center@$Thank goodness you're alive...
$#TheoFlip(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Right@$Yeah, I kinda feel that too!
$#TheoFlip(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$Sorry, Riz, mind if I nap?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHappySmile&$$@Left@$Sure, it's for the best. Get some good rest.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGentleSmile&$$@Center@$(I never expected to reunite with Clare in
a place like this.)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGentleSmile&$$@Center@$("See you later," huh... Next time, I want
to meet without getting into a fight.)
$#Pinocchio(Panicked Girl)#$$&PinocchioSadOpen&$$@Center@$Oh no, no, no.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Center@$Huh, that girl—
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Center@$(She dropped her apples. I'll help her!)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Center@$Are you okay? Is this everything you
dropped?
$#Pinocchio(Panicked Girl)#$$&PinocchioSad&$$@Center@$Th‑Thank you so much... Yeah... That's all.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Clare, as in the Clare from the next village?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Center@$(Huh? She acts younger than she looks...)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSuperHappy&$$@Center@$Good. Try not to drop them again, okay?
$#Pinocchio(Panicked Girl)#$$&PinocchioSad&$$@Center@$W-Wait. Um, I... I want to thank you.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Center@$No need. I only picked up your apples.

$#Pinocchio(Panicked Girl)#$$&PinocchioSad&$$@Center@$Even so, you helped me! So please, take
me to your home...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Center@$My home? Sorry, I can't do that.
$#Pinocchio(Panicked Girl)#$$&PinocchioSad&$$@Center@$You can't...?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Center@$My house is gone. So even if I wanted to, I
couldn't take you there.
$#Pinocchio(Panicked Girl)#$$&PinocchioSad&$$@Center@$I‑I see... Your house is gone...
$#Pinocchio(Panicked Girl)#$$&PinocchioSad&$$@Center@$But it's okay. You can't lose your home.

$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareHappySmile&$$@Right@$I'm glad you're doing well too, Theo. I was
worried.
$#Pinocchio(Panicked Girl)#$$&PinocchioMadSmile&$$@Center@$It's always right here.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Center@$(Is that a key‑shaped...sword?)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteScared&$$@Center@$(I just got a creepy chill...)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteScared&$$@Center@$Hey, who are you?

$#Pinocchio(Panicked Girl)#$$&PinocchioNormalSmile&$$@Center@$You're Rizette, right? I've been looking for
you.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteScared&$$@Center@$H‑How do you know my name? And...you
were looking for me?
$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioNormalSmile&$$@Center@$I'm Pinocchio...

$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioNormalSmile&$$@Center@$I asked lots of people. Entered plenty of
homes.
$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioNormalSmile&$$@Center@$Let me enter your home...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHurt&$$@Center@$Ngh...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHurt&$$@Left@$Yeah! cough cough...
$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioSurprised&$$@Center@$!?
$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioSurprised&$$@Center@$It...was repelled?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHurt&$$@Center@$(She doesn't look like a Bergarian
operative, but it feels too dangerous!)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHurt&$$@Center@$(I have to run!)
$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioSad&$$@Center@$She's gone...

$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioSad&$$@Center@$Why couldn't I peek inside? Something
was blocking me...
$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioHappy&$$@Center@$Oh, I see, that must be...
$#Pinocchio(Pinocchio)#$$&PinocchioHappy&$$@Center@$The Cerulean power!
$#Clare(Clare)#$$&ClareSurprised&$$@Right@$Theo, are you all right!?

Tell me...
Do you hold the key to my heart?

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Where are my mama and papa?"

keys.DescriptionKey:
This unit is not affected by stun effects.

This unit will gain a Charge each time it attacks and does not defeat any non-conjured enemies.

When this unit enters battle:
- If this unit is not conjured, it will have Hold Ground (If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP).
- If this unit is conjured, this unit will Endure the next damage that would defeat it with 1HP. Endure effects cannot stack.

Whenever this unit defeats any number of non-conjured enemies with an attack:
- An Elmina will be added to the front of allied reinforcements. This effect cannot trigger if there are 8 or more "Elmina, Moonveiled Agent" in the ally team.
- Then all charges are removed from this unit.

Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store up to 3 charges and all charges are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield. All Elmina's created by this unit will have matching Levels, Limit Breaks, Awakenings, Boosts, Potential, Mastery, Weapons, and Accessories.
