keys.DescriptionKey:
Triggered the first time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, and when this unit activates Elmina Unleashed:
- All allies will be Purified (any negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed).
- Then all other ally units will be given the next turns by having their TU reduced. Active skills that grant turns cannot be used by those allies until after they have had the turn.

These effects will each only trigger once each time this unit is on the battlefield, and only if this unit entered the battlefield from reinforcements.

Each time this unit damages at least one enemy with an attack and leaves them on or below 10% of max HP (even if they are defeated by the attack), this unit will get another turn. Damaged targets cannot trigger this effect again until TU advances.

Effects that influence TU order may interrupt extra turns (e.g. Stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

keys.DescriptionKey:
Thank you for playing Evertale. We would like to announce some changes to how different types of Poison status effects will overwrite each other:

- The Super Poison status effect could not previously be overwritten by other poisons. It can now be overwritten by Mega Poison. Normal Poison still cannot overwrite the Super Poison status effect.
- The Mega Poison status effect can no longer be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison.

These changes will already be active as of this announcement. Please note that Arena replays from battles conducted before these changes may resolve differently from the recorded result.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing Evertale!

keys.DescriptionKey:
If this unit would be defeated by an attack while there is a Poisoned enemy on the battlefield, this unit will survive with 1HP remaining instead. Then this unit will remove poison (including Lethal Poison) from a random poisoned enemy at the end of turn.

This unit's Attack is increased by:
- 1.05x if there is exactly 1 Poisoned enemy on the battlefield.
- 1.1x if there are exactly 2 Poisoned enemies on the battlefield.
- 1.15x if there are exactly 3 Poisoned enemies on the battlefield.
- 1.20x if there are exactly 4 Poisoned enemies on the battlefield.
These Attack increases do not stack with Enrage effects.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Stuns 1 Mega Poisoned enemy for 200TU. Then, grants them a Burn Ward and the Lethal Poison status effect for 999TU. These effects can only apply if the target is Mega Poisoned. This skill can be redirected by enemy Stun Absorbers. Usable only if there is no more than 1 enemy with the Lethal Poison status effect on the battlefield, and cannot be used if there is a non-Mega Poisoned enemy Stun Absorber on the battlefield.

Burn Wards prevent Burn from being applied once, then are removed. Burn Wards cannot stack. Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects on that enemy, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning units or Boss units.

ZigZaGame INC.
PRIVACY POLICY
 
@@Last Updated: March 3, 2019
This Privacy Policy explains how information about you is collected, used and disclosed by ZigZaGame Inc., (“ZIGZA”, “us”, “we” or “our”) when you use our websites, games, mobile applications and other online products and services that contain this policy (collectively, the “Services”) or when you otherwise interact with us. ZIGZA is the data controller of your personal information for purposes of the EU General Data Protection Regulations (GDPR).
We may change this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make changes, we will notify you by revising the date at the top of the Privacy Policy and, in some cases, we may provide you with additional notice (such as by adding a statement to the homepage of our Services or sending you a notification). If you do not agree to the changes, please do not use our Services or otherwise provide us with your personal information.  We encourage you to review the Privacy Policy whenever you access the Services to stay informed about our personal information practices and the ways you can take appropriate steps to protect your privacy.
I.                    Collection of Information
Information You Provide to Us
We collect information you provide directly to us via your access or use of the Services. For example, we collect information when you create an account, interact with other users, request customer support, sign up to receive newsletters, participate in surveys or otherwise communicate with us. The types of information we may collect include your username, password, email address and any other information you choose to provide.
Information We Collect Automatically When You Use the Services
When you access or use our Services, in addition to information that you provide directly to us, we also automatically collect certain other information about you, including:
·         Usage Information: We collect information about your use of our Services, including gaming service ID, levels completed, game scores, time spent using our Services, and other game play information.
·         Log Information: We log information about your use of our Services, including your browser type and language, access times, pages viewed, your IP address and the website you visited before navigating to our Services.
·         Hardware Information: We collect information about the computer or device you use to access our Services, including the hardware model, operating system and version, browser  mobile network information, list of other ZIGZA mobile applications installed on the device, MAC address, IP address, International Mobile Equipment Identity (“IMEI”) number and other unique device identifiers made available by the operating system of your device.
·         Location Information: We may collect information regarding the geographic location of your device each time you use the Services as provided on iOS or Android platforms, to the extent the setting on your device allowed such geographical location information to be collected. You may opt-out of such collection of your geographic location information by changing the settings on your device. Your location information is stored for the period specified in the Services before collection.
·         Information Collected by Cookies and Other Tracking Technologies: We use various technologies to collect information about your experience with the Services, and this may include sending cookies to your computer or mobile device. “Cookies” are small data files stored on your computer hard drive or in device memory that help us to improve our Services and your experience, as well as allow us to see which areas and features of our Services are popular with our users and to count visits. 
Information We Collect From Other Sources
We may also obtain information from other third party sources as far as it is necessary to perform our Services, and combine that with information we collect through our Services either directly as provided from you or automatically via your use and/or access. For instance, we may collect game ranking and achievement status from your console or mobile operating system game center application. Additionally, when you complete in-app purchases related to the Services, we may collect information about you from the provider of your device operating system when they process the in-app purchases on our behalf. Please note that we do not receive your payment method information from these operating system providers. In all other cases, we will ask you to authorize us to collect, store, and use your personal information from third parties.
II.                 Use of Information
We only collect, store and use your information if you have consented to it or, to the extent that it is necessary (i) for the performance of your agreement with us; (ii) to comply with our legal obligations; or (iii) for the purpose of our legitimate interests, including operating, evaluating and improving our global business. We have carefully balanced our legitimate business interests against your data protection rights. Please contact us using the contact details provided below if you have questions on this balancing of interests.
We (or a third party data processor acting upon our instruction) may collect, store and use information about you for the following purposes, for the periods necessary to achieve such purposes:
·         Provide, maintain and improve our Services;
·         Provide and deliver the products and services you request, process transactions and send you related information;
·         Register you for an account on our Services and assist in the management of your account
·         Respond to your comments, questions and requests and provide customer service;
·         Send you technical notices, updates, security alerts and support and administrative messages;
·         Communicate with you about products, services, offers, promotions, rewards, and events offered by ZIGZA and our other business partners, and provide news, information and other marketing materials that we think will be of interest to you;
·         Monitor and analyze trends, usage and activities in connection with our Services;
·         Process and deliver contest entries and rewards promoted by ZIGZA;
·         Personalize and improve the Services and provide in-Service advertisements, content or features that match user profiles or interests;
·         Link or combine with information we collect from other third parties to help understand your needs and provide you with better service;
·         Detect, investigate and/or prevent fraudulent, unauthorized or illegal activity;
·         For any other purpose required or authorized for us to comply with our legal and regulatory obligations; and
·         For any other specific and clear purpose for which you provided the information.
III.               Sharing of Information
We do not share, sell, transfer or otherwise exchange your personal information with third parties, unless required for the provision of our Services, otherwise in accordance with this Privacy Policy, or permitted by law, or unless you have given us prior consent to do so. In compliance with the aforementioned, we may share information about you as follows or as otherwise described in this Privacy Policy:
·         With other users if you choose to participate in the interactive areas of our Services, such as community forums (however, the use of personally identifiable data (such as your full name) as a username in our services is strictly prohibited under our Service terms of use);
·         With our employees, affiliates, related companies, vendors, consultants and third party service providers who need access to such information to carry out work on our behalf (including, for example, payment processors, website hosting services, or information storage and processing service providers);
·         In response to legal process or a request for information if disclosure is in accordance with, or as otherwise required by, any applicable law, rule, or regulation (including, for example government or regulatory bodies, law enforcement agencies, or competent courts of law);
·         With law enforcement agencies, government authorities, third party service providers and professional advisors (such as legal counsel) if we have reasonable grounds to believe your actions are inconsistent with our user agreements or policies, or to protect the rights, property and safety of ZIGZA, our users or others;
·         In connection with any merger, sale of company assets, financing or acquisition of all or a portion of our business to another company; and
·         With your consent or at your direction.
IV.                Advertising and Analytics Services Provided by Others
We may allow other third parties to provide analytics services on our behalf and to serve advertisements within our Services.  These entities may use technologies to automatically collect information about your device and your use of our Services, including IP address, device ID, time spent on pages within our Services, and links clicked within our Services.  This information may be used by us and others to, among other things, maintain, improve, and analyze the functioning of our Services and deliver contextual or targeted advertising that may be of interest to you. The use of your information by these third parties is covered by their respective privacy policies, and we do not control and are not responsible for the privacy practices of such third parties.
Some of our Services will, with your prior consent, combine game play and analytic information with information collected from other ZigZaGame Inc. games, games from our group companies, and other third party sources to analyze game and monetization trends, create profiles of categories of players, create new games and services, and perform other analytics. We also use certain information collected through our games for advertisement targeting outside of the game. This includes creating profiles of types of players by combining your data with information from our advertising partners, providing the data to our ad agencies and ad platforms to target advertisements of our (and our group company) games and services to you outside of this game, and otherwise performing advertising analytics and performance metrics.
V.                  Social Sharing Feature
The Services may offer social sharing features or other tools, which let you share actions or link the Services with social media.  The use of such features enables the sharing of information with your friends or the public, depending on the settings you establish with the social media platform.  For more information about the purpose and scope of data collection and processing in connection with social sharing features, please visit the privacy policies of the social media platforms. Please note that we do not control and are not responsible for the privacy practices of such social media platforms.
VI.               Security
We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to help protect information about you from loss, theft, misuse and unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration and destruction. However, no transmission over the internet can ever be guaranteed secure so we cannot guarantee the security of any personal information that you transfer over the internet to us.
VII.             Storing and deleting data
Personal information collected through the Services is being stored and deleted in compliance with this Privacy Policy as well as privacy requirements under applicable law. All data will be de-identified or deleted if no longer required for the purposes mentioned above, unless further retention is required by law. Please contact us using the contact details provided below, if you have any questions with respect to our data retention practices. 
VIII.          International Transfers
We are based in Japan, and personal information that we collect from you is usually transferred, stored and processed in Japan. Therefore, please be aware that we may transfer your personal information to locations outside of your country, including Japan, which may not offer the same level of data protection as your country's laws. However, our collection, storage and use of your personal information will continue to be governed by this Privacy Policy, and where we do disclose your personal information to third parties located overseas, we take such steps as are reasonable in the circumstances to ensure it is used in accordance with this Privacy Policy.
IX.               Third Party Sites
Our Services contains links to other websites  or services operated by third parties.  Please note that this Privacy Policy applies only to our Services and we cannot be responsible for personal information that third parties may collect, store and use through their website.  You should always read the privacy policy of each website you visit carefully.
X.                  Push Notifications/Alerts
ZIGZA may send push notifications or alerts to your device. You can deactivate these messages at any time by changing the notification settings on your device. ZIGZA will send push notifications or alerts with promotional content only after your prior opt-in to receiving such messages on your device.
XI.               Data Protection Rights
You, and your legal guardian if you are a minor, may be able to exercise certain data protection rights under applicable law. Your rights under applicable law may include:

·         The right to have personal information corrected or erased,
·         The right to restrict the processing of your personal information,
·         The right to withdraw your consent at any time for consent we have obtained from you, although this will not affect the lawfulness of the processing prior to the withdrawal.
·         You have also have the right to object, at any time, to the processing of your personal information which is based on ZIGZAS's legitimate interests.
·         Where we process your personal information for direct marketing purposes, you have the right to object at any time to such processing, including for profiling purposes to the extent that it is related to direct marketing. If you object to processing for direct marketing purposes, we will no longer process your personal information for such purposes. In that case we may still send you transactional or relationship messages, but only about our ongoing business relations.
To exercise these rights, you should make a request using our contact details set out below. If you are not satisfied with the way we handle your request, you may lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority in your country of residence.
If you refuse to provide your personal information or request we delete or cease collecting your personal information, you may not be able to use all or some parts of our Services.

keys.DescriptionKey:
While there is no ally Mega Odin on the battlefield, this unit will be a Guardian and will ignore any attacks that would damage exactly 2 targets. For any enemy attack that would hit 1 or 2 other allies while this unit is a Guardian, 1 of the hits is instead redirected to this unit. This unit will not redirect skills that don't deal damage.

This unit cannot be defeated while there is an ally Mega Odin or Mega Winged Shade on the battlefield.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Every time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will heal for 10% of max HP. Every second time this unit takes damage from an attack, the attacker will be stunned for 100TU (this is not considered a Skin effect).

This unit cannot be defeated by damage from the Burn or normal Poison status effects (stronger poisons such as Super Poison or Mega Poison can still defeat this unit).

This unit is a Guardian. For any enemy attack that would hit 1 or 2 other allies, this unit has a 100% chance to redirect 1 hit to itself instead. This unit will not redirect skills that don't deal damage.

keys.MessageKey:
There are 25 tiers. Tiers are numbered in decreasing order: the smaller the number, the higher the tier.

Winning games will reward players with extra 'stars' above their tier. The number of stars needed to reach the next tier is as follows:

25 ~ 16    3 Stars
15 ~ 11    4 Stars
10 ~ 1      5 Stars

Once all star slots have been filled for the current tier, earning another star will grant the player the next tier with a single star. Starting at tier 19, losing games will also cause players to lose stars, and potentially tiers, with one exception: tiers 20, 15, 10, 5 and 1 are milestone tiers, and a player can never fall below a milestone tier within a season.

At tiers 25 ~ 5, the winning streak feature grants players a bonus star if they also won the previous two ranked matches.

The rating from Open PVP will be maintained and active during Ranked PVP. It will be relevant in matching and ranking Tier 1 Players.

The player's tier, stars, and rating are used to determine guild ranking.

Each season players will begin at a tier 4 lower than the best tier they reached in the previous season.

Players will receive 100 Soul Stones in their inbox each time they reach a new tier that season. Additionally, at the end of each season, players will be awarded Soul Stones based on [Highest Tier Reached], [Player Rank], and [Guild Rank] within that season. These rewards will be delivered to the inbox after the season has concluded. Only players who complete 5 matches or more within the season will be eligible to receive the awarded Soul Stones. ---------------------- PvP Season Rewards ---------------------- Player Rank 1: 8000 Soul Stones Guild Rank 1: 4000 Soul Stones Player Rank 2: 7000 Soul Stones Guild Rank 2: 3000 Soul Stones Player Rank 3: 6000 Soul Stones Guild Rank 3: 2500 Soul Stones Player Rank 4 to 10: 4000 Soul Stones Guild Rank 4: 2000 Soul Stones Player Rank 11 to 20: 3000 Soul Stones Guild Rank 5: 1500 Soul Stones Player Rank 21 to 50: 1500 Soul Stones Guild Rank 6 to 10: 1000 Soul Stones Player Rank 51 to 75: 1000 Soul Stones Guild Rank 11 to 15: 700 Soul Stones Player Rank 76 to 100: 500 Soul Stones Guild Rank 16 to 20: 500 Soul Stones Tier 1 Reached: 2000 Soul Stones Guild Rank 21 to 30: 400 Soul Stones Tier 2 Reached: 1700 Soul Stones Guild Rank 31 to 50: 350 Soul Stones Tier 3 Reached: 1500 Soul Stones Guild Rank 51 to 100: 300 Soul Stones Tier 4 Reached: 1300 Soul Stones Guild Rank 101 to 250: 250 Soul Stones Tier 5 Reached: 1150 Soul Stones Guild Rank 251 to 500: 200 Soul Stones Tier 6 Reached: 1100 Soul Stones Guild Rank 501 to 1000: 150 Soul Stones Tier 7 Reached: 1050 Soul Stones Guild Rank 1001 and below:100 Soul Stones Tier 8 Reached: 950 Soul Stones Tier 9 Reached: 900 Soul Stones Tier 10 Reached: 850 Soul Stones Tier 11 Reached: 800 Soul Stones Tier 12 Reached: 750 Soul Stones Tier 13 Reached: 700 Soul Stones Tier 14 Reached: 650 Soul Stones Tier 15 Reached: 600 Soul Stones Tier 16 Reached: 550 Soul Stones Tier 17 Reached: 500 Soul Stones Tier 18 Reached: 450 Soul Stones Tier 19 Reached: 400 Soul Stones Tier 20 Reached: 350 Soul Stones Tier 21 Reached: 300 Soul Stones Tier 22 Reached: 250 Soul Stones Tier 23 Reached: 200 Soul Stones Tier 24 Reached: 150 Soul Stones Tier 25 Reached: 100 Soul Stones

keys.DescriptionKey:
She is the beautiful yet terrifying queen who reigns over her dream world from the Castle of Hearts.
Reason and morality has no place in her court. Guilt, punishment, and even the law itself are decided by her word alone. None dare defy her as she delivers her absurd decrees with an elegant smile.

QueenHeartsRegular01.name: The Queen of Hearts
QueenHeartsRegular01.title: Crimson Arbiter
QueenHeartsRegular01.description:
She is the beautiful yet terrifying queen who reigns over her dream world from the Castle of Hearts.
Reason and morality has no place in her court. Guilt, punishment, and even the law itself are decided by her word alone. None dare defy her as she delivers her absurd decrees with an elegant smile.

keys.IntroText: Let the trial begin. But first, some tea.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The Queen of Hearts is rather particular when it comes to preparing for a tea party.
Everything must be just right—the temperature of the tea, the arrangement of the candies, the aroma of pomegranate pastries. She claims it is all to guarantee the delight of her guests, yet at times, her gaze makes it seem as though she is waiting for someone who is no longer there.

QueenHeartsRegular02.name: The Queen of Hearts
QueenHeartsRegular02.title: Crimson Arbiter
QueenHeartsRegular02.description:
The Queen of Hearts is rather particular when it comes to preparing for a tea party.
Everything must be just right—the temperature of the tea, the arrangement of the candies, the aroma of pomegranate pastries. She claims it is all to guarantee the delight of her guests, yet at times, her gaze makes it seem as though she is waiting for someone who is no longer there.

keys.DescriptionKey:
"A gentle lie is better than a cruel reality."

For the longest time, that was the one thing the Queen believed in. No matter how many times she rewound the world or stained her hands with crimson, she believed that her wish to protect would never falter. But in the end, she learned that love means not only holding someone close, but also knowing when to let them go.

Whenever this unit enters the battlefield, whether at the start of battle or from reinforcements, it will Endure the next damage that would defeat it with 1HP. Endure effects cannot stack.

While this unit has the Burn status effect, this unit has:
- Attack increased to 1.5x. This effect does not stack with Enrage skills.
- TU costs for all active skills reduced by 40%. This effect does not stack with Quicken skills.
- 50% damage reduction from attacks.

keys.DescriptionKey:
This unit enters battle with a Stun Ward, and Sleep Ward. This unit cannot be defeated by damage from Poison or Burn status effects.

When attacking, adds 100% to the damage % of this unit's attacks for each Element type on the battlefield. (e.g. Paint Fall: 50% => 350% damage when 3 Element types are on the battlefield)

When this unit damages an enemy with an attack, if they are:
- Water or Dark, Stun them for 100TU.
- Fire or Light, grant them the Sleep status effect for 100TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. Sleep will overwrite other status effects on those units.
- Storm or Earth, grant them the Mega Poison status effect for 100TU. Mega Poison will overwrite other status effects on those units. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison.

keys.DescriptionKey:
This unit's attacks will not wake sleeping enemies.

Whenever another non-conjured ally enters the battlefield from reinforcements, 20% chance for one of the following effects determined by that unit's Element to trigger.

WATER: Grants 1 random non-sleeping enemy Sleep (Forced) for 200TU.
FIRE: Grants Burn to all enemies.
EARTH: Grants 1 random non-sleeping enemy Cursed Sleep for 200TU (blocked by Burn).
STORM: Stuns 1 random enemy for 150TU.
DARK: Mega Poisons 1 random non-sleeping enemy for 200TU.
LIGHT: Purifies all allies and heals them for 400% of this unit's Attack.

Successfully applied Status Effects will overwrite existing status effects on affected units.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Immediately defeats a random non-boss, non-Ephemeral, enemy on the battlefield. This effect triggers once for each time a non-conjured unit (ally or enemy) on the battlefield has been defeated or sacrificed by any source since the user entered the battlefield (max of 5 triggers total). All of these triggers will occur before any enemy reinforcements may replace units defeated by this skill.

These effects ignore Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent their targets from being defeated, and cannot be redirected by Guardians. The user is considered to have defeated with attacks as many units as are defeated by any of these effects.

Locked for 100TU after the user has entered the battlefield. Usable only if a non-conjured enemy unit on the battlefield has been defeated or sacrificed by any source since the user entered the battlefield. Usable once per battle.

$#SeriousFemaleStudent(Serious Female Student)#$$&SchoolUniformGirlMobScared&$$@Right@$What the... What...was that!?
You're a monster!
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Sorry, did you say something?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Clarice)#$(But then she told me to get used to the life
within an order at school first!)
$#SeriousFemaleStudent(Serious Female Student)#$$&SchoolUniformGirlMobScared&$$@Center@$Eek!

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Ma'am, I think the outcome is clear.
My opponent can no longer fight.

$#InstructorLea(Instructor Lea)#$$&LeaSeriousSweat&$$@Center@$Y-Yes, that's quite enough. This match goes
to Clarice.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Of course it does. Not that I care.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolExcited&$$@Center@$Miss Ludmilla!
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolExcited&$Miss Ludmillaaa!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$Clarice!? Shouldn't you still be in class?

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolExcited&$Oh, that class is useless. Meeting you
is so much more important.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolExcited&$I have been so eagerly awaiting this day!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$You make it sound like I was gone for
years.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Clarice)#$(How cold of her!)
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolExcited&$Kuhuhu... Oh, but to my heart, you have been gone for years! For millennia, even.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolExcited&$And what utterly drab millennia they
were!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSigh&$You sure like to exaggerate, don't you?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$In any case, you seem well. I'm glad to see
that.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolWinkSerious&$$@Left@$Sorry, who are you again?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$It's me! Finn! You don't remember?

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolClosedEyesSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No need to panic. I remember you well,
Master.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$Well, as long as you haven't forgotten me.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolSerious&$$@Left@$Who is the other woman? I don't believe
we've met.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$Clarice, this is Lady Rolotia. She's a
former Avatar of the Primordial of Time,

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolExcited&$$@Center@$It could be her way of showing me some
tough love, though... Kuhu... Kuhuhu...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$and a great time sorceress as well.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaNewSmile&$$@Right@$It is a pleasure to meet you. My name is
Rolotia. I do hope we'll get along.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolIrritated&$$@Left@$"Great," huh? Hmm...
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolClosedEyesSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The pleasure is all mine, Lady Rolotia.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$I am the flawless former maid of the
beautiful and splendid Miss Ludmilla!

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolGrin&$$@Center@$You can bring any matters pertaining to
Miss Ludmilla to me.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolGrin&$$@Center@$Kuhuhu♪

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(Something's off about that smile. I'm
sensing hostility toward Rolotia...)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaNewSmile&$$@Center@$Why, thank you. We seem to have a bit in
common, with our "former" titles.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaNewSmile&$$@Center@$I hope we can be great friends.

$#InstructorLea(Instructor Lea)#$$&LeaNormal&$$@Center@$There you are, Clarice. May I have a word
with you?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(Rolotia doesn't seem to have noticed
anything odd from Clarice, though.)
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolSighSweat&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaNewNormal&$$@Right@$Is something the matter?
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolSighSweat&$$@Left@$No, nothing.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Instructor Lea)#$Clarice! What are you doing? Class is still in
session!

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ugh, that instructor can be so loud.
I should just get rid of her for

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolIrritated&$$@Center@$interrupting my lovely reunion with
Miss Ludmilla...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Clarice, do as your teacher says. Okay?
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSchoolExcited&$$@Left@$Yes, Miss! Your wish is my command!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$We were in the same year, so I can vouch
for her skills as a teacher.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Some men go to war for glory. Others for love of battle. Timia joined the war to follow in her father's footsteps, to see his dream of a united Erden fulfilled.

When she was but a child, he showered her with tales of the Bergarian royalty. The early tribal kings who shepherded their people through the mountains. The first true emperor, born of the Primordial of Light. They fought with true nobility, liberating the land from the tyrants who would divide it.

Their legends planted the seeds of courage in her heart. And when her father fell in battle, those seeds burst into bloom.

RedElfOfficer01.name: Timia
RedElfOfficer01.title: Captain of the Guard
RedElfOfficer01.description:
Some men go to war for glory. Others for love of battle. Timia joined the war to follow in her father's footsteps, to see his dream of a united Erden fulfilled.

When she was but a child, he showered her with tales of the Bergarian royalty. The early tribal kings who shepherded their people through the mountains. The first true emperor, born of the Primordial of Light. They fought with true nobility, liberating the land from the tyrants who would divide it.

Their legends planted the seeds of courage in her heart. And when her father fell in battle, those seeds burst into bloom.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Despite her youthful idealism, Timia is no fool. She knows all too well the cost of war. In her military training, her superiors made her memorize the casualties of past battles. They led her unit to rebel villages, forcibly crushed to keep their people under Imperial rule. In every eye, she saw the pain of her father's death, and she came to a resolution.

She could not allow this to continue.

As long as divisions among the people exist, there will be war. As long as there is war, innocent blood will flow. For the sake of lasting peace, the other lands of Erden must fall. And until their people understand that, Timia will do what she must.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The youngest of a family of distinguished warriors, Vivica knew she had to do something special to get out from the shadows of her seven older brothers. When she was offered her first, child-sized sword, she wrinkled her nose and grabbed the largest greatsword she could lift.

Wielding the blade was gruelling work, but the discouragement of her family members only fuelled Vivica's fire. To their amazement, she could soon wield a blade as tall as she was as with unnatural speed.

keys.DescriptionKey: After countless centuries spent in a gloomy magical realm, Rei finds herself dazzled. The bright light filling the church, the sparkling raindrops scattered over cherry blossoms, the perfectly clear blue sky—it's almost too much. But it is all meant to celebrate her, and before she knows it, she has stopped in the middle of the aisle, overwhelmed with emotion.

ReiBride01.name: Rei
ReiBride01.title: Sakura Bride
ReiBride01.description: After countless centuries spent in a gloomy magical realm, Rei finds herself dazzled. The bright light filling the church, the sparkling raindrops scattered over cherry blossoms, the perfectly clear blue sky—it's almost too much. But it is all meant to celebrate her, and before she knows it, she has stopped in the middle of the aisle, overwhelmed with emotion.

keys.IntroText:
It's such a lovely day. Won't you take a walk
in the flower garden with me?

keys.DescriptionKey:
There are unexpected, familiar faces among the guests, and Rei's eyes go wide in surprise. The bikki from Kisenkyo have come, and they are calling out to her from the distance, not a hint of strain in their smiles.
"You look so beautiful, Sage Rei!"
It feels as if her past sin and their years of resentment all have vanished, just for today. As Rei waves back at them, her eyes well up with tears.

keys.DescriptionKey:
"It is customary to sleep together after the ceremony, isn't it?" Rei says as she climbs into bed, her cheeks flushed from all the alcohol she's drunk during the celebrations, her breath a little uneven. However, she is fast asleep the minute her head touches the pillow.
For centuries, that was all that she's wanted—someone who would sleep by her side. As the Sleeping Beauty dreams, a peaceful smile appears on her face.

ReiRegular02.description: Her father, a great water dragon, was once the guardian deity of Kisenkyo, but when he left, the duty fell to her. She's spent her life since then striving to protect her people, and though her devotion is respected by most, there are those who view her in a less favorable light.

keys.DescriptionKey: The Great Sage, eh... aye, I've known her since I was a tadpole, and now I'm a withered old frog. She looks the same, of course... She's powerful, aye, none doubt that, and it's good to have her around...but I just can't trust her. The elders remember, and they share the tales...and now it's my turn to remember. When pressed for more details, the elder bikki simply shook his head, saying it was no matter for outsiders to hear of.

keys.value: $#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$|act2.Voices/mst747|$...What is this place?

$#Rei(???)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst756|$The sage of the Kisen people...
Rei.
$#Rei(???)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst757|$Pleasure to meet you, young lady.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst758|$How... How beautiful...!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst759|$I never dreamed that the Great Sage would
be a maiden lovely as the finest jewel!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSurprised&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst760|$Jewel? No, I'm no jewel. I have dragon
blood, but no scales to speak of.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst761|$M-my poetry had no effect...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst762|$I apologize for our companion.
Please ignore him.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiBlush&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst763|$...I don't really understand,
but okay.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst764|$So, what do you need?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst765|$I am Ludmilla of the Red Dragon Knights,
Captain of the Pandemonium Task Force.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise;Ludmilla.LudmillaSerious;&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Ludmilla.Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst748|$The air... It's so fresh.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSurprised&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst766|$Pandemonium...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst767|$I sincerely apologize for disturbing you in
your sacred sleeping chambers...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst768|$But we have a request of great urgency.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst769|$It seems something sinister is going on
outside. I understand.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst770|$What do you need from me?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad;Ludmilla.Ludmilla.Serious&$$@Right;;;Ludmilla.Left;@$$|act2.Voices/mst771|$I see. So the Pandemonium has come
again...

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst772|$And the Aeon Lords are spreading an
illness you call the Sleeping Death?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst773|$More fall ill every day. Lives are being
lost...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst774|$We were hoping you could produce a cure
that would save them.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst775|$Rigland will pay any price. So please...!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst749|$Is this where the Great Sage is?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiClosedEyes&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst776|$No.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst777|$!?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst778|$No!!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst779|$Hm? What's the matter?
I would never ask payment for this.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst780|$S-So you will...!?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiShouting&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst781|$This illness affects all the peoples of Erden.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiShouting&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$To fulfill my duty, I will give any
time necessary to assist you!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst782|$Did you hear that, Rizette!?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst783|$Great Sage... Th-Thank you!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst784|$No need. But first, I'll need to know
the symptoms we're dealing with.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst750|$Hmm?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst785|$Could you bring one of the afflicted to me?
One will do.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst786|$Are you not able to come to Kisenkyo,
Great Sage?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst787|$If I had more time to prepare,
maybe...

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst788|$But if I leave now, the barrier around
Kisenkyo will be weakened.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst789|$My duty to my people comes first.
I'm sorry.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst790|$Understood. We will bring back one of the
sick people.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst791|$We should head back to Kisenkyo right
away!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst792|$We should bring the princess!!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst793|$We will return soon, Great Sage.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst794|$Okay!
$#Female Voice(Female Voice)#$$|act2.Voices/mst751|$(Yawn)

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst795|$The Pandemonium... why does this land
punish its people so?
$#Saki(Princess Saki)#$$&SakiClosedEye&$$@Center@$...
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious;Nagi.NagiSad;&$$!-1!$$@Right;;;Nagi.Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst797|$I see...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst798|$Great Sage... Do you have a solution?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst799|$This is sleeping magic that uses powdered
yurikabuto, a poisonous herb, as a catalyst.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst800|$So...?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst801|$It creates tiny monsters that absorb
the host's mana, forcing them to sleep.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiIrritated&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst802|$That Aeon Lord must have done some
horrifying experiments to make this.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst803|$Ossia...!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst804|$Can it be cured?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst752|$Did you hear that?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiHappy&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst805|$Yes, it can.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst806|$Did you hear that, Rizette!?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst807|$Y-Yes! Now finally... Theo will be...!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst808|$But...there's something I'll need
to make an antidote.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst809|$Some kind of ingredient?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst810|$Yes, but don't worry. It can be found right
here in this realm.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst811|$I need a herb called Twined Moss.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst812|$Twined Moss... Tell me where to find it, and
you shall have it immediately!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst813|$It grows in a fen to the northeast.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst814|$No problem. We'll go get some right away!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst753|$Did someone just yawn...?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst815|$Thank you. I'll get my tools ready.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst816|$Ah, but there are monsters...
So please be careful.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst817|$You can count on us. Rizette, we're nearly
there!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHeh&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst818|$Yeah!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst819|$Great Sage, we'll be right back!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst820|$Hang in there, Princess Saki! We will return
soon!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst821|$Quickly, friends!

$#Rei(???)#$$&ReiBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst754|$Mm... what a good nap.
Ah. Who might you be?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst755|$Are you...?

keys.DescriptionKey: Once every decade, the sakura of Kisenkyo bloom and the Great Sage makes her appearance. Every time, she hears the whispers: "Betrayer." "Traitor." She says nothing, for she knows this is only what she deserves. Every decade, she witnesses Kisenkyo's peace, its prosperity, and their weight of her unforgiven sin.

keys.IntroText:
...Did you call to me?
I wanted to sleep just a little longer,
but okay. I'll accompany you.

keys.DescriptionKey: The reddish light of the setting sun, the scent of flowers and trees, and her mother's laugh. This is Rei's happiest memory, from when her father still watched over Kisenkyo. To her, an outsider, her mother was her only friend. With her mother a thousand years dead and gone, Rei wondered if she would ever laugh like that again.

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Finn, won't you bathe with me?"
"S-sorry, what?"
"I'm told that serious discussions should be had while baring all to one another."
"But—"
"Sage Rei! The women's and men's baths are separate!"
"Oh, really?"
"What a shame that is, Sir Finn."
"N-Nagi!"
"..."
"E-Elmina?"
"So nice to see you two getting along..."

keys.value: $#()#$That night, at the inn—
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitBlush&$$@Left@$...I wonder if Finn feels the same way.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Right. Finn, your turn.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Huh? Me? But I didn't do anything
special.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$You're the one she wants to hear from,
so quit whining and go!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Y-you don't have to push me...
Sorry for all the hubbub, Sage Rei.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$It's okay, Finn.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$I'm not good at goodbyes, so... let's meet
again soon! I'll be even stronger!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Right@$Yes. I'll rest up as fast as I can...
So I'll see you again, soon.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$We'll be waiting!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiBlush&$$@Right@$Ah, I do have... one request.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Sure. Anything I can do for you, I will.
Just say the word.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSwimsuitNormal&$$@Right@$Finn? Uh, who can say?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Right@$Hold my hand... until I fall asleep.

$#Finn;Rei;(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled;Rei.ReiSerious&$$@Left;;;Rei.Right;@$Your hand? If that's all...
Like this?
$#Finn;Rei;(Rei)#$$&FinnSmile;Rei.ReiSmile&$$@Left;;;Rei.Right;@$Yes. Your hand is so warm.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That's all she wants? Bah. Teenagers...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHappy&$$@Center@$It's very like her.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Center@$What I wouldn't give to be in his place...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Center@$Sorry, pal. This is a Finn-only job.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Center@$Well... I suppose so. Lucky him.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiBlush&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Finn...

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Right@$I know I'll have sweet dreams...
Thanks to you.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSwimsuitBlush&$$@Right@$What do you think of Finn, Sage Rei?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Sleep well, Sage Rei. Good night.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Good night, Finn...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So how long do these trees stay
blooming for, anyway?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$Hmm. They should remain in bloom for
some time, even after the festival.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Left@$So a pretty long time, huh? And then
they'll all start falling?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$When that happens, the festival is
reopened once again.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$@Right@$Another festival? Wow... Well, a lot
happened, but it was a lovely time.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Left@$Yeah. I still can't wrap my head around
one thing, though.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Left@$Nagi. How are you actually popular with bikki women?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Right@$Ohoho, Lady Elmina. Do not weep
tears of jealousy over me!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSurprised&$$@Left@$Me? Hmm. I don't know.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaCommand&$$@Left@$I'm gonna make you weep, frog.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Haha, oh dear.
...Finn? Are you alright?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Ah, yeah, sorry. Just hoping Sage Rei's
sleeping well, that's all.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSmile&$$@Right@$I'm sure she is. All thanks to you
holding her hand, of course.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$Really? I hope so.
Yeah... I'm sure she is.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I'll have to grow stronger by the time
she wakes up! I promised, after all!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSmile&$$@Right@$That's very like you, Finn. Just live
your life to the fullest.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Yeah! Alright, when we get back, it's
training time!

$#()#$$!-1!$With fond memories of a fleeting spring
in his heart, Finn carries on.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitBlush&$$@Left@$But when I think of him, my heart beats
faster and I feel happy and nervous...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSwimsuitSmile&$$@Right@$I see... that sounds pretty serious.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitBlush&$$@Left@$Serious...
Is it a sickness, maybe?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSwimsuitSmile&$$@Right@$Geez, for a sage, you sure act like a
teenager sometimes.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSwimsuitSmile&$$@Left@$And that makes it our duty to give her
good advice, doesn't it, Elmina?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSwimsuitHurt&$$@Right@$Oh, come on, you're throwing this on me?
Fine...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSwimsuitHappy&$$@Left@$So this is an "onsen!" I've always
wanted to try one.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSwimsuitNormal&$$@Right@$First, be honest with your own feelings.
Think about how you feel about him.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitBlush&$$@Left@$How I feel about him...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSwimsuitNormal&$$@Right@$Look, don't overthink it. What's the
first thing that comes to mind?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitBlush&$$@Left@$...I want to be around him forever.
Because he was my very first.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$Yeah, yeah, that sort of—huh?!
F-first?!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Left@$This is an unexpected development.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$W-what do you mean by "first?!"

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Left@$The first person I've respected, aside
from my parents... why do you ask?
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$O-oh... so that's what you meant.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSwimsuitSmile&$$@Left@$Isn't that nice, Elmina?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSwimsuitGrin&$$@Right@$This water's great. I can feel the stress
melting away.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSwimsuitHurt&$$@Right@$W-what do I care?! Okay, I said my
piece! Now it's your turn!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSwimsuitSmile&$$@Left@$Haha. Well, I have one more piece of
advice, Sage Rei. May I?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$Please.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSwimsuitNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...you never know when someone you
cherish might suddenly leave you behind.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSwimsuitNormal&$$@Center@$Time cannot be reversed. If you have
something to tell him, you should.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSwimsuitBlush&$$@Center@$I... couldn't, in the end. I don't want
the same thing to happen to you.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitBlush&$$@Center@$Something to tell him...
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Center@$Right. Thank you both. I'll be back soon!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSwimsuitSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Best of luck.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSwimsuitSmile&$$@Right@$Don't trip and fall over, now.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitHappy&$$@Left@$Oh, this does wonders for my bones.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSwimsuitNormal&$$@Right@$Geez, she really is just a girl...
Not sure why I helped my competition.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Left@$Competition?
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSwimsuitGrin&$$@Right@$Bah, forget I said anything.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSwimsuitBlush&$$@Left@$Haha. So that's how it is, then? I wish
you luck, too.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSwimsuitHurt&$$@Right@$Gah, shut up! Hey! Someone bring me
some booze!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&RolotiaSwimsuitHappy&$$@Left@$Haha. I'll join you!

woman.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Huh... I had no idea.

$#Rei(Sneering Spectator)#$$&ReiSwimsuitClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hmph. So what if she's Suiryu's
daughter? Damn traitor.
$#Rei(Scowling Spectator)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Center@$Yeah! Traitor!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$Hard to say, but it doesn't feel like an
assassin to me.
$#Rei(Scruffy Spectator)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Center@$Get out of Kisenkyo, traitor!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Huh? Nagi, what are they talking about?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$Hmm. Well, Sage Rei is very famous... it
stands to reason she attracts envy. But...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$But? Is there something else?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$...perhaps now is not the time.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Right@$It would be a waste to miss even a
moment of her dance, after all!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Yeah... I guess so.
$#Rei(Spitting Spectator)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Scum! Traitor!
$#Rei(Shouting Spectator)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Center@$How dare you show your face!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$(Even with all this abuse, Rei isn't
flinching at all...)

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$Indeed, they are barely sneaking at all.
Perhaps this is a trap...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$(What could have happened here?)

$#Oto(Oto)#$$&OtoNormal&$$@Center@$The ceremony is now concluded. Pray
enjoy the rest of the festival.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Nagi. What was all that about?
Why were they calling Rei a traitor?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$@Right@$Oh, yeah, I heard them too. Cowards
hiding in the crowd.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Left@$I can hardly believe anyone would say
those things about her.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$There is a history there, you see...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$For now, let us enjoy the flowers! Why
spoil such beauty with dark thoughts?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$Nagi...!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$Sir Finn, I'm sure Sage Rei would not
want to trouble you with such things.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hello, everyone.
...am I interrupting something?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Right@$Well, we'll know for sure once we get our
hands on them.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Ah, Sage Rei...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(I guess she really didn't mind it. Maybe
it's not for outsiders like us to know?)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Oh, no, it's nothing. Should we get
going?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitHappy&$$@Left@$Yes.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$...Sage Rei? You're not going out in
your ceremonial dress, are you?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Left@$I am. I can't take it off.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$...you can't?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Left@$Would you take it off for me?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Huh?! M-m-me?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaCommand&$$@Right@$Hey! That's not the kind of thing you
just say to a guy!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Left@$I agree.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Left@$Why not?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSad&$$@Right@$...let's try a different approach. How do
you usually get out of your outfit?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Left@$I have my shikigami assist me. It's too
difficult to put on by myself.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Right@$I see! Then, allow me to volunteer my
assistance in Sir Finn's place!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Left@$Please be quiet, Nagi.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$Um, Sage Rei? You should only undress
in front of someone special to you.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$It shows a special sort of trust.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSmile&$$@Left@$Is that so? You know quite a lot, Finn.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$Uh, not really. That's just kind of
common sense.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSmile&$$@Left@$Then I will leave it on.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yeah, the three of us can take them down.
Let's go!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Wait, you're not going to change?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSurprised&$$@Left@$Is that unacceptable?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$No, it's just—
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSurprised&$$@Left@$Do you dislike this outfit?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Right@$No, not at all. I think it looks very nice.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Right@$Truly, you are the vision of a Sage!
To change would be inconceivable!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitHappy&$$@Left@$See? It would be inconceivable.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$Right... inconceivable.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitHappy&$$@Left@$Very well, then. I'll keep it on.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$(It's a festival outfit, so maybe it's not
a problem if she wears it around...)
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Huh? They're running?! W-wait for me!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Alright. Let's go buy the supplies we'll
need for the flower viewing.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitHappy&$$@Left@$Indeed.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$@Left@$Ah! What would you say is the tastiest
of Kisenkyo's foods, Sage Rei?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitHappy&$$@Right@$Foods...? Dango.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Those little dumpling things?
Kisenkyo's famous for them, huh.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$How about for drinks? Does Kisenkyo
have any famous drinks?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitHappy&$$@Right@$Hm. Sweet-glazed dango.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Huh, I see.
...hey, wait! That's not a drink!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitHappy&$$@Right@$You can drink the sauce.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$I'm pretty sure you're the only one
who would do that!

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$They turned a corner! Oh no, I'm going
to lose them!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Left@$Let's just get some alcohol. What goes
best with the local booze?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitHappy&$$@Right@$Spicy dango, perhaps.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSurprise&$$@Left@$I mean, yeah, spicy's good, but...
Dango again?
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHappy&$$@Left@$Do you like dango a lot, Sage Rei?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitBlush&$$@Right@$Yes, they are delicious. I could eat them
all day long. Nom, nom.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Nom nom?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitHappy&$$@Right@$Nom?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$S-Sage Rei! You can't just walk off
with a stall's dango!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSurprised&$$@Right@$Why not?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$If you don't pay for what you take,
it's just stealing!
$#Rolotia(???)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Center@$——wah!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&NewRolotiaHappy&$$@Right@$Mm... is that so?
Nom, nom.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$You just can't, okay?! Sorry! I'll pay
for her!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&NewRolotiaHappy&$$@Right@$Nom.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Sage Rei, stop that!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(It's hard to believe she's the same
person who did that dance...)

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Her lack of common sense is just
another aspect of Sage Rei's charm!
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Left@$Haha! Having fun babysitting, Finn?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaBlush&$$@Right@$So she's not just powerful. She's also
very cute. I see!
$#Koto(Koto)#$$&KotoNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...so that is the Great Sage.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Right@$What fine weather for a festival! I shall
find a new princess today for certain.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Who are you?! Are you with the
Gru Grim?!
$#Rolotia(???)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Right@$Gru Grim?! N-no, I...!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Wait, I've heard that voice before...
Rolotia?!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Right@$Yes... ouch. Um, if it's no trouble, could
you... get off me, please?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$Ah, we're still pinning her down!
Sorry!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSurprise&$$@Left@$So it was you all along, huh. You look
different than before.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Right@$Yes. I'm no longer the Avatar of Chronos.
I've returned to my mortal form.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Right@$It's a trial of sorts. To face myself as I
once was... if that makes sense.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$I see... sorry, we didn't mean to be
suspicious of you.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Right@$No, no, it's alright! It's my fault for
following after you all...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$@Left@$Hey, frogboy. Your ulterior motive's
showing.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Actually, yeah. Why were you following
us?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I happened to stumble upon you as I was
wandering the wilderness.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$I saw you hurrying, and I worried you
might have found more trouble...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$I intended to leave as soon as I saw
you were alright.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You were worried about us? Aww,
thanks Rolotia!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaBlush&$$@Right@$Oh no, that's not necessary....
I'm sorry for worrying you.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$Waaaaaaaaugh!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaCommand&$$@Right@$Gah! Stop screaming in my ear, Nagi!
What's the matter with you?!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$How... how could I have been so blind?!
I am a fool, a damned fool!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$To mistake this radiant creature for
an assassin! I will end my unworthy life!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Ulterior motive or no, thanks for
inviting us out here, Nagi.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$@Right@$What?! N-Nagi, no! Don't do that,
please!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$You would forgive me? Truly, you are
a vision of mercy...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$Please, accept a date as my penance
instead.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Right@$Huh? A date?
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$@Left@$Boy, he cheered up quick.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSmile&$$@Left@$Don't take him seriously, Rolotia.
Heck, don't even listen to him.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHappy&$$@Right@$R-right. Haha... this reminds me of the
days when we fought together.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Right@$Of course... he was still with us then...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$Rolotia...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$If you're not busy, why not come with
us to the Kisenkyo festival?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Right@$No thanks needed! After so many
battles, 'tis time to rest our weary bones.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$They say a journey's nothing without
friends, after all. How about it?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSmile&$$@Right@$A festival... that does sound like fun.
It would be my pleasure to join you!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Left@$Ah, excellent! Well done, Sir Finn!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSmile&$$@Right@$Great, then it's settled. Now, shouldn't
we be on our way again?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$Right. Let's get there early and really
soak in the atmosphere!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Left@$Aah, the cherry blossoms of Kisenkyo!
My heart blooms with thee...!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHappy&$$@Right@$W-wow...! What beautiful flowers!
You call these "sakura," right?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$How elegantly you speak our language!
You bless me, Lady Rolotia.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaBlush&$$@Right@$Haha. You're such a flatterer, Nagi.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$Heavens forbid! Not a single word
passes my lips that is not honest truth.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It is such a shame that Lady Rizette
and Lady Ludmilla could not join us...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$Ah, I see a grand sakura tree over there.
Shall we go have a look?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$@Right@$If we keep making stops, we're never
gonna reach the actual town, you know.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$But, Lady Elmina! If we do not gaze
upon the sakura while we walk...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$Then there is hardly any point to
the festival at all!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Does the festival have something to do
with the cherry blossoms?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Left@$Indeed. Kisenkyo's sakura bloom fully
only once every decade.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Left@$This festival is held to celebrate their
majesty.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Wow. So the festival's only held every
decade?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$Ideally... but due to the Pandemonium,
the festival has not been held for a time.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$As a result, we are all rather excited
for a grand return to form.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$@Left@$A festival in Kisenkyo? I'm sorry, but the
Knights have a mock battle that day.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$See? You can already hear the festival
chatter.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Wow, they're really excited! I can
practically feel the ground rumbling!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Left@$The whole town is a festival ground,
after all!
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Left@$And would you look at that! We're here!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$@Right@$So this is Kisenkyo! What a charming
place.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$It was a lot quieter last time we were
here. What a crowd!

$#Oto(???)#$$&OtoNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You must be Lord Finn. We bid you
welcome to Kisenkyo.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Huh? You were expecting us?
$#Oto(Oto)#$$&OtoNormal&$$@Right@$Indeed. I am Oto, of the Onyo-ryo.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$Ah, truly?! What an honor!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Right@$Ah, but you should go, Finn! You've
been working so hard lately.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Nagi? What's an Onyo-ryo?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$They are Kisenkyo's society of
onmyoji, Sir Finn.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$It is rare for them to be seen in public,
outside of state business...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$Are you perhaps here to oversee
the festival?

$#Oto(Oto)#$$&OtoNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yes. This festival was first started by
our order.

$#Oto(Oto)#$$&OtoNormal&$$@Center@$Onmyo is a reflection of the ever-
changing natural world, after all.

$#Oto(Oto)#$$&OtoNormal&$$@Center@$It is good of you to come. Our Lady has
been awaiting your arrival.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Center@$Your Lady?
$#Oto(Oto)#$$&OtoNormal&$$@Center@$Please, this way.

$#Oto(Oto)#$$&OtoNormal&$$@Center@$Lord Finn and his guests have arrived,
my Lady.

keys.value: $#KomaInu(Monster)#$$&KomaInuShouting&$$@Center@$Graaaaaaagh!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Sage Rei! Be careful! This one's strong!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$And that attack was the Pandemonium?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSad&$$@Right@$Yes. It struck while I was incapacitated.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$But why would they brand you a traitor
for that? You were unconscious!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It's not their fault. They had no idea.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitIrritated&$$@Center@$We kept my condition a secret. It would
only have caused panic if they knew.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Center@$It's only natural they began to assume
I had run away.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitClosedEyes&$$@Center@$And that assumption took deeper root
as the years went on...
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitClosedEyes&$$@Center@$By now, there's no way to untangle it.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$But...

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSad&$$@Right@$I can say this much. If I had had more
control, it wouldn't have happened.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSurprised&$$@Right@$That...! That's...

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$That's why I study. To never make such
a mistake again.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$(She's spent who knows how many
years locked away...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$(She's sacrificed her entire life to
make sure that never happens again.)

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$Protecting Kisenkyo is the duty I
inherited from my parents.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$But you, Finn... you have nothing like
that.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSmile&$$@Right@$You protect others for no reason other
than because you want to.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$...where does that strength come from?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Strength? I don't really see it that way.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I just think of it as... doing the things
that only I can do.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSurprised&$$@Right@$The things that only you can do?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Sage Rei?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yeah. I have this Crest, and that means
I can save people.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$I'm thankful to have this power.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$The people I love, my dear friends, and
this wonderful world we live in...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$My dad gave his life so everyone living
here could have a future.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$And now it's my turn to keep them safe,
for him, and for them, too.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$And you're thankful for it?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Yes. I'm thankful for the Crest, and
for all my friends.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitHappy&$$@Right@$...you're amazing, Finn.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitHappy&$$@Right@$To be thankful for what you can do...
Thankful for the chance to help...
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$I'd never even thought of that.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitShouting&$$@Right@$...Finn. Protect me.

$#()#$$!-1!$(The air fills with friendly chatter.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Y'know, I don't really know much about
you, Sage Rei. Can I ask something?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitHappy&$$@Right@$Nom nom.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Um, Sage Rei?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSurprised&$$@Right@$Yes, Finn?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Oh, uh...
$#Koto(Koto)#$$&KotoNormal&$$@Right@$Merely doing my job, Lord Finn.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitHappy&$$@Right@$You want this? Here.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Mghmgh?! W-why did you just shove
a dango into my mouth?!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSurprised&$$@Right@$Oh, did you want this one instead?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Left@$Mhmgh— spicy! No, I don't want any
kind of dango!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$Then what do you want?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$We're all here together, so why not talk
a little instead of just eating dango?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSurprised&$$@Right@$So this isn't just an occasion to enjoy
dango?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$That's part of it, but talking with your
friends is the most important part.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$I see. Then what would you like to talk
about?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Um, hmm...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Hey, I know. Why don't you join us?
Would that be okay?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Left@$Ah! May I ask in his stead? Sage Rei,
how do you spend your time?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$I sleep.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$Is that all?!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSmile&$$@Left@$It's more like... resting and recharging
your magic power, right?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$Yes. Onmyo requires a large amount of
magic, so rest is required very often.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSurprise&$$@Left@$Then what do you do when you're
awake?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$I research onmyo, as well as maintain
and strengthen Kisenkyo's barrier.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$And it's just been that, for 1000 years?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSad&$$@Right@$Yes. I can't afford to make another
mistake, after all...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Mistake? What do you—

$#Koto(Koto)#$$&KotoNormal&$$@Right@$...forgive me. I have a small matter to
attend to, so I must take my leave.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ah, Great Sage! May I inquire as to
what you usually wear beneath—

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaCommand&$$@Center@$Shut it, pervert! Next time you ask
something weird, I'm punching you!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Center@$Y-you already did...
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$White lace.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Sage Rei! You don't have to answer
everything people ask!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSurprised&$$@Right@$Really?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Really.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$@Left@$Ah, then I have a question, too. How
long will you be staying?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$Only until the festival is over. Then I'll
return to my realm for a long sleep.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$@Left@$A long sleep...?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Left@$Ah, what a shame! But I suppose there
is no escape from one's duty.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitClosedEyes&$$@Right@$With the Pandemonium and Gru Grim,
I've used a great amount of power.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$I'll need a longer rest than usual
to fully recover.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$@Left@$I see. We've only just met... it's a shame
we'll be parted so soon.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$In that case, let's make as many fun
memories as we can before then!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSmile&$$@Right@$Finn...
Mm.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Left@$Mghghm!! Not again with the dango!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Right@$Hahaha! I think perhaps you've made
her bashful, Sir Finn.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$@Left@$Does that count as bashfulness?
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHappy&$$@Right@$Sage Rei really can be cute.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Don't just stand there, stop he—
Mghmgnmgh!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Left@$Well, just come on back when you're
done. We'll be here.
$#()#$$!-1!$And so, several hours later...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$You see, Sir Finn? Princesses have,
they have a... something about them...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaCommand&$$@Right@$You think I like living alone, huh?! Hic... bring me more booze!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHappy&$$@Left@$Haha! Hahaha! Oh, oh my... haha!
Being human is, haha, it's wonderful!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Everyone's really out of it...)

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitBlush&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Hey, Finn?
Fiiinn.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Yes, that's me. What is it? Actually,
are you doing okay?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitBlush&$$@Right@$I'm fine. Just a little wobbly. I'm not
drunk at all.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$That counts as being drunk, Sage Rei.
Here, have some water.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$More importantly...
...I'm interested in you.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHappy&$$@Left@$Right! We'll be waiting for you!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Huh?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$I'm intereshted in...
How you think... Right.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$(W-whoa! She's so close!)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$S-Sage Rei, uh! Y-you're, uh...!
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitSurprised&$Finn, why do you...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Sage Rei! You're too close to me! You—
Huh?
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitClosedEyes&$Zzz...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...she fell asleep? Whew... that startled
me.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Well, for now, I'll just lie her down...
and put a coat over her or something.)

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSwimsuitClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Hmnymnm...
Finn...

$#Koto(Koto)#$$&KotoHappy&$$@Right@$If I have the chance, then gladly.
Now, please, enjoy yourselves.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Haha, she's talking in her sleep.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Hey, Finn!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Elmina?! What is it?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSmile&$$@Right@$I wanna be pampered too, you know!
I wanna be tucked in and get head pats!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Huh? I wasn't patting her.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$@Right@$Shut up. Idiot.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHappy&$$@Left@$Hee hee hee! She called you an idiot!
Heeheehee...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$Sir Finn! Are you listening to me?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hey... come on, everyone! Pull yourselves
together!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Aw, geez... Okay, here, lie down.
