$#()#$――Kisenkyo――
The calendar of the bikki changes yearly.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Right@$Those last two are also food... Look, why
don't we look around more?

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasHappy&$$@Right@$Let's go see that big red gate over there.
Oh, or those giant paper lanterns—

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Left@$――Honored guests! Brave warriors! Do
none among you desire glory?

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Right@$Hm? What's that? There's something going
on over by that shrine.

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Left@$The Kisen Royal Tourney begins soon!
There is no cost for participation!

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Left@$The champion will receive the staff Al
Feras, blessed by Sage Rei herself!
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Right@$...

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Left@$Wow, what a beautiful staff. And it must
be powerful, with Sage Rei's blessing.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSerious&$$@Left@$A grand tournament, huh... I bet it'll be
full of strong warriors from all over.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasHappy&$$@Left@$This is great! We can't miss this chance.
Let's go get seats right away!

$#()#$The day the Great Sage Rei awakens
becomes the "New Year" for them.
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSerious&$$@Right@$You're right, Solas. We can't pass this up!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$Hey! Hello! Hi! Sign us up, please!
We're participating!
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Left@$...Huh?
$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Left@$Oho, such spirited youngsters! Splendid!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Right@$Huh?! What?! Luna, you can't just—
...Wait a minute, "sign US up"?!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Right@$Don't be reckless! We have no idea who
else is participating!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Left@$It's not like we have a choice, is it? We
have to win to get that staff!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Left@$I'm not letting anyone else get their hands
on that little beauty! We have to win!
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Right@$Oh, man...

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSmile&$$@Left@$Wow, look at all the people! I mean, wow,
look at all the frogs!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSmile&$$@Right@$There are lots of elves and sziviik too. I
bet they've come from all over the land.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSmile&$$@Left@$Now I see what Granny meant when she
said we had to see this.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSmile&$$@Left@$Those "dango" things and these candied
apricots are super delicious!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Right@$You're really just here for the food stalls,
aren't you, Luna?

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaPout&$$@Left@$How rude! I'm not JUST eating, you know?
I'm enjoying the other stalls too!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHappy&$$@Left@$Like that yo-yo game, and the takoyaki,
and the okonomiyaki too!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasHappy&$$@Left@$We... We did it! We won! Haha! I can't
believe it, Luna, we won!
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Right@$Huh?! The Sage herself?!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Left@$Luna. Solas. Congratulations on your
victory.
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaShy&$$@Right@$Ah...

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Right@$T-thank you very much, great Sage. We're
not worthy to stand in your presence.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$@Left@$Not exactly in my presence.
This is just an illusion, really.
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Right@$Huh?

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Left@$Don't worry about it.
Here...

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiHappy&$$@Left@$Here is your prize: Al Feras, the
Sage-blessed staff.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Left@$You earned this prize with your own
two hands. Go ahead, take it.
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaShy&$$@Right@$Y-Yes, ma'am. Thank you...very much.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$Woohoo! I did it, I did it! I'm! So!
Awesome!

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSmile&$$@Left@$Please use it only in the pursuit of what
is good and righteous.
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaShy&$$@Right@$Right...

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Left@$I still can't believe we actually won. Are
we sure we're not just dreaming?

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSmile&$$@Right@$It's not a dream. This staff is proof of
that.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSmile&$$@Left@$It really is beautiful, huh? The more I look
at it, the less I want to look away.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSmile&$$@Right@$Yeah, it sure is. And Sage Rei was
suuuuuper pretty, too!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSmile&$$@Right@$I seriously think I fell for her! Talk about
your legendary beauties.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Thank you.
Is that the end of my duties?

$#Lord Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Right@$Yes. Thank you once again, Shikigami
of the Great Sage.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Left@$Sorry. The real Rei wanted to come too,
but now's just not a good time, it seems.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$This is where it starts, Solas! My rise to
eternal glory begins right now!

$#Lord Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Right@$Please, do not apologize. You have
already done so much for us.
$#Lord Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Right@$I hope you will enjoy the festival.

$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Left@$...I don't think so. There are too many
people here who dislike the Sage.
$#Rei(Rei)#$$&ReiSad&$$@Left@$Maybe someday that'll change, but...
$#Lord Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Right@$...We can but pray it does.

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I wonder if I'll be as pretty as the Sage
someday. What do you think, Solas?

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Right@$Um... I think maybe you should be careful
what you wish for, Luna...

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Right@$I'm gonna win every tourney in the land
and become Luna, the Living Legend!
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Left@$Um... Yeah. Right. Good luck with that.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Left@$Luna sure does get carried away easily...
Oh well. Guess she's earned it today.

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Left@$Lady Luna! Sir Solas! What a stunning
victory!

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Left@$Splendid! Truly splendid! I can think of no
more fitting word!

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Left@$Now, come! To the winners' stand! Sage
Rei awaits with your prize!
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Left@$I can't believe it. We're actually doing it.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Right@$O-Oh. Thank you very much. It's an
honor, Your Majesty.
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaShy&$$@Right@$...

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Left@$Sir Solas, yes? You show martial wisdom
well beyond your years.

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Left@$And you, Lady Luna. You fight with such
vigor that my old bones feel young again!
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaShy&$$@Right@$Huh? R-Really? Thank you... Ehehe.

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Left@$It makes me glad to see brave youngsters
enjoying the festival. Truly it does.

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Left@$I expect to see great things in the final
battle, young warriors!
$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaShy&$$@Right@$R-Right! Yes! Thank you, Your Majesty!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaShy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Phew... I was so nervous. I didn't think
the King himself would come talk to us.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSmile&$$@Right@$He's expecting great things from us...
It might be flattery, but it feels kinda nice.

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasHappy&$$@Left@$The final match is up next. We're only one
fight away from winning!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Left@$Well, one thing's for sure. We can't let
him down!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaHeh&$$@Left@$Okay! Let's do this! We're gonna win, and
we're gonna get that gorgeous staff!

$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasHappy&$$@Left@$I'm sorry for doubting you, Luna. You
knew we could do it, didn't you?

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaSurprise&$$@Right@$Oh, wow. I can't believe it. We're
actually winning. Wow.
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasSurprise&$$@Left@$Seriously?!

$#Luna(Luna)#$$&LunaPout&$$@Right@$Oh no, I just got really nervous. Can we
really win the next fight? I don't know!
$#Solas(Solas)#$$&SolasTroubled&$$@Left@$Kind of late to worry now, isn't it?
$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Left@$Ah, here you are, young warriors!

$#Omi(Lord Omi)#$$&OmiSmile&$$@Left@$You have shown truly commendable skill!
Simply splendid!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2455|$We're from the Rigland Red Dragon Knights!
We've come to rescue you!

$#ElfWoman(Elven Woman)#$$&ElfWoman&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2456|$Rescue... I never dared dream this day
would come!
$#ElfWoman(Elven Woman)#$$&ElfWoman&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2457|$Chief, we are saved!
$#NushelleChief(Chief of Nushelle)#$$&NushelleChiefSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2458|$Thank you so much for coming for us...

$#NushelleChief(Chief of Nushelle)#$$&NushelleChiefSad&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2459|$The fact that you are here must mean that
you know why we were imprisoned.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2460|$Chief, do you know anything about Callen!?
$#NushelleChief(Chief of Nushelle)#$$&NushelleChiefSad&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2461|$I am sorry. I don't know anything.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2462|$Really? I get you not saying anything to
the knights, but these folks saved your hide!
$#NushelleChief(Chief of Nushelle)#$$&NushelleChiefSad&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2463|$It's the truth... I am sorry to disappoint you.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Left@$$%1%$$|act4.Voices/mst2437|$Ooof!
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2464|$That sounds pretty suspicious to me...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2465|$It's okay, Elmina. Let's focus on rescuing
the rest of the prisoners first.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2466|$Are you sure?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2467|$I really want to know about Callen... But
helping these people needs to come first.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2468|$You're right. Come with us Chief, we'll
escort you out.
$#NushelleChief(Chief of Nushelle)#$$&NushelleChiefSad&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2469|$I'm sorry. Thank you.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2470|$Hurry everyone!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2471|$This way, quick!

$#ElfWoman(Elven Woman)#$$&ElfWoman&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2472|$Thank you so much. I thought we were
going to rot in there...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2473|$Don't worry, we'll take you back to
Nushelle.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2438|$Finn! Are you alright?
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2474|$...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaCommand&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2475|$Finn, that's a demon!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2476|$!?
$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkSerious&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2477|$Oh come ooon...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2478|$Gyurelle!?

$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2479|$For real, Elmina, you totally messed up
my plans...

$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkRage&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2480|$Guess I'll have to show you...what the
Aeon Emperor's best annihilator can do!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2481|$What's going on!? Her magic is way
stronger all of a sudden!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2482|$This is just like what happened with Ossia!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2483|$She's transforming!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2439|$There's some kind of invisible wall here...

$#GyurelleBeast(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkBeastSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2484|$REJOICE, EXHAUSTING EVERY SENSE IN
YOUR IGNORANT QUEST FOR TRUTH.

$#GyurelleBeast(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkBeastSerious&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2485|$DESTROY COUNTRIES...DOCTRINES...
TEACHINGS...HOPES... DESTROY IT ALL!!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2486|$Sorry Gyurelle, it's over for you!
$#NushelleChief(Chief of Nushelle)#$$&NushelleChiefSad&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2487|$That light...!

$#GyurelleBeast(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkBeastSurprised&$$@Center@$$%1%$$|act4.Voices/mst2488|$Ah...aaaah! My faces... My precious
collection... They're all falling apart...!!

$#GyurelleBeast(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkBeastSurprised&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2489|$My personality...my memories...
Everything... Everything's fading!!

$#GyurelleBeast(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkBeastSurprised&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2490|$Which one is my face!? Not this one... Not
that one... Not that one...

$#GyurelleBeast(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkBeastSurprised&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2491|$I can't remember...
I can't remember myseeeelf...!!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHeh&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2492|$We did it!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHeh&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2493|$Finn, that was incredible!
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2440|$It's an aegis... A strong one.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2494|$So this is your crest, Finn... The power to
defeat the immortal Aeon Lords!
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2495|$Finally, those kids can live in peace...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2496|$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2497|$You took the kids back to Nushelle, Elmina?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrin&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2498|$Yep. I'm freed of my motherly duties. Back
to my carefree wandering days!
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2499|$Yeah... Carefree.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2500|$Elmina, are you sure you want to leave?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2501|$Those kids really trusted you.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2502|$If you asked them, I'm sure the elves in
Nushelle would welcome you.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2503|$Nah. I got to see them smile. That's enough
for me.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2441|$We have to get past this. Ah! Maybe I can
smash it with my sword!?
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2504|$How cool!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2505|$Elmina.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2506|$Would you consider using that gift of yours
for Erden?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2507|$You have more than proven your merit.
Hymelia said they will overlook your crimes.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSmile&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2508|$Thanks, Cap... But I've done a lot of things
you don't know about.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSmile&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2509|$I've made mistakes. Looking after those kids
was part of trying to make up for them.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2510|$But I can't walk in the sun with folks like you
just yet.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSmile&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2511|$Well, I've said my goodbyes. Time for me
to get going.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2512|$...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2513|$As long as the Pandemonium continues,
things like this will keep happening.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2442|$Hold on. This looks like the same kind of
barrier that we faced in the Realm of Reia.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2514|$More children might be separated from their
families!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2515|$He's right. That's why I'm going to be there
to help if something like this happens again.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2516|$How about you, Elmina? You wouldn't
abandon people, kids, in need, would you?
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2517|$Grr... I know what you're trying to do! I...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaCommand&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2518|$Of course I wouldn't!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGentleSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2519|$Elmina!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2520|$The Captain is waiting, Elmina.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2522|$(sigh)

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaCommand&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2523|$Fine! I'll do it, I'll help you! Is that what you
want to hear!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2443|$What do you think, Rizette?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaCommand&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2524|$Don't come crying to me when things go
south! I warned you, I have a dark past!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2525|$Everyone has some baggage. You're not the
only one.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2526|$Welcome to the Pandemonium Task Force,
Elmina!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2527|$Elmina... Thank you!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2528|$Looks like we have a new ally!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHappy&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2529|$Nice job, Theo! Welcome aboard, Elmina!
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHurt&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2530|$Unbelievable, the lot of you...
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2531|$Oh, I nearly forgot.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaHeh&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2532|$Finn, I have a message for you from the
Chief of Nushelle.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2533|$For me?

keys.DescriptionKey:
Greta is going to change the world someday. Everyone in her village told her so when she was a child, so it must be true. She has everything a visionary needs: a whip-smart mind, a tireless work ethic, and perhaps most importantly, a total lack of common sense. She dreams of one day capturing lightning in a bottle, so that the people of Erden can have as much light as they want, whenever they want.

A traveling Winvy merchant -- who has gone by many names, but who she knows as Mr. Beauregard Chancy -- saw the potential of her idea when she chased him down at the market fair one day. He agreed to put her through sorcery school in exchange for the exclusive right to sell her invention once she has a working model.

It's been three years. It must be coming any day now.

keys.DescriptionKey:
There's nothing Greta loves more than a good thunderstorm. She goes out in them to take notes whenever she can; she'll drag herself out in her pajamas, if she has to. You must first understand something to tame it, and after three years, Greta understands lightning as much as anyone can. Still, the pouring rain and rolling thunder relax her, so she continues studying anyway.

Storms have always been her friend. Once, when she was very young, she fell asleep reading by candlelight. The wax dripped onto her straw bed, and in minutes, her home went up in flames. Only a passing thundercloud saved her family's lives. She'll never forget how bright the lightning was that split the sky that night.

She's chased it ever since.

$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act1.Voices/sst58|$Hello there, vee! Interested in this sword?
Would you like to hear its story?

$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act1.Voices/sst59|$Of course you've heard of Carmina, the
great founder of Rigland, right, vee?

$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act1.Voices/sst60|$Legend has it that after a great war, an
angel appeared before her.

$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act1.Voices/sst61|$It told her she was destined to found the
mightiest kingdom in Westland.

$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act1.Voices/sst62|$Without hesitation, she plunged her sword
into the center of the battlefield.
$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act1.Voices/sst63|$And this, my friend, is that very sword!

$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act1.Voices/sst64|$What do you mean "it looks too big to be
a real sword!?"

$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act1.Voices/sst65|$Vee! Don't you know what a metaphor is!?
Don't poke holes in the Legend of Rigland!

$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act1.Voices/sst66|$You ought to listen to my tales with more
deference!

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Warrior)#$$|act1.Voices/sst46|$There are some formidable warriors
hanging around Rigland.

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Warrior)#$$|act1.Voices/sst47|$A human near the Proving Grounds
challenged me to a battle earlier.
$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Warrior)#$$|act1.Voices/sst48|$She completely wiped the floor with me...

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Warrior)#$$|act1.Voices/sst49|$What's with that look? You think you could
do any better!?

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Warrior)#$$|act1.Voices/sst50|$Tell you what, if you can defeat her, I'll
give you something cool.
$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Warrior)#$$|act1.Voices/sst51|$I don't like your chances, though.

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Warrior)#$$|act1.Voices/sst52|$What? You beat the Sellsword? Color me
impressed...

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Warrior)#$$|act1.Voices/sst53|$Here. A warrior as accomplished as you will
surely make better use of these than I.
$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Warrior)#$$|act1.Voices/sst54|$You've inspired me to train harder.

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Merchant)#$$|act1.Voices/sst41|$There is a mysterious illness spreading
through Westland...

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Merchant)#$$|act1.Voices/sst42|$I am well-versed in many maladies, but
even I have never seen anything like it.

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Merchant)#$$|act1.Voices/sst43|$It must have something to do with the
Pandemonium...

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Merchant)#$$|act1.Voices/sst44|$The cure Captain Ludmilla brought from
Kisenkyo was incredible!

$#DONTSHOWME(Bikki Merchant)#$$|act1.Voices/sst45|$I never would have thought to use Twined
Moss that way. I still have much to learn.

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act1.Voices/sst26|$Hey there! I see you have a Lightling. How
did you catch it? They're very evasive.

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act1.Voices/sst27|$Oh, you're a hunter? Wow, I've heard the
hunters from the north are very skilled.

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act1.Voices/sst28|$Say, would you mind doing me a favor?
Do you know what a Nocteddy is?

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act1.Voices/sst29|$It's a rare monster found around Rigland.
I really want to see one up close

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act1.Voices/sst30|$If you catch one and bring it to me, I'll give
you a reward!
$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act1.Voices/sst31|$Wow, you have a Nocteddy!

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act1.Voices/sst32|$It's even cuter than I imagined! I simply
must paint a picture of it!

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act1.Voices/sst33|$Please allow me to repay you for the
inspiration you've give me.

$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Enthusiast)#$$|act1.Voices/sst34|$Perhaps one day I will be strong enough to
catch my very own Nocteddy...

$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Traveler)#$$|act1.Voices/sst56|$I suppose humans are not used to
experiencing more than one Pandemonium.

$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Traveler)#$$|act1.Voices/sst57|$18 years, 100 years... It doesn't feel that
different to me.
$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Traveler)#$You look familiar...but that's impossible.

$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Traveler)#$Haven't I seen you
here before the last Pandemonium?
$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Traveler)#$But how could you look the same?

$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Merchant)#$$|act1.Voices/sst55|$The roads are dangerous now, so demand
for weapons and soul stones is on the rise.

$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Merchant)#$Have you seen my sister?
We were supposed to meet here.
$#DONTSHOWME(Elven Merchant)#$It's been a while and I'm getting worried.

$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Traveller)#$$|act1.Voices/sst38|$I've been training with my team all year to
compete in the Champions' Arena!

$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Traveller)#$$|act1.Voices/sst39|$But with all this Pandemonium business
they'll probably cancel it...
$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Traveller)#$$|act1.Voices/sst40|$All that hard work for nothing!
$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Traveler)#$Grr...where has he gone?

$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Traveler)#$My friend and I have been training
for the big annual tournament.
$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Traveler)#$Maybe he got cold feet?

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act1.Voices/sst35|$Everyone is whispering in fear of the
Pandemonium, but I'm not afraid.

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act1.Voices/sst36|$The Red Dragon Knights have protected
Westland from every past Pandemonium.

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act1.Voices/sst37|$They'll come through for us this time too,
I'm sure of it!

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$Have you noticed the crows?
They've all disappeared.

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$I don't like crows so I don't mind...
But it's odd that they've all just vanished.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3162|$There isn't a moment to spare. We need to
head straight for Rigland!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3171|$Let's get going everyone!!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3172|$Wow... It's been 18 years since I last saw
this place!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3173|$At the time it was one of the less damaged
towns, but now it's even more beautiful!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3174|$Let's head for the Red Dragon Knight HQ
and start looking for the Pillar Room!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3175|$Agreed. Move out!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3176|$...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3177|$Okay, everyone in!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3178|$We have about an hour until the guards
come around. We need to—
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3179|$Elmina, Callen, what are you doing?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3180|$I don't know, Callen grabbed my hand all of
a sudden...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenPout&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3163|$It's been so long since I've traveled... I
wonder if I can keep up.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3181|$Is something wrong, Callen?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3182|$I'm trying to detect any objects that have
had magic cast on them.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3183|$I'm temporarily overwriting part of Elmina's
demon-sensing abilities

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$and using them as an amplifier. Hmm,
your mental defenses are impressive.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3184|$This is weird... It's like my magic is
spreading out...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3185|$The synchronization was successful. If
magic is hiding the Pillar Room, we'll know.
$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3186|$Huh...? Right below us...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3187|$!?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3188|$There's a huge space... Right below where
Mysha is standing.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3189|$Huh?
It just looks like a floor to me.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3164|$Want a piggyback, Callen?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3190|$...I see.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHeh&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3191|$It was a good thing you brought me,
Captain.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3192|$Callen?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3193|$There are several magical locks, but they
are not powerful individually.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3194|$No living beings inside. Careful, everyone.
We're going to fall.
$#Finn;Astrid;Rizette;(All)#$$&FinnSurprise;Astrid.AstridSurprirse;Rizette.RizetteSurprise&$$@Center;;;Astrid.AstridLeft;Rizette.RizetteRight@$$|act5.Voices/mst3195|$!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3196|$Ow... Glad it wasn't too far of a fall. Give
us more warning next time!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3197|$Sorry, I figured we shouldn't waste any
time. Look.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3198|$This is...!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3199|$A library...? Or perhaps archives would be
a more apt description?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3165|$Really? I would feel bad...
And I'm not a child, you know.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3200|$It doesn't look much like an assassin's den.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3201|$?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3202|$What's wrong, Theo?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3203|$This document... It says "Westcarte Village"
on it. And Rossé...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3204|$!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3205|$Our villages?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3206|$It looks like some kind of report.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3207|$I wrote the report on Westcarte and Rossé.
I gave it directly to the Commander.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3208|$This isn't what I wrote... Is this a different
report?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3209|$What does it say!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3166|$Of course! I could carry three kids your
size.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3210|$...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3211|$"...These villages, located on the invasion
path, have little economic or military value."

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3212|$"They are not worth the resources it would
take to protect them."

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3213|$"Orders to the Third Regiment should be
delayed by half a day."
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3214|$What... What is this...
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganDetermined&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3215|$To put it simply...

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganDetermined&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3216|$Someone decided these villages, which
were likely to be attacked, had no worth...
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganDetermined&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3217|$So they abandoned them.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3218|$What...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3219|$W-Wait! Are you saying that the Red Dragon
Knights are choosing who they help!?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHeh&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3167|$You aren't making fun of me, are you?
Still... no sense being stubborn. Thank you.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3220|$They knew about the attacks, but they
delayed the report to me...!?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3221|$M-My village... Westcarte... Why!?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3222|$R-Riz...!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3223|$How... How could they...?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3224|$...!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3225|$Gather everything you can find on Rigland's
villages! We'll look through it all!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3226|$What is this... There are requests for aid
that I've never seen before!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3227|$They're from the poorest villages...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3228|$Most of these places were destroyed not
long after they sent these!!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3229|$All of them were ignored... Tossed aside!
$#Callen(Ruvi)#$$&CallenHeh&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3168|$Quruuru ♪

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3230|$Grierport... The home of a politician who
was campaigning for military cuts...

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$These are orders to lure monsters to attack
it!!

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3231|$Choosing who you help is one thing, but
setting monsters on people you don't like!?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3232|$This is a list of the towns that have been
recently attacked
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$and the influential figures who lived there...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3233|$Most of these are people who were
campaigning to reduce the Knights' power...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3234|$This must be a list of backer towns, then.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$There are ignored requests from nearby,
but the towns themselves are unscathed.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3235|$What is this room!?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3236|$Pillar...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3169|$Up you hop!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3237|$I see it now. This is the room that supports
the Red Dragon Knights.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3238|$We've been using the Pandemonium to
raise our own profile.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3239|$For years... Decades... Centuries!!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3240|$This is the "pillar" that the Red Dragon
Knights are built upon!!

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3241|$It doesn't appear that we have been
followed.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3242|$I erased traces of us as best I could.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3243|$Captain, this is the only document we took.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3244|$It is more than enough.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3245|$...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3246|$Astrid and I will return to HQ to wait for
Commander Luther.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3170|$(I want to give Callen a piggyback...)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3247|$After that, we will carry out the plan I
explained earlier. Participation is optional.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3248|$Those who choose to participate should be
prepared for anything.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst3249|$...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSad&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst3250|$Riz...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst3251|$You're dismissed.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act5.Voices/mst3252|$We're supposed to meet in front of the
Red Dragon Knight Headquarters.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act5.Voices/mst3253|$I better make sure I'm ready for whatever
could be waiting for us there...

keys.value: $#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$|act2.Voices/mst830|$Something doesn't feel right...
$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst839|$Long time no see, everyone ♪
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst928|$The light!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst929|$It's gone. First Finn, now Rizette... What is
going on!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst930|$Captain! The aegis, it's fading!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst931|$What!? Did your eyes do this, Rizette?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst932|$I'm not sure... But...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst933|$There was an angel...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst934|$An angel...?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst935|$I think she's a little confused. But we don't
have time to delay!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst936|$Prepare to move out! Rizette, are you okay?
You can rest here if you need to!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst937|$I-I'm fine! I'm a Red Dragon Knight!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst840|$Is that...an Aeon Lord!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst938|$Rizette... I've got your back!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHeh&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst939|$And I have yours!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst940|$Our enemy is an immortal Aeon Lord...
We should do what we can to prepare!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst941|$Okay!

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst841|$I slipped in with my servants while you were
all distracted by the attack in Kisenkyo.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst842|$Are you planning to spread your poison
here too!?

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst843|$That sounds like a lucrative business,
but I have another purpose.

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst844|$The Sage is the only one who can stop me
from infecting Erden with my Thanatox.
$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkHappy&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst845|$So I've come to kill her ♪
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst846|$Not while we're here!!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHurt&$$@Center@$$%0.03%$$|act2.Voices/mst847|$Nghh!?

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst848|$Give up. This aegis is three times stronger
than the one I used in your village.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$|act2.Voices/mst831|$Do not tarry now, Lady Rizette! We are
nearly there!

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst849|$Even if you had the legendary magician
Callen with you it would still take hours.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst850|$No... The princess!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst851|$It's no use... This aegis is powerful!
$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst852|$Finn, was it?

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst853|$From what I hear, that crest of yours can
dispel our Eternity.

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst854|$But it appears to have no effect on our
aegis.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst855|$Grr... Come on!

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst856|$Oh, it won't even glow? I see, so you can't
even use it properly yet... What a waste.

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkHappy&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst857|$I suppose I can take my time with my
patients, then.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst858|$Wait... Stop!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$|act2.Voices/mst832|$Egad! Where did this wall come from!?

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkHappy&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst859|$Ha ha. Come, my servants, vessels of my
Eternity!
$#AeonKnight(Aeon Knight)#$$&AeonKnight&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst860|$Groaaaargh...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGrit&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst861|$D-Demons...!!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst862|$Aeon Knights!!

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst863|$Yes, my slaves... My direct subordinates,
if you will.

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$A group of humans and bikki are no match
for them.
$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkHappy&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst864|$Nor is a little greenhorn hero.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst865|$Grr....!

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst866|$Go, servants, torment them all you want.
Be as brutal as you can...
$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkHappy&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst867|$Good day ♪
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$|act2.Voices/mst833|$Is this... Some kind of magical barrier?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGrit&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst868|$W-Wait! Ossia!!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst869|$Lady Rizette, everyone, brace yourselves!
$#AeonKnight(Aeon Knight)#$$&AeonKnight&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst870|$GROAAAAARGH!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritRed&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst871|$People's lives are depending on us making
this cure!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst872|$So don't get in our way!!
$#AeonKnight(Aeon Knight)#$$&AeonKnight&$$@Center@$$%0.5%$$|act2.Voices/mst873|$GROARGH? GROAAAARGH!?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst874|$Sir Finn... Your eyes!!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst875|$The Crimson Crest... It can defeat Aeon
Knights!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHehRed&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst876|$Alright... Now for the aegis!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurtRed&$$@Center@$$%0.5%$$|act2.Voices/mst877|$Nghh!?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$|act2.Voices/mst834|$This.... This is what happened when my
village was attacked!!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst878|$It's not doing anything!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGrit&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst879|$No...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Center@$$%1%$$|act2.Voices/mst880|$No!!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst881|$Rizette, stop! You'll break your hands!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Center@$$%1%$$|act2.Voices/mst882|$We're so close to saving Theo... To saving
everyone!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$$%1%$$|act2.Voices/mst883|$Nghh... Raaaaaargh!!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst884|$Nagi!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst885|$It may be hopeless... But I shall not give
in!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst886|$I swore that I would fight until my body
turns to dust to protect all princesses!!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst887|$And one day, like the legendary Silver
Knight, I will be remembered as a hero!
$#Female Voice(Female Voice)#$$|act2.Voices/mst835|$Yes... This is my aegis barrier.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst888|$You are an idealist in the purest sense...
But I have my ideals, too!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst889|$Captain...!!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst890|$Let's tear this thing to pieces! There
might be a weak point somewhere!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst891|$You got it!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst892|$We must hurry! The lives of the Great Sage
and the princess are at stake!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst893|$Everyone...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst894|$Yaaaaaaa!!
$#DONTSHOWME(Rizette)#$$!-1!$$|act2.Voices/mst895|$Please, gods!!

$#DONTSHOWME(Rizette)#$$|act2.Voices/mst896|$I didn't have the strength to save my
parents, or my friends...

$#DONTSHOWME(Rizette)#$$|act2.Voices/mst897|$But please, just for this moment, lend
me your strength!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$|act2.Voices/mst836|$You!!
$#DONTSHOWME(Rizette)#$$|act2.Voices/mst898|$Just a little crack in this wall is enough!
$#DONTSHOWME(Rizette)#$$|act2.Voices/mst899|$I will give you anything! So please...!
$#DONTSHOWME(Rizette)#$$|act2.Voices/mst900|$...I don't care where it comes from.
$#DONTSHOWME(Rizette)#$$|act2.Voices/mst901|$A monster, or even a demon is fine!
$#DONTSHOWME(Rizette)#$$|act2.Voices/mst902|$Somebody...

$#DONTSHOWME(Rizette)#$$|act2.Voices/mst903|$Somebody, please give me the strength
to protect Theo...
$#DONTSHOWME(Rizette)#$$|act2.Voices/mst904|$No...
$#DONTSHOWME(Rizette)#$$|act2.Voices/mst905|$To protect everyone!
$#ArcaneVoiceParticle(Mysterious Voice)#$$|act2.Voices/mst906|$There is no wall.

$#ArcaneVoiceParticle(Mysterious Voice)#$$|act2.Voices/mst907|$Walk forward with conviction, Wise Blue.
There are no barriers before you.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$|act2.Voices/mst837|$Ossia!?
$#Arcane(Mysterious Child)#$$&ArcaneSmile&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst908|$You are the weaver of your own legend...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteClosedDetermined&$$@Center@$...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteClosedDetermined&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst910|$I am the weaver of my own legend...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst911|$And this...is my path!!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst912|$A blue...light!?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst913|$Wh-What's going on!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurpriseRed&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst914|$Rizette's eyes!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurpriseBlue&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst915|$You...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurpriseBlue&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst916|$Who are you?
$#Arcane(???)#$$&ArcaneSmile&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst917|$The way is open.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand;Ossia.OssiaDarkSmile;&$$@Left;;;Ossia.Right;@$$|act2.Voices/mst838|$What are you doing here!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurpriseRed&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst918|$Where is that voice coming from?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst919|$Voice? Finn, what are you...?
$#Arcane(???)#$$&ArcaneSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst920|$Go forth.
$#Arcane(???)#$$&ArcaneSmile&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst921|$Follow the path that you know is true...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurpriseBlue&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst922|$Huh...?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurpriseRed&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst923|$It's gone now... What was that?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSeriousRed&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst924|$It sounded familiar...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst925|$Rizette! Are you okay!?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurpriseBlue&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst926|$Y-Yeah. I'm fine...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst927|$Ah...

Also, it is more durable than it looks, providing some protection in addition to transport. Most importantly however, it is full of precious memories of a home that no longer exists.

keys.DescriptionKey: The girl, Rizette, stood defenseless before the Supreme God. At first glance, she seemed insignificant, unworthy of notice. Her skill and magical power were impressive, yes, but nothing more than what another human could attain. Only her eyes were different—they pierced straight through evil itself.

RizetteBrave01.name: Rizette
RizetteBrave01.title: Cerulean Valkyrie
RizetteBrave01.description: The girl, Rizette, stood defenseless before the Supreme God. At first glance, she seemed insignificant, unworthy of notice. Her skill and magical power were impressive, yes, but nothing more than what another human could attain. Only her eyes were different—they pierced straight through evil itself.

keys.IntroText:
I will survive, no matter what—
to uphold my promise.

keys.DescriptionKey: And so, Rizette, having caught the eye of the Supreme God, became a member of the Valkyries. In a different world, surrounded by different races, she was bewildered. Yet as she shared meals, clashed at times, and spent days together with the Valkyrie, she eventually found herself accepted as one of them.

RizetteBrave02.name: Rizette
RizetteBrave02.title: Cerulean Valkyrie
RizetteBrave02.description: And so, Rizette, having caught the eye of the Supreme God, became a member of the Valkyries. In a different world, surrounded by different races, she was bewildered. Yet as she shared meals, clashed at times, and spent days together with the Valkyrie, she eventually found herself accepted as one of them.

keys.DescriptionKey: And so, Rizette came to understand that no matter one's race or birthplace, the desire to take up the blade to protect someone dear is the same. Now, before her lies her wounded friend. So she stands up to uphold her own justice.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The sunlight pouring into the chapel makes all the whites even brighter as Rizette looks up at her intended, slightly taller than her even though she's wearing high heels. She can feel everyone gently watching over her—her beloved little brother who walked her down the aisle, her companions who fought by her side on countless battlefields...
She hears the big question, "Do you?" and the answer is so obvious, has been for ages, really. And as the bells start ringing, she thinks to herself that it all feels like a dream.

keys.DescriptionKey: She doesn't notice it really is a dream, not until an unexpected visitor points it out—another Rizette, dressed in black, visibly angry at the one who dreamed up this happy world. "It's not fair that only you get to have this," that Rizette says. But she drives away all the evil things lurking around nevertheless. Perplexed, Rizette in white can't help but ask, "Have you come to destroy my dream, or to protect it?"

keys.DescriptionKey:
"I came to interrupt this dream. But I won't let anyone else touch it," Rizette in black answers. She knows how precious this fantasy is better than anyone else—she's learned the hard way that being able to be by your loved one's side is the greatest of miracles. And so, she tries giving the other Rizette a push in the right direction.
"Go, make this dream come true in the real world."

keys.DescriptionKey:
Blue roses used to be the symbol of the unattainable. But humans tend to be persistent when they want something, no matter how long it may take to obtain it.
It comes as no surprise that whoever takes this axe, named after a flower once deemed impossible, in their hand, will be given strength to cut through any difficulty and make their dreams come true.

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Are you sure that's not too heavy for you, Theo?"

"I'm fine, Riz. I can carry this much."

"It feels like only yesterday you were smaller than that bag."

"You're treating me like a kid again... You're not that much older than me, you know."

"That doesn't matter. You're my responsibility since Mom and Dad aren't here anymore."

"Riz... Look at the village!"

"!?"

"Those are flames!"

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Riz? Are you sure you're okay?"

"What do you mean?"

"With this Cerulean Crest thing... Everything happened so suddenly. How do you feel about all of it?"

"Theo... You're sweet. But I'm okay, really. I wanted the power to fight, and now I have it. And besides..."

"Besides?"

"Now Finn doesn't have to bear everything alone. He put his life on the line to help us when he didn't even know us, and he ended up with the responsibility of the Crimson Crest. If there's something I can do to lessen his burden, I'll do it."

"Riz..."

keys.DescriptionKey:
Dear Theo,

This is the first letter I've ever written to you, and, if you're reading it, it's also the last.

It wasn't long ago that I couldn't bear the thought of dying if it meant leaving you alone. But it's not quite like that now. I want to fight. Not just for us, but for everyone. Even if it means I don't make it to the end of the story. It's still hard to think of leaving you, but you won't be alone. I know you'll be okay. If you ever feel lost, you just need to think, \'What would Fi—

"Rizette!"

"Wah! Captain!?"

"Tell everyone to meet me outside the laboratory immediately!"

"Has there been an attack!?"

"Not yet. But there will be."

"O-Okay, I'll find Finn!"

keys.DescriptionKey:
They came in numbers Rigland couldn't hope to match. They armed themselves with technology the world had never seen. And when the time came to stand against them, the Red Dragon Knights crumbled from the inside. Not even at the height of the Pandemonium had the future seemed so bleak.

But Rizette had no choice but to move forward.

With her brother at her side, she fled the fallen capital and returned to her hometown: the ruined Westcarte, where her adventure began. Once more, in a place of desolation, hope would rise anew.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Though her kingdom is conquered, its people aren't yet crushed. No matter what indignities the Bergarian soldiers force upon them, no matter the oppression they face, they know that somewhere out there, someone is fighting for their freedom. And they want to aid her however they can.

At the very whisper of Rizette's presence, crates of food and weapons appear at her door. Recruits band together, crude weapons in hand, untrained but ready to fight.

Her rebellion may be young, as fragile as a fawn finding its legs, but as long as Rigland's spirit burns bright, she knows she has nothing to fear.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Rizette once thought the Cerulean Crest gave her strength. And perhaps, at the time, it did. The lonely, scared girl she was never would have believed she could be a hero without its power.

In the end, though, that power was a lie.

She isn't like Finn. She had no legacy to inherit, no Crest to forge for herself. After the Pandemonium, destiny seemed to quietly leave her behind.

No one thought the burden of the kingdom's hopes would fall on her. But fall they did, and even so, she found the strength to stand.

Cerulean as the vault of heaven, this blade has saved Erden once. It will do so again.

When she was young, Rizette was a very timid girl. She would jump in fear at distant footsteps or the howls of wolves. Fortunately, her grandmother was always there for her. Her kind words never failed to bring a smile back to Rizette's face. But she never did understand the "courage" her grandmother spoke of.

RizetteYoung01.name: Young Rizette
RizetteYoung01.title: Pure Blue
RizetteYoung01.description: When she was young, Rizette was a very timid girl. She would jump in fear at distant footsteps or the howls of wolves. Fortunately, her grandmother was always there for her. Her kind words never failed to bring a smile back to Rizette's face. But she never did understand the "courage" her grandmother spoke of.

keys.IntroText:
I'm still a little scared, but I'll be okay.
As long as you'll stay with me.

keys.DescriptionKey:
When Rizette awakens, the sweet smell of pear pie fills the room. Half-asleep, she goes to the table, where her grandmother greets her with a smile. Theo arrives, still yawning, and the three of them start their day.
"Mm, so good!"
"Aah, hot!"
"Haha. Slow down, dear!"
"You're gonna burn your tongue again, Sis!"
She thought those days would last forever.

RizetteYoung02.title: Pure Blue

"Mm, so good!"
"Aah, hot!"
"Haha. Slow down, dear!"
"You're gonna burn your tongue again, Sis!"
She thought those days would last forever.

keys.DescriptionKey: When Rizette was young, bandits attacked Westcarte, and in the chaos, her grandmother lost her life. She's repeated that day over and over, hoping that things could be different, but in the end, the past cannot be changed. Even so, her grandmother lives on within her, supporting her every day. Nothing in the world can change that, either.

keys.value:
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$Hm hmm, hm hmm. ♪
A maiden fair, with flaxen hair... ♪
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$@Left@$No, there's no time to explain. Sorry!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungHappy&$$@Left@$Really? Wow! You're all so nice!
C'mon, Gemina, say thank you.

$#Gemina(Gemina)#$$&GeminaHappy&$$@Left@$T-tank you all so vewy much! You're all bast—
Um, vewy vewy nice people!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(You're laying it on kind of thick, Gemina...
And you almost spilled the beans there, too.)

$#BanditBoss(Bandit Boss)#$$&BanditMaleLecherous&$$@Center@$Aaaw, you're both so cuuuute! C'mon in!
Have a seat! Sorry for all the dust!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungHappy&$$@Center@$(That was easy...)

$#BanditBoss(Bandit Boss)#$$&BanditMaleLecherous&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You look smaller than her, but you're the
older sister, huh?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungNormal&$$@Left@$Y-yeah, I am. I have to keep her safe.
Am I doing a good job?

$#BanditBoss(Bandit Boss)#$$&BanditMaleLecherous&$$@Right@$Yeah, yeah! Very good!
...Yeah!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Left@$(Ah... He just reached over and then stopped
himself. I can use that.)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungHappy&$$@Left@$Ehehe...
Um, mister?

$#Granny(Granny)#$$&GrandmaSad&$$@Right@$Rizette?
B-but the pie...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungHappy&$$@Left@$I did a good job, right?
Will you pat my head?
$#BanditBoss(Bandit Boss)#$$&BanditMaleLecherous&$$@Right@$Hnnnnnnnnnn...!

$#BanditBoss(Bandit Boss)#$$&BanditMaleLecherous&$$@Right@$A-are you sure? I make it a rule not to touch,
but if you're sure...!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungNormal&$$@Left@$(...Yeah, this guy really creeps me out.)
$#BanditBoss(Bandit Boss)#$$&BanditMaleLecherous&$$@Right@$O-okay, here I go—

$#BanditA(Bandit A)#$$&BanditAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hang on a sec, boss!
This's a trap!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Center@$!!!

$#Gemina(Gemina)#$$&GeminaShouting&$$@Right@$Ow! Ow, that hurts!
Get your filthy hands off me!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Left@$Gemina!

$#BanditA(Bandit A)#$$&BanditAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$This one has a magic staff! I don't think
these two're lost kids at all!
$#()#$$!-1!$(The door closes.)
$#BanditBoss(Bandit Boss)#$$&BanditMaleSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Huh!? You're not even kids!?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$@Left@$Um...
(We're really not, so...)

$#BanditBoss(Bandit Boss)#$$&BanditMaleSerious&$$@Right@$Ha...haha...
Taking advantage of my pure heart...
$#BanditBoss(Bandit Boss)#$$&BanditMaleShouting&$$@Right@$Looks like you two need a lesson!!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Theo)#$$!-1!$R-Riz!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Center@$Theo! Don't come out. Just stay in my pocket
where it's safe.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Theo)#$But you two are in danger!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$@Center@$...Ah!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Center@$All mortals' most core form is the soul. When
a life is brought into being on Erden...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Center@$The soul absorbs mana from both parents to
start up their own wellspring of mana.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMonsterHappy&$$@Left@$Riz!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$Right now, Theo, your reserve is essentially
a bone-dry well.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungClosedEyes&$$@Left@$I see...
That's it!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMonsterNormal&$$@Right@$Huh?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Left@$I'm casting it...
Mana Transference!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Now, Rolotia!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaShouting&$$@Right@$Right!
Time Stop!
$#BanditB(Bandit B)#$$&BanditFemaleSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Huh!? I-I can't move!

$#BanditC(Bandit C)#$$&BanditAngry&$$@Right@$Eeep! Retreat, retreat! If someone can't move,
carry 'em! We're gettin' outta here!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$There they go.
...I hope that's enough.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Right@$Are you alright, Finn?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungHappy&$$@Right@$Everyone! And Gemina, too...
I'm glad we're all together.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Left@$Yeah, just bruised a bit. I was hurt last loop,
but I guess that went away when...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$...Hm? Why are you laughing?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSmile&$$@Right@$Haha. I'm glad to hear you're not hurt, but
that isn't what I was asking about.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Right@$You've looked so worried this whole time.
You're afraid for Rizette, aren't you?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...How did you...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$I'm worried about Theo and Gemina too, I mean.
But Rizette...you know, she's small now, so...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$...And that's not all I'm worried about for
them, either.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$Being able to see their grandma again sounds
like a good thing at first, but...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$But they have to keep watching her and their
village get attacked, over and over.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$I just feel bad for them. I know what it's like,
after all, so I can't help but worry.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Something's weird, right? We took down the
bandit leader, but we looped back again.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Don't worry.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSmile&$$@Right@$I haven't spent much time with Rizette, but I
know she has a strong heart.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$...Yeah. You're right.
She really is strong.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$She was already brave when I first met her,
and she's only gotten stronger since then.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$She keeps surprising me, and I just keep
respecting her more and more. She's amazing.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaBlush&$$@Right@$She's gotten stronger...
Not that she's gotten more like you?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Like me?
What do you mean?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaBlush&$$@Right@$Haha.
Ah, to be young!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Huh? I mean, I guess I am young to someone
who's immortal, but...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$@Right@$Now then, let's hurry to the forest.
They may need our help.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMonsterSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Um, about that. I was checking to make sure
we didn't miss any bandits...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Hey, don't change the subject!
What do you mean? Hey!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungShouting&$$@Center@$Come out, Theo!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMonsterDiscontent&$$@Center@$O-okay!
$#BanditA(Bandit A)#$$&BanditSurprised&$$@Center@$W-what is that!? A ball of light!?
$#BanditBoss(Bandit Boss)#$$&BanditMaleSneer&$$@Center@$Don't freak out! It can't do anything!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Center@$I wouldn't be so sure of that!
Here I go, Theo!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungShouting&$$@Center@$Give the mana shape... And pass it on!
Haaaa!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMonsterAngry&$$@Left@$That's right. You don't know what I can do...
$#BanditBoss(Bandit Boss)#$$&BanditMaleSerious&$$@Right@$H-huh? Huuuuh?
$#TheoGiant(Theo)#$$&TheoGiantMonsterDiscontent&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I'll show you...I'm not helpless at all!

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMonsterSad&$$@Center@$And I was worried about Granny at the
riverside, too.
$#TheoGiant(Bandit Boss)#$$&BanditMaleSurprised&$$@Center@$W-w-what the heck is that!?

$#TheoGiant(Theo)#$$&TheoGiantMonsterDiscontent&$$@Center@$You threatened my sister...attacked our
home...attacked our Granny!

$#TheoGiant(Bandit Boss)#$$&BanditMaleSurprised&$$@Center@$Eh? Granny?
A-and we haven't actually—

$#TheoGiant(Theo)#$$&TheoGiantMonsterAngry&$$@Center@$I don't want to hear it!
Take this...
$#TheoGiant(Theo)#$$&TheoGiantMonsterAngry&$$@Center@$Mana Blast!
$#BanditBoss(Bandit Boss)#$$&BanditMaleSurprised&$$@Center@$Gyaaaaaaaaaah!

$#Theo(Finn)#$$&TheoGiantMonsterAngry&$$@Center@$I-Is that Theo!? But we're so far away...
He must be huge!

$#Theo(Rolotia)#$$&TheoGiantMonsterAngry&$$@Center@$I sense a huge pool of mana! Did Rizette
give her mana to Theo instead?
$#()#$Boooooom!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Left@$W-whoa! What was that!?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMonsterNormal&$$@Center@$Anyway, I saw plumes of smoke rising from
the fields on the other side of the village.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Right@$T-the ground is shaking...I can't keep my
feet! Is the world ending!?
$#Gemina(Gemina)#$$&GeminaSad&$$@Right@$Kyaa!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungShouting&$$@Left@$Gemina! Look out!
$#Gemina(Gemina)#$$&GeminaHappyNoLight&$$@Right@$Riz...!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(I was able to catch Gemina, but I can't stay
on my feet myself!)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Center@$(The ground's swept out from under my feet...
I'm going to fall!)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(I'm not hitting the ground. I just feel my
consciousness fading...)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(Finally, darkness takes me...)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Rizette)#$$!-1!$(Ah...)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Rizette)#$(Did we do it this time...?)
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Center@$...Ah! Did they split into two parties?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Rizette)#$(Not again!)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$I looked around after the fight, but I didn't
see any sign of another detachment...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$I'm sorry. I should have been more vigilant.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$It's okay. Sorry you had to fight all of them
on your own.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$So even if we defeat the leader, the other
party needs to be stopped too...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$We don't have a lot of time. It's going to be
hard to take them on one after the other.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Right@$But what else can we do? Even with Gemina's...
Help, we can hardly afford to split up.
$#Gemina(Gemina)#$$&GeminaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hey, what was that pause for!?

$#Gemina(Gemina)#$$&GeminaHappy&$$@Center@$I can do it! I'll use my time magic to stop all
those bandits in their tracks!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Now, wait just a moment! You're still just a
trainee. You don't have the skill necessary.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaShouting&$$@Right@$Mass Time Stop is an extremely advanced
spell, you know!

$#Granny(Granny)#$$&GrandmaNormal&$$@Right@$Oh, dear me. Good morning, Rizette.
The pie's just come out of the oven.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaShouting&$$@Right@$And what's more, it requires an incantation.
Someone would have to buy you time.
$#Gemina(Gemina)#$$&GeminaShouting&$$@Left@$Then why don't you do that, hag?
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$@Right@$I-I suppose I could, but...!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Right@$...I'm sorry. In truth, I'm still not fully used
to having a human body again.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Right@$And I was hardly the most battle-hardened
before I became an Avatar, so, um...
$#Gemina(Gemina)#$$&GeminaSerious&$$@Left@$So basically, you're useless.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Sniffle...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSigh&$$@Center@$......

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$...This is really making me angry!
What is wrong with those bandits!?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaShouting&$$@Center@$If they love cute things so much, they should
try acting a bit cuter themselves!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$@Left@$Granny...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Cute things...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungHappy&$$@Center@$...Ah!
I've got it!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Got what?
Do you have a plan?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungNormal&$$@Center@$Yes. I think I know what to do!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$Are you sure you three will be okay on your
own? I don't mean to doubt you, it's just...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Right@$Yes. I'll fight, Gemina will cast her magic, and
Theo will help keep Gemina safe.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Left@$But if she can't properly cast the spell...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Right@$If she can't access enough mana, then I'll
give her some of my own.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungNormal&$$@Right@$I have...more than enough, after all.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Does that have something to do with the
Cerulean Crest?
$#Granny(Granny)#$$&GrandmaSad&$$@Right@$Hmm? What is it, dear?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungNormal&$$@Right@$Yeah. It's something like an echo of the
Crest, left behind...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenCalm&$$@Left@$One thing you'll notice now that the Crest is
gone— a drastically increased mana reserve.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteCalm&$$@Right@$I did notice that. I didn't realize it was
because of the Crest, though.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenCalm&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Now that Arcane's gone, the Crest itself will
slowly fade away, but...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenCalm&$$@Center@$It seems like the Crest leaves an indelible
mark of sorts on its hosts.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$It's like a deep well of residual mana.
I call it the Cerulean Echo, myself.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I can feel it inside me...but I have no idea
how to access it.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$It feels like it's different from how I used
the Crest when I still had it.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Left@$Yes, it'll likely take you some years of
practice to use it fully. But there is one thing.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenHeh&$$@Left@$A trick to drawing out the mana quickly
and simply.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Another loop! We defeated the bandits, but
time still turned back on itself!)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$Really?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It's a little spell I've developed I like to call...
Mana Transference!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenCalm&$$@Center@$Magic is what happens when you give mana,
this energy, a shape and a purpose, right?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenCalm&$$@Center@$Now, normally it's the shaping that's the
hard part, the part that takes practice.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$But all this spell's "shape" does is give the
mana inside it to someone else.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Give it to someone else... I see!
That does sound like it would be simpler.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Left@$I think it will be. For you, at least.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$For me? What do you mean?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Left@$The Cerulean Crest's magic is intended to
guide, support, and protect.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSmile&$$@Left@$It's perfect for you, isn't it?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Left@$G-Granny! Promise me you won't leave the
house today!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Right@$I'll give Gemina all the mana she needs with
Callen's Mana Transference.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Right@$If we can get all of them with the spell,
maybe we can take them all out at once.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Left@$W-well... I'm not entirely convinced, but...
With your help, it sounds doable.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Left@$But who will buy Gemina time to cast?
Can you handle it?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Don't worry. I have a plan.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Left@$...If you're certain.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$...Is it dangerous?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Right@$A little. But sometimes you don't have a
choice but to take chances.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$...I'm trusting in you here.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Right@$Don't worry. We'll be fine.

$#Granny(Granny)#$$&GrandmaSad&$$@Right@$Huh? But I have to do the washing and fetch
more water, dear...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$...Alright.
We'll leave it to you!

$#Gemina(Gemina)#$$&GeminaSerious&$$@Right@$Why don't you worry about your own end of
things, hm? Hag and Playboy?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Left@$Haha, we'll be careful.
See you all later!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Right@$Yeah!
Let's do this, everyone!
$#Gemina(Gemina)#$$&GeminaSerious&$$@Right@$So this is their hideout...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Left@$The other squad's already left, but the boss
is still here. Okay...just like we planned.
$#BanditB(Bandit B)#$$&BanditFemaleSurprised&$$@Left@$Huh? What's a little brat doin' here?

$#BanditA(Bandit A)#$$&BanditNormal&$$@Right@$Hey now, that's dangerous, missy. Didn't
anyone tell you not to play with blades?

$#BanditBoss(Bandit Boss)#$$&BanditMaleSneer&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hang on, boys!
Look at her...

$#BanditBoss(Bandit Boss)#$$&BanditMaleLecherous&$$@Center@$She's so small!
So cuuuute!!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Left@$Don't worry about it! Really!
Listen, today there's—

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(...Okay, I'm really getting tired of hearing
that by now.)

$#BanditBoss(Bandit Boss)#$$&BanditMaleLecherous&$$!-1!$$@Right@$It's dangerous to play with swords, little
missy. Put it down and come over here.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungHappy&$$@Left@$...You're nice people, right?
