Rizette's mind hasn't reverted, too.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Center@$This is exactly why time magic is strictly
regulated. It can have dire effects.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$That girl, Gemina, is behind this.
I'm sure of it.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$Rizette? Are you okay?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Right@$...Yeah. Sorry, there's just a lot to take in.
I think I'm following, though.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$@Right@$Rolotia, can I ask something? If Westcarte
has been restored, then...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$@Right@$The people who died...our parents. Would
they have been brought back, too?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMonsterNormal&$$@Left@$You mean...we could see our parents again!?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Right@$...I'm sorry, but I need to make things very
clear here.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungNormal&$$@Left@$No, it's best when it's piping hot!
I'd love some!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Right@$The situation is extremely dire. There's no
telling what mistakes she might have made.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Right@$We need to find her, before the burden on
the space-time continuum grows too great.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMonsterNormal&$$@Left@$The space...what?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Right@$Um, it's like...how do I explain this?
Time has a sort of flow, like...mm...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Right@$Ah, like a river. If you force a river to stop
flowing, what happens to the water?

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMonsterNormal&$$@Left@$I think I get it. So basically, we don't know
what could happen, so we have to fix it?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$@Right@$Yes, exactly.
You really are bright, Theo.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Okay, so our first order of business is to
find that girl, Gemina, right?
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&TheoMonsterNormal&$$@Right@$Yes, as soon as possible...
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Kyaaaa!

$#Granny(Granny)#$$&GrandmaNormal&$$@Right@$What a sweet child you are. Ah, but aren't
you forgetting something?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMonsterSurprised&$$@Right@$W-what was that!? A scream!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Come on!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Right@$R-right!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Westcarte Villager)#$Rizette! And...travelers?
Hurry! We have to run!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$What's going on here!?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Westcarte Villager)#$$!-1!$Bandits. They're attacking the village!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$I see...you all get out of here.
Leave this to us!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Come on, everyone!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Right@$Right behind you!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$@Center@$Huff, huff...
H-huh?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungHappy&$$@Left@$Oh, right. Good morning, Granny!
Thanks for the food!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Center@$(Everyone's getting so far ahead...but why!?
I'm running as fast as I can...)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$@Center@$(Oh...right. This was before I started training.
I was much slower back then...)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$@Center@$(What should I do? I can't make them wait,
but I don't want to be alone...)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Center@$Hyaa!?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Center@$O-oww... Oww...!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$@Center@$Waaah...! T-that hurt!
I fell...!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Center@$(...What am I saying!? Now I even sound like a child!)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Center@$(I-I need to pull it together!
I need to go help my friends...!)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Center@$...!?

$#BanditA(Bandit A)#$$&BanditNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hey there, missy. Where are you off to in
such a hurry?

$#Granny(Granny)#$$&GrandmaHappy&$$@Right@$There, that's a good girl. Here, eat up.
Do be careful, it's still hot.
$#BanditB(Bandit B)#$$&BanditFemaleSneer&$$@Right@$Heh heh heh. No running away from us!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(I'm surrounded...but that's okay. These
punks are no match for me!)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Center@$Hyaa!?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Center@$(I-I can barely lift my sword!
My arms are too small...!)

$#BanditA(Bandit A)#$$&BanditNormal&$$@Center@$Hey now, that's dangerous, missy. Didn't
anyone tell you not to play with blades?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungShouting&$$@Center@$S-shut up! I can handle you...!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Center@$(My voice is shaking. Am I...afraid?)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$@Center@$(They look...so big. Did I really used to fight
against people like this?)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(If I could use the Cerulean Crest's power...
It's still inside me. If I could just use it...!)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$@Center@$But what if I don't have courage?
Will I get it someday...?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Left@$Auh! Hot...!

$#Granny(Granny)#$$&GrandmaHappy&$$@Center@$Yes, my dear. Someday, you'll be braver
than anyone else.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Center@$(Granny...!)

$#BanditA(Bandit A)#$$&BanditAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Put the sword down and come over here.
Now!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Left@$N-no...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(I can't move. I'm scared...!
Someone, anyone...!)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Rizette!!
$#BanditA(Bandit A)#$$&BanditSurprised&$$@Right@$Guaaah!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Finn!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Come pick on someone your own size!

$#Granny(Granny)#$$&GrandmaNormal&$$@Right@$Ah, what did I tell you?
Here, some water.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungClosedEyes&$$@Left@$(For a dream, this all sure feels real...)

$#Granny(Granny)#$$&GrandmaNormal&$$@Right@$That reminds me, dear. Will your friends
be staying over tonight, too?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Left@$Friends?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Rizette)#$Mmh...?

$#Granny(Granny)#$$&GrandmaNormal&$$@Right@$You really are still half-asleep! The young
man and young lady, of course.

$#Granny(Granny)#$$&GrandmaNormal&$$@Right@$I must say, I didn't realize you had friends
of that age.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Um...huh?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Center@$(Something's not right here.
I need some time to sort out my thoughts.)

$#Granny(Granny)#$$&GrandmaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Are you feeling well, dear? You keep staring
off into the distance.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$@Left@$Um, maybe not... I'm not really sure.
$#Granny(Granny)#$$&GrandmaSad&$$@Right@$Oh, dear. Here, let me feel your forehead.

$#Granny(Granny)#$$&GrandmaNormal&$$@Right@$You don't feel feverish... I'll take a trip into
town and pick up some medicine, just in case.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$@Left@$O-okay. Sorry...
$#Granny(Granny)#$$&GrandmaNormal&$$@Right@$Now, now. There's nothing to apologize for.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Rizette)#$Someone's singing...? I recognize this voice.
But who...?

$#Granny(Granny)#$$&GrandmaNormal&$$@Right@$Thank you for telling me how you feel, dear.
Good girl.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungNormal&$$@Left@$Ah...
$#Granny(Granny)#$$&GrandmaNormal&$$@Right@$Now then, you rest. I'll be back soon.
$#()#$$!-1!$(The door closes.)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$@Center@$She's gone...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Um, um... i-if this is a dream...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Center@$Wake up, Rizette. Wake up!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$@Center@$...It's not working. And something feels...off.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Center@$Everything feels real, but something's still not right. I just can't tell what...
$#()#$$!-1!$(Knock knock.)

$#GrannyWithPie(Granny)#$$&GrandmaNormal&$$@Center@$Oh, dear me. Good morning, Rizette.
The pie's just come out of the oven.
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$Rizette? Are you in here?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Left@$Huh? That voice!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Right@$Rizette! Thank goodness you're alright.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Left@$Finn!? What are you doing here?
So this is a dream, after all?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$...Huh?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungNormal&$$@Left@$Huh?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$W-w-what the heck!? Rizette, you're...
You're so cute!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Left@$...Huh!? W-what are you saying!?
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaBlush&$$@Right@$A-hem!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Left@$Rolotia!?
When did you get here!?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Rizette)#$$!-1!$...Granny...? But...
How? You're...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$@Right@$I came in with Finn! You just didn't notice
me.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$@Left@$O-oh. Um... Sorry.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Right@$More importantly, Rizette, it sounds as though
you haven't fully grasped your situation?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Left@$My situation...?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(...Is it just me, or are the two of them
taller than usual?)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Center@$(...No, wait. The furniture, the ceiling...
Everything looks taller. It can't be...)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Center@$I-I need to find a mirror!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Center@$...No way.
I've shrunk!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Y-yeah. That's what I meant when I called you...
I mean, you always look nice, it's just...um...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSmile&$$@Right@$Indeed. It's a different kind of cuteness.

$#GrannyWithPie(Granny)#$$&GrandmaSad&$$@Center@$Hm? What am I, dear?
Don't tell me you're still half-asleep.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHappy&$$@Right@$And those clothes are very cute too.
Don't you think so, Finn?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$I do!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$W-wait. Hang on. I'm having trouble dealing
with all of this...!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Center@$W-wait! Theo! Where's Theo?
Isn't he with you two?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$No, we haven't seen him.
I hope he's okay...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMonsterHappy&$$@Center@$Riz! Here I am!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Huh!? A spirit orb?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungShouting&$$@Left@$W-wait! I recognize that cowlick!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMonsterHappy&$$@Right@$Yeah! It's me!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$@Left@$Theo!?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Rizette)#$$!-1!$(It's...really her. And the house is all cleaned.
That patch under the eaves is gone, too.)
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSad&$$@Left@$So, I've been turned into a child...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMonsterNormal&$$@Right@$And I'm something like a ghost. And Granny's
house looks just like it used to.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$What's going on here? I don't get it.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Right@$...I think I may have an idea.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Left@$You do?
What is it?
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Right@$This is most likely time reversal magic.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMonsterSurprised&$$@Left@$Time reversal?
Is that different from what you do?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$!-1!$$@Center@$In the broadest sense, they're both time
magic, at least.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Center@$But in much the same way as healing magic
for curing burns is different from curing poison...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Center@$Time magic also has many branches that are
slightly, but distinctly, different.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Rizette)#$(I see. I'm dreaming. It must be because we
talked about her so much last night.)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Center@$Time reversal magic reverts something to how
it was at a certain point in its timeline.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Reverts... Then, you mean Granny's been
reverted back to before she died?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Right@$It's not just her. I had a look around
earlier...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Right@$And the whole of Westcarte has been reverted
to before it was destroyed in the Pandemonium.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Then, what about Rossé?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Right@$...I'm sorry, Finn.
Rossé is still as it was.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$O-oh...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Right@$The spell's effects are limited to a very small
area around Westcarte.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Right@$The effect is likely tied to something that
happened here a long time ago.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Left@$Only Westcarte, huh...that explains why me
and Rolotia are still the same as always.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Rizette)#$(...What a wonderful dream.)

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMonsterDiscontent&$$@Left@$But what about me? Why did I end up like
this, then!?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Right@$If I had to guess...you've been reverted to back
before you were born, as a sort of spirit.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Left@$But that's weird. If this is when the attack
happened...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteYoungSerious&$$@Left@$Theo should still be around. He's only four
years younger than me.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$You're right, that is weird.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...I'm sorry. I don't have too much experience
with these kinds of situations.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$I can only assume that a mistake in the spell
had an unexpected effect on you.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$Whoever did this clearly has immense power,
but...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$If that power isn't handled correctly, it can
affect things more strongly than intended.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoMonsterSad&$$@Center@$So it's just me? That's not fair...

keys.DescriptionKey: Clare was raised in a peaceful village under the loving care of her parents. Though shy by nature, she had a love for adventure. One day, when lost in the forest, she was rescued by Rizette from the neighboring village. From that day on, the two became close friends. Clare admired Rizette for being a highly skilled hunter and viewed her as a dependable big sister.

keys.IntroText: Let us press onward, comrades!

keys.DescriptionKey: From then on, Rizette would visit Clare's home, sometimes bringing her younger brother along with her. Clare admired the siblings. One, the brave sister and the other, the clever brother. Gradually, the two became irreplaceable family to her. However, a single misunderstanding tore the relationship to shreds.

keys.DescriptionKey: Since childhood, Clare has admired Rizette and trained in secret. Because of this, while undergoing the intense training under the Silver Knights, it became clear that she possessed exceptional talent. Now, she has sworn in her heart to use that strength for the sake of her cherished friend and the order.

$#DONTSHOWME(Edward)#$$|act1.Voices/sst145|$You're from Rossé, aren't you? have you
seen my brother Al?

$#DONTSHOWME(Edward)#$$|act1.Voices/sst146|$Alfred—He went to aid the nothern
villages, but he hasn't come back.

$#DONTSHOWME(Edward)#$$|act1.Voices/sst147|$Let me know if you see him. His family is
getting worried...

$#DONTSHOWME(Edward)#$$|act1.Voices/sst148|$My brother was killed while aiding the
northern villages...

$#DONTSHOWME(Edward)#$$|act1.Voices/sst149|$We Knights know the risk when we join this
order.

$#DONTSHOWME(Edward)#$$|act1.Voices/sst150|$But I didn't expect I would be the one left
to grieve...

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$Something's up. Captain Ludmilla's back
without any of her accompanying troops...

$#DONTSHOWME(Northern Villager)#$$|act1.Voices/sst141|$Hey! Aren't you from Rossé?
I'm from Wyldtern, just southwest of you.

$#DONTSHOWME(Northern Villager)#$$|act1.Voices/sst142|$Some monsters attacked us, too. We drove
them off but the village is in shambles...

$#DONTSHOWME(Northern Villager)#$$|act1.Voices/sst143|$Our doors are open if you need help though.
We northerners have got to stick together!

$#DONTSHOWME(Northern Townsperson)#$Rossé? Yeah, I know it.
My cousin lives in nearby Westcarte.
$#DONTSHOWME(Northern Townsperson)#$We used to adventure in Rossé as kids.

$#DONTSHOWME(Northern Townsperson)#$They say the place is haunted
so we would go there on a dare.

$#DONTSHOWME(Northern Townsperson)#$Considering the tragedy that took place,
it was probably quite inappropriate of us.

$#DONTSHOWME(Northern Townsperson)#$We ought to be thankful
for living in peaceful times now.

$#DONTSHOWME(Northern Townsperson)#$Now that you mention it,
I haven't seen my cousin in a long time!

$#DONTSHOWME(Northern Townsperson)#$He's such a happy-go-lucky guy.
I'd like to catch up with him soon!

$#DONTSHOWME(Northern Villager)#$$|act1.Voices/sst144|$We'll get through this. The folk of the north
are tougher than the scales of a szi chief.

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act1.Voices/sst125|$Do you know about the old ruin outside of
Rigland? The knights use it for training.

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act1.Voices/sst126|$It's a remnant of the Old Kingdom. No one's
quite sure what it was used for.

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act1.Voices/sst127|$There are rumors that secrets about the
Pandemonium are hidden inside!

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$$|act1.Voices/sst128|$Regular folk aren't allowed in, though. I'd
love to check it out someday!

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$I'm a nomad, and some of my sheep
have gone missing.
$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$Somebody must be stealing them!

$#DONTSHOWME(Townsperson)#$It's happening to the other nomads too,
so I've come to file a report.

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act1.Voices/sst137|$Success on the battlefield is all about
managing your Spirit!

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act1.Voices/sst138|$There are attacks that increase your Spirit,
and attacks that consume it.

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act1.Voices/sst139|$If you build your Spirit Gauge by using
Spirit-increasing skills,

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act1.Voices/sst140|$you can unleash deadly high-Spirit attacks
on your enemies!

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act1.Voices/sst129|$You look like an up-and-coming warrior.
Would you like some tips from a veteran?

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act1.Voices/sst130|$Success on the battlefield all boils down to
good time management.

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act1.Voices/sst131|$Have you noticed how every skill has a
cooldown time?

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act1.Voices/sst132|$This time period is measured in TU, or
time units.

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act1.Voices/sst133|$The amount of TU a skill takes determines
your place in the turn order after you use it.

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act1.Voices/sst134|$There are skills like Stun that can increase
the cooldown TU of enemies.

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act1.Voices/sst135|$And some skills, like Time Bolt, deal more
damage to enemies with a high cooldown TU.

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act1.Voices/sst136|$There are a lot of combos you can use if
you pay attention to TU during battle.

keys.DescriptionKey: Some believe that life on Erden began when a meteorite struck the ground aeons ago. The blacksmith who forged this spear claimed it contains fragments of this instigator of primordial life. The truth of his statement is unverified, but there are many accounts of peculiar dreams of an empty planet had by those who have handled it.

keys.value:
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$How long does this storeroom go on,
anyway?

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSerious2&$$@Center@$The master of this labyrinth is using it
to mass-produce cursed weapons.
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAttack&$$!-1!$$@Right@$That's twisted!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$Sounds like we have even more questions
for the Baron to answer when we get out.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSurprised&$$@Right@$First, we need to escape.
...Hm? That light...
$#Marcel(Marcel)#$$&MarcelHappy&$$@Left@$It's the outside! Light from outside!
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$@Left@$It's the exit!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeHappy&$$@Right@$Thank you both so much. Now we can
get the children back to their fam—
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Gooooaaaaa!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSurprise&$$@Left@$What the?!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeShouting&$$@Right@$It's a golem!
A powerful magical construct!

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSerious&$$@Right@$Dunno. There sure are a lot of weapons
down here, though.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Golem)#$Gooooo!

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$Damn, it's strong! I blocked the blow, but
my sword's got cracks in it!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$@Right@$Yuki! We'll hold it off.
You get the kids to safety!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeDetermined&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Don't be ridiculous!
You can't fight that thing!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAttack&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Rody, get around behind it!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$@Right@$$%0.3%$Haa!
Dang, not a scratch!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Golem)#$Gaaaa!

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Left@$Damn...!
We need to buy time!
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Right@$At least until the kids get out, yeah.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Their attacks aren't doing anything to it!
At this rate, they'll...)

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSurprised&$$@Right@$...!
That sword...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Golem)#$$!-1!$Goaaaaa!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Ugh, it's pushing me back!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(But if I use my power...
If they come to fear me, then...)

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Yuki, what are you doing?!
Hurry up and run!
$#YukiAwaken(Yuki)#$$&YukiAwaken&$$@Center@$...Get back, you two!

$#YukiAwaken;(Druke)#$$&YukiAwakenMagic&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Wha—
Whoa!
$#YukiAwaken;(Rody)#$$&YukiAwakenMagic&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Wah!
$#YukiAwaken;(Golem)#$$&YukiAwakenMagic&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Gooo...

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$The golem just...froze and shattered
apart!

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSurprise&$$@Left@$Yuki, did you do that? ...Hm?
Hey, your clothes...
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$@Left@$What is it?
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$@Right@$Yuki, are you...

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Yes. I'm sorry for lying to you.
But the "evil" Winter Witch is well-known.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSerious&$$@Left@$You should have told us sooner! That
thing nearly turned us into paste!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSerious1&$$@Right@$I'm sorry. The rumors are baseless, but
still, I didn't want you to fear me...

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSerious1&$$@Right@$That's what always happens. I was even
framed for the disappearances, too.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$@Left@$I see...

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSmile&$$@Right@$Then hey, want to get to the bottom of it
with us? It'd be great havin' you along.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyNormal&$$@Left@$We're working for the Red Dragon
Knights in secret.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyNormal&$$@Left@$We're here to solve the disappearances
and re-stabilize the Barony.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyNormal&$$@Left@$We'd appreciate your help, and I'm sure
the kids would, too.
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSerious1&$$@Right@$...Look.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSad&$$@Right@$I'm sorry, but I plan to leave the Barony
as soon as possible.
$#YoungBoy;YoungGirl;(Children)#$$&YoungBoyScared;YoungGirl.YoungGirlScared&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;YoungGirl.Right;@$Huh?

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I'm a criminal, after all.
I can't stay here anymore.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Left@$Well, then...
Why not come to Rigland with us?
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiNormal&$$@Right@$Rigland?

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Left@$You should join us! Then we can fight
together, to save Erden.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$@Left@$That power everyone feared can be put
to use for the good of the whole world!
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSurprised&$$@Right@$...Put to use?

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$@Left@$Yeah. We could definitely use your power
to stop the Pandemonium.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSad&$$@Right@$Use my power... I see, Rody.
In the end, you're just like all the rest.

$#CursedWeapon(Druke)#$$&CursedWeapon&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Huh? It's got some kind of...evil-looking
aura hanging around it.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Corrupt Lord)#$You're a genius, Yuki. Ha ha ha... Using
your power, none will dare oppose me.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Twisted Noble)#$You're the only mage I've heard of that
can freeze castle walls. How useful!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Cruel General)#$You're a tool to defend this kingdom with.
Be silent and do as I say!

$#Baron(Baron Yarrell)#$$&BaronYarrellSerious&$$@Center@$How dare you disobey me! Have you
forgotten your purpose here?!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSerious2&$$@Center@$...I've had enough of being put to use.
It's too bad. We could have been friends.

$#Marcel(Marcel)#$$&MarcelScared&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ah! Where are you going?!
Everyone, follow Miss Yuki!
$#YoungBoy;YoungGirl;(Children)#$$&YoungBoyScared;YoungGirl.YoungGirlScared&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;YoungGirl.Right;@$Yeah!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurpriseComedy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yuki! Kids!
Wait!

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAngry&$$@Left@$Damn, the flow of souls from the
labyrinth is blocking my view!
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$@Right@$We'll have to go after them!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The grudge of the souls wandering the
labyrinth permeates the blade.
$#AeonKnight(Monster)#$$&AeonKnight&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Grrr...
$#Druke;Rody;(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit;Rody.RodySurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Rody.Right;@$A monster?!
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$@Right@$It's blocking the path. Why now?!

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Now you've done it...
Crimson Crestbearer.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$@Right@$Who's there?!

$#Argento(???)#$$&ArgentoSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I am Argento, the Silvered Forgefire.
An Aeon Lord.
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$!-1!$$@Left@$An Aeon Lord?!

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoSurprise&$$@Right@$You destroyed my golem, and undid the
spell on my foundry.

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoAngry&$$@Right@$Look at all these souls you've wasted.
Look at them!

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoAngry&$$@Right@$Top-grade materials to forge the most
powerful weapons!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSad&$$@Center@$The despair and hatred they felt, trapped
in this pit of no escape.

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoAngry&$$@Right@$And you just let them dissipate into
nothingness!

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAttack&$$@Left@$Materials? Those are people's lives you're
talking about, scum!

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoSurprise&$$@Right@$Was it you who shattered my golem,
Crestbearer?

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(I can't risk this creep getting wind of
Yuki and the kids.)

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$@Center@$...Yeah, it was me. Did it in one hit.
It was easy.

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You...!
Damn you!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$@Left@$Come on, Argento! Come at me!
I'll break you just like your golem!

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoSerious&$$@Right@$...I have no intention of crossing blades
with you, Crestbearer.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$@Left@$What?

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoSerious&$$@Right@$To fill the world with chaos, suffering,
and hatred. That's how I work!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSad&$$@Center@$These weapons are imbued with their
owners' hatred and rage.
$#AeonKnight(Monster)#$$&AeonKnight&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Graaaaah!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What the?!

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoAngry&$$@Right@$I've summoned a whole host of monsters.
They'll disperse into the Barony soon.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$@Left@$Argento...!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAttack&$$@Right@$You bastard!

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoCreepy&$$@Right@$How ironic. By opposing an Aeon Lord,
you've brought death to these people.

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoCreepy&$$@Right@$Their blood is on your hands...
"Hero". Ahahahaha!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Right@$Damn it, he's gone!
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$Into the town! Hurry!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiHappy&$$@Right@$Phew.
That's the last of them.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$Come on, let's go look for her.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Right@$Aw, why? After what she did to us, I'm
glad to see the back of her.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyNormal&$$@Left@$There's something I want to ask her.

$#Baron(Baron Yarrell)#$$&BaronYarrellAngry&$$@Right@$Gh...what was that sudden flood of
monsters?

$#Baron(Baron Yarrell)#$$&BaronYarrellAngry&$$@Right@$Those damned beasts injured my leg...
I can barely walk.

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraSmug&$$@Left@$Oh, if it isn't your Lordship!
What are you doing here?

$#Baron(Baron Yarrell)#$$&BaronYarrellNormal1&$$@Right@$You...the assassin that attacked the
caravan!
$#Baron(Baron Yarrell)#$$&BaronYarrellNormal1&$$@Right@$It seems my luck has run out.

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraSmug&$$@Left@$There's one thing I want to ask you.
Do you mind?
$#Baron(Baron Yarrell)#$$&BaronYarrellNormal1&$$@Right@$...What is it.

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraHappy&$$@Left@$Wow, that was amazing!
You're amazing, Yuki!

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraSerious&$$@Left@$What made you sell your precious citizens
to an Aeon Lord, of all things?

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraSerious&$$@Left@$I looked into you. You were a fair, wise,
well-liked leader.

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraShouting&$$@Left@$So what happened? How'd you fall so
far, so fast?

$#Baron(Baron Yarrell)#$$&BaronYarrellAngry&$$@Right@$Because fairness and wisdom mean
nothing with Bergaria at our threshold!

$#Baron(Baron Yarrell)#$$&BaronYarrellAngry&$$@Right@$I traded a few lives for the safety and
security of many. And I would again!

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraSerious&$$@Left@$I'd never make a deal like that
if I were a leader.

$#Baron(Baron Yarrell)#$$&BaronYarrellSerious&$$@Right@$Hah. Easy enough to say,
for one of your birth.

$#Baron(Baron Yarrell)#$$&BaronYarrellSerious&$$@Right@$But I could not bear to see my people
crushed under Bergaria's heel!

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraFlirty&$$@Left@$Is that so?
Well, lucky you. You won't have to.
$#Baron(Baron Yarrell)#$$&BaronYarrellShouting&$$@Right@$$%0.3%$Hrgk...!
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$@Left@$So that's the power of the Winter Witch...

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraSmug&$$@Left@$Your kingdom will fall.
But you won't be there to see it.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSmile&$$@Right@$Heh. Looks like we've been upstaged,
huh, partner?

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiNormal&$$@Right@$Now we can start treating the wounded.
Starting with you, Rody.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyNormal&$$@Left@$Thanks. Druke was hurt down in the pit...
Alira, can you— huh?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Rody)#$$!-1!$She's gone...
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAngry&$$@Right@$Nothing strange about that, is there?

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAngry&$$@Right@$Maybe we'll get lucky, and she'll never
come back.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Center@$Argento. Still hammering away in your
gloomy pit, I see.

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoSerious&$$@Right@$Lay waste to Erden? I already am. My
weapons are spread far and wide.

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoSerious&$$@Right@$Powerful weapons have a pull. Those who
find them will want to use them.

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoSmirk&$$@Right@$Humans will slay each other for them.
Kingdoms will bring each other to ruin...

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoSmirk&$$@Right@$Even the Red Dragon Knights will fall
to temptation in time.

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoCreepy&$$@Right@$No one will be left to oppose us. The
Pandemonium will carry on, forever.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Left@$And how many centuries do you intend
to wait for that to happen?

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoSmirk&$$@Right@$It's a slow, but assured death. My wares
invite wars between avaricious nobles...

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoSmirk&$$@Right@$And the survivors will seize the blades
and spread them to the ends of Erden.

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoCreepy&$$@Right@$The strife of man will tear this world
apart, slowly but surely! That's my role.

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoSmirk&$$@Right@$In a manner of speaking, by using my
blade, my young friend...

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Norza. Always a pleasure to see you, too.
Are you after a new weapon?

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoSmirk&$$@Right@$You're not an Aeon Lord.
You're simply one of my pawns.
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Left@$Hah. Ancient history, old man.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Left@$I'm stronger than you now. Go ahead—
Try treating me like a pawn now.

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoSmirk&$$@Right@$Oho. Your bravado reminds me of your
old teacher.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Left@$...I have more important things to do
than stand here listening to you blather.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Left@$I'm letting you live because you're of use
to me. Don't forget that.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Left@$The instant that's not true anymore, I'll
cut you down without a second thought.

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoSmirk&$$@Right@$Yes, I'll be of use. Especially with this
new ore I've just received.

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoCreepy&$$@Right@$With each hammer blow, forging the end
of this world... Haha. Hahahaha!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Left@$No. This blade you forged is all I need.
It's my fate, you see.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Left@$That fate sharpens its edge, and guides
me ever closer to true strength.

$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoSmirk&$$@Right@$I'm so glad you like it. That one's a
particular favorite of mine, after all.
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Left@$So? How are your plans proceeding?
$#Argento(Argento)#$$&ArgentoSerious&$$@Right@$Quite well, thank you.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Left@$The Pandemonium has started. Stop your
tinkering, and come do your duty.
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Left@$The time has come to lay waste to Erden.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Left@$So where are you from, Alira?
$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraFlirty&$$@Right@$Yes, I imagine so.
$#Baron(Baron Yarrell)#$$&BaronYarrellSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I see. Marauders from Bergaria, are you?

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Left@$That's ridiculous!
There's gotta be some kind of mistake!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$@Left@$...Alira! She planted those on us when
she hugged us!

$#Baron(Baron Yarrell)#$$&BaronYarrellSerious&$$@Right@$We will have the truth from these men in
due time. Imprison them.
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAttack&$$@Left@$Damn it, she played us!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Rody)#$(Druke and I were found guilty, and
thrown into a strange pit in the manor.)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Rody)#$(Seems like it's reserved for those who
deserve a fate worse than death...)

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeBored&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Ugh, it's been like this the whole way.
Never gives a straight answer to anything.)

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Center@$(No way that meathead's gonna get
anything useful out of her, anyway.)

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraFlirty&$$!-1!$$@Right@$So you're a mercenary, Rody?
No wonder you look so strong! ♪

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurpriseComedy&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$Hey, don't grab onto me. You'll make
me yank the reins.

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraSmug&$$@Right@$Oh, sorry. I just wanted to thank you for
saving my life, that's all.

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraSmug&$$@Right@$Most men would be glad to get a hug
from a pretty girl, don't you think?

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyEmbarrassed&$$@Left@$Well, maybe, but I'm a married man with
a kid on the way, so...

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraHappy&$$@Right@$Oh, really?! Then here, a hug of
congratulations!
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurpriseComedy&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$H-hey...!
$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraSmug&$$@Right@$A town very, very far away.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(And when she's pressed, she throws the
conversation off like that.)

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSerious&$$@Center@$(She's a sly one. No way Rody's getting
anything out of her.)
$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$And a big hug for you, too, Drukey!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSurprise&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$Whoa!

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraSerious&$$@Right@$Aww, what's the matter?
You don't like hugs either, Drukey?

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Left@$I-I don't mind 'em, but...
What's all this "Drukey" stuff, huh?

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraHappy&$$@Right@$It's a nickname!
Cute, isn't it?
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Left@$I don't need a nickname!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$@Right@$Ha...
Hahaha!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAttack&$$@Left@$Shut your face, Rody!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$@Left@$Huh, you don't say?
Whereabouts?

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraFlirty&$$@Right@$But you're so strong and fierce. Shouldn't
your name be a little friendly, at least?

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Right@$If we bring it back to her, maybe we

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyNormal&$$@Left@$(I'll gloss it over, don't worry. It's not
fair to just ask, right?)

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Right@$Don't worry. She could turn out to be
a lot nicer than people say.
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeBlush&$$@Left@$...Maybe you're right.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeBlush&$$@Left@$Maybe she's not such a bad person
after all.
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeBlush&$$@Left@$...Thanks, Rody.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Okay, kids, head count! Let's move out!
Phew. Dealing with monsters is easier...
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$...

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$And so it turned out Alira betrayed us,
and we got thrown in here.
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSurprised&$$@Right@$...
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$...
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Whew, this is awkward.)
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeDetermined&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...!

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Huh? Something's down that way. A kid?
Looks like a whole bunch of 'em.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Right@$Let's check it out!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSerious1&$$@Right@$...What does that matter?
Why even ask?
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Marcel!

$#Marcel(Marcel)#$$&MarcelHappy&$$@Left@$Ah... Miss Yuki!
Everyone! Miss Yuki's here to save us!
$#YoungBoy;YoungGirl;(Children)#$$&YoungBoyHappy;YoungGirl.YoungGirlHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;YoungGirl.Right;@$Miss Yuki! It's really you!
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You know these kids?

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeHappy&$$@Right@$I would know them anywhere.
They're all my students.
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSerious1&$$@Right@$What are you all doing here?

$#Marcel(Marcel)#$$&MarcelSerious&$$@Left@$On my way home from class, I suddenly
felt faint, and when I woke up, I was here.
$#Marcel(Marcel)#$$&MarcelSerious&$$@Left@$Same for everyone else.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Why would innocent children be thrown
in a prison?

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$The entrance is in the baron's manor.
He must be involved in all this somehow.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Left@$Just curious, I guess. It might give us a
hint on how to get out of here.
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAngry&$$@Right@$Hey. You think all those disappearances...
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$Yeah, I was just thinking the same thing.
$#Marcel(Marcel)#$$&MarcelScared&$$!-1!$$@Left@$We've been looking for the exit for ages...

$#Marcel(Marcel)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Left@$But we're all so hungry, and it's scary,
and chilly too...

$#Marcel(Marcel)#$$&MarcelSerious&$$@Left@$We even stopped looking for the exit...
But then you came, Miss!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSerious2&$$@Right@$You were all very brave. But it's alright
now. We're going to rescue you.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Left@$So you're a teacher, huh?
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeHappy&$$@Right@$Ah... Yes.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSmile&$$@Left@$Heh. Guess we can't give up and die
after all, huh?
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSad&$$@Right@$...
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSerious2&$$@Right@$I already told you, it doesn't matter.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$Druke, you go first. Then Yuki and the
kids, and I'll take up the rear.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$These kids have been through hell. I'll
make sure none of them fall behind.
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSmile&$$@Right@$You got it.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSerious1&$$@Right@$Rody...
Druke...

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSerious2&$$@Right@$Please.
Save these children.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$@Left@$Of course.
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSmile&$$@Right@$You can count on us!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Isn't that great, everyone? These two
are going to help us get out of here!
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(She's like a different person now.)

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Center@$(This must be the real Yuki.
I'm sure of it.)

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyNormal&$$@Left@$Hmm, okay then...
What's your favorite food, then?

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSurprise&$$@Right@$Let's slow down. Hurrying will just make
us more tired...hm?
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$@Left@$What's the matter?

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAngry&$$@Right@$There it is again.
Feels like a draft.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSurprised&$$@Right@$A draft?
That's impossible.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$@Left@$Kud have super-strong senses. And their
greatest warriors' senses are even better.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I didn't notice it the first time we came
through here, but now I'm sure.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAngry&$$@Center@$If we keep going in circles, we'll never
find the way out.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Center@$But...yeah, I think it's this wall.
Haaa!

$#()#$$!-1!$A dull sound reverberates through the
cavern.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$@Right@$An echo from behind the wall...

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSerious2&$$@Right@$Didn't you hear me?
There's no point to asking.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAngry&$$@Left@$The air feels different here. I bet there's
a hollow space behind this wall.
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAttack&$$@Left@$Right. Let's bust it down.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeShouting&$$@Left@$...Alright.
Children, get away from the wall.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAttack&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Here goes...
Haaaa!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSurprise&$$@Center@$Hey, what the—!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It's a trap!
Daggers from the wall!
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Aah!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Look out!
Haa!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyHurt&$$@Right@$$%0.3%$...Man, that hurts.
Got me in the shoulder.
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSerious1&$$@Left@$Rody... You protected me?

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyNormal&$$@Left@$But there's no harm either, right?
Just making conversation, I guess...
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSurprised&$$@Left@$...The children!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Left@$They're fine.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeHurt&$$@Left@$Urgh, that really hurts.
A few of 'em got me.

$#Marcel(Marcel)#$$&MarcelScared&$$@Right@$G-got you?
Are you gonna be okay...?

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSmile&$$@Left@$Hah. Trust me, kid. These little things
are like pinpricks to an Urg Roan.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Why would you go so far for us?
You're mercenaries.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeShouting&$$@Left@$No matter the pretty things you say, in
the end, you only think of yourselves.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSad&$$@Left@$In the end, people only ever use one
another for their own benefit. So why...

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyHurt&$$@Right@$Good question. This hurts something
fierce, and we're not even getting paid.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyNormal&$$@Right@$I don't get it myself. But you haven't done
anything wrong. You're just a teacher.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$(I understand wanting her to open up, but
he's going about this all wrong.)

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyNormal&$$@Right@$If we let you die to save ourselves, I'd
never be able to sleep at night.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$@Right@$I'm sure Druke feels the same way.
Right?

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yup. And if we can't save a bunch of kids,
then how can we call ourselves warriors?

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You'd do anything to keep them safe
too, right?
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Right@$That's what strength's for, after all.
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeBlush&$$@Left@$Right... You're right.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$!-1!$$@Left@$H-hey, come on! Don't pull my hair!
You're gonna undo my braids!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$@Right@$Haha. Looks like the kids have gotten
pretty attached to you, partner.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAttack&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$It's not funny! Hey, you! Don't mess with
my sword! That's dangerous!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$All the children look up to warriors.
As much as I hate to admit it.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$@Left@$Hey, I know. How about I tell you how
Druke and I met? I was visiting Urg Roa...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Druke)#$Look up to us, eh...guess I was the same,
way back— Hands off my ears, dang it!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Right@$It looks like the space behind the wall
is an armory of some kind.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Right@$Well, it's more like a dumping ground.
All of these are too rusty to be used.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSerious2&$$@Left@$They may be the belongings of the people
imprisoned here.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAttack&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$%0.3%$Stop running around! If you get lost,
you won't be able to get home, you know!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Haha. Looks like Druke has his hands
full with the kids.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$@Right@$Hm? Hey, this staff looks pretty new.
It's shaped like a snowflake.

$#YukiWeapon(Yuki)#$$&YukiWeapon&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That's...
The Witch's staff, I suppose.

$#YukiWeapon(Yuki)#$$&YukiWeapon&$$@Center@$The Winter Witch. She froze castles solid,
and stole children to keep herself strong.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Wow, it's that strong? Maybe we should
hold onto it. Still seems usable, after all.
Yuki, Witch of Winter

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAngry&$$@Left@$Damn it...
How big is this place, anyway?
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Look, it is a person after all!
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Right@$Were you imprisoned in here too?

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Right@$I'm Rody and this is Druke. We're looking
for the exit, but this place is massive.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Right@$Do you want to work together? If we work
together, maybe we can escape.

$#Yuki(Woman)#$$&YukiRobeSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Sorry, but...
I'd rather stay here.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Here? With no food or water? That's
like saying you want to die.

$#Yuki(Woman)#$$&YukiRobeSad&$$@Right@$Exactly.
Leave me alone, please.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$You must've been wandering around a
long time down here.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$@Left@$But don't give up. We're mercenaries,
see? We're experts at survival.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$@Left@$We'll find the exit for sure. So don't give
up, okay? We'll make it.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAngry&$$@Left@$All these hallways are identical.
Everywhere we go, it all looks the same.

$#Yuki(Woman)#$$&YukiRobeShouting&$$@Right@$I'm not in despair because I can't find
the exit.
$#Yuki(Woman)#$$&YukiRobeSerious1&$$@Right@$Look over there. In the corner.
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Left@$...Bones. Looks like human.

$#Yuki(Woman)#$$&YukiRobeSad&$$@Right@$A prisoner, who died down here in the
dark.

$#Yuki(Woman)#$$&YukiRobeSad&$$@Right@$Look closely. Try not to blink or
look away.
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSurprise&$$@Left@$Hm...? What's that?!

$#Yuki(Woman)#$$&YukiRobeSerious1&$$@Right@$See the orb of fire floating above the
corpse?

$#Yuki(Woman)#$$&YukiRobeSerious2&$$@Right@$That's the body's soul. It can't escape or
dissipate. It's stuck here, forever.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$@Left@$Now that I look, there's a lot of them
around here, huh?

$#Yuki(Woman)#$$&YukiRobeSerious2&$$@Right@$This labyrinth is a huge boneyard. One
cursed so the souls can never escape.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Right@$Actually, I think we're just going in
circles.

$#Yuki(Woman)#$$&YukiRobeSerious2&$$@Right@$We'll end up just like them. Why waste
your time struggling against it?

$#Yuki(Woman)#$$&YukiRobeSad&$$@Right@$It's nicer in here than it is out there,
anyway... You ought to give up, too.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hah. It'll take more than this to break
the spirit of a warrior of Urg Roa.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSmile&$$@Center@$Come on. Doesn't this make you wanna
kick and scream?

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAngry&$$@Center@$Those bastards who threw us in here are
convinced we'll die down in this pit.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAngry&$$@Center@$Don't you wanna prove 'em wrong? Let's
stuff their smug teeth down their throats.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAngry&$$@Center@$And you can prove the rest of the world
wrong at the same time.
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Center@$That's how we Urg Roans do it!

$#Yuki(Woman)#$$&YukiRobeHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...
...Hah.
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSurprise&$$@Left@$What, did I say something funny?

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Left@$I swear, as soon as we get out of here,
I'm gonna find Alira and I'm gonna— hm?
$#Yuki(Woman)#$$&YukiRobeNormal&$$@Right@$No, just something very foolish.
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAngry&$$@Left@$You making fun of me?

$#Yuki(Woman)#$$&YukiRobeSerious2&$$@Right@$Well, I have nothing better to do until I
die. I suppose I'll walk along with you.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$@Right@$That's all we can ask for.
Good job, Druke.
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Left@$Ha, sounds sarcastic coming from you.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Right@$You seem like you know a lot about magic.
That should come in handy down here.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyTroubled&$$@Right@$Good to meet you, uh...

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$My name is Yuki.
Not that it matters.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiRobeSad&$$@Center@$We stand almost no chance of getting
out of here, after all.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$@Right@$What is it?

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSurprise&$$@Left@$Is that a person?
See? Way down the hallway there.
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSurprise&$$@Left@$Must be a prisoner like us.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Right@$Let's go talk to them.
Maybe we can help each other.
$#Yuki(Woman)#$$&YukiRobeSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSerious2&$$@Center@$I've frozen all the monsters around here
into an ice wall.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Yuki!
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSurprised&$$@Right@$Rody?!
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiDetermined&$$@Right@$Stay back!

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSurprise&$$@Left@$Hey, whoa, don't point that thing at us!
That's dangerous!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiDetermined&$$@Right@$You...you're no different from all the rest!
You just want to use me!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiDetermined&$$@Right@$You plied me with kind words, opened my
heart... All so you could get to me.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiDetermined&$$@Right@$And then, once you were done using me,
you'd turn me out, just like the rest!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSerious2&$$@Right@$Like the lords who used me for conquest,
or suppression, or war.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSerious2&$$@Right@$The Baron was kind to me at first, too.
He told me he was different from the rest.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSerious2&$$@Right@$He promised to only ever use my power
to defend his people if Bergaria invaded.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSerious2&$$@Center@$But stay alert. Marcel, keep the children
in the center. Don't leave my side.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiDetermined&$$@Right@$That lasted until he told me to bury a
city under an avalanche.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSerious2&$$@Right@$I refused. I would never turn my power
on people who hadn't done anything!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSerious1&$$@Right@$The Baron's attitude changed immediately.
He, and everyone else, turned on me.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSerious1&$$@Right@$I was chased out of the manor house and
made to live in a tower in the forest.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSerious1&$$@Right@$I was told I could live there and teach
magic, and I thought things were okay...

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSad&$$@Right@$But looking back now, I was just being
framed for the disappearances.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSad&$$@Right@$It was all to set up rumors that I was
kidnapping the children.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSad&$$@Right@$And eventually, the parents snapped and
had me thrown in the labyrinth...

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiDetermined&$$@Right@$I've had enough. I won't let anyone use
me ever again. I'm sick of being a weapon!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$I'm sorry for what I said. I didn't think
about your feelings at all.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSerious1&$$@Center@$Just a little longer, alright?
The monsters are almost gone.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$But I asked you to join us because of
how kind a person you are.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$I've met plenty of super-powerful people
who use their power for evil.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$To destroy, not protect. For themselves,
not for others. To kill, not to save.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Left@$I know you'd never use your power
like that, Yuki.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Left@$I could tell as soon as I saw you
protecting the kids.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Left@$I'll ask one more time.
Won't you join us?

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$We'll never ask you to use your power
in a way you don't want to.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$It's entirely up to you. We'll respect
whatever you choose.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSerious&$$@Left@$Trust me, this guy doesn't have a lying
bone in his body. You can believe him.
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSerious1&$$@Right@$(Maybe they are different from the rest.)

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSerious1&$$@Center@$(And then, once the town is safe, I'll
be leaving you forever.)
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSerious1&$$@Right@$(I can tell that much. But—)
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAttack&$$@Left@$Hey, we've got more monsters!

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraShouting&$$@Right@$Flying ones this time. They're trying to
crack the pillars and free their friends.
$#YoungBoy;YoungGirl;(Children)#$$&YoungBoyScared;YoungGirl.YoungGirlScared&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;YoungGirl.Right;@$Aaah!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAttack&$$!-1!$$@Left@$The shards are flying everywhere!
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiDetermined&$$@Right@$Look out, children!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(No...my magic is putting them all in
danger!)

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiShouting&$$@Center@$(I'll blow the shards away with— No!
I won't make it in time!)
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyHurt&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$Nngh, that hurts!
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSurprised&$$@Right@$Rody! Not again!
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSerious1&$$@Center@$(I can never come back here, after all.)

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyNormal&$$@Left@$What can I say? Seems like today's a
stabby kind of day.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSmile&$$@Left@$Hah, that was a close one.
Good job, partner.

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraSmug&$$@Left@$Why not trust in them, Yuki? It won't be
often you get a chance like this.

into him when he gets like this.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Center@$Druke and I will return to the village with
the shards to heal the dragons.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiDetermined&$$@Center@$Then... I'll use a shard to replenish my
mana and stop the eruption.
$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraShouting&$$@Center@$I'll go with you, Yuki!
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$@Center@$All right... I'm counting on all of you.
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiShouting&$$@Center@$Rody!
$#Chief(Village Chieftain)#$$&ChieftainShouting&$$@Center@$Ah! Sir Luther!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSad&$$@Center@$Promise me... promise me you're going to
make it back alive.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Center@$I will. I promise.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Center@$Let's do this, then...

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Center@$I'll come back to you no matter what,
Sarina...

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyHurt&$$@Center@$Rrrgh! Mmph, this primordia... This is...
strong... stuff...! Gaaaah!
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&YoungLutherIrritated&$$@Center@$...!!

$#Chief(Village Chieftain)#$$&ChieftainShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$This is an emergency! Where are you
going with our dragon riders?!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&YoungLutherSerious&$$@Right@$...this situation has gotten out of hand.
I will return to Rigland and request aid.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$@Center@$Wow, look at all these decorations. Is the
village preparing for a festival?

$#Chieftain(Village Chieftain)#$$&ChieftainSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$No, but these are important guests. We have
matters to discuss. Go help with the festival.
$#Darna(Young Boy)#$$&YoungDarnaSerious&$$@Right@$Oh... so they're not doctors...

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$@Left@$No, we're not. But you can bet we'll help
your village out however we can!
$#Darna(Young Boy)#$$&YoungDarnaAngry&$$@Right@$...

$#Chieftain(Village Chieftain)#$$&ChieftainSurprised&$$@Right@$Darna!
I must apologize for my son's behavior.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$@Left@$It's alright. But why is he so hung up about
you finding doctors?

$#Chieftain(Village Chieftain)#$$&ChieftainSerious&$$@Right@$That... is part of why I've called you here.
Please come this way.
$#BlueDragon(Druke)#$$&BlueDragonSick&$$@Center@$These dragons, they're...!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&YoungLutherSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hmm. They appear to be catatonic.
And in no small numbers, either.

$#Chieftain(Village Chieftain)#$$&ChieftainSerious&$$@Center@$A plague began spreading some weeks ago,
claiming the lives of many of our dragons.

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraFlirty&$$!-1!$$@Left@$A festival, Drukey! Isn't that fun?
You're not still mad at me, are you?

$#Chieftain(Village Chieftain)#$$&ChieftainSerious&$$@Center@$The dragons are a part of our tribe. They
have always been with us, and now...

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSad&$$@Center@$To have a lifestyle that's taken generations
to foster taken from you... I feel your pain.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&YoungLutherSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I presume this is why you have yet to send
us your riders.

$#Chieftain(Village Chieftain)#$$&ChieftainAngry&$$@Right@$Yes. So many of our dragons have perished,
we fear they may face extinction.

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Huh. Makes sense that you don't want to
send the last of 'em to die in battle.
$#Rody;Yuki;(Rody)#$$&RodyGrit;Yuki.YukiSurprised&$$@Left;;;Yuki.Right;@$Wha— an earthquake?!
$#Rody;Yuki;(Yuki)#$$&RodyGrit;Yuki.YukiShouting&$$@Left;;;Yuki.Right;@$Ah! Oh, Rody?!

$#Rody;Yuki;(Rody)#$$&RodySerious;Yuki.YukiSurprised&$$@Left;;;Yuki.Right;@$Careful. The aftershocks haven't stopped
yet.
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiBlush&$$@Right@$R-right. Thank you for catching me.
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&YoungLutherSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I thought this volcano of yours was dormant.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAngry&$$@Right@$I'm not mad. I'm calm as a bikki monk.
So stay the hell away from me.

$#Chieftain(Village Chieftain)#$$&ChieftainHurt&$$@Right@$It is, but its tremors have grown more
frequent. We may yet see an eruption.

$#Chieftain(Village Chieftain)#$$&ChieftainSerious&$$@Right@$If our village's records are correct, such
a thing has not happened in centuries.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$So that's why the villagers look so glum.

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraSerious&$$@Center@$A plague and an eruption... seems like too
much of a coincidence to me...

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Commander, this can't be anything natural.
We have to help these people investigate.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSerious&$$@Right@$Agreed. It's affecting our military strength,
and besides, it reeks of the Pandemonium.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&YoungLutherNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...I am inclined to agree.
Very well.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&YoungLutherNormal&$$@Center@$I'll send for a team of doctors. In the
meantime, Rody will investigate the volcano.

$#Chieftain(Village Chieftain)#$$&ChieftainSerious&$$@Center@$Thank you. You have my people's deepest
gratitude.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&YoungLutherSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Rody, focus your efforts on uncovering any
influence of the Aeon Lords here.

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraFlirty&$$@Left@$Aww. It was so much fun though, wasn't it?
Let's go riding again sometime!
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$@Right@$Yes, sir. Just leave it to us.
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAngry&$$@Right@$Sure. When the Habsu Desert freezes over.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$For a festival day, everyone here sure looks
gloomy...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&YoungLutherSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Perhaps now would be a good time for your
explanation, chieftain.

$#Chieftain(Village Chieftain)#$$&ChieftainSerious&$$@Right@$It is as you observed.
Our village is currently—

$#Darna(Young Boy)#$$&YoungDarnaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Father, you're back! Did you bring doctors
with you?
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSerious&$$@Center@$Rody, you sure about this?
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSerious1&$$@Right@$I'm not seeing anything either.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Left@$You can't either, Yuki? Even as a mage
yourself? How interesting...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$As much as I'd like to figure out why, we
have more pressing matters to attend to.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$These shards can be used to replenish
the mana taken from the dragons.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Then I think we're done here.
Let's head out.

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraHappy&$$@Center@$One, two, three! Yeah, spin around right
there... way to go, Ossia!

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&NewOssiaSmile&$$@Center@$Hehehe... I like this.
This is fun.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Center@$...she seems just like any other girl
when she's like this.
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSad&$$@Center@$Rody...
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Center@$Sorry to keep you two waiting.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Center@$Yeah, I'll tell Ossia. Somebody's gotta do it.

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&NewOssiaSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh, how did it go? Is Mama better now?
She's not mad at me, is she?

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Right@$Umm... about that. This is important,
Ossia, so I need you to listen.
$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&NewOssiaConfused&$$@Left@$Hm?

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Right@$Your mother doesn't have any more power.
And it's too late to give her any more.

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&NewOssiaConfused&$$@Left@$What do you mean, she doesn't have any
power? Does she need something else?

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Right@$...Ossia, I'm just gonna be blunt, okay?
Your mama is...
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Right@$—she's dead.
$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&NewOssiaConfused&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Dead? What's dead?
Is Mama angry at me?
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$@Right@$...dead is, um...
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSad&$$@Center@$Rody...

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...!
Enough, Rody. Let me handle this.

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You see, Ossia, your mother's body is still
here, but her spirit is gone.
$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&NewOssiaConfused&$$@Left@$Gone? Gone where?
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSad&$$@Right@$To... to a very far away place...

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&NewOssiaSurprised&$$@Left@$Has she left me behind?
Am... am I all alone...?

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&NewOssiaSad&$$@Left@$When is she coming back?
When is Mama coming back?!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSad&$$@Right@$...she's never coming back, Ossia.
I'm sorry.
$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&NewOssiaCrying&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ah... Ah-aaah...
$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraScared&$$@Center@$Ossia?
$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&NewOssiaCrying&$$@Center@$Aaaah, no... No!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$These crystals you brought back... they're
primordia!
$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&NewOssiaCrying&$$@Center@$No, no, no, no, no, no, no!!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAttack&$$@Center@$What the hell?!
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$@Center@$Ossia!! She's flown so high up...!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Center@$Th-the entire island is shaking...! I've never
felt such a terrible earthquake!!
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiDetermined&$$@Center@$Look! Over there! The volcano!

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraScared&$$@Center@$These quakes have disrupted its magma
source! It's going to erupt!
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Center@$Haha. Well, well...

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Center@$I come to have a look at this explosion of
mana, and what do I find?
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$A volcano practically spewing primordia!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$With this, I'll be able to produce a never-
ending horde of monsters...

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSurprise&$$@Right@$That's the stuff with, uh... every kind of
mana, right?

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$Even one shard will produce enough to
conquer this island. Go forth!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$She probably built her lab here because of
the high concentration in this area.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$And that explains why I could share my
mana without collapsing, too.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprise&$$@Left@$Look, you can actually see the six types of
mana rolling off these shards!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSerious&$$@Right@$Not really. I can't see a thing.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Center@$What's the news, then? If you called us out
here, something must be up.
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$B-beyond the sea...? N-no problem...
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSurprised&$$@Right@$Are you okay, Druke? You look a little pale.
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSmirk&$$@Left@$H-heh, I'm fine.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Tuatha Island, huh? What exactly is
happening there?

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&YoungLutherNormal&$$@Center@$Tuatha is home to many dragons, and
has long trained skilled dragon riders.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&YoungLutherNormal&$$@Center@$The Knights have ties with them. We give them
special assistance during the Pandemonium.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&YoungLutherSerious&$$@Center@$And in return, they send us their riders.
So far, however, they have yet to appear.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Sounds like something we should look
into.

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraSerious&$$@Right@$It does seem a bit fishy. And that's saying
something, coming from me.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&YoungLutherSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The chieftain has asked us to come see
the situation for ourselves.
$#Luther(Luther)#$$&YoungLutherNormal&$$@Center@$Hmm...

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&YoungLutherNormal&$$@Center@$The power of the Crimson Crest may be
needed. We depart this afternoon.

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraHappy&$$@Left@$Heya, Yuki. Wanna go shopping for
swimsuits?
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSurprised&$$@Right@$Um... swimsuits?

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraSmug&$$@Left@$We're going to a tropical island, after all!
We're gonna need swimsuits for sure.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSerious&$$@Right@$We're not going there on vacation, you
know.

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraHappy&$$@Left@$Aww, come on, Drukey. You can buy a
swimsuit too!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSerious&$$@Right@$I'll pass, thanks.

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraFlirty&$$@Left@$But what if we go swimming? Are you going
to strip down in front of two fair maidens?
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAttack&$$@Right@$I'm not going swimming!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$W-what about you, Rody? If you're going,
then, maybe I will...

$#Alira;Yuki(Luther)#$(The Winter Witch and a dancer... he once
again returns with interesting companions.)

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Center@$Hmm... well, if we're going to a beach, I
guess it couldn't hurt!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSmile&$$@Center@$Y-you think so? Then I'll get a swimsuit too.
Oh, but what kind? I've never worn one...

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraHappy&$$@Center@$Don't worry! I'll pick out something perfect
for you!
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Haha. Looks like Alira's having fun.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSerious&$$@Right@$Hey, partner. Stay on your guard. We have
no idea what we'll face over there.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$Is this your warrior's instinct talking?

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSerious&$$@Right@$Yeah. You know I get these hunches
every now and then.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSerious&$$@Right@$This is no holiday we're taking. I bet we're
dealing with the Pandemonium here.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$Don't worry, I know. You seem awfully tense,
though. Is everything okay?

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Right@$Yeah, it's just the sea. I... Bah, never mind!
It's nothing.

$#Alira;Yuki(Luther)#$(According to my reports, the Winter Witch's
power is immense. She will be useful.)

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyNormal&$$@Left@$Anyway, we need to go and see things for
ourselves. At least everyone's excited!

$#Chieftain(Village Chieftain)#$$&ChieftainSerious&$$@Center@$Greetings, all.
I am the chieftain of Tuatha Village.

$#BlueDragon(Alira)#$$&BlueDragonNormal&$$@Center@$Oh, wow! Look at those blue dragons!
They're enormous!
$#BlueDragon(Rody)#$$&BlueDragonNormal&$$@Center@$Incredible...
$#Chieftain(Village Chieftain)#$$&ChieftainSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Thank you for responding to our summons.

$#Chieftain(Village Chieftain)#$$&ChieftainSerious&$$@Center@$Is this your first time flying dragonback?
I recommend riding in pairs behind us.

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraFlirty&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Drukey, be sure to hold on to me reeeeal tight,
so you don't fall off!

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSurprise&$$@Right@$Are we seriously doing this...?! Crossing the
open sea on these slippery beasts?!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Um, Rody. Do you think this will be safe for
us?

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Left@$The villagers rode all the way here on these
dragons, so I'm sure it's fine.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&YoungLutherNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(But she is inconstant, I'm told. The risks...
As for the dancer, she is an unknown.)

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Left@$If you're scared, just hold on to me and
don't look down.
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiHappy&$$@Right@$Okay...! Thank you.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Dragon Rider)#$$!-1!$We'll be taking off now.
Hold on tight, everyone!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$@Center@$Whoa, this is amazing! The houses look
like tiny specks from up here!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSurprised&$$@Center@$We're moving so much faster than on
horseback!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Look over there, Yuki. Have you ever seen
the ocean up close before?

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiHappy&$$@Right@$I've only ever seen it in books!
It's... it's beautiful!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Dragon Rider)#$$!-1!$Hold on! There's a gust of wind incoming,
things are about to get a bit bumpy!
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiShouting&$$@Right@$Aaah!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$@Left@$You okay, Yuki? Here, hold onto me tight.
I don't want you falling off.
$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraFlirty&$$@Center@$My, Commander. See something you like?
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiHappy&$$@Right@$O-okay...!

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraFlirty&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Ooh, that was too fun! Here, I'll hold onto
you too, Drukey. You don't mind, right?

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Right@$W-whatever. Ugh... l-look at all that water.
If I fall... there's no coming back...!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmirk&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hey, Druke, you're not afraid of a little
water, are you?

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Center@$B-bah! A proud kud warrior afraid of
water? Preposterous.

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraFlirty&$$@Left@$Hmm? Drukey? Your heart is beating so fast!
I can feel it against my back.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAttack&$$@Right@$C-cut that out, fool girl! Stop bloody moving!
You're making me lose my balance!

$#Alira(Alira)#$$&AliraFlirty&$$@Left@$Aww, Dwukey. A wittle hug got you all
excited? Do you have feewings for me?
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeAngry&$$@Right@$Hardly! It's just the nerves!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(But... I'm not scared.
Why is my heart racing too...?)

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Center@$Knock it off. This isn't the time for your
dirty jokes.
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hey, I can see the island from here!

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&YoungLutherNormal&$$@Right@$From what I've heard, the volcano in the
middle has remained dormant for ages.
$#Chieftain(Village Chieftain)#$$&ChieftainSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That is correct, Commander. However...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Dragon Rider)#$$!-1!$Hang tight!
We're starting our descent.

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySmile&$$@Center@$Hear that, Yuki? It's about to get bumpy!
Make sure you don't let go of me.
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiSmile&$$@Center@$O-okay! I won't!

$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiBlush&$$@Center@$(That's it... my heart only races like this
when I'm close to Rody.)
$#Yuki(Yuki)#$$&YukiBlush&$$@Center@$(Could I be — is this...?)

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&YoungLutherSerious&$$@Center@$...anyway. Your mission this time is to
investigate a certain village.

$#Luther(Luther)#$$&YoungLutherSerious&$$@Center@$Beyond our shores lies the beautiful island
of Tuatha. Something is happening there.

keys.MessageKey: In order to play this mode, you have to select at least one character from your inventory.

keys.DescriptionKey: A magnificent clock crafted by Chronos, the Primordial of Time. No matter what calamities it suffers, no matter how long it ticks away, its hands will never fall behind. Some say it controls the flow of time itself.

RolotiaClock01.description: A magnificent clock crafted by Chronos, the Primordial of Time. No matter what calamities it suffers, no matter how long it ticks away, its hands will never fall behind. Some say it controls the flow of time itself.

keys.DescriptionKey:
That day, that moment, Rolotia chose life over death. But what awaited her was no blessing, it was a curse.
Imprisoned by the one she loved, her powers exploited, her sanity eroded away... losing even her soul.

RolotiaDark01.name: Dark Rolotia
RolotiaDark01.title: Corrupted Sorceress of Time
RolotiaDark01.description:

Imprisoned by the one she loved, her powers exploited, her sanity eroded away... losing even her soul.

keys.IntroText:
At the end of the cycle of darkness,
the last light faded to nothing.

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Come on, gimme more sweets! If you don't...I'll throw a tantrum!"
Once again, Chronos holds her head in her hands, terrorized by the little devil that has taken up residence in the Temple of Time.

RolotiaDark02.name: Dark Rolotia
RolotiaDark02.title: Corrupted Sorceress of Time
RolotiaDark02.description:

keys.DescriptionKey:
Though on the verge of madness, stuck in the depth of darkness, there remained a voice, steadfast beside her, calling out to her from her memory.
"What a pathetic face. Get on your feet—you're stronger than this, aren't you?"

RolotiaDark03.title: Corrupted Sorceress of Time
