keys.value: $#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$...Shortly after my body welcomed death...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$Countless lives were snuffed out. Many
beautiful, precious things were lost.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$If... If Cassius died that night, during the
celebration feast, then...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$He would never have attacked Ptak. The
Empire would have eventually dissolved.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$Each nation would still have their power,
balancing the world, maintaining peace.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$This Bergarian invasion, too, would never
have happened...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$Rolotia. Are you dwelling in the past again?
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$...Chronos.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$$!-1!$Ever since the Gru Grim incident, you have
been lost in thought quite often.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$@Center@$My time on Erden was so chaotic... I had
no time to reflect on the past.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$...Is this pain the price I have to pay for
violating the ancient taboo?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$Erden was consumed by the flames of war.
Hundreds of thousands lost their lives.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$My soul, which should have died with my
body, lives on with its memories and sins.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$You chose me to live on as your Avatar
in atonement for my sins, didn't you?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$$!-1!$No. I made you my Avatar in accordance
with your own wishes.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$@Center@$What...? I-I wished for this? But I...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$$!-1!$Your soul understands that death is just an
escape.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$$!-1!$Your consciousness rebelled against the
repose of death, burdened as you were.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$Desperate to atone for your sins, your soul
never left for the realm of the dead.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$And eventually, it drifted to my temple...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$I granted you an immortal form and
made you my Avatar, as you desired.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$Cassius, he... He truly loved me.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$You crossed the forbidden line, but your
heart has always striven to be righteous.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$Therefore, you are not bound by the small
laws of mortals, nor by time, nor by Fate.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$If you harbor doubts, and believe that your
redemption is better sought elsewhere...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$Then step forward of your own will,
and discover your own future.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$Just as you did in your previous life...
As a simple witch.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Center@$You...will turn me back into a mortal...?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$$!-1!$Indeed.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$...No, I don't want that. If I became mortal
again, I would just make the same mistake.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$Even as the Avatar of Time, I still mingled
with the mortals and used my powers.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$So...I don't think I'd be able to keep
from falling to temptation.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$Which is why my death drove him mad.
He became brutal and cruel.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$$!-1!$Is that how you truly feel?
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$$!-1!$The thousand years you served me
without letting go of your sins...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$And the short time you spent as my Avatar
upon Erden.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$Your time with the Red Dragon Knights,
the human warmth you experienced...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$and the strength of one who could slash
open a path to the future he envisioned.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$Let the experiences that form your past
guide you to the future you wish to create.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$Chronos...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$I'm selfish. I'm a fool, swayed by my
emotions, unable to see the big picture.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Center@$But you, of all people, accepted me. And if
you judge me worthy of it, then...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$He went down in history as a butcher, the
monster of the First Bergarian War.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$...Please release me from my role as your
Avatar and return me to my mortal shell.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$I want to fight with all I have, one more
time...for Erden's future.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$$!-1!$...Rolotia.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$Go. With the power, responsibility, and
dreams of those to whom much is given.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$Farewell...
Foolish, but beautiful daughter of man.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$@Center@$...Where am I?
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$Chronos. Chronos...?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Center@$(I can feel the power of time, like before.
Chronos must still be watching over me.)
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Center@$(But there's no answer when I call...)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$@Center@$(I'm no longer an Avatar. I'm just a witch
again, with just a little bit of power.)
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$In the end, Bergaria failed to unite Erden.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$Cassius... Norza...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$The precious memories you gave me will
bring about a brighter future...for everyone.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$This, I promise. So, please...
Watch over me.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$The bikki protected their nation with their
mystic arts and magic...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$And the hero Carmina, future Queen of
Rigland, stopped them at the mountains.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$But...the war ravaged the world, just as
Chronos said. The results were gruesome.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$...As the days went by, my worries only
deepened.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$It's because you told me the truth. I never
told a soul about your past...

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$But your words allowed me to profess my
faith in you, in the face of my men's doubts.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Center@$Now, there is nothing keeping us apart. Our
hearts are one! We will defeat any foe!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$Hearing his strong words eased my fears.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$I wanted to protect him. I didn't believe that
helping him could invite calamity...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$My resolve was strengthened, but...
My obstinacy made me blind.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$Finally, the day dawned...when Cassius and
I set foot upon the Ptaki Isles.

$#Guard(Bergarian Soldier)#$$&GuardCommand&$$@Center@$The road ahead is secure!
Please, come this way!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Cassius, is it really safe to advance with so
few men? You've chosen the best, but...

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$The fewer, the better. Our objective is to
proceed quickly and quietly, after all.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$I was too hasty, brushing Chronos's warning
aside... Regret sat heavy on my heart.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$The fleet attacking from the front is just a
ruse, while we strike at their warlord.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$It's fortunate we have a guide. The man
you captured at the feast.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Left@$(The assassin from the feast... The man
who took Cassius's life...)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Left@$(No, that never occurred. Not anymore.
There's no need for me to think about it.)

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$We are almost there. Our destination is the
command room in that fortress.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$Rolotia, just as we planned, I need you to
stop the enemy soldiers in their tracks.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Center@$Your magical gift is the key to our victory.
Can you do it?
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$Yes, just leave it to me.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$...!

$#Guard(Bergarian Soldier)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Center@$Wow...the air itself feels different.
It's as if the whole world has slowed.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$But I couldn't stand the thought of going
back to the temple.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$!-1!$$@Left@$At the least...the soldiers in the fortress
should be completely frozen.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$@Right@$Using such powerful magic must be
exhausting... How do you feel?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Left@$I'm fine...as long as we...
Don't move too quickly...

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusShouting&$$@Right@$Of course. Don't leave my side, Rolotia.
...Soldiers, charge!
$#GuardA(Bergarian Soldier)#$$&GuardCommand&$$@Right@$This way! Hurry!!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Left@$(Huh? Aren't we going to the war room?
Is it really that way...?)

$#Guard(Bergarian Soldier)#$$&GuardCommand&$$!-1!$$@Center@$There, the Queen! Lady Rolotia's magic has
frozen her! Bring her to Sir Cassius!
$#PtakiQueen(Ptaki Queen)#$$&PtakiWifeGrit&$$@Center@$...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$W-Wait, what? Isn't our target the
warlord?! Why are you taking the queen...?!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$Our demands to the warlord will be far
more effective with his queen as leverage.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$A cold, heartless existence, bound by strict
practices and solemn shackles...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Left@$You're...taking a helpless innocent
hostage?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Left@$You didn't mention this when we went
over the plan!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusAngry&$$@Right@$Do you think me a coward? This is the
only way to prevent unnecessary bloodshed.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Left@$Do you...actually believe that?

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$No matter the outcome, we won't hurt her.
This is to prevent more casualties.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Left@$...

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Left@$That's the warlord. Rolotia, release your
spell.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Right@$Done...
$#PtakiKing(Ptaki Warlord)#$$&WarlordShocked&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Wha-...What is going on?!
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusShouting&$$@Center@$Don't move!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$After knowing the joys of love, I couldn't
bear to go back to that oppressive place.

$#PtakiQueen(Ptaki Queen)#$$&PtakiWifeGrit&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...I see. You're using me as a hostage to
threaten my king.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Left@$That's right. Warlord, tell your men to
stand down!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusAngry&$$@Left@$Otherwise, your queen's blood will join
that of your people, to drown these islands.

$#PtakiKing(Ptaki Warlord)#$$&WarlordShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What wicked magic allowed you to abduct
my wife?!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I did not come to hear your questions.
Only your surrender.

$#PtakiQueen(Ptaki Queen)#$$&PtakiWifeGrit&$$@Right@$You're that infamous Bergarian general,
aren't you?

$#PtakiQueen(Ptaki Queen)#$$&PtakiWifeShouting&$$@Right@$The vicious man who tramples across the
land, consuming everything in his path!

$#PtakiQueen(Ptaki Queen)#$$&PtakiWifeShouting&$$@Right@$Our people are fierce and proud. We will
never surrender to a villain like you.

$#PtakiQueen(Ptaki Queen)#$$&PtakiWifeShouting&$$@Right@$Even if you were to run the blade you hold
across my neck!
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Left@$That is for your husband to decide.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$...My feelings for him had grown so strong,
the thought of leaving him ripped me in two.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Now, Warlord! Choose whose blood you
wish to see flow!

$#PtakiQueen(Ptaki Queen)#$$&PtakiWifeShouting&$$@Center@$Do not surrender! Do not allow his words
to strip away your pride as Ptak!
$#PtakiKing(Ptaki Warlord)#$$&WarlordAngry&$$@Center@$...Krgh...

$#PtakiKing(Ptaki Warlord)#$$&WarlordAngry&$$@Center@$...Tell the soldiers. Tell them to surrender,
or to flee...
$#PtakiQueen(Ptaki Queen)#$$&PtakiWifeGrit&$$@Center@$My king!

$#PtakiKing(Ptaki Warlord)#$$&WarlordSurprised&$$@Center@$Please understand... I can crush any enemy
and feel nothing, but I cannot lose you.

$#PtakiQueen(Ptaki Queen)#$$&PtakiWifeGrit&$$@Center@$You fool. You besmirch the honor of our
people. You have doomed us to ruin!

$#PtakiQueen(Ptaki Queen)#$$&PtakiWifeShouting&$$@Center@$I...will never forgive you!
Not you, and not this villain!
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusShouting&$$@Center@$Grgh?! What are you...?!
$#PtakiKing(Ptaki Warlord)#$$&WarlordShocked&$$@Center@$What are you doing?! Stop!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Center@$Rolotia, good news! My men were all greatly
impressed by your capture of the assassin!
$#PtakiQueen(Ptaki Queen)#$$&PtakiWifeShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$All honor, all glory to the Ptak!

$#Cassius;PtakiQueen;(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSurprised&$$@Left@$How could she...?! She cut her own throat
with my knife!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No... No...!
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSurprised&$$@Center@$...Rolotia?
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Center@$...Aaah...aah!
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$!-1!$Rolotia?! Can you hear me? Rolotia!!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Center@$Surely no one would object to you
accompanying us to the Isles now!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHappy&$$@Center@$Really?! Oh, thank goodness...
Now I can be of use to you!
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$Rolotia, I'm coming in.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...
...Right.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$I...suppose I have no choice.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$As you said, I was born with the power
to control time.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSurprised&$$@Center@$That's amazing. To think a person with such
power could exist in this world.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$Yes, the gift of time is very rare, I'm told.
But I'm not the only one.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$Until I met you, I lived in a hidden temple
with other women who share my power.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$The power of time can be used for all kinds
of evil acts...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$Thus, women with powers like ours live in
secret, hiding in the temple forever.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$I underwent terrifyingly cruel training in
that cramped temple, to master my power.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$...Living there was painfully lonely.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$Cassius...
Um, I...
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSmile&$$@Left@$But...I met you. Within the flames of battle,
close to the temple.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$And you brought me back from the brink of
death with that power.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...I had no choice. Even if people saw me,
I still wanted to save you.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$And after that, my heart yearned for you...
I fell in love.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$That's why...I was desperate...
...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$I begged the elders to let me out, to let me
return to your side, no matter the price...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$As a result...here I am. My whole heart
yearned to be by your side.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$...Cassius...are you disappointed in me?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$I've lied to you this whole time.
It's only natural for you to lose faith in me.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Rolotia, was that the secret you've been
hiding?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$If you can't stand the sight of me anymore,
then you can cast me aside if you wish.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$But please believe me:
I never betwitched you.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$I haven't used any magic since I came to
this castle, not until today! So...!
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$Rolotia.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...Cassius?

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Right@$I have never been more thankful to anyone
in my whole life.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Right@$You found me. You love me. You long to be
by my side. You, who I cherish so much!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Right@$If we join hands, then we will be one step
closer to uniting Erden in eternal peace!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Left@$You...forgive me?

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Right@$There is nothing to forgive! Rolotia, you
are wonderful. Please, stay by my side.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Left@$...

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Right@$I will drive away anyone or anything that
even dreams of threatening you.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Left@$Truly? You...truly believe me?
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaBlush&$$@Left@$Thank you... I love you, Cassius...!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$(...A walk to ease my sleeplessness is all
well and good, but...)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$(It's chilly out at night.
I'm feeling more and more awake.)
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$...I'm a coward.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$I'm too scared to tell Cassius everything...
I lied to protect myself.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$(...I can't think this way. This is only going
to depress me.)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$@Center@$(I'll take a little rest, then go back to bed.
I'll sit by the fountain over there...)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSmile&$$@Center@$(...Oh, the full moon reflected on the water
is breathtaking. A perfect, clear circle...)

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$You can use time magic, right? The same
thing you used to "heal" me back then.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$@Center@$...Huh?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$@Center@$...! The reflection of the moon turned into
the face of a clock...?!
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$...Rolotia.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Center@$...?! Wh-Who are you?!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$I can hear a voice... No, wait...
This voice is coming from inside me!

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Rolotia...speak the name of the Primordial
worshipped in the temple.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$...The protector of Erden, the Primordial
of Time...Chronos?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$$!-1!$Indeed. Rolotia...you used my powers and
violated the ancient taboo.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$I know all. I can see through all who were
granted my power.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$@Left@$How did you know?!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$$!-1!$You changed fate, and warped a decided
future. You have made a terrible mistake.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$Because that man escaped his fate, a great
disaster will befall all of Erden.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Center@$A disaster...? But why...?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$$!-1!$There is still a path which can set
right your great wrong.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$Rolotia, return to the temple.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$No! Back to that cramped, dank, and
moldy old temple?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$$!-1!$If you return at once, then the disaster may
yet be prevented.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$This is a rite to absolve your sins.
Return to the Temple of Time...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$And atone for your deception.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Center@$...!
Don't speak of that!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Left@$...T-that isn't a confession! I don't know
how you came to such a wild conclusion...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$I'm staying here, with Cassius! I never want
to go back! Leave me!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$...Rolotia...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Center@$......
The voice...is gone now.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$(...Chronos really does know everything.
Even the truth that I never told Cassius...)
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$(I never actually convinced the elders...)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$(I warped time around me and managed to
escape the temple.)
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$...The clock...turned back into a moon.
I can't hear Chronos anymore, either.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$I...I'm never going back. Why would saving
someone I love cause a disaster?

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$...Calm yourself. There's no use hiding it
any longer.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$It's fine... The man I love is still alive.
And the disaster...will never happen.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$It's fine... I'll be fine...

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$Please tell me everything. You don't
have to rush. Just let it all out.

keys.IntroText:
In order to keep the past and the future safe
She calls upon her powers once more

keys.DescriptionKey:
She promised herself she would never use time reversal magic again. It is no wonder then that she felt nervous when Chronos herself ordered her to do so. And so, with the weight of the past and the future on her shoulders...she stammered during the incantation. Badly. And the botched spell had a noticeable effect on her body.
"Th-This isn't how it was supposed to work..."

She wanted to protect the boy from this cruel world and even crueler time. For the sake of the one she failed to save in the past.

$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$@Center@$...Rolotia...
Rolotia.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$It happened over a thousand years before
Erden was rid of the Pandemonium.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$The Bergarian Empire, in the name of their
ruler, began expanding their territory.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$They crushed many tribes in order to gain
control of the northern continent.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$I lived there, in the castle of a local lord,
a subject of Bergaria.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$Mm... What's going on?
It's so loud outside...
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$...To greet...General...came back to...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$@Center@$I can hear voices from the hallway...
The General's...back?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$@Center@$!!!
I have to go see him!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSmile&$$@Left@$Has Cassius returned?
$#Servant(Servant)#$$&MaleVillagerAScared&$$@Right@$Y-Yes, ma'am. He's nearing the gates...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...Hm?
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHappy&$$@Left@$Thank you! Oh, Cassius!

$#Servant(Servant)#$$&MaleVillagerASmile&$$@Right@$Haha... That brings a smile to my face.
Why haven't they married yet, I wonder?

$#Guard(Bergarian Soldier)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Left@$They would if they could. Sir Cassius is the
greatest general in all of Bergaria.

$#Guard(Bergarian Soldier)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Left@$While Lady Rolotia is a witch of unknown
origin who arrived only recently.

$#Guard(Bergarian Soldier)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Left@$It's only natural that they wouldn't
broach the subject...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager A)#$General Cassius has safely returned!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Villager B)#$He's so wonderfully gallant, as usual!
Oh, General, please look my way!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$!-1!$$@Left@$S-Sorry, please let me through!

$#Guard(Bergarian Soldier)#$$&GuardCommand&$$@Right@$Lady Rolotia?! Be careful! We're in the
middle of our march back...

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Rolotia! Is that you, Rolotia?!
I'm right here!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Center@$F-forgive me, Lord Chronos! How
rude of me to doze off like that...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHappy&$$@Left@$Cassius is calling for me! I have to go.
Thank you for looking out for me!
$#Guard(Bergarian Soldier)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Right@$...There's no stopping them.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHappy&$$@Right@$Cassius! Welcome back, Cassius!
I'm so glad you're safe!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Left@$Oh, Rolotia! My beloved witch!
I'm back, my dear!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Left@$Being apart from you and your beauty...
I could hardly breathe for missing you!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Right@$I've missed you so much too. It's so hard,
waiting for your return day after day...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Right@$...Is this a new injury?

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Left@$It's nothing major. Rather, it's a mark of
my honor as a Bergarian general.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Left@$You must hear this, Rolotia! My army has
suppressed yet another tribal revolt!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Left@$The Emperor was so impressed with me, he
entrusted me with the invasion of Ptak.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$@Center@$I believe I have fulfilled my duty as your
Avatar. Is there something amiss?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$@Right@$Ptak? That little island nation to the
southeast of the Empire, right?

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Left@$Indeed, between Bergaria and Eastland.
It's ruled by a warlike, savage tribe.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Left@$Once we bring the Ptaki Isles to heel,
we'll have a straight shot into Eastland.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSurprised&$$@Left@$This is an essential, noble mission! The
unification of Erden grows ever closer!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Right@$...Right. Right, of course.
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Left@$What's wrong?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSmile&$$@Right@$I-I'm sorry, it's nothing! You're amazing to
have received such an important mission.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Left@$There's no need to hide your worry.
You're concerned for my safety, aren't you?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$@Right@$...Yes... I'm sorry.
I wish I could share your joy.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Right@$It's just that, such a critical mission must
come with all kinds of perils! That's why...
$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$!-1!$$@Center@$No. I simply worry for your condition.
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Left@$You need not worry, Rolotia.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaBlush&$$@Right@$...!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Left@$This mission will succeed, just like all the
rest. Believe in me.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSmile&$$@Right@$...Cassius...

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSurprised&$$@Left@$We have several days of leave before my
next mission. Tonight, we feast in triumph!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Left@$But before that... I want to speak with you.
I've missed you. Will you make time?
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHappy&$$@Right@$Yes...!

$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$@Center@$Do try not to overthink. Relax.
Now, if you will excuse me...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...Chronos's presence is fading. Was he
really here just to check up on me?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$(With the battle against the Gru Grim long
over, I've found myself lost in thought.)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$(...There it is again...
My heart is winding back in time...)

keys.DescriptionKey:
In ancient times, Bergaria was not a vast, imposing empire, but a scattered collection of tribes. The harsh mountains left little room to farm, so famines came both fierce and frequent. If they hoped to survive, peasants would have to swear their service to a warlord, turning their eyes away from the cruelty they inflicted.

The priestesses of Chronos, hidden in a northern temple, were spared their land's turmoil. In exchange for keeping watch over time's flow, the Primordial granted them both safety and power. In all of Erden, only they could manipulate time. 

Rolotia, gifted with the most prodigious time magic seen in generations, always felt that fate was more a curse than a blessing.

keys.IntroText:
"Humble, pure, redeemed is she. 
A grey sky turned splendid in sunrise."

keys.DescriptionKey:
As a child, Rolotia drove the other priestesses to no end of frustration. Though she was never malicious, never drunk on her own power, she proved too spirited to abide by the order's rules of isolation. Her eyes forever strayed to the horizon. Had she not been such a prodigy, perhaps the elders might have let her go. But doing so would have been too great a risk.

Before long, their indecision became their undoing. One morning, when the priestesses went to wake Rolotia for prayer, they found her staff gone and her bedroom empty. She had frozen time and escaped into the world so long forbidden to her.

keys.DescriptionKey:
There was another rule that bound the priestesses of Chronos. No matter what tragedies befell mankind, they were never to reverse history once it had been decided. A single altered choice could change the future in ways no mortal could foresee.

After her escape, Rolotia cast aside her powers, aware of the temptation they would pose. But when her beloved—a general in the Bergarian army—fell, she rewrote time itself to bring him back.  The consequences of that sin would echo for a thousand years.

Even so, she greets each dawn with hope, for each new day offers her its chance of redemption.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Rolotia)#$When I first met Cassius, I was still living in
the temple.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Center@$Ah, they found him!
At this rate, he'll be killed!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Center@$...I can't watch this!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Center@$Our actions in the present become the past,
shaping the future. That's what I was told.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$@Center@$Then, it's okay for me to do what I can on
my own volition, right...?!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$Time...freeze for these brave men who cast
their souls into war! Time Stop!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$...It worked! Ah, his injuries are deep...
I need to carry him away from here.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$He's...heavy!!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$(Pant)...(Pant)... I somehow managed to
get him away...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$Now, next.
What do I do to heal his wounds...?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$There's so much blood... If I accelerate his
natural healing, he'll die of blood loss.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Rolotia)#$Like every other woman there, I underwent
harsh training and strict punishments.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$@Center@$I'll have to adjust the time of the blood,
while reversing the time of his injury.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$That's it... Slowly and carefully...
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusHurt&$$!-1!$$@Right@$U-Urgh...?
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Left@$Don't speak. Save your strength...
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSurprised&$$@Right@$...A goddess?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Left@$Wh-What?! A goddess?! Me?! ...Ah! I'm
losing focus! I need to concentrate!
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusHurt&$$@Right@$Who are you...?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaBlush&$$@Left@$M-My name is Rolotia. I'm just a... Right.
A witch. From the forest.
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Right@$Rolo...tia... Rolotia...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Left@$...He fell asleep.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$When I finally escaped, I found myself on
a cliff, directly above a battlefield.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaBlush&$$@Left@$He called me a goddess.
What an exaggeration...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Left@$You'll let me stay in the castle? Are you
sure? It's...no trouble?

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Right@$I'm the one inviting you.
Of course it's no trouble at all!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Right@$I am overjoyed you'd give me the chance
to repay you for your kindness.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Right@$These lands are mine, so relax and enjoy
them as you will.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Left@$To think someone as reckless as you was a
lord... Ah, should I be more formal?

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$Worry not. It is rather past the point of
keeping up appearances, I would say.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Left@$But perhaps you should be more mindful
of your own status.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Left@$It was thanks to you that those villagers
managed to escape, but...

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Right@$It is in my nature; there is nothing for it.
My subjects will surely understand.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$To think I would escape that terrible place
just to find myself in the midst of battle...

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$Besides, my very reason for going to war is
to protect people from violence and strife.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Left@$Really? But your homeland, Bergaria,
is the one that started the war, isn't it?

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$You are correct. But the root of all strife
is the division that plagues our world.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$With my recent victory, the Empire has
finally united half of the northern continent.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Right@$Centuries of war and unrest, put to an end.
Peace is finally upon us.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Right@$The Emperor plans to unite the whole world
before the next Pandemonium.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Left@$The whole world?
Before the next Pandemonium...?

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$If everyone stands together, then surely,
we will put an end to the Pandemonium!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Right@$With all of Erden at peace, the entire world
will finally know true happiness!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSmile&$$@Left@$What an incredible goal... I can barely
wrap my head around it.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$...I was devastated.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Right@$I am blessed to serve such an ambitious
Emperor. That's why I give my all to fight.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$Of course, I do not seek death. But I must
sometimes be reckless, for my people.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaBlush&$$@Left@$...They must really love you.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$As it should be. And I repay their trust in
me in kind.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaBlush&$$@Left@$...You're even more amazing than I first
thought.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Left@$I'm envious...almost painfully so. No one's
ever supported or loved me...
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Right@$But you saved me.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$You rescued a total stranger from the crush
of war, and even nursed me back to health.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$No ordinary woman could perform such a
feat.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$@Left@$Huh? Y-you really...think so?

$#Cassius;(Rolotia)#$$&CassiusAngry&$$@Center@$...? There's someone over there.
He's dressed well... Is that the commander?

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Right@$Be confident in yourself. I am very glad
to have met a woman like you.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaBlush&$$@Left@$Cassius... Thank you.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSmile&$$@Center@$Haha...how nostalgic. He hasn't changed
one bit since I first met him.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$But...to think that his grand ambition leads
to nothing but despair...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$Even the best intentions can't
guarantee peace.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$This whole time, I was merely dreaming...
Dreaming that the one I love was right.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$...I'm sorry, Cassius. I'm taking off your
necklace.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$I...don't have the right to wear it...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Cassius)#$$!-1!$...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$Cassius... He's in deep sleep...

$#Cassius;(Rolotia)#$$&CassiusAngry&$$@Center@$...He's running toward a group of civilians.
Were they caught between the battle lines?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$If I take his life with this dagger, then I can
steer Fate back to how it ought to be.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Center@$Sacrificing one life to save many...
It's the same thing he did on the Ptaki Isles.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$I need to be brave...I have to kill him. Then,
he won't lead the world to destruction...!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$Now...!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Cassius)#$$!-1!$...Rolo...tia...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Center@$!!!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaCrying&$$@Center@$Ah... Aaaah... I...I...!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaCrying&$$@Center@$(I can't...do it.
I could never do it!)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$(No matter how much blood is on his hands,
no matter what kind of future awaits...)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaCrying&$$@Center@$(Even in exchange for the world, I can't...
I can't bear to hurt him...)

$#Cassius;(Rolotia)#$$&CassiusHurt&$$@Center@$...I-Is he trying to help them escape
by himself?!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaCrying&$$@Center@$(I...love him.)
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$...!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$(What's left for me to do?)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$(Should I use my power and stop the war?
No, I don't have the strength for that...)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$(Then, back to the temple? No... I broke
the rules when I escaped.)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$(I'm a sinner who led the world to
damnation. I can't go back now.)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$(Then, can I stay by Cassius's side,
pretending I don't know what's coming?)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaCrying&$$@Center@$(Even if that will bring the world to ruin?
Can I forget what Chronos showed me?)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaCrying&$$@Center@$(Can I watch silently while thousands lose
their lives?)
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$(Aaah... I... I really am...helpless...)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$The villagers got away, but...there's no way
he'll be able to!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$(I'm trapped in a dead end.
There's no way out, not anymore...)
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$(...No. There is still one way.)
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$...Cassius.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Cassius)#$$!-1!$...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$Thank you. I'm so glad...I got to love you.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$I don't know what else I can do anymore.
I'm sorry...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaCrying&$$@Center@$Because of me, many lives will be lost.
Because of me, you'll lead the world to ruin.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaCrying&$$@Center@$I'm sorry...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$I gripped my beloved's necklace in
my hand...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$...And jumped off the balcony.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$Ngh... Where...am I...?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Left@$Why would you keep such a thing
from me?!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Left@$I know war is ugly! I know the Warlord
is a ruthless and cruel man!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Left@$But even so, it's still not right to hurt
an innocent person!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$...I understand why you feel this way.
I will tell you everything.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$But first, you must calm down. I would hate
for your condition to worsen.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Left@$Right...I'm sorry.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...The kidnapping was part of the original
plan. I made the decision not to tell you.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$You are kind and merciful. I was afraid
that kindness might blind you.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$Yes...I see why. I would never accept a
strategy like that one.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$I lied to you. I admit it. But I would never
take a coward's path without reason.
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSurprised&$$@Center@$Rolotia...! Thank goodness, you're awake!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$I thought up this strategy to curtail
unnecessary bloodshed...to protect you.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$@Center@$If we had not forced the warlord's hand,
the Ptaki would have fought to the last.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$The Isles are a key strategic location. We
cannot afford to take any losses.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$@Center@$...I never imagined the Queen would take
such drastic measures.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Indeed. She was an extraordinarily brave
and noble woman...

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$@Right@$I regret letting you witness such a dreadful
scene. I apologize, wholeheartedly.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$While you were unconscious...I had time to
think about what is truly important to me.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$Please accept this. As a token of my
apology...and my love.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$This is...a necklace?

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$Yes, one passed down in my family for
generations.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...Cassius? Why do you look so tired?
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Center@$Marry me, Rolotia.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$...What?
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$I don't ever want to lose you.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$@Center@$I feared to leave you widowed, but...
I see now that I was weak.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Center@$I won't die. Let us walk hand in hand.
When all of Erden is united, then...

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Center@$I will devote my life to making you forget
the terrible sights of this war.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$(Cassius wants...to marry me?)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$(I wished for it. I should be thrilled...
But my heart remains clouded.)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$...This might be brazen of me to ask, but
I have one request.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Say the word, and it shall be done.
Anything for you, my love.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$Does it show...? Of course it would.
I've been at your side for two days.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Left@$Don't use my powers again in the war.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Left@$I know it's unreasonable when I was the one
who asked to come with you, but...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Left@$But I...never want to use my power for
something so dreadful again!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$@Right@$As you wish. I take responsibility for all of
your pain. Your suffering is over.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Right@$Stay by my side, Rolotia. Just having you
with me will make me invincible.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Left@$...Thank you.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Left@$I will...accept your proposal. So please...
you must live, Cassius...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$We returned to our home. With the
Emperor's blessing, we held our ceremony.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$The news of my rescue of Cassius and my
part in the victory in Ptak began to spread.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$No one looked at me with suspicion again.
Everyone blessed our marriage.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$@Right@$I thought I had forced you to use too much
magic. I thought...you were going to die.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$I chose the right path. I protected the man
I loved. I truly thought...I was happy.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$But my meager confidence began to crack...
And crumble...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSmile&$$@Center@$(I can't seem to sleep... Haha.
It's been a while since this happened.)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$(After some refreshing night air, I'll go
back to bed...)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$@Center@$...?
That's... N-No...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Center@$The full moon on the water's surface
became a clock again...!!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$$!-1!$...Rolotia. What have you done?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$The door to oblivion stands open. The
future you corrupted envelops all of Erden.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$That's a lie! I'm happy!
I'm so very happy right now!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$Bergaria's unification is proceeding well,
too! There's no way...!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$I'm so glad you finally awoke.
Come into my arms, my love.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$$!-1!$Then allow me to show you the future that
awaits. The future of all mortals...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$As Chronos spoke, the water's surface
dyed blood-red, displaying an image of war.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$I saw anguished, agonized Bergarians,
panicking as they drowned.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$Mountains of bikki corpses, warships
wreathed in flames, sinking below the waves.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$A dragon's shadow crossed over the moon,
and when it breathed...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$A searing white light consumed everything.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Center@$No... This can't be...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$We... Cassius is trying to unite all of Erden
to bring about a future of peace!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$But this...this cruel vision...
Is this the future the Empire will bring?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$$!-1!$Their drive to unite Erden will fail. In
the attempt, all mortal life will suffer.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Left@$I...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$Cassius's survival and capture of Ptak are
the events that bring about this future.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$B-But...the future isn't set in stone. There
might be a future where Bergaria wins...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$$!-1!$The future arises from the past.
What came before guides what comes after.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$The course you have set the future upon
is one of blood, and destruction.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$However, as the present shapes the future,
there is one way you may yet correct this.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$@Center@$R-Really?! What should I do?!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Chronos)#$$!-1!$You must right the course you diverted.
What was saved...you must destroy.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$...What...?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$A...a knife?
When did I...?
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Center@$Chronos? Are you there, Chronos?!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$@Right@$...I see. You still haven't forgiven me for
deceiving you.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$I don't hear Chronos's voice anymore...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$I have to destroy what I have saved...?
That means I have to...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Center@$...kill Cassius...?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Left@$Tell me, Cassius. Did you plan to kidnap the
Queen from the very beginning?

keys.DescriptionKey:
The great Primordial Chronos gifts few with her power over time. The temptation to misuse it—to erase mistakes or to freeze oneself in a moment of happiness—is too much for many to bear. A weak person, with such magic in their hands, could twist the flow of history into something unrecognizable.

It is fortunate, then, that the wielder of Chronos's most powerful staff is anything but weak.

keys.IntroText:

All you have is here and now."

keys.DescriptionKey:
Growing up in the mountains of Bergaria, Rolotia knew only chilly springs, frost-kissed autumns, and winters so bitter they killed all memory of warmth.

Now that she's made it to the beach for the first time, she's as thrilled as she is overwhelmed. The sun shines so strongly she can feel its rays brush her skin. The sea stretches from her feet to the horizon, free and untamed, nothing like the icy peaks that shadowed her childhood.

If this is summer, she never wants it to end.

RolotiaSwimsuit01.name: Rolotia
RolotiaSwimsuit01.title: Lady of Eternal Summer
RolotiaSwimsuit01.description:

If this is summer, she never wants it to end.

keys.IntroText:
"What a gorgeous day!
If only it could last forever..."

keys.DescriptionKey:
Rolotia loves the beach. She'd much rather race across golden sand than harsh, glinting snow. Unfortunately, sunshine and her pale northern skin don't get along well.

After that first day, which saw her going to bed a painful shade of crimson, Rolotia has come prepared. She persuaded Rizette to part with some sun-cloaking cream in exchange for a few magically extended moments with Finn. She made herself an oasis of shade with her umbrella. But what is she to do when she wants to join her friends in the water?

Perhaps a hat can keep the sun away.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The close of her vacation has filled Rolotia with a surprising melancholy. As the Avatar of Time, she's learned well that all good things must end. Surely a summer is nothing to mourn.

Yet each wave heralds their return to war, to worry, to reality. Could she ask Chronos to keep them here forever, suspended in a perfect summer's day, never to know suffering again?

No. The Primordial of Time would never allow it. As long as they draw breath, all living things must change. That is the foremost law of time.

But as long as she keeps the memory in her heart, Rolotia's first summer need never truly end.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Time moves differently in summer. Lazy afternoons drift by as slowly as the clouds overhead, yet the season itself passes in the blink of an eye. Why does this happen? Is there an explanation, or does the heat simply drive the world mad?

Perhaps the erratic ticking of Chronos's summer clock is to blame.

keys.value:
$#Guard(Bergarian Soldier)#$$&GuardCommand&$$@Left@$General Cassius! Congratulations on your
victory! I am honored to serve under you!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$(...? Did something just glitter
in the rafters...?)
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$@Center@$...What?
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSurprised&$$@Center@$Grgh?!

$#Servant(Villager)#$$&MaleVillagerAScared&$$@Center@$Eeeeeek! Sir Cassius! There's a knife...
sticking out of his throat!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$@Center@$Out of my way!
...Cassius!
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusHurt&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Grgh... Hagh...!!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Left@$No...! There's...so much blood...!
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusHurt&$$@Right@$...Hrgh! Ro...lo...!!

$#GuardA(Bergarian Soldier A)#$$&GuardCommand&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Something just fell from the ceiling!
A...feathered cape?

$#GuardB(Bergarian Soldier B)#$$&GuardCommand&$$@Left@$Did the Ptaki send an assassin
to sabotage us?!

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Right@$Oh, it's you! Come, drink up! You did well
to defend the castle in my absence!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaCrying&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No...! Cassius, no! You can't die!
Ah, what should I do...?!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaCrying&$$@Center@$(He's slipping away. He's going to—
He's going to die!)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaCrying&$$@Center@$(I have no choice...! I have to use...
my time powers!)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Old Lady)#$You must not, Rolotia.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$(...Huh? Oh... This is...a distant memory.)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Old Lady)#$We, who were bestowed the powers of a
Primordial, hold great might.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Old Lady)#$Come what may, we must remain
unmoved.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Old Lady)#$Do you understand? You must never
interfere with history...with the past.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Old Lady)#$We cannot know what changes may occur
in our present or future if we meddle.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Old Lady)#$with the past, even for a moment.
It is strictly forbidden.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Cassius... He's acting like nothing
happened.)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Right... It's taboo to interfere with the
the past. That's what I was taught...)
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$(...But I don't care!)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaCrying&$$@Center@$(My beloved is about to die before my eyes.
What could be worse than that?!)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaCrying&$$@Center@$Hold on, Cassius. I'm going to...
I'm going to save you!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$@Left@$Huh...?

$#Guard(Bergarian Soldier A)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Right@$Lady Rolotia, what's wrong?
Do you feel unwell?
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaThoughtful&$$@Left@$Huh...? Oh, no... I'm fine. Thank you.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Where am I...? When is this?!
Where's Cassius...?!)

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusShouting&$$@Center@$A toast! A toast to Bergaria's victory!
Raise your glasses with pride!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Center@$(Cassius— he's alive! But that knife—
Any moment now—!)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$@Center@$(He's the guest of honor, after all. He can't
let them see him looking down.)
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Center@$(It'll come from...up there!)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$(...There! The shimmer!
It's flying right toward him!)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$(I'll turn the knife's time back,
before it reaches Cassius!)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Assassin)#$$!-1!$What?! The knife turned back?!
A-aah! I'm falling?!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Center@$(Oh no! If he falls from that height,
he'll die!)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$(I can't let that happen. I'll slow his time
as he falls!)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Assassin)#$$!-1!$Gaagh?!
I-It...doesn't...hurt?!

$#GuardA(Bergarian Soldier A)#$$&GuardCommand&$$@Left@$W-Who are you?! What sorcery allows Ptaki
garbage to fly?!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Seize him! He's an assassin!
$#Guard(Bergarian Soldier B)#$$&GuardSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...What?
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$(...Have I hurt Cassius by hiding my past?)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Uh... I mean...
(Ah... Everyone's confused...)
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...Seize the assassin! Don't let him escape!

$#Guard(Bergarian Soldier A)#$$&GuardCommand&$$@Right@$Y-Yes, sir!
Hey you, hurry and get some rope!
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Center@$(I want to tell him the truth. I do.
If I only could...)

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$(But...where would I even start?
Would he even believe me...?)

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusShouting&$$@Center@$A toast! A toast to Bergaria's victory!
Raise your glasses with pride!
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaBlush&$$@Center@$Oh...my glass...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSmile&$$@Left@$...The sunset really is beautiful.
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Left@$Um... I'm not saying that I want a whole
ceremony, but...! It's just... I'm worried...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$@Left@$I want proof of your love, before you leave
for battle...where you might not return.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$@Right@$Are my feelings for you insufficient, that
you need proof of them?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHorrified&$$@Left@$No! That's not it! I know you care deeply
for me!

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Left@$But...I see. I guess you aren't thinking
about... marriage.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...I'm sorry if I hurt you. But I don't want
to seal your future in misery.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$You know too little of our world. A wedding
here is more than a simple seal of love.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$If I marry you and lose my life on the
battlefield, then...

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$@Center@$You will be bound to my land as a widow,
left to a desolate life of solitude.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Left@$I wish peaceful times like this could
last forever.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$@Center@$You cannot find a new love, or a new place
to live... I don't want you to be miserable.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$I know. But I'm fine with that, even so...
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$Rolotia, the war will end someday.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$The Emperor and I will unite Erden
under the Bergarian Empire.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$@Center@$I cannot ask you to shoulder an uncertain
fate...so please, wait until then.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Center@$...In that case, I would like to ask you for
something else.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSmile&$$@Center@$When you go to the Ptaki Isles...
Take me with you.
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What?

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$@Left@$If I can stay by your side, then I won't
feel anywhere near as helpless.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Left@$I'm tired of staying in the castle, unable to
do anything but wait and pray.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$@Right@$Rolotia, does worry still linger in
your heart?
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Right@$I would love to have you with me, but...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Left@$You should already know that I can fight.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaDetermined&$$@Left@$I can protect myself. We first met on a
battlefield, don't you remember?
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$@Right@$You're right... We did.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Left@$Then why do you look so grim?
Don't you believe in my strength?

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$@Right@$I do. But...
My men do not.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSurprised&$$@Left@$...What do you mean?

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I didn't want to hurt you, but...
I can't keep this hidden any longer.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$No one knows where you came from. There
are many who doubt you because of that.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$They do not believe you saved my life.
Instead, they say you bewitched me...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaNormal&$$@Left@$Y-Yes. It's not that I don't believe in you,
but...

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$@Center@$Some even consider you wicked,
or cursed.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$@Center@$Rolotia. You know that normally, I would
never pry into my beloved's past.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$And you have told me not to ask about your
history. I want to respect your wishes...

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$But secrets build unrest. If you wish to
join us, you will need to win their trust.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$Just say what you can. If you tell me your
secret, I will convince the others.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Left@$My past...must remain hidden. I'm sorry.
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$@Right@$...That is unfortunate.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaWorried&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Wait, Cassius...
Where are you going?
$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSerious&$$@Center@$I need to cool my head.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Left@$I just can't seem to shake the anxiety off
completely.

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSad&$$@Center@$If you will not trust me with your past,
I am not sure what our future can be.
$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaSad&$$@Center@$Cassius...

$#Cassius(Cassius)#$$&CassiusSmile&$$@Right@$It's a sign of your love. Don't worry.
Your feelings for me bring me joy.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaHappy&$$@Left@$Haha. in that case, I can worry as much as
I want to, then.

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaBlush&$$@Left@$...Cassius, if... If it would please you...
If you would like, then...

$#Rolotia(Rolotia)#$$&NewRolotiaBlush&$$@Left@$Before you leave for the Ptaki Isles, won't
you officially take me as your wife...?

keys.DescriptionKey:
Trevyn was always a talented swordsman, a quality that made him overconfident and brash in his youth. His arrogance got him into a duel with a blind human swordmaster, but he had his world turned upside down when the elderly woman defeated him.

Believing that she had the key to something he lacked, Trevyn pleaded with her to take him on as her disciple. At first the woman would have none of it, but Trevyn's newfound humility and enthusiasm eventually won her over. From that day forth, Trevyn trained to use his sword without his eyesight.

RoseElf01.name: Trevyn
RoseElf01.title: The Petal Paladin
RoseElf01.description:
Trevyn was always a talented swordsman, a quality that made him overconfident and brash in his youth. His arrogance got him into a duel with a blind human swordmaster, but he had his world turned upside down when the elderly woman defeated him.

Believing that she had the key to something he lacked, Trevyn pleaded with her to take him on as her disciple. At first the woman would have none of it, but Trevyn's newfound humility and enthusiasm eventually won her over. From that day forth, Trevyn trained to use his sword without his eyesight.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Under his new master's tutelage, Trevyn quickly became adept at using his hearing to compensate for his sight. Soon he could hear a single flower petal fluttering on the wind, and then slice it cleanly into half.

But his teacher's old age soon caught up with her. On her deathbed, she confided in Trevyn that she feared her life was meaningless, as whatever she had accomplished, a swordmaster with sight could have easily done better. Trevyn assured her that her this was not the case, and swore to prove that her techniques were unrivalled. He now travels through Erden to hone his skills and fulfill his promise.

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$|act0.Voices/mst45|$Captain Ludmilla, we have eliminated all
of the hostiles!
$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$|act0.Voices/mst54|$Yes ma'am!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$|act0.Voices/mst55|$So the veil of evil has fallen on this land
once more...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst56|$!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$|act0.Voices/mst57|$What... What happened here!? Where is
everyone!?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$|act0.Voices/mst58|$Did that woman attack Rossé too!?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst59|$Are you three from this village?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst60|$I am... Rizette and Theo are from
Westcarte...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$|act0.Voices/mst61|$I see...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst62|$I am Captain Ludmilla of the Rigland
Red Dragon Knights, Third Regiment.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst63|$We have evacuated the people of Rossé.
Don't worry, they are safe.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst46|$What about the villagers? Have they all
been evacuated?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSad&$$|act0.Voices/mst64|$We...were not able to reach Westcarte in
time. I am truly sorry...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$|act0.Voices/mst65|$...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst66|$Rossé has also suffered heavy damage.
It will take time for the village to recover.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAngry&$$|act0.Voices/mst67|$For Rossé and Westcarte to be attacked
simultaneously... Captain, is this...?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst68|$I am afraid so. The Pandemonium has
begun once more.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$|act0.Voices/mst69|$But it's only supposed to happen once a
century...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$|Cont|$The last one only ended 18 years ago,
didn't it!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$|act0.Voices/mst70|$The Pandemonium...!?
$#???(???)#$$|act0.Voices/mst71|$C-Captain!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst72|$...?

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$|act0.Voices/mst47|$Yes. The injured are being treated on a hill
east of here.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$|act0.Voices/mst73|$Alfred! What's wrong!?

$#RedKnight(Alfred)#$$&RedKnight&$$|act0.Voices/mst74|$They are coming from the north, my whole
unit was—
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$|act0.Voices/mst75|$Alfred!!

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$|act0.Voices/mst76|$I don't enjoy having my patients stolen
from me before I arrive, little knight.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoAlarmed&$$|act0.Voices/mst77|$R-Riz...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGrit&$$|act0.Voices/mst78|$That's the woman who attacked Westcarte!!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$|act0.Voices/mst79|$You... You killed everyone!! Why!?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$|act0.Voices/mst80|$Who are you!?
$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$|act0.Voices/mst81|$Ossia, the Illustrious Plaguebearer...

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$|Cont|$I am an Aeon Lord, blessed with the
Eternity of the great Aeon Emperor ♪

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst48|$It is practically a miracle that no lives were
lost.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$|act0.Voices/mst82|$An Aeon Lord... One of the immortal
harbingers of the Pandemonium!?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$|Cont|$Are you the one leading monsters to
attack villages!?

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$|act0.Voices/mst83|$So you've evacuated everyone? You knights
are so rude.

$#Ossia(Ossia)#$$&OssiaDarkSmile&$$|act0.Voices/mst84|$No matter. I will simply have to hunt for
them after I finish with you!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHurt&$$|act0.Voices/mst85|$Urgh!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$|act0.Voices/mst86|$Theo!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$|act0.Voices/mst87|$Stop!!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act0.Voices/mst49|$Has there been any word from the
detachment we sent to Westcarte?

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$|act0.Voices/mst50|$Yes... By the time they arrived, the village
was destroyed. There were no survivors.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$|act0.Voices/mst51|$...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$|act0.Voices/mst52|$Whoever commanded those monsters to
attack must still be somewhere close by.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$|act0.Voices/mst53|$Find them!

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$Captain Ludmilla!
We have eliminated all of the hostiles!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Left@$What happened here!?
Rossé...my home...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$What do you mean your home?
Nobody lives here.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Left@$What are you talking about!?
I've lived here all my life!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Left@$What exactly is going on here!?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$You must be mistaken.
This place was destroyed 18 years ago.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$It's been a ghost town ever since.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Everyone knows this.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$No way... That can't be...
Then what are you doing here?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$We received a distress signal
from Westcarte.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$We were on our way from Rigland
when we made a brief stop here.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$Alert the troops.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$We got held up by a monster attack.
We must get to Westcarte post haste.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedUpset&$$@Left@$You're too late.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$Excuse me?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedUpset&$$@Left@$Westcarte is gone. Destroyed.
By something unknown.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedUpset&$$@Left@$My brother and I are the only survivors
and now he's missing...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Left@$I see... Please, forgive me.
If only we'd gotten there in time...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Left@$Are you okay?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedWorried&$$@Left@$I'm okay... It's not your fault.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedScared&$$@Left@$But we need to find my brother.
We got separated during our escape.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Understood. I'll alert the troops.
I promise, we will bring him back to you.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$We shall resume the advance
on Westcarte in five minutes!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Oh, and my name is Ludmilla.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$I am the Captain of the Rigland 
Red Dragon Knights, Third Regiment.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$Captain Ludmilla!
Please tell me what happened here!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$...!?
$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$Yes ma'am!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$To think we'd get stranded here...
And what's worse...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$The monsters have gone berserk.
They're acting so unnaturally.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Almost like they're being controlled
by something...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Left@$Could it be that it has begun? If so, we need to get to Westcarte ASAP!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$...!?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Yes, Alfred?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedAngry&$$@Left@$That voice...!

$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaSmile&$$@Right@$You called that thing "Alfred," right?
How amusing for such a pathetic being!
$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaSmile&$$@Right@$A ha ha ha!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Left@$You scum!

$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaSmile&$$@Right@$Don't look so pitiful.
I'll make sure you join him soon enough.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$In the name of the Red Dragon Knights,
I will ki—
$#LudmillaDamaged(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedHurt&$$@Left@$Ghh!
$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaSmile&$$@Right@$I'm sorry, what were you saying?
$#LudmillaDamaged(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedScared&$$@Left@$She brought the captain to her knees
with just the swipe of her hand...

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$Captain Ludmilla...I bring news.
The Third Regiment is gone...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedUpset&$$@Left@$You must be the one who destroyed my
village!

$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaSmile&$$@Right@$Come to think of it, you look just like
that lost little lamb trying to escape
$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaSmile&$$@Right@$from that pathetic little village.

$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaSmirk&$$@Right@$And what fun it was to watch
those wretched little insects there!

$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaSmirk&$$@Right@$Crying desperately for their lives,
"I don't want to die!" A ha ha!

$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaSmirk&$$@Right@$That's why I took my sweet time...
dissecting them.

$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaSmirk&$$@Right@$I ripped off their arms
and plucked out their eyes...

$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaSmirk&$$@Right@$Oh, their faces!
They contorted in such ghastly ways!
$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaSmirk&$$@Right@$A ha ha ha!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedAngry&$$@Left@$You... You won't get away with this!
$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$Annihilated in seconds.

$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaSmirk&$$@Right@$Heh, little pup with all bark and no bite.
You have no idea how beneath me you are.

$#LudmillaDamaged(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedAngry&$$@Left@$Please you two, get out while you can!
Don't try to fight this demon!

$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaSmirk&$$@Right@$Oh, but don't you see, Captain?
It's too late.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What...!
How can you move so quick—
$#FinnNearDeath(Finn)#$$&FinnDamagedHurt&$$@Center@$Graaah!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedUpset&$$@Center@$Finn! No!

$#LudmillaDamaged(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaDamagedHurt&$$@Center@$You vile scum!
Damn, I can't do anything right now...
$#FinnNearDeath(Finn)#$$&FinnDamagedHurt&$$@Center@$Huff...puff...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedUpset&$$@Center@$No...your body is getting cold...
Finn! Please don't die!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedUpset&$$@Center@$I can't go through this again...
I don't want to see good people dying...
$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$I was the last one stand—
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedUpset&$$@Center@$Finn...please don't close your eyes...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$Alfred!!!

$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaSmile&$$@Right@$Well, hello there.
My beloved specimens.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Left@$Y-you! You killed Alfred...!

$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaSmile&$$@Right@$Heh heh heh, and you must be
the Captain of the Red Dragon Knights.
$#Ossia(Demon)#$$&OssiaSmirk&$$@Right@$My, aren't you a fine specimen!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act0.Voices/sst3|$I need to focus on making sure no other
villages end up like Rossé.

$#DONTSHOWME(Woman)#$$|act1.Voices/sst10|$I saw the Rossé folk being escorted to
Rigland.

$#DONTSHOWME(Woman)#$$|act1.Voices/sst11|$I had hoped my children would never
experience a Pandemonium...

$#DONTSHOWME(Woman)#$Rossé? It was there when I was a child,
but I hear it was destroyed
$#DONTSHOWME(Woman)#$during the last Pandemonium.

$#DONTSHOWME(Woman)#$It was supposedly attacked by demonic
monsters led by an Aeon Lord.

$#DONTSHOWME(Woman)#$But there are also rumors that the people
there actually all killed each other...

$#DONTSHOWME(Woman)#$I mean, that's just what I've heard.
I don't know whether it's true or not.

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Traveler)#$$|act1.Voices/sst12|$Are you the Red Dragon Knights? Could
you spare some time to help me?

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Traveler)#$$|act1.Voices/sst13|$A stranger in a brown cloak just stole a
pouch of soul stones from me!

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Traveler)#$$|act1.Voices/sst14|$I think he ran off toward Rigland, but he
has some tough monsters with him...

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Traveler)#$$|act1.Voices/sst15|$How about it? If you help me out, I promise
I will make it worth your while!

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Traveler)#$$|act1.Voices/sst16|$Hey! That's the thief who stole my soul
stones!

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Traveler)#$$|act1.Voices/sst17|$What? These folk defeated you so you're
turning over a new leaf?

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Traveler)#$$|act1.Voices/sst18|$Sounds suspicious... But if you return my
soul stones, I'll let bygones be bygones.

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Traveler)#$$|act1.Voices/sst19|$Knights, thank you for your help. Here, take

keys.DescriptionKey: A Knight of the Round Table raised by a faerie known as the Lady of the Lake—that was the original Lancelot. The path this one is walking, and the paths she refuses to follow are not the same as her predecessor's. Her mind is as open as a wide lake, her appearance and expressions ever changing like a water surface that reflects the sky. And still, just like the waters of an inland lake do not ebb and flow with the tide, so does her swordsmanship stay ever unwavering. She withstands every attack and launches her own special move. She bears the title of the strongest like it's nothing, for she is the current Lancelot.

Nevertheless, she believes that sinners aren't forbidden from doing what's right or following their principles. That's why she won't ever lay down the burden of sin she has inherited along with her name—even though it is not hers personally, she feels it is her to bear as another Lancelot.

keys.DescriptionKey:
When the Knights of the Round Table were asked to choose one member to model a wedding dress, the king passed the task on to Gawain, and Gawain—to Lancelot. "This kind of thing is not exactly what I'm into..." she protested, but when she tried to find someone else to do it, all the other knights were mysteriously absent.
When Gawain, haunted by her guilty conscience, went to the photoshoot venue later, she found Lancelot entangled in the ribbons decorating the place, with a deep flush on her face.

RoundTableKnightBride02.title: Swordmaster Bride
RoundTableKnightBride02.description:
When the Knights of the Round Table were asked to choose one member to model a wedding dress, the king passed the task on to Gawain, and Gawain—to Lancelot. "This kind of thing is not exactly what I'm into..." she protested, but when she tried to find someone else to do it, all the other knights were mysteriously absent.
When Gawain, haunted by her guilty conscience, went to the photoshoot venue later, she found Lancelot entangled in the ribbons decorating the place, with a deep flush on her face.

keys.DescriptionKey:
After Gawain reprimanded Lancelot for not taking the task seriously and left, the king herself appeared at the venue to check on her subordinate's progress.
"Huff, huff... Ah, Your Majesty. Um, I got tangled in these decorative chains somehow... Nghh! Could you perhaps help me...?" Lancelot implored, but the king, well aware and understanding of her preferences, just closed the door silently.
Though it might not appear so from the way she looks now, left alone and breathless in the wedding hall, for anyone who knows her it is clear that the upright and honest Lancelot, always ready to meet any challenges life throws her way, would surely make a wonderful bride.
