keys.value: $#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$...I'm back.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Center@$...not even I can repair damage this
extensive, you know.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Center@$I'm struggling to even keep you here.
Honestly, Ryouma...
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Yes?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Right@$...you did this for a reason, right? There
was something you had to do?
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$Yes.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaNormal&$$@Right@$And did you accomplish it?
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$I did.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Right@$I see. Then... I suppose this is farewell.
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSmile&$$@Left@$It's been nice.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$!-1!$$@Center@$A thousand years of companionship,
and that's all you have to say?!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Center@$No, you aren't! I mean, I guess you kind
of are, but...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Center@$Who will protect my shrine now, huh?!
And who will make my lunch?!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Center@$And, and... ugh! I hate selfish people like
you!

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$I really am sorry. I don't know what else
I can say.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$...thanks for everything. You're childish,
selfish, and spoiled...

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSmile&$$@Center@$But you're also merciful, wise, and kind.
When you decide to be.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSmile&$$@Center@$You gave my life new meaning.
I can't thank you enough.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Center@$...hmph.
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh, and... can I ask you one more thing?

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$You took me as your Avatar on
Yan-Naharl's request, right?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaNormal&$$@Right@$...hmph. Don't be ridiculous. It was a whim,
that's all!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Center@$I hardly consider destroying your own
body to be "coming back."

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$I see. Then, could you pass on a message
when my master comes through?

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSmile&$$@Left@$Your wish was very kind. And I lived
a happy life because of it.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSurprised&$$@Right@$Hm? So you learned of Yan-Naharl's
wish after all?

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$I didn't get a chance to ask. But I got
a chance to... teach...
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Right@$H-hey...

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$Teaching someone... handing down...
your art... watching them grow...
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSmile&$$@Left@$That's... the wish... of all... teachers...
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Right@$...he couldn't hold on any longer.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSad&$$@Right@$...So, Yan. Did he guess right?
$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yes... as embarrassing as it is to admit.
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$My apologies.

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlNormal&$$@Center@$Ryouma is correct. I gave him my all,
and wished for him to be happy.

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlOpenMouth&$$@Center@$To hear that he was happy, even in
death... surely, I am equally blessed.

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlOpenMouth&$$@Center@$Thank you, Aria, for looking after him for
so many long years.

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlOpenMouth&$$@Center@$I think it is time for me to rest, too.
I humbly ask for your guidance.

and dodged. Change up your pace.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$Change up my pace...!
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(...I see. She's good.)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSmile&$$@Center@$(She already has talent and experience
to spare. And she's taking to this well.)
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$And with the undead around...

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSmile&$$@Center@$(Above all else, she has drive. She wants
to be stronger. I can feel it.)
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$(...stronger, huh.)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$How can I catch up with you? What
can I do to finally match you?
$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlNormal&$$@Right@$...Ryouma.

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlNormal&$$@Right@$Why do you wish to be strong?
For what purpose?
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$I... to protect my homeland, of course.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$I've told you before. I'm the bastard son
of Sanga's shogun.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$Born in secret, unknown to his family.
A shadow of a prince.

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlNormal&$$@Right@$Sanga holds a pact with the slumbering
Primordial, does it not?

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlNormal&$$@Right@$A vow to protect her shrine. A vow that
must be kept by the shogun's true heir.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$It only makes sense to assume you're
dead. That's what I would do.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$Yes. That's why my father fears a
succession crisis over all else.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$That's why I'm kept a secret. Why I can't
be allowed to exist.

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlSurprise&$$@Right@$And yet you would fight for the land
where you must not exist?

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$Of course. Even if it reviles me, Sanga is
still my home.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$If I must serve my home as a shadow, so
be it.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSmile&$$@Left@$Is it so strange, to want to fight for one's
homeland?

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlNormal&$$@Right@$No, not at all. If that is indeed what you
want.
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$...
$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ryouma. You lack a truly heartfelt wish.

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlNormal&$$@Center@$You are already strong enough to help
anyone who may require it.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Center@$Yeah... you're probably right.

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlEyesClosed&$$@Center@$If you wish to grow stronger still, you
must first turn your gaze inward.

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlEyesClosed&$$@Center@$Why do you, forsaken by your family,
wish to protect those who left you?

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlNormal&$$@Center@$The blade is a reflection of yourself.
An untrue heart will turn it dull.

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlNormal&$$@Center@$The heart desires a goal. Without one,
you will never reach your pinnacle.

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlOpenMouth&$$@Center@$Only that clarity of purpose will allow
you to find the strength you seek.
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$I... what I want...

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$If that's what you believe, what is your
heartfelt wish, Master?

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$How did you get as strong as you are?
What was it you sought?
$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlNormal&$$@Center@$...haha. I wonder, indeed.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Don't try to deflect. It's not fair if I'm
the only one who has to say it.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Center@$...heh.

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlNormal&$$@Right@$Teacher's privilege. Shall we spar
again? I will defeat you even faster.
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What? Ha... just try it!

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$(Master. I'm sorry. I still don't know what
my wish is.)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$(I just wanted to protect my home. Even
if it never protected me back.)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$(...but I've had enough of these gloomy
thoughts.)
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackUp&$$@Center@$Haaaa!
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...!!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Right@$...! Hey, Ryouma! Did you see that one?!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriHappyUp&$$@Right@$I feel great! I feel like I could even
cut a boulder in half if I had to!
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$Y-yeah...

keys.DescriptionKey:
There was a world before the wall.

A world before black rain, and dragonfire, and rations that never last. A world before the undead, where the sky shone bright and the spring brought flowers.

She has never seen such things herself. The monstrous goddess started her war before she was ever born, leaving her with nothing but legends and tales of days gone by. Most these days don't have even that, so beaten down by the undead siege that every hope has fled them.

But not her. Never her.

Even knowing they will die, the sakuras bloom. And so will she.

keys.IntroText:
"With hope and steel she arms her heart.
Her blade reflects the sunrise."

keys.DescriptionKey:
The war with the undead started eighteen years ago, but the history of her clan stretches much, much further. Though her village was little more than a farming settlement by the time it fell, it guarded an ancient samurai fortress. The last lord to reside in that fortress met his death at the hands of the undead. Now, like everything else, it sits abandoned.

Shiori has never set foot inside it herself. As bodyguards of the samurai, her family was not permitted within its walls without their master's blessing.

But sometimes in her dreams, she travels to its gates to stand watch.

keys.DescriptionKey:
A thousand years ago, Shiori's ancestor swore to guard a noble samurai with his life. That vow has passed from generation to generation, and now rests with her. The man who first made it could have never imagined the world his descendant would find herself in, but even so, she holds the promise fast.

Her father may have died in battle. Her mother may have fallen when her village fell. But she understands something the goddess, in all her immortal glory, never could.

As long as she honors her family's memory, they are never truly gone.

keys.value: $#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaShouting&$$@Center@$Haaa!
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSmile&$$@Left@$...perhaps.

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlNormal&$$@Right@$It is good to desire victory. That fuels
determination, and in turn, strength.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$If you say so, it must be true. Though it
hardly feels like I've gotten any stronger.

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlOpenMouth&$$@Right@$Oh? What place was it you earned in the
Sanga martial arts tournament, again?

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$First. Which hasn't made me any
friends in the castle, I'll admit.

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlOpenMouth&$$@Right@$You defeated foes you once thought
unbeatable. That is growth, indeed.
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$I will try to see it like that.

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlOpenMouth&$$@Right@$Most importantly, I, your teacher,
recognize the strength in you.

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlNormal&$$@Right@$You are already beyond the grasp of
most mortals.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Sure, but that just makes our training
stranger.
$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlOpenMouth&$$@Center@$Foolish man.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$The stronger I get, the further above me
you seem.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$How can I catch up with you? What
can I do to finally match you?
$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlEyesClosed&$$@Center@$...Ryouma.
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$Yes, Master Yan-Naharl?

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlNormal&$$@Center@$Why do you wish to be strong?
For what purpose?
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$I...
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...I...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Left@$Ryouma! Keep those hands moving!
I'm hungry!
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Right@$...can I raise a point, Aria?
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaNormal&$$@Left@$What?
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaHurt&$$@Left@$—ugh!
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You claim you're hungry...

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$But you're a Primordial. You don't have
to consume food.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$I could take a hundred years to finish this
meal, and you'd be no worse off.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So? Are you trying to tell me to shut up
and wait?

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSmile&$$@Right@$That I am, my Lady. Unless you want
chicken charred to the bone.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Left@$Hey! How long do you think I've slumbered?!
A thousand years! One thousand!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$@Left@$I am sick to death of sleeping! I'll eat
literally anything, so get cooking!
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Fine, fine.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Left@$Hmph. So. What were you spacing out
for just now? Do you not feel well?

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaClosedEyes&$$@Right@$I was remembering my past life. And my
old master, Yan-Naharl.

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlNormal&$$@Right@$Remember, when fighting any foe, you
must keep their whole body in view.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSmile&$$@Left@$Ah. There's a name I haven't heard in a
while.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSerious&$$@Left@$It's been over a thousand years now.
I hope he's doing well.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Right@$I haven't seen him since you called me
to be your Avatar...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSmug&$$@Left@$Really? I guess you're not as dutiful as you
look.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSmile&$$@Left@$A disciple should visit their master at
least once a millennium, I'd say.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Right@$I've been protecting this entryway to
the underworld since the day you raised

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Right@$me from the dead. I can't simply abandon
my duty.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Left@$Sure, sure. Blame your job for making you
lazy.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Right@$Says the girl who's been sleeping here for
a thousand years.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAnnoyed&$$@Left@$Gah! I-I'm not lazy! I'm just gathering
my strength to face the undead, that's all!
$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlNormal&$$@Right@$Otherwise, they will catch you off guard.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(What did I ever do to catch the eye of such
a frivolous Primordial...)
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSmile&$$@Center@$(...actually, come to think of it...)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$Aria. I'd like you to tell me why you
made me your Avatar.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Center@$Hm? What's this, all of a sudden?

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$I was strong, in life. No one in Sanga
could best me with a blade.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$But there were plenty of beings in
Erden stronger than me. Like my master.
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$So why choose me above all of them?

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$...did Master Yan-Naharl have a hand in
it?
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSurprised&$$@Center@$...
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaScared&$$@Center@$A-Aah, sorry. Can't seem to remember.
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$...I suppose you're right.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAnnoyed&$$@Center@$In any case, you're wasting time again!
Hurry up! I'm hungry!
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$...

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Sorry. I think I need some air. You can
finish making lunch yourself.
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaShout&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Wha... huh?! Wait just a minute!
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Right@$No. I'll be back later.

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Damn you, Ryouma! This is dereliction
of duty! What about my chicken?!

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...all those who prosper must one
day fall. The proud cannot endure.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$It was only natural that Sanga would
fall, after a thousand years.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$(The undead are sweeping across
Erden. Our world stands on its last legs.)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$(Aria can't do anything because of
the old pact. Just sleep, and wait.)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$Though you're the only foe who's ever
attacked me with a tail.
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(And I... I must stand guard over her shrine.)
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$(That's my only duty.)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$(There are few intruders. I might as well
be slumbering too.)
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$(If...)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(If Yan-Naharl did ask Aria to take
me on as her Avatar...)
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(I want to know the reason why.)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$(I'll track him down again. And I'll get the
truth from him, once and for all.)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSmile&$$@Left@$I've never fought anyone who can trip me
so easily.
$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlOpenMouth&$$@Right@$Oh, dear. Have I wounded your pride?
$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlDarkNormal&$$@Center@$Aah...
$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlDarkNormal&$$@Right@$Aah...

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$I should have realized sooner what it
was you'd given me.
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$It wasn't just strength, or technique.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$You gave an unwanted boy a goal to
reach for and a place to call home.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$And when I died not realizing that,
you found me a new home, too.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$When you... died? What do you mean?
$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeThoughtful&$$@Center@$...

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$I can never thank you enough, Master.
All I can do now is try and save you.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$To free you from this curse, and guide
you back to your proper place...
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackUp&$$@Center@$W-wait, Ryouma! What are you doing?!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$Amazing... to battle a dragon to a standstill
like that!

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$If I can help someone suffering right
in front of me...

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$Shiori. I couldn't have made it here
without you.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Center@$But...
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Master. Your suffering is over.
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaClosedEyes&$$@Left@$Let's end it all...
$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlDarkNormal&$$@Right@$...

$#Yan-Naharl(Yan-Naharl)#$$&Yan-NaharlDarkOpenMouth&$$@Right@$Yes... let us end it.
Ryou...ma...
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ryouma! Wait, Ryouma!
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$...thank you.
$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSurprised&$$@Center@$Shioriii! Hajimeeee!
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$...

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighShout&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Stop shouting, damn it! The undead will
hear you!

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSerious&$$@Right@$Sorry... it's just, these marks are very
new, so they must be nearby.
$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSurprised&$$@Right@$Ah! Look! Over there!

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighGrit&$$@Left@$They're collapsed...
No, it can't be...!
$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleScared&$$@Right@$Shiori! Hajime!!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedDown&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...
...nnh...

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeHurt&$$@Center@$Ugh...
What the...
$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSmile&$$@Center@$Oh, thank goodness! They're alive!
$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$For now, at least! Hurry up and get healing!
$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSurprised&$$@Right@$O-oh, right! Hold still, you two!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$Huh? Ryouma?! Why did you lower your
sword?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Lucelle. Thank goodness you made it
to Last Bastion safely.

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$D-don't worry about me! I owe you
my life, you know!

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$@Left@$Still, what are you doing out here?
You went directly away from the city.

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSerious&$$@Right@$That cave was full of fallen undead. Did
you do all that, Shiori?

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It was already like that when I got
there.
$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Center@$Did you take on that army by yourself?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$Oh, no, I couldn't have done it all alone.
There was...
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$...huh?
$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Shiori? Are you okay?
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Right@$That's strange... I can't seem to remember.
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$That's enough.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$I feel like... something really important
happened, but...

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Did you hit your head or something?
Lucelle, does she have a lump?
$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hmm... I don't feel one.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedDown&$$@Right@$Eep! Don't pet my ears like that! That
tickles!

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSurprised&$$@Left@$Stress can interfere with memory
formation, so maybe that's it?

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSerious&$$@Left@$But I can't find him anywhere!

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighGrit&$$@Right@$That bastard... he couldn't wait even a
second to do things the smart way.
$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighHappy&$$@Right@$Look what I managed to get!

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSurprised&$$@Left@$Huh... is that permission for a sortie?!
How did you—

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSerious&$$@Right@$I told the Commander I spotted more undead.
I didn't mention Shiori at all.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$You're not feeling well, right? Just passing
out like that in the open...
$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSurprised&$$@Left@$Raleigh... you lied to Ludmilla?

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighSmile&$$@Right@$As long as we kill some undead on the
way, it's not lying, is it?

$#Raleigh(Raleigh)#$$&RaleighHappy&$$@Right@$Come on. Let's go rescue Shiori—
and Hajime too, while we're at it!
$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSmile&$$@Left@$Okay!

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I'll rest when I need to. There should be
a house or two up ahead.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadUp&$$@Right@$Ah...
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$What?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadBack&$$@Right@$If you mean the Sanga hunting camps
out on the outskirts...
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackUp&$$@Center@$Lucelle! Over here!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackUp&$$@Center@$No! Don't come any closer, Lucelle!
Just get out of here!
$#Skeleton(Undead)#$$&Skeleton&$$@Center@$...
$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleScared&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Eep...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackBack&$$@Right@$I'll be okay! Get back to the city and ask
for reinforcements!
$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSerious&$$@Left@$B-but...

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleScared&$$@Left@$...alright. We're coming right back for you,
though! Don't you dare die on me!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedBack&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I won't! Stay safe, okay?
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackUp&$$@Center@$Ah...!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$Urgh... all that shouting... really did a
number on me, huh.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$!-1!$(I'm honestly amazed I'm still alive after
a fall like that.)

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleScared&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Shiori, please! This is way too dangerous
for just the two of us!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$(I should be glad I got off with a couple of
wounds, but...)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$(I can't make it back in this condition.
And there are still undead around.)
$#Skeleton(Undead)#$$&Skeleton&$$@Center@$...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Center@$Speak of the devil... well, better you come
for me than Lucelle, I guess.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Center@$Alright then. Who's... f-first...?
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidDown&$$@Center@$(I-I can't... can't breathe.)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidDown&$$@Center@$(My back hurts... I did hit it pretty hard
on the way down.)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidDown&$$@Center@$(I can't breathe... no. No, calm down. I have
to calm down...!)
$#Skeleton(Undead)#$$&Skeleton&$$@Center@$...!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidDown&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(So this is it?)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Right@$I know it's dangerous. But killing the
undead is our duty!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Center@$(At least Lucelle escaped. And at least
the squad's safe in the city.)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Center@$(A river at my back... they've driven me
into a corner now.)
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadDown&$$@Center@$(...forgive me, Hajime.)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$Hm? A group of undead? What are they
hunting?
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$A living person...

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$...my Primordial says we must save our
strength for the final battle.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$It's cruel, but I shouldn't involve myself
in the world of mortals either.
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(She's surrounded. An army ahead of
her, a river behind...)
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$Just like...
$#Skeleton(Undead)#$$&Skeleton&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$(An army ahead of me, a river behind.
No getting out of this one...!)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$Friends! Cut them off from behind!
We'll take them from both sides!

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaShouting&$$@Center@$Hey! Ryuuji! Misato?! Can anyone hear
me?
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$...why won't you answer?!

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaShouting&$$@Center@$I've fought all my life for Sanga!
Will Sanga not fight for me?!
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaShouting&$$@Center@$Why?!
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$It's just like back then.
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(...I want to help her.)
$#Skeleton(Undead)#$$&Skeleton&$$@Center@$...

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$(I can't get to her in time. They've nearly
overwhelmed her...!)
$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleScared&$$@Center@$Hyaa! Here they come!
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$(...fine! Aria, lend me your power! Now!)
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaShouting&$$@Center@$Return to your rest, you fiends!
$#Skeleton(Undead)#$$&Skeleton&$$@Center@$...
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaHurt&$$@Center@$Urgh... now I've done it.
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$...but I suppose I had no choice.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$Alright, you lost souls... go see Aria.
She'll send you on your way.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedDown&$$@Center@$Ah...
...huh?
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Looks like you're safe, after all.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedDown&$$@Right@$Nnh...

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(She's on the verge of passing out. Good
thing she didn't see what happened.)
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackUp&$$@Center@$Look out!

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$(Her breathing's pretty rough, but she
should recover soon.)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$(Time for me to get out of here. I still
need to find Yan-Naharl...)
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaHurt&$$@Center@$...guh!

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaHurt&$$@Center@$Damn... guess it really was too much,
drawing on sealed power like that...!

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$!-1!$(Head's going fuzzy... world's going
dark. I can't keep my balance.)
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$(...no other undead around. Just the girl.)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$(I guess I can rest... just a bit. Then I'll
be right back up and on my way...)
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedBack&$$@Center@$I-is that you...?
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadBack&$$@Center@$Haji...me...?
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedBack&$$@Center@$Waaah?!
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(Hajime? Who's...)
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(Ugh. I can't think straight...)
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadBack&$$@Center@$...

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$...ey.
......lright?
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaHurt&$$@Center@$Nnh...
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Center@$Oh, good, you're awake! Are you okay?
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Who... ah. The girl from before...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Right@$Yes. You saved me, didn't you? I didn't get
a chance to thank you!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedBack&$$@Right@$You looked like you were in really bad
shape when I woke up...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedBack&$$@Right@$For a moment, I thought I'd have to bury
you in the river.

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleSurprised&$$@Center@$Shiori! No... they pushed her right over
the cliff...!
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(In the river?)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(Ah... right. The water burial the
people practice now.)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$(With Orcanix's cursed black rain
falling...)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$(Anyone who dies is eventually raised
as a soldier for her armies.)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Center@$(The only way to prevent it is to strap the
dead with stones and sink them in water.)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(...it's a cruel fate. I wouldn't wish it on
anyone.)

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$How about you, are you hurt? You seemed
unsteady back there.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$Ah, I landed pretty hard when I fell.
Had the wind knocked out of me.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$I'll have bruises all up my back for
days, but that's all.
$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSerious&$$@Left@$That's all, huh. You got lucky.

$#Lucelle(Lucelle)#$$&LucelleScared&$$@Center@$S-stay right there! I'll come down to heal
you, don't worry!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Right@$I certainly did. I was lucky enough to
have you save me, after all.

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSmile&$$@Left@$Right. Well, here's hoping your luck holds
out. Take care.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Right@$Thanks, you too... huh?

$#Ryouma(Ryouma)#$$&RyoumaSmile&$$@Left@$Thanks for waking me up, but I can't
stick around.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$W-wait! Where are you going?!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$If you're heading back to Last Bastion,
we should travel together!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$I'm a squad captain of the Vanguard,
you know! I can keep you safe!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackUp&$$@Center@$Hey! Wait, I said! Stop ignoring me!

Bow before the great Demon Overlord!

keys.DescriptionKey: However, even at the height of their short-lived glory, the demonfolk couldn't escape the clutches of the Pandemonium. The few who managed to evade the Eternal and his hordes of crazed monsters hid themselves in remote corners of the world, waiting for better times.

Satsuki01.name: Satsuki
Satsuki01.title: The Loudest Seeker
Satsuki01.description: The ancient hunter/assassin order known as the Seekers are renowned silent warriors—not Satsuki. She finds silence uncomfortable, and prefers to instead blend into crowds and other loud places.

keys.DescriptionKey: Satsuki strives to learn silence like her peers. But as she fails horribly when she tries, she's learned a new trick. She's learned that if she employs loud explosives in her missions, she deafens would-be witnesses.

keys.DescriptionKey: Satsuki's all but given up on being quiet. Instead, she's started her own Seeker school centered on the art of being distractingly loud. After all, a sufficient distraction is just as good as stealth.

keys.DescriptionKey:
When this unit is defeated by an enemy, 1 random non-sleeping enemy is granted the Sleep status effect for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. This effect triggers again for each time this unit has defeated an enemy with an attack while on the battlefield (max of 4 triggers total). Then if all enemies are asleep, all allies on the battlefield will immediately get the turns by having their TU reduced.

This unit has a 100% chance to immediately have its TU reduced to 0 after the first enemy turn while this unit is on the battlefield. If this successfully triggers, the enemy unit that had the turn is also granted the Sleep status effect for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield.

When this unit defeats 1 or more enemy units with an attack:
- If no enemies are sleeping, 1 random enemy is granted the Sleep status effect for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield.

keys.value: $#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$|act5.Voices/mst2920|$!?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2929|$Your method isn't utterly foolish, but the
amount of crystals you must have used is.

$#Rody(???)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2930|$But hey, who cares about people's lives
when there's money to be had, right?

$#Miner(Miner)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2931|$I didn't want to do it! But those Hymelians
wouldn't listen to me...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2932|$What are you going to do now, Mr. Hero?
Kick down their doors?

$#Rody(???)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2933|$No. Our job is to rescue the people trapped
in the mines. That's all.
$#Rody(???)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2934|$The tremors are getting stronger.

$#Rody(???)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2935|$The exit's just up ahead. We're gonna check
if any other folk are still down here.

$#Miner(Miner)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2936|$Thank you... Please, could you tell me your
names?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2937|$My name is not important. I am just your
average beautiful genius magician.

$#Rody(???)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2938|$Not sure if that's you bragging or being
humble...
$#Rody(???)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2921|$You okay?

$#Rody(???)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2939|$Then I'm just your average amazing hero.
Nothing to write home about.
$#Rody(???)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2940|$You should get out of here.

$#Miner(Miner)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2941|$Ms. Magician, Mr. Hero... Thank you. I
won't forget this! Be careful!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2942|$All of these workers are from nearby
farming villages.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2943|$They were drafted by Hymelia when mithril
was discovered in the Gamlan Mines.

$#Rody(???)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2944|$And now they're being forced to do
dangerous things just to increase the yield?

$#Rody(???)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2945|$What a lovely bunch the owners of this
hole must be.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2946|$If only they had never discovered there was
mithril down here...

$#Rody(???)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2947|$Let's seal these mines shut, Callen. Let's
make it so no one can enter again!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2948|$...I knew you were going to say that, Rody.
$#Miner(Miner)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2922|$Yes... Thank you...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act5.Voices/mst2949|$...!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$|act5.Voices/mst2950|$Rody... Then that man really is your...!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act5.Voices/mst2951|$Yeah... That was my dad!!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$|act5.Voices/mst2952|$Finn...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act5.Voices/mst2953|$(He sure had presence... Can I measure
up...?)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act5.Voices/mst2954|$(No... I have to do more than that.)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$|act5.Voices/mst2955|$(Finn... Can you really fight him? Can we
expect you to?)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act5.Voices/mst2956|$(I have to fight, and I have to win.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act5.Voices/mst2957|$(Win against the Eternal... And...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$|act5.Voices/mst2958|$(Against my father!)
$#Miner(Miner)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2923|$A-Are the others...?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$|act5.Voices/mst2959|$Rizette, I... I'm going to get stronger.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$|act5.Voices/mst2960|$Stronger than my dad. Then, I'm going to
defeat the Eternal!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$|act5.Voices/mst2961|$You don't have to fight alone, Finn. We're
with you every step of the way.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$|act5.Voices/mst2962|$Thank you, Rizette. Alright, lets go get
some mithril!

$#Rody(???)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2924|$Don't worry, the rest of our party is
helping them.
$#Miner(Miner)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2925|$Thank the gods...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2926|$The air down here is filled with magical
particles...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$|act5.Voices/mst2927|$You used flare crystals as a catalyst for

keys.DescriptionKey:
This unit has 35% damage reduction from attacks, plus 10% for each poisoned enemy on the battlefield (up to 75% max).

At the end of each of this unit's turns:
- A random enemy on the battlefield is granted Super Poison.
- A random enemy on the battlefield is Weakened.
- This unit steals up to 1 Spirit from the enemy team.

Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. This effect will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on affected units. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects. Super Poison will overwrite other status effects on affected enemies. Super Poison deals 4 times the damage of normal poison, and cannot be overwritten by normal poison.

This unit cannot be defeated by damage from Burn status effects. This unit is not affected by stun effects and cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

Whenever there are 3 or more burning allies on the battlefield, this unit will survive any attack that would defeat this unit with 1HP.

keys.value: $#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaShouting&$$@Left@$Haa!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaHurt&$$@Center@$(What should I do? At this rate, she's
going to win without breaking a sweat!)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Permed Student)#$$!-1!$Just kidding, geez! Here, open your
mouth, I'll toss it to ya!
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteHappy&$$@Left@$It sure is lively over there.

$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSleepySmile&$$@Right@$Just getting Hibiki to lie down at all
is a victory, I think.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSad&$$@Left@$Oh, no... how am I supposed to sleep with her next to me?!
$#Kitten(Kitten)#$$&KittenMeow&$$@Center@$Nya, nyaa!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSurprised&$$@Center@$W-wait, come back!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$@Center@$Wah! What the heck?!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Permed Student)#$$!-1!$A kitty cat! Omigoddess, it's so cute!
Like, how'd you get in here?!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Center@$Hey! Keep your nose outta my cookies!
$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneHappy&$$@Center@$So she's a cat burglar, huh...

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiNormal&$$@Center@$I guess it's too early to expect her to
hold her own against Hibiki...

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSad&$$@Center@$(Come back here! Ah, but then they'd
know I'm keeping her...!)
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Saya, we ought to get going...
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSmile&$$@Left@$Right... sorry to keep you. Thanks again.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Though I have to say...)

$#Kitten(Kitten)#$$&KittenNormal&$$@Center@$Nyaaa...
Purr purr purr.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmirk&$$@Center@$D'aww, how'm I supposed to stay mad!
You little thief!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordIrritated&$$@Center@$(That little traitor. I'm her owner, not
Hibiki.)
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordIrritated&$$@Center@$(...I know. I'll name her Fran.)
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordIrritated&$$@Center@$(After the cheating male lead Franz from Coppélia.)

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSerious&$$@Center@$(Well, everyone's gone home. I should
get started on my homework.)

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaIrritated&$$@Center@$(Shut up...! Don't just say that to my
face!)

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSerious&$$@Center@$(If I read through my textbooks, I should
be able to figure it out...)
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSurprised&$$@Center@$Hyah?!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmirk&$$@Center@$Haha, look at you jump!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSurprised&$$@Center@$W-what was that?
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiGum&$$@Center@$Gum.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordNormal&$$@Center@$(...bubble gum...)

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Center@$Ugh, I'm bored. Bored, bored, bored,
bored, bored, bored.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordIrritated&$$@Center@$(It's your own fault, you know...)

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHappy&$$@Center@$...pfft!
Hahahaha!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaIrritated&$$@Center@$(This is just like before...)
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordIrritated&$$@Center@$(What is it this time?)

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSerious&$$@Center@$(Ah, some manga in a magazine? She sure
is carefree.)
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmirk&$$@Center@$Hell yeah, got another life. Let's gooo!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordIrritated&$$@Center@$(And back to her game...
Ugh, I can't hear myself think.)
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiWink&$$@Center@$Hell yeah! Here we go!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(I have to ignore her, or it'll just annoy me
even more.)
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmirk&$$@Center@$Yeah, yeah!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(Ignore her...)
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmirk&$$@Center@$Alright, alright, alright, alright!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordShouting&$$@Left@$Oh, come on! Can't you be quiet for
ten minutes?!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Ballet Teacher)#$...we'll have to cut the final set of
99 pirouettes down to 10.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiGum&$$@Right@$Sorry, Your Majesty.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordShouting&$$@Left@$You're doing this on purpose. The studio,
the fight, and now this!

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Right@$Huh? Sounds like somebody's got a
victim complex.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordShouting&$$@Left@$Worst of all, you stalked me before I
even knew I was a Vessel!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordIrritated&$$@Left@$Do you do that to everyone? Is that why
no one likes you?!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$@Right@$Hang on, what—

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordShouting&$$@Left@$Is this some sick mental game for the
Requiem? Well, it won't work on me!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiClosedEyes&$$@Right@$...hmm.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordIrritated&$$@Left@$What, is that it?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$@Right@$Nah. I'm not bullying anyone. Not you,
and not the others, either.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Ballet Teacher)#$If this is all you're capable of, you'll never
make it as a pro anyway.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$@Right@$I'm just trying to live how I want to.
That's all.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(How she wants to? So she likes making
trouble for other people...?)

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$@Center@$Being Vessels sucks. We don't even get a
chance to say no, y'know?
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmirk&$$@Center@$So like, why not do what we want sometimes? We deserve it, don't we?
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...I guess you're not wrong there.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$@Right@$I was interested in you. But I wasn't
trying to spook you. Promise.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordIrritated&$$@Left@$Why the hell would you be so interested
in me?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiClosedEyes&$$@Right@$You're the first I've ever seen work so
hard at something she hates so much.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSurprised&$$@Left@$...what?
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ballet. You hate it, don't you?

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaShouting&$$@Left@$Don't just assume I can't do it...
Before I've even tried!!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordScared&$$@Center@$...
...of course not.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Liar. You're graceful, sure, and good
at it. Your dancing's pretty, too.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$@Right@$But there's no feeling to it. 'Cause you
don't feel anything yourself, right?
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordShouting&$$@Left@$That's not...

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmirk&$$@Right@$You can just kinda... tell. Least, I can.
It's something in your eyes.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordShouting&$$@Left@$Shut up...
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(I hate to admit it, but... she's right. I wasn't excited for Requiem at all.)

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSad&$$@Center@$(I wanted people to see my dance, and
praise me. That's all it was...)

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$See, folks try to suppress their emotions,
but it doesn't really work.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordIrritated&$$@Left@$Suppress—!

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$@Right@$?!
D-damn it...
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordShouting&$$@Left@$...I'm done with this. I'm done with you.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ah, hey, wait! You're gonna tear your
stitches!

$#Kitten(Fran)#$$&KittenMeow&$$@Center@$Nya!
Nyaa!

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Not you, too! This place doesn't allow
pets, dang it!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Center@$...there they go.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Center@$Aw, what the hell... why do I feel like
I'm the bad guy here?

$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Huh...
She got one in on the Super Slacker.
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteShouting&$$@Right@$...Saya! You can do it, Saya!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Right@$You call that an attack?!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Huh?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Student A)#$$!-1!$Hey, look. Hibiki actually looks kind
of upset!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Student B)#$Not bad, transfer student! Go on, give her
hell!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSurprised&$$@Center@$(Cheering? But why? They were all
so cold just a few minutes ago.)
$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Honestly...

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiSmile&$$@Center@$Still, we could be seeing the end of
Hibiki's perfect win streak here.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Center@$Huh?! How come everyone's cheering
for her, huh?!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Center@$Cheer for me too, damn it!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSmile&$$@Center@$(Ah... I think I understand.)
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(Hibiki is probably too strong. So everyone just feels like...)

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmirk&$$@Right@$Is that really all you got? Talk about a
disappointment!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$("Why even bother? Hibiki is just going
to win the Requiem, anyway.")

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSerious&$$@Center@$(But if that certainty can be shaken,
even for a moment...)
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaIrritated&$$@Center@$(Then they can still have hope!)
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaShouting&$$@Left@$Haaaa!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Right@$Gah! Damn it...!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaShouting&$$@Left@$(No one, absolutely no one, wants to just give up on everything!)
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Right@$Enoooough!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaHurt&$$@Left@$Aah...!

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSurprised&$$@Right@$She knocked one of Saya's blades out of
her hand!
$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSleepy&$$@Left@$Ah, well. It was nice while it lasted.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaHurt&$$@Left@$Ngh!
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSerious&$$@Right@$...the match isn't over yet, Kotone.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Come on, come on! We were just getting
to the fun part!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaHurt&$$@Center@$Ah...! Nngh!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaShouting&$$@Left@$I'm not just going to sit here...
And take it!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Right@$Ow!
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$She cut Hibiki's ankle!
$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSurprised&$$@Right@$Are they really gonna kill each other...?
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You just don't know when to quit!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaShouting&$$@Left@$Not yet... not enough, not yet!
$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Both of you, stand down! Now!

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Personal fights are against school rules!
Drop your weapons, now!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaHurt&$$!-1!$$@Left@$......

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiHurt&$$@Right@$...you're insane, you know that?
And that's a compliment.

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Put your weapons away, right now.
Get to medical, both of you!
$#SayaNoSword(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordHurt&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Y-yes, Miss.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmirk&$$@Right@$Bleeeh!

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSurprised&$$@Center@$Hard to believe you got so cut up on your
first day. You might be trouble.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Trouble? I don't...

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$And you, Himeno. Try not to bully the
new girl too much, hm?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Left@$Says the girl who gets off on bullying
everyone else.
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaIrritated&$$@Right@$Now, why would you think that?
$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiHurt&$$@Center@$...they're not listening.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$You seem to be in high spirits, Himeno.
No painkillers necessary for you, then.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiShouting&$$@Left@$H-hey!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(What am I even doing, getting all
worked up like that?)
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSadSmile&$$@Center@$(But I guess it did feel kind of nice.)
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Pardon me.
$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneNormal&$$@Right@$Hey, we're here...
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Charlotte, Kotone!

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$How are your injuries? Do you feel
alright?

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSadSmile&$$@Left@$Oh, yeah. I'm told I'll heal up overnight...
since I'm a Vessel and all.

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteHappy&$$@Right@$Still, don't overdo it. Here, I brought
your homework from our later classes.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaShouting&$$@Left@$I've got you!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSmile&$$@Left@$Ah, thanks...
Sorry for the trouble.
$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSerious&$$@Right@$Oh, and... c'mere. I have a secret for you.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSurprised&$$@Left@$Huh?

$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSerious&$$@Right@$...let's have a good fight, Despondent

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaIrritated&$$@Center@$(This is like... in the river. Like my blood

$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneShouting&$$@Right@$Getting so close to me is dumb, you know.

$#SayaNoSword(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh, Nana— er, Miss. You use a katana,
then?
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaIrritated&$$@Left@$(I can see where her strike will go!)

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaIrritated&$$@Left@$(Her swings aren't that fast... and she's
wide open after they land!)
$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneShouting&$$@Right@$I see you over there!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaShouting&$$@Left@$Haaa!
$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSurprised&$$@Right@$Ngh...!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(I got her!)

$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneHurt&$$@Right@$...not bad, ballerina. But it won't happen
again!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaIrritated&$$@Left@$(Here she comes!)
$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneSleepy&$$@Center@$Nn...?
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Huh? She stopped moving?)

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiHappy&$$@Right@$Yes. It's beautiful, isn't it? Though
obviously pretty dangerous.
$#Kotone(Kotone)#$$&KotoneClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Zzz...
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSurprised&$$@Center@$...s-she fell asleep?!

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Oh, Kotone... you always fall asleep at the
worst possible time.
$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiShouting&$$@Center@$The match is over! Winner: Saya Saionji!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSurprised&$$@Center@$Huh? W-wait, really? I won?!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$@Center@$......
$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiShouting&$$@Center@$Enough! Winner: Saya Saionji!

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiShouting&$$@Center@$Saya Saionji wins! That's the end of the
semifinals!

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiHappy&$$@Center@$Well done, Saya. You've made it all the
way to the finals.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$But... but how? How could I...
$#SayaNoSword(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSurprised&$$@Left@$I-is that a real blade?!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSad&$$@Left@$I don't want to fight. I kept hoping I'd
lose, but my body won't let me...

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSerious&$$@Right@$So you say, but you look positively
radiant right now, you know.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSurprised&$$@Left@$Charlotte? So you're my last opponent?
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSerious&$$@Right@$Yes. I do hope you'll go easy on me.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(She's using a spear and a shield?)

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSerious&$$@Center@$Your streak of beginner's luck ends here,
I'm afraid!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSerious&$$@Center@$(I can't aim for her shield side. She'll
just block me—)
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Aah?!
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteShouting&$$@Right@$There!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaShouting&$$@Left@$...! No, you don't!
$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiSmile&$$@Right@$Of course. But there's no need to worry.
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSerious&$$@Right@$...!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSerious&$$@Left@$(I got her! But... but how?)
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteShouting&$$@Right@$Haaa!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSurprised&$$@Left@$(Her expression didn't even change!
Isn't she in pain?!)
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Nnh...
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSerious&$$@Center@$I didn't expect this to take this long.

$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSerious&$$@Center@$But you know, I must admit...
I really enjoy battles of attrition.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSurprised&$$@Center@$(She's all cut up and bloody, but she
just keeps coming!)

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaSerious&$$@Center@$(It's not her body that's strong,
it's her spirit.)

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaHurt&$$@Center@$(If I don't end this in the next few
minutes, I'm done for.)

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiSmile&$$@Right@$Even if you bleed out, or lose all your
limbs, you won't die.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaShouting&$$@Center@$(So... I'll go for her shield! I'll feint,
then—!)
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What are you—
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteSurprised&$$@Right@$...?!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaShouting&$$@Left@$(Her vitals are exposed!)
$#Charlotte(Charlotte)#$$&CharlotteHurt&$$@Right@$Guh...!
$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Enough! Saya Saionji is the winner!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaHurt&$$@Center@$I... I did it...?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Student A)#$$!-1!$No way...
What kind of monster is she?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Student B)#$Now I feel like an idiot for ever thinking
I could win...
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaHurt&$$@Center@$(Ah...)
Requiem Shop
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSerious&$$@Center@$Hello? Excuse me. I'm Saya Saionji...

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Right@$Haha. You're a lot more easily shaken
than you look.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaClosedEyes&$$@Right@$I understand the feeling. We live such
brief and fleeting lives, after all.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Brief and fleeting...

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSerious&$$@Center@$You're right. It's honestly amazing how
calm everyone seems here.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Is it? Everyone's just enjoying the perks
of being a Vessel.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSerious&$$@Left@$What perks? The food? The cars? Those
aren't worth dying for.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$Oh, dying isn't so bad. Some girls here
do it all the time.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$Why not give it a try? I'm sure you could
find someone to help you out.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSurprised&$$@Left@$Huh...?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Right@$Coming back from the dead is certainly a
perk, wouldn't you agree?
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSerious&$$@Center@$...is anyone here?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Right@$It's not true death, of course, but the
adrenaline high is incomparable.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$I recommend it highly, if you ever have
the time.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordScared&$$@Center@$(W-what is she talking about?)

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Ah, but perhaps it isn't advisable in your
case. What with your temperament...
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$My temperament? What do you mean?
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$Your left leg's bothering you, isn't it?

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSurprised&$$@Left@$...I haven't even been favoring it.
How did you...

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$That medical degree on the wall's not
for decoration, you know.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Right@$We Vessels are capable of recovering
from even death, given time to rest.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaClosedEyes&$$@Right@$It's even theorized that the Requiem won't
start if any one of us is injured.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Center@$Do forgive me, I had to step out for a
moment. I'm Reina Fujiwara, the nurse.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSurprised&$$@Left@$Injured...?
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yes. We can't say for sure why.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Maybe the Goddess wants all 100 of us to
have a chance to kill.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Center@$The problem is, that means some
students have gotten hooked on death.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Center@$If they're always hurt, the Requiem
can never begin, or so they think.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(If the alternative is death, I can see how
that might be better...)
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Center@$I just hope you're not among them.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Center@$Now then, your results look fairly
decent overall.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Center@$Nothing I could find explains your leg
though, I'm afraid.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I see... could I have some medicine for the
pain, at least?

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSurprised&$$@Center@$(Huh? She doesn't look much older than
me either.)

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$Of course. As long as you can offer me
something in return.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSurprised&$$@Left@$In return...?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Have any information that might come
in handy during the Requiem?

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSurprised&$$@Left@$I only just arrived here yesterday.
What could I possibly know?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$Ah, of course. The name of your Gift will
be quite enough, then.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordShouting&$$@Left@$I don't know that either! I only learned I
was a Vessel yesterday!

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSurprised&$$@Right@$That's strange. Why would they admit
you without recording your Gift?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Right@$Do you have any recollection of using
superhuman abilities recently?
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSurprised&$$@Left@$Superhuman...

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuHurt&$$@Center@$(My chest feels hot. I feel like I'm on
fire, even down in the water!)

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Center@$I also work as a teacher, so I figured
we'd meet each other in due time.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSmile&$$@Center@$(I'm out! I can swim! I can make it!)
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSurprised&$$@Center@$(Was that my Gift...?)

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$I can guess, given your history. Junior
Ballet Champion 3 times running, hm?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Definitely a physical Gift. Flexibility,
perhaps, or Poise...

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Left@$But I never had any talent for ballet.
I worked hard to get where I am!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordIrritated&$$@Left@$It's not like I just breezed through because
I had a Gift...

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$Or so you think. We get a lot of girls
who feel that way, at first.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaClosedEyes&$$@Right@$No one likes to admit they're just
following the rails ahead of them.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordShouting&$$@Left@$...you're trying to rile me up so you can
get more information, aren't you?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$Trust me, I would if I could. But no, I'm
telling you the truth, Saionji.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Ah, i-it's my pleasure...

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordShouting&$$@Left@$Do you enjoy kicking people where it
hurts? Do you want to win that much?
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$Of course. I don't want to die.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You're awful. You, the other Vessels,
everyone who just accepts this...

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Center@$You're decent, Saionji. I like girls like
that, and I consider myself decent too.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Center@$But decency won't keep you alive. Not
in here, and not out there.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Center@$Lots of girls refuse the physical, so no
one else knows what their Gift is.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaClosedEyes&$$@Center@$But you never even considered that,
did you? That will be—
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Left@$How much?
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSurprised&$$@Right@$Hm?

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordShouting&$$@Left@$How much was my effort, and how much
was the Goddess's?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$You seem confused. I'm a Vessel too,
don't worry.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordShouting&$$@Left@$Was everything I've accomplished...
only because I'm a Vessel...?
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Right@$...haha.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordIrritated&$$@Left@$W-what's so funny?!

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaClosedEyes&$$@Right@$You get hung up on the most pointless
things, that's all.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Right@$Vessels aren't the only ones born with
Goddess-given talents, you know.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Right@$You've seen piano prodigies or math
geniuses on TV before, haven't you?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Right@$Does it matter if their skill is genetic,
a whim of the Goddess, or pure luck?

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaSerious&$$@Right@$You were born with talent. That's all there
is to it.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordIrritated&$$@Left@$(That's all there is to it? Can it really be
so simple?)

$#DONOTSHOWME(School PA)#$$!-1!$[All students. 3rd Period is about to
begin. Report to the practice field.]

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSerious&$$@Left@$Oh, um, it's not that. You just seem...
young.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$@Right@$Oh, off to the practice field with you,
I see.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSurprised&$$@Left@$Practice field? What are we practicing?
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What do you think?
$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Center@$Killing, of course.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaNoSwordSerious&$$@Left@$That, and I was wondering what subject
you teach...

friends. I'll even read comics...!)
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSurprised&$$@Center@$Huh? My leg...
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSurprised&$$@Center@$It doesn't hurt. It doesn't hurt at all...

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSmile&$$@Center@$No matter how far I run...
It doesn't hurt at all!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...sigh. This just isn't working.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiIrritated&$$@Center@$Stupid dumbass game! Your hitboxes
are stupid and so are you!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuShouting&$$@Center@$Hibiki!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Huh?
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSurprised&$$@Right@$Hey, what are you wearing...?
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuIrritated&$$@Left@$I'm going to protect you.

$#Reina(Reina)#$$&ReinaColdSmile&$$@Left@$Ballet? I didn't realize you had such
refined tastes in entertainment.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$@Right@$...what?

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSerious&$$@Left@$On the day of the Requiem...
I'll protect you.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuIrritated&$$@Left@$I want to stay with you. I want to spend
every second we can together,
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuIrritated&$$@Left@$until the very end.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiClosedEyes&$$@Right@$...pfft. What are you talking about?

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I thought about running away with you,
you know.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuClosedEyes&$$@Center@$But if we did that, I think I'd just hate
myself even more for it.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSad&$$@Center@$In the end... I can't bring myself to cheat.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmirk&$$@Center@$Because you're a straight-laced goody
two-shoes?

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSad&$$@Center@$I told you, I wanted to be a hero when
I was little, remember?
$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiSmile&$$@Right@$What, do you think I'm a barbarian?

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSad&$$@Center@$Being a Vessel, dying to save the world...
I hated the thought of it.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSerious&$$@Center@$But if I can protect you... the one who
gave me my life back...

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuShouting&$$@Center@$If I can do that, then I might be able
to love myself, and this Gift, after all.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSad&$$@Center@$Saya...
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...haha.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSurprised&$$@Center@$?
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Open your mouth.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuNormal&$$@Left@$Huh?
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmile&$$@Right@$There you go.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSurprised&$$@Left@$Mmf. What is this? ...maple?

$#Nanami(Nanami)#$$&NanamiClosedEyes&$$@Right@$I don't really care about it, honestly.
But... I want to see Saya dance.
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiWink&$$@Right@$Tastes like freedom, doesn't it?
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSadSmile&$$@Left@$A little bit, yeah.

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiWink&$$@Right@$And there's plenty more where that
came from. For you, and for me!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSmile&$$@Left@$...yeah!

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$First things first...
How about a rematch?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmirk&$$@Center@$If you're gonna protect me, then you'd
better be pretty damn strong!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSadSmile&$$@Center@$Haha. Alright, then. Would you teach
me?

$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Sure will. But first, we've gotta wrap
up that match from before!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSmile&$$@Left@$Bring it on!
$#Hibiki(Hibiki)#$$&HibikiSmirk&$$@Right@$Pfft.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuHurt&$$@Center@$Ow...!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...whatever. I'm going to bed.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuClosedEyes&$$@Center@$It sure is windy out, though. How am I
supposed to sleep with—
$#Hibiki;(Saya)#$$&HibikiSerious&$$@Center@$Waah!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuScared&$$@Center@$W-what the...?! I saw that oni girl
again...!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSad&$$@Center@$N-no, I'm just tired. I'm tired, and
my mind is playing tricks on me!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuClosedEyes&$$@Center@$That's it. It has to be. It has to be...

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSad&$$@Center@$(I couldn't sleep a wink. My leg still
hurts, and it's pouring rain... this sucks.)

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSad&$$@Center@$(What if that oni is there tonight?
I'll end up embarrassing myself again.)

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuIrritated&$$@Center@$(No! Don't think like that! Demons don't
exist!)
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuIrritated&$$@Center@$(Be positive. You have to be.)

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuHurt&$$@Center@$This really stings. Where are the cold
compresses...
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSerious&$$@Center@$...to the theater, please.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$Understood.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(At least I was able to snag a taxi...)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$There's some flooding ahead. Mind if we
take an alternate route?

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSerious&$$@Center@$Ah, sure. Whatever gets us there
the fastest, please.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$Pardon me for asking, but are you
dancing in the show today, miss?
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSurprised&$$@Center@$I am, why?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$My daughter's dancing too, you see.
Just a minor part, but she's thrilled.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$I get off shift soon, so I plan to go see her.
I'm looking forward to it.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSad&$$@Center@$...what a nice father you are.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Oh... of course we're out. Forget it.
I don't want to go buy more.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$Ah... are your parents not coming today?

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSad&$$@Center@$Forget today, they've barely ever come
to any of my shows.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSad&$$@Center@$I'm sure they couldn't care less about
ballet.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$Well... to be honest, I don't understand
the appeal myself.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSurprised&$$@Center@$But you love your daughter, right?
$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$Of course I do.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSad&$$@Center@$...I'm sorry. Please forget I said anything.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$If there's something you wanna get
off your chest, I'd be glad to listen.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...thank you.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$By the way, miss, what role are you
dancing?

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSurprised&$$@Center@$Ah! A voicemail from Mom! Maybe she's
on her way home?!
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSad&$$@Center@$I'm the lead.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$Wow, really?! That's amazing! My
daughter would love to meet you.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$All roles are important, sure, but the
stars are something else, she says.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSad&$$@Center@$...I worked hard for it. I've done
everything I can do.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSad&$$@Center@$But I always fail at the critical moment.
I let everyone down, myself included.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$I see. It sounds like being a star's not
always nice.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuIrritated&$$@Center@$Is it ever nice? I feel like I'm always
angry and afraid, no matter what I do.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...there's a girl in my class who tries to be
my friend. Despite how cold I am.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSad&$$@Center@$I want to be friends with her too, but
I'm so twisted up inside...

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSad&$$@Center@$...it's fine. I don't have the time or
energy for it anymore, anyway.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Saya's Mom)#$$!-1!$Sorry, Saya, I won't be able to make your
show. Dad and I will be—

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSerious&$$@Center@$She's the type to rescue a stray kitten.
I'm sure I'd just end up hurting her...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$Miss, if it makes you feel that bad,
then why do you keep dancing?
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSurprised&$$@Center@$Huh? I...
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuNormal&$$@Center@$...to have people look at me, I guess.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuNormal&$$@Center@$When I'm dancing, the audience is
watching... and I feel like it's okay.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuNormal&$$@Center@$Like it's okay that I'm here. Okay to
be myself. I think that's why I dance.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$So you've been suffering this whole time,
then? All for this performance?

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSadSmile&$$@Center@$...I suppose so. Hah. It's pretty silly,
isn't it?

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSad&$$@Center@$But ballet is the only thing I'm any good
at, so...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$Give it up.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSad&$$@Center@$...shut up.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSurprised&$$@Center@$Huh?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$Ballet. If it hurts that much, then just
go ahead and give it up.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuShouting&$$@Center@$D-don't say that! You don't know what
I've given up to get where I am!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuIrritated&$$@Center@$Not just friends, but movies, fashion,
tasty food... I've given it all up.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$There's a whole big world outside ballet,
you know. You oughta see it.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$Then you'll see. Ballet's just a little tiny
bit of the world, not all of it.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSurprised&$$@Center@$Just a bit...? But I'm going to be an étoile...
$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$It won't make you happy, you know.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$The more you build it up, the more you'll
be let down. You know that.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuShouting&$$@Center@$S-stop it! You don't know anything about
me!

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuIrritated&$$@Center@$You'd think they could make time for
my big break on the stage.

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuShouting&$$@Center@$It's been hard, but I'll get through it!
It'll all be worth it in the end!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$I see... you find it that hard to imagine
a world without ballet?

$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuIrritated&$$@Center@$I do! Of course I do! Without ballet, I...
I wouldn't be me...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$You're a stubborn one, aren't you?
Guess it's time for shock therapy.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSurprised&$$@Center@$Huh...?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$You're going to learn there's so much
much more to you than ballet.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuScared&$$@Center@$H-hey! We're in the wrong lane!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Taxi Driver)#$$!-1!$The time has come for you to take the
first steps into your new life.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuScared&$$@Center@$No, no, we're going to crash!

$#Cyrus(Taxi Driver)#$$&CyrusShouting&$$@Center@$Hold on tight, missy. Time for a little dip
in the river.
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSad&$$@Center@$Or at least be here when I'm hurt...
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuScared&$$@Center@$What?! Ah...aaah...
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuCry&$$@Center@$Nooooo...!
$#Cyrus(Taxi Driver?)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$...phew. That was certainly unpleasant.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusCheeky&$$@Center@$Can't say I enjoy tormenting young
ladies, but there's nothing for it.

$#Cyrus(Cyrus)#$$&CyrusSad&$$@Center@$This is nothing compared to what's
coming her way...
$#Saya(Saya)#$$&SayaTutuSad&$$@Center@$...or when I'm so lonely, I could cry...

keys.DescriptionKey:
The Goddess works in mysterious ways. Even with her lifelong apathy toward religion, Saya knows this to be true. Why else would they need the Requiem every hundred years? Not even the Church can explain just how the blood of ninety-nine innocent girls revives the world, but somehow it does, every century since the dawn of history. 

Truthfully, Saya only cared about the Requiem because some old composer chose to turn it into a ballet. Her teacher cast her as the Goddess's Grace, the lead, hoping to make her a star. 

In a way, she did. Soon after the performance, the whole world knew her name. But not for the reasons Saya had hoped.

keys.IntroText:
She traded silken shoes for steel.
Now, with blade in hand, she dances.

keys.DescriptionKey:
It happened so fast. Her car dove off the bridge and crashed into the water below, submerging her, drowning her. It should have been her end, a rising star snuffed out by tragedy. For better or for worse, it wasn't. 

Deep beneath the river, Saya escaped the wreckage and rose light as air, buoyed by the burning power inside her. Something would not allow her to die. Not yet. Not before she'd served her purpose. 

As she soon learned, the Vessels of the Goddess cannot die before the Requiem. The shard of divinity inside her, the Goddess's Grace she'd shown through her dance, had protected her from death. 

But at what cost?

keys.DescriptionKey: In a way, being a Vessel and being an etoile aren't so different. They both sacrifice their freedom for a greater purpose, though dancers do so at least a little by choice. As a ballerina, Saya shut herself away, too busy dancing to bother with a normal life. She convinced herself hard work meant misery. She accepted that a person could either choose greatness or happiness, never both. Now, as a Vessel, she can live how she chooses. She can make friends, and eat sweets, and study the katana, even if swordwork goes against her Gift. There's nothing to prove anymore, not with the Requiem coming. And even though that should scare her, Saya's never felt so free.

keys.DescriptionKey:
An ancient warhammer passed down for generations by a clan of seafaring raiders. Some say their first chieftain pulled it from the ocean depths. Some say it was forged as an offering to the great dragon Kaidaros, and that is why it possesses its power over the sea.

All know its strikes echo like thunder, and any captain who sees it knows his ship is doomed.

ShannaRidingHood02.description: Today, as usual, she brings her beloved axe Van Helsing with her on a walk into the forest— for the doom of the Gods, the dawn of Ragnarok, draws nigh, and she must train. On that day, the powers of her cursed left eye, her evil right arm, and the darkness billowing inside her will all be unleashed... or so she says, causing her adoptive mother no end of worry.

keys.DescriptionKey: There's a reason for her extreme fear of beasts. Her parents were kind and gentle folk who doted on their daughter in their little home in the woods. But one day, she came home to find them torn apart— with a wolfman, fangs dripping red, standing over their bodies. The image has never left her to this day.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Holmes is a private detective based in the fog-shrouded city of Londinium. At the mere mention of a case, she rushes straight to the scene, utterly unfazed by the grim looks given to her by the city guards.

She is a master detective who appears without warning, and unravels even the most baffling mysteries before the sun rises.

SherlockRegular01.title: Ubiquitous Master Detective
SherlockRegular01.description:
Holmes is a private detective based in the fog-shrouded city of Londinium. At the mere mention of a case, she rushes straight to the scene, utterly unfazed by the grim looks given to her by the city guards.

She is a master detective who appears without warning, and unravels even the most baffling mysteries before the sun rises.

keys.IntroText: Hehe... I smell a case afoot!

keys.DescriptionKey:
Believing that information is the key to solving any case, her room is buried beneath newspaper clippings, case files she has gathered on her own, and towering stacks of reference materials.
Although she claims to be a neat freak, her landlord begs to differ, having recently given her a stern warning. Despite being an individual with impressively thick skin, the complaint left her rather dejected for a while.

keys.DescriptionKey:
The chief of Londinium's city guard finds the detective utterly insufferable, as she would barge into crime scenes uninvited and steal the glory of solving them for herself.
Among his subordinates, however, her brilliant mind and beauty had captivated more than a few admirers, and eventually, some of them formed a fan club.

Unfortunately for anyone smitten by this detective, she herself is interested in nothing but mysteries.

keys.DescriptionKey: The Angelic Order of the Morning Light is known to be a quick and agile group of angels which dart in and do elite jobs unscathed.
