$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaSmile&$$@Center@$Admind, I brought back Finn and Toshizo
Hijikata, as ordered.
$#Admind(Admind)#$I ordered them to be eliminated.
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaLookaway&$$@Center@$Oh, really? Sorry, I must have missed that.
$#Admind(Admind)#$Then, destroy them here.

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaSigh&$$@Center@$Of course. Take that! Ah, cough cough...
Oh, no, the sickness...
$#Admind(Admind)#$NA88, perform the elimination instead.
$#Kaguya(Kaguya)#$$&KaguyaSwimSerious&$$@Center@$...I can't.
$#Admind(Admind)#$I repeat. Perform the elimination.

$#Kaguya(Kaguya)#$$&KaguyaSwimPainful&$$@Center@$I said no! I couldn't kill Finn even if the
world turned completely upside down!
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataClosedEyesSweat&$$@Center@$That's enough.
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaGrin&$$@Center@$It's because of the backup. Cough, cough...

$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataSerious&$$@Center@$You realized what is happening and still let
us back on the ship, didn't you, Admind?

$#Admind(Admind)#$Affirmative. It was deemed an opportunity
to eliminate the targets in the conrolled

$#Admind(Admind)#$environment of the vessel, hence the use
of the transporter being permitted.

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaSigh&$$@Center@$Aw, you should've told us from the start.
You're mean, you know?
$#Admind(Admind)#$This is your final chance.

$#Admind(Admind)#$The designated elimination area remains
intact. I urge you to complete the mission.
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaHappyGrin&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Sorry. We can't. Right, Kaguya?

$#Kaguya(Kaguya)#$$&KaguyaSwimSerious&$$@Right@$Right! We'll destroy you and put an end to
your plans here and now!

$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Agreed. Admind, we will purge you from
this world!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Yeah, if you still want to harm Erden,
you'll have to go through us!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$...!

$#Admind(Admind)#$$!-1!$Your thought process is illogical... Your
actions are completely irrational...

$#Admind(Admind)#$Why make a decision that is equivalent
to throwing your lives away?

$#Admind(Admind)#$Why choose to waste your time and energy
helping others instead of saving yourselves?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$It's simple, Admind. We protect those we
care about, no matter the cost.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$If you don't understand that, then you'll
never defeat us.

$#Admind(Admind)#$...
I am unable to comprehend that.

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaSigh&$$!-1!$$@Left@$We don't have time for this pointless chit-
chat. Our activity time is running out!

$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataSerious&$$@Right@$Yes. The central power core must be
somewhere around here.
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataSerious&$$@Right@$We need to destroy that and—

$#Admind(Admind)#$$!-1!$Do you really think I'll allow you
to proceed? Come out, ***.

$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataSmile&$$@Center@$Don't worry, Finn. She is no longer our
enemy.
$#FakeHimiko(Himiko?)#$$&HimikoPossessed&$$@Center@$...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What are you doing here, Himiko? Weren't
you supposed to stay in the village?

$#Kaguya(Kaguya)#$$&KaguyaSwimSerious&$$@Right@$It's likely a fake. It lacks the presence
of the real Lady Himiko.
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hmph, a mere imitation—
$#Kaguya(Kaguya)#$$&KaguyaSwimShouting&$$@Center@$Hijikata, no!
$#FakeHimiko(Fake Himiko)#$$&HimikoPossessed&$$@Center@$Himiko...Punch...
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataHurt&$$@Center@$Wha—Aaaagh!
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hijikata! Are you okay?
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataHurt&$$@Right@$Yes... More or less. It only grazed me.
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaSurprised&$$@Left@$You call that "only grazing"?

$#()#$—Returning to the past, before Finn and
his companions arrived in Eastland...
$#Hostage(Hostage)#$Aaah... H-Help!

$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataSerious&$$@Center@$I didn't realize there were civilians here.
That's my oversight.
$#CorneredOni(Cornered Oni)#$$&OniMaleMobSmile&$$@Center@$Heh... Hahahahaha!
$#CorneredOni(Cornered Oni)#$$&OniMaleMobSurprised&$$@Center@$...Huh?!

$#Okita(???)#$$&OkitaGrin&$$@Center@$Hijikataaa, you're rushing ahead on your
own again.
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataClosedEyes&$$@Center@$You're the one who can't keep up, Soji.

$#LastOni(Last Oni)#$$&OniMaleMobHurt&$$@Center@$"Soji"...? Soji Okita!? The captain of the
first unit!?
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaSmile&$$@Center@$Ugh... You're still here?
$#LastOni(Last Oni)#$$&OniMaleMobSurprised&$$@Center@$Gaaaah!

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaHappyGrin&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Nooo, my nail polish is peeling.. And I picked
such a pretty color today. Look, Hijikata.
$#Oni(Fleeing Oni)#$$&OniMaleMobSurprised&$$@Center@$Run, everyone!

$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataClosedEyes&$$@Right@$This is a battlefield, Soji. Your nails are
an inconvenience. Cut them.

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaComplaint&$$@Left@$Aw, Hijikata, you're such a buzzkill.
Fashion is everything.

$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Report the results of your investigation. I
assume your delay was due to its complexity.

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaShouting&$$@Center@$Are you kidding me? I was late because
I couldn't decide how to do my bangs today.
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaHappy&$$@Center@$The investigation was done in a flash.
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataSigh&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Then hurry up and report.

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaGrin&$$@Left@$Hmm, I don't knooow... You're not being
very nice to me...
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataClosedEyesSweat&$$@Right@$Soji, enough is enough.

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, fiiiine. It's just as you theorized, they're
guilty as hell.
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataSerious&$$@Center@$I see.
$#CorneredOni(Fleeing Oni)#$$&OniMaleMobSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$They're here!
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaHappyGrin&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So, do you have a plan for our next move?
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataSerious&$$@Right@$That goes without saying.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Land of Peace Resident A)#$Hey, why are the Shinsengumi here?

$#DONOTSHOWME(Land of Peace Resident B)#$Do you think they got word about the oni
we have here? We should run!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Land of Peace Resident C)#$No, wait, if we make a move now, we won't
have an excuse later.
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaLookaway&$$@Center@$Hm? What excuse are we talking about?
$#LandofPeaceResidentA(Land of Peace Resident A)#$$&KImonoMaleMobSurprised&$$@Center@$C-Captain Okita!?
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataSerious&$$@Center@$I'm here as well.
$#LandofPeaceResidentB(Land of Peace Resident B)#$$&KImonoMaleMobSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$M-My noble ladies of the Shinsengumi!

$#LandofPeaceResidentB(Land of Peace Resident B)#$$&KImonoMaleMobSmile&$$@Left@$Uh, thanks to you, we were able to round
up the oni.

$#LastOni(Fleeing Oni)#$$&OniMaleMobHurt&$$@Right@$It's the Shinsengumi!
Run!!!
$#LandofPeaceResidentC(Land of Peace Resident C)#$$&KImonoMaleMobSmile&$$@Right@$Y-Yes, and with minimal casualties!
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$This is a crackdown.
$#LandofPeaceResidentA(Land of Peace Resident A)#$$&KImonoMaleMobSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Wh-What? What are you talking about?
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaClosedEyesSmike&$$@Left@$You seem very rattled, buddy.

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaGrin&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Your breathing and pulse are quickened,
and look, you just swallowed heavily.
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataSerious&$$@Center@$What a pity.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Land of Peace Resident A)#$$&KImonoMaleMobSurprised&$$!-1!$Gah...!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Land of Peace Resident B)#$$&KImonoMaleMobSurprised&$Aaaaaagh!
$#LandofPeaceResidentC(Land of Peace Resident C)#$$&KImonoMaleMobSurprised&$$@Center@$Eeeek!

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaSmile&$$@Center@$The jig is up. You guys were inviting the oni
into your town, weren't you?

$#Hijikata(???)#$$&HijikataSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Foolish oni. Did you really think you could
escape?

$#LandofPeaceResidentC(Land of Peace Resident C)#$$&KImonoMaleMobSurprised&$$@Center@$We... Uh... Well... We're sorry! There was
nothing we could do!

$#LandofPeaceResidentC(Land of Peace Resident C)#$$&KImonoMaleMobSurprised&$$@Center@$They were going to kill our wives and
children...
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataSeriousSweat&$$@Center@$Families taken hostage, hm...
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaSigh&$$@Center@$Not good enough.
$#LandofPeaceResidentC(Land of Peace Resident C)#$$&KImonoMaleMobSurprised&$G-Gah...! Aaaah...

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaSigh&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Did they really think such an obvious lie
would win them our mercy?
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataClosedEyesSweat&$$@Right@$Evidently.
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ah!!!
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What is it?
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaComical&$$@Left@$Blood! On my favorite clothes! Ugh!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Fleeing Oni)#$$&OniMaleMobHurt&$Gah... Aaaah!

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaComical&$$@Left@$I managed to keep them spotless while
fighting the oni, and now look!
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataSigh&$$@Right@$That's what you're so upset about? Really?
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaComical&$$@Left@$What do you mean, "Really"!?

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaComical&$$@Left@$You know how hard it is to get blood stains
out of clothes! Aaaaargh!
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaComical&$$@Left@$This is bad... My spark has been dimmed...
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataSadSmile&$$@Right@$Hmph...
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaShouting&$$@Left@$Did you just snort!? I heard that!

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaHappyGrin&$$@Left@$Anyway, how about the outfit I picked out
for you? Isn't it cool?
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataSerious&$$@Right@$Its functionality is outstanding.
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaComplaint&$$@Left@$That's not what I mean! Gosh! Do you have any fashion sense at all?
$#Hijikata(???)#$$&HijikataSerious&$$@Center@$...
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataConfuse&$$@Right@$What do you mean?

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaComplaint&$$@Left@$Hmph, nevermind, we can talk about it
later...
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Now, on to more important matters.

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaSerious&$$@Center@$You didn't bring more soldiers here because
you wanted to avoid casualties, right?

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaSerious&$$@Center@$I mean, just now, you decided to lower your
sword and listen to that man.
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaSerious&$$@Center@$Did the Bureau of Onmyo give you this
task?

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaSerious&$$@Center@$They know how much you dislike
assassination missions.
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataSerious&$$@Center@$...They were not involved.
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaSigh&$$@Center@$Like hell they weren't.
$#CorneredOni(Cornered Oni)#$$&OniMaleMobSurprised&$$@Center@$Damn, that's Toshizo Hijikata...

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaComplaint&$$@Center@$I bet they threatened to disband
Shinsengumi if you hadn't obeyed.
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaComplaint&$$@Center@$You're always letting them push you around.
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataClosedEyes&$$@Center@$I am simply being faithful to our motto.

$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Protecting Shinsengumi's place in this
world—that is my truth.

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaSigh&$$@Center@$Oh, okay, then maybe don't make such
a pained face when you say it.

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaSigh&$$@Center@$Because right now, looking at you makes
me...wanna choke...
$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaHurt&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$...Cough, cough!
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataShouting&$$@Center@$S-Soji?

$#Okita(Okita)#$$&OkitaHurt&$$@Center@$Y-You wanna know...what my truth is?
Cough, cough, cough!
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataShouting&$$@Center@$Is that blood...!?

$#CorneredOni(Cornered Oni)#$$&OniMaleMobSurprised&$$@Center@$H-Hey, Shinsengumi! Drop your weapons, or
I'll tear this woman to pieces and eat her!
$#Hijikata(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataShouting&$$@Center@$I'm taking you back to headquarters!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Hijikata)#$$&HijikataShouting&$$@Center@$Stay with me, Soji!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Okita)#$$@Center@$Cough, cough, cough, cough...

$#()#$—Barely holding onto life, Soji Okita
received care from a dedicated doctor,
$#()#$but her disease still progressed rapidly.

$#()#$At the same time, the conflict between oni
and humans took a severe turn.
$#()#$And then, the end had come.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Tonight, as the moon brushes stray clouds away, its light falls on the beautiful cherry blossoms that mark the end of winter—ah, no, no. It falls on a bewitching oni monarch, whose arrival marks the end of the human world. Those who dare take but one look at her can smell a flowery scent in the air, can hear laughter ringing out like a bell.
In the end, they get to know why at times cherries bloom in red.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Touch repaid with destruction, smile—with fear, trust—with betrayal. There are only those who have power and those who don't. Those with horns and those without them. And in both cases, a world in which the latter outnumber the former was one too weak for the Oni Queen's liking, too small. She isn't kind about it—she'll be out tonight as well, destroying, devouring, amusing herself, as the mysterious Shuten-Douji should.
Makes you wonder what came first—the stones being thrown at the mere sight of horns, or the oni girl wishing for freedom.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Always seeking pleasure in any shape or form, she indulges each and every one of her whims—and drinks to excess wherever she goes. She's free, unfettered, and so she doesn't need to bother telling dreams and reality apart. It's only natural that they call her Shuten, a drunkard. Who knows if she herself remembers her actual name.
Have a drink with her, and the next thing to quench her thirst might be your blood.

keys.DescriptionKey: Siegfried, once hailed as the legendary dragonslayer. After a fierce battle with the calamitous dark dragon known as the "Winged Demon," she succeeded in sealing it away. However, the wounds she sustained in that battle ultimately forced her to retire from life as a swordswoman.

SiegfriedRegular01.name: Siegfried
SiegfriedRegular01.title: Dragonslayer of Legends
SiegfriedRegular01.description: Siegfried, once hailed as the legendary dragonslayer. After a fierce battle with the calamitous dark dragon known as the "Winged Demon," she succeeded in sealing it away. However, the wounds she sustained in that battle ultimately forced her to retire from life as a swordswoman.

keys.IntroText:
I've already retired you know...
Well, guess it can't be helped.

keys.DescriptionKey: After retiring, Siegfried settled down in a quiet countryside with the dark dragon, now in the form of a young girl. Having earned a fortune from defeating the dragon, she had no intention of ever working again. Instead, she spends her days drinking, fishing and gambling while looking after the spoiled little dragon.

keys.DescriptionKey: Before long, Siegfried had come to feel a motherly affection toward Bahamut. Her decision to live in seclusion was a way to keep the girl away from people and war. Once she becomes certain there is no longer any threat of Bahamut running wild, she plans to remove the collar and set her free.

$#DONTSHOWME(Mountain Villager)#$$|act6.Voices/sst411|$Life isn't easy so high in the mountains, but
my family has lived here for generations.

$#DONTSHOWME(Mountain Villager)#$$|act6.Voices/sst412|$We are grateful that the Red Dragon Knights
have not forgotten about us.

$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act6.Voices/sst413|$Hello there, vee! I was just admiring the
view.
$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act6.Voices/sst414|$Have you heard the tale of the Silverdrake?

$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act6.Voices/sst415|$Many years ago this region was as flat as
the Rigland Central Plains.

$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act6.Voices/sst416|$Until an enourmous but lazy dragon landed
here and fell into a deep sleep, vee!

$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act6.Voices/sst417|$It was so huge that snow began to fall over it.
That's how the Silverdrake Mountains formed!

$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act6.Voices/sst418|$That dragon is still sleeping under these
mountains to this day.

$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act6.Voices/sst419|$Hm? That's not the story you've heard? Well
there are many stories in this world, vee!
$#DONTSHOWME(Quilvy)#$$|act6.Voices/sst420|$Isn't my story more exciting?

keys.DescriptionKey:
Though most people value harmony over strife, Imran was always the opposite. Even as a child, he was always caught up in some kind of fight. As soon as he was old enough to participate in wars against neighboring clans, it was clear that Imran was to become the greatest warrior of the Dust Steppes.

However, he soon tired of defeating fellow humans, so he turned to hunting down vicious monsters for a greater challenge. One day, he tracked down the whereabouts of a legendary dragon, but even he was no match against it. However, the dragon found a kindred spirit in the ever battle hungry Imran, and they agreed to have a rematch some day.

SilverHairBerserker01.name: Imran
SilverHairBerserker01.title: The Walking Storm
SilverHairBerserker01.description:
Though most people value harmony over strife, Imran was always the opposite. Even as a child, he was always caught up in some kind of fight. As soon as he was old enough to participate in wars against neighboring clans, it was clear that Imran was to become the greatest warrior of the Dust Steppes.

However, he soon tired of defeating fellow humans, so he turned to hunting down vicious monsters for a greater challenge. One day, he tracked down the whereabouts of a legendary dragon, but even he was no match against it. However, the dragon found a kindred spirit in the ever battle hungry Imran, and they agreed to have a rematch some day.

keys.IntroText:
"Like the gale, I rage. Like thunder, I roar.
Brace yourself. I am here!"

keys.DescriptionKey:
As a sign of this promise, the dragon granted Imran small portion of its power. As a result of this boon, Imran's body now constantly crackles with electricity. Any warrior lucky enough to land a blow against him will find themselves electrocuted.

Combined with his combat prowess, Imran had now become nigh unstoppable on the battlefield. Yet he knows that he must become even stronger, in preparation for when he would meet the dragon again. For this time, the battle will undoubtedly end with one of them dying.

With a greater zeal than ever before, Imran rushes forward into conflict, striving to ready himself as much as possible before the fateful day.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Though he would never admit it, thinking about the rematch with the dragon fills Imran with an unfamiliar emotion: fear. But it is not the fear of his own death, for he has become quite numb to that long ago. What he really fears is that he may have to kill the one being which seems to understand him.

However, to accept this would be admitting weakness, which the dragon surely would not approve of. And thus, he continues to prepare to slay the only creature that he could call a friend.

$#DONTSHOWME(Villager)#$$|act6.Voices/sst422|$Are you the Pandemonium Task Force we
have been hearing about?
$#DONTSHOWME(Villager)#$$|act6.Voices/sst423|$Thank you for coming to our aid!

$#DONTSHOWME(Villager)#$$|act6.Voices/sst425|$We don't have much, but we will do anything
we can to assist you!

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act6.Voices/sst424|$It's freezing up here... I wish I had brought
thicker socks.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$|act6.Voices/mst3594|$Alright, get in position! We shall engage the
enemies as they come!
$#AeonKnight(Aeon Knight)#$$&AeonKnight&$$@Center@$$%0.5%$$|act6.Voices/mst3603|$GrRrrOOOAarGH!!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3604|$There are more!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3605|$But I think I see the last of them!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3606|$Brother! Let us take out these stragglers in
one swoop!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3607|$You got it!
$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Pack)#$$|act6.Voices/mst3608|$GROOOAAARGH...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3609|$They're retreating...?
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3610|$Did they give up?
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3611|$I'm not so sure about that...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3612|$None of them were Lords. That was
probably just the first wave.
$#DONTSHOWME(Monster Pack)#$$|act6.Voices/mst3595|$GROOOAAAAARGH!!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3613|$That was just the first wave? But there
were so many!
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganDetermined&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3614|$They were testing us.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3615|$The smell when the Aeon Knights were
defeated... I've smelt it before.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3616|$It was the same when we defeated the
xahe'oyai.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3617|$The smell of Aeon Thorns!?
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaTroubled&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3618|$Those things Norza used on us...?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3619|$So the one commanding this army is most
likely...
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganDetermined&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3620|$Norza.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3621|$Knights, fall back to Silverlodge. Let's
discuss our next move with the others.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3596|$There they are... There's so many!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3623|$(Norza... The one behind all the pain
caused by the xahe'oyai!)
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3624|$The Silverdrake Valley?

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3625|$It's a large valley near the village.
That's where that army came from.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3626|$So that's where their base must be...

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3627|$About that... The valley goes right to the
foot of that tower we reported.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3628|$So those monsters come directly from the
tower!

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3629|$Most likely. The valley has never been
known to house such vicious monsters.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3630|$So in a matter of days it has become a
nest of powerful hostiles...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3631|$Is there any other way to get to the tower?

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3632|$Yes, a detour through the mountains. It is
several times longer and very treacherous.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3597|$Attack! Don't let them into the village!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3633|$That doesn't sound promising. And we
can't just ignore the monsters in valley.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3634|$There has not been any more movement
from there. Are they trying to lure us in?

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganSad&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3635|$They're waiting. They have the advantage
while we have the village at our backs.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3636|$It seems we have little choice but to leap
into the dragon's mouth.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3637|$Yes. Even if it's a trap...

$#RedKnight(Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3638|$You can rest assured that our unit will
protect the village!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3639|$Thank you!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3640|$Knights, we will use Silverlodge as our
base as we proceed through the valley!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3641|$This will be a prelude to our siege of the
tower, and a beachhead in our campaign!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3598|$Finn, look! That demon at the front!
$#AeonKnight(Aeon Knight)#$$&AeonKnight&$$@Center@$$%0.5%$$|act6.Voices/mst3599|$ROOAAAAARGH!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3600|$An Aeon Knight... It must be leading all
these monsters!

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganDetermined&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3601|$Something about this Aeon Knight feels
familiar...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3602|$I... I can smell Ossia's medicine...? No,
this must be...!

$#DONTSHOWME(Villager)#$$|act6.Voices/sst426|$Air Sentinels have been spotted 'round here
lately.

$#DONTSHOWME(Villager)#$$|act6.Voices/sst427|$I heard it was elven magic that made them
into monsters.

$#DONTSHOWME(Villager)#$$|act6.Voices/sst428|$There's no elves in these parts, so them
being here must be a Pandemonium thing.

$#DONTSHOWME(Villager)#$$|act6.Voices/sst429|$They're pretty tough so they're frightening
the locals.

$#DONTSHOWME(Villager)#$$|act6.Voices/sst430|$They'd probably be a good ally in a fight if
you can catch one though. How 'bout it?
$#DONTSHOWME(Villager)#$$|act6.Voices/sst431|$Ha, you really caught an Air Sentinel!

$#DONTSHOWME(Villager)#$$|act6.Voices/sst432|$Here, take these. I appreciate you making
the area a little safer for us.

$#DONTSHOWME(Villager)#$$|act6.Voices/sst433|$Is than an Air Sentinel? We've been too
afraid to try catching them.

$#DONTSHOWME(Villager)#$$|act6.Voices/sst434|$I'll sleep better knowing that one is helping
you instead of attacking passersby.

$#DONTSHOWME(Villager)#$$|act6.Voices/sst435|$Here, take these as a thank you for making
our village safer.
$#DONTSHOWME(Villager)#$$|act6.Voices/sst436|$How's that Air Sentinel going?

$#DONTSHOWME(Knight)#$$|act6.Voices/sst437|$You arrived just in time... I don't think we
could have held out much longer alone.

keys.DescriptionKey:
300% damage to 1 enemy, plus 100% for each charge stored by the user (max of 600% total damage). This attack does not consume charges. This attack ignores any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated. That enemy will also be granted the Burn status effect, and become infected with it.

After the end of each turn, this infection will trigger to apply Burn to a random non-burning unit on the infected unit's team. Infection ends after 3 triggers (even if they find no valid target) or once the infected enemy is defeated or leaves the battlefield. Infection is not a status effect and cannot be prevented or purified, but the status effect spread by the infection may be. A unit cannot get a new infection until their existing one ends.

Burn will overwrite other status effects. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with burn will also become burned.
keys.SelectedKey: 300%+ damage, grants Burn & Infection

Cursed Sleep will overwrite status effects other than Burn, cannot be overwritten by Poison, can be applied repeatedly to units that have already slept while on the battlefield, and will not end from damage caused by Dream Hunter type active skills.

Burn or attacks that grant Burn will remove Sleep Thorns and prevent Cursed Sleep from applying. Cursed Sleep will overwrite status effects other than Burn, cannot be overwritten by Poison, can be applied repeatedly to units that have already slept while on the battlefield, and will not end from damage caused by Dream Hunter type active skills.

keys.value: $#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act5.Voices/mst2634|$This looks like a good spot for a break.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2643|$She said she was going to take a nap...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2644|$I've heard that Captain Ludmilla can sleep
standing up.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2645|$What?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2646|$Is she really asleep right now?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2647|$It's a core training regimen she developed
herself.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2648|$She's training in her sleep!?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2649|$Is something wrong!?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2650|$Wah!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2651|$N-No, everything's fine!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2652|$Good.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2635|$(yawn) This forest is so warm and nice, it
makes me sleepy.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2653|$zzz...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled;Rizette.RizetteSurprise;&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Rizette.Right;@$$|act5.Voices/mst2654|$(whisper) Is she really asleep? It looks like
she's just standing there.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2655|$She values training so much she even
figured out a way to do it in her sleep...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2656|$That's amazing. I want to get stronger, but
I don't think I could sleep like that.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2657|$Nghh...You wish to court me?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2658|$First you must best me in combat...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2659|$zzz...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2660|$Is she talking in her sleep?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2661|$I wonder what she's dreaming about.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2662|$(mumble) You all need to train more...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2636|$There doesn't seem to be any immediate
danger here. We should take turns to rest.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2663|$zzz...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act5.Voices/mst2637|$Good idea. It has been a while since I have
had a good workout.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act5.Voices/mst2638|$?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2639|$I am going to take a nap. Wake me if we are
attacked. Use any method necessary.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2640|$Goodnight.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSleep&$$@Center@$$|act5.Voices/mst2641|$...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise;Finn.FinnSurprise;&$$!-1!$$@Right;;;Finn.Left;@$$|act5.Voices/mst2642|$What is she doing? She's just standing
there with her eyes closed....

keys.DescriptionKey:
Allies gain 1 Spirit for each ally on the battlefield. This skill unlocks Disabling Music upon use.

Then if ally Spirit is:
- 1+, all allies on the battlefield are Purified (negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed) at the end of the turn.

- 5+, another random ally is given the next turn by reducing their current TU to 0 at the end of the turn. Active skills that grant turns cannot be used by any affected units until after they have had the turn.
- 10, adds 500% to the damage % of this user's next attack (e.g. Disabling Music: 300% => 800%).

This skill is locked until it becomes unlocked by Vocal Warmup. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.

keys.value: $#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise;Rizette.RizetteSurprise;&$$@Left;;;Rizette.Right;@$$|act3.Voices/mst1664|$Rizette? What's wrong?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1672|$That is a worrying thought, but we must
keep moving. Prepare yourselves.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1673|$We must nearly be at the center of the ruins
by now. Let's do this!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1665|$There's a smell that's been bothering me
since we entered these ruins.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1666|$It smells like Ossia's poison.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1667|$!?

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1668|$That's the Aeon Lord you knights
supposedly defeated.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$I found it hard to believe, but does this
mean she has something to do with this!?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1669|$No, Ossia was certainly defeated. But
perhaps she made these thorns.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act3.Voices/mst1670|$Maybe I'm imagining the smell, but I can't
shake this awful feeling...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act3.Voices/mst1671|$You think an Aeon Lord is behind all this?

keys.DescriptionKey: She has always been alone. Born in a snowy kingdom, she was kept imprisoned in a single room of a castle by her stepmother. Even when she was abandoned in the woods as a child and adopted by her new mother, she was unable to go outside. The outside world, framed by her window, has always been faded in shades of black and white.

SnowWhite01.description: She has always been alone. Born in a snowy kingdom, she was kept imprisoned in a single room of a castle by her stepmother. Even when she was abandoned in the woods as a child and adopted by her new mother, she was unable to go outside. The outside world, framed by her window, has always been faded in shades of black and white.

keys.IntroText:
Welcome home.
Wait a moment— dinner's almost ready.

keys.DescriptionKey: She was kinder and more pure than anyone. No one would doubt that. Yet within her, a pitch-black evil ate away at the snowy white of her heart. When it finally reached the tipping point...

SnowWhite02.name: Snow White

SnowWhite02.description: She was kinder and more pure than anyone. No one would doubt that. Yet within her, a pitch-black evil ate away at the snowy white of her heart. When it finally reached the tipping point...

keys.DescriptionKey: A being created from malice and ill will. In a sense, her purity of self has been retained— she now exists solely to destroy, to crush, to devour. The pure, almost childlike whims of her power will lead the world, all worlds, to ruin.

SnowWhite03.name: Snow White
SnowWhite03.title: Queen of Dreams
SnowWhite03.description: A being created from malice and ill will. In a sense, her purity of self has been retained— she now exists solely to destroy, to crush, to devour. The pure, almost childlike whims of her power will lead the world, all worlds, to ruin.

keys.DescriptionKey:
If she had met the seven dwarfs, if she had eaten the poisoned apple, if she had fallen into eternal sleep, she might have ended up being "her".
Instead, she met an awkward mother and a fantasy prone little sister, she shared warm, hearty meals with them—and yet, a tragedy still struck, although the one who never woke up wasn't her, but someone she held dear. The one who helped her was a true prince, as strong as he was kind—that still happened, too.
A little bit different, a little bit the same; Snow White and "Snow White"—
Unlike the fairy tale, Snow's story is going to continue past "they lived happily ever after."

keys.DescriptionKey:
Snow Black despised the Prince who saved Snow White from her dark influence. She watched them act all lovey-dovey, even though she was right there, inside—and her patience was running out. So, she put her plan into motion: she separated the pair, and by keeping the Prince to herself, she stripped Snow White of all hope. But that was only the surface. Deep inside, Snow Black also had feelings for—
"As if! I just wanted to take away everything Snow White ever loved!" she claims, but even in her anger, her face seems even more fickle than before.

"As if! I just wanted to take away everything Snow White ever loved!" she claims, but even in her anger, her face seems even more fickle than before.

keys.DescriptionKey:
As Snow Black has changed, so has her relationship with Snow White.
There are still things they won't compromise on, things they won't forgive each other. However, Snow White has learned to smile at the way Snow Black has changed under Finn's influence, to see her as a sister who just cannot be honest about her feelings; meanwhile, Snow Black started to remark on the lack of progress in Snow White's relationship with Finn, like one would when annoyed at a sibling's awkwardness.
They still fail to meet halfway most of the time, but it might not take that long for their icy bond to thaw.

keys.value: $#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Stop the wedding!

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierEvilSmile&$$@Center@$Wh-What about your sister? You reap what
you sow, Finn. Are you ready for that?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$I know you can't hurt her. Not in this
world.
$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierImpatience&$$@Center@$What are you talking about...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$I mean it's time for you to pay! Give
yourself up!

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierImpatience&$$@Center@$Grr, how dare you! Did you really think
I'd just hand the princess over?

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierShouting&$$@Center@$Witch! Release the poison! Send every
last one of them to sleep!!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Wait, does he mean this cleric!?)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Snow! Get away from the cleric!
$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteBrideNormal&$$@Center@$"Snow?"
$#Cleric("Cleric")#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Center@$Goodnight, sweet Princess...
$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteBrideSurprised&$$@Center@$Sir Knight...!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Oh no you don't!
$#Cleric("Cleric")#$$&PhilomeneHurt&$$@Center@$Ngh...

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierImpatience&$$@Center@$What are you doing, you useless fool!
I've had enough of you!

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierImpatience&$$@Center@$My knights! This is an order! Capture the
traitor!

$#CamelotSoldierNoCapeA;CamelotSoldierNoCapeB;CamelotSoldierNoCapeC()#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape;CamelotSoldierNoCapeB.CamelotSoldierNoCape;CamelotSoldierNoCapeC.CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;CamelotSoldierNoCapeB.Center;CamelotSoldierNoCapeC.Right;@$——
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Now we see his true colors...!)
$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteBrideAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Sir Knight... We're surrounded...!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Your Highness, do you know who I am? Am
I still one of this world's knights to you?

$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteBrideSurprised&$$@Right@$Well, yes! You are Sir Knight and you are
very special to me!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Then as the "Finn" of this world, as the
legitimate heir to the Red Kingdom—

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierImpatience&$$@Center@$Wh-What is happening!? How can you be
awake without the antidote—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$I shall protect you, because you are special
to me, too! Even if it means risking my life!
$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteBrideEmbarrassed&$$@Center@$I...am special to to you...

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierEvilSmile&$$@Center@$I'll snatch her away from you again, Finn!
Right out of the palm of your hand!

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierEvilSmile&$$@Center@$Knights!
Kill that man, now!

$#CamelotSoldierNoCapeA;CamelotSoldierNoCapeB;CamelotSoldierNoCapeC("Prince's Guard")#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape;CamelotSoldierNoCapeB.CamelotSoldierNoCape;CamelotSoldierNoCapeC.CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;CamelotSoldierNoCapeB.Center;CamelotSoldierNoCapeC.Right;@$...
$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What are you waiting for!?
$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierShouting&$$@Center@$That was an order!

$#CamelotSoldierNoCapeA("Prince's Guard A")#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$!-1!$$@Left@$We are knights. Following our lord's orders
is our supreme duty.

$#CamelotSoldierNoCapeB("Prince's Guard B")#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Right@$But we are not pawns with no minds of our
own!

$#CamelotSoldierNoCapeC("Prince's Guard C")#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Center@$This man has laid his life on the line for
the kingdom time and time again, my lord.
$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteBrideAngry&$$@Center@$Antidote...? What antidote!?

$#CamelotSoldierNoCapeC("Prince's Guard C")#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Center@$Please explain the transgressions he has
made that would warrant his death!
$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierImpatience&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Y-You dare question your master!?

$#CamelotSoldierNoCapeA("Prince's Guard A")#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Center@$If you cannot provide a sufficient answer,
then we shall abide by the chivalry code.

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierImpatience&$$@Center@$Why you...! How dare you raise your
swords against me!
$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Witch! Do something already!
$#Cleric("Cleric")#$$&PhilomeneClosedEyes&$$@Left@$Such a pitiful man...
$#Cleric("Cleric")#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Mirror mirror—

$#Cleric("Cleric")#$$&PhilomeneSerious&$$@Center@$Clear the path ahead of us so that we may
escape.
$#MonsterA;MonsterB;MonsterC("Monsters from the Mirror")#$$&GenericMonster;MonsterB.GenericMonster;MonsterC.GenericMonster&$$@Left;;;MonsterB.Center;MonsterC.Right;@$GWOOOOOOAR!!!
$#CamelotSoldierNoCapeA("Prince's Guard A")#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$!-1!$$@Left@$There are monsters coming out of that mirror...!
$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierImpatience&$$@Center@$Oh...uh...

$#CamelotSoldierNoCapeB("Prince's Guard B")#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Right@$Maintain formation! Stand firm, knights,
and raise your weapons!

$#CamelotSoldierNoCapeC("Prince's Guard C")#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Center@$Leave the monsters to us, you go after
that villain!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Thank you!

$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteBrideAngry&$$@Right@$Sir Knight! I can fight too! I'm tough,
and I want to—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Of course! I know you're brave, kind, and
caring, regardless of the place or situation.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Let's go, we need to save this world!
$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteBrideAngry&$$@Center@$Let's go!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Well, you see, this sleeping sickness is no
natural occurrence.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$The Prince poisoned everyone affected. Or
should I say, the IMPOSTER poisoned them!

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierImpatience&$$@Center@$...!? How dare you speak to your lord like
that!

$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yes, how could I ever forget.
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackNormal&$$@Center@$So, what happened to that "Snow White"?

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$—And that's pretty much it. I think she's
with the Prince now.

$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackSurprised&$$@Right@$So he stole your achievement and you came
back home all defeated, huh?
$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$There's no achievement to steal.

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Besides, the Prince is infatuated with her.
I can't be making him feel jealous.

$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Why are you always sticking up for that
guy?

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$I am bound by my oath as a knight. And
besides, we need the money.

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Looks like they've rolled around quite a
bit. All right, let's start picking.
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$So that I can get better?

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Center@$Well, yeah. You're my sister. You mean a
lot to me, and I want you to be well.
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackClosedEyes&$$@Center@$I...mean a lot to you...

$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackSerious&$$@Center@$But you're the real Prince of the Red
Kingdom.

$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackSerious&$$@Center@$I hate that Black Kingdom. If they never
invaded us, Mom and Dad wouldn't be
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackSerious&$$@Center@$under house arrest and you'd be our prince.

$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackAngry&$$@Center@$And that stupid guy who was only third in
line to the Black Kingdom's throne
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackAngry&$$@Center@$would never have come to power.

$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackAngry&$$@Center@$Don't you resent that? Don't you want to
get back at them?

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Center@$It's not like Mom and Dad are in prison.
And besides, I just want to protect you.
$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$And that's the last one.

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Now, you should go back to bed. We don't
want you catching a fever.

$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Hah, you're just selfless to a fault, aren't
you? Fine, I'll let you dote on me for now.
$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, I'll be doting on you forever.
$#SnowBlack(Snow Black)#$$&SnowBlackGrin&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hehe, I'll hold you to that♪

$#SnowWhite(???)#$$&SnowWhiteHappy&$$@Left@$Thank you so much! You really helped me
out there.

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Not at all, it wasn't a big deal. What's your
name, by the way?
$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteOpenSmile&$$@Left@$Oh, my apologies. My name is Snow White.

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$(Snow...White!?
Isn't that the Princess?)

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Begging your pardon, Your Highness! It
never even crossed my mind...

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$A party in the White Kingdom today.
Hmm... Better brace myself.

$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteTroubled&$$@Left@$Ehehe, it's okay. It's not like you often see
princesses on the floor collecting berries.

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That is no excuse. But anyway, you're not
hurt, are you?
$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteNormal&$$@Center@$Huh?

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$I thought maybe you'd fallen over, seeing
as the berries had rolled so far.
$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteSurprised&$$@Center@$No, my mother—I mean, I'm okay!

$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Ehehe, I'm fine, really! It's kind of you
to be so worried about me.

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$(Her "mother"... Not the dearly departed
Queen of the White Kingdom,

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$but the woman the King took as his
second wife.)

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$(Surely she didn't do anything to make the
Princess drop the berries, right?)

$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteOpenSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, I need to feed them before the party
starts!

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$No! Knock it off, Finn! A royal knight
must fulfil his duties without complaint.

$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteHappy&$$@Center@$Good luck with your duties, Sir Knight of
the Red Kingdom!

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$("Sir Knight"... Why do those words
make me feel so...uneasy?)
$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Center@$Take care, Your Highness.
$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierSerious&$$@Left@$There she is... Snow White.
$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierClosedEyes&$$@Left@$She is so beautiful—

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierClosedEyes&$$@Left@$To be walking around after all she's been
through... Truly breathtaking.
$#()#$And so we return—

$#()#$To the forest where "Snow White"
sleeps eternally—
$#"First of the Seven Bikki"("First of the Seven Bikki")#$—Your Highness! Your Highness...!
$#"Second of the Seven Bikki"("Second of the Seven Bikki")#$—Please wake up!

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Just think, if anything should happen to
the Prince—
$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Huh?
$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What is it, Finn?

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$I thought I heard someone crying deep
inside the forest.

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Look! Someone's lying on the ground
over there!
$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierSurprised&$$@Center@$What? Good heavens, we must help them!

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Your Highness, you should stay here.
I cannot let anything happen to you.

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierSerious&$$@Right@$A true prince must always be ready to
save a life. I am coming with you.
$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$All right. In that case, I'll lead the way.
$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Is that...Princess Snow White!?

$#OtoA("Third of the Seven Bikki")#$$&OtoShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Please, good sirs, you must help our dear
princess. She has not woken up in days!
$#???(???)#$Um, can someone help me?
$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$What...!?
$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$She truly is a beauty...

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Your Highness, now's not the time!
We must act fast!

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yes, I know.
I'll just wake her with my power!
$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(He has a power like that?)

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(He's putting his hand over her face... Did
he just give her something to drink?)
$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteClosedEyes&$$@Center@$...

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierImpatience&$$@Right@$What...? What's going on, why isn't she
waking up...?

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(She must be in a really deep sleep. At
this rate she might never wake up—)
$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Your Highness! You can't die here!
$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$A voice?

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$The world still needs your pure and kind
heart!
$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Please wake up, Snow White!
$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteClosedEyes&$$@Center@$——
$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierSurprised&$$@Center@$...!?

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(She's...glowing? Is she casting magic in
her sleep?)
$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Her eyelids are moving!
$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteSad&$$@Center@$Nnh...

$#OtoA("First of the Seven Bikki")#$$&OtoShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$She's awake! The Princess is awake! It's a
miracle!

$#"Finn"("Finn")#$(I saw an apple lying next to the princess
back there—)

$#"Finn"("Finn")#$(There were a lot of dead bugs around it.
It must have been poisoned...)
$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What's wrong?

$#"Finn"("Finn")#$(I'll need to handle this information
carefully.)

$#"Finn"("Finn")#$(This is the sort of thing that could spell
political turmoil for the Prince...)
$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteNormal&$$@Center@$Um, there's something I'd like to know...

$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteNormal&$$@Center@$Which one of you was the one who woke me
up?

$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteSadNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Sorry, I'm still a little hazy after my
slumber...

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$(That makes sense. Who knows how long
she's been asleep for.)
$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It was me, Your Highness.

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierClosedEyes&$$@Center@$You were suffering from a rare illness, and
I had the power to cure you.

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$(whisper) But Your Highness, I thought
whatever you were doing wasn't working?

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierLaugh&$$@Center@$(whisper) Just play along, okay, Finn? Help
me look cool in front of the Princess.

$#SnowWhite(???)#$$&SnowWhiteSurprised&$$@Left@$Sorry to bother you! Could you please
help me?
$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$(whisper) Okay...
$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteOpenSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So it was you, Your Highness.

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierSmirk&$$@Right@$I merely did what any prince would do—
what any decent human would do.

$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteOpenSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Thank you, Your Highness. And thank
you too, Sir Knight.
$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Me?
$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteOpenSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I remember you helped me out before.

$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteOpenSmile&$$@Left@$You're the one who helped me pick up the
food for my little ones.
$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Right@$Oh, right. So you remembered that.
$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteHappy&$$@Left@$Of course I remember!
$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Do you remember me as well?

$#SnowWhite(???)#$$&SnowWhiteSurprised&$$@Left@$I've spilled berries all along the hallway,
could you please help me pick them up?

$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteOpenSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Yes, I remember. You're the Prince of the
Red Kingdom.

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierLaugh&$$@Right@$Oh my! It is an honor for a nobody like me
to be remembered by you, Your Highness.

$#SnowWhite("Snow White")#$$&SnowWhiteSurprised&$$@Left@$A nobody? But I recall you were quite
popular among the people.
$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You flatter me, Your Highness. But look—
$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierSmirk&$$@Center@$You can see the castle from here.

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierSmirk&$$@Right@$Finn, you are excused. You may report to
the command and go home for the day.

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$But Your Highness, I am sworn to protect
you. I'd like to continue with my duty.

$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Besides, Her Royal Highness is in our
care. If anything were to happen...

$#ThePrince("The Prince")#$$&CrozierClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Do you think something is going to happen
to us within the castle walls?
$#Finn("Finn")#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I guess not...

Snow White finds the work of a maid rewarding. She is glad she can offer her expertise in cooking and housekeeping to the master she adores.

SnowWhiteMaid01.title: Frost Flower Maid
SnowWhiteMaid01.description:
"Welcome home, my lord!"
Snow White finds the work of a maid rewarding. She is glad she can offer her expertise in cooking and housekeeping to the master she adores.

keys.IntroText: Welcome back, my lord! The dinner is ready♪

keys.DescriptionKey: "Welcome home...my lord..." Snow Black finds the work of a maid humiliating. How is it possible that she, Queen of Nightmares, has to serve some foolish lordling? Honestly, she should just smother him in his sleep...

SnowWhiteMaid02.name: Snow White
SnowWhiteMaid02.title: Frost Flower Maid
SnowWhiteMaid02.description: "Welcome home...my lord..." Snow Black finds the work of a maid humiliating. How is it possible that she, Queen of Nightmares, has to serve some foolish lordling? Honestly, she should just smother him in his sleep...

keys.DescriptionKey:
Nevertheless, Snow Black gets performing domestic chores down to a fine art in no time at all, and every time her master smiles and praises her cooking, deep in her heart she feels a spark of—
"Nothing! I'll thank you to stop talking nonsense!"

keys.DescriptionKey: Light and shadow — Snow White and Snow Black. The soul of the shadow had begun to sense her own existence gradually fading away. This was because of emotions that had unexpectedly taken root within her, born from her interactions with the hero and Snow White.

SnowWhiteNew01.name: Snow White
SnowWhiteNew01.title: Snow Maiden of Black & White
SnowWhiteNew01.description: Light and shadow — Snow White and Snow Black. The soul of the shadow had begun to sense her own existence gradually fading away. This was because of emotions that had unexpectedly taken root within her, born from her interactions with the hero and Snow White.

keys.IntroText:
From white and black snow,
a new light rises.

keys.DescriptionKey: As though exploiting the opening left in her heart, the "other shadow" that was supposed to have been sealed away returns to life once more. She is the black witch, steeped in malice and hatred — the one who was vanquished by Snow Black after attempting to steal her body.

SnowWhiteNew02.name: Snow White
SnowWhiteNew02.title: Snow Maiden of Black & White
SnowWhiteNew02.description: As though exploiting the opening left in her heart, the "other shadow" that was supposed to have been sealed away returns to life once more. She is the black witch, steeped in malice and hatred — the one who was vanquished by Snow Black after attempting to steal her body.

keys.DescriptionKey:
In the depths of darkness, Snow White and Snow Black joined hands. It was but a fleeting alliance — light and shadow were never meant to intertwine, for darkness is fated to be erased by the light. And yet, Snow Black did not disappear.
Without realizing it, she had already crossed the boundary into the light.

The brilliance of this staff.

keys.DescriptionKey: Snow White has never seen the sea before. Raised in a dark forest on the outskirts of a small kingdom, she's only ever heard of things like the summer sun and the azure sea in bedtime stories. "S-Sorry I made you wait," she says, nervousness mixed with excitement in her voice. When your eyes meet, she makes a peace sign with both hands to hide her embarrassment. "Let's make a lot of good memories today!"

SnowWhiteSwimsuit01.name: Snow White
SnowWhiteSwimsuit01.title: A Midsummer Snow's Dream
SnowWhiteSwimsuit01.description: Snow White has never seen the sea before. Raised in a dark forest on the outskirts of a small kingdom, she's only ever heard of things like the summer sun and the azure sea in bedtime stories. "S-Sorry I made you wait," she says, nervousness mixed with excitement in her voice. When your eyes meet, she makes a peace sign with both hands to hide her embarrassment. "Let's make a lot of good memories today!"

keys.IntroText:
So this is summer... It's as hot as they say.
But it's exciting too!

keys.DescriptionKey:
"What a revolting season..."
Unexpectedly, Snow Black manifests to take control. However, she seems to have emerged at the wrong moment—she immediately hides from the sun underneath a beach umbrella, loudly voicing her displeasure. Evil as she is, even she cannot bring herself to act in uncomfortable conditions.
"What are you waiting for? Hurry up and help me put on some sunbathing oil."

SnowWhiteSwimsuit02.name: Snow White
SnowWhiteSwimsuit02.title: A Midsummer Snow's Dream
SnowWhiteSwimsuit02.description:

"What are you waiting for? Hurry up and help me put on some sunbathing oil."

keys.DescriptionKey:
Even the warmest midsummer dream turns into a chilling nightmare in Snow Black's hands. Her bitterness unleashed, she freezes the sun, the sea, even the summer moon, and fills people's hearts with fear.
"I won't let you ruin everyone's summer fun," a voice says, and all of a sudden there's a girl standing before her.
"Haha, you came at last! Very well, let's have some fun... Princess."

keys.value: $#DONTSHOWME(Monster Pack)#$$|act6.Voices/mst3658|$Groooooaaargh...

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3667|$I'm impressed you knights have come so
far against my Eternity Knights.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$Each of them has been sculpted to
perfection with my Aeon Thorns.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGrit&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3668|$Eternity Knights!?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3669|$We have already done away with your pets!
I am sick of all your Eternity babble!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3670|$They are easily replaced. With more
demons, or any race I so desire.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3671|$All it takes is the prick of a thorn to turn
anyone into my elite warrior.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3672|$You plan to spread those awful things
around all of Erden!?

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3673|$Not while I am standing! I will never allow
you to repeat what you did to my brother!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3674|$Norza, I shall avenge my fallen brethren
with your death! Come, Brother!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3675|$Way ahead of you, Brother! This time we'll
settle this for good!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3659|$I can't believe there are still so many
monsters left in here...

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3676|$Ha ha, very well, Crestbearer. Show me
how well you've polished up!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3677|$Ha ha ha! Your little crimson flame is
burning quite brightly!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3678|$Your troops are gone, Norza!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3679|$You're the only one left. I'm gonna
avenge my uncle, here and now!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3680|$Marvelous... How brilliantly you little
buds have bloomed on the battlefield!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3681|$Stay on guard! He might transform like the
others did!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3682|$If you do not do it soon you will die before
you have the chance, Norza!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3683|$Come on, fiend! Show us your true colors!
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3684|$My "true colors"?

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3685|$Heh... Ha ha ha!! I do not need to transform!
I am not handing over my control!!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3660|$But this must be the last of them. If we
can take them out—
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritRed&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3686|$What!?

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3687|$I have sworn to swing my blade only in my
current form.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3688|$Stealing, destroying, and perfecting myself
while in full command of this weak form—

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3689|$that is my greatest thrill.
It is my way!!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3690|$Your way!?

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&GilganDetermined&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3691|$The philosophies of fiends like you are
worth less than the dirt we walk on.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3692|$If that is your wish, so be it! Rot in that
form of yours, Norza!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3693|$This is it! This elation, this risk! This is
what I live for!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3694|$Come, little heroes! Let us shed blood
together!!

$#DONTSHOWME( )#$$|act6.Voices/mst3695|$










COMMAND

$#DONTSHOWME(Male Voice)#$$|act6.Voices/mst3661|$If you take them out, you think you can
win?

$#DONTSHOWME( )#$$|act6.Voices/mst3696|$










LURE

$#DONTSHOWME( )#$$|act6.Voices/mst3697|$










TOWER
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3698|$...?
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3699|$(Who said that?)

$#DONTSHOWME( )#$$|act6.Voices/mst3695|$










COMMAND

$#DONTSHOWME( )#$$|act6.Voices/mst3696|$










LURE

$#DONTSHOWME( )#$$|act6.Voices/mst3697|$










TOWER
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3703|$But...
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3704|$But this is not the stage for our battle!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritRed&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3705|$!?
$#Ludmilla;Astrid;(All)#$$&LudmillaSurprise;Astrid.AstridSurprise;&$$@Left;;;Astrid.Right;@$$|act6.Voices/mst3662|$!!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3706|$Come to the Throne Room, the womb of
evil...

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3707|$The core of the terrible fate that gnaws at
Erden... Come, to the Aeon Tower!!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3708|$He vanished!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3709|$...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3710|$What's the matter, Callen?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3711|$The Aeon Lords were loyal only to their
own philosophies and greed in my time, too.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3712|$But none of them rejected their master's
control.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3713|$Is Norza really that unusual?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3714|$I cannot say. Even I have only met a small
number of them.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3715|$Norza escaped, but we still cleared out
most of the monsters in here.
$#DONTSHOWME(Male Voice)#$$|act6.Voices/mst3663|$Well then, Astrid von Draclow...
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3716|$The people in Silverlodge will be relieved.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3717|$This snake will just keep reforming if we
don't take out the head, though.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3718|$Let's keep going.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3719|$Yeah.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3720|$To the Eternal's stronghold!
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3721|$...
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3722|$(What am I doing here?)

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3723|$(Why did I retreat? Because my knights
lost? No...)

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3724|$(I could have kept fighting. I still have so
much power!)

$#DONTSHOWME( )#$$|act6.Voices/mst3725|$










INDUCT
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3664|$Can you take me out?

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3726|$I may have given myself to the darkness in
the pursuit of ultimate power...
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3727|$But my body and soul are my own!

$#DONTSHOWME( )#$$|act6.Voices/mst3728|$










FATE

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3729|$Yes, give it to me! Make it my fate to cross

$#DONTSHOWME( )#$$|act6.Voices/mst3730|$










CONTRACT

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3731|$This is the contract? But this would

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$A glorified servant!!

$#DONTSHOWME( )#$










...

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3733|$Whose voice is that...? What are you trying to

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$$|act6.Voices/mst3734|$GROOOOOOAAARGH
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act6.Voices/mst3665|$Norza!!
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3735|$My lord...?
$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$$|act6.Voices/mst3736|$REJOICE...
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3737|$Wh-What are you saying...?

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$$|act6.Voices/mst3738|$REJOICE, FOR THIS IS THE END OF
YOUR MORTAL COIL.

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst3739|$BECOME CHAOS. PAINT ALL THE LAND
IN CRIMSON.

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst3740|$BECOME FURY. DESTROY EVERY NEW

$#DONTSHOWME(???)#$$|act6.Voices/mst3741|$OOAAAAARGHHH...

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3742|$Ha ha... Finally, I understand...
Ha ha ha...
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$$|act6.Voices/mst3743|$HA HA HA HA!!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridGrit&$$@Right@$$|act6.Voices/mst3666|$...!!

keys.DescriptionKey:
This unit has a 33% chance to:

- have its TU reduced to 0 after dealing damage with an Attack (1 chance per hit).
- each turn, survive any damage that would defeat it with 1HP.
- ignore the incoming status effects Poison, and Burn.
- ignore attacks that would damage exactly 2 targets. Attacks that target All allies will not be ignored.
- enrage 1 random ally at the end of each turn.
- weaken 1 random enemy at the end of each turn.

The chance for each effect is determined independently each time they may occur. Enraged units have their Attack increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn. Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. These effects will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on affected units. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Lillian Rosalinde von Dreyer was born with a certain problem. Since its founding, her bloodline has been known for two things: indefatigable spirit and truly enormous size. The story goes that, after giving birth to five strapping boys, her mother swore that her sixth would be the strongest warrior of them all. So, naturally, Lillian arrived not only small for her family, but small for any Hymelian.

Only the foolish dare bring up this little legend around her, however. She tends to challenge anyone who does to a duel, to prove that her mother's prediction was in no way false.

SpearGirlWarrior01.name: Lillian
SpearGirlWarrior01.title: Spritely Spearmaster
SpearGirlWarrior01.description:
Lillian Rosalinde von Dreyer was born with a certain problem. Since its founding, her bloodline has been known for two things: indefatigable spirit and truly enormous size. The story goes that, after giving birth to five strapping boys, her mother swore that her sixth would be the strongest warrior of them all. So, naturally, Lillian arrived not only small for her family, but small for any Hymelian.

Only the foolish dare bring up this little legend around her, however. She tends to challenge anyone who does to a duel, to prove that her mother's prediction was in no way false.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Lillian's father worried that having five elder brothers might overwhelm a dainty little girl. However, his worry soon proved to be quite unfounded. More often than not, Lillian was the one who sent her brothers running, beating them back from her dolls with a tree branch spear. When they heard of the Hymelian princess's penchant for combat, Lillian's parents sent her to be her handmaiden -- or perhaps, more accurately, her apprentice.

 Though Maxima fights with a sword instead of a spear, Lillian has taken her aggressive philosophy quite to heart. In battle, she ensures her opponents never gain an inch on her allies, no matter what she has to do.

keys.DescriptionKey: Few names inspire as much fear in sailors as "Dargarossa," the most notorious pirate to ever cruise the Ashiran Sea. With his ferocious crew in tow, Dargarossa has plundered countless ships and sunk just as many. His favorite prey are ships carrying high-class passengers, as he has an insatiable appetite for the valuable trinkets they tend to wear. As such, the nobility living along the coast have placed an exuberant reward on his squid-like head. But the local bounty hunters don't dare pursue him, as all those who have tried in the past now rest at the bottom of the sea.

keys.DescriptionKey: Some say that he was formerly a normal man, cursed by the goddess of the sea for rejecting her affections. Others say he is a demon of the deep, drawn to the surface by the promise of treasure. Whatever his true nature may be, it is clear that Dargarossa has no intention of divulging it to anyone. His crew know better than to ask him about it, for those who do are sent "fishing"—they have one ankle tied by rope to the aft and are then tossed overboard, while the ship cruises at full speed.

keys.DescriptionKey:
This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

This unit's attacks ignore damage reduction effects, and any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent targets from being defeated.

This unit will gain a Charge each time another ally gets the turn. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges, and all charges are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield.

When this unit enters battle, this unit grants all allies Sleep Immunity, Poison Immunity, and Stun Immunity until the end of their next turn while on the battlefield.

When this unit defeats an enemy with an attack, if they are:
- Dark or Storm, after the end of the turn, all allies on the battlefield, will be given the next turns by reducing their current TU. These TU reductions may trigger before or after other effects that adjust the turn order.
- Light or Earth, all allies on the battlefield will have the TU costs for all of their skills reduced by 20%. This will overwrite the effects of other Quicken skills.
- Water or Fire, all allies on the battlefield will be Purified (any negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed).
All of these defeat effects may trigger before or after other effects.

keys.DescriptionKey: Lightlings are highly sought after by many would-be monster trainers. Their winged adult forms can fly while carrying a passenger, making them excellent companions in battle. Because their sheer ferocity makes them nigh impossible to tame as adults, hunters often try to capture them while they are still infant Lightlings. However, this task is far from easy, as poisonous claws and a nasty bite make even Lightlings quite dangerous.

keys.DescriptionKey: While finding and capturing a rare Lightling is a test of skill for a monster trainer, taming the older Shockling is a test of patience. In addition to being much larger, Shocklings are also more aggressive and fearless, requiring constant supervision to keep them out of trouble. However, despite their disobedient tendencies, Shocklings care deeply for their masters, and they will protect them from any threats with zeal. They also like to bring their master fresh prey each morning, though this is not always quite as appreciated.

keys.DescriptionKey: Once a wild Shockling turns into a Thundring, it grows a pair of mighty wings and takes to the skies. From then on, it will spend the bulk of its time in flight. Wild Thundrings gather around storm clouds, absorbing their electrical energy. While hunting, a Thundring will swoop down and unleash this energy on unsuspecting prey, like a living lightning bolt. This is why the traditional Baltu'kud language uses the same word for both Thundrings and real lightning strikes.

- When this unit enters the battlefield.
