keys.value: $#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst272|$Is this the Proving Grounds?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst280|$This is a training mission, but your success
is of vital importance.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|Cont|$It will prove you have what it takes to call
yourself a Red Dragon Knight.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst281|$If you can complete this mission, I will
allow you to join my unit.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst282|$And what if... What if I don't make the cut?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst283|$You'll keep going until you do. I'll do my
best to ensure you don't die in the process.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst284|$You can bounce back from half-dead, can't
you? Ha ha ha!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst285|$(She's laughing, but her eyes are dead
serious...)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst286|$Just to be clear, we don't plan on giving
you up.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst287|$We need you to become the hero who
defeats the Eternal!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst288|$Hero... It feels weird to be called that, but...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst273|$It's a remnant from the Old Kingdom, but
now we use it for training new recruits.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst289|$I'll do it.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst290|$If I train, I might get better at using this
crest.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst291|$Then maybe I can help cure Theo and the
other sick folk...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst292|$That's the spirit! Alright, your Proving
starts...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act1.Voices/mst293|$Wait!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Center@$$|act1.Voices/mst294|$Please, wait. I... I want to join the Red
Dragon Knights too!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Center@$$|act1.Voices/mst295|$I've been hunting for 10 years! I won't be a
burden, so please let me join!!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst296|$Rizette!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst297|$Rizette... There's no need for you to fight.
You need to stay with Theo.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act1.Voices/mst298|$There's nothing I can do for him that the
healers can't!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst274|$So I just need to prove that I have what it
takes to join the Knights?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Center@$$|act1.Voices/mst299|$The Knights are fighting against the
Pandemonium.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Center@$$|act1.Voices/mst300|$If I join, I might be able to save Theo! So
please!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act1.Voices/mst301|$...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act1.Voices/mst302|$Rizette, you misunderstand us.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$We have no need for someone who only
wishes to save their brother.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act1.Voices/mst303|$But someone who can aid their friends
while protecting their own life...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|Cont|$may be able to save not only their brother,
but the lives of many.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$$|act1.Voices/mst304|$Can you become such a person before the
end of this trial?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst305|$!!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst306|$...I can. I will!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst275|$I want you to join a special Pandemonium
task force under my command.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst307|$Good.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst308|$Finn, Rizette... I'll be waiting for you at the
exit.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst309|$Yes ma'am!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst310|$Yes ma'am!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act1.Voices/mst311|$Begin the Proving!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst276|$Battles, reconnaissance, recovery... It will
be a mixed bag.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst277|$This trial is designed to teach you how to
handle a variety of situations.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst278|$Inside you will find sentinel stones—statues
with powerful opponents sealed within them.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|Cont|$They will activate as soon as you get close.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst279|$Your task is to locate the exit.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$This must be the dungeon
the commander was talking about.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$Not yet, but he left a message for me
on the town noticeboard.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$He said he'd gone looking for me
inside this dungeon.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Why would he think you'd come here?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$I don't know, but when I asked around
the townspeople all said the same thing.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$Apparently people and animals have been
disappearing around the city.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$Rumor has it that those who disappear
are brought to this dungeon.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Right@$Theo may have heard those rumors,
and when we didn't arrive in Rigland
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Right@$because we got held up in Rossé...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Right@$Well, he probably thought that I was
one of the ones who disappeared.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$So Theo could be inside.
We'd better stay on our guard.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$It's really dark and ominous...
and are those bloodstains!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$There's something off about this place.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$It feels ominous, just like whatever was
in the forest when we first met.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$Yeah. I feel it too.
That's why I'm coming with you.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Right@$If there are people here, if Theo's here,
we'd better hurry before it's too late.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$You're right. Let's go!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$And this overwhelming menacing 
presence...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Like there is some great evil
sleeping deep within the dungeon...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteAngry&$$@Right@$Finn, wait up!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Rizette!? What are you doing here!?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$I saw you ahead, so I followed you. What are you doing here?

keys.DescriptionKey:
Each time this unit damages an enemy that has the Stealth or Armor Status Effect with an attack, this unit will immediately get the next turn. This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

- The extra turn is granted after Counter Skin type effects triggered by this unit's attacks, and so this unit will act before a countering enemy.
- Effects that influence TU order may interrupt the extra turn (e.g. Stuns targeting the lowest TU target).
- This cannot trigger again against the same target until TU advances.

Enemies damaged by this attack will be granted one of the following effects:

- Mega Poison for 200TU if they are a Storm or Earth unit.
- Stun for 200TU if they are a Water or Dark unit.

Locked for 200TU after the user has entered the battlefield, and locks again after each use. After the first use, unlocks each time the user damages an enemy with a different attack. Sleep and Mega Poison will overwrite other status effects on that enemy. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison. This is not considered a Combo Burst type active skill.

keys.DescriptionKey:
This unit has 50% damage reduction from attacks. If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

When this unit gets the turn with less than 50% HP, this unit exchanges its current HP with the amount of HP it has currently lost.

Grants all other allies the Armor status effect, and all Enemies 3 Discharge Counters. Triggered both at the very start of the battle if this unit is on the battlefield, and when this unit enters the battlefield from reinforcements. New enemies entering the battlefield will be granted 3 Discharge Counters.

Armor will overwrite other status effects on those allies. Armor grants 50% damage reduction from the next attack, then the effect is removed. A unit can store a maximum of 3 Discharge Counters, and all are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield.

keys.DescriptionKey:
"I've spent my whole life following in my father's footsteps. I learned of duty and responsibilty before I could walk. The mantle of the commander of the Red Dragon Knights, the title of "Hero of Rigland"... I never realized how heavy they were before. If I'd kept shouldering them, sooner or later I would be crushed under the weight. 
Thank you for giving me this respite, my friends. I'll have to pick up that weight again soon... but for right now, I'll let the waves carry me."

keys.IntroText:
Warm sun, warm sand, and a cool breeze.
Even the Valkyrie has to relax sometimes.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Laomis: the glimmering pearl of the South Seas. Every Riglander dreams of visiting this tropical paradise at least once, and the Red Dragon Knights' hard-headed Marshal is no exception. However, with all of her responsibilities, it seemed like a faraway dream within a dream. She had halfway given up when Queen Esma's invitation descended like a gift from on high.
"I cannot afford to fail on this mission. I must enjoy myself to the fullest...!"
Vacation is no excuse to slack off, after all.

keys.DescriptionKey: Even with the Pandemonium ended forever, Ludmilla has no time to rest. Supporting her young Commander, punishing bandits and looters, destroying any remaining monsters... Her days are packed to the brim, and she wouldn't have it any other way. Still, taking rest when you can is a basic rule of battle, and Ludmilla knows that very well. Improving oneself has no point if you run yourself into the ground to do it. So, she pushes herself to her limits, rests, and then pushes herself to her new limits once again. Tomorrow she takes up her mantle and sword once more; tomorrow she must push herself once again, so today, she rests with all her might.

keys.value: $#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Center@$An invitation to a wedding?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$(I have no time to waste at a banquet. Not
now, and not in the future either.)

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSad&$$@Left@$But they are rare, and make up a very
small part of our economy—

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSad&$$@Left@$Which is sustained largely by small-
scale trade and tourism.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$I see...

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSerious&$$@Left@$We are lucky to have Lord Bonnett's
cooperation as a trading partner.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$Then, is this marriage a condition of
that cooperation...?

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSerious&$$@Left@$...The benefits to my people far outweigh
my own personal desires.
$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSad&$$@Left@$And...I'm unworthy of love, in any case.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(Ah...that explains why she looks so sad.)

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(How devoted, to endure marriage to that
vulgar man for her country's sake...)

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSerious&$$@Left@$We're not so different, are we?
You and I.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$(But it is true that we can't afford to lose
House Bonnett's financial support...)
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$Ma'am?

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSad&$$@Left@$Both burdened with titles far beyond our
ages, and the responsibilities attached.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$...Certainly so.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$And both with a knife to our throats from
House Bonnett, as well.

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSmile&$$@Left@$Hee hee.
You can say that again.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSmile&$$@Right@$Haha...

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(Phew...noble or soldier, dealing with
drunks is such a pain.)

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitGrit&$$@Right@$(If they didn't pay our salaries, I'd throw
that wine-soaked gutter rat and his
$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitGrit&$$@Right@$stuffed shirt of a father overboard, but...)

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(At least I was able to defuse things
without causing trouble for Lady Astrid.)

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$Lord Bonnett, may I request a day's time
before making my formal reply?

$#Crew(Crew)#$Geez, dealing with all these spoiled nobles
is exhausting, I'll tell you what.

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(Oh? It sounds like the crew and I are of
a similar opinion.)

$#Crew(Crew)#$You can say that again. All high and mighty
just 'cuz their folks got money.

$#Crew(Crew)#$Wish we could switch with the guys in the
hold. Watching cargo sounds a lot easier.

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$(The hold? Cargo?
What are they talking about?)

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(This is a pleasure cruise. There shouldn't
be any cargo other than guests' luggage.)

$#Crew(Crew)#$$!-1!$Hm? Hey, what's that ship there?
It's coming closer...
$#Crew(Crew)#$L-look! That flag!

$#Crew(Crew)#$That's a pirate flag!
It's Dargarossa!

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertAngry&$$@Left@$How did they catch us so easily?! What
are we paying you louts for?!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$I think it is a fine idea. Let us accept,
Lady Astrid!
$#Crew(Crew)#$Forgive us, sir! That ship is just so fast—

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertAngry&$$@Left@$Enough!
All hands to battle stations!
$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSurprise&$$@Right@$Lady Astrid!

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$@Left@$Get down, Your Majesty!
Stay close to me!

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitCommand&$$@Right@$Commander!
Your sword!

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$@Left@$Thank you! At my command, Marshal.
We will protect the Queen and the guests!
$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$Yes, ma'am!
$#Crew(Crew)#$$!-1!$Look out! They're boarding!
$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Center@$...

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitGrit&$$!-1!$$@Right@$It's the Bane of the Ashiran Sea...
The dread pirate, Dargarossa!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$This hardly seems like the time to make
jokes, Marshal.
$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSmug&$$!-1!$$@Center@$All of you better keep yer heads down if
ya wanna keep 'em attached!

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Dargarossa! How considerate of you to
save us the trouble of finding you!

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$@Right@$Your reign of terror ends now. You'll rue
the day you boarded this vessel!

$#Pirate(Pirate)#$$&PirateB&$$@Left@$Oho, we got a live one here, boys! Let's
make her regret—
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$@Right@$Haaa!
$#Pirate(Pirate)#$$&PirateB&$$@Left@$Gaah!

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitCommand&$$@Right@$Prepare yourselves, villains!
Haaa!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$I agree with her, Commander.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$You've been working too hard lately. Why
not take this chance to relax a little?
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$Not you too, Rizette.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$It's out of the question. I can't just leave
my duties unfulfilled.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Left@$Don't worry about it! We'll handle things
here while you two are away.

$#Lord Bonnett(Lord Bonnett)#$$&LordBonnettSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Yes. I would be honored if you and Lady
Ludmilla were to attend.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Left@$It's not every day you get a chance to go
on a cruise, you know! Go have fun!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$But...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$(I only officially assumed command of the
Knights less than a week ago.)

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$(I still don't quite feel worthy of this.
Of standing where my father once stood.)

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$(And with Finn...this is no time to leave
Rigland for a party, of all things.)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$We need House Bonnett's gold to keep
our knights equipped and our people safe.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Securing funding is also part of the
Commander's responsibilities, Lady Astrid.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$...You do know just what to say.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$Alright, then. I'll let Lord Bonnett know
that we accept his kind invitation.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$(That said...I hardly know what to expect.
Especially with that postscript.)

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$...I apologize, Lord Bonnett, but
respectfully, I will have to decline.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$("All guests are requested to bring
a swimsuit"...?)
$#Guest(Guest)#$Come on in already! The water's great!

$#Guest(Guest)#$Wow, what a ship! Swimming in a pool
on the ocean—what'll they think of next?!

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(This ship is a marvel—an extravagant,
wasteful marvel.)

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(A freshwater pool in the deck of a cruise
ship...it's ridiculous.)

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(And the interiors are as ostentatious as
any noble mansion in the capital.)

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(House Bonnett's coffers run deep...
As do those of the bride's family.)

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(They are the royal family of Laomis,
after all.)

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(The other guests are certainly enjoying
themselves, but I...)

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSerious&$$@Left@$Lady Astrid, you look pale. Are you
feeling seasick?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$I'm afraid I am far too busy to attend a
banquet at this time.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSurpriseBlush&$$@Right@$Ah...no, Marshal.
It's nothing.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$You look like you're having fun.

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSmile&$$@Left@$Of course! It is not every day one gets to
swim in a pool while on the sea.

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSmile&$$@Left@$They look to be serving refreshments
over there. Shall we?

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$...No, thank you. Please, don't hold back
on my account, though.
$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSerious&$$@Left@$I see...then I will be right back.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(I knew I shouldn't have come...)

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Hey, missy! Aren't you "our hero", the
great Astrid von Draclow?
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$@Right@$(...Missy?!)

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$@Right@$How rude!
I am no "missy"!

$#Lord Bonnett(Lord Bonnett)#$$&LordBonnettSerious&$$@Left@$Oh? Am I to understand you are turning
down a personal invitation from me?

$#Drunk Guest(Drunk Guest)#$$!-1!$Aw, c'mon!
Don't be like that, o' grand warrior!

$#Drunk Guest(Drunk Guest)#$Yeah, yeah! Why don'tcha come and talk
tactics with the guest of honor!

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$(Guest of honor? Then this man is
Lord Bonnett's son?)

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Left@$Oh, my apologies if we have insulted the
Commander of the Red Dragon Knights.

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Left@$We were actually just talking about you,
and your crusade against the Eternal.

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Left@$There were a few things you could've done better,
but overall, not badly done for a young kid!
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$...Do you require something from me, Sir?

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Left@$Now, now, don't get mad!
This is my blessed day, you know?

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Left@$Come on. Won't the great Hero of Rigland
raise a glass to my good health? Hmm?

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$I will refrain, Sir. By all means, though,
I will wish you health in—
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$...

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Left@$...What, too good to drink with me?
Is that it?

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$Coercing a lady to drink is boorish
behavior, Sir Robert.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitGrit&$$@Right@$I would have thought the heir of House
Bonnett would show better breeding.

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertAngry&$$@Left@$...You little wench!
Watch your tongue!
$#Lord Bonnett(Lord Bonnett)#$$&LordBonnettSerious&$$@Right@$What ho, Robert! Is there a problem?
$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSerious&$$@Left@$...Yes, Father, there is.

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSerious&$$@Left@$It seems the good Commander considers
the wine you ordered for us "swill".

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$Wha—?!
I said nothing of the—

$#Lord Bonnett(Lord Bonnett)#$$&LordBonnettSerious&$$@Left@$Ah, of course the Lady Commander has a
refined palate befitting her station.

$#Lord Bonnett(Lord Bonnett)#$$&LordBonnettSerious&$$@Left@$But I must admit, I am hurt to hear you
are dissatisfied on my son's special day.

$#Lord Bonnett(Lord Bonnett)#$$&LordBonnettSerious&$$@Left@$The wedding of my only son and heir is a
momentous occasion for House Bonnett.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitGrit&$$@Right@$...

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSmile&$$@Left@$Now, now. If you wish to discuss tactics, I
would be honored to join you, Sir Robert.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$Marshal?!
$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSerious&$$@Left@$Leave this to me, Lady Astrid.

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSmile&$$@Left@$A toast to you on your happy day, Sir.
Now, you were saying?

$#Lord Bonnett(Lord Bonnett)#$$&LordBonnettSmile&$$@Right@$Hrrm. Tactics, is it? I must admit to
dabbling in the art myself.

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Left@$...How lucky you have such understanding
subordinates, Lady Commander.
$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Left@$This had better not happen again.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSad&$$@Right@$...
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSad&$$@Right@$(...What have I done?)

$#Lord Bonnett(Lord Bonnett)#$$&LordBonnettSerious&$$@Left@$A time of joy and fortune...which we will
of course share with our supporters.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSad&$$@Right@$(Provoked or no, I insulted the
bridegroom to his face...)

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSad&$$@Right@$(And Marshal Ludmilla had to clean up
my mess. I should know better.)

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitGrit&$$@Right@$(How can I claim to be worthy of the
mantle of Commander if—)

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$Is something troubling you?
You look terribly upset.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$Pardon me, you are...

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSmile&$$@Right@$(Ah...if I recall correctly, this would be
the other guest of honor.)

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSmile&$$@Right@$Forgive me. Congratulations on your
wedding, Queen Esma.

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSerious&$$@Left@$...
...Thank you.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$...?

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(She looks troubled, too. It seems I'm not
the only one who isn't enjoying herself.)

$#Lord Bonnett(Lord Bonnett)#$$&LordBonnettSerious&$$@Left@$It would be a shame if the Red Dragon
Knights were not among that number.

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSerious&$$@Left@$You must be Lady Astrid, yes?
Of the Red Dragon Knights.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$You know of me, Your Majesty?

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSerious&$$@Left@$Of course. The courageous Hero of
Rigland is known even on our shores.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$...You honor me.

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSerious&$$@Left@$The protector of your people, at such a
young age. You have my deepest respect.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$I could say the same of you, Ma'am.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$I can scarce imagine the weight a crown
must bear for one so young.

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSerious&$$@Left@$It is not so heavy. Laomis is a small and
poor kingdom, after all.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$Poor? Forgive me, but I had heard Laomis
was renowned for its lustrous pearls...

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSerious&$$@Left@$Indeed, we are blessed with pearls of
uncommon beauty and value.
$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertAngry&$$@Left@$...

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$We have a voyage to complete, but
we can't helm this ship alone.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$You are to reform the crew, and ensure
we reach port in Laomis safely.

$#Lord Bonnett(Lord Bonnett)#$$&LordBonnettSerious&$$@Left@$O-oh, well, that should be no trouble.
As you say, Lady Astrid.

$#Crew(Crew)#$Wait, you mean we get off free, then?
Not that we're complainin'...

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$I never said that. But cooperation will
lower your punishment from execution

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$for treason to a comparatively light fine,
I would imagine.

$#Crew(Crew)#$Fer good behavior, eh...
Alright, sure.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSmile&$$@Right@$...Phew. At least we won't be stranded
out here in the ocean.

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSmile&$$@Left@$...Lady Astrid, thank you. For everything.
How can I ever repay you for this deed?

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSmile&$$@Right@$...No, I'm not the one you ought to thank,
Your Majesty. That would be—

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$Your character may be rotten, but your
skill, at least, is true.

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitCommand&$$@Left@$Lady Astrid!
We've been had!

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitCommand&$$@Left@$The ship's hold is empty! There's not a
single ounce left of the smuggled gold!
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$What?!
$#Crew(Crew)#$Hey, look! The pirate ship is moving away!
$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$...
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitGrit&$$@Right@$Damn, I let my guard down!

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSad&$$@Left@$Oh, no...I hadn't had a chance to thank
him yet! To apologize...!
$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSad&$$@Left@$Wait! Wait, please, don't go!

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSad&$$@Left@$Please don't go!
Edwaldo!

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSerious&$$@Left@$Hey, Cap'n. That Queen was shoutin'
something at ya.

$#Lord Bonnett(Lord Bonnett)#$$&LordBonnettSurprised&$$@Left@$Ohh...
Oh, my son...

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSerious&$$@Left@$But...huh, I feel like she called you by
a different name?

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Right@$...It's no name of mine. She must have
mistaken me for someone else.
$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSmug&$$@Left@$Not very likely, with a face like yers...

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSmug&$$@Left@$Oh well. No one got hurt, an' we got a
hold full o' treasure! Good day all 'round!

$#Pirate(Pirate)#$$&PirateB&$$@Right@$Yeah! The Cap'n sure comes at 'em well-
armed! Get it?! 'Cuz he's an octo—

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaAngry&$$@Left@$...
(Thump!)

$#Pirate(Pirate)#$$&PirateB&$$@Right@$Hurf...!
(Splash!)

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSmug&$$@Left@$Ah, okay, one person got hurt.
Someone throw 'im a rope already!
$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$...
Queen Esma?

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$Lord Bonnett, your son is a criminal.
There can be no further doubt of that.

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSerious&$$@Left@$...No, it's nothing.
Forgive me.

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSmile&$$@Left@$More importantly, I've decided what to do
to repay you for your valor.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$I was only doing my duty, Your Majesty.
I don't need any repayment.
$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSmile&$$@Left@$Now, now, don't argue.

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSmile&$$@Left@$I feel awful your vacation was ruined.
Won't you continue it on Laomis?
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$Vacation...?

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSmile&$$@Left@$Pearls aren't the only thing Laomis is
famed for, you know.

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSmile&$$@Left@$Our beaches are also very highly praised
by visitors. Won't you see for yourself?

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$...Thank you, Ma'am, but I'm afraid I must
return to Rigland and resume my duties—

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSmile&$$@Left@$Lady Astrid, it's rude to refuse
someone's kind intentions like that.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$He'll be put to trial, but I'm led to believe
that you had no knowledge of all this?
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$Marshal...

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSmile&$$@Left@$The white-sand beaches of Laomis are
famed across Rigland.

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSmile&$$@Left@$And the seafood! The shellfish, especially,
is said to be second to none—

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$You seem...oddly well-versed in the
topic, Ludmilla.

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSmile&$$@Left@$Ah...ahem. In any case, it seems a shame
to turn down such a gracious offer.

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSmile&$$@Left@$I am sure our companions are managing
matters just fine in our absence.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$Our companions...

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(...Right. Dargarossa said something
like that, too.)
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(Believing in one's subordinates...)

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$Alright, then. We would be honored
to accept your kind offer, Ma'am.

$#Lord Bonnett(Lord Bonnett)#$$&LordBonnettSurprised&$$@Left@$O-of course not! I would never condone
smuggling, of all things!
$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSmile&$$@Left@$...I'm glad.

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSmile&$$@Right@$Thank you, Lady Astrid! You'll receive
our most luxurious welcome!
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(To think I'd learn so much from a pirate.)

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(I owe him my thanks...but that doesn't
change my duty.)

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitGrit&$$@Right@$(Dargarossa, someday...someday I will
bring you to justice!)

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSmile&$$@Left@$Look, Lady Astrid! An island's come into
view. Is that it?

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSmile&$$@Right@$Yes. Welcome to my home—
Welcome to Laomis.

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSmile&$$@Left@$We have finally arrived.
Aren't you excited, Lady Astrid?!

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSmile&$$@Right@$...Yes.
I really am.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$In that case, I see no reason to arrest you
as well.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$However, you will have to take some
responsibility for your son's actions.

$#Lord Bonnett(Lord Bonnett)#$$&LordBonnettSurprised&$$@Left@$R-responsibility?!
What do you mean?
$#Pirate(Pirate)#$$&PirateB&$$@Left@$D-damn, they're strong!

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Right@$That would be me.
What do you want?

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$Please, Your Majesty, do not blame
yourself for this.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$The fault lies with me. I thought the
pirates were our only enemy.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitGrit&$$@Right@$If I had kept an eye on the ship's crew, as
well, you would not have been in danger.
$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaAngry&$$@Left@$...Foolish.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$@Right@$I beg your pardon?! What's foolish?!

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaAngry&$$@Left@$This whole pity party.
It's getting us nowhere.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$...
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$Well, I don't see you helping...

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaAngry&$$@Left@$Stop fiddling with those chains.
You're hurting my ears.

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$These are sturdily made. We'll never
break them with our bare hands.

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$This would've been a simple take, if it was
just you small fry.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$@Right@$So you suggest we just sit here?!
$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$Why not?

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$Whether you're handed over to the Navy,
or executed up on deck—

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$@Right@$Your life is forfeit. How can you look so
calm, knowing that?!

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$(...Not that I can actually tell if he looks
calm right now or not.)
$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$...Because I'm the Captain.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$What does that have to do with anything?

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$On the sea, it's an ironclad rule—
the captain holds the crew together.

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$When the sea swallows all, if the captain
falters, then the ship is already lost.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$...

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$But the Red Dragon Knights...
complicate matters.

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$But of course, a captain can't man the ship
alone. Anyone who tries is a fool.

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$The reason I can stand resolute is
because I know my crew has my back.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$...

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$Commander. Your Marshal— do you doubt
her? Do you think your trust in her

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$is foolish or misplaced? Or perhaps
you don't trust her at all?

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$@Right@$What?! Don't be ridiculous! Marshal
Ludmilla has always been there for me.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$@Right@$I trust her with my life!
Of course we believe in each other!
$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$Aye. Then we wait.

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$We stand resolute,
and we wait for them.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$...
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$...
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$(...Squidhead here might actually have a point.)

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$(Who would've thought that an infamous pirate
could dispense somewhat useful advice?)
$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaCommand&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Cap'n! You okay?!
$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...Yeah.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$You—! How did you find us?!
What about the guards?!

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSmug&$$@Left@$I drugged their wine. Oldest trick
in the book!

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSerious&$$@Left@$Here, show me yer hands. I got the key
too. And...there ya go.
$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSmile&$$@Right@$...Thank you. How can I ever repay you?

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSmug&$$@Left@$I'm here for the Cap'n. Yer kind of a
bonus, so...no need for any of that.

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSerious&$$@Left@$Brought yer sword, Cap'n.
Yours too, Commander.

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$I think we'd all like to avoid any
unnecessary bloodshed. Don't you?
$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$...Right.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$Mine, as well?
But why?

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$I'm going to go take back my ship now,
Commander.

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$You're free to do as you will, but if you
value the guests' lives, cooperate with me.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$As Commander of the Red Dragon Knights,
I can't in good conscience obey a pirate—

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$I didn't say obey.
I said cooperate with.

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$There's no point fighting among ourselves.
Work with me, and let's settle this.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$...Right.
Let's...do that, then.

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$I really would rather not, but...let's
fight together.

$#Crew(Crew)#$Gyahaha! Eh? Hey, we're outta booze!
Someone go get some more!
$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSerious&$$@Right@$...What are you getting at?

$#Crew(Crew)#$Get it yourself, rotbrain! Or drink from
the pool, if you're that thirsty!

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(The crew have totally let their guards
down.)

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(But with Lady Astrid held hostage, there
is precious little I can do here.)

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitGrit&$$@Right@$(I must find a way to rescue her.
But how?)
$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSerious&$$@Left@$...
$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$...Do you need something?

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSerious&$$@Left@$Keep it down an' don't look at me.
Whisper. Got it?
$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$...?

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSerious&$$@Left@$I got yer mace. It's with my spear, under
that table over there.
$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$What?! How did you—

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaAngry&$$@Left@$I'm here for the cargo. Hand it over, and
you're all free to go.
$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSerious&$$@Left@$Shhhut up! I said keep quiet!

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$...Right. But why would you bring my
weapon, as well?

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSmug&$$@Left@$Cuz yer an "interested party", as Cap'n
would say. We freed all the hostages.

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$All of them?! Thank you.
But—

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSerious&$$@Left@$Where's that puffed-up pissant of a
noble bratling?

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$Making the rounds of the guests'
staterooms, I believe.

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$To see if any of them are willing to ally
with him, no doubt.

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSmug&$$@Left@$So the bigwigs've gone back to their
rooms, eh? That's a help.

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSerious&$$@Left@$Okay, Marshal. Just do as I say, yeah?
Trust me here...

$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitCommand&$$@Right@$—...You insult me! I would never join
forces with the likes of you!

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$What say you?
Not a bad deal, is it?
$#Crew(Crew)#$$!-1!$Huh? What's all that shouting?

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaCommand&$$@Left@$Tch. Fine! Woulda stuck in my craw to
play nice with you, anyway!

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaCommand&$$@Left@$Ya stuck-up shiny breastplate! You make
me sick! Get outta my sight!
$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitCommand&$$@Right@$Ha! You get out of my sight!

$#Crew(Crew)#$$!-1!$Hey, we got a catfight!
Yeah, get 'er!

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaCommand&$$@Center@$Now you've done it!
Take this!

$#Crew(Crew)#$$!-1!$H-hey, don't break the furniture!
That stuff's expensive!

$#Crew(Crew)#$Someone stop 'em!
They're gonna trash the ship!
$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertAngry&$$@Left@$Hey! What's all this commotion?!
$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSerious&$$@Right@$(Look! There he is!)

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$(The ship can't be carrying anything too
valuable outside of the guests.)
$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSerious&$$@Left@$(Just like I said!)
$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaCommand&$$@Left@$Now, Cap'n!
$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Right@$...
$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSurprise&$$@Left@$W-what?! How did you—!

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$@Right@$The hostages are freed! You have no
leverage left!

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$@Right@$Surrender, and stand trial in Rigland.
Or resist, and face justice here!
$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertAngry&$$@Left@$You... You wench!

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertAngry&$$@Left@$I'm so close! You can't stop me! I'll turn
you and that damn Queen into fish food!

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$(It galls to deal with pirates, but in
exchange for all the guests' safety...)
$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaCommand&$$@Right@$Cap'n! Cap'n, we got bad news here!

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$Captain, I urge you to accept.
It's our best option!

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSerious&$$@Left@$......No,
I don't think so.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$What?!

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSerious&$$@Left@$You pirates seem to be laboring under
a misapprehension here.

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSerious&$$@Left@$This is a cruise ship. We don't have any
cargo worth the name.

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Right@$...Hm.
A weak attempt at diversion.

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaCommand&$$@Right@$Don't go playin' dumb now, rich boy!
We saw it all!

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaCommand&$$@Right@$This ship's stuffed to the gills
with stacks of gold bars!
$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertAngry&$$@Left@$...Tch.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$Gold...bars?
$#Lord Bonnett(Lord Bonnett)#$$&LordBonnettSurprised&$$@Left@$L-Lady Astrid, what should I—
$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSurprise&$$@Left@$Lord Robert, what is he talking about?

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSerious&$$@Left@$This ship is bound for Laomis. No one in
Laomis is set to receive that much gold!

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Right@$...Well, that's where you're wrong,
Your Majesty.

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Right@$There are smugglers in Laomis's port
anxiously awaiting this gold.
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$Smugglers?!

$#Lord Bonnett(Lord Bonnett)#$$&LordBonnettSurprised&$$@Left@$W-what are you talking about, my son?
I wasn't told of this!
$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSerious&$$@Right@$It's for the good of our family, Father.

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSerious&$$@Right@$This ship was originally built to smuggle
gold, you see.

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Right@$Who would think such a glamorous ship
could be a front for smuggling?

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Right@$And with the flag of Laomis flying, what
customs official would ever stop us?

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$@Right@$Fall back, Lord Bonnett!
Find a place to hide!

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSerious&$$@Left@$Then...
The wedding was all for...

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Right@$Exactly. Royal titles carry weight, even
from a little nowhereland like Laomis.

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Right@$I figured it would be simple to pull the
wool over your eyes. And then,

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Right@$As Prince-Consort, I'd have free reign to
help myself to Laomis's pearls.

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaAngry&$$@Left@$Preposterous!
This is entirely unacceptable!

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaAngry&$$@Left@$I may have signed away my body, but I
will never sell out my people!

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaAngry&$$@Left@$I declare this marriage null and void! Lord
Bonnett, our agreement is hereby negated!

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$@Right@$Robert Bonnett. You were a fool to admit
your corrupt deeds before me!

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$@Right@$I'm placing you under arrest for the crime
of smuggling. Do not resist!

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Left@$A fool, was I? Ha! Who's the fool now,
Commander?!

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$Astrid...? I see. Of the Red Dragon
Knights...
$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertAngry&$$@Left@$You! Do it!

$#Crew(Crew)#$$!-1!$Everyone settle down, or I'll stick her!
I swear I will!

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSurprise&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Aaah?!
U-unhand me!
$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What?!
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$@Right@$You scoundrel...!
$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Right@$Heh heh heh.
Weren't expecting that, were you?!

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitGrit&$$@Right@$(Damn! He distracted us to let that sailor
get behind the Queen with a knife!)

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitGrit&$$@Right@$(I underestimated how far he would be
willing to take this villainy...)

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Left@$If not my fiancée, then would you prefer
to be my hostage, Queen Esma?

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaAngry&$$@Left@$Adena, fall back. The rest of you, too.
Sheathe your swords.

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Left@$And Astrid. Unless you want her blood all
over the deck, drop your sword. Now!
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$...
$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSerious&$$@Left@$Lady Astrid...

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$...We have no choice.
Let's do as he says.
$#LudmillaSwimsuit(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSwimsuitSerious&$$@Left@$...Understood.

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSerious&$$@Right@$Right. That's the knights taken care of.
Now for the pirate scum.

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaCommand&$$@Left@$Hah! If you think we care about some
Queen, you got another thing coming—
$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Right@$...
$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSurprise&$$@Left@$Huh?! Hey, Cap'n, what the—!

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Right@$...If the Queen of Laomis dies, the Navy
will hunt us to the ends of Erden.

$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSurprise&$$@Left@$Huh? Why?!
Well, if you say so, Cap'n...

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Right@$We'll have nowhere to run. Put down your
weapon for now, Adena.
$#Adena(Adena)#$$&AdenaSerious&$$@Left@$Uh, well... Yeah, sure, if ya say so, Cap'n.
$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Right@$Ha... Haha! How interesting.
$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Right@$I never thought the terror of the seas, Dargarossa, was so soft.
$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSerious&$$@Right@$But I still have a bone to pick with you.
You've stolen a lot of my shipments!

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSerious&$$@Right@$Lock up the Queen and the pirates in a
stateroom. The good Commander, too.
$#Crew(Crew)#$Sir!
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$@Right@$You varlet...!

$#Lord Bonnett(Lord Bonnett)#$$&LordBonnettSerious&$$@Left@$C-come now, Robert. What is the meaning
of—
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitAngry&$$@Right@$Are you surrendering? A fine idea!

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSerious&$$@Right@$Father, stop your dithering already.
It's unsightly.

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSmug&$$@Right@$I'm leading House Bonnett to wealth we've
never dreamed of. You just watch me.

$#Lord Bonnett(Lord Bonnett)#$$&LordBonnettSerious&$$@Left@$O-oh...yes, well, indeed.
I suppose I'll do just that.
$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSerious&$$@Right@$Sir Robert, you...

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSerious&$$@Left@$Queen Esma, I hope you'll take this time
to consider what you do next.

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSerious&$$@Left@$Marry me, and hand over your country's
treasure with a minimum of fuss...

$#Robert(Robert)#$$&RobertSerious&$$@Left@$Or resist, and force me to ransom you for
all your country is worth. Think it over.
$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSerious&$$@Right@$...

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitGrit&$$@Right@$(Ugh...not only are we being imprisoned,
but shackled, too?)
$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaAngry&$$@Left@$Hah. Don't make me laugh.
Where's your Captain?

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$(That the Queen is safe is the one silver
lining to this situation. But...)
$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$...

$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitTsun&$$@Right@$(Being locked up in here with this...
Thing...)
$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSad&$$@Left@$...Forgive me.
$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Right@$...For what?

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSad&$$@Left@$I got you involved in another of my messes,
just like before...
$#AstridSwimsuit(Astrid)#$$&AstridSwimsuitSurprise&$$@Right@$(Before? What is she talking about?)

$#Dargarossa(Dargarossa)#$$&DargarossaSerious&$$@Left@$...Don't worry about it. I got myself
involved, not you.

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSad&$$@Right@$But if it were not for me, you would have
been able to escape.

$#Esma(Esma)#$$&EsmaSad&$$@Right@$No, if I had only had more sense, none of
this would have happened at all.
Red Dragon's Vacation

keys.DescriptionKey:
This unit cannot be defeated by damage from Burn status effects.

This unit cannot be Stunned if any ally on the battlefield is burning.

While all enemies on the battlefield are burning, this unit has 0.5x of their original Attack added to their Attack. This does stack on top of Enrage effects, and other Attack increases (e.g. 1.5x + 0.5x => 2.0x total)

At the end of each of this unit's turns, all burning enemies on the battlefield will be stunned for 25TU.

Each time this unit damages a burning enemy with an attack, a random burning ally will have their TU reduced to 0 at the end of the turn. This cannot trigger unless there are 2 burning allies on the battlefield.

Each time an ally unit damages an enemy with an attack, this unit will gain a Charge. If that enemy was burning, a random ally will be granted Piercing. A unit with Piercing will have their Attacks ignore enemy damage reduction effects until the end of their next turn. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store up to 3 charges and all charges are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield.

keys.DescriptionKey: Northerners warn travelers about the Grenzor, ancient beasts that must keep a fire burning deep in their hearts. They do so by devouring the warm, still beating hearts of others—the bigger the better. Though they prefer larger prey, when this becomes scarce, no living creatures, including people, are safe from them.

keys.DescriptionKey: Grenzor are known for grabbing travelers during snowstorms. Despite their size, they are surprisingly stealthy. As such, very little else is known about these predators, though they are commonly referenced in folklore of the north, including many stories to discourage children from misbehaving. When someone goes missing there, the locals automatically assume that they have fallen prey to a ravenous Grenzor.

Taotie02.name: Grenzor
Taotie02.title: Scourge of the Hinterlands
Taotie02.description: Grenzor are known for grabbing travelers during snowstorms. Despite their size, they are surprisingly stealthy. As such, very little else is known about these predators, though they are commonly referenced in folklore of the north, including many stories to discourage children from misbehaving. When someone goes missing there, the locals automatically assume that they have fallen prey to a ravenous Grenzor.

keys.DescriptionKey: Despite the danger they pose, the Grenzor are deeply respected by inhabitants of the far north. They believe that during a Pandemonium, the Grenzor prey just as much on the Eternal's hordes as they do on innocent travellers, acting as guardians of the land against tides of demons and frenzied monsters. No one knows for sure if this really is the case, but it is true that the northeastern regions have suffered far less during prior Pandemoniums than other areas.

keys.DescriptionKey: The user Taunts 1 enemy. On the taunted unit's turns, the user will become a Guardian, and cannot be defeated on those turns. This taunt will end when the taunted unit deals damage to the user with an attack, or if either the user or the taunted unit leaves the battlefield. For any enemy attack that would hit 1 or 2 other allies while the user is a Guardian, 1 of the hits is instead redirected to the user. The user will not redirect skills that don't deal damage. The user will no longer be considered a Guardian when the taunt ends, so some active skill effects that target Guardians may fail to affect the user. This skill becomes locked after use until the user activates another active skill, and cannot be used if any enemy is already taunted.

keys.value: This is the <color=#ffa500ff>Team Management</color> screen.

<color=#ffa500ff>Weapons</color> and <color=#ffa500ff>characters</color> have a <color=#ffa500ff>cost</color>. The more powerful they are, the higher the <color=#ffa500ff>cost</color> to put them in your <color=#ffa500ff>team</color>.
You won't be able to save your team if the <color=#ffa500ff>cost</color> is too high.
You can increase your <color=#ffa500ff>cost limit</color> by increasing your <color=#ffa500ff>Hero Rank</color>.
<color=#ffa500ff>Accessories</color> can be attached to any <color=#ffa500ff>character</color>, and have no <color=#ffa500ff>cost</color>.
You can manage your <color=#ffa500ff>Characters, Weapons, and Accessories</color> here.
Drag <color=#ffa500ff>characters</color> to here to add them to your <color=#ffa500ff>team</color>.
You can view a character's <color=#ffa500ff>information</color> by clicking this button.
Here you can see the character's <color=#ffa500ff>Active Skills</color> and <color=#ffa500ff>Passive Skills</color>.
You can equip <color=#ffa500ff>weapons</color> by clicking on the <color=#ffa500ff>Weapons Tab</color>.
Drag <color=#ffa500ff>weapons</color> from here to here to <color=#ffa500ff>equip</color> them to a <color=#ffa500ff>character</color>.
<color=#ffa500ff>Weapons</color> with a yellow icon can go into yellow slots. <color=#ffa500ff>Weapons</color> with a red icon can go into red slots
<color=#ffa500ff>Weapons</color> can increase a <color=#ffa500ff>character's HP and ATK</color>.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Heals all allies for 800% of the user's Attack and Purifies them. Allies other than the user also become Enraged, having their attack increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn, and their current TU is reduced by 50 if their current TU is 50 or more.

This skill becomes locked for 200TU after use. While this skill is locked, allies cannot enter the battlefield from reinforcements. When any unit gets the turn after this lock expires, the lowest TU enemy will be stunned for 50TU, and then the user will be Purified (even if sleeping) and get the next turn by having their TU reduced to 0. This extra turn may be interrupted by other effects that influence the turn order (e.g. other stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

keys.DescriptionKey: Tevis adventures for research—he is studying a theory that says healers are inherently more self-sacrificing than other warriors, studying why healing magic for some reason trends toward martyrdom. Against all his wishes, he has managed to accrue a massive following of healers all over Erden, fascinated with his studies and practices. He's unintentionally inspired a new school of healer, which praises self-sacrifice.

keys.DescriptionKey: When the Empire came and took away everything he had, Theo didn't give in to despair. Here, among the charred ruins of his hometown—the place where they once led such peaceful lives—he makes his vow. To protect the white flowers that started blooming here again. To become a full-fledged Blue Dragon Knight, one that can defend his beloved sister.

TheoRegular01.name: Theo
TheoRegular01.title: Cerulean Sorcerer
TheoRegular01.description: When the Empire came and took away everything he had, Theo didn't give in to despair. Here, among the charred ruins of his hometown—the place where they once led such peaceful lives—he makes his vow. To protect the white flowers that started blooming here again. To become a full-fledged Blue Dragon Knight, one that can defend his beloved sister.

keys.IntroText:
I've decided to become stronger!
I don't want to lose anyone ever again...

keys.DescriptionKey: When Rizette comes home after carrying out all her daily duties—securing food supplies, maintaining order in the neighboring villages, recruiting new Blue Dragon Knights, scouting the territory ocuppied by Bergarian forces—Theo always waits for her with a homemade meal. In his hands even the plainest ingredients turn into the finest cuisine. "I'm sorry I can't do much more yet," he says modestly, and Rizette's heart swells with pride.

TheoRegular02.title: Cerulean Sorcerer
TheoRegular02.description: When Rizette comes home after carrying out all her daily duties—securing food supplies, maintaining order in the neighboring villages, recruiting new Blue Dragon Knights, scouting the territory ocuppied by Bergarian forces—Theo always waits for her with a homemade meal. In his hands even the plainest ingredients turn into the finest cuisine. "I'm sorry I can't do much more yet," he says modestly, and Rizette's heart swells with pride.

keys.DescriptionKey:
After Rizette leaves in the morning, Theo quietly devotes himself to his training. A particular memory always keeps him company—the memory of a man who showed him kindness, even if in a stiff, awkward way; a man who set out to be a hero and put his life on the line in order to atone for his past crimes. 
Every day, Theo strives to get a little stronger, so that he can keep his legacy alive.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2053|$And he tries new things all the time so
you never get sick of anything.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGentleSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2054|$Heh heh...
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2055|$What are you looking so smug about?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2056|$Rizette loves it when people praise Theo.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2057|$The sziviik eat most things raw, so our
meals aren't usually this intricate.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2058|$The kud used to be like that too, but we
adopted a lot from other countries.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2059|$My favorites are the sweets!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2060|$We bikki brought our cuisine with us when
we travelled west.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$A lot of our dishes have become popular
among other races, particularly humans.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2061|$Yes, I'm quite fond of Eastland cuisine.
Especially sashimi.
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2045|$This soup...

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2062|$I've always wanted to try cooking with fish
from the ocean.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2063|$If Theo is this good of a cook, surely you
must also be quite skilled, Rizette?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2064|$I'm nowhere near as good as Theo, but I
help sometimes.

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2065|$Riz has a keen sense of smell and taste,
so she helps me adjust the flavor.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2066|$Cooking, huh...I cooked a lot back home,
but I'm not a chef or anything.

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2067|$Are you sure Gilgan will be okay without
you? He may be drowning his sorrows.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaGrit&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2068|$No, he told me to go, after all. But you're
right! I'll send him lots of letters.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2069|$I have never cooked meals, myself, but...
I am fond of baking cakes and cookies.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2070|$Cakes...!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2071|$Cookies!
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2046|$It's amazing!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurpriseBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2072|$I-I suppose I could make some for you some
time...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act4.Voices/mst2073|$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2074|$(Huh? Why is the Captain backing away?)

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2075|$What kind of things do you like to cook,
Captain?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2076|$I...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2077|$I respect the cuisines of all peoples. Eating
is an important part of life.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2078|$In fact, I believe that it is the highest form
of training for all living beings!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2079|$O-Oh! Um, sure?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2080|$I don't think you should have asked that,
Theo.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2081|$Captain, you are clearly avoiding the
question.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2047|$Mm, so good! I can feel my strength
returning already.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2082|$B-Break time is over! Prepare to move out!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2048|$Theo, this is delicious.

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2049|$Your cooking alone is enough to make me
glad to have joined this unit again.
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2050|$Thanks everyone! I'm just glad you like it!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2051|$Theo tailors each dish he makes to the
person who will eat it, doesn't he?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2052|$Such compassion!

keys.DescriptionKey: This spear bears no ornamentation to draw the eye. It wasn't forged from dragonbone or star iron, and no legendary smith shaped it. But ornamentation weighs a wielder down, and talk of legends breeds dependence, or overconfidence. This is a spear stripped down to its most essential form: a weapon meant for killing, which it does very, very well.

keys.value:
$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaNEWHehHapy&$$@Center@$By Odin's might—let my war-flames
cleanse the field!
$#AesirA;HumanA;(Aesir & Humans)#$$&Enforcer;HumanA.MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left;;;HumanA.Right;@$Oooooaah!!
$#Ruvi(Ruvi)#$$&RuviShouting&$$@Center@$You—!!
$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorCrazyGentle&$$@Center@$You're in the way...
$#Ruvi(Ruvi)#$$&RuviHurt&$$@Center@$Nnh... Aah...

$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorCrazyGentle&$$@Center@$I'll save the strong ones for later, so I won't
kill you yet.
$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorCrazySmile&$$@Center@$I want a lot. Lots and lots and lots...
$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorCrazySmile&$$@Center@$Of death.
$#Prisoners(Prisoners)#$$!-1!$Aaaaah!
$#Prisoners(Prisoners)#$Arg... Grh...
$#Prisoners(Prisoners)#$Noooo... Urg!!

$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorCrazyHappy&$$@Center@$Amazing, amazing, so much death. Red
succulent blood and pretty white bones!
$#GiantMan(Giant Soldier A)#$$&Golem&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ngh... You darting pests!! You rabble—!!
$#Thor(Thor)#$$@Center@$Many! So many!

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusWorried&$$!-1!$$@Right@$She's beyond handling. Hey, Callen. You
alive?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunHurt&$$@Left@$S-Somehow...
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Then get the survivors out. Use another exit.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$But what about her...
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHeh&$$@Center@$I will handle it. I am a goddess, you know.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$I can trust you with this?

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$@Center@$Yep, it's fine. I'm also interested in the
greedy type.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$Ruvi, are you okay?

$#Ruvi(Ruvi)#$$&RuviSerious&$$@Center@$Yes, I took a nasty one... But I'm fine. And
you, Lady Callen?

$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaNEWSerious&$$@Center@$(We have the upper hand for now... Keep
pressing them and buy time.)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$Same here. We'll leave her to Venus. Let's
get the living out!
$#Ruvi(Ruvi)#$$&RuviSerious&$$@Center@$Understood.
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSmile&$$@Center@$All right then—
$#BeggingPrisoner(Begging Prisoner)#$Eek... S-Stop...

$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorSad&$$@Center@$I think I'm tired of that scream. Try crying
a different way.
$#BeggingPrisoner(Begging Prisoner)#$No... Please no...
$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorCasual&$$@Center@$Nope, failed—goodbye.
$#BeggingPrisoner(Begging Prisoner)#$$%1%$Ngh—aaah...

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSmile&$$@Center@$For someone who wants lots of death, you
look rather bored, mass-murderer.

$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorSmile&$$@Center@$It's rare for someone to come at me. How
do you want to be killed? I'm taking requests.

$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaNEWSerious&$$@Center@$(If we don't have to use that tool, so much
the better!)

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusWorried&$$@Center@$I'm not planning on dying yet. I want lots
of love.

$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorCold&$$@Center@$Aww, and I was going to grant the request
too...
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSmile&$$@Center@$Do you know what love is?

$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorHappySmile&$$@Center@$I do. Love is death. And I love everyone.
So I kill them.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSmile&$$@Center@$I don't hate that understanding. But it's
far too unbalanced.
$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorCold&$$@Center@$Annoying. Die.
$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorSpeak&$$@Center@$You blocked it...!?

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusCold&$$@Center@$Don't make me repeat myself—I'm not
dying any time soon.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusCold&$$@Center@$You're strong, I guess. But I am stronger.
Probably. Chalk it up to experience.
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusCold&$$@Center@$Your love is far too half-baked.

$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaNEWSurprised&$$@Center@$Is that also one of Odin's secret tools? I've
never seen it...
$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorCold&$$@Center@$Mmm, I don't get it.
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$@Center@$I see...

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$@Center@$By the way, you're under Zeus's "Absolute
Command," right?

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$@Center@$All the prisoners ran away. Are you okay
with that?

$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorCasual&$$@Center@$I don't mind. The current order is to
"fight the escapees." As long as I'm
$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorCasual&$$@Center@$fighting, it's fine.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusWorried&$$@Center@$There are lots of gaps in that phrase.
Maybe she was caught on the back foot...
$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorCrazyGentle&$$@Center@$Tell me your name, pleeease.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusTongue&$$@Center@$Venus, the goddess of love. Let's do
something fun.

$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorCrazyGentle&$$@Center@$Sure—after I kill you. With your bones,
blood, and meat!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunNormal&$$@Center@$It's called Valhalla Recall. It returns large
numbers of people to a designated place.
$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorCrazyGentle&$$@Center@$Take this, Venus. Bye-bye.
$#Ruvi(Ruvi)#$$&RuviNormal&$$@Right@$Will Lady Venus be all right?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Left@$We'll bet on that goddess's secrets. For
now, focus on getting everyone out.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(More than half were killed by that murderer...
How terrible...)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$(No, we have to focus on getting the
survivors outside!)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$I'll use the communicator. Ruvi, keep
scanning the surroundings—
$#Ruvi(Ruvi)#$$&RuviNormal&$$@Center@$Understood.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$Hey, can you hear me? Finn! Hellooo!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$Callen? What's the situation?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$Terrible... More than half of them were
killed.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunNormal&$$@Center@$In short, a portable transfer device.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$More than half...? You contacting me must
mean you can't use the Key's passage.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$Yes. We'll enact Plan B. I'm counting on you.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$Roger... Please be careful!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$You too. Stay alive, Finn—
$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$(More than half killed...)

$#DONOTSHOWME(Finn)#$(Something unexpected is happening. All
I can do is get to Asgard!)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$All right—Venus said it was this way.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$The landmark was this big tree... Which
means it's around here...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$There it is. The other door that connects
to Asgard...!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$Small and inconspicuous. Maybe some god
made it as an escape route.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Transfer—as in sending a large number
of people to a set location.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$I'll relay Plan B. We'll use the door Venus
was hiding.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunPokerFaceMouth&$$@Center@$Yes, that goddess was hiding it. She likely
has even more secrets.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSigh&$$@Center@$Well, that doesn't matter now. For Plan B—

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$We'll use it if we get stuck bringing the
prisoners out of Jotunheim.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$Listen—go to Asgard through the door
Venus hid.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$For that, I order you to remain at the base
and not on the battlefield.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$It's an important role. I can't entrust it to
anyone else. Please understand, Finn...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$Also, it might be the most dangerous...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$Once in Asgard, open the door that links
Jotunheim and Asgard.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$Zeus's guards should be guarding the gate.
You'll have to defeat them on your own.
$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaNEWSurprised&$$@Left@$Hmm, and it's a tiny ring...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$Finn, it all comes down to you. I'm counting
on you!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$All right, let's go! This is my mission!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$I'll see it gets done!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$(The door from Jotunheim to Asgard is
likely—)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$(Inside Zeus's temple at the center of the
city...)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$(We'll have to cut straight through the
city...)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$(Given the emergency, there should be
fewer guards...)
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$(But it probably won't go without incident—)
$#Ruvi(Ruvi)#$$&RuviSmile&$$@Center@$Lady Callen, I'm with you. You'll be all right.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunNormal&$$@Center@$Ruvi...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Right@$How do we set the location?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSmile&$$@Center@$You're right—sorry. I let myself get flustered.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunHeh&$$@Center@$Everyone, stay with me just a little longer.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunHeh&$$@Center@$Now, let's go... To Zeus's temple!
$#GiantMan(Giant Soldier A)#$$&Golem&$$@Center@$Aaaah... Gah!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I've already set the point inside the base.
Just press the ring's button and—
$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaNEWShouting&$$@Center@$Teleported in a flash!? It's real!
$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaNEWShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Is there a limit on the headcount?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunDoya&$$@Right@$Shouldn't be. Odin's memories said it
could move an entire nation.
$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaNEWSmile&$$@Left@$Then there is no problem.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunHeh&$$@Right@$Right—those returning will raise a hand,
and at that moment, press the ring's button.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunHeh&$$@Right@$That's all.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunPokerFaceMouth&$$@Right@$Still, it's downright supernatural... I feel
silly explaining it myself...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, and the timing to use this ring.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunNormal&$$@Center@$One is when you judge that further fighting
is too dangerous.

$#GiantSoldierB(Giant Soldier B)#$$!-1!$These flames... What power!! So this is a
god's might—

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunNormal&$$@Center@$And the other—after we've rescued all
prisoners and made it outside Jotunheim.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunNormal&$$@Center@$It seems the ring's effective range lies
outside Jotunheim.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$So we must get out no matter what.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$At that time, we'll have the prisoners
raise their hands, and we'll all return to
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$the base together. That's the plan.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$How do we keep track of time? It'll be difficult
to make eye contact in the heat of battle.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSmile&$$@Right@$With this—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$I remember that... The magic tool we used
at Orka's casino!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunHehHappy&$$@Right@$Exactly!
$#Ruvi(Ruvi)#$$&RuviNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Orka, huh...

$#GiantSoldierC(Giant Soldier C)#$Don't be pushed back! We must protect
those behind us!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Come to think of it, you were there too, Ruvi.
But you didn't go into the casino...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunDoya&$$@Left@$She flew off to a neighboring island, if I
recall. Nostalgic.

$#Ruvi(Ruvi)#$$&RuviAngry&$$@Right@$That was...a strategic retreat... I couldn't
stay long among those yo-ster people!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunTroubled&$$@Left@$Yo-ster people, huh. True—their vibe
was...unique.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Let's skip the reminiscing. With this tool,
we can communicate from afar.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSmile&$$@Right@$Freya, Finn, and we will each carry one.
So we can speak no matter where we are.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Good. These comms will be the linchpin of
our strategy...
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSmile&$$@Center@$Don't you dare forget!
$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaNEWClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(Is there no message yet...!?)

$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaNEWSerious&$$@Center@$(Seems the prisoners haven't made it out
of Jotunheim.)
$#GiantMan(Giant Soldier A)#$$@Center@$Arrrggh... Even if my bones melt!!

$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaNEWSerious&$$@Center@$(Everyone, hold on just a little longer! It'll
work, surely it will—)
$#Voiceheardfromafar(Voice heard from afar)#$$!-1!$Oblivion Blast
$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaNEWSurprised&$$@Center@$!!
$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaNEWSerious&$$@Center@$So you made it, Zeus...
$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorGentleSmile&$$@Center@$Hmm, which one's next... I can't decide.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusTongue&$$@Center@$An uninvited guest—but I'll overlook that,
given those eyes starving for love.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Venus, get everyone out of here! You can
do it, right?

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusWink&$$@Right@$Moving the scattered wounded all at once—
mmm, probably impossible.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Left@$This isn't the time for jokes!

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusBoo&$$@Right@$I'm not joking. Not really. If I show even
the slightest sign of retreat, that girl will
$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaNEWSurprised&$$@Center@$(What spirit... Is this a giant's true strength!?)
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusBoo&$$@Right@$kill me without a second thought.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusWorried&$$@Right@$I could escape alone, but taking others
with me is impossible.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(That one is abnormal... I understand Venus's point...)

$#Ruvi(Ruvi)#$$&RuviNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Lady Callen, this isn't good! Too few here
can fight!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Left@$I know...
$#FleeingPrisoners(Fleeing Prisoners)#$$!-1!$Eek... D-Don't come over here!
$#Thor(Thor)#$$&ThorCrazySmile&$$@Center@$Hehehe...
