$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunIrritate&$$@Center@$"Tiny" is unnecessary!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Why are you in this world again, Callen?
I heard you were off on a field survey up north.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunDoya&$$@Center@$Yes, I was investigating a rampaging dragon
on Astrid's orders.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunDoya&$$@Center@$But, I'm an excellent scientist, so I finished
quickly.
$#Ruvi(Ruvi)#$$&RuviDragonPillar&$$@Left@$Krrrr!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$Then I stopped by that monument and was
shocked! They were making a fuss that
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSerious&$$@Center@$Rizette had vanished.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHeh&$$@Center@$Even the Eye of All Laws can't read
people's hearts, right?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunPokerFace&$$@Center@$While I was examining them, the monument
started glowing on its own.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunPokerFace&$$@Center@$An unforeseen development...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunHehHappy&$$@Center@$Still, since I managed to link up with Finn,
all's well that ends well.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Wait—Rizette vanished!? You mean, she
came to this world?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunNormal&$$@Right@$Which means you haven't met her yet,
have you?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$I haven't...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Zeus mentioned Rizette's name. So I thought
it might be possible...)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunPokerFaceMouth&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Asgard was empty; I wonder where she
could be.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$That's right—if she came through that door,
then she was in Asgard!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSmile&$$@Right@$That's true. And there, I met this—

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusExcited&$$@Center@$So this is that memory device...
Hmmm, if I do this and this... It works!

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusWorried&$$!-1!$$@Left@$(Callen—remember, we promised not to
talk about our meeting!)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSurprised&$$@Right@$(Ah, you said you slipped out, didn't you?
Honestly, you goddesses are troublesome...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What are you whispering with Venus about,
Callen?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunTroubled&$$@Right@$Sh-She gave me some tasty sweets!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunPokerFaceMouth&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, right—more importantly, I heard
from Theo.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunPokerFaceMouth&$$@Center@$Finn! I heard you apparently ditched a
festival date!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Uh, ah... That... I'm sorry...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunPokerFaceMouth&$$@Right@$I thought you were the type to keep promises,
unlike that Rody...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunPokerFaceMouth&$$@Right@$Make sure you speak with Rizette directly
when saying sorry!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Yeah, you're right...

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHehTongue&$$@Center@$Hehe, so that's how it is.
And this one here...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Did...my father also break promises?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunPokerFace&$$@Right@$No, he wasn't that frivolous...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunPokerFace&$$!-1!$$@Center@$But he was the kind to be off adventuring
instead of holding you as a baby.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunPokerFace&$$@Center@$Yuki, Alira, and I really tore into him for
that...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Center@$I see. So, I'm like my father.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSurprised&$$@Center@$Hey! Why are you grinning!?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunIrritate&$$@Center@$Gah, men who live for adventure, I swear!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunLookaway&$$@Center@$Never make a girl cry, Finn!
Though it seems you're doing that right now...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Center@$No, I don't think that's true!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunTroubled&$$@Center@$(Rody, your boy is truly your boy...)
$#SuddenScream(Sudden Scream)#$Ouch!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$More importantly, Callen—what's with
that outfit—?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunDoya&$$@Right@$This? I borrowed a few things when I visited
Odin's room.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunHehHappy&$$@Right@$Hehehe... I can't wait to analyze them
when we get back.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSmile&$$@Right@$Oh, and I brought these too.
They looked useful.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$I've never seen these before...
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHeh&$$@Right@$They're Odin's secret gadgets. Super handy.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$I see... So these are also Odin's...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Hm? How do you know that, Venus?
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSurprised&$$@Right@$Uh... Ah!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(This goddess done dug her own grave.)
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$W-Whoa, you scared me! Who are you?
$#Ruvi(Ruvi)#$$&RuviDragonPillar&$$@Left@$Krrr...

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusWorried&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Eek, even the little dragon's giving me that
look... Loki explained it to me ages ago,
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusWorried&$$@Right@$that's all!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$You heard from Loki, huh. You two did
look pretty close, all things considered.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusWink&$$@Right@$Yeah, yeah, totally. It's lovely when people
get along.
$#Ruvi(Ruvi)#$$&RuviDragonPillar&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Kr...?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunTroubled&$$@Center@$(So many slips of the tongue... Well, doesn't
really matter.)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Now, let me explain these tools. The most
promising one right now is this round thing.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSmile&$$@Right@$That one—if I recall—was called the
Yggdrasil Core.
$#FreyaGigant(Freya)#$$&FreyaShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The Yggdrasil Core, you say!?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenPokerFace&$$@Center@$Owow! My precious ear got caught... Ouch.
You need to keep this place tidier, hmph...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$What's wrong, Freya?
$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaHappy&$$@Left@$I've heard of that name from Odin!

$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaHappy&$$@Left@$She said it was too dangerous to test—but
that it would surely make you stronger.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSmile&$$@Right@$I think Loki said something like that too.
It instantly maxes out your potential.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Even with no training or practice, huh...
That's incredible...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$But artifacts like this are far too dangerous.
I brought it as a last resort.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$But if it works, it could turn the tide.

$#FreyaGigant(Freya)#$$&FreyaLaugh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Then I shall try it! I've been curious for
quite some time!

$#AesirA(Aesir A)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Center@$No, there's no need for you to use it, Lady
Freya... What if something happens!

$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaLaugh&$$@Center@$If that time comes, so be it.
How does it work—bah, like this!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprised&$$@Right@$Hm? And who are you—?
$#AesirB(Aesir B)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Center@$Lady Freya, that's far too reckless!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenGunSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Stop! If you use it like that—!
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$@Right@$Uh-oh, this could be bad.
$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ng... Ooooooooohhhh!!?
$#FreyaNEWGigant(Freya)#$$&FreyaNEWLaugh&$$@Center@$Ha... Haha, hahahahaha!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$I-Is this... A success...?

$#FreyaNEW(Freya)#$$&FreyaNEWHeh&$$@Center@$This is it, I feel the power budding,
pulsing from deep in my viscera!

$#FreyaNEW(Freya)#$$&FreyaNEWLaugh&$$@Center@$Behold the birth of New Freya—
Hahahaha!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(I swear I can feel power radiating from
her just by her standing here...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Does it hurt or anything?

keys.DescriptionKey:
Before the Bergarian Emperor rose to power, tribal warlords vied for control of the Northland continent. The most legendary was a man called Sven Stormlord, who led a fleet of ships so fearsome the northern ice split before them.

At the height of his conquest, the Primordial of Storms chose him as his Avatar and gifted him a hammer worthy of a god. They say Sven never died but sails through the heavens still, battering Erden's enemies with the fury of thunder.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Heals all non-burning allies for 10% of their max HP and grants them Sleep Thorns. When an ally with Sleep Thorns is dealt damage by an attack, that ally's Sleep Thorns will be consumed to immediately grant the Cursed Sleep status effect to the attacker. Burn or attacks that grant Burn will remove Sleep Thorns and prevent Cursed Sleep from applying. Usable if there are no Sleep Thorns on allies and the user is not burning.

Cursed Sleep will overwrite status effects other than Burn, cannot be overwritten by Poison, can be applied repeatedly to units that have already slept while on the battlefield, and will not end from damage caused by Dream Hunter type active skills.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Activates Time Freeze For 100TU. While Time Freeze is active, the user:
- Cannot be defeated by Poison or Burn damage (including Lethal Poison).
- Is immune to Poison, and Burn status effects.
- Has their Active Skill TU Costs reduced by 50%. This does not stack with Quicken effects.
- Disables the Active Skills of all other units on the battlefield (including new units that enter from reinforcements).

When Time Freeze expires, all allies will be healed for 10% of max HP and be Purified (any negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed), and all non-boss enemies on the battlefield that are below 10% of their max HP will be immediately defeated (the user is considered to have defeated those enemies with an attack) . This effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the enemy from being defeated.

Usable once per battle. The effects of Time Freeze cannot be Purified and will be cancelled if the user is defeated. When a unit's Active Skills are disabled and they get the turn, they will lose the turn as if they were sleeping.
keys.SelectedKey: Other units Active Skills are Disabled

TimeStopAChronosRegularBoss.name: Time Freeze
TimeStopAChronosRegularBoss.description:
Activates Time Freeze For 100TU. While Time Freeze is active, the user:
- Cannot be defeated by Poison or Burn damage (including Lethal Poison).
- Is immune to Poison, and Burn status effects.
- Has their Active Skill TU Costs reduced by 50%. This does not stack with Quicken effects.
- Disables the Active Skills of all other units on the battlefield (including new units that enter from reinforcements).

When Time Freeze expires, all allies will be healed for 10% of max HP and be Purified (any negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed), and all non-boss enemies on the battlefield that are below 10% of their max HP will be immediately defeated (the user is considered to have defeated those enemies with an attack) . keys.DescriptionKey:
Deep within the northernmost mountains of Bergaria, an order of secretive priestesses makes their home. Few know of their existence, and even fewer could locate them if pressed. Long ago, Chronos herself gifted their ancestors with power over time, a gift she bestowed only on them. If time magic were to spread among the peoples of Erden, history itself could dissolve into a meaningless paradox.

And so it is the priestesses' duty to watch the flow of time, ever neutral, ever detached from the world. It is a peaceful life, free of worry. Few acolytes find reason to complain.

But Gemina's curiosity was much too great to let her remain an observer.

TimeWitch01.name: Gemina
TimeWitch01.title: Devoted Timekeeper
TimeWitch01.description:
Deep within the northernmost mountains of Bergaria, an order of secretive priestesses makes their home. Few know of their existence, and even fewer could locate them if pressed. Long ago, Chronos herself gifted their ancestors with power over time, a gift she bestowed only on them. If time magic were to spread among the peoples of Erden, history itself could dissolve into a meaningless paradox.

And so it is the priestesses' duty to watch the flow of time, ever neutral, ever detached from the world. It is a peaceful life, free of worry. Few acolytes find reason to complain.

But Gemina's curiosity was much too great to let her remain an observer.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Gemina heard legends as she was growing up. Cautionary tales of a priestesses who ran from the temple and caused untold disaster. Her elders used their tragic fates to scare the acolytes into compliance. Gemina, however, would not be swayed.

She understood the importance of her order's neutrality. Those trusted to oversee time itself had a great responsibility, greater than most in Erden would ever have to face. But how could the guardians of history perform their duty if the world was nothing to them but a collection of sad stories?

That is why she ran away. Gemina escaped the priestesses' temple not to defile her duty, but to embrace its truest purpose.

keys.value: $#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2420|$Haaaaargh!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurtRed&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2429|$Elmina! Where is she!?

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaGrit&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2430|$Grr... I'm not sure, she diffused her magic
again!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteGritBlue&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2431|$Did she run!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2432|$No, we nearly had her!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2433|$She's wounded, though. Even if she's an
Aeon Lord, she'll still need time to recover.

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaCommand&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2434|$Let's head to the cells, Cap! This is our
chance to free the elves!
$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkHurt&$$@Center@$$%0.5%$$|act4.Voices/mst2421|$Urgh!!

$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkSad&$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2422|$That Crimson Crest is way stronger 
than in the last report... Maaaan...

$#Elmina(Elmina)#$$&ElminaSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2423|$Finn's eyes... They're giving off a huge
amount of magical power!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2424|$So this is the power of the Crimson Crest...!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2425|$Captain, your plan to go straight for the
ringleader worked!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2426|$We couldn't have done it without Elmina.
$#Gyurelle(Gyurelle)#$$&GyurelleDarkRage&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2427|$You think you can beat me just like that? No chance in hell!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurtRed&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2428|$Urgh, my eyes!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGrit&$$|act0.Voices/mst31|$!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$But those wounds... You're badly hurt!
What happened to you?

$#Rizette(Girl)#$$&RizetteDamagedUpset&$$@Right@$I'm sorry, there's no time to explain.
We have to get out of here.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Why? What's wrong?

$#Rizette(Girl)#$$&RizetteDamagedUpset&$$@Right@$The monster... It attacked our village.
My friends, my family, they're all dead!

$#Rizette(Girl)#$$&RizetteDamagedUpset&$$@Right@$We have to get away
before it kills us too!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Okay, my village is just north of here.
We'll go there and get you patched up.
$#Rizette(Girl)#$$&RizetteDamagedSurprised&$$@Right@$What do you mean a village north of here?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Yeah, it's where I live. The name's Finn.
Here, lean on my shoulder.
$#Rizette(Girl)#$$&RizetteDamagedGentleSmile&$$@Right@$I'm Rizette. Thank you, Finn.

$#Rizette(Girl)#$$&RizetteDamagedScared&$$@Right@$But I'll be okay to run on my own.
If we're not quick it'll catch up to us...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$H-hey, are you all right!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Okay. Let's go!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedWorried&$$@Right@$(Once we get out of here
we'll meet up again in Rigland.)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteDamagedWorried&$$@Right@$(Forgive me, Theo.
I hope you make it out okay!)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Center@$Such terrible wounds!
$#Rizette(Girl)#$$&RizetteDamagedHurt&$$@Center@$W-where am I?

$#Rizette(Girl)#$$&RizetteDamagedHurt&$$@Center@$I think...I fell unconscious...
Nngh...!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$@Center@$It's okay! Don't push yourself!
I'll call for help!
$#Rizette(Girl)#$$&RizetteDamagedHurt&$$@Center@$It's okay, I can stand. Thank you.

$#Rizette(Girl)#$$&RizetteDamagedWorried&$$@Right@$Have you seen my brother?
He looks just like me, but he's shorter...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$I'm sorry, I haven't seen anyone like that.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|act1.Voices/mst271|$The Proving Grounds are northeast of
Rigland. I will accompany you as a proctor.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Your mission is to the north of Rigland,
just as the commander said.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$You risked your life for people
you'd only just met. Of course I trust you!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$You are too kind.
You really do have a good heart.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$May you be successful in your trial.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$The dungeon is a remnant of an ancient,
unknown civilization.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$The place is secured with Sentinel Stones.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$It's not too difficult, you'll do fine.
It's just a proving grounds for new recruits.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Don't worry about Rizette.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$I'll look for Theo with her and make sure 
she stays out of trouble.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$I hope you'll trust me,

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaGrit&$$@Left@$though I was nothing short of pathetic
during our last fight together...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Don't say that!
You did your best to protect us!
$#Knight A(Knight A)#$$|act5.Voices/mst3373|$There it is!

$#Knight B(Knight B)#$$|act5.Voices/mst3374|$No doubt. It's just like the folks in
Silverlodge said.

$#Knight A(Knight A)#$$|act5.Voices/mst3375|$They also said there was nothing here half
a year ago.

$#Knight A(Knight A)#$$|act5.Voices/mst3376|$So where in Erden did that tower come
from!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise;Rizette.RizetteSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Rizette.Right;@$$|act4.Voices/mst2189|$Astrid and Mysha use every spare moment

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2190|$It looks tough to have so many teachers

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2191|$But they look like they're having fun!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious;Nagi.NagiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Nagi.Right;@$$|act4.Voices/mst2192|$Astrid, you need to trust your instincts.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2193|$You are well versed in the military
tactics of the Red Dragon Knights.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$Now you just need to put them into action
in real combat.
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsunBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2194|$...Thank you for your advice.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious;Mysha.MyshaGrit&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Mysha.Right;@$$|act4.Voices/mst2195|$Mysha, your techniques are quite polished.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$What you need is strength and stamina—
in other words, training!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaAngry&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2196|$Thanks, Captain! Teach me more...
Uh, ma'am!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Center@$$%1.5%$$|act4.Voices/mst2182|$Ha! Ya! Ha!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh;Rizette.RizetteCalm&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Rizette.Right;@$$|act4.Voices/mst2197|$We'd better stop lazing about.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHeh&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2198|$We can't let the newer members show us
up!

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHeh;Mysha.MyshaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Mysha.Right;@$$|act4.Voices/mst2199|$I think perhaps I awakened my inner
warrior in Lu'Ganan.

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2200|$I know it was some bad stuff, but it felt
good to really go all-out. In a weird way!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2201|$Finn. Duel me.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2202|$Wh-What? Why?

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2203|$If I crush... I mean, if I cross blades with
you...

$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridTsun&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$I'll remember how I felt in Lu'Ganan and
make greater strides in my training!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2204|$Did you just say crush!?

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaHeh&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2205|$Oh, hey, yeah!
Then I'll fight Ga'Luga!
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaShouting&$$@Center@$$%1.5%$$|act4.Voices/mst2183|$Yah! Hah!!

$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2206|$Knock some sense into these uppity
softscales, Brother.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2207|$Alone!?
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaSleep&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2208|$My weapon is not suited for sparring.
$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaAngry&$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2209|$Come on, Finn!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridAngry&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2210|$We'll get revenge for the ruins!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2211|$Two on one!?
$#Astrid;Mysha;(Astrid & Mysha)#$$&AstridAngry;Mysha.MyshaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Mysha.Right;@$$|act4.Voices/mst2212|$En garde!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2213|$Waaaah!?
$#GaLuga(Ga'Luga)#$$&GaLugaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2184|$Astrid, don't hesitate!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2185|$Your enemies will use it against you!
$#Astrid(Astrid)#$$&AstridHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act4.Voices/mst2186|$I didn't even notice I did that...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$!-1!$$@Left@$$|act4.Voices/mst2187|$Mysha, you focus too much on your blade.
Be more conscious of your own body.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaCommand&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$Always be aware of where you are in
relation to your opponent!

$#Mysha(Mysha)#$$&MyshaTroubled&$$@Right@$$|act4.Voices/mst2188|$Oh, right...
Gramps always says the same thing...

If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

This unit enters battle with a Frostburn Ward, and Stun Ward. After entering the battlefield, this unit heals for 100% of max HP at the start of every turn (ally or enemy) for 100TU.

This unit is Fortified, and will immediately get the turn by having its TU reduced to 0. These effects are all triggered whenever this unit enters the battlefield from reinforcements.

While this unit is on the battlefield, the first time another non-conjured unit on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, so long as this unit is not defeated or sacrificed at the same time:
- this unit will be Purified (any negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed).
- add another Dracula to the next in line of allied reinforcements. This Dracula's Level, Limit Breaks, Awakenings, Boosts, Potential, Mastery, Weapon and Accessory will match this unit.

A Fortified unit has 50% damage reduction from attacks. This reduction cannot be ignored by attacks that do not specifically ignore Fortify. Fortify will be removed after reducing damage 3 times since applying, and will be reset if reapplied. This is not a status effect.

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainNormal&$$@Right@$Let's hear your reports. Gareth, what's
the situation in the town?
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Stopping the March should be our priority.

$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$In Gagokhalkis, I was able to use my power
to heal people touched by the curse...

$#DevenKnightA(Deven Knight)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Right@$How many? The number of people joining
the March every day is overwhelming.

$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalLookAway&$$@Left@$A snowball effect... Well, it is to be
expected, when you think about it.

$#DevenKnightA(Deven Knight)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$!-1!$$@Center@$As a last resort, we plan to shoot arrows at
those who fall into the ditch.

$#DevenKnightA(Deven Knight)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Center@$We'd rather not crush what little remains
of our conscience, though.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Yes, please... Let's do what we can to help
them!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$We have to save as many people as possible.
$#DevenKnightA(Deven Knight)#$$&CamelotSoldierNoCape&$$@Center@$Of course. We will do our utmost.

$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$Heh, give it a try if you want. See how it
ends for you.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(A moat, huh... It does sound like a good
way to trap a mindless mob.)

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSerious&$$@Center@$Then we have no choice but to defeat King
Arthur.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(But Mordred is right, there's no
guarantee it'll work.)
$#()#$Heeey!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$I know that voice...
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleGrin&$$@Center@$There you are, Finn!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$Mikaela!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneHappy&$$@Center@$Finn! It's so good to see you!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$Jeanne! I'm happy to see you too!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$For us to meet in such a place, it must be
divine guidance.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$I guess I can't argue when you're the one
saying it.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$But how did you end up here in Deven?

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSerious&$$@Center@$Or persuade her to stop, if that's even
possible.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneTroubled&$$@Right@$Well, you see—

$#CitizenofDevenA(Citizen of Deven A)#$$!-1!$Oh, you're friends with these ladies?
They saved us!

$#CitizenofDevenB(Citizen of Deven B)#$We got attacked by monsters in the woods,
and then these two saints appeared
$#CitizenofDevenB(Citizen of Deven B)#$out of nowhere to defend us.

$#CitizenofDevenA(Citizen of Deven A)#$We wanted to treat them to something special
as a thanks, so we brought them here.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$I see... Wait, Mikaela, weren't you invisible
to regular people?

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I am. That's the other "saint" they're talking
about.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$@Right@$Finn, let me introduce you. This is
Excalibur.
$#Excalibur(Excalibur)#$$&ExcaliburNormalOpen&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ah. Of course. Finn.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprisedBlush&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You know each other?

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSadComical&$$@Center@$I doubt it. Considering everything she's
done, I don't think we can reason with her.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Um, no. I've never seen her before.
$#Excalibur(Excalibur)#$$&ExcaliburNormalOpen&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Bearer of the Crest.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$How do you know about that!?
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Left@$Are you sure you don't know her?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneNormal&$$@Right@$She seems to know you.
$#Excalibur(Excalibur)#$$&ExcaliburNormalOpen&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Finn.
$#Excalibur(Excalibur)#$$&ExcaliburNormalOpen&$$@Center@$Look into my eyes and say, "Raise."
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$What in the—
$#Excalibur(Excalibur)#$$&ExcaliburNormalOpen&$$@Center@$Just say it.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Is this some kind of spell?)
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$@Center@$(Back then, on Avalon...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Triggering unknown magic... It could be
a trap. But—)
$#Excalibur(Excalibur)#$$&ExcaliburNormalOpen&$$@Center@$Lend me your power, Finn.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(I see no deception in her eyes...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$All right... I trust you.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Raise.
$#Excalibur(Excalibur)#$$&ExcaliburSpecialNormalOpen&$$@Center@$Pact formed!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(What is this warm sensation... What is
happening!?)
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hang on, why is she shining!?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneMichelleInsideHurt&$$@Right@$I-I can feel... Immense magical power...
$#Excalibur(Excalibur)#$$&ExcaliburSpecialNormalOpen&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I've finally met you.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$Why would you go that far...? What could
possibly justify this much bloodshed!?
$#Excalibur(Excalibur)#$$&ExcaliburSpecialNormalOpen&$$@Center@$Twister of fate... Slayer of gods.
$#Excalibur(Excalibur)#$$&ExcaliburSpecialNormalOpen&$$@Center@$From now on, you are my wielder.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$Transcending my current existence and
evolving into something never seen before.
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Center@$So, all this time...you were deceiving us?
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkClosedEyes&$$@Center@$Naturally.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$This world has too many useless beings in
it. A selection must be held.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSadComical&$$@Left@$It's more or less stable. Thanks to the food
from Deven, things have calmed down a bit.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$With Avalon's power, I will distribute
curses from shore to shore.
$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$What do you think will happen then?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$Nothing but chaos, what else!?

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$Quite the opposite. Although...to be fair,
there will be wars.

$#KingArthur(King Arthur)#$$&ArthurDarkSerious&$$@Center@$And those who survive them will become
the new humanity. Create the new world.

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$@Center@$When we fought King Arthur in the
caverns of Avalon...

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$@Center@$She spoke of "creating the new world." I had
never heard her express such lofty ambitions...
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You don't think she was telling the truth?

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$@Right@$I don't know. But something about it felt
off...

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethTroubled&$$@Left@$Yeah, it's a bit much, even for her. I can't
tell if it's the truth or not.

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSmile&$$@Right@$We have distributed food to the knights as
well and reestablished public order.
$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinStare&$$@Center@$It is the truth, but also not really.
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSurprised&$$@Right@$M-Merlin!?
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSurprised&$$@Left@$Finally!
$#Merlin(Merlin)#$$&MerlinConfused&$$@Center@$Impatient, are we? Tsk, tsk.

$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanSweat&$$@Center@$They likely can't even discern the living
from the dead.

$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanSweat&$$@Center@$(And it's her curse that made this
possible...)

$#CaptainofDevenForces(Captain of Deven Forces)#$$&RebelMobHurt&$$@Center@$They aren't stopping! At this rate, the
ditch will be filled in no time!
$#Excalibur(Excalibur)#$$&ExcaliburNormal&$$@Left@$The moon is just the moon.

$#CaptainofDevenForces(Captain of Deven Forces)#$$&RebelMobHurt&$$@Center@$Send word to all knights guarding the
main gate! Permission to use bows!

$#CaptainofDevenForces(Captain of Deven Forces)#$$&RebelMobHurt&$$@Center@$Shoot those closest to the gate! Don't let
them enter the city, at any cost!
$#MarchofDeathA(March of Death)#$$&GuardSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Slaughter...
$#MarchofDeathB(March of Death)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Right@$K i l l...
$#CaptainofDevenForces(Captain of Deven Forces)#$$&RebelMobHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What's wrong? Why aren't you shooting!?

$#DevenArcherA(Deven Archer A)#$$!-1!$Their front lines have children in them...
Lots of children!

$#DevenArcherB(Deven Archer B)#$I can't... Some of them are around my
son's age...
$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanTrouble&$$@Center@$Even children were cursed!? How cruel...
$#DevenArcherC(Deven Archer C)#$I can't... I can't do it...
$#MarchofDeathA(March of Death)#$$&GuardSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Kill...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$But it stirs something in our hearts. Makes
you want to forever remember that light,
$#MarchofDeathB(March of Death)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Center@$Kill...
$#MarchofDeathC(March of Death)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Right@$K i l l...

$#CaptainofDevenForces(Captain of Deven Forces)#$$&RebelMobHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$At this rate, they'll breach the gate soon... And 
get to the women and children in the city...
$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanIrritate&$$@Center@$No other choice, then—
$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanIrritate&$$@Center@$Royal Fortissimo!
$#MarchofDeathA(March of Death)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Left@$Agh...
$#MarchofDeathB(March of Death)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Right@$Ngh...
$#MarchofDeathC(March of Death)#$$&GuardSerious&$$@Center@$Aahh...
$#CaptainofDevenForces(Captain of Deven Forces)#$$&RebelMob&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Sir Tristan? What was that?
$#Tristan(Tristan)#$$&TristanSweat&$$@Center@$My cursed power is the power of sound.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Right@$A girl...?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$@Right@$Well, sure, an explanation would be nice...
But Merlin must have some kind of a plan.
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Left@$A plan, sure. I don't trust her.

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Left@$First of all, if she's such a great magician,
why can't she even hear my voice?
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Left@$She's just a fraud, I'm telling you.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneTroubled&$$@Right@$I think that might be going too far... I trust
Merlin.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Thanks to her, we met the Knights of the
Round Table and Finn, didn't we?
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Center@$Yeah, and we also got in a lot of trouble.

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Center@$Whatever. Merlin aside, what about
that girl?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneNormal&$$@Right@$Right. She was lying in that cave, but now
she's here with us.

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleNormal&$$@Left@$So Merlin's spell move her along with us,
huh.
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Left@$What is she doing in a place like this?
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Left@$...She's not dead, right?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprisedBlush&$$@Right@$I think she's just sleeping.

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$We should carry her to the nearest town.
Let me handle it.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$@Center@$No, if you use your powers, it'll drain you.
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleBlush&$$@Center@$That's true, but still...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneHappy&$$@Center@$It's okay, it's okay. Leave it to the Saint of
the North!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneHappy&$$@Center@$I can carry her just fine!
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Center@$...You've grown strong, Jeanne.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$@Center@$Well, it's all thanks to my comrades.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$@Center@$Okay, let's go!
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Left@$Whoa! What was that?
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSmile&$$@Center@$(She's really come into her own...)
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneNormal&$$@Right@$Wait, is this Camelot!?
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Left@$I knew it looked familiar!

$#GateGuardA(Gate Guard A)#$$!-1!$Who goes there! You're not from this town,
are you?
$#GateGuardB(Gate Guard B)#$And you're carrying...a corpse?

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprised&$$@Center@$Oh, no, she's not dead, not yet... Um, she
needs to see a doctor.
$#GateGuardA(Gate Guard A)#$$!-1!$You'll have to find one elsewhere! Go away!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Oh...
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Left@$Go away? This poor girl needs help!

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSerious&$$@Right@$Can't you do something just for her?
I'll leave.

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The scenery's different. Are we even still
in the same place?

$#GateGuardB(Gate Guard B)#$$!-1!$Right now, we can't let even a dog into
this town. We don't have the capacity.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneNormal&$$@Center@$Capacity...?

$#GateGuardA(Gate Guard A)#$Our food supplies are severely depleted,
and we're short on everything else, too.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSad&$$@Center@$I didn't know things were so bad...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSerious&$$@Center@$S-Still, she's sick! Could you speak to
the Knights of the Round Table for us?
$#GateGuardB(Gate Guard B)#$$!-1!$I said leave! Or you'll be thrown into jail!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSad&$$@Right@$Ugh...

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSad&$$@Left@$Screw this, let's turn back. If we go to
Lonsbury, we'll at least have a place to sleep.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneWorried&$$@Right@$Lonsbury... Right.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSad&$$@Right@$Sorry for causing a scene. Excuse us.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneTroubled&$$@Center@$It might have been Merlin's magic!
$#GateGuardA(Gate Guard A)#$$!-1!$Good, finally.

$#GateGuardB(Gate Guard B)#$How long do you think we can keep turning
people away?
$#GateGuardA(Gate Guard A)#$For now, this is all we can do.

$#GateGuardB(Gate Guard B)#$But that girl just now, it's like I know her
from somewhere...
$#GateGuardA(Gate Guard A)#$Hmm, now that you mention it...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneMichelleInsideHurt&$$@Right@$Huff, huff... Phew...

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSad&$$@Left@$Jeanne, are you really okay? Should I take
over?
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSmiling&$$@Right@$No, I'm fine.
$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&ExcaliburClosedeyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Mmm...
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Center@$Oh, looks like she's up.
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Center@$Ugh, not her again!
$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&ExcaliburNormal&$$@Center@$Where am I...?
$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&ExcaliburNormal&$$@Center@$Ah... You two brought me out...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprised&$$@Center@$Wait a second...
$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&ExcaliburNormal&$$@Center@$Let me down.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprised&$$@Center@$Oh, of course. Um... Just now, you said
"you two"?

$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&ExcaliburNormal&$$@Center@$Yes. You're strange. One person, and yet
two.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I knew it!
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Left@$Whoa, you can see me!?
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Left@$No one but Finn could ever see me before...
$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&ExcaliburNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That's because I'm not human.

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Center@$You keep moving us around and for what?
Come out, you coward!
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleNormal&$$@Center@$Huh? What do you mean?
$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&ExcaliburClosedeyes&$$@Center@$Goodbye.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Right@$W-Wait!
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Left@$Don't just wander off alone, it's dangerous!
$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&ExcaliburNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Dangerous?

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleShouting&$$@Center@$Yeah, if you go in that direction, you'll
walk straight into—
$#Monster(Monster)#$$&GenericMonster&$$!-1!$$@Center@$GRRROAAAAAAAAR!!!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneScream&$$@Center@$A den of ravenous monsters!

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Center@$Jeanne, let me take over. You can't use
your prayer when you're that tired!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneMichelleInsideHurt&$$@Center@$I can! I just need to... Ngh...
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Mikaela, please try to calm down.
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSerious&$$@Center@$I told you not to overdo it.

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneMichelleInsideHurt&$$@Center@$(If I switch with Mikaela now, she'll be the
one overdoing it...)
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneMichelleInsideHurt&$$@Center@$(Just a little longer—)
$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&ExcaliburNormal&$$@Center@$An enemy? I see.
$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&ExcaliburSpecialNormal&$$@Center@$$%1%$Sacred Blade.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Monster)#$$&GenericMonster&$$@Center@$$%1%$Groooarr...!
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneSurprised&$$@Center@$Was that...magic?
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSurprised&$$@Center@$That monster just split in two...
$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&ExcaliburHurtSad&$$@Center@$Ngh...
$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&ExcaliburHurtSad&$$@Center@$I...shouldn't...have...

$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleAngry&$$@Left@$Aren't you mad, Jeanne? She can't just drag
us wherever she wants with no explanation!
$#MysteriousGirl(Mysterious Girl)#$$&ExcaliburHurtSad&$$@Center@$Without...a wielder...I...

$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Right@$A-Are you okay!? What should we do,
Mikaela!?
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSerious&$$@Left@$Calm down, she just fainted.
$#Mikaela(Mikaela)#$$&MichelleSerious&$$@Left@$Let's carry her inside that house.
$#Jeanne(Jeanne)#$$&JeanneTroubled&$$@Right@$O-Okay!
$#()#$—First, Avalon, the birthplace of sin.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$I guess that's to be expected if you've
never left that island before.
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHappy&$$@Right@$Let's rest a little.

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHappy&$$@Right@$This town is within Camelot's domain.
We should be safe here.
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSurprised&$$@Center@$I wouldn't be so sure...
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Right@$It smells like...corpses?

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSurprised&$$@Left@$You're right...! I didn't notice at first over the
sea breeze.

$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredGrinOpen&$$@Right@$Hehehe, now that's what I'm talking
about! I love the smell of blood♪
$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalShouting&$$@Left@$Was this place attacked?
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No, I think it must have been infighting...

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSerious&$$@Center@$The townsfolk taking up arms against each
other...

$#()#$Next, Gagokhalkis, the island burdened
with the same evil.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$Just like on Gagokhalkis!

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainIrritated&$$!-1!$$@Right@$King Arthur's curse was at work here,
without a doubt.
$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalSad&$$@Left@$The same tragedy, all over again...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Right@$Just how far is she planning to take this
madness?
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I used to come to this town a lot.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSad&$$@Center@$Everyone was so nice. Whenever I got
hungry, they'd just say, "Eat up!" and share
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSad&$$@Center@$their food with me...
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$@Center@$Yes, I remember that too.
$#TownPeople(Town People)#$$!-1!$Agh... Agh...
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSurprised&$$@Left@$There are survivors!

$#()#$Following the trail of sin, Finn and
the Knights of the Round Table arrived at

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotAngry&$$@Right@$They have a strange look in their eyes.
Be on your guard.
$#TownPeople(Town People)#$$!-1!$Kill...
$#TownPeople(Town People)#$Kill...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$!-1!$$@Right@$They've lost their sanity...
$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalClosedEyes&$$@Left@$So it really is King Arthur's doing.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$That means they're just being controlled, right?
It's not their fault. We have to help them!
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Right@$I agree, but there are so many of them...
$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I'll use Royal Void!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$On all of them at once!?

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Right@$If we free only some of them, we'll only
increase the number of victims.
$#()#$a port town near Camelot.
$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I know! But—
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$I've got an idea.
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$Royal Crimsonsting.
$#TownPeople(Town People)#$Gaaah...aaah...aah...
$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalShouting&$$@Center@$Mordred!!!
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethShouting&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Wh-Why did you kill them!?

$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&ModredHuh&$$@Left@$Huh? If I hadn't killed them, they
would've killed everyone here, right?
$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethIrritated&$$@Right@$That might be true, but...
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredGrinOpen&$$@Left@$Then what's the problem?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$The problem is those people were innocent.
We don't have the right to just take lives.
$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalDejected&$$@Center@$Uh... Ugh...

$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredHappySmile&$$@Center@$Aw, how cute♪ No one in this world is
innocent!

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$That is true. However, everyone deserves
a chance to atone for their sins.
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredHappySmile&$$@Left@$Empty words, if you ask me.

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Well, denying something even though you
know it's true is also very human.
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredLoojAwayIrriitate&$$@Center@$Geez, you're annoying. Ugh.

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$The people Mordred just killed are likely
only a small fraction of the survivors.

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSerious&$$@Right@$Judging by the tracks, there are probably
twice—no, ten times as many.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$That many people are still being
controlled by King Arthur?
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSerious&$$@Right@$Yes. They probably left the town to follow her.
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$In that case, we must pursue them.
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredColdLaugh&$$!-1!$$@Right@$You look like a ghost, Percival.

$#Gareth(Gareth)#$$&GarethIrritated&$$@Left@$Let's hurry! Or other towns will end up
like this one!

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$@Right@$Our objective is set. We want to rescue as
many people as we can. Got it, Mordred?
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&MordredClosedEyesSigh&$$@Left@$Whatever. I just want to kill that king.
$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I apologize. I should have intervened.

$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalSerious&$$@Left@$Next time Mordred starts misbehaving,
I'll stop her, even at the cost of my life.
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$@Right@$All right, the break is over.
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$@Right@$Let us head to Camelot.
$#Mordred(Mordred)#$$&PercivalDejected&$$@Right@$Serves you right... Ugh...

$#Percival(Percival)#$$&PercivalDejected&$$@Left@$Look who's talking, Mordred... Ngh...
Ugh...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So both of you get seasick, huh...

is the herald of death

keys.DescriptionKey: The noble house of Tristan has always served as the right hand of the king, and it was only natural that the young Tristan would be entrusted with being a companion and sparring partner of Princess Leidram. Despite being a confidante to the future king from a young age, even she hardly ever witnessed Leidram showing any genuine emotion.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Being the Round Table's greatest musician, Tristan was especially popular amongst the populace of Camelot. Little did they know that she was actually terrified of being the center of attention.
"I-I know this is an important ceremony, but I... I'm feeling sick to my stomach... Could I please sit this one out?"

This unit cannot be poisoned for 100TU.

If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will be Purified.

After the end of each other ally's turn, this unit will have its TU reduced to 0. This TU reduction may trigger before or after other effects that adjust the turn order. Then this effect cannot trigger again until 50TU advances.

When this unit takes damage from an attack, they will immediately get the next turn, this cannot trigger again until TU advances. This is a skin effect. This unit cannot become a Guardian or Stun Absorber.

keys.IntroText:
A lone knight wanders far and wide
looking for the one who can save this world

keys.DescriptionKey: And so, Unicorn embarked on her long, solitary journey. Though many dangers lurked along the way, they weren't enough to discourage her. Chevalier's Grace protected her from physical injuries, poison, and other direct threats, and, more importantly, she wasn't doing it out of obligation, but because becoming a fine knight serving her own master has always been her dream.

keys.DescriptionKey:

Still, she is not easily perturbed and tends to do things at her own pace, so when trouble comes, she just has a meal and a good night sleep—she has found that more often than not, things work themselves out before she knows it.
And so, having traveled across the world and beyond, she finally found you.
"Maybe this person will turn out to be my master..." she thinks, hope stirring in her heart.

keys.DescriptionKey:
We would like to announce some changes to existing characters that have been made in the latest update.

General Skill Adjustments:

-The 130TU version of the active skill "Sleep" has the Spirit cost reduced to -3.
-The active skill "Burn Drive" no longer requires another Fire ally to activate. (Akatsuki, Ja'Nafaat)

Adjustments to SSR Characters:

Yuki:
-Units now become Frozen once they have 2 Frost Marks.
-Removed the limit to the number of units Frozen at a time.
-Yuki's active skill "Ice Breaker" now deals 150% damage if conditions are not met. The Spirit cost is reduced to -1.
-Yuki's active skill "Grant Frozen" has its Spirit cost reduced to -1.
-Yuki's active skill "Ice Shard" now hits 2 targets and the use condition is removed. The damage while at least 1 ally is Frozen is 350%, otherwise it is 100%.

Finn:
-Finn's passive skill "Thundering Entry" no longer requires another Storm ally to activate.

Orzachron:
Orzachron's passive skill "Thundering Entry" no longer requires another Storm ally to activate.

Rei:
-Rei's passive skill "Dreamy Entry" no longer requires other Water allies to activate.

Other Changes:

-All Mana costs have been reduced.
-Experience points earned in battles that consume Mana have been reduced.
-Drop rates of Evolution Materials in battles that consume mana remain unchanged.

-Evolution Ingredients now display specific drop locations when examined.

-Further general quality of life improvements.

Thank you for playing Evertale! Please read on for a list of changes made in the latest update.

- In PvP, your active unit will now be set back by 100TU if your turn times out when passing is not allowed.
- Event drops can now be increased by using specific characters and weapons if they are listed on the event.
- Added a Summon History button to the Summon page for viewing your last 5 summons.
- Optimized mercenary selection.
- Greatly expanded the guild chat message log.
- Optimized story scene skipping.
- Monthly login bonus reworked as a repeating 7 day consecutive login bonus. Players who were on track to earn the monthly rewards from the end of February will be compensated accordingly.
- Zoom function added to character art on out of battle profiles. Activated by tapping the character art.
- On screens where long taps are used to bring up details of items, characters and weapons, short taps can now be used as well if they had no previous function.
- Bug fixes and more quality of life improvements.

2020/04/03 Update:

We understand that the behaviors of the Weapon Skills for "Whalesbreath" and "Pride of Roa" have changed in the last update. This was a side effect of a bug fix.

As such we are adjusting the wording and behavior of the skill to more closely align with previous behavior:

"X% bonus to attacks if allies will have 2 or less Spirit left after this unit attacks."

Please note that the bug is still resolved and so the skill is not expected to trigger outside of the new Spirit range. We apologise for any confusion caused by this change in skill behavior.

$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Villager)#$$|act3.Voices/sst301|$But after what happened, they'll probably
never trust us again.

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Traveler)#$$|act3.Voices/sst304|$I don't care what my comrades say. The
people of Urg Roa are our allies.

$#DONTSHOWME(Szi Traveler)#$$|act3.Voices/sst305|$I am sure we can get through this and
repair the friendship between our cities.

$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Villager)#$$|act3.Voices/sst302|$I've lived my whole life in the desert, but
I have family in the Silverdrake Mountains.

$#DONTSHOWME(Kud Villager)#$$|act3.Voices/sst303|$I really hope I can visit them some day. I've
never seen snow before!
Use 75 Mana

keys.value:
$#Citizen A(Citizen A)#$I heard Captain Averna was chosen as
the newest Valkyrie!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Right@$I just couldn't do what had to be done.
That's all.
$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Left@$What...had to be done?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Right@$$%0.3%$(A wife sobbing over her husband. A son
shaking with rage...they were people.)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Right@$(To protect people...do I have to be
cold enough to just cut them down?)
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadDown&$$@Right@$(...No.)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadDown&$$@Right@$(If there was no way to save them, should
I have hesitated? I would have won...)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidUp&$$@Right@$(What was the right thing to do?
I just... I don't...)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Hajime)#$Rain again today.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Shiori)#$Black rain...

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaShouting&$$@Center@$Stay calm, everyone. Don't worry.
Someday, we Valkyries will stop this rain!

$#Citizen B(Citizen B)#$They say she's an excellent soldier.
I'm sure she'll protect us all!

$#Citizen A(Citizen A)#$$!-1!$Oh, Lady Averna! How lucky we are that
you're our newest Valkyrie!

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSmile&$$@Center@$Thank you so much for saying so.
It's a little embarrassing, though.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$!-1!$$@Right@$She looks so happy, surrounded by
the townspeople.

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeIrritated&$$@Left@$Such a bright smile...
Almost disgustingly bright.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$$%0.3%$(Averna is the newest face of hope for
this closed-off fortress.)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$(If I had burned the village, I would be
a hero to thousands...)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Right@$(But for those thirty people, I would be
a monster. A murderer.)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$Hajime.
I...want to live with my head held high.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Right@$I'll continue fighting fair and square,
for this city and its people.

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeThoughtful&$$@Left@$As soft as ever...but that's how it ought
to be, I think.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadDown&$$@Right@$...
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Right@$Hajime...

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Left@$This world doesn't need any more
monsters. You do what feels right.

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Left@$And I'll be right behind you,
all the way.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$...Thank you.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Shiori)#$The black rain continues to fall. Slowly,
endlessly, drowning this world.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Shiori)#$But even in this unjust world, I have a
dream. It may be foolish...

$#DONOTSHOWME(Shiori)#$But I want to protect everyone.
To save everyone, with my own two hands.
$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Left@$I thought for sure you would win.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Right@$I don't need flattery, Hajime...

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Left@$It's not. You're naïve, but you always fight
for what you feel is right.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Right@$What I feel is right...

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeIrritated&$$@Left@$I'm sure Averna just cheated her way in.
What kind of tricks did she use?
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Right@$...She didn't do anything like that.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Center@$(I can't sleep.)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$A man?
Who...?
$#KeiDad(???)#$$&KeiDadNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$――, ――――!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$He has no eyes...! Just a black flame!
He's an undead!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackBack&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$I won't let you hurt these people!
Haaaaa!
$#KeiDad(???)#$$&KeiDadScream&$$@Left@$Ah...agh...!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackBack&$$@Right@$Now to finish it off!
$#KeiDad(???)#$$&KeiDadScream&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$Aaaaah... Aaaaaaaaah——!

$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Shiori...?
What on Erden is—
$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomCrying&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$...Ah?!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackUp&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Stay back! It'll burn out soon, but it
could still hurt you!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$(I need to rest up so I can make up for
lost time tomorrow, but...)

$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomCrying&$$@Left@$No... Nooooo!
Richard! My love!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Right@$Huh...?
My love...?

$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomCrying&$$@Left@$No, no...! The fire! We have to put
the fire out!

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Right@$Stop it, Ma! Stay back!
It's too dangerous!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedBack&$$@Left@$Kei, what's going on here?!
$#Villager A(Villager A)#$$!-1!$The innkeeper's husband...!

$#Villager B(Villager B)#$She's the one what did it.
The outsider...!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$(The villagers are crowding around.
But...)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidBack&$$@Center@$(All of them have deep wounds. Fatal
wounds. And black fire inside...!)
$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiAngry&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Shioriiiii!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$(Actually, can I make up for it tomorrow? Am I already disqualified?)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Right@$$%0.3%$Wha—!
What are you doing?!

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Left@$I should never have brought you here!
If I hadn't...if you hadn't...!
$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiAngry&$$@Left@$...That's my Pa you just murdered!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidBack&$$@Right@$What?
Your...father?
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidBack&$$@Right@$That man was your father?

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Left@$That's right! And now his soul has been
sent back to that Tower!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Right@$Tower...the Endless Pyre?

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiAngry&$$@Left@$Yeah. Now that you've destroyed his body,
he'll be forced to resurrect there.

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiAngry&$$@Left@$Trapped for all eternity!
As one of Orcanix's damned soldiers!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidBack&$$@Right@$But...but why?
What's going on here, anyway?!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Center@$...
$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$Shut up! Just shut uuuup!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadDown&$$@Right@$$%0.3%$Ngh!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadDown&$$@Right@$(He's deadly serious. If I don't fight back,
he's going to kill me!)
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedDown&$$@Center@$Ah, darn it! Now I can't sleep even more!

$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$(Another clatter comes from the door
in the back of the kitchen.)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$(There's that sound again...but it's so
late. Who could it be?)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Center@$(An undead could have found its way into
the village. I'd better check it out.)
$#KeiDad(???)#$$&KeiDadNormal&$$@Center@$――――.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$Phew, that's that.
Oh, can't forget the deathglass...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$Um...
That's all.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$$%0.3%$It'll be dark soon. Take care, okay?
I'll just be going...
$#Kei(???)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$...Wait up.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Left@$What is it?
$#Kei(???)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Right@$You...what's your name?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Left@$Shiori. Like I said, I'm a soldier,
from Last Bastion.

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiNormal&$$@Right@$Shiori... I'm Kei. And hey, I'm sorry too.
Thanks for saving me.

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Right@$You're right, it'll be dark soon. And
soldier or no, these woods are dangerous.

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiNormal&$$@Right@$So, uh...
You can come to our village...if you want.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Left@$Really?!
$#Kei(???)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Left@$You burned them...
$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSmile&$$@Right@$Y-yeah.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Left@$Oh, good...that's actually a huge relief.
I really didn't want to camp out.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Left@$I'll take you up on your kind offer.
And so, um...
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Left@$Are you sure you don't want the meat?

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiNormal&$$@Right@$...I'll take it.
Thanks.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$So this is Kei's village...they really do live
way down deep here.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Center@$Ah, you must be a villager. Hello there!
I'll be staying with you tonight.
$#Villager(Villager)#$$!-1!$Eek...!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Right@$Huh? Did I scare her?

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Left@$...Sorry. You're the first visitor we've
had since the war with Orcanix started.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Right@$Okay. Now, you!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Right@$It's okay. I'm used to it.

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSad&$$@Left@$You're...used to it?
To people being scared of you?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Right@$Yeah. It's just the same as being on
patrol in Last Bastion.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$Collecting taxes, stifling unrest... That's
Vanguard work too, so everyone hates us.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$So it doesn't really hurt to be feared.
Not anymore.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$...I am sad I've gotten to that point,
though.

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Left@$...
...Sounds like you have it rough.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Right@$Well, maybe.
Ah, is this your house?

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiNormal&$$@Left@$Yeah, we run an inn. Perfect for an
unexpected guest.
$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSad&$$@Left@$...Ma, I'm coming in, okay?
$#Kei(???)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Left@$W-what do you want?!

$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomSmile&$$@Center@$Oh? Oh, oh dear! Dear me!
A customer?!

$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomBigSmile&$$@Center@$Welcome! Welcome, bless you! Oh, how
long has it been, I wonder!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$!-1!$$@Left@$(Since the war, he said... I'm amazed the
inn's stayed open this long.)

$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomNormal&$$@Right@$I'll get dinner on right away.
Kei, be a dear and help me?
$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiNormal&$$@Left@$Sure thing.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Left@$Ah, I can help too, if it wouldn't be
a bother...

$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomSmile&$$@Right@$You relax and make yourself at home,
dear!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Left@$Okay...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Left@$Mm, this is delicious! I can't remember
the last time I had something so good!

$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomBigSmile&$$@Right@$I'm so glad you like it! There's plenty
more where that came from, too.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$I'm sorry!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Left@$It's such a waste. So many people would
love to eat your cooking, ma'am!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Left@$Why haven't you moved to Last Bastion?
$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$18 years ago, this used to be a
coalmining town.

$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomSerious&$$@Right@$When the war started, everyone who
could afford to leave, left.

$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomSerious&$$@Right@$The only ones still here are people like
me, tied to the land we live on...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Left@$I understand that a field or an inn can't
be taken with you, but this is life or death.

$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomNormal&$$@Right@$Oh, dear. Are you worried for us?
Thank you, but we're alright.

$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomNormal&$$@Right@$We're far away from other villages, so
the undead have paid us no mind.

$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomSmile&$$@Right@$Life here is very peaceful, very quiet.
We hunt and grow only what we need.
$#Kei(???)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Left@$...Huh?

$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomSmile&$$@Right@$It's a very comfortable life.
Why would we go anywhere else?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Left@$Really? I understand wanting to stay away
from the war, but...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Left@$In Last Bastion, you can live safely, and
you can get help from the Vanguard...
$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Right@$We don't need it.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedBack&$$@Left@$Huh?
$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Right@$I said, we don't need their help!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Left@$Ah...
$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomSerious&$$@Left@$Kei!
$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSad&$$@Right@$...Sorry.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Left@$(Was what I said really that bad?)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$About earlier. I was being selfish, and
just being even ruder than before.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Left@$(This place doesn't even have a wall.
The city would definitely be safer...)

$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomNormal&$$@Right@$...I see you've cleaned your plate.
I'm so glad you enjoyed your meal.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Left@$Ah...o-oh, yes!
It was delicious. Thank you so much.

$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomSmile&$$@Right@$Thank you for saying so, dear. Kei,
could you show her to her room?

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Right@$Sure...thanks for the food, Ma.
You can use this room, Shiori.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Left@$O-okay.

$#()#$(A soft thump sounds from a door in
the back.)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedBack&$$@Left@$Huh? I heard a noise.
Is someone else here?

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Right@$...I didn't hear anything.
You must have imagined it.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedBack&$$@Left@$I guess so...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$If you don't need the food, then I'll
figure out something to do with it myself.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$Look, Hajime! How long has it been since
you saw so many people gathered here?!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileBack&$$@Right@$I could be a Valkyrie by week's end.
My dream is finally within reach!

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Left@$...I know it's your dream, but
I just don't understand it.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Right@$What do you mean? As a Valkyrie, I can
do more to protect people!

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Left@$Not that. I don't understand all this
ceremony.

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeIrritated&$$@Left@$The Valkyries are important, but why
gather all the soldiers here together?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$...That's a good point. There can't be
many guards on the wall right now.

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Left@$The undead could take this chance to
invade and we would have no warning.

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Left@$And if Orcanix has some way to attack
us all from range...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedBack&$$@Right@$This would be a perfect opportunity to
take us all out at once.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Hajime)#$...Speak of the devil.
The black rain's started to fall.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Center@$And not just soldiers like us, either.
There are even civilians here!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Citizen A)#$Aaah! The cursed rain!
If it touches you, you'll turn undead!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Citizen B)#$Quickly, get inside!
Take cover under a roof!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Right@$Everyone, please calm down! The rain
has no effect on the living!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$The rain will only affect corpses!
Please remain calm!

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeIrritated&$$@Left@$It's no use. There's no calming this lot
down.

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Left@$Head on to the Proving Ceremony, Shiori.
I'll catch up once things are in hand here.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$Okay. Thank you.
Keep them safe, alright?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$Now... Where are the Vanguard squad
captains lining up, again?
$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Shiori! Over here.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Averna!
Thanks.
$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Mostly rubberneckers, of course.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSmile&$$@Left@$No need to thank me. A soldier's job
is to help those in need, right?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Right@$(That's just like her. Strong, gentle,
and humble, too.)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Right@$(I hope I can be like her someday. I want
to stand alongside her.)

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSerious&$$@Left@$Say, Shiori. Do you intend to join the
Proving this year?
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Right@$I—
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$Attention!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedBack&$$@Right@$That voice...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I am Ludmilla! Marshal of the Valkyries
who protect Last Bastion, our final stand!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Citizen C)#$$!-1!$Protect, she says. Yeah, protects our
coffers from getting too full...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Center@$Pardon me, citizen.
Is there something you want to say?

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeThoughtful&$$@Left@$...A lot fewer soldiers here than I'd
like to see.

$#Citizen C(Citizen C)#$$!-1!$Huh?!
Uh, no, I...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Center@$With the corrupt rule of Draclow ended
by undead hands...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Center@$The governance and security of the
city now falls to the Valkyries— to me.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Center@$I levy taxes and labor as needed to guard
this city from the horrors of the war.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaShouting&$$@Center@$The horrors that we Valkyries face every
day to keep you and yours safe!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Center@$If you want to complain, feel free to
do so from outside the wall!
$#Citizen C(Citizen C)#$$!-1!$F-forgive me...!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Center@$...Moving along.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$The Valkyries: the best of the best, elite
troops chosen from among your ranks.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$They are the pillars upon which Last
Bastion, our final hope, stands tall.

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeThoughtful&$$@Left@$Probably more accurate to say that
there are fewer left alive...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Center@$They are granted privileges commensurate
with the harsh training they undergo.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Center@$The right to command soldiers, as well
as the right to leave Last Bastion.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$!-1!$$@Right@$(That's right. The Valkyries can leave
the city to go hunt undead.)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$(I won't have to enforce taxes or curfews
on the citizens anymore.)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Right@$(I'll be able to focus on doing good, and
serving the cause of righteousness!)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I know all of you gathered here today
would be proud to become Valkyries!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$However, only one of you will be chosen.
The very best of the best.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Center@$Here is how the Proving will be done.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedBack&$$!-1!$$@Right@$(It's really happening.
Oh, I'm so nervous.)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$You will be granted special dispensation
to leave the city, for one day only.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$Whoever kills the most undead before
returning to the fortress...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaShouting&$$@Center@$Will be named as this year's Valkyrie!

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$How will we prove our kill count,
Marshal?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$With this. This bottle, and the liquid
inside, is known as dragonfire.

$#Dragonfire;(Ludmilla)#$$&Dragonfire&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Thrown upon an undead, it will burn,
producing a crystal called deathglass.

$#Dragonfire;(Ludmilla)#$$&Dragonfire&$$@Center@$The undead will revive in time, of course,
at Orcanix's Endless Pyre...

$#Dragonfire;(Ludmilla)#$$&Dragonfire&$$@Center@$But it is very effective crowd control
nonetheless.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Each prospective Valkyrie will be given
bottles of dragonfire.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Center@$Bring back the most deathglass, and
you will be our newest Valkyrie!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaShouting&$$@Center@$That concludes my explanation. Now—
who among you dares to reach for glory?!

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Left@$And those who have fallen join the ranks
of Orcanix's undead army.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackUp&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I do!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$You are brave.
What is your name, soldier?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Right@$Shiori, ma'am!
Squad captain of the Vanguard!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$Excellent.
Are any brave enough to follow Shiori?!
$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaDetermined&$$@Right@$Yes, ma'am!
$#Soldier A(Soldier A)#$Me too!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Wow, so many people are raising
their hands.)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Center@$(They all look strong. Each one of them
is my rival...)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedBack&$$@Center@$(...I need to do my best. I need to kill
more undead than anyone else!)

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeIrritated&$$@Left@$Our allies decrease, while our foes only
grow in number. There's no end to it.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousBack&$$@Right@$...Enough dark talk, okay? Today is a
special day: the Proving Hunt!
