$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Center@$Nn...hm?
It's morning already?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$Some have yet to return to Last Bastion,
but I doubt any will have more than this.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$I'll proclaim it officially later, but...
Welcome to the Valkyries, Averna.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadDown&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Averna's the new Valkyrie? With the
deathglass from the village?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadDown&$$@Center@$(She reported the villagers...
But how did she know about them?)

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaAngry&$$@Left@$You swooped in to steal my kill.
Not very "fair and square" of you, is it?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Right@$Your kill... I-I mean, we were following
the same tracks, sure, but...

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaNormal&$$@Left@$Haha. You're right, it's not against the
rules. I'll let you have it.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaAngry&$$@Left@$But I won't give up the Valkyrie position.
And now, you owe me one.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidUp&$$@Center@$No...
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAngryBack&$$@Center@$Averna!!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadDown&$$@Center@$I can't believe I slept after all that.
Soldiers really are something else...

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Shiori! What's the matter?
You're dreadfully pale.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAngryBack&$$@Right@$Averna, did you follow me into the village?

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaAngry&$$@Left@$I did. And?
It's not against the rules, is it?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackBack&$$@Right@$That's not what I mean!
Why did you sell them out?!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadDown&$$@Right@$Yes, they were undead! But they weren't
hurting anyone living down there!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You won't have heard of this, but undead
have slipped Orcanix's notice before.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Right@$Huh?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$Carriers of the black flame of undeath,
without Orcanix's red eyes.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Right@$(Just like Kei and the villagers!)

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$But even they end up the same as all the
rest— more bodies for Orcanix's army.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$...Huh?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$They could turn on us at any time. It's
far too great a risk to shelter them.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$Much better to destroy their bodies and
return them to the Pyre, away from us.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Left@$Hostile or no, an undead is an undead...
A danger to every living thing on Erden.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaAngry&$$@Left@$You get it, don't you? It's not difficult.
And yet you were going to let them live?

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaAngry&$$@Left@$I didn't think you were so foolish, Shiori.
I'm disappointed in you.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadDown&$$@Right@$A-Averna...!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$Shiori, was it?
How much deathglass do you have?
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Right@$...Three, Marshal.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$Hm. You survived a night on your own,
I see. You have potential, at least.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$@Left@$I won't discharge you. But you placed
undead above mortal lives today.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$Smoke...coming from the direction of
the cave?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Left@$I can't overlook that. You will correct this
fault, soldier. Or I have no use for you.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaAngry&$$@Left@$If you can't do what must be done,
then you will never be a Valkyrie.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAngryUp&$$@Right@$But...
That's...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaShouting&$$@Left@$We're done here. Back to the city!
Time to announce our newest Valkyrie!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidUp&$$@Center@$No...
No, it couldn't be...!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidUp&$$@Right@$Kei's village is burning.
But why?!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadDown&$$@Right@$Someone's coming... Marshal Ludmilla?
The Valkyries? Averna?!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$This deathglass belongs to you, as our
informant. Take it, Captain.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSerious&$$@Right@$Y-yes, Marshal!
You honor me!
Soldiers of Iron and Fury
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadUp&$$@Right@$$%0.3%$Nnh...!

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Left@$We got attacked by the undead and
killed years ago.

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Left@$But for some reason, we weren't taken
over by Orcanix.

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSad&$$@Left@$A few of us never really accepted what
happened...like my Ma.

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSad&$$@Left@$Pa took a lot of hurt to the head, so...
He never really came back.

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Left@$But to keep Ma safe, I hunt, I help with
the food...we just live like we always did.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedDown&$$@Right@$That's...

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSad&$$@Left@$...I know. There's no future for us,
no matter what happens.

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSad&$$@Left@$There's no way to know when our bodies
will fail. When Orcanix might take us.

$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomCrying&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Richard...
Richaaard...!
$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...What did I even bring you here for?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadUp&$$@Right@$(I'm more skilled than he is, but...
It's like he's not tired at all...)

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Left@$I guess I felt scummy turning you out
into the forest after you saved me.

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiAngry&$$@Left@$And look what I got for it. One slip-up,
and my Ma's broken forever.

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiAngry&$$@Left@$This is my fault. This is on my head.
Shiori...!

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Left@$I'm gonna kill you. I'll kill you, and make
up for what I've done!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadDown&$$@Right@$...I'm sorry.
I can't ever undo what I've done.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedBack&$$@Right@$But I won't just stand and let you
kill me, either!
$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiAngry&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$Ngh!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Right@$...It's over.

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Left@$Yeah, looks like it...
Are you gonna kill my body?

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Left@$You gonna send me where you sent Pa?
Off to be Orcanix's slave, forever?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidUp&$$@Right@$Kei...you too?
Are you...
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Right@$...!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Right. Kei can't die... He's an undead.)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Center@$(His mother is still sobbing, and the
others are all wounded and afraid.)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$(About thirty of them in total. If I kill
them all...would that secure my win?)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$(Should I kill them, then?
After all...)
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidUp&$$@Center@$(It's not like they're people.)
$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomCrying&$$!-1!$$@Center@$My love......
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...!

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What's the matter?
Do it already.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAfraidUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(What was I thinking?)
$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSad&$$@Left@$...Yeah.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadDown&$$@Center@$(They may be undead, but they're still
people. I'm a soldier, not a murderer!)
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...I won't kill you.
$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Left@$Huh?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Right@$I won't tell anyone about this place,
either. I'll...leave and never come back.
$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Left@$Shiori...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ma'am...
Thank you so much for the food.

$#KeiMom(Kei's Mother)#$$&KeiMomCrying&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Hic...
Aaaa... Aaaaah...!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Center@$Okay. This should be far enough.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Center@$Still...
I've lived so long in pursuit of my dream.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Center@$It was right in front of my eyes, and I
just...let it go.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackUp&$$@Right@$...But why don't you all serve Orcanix?!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadDown&$$@Center@$What am I doing...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackUp&$$@Right@$And you were hunting! Undead don't
need food, so why?!
$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Left@$No, we don't. We can live without it.

$#Kei(Kei)#$$&KeiSad&$$@Left@$But my Ma...without something to do
every day, she just...breaks.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaSerious&$$@Center@$—Dawn has broken. I hereby proclaim the
Proving Hunt underway!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedBack&$$@Center@$(Hm? There's someone behind me...
Averna?)
$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaDetermined&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(She's following the same tracks I am.
So she's using the same methods...)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$(But I'm further ahead. I should catch up
with the undead first.)
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Center@$(This is my chance.)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Center@$(I'll prove to Averna that I'm a worthy
rival, too!)
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackBack&$$@Right@$$%0.3%$Take this!
$#Skeleton(Undead)#$$&Skeleton&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$―――― !

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Right@$Alright! That's the second crystal.
Everything's going...well?
$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSad&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Shiori...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&DarkLudmillaShouting&$$@Center@$Show me your strength, brave soldiers.
Destroy the undead!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Averna!
I guess you caught me.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSad&$$@Left@$You got ahead of me? Then, I'm guessing
the owner of those tracks...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Right@$I took it down. You would have gotten it
no problem if you found it first, though.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaDetermined&$$@Left@$Right. You and I are at about the same
skill level, after all.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Right@$O-oh, no, I wouldn't say so. You're much
stronger. And people trust you, and—

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaAngry&$$@Left@$Thank you, Shiori. But I have to say...
I'm disappointed in you.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Right@$Huh...?

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaDetermined&$$@Left@$"You caught me", you said. Which means
you knew I was following these tracks.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaAngry&$$@Left@$And yet you swooped in to steal my kill.
Not very "fair and square" of you, is it?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Right@$Your kill... I-I mean, we were following
the same tracks, sure, but...

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$So it's begun. Fight well, Shiori...
And don't let your guard down.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaNormal&$$@Left@$Haha. You're right, it's not against the
rules. I'll let you have it.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaAngry&$$@Left@$But I won't give up the Valkyrie position.
And now, you owe me one.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriVerySadDown&$$@Right@$Averna...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Center@$(Did I make her mad? No...let's just say
she acknowledged my ability. Right.)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Center@$(As of right now... I'm winning against
Averna. The woman I look up to.)
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$No, no. What am I thinking?!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$My goal isn't to surpass Averna. It's to
become a Valkyrie!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$I'll go the other way from her. I need to
find as many undead as possible!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$Huh? Wait a minute...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Center@$Yes! New tracks! And hidden in the grass.
No one's likely to have spotted these.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Left@$I know.
Keep a light on for me!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Center@$If I just follow these, I should find a new
target!
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedBack&$$@Center@$(Ah! There it is!)
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackBack&$$@Center@$Haaaa!
$#Kei(???)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$Waah!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackBack&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I-it dodged?!
I won't miss this time, you— huh?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It ran away...
What was that?
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$(Huh? A hare...pierced by an arrow.)
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$(Wait, that undead was...hunting?!)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$(Undead don't eat. And every undead I've
seen until now has had red eyes.)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$(How long has it been since I've walked
freely outside the walls like this?)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$(That boy's eyes weren't red at all, which
means... No. No, it couldn't be!)

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$That boy is human?! I didn't think there
was anyone left outside of Last Bastion!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Center@$It's dangerous out here. I need to find
him and make sure he's safe!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSeriousUp&$$@Center@$(A cave...
I wonder if he lives in here?)
$#Kei(???)#$$&KeiShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Ah!
W-wait!
$#Kei(???)#$$&KeiAngry&$$@Left@$O-out of my way!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Right@$I promise I'll leave as soon as I'm done.
First, won't you take these?

$#Kei(???)#$$&KeiSerious&$$@Left@$These are...rabbits and birds?
And so many... Did you hunt these?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Right@$Yeah, on my way here.
I'm sorry for interrupting your hunt.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadUp&$$@Center@$(...I miss my hometown. I wonder how
things are over there now...)

$#Kei(???)#$$&KeiAngry&$$@Left@$...What is this, some kind of charity?
I don't need it.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedBack&$$@Right@$Why would you turn it down?! It's not
like having extra food hurts, you know!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedBack&$$@Right@$I know it's a lot, but if you don't take
it, the rain will turn them into undead!
$#Kei(???)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Left@$...!

$#Kei(???)#$$&KeiAngry&$$@Left@$I told you, I don't need it! Who would just
take food from a stranger?!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Right@$I just want to apologize for earlier,
that's all!

$#Kei(???)#$$&KeiAngry&$$@Left@$That sounds like your problem, not mine!
I told you, I don't need your—
$#BatWing(Undead)#$$&BatWingWarrior&$$@Center@$$%0.3%$(Grr...!)

$#Kei(???)#$$&KeiShouting&$$!-1!$$@Left@$...!
An undead?!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriAttackUp&$$@Right@$It must have heard us arguing.
Get behind me!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Center@$(No, that can wait. Once I become a
Valkyrie, I can go look anytime.)
$#Kei(???)#$$&KeiShouting&$$@Left@$Huh?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Right@$I'm a member of the Vanguard of Last
Bastion. Protecting people is what I do!

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Center@$I need to find some undead.
There may be some tracks around...

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Center@$Ah, there. Too narrow to be mortal
footprints...a skeletal undead, must be.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Soldier A)#$Hey, you hear? The captain of East 5
collapsed over breakfast.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Right@$Did you see that?! Averna is so amazing!
No wonder everyone respects her.

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeIrritated&$$@Left@$I did see that...but if you keep shouting,
she's going to hear you.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSmile&$$@Left@$I certainly am.
Trying to butter me up, Shiori?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSmileUp&$$@Right@$Not at all. I'm just telling the truth.
As your fellow captain, I respect you.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriWorriedUp&$$@Right@$But that talk earlier...that's ugly stuff.
Did someone really poison him?

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSad&$$@Left@$Most likely. It's a pity, but things like this
happen every year at the Proving.

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeThoughtful&$$@Left@$No matter how skilled you are, actually
finding the most undead is up to chance.

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeThoughtful&$$@Left@$Having even one fewer rival out there
could make the difference, I guess.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Right@$That's...no, a Valkyrie should be able to
win without such underhanded methods.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Right@$I would never stoop so low. I want to
compete fair and square.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Soldier B)#$Poisoned, probably. I know the Valkyries
are a big deal, but that's just low...

$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Left@$If you're the only one fighting fair, you'll
just be putting yourself at a disadvantage.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaNormal&$$@Left@$He's right, you know. I hate to admit it,
but that's just how the world works.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSurprisedUp&$$@Right@$Not you too, Averna...
Please don't say that.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSad&$$@Left@$I take no pleasure in it. But sometimes
you have to make hard choices.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaDetermined&$$@Left@$This city is all we have left. I'll do
whatever it takes to protect it.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaDetermined&$$@Left@$Sometimes sacrifices are necessary for
the greater good. Don't you agree?

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Right@$...I understand what you mean.
Logically, it makes sense.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Right@$But the idea of hurting someone to save
someone else...I don't like it.
$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSad&$$@Left@$...I see.
$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeIrritated&$$@Left@$As soft as ever, I see.
$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSerious&$$@Center@$You two.
$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriSadDown&$$@Right@$I guess it is a little soft.

$#Shiori(Shiori)#$$&ShioriDeterminedUp&$$@Right@$It may be hard, but I'll win this fairly.
Command is yours while I'm away.
$#Hajime(Hajime)#$$&HajimeSerious&$$@Left@$No rest for the wicked, I see.

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSmile&$$@Left@$Haha.
Best of luck, Shiori.

$#Soldier A(Soldier A)#$$!-1!$C-Captain Averna?! We were just—
We didn't mean to gossip!

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaNormal&$$@Center@$I know.
Could you do me a favor?

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSmile&$$@Center@$Could you bring this to the captain you
mentioned? Don't worry, it's not poison.
$#Soldier B(Soldier B)#$$!-1!$Is this...medicine?

$#Averna(Averna)#$$&AvernaSmile&$$@Center@$He's a valuable comrade-in-arms, after
all. I'd like to see him get well soon.

$#Soldier A(Soldier A)#$$!-1!$Yes, ma'am!
We'll go right away!

keys.DescriptionKey: As a dreamy young girl, Helsing loved the meat pies her mother made. Whenever she would cry, her mother would bake one for her and make the tears stop. The two of them had always lived together in poverty, just mother and daughter. Even so, looking back, those were the happiest years of her life.

keys.IntroText: You like this sweet smell? My, how adorable...

keys.DescriptionKey:
Helsing admired the castle that stood atop the hill overlooking the town where she lived with her mother.
Each night, whenever the bells rang, she imagined herself taking the hand of a prince she had yet to meet, dancing with him in a splendid hall.

She never knew that every night within that mansion, a dance of death was being performed by monsters thirsting for blood.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Her mother, Ekaterina, taught her young daughter the name of a certain flower. A flower with a sweet fragrance and delicate beauty, yet hiding a deadly poison within.

"Whether something becomes poison or medicine depends on the heart of the one who uses it."

Ten years later, the daughter would turn the lesson her mother had given her into a weapon of revenge, and quietly close in on the throat of the monster who had stolen her mother away.

keys.value: $#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaSurprised&$$@Center@$Nngh... Mm... Wh-Where am I?
$#Guard(Guard)#$appropriate care and put her to rest.

$#Lupin(Lupin)#$$&LupinNormal&$$@Center@$It is only for the beloved queen, who
understands what it means to carry this

$#Lupin(Lupin)#$$&LupinNormal&$$@Center@$country and chooses to let go of what she
loves—
$#ChancellorGarismor(Chancellor Garismor)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Center@$What?

$#Lupin(Lupin)#$$&LupinSmile&$$@Center@$And with that, your plan is ruined. What
a sloppy, foolish thing you did.

$#ChancellorGarismor(Chancellor Garismor)#$$&AugustinShouting&$$@Center@$What would you know, you bandit!! My
plan was perfect!

$#ChancellorGarismor(Chancellor Garismor)#$$&AugustinShouting&$$@Center@$That poor girl botched it all, after I so
graciously aided her, too.

$#ChancellorGarismor(Chancellor Garismor)#$$&AugustinShouting&$$@Center@$If that girl had killed Victoria, this never
would have—
$#Lupin(Lupin)#$$&LupinPero&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Did you hear that, Your Majesty?
$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaSerious&$$@Right@$I am disappointed, Garismor.
$#ChancellorGarismor(Chancellor Garismor)#$$&AugustinSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Victoria... Your Majesty! Since when...

$#Guard(Guard)#$Of course, as the one who carried out the
assassination attempt, we've had to keep

$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaSerious&$$@Center@$There is a secret passage, only known to
the royal family.

$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaSerious&$$@Center@$I hid there and heard everything.
Garismor, you've disappointed me.

$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaSerious&$$@Center@$And on top of that, how dare you turn my
companion, my friend—into a tool for
$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaSerious&$$@Center@$murder.
$#ChancellorGarismor(Chancellor Garismor)#$$&AugustinSneer&$$@Center@$Wh-What... What are you saying...

$#ChancellorGarismor(Chancellor Garismor)#$$&AugustinSneer&$$@Center@$Your Majesty, surely you don't seriously
believe the nonsense of that thief?

$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaSerious&$$@Center@$Lupin is my friend... My accomplice for
three years now.
$#ChancellorGarismor(Chancellor Garismor)#$$&AugustinSneer&$$@Center@$Tch... Hah, is that so! Then you are the traitor to the nation! I'll execute you
$#ChancellorGarismor(Chancellor Garismor)#$$&AugustinSneer&$$@Center@$here and now!
$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaSurprised&$$@Center@$That's one of those Bergarian weapons—!?
$#Guard(Guard)#$her confined in a cell...
$#ChancellorGarismor(Chancellor Garismor)#$$&AugustinSneer&$$@Center@$A gun!
$#BurstingGunshot(Bursting Gunshot)#$$!-1!$BANG—!
$#ChancellorGarismor(Chancellor Garismor)#$$&AugustinSurprised&$$@Center@$Ugh... Ah... Ow... Why do you have—

$#Lupin(Lupin)#$$&LupinPero&$$@Center@$I confiscated it from someone causing a
scene in town.

$#Lupin(Lupin)#$$&LupinPero&$$@Center@$If you still plan on fighting, you will lose
more than just your right hand.
$#ChancellorGarismor(Chancellor Garismor)#$$&AugustinSurprised&$$@Center@$H-Hng...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletShouting&$$@Center@$Lady Victoria, are you safe!?

$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaSerious&$$@Center@$Ludmilla, Knights of Wellmund. He's the
mastermind behind the whole incident.
$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$@Center@$Arrest Garismor.
$#WellmundKnight(Wellmund Knight)#$$@Center@$Understood!!

$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaSadSmileSad&$$@Center@$I see... I understand. Please continue to
treat her with care.
$#ChancellorGarismor(Chancellor Garismor)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Center@$My dreams... My future...

$#AmazedAudience(Amazed Audience)#$Seeing them like this, each and every one
of them, is beautiful.

$#AmazedAudience(Amazed Audience)#$It is the royal ballet troupe! Every one of
them is étoile-class!

$#AmazedAudience(Amazed Audience)#$Someday, I want to join the ballet troupe
too.
$#AmazedAudience(Amazed Audience)#$Oh, looks like a scene change!

$#()#$Victoria's final performance ended
safely—with the best possible finale.
$#()#$It is said the final grand pas de deux was so dazzling that everyone sighed in
$#()#$wondrous unison, breathless and amazed.

$#()#$And Victoria, seeing her father smiling
gently in the box, shed quiet tears.

$#()#$The day of Ludmilla and Clarice's
departure—

$#Guard(Guard)#$Understood. And then, about the other
one—

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$Thanks to your work, the festival ended
safely.

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$It seems there may be a change in policy
about seeking help from other countries.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$We didn't do anything. If anything, all the

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$Lupin, yes... Certainly. But even if we

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$where she is...
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSadSmileNoSword&$$@Center@$She's probably nearby. Maybe.
$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaSadSmile&$$@Center@$Yes, I have that feeling too.

$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaNormal&$$@Center@$As for Former Chancellor Garismor...
He will likely be exiled.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Center@$But if you exile him, won't he defect to the
country he was colluding with?

$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaSerious&$$@Center@$Not to worry. We've informed that country
of what happened and our concerns.
$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaNormal&$$@Center@$The other one?

enough.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceBalletShy&$$@Left@$I-I didn't expect such a quick apology... I'm
sorry, I went too far with the sarcasm.

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Her Majesty has practiced ballet since
childhood, and she is currently the star of
$#Moore(Moore)#$$@Center@$the troupe—the étoile.

$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaNormalSmile&$$@Center@$So as not to disgrace the title of étoile, I
will continue to devote myself—
$#ChancellorGarismor(Snide Man)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Center@$That would be a problem, Your Majesty.
$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaNormal&$$@Center@$Chancellor Garismor...

$#ChancellorGarismor(Chancellor Garismor)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Center@$Break time is over. I dare say this is
hardly the time to indulge in such antics,

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$No, there's no problem. Now then, you
two, introduce yourselves.
$#ChancellorGarismor(Chancellor Garismor)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Center@$don't you think?
$#BalletMember(Ballet Member)#$Such antics!?
$#ChancellorGarismor(Chancellor Garismor)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Center@$Do you have something to say?
$#BalletMember(Ballet Member)#$N-No...

$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaPout&$$@Center@$Chancellor Garismor, the Royal Ballet is
this country's treasure!
$#ChancellorGarismor(Chancellor Garismor)#$$&AugustinSerious&$$@Center@$I spoke out of turn... However, you will fulfill your duties as queen.
$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaPout&$$@Center@$...

$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaSigh&$$@Center@$I'm sorry, everyone. It seems I must
return.
$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaSad&$$@Center@$Ludmilla and Clarice... My apologies.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSmile&$$@Center@$Please don't worry about us...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I'm Ludmilla. I look forward to practicing
with you all!

$#Helena(Cheerful Ballet Member)#$$&BalletLadyASmile&$$@Center@$Your Majesty, you are welcome here
anytime!
$#Victoria(Victoria)#$$&VictoriaSadSmile&$$@Center@$Thank you, Helena.
$#Helena(Helena)#$$&BalletLadyASmile&$$@Center@$Your Majesty!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSerious&$$@Center@$(I understand the chancellor's argument,
but... Even so...)

$#BalletInstructor(Ballet Instructor)#$$!-1!$Everyone, pull yourselves together—we
will resume the lesson! Get in position!
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceBalletSmile&$$@Left@$I am Clarice. A pleasure to meet you.

$#BalletMemberA(Ballet Member A)#$$!-1!$Of course! We welcome you with open
hearts.

$#BalletMemberB(Ballet Member B)#$Both of you are so beautiful, and you have
such graceful limbs. I'm jealous.

$#Helena(Cheerful Ballet Member)#$$&BalletLadyASmile&$$@Left@$Yeah, your bodies are suited for ballet!
Let's do our best together!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletTroubledLaugh&$$@Center@$Hold on a moment, Mr. Moore! What is
this turn of events...

$#Louise(Sharp-Tongued Ballet Member)#$$&BalletLadyBSerious&$$@Right@$Our next production is coming soon,
whether you like it or not! It's especially

$#Sharp-TonguedBalletMember(Sharp-Tongued Ballet Member)#$$&BalletLadyBSerious&$$@Right@$important because it's the day before the
festival. Don't get in the way, trainees.

$#BalletInstructor(Ballet Instructor)#$$!-1!$All right! If that is all for announcements,
start stretching right away!

$#BalletInstructor(Ballet Instructor)#$You two, come over here. I want to see
what your current level is.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletNormal&$$@Right@$Come to think of it, Father made me
watch ballet a few times when I was little.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletNormal&$$@Right@$And you were with me, right, Clarice?

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceBalletNormal&$$@Left@$Yes, when I served you at the Aldyne
household, I accompanied you to the
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceBalletNormal&$$@Left@$theater.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSerious&$$@Right@$If we've seen it before, then surely we can
dance it ourselves!
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceBalletShy&$$@Left@$Y-Yes... Surely...

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$(Whisper) I'll explain later, please play
along for now.
$#BalletInstructor(Ballet Instructor)#$$!-1!$All right, get ready.

$#BalletInstructor(Ballet Instructor)#$First, stand straight—turn your heels
inward, and en dehors!

$#BalletInstructor(Ballet Instructor)#$Your postures are both fairly good... All
right, I'll play the music.
$#BalletInstructor(Ballet Instructor)#$All right, that's enough. Thank you both.

$#BalletMemberA(Ballet Member A)#$Th-That was amazing... Especially
Ludmilla...

$#BalletMemberB(Ballet Member B)#$I've never seen such innovative dancing...
As intense as slashing with a sword...

$#BalletMemberC(Ballet Member C)#$Yes, I could almost see people getting cut
down...

$#Louise(Sharp-Tongued Ballet Member)#$$&BalletLadyBAngry&$$@Center@$Don't insult ballet. That kind of
haphazard dancing isn't ballet!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletBlush&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I-I got scolded...

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceBalletColdAngry&$$@Left@$That woman, how dare she speak to Miss
like that...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletTroubledLaugh&$$@Center@$(Whisper) Is this part of the top-secret
mission?

$#BalletInstructor(Ballet Instructor)#$$!-1!$It's true. Ludmilla, it looks like you will
have a lot to adjust.

$#BalletInstructor(Ballet Instructor)#$Clarice, you seem to lack the proper
knowledge, but your fundamentals are
$#BalletInstructor(Ballet Instructor)#$all there. Especially your fouette.

$#BalletInstructor(Ballet Instructor)#$That careful control all the way down to
your fingertips and tiptoes... Where did you
$#BalletInstructor(Ballet Instructor)#$learn how to turn?

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceBalletSleep&$$@Center@$Just imitation. I use spins in combat, after
all. It's efficient.
$#BalletMemberA(Ballet Member A)#$Combat?
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceBalletUpset&$$@Center@$Never mind.

$#BalletInstructor(Ballet Instructor)#$$!-1!$In any case, for today, your priority is to
observe and learn what ballet truly is.
$#PreparingBalletMember(Preparing Ballet Member)#$We're done stretching!
$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$(Whisper) Of course.

$#BalletInstructor(Ballet Instructor)#$Take your place by the barre—all right,
let's begin.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletBlush&$$@Center@$Seeing and doing are completely different
things... This will take some training...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSmile&$$@Center@$All right, let's watch them practice! It
might benefit future combat training!

$#BalletInstructor(Ballet Instructor)#$$!-1!$Then, from the top: three, four, five—
parallel. Watch the soles of your feet.
$#BalletInstructor(Ballet Instructor)#$From plié through relevé, the full set—— all right, un, deux, trois.

$#BalletInstructor(Ballet Instructor)#$Good. Fundamentals are key. Always keep
that in mind, and don't neglect them.
$#BalletInstructor(Ballet Instructor)#$Next, we'll practice pas de bourree. Come forward one at a time.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSerious&$$@Right@$The moment practice began, everyone's
demeanor changed.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceBalletNormal&$$@Left@$Yes. Almost like they're crossing swords...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSerious&$$@Right@$As expected of the Royal Ballet, they train
with such intensity...
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSigh&$$@Center@$(Whisper) I understand...
$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ludmilla, Clarice... May I have a moment?

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$I thought I might explain the top-secret
mission in detail.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSmile&$$@Center@$Then let's step outside for a moment.

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$My apologies, Mrs. Sophie. There is
something I need to tell them briefly.

$#BalletInstructor(Ballet Instructor)#$$!-1!$Very well, but come back quickly.
Observing is part of learning too.

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$Now then, let's talk about why this
mission must be top secret.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceBalletSerious&$$@Center@$Because of the traditions of your country's
knights, I presume.

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$Yes, exactly as you surmised. Our knight
order is this country's greatest military

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$force, and it holds great authority and
power.

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$No one can openly defy that prestige. Such
is the air of this country.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceBalletHah&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Is this really fine...? You could refuse, you
know?

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$Even the knight order itself is not exempt
from it.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$So you mean, the knight order wants more
manpower, yet is obstructed by the very
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSerious&$$@Right@$prestige it upholds.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceBalletUpset&$$@Left@$How ridiculous. That's just shooting
yourself in the foot.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSerious&$$@Right@$If the knight order openly sought help
from other nations, their authority would

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSerious&$$@Right@$be diminished. Hence, a top-secret
mission.

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It is just as you say. And as a loyal
retainer of the Kingdom of Wellmund, it
$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$pains me deeply...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSerious&$$@Center@$But don't the Wellmund Knights have
Sir Gevodan, the renowned knight?

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$Therein lies the problem. He was seriously
injured recently and can no longer fight.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSadSmile&$$@Right@$It seems we have no choice. Clarice, play
along.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSurprised&$$@Center@$To think even that Sir Gevodan...

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$Yes. And in the midst of that, came this
notice—
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSerious&$$@Center@$A notice?
$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$Yes, please take a look.
$#Notice(Notice)#$$!-1!$On the day of the coming festival, I shall claim the soul of this realm's fairest swan.
$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$The sender is Arsene Lupin.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceBalletNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$That great thief!? The name is well known
even in Rigland.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSerious&$$@Right@$What would the swan's soul be?

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Surely the symbol of the Wellmund royal
family—a crown made of pure gold known
$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$as the Swan Crown.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceBalletShy&$$@Left@$If you say so, Miss... But ballet isn't
exactly my style...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSerious&$$@Center@$And the coming festival refers to the
festival one month from now.

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$If the crown were to be stolen, confidence
in our nation would surely be shaken.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSerious&$$@Center@$I now understand the situation. We will
cooperate fully.

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$You have my gratitude. And so, I would
like to ask you both to guard Her Majesty.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceBalletNormal&$$@Center@$Not to capture Lupin?

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$There are still those within the knight
order who believe we must not allow
$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$foreign intervention...

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceBalletSleep&$$@Center@$If our goal is the same and the outsiders
accomplish it first, it could foster grudges?

$#Moore(Moore)#$$&BlackwoodMobSerious&$$@Center@$Yes... I am truly sorry. Even after you've
come all this way...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaBalletSmile&$$@Center@$No, that's fine. If we can be of help in any
way, that is our wish.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Victoria was born as the eldest daughter of the long-standing Royal House of Wellmund.
Raised from childhood to one day succeed her father, the king, she received a thorough royal education. Combined with her exceptional talent, she has mastered horsemanship, etiquette, diplomacy, and politics.

VictoriaRegular01.name: Victoria
VictoriaRegular01.title: The Crowned Étoile
VictoriaRegular01.description:
Victoria was born as the eldest daughter of the long-standing Royal House of Wellmund.
Raised from childhood to one day succeed her father, the king, she received a thorough royal education. Combined with her exceptional talent, she has mastered horsemanship, etiquette, diplomacy, and politics.

keys.IntroText:
The curtains have risen...
Let us go forth, the stage is calling for us!

keys.DescriptionKey:
She also joined the Royal Ballet Troupe, one of Wellmund's proudest cultural institutions. There, she quickly blossomed as a skilled dancer and rose to the prestigious position of étoile—the very face of the entire troupe.
But when her father, the king, fell gravely ill and could no longer carry out his duties, Victoria had to inherit the throne. From that day on, she found herself consumed by the endless demands of being a queen.

VictoriaRegular02.name: Victoria
VictoriaRegular02.title: The Crowned Étoile
VictoriaRegular02.description:
She also joined the Royal Ballet Troupe, one of Wellmund's proudest cultural institutions. There, she quickly blossomed as a skilled dancer and rose to the prestigious position of étoile—the very face of the entire troupe.
But when her father, the king, fell gravely ill and could no longer carry out his duties, Victoria had to inherit the throne. From that day on, she found herself consumed by the endless demands of being a queen.

keys.DescriptionKey: Before long, her ballet training had to fall by the wayside. A perfectionist to her core, Victoria could not tolerate performing at anything less than her best, and resolved to leave behind the ballet she loved rather than drag down the rest of the troupe. But through the events of the recent incident, she came to understand the strength it takes to rely on others. And with the help of this strength, she hopes that once she has truly grown into her role as queen...she might one day return to the stage again.

keys.DescriptionKey:
This unit cannot fall asleep.

When this unit enters battle, for 200TU, at the end of each turn an ally gets, the ally:
- will heal for 1% of their max HP.
- will be Purified (any negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed).
- may gain a Sleep Ward, Stun Ward and a Poison Ward (50% chance for each ward).
This effect will end if this unit leaves the battlefield. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack.

If all allies on the battlefield are at max HP when this unit enters battle, this unit gains a Power Charge.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHeh&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst545|$My blade is as fierce and unpredictable as a
flood! You never stood a chance!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst553|$You are both miraculous flowers, blooming
upon this battlefield!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise;Ludmilla.LudmillaSerious;&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;Ludmilla.Right;@$$|act2.Voices/mst554|$A bellflower... That's actually one of my
favorite flowers.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst555|$A sunflower, hmm? It's a nice comparison,
though a little strange to hear.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst556|$I'm Finn!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst557|$Oh yes, Sir Finn. A fine name.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst558|$Hey, no flower for me?

$#FrogKnightA(Bikki Guard A)#$$&FrogKnight&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst559|$Knights, thank you so much for your aid!
Our town is mostly unscathed as a result!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst560|$We are just happy we could be of help.
$#FrogKnightA(Bikki Guard A)#$$&FrogKnight&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst561|$May we ask what business brings you here?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst562|$Very well.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy;Nagi.NagiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right;;Nagi.Right;@$$|act2.Voices/mst546|$That was incredible! You drove off a
demon!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst563|$I am going ahead to explain our situation.
Meet me at the palace in a little while.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst564|$Yes ma'am!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst565|$And Rizette...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst566|$If you disobey my orders again, I will expel
you from the Knights.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst567|$I... I'm sorry.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst568|$I want Theo to get well as soon as possible
too.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$|Cont|$But if you want to see that happen, you
need to stay alive. Understood?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst569|$Yes ma'am...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst570|$Good. Nagi, I will find a way to repay you
later. We will be in town for a while.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left;0.5;;@$$|act2.Voices/mst571|$The Captain can be kind of scary, huh?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst547|$Heh... You have quite the arm yourself, sir!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSadSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst572|$Scary... but kind.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst573|$Finn, your Captain is an individual of great
caliber, a magnificent sunflower!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst574|$Now then, I have business to attend to.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst575|$Are you leaving, Nagi?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst576|$I will remain in this town for a while. I am
sure we shall meet again.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst577|$Lady Rizette, I would love to treat you to
some mochi at the local sweet store later.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst578|$Farewell!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right;0.5;;@$$|act2.Voices/mst579|$Um... Bye.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst580|$He's an incredible swordmaster, but he's
kind of weird.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst581|$He's kind of weird, but he's really strong.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst548|$I'm Rizette... Thank you for your help.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst582|$Want to take a look around before we head
to the palace?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteHeh&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst583|$Okay. Maybe someone in town knows
something helpful.

$#Norza(Silver-haired Demon)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst584|$So the Crimson Crestbearer has reared
their head...
$#Gyurelle(Dragon-horned Demon)#$$&GyurelleDarkNormal&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst585|$Yep! In Ossia's territory.

$#Norza(Silver-haired Demon)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst586|$Call that rookie back. She can't handle
the front lines. Let me take over.

$#Gyurelle(Dragon-horned Demon)#$$&GyurelleDarkBlush&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst587|$No can do∼
His Majesty's orders are absolute.

$#Norza(Silver-haired Demon)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst588|$This is inefficient. I could obliterate those
frogs and their sage by noon tomorrow.

$#Gyurelle(Dragon-horned Demon)#$$&GyurelleDarkSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst589|$Y'know, if you disobey His will...you can kiss
your Eternity goodbye here and now.

$#Norza(Silver-haired Demon)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst590|$Ha. You think you're our Lord's right hand?
Want to lose a horn, here and now?

$#Gyurelle(Dragon-horned Demon)#$$&GyurelleDarkHappy&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst591|$Yikes... You're so meeean.
Anyways, there's no way Ossia's gonna lose.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst549|$Ludmilla, of the Red Dragon Knights.

$#Norza(Silver-haired Demon)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst592|$Fine. Let the Illustrious Plaguebearer
show us what she's got.
$#Norza(Silver-haired Demon)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst593|$I'm going back to Me'Rizanté.

$#Norza(Silver-haired Demon)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$You can look forward to my work with the
kud and sziviik.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Left@$$|Cont|$Nagi, you saved one of my knights. There
must be something we can do to thank you.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$!-1!$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst550|$Lady Rizette, Lady Ludmilla... You are
both so gallant, and so beautiful!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst551|$Lady Rizette, I would compare thee to a
bellflower, at once brave and gentle.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Center@$$|act2.Voices/mst552|$Lady Ludmilla, you are brilliant and
benevolent as a sunflower...
WWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWW
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst318|$Wh-Where are we? What just happened?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst327|$This wall... Take a closer look.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst328|$Huh? Oh... There's something written on it?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst329|$My eyes have adjusted now. This is...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst330|$...!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst331|$Some kind of wall carving? It looks really
old...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst332|$Are these...demons? And humans? They're
fighting.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst333|$Not just humans. Look at these ears—this
one is an elf.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$|Cont|$There's bikki and kud too.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst334|$And sziviik...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst335|$This looks like a Pandemonium. From a
really long time ago.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst319|$Is this some kind of hidden room?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst336|$Look, there's a huge demon in the middle.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst337|$This must be their leader...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst338|$...!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst339|$(The Eternal! And there's a warrior facing
it...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst340|$(Their eyes are glowing red. Is this the
Crestbearer!?)

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst341|$Even all these years ago, the Pandemonium
was happening.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst342|$And the people of Erden have been fighting
back against it all this time...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst343|$"The Great Cycle."
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst344|$Huh?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst345|$That's what one of the elders in my village
called the Pandemonium.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst320|$The Captain did say this place is a remnant
of the Old Kingdom.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$|Cont|$"The tears of Erden's children shall cleanse
the land of its sins. All shall be renewed."

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst346|$She told me the Pandemonium is necessary
to maintain balance in the world.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$|Cont|$It is at once an ordeal, and a boon,
bestowed upon us by the gods.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst347|$But... The cost is far too great!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst348|$My home, my friends, my family, everything
is gone.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst349|$And soon, even Theo might be...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst350|$He's all I have, and I couldn't protect him!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteUpset&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst351|$What good could possibly come of this...
This horror!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst352|$...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCryRed&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst353|$Rizette!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst321|$Did we activate some kind of old magic?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSurprise&$$@Right@$$|act1.Voices/mst354|$Finn!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCryRed&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst355|$I'm sorry I... Everything that happened is
so...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst356|$Rizette, we can't let the ones who did all
these terrible things get away with it!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommandRed&$$@Left@$$|act1.Voices/mst357|$Maybe there's not much we can do alone.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Washington was an ordinary girl with unremarkable grades — the kind you could find anywhere. Then she met Chopin, a dazzling, almost blinding genius.

Strangely enough, they clicked. And for some reason, she alone could understand Chopin's outrageous ideas. Before she knew it, the two had become inseparable.

She never once doubted that she would stay by Chopin's side forever.

WashingtonRegular01.name: Washington
WashingtonRegular01.title: Always the Number One!
WashingtonRegular01.description:
Washington was an ordinary girl with unremarkable grades — the kind you could find anywhere. Then she met Chopin, a dazzling, almost blinding genius.

Strangely enough, they clicked. And for some reason, she alone could understand Chopin's outrageous ideas. Before she knew it, the two had become inseparable.

She never once doubted that she would stay by Chopin's side forever.

keys.IntroText: Did someone call for this genius scientist?!

keys.DescriptionKey:
As they grew older, Chopin's brilliance began to bloom at an astonishing pace.
As she merrily spoke of increasingly complex scientific theories, Washington felt more and more distance between them.
She used to understand Chopin. She had believed she was the only one who truly could. But the reality that she — the ordinary girl that she was — was slowly getting left behind frightened her...

WashingtonRegular02.name: Washington
WashingtonRegular02.title: Always the Number One!
WashingtonRegular02.description:
As they grew older, Chopin's brilliance began to bloom at an astonishing pace.
As she merrily spoke of increasingly complex scientific theories, Washington felt more and more distance between them.
She used to understand Chopin. She had believed she was the only one who truly could. But the reality that she — the ordinary girl that she was — was slowly getting left behind frightened her...

keys.DescriptionKey:
The thought of not being able to stay beside Chopin was unbearable. And so Washington made a decision: she would become a genius as well.

If she lacked talent, then she would make up for it with effort. To remain at Chopin's side, she studied more than anyone, thought harder than anyone, and never stopped challenging herself. In the end, that extraordinary determination allowed Washington to finally catch up to Chopin.

It was a struggle that she chose willingly — so that the two of them could always remain together.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Despite her young age, Adena is the first mate and right hand of Dargarossa, the fearsome Bane of the Ashiran Sea. While on her way to be sold as a slave in a far-off land, her ship was raided by Dargarossa and she was freed; with nowhere else to go, she decided to stick around, and became a pirate. Though free-spirited, she respects Dargarossa deeply.
When the call to board is sounded and the battle is joined, she's the first one across the gap, leaping to the deck of the other ship and laying waste around her with her spear. Despite her young age, the crew respects her second only to the Captain himself, and they call her "Sis".

keys.DescriptionKey: The young Queen of the island nation of Laomis, and head priestess of Nautica, the Primordial of Water. The people of Laomis depend entirely on the sea for their lives, so they view Esma, whose job it is to keep the favor of the tempestuous Primordial, with the utmost respect. Though she's a fine ruler and well-liked by her people, she's still very young, and sometimes feels like she'll buckle under the weight of her responsibilities.

WaterPriestess01.name: Esma
WaterPriestess01.title: Bride of the Sea
WaterPriestess01.description: The young Queen of the island nation of Laomis, and head priestess of Nautica, the Primordial of Water. The people of Laomis depend entirely on the sea for their lives, so they view Esma, whose job it is to keep the favor of the tempestuous Primordial, with the utmost respect. Though she's a fine ruler and well-liked by her people, she's still very young, and sometimes feels like she'll buckle under the weight of her responsibilities.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Though a demure and gentle ruler now, Esma used to be quite a tomboy, sneaking out of the palace to go down to the docks, listen to the pirates' tales of their exploits, and dream of the world on the other side of the ocean.
\Over the course of her visits, she fell in love with a dashing young pirate; but he refused her feelings. Heartbroken, in a moment of weakness, she prayed to Nautica for revenge... and upon hearing that his ship had been lost to the sea, she realized that she had done something unforgivable. The regret still torments her, but the harsh lesson helped shape her into the responsible monarch she is today.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst671|$This sounded noble at first, but now it's
getting fishy...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst672|$What are you saying, Lady Rizette!? I
admire and adore every princess equally!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst673|$That is why I am so saddened by this news!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$That not even the medicines of Kisenkyo
can cure this ailment...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst674|$What must I do? What must I do to see the
Lily of Kisenkyo smile once more!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst675|$His motive is a little hard to get behind...
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst676|$He seems genuinely worried, though.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst677|$...

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst655|$Oh, Sir Finn, Lady Rizette... There has been
a great tragedy...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst678|$Nagi, there might still be a way to save the
Princess.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst679|$What!?

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst680|$It's dangerous, and uncertain. But people
are depending on us, so we're going to try.
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst681|$If you really want to save the Princess...
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst682|$Let's go!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst683|$That was fast!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst684|$I would freeze my skin in the Silverdrake
Mountains!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|Cont|$Boil my blood in the Habsu Desert! Break
my bones on the Cliffs of Tannhauser!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst685|$If it is for a princess, there is nothing I
won't do! Let's go!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst686|$Finn... I think we can trust him.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst656|$Princess Saki of Kisenkyo has fallen ill!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst687|$He does seem reliable. But could someone
really risk their life for a reason like that?
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst688|$As if you can talk.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst689|$Huh?

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst690|$Lead the way! I will strike down any
obstacle that stands in our way!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst691|$Okay. I'll talk to the Captain.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst692|$Let's save everyone who is suffering from
this illness!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst693|$It would be my honor!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst694|$...so Nagi would like to help, Captain. Is that
okay?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst695|$Nagi is a seasoned warrior. And I sense
sincerity in his motive.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSerious&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst696|$I see no reason to turn him away.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst657|$Yeah, we just found out too.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst697|$Did you hear that, Nagi?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiAngry&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst698|$Lady Ludmilla, I give you my blade!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst699|$We are grateful to have it!
$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst700|$Captain, we're ready to go!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst701|$Very well. Let us make for the Realm of
Reia, where the Great Sage sleeps!

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteWorried&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst658|$She has the Sleeping Death... Just like my
brother.
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSad&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst659|$Your brother is also ill, Lady Rizette?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$$|act2.Voices/mst660|$Do you know the princess, Nagi?
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Right@$$|act2.Voices/mst661|$Know her? She is princess of my heart!

keys.DescriptionKey:
A knight of Hymelia. Unlike his childhood friend Merdain, he comes from a high-ranking, long-standing noble house. He was sickly and weak as a child, but he forced himself to keep up with his friends Merdain and Maxima, overcame his weakness, and is now an outstanding knight.
Lucius strongly respected Merdain's father Artorias, who rose from the rank of footsoldier to the rank of General, and then to nobility. He sees Artorias as proof that anything is possible if you work hard, and believes he can overcome his illness too if he only works hard enough.

Maxima: "First one to the big oak is the winner, okay? Ready, set, go! ...Haha, I win again! You're so slow, Lucius!"

Merdain: "Lay off, Maxima. Last month he couldn't even keep up with us, remember?"

Maxima: "Hmph. You always take Lucius's side."

Lucius: "Sorry, I just... need to catch my breath. Can we rest for a minute?"

keys.DescriptionKey:
Lucius arrives on Avalon with Merdain, and they learn the truth about Merdain's father. However, it doesn't change Lucius's respect for Artorias. He believes that Artorias would have distinguished himself even without the Fruit of Wisdom.

Artorias was kind and supported Lucius when he was starting out as a knight, and he served as Lucius's inspiration to better himself. Partially in order to repay that debt, Lucius wants to protect Merdain from his own self-destruction and rescue him from ending up as food for Avalon. He'll face any foe, even the gods themselves, to keep that from happening.

With a strong enough will, even fate can be changed, or so he believes.

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Day 26, on the road to elven lands:

I have slept in my saddle now for three days straight. Our caravan leader insists he will not stop until he spies a baby Aethrodon -- the blasted things appear only in total safety, he says. Camping anywhere else would doom us all, he says.

Confound these elves. Pandemonium or not, we're armed to the teeth. I think we can take our chances, tiny lizard's blessing be damned."

-- From The Travels of Caerwyn

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Day 31, in the heart of the elven forests:

I'd seen nothing like it in all my days. Bedecked in bronze armor, brilliant as a shard of the summer sky -- this, I asked, is what comes of those skittish creatures we glimpsed on the road?

'Why else would we wait to see one before we camp?' the chieftain answered me. 'Wherever a young Aethrodon wanders, its mother guards its path. No enemy would dare approach.'"

-- From The Travels of Caerwyn

keys.DescriptionKey:
Once upon a time, a little girl named Clarice lived with her mother on the streets of a very cold, very cruel city.

Clarice loved her mother dearly, but love could not fill their hungry bellies. Day after day, her mother would lead her around, asking for coin, for shelter, for anything.

No one could give her what she asked, because no one had anything to spare.

Finally, on a night when the wind cut like knives, she abandoned her daughter and never once looked back. What a bad little girl she must have been, for her own mother to leave her to die.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Clarice found her way to the mansion of a lord. For a long, long time, the lord kept her as his servant, but she was so clumsy he sold her away, to a noble couple who needed a handmaiden for their daughter Ludmilla.

Even though she was a terrible maid, Ludmilla showed Clarice great kindness. She let her borrow her books and do her hair, and over time, they became the best of friends.

Until she grew up and didn't want her anymore. Until she tried to run away.

Why would she do that? Weren't they friends? Was she a bad girl again?

Why... why... why why why whywhywhywhywh—

keys.DescriptionKey:
Clarice was a bad girl for a very long time. She hurt her best friend, then learned to hurt others too. A sorcerer gave her great power in exchange for her freedom, a trade she made all too happily. As long as he wouldn't abandon her, she'd never leave his side.

Little did she know, being left alone was not the same as being forgotten.

Though she had grown into a twisted assassin in their time apart, Ludmilla saw the lonely, scared girl inside Clarice. She forgave her for the terrible things she'd done, and released her from the evil binding her heart. For the first time in her life, Clarice was truly free.

A happy ending had found her after all.

YandereMaidDark01.title: Maid of Darkness
YandereMaidDark01.description: A maid, by the name of Clarice, suddenly appeared in the Greyford palace. The silverware she polished was flawless, the morning tea was always at the perfect temperature, the hallways she cleaned did not have a speck of dust. She accomplished her every duty even before being ordered—truly, the perfect maid.

keys.IntroText:
Your orders?
Not that I intend to follow them, of course.

keys.DescriptionKey: However, her demeanor could hardly be called submissive. She would even defy the young queen. "You thought you could tame me? How utterly presumptuous." Stung by her words and thrown off by her whims, the courtiers soon formed a secret fan club.

keys.DescriptionKey: Within Clarice, Ludmilla was the immovable, absolute number one. That will never change. But she began to see flickering mirages of others in her cold, isolated world. These were colored differently. Colored with words like friendship and affection; words she had never known before.

keys.DescriptionKey:
At a sunlit race course, the spectators' eyes are not on the state-of-the-art cars lining the pits, but on a certain silver-haired woman—one fitting the role of a race queen so seamlessly, you would never guess her day job is a maid.
Head to toe in cool blue to complement Ludmilla's deep red, Clarice stands by her mistress's side, and the venue bursts into deafening applause.

YandereMaidRaceQueen01.name: Clarice
YandereMaidRaceQueen01.title: Full-Throttle Racer
YandereMaidRaceQueen01.description:
At a sunlit race course, the spectators' eyes are not on the state-of-the-art cars lining the pits, but on a certain silver-haired woman—one fitting the role of a race queen so seamlessly, you would never guess her day job is a maid.
Head to toe in cool blue to complement Ludmilla's deep red, Clarice stands by her mistress's side, and the venue bursts into deafening applause.

keys.IntroText:
Looks like Miss Ludmilla needs my support!
Let's go then! Onwards!
Just the two of us on the road to victory!

keys.DescriptionKey:
As a matter of fact, today Clarice is neither a maid, nor a race queen—she's a driver, and she's here to win. The way her heart resonates with the engine of her car from the moment the green flag is waved, and the breakneck back-and-forth with other competitors... For her, racing is just like love.
She won't stop her car or let her heart slow down, no matter what—not until the victory is hers.

YandereMaidRaceQueen02.name: Clarice
YandereMaidRaceQueen02.title: Full-Throttle Racer
YandereMaidRaceQueen02.description:
As a matter of fact, today Clarice is neither a maid, nor a race queen—she's a driver, and she's here to win. The way her heart resonates with the engine of her car from the moment the green flag is waved, and the breakneck back-and-forth with other competitors... For her, racing is just like love.
She won't stop her car or let her heart slow down, no matter what—not until the victory is hers.

keys.DescriptionKey:
Racing doesn't end when you cross the finish line; every driver has their own race that keeps going. To make sure they win next time. To move forward, as far as possible. To reunite with the person they miss.
Clarice's heart doesn't stop racing once she's cut the engine, either. Is it because of her mistress, or maybe—
The answer is waiting for her at her destination.

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Kuhuhu. How do I look, Miss? It suits me? My, how wonderful to hear."
"Since we have the chance, would you do me the honor of playing with me? You would!? Then please, assist me in making a boat. Once we have, we can row to a deserted island, then send the boat out into the sea. Then it will be just you, me, and our love, forever."

keys.IntroText:
"Kuhuhu. Step out of the way, please.
Where is my Mistress?"

keys.DescriptionKey:
"Miss! Would you care for a drink?"
"Ah, this other one? Mm. You, over there. If you must stare so enviously, then here, have it before the ice melts."
(How rude of you, to intrude upon my private time with my Mistress. For all you know, someone might have put something in that. Fortunately for you, that isn't the case... this time. Kuhuhu...)

keys.DescriptionKey: Between a bright blue sky and soft white sand, the maid and her mistress play together. Separated by a desperate sin, reunited by a chance twist of fate. Only time will tell if further tragedy lies in their future, but for now, the two laugh and smile together, as the surf laps the sand.
