$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaHappy&$$@Center@$Go for it, Fiiiinn!
Ha, first team done and done.
$#AdultCallen(Adult Callen)#$$&CallenDragonRedEyeComplainBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Gah! I am so late!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$!-1!$$@Left@$There are times in life when sacrifices need
to be made! Come on, Clarice!!!

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceRaceQueenSigh&$$@Right@$Right, we may have different motives,
but I can't afford to lose either.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceRaceQueenShouting&$$@Right@$Here we go!!!
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Hey, Finn!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Left@$I can see the fourth checkpoint! Theo's
there!
$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoSmile&$$@Right@$Good luck, Finn!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyes&$$@Center@$(Theo is such a beacon of purity. I can do
anything knowing he's got my back!)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$Thank you, Th—

$#Theo(Theo)#$$&TheoHappy&$$@Right@$Oh, it's Norza!!! You can do it, Norza!
I believe in you!!! Go go gooooo!!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHorror&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Th-Theo... No... Not you too!
What else is he going to take from me...!?
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Now who is this!?

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzGrin&$$@Center@$What's wrong, Hero?
Ahahaha!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$Norza! You won't get away with this!!!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzGrin&$$@Center@$This feeling... Pure ecstasy! Just like the
good old Pristine Corpseblade days—
$#NorzaDark(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$Chronos! No meddling in this time!
$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Very well, but do not forget our goal.
$#NorzaDark(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Right@$Heh, don't worry about that.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What could a human and a Primordial
possibly have in common to wish for?
$#NorzaDark(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$@Center@$There is only one thing we want—
$#Chronos;NorzaDark;(Norza & Chronos)#$$&RolotiaClock;NorzaDark.NorzaAngry&$$!-1!$$@Left;;;NorzaDark.Right;@$to buy that poor thing some normal clothes!

$#Rololitia(Rololitia)#$$&YoungRolotiaSurprised&$$@Center@$Huh? Why did the camera suddenly pan
to me...?

$#AdultCallen(Adult Callen)#$$&CallenDragonRedEyeHeh&$$@Right@$I am Callen! The buxom genius scholar!
And you are...me?

$#Rololitia(Rololitia)#$$&YoungRolotiaShock&$$@Center@$S-Surely you're not calling me "that
poor thing!"

$#Rololitia(Rololitia)#$$&YoungRolotiaShock&$$@Center@$It's not what you think! I only look this
way because I had to use all my magic!

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Awww, don't you just look adorable!
I wish I had an outfit like that!♪

$#TavunRabbit(Tavun Rabbit)#$$&RabbitSmile&$$@Left@$Ah yes, the fabled Magical Girl look!
It really suits you!
$#Rololitia(Rololitia)#$$&YoungRolotiaClosedEyeSweat&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I mean...it is cute and all but... Hmph...

$#Rololitia(Rololitia)#$$&YoungRolotiaConfused&$$@Left@$No fair. Why did you get away with no side
effects after casting such powerful magic?
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceWink&$$@Right@$Well, all I did was provide a dream.

$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceWink&$$@Right@$Besides, if I'd gone any younger, I'd be a
literal baby now♪
$#Alice(Alice)#$$&AliceSurprised&$$@Right@$Oh, and by the way, about your name—

$#Rololitia(Rololitia)#$$&YoungRolotiaShock&$$@Left@$My name...? Aaaaaah!!!
It says "Ro-loli-tia"!?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSad&$$@Left@$I suppose I am. So there is a world out there
where the accident never happened...

$#Rololitia(Rololitia)#$$&YoungRolotiaShock&$$@Left@$All right, that's it! Come on out, whoever
came up with this whole prank! Now!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Beni-Shoga)#$$&BenishogaShouting&$The crowd yearns for more as we venture
into the last leg of the race!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Beni-Shoga)#$$&BenishogaShouting&$I anticipate all shall be fastened to the
brink of their seats henceforth!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Beni-Shoga)#$$&BenishogaShouting&$Lo, we approacheth the grand twist!

$#NorzaDark(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$@Center@$Hm? The road's getting narrow all of a
sudden...
$#NorzaDark(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Center@$No—!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$!-1!$$@Left@$The edges of the road are crumbling! Clarice,
step on it!

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceRaceQueenShouting&$$@Right@$I am!
We'll get through this!

$#NorzaDark(Norza)#$$&NorzaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Damn you, race officials and your nasty
tricks...
$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Left@$Is everything all right, Norza?

$#AdultCallen(Adult Callen)#$$&CallenDragonRedEyeGrit&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ah, so you are from the same world as that
Finn!
$#NorzaDark(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Of course it is! Who do you think I am?
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceRaceQueenShouting&$$@Center@$Hyaaaaaa!!!
$#NorzaDark(Norza)#$$&NorzaEvil&$$@Center@$Hmph!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$...Did we make it?

$#NorzaDark(Norza)#$$&NorzaSmirk&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Looks like it, but anyone behind us won't be
so lucky now.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Left@$So it's come down to just us. Head to head.

$#DONOTSHOWME(Beni-Shoga)#$$&BenishogaShouting&$Verily, we are on the home stretch now! It
hath dwindled to a duel betwixt two.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Enthusiastic Spectator)#$Oooooh, a duel!!!

$#DONOTSHOWME(Sweaty Palms Spectator)#$What a race!
Who's it going to be???

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceRaceQueenClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Right@$A duel... No, I hear someone else.
Can't you hear that?
$#AdultCallen(Adult Callen)#$$&CallenDragonRedEyeStare&$$@Center@$Ha, it is like looking at my own child self.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$What? I can't hear anything...

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceRaceQueenExcited&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No, it's definitely something. It's coming
this way... Kuhuhu!♪
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$It's coming?
$#NorzaDark(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Center@$What is!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Down this road? But not even a motorbike
could make it now!

$#NorzaDark(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Center@$I know that intense presence...
It's—
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaRacequeenShouting&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Haaaaaaargh!!!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Beni-Shoga)#$Could it be... Was she not just... It cannot be—
$#DONOTSHOWME(Beni-Shoga)#$MARSHAL LUDMILLA ON A BICYCLE???
$#DONOTSHOWME(Beni-Shoga)#$My word, when did she even get there!?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprised&$$@Center@$Do NOT call me a child! Argh, why must
this always happen...

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaRacequeenHappy&$$@Center@$Ahahaha! This is the perfect way to get
my spin workout in!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That's insane! How is she getting that
bike to go as fast as a racecar!?
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceRaceQueenExcited&$$@Center@$You're so amazing, Miss Ludmilla!
$#NorzaDark(Norza)#$$&NorzaAngry&$$@Center@$This makes absolutely no sense...
$#DONOTSHOWME(An NPC Somewhere)#$The Marshal is incredible!

$#AdultCallen(Adult Callen)#$$&CallenDragonRedEyeHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Jealous, are we? I suppose I would be too,
seeing this voluptuous body!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprised&$$@Left@$Hearing it from myself just adds insult to
injury!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Left@$But why are you two even here? I am the
one who was called to man the checkpoint!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Curses! I am supposed to be manning the
third checkpoint and I missed Finn...

$#AdultCallen(Adult Callen)#$$&CallenDragonRedEyeHehOpenMouth&$$@Right@$They called for an "Old Soul Girl."
That is me, so here I am.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprised&$$@Left@$Clearly I am the only one that call could be
referring to!

$#AdultCallen(Adult Callen)#$$&CallenDragonRedEyeHeh&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What are you talking about? I am an old
soul girl!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenShouting&$$@Center@$You can hardly call yourself a girl with a
body like that!

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaHappy&$$@Center@$Well, I fit the bill, don't I? I've been doing
my job since the dawn of time!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Right@$N-No, it is completely different! There is
more than age to being an old soul...

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaAngry&$$@Left@$Ugh, at this rate, we won't get anything
done here!

$#AdultCallen(Adult Callen)#$$&CallenDragonRedEyeHehOpenMouth&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Well, one person is more than enough to
man this checkpoint!

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprised&$$@Left@$Indeed, and it is going to be me!
The only true old soul girl around here!

$#Darna(Darna)#$$&MagnifoDarnaEvilGrin&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Now, now, everyone, there's no need to fight.
The 15th lesson of the True Gru Grim says—

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaNormal&$$@Left@$Um, excuse me? I am manning the third
checkpoint.

$#Darna(Darna)#$$&MagnifoDarnaEvilGrin&$$@Center@$"Get along, drink your milk, and enjoy the
taste of friendship!"

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenSurprised&$$@Center@$I would prefer not to be lectured by the
person who is the most out of character!
$#"Kind"Voice("Kind" Voice)#$$!-1!$Now, now, everyone.
$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduAngry&$$@Center@$THERE. IS. NO. NEED. TO. FIGHT!!!
$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaScared&$$@Left@$Eeeeeeeek!!!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenPanic&$$@Right@$A monster!!!
$#AdultCallen(Adult Callen)#$$&CallenDragonPanic&$$@Center@$Heeeeeeelp!!!
$#Darna(Darna)#$$&MagnifoDarnaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Ah, look, they all ran off together.

$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduEvilSmile&$$@Right@$Haha, it is so nice when everyone is getting
along.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, you've pulled over? How complacent
of you. I'll just zip right past, then!
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenPokerFace&$$@Right@$And who might you be?

$#Darna(Darna)#$$&MagnifoDarnaEvilGrin&$$!-1!$$@Left@$We've been overtaken... Shall we go back to
the race?
$#Kadu(Kadu)#$$&KaduEvilSmile&$$@Right@$Yes, Reverend Darna!
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzSmirk2&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Here they come.
$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Right@$Shall I take the wheel?

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Left@$Heh, I doubt a clock could handle the
intricacy of this vehicle.

$#Chronos(Chronos)#$$&RolotiaClock&$$@Right@$...Clock? I doubt anyone but you would ever 
dare to call me that.

$#Darna(Darna)#$$&MagnifoDarnaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Do I sense a touch of discord? We should all
do our best to embrace peace!

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzSmug&$$@Center@$You're the last person I'd expect to
understand the concept of "peace."
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzSmug&$$@Center@$But maybe things are different for you in this world.

$#Darna(Darna)#$$&MagnifoDarnaSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$So you've realized this is not the world
we're used to?

$#Aria(Aria)#$$&AriaSmug&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I am Aria! The judge of all souls and the
Primordial of Death! Who might YOU be?

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$Well, I do have quite the unique vantage
point.
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$So, how do you find this world?
$#Darna(Darna)#$$&MagnifoDarnaEvilGrin&$$@Left@$Haha, it's beyond belief!

$#Darna(Darna)#$$&MagnifoDarnaEvilGrin&$$@Left@$A miraculous place detached from the past,
the future, and even the present!

$#Darna(Darna)#$$&MagnifoDarnaSerious&$$@Left@$Which is precisely why I can be back to
"normal" here.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzSerious&$$@Right@$And this "normal" version of you bears me no
ill will? Even though I killed your father?

$#Darna(Darna)#$$&MagnifoDarnaSerious&$$@Left@$I'd be lying if I said there was no ill will...
But the True Gru Grim teaches—
$#Darna(Darna)#$$&MagnifoDarnaSerious&$$@Left@$"Remember: the present is a fabulous gift."

$#Darna(Darna)#$$&MagnifoDarnaEvilGrin&$$@Left@$I no longer dwell on the past. That is the
mark of the "normal" me.
$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzClosedEye&$$@Right@$The present, huh...

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenComplacent&$$@Center@$I am Callen! The 200-year-old genius
scholar!

$#Darna(Darna)#$$&MagnifoDarnaEvilGrin&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Yes, here and now. Perhaps there is a
reason we were all brought to this world.

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzCommand&$$@Center@$Heh, you may be right. And now that
we're here, as former kindred spirits—

$#Norza(Norza)#$$&OzCommand&$$@Center@$Let us pledge here and now to fight a
fair fight!

$#Darna(Darna)#$$&MagnifoDarnaEvilGrin&$$@Center@$Yes, a fair fight! That is exactly what the
True Gru Grim teaches!

$#Darna(Darna)#$$&MagnifoDarnaEvilGrin&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Haha! How refreshing it is to have made
a new friend! Full speed ahead, Kadu!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnOpenHappy&$$@Center@$So, thank you too, Clarice!
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceRaceQueenSmileClosedEyes&$$@Center@$I won't forget the sound of your heart.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceRaceQueenSmileClosedEyes&$$@Center@$I just know I'll recognize that sound, no
matter who or where I am.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceRaceQueenHappy&$$@Center@$Next to Miss Ludmilla, you are the second
most important person in my life.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceRaceQueenHappy&$$@Center@$I will always look out for you.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceRaceQueenLookAway&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I see you're still as popular with the
ladies as ever.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$(The world is made up of the people who
live in it.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$(I'm going to protect this world's peace,
no matter what—)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Center@$Right, I'm off. Full speed ahead!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSleep&$$@Center@$(I wish I didn't have to wake up just yet.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSleep&$$@Center@$(As soon as I open my eyes, I'll be faced
with reality.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSleep&$$@Center@$(This world will vanish forever, replaced
with the usual order...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSadSmile&$$@Center@$—I'll miss it.
$#()#$$!-1!$$@Center@$You're wrong.

$#()#$$@Center@$Though memories may fade, if there is
something you truly wish for...
$#()#$$@Center@$Then it will forever remain in your soul.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Clarice... I thought you were hanging
out with everyone? Is everything all right?
$#()#$$@Center@$So it'll be fine. I promise.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$That voice...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$(Who was it? It must be someone
important from my past or my future...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Center@$I'll keep meeting new people. I'll keep
believing in a peaceful world...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Center@$I'll have faith in my wish!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHeh&$$@Center@$And I'll keep walking this path I have
chosen.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceRaceQueenLookAway&$$@Right@$Don't worry about me.
Besides, you're leaving soon, right?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Ah, you heard my conversation just now?
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceRaceQueenSigh&$$@Right@$I happened to be nearby.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceRaceQueenSadSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$So, how was it? Was this world what you
expected?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Well, I had a lot of fun, and I'm happy.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiSmile&$$@Left@$Tis stated in the rules that the Eternal Race
is to be held once every 100 days, is it not?
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceExcitedNoSword&$$@Center@$What other reason could there ever be?

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSurprised&$$@Left@$More importantly, did you happen to see a
maid with silver hair and red eyes around?

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainNormal&$$@Right@$Yes, she just left. She was asking about
you.

$#LancelotArm(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotEcstasy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$She was!? What a twist of fate for us to pass
each other by!

$#LancelotArm(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotClosedEyes&$$@Center@$I must convince her to supervise a 24-hour
whipping session for me next time I see her!
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSad&$$!-1!$$@Right@$...
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSmile&$$@Left@$What's wrong, Gawain?

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSurprised&$$@Left@$Is there something in your eye?
Gawain, you're not about to cry, are you!?
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceExcitedNoSword&$$@Center@$Ah, there she is!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSigh&$$!-1!$$@Left@$As luck would have it, I have been chosen
to be the coordinator of the Eternal Race.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$I hope I can count on you when the time
comes. Thank you, everyone, in advance.

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenComplacent&$$@Right@$You also plan to serve as a commentator,
correct?

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenComplacent&$$@Right@$It would not hurt you to start counting on
us already, you know.

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiHappy&$$@Right@$Verily! It shall be our pleasure to share the
burden of your duties, Lady Ludmilla!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$Thank you, everyone... I'm truly grateful to
have friends like you.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceExcitedNoSword&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Miss Ludmilla looks so happy—
Ah, what a lovely sight!)

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSadNoSword&$$@Center@$(I'd love to chat with her... But I don't
want to interrupt.)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenConsidering&$$@Right@$Yes, but it would seem that this time
is an exception to the rule.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceExcitedNoSword&$$@Center@$(I can talk to her so easily when she's on
her own...)
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceShyNoSword&$$@Center@$(Or even with that airhead Finn around...)

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSighSweatNoSword&$$@Center@$(He's always popping up uninvited, where
is he when he could be useful for once...!)

$#Lancelot(???)#$$&LancelotSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Are you the coordinator of the upcoming
Eternal Race?
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$I am... And you are?

$#Lancelot(???)#$$&LancelotSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh yes, begging your pardon. I am the
navigator of Team Camelot.

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHappy&$$@Center@$My name is Lancelot, Knight of the Round
Table. Pleased to make your acquaintance!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$Well, how very genteel of you! My name
is Ludmilla.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Center@$I am the coordinator for the upcoming
race and...um... Can I help you?

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Hnnnn? Oh.
I like the way you smell.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$Still, why hold another one just 18 days
later?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$I...smell!? I did just undergo a 24-hour
whipping drill, but I showered afterwards...

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSurprised&$$@Right@$Oh no, my apologies, I did not mean you
literally smell—

$#LancelotArm(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotEcstasy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Wait, did you say whipping? For 24 hours!?
You train like that!?

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Yes, it is a customary training regimen to
build up endurance.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$Are you interested in this sort of thing?

$#LancelotArm(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotEcstasyClosedEyes&$$@Right@$Am I interested!? A 24-hour whipping sounds
like absolute heaven!
$#LancelotArm(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotEcstasy&$$@Right@$You must let me join you next time!
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaHappy&$$@Left@$Of course! We can do it now, if you like?
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceUpsetNoSword&$$!-1!$$@Center@$...

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceUpsetNoSword&$$@Center@$(Something tells me I shouldn't let those
two be alone together...)

$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenPokerFace&$$@Right@$The number 18 must have some sort of
significance.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceShoutingNoSword&$$@Center@$That's it, I am stepping in.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceShoutingNoSword&$$@Center@$I cannot let Miss Ludmilla fall into the
clutches of that fetishist!

$#RedDragonKnight(Red Dragon Knight)#$$&RedKnight&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Marshal Ludmilla! The Race Executive
Committee is here to see you!

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSurprise&$$@Left@$Oh dear, I completely forgot about the
meeting.
$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSigh&$$@Left@$Please excuse me, Sir Lancelot.

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSmile&$$@Right@$Of course, I expect you must be busy.
We can talk more when you are free.

$#Ludmilla(Ludmilla)#$$&LudmillaSmile&$$@Left@$Thank you! In that case, I will see you
later.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceShoutingNoSword&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Miss Ludmilla!
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSurprisedNoSword&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Huh? Miss...?

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotSurprised&$$@Right@$Are you looking for Marshal Ludmilla?
She was just called to a meeting.
$#Callen(Callen)#$$&CallenNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$And this time the coordinator is—
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&LancelotSurprised&$$@Left@$Oh... I see...

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSadNoSword&$$@Left@$(We seem to always be missing each other
by a hair lately.)

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSadNoSword&$$@Left@$(And I went through all the trouble to
join the knights to be with her...)
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotClosedEyes&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Wh-Wh-Whoa!
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceUpsetNoSword&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Wh-What is it?
$#LancelotArm(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotClosedEyes&$$@Right@$$%1%$You have this scent about you...

$#LancelotArm(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotEcstasy&$$@Right@$The scent of strength... Like Gawain...
No, even stronger!

$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Ah, it is you! My resplendent rose has
returned to grace us with her presence!
$#LancelotArm(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotEcstasy&$$@Center@$...!

$#LancelotArm(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotEcstasy&$$@Center@$A resplendent rose... A beauty whose
thorns deliver a painful sting!
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceClosedEyesNoSword&$$@Center@$Haa...

$#LancelotArm(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotEcstasyClosedEyes&$$@Center@$How fitting for someone who radiates
such a genuine sense of forcefulness!

$#LancelotArm(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotEcstasy&$$@Right@$Ah, what wouldn't I give to receive a night
of thorny lashings...for training, that is!
$#Nagi(Nagi)#$$&NagiDoya&$$@Left@$Me as well! Not for training, though!
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSighSweatNoSword&$$@Center@$Ugh...
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSighSweatNoSword&$$@Center@$...!
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHurtBlush&$$!-1!$$@Center@$No, wait, come back! Miss Roooose!
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceUpsetNoSword&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Ugh, what's with that Lancelot...

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSighSweatNoSword&$$@Left@$Everything about her was practically
screaming, "I'm a pervert!"

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceContemptNoSword&$$@Left@$For the sake of Miss Ludmilla's sanity, I 
must not let that woman anywhere near her.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceContemptNoSword&$$@Left@$If she makes a move again, I'll just have to
dispose of her...
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceIrritatedNoSword&$$@Center@$That was one back-breaking mission...
$#Gawain(???)#$$&GawainNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$"Dispose..." Such a dangerous word.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceAngryNoSword&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Who are you!?

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&Gawain&$$@Right@$Gawain of Camelot. Knight of the Round
Table.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceConcideringNoSword&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Camelot? I think she mentioned that as well...)

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceSeriousNoSword&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You wouldn't happen to know an insolent
woman named Lancelot, would you?
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSad&$$@Right@$...What has she done this time?
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$@Right@$Let me apologize on her behalf.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceClosedEyesNoSword&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I don't want an apology, I want to stop her
from associating with my mistress.
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainNormalOpen&$$@Center@$Mistress?

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceExcitedNoSword&$$@Center@$Miss Ludmilla. Daughter of the venerable
House Aldyne, sharp and graceful, witty—
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceShyNoSword&$$@Center@$Why do I even do this to myself?
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$The coordinator for the Eternal Race?

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceYandereSmileNoSword&$$@Left@$Yes, that's her. So, can you make that girl
stay away?

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$!-1!$$@Center@$I'm afraid not. Lancelot does as she pleases.
I cannot control her.
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceUpsetNoSword&$$@Center@$Oh, for...

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceUpsetNoSword&$$!-1!$$@Left@$There's got to be a way. Maybe I should
hang a garland of garlic around her neck?
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Right@$Lancelot is not a vampi—
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainNormalOpen&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Wait, that's it!
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceConcideringNoSword&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Garlic? I knew it.

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Right@$No, why would you even—
I meant the Eternal Race.

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$If you win the Eternal Race, you get to
have one wish granted.

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceExcitedNoSword&$$@Center@$No, I know why. It's all for Miss
Ludmilla, obviously!

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceCrazyNoSword&$$@Center@$Oh, that's it!
You're a dead woman walking, Lancelot...

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I should warn you that Lancelot is a
Knight of the Round Table.

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainSerious&$$@Right@$Should you wish harm on one of our
members—

$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceHappyNoSword&$$@Left@$Don't worry, it's just a figure of speech. But
now I know how I can protect my mistress!
$#Clarice(Clarice)#$$&ClariceHappyNoSword&$$@Left@$I need to go get ready for the race!

$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Right@$The way that maid carries herself...
She is not one to be trifled with.
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainHurt&$$@Right@$I should keep an eye on her.
$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh, Gawain! There you are.
$#Gawain(Gawain)#$$&GawainNormalOpen&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Lancelot? Where have you been?

$#Lancelot(Lancelot)#$$&LancelotNormal&$$@Left@$I mean, I was just chatting with the race
coordinator?

keys.DescriptionKey: Born the only child of a wealthy merchant family, Shorelle had his destiny laid out for him by his parents—he would continue the family business as the head of a caravan of merchants. But Shorelle, obsessed with the daring heroes of the stories he heard from travelers on the road, longed to become an adventurer himself. His parents did everything they could to keep him from pursuing his dangerous dream, but Shorelle was determined to forge his own fate. One evening, he gathered a few of his belongings and ran away from home.

YoungDesertWarrior01.name: Shorelle
YoungDesertWarrior01.title: Adventuring Merchant
YoungDesertWarrior01.description: Born the only child of a wealthy merchant family, Shorelle had his destiny laid out for him by his parents—he would continue the family business as the head of a caravan of merchants. But Shorelle, obsessed with the daring heroes of the stories he heard from travelers on the road, longed to become an adventurer himself. His parents did everything they could to keep him from pursuing his dangerous dream, but Shorelle was determined to forge his own fate. One evening, he gathered a few of his belongings and ran away from home.

keys.DescriptionKey: Nobody expected the spoiled and pampered young boy to last for long on his own, but surprisingly, Shorelle thrived as an adventurer, quickly making a name for himself as a tough warrior who went out of his way to help others. One day, Shorelle joined a group of adventurers on a mission to wipe out a den of raiders. However, the den turned out to be a starving village, which had only resorted to raiding for survival. Shorelle and his fellow adventurers could not help the settlement, but Shorelle knew of someone who could. He went back home and negotiated with his parents to procure some funds, in exchange for accepting his role as successor to the family business. Using those funds, Shorelle was able to create an irrigation system, allowing the village to become self-sufficient. He was hailed as a true hero.

He went back home and negotiated with his parents to procure some funds, in exchange for accepting his role as successor to the family business. Using those funds, Shorelle was able to create an irrigation system, allowing the village to become self-sufficient. He was hailed as a true hero.

keys.DescriptionKey: Shorelle now travels the lands with his parents in their merchant caravans, learning the tricks of the trade as quickly as he adapted to adventuring. He looks foward to inheriting the business, so he can use his wealth to help those whose problems cannot be solved by mere heroics. But his new perspective doesn't mean Shorelle's days as a warrior have ended. Whenever their caravan is threatened by hostiles, Shorelle doesn't hesitate to join the fray, much to his parents' chagrin.

keys.value: Druke, the Blademaster
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&YoungGilganSerious&$$@Right@$It seems the ambush was a wise choice.

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSerious&$$@Left@$I knew I wasn't hearing things! Did you
hear that?!

$#Xandra(Xandra)#$$&XandraEvilSmile&$$@Left@$I can make it quick and painless for you.
I promise.
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Right@$...

$#Xandra(Xandra)#$$&XandraEvilSmile&$$@Left@$Simply nod, and I will end your life.
What do you say?
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Right@$...
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Right@$(Maybe...maybe she's right.)

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeGrit&$$@Right@$(If I'm just going to turn into that thing...
Maybe it's better...)
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeSerious&$$@Right@$I... I'll...
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$@Right@$Open your eyes, Druke!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeClosedEyes&$$@Left@$...!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$@Right@$Get a grip, Druke!
Don't let her deceive you!
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&YoungGilganSurprise&$$@Right@$Huh? What is it, Druke?!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeClosedEyes&$$@Left@$Rody...?

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeClosedEyes&$$@Left@$(What's going on? What is that...
That light...?!)

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$@Right@$Even if you can't escape that future!
Even if it is your Fate!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$@Right@$What the hell does it mean to us in the
here and now?! Absolutely nothing!
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeClosedEyes&$$@Left@$Rody...

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$@Right@$Remember, Druke!
Why did we come here?!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$@Right@$Remember what the Chief said!
The fate of Urg Roa is in our hands!
$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&YoungGilganCommand&$$@Left@$Druke, don't let her lead you astray!

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&YoungGilganCommand&$$@Left@$She's attempting to lead you into despair!
Don't listen to her subtle lies!

$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodyAttack&$$@Right@$Come back to us, Druke!
Damn it, come back!
$#Rody(Rody)#$$&RodySerious&$$@Left@$I don't hear anything. Are you sure?
$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeClosedEyes&$$@Left@$(Urg Roa...)

$#Druke(Druke)#$$&DrukeClosedEyes&$$@Left@$(Right... I'm here...we're here...
To save Urg Roa!)

$#Xandra(Xandra)#$$&XandraSurprise&$$@Left@$No...no! This wasn't how it was
supposed to happen!

$#Xandra(Xandra)#$$&XandraAngry&$$@Left@$One chooses death, and the other falls
into darkness in despair!
$#Xandra(Xandra)#$$&XandraAngry&$$@Left@$That was Fate! I saw it! But...!
$#Xandra(Xandra)#$$&XandraAngry&$$@Left@$You...! You just had to interfere!

$#Xandra(Xandra)#$$&XandraAngry&$$@Left@$Aeon Knight! Come to my side, and
destroy this meddler!
$#AeonKnight(Aeon Knight)#$$&AeonKnight&$$@Left@$$%0.3%$Grrrrr!

$#Gilgan(Gilgan)#$$&YoungGilganCommand&$$@Right@$Rody, look out!

$#Kisara(Kisara)#$$&KisaraGrin&$$@Left@$Leave the enemy to us. You fulfill your
duties and keep the townsfolk safe.

$#Kisara(Kisara)#$$&KisaraSmirk&$$@Left@$...That said, given the circumstances, no
one would blame you for fleeing.
$#Menue(Menue)#$$&MenueSmile&$$@Right@$I would!
Memories of the Past

keys.value: $#GigantFreya(Freya)#$$&FreyaClosedEyesSweat&$$@Center@$Mmmmm... Mmmm—ping!

$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaHappy&$$@Center@$While that happens—you lot will sneak
into Jotunheim and dig a huge pit—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Top-quality ingredients, and prepping it
beforehand removed the gamey smell.

$#MidgardHuman(Midgard Human)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$!-1!$$@Right@$As expected of a former hunter. Not
something amateurs could do.

$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaHappy&$$@Left@$Thank you, boy! Let's exchange burning
love later!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Right@$As long as it's not a duel... But I'm up for
chatting!

$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaShouting&$$@Left@$Oh, this is what they call the sweet side!
Hahaha, then let's start right now!
$#Aesir(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Right@$We're eating, Lady Freya.

$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaHappy&$$@Left@$Mmh... True. Something always interrupts
our love. But that makes it burn brighter!

$#MidgardHuman(Midgard Human)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Right@$Whoa, you're literally burning!
Calm down, Lady Freya!
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hm...?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$It's shaking...

$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaHappy&$$@Center@$It's simple: the Grand Decoy Operation,
using me!
$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaSad&$$@Left@$It's not me.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Right@$I know, it's...
$#Aesir(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Giant footsteps. Quiet, no noise!
$#DONOTSHOWME(Giant Footsteps)#$$!-1!$Boom! Boom... Boom... oom—
$#MidgardHuman(Midgard Human)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Left@$Sounds like they've passed...
$#Aesir(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Right@$How long must we live like this...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Everyone's running on empty. We'll need
an answer soon...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Ulf, right? Are you okay?

$#Ulf(Ulf)#$$&PawnSmile&$$@Center@$Yeah, I'm fine. This is nothing if I think
of him.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Him...?
$#Aesir(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$!-1!$$@Left@$My apologies, but rejected...

$#Ulf(Ulf)#$$&PawnLookaway&$$@Center@$We had another friend... Jotunheim's
people took him away.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Center@$I see... Sorry to remind you.
$#Ulf(Ulf)#$$&PawnLookaway&$$@Center@$No, it's okay...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Don't worry, he'll be saved. So you keep
living with hope.
$#Ulf(Ulf)#$$&PawnSmile&$$@Center@$Yeah... This meat's good, big bro.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Taken... But not eaten by giants.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Then maybe he still lives as a captive
somewhere.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(There's still hope!)
$#SobbingVoice(Sobbing Voice)#$Ugh...
$#SobbingVoice(Sobbing Voice)#$Uuugh...

$#MidgardHuman(Midgard Human)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Right@$How is that any different from the "drop
100 giants into a pit" plan...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Crying for the dead is louder than yesterday.
The giant's footsteps stirred them...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(If we don't fix this soon, these people are
in real danger.)
$#Runa(Runa)#$$&VictoireWorried&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Big bro!
$#Sigrid(Sigrid)#$$&LiliaSad&$$@Right@$Brother!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$What's wrong this late at night?
$#Sigrid(Sigrid)#$$&LiliaSad&$$@Center@$It's bad! He's gone...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Gone—who?
$#Sigrid(Sigrid)#$$&LiliaSad&$$@Center@$Ulf! He's not here!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Ulf—the boy who told me about their
friend who'd been taken!)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Any idea where he is?

$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaShouting&$$@Left@$Hmm... Room for improvement! Stay
tuned for version three!

$#Sigrid(Sigrid)#$$&LiliaSad&$$@Center@$Yeah... But the adults said it's too dangerous—
we should wait until morning.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$They're right. It's safer here.
$#Sigrid(Sigrid)#$$&LiliaSad&$$!-1!$$@Left@$You're just like them...
$#Runa(Runa)#$$&VictoireWorried&$$@Right@$Big bro—if we wait, Ulf will—!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(Kids alone at night, giants roaming...
Can't risk it.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(We need to find him immediately.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$We can't wait till morning... I agree.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Leave it to me. I'll find Ulf and bring him
back.
$#Runa(Runa)#$$&VictoireWorried&$$@Center@$Really?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Yes, really.
$#MidgardHuman(Midgard Human)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Right@$Looks like the pitfall series will continue...
$#Sigrid(Sigrid)#$$&LiliaSad&$$@Center@$Please... Bring him back!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$You two stay here. Follow Freya's orders
and stay safe. Got it?
$#Runa(Runa)#$$&VictoireNormal&$$@Center@$Okay... We'll wait.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(I won't let these kids suffer another loss—)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(Stay safe, Ulf!)

$#Aesir(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Well, Lady Freya is serious about looking
out for us.
$#MidgardHuman(Midgard Human)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Right@$That's true, she's a good goddess.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(With Freya's carefree and bold personality,
I was worried about her as a leader...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$(But everyone seems to admire her. Even
if they're a little exasperated...)
$#GigantFreyaSuper(Freya)#$$&FreyaShouting&$$@Center@$I've got it, I've got it!!
$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Hey boy... Did you sleep well last night?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Right@$Uh, well, a lot happened, so...
$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaLaugh&$$@Left@$I see. Not much then...

$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaLaugh&$$@Left@$You must be lacking exercise! Let's express
love—you and I—strength against strength!
$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaLaugh&$$@Left@$Come on, come on—!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Right@$(This part of her hasn't changed!!)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Right@$N-Now isn't the time, we both have too
much to do. Right, I'll go gather food!

$#Aesir(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Lady Freya—you have plenty of tasks too.
You are our leader, after all.
$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaSurprised&$$@Left@$But I have love-business with the boy!
$#MidgardHuman(Midgard Human)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Right@$Please save it for after everything's done!
$#Aesir(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$!-1!$$@Left@$What is it this time, Lady Freya?

$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaShouting&$$@Left@$Ugh, fine... Boy, I leave the food matter to
you.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Understood. Oh, in that case—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Right@$Could you introduce me to someone who
knows the terrain around here?

$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaHappy&$$@Left@$Of course. Knowing the land means better
hunting.
$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaHappy&$$@Left@$I'll send a specialist—wait outside.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$(On the way to the shelter, I caught a scent...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$(This forest should be full of game.)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$(If I can manage the terrain, the hunt will
be decent.)
$#Ulf(Boy)#$$&YoungBoyHappy&$$@Center@$Uh—are you the guy Lady Freya mentioned?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Hm? Oh, yeah... Wait, huh?
$#MidgardHuman(Midgard Human)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Right@$Not another impossible plan, I pray—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$(Why are kids coming over? Don't tell me
they're the specialists!?)
$#Ulf(Ulf)#$$&PawnHeh&$$@Center@$I'm Ulf, nice to meet you!
$#Sigrid(Sigrid)#$$&LiliaSmile&$$@Left@$Sigrid!
$#Runa(Runa)#$$&VictoireHappy&$$@Right@$I'm Runa!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Center@$W-Wait a sec! You're the terrain experts!?

$#Sigrid(Sigrid)#$$&LiliaSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Yup! We play hide-and-seek and tag all
the time—we know almost everything!
$#Runa(Runa)#$$&VictoireNormal&$$@Right@$Hehe! Leave it to us, big bro!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(They might actually know more than
adults...)
$#Ulf(Ulf)#$$&PawnHeh&$$@Center@$That way. Probably has tons of game!
$#Sigrid(Sigrid)#$$&LiliaSurprised&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Wait, Ulf—hurry up, brother!

$#MidgardHuman(Midgard Human)#$$&MaleVillagerAMob&$$@Right@$Like digging a pit to drop 100 giants in,
or eating a ton to grow taller than them—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$No choice... I'll just keep an eye out for
danger.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Hey, don't go too deep into the forest!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Thanks to you guys, we got quite a few
small animals.
$#Sigrid(Sigrid)#$$&LiliaSmile&$$@Right@$Hehe, really?

$#Runa(Runa)#$$&VictoireNormal&$$@Left@$But you're amazing, big bro. You can block
the path of the quick ones so easily.

$#Sigrid(Sigrid)#$$&LiliaSmile&$$@Right@$Like dashedy-dash! And then shwoop,
caught!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$I used to be a hunter, so I have some skill.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$And here's a waterway... Shame I didn't
bring fishing gear.
$#Ulf(Ulf)#$$&PawnSweat&$$@Right@$We don't have any either.

$#Sigrid(Sigrid)#$$&LiliaSadSmile&$$@Left@$And we used all the bait last time. If we
flip stones, we might find some.

$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I'm sorry I caused trouble back then. But
this time, my aspirations are realistic!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$I'd like to catch some bigger game. What
we have won't fill everyone's stomachs—
$#Runa(Runa)#$$&VictoireNormal&$$@Right@$Over there, something's splashing!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Splashing...? Maybe a big bird bathing.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(If so, I might be able to get it with a stone...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Let's check it out...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurpriseBlush&$$@Center@$This way, let's see... Oh!
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusTongue&$$@Center@$Oh.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSeriousBlush&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Sorry, Venus... Didn't know you were
bathing!

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHeh&$$@Right@$My my, you peeper, you... What a lewd
savior boy—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyesSurprisedBlush&$$@Left@$No, I didn't mean to! I thought it was a
bird or something—sorry!
$#Aesir(Aesir)#$$&Enforcer&$$@Right@$Then, by all means, let's hear it.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusExcitedTongue&$$@Right@$It's fine—I'm not mad. Honestly, I'd love
for you to join me.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnClosedEyesSurprisedBlush&$$@Left@$N-No thanks.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusWink&$$@Right@$Hmm, resisting the goddess of love's charms?
You're 100—no, 1000 years too young.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Kids, you wanna swim too? It's cool and
feels great—also, drag that boy in!
$#Sigrid(Sigrid)#$$&LiliaHppy&$$@Center@$Ahh, I wanna swim!
$#Ulf(Ulf)#$$&PawnLaugh&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Come on, big bro, let's swim!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Left@$N-No, I'm fine.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusTongue&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Refusing even a child's request? What a
cold, lewd savior.
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$@Center@$Fine, come, you kids! Let's play!
$#Runa(Runa)#$$&VictoireHappy&$$@Center@$I'll bathe! Wait for me, Lady Venus!

$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaHappy&$$!-1!$$@Center@$First, from the west of Jotunheim, I'll
draw all the enemy's attention with fire
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$@Center@$Here you go, splash! Ahahaha—take this!!
$#Sigrid(Sigrid)#$$&LiliaHppy&$$@Center@$Waaa!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(Phew, escaped that... But what's with the
"lewd savior" thing...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Still, I didn't know Venus could laugh like
that.
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusWorried&$$@Right@$Phew... Break time.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Take a rest, Venus.
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSurprised&$$@Right@$Ah, the lewd savior boy.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Left@$Please stop... If anyone hears, they'll laugh.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSmile&$$@Right@$But kids are nice and innocent... They're
allowed to be thoughtless and carefree.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Yeah, and adults need to protect them.
$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaHappy&$$@Center@$and shouting.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Their lives, and their freedom.
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSmile&$$@Right@$Protect their freedom?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Children are uniquely free—and adults
have a duty to protect that.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Back in my village, the adults watched
over me that way. Now it's my turn.
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$That's one thing I can't hate about humans...
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSmile&$$@Center@$No, in fact, I love it.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$R-Really...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$(Was that Venus's true face? That "love"
hit hard...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$(The goddess of love, huh...)

$#Freya(Freya)#$$&FreyaHappy&$$@Center@$Mm, delicious! I feel vigor stirring in my
veins!

$#ValkyrieA(Reporting Valkyrie)#$$&ValkyrieMobSerious&$$@Center@$Report from the fortress guards—
intruders have been captured.

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBraveSerious&$$@Center@$(I can still see the face Zeus made when
she spoke about the betrayal of love.)
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiTehepero&$$@Left@$Look who's talking☆
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Loki, we don't have time. Please guide us!

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiNormal&$$@Center@$If we're caught by the guards, we'll be in
serious trouble. Still wanna risk it?

$#Ulf(Ulf)#$$&PawnHeh&$$@Center@$If I can save him, I don't care what
happens to me! Please!
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHeh&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Hear that?
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiCrying&$$@Left@$Can't say no to a child... This way.
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiNormal&$$@Center@$He's locked here. I'll open it.
$#DONOTSHOWME(Door Sound)#$Click... Creak...
$#Ulf(Ulf)#$$&PawnHeh&$$@Center@$—Bjorn, I came to save you!!
$#Bjorn(Bjorn)#$$&SpicaSerious&$$@Center@$Ulf...? Ulf!! You're alive...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBraveSerious&$$@Center@$(Something happened in her past...
Something that twisted her into this.)
$#Bjorn(Bjorn)#$$&SpicaScared&$$@Center@$I'm so glad to see you again—

$#Ulf(Ulf)#$$&PawnSweat&$$!-1!$$@Right@$I'm sorry I couldn't protect you, and sorry
for being late!

$#Bjorn(Bjorn)#$$&SpicaScared&$$@Left@$It's okay... As long as you and everyone
else are safe.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSmile&$$@Right@$No life-threatening injuries. Thank
goodness.
$#Bjorn(Bjorn)#$$&SpicaScared&$$@Left@$Yes, thank...you.

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiNormal&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Finn, here's your sword. Use it to break
those chains.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Thanks, Loki. Stay still, kid.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Haaah!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$—There, it's cut!
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiConsidering&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Oh...?
$#Gunnhildr(Gunnhildr)#$$&GunnhildrSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Rizette, you were brought here too...
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSmile&$$@Right@$They've already noticed.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(The ground's shaking. The guards are
returning with reinforcements.)
$#DONOTSHOWME(Captive Humans)#$$!-1!$...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(This prison has other rooms full of
weakened captives.)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Can't we free everyone?

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$@Right@$If we try, no one—not even us—can
escape.
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$@Right@$If you want to try torture, go alone.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Loki, isn't there a way...

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiNormal&$$@Right@$Don't look at me like that. There'll be
another chance.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSad&$$@Left@$Yeah... You're right...

$#Rizette(Rizette)#$$&RizetteBraveSighComical&$$@Left@$Yeah, a lot has happened—and these
intruders?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(For now, there's no choice...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$(If I hesitate, even these kids will be lost...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Forgive me, everyone... Loki, please.
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiTehepero&$$@Center@$Valshamr.
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSurprised&$$@Right@$What?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Is this forest near the prison? Loki, a little
farther—

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSerious&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Don't get distracted, Finn—or you'll be
erased in a blink.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Erased...?
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$She's coming!

$#Zeus(Zeus)#$$&ZeusSmile&$$@Center@$So this is the commotion—escapees from
the prison fortress.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(What's this... The air is heavy... I can't
breathe...)
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSerious&$$@Center@$Don't let her presence overwhelm you—

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSerious&$$@Center@$Don't even try to fathom it all. She's that
kind of god.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$A god... That's Zeus...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(There's no way we escape unscathed...)

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(It's like she's cloaked in a state of despair
far beyond human comprehension—)
$#ValkyrieA(Valkyrie Squad)#$$&ValkyrieMobSerious&$$@Center@$Lady Zeus, Gunnhildr... She's...!

$#Zeus(Zeus)#$$&ZeusIrritate&$$@Center@$She still breathes. Take her to base. She
won't die.
$#ValkyrieA(Valkyrie Squad)#$$&ValkyrieMobSerious&$$@Center@$Y-Yes, thank you!

$#Zeus(Zeus)#$$&ZeusIrritate&$$@Center@$How dare you harm my subordinate. You
insects...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$You tried to drag children into this!

$#Zeus(Zeus)#$$&ZeusSmile&$$@Center@$Oh? You're able to make that face even in
my presence... Much like Rizette.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(Rizette...? How does Zeus know that name?)
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSerious&$$@Center@$Finn, she's on another level. We need to run.
$#Zeus(Zeus)#$$&ZeusHuh&$$@Center@$Finn...?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(But still—we must protect these children,
no matter what!)
$#Zeus(Zeus)#$$&ZeusSmile&$$@Center@$Ah, so you are Rizette's—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(Again... Rizette's name! I'm not
mishearing!)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$How do you know Rizette's name!?

$#Zeus(Zeus)#$$&ZeusIrritate&$$@Center@$To speak to me in such a manner—such
insolence!
$#Zeus(Zeus)#$$&ZeusIrritate&$$@Center@$Bow down.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$Gh—!?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$(My body's getting...heavier!? W-What is
this...!)
$#Zeus(Zeus)#$$&ZeusIrritate&$$@Center@$Now, the end—Oblivion Bla—
$#()#$$!-1!$—I won't let you kill him yet.
$#Zeus(Zeus)#$$&ZeusShouting&$$@Center@$Why are you here?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(Even if it costs us our lives!)
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$@Center@$Long time, Zeus. You're looking tired.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$@Center@$You can't do anything without me. Not
even sleep, apparently.
$#Zeus(Zeus)#$$&ZeusShouting&$$@Center@$!! If you're a phantom—vanish! Oblivion Blast!
$#Zeus(Zeus)#$$&ZeusAngry&$$@Center@$Haa... Haa...
$#Zeus(Zeus)#$$&ZeusAngry&$$@Center@$That woman... Was that really her—
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$Ghh...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$What...? What happened? Where is this?
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$They won't be able to follow us here.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Was that your Valshamr? But you said
you couldn't...

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusBoo&$$@Right@$Have you already forgotten? I told you—
this goddess is a liar.
$#ValkyrieA(Valkyrie Squad)#$$&ValkyrieMobShouting&$$@Center@$—Eradicate the ones above! Attack!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$So it was a lie...

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiHappyClose&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Not entirely. My power really was
suppressed—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Well, thanks anyway. Because of you, the
kids and I are safe.
$#Ulf(Ulf)#$$&PawnSmile&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Thank you, Lady Loki!
$#Bjorn(Bjorn)#$$&SpicaScared&$$@Right@$...Lady Loki!
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Hehe, grow up into fine men, you two.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$The shelter should be that way.
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$I'll rest a bit.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Can't walk? Then I'll carry you.

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiTehepero&$$@Center@$My, how lewd. Want to feel me on your
back? Hehe.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$Ghh!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$N-No, that's not... Kids are here, stop that!

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiNaughty&$$@Center@$All right, all right, just joking. I just want
to take a breather.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Loki... Are you all right?

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiNormal&$$@Center@$Of course. However... Come here a sec—
hero boy.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Center@$Huh? What is it?
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiNormal&$$@Center@$Mwah
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurpriseBlush&$$@Center@$W-What are you—

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiTehepero&$$@Center@$Just a prank. A kiss on the cheek is fine,
isn't it?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Center@$Honestly, since the day we met...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Anyway, I'll go ahead. I'll take care of Ulf
and Bjorn.
$#()#$Beyond the plains, on the northern hill—
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Pushy as always, aren't you?

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiNormal&$$@Center@$No, smaller than Ymir. Yet still of the
same kind.
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiNormal&$$@Center@$The calamitous race, giants—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(Even if smaller than Ymir... It's too
dangerous to face them head-on.)

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$!-1!$$@Right@$The only move here is to run. Otherwise,
you'll get stomped or eaten.
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiNormal&$$@Left@$Then to Bifrost Bridge. Giants can't cross it.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusWink&$$@Right@$That bridge is already destroyed. It can't
be used.

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSurprised&$$@Left@$The Bifrost Bridge was destroyed!? Then how
did you get here?
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusWink&$$@Right@$Not telling.
$#Giant'sroar(Giant's roar)#$$!-1!$GWOOOOOOOOO!!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$They're close... Loki, can't we escape with
Valshamr?
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiConsidering&$$@Right@$There are guards around the door.
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiCrying&$$@Right@$That takes a lot of energy.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Sorry, but it's needed!
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiTehepero&$$@Right@$Fine, but you owe me.
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$@Center@$If you're fleeing, head east into the forest.

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSad&$$@Right@$East forest... We can make it in a few jumps.
Let's go.
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSad&$$@Right@$Valshamr!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$Red Dragon Knights. They're tasked with
guarding the monument.
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiTehepero&$$@Right@$Then we'll jump straight in. Hold on, Finn!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Straight in...with teleportation!?
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiTehepero&$$@Right@$Bingo—Valshamr!

$#()#$We arrived at the same place as before—
the secret chamber of Odin.

$#()#$Odin is now confined in prison for the crime
of trying to destroy the world.

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$Still feels divine. I always hated that about
her...
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$Let's move on.

$#()#$There, just as before, towered the
unreplicable, unknown monument.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$Ugh, I feel a little motion sickness...
Slow down, Loki!
$#()#$Leaving Odin's hidden chamber...
$#()#$We slipped out of Asgard's castle—
$#()#$And then...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$This is Asgard, right?
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSmile&$$@Center@$My homeland... Supposedly.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Then why is no one here!?

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSmile&$$@Center@$Looks like things really did get interesting.
Hehe, I'm excited☆

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$I thought that the gods living in Asgard
and the humans living in Midgard

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$reconciled after the battle with the giant,
Ymir.

$#()#$A single door connecting this world with
the heavenly kingdom, Asgard—

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$And that they have been living together in
harmony.

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiTehepero&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Yes, the last farewell was warm as could be,
everyone sending you off with smiles.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$We have to find them... Maybe they're
hiding for some reason!
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSerious&$$@Right@$What, playing hide-and-seek?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$If only that joke were true...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$N-No way...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(The city looks like it's been through a war...
It's completely destroyed...)
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$So that's what my hunch was.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Something happened...
To this city, to everyone...
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSmile&$$@Right@$I'm sure they escaped somewhere.

$#()#$Since then, teams led by the genius scholar
Callen have studied it endlessly, but...

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSmile&$$@Right@$Do you really think the Aesir and Midgard
humans would die that easily?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Yes, you're right, they must be alive.
Somewhere, surely—
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Hum, hum-hm-hm...♪
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Loki, did you just say something?
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSmile&$$@Right@$No, but that was a song—
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$Humming?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$It's coming from this way!
$#DONOTSHOWME(???)#$$!-1!$Hum, hum-hm-hm...♪
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSerious&$$@Center@$!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$!-1!$$@Left@$(Humming... Among this wreckage?)
$#()#$To this day, its mechanism remains a mystery.
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSerious&$$@Right@$Step back, boy.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$(Loki's expression just turned serious...)

$#Venus(???)#$$&VenusWink&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Oh wow, what a pleasant surprise! To meet
you here, of all places—right, Loki-Lok?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$(A girl...)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Loki, you know her?

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSerious&$$@Center@$Of course I do. That's Venus, goddess of
lust and arrogance.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Wait, what?
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusBoo&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Stop it! That's not true at all!

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiTehepero&$$@Left@$Oh my, did I get it wrong?
The lovesick goddess, was it?

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusTongueWink&$$@Right@$Geez, keep saying stuff like that, and I'm
gonna peel off that shameless mask of
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$We're really going?
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusTongueWink&$$@Right@$yours. You big liar, goddess Loki♡

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiNaughty&$$@Left@$That smile of yours is more of a lie than
anything else.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$!-1!$$@Center@$(She's trading barbs with Loki... Could she
be a really powerful goddess?)
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$@Center@$Teehee, still as fun as ever, Loki-Lok.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusTongue&$$@Center@$By the way, won't you introduce me to
that boy you're desperately trying to hide?

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusTongue&$$@Center@$When something's kept from me, I just
want it even more.
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiHappyClose&$$@Center@$In that case, maybe I'll hide him completely☆

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSmile&$$@Center@$So, your secret treasure, huh. Well, I don't
feel like starting a war now, so I'll save
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSmile&$$@Center@$exposing him for another time.
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusSmile&$$@Center@$All right then. Bye-bye.
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiNormal&$$@Right@$If nothing happens, we'll just come back.

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSerious&$$@Center@$Wait, Venus. Don't tell me you don't know
why this place is like this.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$@Center@$Why? Because they lost, and pathetically
too. All those mighty gods.
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSerious&$$@Center@$The gods... Lost to who?

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$@Center@$You really want to know? Hehe, then I
definitely won't tell you.
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiEmbarrassed&$$@Center@$Tch...

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusWink&$$@Center@$Besides, I don't have time to explain right
now. Sorry, Loki-Lok.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusWink&$$@Center@$Oh right, do you know about the key to
Odin's secret room?
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiComplain&$$@Center@$Odin's key... No, never heard of it.

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusBoo&$$@Center@$Really... If anyone had it, I thought it
would be you. Guess not. Too bad.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Venus... Ms. Venus!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$True, but... I had prior plans.
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiEmbarrassed&$$@Center@$Finn!

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusTongue&$$@Center@$Oh my, sticking your own neck out?
Reckless kid... But I like that.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$(What's this... It's not intimidation, but it
feels like my heart is being...stirred up...)

$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiClosedEyesSmile&$$@Center@$Once you're caught in Venus's allure, it's
not easy to escape, boy.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnHurt&$$@Center@$(Right, get a grip, Finn!)

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$@Center@$Oh, sturdier than I expected... Honestly,
I'm surprised.
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$@Center@$So, what do you want me to tell you?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$The people who lived here... Are they safe?
Just tell me that much!
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusDoya&$$@Center@$Safe, huh...

$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusDoya&$$@Center@$Quite a lot were killed. And nearly half
were taken away to Jotunheim.
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiHappy&$$@Right@$Yes yes, stop whining—let's go already.
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSerious&$$@Center@$To Jotunheim...!?
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Center@$Many were killed...
$#StrangeTremor(Strange Tremor)#$$!-1!$Thud... Thud... Thud...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(This tremor... It sounds...like footsteps?)
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$(No, they're too big—what is this!?)
$#Venus(Venus)#$$&VenusHappy&$$@Center@$Oh my, they're already here...
$#Loki(Loki)#$$&LokiSad&$$@Center@$As I thought, giants...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$Giants...!?
$#Giant'sroar(Giant's roar)#$$!-1!$Uwaaaaaaooooooo!!
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnGritSweat&$$@Center@$Is it...Ymir!?

keys.DescriptionKey: Zeus, the one and only god—In a world where gods and humans coexisted, she stood as the absolute authority. Though at times willful and tyrannical, her overwhelming power made her rule unshakable. And the people placed their trust in her.

ZeusRegular01.name: Zeus
ZeusRegular01.title: God of Absolute Dominion
ZeusRegular01.description: Zeus, the one and only god—In a world where gods and humans coexisted, she stood as the absolute authority. Though at times willful and tyrannical, her overwhelming power made her rule unshakable. And the people placed their trust in her.

keys.IntroText: Bow before me.

keys.DescriptionKey: However... one day, gods from another world invaded Zeus's realm. Zeus put her life on the line, fighting to protect her people. But alone, she could not hold them off, and in time the people began to show open disappointment in her. As scorn rained down upon her, Zeus realized that she had never been loved by her people after all.

keys.value: $#Kirin(Kirin)#$$&KirinGirlBigSmile&$$@Center@$Mmm! So good♪

$#Zoro(Zoro)#$$&ZoroHappySmile&$$@Right@$Oh, certainly. Especially from that uncouth
woman. Her brand of idiocy is quite infectious.
$#Zoro2(Zoro)#$$&ZoroHeh&$$@Center@$Thank you, Bernard!
$#Bernard(Bernard)#$$&JirenMob&$$!-1!$$@Left@$May fortune favor you.

$#Zoro2(Zoro)#$$&ZoroHeh&$$@Right@$Please look after my father and everyone
who was injured.
$#Bernard(Bernard)#$$&JirenMob&$$@Left@$It will be done.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Zoro, I can't let you go alone! This is going
to be dangerous!
$#Kirin(Kirin)#$$&KirinGirlHeh&$$@Center@$Yeah, we're coming with you.
$#Zoro2(Zoro)#$$&ZoroHeh&$$@Center@$You...

$#Zoro2(The Marvelous Zoro)#$$&MaskZoroHappy&$$@Center@$Very well! As long as you don't slow me
down!

$#Zoro2(The Marvelous Zoro)#$$&MaskZoroHappy&$$@Center@$Just this once, I shall allow you to join the
Marvelous Zoro's company!

$#VillageChief(Village Chief)#$$&MaleSamuraiMobSerious&$$@Center@$Our merciful lady, please return to us! We
have prayed tirelessly for so long!

$#Kirin(Kirin)#$$&KirinGirlStare&$$@Left@$Huh? I think I just heard something about
idiots. Looking for trouble, Princess?
$#VillagerA(Villager A)#$$&KImonoMaleMobNormal&$$!-1!$$@Left@$Our merciful lady, please return to us!
$#VillagerB(Villager B (female))#$$&KImonoMaleMobNormal&$$@Right@$Please, we beg of you!
$#Nicole(Nicole)#$$&KaguyaDarkPossessed&$$!-1!$$@Center@$It's here...
$#VillageChief(Village Chief)#$$&MaleSamuraiMobShouting&$$@Center@$Ooooh!

$#VillageChief(Village Chief)#$$&MaleSamuraiMobShouting&$$@Center@$Our Goddess! Our Goddess has returned!
She graces us with her presence once more!
$#Nicole(Nicole)#$$&KaguyaDarkPossessed&$$@Center@$Where's the memory chip?

$#VillageChief(Village Chief)#$$&MaleSamuraiMobSurprissed&$$@Center@$Wh-What are you talking about?
"Chip"? What is that?
$#Nicole(Nicole)#$$&KaguyaDarkPossessed&$$@Center@$The external memory chip. Where is it?
$#VillageChief(Village Chief)#$$&MaleSamuraiMobSurprissed&$$@Center@$I apologize, but I don't quite understand...

$#Nicole(Nicole)#$$&KaguyaDarkPossessed&$$@Center@$The bracelet-like device. It must be in the
shrine.

$#Zoro(Zoro)#$$&ZoroSad&$$@Right@$As if I ever could ever do anything so
unrefined.

$#VillageChief(Village Chief)#$$&MaleSamuraiMobSurprissed&$$@Center@$W-Well... No, I don't recall anything like
that...
$#Nicole(Nicole)#$$&KaguyaDarkPossessed&$$@Center@$Lying is not advisable.
$#Villagers(Villagers)#$$!-1!$Ngh... Agh... It hurts!
$#Villagers(Villagers)#$Ow, ow, ow, my entire body hurts!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnCommand&$$@Center@$Kaguya!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$Well, if he said so, I guess I'll give it my
best shot.

$#Kirin(Kirin)#$$&KirinGirlHeh&$$@Right@$That's what I'm talkin' about! Oh, we're
almost there.

$#()#$The stillness of the night felt even more
pronounced in the village.

$#()#$I looked around at the dark, scattered
houses.

$#()#$After a while, I started to spot some lights
here and there...

$#()#$By the time I realized they were torches,
we were already surrounded by villagers.

$#VillagerA(Villager A)#$$&KImonoMaleMobNormal&$$@Center@$Who are you? What do you want in our
village?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$!VillagerB!$$@Left@$Sorry to bother you at this hour. My name
is Finn, and this is—

$#Kirin(Kirin)#$$&KirinGirlSerious&$$@Right@$I'm Kirin. We traveled here by boat from
Westland.
$#VillagerB(Villager B)#$$&KImonoMaleMobNormal&$$!-1!$$@Center@$From Westland!? Wait here for a moment...
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Huff... Huff... It was just a dream, huh...

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$(whisper) "Traveled by boat"? You brought
me here, Kirin...

$#Kirin(Kirin)#$$&KirinGirlBigSmile&$$@Right@$(whisper) No need to explain everything,
it'd be a pain.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$(She's really nothing like the Kirin I met
my dream...)
$#Kirin(Kirin)#$$&KirinGirlStare&$$@Right@$Huh? What's with that face?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$I was just thinking... You have your father's
name, but you're so different from him.

$#Kirin(Kirin)#$$&KirinGirlHeh&$$@Right@$Well, duh. It's not like we're related by
blood.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Left@$(So she's adopted? That would explain
things.)

$#VillageChief(Village Chief)#$$&MaleSamuraiMobSmile&$$!-1!$$@Center@$Greetings! I'm the chief of this settlement.
Apologies if my people seemed to lack

$#VillageChief(Village Chief)#$$&MaleSamuraiMobSmile&$$@Center@$hospitality, it's just that travelers are a
rare sight in these parts.

$#VillageChief(Village Chief)#$$&MaleSamuraiMobSmile&$$@Center@$Welcome to our humble village! Please,
make yourselves at home.
$#Kirin(???)#$$&KirinGirlSpeak&$$@Center@$Yo, kid. You're finally up.

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Center@$Thank you very much for your kindness,
sir.

$#VillageChief(Village Chief)#$$&MaleSamuraiMobSmile&$$@Center@$We've prepared a modest celebration for
you. What do you say?
$#Kirin(Kirin)#$$&KirinGirlBigSmile&$$!-1!$$@Right@$Oh, sweet! Gimme that VIP treatment!

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnNormal&$$@Left@$VIP treatment, huh. Kirin, can I talk to
you for a second?

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSerious&$$@Left@$(whisper) Don't let your guard down.
Something's off here.
$#Kirin(Kirin)#$$&KirinGirlThinking&$$@Right@$You're overthinking it.

$#Kirin(Kirin)#$$&KirinGirlSerious&$$@Right@$We're their guests. It'd be rude not to
accept their hospitality.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnTroubled&$$@Left@$I guess you have a point...
$#Kirin(Kirin)#$$&KirinGirlBigSmile&$$@Right@$I sure do! Now, let's go enjoy the party♪

$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSmile&$$@Left@$Maybe I am overthinking this.
Excuse me, sir, we'd be happy to join you.
$#Finn(Finn)#$$&FinnSurprise&$$@Center@$Who are you!? Wait, where am I?

$#VillageChief(Village Chief)#$$&MaleSamuraiMobSmile&$$@Right@$Excellent! We're all eager to hear stories
of your travels. This way, please.

keys.DescriptionKey: Raised in a dazzling royal court as Princess of the Kingdom of Storano, Zoro possessed both  elegance and arrogance, a truly 'perfect young lady.' She had no patience for uncouth behavior, and cheap cuisine was absolutely out of the question—an attitude revealing her natural haughtiness. Even so, if someone clearly needed help, she would surreptitiously aid them.

keys.DescriptionKey: Her younger sister, Nicole, was her entire world. Though Nicole was diligent and Zoro was free-spirited, they read books together, romped across the fields, and were each other's closest friend. But tragically, Nicole lost her life to illness.

keys.DescriptionKey: Ever since she lost her sister, her nightly routine changed. Though cloaked in the royal family's prestige, she secretly brandishes her sword for the nameless masses. What she steals is authority; what she challenges is injustice. A masked thief known to no one—her eyes, even now, remain fixed on her sister's future.
